dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here.

dialogText.cn: 没事，我也刚到没多久。
dialogText.en: It's alright. I only just arrived as well.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，有看到让你感兴趣的东西吗？
dialogText.en: So, saw anything interesting for you?

dialogText.cn: 每当看到那些事物，总会让人想起很多事情……
dialogText.en: Every time I see them, I'm always reminded of plenty of things...

dialogText.cn: 关于我们的过去，也关于人类的未来。
dialogText.en: Things about our past, as well as our future.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，平常很少会有这种规模的维护工作，要去逛逛吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, maintenance work of such scale is actually pretty rare. Interested in a tour?

dialogText.cn: 我知道几处地方，很适合拍照纪念。
dialogText.en: I know a few picture-perfect locations aboard this ship for commemoration photos.

dialogText.cn: 怎么了，管理员？
dialogText.en: What is it, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 不得不说，启明驻留平台的设计确实巧妙，很吸引人。
dialogText.en: I have to admit, the design of Qiming Station is rather intricate. It's quite attractive as well.

dialogText.cn: 各个舱段既能独立运行，又能协同作业，多样的分区设计足以支持长期在轨生活。
dialogText.en: Every cabin can operate independently, or cooperate as a linked system. The modular design is capable of sustaining life for prolonged periods in orbit.

dialogText.cn: 驻留平台还拥有门类齐全、体系完善、技术先进的舱内外实验与试验支持设施。
dialogText.en: The Station is also furnished with an advanced and comprehensive suite of experimental devices and test instruments, both inside and outside the cabin.

dialogText.cn: 或许……它还有着尚未完成的使命。
dialogText.en: Perhaps ... its mission is still incomplete.

dialogText.cn: 很难想象，如此轻巧的朔风号勘探车是怎样塞满了那么多探测仪器的。
dialogText.en: It is hard to imagine how they filled up this lightweight rover with so many sensors and detectors.

dialogText.cn: 精巧的轮式行走机构，足够让它应对各种复杂的地貌环境。
dialogText.en: A well-designed wheeled locomotion allows it to navigate complicated terrain.

dialogText.cn: 至于飞天兔……我没想到工程中心把这个也摆放出来了。
dialogText.en: As for the astrocautus... I actually didn't expect the Engineering Division to display this.

dialogText.cn: 每次见到这只穿着外层空间作业服的飞天兔，像现在这样望向远方——
dialogText.en: Every time I see this astrocautus wearing its outer space operations suit and gazing into the far distance —

dialogText.cn: 即便是在平坦的桌面上，也能从这位旅人的眼中，感受到它向着未知前进的勇敢与决心。
dialogText.en: Despite being placed on a flat table, the voyager's gaze is filled with courage and determination to delve into the distant unknown.

dialogText.cn: “勇于探索”。
dialogText.en: "Seek the stars".

dialogText.cn: 在我第一次系统性了解人类历史时，我曾问过自己：究竟是什么驱使着我们不断奔赴星海。
dialogText.en: When I gained systematic understanding of our history for the first time, I asked myself: "What is it that drove us towards the stars?"

dialogText.cn: 直到我望向舰桥外，才发现了那颗早已埋藏在人类心底的种子。
dialogText.en: It wasn't until I looked out from the bridge that I realized. The seed had long been planted in the deepest part of the human spirit.

dialogText.cn: 在探索精神的滋养下，种子破土而出，最终结出了属于这个时代、承载人类前行之愿的果实。
dialogText.en: Nourished by the spirit of exploration, the seed germinated and finally produced a fruit that truly belongs to this era, one bearing our wish of pushing ever onwards.

dialogText.cn: 这颗果实，不但是我们从地面迈向苍穹的燃料，更是我们向群星寻求答案的永恒执念。
dialogText.en: This fruit isn't just the fuel that propels us into the cosmos, but our unending drive to seek answers from the stars.

dialogText.cn: 它唤醒了无数人奔赴星海的初心，这便是，“叩问苍穹”。
dialogText.en: It stirs and ignites the cosmic dreams of countless individuals. And this would be our way to "challenge the cosmos" and go "beyond limits".

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你觉得怎么样？
dialogText.en: Endmin, what do you think?

dialogText.cn: 你喜欢，真是太好了。
dialogText.en: You like it? That's wonderful.

dialogText.cn: 人类对深空的探索刚刚开始，文明的边界远未触及。
dialogText.en: Our exploration of deep space has just begun. We have yet to reach the boundaries of civilization.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我在想，或许有一天，我们也会承载着这份对探索的信念，航向远方。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I think there may come a day when we take our desire to explore the unknown, and sail into the great beyond.

dialogText.cn: 群星正在闪烁，而未来，已经向我们敞开了大门。
dialogText.en: Yet the stars sparkle. The gates to the future have already been opened for us.

dialogText.cn: 等到那一刻真的来临，我们会为人类，交出一个怎样的答案？
dialogText.en: But if that moment were to arrive, how should we, as members of this civilization, answer the call?

dialogText.cn: 未来的方向很多，但我们眼前的事物又太少。
dialogText.en: The future holds many paths for us, but our gaze can only reach so far.

dialogText.cn: 嗨，管理员！
dialogText.en: Hey, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 我是负责本次环境生存训练的教官，克拉拉！
dialogText.en: I'm Klara! I'll be your instructor for this survival training!

dialogText.cn: 该特训是为帮助干员熟悉四号谷地的环境，以便自如应对开拓探索中的危险。
dialogText.en: The purpose of this training is to familiarize you with Valley IV, so you can handle anything that comes your way.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，欢迎您正式参与“四号谷地拓荒环境生存训练”！
dialogText.en: Alrighty, Endmin! Let's get started with the Valley IV Frontiers Survival Training!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……小道奇没骗我，成为拓荒训练计划的教官真的有隐形福利啊。
dialogText.en: Hehe... Lil' Dodge didn't trick me. There really are hidden perks to being a Frontiers training instructor.

dialogText.cn: 回去我就提交申请……争取多当几期教官，最好把其他地方的环境训练也争取上！
dialogText.en: I'll submit more applications when I get back. Hopefully I can be an instructor for a few more sessions ... and maybe even lead training in other environments.

dialogText.cn: 合金萝卜城的阿姨们肯定不敢相信，我这辈子竟然有机会指导管理员特训！
dialogText.en: Bet everyone in Alloycarrot would flip if they knew I'm actually running special training for the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 啊，差点忘了眼下……管理员！整个特训会分成多轮，内容各有不同，会定期开放！
dialogText.en: Oh, before I forget! Endmin, this special training's divided into multiple sessions that become available on a regular basis!

dialogText.cn: 请开始吧！您放心，拓荒环境生存训练不是枯燥的项目，保证新鲜、刺激、有趣！
dialogText.en: Alright, let's kick things off! Trust me, this is going to be super fun and packed with surprises!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，生存训练可以帮你更快地熟悉该地的环境。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this survival training will help you get up to speed with the area.

dialogText.cn: 请您务必认真对待，掌握技巧后能有效减少实地探索中的风险。
dialogText.en: Please take it seriously, as mastering the skills will cut your field risk.

dialogText.cn: 哇，这么快就毕业了，不愧是管理员啊！
dialogText.en: You finished in no time! Awesome as always, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，按照以前的惯例，我都会夸奖一句，你们是我带过的干员中最优秀的。
dialogText.en: You know, by tradition, I always give praise like this: you're the best operators I've ever trained.

dialogText.cn: 哼哼，是后勤干员最近更新过终端，增加了展示成绩的功能。
dialogText.en: Well, the Logistics Operators recently updated the terminal to show performance scores.

dialogText.cn: 结果好多干员会去反复刷新自己的纪录，榜首的归属一日三变。
dialogText.en: So everyone keeps refreshing their records. The top spot changes at least three times a day!

dialogText.cn: 从那以后，我就痛失掉自己绞尽脑汁才编好的大段赞美之词了……
dialogText.en: Ever since then, all my carefully written compliments went to waste...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我打从心底相信您一定是最优秀的！
dialogText.en: Endmin, deep down, I really believe you are THE best!

dialogText.cn: 尝试一下限时模式的终极训练吧，一起来刷新最佳纪录！
dialogText.en: Feel free to try the timed ultimate training and set a new record!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，生存训练可以帮你更快地熟悉该地的环境。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this survival training will help you get up to speed with the area.

dialogText.cn: 请您务必认真对待，掌握技巧后能有效减少实地探索中的风险。
dialogText.en: Please take it seriously, as mastering the skills will cut your field risk.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎尝试限时模式的终极考核，一起来刷新最佳纪录！
dialogText.en: You're welcome to try the timed ultimate training. Let's set a new record together!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我在这里！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'm here!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢管理员！我的故事书终于完成了！
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin! I'm finally done with my storybook!

dialogText.cn: 大家一定会喜欢！
dialogText.en: Everyone will really like it!

dialogText.cn: 我想快点把故事书拿给大家看！
dialogText.en: I wanna show everyone my storybook now!

dialogText.cn: 大人们最近总是很忙、很累的样子……没时间和我们玩，好无聊。
dialogText.en: But the grown-ups are always so busy and tired... Nobody has time to play with me. I'm so bored.

dialogText.cn: 现在有了我的故事书，大家一定能开心起来！
dialogText.en: But I have my storybook now! It'll make everyone happy!

dialogText.cn: 不用啦，我想亲手送给他们！
dialogText.en: Nah. I wanna do that on my own!

dialogText.cn: 我还想画好多好多的故事书，想把管理员的其他故事也画进来！
dialogText.en: I wanna draw more storybooks about the Endmin and other people too!

dialogText.cn: 但画笔用完了……要等有了新画笔才能画……
dialogText.en: But I'm out of crayons... I can only start drawing again when I get new crayons...

dialogText.cn: 等我开始画新的故事书，就来告诉你！
dialogText.en: You'll be the first to know when I start my new storybook!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我在这里！
dialogText.en: I'm here, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 因为，我见过管理员！管理员来过这附近。
dialogText.en: Yeah, because I've met you before! You visited this place, remember?

dialogText.cn: 管理员真的来了！
dialogText.en: The Endmin is really here!

dialogText.cn: 我想画一本让大家开心起来的故事书。
dialogText.en: 'Cos I wanna draw a storybook that makes everyone happy.

dialogText.cn: 大家说，管理员每——天都在外面冒险，去过好——多有意思的地方。
dialogText.en: Everyone said you go on adventures EVERY SINGLE DAY! They also said you went to TONS of interesting places.

dialogText.cn: 我想去那些地方，把你的故事画出来给大家看。
dialogText.en: I wanna go to those places and draw your story so that everyone can see them too.

dialogText.cn: 但大人们说外面不安全，不让我离开这里……
dialogText.en: But the grown-ups said the places outside aren't safe and won't let me leave...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，可以把你的冒险拍成照片吗？这样我就能画下来，完成我的故事书。
dialogText.en: Endmin, can you take photos of your adventure? I'll then draw them out and complete my storybook.

dialogText.cn: 你答应啦！管理员最好了！全塔卫二第一好！
dialogText.en: You agreed?! I knew you're the best Endmin! The bestest of Talos-II!

dialogText.cn: 给你！我把想画的地方，写在这上面了。
dialogText.en: Take this! I made a list of all the places I wanna draw.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你和我一起画故事书！
dialogText.en: Thank you for helping me draw my storybook!

dialogText.cn: 水泥丛林……卡莉公主……还有天空骑士！
dialogText.en: Concrete Jungle ... Princess Carly ... and Knights of the Sky!

dialogText.cn: 大人们说，天上有个城堡，城堡里的骑士们会保护我们，管理员也在那个城堡里！
dialogText.en: The grown-ups told me about a castle in the sky with all sorts of knights who'd protect us! The Endmin lives in that castle too!

dialogText.cn: 我就想把卡莉公主和天空骑士一起冒险的故事也画进去！
dialogText.en: I wanna draw Princess Carly going on an adventure with the Knights of the Sky!

dialogText.cn: 因为、因为这座塔真的很高很高！
dialogText.en: It's very tall, you know! Very, very, very tall!

dialogText.cn: 我想回以前的家看看，但每次这么说，大人们看起来都很伤心……
dialogText.en: I wanna head back to my old place and look at it. But whenever I said that, the grown-ups would start looking sad...

dialogText.cn: 大人们会说，四号谷地就是卡莉的家，他们都是卡莉的家人。
dialogText.en: The grown-ups told me that Valley IV is our home now. They all promised to be Carly's family.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我还是想看看以前的家。也许爬上那座塔就能看到了！
dialogText.en: But I still wanna look at my old place. If I could climb that very, very, very tall tower, I'll be able to see it!

dialogText.cn: 我听门卫爷爷说，管理员在这里打败了想伤害我们的大坏蛋！
dialogText.en: Grampa Gate Guard told me that the Endmin defeated an evil and naughty big bad at this very place!

dialogText.cn: 我就想把这里画进去。这样大家看了故事书都会想起，还有管理员在帮助我们，就不会再害怕那些坏蛋了！
dialogText.en: I wanna draw it in so that people who read the storybook will remember that we have the Endmin helping us! That'll make us less scared of the naughty big bad!

dialogText.cn: 以前我和朋友们喜欢到那里玩，但大人们突然就不让我们去了……
dialogText.en: My friends and I used to play there, you know. But the grown-ups suddenly showed up and said: NO...

dialogText.cn: 我们在那边用积木堆城堡，玩公主与骑士的游戏。那个大吊车就是保护我们的巨人！
dialogText.en: We used to build castles with bricks. And we'll have princesses and knights as well. That super big crane is the great giant who protects us!

dialogText.cn: 我们都想早点回到那里一起玩。
dialogText.en: Everybody wants to go there and play again.

dialogText.cn: 我记得，管理员来这里的时候，旁边有一个长着角的姐姐！
dialogText.en: I remember your last visit, Endmin! You came with a pretty miss who has horns on her head!

dialogText.cn: 问了大人后才知道她是龙。
dialogText.en: I went and asked the grown-ups who told me she's a Lung.

dialogText.cn: 能在管理员身边的人一定都很厉害！
dialogText.en: I bet ALL of your companions are super amazing, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 她一定和管理员一样，也是个大英雄，能保护大家！
dialogText.en: So I am also betting Miss Lung is an awesome hero who can protect everyone too!

dialogText.cn: 原来真的还有石头树苗……
dialogText.en: So, the stony sapling actually exists, you know...

dialogText.cn: 大人们都说，石头大树是四号谷地的希望……
dialogText.en: The grown-ups told me that the Big, Big Oak of Stone is the hope for the entire Valley IV...

dialogText.cn: 要是我在故事书里画上石头大树的树苗，大家一定也会开心的！
dialogText.en: If I could draw the sapling of the Big, Big Oak of Stone, that would definitely make people happy!

dialogText.cn: 朋友告诉我，那里很像是坏术师的城堡。
dialogText.en: My friends told me about a place that seems to be Evil Caster's castle.

dialogText.cn: 最近大家都在说，管理员在那里救了我们所有人。
dialogText.en: Everyone said that was where the Endmin saved all of our lives.

dialogText.cn: 我就想到，我的故事书里，天空骑士还有龙在那里打败了发着光的坏术师！
dialogText.en: So I thought about drawing the Knights of the Sky and the Lung in my storybook! And how they defeated the glowing Evil Caster!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，管理员，感谢您接受邀请！我是后勤干员，赛尔乔·莱昂。
dialogText.en: Endmin! I'm so glad you came! I'm Sergio Leon from logistics.

dialogText.cn: 我向终末地的大家发出了邀约，没想到最先回应的竟会是管理员！我的首个系列作品《影拓丰碑》创作完成了！
dialogText.en: I invited every Endfielder but I never expected that you'll be the first to respond, Endmin! I've completed my first series, the Umbral Monument!

dialogText.cn: 啊哈，请容我解释一下。我来自于一个电影世家，在成为终末地干员前，也曾是一名电影导演。
dialogText.en: Ah, let me give you a quick intro. I come from a family of filmmakers. Before joining Endfield, I was a director myself.

dialogText.cn: 我的祖辈父辈都是鼎鼎有名的大导演，从影经历甚至可以追溯到泰拉时期的蓝卡坞……
dialogText.en: My parents, grandparents, great-grandparents, even great-great-grandparents were all famous directors. You could easily spot their names in Wrankwood as far back as the Age of Terra...

dialogText.cn: 但他们所拍摄的影片都过于商业化，过于娱乐化了，掩盖了英雄们不畏苦难的真正荣光！
dialogText.en: But they only produced commercial flicks for base entertainment. None of their works depicted the true glory of heroes who faced suffering without fear!

dialogText.cn: 比起被娱乐化的英雄，我更欣赏从真实中诞生的力量，欣赏于苦暗中勃发的勇气！
dialogText.en: Unlike heroic depictions that cater to mass entertainment, I admire the strength that springs from truth, and the courage born of real life-and-death struggles!

dialogText.cn: 因此我收集了外勤干员的真实经历，从中找寻可以作为素材的故事，创作影片。
dialogText.en: That's why I gathered real-life experiences from field operators to film my movies.

dialogText.cn: 每一段真实的战斗经历，都让我感受到沉重的分量。
dialogText.en: I felt the somber weight of every battle actually fought.

dialogText.cn: 英雄的影片，理应有英雄的观众，没人比管理员您更合适了！
dialogText.en: A heroic film deserves a heroic audience, and none is more fitting than you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 请您务必沉浸式体验下我的首个系列作品《影拓丰碑》——根据外勤干员们的真实经历改编！
dialogText.en: So please, if you have a moment, how about an immersive dive of my first series, Umbral Monument, adapted from the real-life experiences of our field operators!

dialogText.cn: 唉，一个人的想象力终究是有极限的……我需要更多素材！
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Guess one person's imagination can only go so far... I need more stories and materials!

dialogText.cn: 我在担心之前的《影拓丰碑》还是不够“有力度”呀！
dialogText.en: Ugh, I'm worried my previous Umbral Monument wasn't "striking" enough!

dialogText.cn: 与真正的英雄事迹相比，我的作品还是差了些分量，不够动人！
dialogText.en: When compared to the actual achievements of true heroes, my work is still missing the mark! It's got to hit at our emotions!

dialogText.cn: 我必须再接再厉，创作出真正能为无畏者们歌颂勇气的史诗！
dialogText.en: I must push myself harder! I must create a true epic to laud the dauntless souls who once walked amongst us!

dialogText.cn: 再见，管理员，请您期待我的新作吧！
dialogText.en: Farewell for now, Endmin! I'll be back with my new work!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，快来体验一下新的《影拓丰碑》吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Come and check out my latest Umbral Monument!

dialogText.cn: 全新的作品，也需要真实的评价，没人比管理员您更合适了！
dialogText.en: Even a brand-new work deserves the most discerning of critiques, and no one is more fitting than you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 我已经将英雄事迹的素材再创作为影片，希望得到真实的评价。
dialogText.en: I now have the materials that can finally bring justice for the heroes, and I hope they can be properly evaluated.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，体验过《影拓丰碑》之后，感觉如何？
dialogText.en: Endmin, how do you feel about your immersive experience of the Umbral Monument?

dialogText.cn: 如果能把每个干员的经历都编入作品，这一定会成为经典之作！
dialogText.en: This is definitely gonna be a classic if we include every operator's experience in this work!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您来了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here.

dialogText.cn: 再过不久就是四号谷地的开拓节。
dialogText.en: Valley IV Exploration Day is approaching.

dialogText.cn: 但在安排人手的时候，我们发现，有一些特色美食来不及做了。
dialogText.en: While assigning jobs to the crew, we realized that we don't have people to make every specialty dish.

dialogText.cn: 对从小在四号谷地长大的工友们来说，大家都是听着工人先辈的故事长大的。
dialogText.en: For the crew mates who were raised in Valley IV, they grew up with stories told by their crew mate forebears.

dialogText.cn: 每到这个时候，到处都是摆满<@qu.key>特色美食</>的会场，孩子们围在老一辈的身边，听他们讲开拓谷地的故事。
dialogText.en: Whenever the day arrives, we'll have <@qu.key>specialty food</> everywhere. The children would sit around the veterans and listen to stories of Valley surveyors and cartographers.

dialogText.cn: 而现在，四号谷地是开始重建了，但工友们还是没有从裂地者的袭击里缓过气儿来。
dialogText.en: Although Valley IV is being rebuilt, the crew has yet to fully recover from the Landbreaker attack.

dialogText.cn: 因为特色美食是开拓节最为重要的一环，要是没有这些，开拓节就失去了很多意义。
dialogText.en: Look, the specialties are the most important part of Exploration Day. Take away the food, and the festival loses its meaning.

dialogText.cn: 虽然做不到大张旗鼓的庆祝，但只要能尝到特色美食，那就是能让人充满力量的开拓节。
dialogText.en: The celebration might not be an absolute carnival, but as long as we have the specialties, this Exploration Day will get everyone pumped and ready.

dialogText.cn: 您答应了？太好了，这些特色美食大多都是从四号谷地的开拓时期流传下来的。
dialogText.en: You agree? Excellent. Most of these special dishes date back to the Valley IV Era of Exploration.

dialogText.cn: 所以会用到像是在天使身上采集到的异香石，或者裂地者会随身携带的草籽干粉……
dialogText.en: They typically use Aggagrit harvested from the Aggeloi, or the Powdered Grass Seeds that many Landbreakers carry...

dialogText.cn: 是的，还有源石虫的虫肉，这些都可以用来制作工友们喜欢的特色美食。
dialogText.en: Exactly. And Originium Slug meat. All of them can be used to create specialties beloved by the crew.

dialogText.cn: 我们实在抽不出人手……拜托管理员了。
dialogText.en: But we don't have anyone to spare... Please help us, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 而这个节日就是为了纪念在开拓时期，投身四号谷地建设的先行者们。
dialogText.en: This holiday celebrates the brave pioneering crew who committed themselves to the development of Valley IV during the Era of Exploration.

dialogText.cn: 我们本应该通过开拓节鼓舞士气，可偏偏……
dialogText.en: We should be using Exploration Day as a morale booster, but...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，开拓节的大厨！
dialogText.en: Endmin, you'll be the End-Chef of Exploration Day!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，实在太感谢了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, thank you so much.

dialogText.cn: 我还在研究给其他人送些什么特色美食比较合适，这段时间得麻烦您了。
dialogText.en: I'm still trying to figure out the best specialty menu to give the others. All of us are counting on you.

dialogText.cn: 闲暇之余，您可以看看我这里的留言，我把大家的评价汇了个总，您做的美食大家可都赞不绝口！
dialogText.en: If you have time, feel free to check the messages here. I compiled the crew's feedback. You have made some quality food, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们都期待着能品尝到您做的美食。
dialogText.en: Endmin, everyone's looking forward to the food you make.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了您做的这些特色美食，工友们比以前精神多了。
dialogText.en: Thanks to the specialties you made, the crew is looking far better than before.

dialogText.cn: 最近在吃饭的时候，大家都会笑着聊起开拓谷地的故事。实在太感谢您了！
dialogText.en: During lunch breaks, the crew would talk about the first explorers of Valley IV. Everyone really appreciates what you did!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您来了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here.

dialogText.cn: 我刚想到了大家肯定喜欢吃的开拓节美食，得再麻烦您帮个忙。
dialogText.en: I just thought about some holiday food that everybody would like. I might need your help again.

dialogText.cn: 真没想到，现在既没资源又没人手，我们还能过上开拓节，实在是太感谢您了。
dialogText.en: I can hardly believe this. Despite the lack of resources or people, we still got to celebrate Exploration Day. All thanks to you.

dialogText.cn: 大家吃着管理员您送来的美食，谈论起了小时候听老一辈工友们讲过的故事。
dialogText.en: Everyone's enjoying the great food you made, Endmin. Everyone's talking about the stories that the old veterans told us when we were kids.

dialogText.cn: 现在，也轮到我们给孩子们讲故事了。
dialogText.en: Now, it is our turn to tell stories to the children.

dialogText.cn: 话说回来，管理员，制作这些特色美食，对您来说应该也是一次特别的体验吧。
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, Endmin, making the specialties must have been a special experience, isn't it?

dialogText.cn: 这些美食，特别是食材不常见的那几样，过去一直支撑着开拓者们不懈努力。
dialogText.en: The food, especially those with unusual ingredients, has sustained our hardworking pioneer crew.

dialogText.cn: 随处可见的天使，不断侵扰的裂地者，能源供应的频繁中断，阻拦运输队的灾害……
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi were everywhere, the Landbreakers wouldn't stop raiding, power outages kept happening, disasters slowed the convoys...

dialogText.cn: 那时候，开拓者们只能用从天使身上采集到的异香石充当调味料，连粗制的草籽干粉都成了不可多得的美味。
dialogText.en: The pioneers could only scrape Aggagrit from the Aggeloi for seasoning. Even the coarsely powdered grass seed was considered heaven-sent.

dialogText.cn: 哈，那么苦的日子都挺过来了，现在我们又怎么可能会被这点小挫折吓住嘛！
dialogText.en: But we got through the difficult times. A minor setback like this doesn't scare us at all.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这次太谢谢您了，等重建工作差不多结束了，也让您尝尝我的手艺。
dialogText.en: I really appreciate your help, Endmin. Once the rebuilding is complete, I shall personally lavish a feast for you.

dialogText.cn: 哎哟……我的老腰啊……
dialogText.en: Hngh... This back is killing me...

dialogText.cn: 噢，年轻人，你就是今天的体验者吗？抱歉，刚刚腰痛发作了……没注意到有人来了……
dialogText.en: Ah, sunshine. Here to experience urban sanitation work? Sorry, my back's hurting again ... I didn't notice you just then...

dialogText.cn: 我的名字是俞秀丽，叫我老俞就行。
dialogText.en: I'm Yu Xiuli. Just call me Auntie Yu.

dialogText.cn: 情况如你所见，我们现在得先清理这些看上去是蟠兽留下的污渍……
dialogText.en: As you can see, we gotta clean up these stains. Looks like the work of pantailbeasts...

dialogText.cn: 唉，太不好意思了，本来应该是我带着你清洁的。
dialogText.en: Oh, that's so kind of you. I was supposed to show you how we keep the city clean.

dialogText.cn: 现在倒好，要麻烦你替我弄了！
dialogText.en: I'm sorry my back disagrees. You'll have to help me out!

dialogText.cn: 不过，你似乎没带清洁用的工具？用我的吧。
dialogText.en: But since you lack the sanitation tools, you should use mine.

dialogText.cn: 射流……无人机？可以用在清洁上了？
dialogText.en: Jet ... drone? For cleaning?

dialogText.cn: 哎哟……我的老腰，我好久没处理过这么多污渍了，一不小心就闪着腰了。
dialogText.en: Aiyooo... my back is acting up again. It's been a while since I had to clean so many stains. One wrong move and my back starts screaming...

dialogText.cn: 哦哦，有的，给，水管够。
dialogText.en: Oh, of course. Here. There's plenty of it too.

dialogText.cn: 现在的无人机都这么厉害了？！
dialogText.en: Drones nowadays are so incredible!!

dialogText.cn: 竟然这么快就清理完毕了，这效率都可以拿环卫标兵了。
dialogText.en: Cleaned it up real quick, didn't you? Such efficiency! You'll definitely nab the title of Sanitation Elite!

dialogText.cn: 先不想这些了，幸好武陵还有很多像你这样有干劲的年轻人，我可以放心退休咯！
dialogText.en: I'll think about that later. Well, I'm glad to see plenty of energetic sunshine like you in Wuling. I can finally retire in peace!

dialogText.cn: 本来还想在这次活动里尽自己最后一份力，结果在这时候把腰闪了！
dialogText.en: I wanted to use the event and help the city out one last time. But my back disagrees!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，没想到我遇见了这么“讲义气”的体验者！
dialogText.en: Haha. Maybe I got lucky and ran into a truly "honorable" event participant!

dialogText.cn: 回去可得和我孙子好好说说，让他以你为榜样！
dialogText.en: Better tell my grandkid about this. You'll be a shining example!

dialogText.cn: 那么，我们等会儿在……应该在哪儿见来着？
dialogText.en: So, what's after this...? Where are we going again?

dialogText.cn: 人老了，得靠笔记咯，让我看看我的工作日志……生态实验站附近的花田！
dialogText.en: I'm getting old. Gotta keep a work log in case I forget... Ah, the flower beds near the Ecological Research Station!

dialogText.cn: 刚才真是辛苦你了，先好好休息下吧，我也回去给我的老腰上点药。
dialogText.en: You did well, sunshine. Enjoy a break. I have to head home and put some herbs on this creaky back.

dialogText.cn: 只是居民区怎么突然被弄得这么乱，这周围的蟠兽都挺温顺的啊，难道……
dialogText.en: But how did the Residential Area get in such a mess? The neighborhood pantails should be tame and cuddly. Can it be...?

dialogText.cn: 难道真像老俞说的那样，这些都是神秘生物在捣鬼？
dialogText.en: Maybe Auntie Yu is right about this. A mystery critter is making a mess of this place.

dialogText.cn: 但为什么是把公告栏搞糊了……我明白了！
dialogText.en: But why ruin the bulletin board...? Oh, I get it!

dialogText.cn: 玷污我们学习的榜样，好让人类全都堕落，最后霸占武陵城！真是太坏了……
dialogText.en: They're trying to deface our heroes, corrupt our people, and conquer Wuling City! Such evil...!

dialogText.cn: 把我们每天跑步的地方都弄脏了……
dialogText.en: We jog here everyday but it's all dirty now...

dialogText.cn: 我听大人们说，是有很坏很坏的神秘生物想要让我们不能继续锻炼身体。
dialogText.en: The grown-ups told me that a very, very bad mystery creature wants us to stop exercising.

dialogText.cn: 等到我们都没有力气反抗了，就把我们抓去吃掉！
dialogText.en: Once everyone gets soft and weak, it'll start to hunt and eat us!

dialogText.cn: 欸，有电了有电了！但为什么偏偏是我这里的能源板……
dialogText.en: Oh! Power is back! But why is it just *mine* energy panel that broke...?

dialogText.cn: 哦！其实这只是一个试验，想试试看我们的反应！一定是这样！
dialogText.en: I get it! It's a test! Someone wants to see our reaction! That must be it!

dialogText.cn: 要是没有及时清理的话，下一步就是全面瘫痪武陵城的能源供应……
dialogText.en: If nobody cleaned it up on time, their next move is to bring down the Wuling City power supply...

dialogText.cn: 看来真的有神秘生物在捣乱……不行，我要关好门窗，谁知道它们的目的是什么！
dialogText.en: This must be the work of a mystery critter... Hmph. Better keep my doors and windows closed properly. Who knows what they're up to.

dialogText.cn: 这是……发生什么事了？
dialogText.en: What is this...? What happened here?

dialogText.cn: 啊！年轻人，你来了……
dialogText.en: Ah! Sunshine, you're here...

dialogText.cn: 我正发愁呢……我一来就发现这里的驮兽都不听指挥地到处乱走……
dialogText.en: I'm so confused... When I arrived, these local burdenbeasts just kept wandering about and ignored every instruction...

dialogText.cn: 真不知道这群驮兽是受了什么刺激……
dialogText.en: I don't know if something scared them...

dialogText.cn: 唉……把这些驮兽清理干净可不是什么小工程。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Cleaning up the burdenbeasts won't be easy.

dialogText.cn: 这次有你在，真是太好了。
dialogText.en: I'm so glad to have you around, sunshine.

dialogText.cn: 嗐，一看就是那七头领头的驮兽身上沾了泥。
dialogText.en: Meh. It's because the seven bosses are all covered in mud.

dialogText.cn: 我的这群驮兽里，就属它们七头最爱干净，脏了就走不动道了。
dialogText.en: Of my entire herd, those seven like being clean. They'll refuse to budge once they get a little dirty.

dialogText.cn: 其他驮兽没了领头的带路，就到处乱跑……我也没清洁工具，就只能找你们帮忙了。
dialogText.en: Once the bosses stop moving, the rest would just wander about... I got no cleaning tools. That's why I had to call the sanitation team.

dialogText.cn: 领头的驮兽为了维持威望，也不会在泥里打滚儿啊，难道老俞你说的是真的？
dialogText.en: The bosses gotta maintain their status, so they won't roll in the mud. Maybe you're right, Auntie Yu.

dialogText.cn: 真是太麻烦你们了，看着这群驮兽把田给踩成这样……欸，你们看，还把路给堵住了！
dialogText.en: I'm really sorry to trouble you with this. The burdenbeasts even trampled all over the fields... Oh, look! They're even blocking the road!

dialogText.cn: 又是一篇情况说明报告要上交，嗐……
dialogText.en: That means I have to write another situation report. Ugh...

dialogText.cn: 就是奇了怪了，它们身上哪儿来的泥？
dialogText.en: But I don't get this at all. How did they end up all muddy and dirty?

dialogText.cn: 瞧瞧这些驮兽，和我那孙子一样，整天到处乱跑，给自己整得脏兮兮的。
dialogText.en: Look at them. Mindlessly running about all day and getting themselves caked in dirt. Just like my grandkid.

dialogText.cn: 不过……我都来这儿清理好多回了，也没见闹成这样过……
dialogText.en: The thing is ... I've cleaned this place a couple of times, but never seen such a mess before.

dialogText.cn: 先是蟠兽被刺激到了，现在是驮兽……难道是有什么东西在捣乱……
dialogText.en: First it was the pantails, and now it's the burdenbeasts... Is something or someone behind this?

dialogText.cn: 《塔卫二未解之谜》里提到的“驮兽克星”？
dialogText.en: Maybe it's the "bane of burdenbeasts" mentioned in the Unsolved Mysteries of Talos-II?

dialogText.cn: 还是说，像其他人分析的那样，是裂地者鼓捣的阴谋？
dialogText.en: Perhaps those egghead analysts are right. The breaker bandits are up to no good again.

dialogText.cn: 总不能……是天师们最近聊到的“超域”，有什么危险的神秘生物从那里面爬出来了吧？
dialogText.en: But the ... Tianshi have been talking about the Æther. Did some dangerous cryptid crawl out of the place?

dialogText.cn: 啊，也对，还剩几天退休了，我瞎操什么心呢……真有什么事，交给巡卫就好了。
dialogText.en: Why, of course. My retirement's just round the corner, so why worry? Our watchguards have it covered.

dialogText.cn: 我这人啊，就是容易想太多，毕竟连续遇上两件怪事了。
dialogText.en: I can't help but think about things. We did run into strange things twice.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……？奇怪，我的工作日志去哪儿了？
dialogText.en: Hmm... This is odd. Where did my work log go?

dialogText.cn: 不过没关系，在来这里之前，我已经记下了后面几天的体验地点……
dialogText.en: It's alright. I actually had memorized the sites for the rest of the event before coming here...

dialogText.cn: 如果没记错的话，就在材料研究所后头的息壤堰附近。我会在那儿等你。
dialogText.en: If memory serves, they need some clean up near the Xiranite Dam behind the Institute of Materials Science. I'll be waiting there.

dialogText.cn: 啊？这只驮兽我记得洗过了啊，为什么…
dialogText.en: Oh? But I remember washing this one. Why...?

dialogText.cn: 哦，难道它是刚从泥巴里悟出了什么真理？
dialogText.en: Oh. Perhaps it just learned the truth about the mud.

dialogText.cn: 我们并非驮兽，又怎能知道驮兽是不是乐于被泥巴盖住……
dialogText.en: We are not burdenbeasts, after all. We don't know if the burdenbeasts like being covered in mud, or not.

dialogText.cn: 还是说，泥巴让它们感受到了自然的气息？驮兽又如何证明“泥巴”物质的存在？
dialogText.en: Maybe the mud gives them a feel of nature itself? Then again, how would burdenbeasts prove the existence of "mud"?

dialogText.cn: 今天可麻烦你们了，这小子后面就交给我吧，等它想走的时候我再给它清理干净。
dialogText.en: Thanks for the work today. Lave this maverick to me. I'll hose it down once it feels like moving.

dialogText.cn: 唉，正好也能想想情况说明报告该怎么写。
dialogText.en: Phoo. While I wait, I should think about how to write the situation report.

dialogText.cn: 年轻人，你来啦。
dialogText.en: Sunshine, you're here.

dialogText.cn: 息壤堰上各处都出现了奇怪的污渍……真是怪事连连！
dialogText.en: Stains have appeared all over the Xiranite Dam... I guess strangeness now comes as a crowd!

dialogText.cn: 有些污渍在够不着的高处……不过看起来，爬上去就好了。
dialogText.en: Some stains are at pretty high places... We may have to do some climbing.

dialogText.cn: 我们现在不用真的爬上去，我给你申请了浮块，你站在上面清理就好了。
dialogText.en: Of course not in a literal sense. I applied for several floating platforms. Just stand on top of them and do your thing.

dialogText.cn: 你终于回来了，看你跑到这么高的地方，我在底下也跟着紧张。
dialogText.en: Finally back, sunshine. Oh, you got me all jittery and worried when you got really high.

dialogText.cn: 那些诡异的污渍到底是什么呢？
dialogText.en: What are those strange stains?

dialogText.cn: 坏了，和我猜的一样……果然……是“邋遢妖”干的……
dialogText.en: Oh dear. I knew it... It's the work of ... "Grimy Mucker"...

dialogText.cn: 就像前几期的《环带奇闻》中提到的，这几年，文明环带总有这样的怪事发生——
dialogText.en: It's a cryptid mentioned a few episodes ago in Wild Tales of the Band. After all, strange things kept showing up in the Band recently—

dialogText.cn: 这个神秘生物，到处搞破坏，还会把泥巴扔到温顺的驮兽身上……
dialogText.en: The cryptid has a thing for vandalism. Like throwing mud on poor, peaceful burdenbeasts...

dialogText.cn: 大家都管这个神秘生物叫作“邋遢妖”。
dialogText.en: That's why everyone calls this cryptid the Grimy Mucker.

dialogText.cn: 息壤堰上的污渍，一定就是“邋遢妖”留下的符号！它盯上武陵了！
dialogText.en: The stains on the Xiranite Dam must be the work of the Grimy Mucker! It's got its evil eyes on Wuling!

dialogText.cn: 先不用劳烦巡卫了，对抗污渍是我们环卫职工的责任！
dialogText.en: I say let's not trouble the watchguards. The Urban Sanitation Workers must combat the stains ourselves!

dialogText.cn: 我得立刻通知各位同事留意类似的异常现象！
dialogText.en: I must call my fellow Sanitation workers to watch out for such strangeness!

dialogText.cn: 年轻人，那明天我们在方兴衢见。
dialogText.en: Alright, sunshine. See you tomorrow at Fangxing Avenue.

dialogText.cn: 原本乖巧的蟠兽，突然被一个神秘生物控制，把整洁的街区和楼房弄得一团糟……
dialogText.en: Cuddly pantails suddenly get possessed by a cryptid. The poor things then made a mess of an entire block...

dialogText.cn: 浮块已经在运行了，方便你在息壤堰上进行高空作业。
dialogText.en: The levitating platform is working. It'll help you perform elevated operations at the Xiranite Dam.

dialogText.cn: 清理的时候也要麻烦你，帮忙看看这些污渍究竟是怎么一回事。
dialogText.en: Do keep an eye out while cleaning. Try to figure out what's making those stains.

dialogText.cn: 你来了呀，年轻人。昨天同事们反馈，各自负责的区域都没有异常现象。
dialogText.en: You're here, sunshine. My colleagues reported zero anomalies in their respective areas.

dialogText.cn: 我本以为是虚惊一场……
dialogText.en: I thought it was a false alarm...

dialogText.cn: 结果，我今早来到方兴衢，一眼就发现这里被弄得乱七八糟的，连龙泡泡也遭了殃！
dialogText.en: But no! I arrived at Fangxing Avenue this morning and found the place in a great mess! Even the Chubby Lungs weren't spared!

dialogText.cn: 如果不是“邋遢妖”，谁还能上到这么高的地方去。
dialogText.en: It must be Grimy Mucker! Nothing else could get so high.

dialogText.cn: 龙泡泡洁净如初了，太感谢你了！
dialogText.en: The Chubby Lungs are as good as new. Thank you so much!

dialogText.cn: 就在你清理的时候，我在这里发现了一串沾满羽毛的奇怪脚印……
dialogText.en: While you were cleaning, I found strange footprints with feathers stuck to them...

dialogText.cn: 不过，还是先听听你对于龙泡泡身上那些污渍的看法吧。
dialogText.en: But I'll hear what you found about the stains on the Chubby Lungs.

dialogText.cn: 又是羽兽？可是……节目里说，“邋遢妖”从来不会重复自己的招数……
dialogText.en: Fowlbeasts again? But ... the show told us Grimy Mucker never uses the same trick twice...

dialogText.cn: 原来如此，先前我被误导了，这不是“邋遢妖”干的，而是“兽语密会”！
dialogText.en: Hmm. I believe I have been misled. This isn't the work of Grimy Mucker. It's the Circle of Beast Whisperers!

dialogText.cn: 你看过《塔卫二未解之谜》吗？
dialogText.en: Have you watched Unsolved Mysteries of Talos-II?

dialogText.cn: 有一期讲过，他们是一群能够操纵野兽的术师，据说许多历史事件背后都有他们的影子……
dialogText.en: One of the episodes talked about them. A secret circle of casters who know how to control beasts. They worked from the shadows in many historical events...

dialogText.cn: 肯定是他们偷偷操纵这些动物，为了干些什么见不得人的事情！
dialogText.en: These poor critters must have been secretly controlled by the Whisperers to achieve evil and mischief!

dialogText.cn: 不能再拖了，我现在就要顺着这串脚印继续调查。
dialogText.en: We can't let this go on. I shall track these footprints and investigate.

dialogText.cn: 两个人一起追踪太显眼了，难免打草惊蛇……
dialogText.en: But a team of two is too conspicuous. The mischievous pranksters will be spooked...

dialogText.cn: 我自己来就正好，干这一行这么多年了，这么脏的脚印可逃不过我的眼睛……
dialogText.en: No, sunshine. I'll do this alone. I am a veteran Sanitation Worker. Such footprints won't escape my eyes...

dialogText.cn: 我知道你关心我，放心，有消息我也第一时间和你说！
dialogText.en: You have a heart of gold, sunshine. I'll toast you a message if I find something!

dialogText.cn: 一反常态的蟠兽、突然在泥里打滚的驮兽、把首墩弄脏了的羽兽……
dialogText.en: Misbehaving pantails, burdenbeasts that rolled in the mud, fowlbeasts that soiled the Marker Stone...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，说得对，先完成清洁工作，再看看周围有没有线索吧……
dialogText.en: Yes, you're right. We clean up the mega-beans and see if there are any clues nearby...

dialogText.cn: 竟然把方兴衢的高人气地标糟蹋成这副肮脏的模样……真是对我们环卫职工的挑衅！
dialogText.en: How dare it spoil the best landmark of Fangxing Avenue...! The Urban Sanitation Team will make it pay!

dialogText.cn: 年轻人，我就知道你会来帮我，我看人可准了。
dialogText.en: I knew you'd come and help, sunshine. I know a kind soul when I see one.

dialogText.cn: 这“兽语密会”真是和我杠上了，附近恰好也是我今天负责清洁的区域……
dialogText.en: The Circle of Beast Whisperers declared war on me. I'm actually in charge of cleaning this area today...

dialogText.cn: 脚印都被这些污渍盖住了……他们肯定在搞什么见不得人的勾当。
dialogText.en: The footprints are completely covered by the stains... The Beast Whisperers are definitely up to no good.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，我就说你肯定有办法！
dialogText.en: Hah! I knew you have what it takes!

dialogText.cn: 看这片污渍，肯定是操纵了一整窝的源石虫，才弄成现在这样。
dialogText.en: Look at this mess. They must have possessed an entire nest of Originium Slugs to desecrate my site.

dialogText.cn: 这两条路，该往哪儿走啊……
dialogText.en: We now have two trails. Which one should we take...?

dialogText.cn: 这一片乱七八糟的污渍……完全不知道脚印往哪边去了。
dialogText.en: This is a major patch of dirt... I have no idea where the prints lead.

dialogText.cn: 我们仔细清理，一点一点把线索找出来吧。
dialogText.en: Be thorough when cleaning the place and try to find the clues.

dialogText.cn: 这本子里面还没有完全被水浸湿……这不是我的工作日志吗？
dialogText.en: This notebook isn't completely soaked... Wait. This is my work log.

dialogText.cn: 上面新增的笔迹……看来和我孙子是同龄人！
dialogText.en: Judging from the handwriting of the latest entries... They've been written by someone as young as my grandkid!

dialogText.cn: 奇怪，我记得“兽语密会”里没有小孩啊？
dialogText.en: This is very odd. The Beast Whisperers don't actually admit children.

dialogText.cn: 这到底是怎么一回事！
dialogText.en: Just what on Talos is going on?

dialogText.cn: 拜托你了……
dialogText.en: Of course, thanks for helping...

dialogText.cn: 怎么样孙子？伤着哪里没有？真是吓坏奶奶了！
dialogText.en: Are you hurt, Leilei? You almost gave granny a heart attack!

dialogText.cn: 奶奶，我没事，就是被这些源石虫吓了一跳……
dialogText.en: I'm alright, granny. I just got scared by these Originium Slugs...

dialogText.cn: 人没事就好……
dialogText.en: I'm just glad you're alright...

dialogText.cn: {F}你这小子，怎么一个人跑到野外来了，今天要不是有这位大姐姐，奶奶都不知道能不能再见到你！{M}你这小子，怎么一个人跑到野外来了，今天要不是有这位大哥哥，奶奶都不知道能不能再见到你！
dialogText.en: {F}But Leilei, what are you doing in the wilderness? Granny might lose you if not for this kind young miss!{M}But Leilei, what are you doing in the wilderness? Granny might lose you if not for this kind young sir!

dialogText.cn: 奶奶，我只是想帮你分担一点工作……
dialogText.en: I just wanna help share your work, granny...

dialogText.cn: 知道你腰闪了以后，我就想着帮你完成工作呀！你看，我都记在你的工作日志里了，嘿嘿……
dialogText.en: I've been wanting to help, ever since I knew about your back ache! See! I wrote down everything I did in your work log. Heheh...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？工作日志哪儿去了？
dialogText.en: Wait. Where did the work log go?

dialogText.cn: 你还得意起来了。你瞧瞧你干的好事……
dialogText.en: Well, Mister Leilei. Look at what you've done...

dialogText.cn: 居民区？我没有收拾过那里呀。因为那里有很多城外躲进来的蟠兽，我不想去打扰它们。
dialogText.en: Residential Area? I never cleaned that place. Plenty of pantails from outside were hiding in the city. I don't wanna disturb them.

dialogText.cn: 我看到墙壁上面沾了些羽兽的粪便，就坐着浮块，用拖把去擦。
dialogText.en: I saw fowlbeast poop sticking to the walls. So I rode a levitating platform and tried to wipe them clean with a mop.

dialogText.cn: 但是浮块越升越高，我不敢往下看，就闭着眼睛去擦的。
dialogText.en: But the levitating block kept rising higher. I got scared so I closed my eyes while I mopped the place clean.

dialogText.cn: 因为我前一天刚清理完羽兽粪便，闻着实在又脏又臭！我决定防患于未然，就把方兴衢地上所有的羽兽都赶走了……
dialogText.en: I just cleaned fowl poop the day before. And they stank so bad! So I decided to be smart and shooed off all the fowlbeasts from Fangxing Avenue...

dialogText.cn: 只是，后来它们一直往高处飞，停在龙泡泡上了。
dialogText.en: But they just flew to very high places. Like Chubby Lungs...

dialogText.cn: 我结合了清理墙上的羽兽粪时的经验，准备了一些清洁剂，清理起来可快了，果然有效果！
dialogText.en: I got smart after mopping the fowl poop, so I brought some soap. Cleaning got super quick and effective too!

dialogText.cn: 效果就是你差点把奶奶气晕了！那些源石虫你又是怎么招惹上的？
dialogText.en: Effective?! Boy, you just made your granny super angry! What about these Originium Slugs?

dialogText.cn: 我在岔路口看到一只源石虫把周围弄得脏脏的，怕它进奶奶的工作区域捣乱，就想把它赶走。
dialogText.en: I saw an Originium Slug making a mess at the intersection. So, I tried chasing it off before it could leave icky stuff in granny's area.

dialogText.cn: 我一直赶啊赶……最后它好像生气了，把它的同伴都喊过来欺负我了！
dialogText.en: So I kept chasing and chasing... And then the slug got angry and called all its friends to bully me!

dialogText.cn: 年轻人，这几天真是谢谢你的帮助，没想到这些祸都是我家这小子闯出来的！
dialogText.en: Oh dear. Sunshine, I really appreciate all the help you gave me. My own grandkid turns out to be the culprit!

dialogText.cn: 我之前还信誓旦旦，怀疑这个，怀疑那个的，真是闹笑话了！
dialogText.en: I was so sure it was the Grimy Mucker or the Beast Whisperers. I really made an old fool of myself.

dialogText.cn:
{F}孙子，好好和大姐姐道谢吧，这些天都是她在帮我们解决你闯出来的祸。
{M}孙子，好好和大哥哥道谢吧，这些天都是他在帮我们解决你闯出来的祸。
dialogText.en:
{F}Alright, Leilei. You owe this young miss a big thank you. She was the one who had to clean the mess you've made.
{M}Alright, Leilei. You owe this young sir a big thank you. He was the one who had to clean the mess you've made.

dialogText.cn: {F}嗯……我知道错了，大姐姐，谢谢你救了我……{M}嗯……我知道错了，大哥哥，谢谢你救了我……
dialogText.en: {F}Okay... I'm sorry, miss. Thank you for saving me...{M}Okay... I'm sorry, sir. Thank you for saving me...

dialogText.cn: 今天剩下来的这些污渍，你就担起责任来，自己清理干净，奶奶在这儿陪着你。
dialogText.en: As for the stains today, time for you to buckle up and start cleaning. Granny will keep you company.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我要当这个月的环卫标兵！
dialogText.en: Yeah! I wanna be the Sanitation Elite of the Month!

dialogText.cn: {F}你啊，还早着呢，要当也是这位大姐姐当。{M}你啊，还早着呢，要当也是这位大哥哥当。
dialogText.en: {F}You still got a long way to go, Leilei. Miss Sunshine deserves the Elite of the Month.{M}You still got a long way to go, Leilei. Mister Sunshine deserves the Elite of the Month.

dialogText.cn: 前段时间，天师桩阵列打跑了几只天使，我看到一群蟠兽被吓得躲到了居民区。
dialogText.en: Just a while ago, the Tianshi Pillar Array blasted a few Aggeloi. But it scared the pantails and they hid in the Residential Area.

dialogText.cn: 我路过那里的时候，它们还是很害怕，我一靠近，它们就要跑，我就没去那里……
dialogText.en: When I walked past and got too close, they became super scared and ran away. So I went somewhere else...

dialogText.cn: 我把那里的垃圾全都收拾干净了，临走的时候，想逗旁边的驮兽玩玩，结果它们一点面子都不给，追了我老半天！
dialogText.en: I cleaned up all the garbage there. Before I left, I tried playing with the burdenbeasts nearby. But they got real mean and chased me around all day!

dialogText.cn: {F}怎么啦，大姐姐？{M}怎么啦，大哥哥？
dialogText.en: {F}What is it, Miss Sunshine?{M}What is it, Mister Sunshine?

dialogText.cn: 嗯嗯？
dialogText.en: Oh?

dialogText.en: {F}You really think so? Thank you, Miss Sunshine!{M}You really think so? Thank you, Mister Sunshine!

dialogText.en: Well, I saw an Originium Slug making a mess at the intersection. I tried chasing it off before it could leave icky stuff in granny's area.

dialogText.cn: 脚印是露出来了……就是有点看不太清楚。
dialogText.en: I can see the footprints ... just not very clearly, though.

dialogText.cn: 好歹可以辨认出是往那边去了。
dialogText.en: At least I can tell they lead that way.

dialogText.cn: 您好，请问是来参加比赛的吗？
dialogText.en: Greetings. Are you a tournament contestant?

dialogText.cn: 好的，我们这就为您准备场地。
dialogText.en: Great! I'll setup the tournament area for you.

dialogText.cn: 比赛项目为清理息壤堰中指定区域里的污渍，我们会记录您清理污渍所花费的时间。
dialogText.en: Here are the rules. Clean up the stains in the specific area of the Xiranite Dam. We'll clock you based on the time you spent cleaning up the stains.

dialogText.cn: 您最终花费的时间将会被记录到排行榜上，用时越少，排名越靠前。
dialogText.en: The amount of time spent will be recorded on the leaderboards. The fastest cleaners will get better rankings.

dialogText.cn: 我们还在布置比赛场地时，使用了彩色颜料充当污渍。您准备好后随时可以开始。
dialogText.en: We're still preparing the tournament area. Paint will be used to create the "stains". You may begin once you're ready.

dialogText.cn: 您已经参加过比赛了，是想要再挑战一次平台清污演练吗？

dialogText.cn: 嗯……还能改善一下……嗯？管理员？又见面了，刚好有点事情想找你商量下。
dialogText.en: Hmm... This can be improved upon... Oh? Endmin? We meet again. There's something I want to discuss with you.

dialogText.cn: 根据观测站回传的数据，近期武陵地区的整体深度读数呈上升趋势，侵蚀正逐渐变得活跃起来。
dialogText.en: Data from our monitoring center revealed an upward trend for region-wide Depth readings of Wuling. The Blight is becoming increasingly active.

dialogText.cn: 我们打算为居民们研发一批可以在周围有侵蚀的情况下保护他们生命健康的<@qu.key>息壤防护装置</>。
dialogText.en: I plan to develop a <@qu.key>Xiranite-based protection device</> that can safeguard the health of our residents against ambient Blight in the environment.

dialogText.cn: 只是相比于我们，清波寨的寨民们会更需要这些息壤防护装置。
dialogText.en: I believe the Qingbo Stockaders need the Xiranite-based protection device more than we do.

dialogText.cn: 如果像之前一样，把大批量物资放到储备站……一是之后无法做到快速更新迭代，二是怕寨民们会起疑。
dialogText.en: If we do things the old way, like placing large stockpiles at the Field Logistics Depot... we can't really upgrade the devices quickly enough. Plus, the Stockaders might get suspicious.

dialogText.cn: 阿庄这几天因为城外的侵蚀已经忙得焦头烂额……
dialogText.en: Dealing with the Blight outside the city has taken a serious toll on Fangyi...

dialogText.cn: 还好你愿意帮忙……对了，管理员，这位是左顾言，是主动请缨协助进行物资调度工作的巡卫。
dialogText.en: I'm just so glad you're willing to help... By the way, Endmin, this here is Zuo Guyan, a watchguard who volunteered to assist stock redistribution.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您叫我顾言就是。今后若有不足之处，还望海涵。
dialogText.en: Greetings. Just call me Guyan, Endmin. I'll do my best but please forgive my shortcomings, if any.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？嘶……奇怪，我看指南里，和领导第一次见面就是这么打招呼啊……
dialogText.en: Oh? Hmm... Strange. But my guide told me that this is the proper way to greet a superior...

dialogText.cn: 《今天你升职了吗？》第一章——要主动替领导分忧。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Got a book titled "Did You Get Promoted Today?" Chapter One — Be Proactive in Sharing Your Superior's Woes.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，不如我们帮彦宁天师给息壤防护装置升升级？
dialogText.en: Endmin, maybe we can help Tianshi Yan Ning upgrade her Xiranite-based protection device?

dialogText.cn: 要是成了，也是帮彦宁天师还有庄管代分担了工作不是吗？
dialogText.en: If we succeed, Tianshi Yan Ning and Viceroy Zhuang would be spared quite a bit of work, right?

dialogText.cn: 息壤防护装置还有些地方需要迭代升级……我先去继续研究了，等到可以使用时我再来找你。
dialogText.en: There are still a few Xiranite-based protection device upgrades I need to work on... I'll come looking for you once it is ready.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！
dialogText.en: Wonderful!

dialogText.cn: 升职……咳咳，当然当然，这都是为了替彦宁天师分分担子，都听管理员的。
dialogText.en: My promo... Ahem. Of course, we're doing all this to share Tianshi Yan Ning's burdens. I shall heed your command, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？好呀。只是目前还在思考该怎么迭代，图纸还有点潦草。
dialogText.en: Oh? Yeah. I'm still thinking about the upgrades. The design drawings are still a little rough.

dialogText.cn: 能见识管理员如何对装置进行升级迭代，也是难得的学习机会。白霜，过来，好好看着！
dialogText.en: But witnessing the Endmin coming up with device upgrades is a good learning experience. Come here, Bai Shuang. Pay close attention!

dialogText.cn: 是，老师！
dialogText.en: Yes, ma'am!

dialogText.cn: 居然只是把材料改为了几个基本的材料……
dialogText.en: It simply swapped the original construction for more basic materials...

dialogText.cn: 以实验息壤瓶为基础的防护装置，说到底也确实是一种源石产物，是协议源石发挥了作用吗……
dialogText.en: The protection device is based on the Experimental Xiranite Bottle, which is essentially an Originium-based product. Did the Protorig achieve this...?

dialogText.cn: 我们对协议源石的了解还是太少了，嗯，朝着这个方向的话，确实有很大的优化空间。
dialogText.en: We know too little about the Protorig. Hmm. This approach actually offers a rather substantial optimization.

dialogText.cn: 后续的迭代就交给我和白霜了，这件防护装置……就先叫它“<@qu.key>息壤葫芦</>”吧。
dialogText.en: Bai Shuang and I shall handle subsequent iterations of the protection device... I'll call it the "<@qu.key>Xiranite Gourd</>" for now.

dialogText.cn: 生产和分发<@qu.key>息壤葫芦</>就交给你了，管理员。
dialogText.en: I'll leave the production and distribution of the <@qu.key>Xiranite Gourds</> to you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？有什么是我可以帮到的吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin? Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，黑面煞，我认得你，你刚刚是不是送了一批葫芦来寨里？
dialogText.en: Oh, Darkmask! I know you. Were you the one who delivered the gourds to the Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 你这次回寨子，是要办什么事情？
dialogText.en: Back to the Stockade, huh. What's your biz?

dialogText.cn: 息壤……武陵城的玩意儿？有耳目就是不错，武陵城的宝贝居然能搞来这么多。
dialogText.en: Xiranite...? The artsy green dirt from Wuling? See, connections are awesome. We got ourselves a load of Wuling loot.

dialogText.cn: 我们最近确实有外出的兄弟姐妹受了伤，但这个小玩意儿……真的有用吗？
dialogText.en: Say, some of the Fam working out in the wilderness got hurt. Can this little thing ... really work?

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，兄弟姐妹们是相信你的，只是这个小东西……看着真不像是有什么用的样子。
dialogText.en: Darkmask, the Fam has faith in you, but this gourd ... doesn't really look useful.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟这就是一个……看上去像装饰的葫芦？
dialogText.en: Methinks the gourd is more like a ... small trinket.

dialogText.cn: 也别说我们不信你，黑面煞，你送到寨子里的葫芦要是真有用，兄弟姐妹们就再来找你拿。
dialogText.en: We do trust you, Darkmask. But we gotta test out the gourds. If they work, the Fam will take them off your hands.

dialogText.cn: 要没用……反正也没损失，带着就带着，当个挂件就是了。
dialogText.en: And if they don't... I don't think it's a big deal. We'll just keep wearing it like a charm.

dialogText.cn: 难不成武陵城还能靠这么个小玩意儿控制我们吗？
dialogText.en: I don't think the Wulingers are trying to manipulate us with these gadgets.

dialogText.cn: 哎哟……这该死的侵蚀，怎么到处都有……哎哟……
dialogText.en: Ugh... The friggin' Blight. It's everywhere... Hngh...

dialogText.cn: 哎哟……还好带了……嘶……
dialogText.en: Argh... Thank goodness I brought... Ssss...

dialogText.cn: 兄弟姐妹们，黑面煞又带着宝贝葫芦来了！
dialogText.en: Fam, Darkmask is here! We're getting more of those precious gourds!

dialogText.cn: 太谢谢你了黑面煞，要是没有你带来的葫芦，我可就交代在寨子外面了。
dialogText.en: You're a lifesaver, Darkmask! If not for your gourd, I would've ended up as a corpse outside the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 之前怀疑你的葫芦，是我不对，我给你赔个不是……嘶，痛痛痛……
dialogText.en: I should've never doubted your gourd... Gotta apologize to you, Darkmask... HNGH! THE PAIN...

dialogText.cn: 还好，命还在……黑面煞？
dialogText.en: I'm good. Still alive... Darkmask?

dialogText.cn: 谁说没起作用……黑面煞？
dialogText.en: Doesn't work? Says who...? Oh, Darkmask?

dialogText.cn: 安全起见，还是得检查下清波寨外面的侵蚀情况。
dialogText.en: I should play it safe and check on the Blight outside Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 啊？管理员？哦哦，我刚刚巡逻经过此地，正巧听见清波寨里好像有什么动静，就过来瞧瞧。
dialogText.en: Oh? Endmin! Hah. I have patrol duties in these parts. Decided to pay a visit when I heard something happened at Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 《巡卫故事》里写了——最少被注视到的地方往往藏有大秘密。
dialogText.en: Picked it up from "The Watchguard's Tale" — The book says that huge secrets are usually hidden in the most unassuming of places.

dialogText.cn: 哦对了，管理员，寨民们都用上葫芦了吗？
dialogText.en: Say, Endmin, did our Stockaders start using the gourds?

dialogText.cn: 都用上了就好。
dialogText.en: Nice. As long as they're using the gourds.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，这不刚好巡逻到清波寨外面嘛……
dialogText.en: Heheh, my patrols took me outside Qingbo Stockade...

dialogText.cn: 呃……哈哈哈，果然，什么事都瞒不过管理员。
dialogText.en: Oh... Yeah, well. I should know better than to hide things from our Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 其实也不是什么大事，我只是想找个人……但我不知道他长什么样，只知道他是一个寨民。
dialogText.en: It's nothing serious. I just want to look for someone... The person's a Stockader, but that's all I know.

dialogText.cn: 很多年前，我在巡逻的时候被天使袭击，要不是寨民们救了我，我早就死了。
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi ambushed me during patrol duties several years ago. Fortunately, the Stockaders saved my life.

dialogText.cn: 但当时天色太暗，我没看清那些寨民们的样貌，想报恩，但连是谁救了我都不知道。
dialogText.en: But the day was really dark and I didn't see any of them clearly. I wanted to give my thanks, but I have no idea who I should look for.

dialogText.cn: 这次终于让我遇上机会了！《驮兽报恩》里写了——当找不到目标时，就把所有事情都做了。
dialogText.en: I finally found my chance this time! In "The Grateful Burdenbeast", if you can't find a goal, you just do everything.

dialogText.cn: 只要一口气帮了所有的寨民，那我心里的这块石头，也就能放下了。
dialogText.en: I will help every Stockader and finally set my heart at ease.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，管理员，你可不要和别人讲哦。
dialogText.en: Hahaha. Yeah, Endmin, please don't go around telling people about this.

dialogText.cn: 我都没和其他人讲过。
dialogText.en: I've never mentioned it to anyone.

dialogText.cn: 瞧您这话说的，我可是巡卫啊，我看了指南里写的，像我们巡卫，可不能被寨民救下来。
dialogText.en: Well, it's kinda obvious. I'm a watchguard. According to the guide, Stockaders don't like helping us at all.

dialogText.cn: 要是被同僚或者熟人知道了，那不得笑死我。
dialogText.en: And if my colleagues or friends learn that the Stockaders saved my skin, I'd be a laughingstock.

dialogText.cn: 而且万一传进了弭队的耳朵里……想想都害怕。我还指望早点晋升呢，可不能闹这一出。
dialogText.en: Imagine if Captain Mi Fu hears about this... Now that's a truly scary thought. Last thing I need if I really want that promotion fast.

dialogText.cn: 嗐，就是之前在方兴衢巡逻的时候，买的一本《如何升职三千问》，不过管理员您用不着。
dialogText.en: Haiz. Got it right from "3000 Questions for Nabbing that Promo" I bought during patrol duty on Fangxing Avenue. You won't need it, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 欸，您笑什么啊，真的有用！其他巡卫都可乐意和我一起搭档巡逻嘞。
dialogText.en: Oh. It's not a joke, Endmin. They're super useful! I impressed the other watchguards and everyone wants to go on patrols with me.

dialogText.cn: 时间不早了，那管理员，我先继续巡逻了，就不打扰你了哈。
dialogText.en: And time's getting late. I'll get back to patrolling, Endmin. Don't let me keep you around.

dialogText.cn: 啊？哦对对对，光顾着巡逻，把正事给忘了，彦宁天师让我把这个交给您。
dialogText.en: Ah? Oh yeah, this patrol made me forget about the super important biz. Tianshi Yan Ning told me to give this to you.

dialogText.cn: 这一代虽然依旧无法与侵蚀潮正面抗衡，但相较于您手上那代息壤葫芦，性能提升非常大。
dialogText.en: This upgrade won't get you through the Blight Tide directly, but it performs way better than the previous version of the Xiranite Gourd.

dialogText.cn: 幸好有管理员提醒，不然得拖到回武陵城后才能给您了。
dialogText.en: Thank Talos you reminded me, Endmin. I'd taken this all the way back to Wuling otherwise.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你终于来了，先别管我伤的事儿了，阿华还没回来……
dialogText.en: Darkmask, you're finally here! Ignore my wounds for now. Ah Hua hasn't returned...

dialogText.cn: 平常跟我一起去挖笋的兄弟，这几天我受伤了，都是他在照顾我。
dialogText.en: A fellow sprout-forager. Ah Hua's been caring for me during these couple of days since I got hurt real bad.

dialogText.cn: 我今天一直没见着他，问了其他人，说是他和一些兄弟姐妹早上跑到林子里挖笋去了。
dialogText.en: I didn't see him today so I asked around. Turned out he went out sprout-foraging with some of the Fam.

dialogText.cn: 但在他们离开后不久，侵蚀突然变多了。他们现在都没回来，怕是……大家又不敢出去找。
dialogText.en: But we suddenly got a huge load of Blight short after they left. They're not even back yet... We're afraid, but none of us dared to start a search right now.

dialogText.cn: 我当然相信，我告诉大家，黑面煞的宝贝葫芦这么好用，大家再想想办法，一定可以避开危险。
dialogText.en: Of course I do. I told everyone that Darkmask's gourds are super useful. We just need to think of a way to dodge the Blight.

dialogText.cn: 但大家都很担心，毕竟，外面的侵蚀越来越吓人了，兄弟姐妹们觉得宝贝葫芦可能挡不住。
dialogText.en: But still, Fam's scared, Darkmask. The Blight is getting worse. Those tiny gourds probably can't beat the bloody goop.

dialogText.cn: 不好意思管理员，我拿新的葫芦去了，花了点时间。
dialogText.en: Apologies, Endmin. I was picking up the new gourds. That took me a while.

dialogText.cn: 人找到了吗？
dialogText.en: Did you find the missing people?

dialogText.cn: 《武陵城的巡卫》里写了——不要忽视任何细节。
dialogText.en: A lesson from "Watchguard of Wuling". Never ignore any detail.

dialogText.cn: 我来这里巡逻的时候，正巧听见了他们在吵着要不要冒着生命危险出去找失踪的寨民。
dialogText.en: When I was patrolling these parts, I overheard them arguing if they should risk their lives to find their missing people.

dialogText.cn: 我看他们吵得挺凶的，就想着把您找来，帮忙调停调停，毕竟我不太方便出面……
dialogText.en: It was a very heated argument. I think it's best if you can mediate the thing. After all, it'd be inappropriate for me to butt in...

dialogText.cn: 什么？这样吗……但最新一代的防护装置能应对现在这种程度的侵蚀啊，我都戴着的。
dialogText.en: What? Really...? But the latest protection device is capable of dealing with the local Blight. I'm always wearing one.

dialogText.cn: 欸，我有法子了！
dialogText.en: Oh, I got an idea!

dialogText.cn: 我也来帮你们找。
dialogText.en: I'm volunteering for the search party.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞身边的那个巡卫？我们寨子里的事跟你这个外人有什么关系？
dialogText.en: It's the damn badge hanging around Darkmask! Hmph. Why are you poking your nose in Stockade biz, Wulinger?

dialogText.cn: ……算了，多一个人多一分力量，你当真不怕外面的危险？
dialogText.en: Ugh. I guess I can use another pair of eyes. Aren't you afraid of that Blight shite out there?

dialogText.cn: 我可是巡卫，怕这怕那的就不会来干这行当了。
dialogText.en: I'm a watchguard. That means I'm no coward 'cos it doesn't fit with our outfit.

dialogText.cn: 有骨气，但只有我们俩怕是不行。
dialogText.en: You talk the talk. But it takes more than two for a proper search.

dialogText.cn: 我有法子。
dialogText.en: I got an idea.

dialogText.cn: 寨民们，我是从武陵城来的巡卫，你们不用担心，我一定会帮你们把失踪的寨民都找回来！
dialogText.en: Stockaders! I'm a badge from Wuling. Don't worry. This watchguard will find your missing Fam and bring them home!

dialogText.cn: 等等，我们寨子里的事，什么时候要指望你们武陵人了？你是当我们寨子里没人了是吧！
dialogText.en: HEY! This is Stockade biz, badge. And we don't need no Wulinger to help us out! Are we Stockaders a joke to you, huh?

dialogText.cn: 我们这么多兄弟姐妹可都站在这儿呢！武陵来的，我告诉你，清波寨没有孬种！
dialogText.en: I got an army of Fam with me! Lemme educate you, Wulinger. We Stockaders are FEARLESS!

dialogText.cn: 《我曾走在环带边缘》——有对方熟人配合的激将法往往最有效果。
dialogText.en: Learned it by reading "I Walked On the Fringe of the Band". Having a friend on the other side makes instigation tactics more effective.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，在这里！
dialogText.en: Endmin, over here!

dialogText.cn: 终于回寨子了，阿华他们没事可太好了。多亏了黑面煞，还有……欸，那个巡卫呢？
dialogText.en: Finally, home sweet home. I'm just glad that Ah Hua and the others are alright. Gotta hand it to you, Darkmask, and that ... hmm. Where's Mister Badge?

dialogText.cn: 啊？好吧好吧，他走了就算了，我还想着好好谢谢他。
dialogText.en: Oh? He's already gone. Fine. I was thinking about thanking him in person.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你说，这些武陵人是不是看书看傻了。
dialogText.en: Say, Darkmask, all those books and reading ... turned the Wulingers' brains into blight-goop, right?

dialogText.cn: 我听见他和你说话，张口一句这本书，闭口一句这本书。
dialogText.en: I heard him talk to you. "Oh, I learned it from this book." "Ah. I got it from that book."

dialogText.cn: 跟几年前的那个武陵人一模一样。
dialogText.en: Reminds me of another Wulinger I've met a few years back.

dialogText.cn: 对呀，当时我和几个兄弟姐妹刚打完秋风准备回寨子，突然听到了求救的声音。
dialogText.en: Ah, yeah. There was this time when my Fam was heading back after a major haul when we heard people calling for help.

dialogText.cn: 走过去一看，是水花子在攻击一个武陵人。
dialogText.en: We got closer and saw a Wulinger getting roughed up by a bunch of splatters.

dialogText.cn: 我们给他救下来后，那人也是这样，这本书那本书什么什么什么。
dialogText.en: We saved that dude, but he kept blabbering on and on about some blight-ass books.

dialogText.cn: 说“《驮兽报恩》里写了——被人帮助过就一定要报答回去”。
dialogText.en: Told us about "The Grateful Burdenbeast" and how everyone must repay a debt of kindness.

dialogText.cn: 我们还急着把那些东西带回寨子，哪儿还有空听他唠叨，就走了。
dialogText.en: We were busy trying to haul our loot back to the Stockade, so we just left him there. Got no time for his book-pushing.

dialogText.cn: 不像我们黑面煞，一看就不是武陵那边的人！
dialogText.en: Nothing like our Darkmask. You got none of his funny Wulinger habit.

dialogText.cn: 以后宝贝葫芦的事，可就拜托啦，这玩意儿可太好用了！
dialogText.en: The Fam's counting on you about the gourds. Those gadgets are truly wonderful.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，正巧你来了，刚打算去找你。
dialogText.en: Endmin, what a coincidence. I was about to go and find you.

dialogText.cn: 你有兴趣和我一起去吗？
dialogText.en: How about attending the event with me?

dialogText.cn: 赛事的组织者现在就在<@qu.key>方兴衢</>。
dialogText.en: The competition's organizer is at <@qu.key>Fangxing Avenue</>.

dialogText.cn: 我记得是一位名叫田悯的天师。
dialogText.en: I believe he is a Tianshi named Tian Min.

dialogText.cn: 我们先去找他了解下比赛的情况吧。
dialogText.en: Let's find him to learn more about this competition.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师刚才和我说，武陵的天师携同方兴衢的商家，要举办一场名为“<@qu.key>武陵特厨</>”的厨艺爱好者竞赛。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang just told me that the Tianshi of Wuling and the business owners of Fangxing Avenue are jointly organizing "<@qu.key>Wuling Super Chef</>", a competition for culinary aficionados.

dialogText.cn: 又见面了，你这是要参加“武陵特厨”吗？
dialogText.en: We meet again. Are you taking part in Wuling Super Chef?

dialogText.cn: 没错，正好，我打听到决赛的题目会很特殊。
dialogText.en: That's right. And I just caught wind that the final round will be quite special.

dialogText.cn: 本来是来参赛的，但是我现在有个更好的主意。
dialogText.en: Originally, but not anymore. I got a better idea.

dialogText.cn: 我手头呢，有一些新品种的种实。它们一受热就会变成最好的调味料，风味新奇得很。
dialogText.en: I got some seeds of brand new cultivars I grew. Cooking them yields the best condiments with unique flavors.

dialogText.cn: 正愁怎么跟这里的天师谈合作呢，碰巧赶上特厨大赛。我就想借这个机会，先让它们出出风头。
dialogText.en: I don't really know how to start working with the Tianshi, but this Super Chef cook-off presents an opportunity for my seeds to shine.

dialogText.cn: 但我的厨艺一塌糊涂，就算硬着头皮参赛恐怕也得不到什么好的结果，到时还糟蹋了种实。
dialogText.en: I can't cook to save my life. Even if I tried my best, I probably flop like a dead fin and end up wasting my precious seeds.

dialogText.cn: 虽然没打听到具体是什么，但如果是特殊菜品的话，我的种实应该会发挥更大的作用。
dialogText.en: Nothing concrete so far, but they might need you to cook something special. I believe my seeds will come in very useful.

dialogText.cn: 让我回顾一下赛事规定……嗯，比赛没有限制参赛选手使用自备的香辛料。
dialogText.en: Let me look at the competition rules... Hmm. There are no restrictions on condiments and spices used by the participants.

dialogText.cn: 那就拜托你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Counting on you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，你们也是来参加比赛的吗？
dialogText.en: Endministrator, Supervisor Perlica, are you here to take part in the competition?

dialogText.cn: 哦？那我可要好好期待管理员的作品了。管理员，关于比赛你有什么想要了解的吗？
dialogText.en: Oh? I'm really looking forward to your dishes, Endmin. Anything you want to know about the competition?

dialogText.cn: 很简单，本次“武陵特厨”厨艺爱好者竞赛设有一位主持人。
dialogText.en: Simple. We have appointed a host for the "Wuling Super Chef" cooking competition.

dialogText.cn: 参赛选手可以将他们的得意之作提交给赛事主持人，而主持人也会向参赛选手转达赛事评委对作品的评价。
dialogText.en: Participants can submit their dishes to the competition host. The host will then share the judges' evaluations.

dialogText.cn: 大概就是这样。
dialogText.en: That's basically how it works.

dialogText.cn: 好问题，管理员。举办厨艺比赛，是为了用美食活跃活跃城里的气氛。
dialogText.en: Good question, Endmin. We organized this cooking competition to liven up the atmosphere of Wuling City with great food.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟前段时间才发生了紧急情况，大家都紧绷着神经，笑容都变少了。
dialogText.en: We did have quite a crisis a while ago. People are still very tense and distressed. Hardly anyone is smiling.

dialogText.cn: 这场厨艺竞赛的目的嘛，就是让大家一块儿下下厨，较量一下手艺，借这个机会放松一下！
dialogText.en: This cooking competition aims to let everyone start cooking again and see who's the best chef. It's an opportunity for people to relax!

dialogText.cn: 好嘞，比赛差不多也快要开始了。
dialogText.en: Great. The competition is about to start too.

dialogText.cn: 到时候管理员要是想参加比赛的话，将作品交给主持人便是。
dialogText.en: If you're taking part, just submit your dish to the host.

dialogText.cn: 尊敬的各位评委，各位来宾，大家好。
dialogText.en: Greetings, honorable judges and distinguished guests!

dialogText.cn: 欢迎大家来到第一届“武陵特厨”武陵厨艺爱好者烹饪大赛的比赛现场！
dialogText.en: Welcome to our first Wuling Super Chef Culinary Aficionado Cook-Off! Coming to you live from the event!

dialogText.cn: 首先，我将会为各位介绍本次大赛的比赛规则：<@qu.key>比赛分成两个阶段，共七场比拼</>！
dialogText.en: Allow me to lay down the rules for this cook-off: <@qu.key>This is a TWO-phase competition with a total of SEVEN rounds!</>

dialogText.cn: 初赛阶段，各位将会有<@qu.key>六天的时间，完成六道题目，每天会为各位选手解锁一道新题目</>。
dialogText.en: The first phase gives our contending chefs <@qu.key>SIX days to complete SIX challenges! One challenge will be unlocked every day!</>

dialogText.cn: 而到了决赛阶段，就是最考验各位厨艺的时候，决赛阶段的题目将会是一道参赛者认为最能代表自己的美食！
dialogText.en: The FINAL phase is a true test for your cooking skills! The challenge is to make a dish that best represents yourself!

dialogText.cn: 当然，决赛我们允许选手在选定作品的过程中，寻求赛外人员的帮助。话不多说，让我们，正式开始比赛！
dialogText.en: Of course, we do allow our chefs to seek help from non-participants when choosing the dish. But I've said enough already! Time to get the stoves hot and blazing!

dialogText.cn: 你好，管理员，是来提交参赛作品的吗？
dialogText.en: Hi, Endmin. Ready to submit your dish?

dialogText.cn: 好，让我们期待评委会作何评价！
dialogText.en: Alright. Let's see how our judges rate your culinary work!

dialogText.cn: 好，期待您的作品！
dialogText.en: Okay. We're looking forward to it!

dialogText.cn: 怎么了，在苦恼什么吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, is something troubling you?

dialogText.cn: 这些思路都不错，但……管理员，你其实已经有头绪了吧？
dialogText.en: Sounds like a great idea, but ... I believe you have something in mind already, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 啊……头绪？什么头绪？
dialogText.en: Ah... Idea? What idea?

dialogText.cn: 在我们与罗德岛接洽时，有这么一道菜，几乎每位罗德岛干员都会提到。
dialogText.en: When we engaged with Rhodes Island, there was this dish that almost every Rhodes Islander mentioned.

dialogText.cn: 虽然描述的方式各有不同，但他们每一个人都清晰记得这道菜的口味和做法。
dialogText.en: Though descriptions differ, all of them vividly remember the taste and recipe of the dish.

dialogText.cn: 我也试着做过，确实感觉和管理员……咳，管理员，我来复述做法，烹调就交给你了。
dialogText.en: I tried making it once, and it felt like what the Endmin... Ahem. Well, Endmin, I'll dictate the recipe and let you handle the cooking.

dialogText.cn: 是啥，是啥呀？为什么只有我没听懂你们在说什么！
dialogText.en: Wha-wha-what?! Were you two talking in code? Because I totally didn't get any of that!

dialogText.cn: 这样啊……没事！
dialogText.en: Ah... It's totally alright!

dialogText.cn: 正好我刚执行完任务回来，也帮管理员参谋参谋。
dialogText.en: I just got back from a mission. I can totally give some great advice for our Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我好像明白管理员是在说哪道菜了。
dialogText.en: I think I know that dish, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 时间过得真快，转眼就来到了决赛的最终阶段！
dialogText.en: How time flies. We've now arrived at the final round of this cook-off!

dialogText.cn: 那么，让我们邀请参赛选手，进行最后的比拼。有请第一位选手——
dialogText.en: We now invite our participants to engage in the last bout of this competition! Our first contender —

dialogText.cn: 终末地，管——理——员！
dialogText.en: The EEEEEND-MINISTRATOR of Endfield Industries!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，管理员，你在初赛的表现非常亮眼，我们都很期待你在决赛会为我们带来怎样的惊喜。
dialogText.en: Stellar performance in the preliminaries, Endmin. You got everyone excited about the surprise you'd deliver for the final round.

dialogText.cn: 而你的决赛作品也确实给了我们一个惊喜——想法大胆打破传统，传承过往又带有创新。
dialogText.en: Your final round dish truly took us by surprise — the idea is a bold break from tradition, and it carries on our legacy while being innovative at the same time.

dialogText.cn: 但现在评委们有一个问题，我们很好奇，你为什么选择烹饪这道美食呢？
dialogText.en: But our judges got curious and have a question for you. Why did you choose to prepare this dish?

dialogText.cn: 评分出来了！不错的分数！感谢管理员的作品！让我们欢迎……
dialogText.en: The score is out and it looks INCREDIBLE! Thank you for your wonderful dish, Endmin! Now let's welcome...

dialogText.cn: 欸，管理员？这么厉害！我以后……不对，我现在就要尝尝管理员做的菜！
dialogText.en: WHA?! Our Endmin? That's really super! I think I'm gonna... NO! I wanna try the Endmin's dishes right now!

dialogText.cn: 和我预料的一样，这批种实非常、非常成功。
dialogText.en: Just as I expected. This batch of seeds has truly proven their worth.

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么说，恭喜你管理员，拿到了特等奖。
dialogText.en: No matter. Congratulations are in order, Endmin. The grand prize is yours.

dialogText.cn: 真是太好了。
dialogText.en: It's truly wonderful.

dialogText.cn: 别这么说，我还是有自知之明的。
dialogText.en: You flatter me. I know myself well. Too well.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，恭喜呀。嘿嘿，我在你的原料报备清单中看到了一些我从没见过的……种实。
dialogText.en: Congratulations, Endmin. Heheh. I saw your list of ingredients and noticed some ... seeds I'd never seen before.

dialogText.cn: 这位天师，看来你对我的种实感兴趣？
dialogText.en: Tianshi, you seem to be interested in my seeds.

dialogText.cn: 别忙着高兴，想要种实，一口价，概不还价，这可是你们宏科院都没有的全新品种。
dialogText.en: Don't celebrate just yet. Seeds cost money, and I don't haggle. They're brand new cultivars, even Hongshan doesn't have them.

dialogText.cn: 你好，管理员。准备好决赛作品了吗？
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endmin. Ready to submit your final dish?

dialogText.cn: 好哦，期待您的作品！
dialogText.en: Great. Looking forward to your work!

dialogText.cn: 以上便是获得了二等奖与一等奖的参赛选手，下面我宣布，获得本次“<@qu.key>武陵特厨</>”武陵厨艺爱好者烹饪大赛特等奖的是——
dialogText.en: These are our chefs for the first and second runners-up. And now, it's time to reveal the winner of the <@qu.key>Wuling Super Chef</> Culinary Aficionado Cook-Off Grand Prize —

dialogText.cn: 管理员！
dialogText.en: The ENDMINISTRATOR!

dialogText.cn: 说到底，这种实只是辅料。当然，我的种实必定是最好的，但也得靠掌勺的厨子。
dialogText.en: My seeds serve only as condiments and seasoning. Though impeccable in quality, they are worth nothing without a capable chef.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈，山重水复疑无路，我就知道，项目没头绪的时候一定会有别的办法！
dialogText.en: Hahahaha. And I was worried I'd never see this dish again. Projects may hit bottlenecks, but there's always a way!

dialogText.cn: 尝起来与过去提供给铁誓军的军用食品有些相似，但风味上又有着决定性的不同……
dialogText.en: It tastes like Order of Steel Oath military rations we used to supply, but the flavor is definitely different...

dialogText.cn: 你给了我们一份从未体验过的美味，实在是令人意外。
dialogText.en: You gave us something new and delicious. Truly, it took us all by storm.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，正如选手们所说，无论菜品的品质如何，都代表了他们对烹饪、对生活的热爱！
dialogText.en: Hahaha! As our contending chefs put it, it doesn't matter what the dishes are. They simply love cooking and living the life!

dialogText.cn: 你的种实？
dialogText.en: Your seeds?

dialogText.cn: 好说好说，哦对了，还有配套的培育方法，我们谈谈价钱！
dialogText.en: Well said, my good man. I wonder if the cultivation method is on the table too. We can offer a good price for a bundle!

dialogText.cn: 你好，管理员，你做的美食真让人印象深刻啊。
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endmin. Your dish has truly left an impression.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>壤晶</>是制造<@gd.key>中容武陵电池</>的必要原料。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Xircon</> is an essential material for producing <@gd.key>SC Wuling Batteries</>.

dialogText.cn: 工团的工人布置了一条<@gd.key>壤晶</>产线，但是忘记设置<@gd.key>反应池</>的<@gd.key>输出物品</>。
dialogText.en: The UWST crew mates have laid down a <@gd.key>Xircon</> production line but they forgot to set the <@gd.key>outputs</> for the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</>.

dialogText.cn: 请帮助恢复<@gd.key>壤晶</>产线。
dialogText.en: Please fix the <@gd.key>Xircon</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 工团需要使用<@gd.key>精炼炉</>生产一批<@gd.key>赤铜块</>。
dialogText.en: The UWST needs the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to produce a batch of <@gd.key>Cuprium</>.

dialogText.cn: 但离工厂最近的水源被乱石阻隔，无法通过常规水管引入清水。
dialogText.en: However, stones are blocking the source water closest to the Factory. Standard pipes would be incapable of bringing in Clean Water.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>地下暗管</>可以<@gd.key>跨地图和障碍</>传输液体。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Conduits</> can transport fluids <@gd.key>across various obstacles on the map</>.

dialogText.cn: 请利用<@gd.key>地下暗管</>将清水引入工厂完成<@gd.key>赤铜块</>的生产。
dialogText.en: Use <@gd.key>Conduits</> to bring Clean Water to the Factory to complete the <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 已成功完成<@gd.key>赤铜块</>的生产，但生产赤铜块会持续产生<@gd.key>污水</>，污水填满缓存区后会阻塞精炼炉工作
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production successful, but it also generates <@gd.key>Sewage</>. Once Sewage fills up the Cache, the Refining Unit will become clogged and stop working.

dialogText.cn: 需要将<@gd.key>精炼炉</>产生的污水连接至<@gd.key>废水处理机</>，才能让产线持续正常工作
dialogText.en: Make a pipeline connection from the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</> so that the Sewage byproduct gets treated and keep the production line working.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>废水处理机</>已被放置在工厂区域外
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</> is placed outside the factory area.

dialogText.cn: 请使用发放的<@gd.key>暗管入口</>和<@gd.key>暗管出口</>将精炼炉产生的污水传输至<@gd.key>废水处理机</>处进行处理
dialogText.en: Use the <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> and <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> to move Sewage produced by the Refining Unit to the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</> for processing.

dialogText.cn: 别内疚，这是常有的事。我们先回去吧！
dialogText.en: It's alright. Oopsies happen. Let's just head back!

dialogText.cn: 啊，管理员！
dialogText.en: Ah, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，没什么啦。我在等管理员，顺便发会儿呆。
dialogText.en: Heheh. It's nothing. I'm waiting for you, Endmin. And just zoning out while I'm at it.

dialogText.cn: 谷地现在人手严重不足，有很多送往各处的包裹，但没有人配送，所以我就来帮忙啦。
dialogText.en: Delivering! The Valley has plenty of packages to send, but only a few messengers are around. That's why I'm here to help.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟我是信使嘛！
dialogText.en: After all, I'm a messenger!

dialogText.cn: 是送往枢纽区基地的货物，还剩下这么多呢。这里刚发生过意外，我想多给大家鼓鼓劲。
dialogText.en: These packages need to go to the Hub Base. I've got quite a few more to deliver. People here have been through a terrible incident, and I wanna give them some encouragement.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……意外发生后，大家的情绪都很低落。他们要是看到管理员，一定就能振作起来吧。
dialogText.en: Heheh... Everyone's feeling a little low after the incident. I figured your presence would brighten everyone's mood.

dialogText.cn: 所以，翻着通讯录，我就在犹豫要不要麻烦管理员来帮忙。
dialogText.en: So, I looked through my contacts, wondering whether I should ask you to come or not... I just didn't wanna be a bother...

dialogText.cn: 求求你帮帮我嘛！
dialogText.en: Maybe ... just this once, you could help me out, Endmin? Pretty please?

dialogText.cn: 这里还剩下一些<@qu.key>包裹</>。马上就要黄昏了，我们一起去送吧。
dialogText.en: There are just a few <@qu.key>packages</> left and the sun is about to set. I'm thinking we make the last deliveries together.

dialogText.cn: 这是送去<@qu.key>食堂</>的包裹，应该是交给工作人员的，快到饭点了，我们赶紧吧！
dialogText.en: This package needs to reach the <@qu.key>canteen</>. The recipient should be one of the staff there! It's almost mealtime, so we need to hurry!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，准备好了的话，我们就出发吧！
dialogText.en: If you're ready, Endmin, we can set off any time!

actorName.cn: 工作人员{c13-食堂工作人员}

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，是我们订购的调味剂到了吧？真是辛苦信使小姐了。
dialogText.en: Oh, is this our order of special condiments? Thank you, Miss Messenger — just in time!

actorName.cn: 工作人员{c13-食堂工作人员}

dialogText.cn: 唉，工团地下水管道都被侵蚀污染了，现在我们用的食材和水都受到了影响……所以，当下也只能用速食品给大家凑合一下。
dialogText.en: Ugh. The underground water pipes have been contaminated by the Blight. We don't even have safe food and water anymore... The crew will have to make do with field rations.

dialogText.cn: 那已经很难得啦。
dialogText.en: That's rough, but you're doing an incredible job.

actorName.cn: 工作人员{c13-食堂工作人员}

dialogText.cn: 好在现在有了这些调料，速食品吃起来也不会太难以下咽了！……感谢你们的帮助啊，尤其是你，终末地的管理员。要是没有你，事情还不知道什么时候能结束呢。
dialogText.en: Now, with these condiments, field rations will taste far better...! Thank you so much for helping us. And that goes double for you, Endmin. If you weren't here, the disaster might have never ended!

dialogText.cn: 这份包裹上写着“精密零件”，是送往<@qu.key>集成核心区域</>的。我可接触过不少这种包裹，稍微磕了碰了，收件人们就会大呼小叫……希望别遇到什么绊子……
dialogText.en: Package description reads "Precision Machine Parts". I think this goes to the <@qu.key>Core AIC Area</>. I've delivered plenty of things like this. We need to make sure it arrives without a single dent or scratch — otherwise, the recipients will get really upset and loud... Fingers crossed for no hiccups!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，准备好了的话，我们就出发吧！
dialogText.en: Tell me when you're ready, Endmin, and then we'll set off!

dialogText.cn: 今天是什么日子，劳驾管理员亲自给我送货来了！
dialogText.en: Whoa! Endmin! Is this a special day?! You're personally delivering a package for me!

dialogText.cn: 我们和工团的合作正在稳步展开。现在首先要解决的是净化水的问题。
dialogText.en: Our partnership with the UWST is going well. Getting clean water is our primary concern right now.

dialogText.cn: 啊，食堂的人也说，饮用水都被污染了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. The canteen lady also said that the drinking water has been polluted.

dialogText.cn: 这个包裹里的零件刚好赶上了。照这个进度，明天就能先把大型设备开起来。
dialogText.en: And thank goodness my order for the special parts has arrived! If we stay on schedule, our large facilities should be able to start working tomorrow.

dialogText.cn: 真是不容易。
dialogText.en: Oh my... Your job sounds really tough.

dialogText.cn: 没事，管理员在这里，大家心里都很有底！嘿嘿，我先去忙了，下次再来叙叙旧。
dialogText.en: Never mind me. The Endmin's here, so everyone knows things will work out! Hoohoo. I gotta dash to a job. We'll catch up on the good ol' times later.

dialogText.cn: 还有信使小姐在。怎么样，我的零件没问题吧？
dialogText.en: And hello there, Miss Messenger! I hope the parts are still in good working order?

dialogText.cn: 嗯！货物完好无损！
dialogText.en: Don't worry — the package is in pristine condition!

dialogText.cn: 不仅如此，工业用水也很吃紧。现在只能拿离心机进行简单的脱水和排污处理。
dialogText.en: Not just drinking water. We're also really low on industrial water. Our current solution is to use centrifuges for simple purification and pollutant removal.

dialogText.cn: 最后一份啦！这份包裹写着“药品”，应该是<@qu.key>医务室</>急需的药物吧。这里面都是瓶瓶罐罐，我们小心点儿！
dialogText.en: Final package! Description reads "Medication". I think this one is meant for the <@qu.key>medical bay</>. Sounds like a lot of vials and bottles. We must be gentle with this one!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，准备好了的话，我们就出发吧！
dialogText.en: If you're ready, Endmin, we can set off any time!

dialogText.cn: 是我们求援的针剂吗？可算盼来了！
dialogText.en: Is this the medication we've been asking for? Thank goodness it's finally arrived!

dialogText.cn: 太好了，现在伤员太多，所有医疗物资都很吃紧，要是库存没续上就难办了！好在来了，好在来了。
dialogText.en: We have so many injured, and our medical supplies are running low. I can't imagine what things would be like if we didn't get restocked! You two are true lifesavers!

dialogText.cn: 对了，洁尔佩塔，你不在，<@qu.key>卡莉</>又不肯打针了。
dialogText.en: Oh, and Gilberta, while you were away, little <@qu.key>Carly</> refused to get her injections again.

dialogText.cn: 咦？说好的好好打针，我就给她一个奖励呢？卡莉，我来啦！
dialogText.en: Again? But I told her she'd get a prize if she took her medication properly! Alright, Carly — Miss Gilberta is back!

dialogText.cn: 啊，不巧，好像没赶上！只能先和收件人另约一个时间再来啦！
dialogText.en: Ooops. I guess we didn't make it in time! It's okay. I'll just schedule another delivery appointment with the recipient!

dialogText.cn: 别内疚，这是常有的事。我们先回去吧！
dialogText.en: Don't sweat it. Oopsies happen. Let's just head back!

dialogText.cn: 别内疚，这是常有的事。我们先回去吧！
dialogText.en: It's okay, oopsies happen. Let's just head back!

dialogText.cn: 放眼望去，满眼都是这些骇人的伤痕……
dialogText.en: Wherever I look, I see nothing but these horrifying wounds...

dialogText.cn: 不仅是大地被破坏，人们失去了亲人，丢失了理想……人们的内心被伤害得更深。
dialogText.en: This land has been torn apart. People have lost their loved ones, their friends, and even their dreams... Their hearts, too, have been torn into pieces.

dialogText.cn: 这个世界，总是这么纤细易碎。像一根轻盈的羽毛，也像是一颗浑浊的玻璃球……
dialogText.en: This world has always been so delicate and fragile. It's like a fine, downy feather ... and also like a polluted orb of glass...

dialogText.cn: 我没事啦，管理员。
dialogText.en: I'm alright, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我只是在想……如果不珍惜眼下，很可能留不住那稍纵即逝的珍贵时光……
dialogText.en: I was just thinking ... if we fail to value what we have, those sweet moments might slip right through our fingers.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我想……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I want to...

dialogText.cn: 欸，碎石块已经开始松动了。管理员，这些受超域影响的异状又产生变化了，这里可能会更加危险……我们快离开吧。
dialogText.en: Oh no, these rocks are coming loose! Endmin, the Æther anomaly is shifting. This place is getting dangerous... We should leave quickly.

dialogText.cn: 走吧！
dialogText.en: Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 我们离开这里吧。
dialogText.en: Let's get out of here.

dialogText.cn: 相机？咦，原来卡莉不是因为害怕打针才躲起来的吗？
dialogText.en: Cameras? So, you weren't just running away from the needles because you were scared.

dialogText.cn: 是门卫爷爷借给我玩的，他的<@qu.key>旧相机</>。他还说卡莉能成为了不起的摄影师！
dialogText.en: The security guard gave me his <@qu.key>old camera</>. He also told me I'll become a great photographer!

dialogText.cn: 呜……但是，我怎么也拍不出好看的照片……
dialogText.en: Hngh... But ... I can't even take a proper photo...

dialogText.cn: 我也不知道该拍些什么……
dialogText.en: What photo should I take...? I don't know...

dialogText.cn: 石头也拍不好看，源石虫也拍不好看……长耳兽跑来跑去，拍下来都是模糊的影子……
dialogText.en: My rock photos look ugly. My Originium Slug photos look ugly... The long-ears kept jumping around ... and all my photos ended up super blurry...

dialogText.cn: 拍些卡莉喜欢的东西呢？
dialogText.en: Maybe try snapping things you like, Carly. It'll be fun!

dialogText.cn: 我喜欢……我喜欢洁尔佩塔姐姐！
dialogText.en: What do I like...? I like you, Miss Gilberta!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我也喜欢卡莉喔！
dialogText.en: Oh! I like you as well, Carly!

dialogText.cn: 我想！但是我拍不好……
dialogText.en: Oh! I wanna do that! But ... all my photos look ugly...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……那我们拍好了照片，卡莉就会回去打针吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm... Once we take the photo, you'll be super brave and get your injection, okay?

dialogText.cn: 嗯！我们说好了，等拍完照就回去打针！
dialogText.en: Okay! Photo first! Then we'll head back for the injection!

dialogText.cn: 那……管理员，可以请你帮我们个小忙吗？
dialogText.en: So... Endmin... Can I ask you for a little favor?

dialogText.cn: 咯咯，你骗不了我！你是管理员！
dialogText.en: Haha! Liar, liar, pants on fire! You're just the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 我、我想和洁尔佩塔姐姐<@qu.key>合照</>，这样也可以！
dialogText.en: I ... I wanna be in the <@qu.key>same photo</> as Miss Gilberta! That'd be super good!

dialogText.cn: 对卡莉来说，多拍喜欢的东西才会越拍越好吧？
dialogText.en: Carly, if you want pretty photos, why not snap things you like?

dialogText.cn: 卡莉喜欢橙汁，喜欢小熊“呼噜”，喜欢工人之家的爷爷奶奶。
dialogText.en: And I know you like orange juice, Dozy the Plush, and visiting the gramps and grannies at the Worker Dorms.

dialogText.cn: 去找到更多卡莉喜欢的东西怎么样？照片呀，就是把美好的事物刻印成回忆的东西。
dialogText.en: We can go around and look for things you like, Carly. Photography is our way of recording beautiful things into snapshots of precious memories.

dialogText.cn: 美好的事物……我知道了！我想到要拍什么了！
dialogText.en: Beautiful things... Ah! I know what I wanna take a photo of!

dialogText.cn: 我要去打针，我要去把朋友们勇敢的表情拍下来！
dialogText.en: I'm gonna get my injection! And I'll take photos of my friends being brave!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，卡莉也是勇敢的孩子。
dialogText.en: Heheh! You're just as brave as your friends, Carly.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢洁尔佩塔姐姐，谢谢管理员！
dialogText.en: Heehee, thank you, Miss Gilberta! And you too, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 没有啦……啊，不对，并不是说不想拍……
dialogText.en: Not really... Ah! No! What I meant was ... I really like photos but...
