dialogText.cn: 我……我只是在想，明明我告诉卡莉去找到自己喜欢的事物……
dialogText.en: I ... I was just thinking about what I said to Carly. I told her to find things she likes...

dialogText.cn: 但我却还有很多事情没有想明白……没想好应该写些什么……
dialogText.en: But I'm in a heap of a mess myself... I can't even figure out what to write...

dialogText.cn: 也还没有勇气……
dialogText.en: And I never found the courage...

dialogText.cn: 啊！没什么，只是一张<@qu.key>信纸</>……
dialogText.en: Oh! Nothing! It's just a <@qu.key>letter</>...

dialogText.cn: 不、不说这个了，管理员，我们再去看看还有没有什么需要帮忙的人吧！
dialogText.en: Let's ... let's just talk about something else, Endmin. Why don't we look around and see if anyone needs help?

dialogText.cn: 哇！好漂亮……
dialogText.en: Wow! This is such a pretty photo...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，教教我怎么才能拍得这么好嘛。
dialogText.en: Endmin! Please teach me how to make the photos look pretty like this.

dialogText.cn: 罗普？他在最靠里面的病床上。要找他的话，麻烦脚步轻一些，病人还在昏迷，需要休息。
dialogText.en: Ropp? He's on the bed way inside this medical bay. And please be quiet. Our patients really need to rest.

dialogText.cn: （含糊不清的字眼）
dialogText.en: (Unintelligible mumbling)

dialogText.cn: 他好像很痛苦……真希望能为他做点什么。
dialogText.en: He seems to be in great pain... I hope there's something we can do for him.

dialogText.cn: 有一周了，我们是从<@qu.key>超域试验场</>外把他救回来的。
dialogText.en: About a week. We rescued him just outside the <@qu.key>Æther Test Site</>.

dialogText.cn: 除了一些小的随身物品，像证件、手套之类……没有什么特别的。
dialogText.en: A few personal belongings, ID card, gloves ... and that sort of stuff. Nothing out of the ordinary.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们先出去吧……
dialogText.en: Endmin, maybe we should leave for a while...

dialogText.cn: 嗯。我……总觉得，自己没有真正帮助到饱受创伤的人们……
dialogText.en: Yeah... I feel like I haven't really helped those who are suffering...

dialogText.cn: 我要是更强大的话……我要是，行动更快一些，更早来到这里……
dialogText.en: Endmin, if only I were stronger ... or faster ... I could have arrived at the Valley sooner...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我决定了——我要去找<@qu.key>过滤装置</>！
dialogText.en: Okay, Endmin. I've made up my mind! I'm gonna look for the <@qu.key>filter</>!

dialogText.cn: 最起码，让我做一点事，总要比无助地等待要好一些。
dialogText.en: You gotta let me do something. I can't just sit around feeling bad and helpless all day.

dialogText.cn: 不对，不能这样垂头丧气的——
dialogText.en: No. That still sounds sad and depressed —

dialogText.cn: 是我想要帮助大家！
dialogText.en: Alright! I'm doing this because I want to help everyone!

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 啊，是管理员，还有洁尔佩塔小姐。
dialogText.en: Ah, it's the Endministrator! And Miss Gilberta.

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 什么？你们要进去？
dialogText.en: Hold on. You're going in?

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 呃……里面很危险的，就连搜救小组都很难进去展开工作。
dialogText.en: For one thing... The site is still quite dangerous. Our rescue teams can hardly carry out their work in there.

dialogText.cn: 可是，我现在必须去找一件重要的装置。
dialogText.en: But I have to go in and find a piece of very important machinery.

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 这……非得进去不可吗？
dialogText.en: If you insist ... but do you really have to go in there?

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 这个……那个……要是连管理员都这么说了的话……
dialogText.en: Yeah ... well ... since the Endmin said so...

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 行吧，我……可以放行！但是，一个小时内必须要从里面出来，不论找到了还是找不到——这是出于安全考虑。
dialogText.en: Fine. I'll grant you passage... But as part of our safety precautions, do not stay in there for more than 60 minutes, even if you fail to find your thing. Nothing personal. Just trying to keep you safe.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我的分析仪可以析取过滤装置中残留的侵蚀提取物，为我们提供大致的方位。这是出发前安德烈交给我的。
dialogText.en: Endmin, my analyzer can detect residual Blight extracts in the filter. This will give us an approximate location of the device. Andre gave me the analyzer before I left for this search.

dialogText.cn: 分析仪指出了几处可能的方位，我这就把数据分享给你。
dialogText.en: The analyzer has identified several potential locations. I'm sending you the data.

dialogText.cn: 唔……我们先就近找找吧！用<@qu.key>扫描</>就可以看到了哦！
dialogText.en: Hmm... I think we should look around this place first. Use the <@qu.key>scanner</>. We should find something!

dialogText.cn: 时间也不早了，我们快来找东西吧！
dialogText.en: It's getting pretty late. Let's find this thing quickly!

dialogText.cn: 就在这里……
dialogText.en: It's here...

dialogText.cn: 裂隙影响了这里的环境，这些岩石浮在了天上……没有人知道它们什么时候才会落下来。工团只能暂时封锁这一带。
dialogText.en: The rift really affected the environment. Look at the floating rocks... No one knows when they will start falling back to the ground. The UWST can only seal this place off for now.

dialogText.cn: 只能期望时间抹去这些创伤了……
dialogText.en: We can only pray that time can heal these wounds...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，越往深处走，侵蚀越严重。也许活跃着很多敌人，一定要当心。
dialogText.en: Oh, Endmin, the Blight seems to get worse the deeper we go. There might be enemies active nearby. We'd better be careful.

dialogText.cn: 可能还有更多敌人藏在附近……管理员，我们得继续往前走！
dialogText.en: More enemies might be hiding nearby... Endmin, we gotta keep going!

dialogText.cn: 哼哼，路上我已经想到了办法……管理员，你先闭上眼睛。
dialogText.en: Hehe. I thought of a clever solution along the way. Alright, Endmin... Close your eyes.

dialogText.cn: 不许偷偷看哦，我会给你一个惊喜！
dialogText.en: Ah-ah. No peeking. I'm giving you a surprise!

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 唔……上一次我们来找保险柜的时候，我看到旁边还散落着一些东西。所以刚才就折返回去，想找到更多的信息。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Remember when we came here and found the safe? I noticed a few things scattered nearby. So, I decided to come back and see if I could find anything else.

dialogText.cn: ……就发现了这个。
dialogText.en: ...And then I found this.

dialogText.cn: 这是过滤装置的主人留下的最后的日记……
dialogText.en: It's the final diary entry, written by the owner of the filter device...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这和之前捡到的日记是同一个人留下的……也就是罗普口中的研究员……
dialogText.en: Yeah. The diary we picked up was from the same person... She's the fellow researcher that Ropp talked about...

dialogText.cn: 这是最后一页……也是用来道别的一页。
dialogText.en: The last entry... She wrote it to say her goodbyes.

dialogText.cn: 和侵蚀相关物质的接触早已影响了她的心智。她从很早开始，就意识到自己的记忆正在逐渐流失……
dialogText.en: Contact with Blighted materials affected her mind. She knew early on that she was gradually losing her memories...

dialogText.cn: 她发现了过滤装置的漏洞，而自己是第一个受其影响的人……
dialogText.en: She found the problem with the filter, and became the first to be affected by it...

dialogText.cn: 为了不让他卷入其中……她选择自己去攻克最后的漏洞。
dialogText.en: She didn't want him to be part of the mistake... And she chose to tackle the final issue on her own.

dialogText.cn: 随身携带的信……保险柜的密码……那一条条提醒自己的日记……这个女孩，独自承受着无助和孤独，也不希望自己遗忘重要的人……
dialogText.en: She carried the letter ... made herself part of the safe's password ... and wrote all those diary entries to help her remember... She suffered helplessness and loneliness on her own. She also didn't want to forget the one she held close to her heart...

dialogText.cn: 看着记录过去的信，慢慢尝试找回曾经的自己。或许故事书中都是这样的，但是……
dialogText.en: Perhaps one can eventually find their story by reading letters about the past. That's how the tales go, but...

dialogText.cn: 但她最后选择了离开……而不是找回过去……
dialogText.en: But in the end, she chose to leave ... instead of seeking her past...

dialogText.cn: 我没有失忆的经历……但，我有时也会害怕……
dialogText.en: I've never felt memory loss before... But the thought of it scares me at times...

dialogText.cn: 当那个女孩看着并不属于“自己”……又像是自己的过往时，她在想什么呢？
dialogText.en: What did she feel or think about when she saw recordings of a past ... that seems foreign yet actually belongs to her?

dialogText.cn: 我很害怕那种……遗忘的感觉，看着那些相近又有所不同，从我身边飞逝而过的记忆……我总会觉得，自己是否弄丢了什么……
dialogText.en: I'm ... afraid of the feeling called oblivion. When I see memories flying past me that feel familiar yet foreign at the same time ... I cannot help but wonder if I've actually lost something...

dialogText.cn: 每当那些回忆涌起，就像是隔着一层黯淡的薄雾……
dialogText.en: Whenever those memories well up within me, I feel as though I am kept away by a dark, misty veil...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，告诉我，失去记忆是一种什么样的感觉呢？
dialogText.en: Endmin, can you tell me how it feels to lose your memories?

dialogText.cn: 是吗……
dialogText.en: Is that so...?

dialogText.cn: 欸？
dialogText.en: Hmm?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我喜欢它们！不光是这些……还有那只属于我自己的回忆，我都好喜欢。
dialogText.en: So ... I really do like those memories! Not only that ... I'm totally in love with the memories that I made on my own.

dialogText.cn: 旅行中的经历，独自飘在夜空中的秘密，还有……和管理员在一起的记忆……
dialogText.en: The memories I made while traveling, the secrets I saw in my solo flights across the night skies, and ... those special moments I shared with you, Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 无论是哪些记忆，我都不想失去它们。
dialogText.en: I don't care which memories they are. I don't want to lose any of them. Ever.

dialogText.cn: 这是我和相遇的人们创造的真切的回忆……
dialogText.en: These are real, authentic memories that I made with the people I've met...

dialogText.cn: 有时候我会想，这个世界上的一切，都像水泡一样，那么容易消失，那么容易破碎……一不留神，你就会把美好的回忆丢掉……
dialogText.en: Sometimes, I feel everything in this world is just so ephemeral and delicate ... like bubbles of water... All it takes is a simple slip to lose those beautiful moments...

dialogText.cn: 但也因此……我会更珍惜这些重要的记忆。人们或许不会记住信使的样子，但我想尽可能记住每一个见过的笑脸。
dialogText.en: But that is also why ... I'll do my best to keep these important memories safe. People might not remember the faces of us messengers, but I'll do all that I can to remember every smile I see.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你还记得这个吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, do you still remember this?

dialogText.cn: 这封信，我想好要寄给谁了。
dialogText.en: Now I know who to send this letter to.

dialogText.cn: 不……从来不会。
dialogText.en: No... They never have.

dialogText.cn: 我喜欢那些记忆。或许它们并不属于我，但每当想起它们时，却又像太阳一样温暖。
dialogText.en: I like those memories. They may not be mine ... but thinking about them makes me feel warm inside, like the sun itself.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，管理员，我不再觉得困惑了……我会把这些记忆，当作珍贵的礼物……无论是哪一边，现在都是属于我的宝藏。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin. I don't feel confused anymore... I'll treat these memories like precious gifts... No matter where they came from, all of them are now mine to treasure.

dialogText.cn: 有些冰冷……陌生……
dialogText.en: {F}It feels cold ... and unfamiliar...{M}It feels cold ... and unfamiliar...

dialogText.cn: 但是，并不令人畏惧。
dialogText.en: {F}But it's nothing to fear.{M}But it's nothing to fear.

dialogText.cn: 因为，有洁尔佩塔，有大家陪在我身边。
dialogText.en: {F}Because I have you with me, Gilberta. And everyone as well.{M}Because I have you with me, Gilberta. And everyone as well.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，其实……如果我没有接住你，是不是也不会出什么问题？
dialogText.en: So, Endmin... If I failed to catch you, would you still be alright?

dialogText.cn: 哼，我就知道。
dialogText.en: Hmph. I knew it.

dialogText.cn: 不过……还是谢谢管理员陪我聊了这么多。
dialogText.en: But ... I'm really happy you spent all this time talking with me.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了管理员，烦恼一扫而空了。
dialogText.en: Hooo. Thanks a lot, Endmin! You swept all my troubles away!

dialogText.cn: 现在已经是管理员的东西了。
dialogText.en: Well, it's yours now, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 虽然还没想好要写什么内容，但我已经决定要把它寄给管理员了。
dialogText.en: Although I couldn't figure out what to write, I've decided to give the letter to you.

dialogText.cn: 当我来到塔卫二时，就带着这样一张空白的信纸。
dialogText.en: I carried this blank letter with me when I first arrived in Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 我一直在想，这是什么……它为什么会出现在我身边，我又要在上面写点什么，要寄给什么人？
dialogText.en: I kept thinking about what it was... Why did it appear with me? What should I write on it? Who should I send it to?

dialogText.cn: 我想，这一定是希望我写上重要的事，将它交给重要的人……
dialogText.en: I once thought the letter probably wanted me to write something very important on it, and send it to someone very important as well...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我有很多想和管理员分享的故事，想发的牢骚，想传达的心情……
dialogText.en: And yes, there are so many stories, so many troubles ... and so many feelings that I wanna share with you, Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 但是……我还没有想好……
dialogText.en: But ... I haven't figured out what exactly to write...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我希望管理员能够收下。
dialogText.en: Of course. I was hoping you'd take it.

dialogText.cn: 等到哪一天，我整理好了心情，找到了想写的内容，我会向管理员要回它，然后正式交给你。
dialogText.en: Perhaps a day will come when I sort out my feelings and know what to write. When that happens, I'll ask you for it and return a proper letter to you.

dialogText.cn: 一封信使洁尔佩塔自己的信。
dialogText.en: And that will be a letter from Gilberta the Messenger herself.

dialogText.cn: 对了，管理员——
dialogText.en: Oh, by the way—

dialogText.cn: 管理员可不要忘记我哦。
dialogText.en: Don't you forget about me, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 不过，就算你忘掉，我也会再次出现在你的面前——
dialogText.en: But even if you did forget, I'll just show up right in front of you.

dialogText.cn: 这个是你的……
dialogText.en: {F}This is your...{M}This is your...

dialogText.cn: 我可以收下吗？
dialogText.en: {F}Can I still keep it?{M}Can I still keep it?

dialogText.cn: 说着“我是信使洁尔佩塔，这是我们第一次见面”，让你再一次认识我。
dialogText.en: Then I'd say: "I'm Messenger Gilberta. This is the first time we've met!" And then we'll get to know each other once again.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这边！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Over here!

dialogText.cn: 刚才我到处打听，听负责人说你们进去找东西了，我好担心啊！
dialogText.en: I was looking all over the place for you! The Monitor told me you went into the place for a salvaging run! I was so worried!

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 欸？看起来，你们是找到了？
dialogText.en: What? It seems you actually found the thing!

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 没想到还真能有人从里面捞出东西来！我对终末地各位的认知，真是每天都在变化……
dialogText.en: I didn't expect anyone to salvage anything from that place! You Endfielders make me more impressed with every passing day...!

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 当然！往好处想，真希望咱们和终末地长久合作下去；往坏处看，真担心我之后跟不上你们前进的脚步了。哈哈哈！
dialogText.en: Of course! Looking at the bright side of things, I really hope our partnership with Endfield continues well into the future. But on the other hand, it won't be long before you simply outpace the UWST and leave us in the dust! Hah!

dialogText.cn: 咦，保险柜上锁了？
dialogText.en: Hmm. The safe is locked.

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 噢，那是合规的做法。工团允许研究员们在紧急时刻封锁和保护重要数据，不过这个保险柜上的划痕……看起来不是刚被遗弃的……
dialogText.en: Oh, it should be locked according to our SOP. The UWST allows its scientists to lock and protect key data in emergency situations. But I'm seeing plenty of scratch marks on the safe... So I believe it's been left behind for quite a while.

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 当然在每个保管设备的人那里。
dialogText.en: The passwords are definitely safe with the crew in charge of protecting the assets.

dialogText.cn: 啊？可是据说，罗普还没醒过来呢……
dialogText.en: Oh? But ... I think Ropp is still ... unconscious...

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 呃……那有点难搞了。
dialogText.en: Ah, yeeeaah... That kinda complicates things.

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 如果找不到密码，我们也可以试图强行破开保险柜，但这样也许会损坏到里面的仪器。
dialogText.en: If we can't get the password, we can try cracking the safe physically. But that might damage the instruments inside.

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 往好处想，咱们工团的设备质量是一等一的，这保险柜从设计之初，就以难以破坏而闻名塔卫二，畅销不绝呢！
dialogText.en: Looking at the bright side of things, UWST products are known for quality. Our safes dominate the market of Talos-II because they are utterly indestructible!

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 呃……总之，还是优先取得密码、安全开柜的计划吧。那……安德烈老兄，先拜托你把这个保险柜带回去吧。
dialogText.en: Erm... Yeah. Well, this means we should get the password to open the safe properly. Alright. Andre my man, I'll let you hold on to our safe for now.

dialogText.cn: 行行行，交给我！
dialogText.en: Alright, my Syndicates friend. I'll keep it safe!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们也先回<@qu.key>医务室</>一趟，看看有什么办法吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin, why don't we head back to the <@qu.key>medical bay</>? We might work something out.
...Mas... Masie...

dialogText.cn: 欸，他好像嘴里在念些什么……再凑近听听看。
dialogText.en: Hmm. I think he's trying to say something... Maybe we should get closer to hear him better.

dialogText.cn: 小美……小美……
dialogText.en: Masie... Masie...

dialogText.cn: 小美？他是在叫“小美”吗？
dialogText.en: Ma ... sie? Is he saying "Masie"?

dialogText.cn: 他昏迷的这几天，嘴里一直在念叨这个名字呢。我们其实也在猜测……“小美”，是一个人名吗？
dialogText.en: He's been unconscious for a few days but he never stopped mumbling this word. We're thinking that "Masie" might be ... a person's name.

dialogText.cn: 啊，对了，今天刚巧是发放物资的时间，有很多工团成员都在这附近！
dialogText.en: Of course! We're also handing out supplies today. Most of the Syndicates crew should be nearby!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们去碰碰运气吧，万一撞到了罗普的熟人呢？
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's go try our luck and see if we can find someone who knows Ropp!

dialogText.cn: 小美？唔，是罗普叔叔的好朋友吗？
dialogText.en: Masie? Hmm. Is that Uncle Ropp's good friend?

dialogText.cn: 小美？不知道，我还在忙，你去那边打听打听吧。
dialogText.en: Masie? No idea. I'm a little busy right now. Why don't you ask around over there?

dialogText.cn: 从来没听说过“小美”这号人噢……或许是宠物的名字？
dialogText.en: I don't remember seeing someone named Masie... Maybe it's a pet's name?

dialogText.cn: 罗普好像也没有养过什么宠物。他是去年才调职到四号谷地来的，我们还没跟他熟起来呢——是个比较内向的人。
dialogText.en: But Ropp never kept pets either. He was assigned to Valley IV last year and we don't know him very well. The young man really keeps to himself.

dialogText.cn: 然后，就发生了这种事……唉，谁说世上没有“命”呢？
dialogText.en: And then he got hit by the disaster... Fate really has a way of dealing her cards.

dialogText.cn: 我也帮不上什么忙，但那边有一堆从地下实验室那儿抢救回来的<@qu.key>文件</>。罗普这人做研究可勤奋了，你们去翻翻看，说不定有很多他的东西。
dialogText.en: I can't help you much, but we've got a pile of <@qu.key>books and documents</> salvaged from the underground lab. Ropp is a hardworking egghead. Go through his stuff. You might find something.

dialogText.cn: 他倒是和一个外面来的女孩走得很近，那段时间他罕见地没埋头在工作间，而是天天跑来跑去。
dialogText.en: Oh, he seems pretty close to a girl who works outside, though. That's the only time we ever saw him running around outside. Usually, Ropp locks himself inside his workshop.

dialogText.cn: 但那女孩没过多久就从谷地消失了……或许她就是你们要找的“小美”？
dialogText.en: But she seemed to leave the Valley after a while... Perhaps she's the Masie you're looking for.

dialogText.cn: 没见过罗普跟什么人走得近，更别说女孩了。
dialogText.en: Ropp has a girl? Hmm. I've never seen Ropp talking or hanging out with anyone.

dialogText.cn: 啊，不过听说你们在打听罗普的事。我这里有罗普的通讯终端，你们看看能不能用上。
dialogText.en: Wait. Since you're helping out Ropp, I happen to have his comm device right here. See if you can use it.

dialogText.cn: 通讯终端？这么私人的物件……
dialogText.en: Comm device? That's actually ... a very *personal* belonging...

dialogText.cn: 嗐，别把我当那种古怪的老头嘛！我先前在保安室上班，大家伙儿进厂房的时候都会上交终端，统一保管。我这种退休的人，就是被返聘来干这活儿的嘛。
dialogText.en: Hey! I'm not some weird old man! I was part of the Syndicates' security. Everyone who enters the factory area has to deposit their comm devices at the gatehouse. Gotta protect our secrets, you know. And it's an easy job for old, semi-retired boys like me.

dialogText.cn: 我们找找有没有有用的信息吧。
dialogText.en: Alrighty! Let's see if we can find any useful information!

dialogText.cn: 这是罗普丢在野外的终端，有人把它捡了回来，但罗普拒绝收回它，让我自行处理。我总觉得他有一天会改变想法，就一直留在这里。
dialogText.en: Ropp dropped this comm device in the wilderness and someone picked it up. The young lad didn't want to take it back and told me I could keep it. I held it here, since I have a feeling he might change his mind eventually.

dialogText.cn: 失物和收上来还没来得及物归原主的<@qu.key>终端</>，都在那边桌上堆着，你们去找找。
dialogText.en: Try your luck over there. That pile has plenty of lost items and <@qu.key>comm devices</> that people have yet to claim.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有什么头绪吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, found any leads?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，无论如何，我们先试试打开<@qu.key>保险柜</>吧。
dialogText.en: In any case, we should try opening the <@qu.key>safe</>.

dialogText.cn: 但不管怎么看，“小美”这个名字肯定对他有着很重要的意义。
dialogText.en: Well, no matter how we look at this, MASIE definitely means something important to him.

dialogText.cn: 这么一说，我想起来了，罗普这人，好像确实以一心扑在工作上闻名园区呢……
dialogText.en: Oh... Yeah... I suddenly remember Ropp being a well-known workaholic...

dialogText.cn: 试试“小美”这个专利的全称吧。
dialogText.en: Try using MASIE. That's the name of his patent application.

dialogText.cn: 咦？这里面除了过滤装置之外，还有一封信。
dialogText.en: Oh. There's something else besides the filter in the safe. It's a letter.

dialogText.cn: 收件人写着“小美”呢，看来是和罗普有关的信。等他醒来以后，我去交给他吧。
dialogText.en: "MASIE" is the recipient's name. Hmm. I think it has something to do with Ropp. I'll deliver it to him once he comes around.

dialogText.cn: 还是不行……
dialogText.en: No. Not working...

dialogText.cn: 还真对了！
dialogText.en: Woohoo! It worked!

dialogText.cn: 把自己的发明视为亲密爱人这种事也不算奇怪啦，在工团，我们尊重每个工人的私人喜好……
dialogText.en: Naming a patent after a close friend or lover isn't unusual. Ahem. The UWST is known for respecting the personal choices of every crew member...

dialogText.cn: 是这样吗……
dialogText.en: Is that so...?

dialogText.cn: 我在想那些日记……不过，眼下柜子打开了就好！
dialogText.en: I'm still thinking about the diary entries... But hey, at least the safe is finally open!

dialogText.cn: 啊，你们果然在这里。管理员，洁尔佩塔。
dialogText.en: Ah, Endmin and Gilberta! You're really here.

dialogText.cn: 罗普刚刚醒过来了，我听说你们和安德烈在一起，就想来告诉你们。
dialogText.en: Ropp just came out of his coma. I heard that you're with Andre, so ... I came rushing here to tell you the good news.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？那我们先去<@qu.key>医务室</>吧。
dialogText.en: Really? Then let's head to the <@qu.key>medical bay</> right now.

dialogText.cn: 果然……那些痕迹是她留下的……
dialogText.en: Those traces ... she was the one who left them...

dialogText.cn: 我还以为……她被卷入了什么危难之中，早就不在四号谷地了……
dialogText.en: I thought ... she was... I thought ... she was caught up in something dangerous ... and left Valley IV a long time ago...

dialogText.cn: 小美，是你爱人的名字吗？
dialogText.en: Mr. Ropp, is Masie the name of a loved one?

dialogText.cn: 不，她……
dialogText.en: No, she...

dialogText.cn: 她不是谷地的人……有一天，她突然出现了，带着一个没有完成的设备……
dialogText.en: Masie's not from the Valley... But she showed up one day with an incomplete machine...

dialogText.cn: 那是一台装有侵蚀物质的过滤装置……
dialogText.en: It's a filter device containing Blighted materials...

dialogText.cn: 那和我的想法不谋而合……那段时间是我人生中最重要的时光，是我第一次遇到志同道合的人，我们每天在一起研究……
dialogText.en: The device was built on ideas that matched mine... And that was the most important period of my life. It was the first time I met someone who agreed with my approach. We would spend all day studying together...

dialogText.cn: 我们满心沉浸在项目里……我甚至没有去问她的名字……我曾以为能一直这样下去……
dialogText.en: We spent all our waking hours on the project... I didn't even ask her name... I thought those days would last forever...

dialogText.cn: 那为什么……
dialogText.en: So why...

dialogText.cn: 就在过滤装置即将完成时……她突然带着小美不辞而别……
dialogText.en: We were almost done with the filter... But she suddenly took Masie with her and left ... without saying goodbye...

dialogText.cn: 我不相信会发生这样的事，我不认为她是为了这种目的离开的。
dialogText.en: I don't believe it. I refuse to think that she left for that.

dialogText.cn: 我写了很多信……放在了我们常去做实验的地方……但是一直没能有回应……
dialogText.en: I wrote plenty of letters ... and left them where we used to research and work on the project... But I never received any reply...

dialogText.cn: 信……难道是这个吗？这是我们在保险柜里发现的。
dialogText.en: The letter... Is this what you're talking about? We found it in the safe.

dialogText.cn: 是……就是它！我把收件人写成了小美……因为我不知道她的名字……
dialogText.en: This ... this is it! I ... I put down Masie as the recipient's name ... because I don't know what her actual name is.

dialogText.cn: 我们找到保险柜的地方……已经被严重破坏了，碎石因为超域的影响浮在了空中……
dialogText.en: The place where we found the safe ... has been really torn up... We saw huge slabs of rock floating in the sky because of the Æther...

dialogText.cn: ……我不会放弃的，既然她拿到了这封信，那就说明她……我还是很担心她。
dialogText.en: ...I won't give up. If she did receive the letter, it would mean that... I ... I'm just really worried about her.

dialogText.cn: 我要去找她……我想知道她为何不辞而别……
dialogText.en: I'm going to find her... I got to know why she left without telling me...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢二位把信带给了我。
dialogText.en: Thank you for bringing the letter to me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我突然想起了一件事，要去确认一下……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I just remembered something and need to verify it...

dialogText.cn: 她把它取名为小美，其他人都说听上去很可笑……但，我却产生了浓厚的兴趣。
dialogText.en: She called it Masie. Everyone thought it was a funny name, but ... I got really interested in the machine.

dialogText.cn: 身边的同事告诉我，她看重的是这个装置的专利……
dialogText.en: My colleagues told me that she only cared about making the device work and getting it patented...

dialogText.cn: 一定是发生了什么！
dialogText.en: Something else must have happened!

dialogText.cn: 她看到了我的信！但是为什么……
dialogText.en: But this means she... But this also means that she saw my letter! So why did...

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，这下舒服了，水污染的问题也解决了。舒服舒服！
dialogText.en: Ohoho. We got the water contamination issue all figured out! Today's a lovely day!

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地重建，开始往好的方向稳步推进了，多亏了你们终末地的协助啊！
dialogText.en: The reconstruction of Valley IV has made significant progress. Endfield has proved itself to be a most indispensable friend.

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 啊，是管理员来了！这次要不是你和那位信使小姐找到了过滤装置，我们估计还要再延期好几天呢。
dialogText.en: Ah, Endministrator! Without the filtering device you and the lady messenger found, we would be days behind schedule!

actorName.cn: 严肃的负责人{c13-工团负责人}

dialogText.cn: 咦，信使小姐没来吗？等她下次来了，我再当面谢谢她吧！
dialogText.en: Hmm. Where did Miss Gilberta go? I was hoping to thank her in person.

dialogText.cn: 最近做过梦吗？在梦中，你见到了什么？
dialogText.en: Did you have any dreams recently? What did you see in those dreams?

dialogText.cn: 这样吗……
dialogText.en: Is that so...

dialogText.cn: 没关系的，管理员。这片土地与你有很深的关联，你会慢慢感受到的。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Endmin. You have a strong bond to this land. Those feelings will slowly come back.

dialogText.cn: 只要继续我们的旅途，就会遇到更多与你有关的人和事，也许……某一天，丢失的记忆就会回到你身边。
dialogText.en: As we journey on, you will encounter more people and events connected to you. Perhaps a day will come ... when your lost memories return.

dialogText.cn: 一闪而过的火光？那是……
dialogText.en: {F}Hm? A flash of fire...?{M}Hm? A flash of fire...?

dialogText.cn: 那么，深呼吸，闭上眼睛，回想迄今为止的记忆……
dialogText.en: It's okay. Take a deep breath and close your eyes. Try and recall what's happened so far...

dialogText.cn: 协议奇点上的痕迹……是怎么回事？
dialogText.en: {F}Traces on the Protocol Singularity... Something's off.{M}Traces on the Protocol Singularity... Something's off.

dialogText.cn: 这儿不是你该来的地方。
dialogText.en: A place you shouldn't be.

dialogText.cn: 为了安全，你最好马上离开。
dialogText.en: Leave now, for your own good.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？真意外……这里还会有别的闯入者？
dialogText.en: Oh? How unexpected... Another intruder in this place.

dialogText.cn: 迷路了？那不大容易出去，除非你“记得”。
dialogText.en: You're lost? Getting out won't be easy, unless you "remember".

dialogText.cn: 看来你没明白什么意思，那就跟着我走吧。
dialogText.en: You clearly don't understand, do you? Well then, follow me.

dialogText.cn: 看不出来，你还挺能打的。
dialogText.en: You fight well, even though you don't look it.

dialogText.cn: 怪不得。我能感觉得到……遇见你，不会只是巧合。
dialogText.en: No wonder. I can feel that ... meeting you here is no simple coincidence.

dialogText.cn: 除了失去记忆之外……我的脑海里还充满了乱七八糟、不属于自己的经历。
dialogText.en: Not only did I lose my memories ... my mind's filled with experiences that weren't even mine to begin with.

dialogText.cn: 这里是记忆所构成的空间。我们所见到的，都是过往记忆里的东西，通过源石转译形成的。
dialogText.en: This is a place constructed with memories. Everything we see is taken from our memories and transcribed by Originium.

dialogText.cn: 原来叫“协议空间”……那么你呢？也是来寻找记忆的吗？
dialogText.en: "Protocol Space"? That's the name, huh... What about you? Are you here looking for memories too?

dialogText.cn: 遗忘了过去的人，才会来到这里，而你，也是这样的人。
dialogText.en: Only those who forgot their past end up in this place. And you happen to be one of them.

dialogText.cn: 恐怕比这更糟。
dialogText.en: Worse than that.

dialogText.cn: 也包括那些怪物。
dialogText.en: Including those monsters.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，看看这里藏着什么记忆，然后就带你离开。
dialogText.en: Let's move. We'll search around for hidden memories, then I'll take you out of this place.

dialogText.cn: 所以我才想方设法来这儿，搞清楚我来自哪里，到底做了些什么，以及……真正的我，到底是谁。
dialogText.en: So I found a way to come here. I'll figure out where I'm from, what I actually did, and ... who I'm *actually* supposed to be.

dialogText.cn: 要不然呢？我就是追着记忆来的。
dialogText.en: What do you think? I came here chasing after them.

dialogText.cn: 这是我过去的事。那时我一个人跑到雪原深处，寻找被埋葬的真相。
dialogText.en: This is my past. I ran to the middle of an icefield alone in search for buried truths.

dialogText.cn: 对。很久很久，久到像另一段人生里的事情。
dialogText.en: Yes. A very long time ago — it almost felt like someone else's experience.

dialogText.cn: 梦……有时候和记忆挺像的。发生的时候感觉它无比真实，但过了一段时间再去看它……就荒诞得不成样子。
dialogText.en: Dreams... They're like memories at times. Feel almost real while they happen. But when you think back on them later ... you'd realize how ridiculous they are.

dialogText.cn: 继续找吧。
dialogText.en: Let's keep looking.

dialogText.cn: 梦？
dialogText.en: A dream?

dialogText.cn: 在记忆里，我曾用火焰和大剑焚毁了数不清的敌人。
dialogText.en: In those memories, I vanquished countless foes with fire and a greatsword.

dialogText.cn: 不过到底为了什么，敌人是谁，甚至这段记忆是否属于我……
dialogText.en: But why was I fighting? Who were the enemies? And are those memories truly mine...?

dialogText.cn: 都还是未知。
dialogText.en: Everything remains unknown.

dialogText.cn: 又是这段祷文……
dialogText.en: This prayer again...

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Yes.

dialogText.cn: 不同记忆里的“我”……处境、身份、所做的事情，都不一样。
dialogText.en: I have all sorts of memories ... where "I" was in different situations, had different identities, and did different things.

dialogText.cn: 最好不是。
dialogText.en: Hmph. I hope not.

dialogText.cn: 雪原里的战士。我曾和他们一起面对某种超乎常理的东西。
dialogText.en: Warriors of the icefield. I once stood alongside them as we faced something beyond our understanding.

dialogText.cn: 那你经历了什么？
dialogText.en: Oh? Tell me more about it.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。但结果……我记不清了。
dialogText.en: Yes. But ... I couldn't recall the outcomes of that battle.

dialogText.cn: 使命？你的记忆也让我有点好奇了。
dialogText.en: Mission? Your memories are making me curious.

dialogText.cn: 会让捡起它的人拥有强大的力量。
dialogText.en: Those who pick it up will be granted tremendous power.

dialogText.cn: 但最后，它会反过来把持有者烧干。
dialogText.en: But the sword shall burn on until its wielder turns to cinders.

dialogText.cn: 总之，现在它十分安静。
dialogText.en: It's very quiet now, at least.

dialogText.cn: 我也曾遇见这样一把剑……
dialogText.en: I once saw a sword like this...

dialogText.cn: 有点像……但又不像。
dialogText.en: Looks like it ... though not quite.

dialogText.cn: 不过，这不重要。
dialogText.en: Regardless, this isn't important.

dialogText.cn: 在找到自己是谁之前，休想让我停下来。
dialogText.en: Until I find out who I am, there is no stopping me.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 我们又见面了。这一次，你有点慢。
dialogText.en: We meet again. You're actually slower this time.

dialogText.cn: 烦人的家伙，还要来阻止我吗？
dialogText.en: Damn you. Are you trying to stop me again?

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 哦？你的同伴？看来这一次，有点不同。
dialogText.en: Ooh. You've got a companion? This feels rather refreshing.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 别再继续了，这都是为了你好。
dialogText.en: Give up already. This is for your own good.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 那你就继续流浪，直到消亡吧。
dialogText.en: Then enjoy your aimless wandering ... till oblivion takes you.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 还不明白？我并没有在“阻止”你。我会出现在这里，难道不是你自己追寻的结果吗？
dialogText.en: Don't you understand? I'll never try to "stop" you. In fact, isn't my presence here the result you seek?

dialogText.cn: 少来。今天你别想跑掉。
dialogText.en: Enough nonsense. There'll be no escape for you this time.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 那就让你不该找到的东西……消失吧。
dialogText.en: There are things you aren't meant to find... Let them disappear.

dialogText.cn: 别走！
dialogText.en: Stop right there!

dialogText.cn: 那些怪物才没办法伤到我。是旧伤。
dialogText.en: It's an old wound. There's no way those creatures could hurt me.

dialogText.cn: 我会……找到你！
dialogText.en: I will ... find you!

dialogText.cn: 好几次，我已经接近真相……但都被她破坏了。
dialogText.en: There were times when I came close to the truth ... but she had to ruin it all.

dialogText.cn: 追上她。拿回属于我的记忆。
dialogText.en: Chase her down. I must reclaim my memories.

dialogText.cn: 看来我们不应该继续在这里待下去了。总之，刚刚感谢你的协助，管理员。
dialogText.en: Hmm... We shouldn't stay here any longer. In any case, thank you for your assistance, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 很难猜吗？能毫发无伤地进入协议空间，而且对抗天使，身负使命……
dialogText.en: It's not that hard of a guess. I can't think of anyone else who could enter a Protocol Space unscathed, fight Aggeloi, and run a pretty important mission...

dialogText.cn: 遇见你很有趣……
dialogText.en: Meeting you has been fun...

dialogText.cn: 一个总是在阻止我的家伙。
dialogText.en: Someone who's always getting in my way.

dialogText.cn: 我找了很多地方，也落空了很多次。这个“我”，总是在最后出现。
dialogText.en: I've searched many places, but mostly in vain. This version of "me" always shows up at the very end.

dialogText.cn: 再见。
dialogText.en: Until next time.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你没事吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 刚刚发生了什么？
dialogText.en: What just happened?

dialogText.cn: 她是……？
dialogText.en: Who is she...?

dialogText.cn: 这很不寻常……
dialogText.en: That does not sound normal...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……不过仅凭现在的线索……还不足以下结论。
dialogText.en: But I'm afraid we lack enough evidence to reach a proper conclusion.

dialogText.cn: 难道你刚刚进入了协议空间……这也太突然了……
dialogText.en: Did you just enter a Protocol Space...? This is quite unexpected...

dialogText.cn: 我这就去做调查，请等我的消息。
dialogText.en: I'll try to look into this. Wait for my updates.

dialogText.cn: 嗨，管理员！四号谷地最近又发现了一些奇怪的源石反应。而且——
dialogText.en: Hi, Endmin! We recently picked up a few strange Originium reactions across Valley IV. And —

dialogText.cn: 伴随源石反应出现的，还有一些特殊的火光……
dialogText.en: Witness reports also mentioned some form of fire that accompanied those Originium reactions...

dialogText.cn: 咦？管理员，你有头绪吗？
dialogText.en: Wha? Endmin, you have a lead on this?

dialogText.cn: 那就拜托你去查看一下情况吧，我这就把位置坐标同步给你！
dialogText.en: Then perhaps it is best to have you investigate this. I'll sync the coordinates to you.

dialogText.cn: 协议空间的本质是源石内的信息碎片……包含往日记忆的信息，当然也有可能在其中重现。
dialogText.en: The Protocol Space is essentially a data shard within Originium... And if it includes data from past memories, they might be recreated within the Space as well.

dialogText.cn: 但要找某一个特定的人的记忆，无异于大海捞针。
dialogText.en: But finding the memories of a particular person is difficult. It's like hunting for a needle in a haystack.

dialogText.cn: 她来过这儿……这是她的痕迹？
dialogText.en: {F}She's been here... Are these the traces she left behind?{M}She's been here... Are these the traces she left behind?

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 小家伙，你也不想离家太远。
dialogText.en: Alright, little one. I guess you don't wanna leave your home too far behind.

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 那些印象……是真实的童年，还是虚假的童话？
dialogText.en: Are these childhood impressions ... real? Or are they just false fairy tales?

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 但我的家乡呢？
dialogText.en: But ... what about my home?

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 我到底来自哪里？
dialogText.en: Where did I really come from...?

dialogText.cn: 她在找关于家乡的记忆……
dialogText.en: {F}She's looking for memories of home...{M}She's looking for memories of home...

dialogText.cn: 我的童年和家乡……又被埋在哪里？
dialogText.en: {F}My childhood and home... Where are those memories buried?{M}My childhood and home... Where are those memories buried?

dialogText.cn: 成为管理员之前……我是谁？
dialogText.en: {F}Who was I ... before I became the Endministrator?{M}Who was I ... before I became the Endministrator?

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 这些旧闻记录……没什么用。还是不能告诉我“我是谁”。
dialogText.en: These old records ... are useless. They tell me nothing about who "I" am.

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 去别处看看吧。
dialogText.en: Time to look elsewhere.

dialogText.cn: ……她还是没找到记忆。
dialogText.en: {F}She still didn't find her memories...{M}She still didn't find her memories...

dialogText.cn: 不过，“管理员”的身份……足够回答“我是谁”吗？
dialogText.en: {F}But does my role as the "Endministrator" really tell me who I actually am?{M}But does my role as the "Endministrator" really tell me who I actually am?

dialogText.cn: 我又是怎么成为……
dialogText.en: {F}And how did I become...{M}And how did I become...

dialogText.cn: 詹娜、安德烈，还有更多人记忆里那个“管理员”的？
dialogText.en: {F}...the Endministrator that Jenner, Andre, and all those people remember?{M}...the Endministrator that Jenner, Andre, and all those people remember?

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 果然，还得是这个味道。
dialogText.en: Hooo. I really needed that.

actorName.cn: 广播声{c16-收音机的广播声}

dialogText.cn: ……近期，世代摇篮区域的威胁已经清除，但仍然残留异常源石反应……暂时禁止无权限者进入……
dialogText.en: ...threat at the Cradle of the Ages ... eliminated ... residual anomalous Originium reactions ... temporarily close these areas to unauthorized personnel...

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 世代摇篮……
dialogText.en: The Cradle of the Ages...

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 或许在那里，可以再打开一扇通往记忆的门。
dialogText.en: Perhaps another gateway to memories can be created there.

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 线索……断了。
dialogText.en: The trail ... has gone cold.

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 如果一直找不到“家”的方向……
dialogText.en: If I can't find my way "home"...

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 不行，这些烦心事把记忆都搅乱了。先来点冰淇淋吧。
dialogText.en: No. The annoying stuff is messing with my memories. Gotta get myself an ice cream break.

actorName.cn: 红发少女的痕迹{莱万汀}

dialogText.cn: 吃完了？最后一根？唉……如果世界上真有糖果冰淇淋熔炉就好了。
dialogText.en: Wha? I'm down to the last popsicle? Ugh... If only they had a furnace for candy-flavored ice cream.

dialogText.cn: “殆死的摇篮，源石大树的残迹”……难道是世代摇篮？
dialogText.en: {F}"A lifeless cradle, and the ruins of the Great Oak"... This feels like the Cradle of the Ages.{M}"A lifeless cradle, and the ruins of the Great Oak"... This feels like the Cradle of the Ages.

dialogText.cn: 她……已经走了。
dialogText.en: {F}She's ... left.{M}She's ... left.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这些灼痕的报告是我提交的。
dialogText.en: I did. In fact, I was the one who submitted the reports about these markings.

dialogText.cn: 在蚀崖观测站那边发现的。
dialogText.en: I found them at the Blightcliff Observation Post.

dialogText.cn: 值得注意的是，我们还在那里发现了不少天使的残骸……情况还挺惨烈的，像是有一把猛火将它们烧过了一样。
dialogText.en: We also found plenty of Aggelos remains at that place... It must have been a terrifying battle. Someone literally burned those Aggeloi with incredibly hot flames.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，听秦主管说你在找这种灼痕？
dialogText.en: Endmin, Director Qin told me you're looking for this type of burn mark?

dialogText.cn: 这是汇总的数据。
dialogText.en: This is the set of data we collected.

dialogText.cn: 莱万汀！
dialogText.en: {F}Laevatain!{M}Laevatain!

dialogText.cn: 先知会佩丽卡，再向她请求协助吧。
dialogText.en: {F}I should inform Perlica and ask her for help.{M}I should inform Perlica and ask her for help.

dialogText.cn: 这里还是四号谷地……她去哪儿了？
dialogText.en: {F}I'm still in Valley IV... Where did she go?{M}I'm still in Valley IV... Where did she go?

dialogText.cn: 下一个地方……下一个协议空间。
dialogText.en: Next location ... next protocol space.

dialogText.cn: 莱万汀可能走向了歧途。她在协议空间里走得越深，也许不仅无法找到属于她的记忆，还会遇上一些未知的威胁。
dialogText.en: Laevatain may have started on the wrong trail. The further she goes into the Protocol Space, the less likely she is to find her memories. She might even encounter unknown threats.

dialogText.cn: 那么从现在开始，你就是我寻找记忆这条路上的同行者了。
dialogText.en: Very well. From this point forth, you shall be my fellow companion in this journey of memory search.

dialogText.cn: 在这条路上，我会帮你寻找失去的记忆。这是我作为同伴的承诺。
dialogText.en: As your companion, I shall help you find your lost memories. Consider this a promise.

dialogText.cn: 这会对她造成越来越深的伤害。
dialogText.en: Her injuries will only get worse with each attempt.

dialogText.cn: 不能放下她不管，得想办法找到她。
dialogText.en: {F}I can't just leave her alone. Gotta find her quickly.{M}I can't just leave her alone. Gotta find her quickly.

dialogText.cn: （痛苦的表情）
dialogText.en: *Painful emote*

dialogText.cn: 千万注意安全啊，别再把我的宝贝小车搞坏了！
dialogText.en: So, play it safe, okay? Don't break my baby bot again!

dialogText.cn: 不对……
dialogText.en: {F}Wait... Something's wrong...{M}Wait... Something's wrong...

dialogText.cn: 这也是假象吗？
dialogText.en: This is a falsehood?

dialogText.cn: 没想到管理员真回来了。
dialogText.en: I didn't expect the Endmin to be back.

dialogText.cn: 已经很多年没见到种下大树的那个人了。但……
dialogText.en: I haven't seen the planter of the Great Oak for many years. But...

dialogText.cn: 管理员忘记了那么多事情，能力也还没有恢复……还能继续领导我们吗？
dialogText.en: Having lost so many memories and powers, I don't know if the Endmin can continue to lead us...

dialogText.cn: 管理员已经不是当初那个拯救我们的人了。或许就不该指望救世主会出现两次……
dialogText.en: The Endmin is no longer the hero who saved us. Perhaps it is wrong to expect the savior to appear twice...

dialogText.cn: 他们信任的……不是我……
dialogText.en: {F}They don't trust me...{M}They don't trust me...
Hmph...

dialogText.cn: 没想到你还挺多愁善感的，管理员。
dialogText.en: Quite the sensitive soul, aren't you?
{F}But...{M}But...

dialogText.cn: 罗丹？
dialogText.en: {F}Rhodagn?{M}Rhodagn?

actorName.cn: 难民的幻影{c16-难民的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 救命……终末地会出现吗……
dialogText.en: Help...! Will Endfield come and save us...?

actorName.cn: 工团成员的幻影{c16-工团成员的幻影A}
actorName.en: Illusion of a UWST Crew Mate {c16-Illusion of UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 快去找管理员……
dialogText.en: We must call the Endmin...

dialogText.cn: {F}垃圾，尽管叫唤吧！她不会再来了！{M}垃圾，尽管叫唤吧！他不会再来了！
dialogText.en: {F}Trash! Scream all you want! She'll never come!{M}Trash! Scream all you want! He'll never come!

dialogText.cn: 谁都别想逃！都烧成灰！
dialogText.en: No one leaves here alive! I'm burning you all to cindahhh!

dialogText.cn: 住手！
dialogText.en: {F}Stop right there!{M}Stop right there!

dialogText.cn: 为了头领！
dialogText.en: For the boss!

dialogText.cn: 怎么可能……我明明已经打败过他了……
dialogText.en: {F}How is this possible...? I've defeated him already...{M}How is this possible...? I've defeated him already...

dialogText.cn: 那就先让这里安静下来。
dialogText.en: Then we just silence him again.

dialogText.cn: ……莱万汀？！
dialogText.en: {F}...Laevatain?!{M}...Laevatain?!

dialogText.cn: 你们的“救世主”，杀不死我！
dialogText.en: YOUR "SAVIOR" CANNOT KILL ME!

dialogText.cn: 又见面了，管理员。没想到在半路上还能撞见你。
dialogText.en: We meet again, Endmin. I wasn't expecting to run into you here.

dialogText.cn: 我也想问。这个大块头显然和我没有关系。
dialogText.en: Took the question out of my mouth. I had nothing to do with that big, noisy dude.

dialogText.cn: 所以，刚经历的事情，你就记不清了？
dialogText.en: So you couldn't remember what just happened?

dialogText.cn: 记忆可不总是真的。
dialogText.en: Memories aren't always true.

dialogText.cn: 有时候，它会被虚假的幻影代替。在这里可有不少假的记忆。
dialogText.en: Sometimes they are replaced by deceptive illusions. And this place has plenty of false memories.

dialogText.cn: 忘了吗？我还要找到那个夺走了我记忆的影子。
dialogText.en: Don't you remember? I'm after the shadow that took my memories.

dialogText.cn: 这些扭曲的怪物，正是由你的记忆而生。现在你还没法辨明真假，这很危险。
dialogText.en: These twisted beings are created from your memories. And since you don't know how to tell the truth apart yet, things can get pretty dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 看来你也已经知道我的身份了。
dialogText.en: Seems like you've learned of my identity.

dialogText.cn: 你还是第一个能做到这种事的。
dialogText.en: You're the first person who managed to pull that off.

dialogText.cn: 那么从现在开始，你就是我寻找记忆这条路上的同行者了。
dialogText.en: Very well. From this point forth, you shall be my fellow companion in this journey of memory search.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。难道你不想找到记忆？
dialogText.en: Mmhmm. Don't you want to find your memories?

dialogText.cn: 不过我要纠正你一点，不是“了解自己的记忆”，而是“了解失去记忆的自己”才对。
dialogText.en: But I gotta correct you on something. This isn't about "understanding your memories". It's more like "understanding your amnesiac self".

dialogText.cn: 这是……我的……？
dialogText.en: {F}Is that ... my...?{M}Is that ... my...?

dialogText.cn: 你“自己的记忆”。
dialogText.en: "Memory of your own."

dialogText.cn: 总之，先跟着我走吧。
dialogText.en: Anyway, you better stay with me.

dialogText.cn: 你对我感兴趣，难道不是因为在你内心深处，对自己的记忆也充满好奇和渴望吗？
dialogText.en: Interested in me, huh? But isn't that because, deep down, you're curious and hopeful about finding your own memories?
{F}Well...{M}Well...

dialogText.cn: 那两个人……是你的朋友？
dialogText.en: Are those two ... friends of yours?

dialogText.cn: 这让你感到很担心？
dialogText.en: And does that make you worried?

dialogText.cn: 你……有和别人说过这些想法吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm... Then did you ever share these thoughts with others?

dialogText.cn: 我怕佩丽卡、陈……我怕更多人会因为我而失望，动摇。
dialogText.en: {F}I'm afraid that Perlica, Chen ... and many others would be disappointed and lose faith because of my failings.{M}I'm afraid that Perlica, Chen ... and many others would be disappointed and lose faith because of my failings.

dialogText.cn: 我怕聂菲斯会更加肆无忌惮。
dialogText.en: {F}I'm afraid that Nefarith will be emboldened by my weakness.{M}I'm afraid that Nefarith will be emboldened by my weakness.

dialogText.cn: 所以你一直在“扮演”一个强大而又坚定的管理员……哪怕连你自己都不确定自己是谁。
dialogText.en: That's why you kept "playing" the role of a powerful and resolute Endministrator... Even though you've got no idea who you actually are.

dialogText.cn: 是啊……我自己都不确定自己是谁。
dialogText.en: {F}Yeah... I don't even know who I actually am.{M}Yeah... I don't even know who I actually am.

dialogText.cn: ……这已经很了不起了。
dialogText.en: You're doing a pretty good job already.

dialogText.cn: 我可以告诉你，我也一直都在害怕——害怕无法知道自己是谁。
dialogText.en: I'll be honest with you. I've been dealing with the same issue. I'm afraid I won't know who I really am.

dialogText.cn: 我有火焰、一把剑，还有这个名字……可我没有记忆，没有故事，也没有过去。
dialogText.en: I have the fire, a sword, and a name... However, I have no memories, no stories, and no past to speak of.

dialogText.cn: 我害怕自己拥有的只是“莱万汀”的名字，而实际上……却是一具空壳，什么都不是。
dialogText.en: I'm afraid that the only thing I have is the name "Laevatain", and beyond that ... I have nothing. I am nothing but an empty shell.

dialogText.cn: “空壳”……或许，我也是一样的。
dialogText.en: {F}An "empty shell"... Maybe I'm the same thing.{M}An "empty shell"... Maybe I'm the same thing.

dialogText.cn: 别这么想！和为了使命而努力的你比起来——
dialogText.en: No, you're different! You have a mission and you fight for it, while I —

dialogText.cn: 我们到底在比什么……失忆大赛？
dialogText.en: Heh! This feels like we're competing for... the title of Chief Amnesiac.

dialogText.cn: 两个同样失去记忆的人，还在相互安慰，为对方担心。听上去可真够惨的。
dialogText.en: Two souls with lost memories, getting worried and trying to make the other feel better. Can't think of a sadder story than this.

dialogText.cn: 因此我们才是同行者，对吧？
dialogText.en: That's why we're fellow companions, right?

dialogText.cn: 那么同行者，该看看答案是什么了。
dialogText.en: So, my fellow companion. Time to finally reveal the answer.

dialogText.cn: 担心……？
dialogText.en: Why's that...?

dialogText.cn: 这就是塔塔？
dialogText.en: So this is Tata?

dialogText.cn: 跟着痕迹，继续吧。
dialogText.en: Let's keep moving. Follow the trail.

dialogText.cn: 所以这景象……其实是你内心害怕的事情。
dialogText.en: So what we're seeing here ... is a reflection of your inner fears.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我还以为肩负文明环带安危的管理员，一定是坚定如铁的人。
dialogText.en: Hmph... And I thought the Endministrator, guardian of the Civilization Band, would be someone with ironclad resolution.

dialogText.cn: 没想到……
dialogText.en: The real one turned out...

dialogText.cn: 我可没有。
dialogText.en: I totally did not do that.

dialogText.cn: 只是感觉你没那么陌生了，不如说，其实还有点……
dialogText.en: I just felt you're no longer that distant or unfamiliar anymore. In fact, I can even say you're actually quite...

dialogText.cn: 算了，别太在意。再说了，谁的心底都会有害怕发生的事情。
dialogText.en: Whatevs. It's nothing to be concerned about. Everyone's scared of something.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？你觉得我像个没有情感的人吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm? Do I look like someone without emotions?

dialogText.cn: 没想到你也会有害怕的事情……害怕搞砸使命。
dialogText.en: A worrisome soul, afraid of something... You fear failing your mission.

dialogText.cn: 我种下这棵树，是为了延续生命与文明……
dialogText.en: {F}I planted this Oak to secure the continuation of life and civilization...{M}I planted this Oak to secure the continuation of life and civilization...

dialogText.cn: 为了拯救垂死的新家园……
dialogText.en: {F}...to rescue your new homes from the brink of death...{M}...to rescue your new homes from the brink of death...

dialogText.cn: 为了铺就通往未来的道路……
dialogText.en: {F}...to pave a path that leads to the future...{M}...to pave a path that leads to the future...

dialogText.cn: 可长久以来，正义、良善，都一无所获……我一无所获。
dialogText.en: {F}Though years have passed, I remain bereft of my due... The seeds of justice and benevolence yielded nothing...{M}Though years have passed, I remain bereft of my due... The seeds of justice and benevolence yielded nothing...

dialogText.cn: 除了你们与生俱来的贪婪、暴虐，还有挥之不去的嫉妒和憎恨……
dialogText.en: {F}...nothing save your base instincts of greed and malice, and your perpetual propensity for envy and hatred...{M}...nothing save your base instincts of greed and malice, and your perpetual propensity for envy and hatred...

actorName.cn: 工团成员的幻影{c16-工团成员的幻影A}
actorName.en: Illusion of a UWST Crew Mate {c16-Illusion of UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 我们错了……
dialogText.en: We have sinned...

dialogText.cn: 你以前是这种性格？
dialogText.en: Eww. That's the old you?

dialogText.cn: 我凭什么要拯救你们？
dialogText.en: {F}And why do you deserve the salvation I bring?{M}And why do you deserve the salvation I bring?

dialogText.cn: 看来你还没有准备好……
dialogText.en: Seems like you're not ready for this...

dialogText.cn: 给我们一个机会……
dialogText.en: Just give us a chance...

dialogText.cn: 你还是救世主吗？……希望……消失了……
dialogText.en: Are you still the savior? Have we lost ... all hope?

dialogText.cn: 赎罪吧！
dialogText.en: {F}Pay for your sins!{M}Pay for your sins!

dialogText.cn: 我的过去……究竟是……
dialogText.en: {F}What was my past ... actually like...?{M}What was my past ... actually like...?

dialogText.cn: 救救我们！……带我们逃离梦魇！
dialogText.en: Deliver us...! Help us escape this nightmare!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，刚才我迟疑了。
dialogText.en: {F}Hoo... Sorry. I hesitated a bit.{M}Hoo... Sorry. I hesitated a bit.

dialogText.cn: 对我们而言，面对过去……是挺难的，别太怪自己。
dialogText.en: For people like us, facing the past can be ... quite a challenge. Don't blame yourself too much.

dialogText.cn: 你最后还是辨别出来了。
dialogText.en: You figured it out at the last moment.

dialogText.cn: 呵，那倒也是。换作我，也会讨厌那个自命不凡的“救世主”。
dialogText.en: Hur. That's true. I would have hated that "almighty savior" and that stupid speech.

dialogText.cn: 你还是现在这样更好。
dialogText.en: I'd rather have you like this.

dialogText.cn: 可我还是有一个问题……现在的我，到底算不算是真正的“管理员”？
dialogText.en: {F}Thanks, but I still have one question... Does this version of me ... count as the true "Endministrator"?{M}Thanks, but I still have one question... Does this version of me ... count as the true "Endministrator"?

dialogText.cn: 那我也有一个问题……我是谁？
dialogText.en: Then I got another question in return... Who am I?

dialogText.cn: 我先问的……
dialogText.en: {F}I asked first...{M}I asked first...

dialogText.cn: 我、是、谁？
dialogText.en: Who. Am. I?

dialogText.cn: 莱万汀……
dialogText.en: {F}Alright... Laevatain...{M}Alright... Laevatain...

dialogText.cn: 再旅者？
dialogText.en: Reconvener?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，你是史尔特尔的……
dialogText.en: {F}Yes. You are Surtr's...{M}Yes. You are Surtr's...

dialogText.cn: 史尔特尔……她留给我的……只有乱七八糟的记忆。
dialogText.en: Surtr... She left me nothing ... but a jumbled heap of memories.

dialogText.cn: 其他再旅者可以从记忆里知道自己“可以”是谁，又“应该”做什么，但我……只记得各种虚假的往事。
dialogText.en: Other reconveners, with their memories, know who they "could" be, what they "should" do. But I got nothing ... except delusional memories.

dialogText.cn: 活像个在大海里渴死的人，眼前明明都是水，却没有一滴可以喝。
dialogText.en: Like someone stranded at sea, parched. Got water everywhere, but none of it quenches your thirst.

dialogText.cn: 你这次一醒来，就被叫作“管理员”，然后卷入了各种事情，我猜得对吧？
dialogText.en: I guess they woke you up, said you are their "Endmin", then instantly got you in all sorts of mess, right?

dialogText.cn: 就像是一直在追赶另一个人。
dialogText.en: {F}It really feels like I'm trying to become someone else.{M}It really feels like I'm trying to become someone else.

dialogText.cn: 追赶着另一个自己。
dialogText.en: Yet that someone else is but yourself.
{F}Yeah...{M}Yeah...

dialogText.cn: 一边被过去困着，一边又拼命想从中逃出来？
dialogText.en: Getting trapped by the past ... and doing everything you can to break out of it.

dialogText.cn: 我也和你一样。所以，史尔特尔没有告诉我的答案，我就自己去找。
dialogText.en: I got the same problems. So, since Surtr didn't give me an answer, I decided to look for it myself.

dialogText.cn: 如果你也还疑惑的话，那就去找回失去的记忆……看看真正的管理员是什么样子。
dialogText.en: If you're confused, then just look around for the lost memories... Then you can see what the true Endmin was like.

dialogText.cn: 记忆……有这么容易就找到吗？
dialogText.en: {F}Memories... Can they be found that easily?{M}Memories... Can they be found that easily?

dialogText.cn: 如果两个人一起的话，也许就没那么难了。
dialogText.en: If the two of us work together, the search might be a little easier.

dialogText.cn: ……一起？
dialogText.en: {F}Together...?{M}Together...?

dialogText.cn: 在这条路上，我会帮你寻找失去的记忆。这是我作为同伴的承诺。
dialogText.en: As your companion, I shall help you find your lost memories. Consider this a promise.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，那你呢？
dialogText.en: So, Endmin, have anything to say to that?

dialogText.cn: 接着要去哪里？
dialogText.en: {F}Where are we going next?{M}Where are we going next?

dialogText.cn: 下一个地方……下一个协议空间。既然有你在，我们说不定真的能找到些什么。
dialogText.en: Next location ... next Protocol Space. Since you're around, we'll probably end up finding something for once.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，走吧。
dialogText.en: {F}Okay, then. Let's go.{M}Okay, then. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 没错！不久前我送货到源石实验园区……
dialogText.en: Yes, I did! I recently made a delivery to the Originium Science Park...

dialogText.cn: 半路上车抛锚了，中了裂地者的埋伏。
dialogText.en: But my car broke down halfway and the Landbreakers ambushed me.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了那姑娘及时出现，硬生生把裂地者的斧子都斩断了。
dialogText.en: Thankfully that fine lady appeared. She literally slashed right through the Landbreakers' axes.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您找我？
dialogText.en: Looking for me, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 这是那天留下的记录。
dialogText.en: Here is the record from that day.

dialogText.cn: 我记得她……
dialogText.en: I remember her...

dialogText.cn: 那一次我被借调去采石场帮忙，结果没拿准爆破当量，和一群工人被塌方困住了。
dialogText.en: I got a temporary assignment at the Quarry. I, uh, miscalculated the explosive payload. I was in a shaft with a mining crew, and we got trapped by falling rocks.

dialogText.cn: 他们前脚都开始写遗书了，结果后脚洞口的石头就被劈开了。
dialogText.en: Everyone got really depressed and began writing their wills. Lucky for us, the huge stone blocking the exit was cut right in half.

dialogText.cn: 就是那个红发女孩，不会错的。
dialogText.en: That must've been the work of your red-haired girl. No mistake about that.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你想打听什么？
dialogText.en: Ooh, Endmin. You wanna talk?

dialogText.cn: 喏，这是当时的报告。
dialogText.en: Here. The report of that incident.

dialogText.cn: 这里就是帝江号……
dialogText.en: So this is Dijiang...

dialogText.cn: 带我去记忆迷宫里见过的地方。
dialogText.en: Show me the places we saw in that maze.

dialogText.cn: 果然和罗德岛很不一样。
dialogText.en: It's quite different from Rhodes Island.

dialogText.cn: 很好。
dialogText.en: Excellent.

dialogText.cn: 作为一个新的开始。
dialogText.en: Yes. For a new beginning.

dialogText.cn: 从今以后……
dialogText.en: From now on...

dialogText.cn: 以莱万汀的身份，履行对同伴的承诺。
dialogText.en: I shall be Laevatain, and fulfill the promise made to my fellow companion.

dialogText.cn: 我知道。所以你得为我创造记忆。
dialogText.en: I know. So you gotta make new memories for me.

dialogText.cn: 我可以成为你的干员，你的剑，你的火焰。
dialogText.en: I can be your operator, your sword, and your fire.

dialogText.cn: 但要给我独一无二的游历、独一无二的冒险，和独一无二的“家”。
dialogText.en: But in return, I demand a unique journey ... a unique adventure and ... a unique "home".

dialogText.cn: 这样我就有属于我自己的终末地了。
dialogText.en: That will give me an Endfield of my own.

dialogText.cn: 那个可以让我忘却回忆的地方。
dialogText.en: A place where I can forget about my memories.

dialogText.cn: 怎么？为难了？
dialogText.en: What. That's too much for you?

dialogText.cn: 这里不会让你失望的，莱万汀。
dialogText.en: {F}This place won't disappoint you, Laevatain.{M}This place won't disappoint you, Laevatain.

dialogText.cn: 我也不会让你失望的，管理员。
dialogText.en: Neither will I disappoint you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你回来了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're back.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请保护好莱万汀，把她带回来。但更重要的是……你也一定要平安归来。
dialogText.en: Please keep Laevatain safe and bring her back here. Most importantly ... make sure you return safely as well, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 要进入协议空间里寻找莱万汀……理论上可行，但也有风险。以你现在的身体情况……我有些担心……
dialogText.en: Finding Laevatain in the Protocol Space is ... theoretically feasible, but risky too. Your physical condition ... has got me a little concerned...

dialogText.cn: 刚才我和菲奥娜已经把方案准备好了。
dialogText.en: Understood. Fiona and I just completed a plan.

dialogText.cn: 简单来说，莱万汀所做的，是寻找合适的“缝隙”，以记忆为线索强行进入对应的协议空间。
dialogText.en: Simply put, Laevatain would have looked for a suitable rift "opening". Then, by using memories as a clue, she would have forcibly entered the matching Protocol Space.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地近期的超域活动给了她机会，也因此与管理员你建立了联系。
dialogText.en: The recent Æther activities of Valley IV gave her an opportunity. This is why she got in touch with you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 以相同的方法……就是通过协议奇点和你的能力。你可以循着莱万汀的源石反应痕迹，来定位她所在的协议空间。
dialogText.en: We can use the same method ... with the Protocol Singularity and your abilities. By following traces of Laevatain's Originium reactions, you can locate the Protocol Space she went to.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。无论是协议空间还是再旅者，都和你有千丝万缕的联系。只要你耐心去找，应该不难找到。
dialogText.en: Yes. Both the Protocol Space and reconveners are somehow related to you. Your thorough search is definitely going to help us locate her.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们已经将莱万汀的源石反应参数分析完毕，你随时可以出发！
dialogText.en: Endmin! We finished analyzing the parameters of Laevatain's Originium reactions. You're good to go, anytime!

dialogText.cn: 管理员……你来了。没让我等太久。
dialogText.en: You're here ... Endmin. Didn't keep me waiting for too long.

dialogText.cn: 没什么，只不过来这儿之前跋涉了一段路。
dialogText.en: It's nothing. Just walked a long way before coming here.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，看来我们不该在这里久留。
dialogText.en: Let's go. I don't think we should stay here.

dialogText.cn: 还差得远。不过，我不会停下。你呢？
dialogText.en: Found nothing so far. But that wouldn't stop me. What about you?

dialogText.cn: 那就像我们约定过的那样，一起寻找记忆吧。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Then we should make good on our promise, and start our memory search together.

dialogText.cn: 一言为定。
dialogText.en: Then it's a deal.

dialogText.cn: 这里是……
dialogText.en: What is this place...?

dialogText.cn: 这就是“家”……即使忘记了，也有人迎你回去的地方。
dialogText.en: "Home"... A place welcoming you back, even when you've forgotten about it...

dialogText.cn: 可我的记忆里始终未曾找到……
dialogText.en: But I found none of this in my memories...

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 难为管理员了，陪着你到处过家家。
dialogText.en: Awww, poor Endmin, forced to tag along with your shenanigans.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 深入协议空间这么久，还是一无所获。
dialogText.en: After all this diving in the Protocol Space, you still ended up with nothing.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 还不明白吗，莱万汀？你的快乐是假的，仇恨也是假的。就连追寻的目标本身……也是假的。
dialogText.en: Don't you understand, Laevatain? Your happiness is false. Your hatred is false. Even the thing you've been searching for ... is false.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 这就是你永远找不到“家”的缘由。因为你只是一具徒有其形的空壳！
dialogText.en: This is why you'll never find "home" — you're just an empty shell, a pretty husk without a soul!

dialogText.cn: ……空壳？
dialogText.en: An empty shell...?

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 史尔特尔的过去……与你何干？
dialogText.en: The past of Surtr ... isn't your concern.

dialogText.cn: 莱万汀！你怎么样？
dialogText.en: {F}Laevatain! Are you alright?{M}Laevatain! Are you alright?

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 我从未与你为敌，是你一直在伤害你自己。我只是让你免于被自己所追寻的东西毁灭。
dialogText.en: I've never opposed you. You're the one who keeps hurting yourself. I'm only trying to protect you — what you're seeking will destroy you.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 从你开始质疑自己是谁，对记忆产生渴望的那一天开始，我就存在了。
dialogText.en: Since you started doubting who you are and longing for your memories, I have existed.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 你不可能找到自己未曾拥有的东西，这就是你的命运。你只能抛弃自我，作为一个工具而活着。
dialogText.en: You'll never find something that you *never* owned. Such is your fate. You can only abandon your self, and live on as a mere tool.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 放弃吧，为什么不在这么多碎片中随便挑一个，就当是自己的？
dialogText.en: Give up. Why not stop resisting and just take one of these fragments ... and treat it as yours?

dialogText.cn: 说什么胡话……我怎么会放弃……
dialogText.en: What a load of ... crock... Give up? Pfft...

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 那就看看，当你抵达史尔特尔的“家乡”之后，又能得到什么呢？
dialogText.en: Well then, let's see what you can walk away with ... after you reach Surtr's "home".

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 既然你一定要坚持，那我就放你走上自我毁灭之路。去卡兹戴尔吧，去她的家乡。
dialogText.en: Since you insist so stubbornly and foolishly, I'll let you take the path of self-destruction. Go to Kazdel. Go to her home.

dialogText.cn: 那就让我拿回自己的记忆！
dialogText.en: Then it's time to reclaim my memories!

dialogText.cn: 你究竟为什么……与我为敌？
dialogText.en: Why? Why are you ... going against me?

dialogText.cn: 原来这孩子叫阿吉。
dialogText.en: Ginny? Is that the name of this child?

dialogText.cn: 风很软……草地很安静……我在那里小憩。
dialogText.en: Where the wind was soft ... and the meadows were quiet... I took my naps at that place.

dialogText.cn: 漂亮姐姐，你喜欢哪朵花？可以送你！
dialogText.en: Hi, pretty lady. What flowers do you like? Just take them!

dialogText.cn: 来和我一起玩吧！还可以拿花瓣做颜料，把大家都画下来！
dialogText.en: Come play with me! We can make colors from the petals and draw everyone!

dialogText.cn: 喜欢鲜花吗？
dialogText.en: Do you like flowers?

dialogText.cn: 花瓣吹到我脸上，带着淡淡的香气。
dialogText.en: Petals brushed against my face, carrying a subtle fragrance.

dialogText.cn: 讽刺的是，这是众多不属于我的记忆碎片之一。
dialogText.en: Ironically, this is just one of the many fragments that do not belong to me.

dialogText.cn: 却也是我脑海中仅有的几段美好回忆之一。
dialogText.en: Yet, it is also one of the very few beautiful memories carried within my mind.

dialogText.cn: 那，你也见过让人快乐的花丛吗？
dialogText.en: So, have you seen flowers that make you happy?

dialogText.cn: 不算哦！那里一朵花都没有！
dialogText.en: That doesn't count! That place has no flowers!

dialogText.cn: 不对，那里只有可怕的裂地者！
dialogText.en: No! Only scary pipefaced people live there!

dialogText.cn: 这样啊……这也能算是你自己的快乐吗？
dialogText.en: Hmmm... Would you consider that your own happiness?

dialogText.cn: 别灰心，再找找吧！
dialogText.en: Don't give up! Keep looking around!

dialogText.cn: 谢……谢谢。
dialogText.en: Ah ... thank you.

dialogText.cn: 花……我想起了一段……没有火，没有战斗，剑也不在身边的时光。
dialogText.en: Flowers... I remember something ... a time when there was no fire, nor battles, nor a sword by my side.

dialogText.cn: 那是记忆里最无忧无虑的时光。
dialogText.en: It was the most idyllic moment I remember.

dialogText.cn: 这是你的敌人？
dialogText.en: Is this your enemy?

dialogText.cn: 敌人……我记忆里有很多敌人。
dialogText.en: Enemies... My memories have plenty of enemies.

dialogText.cn: *咕哝*
dialogText.en: *Mumbles*

dialogText.cn: ……或许吧。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Perhaps...

dialogText.cn: 所谓的“管理员”，你为什么要与我们为敌？
dialogText.en: You! "END-MINI-STRATOR", huh? Why treat us as your enemy?

dialogText.cn: 还沉睡在谎言的迷梦中吗？我们会埋葬你，“救世主”！
dialogText.en: Still dreamin' about your lies? We will bury you, "SAVIOR"!

dialogText.cn: 帮助只是欺骗！是欺骗！你只是借此安慰同样失去记忆的自己。
dialogText.en: HELP?! Lies! ALL LIES! An excuse to make your forgetful self feel better!

dialogText.cn: *咕哝*！傀儡！源石的旧世界，早就完了！未来属于超域！
dialogText.en: *Mumble*! Puppet! The old world of Originium is finished! The future is in the Æther!

dialogText.cn: 你们……都是徒劳的挣扎！
dialogText.en: You... Your struggles are useless!

dialogText.cn: 马上干掉你！
dialogText.en: I'LL KILL YA!

dialogText.cn: 闭嘴，除非你想马上被烧成灰。
dialogText.en: Zip it, or I'm burning you to ash, right now.

dialogText.cn: 我体会到的，都是被灌输的愤怒、耻辱、狂躁……
dialogText.en: All I felt were instilled fury, shame, frustration...

dialogText.cn: 这个地方……
dialogText.en: {F}This place...{M}This place...

dialogText.cn: 有你眼熟的东西吗？
dialogText.en: See anything familiar?

dialogText.cn: 那就看看这里都有些什么吧。
dialogText.en: Then let's look around and see what they have.

dialogText.cn: 我知道……但比起记忆的残缺，躯体的损伤简直不值一提。
dialogText.en: I know... But an injured body is hardly a concern when compared with broken memories.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，那就一起前进吧。
dialogText.en: Indeed. We shall press forward together.

dialogText.cn: 比起什么事到如今才出现的线索，只要不回头，再多走几步……
dialogText.en: I never dwell on a clue that came too late. I just keep going and never turn back...

dialogText.cn: 或许就能看到真正的自己……
dialogText.en: That's how I'll find my true self...

dialogText.cn: 而且我的直觉告诉我，我一直在寻找的答案就在这里……
dialogText.en: Instincts tell me that the answers I seek can be found here...

dialogText.cn: 那个她……有什么样的色彩？
dialogText.en: She...? Tell me about her colors and shades.

dialogText.cn: 没有这样的人。我只记得萨米雪后湛蓝的晴空。
dialogText.en: There isn't anyone with that color. I only remember the spotless blue skies of Sami after snow.

dialogText.cn: 没见过。我只记得融冰灌溉的绿色嫩芽。
dialogText.en: Never seen that before. I only remember tender green shoots watered by snowmelt.

dialogText.cn: 没错。是她……带着和战火一样的颜色，穿过我们中间。
dialogText.en: Oh, I know. It's her... She brought the war-like hues and walked amongst us.

dialogText.cn: 往前走，追上她吧。
dialogText.en: Go forth and catch up to her.

dialogText.cn: 你在看什么？
dialogText.en: What are you looking at?

dialogText.cn: 你要寻找的人……叫什么名字？
dialogText.en: And what is the name of this ... someone you're looking for?

dialogText.cn: 带着这个名字的来客……在废墟中留下叹息，匆匆而过。
dialogText.en: A visitor bearing this name ... left the ruins in a hurry, and gave nothing but a sigh.

dialogText.cn: 不是她。这个存在早就不属于这里了。
dialogText.en: That's not her. The entity no longer belongs to this place.

dialogText.cn: 你想要认识你自己……但来错了地方。
dialogText.en: I'm afraid this is the wrong place ... to learn about yourself.

dialogText.cn: 追上去吧，小心脚下的深渊。
dialogText.en: Go catch up to her, but watch the deep beneath your feet.

dialogText.cn: 陌生人，你在找什么？
dialogText.en: I don't recognize you. What brings you here?

dialogText.cn: 带着火焰的少女……为了什么而来到这里？
dialogText.en: The girl bearing fire... Why is she here?

dialogText.cn: 不，她甚至愿意为了求索而伤害自己的生命。
dialogText.en: No. She's more than willing to harm herself in her own pursuits.

dialogText.cn: 就是她。她向每一个人打听，是否见过与自己容貌相同的少女。
dialogText.en: That's her. And she's asking everyone if they had seen a girl with her likeness.

dialogText.cn: 好好想想吧，仇恨对她不重要，“自我”才重要。
dialogText.en: Think about it. She cares little about hatred. "Her identity" is what matters to her most.

dialogText.cn: 去她家做客吧。但要快，她已经很累了。
dialogText.en: Make yourself a guest at her home. But be quick. She is very exhausted.

dialogText.cn: 你终于来了。
dialogText.en: You're finally here.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 你已经知道了莱万汀的结局，为什么还要踏入深渊？她是你的什么人？
dialogText.en: You already know what's going to happen to Laevatain. Why risk diving into the Deep? Who is she to you?

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 不要再往前走了。
dialogText.en: Do not go any further.

actorName.cn: 神秘的幻影{c16-莱万汀的幻影}

dialogText.cn: 停下你的脚步吧。别像莱万汀，从不知道量力而行，最后害死了自己。
dialogText.en: Cease this pursuit, and don't be like Laevatain. She ignores the risks of overreaching and will get herself killed.

dialogText.cn: 既然她人在这里，我就要把她平安带出去。
dialogText.en: {F}Hmph, I will bring her out safely.{M}Hmph, I will bring her out safely.

dialogText.cn: 嘁……碍事……
dialogText.en: Tsk... This is slowing me down...

dialogText.cn: 即使付出生命，还有什么比记忆的真相更重要的呢？
dialogText.en: Even if this is going to take my life, nothing's more important than finding the truth in my memories.

dialogText.cn: 我感觉到史尔特尔“家乡”的所在了，就在前方。
dialogText.en: I can sense the whereabouts of Surtr's "home". It's close.

dialogText.cn: 不过……时间不多了，我得快一点。
dialogText.en: But time's running out... I gotta act quickly.

dialogText.cn: 等等！
dialogText.en: {F}Wait!{M}Wait!

dialogText.cn: 你……找到我了。
dialogText.en: You ... found me.

dialogText.cn: 我来到了史尔特尔的“家乡”，但是……
dialogText.en: I arrived at Surtr's "home" but...

dialogText.cn: 我看到了名字已不可考的少女……
dialogText.en: I only saw a girl whose name has been lost...

dialogText.cn: 为躲避战火而出逃的流浪者……
dialogText.en: A refugee escaping the fires of war...

dialogText.cn: 被灼热碎片刺痛的掌心……
dialogText.en: A hand stinging and burning from the scorching heat...

dialogText.cn: 尘土中无从辨认的家人和旧宅……还有很多很多……
dialogText.en: A family and home in the dust that I do not recognize ... and many other things...

dialogText.cn: 我已经看遍了这里的记忆……但这些……还是没能告诉我“我是谁”……
dialogText.en: I have seen every memory fragment of this place... But found nothing... None of them can tell me "who I am"...

dialogText.cn: 我还想再走下去……但……还能去哪儿……
dialogText.en: I want to keep going ... but ... where else could I go...?

dialogText.cn: 我不能到了最后一刻，都只能作为一个空壳而……
dialogText.en: I don't want to live out my life ... as an empty shell...

dialogText.cn: 不，你不是空壳。
dialogText.en: {F}No. You are not an empty shell.{M}No. You are not an empty shell.

dialogText.cn: 我可以见证你的存在。
dialogText.en: {F}I bear witness to your existence.{M}I bear witness to your existence.

dialogText.cn: 我的……存在？
dialogText.en: My ... existence?

dialogText.cn: 你是带我走出迷途，辨别假象的同行者……
dialogText.en: {F}You are my companion — you ended my confusion and taught me to see through falsehoods...{M}You are my companion — you ended my confusion and taught me to see through falsehoods...

dialogText.cn: 我记得你的姓名、你的火焰、你的追寻之路……
dialogText.en: {F}I remember your name, your fire, and your pursuit for the truth...{M}I remember your name, your fire, and your pursuit for the truth...

dialogText.cn: 这些都属于“莱万汀”，而不是任何其他人。
dialogText.en: {F}All these belong to Laevatain and no one else.{M}All these belong to Laevatain and no one else.

dialogText.cn: 但“寻找记忆”就是我唯一的意义了吗？
dialogText.en: But isn't this "search for memories" the sole reason I exist?

dialogText.cn: 不，“找到自己”才是你的意义。
dialogText.en: {F}No. It's "self-discovery" that gives you meaning.{M}No. It's "self-discovery" that gives you meaning.

dialogText.cn: 不要放弃，我可以帮你。
dialogText.en: {F}And I can help you. Do not give up.{M}And I can help you. Do not give up.

dialogText.cn: 你在消耗自己……来稳定我的存在。为什么要这么帮我？你刚苏醒，又正在面对强敌……
dialogText.en: You consumed yourself ... to stabilize my existence... Why? You've just awakened, and you're fighting a powerful enemy...

dialogText.cn: 因为我承诺过要帮助你找回记忆。
dialogText.en: {F}Because I promised to help you recover your memories.{M}Because I promised to help you recover your memories.

dialogText.cn: 作为一个同样需要找回自己的人……这理所应当。
dialogText.en: {F}And helping another Chief Amnesiac like me ... goes without saying.{M}And helping another Chief Amnesiac like me ... goes without saying.

dialogText.cn: 这是……史尔特尔的“答案”……
dialogText.en: This is ... Surtr's "answer"...

dialogText.cn: 走吧。
dialogText.en: {F}Let's take it.{M}Let's take it.

actorName.cn: 莱万汀&管理员{莱万汀、管理员}

dialogText.cn: 史尔特尔……/莱万汀……
dialogText.en: Surtr.../Laevatain...

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员B}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator B}

dialogText.cn: 恭喜你！来到罗德岛一周年了！对这里满意吗？
dialogText.en: Congratulations on your first anniversary at Rhodes Island! Do you like it here?

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员A}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

dialogText.cn: 此刻罗德岛就是你的家。冰淇淋已备好三箱，随时来采购部领取。另外，本周不安排外勤任务，好好休息。
dialogText.en: Rhodes Island is your home. And we prepped three crates of ice cream that can be claimed at the Procurement Department. There won't be any field operations this week. So, enjoy your break.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员B}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator B}

dialogText.cn: 知道你喜欢自由自在，我们准备了滑板作为礼物！
dialogText.en: We know you like the thrill of freedom, so we got you a skateboard as a gift!

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员D}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator D}

dialogText.cn: 特调熔岩血酿鸡尾酒——加了液氮的冰爽版！放心喝，这次绝对没加什么试剂……大概？
dialogText.en: A special lava slug bloodbrew cocktail — super cooled with liquid nitrogen! Don't worry, it's safe. No crazy chemical reagents were added this time ... I think.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员C}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator C}

dialogText.cn: 派对结束后想去“再来一杯”吗？还是去顶层甲板吹吹风？
dialogText.en: Interested in an after-party at One More Shot? Or enjoy the fresh air on the top deck?

dialogText.cn: 这不就是“家”吗……那我为什么还需要寻找过去的家呢？
dialogText.en: This place is my home. So why should I obsess about finding the last one I had?

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员A}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

dialogText.cn: 这份相册汇集了我们和你共同的行动记录，虽然你还没找到过去，但你的未来，我们都会在场。
dialogText.en: This album is an anthology of all the operations we did together! If you have trouble finding your past, just know that everyone's here for your future.

dialogText.cn: 原来，即使没有过去，人也可以活在当下。
dialogText.en: It seems that people without a past ... can also choose to live in the present.

dialogText.cn: 如果我在苏醒的时候就见到这些，会选择不一样的道路吗……
dialogText.en: If I saw this at the moment of my awakening, would I choose a different path...?

dialogText.cn: 这可能是一种缺憾……但同样也给了你选择的权利。
dialogText.en: {F}It's a shame ... but it also gave you the freedom of choice.{M}It's a shame ... but it also gave you the freedom of choice.

dialogText.cn: 让你以自己的方式跨过“记忆”。
dialogText.en: {F}You get to choose how to go "beyond" the memories.{M}You get to choose how to go "beyond" the memories.

dialogText.cn: 选择……
dialogText.en: Choice...

dialogText.cn: 她选择像热爱“家”一样热爱罗德岛。
dialogText.en: She chose to love Rhodes Island as "home".

dialogText.cn: 我能体会到那种感觉。很聒噪，很麻烦，也很温暖，而且……很有趣。
dialogText.en: I think I understand that sensation. A noisy place filled with hassles, but it's also warm and ... interesting.

dialogText.cn: 所以对她而言……找寻过去，已经不重要了。
dialogText.en: That's why she gave up ... 'cause finding the past is no longer that important.

dialogText.cn: 但我不是那个有了热爱的人和事，所以才能放下记忆的她。
dialogText.en: But I'm different. I haven't found the people or things to make me give up those memories.

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二并没有我的“罗德岛”。
dialogText.en: I can't find my own "Rhodes Island" on Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 那也许……可以有属于你的终末地？
dialogText.en: {F}Perhaps ... you can find your own Endfield?{M}Perhaps ... you can find your own Endfield?

dialogText.cn: ……想乘虚而入？看不出你还挺狡猾的，管理员。
dialogText.en: ...Making your move already? Never expected you to be the cunning type, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 只要你愿意。
dialogText.en: {F}Only if you're willing.{M}Only if you're willing.

dialogText.cn: 哼。那我就接受你的邀请。
dialogText.en: Hmph. I'll accept your invitation.

dialogText.cn: 看来你已经想明白了？
dialogText.en: {F}Looks like you've sorted things out.{M}Looks like you've sorted things out.

dialogText.cn: 这还只是开始。
dialogText.en: This is just the beginning.

dialogText.cn: 我究竟能不能跨过记忆的泥淖……取决于会在终末地找到什么。
dialogText.en: Whether I can free myself from this mire of memory ... will depend on what I discover at Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 我以管理员的身份承诺，终末地会成为你的“家”。
dialogText.en: {F}I give you my word as Endministrator: Endfield will become your "home".{M}I give you my word as Endministrator: Endfield will become your "home".
Home...

dialogText.cn: 好，那就走着瞧吧。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'll see how you make good on this promise.

dialogText.cn: 罗德岛……是个随时能接纳我，随时能回去，不会束缚我的地方。
dialogText.en: Rhodes Island... A place that welcomes me home whenever I want. A place that lets me do what I want.

dialogText.cn: ……你的“答案”，就是这样啊……
dialogText.en: ...So that's how you "answered" the question...

dialogText.cn: 看来你已经被驯服，那就别再想着变回什么火焰巨人了。
dialogText.en: Good. You're finally behaving. Now you can say goodbye to the flaming giant you once were.

dialogText.cn: 游历、冒险……原来最后她不再寻找记忆了吗？
dialogText.en: Journeys and adventures... Did she actually give up her memory-search because of these?

dialogText.cn: 不管你之前被多少人握在手里，我会是最后一个。
dialogText.en: I don't care how many people wielded you before. I'll be the last of them.

dialogText.cn: 从此以后，你只能服从一个声音。史尔特尔，就是我。
dialogText.en: From now on, you shall only follow one voice. Surtr's voice — my voice.

dialogText.cn: 如果你还敢命令我，我会利用你自己的力量，把你给彻底消灭。
dialogText.en: And if you dare order me around, I will annihilate you completely, with your own powers.

dialogText.cn: 还是跟着我四处游历，吃好吃的，暴揍那些欠揍的混蛋才有趣。
dialogText.en: You're joining my journey. We'll eat good food and beat up people who have it coming.

actorName.cn: 火焰巨人的声音{c16-火焰巨人}

dialogText.cn: 服从我！成为火焰的使者！
dialogText.en: Bend to me! Become the Envoy of the Fire!

dialogText.cn: 不。
dialogText.en: No.

actorName.cn: 火焰巨人的声音{c16-火焰巨人}

dialogText.cn: 那你就休想离开！
dialogText.en: Then you will never leave!

dialogText.cn: 哦？看来你也能感受到这份凉意，那就再来点冰淇淋吧。
dialogText.en: Ooh. You actually can feel the cold. That means more ice cream is coming your way.

dialogText.cn: 那些记忆带来的烦躁和痛苦……最终就这样归于平静了。
dialogText.en: All the frustrations and pain from the memories... This is how they ended in peace.

actorName.cn: 火焰巨人的声音{c16-火焰巨人}

dialogText.cn: 冰冷……刺痛……甜腻……
dialogText.en: The icy cold ... the stinging sensation ... the cloying sweetness...

actorName.cn: 火焰巨人的声音{c16-火焰巨人}

dialogText.cn: 荒谬……但这感受……慰藉……
dialogText.en: Ridiculous... But why is the sensation ... so comforting...

dialogText.cn: 不，听说那儿的冰淇淋机不错，我想去试试。
dialogText.en: No. I just heard about their fancy ice cream machines. Gonna try them out.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员B}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator B}

dialogText.cn: 抱歉史尔特尔干员，食堂的冰淇淋库存已经消耗完了……我们马上调拨原料紧急制作一批！请稍候！
dialogText.en: Apologies, Operator Surtr. The cafeteria pantry is out of ice cream... But an emergency batch is being made right now! Just wait a minute!

dialogText.cn: 我可以等。
dialogText.en: It's okay. I can wait.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员C}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator C}

dialogText.cn: 史尔特尔！下次外勤任务，你要去哪里？
dialogText.en: Surtr! Where's your next field operation?

dialogText.cn: 拉特兰吧。
dialogText.en: Laterano, I think.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员C}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator C}

dialogText.cn: 这回你要验证的记忆与拉特兰有关？
dialogText.en: Are you going there to validate some memories?

dialogText.cn: 这是加入罗德岛时的情景……这段记忆……对她很重要。
dialogText.en: This is when she joined Rhodes Island... She treated these memories ... with great importance.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员A}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

dialogText.cn: 你想要什么代号？
dialogText.en: Is there any codename you want?

dialogText.cn: ……就叫史尔特尔吧。
dialogText.en: Just call me Surtr.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员A}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

dialogText.cn: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。
dialogText.en: Clinical analysis has confirmed that you are infected with Oripathy.

dialogText.cn: 我不会源石技艺。
dialogText.en: I don't know how to wield Arts.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员A}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

dialogText.cn: 不必了。我们充分了解过你的实力。欢迎加入罗德岛。
dialogText.en: That won't be necessary. We have a good understanding of your potential. Welcome to Rhodes Island.

dialogText.cn: 希望今后你们不会让我感到无聊。
dialogText.en: I just hope you won't bore me.

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员A}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

dialogText.cn: 放心，那些条条框框……不会束缚你的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Our clauses and terms ... are not restrictive.

dialogText.cn: 不过，什么麻烦我都能应对。要试试吗？
dialogText.en: But I can deal with all sorts of problems. Need a demo?

actorName.cn: 罗德岛干员的声音{c16-罗德岛干员A}
actorName.en: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

dialogText.cn: 体细胞与源石融合率1%，体表基本无感染特征，血液源石结晶密度0.10u/L，但源石技艺适应性……
dialogText.en: Cell-Originium assimilation is at 1%. No signs of infection on the surface of the body. Blood Originium-Crystal Density is at 0.10u/L, but Originium Arts Assimilation...

dialogText.cn: 这座由记忆构成的迷宫，正被敌意重塑。
dialogText.en: Looks like a malicious being is remaking this maze of memories.

dialogText.cn: 记忆没那么容易被抛弃……它们会变成敌人。
dialogText.en: Memories aren't easily cast aside ... they resurface as enemies.

dialogText.cn: 准备与往事战斗吧。如果不能尽快离开，我们的意识将会被永远禁锢在这里。
dialogText.en: Be prepared to fight the past. If our minds fail to escape quickly enough, they might be trapped here forever.

dialogText.cn: 现在它想“挽留”我们了。
dialogText.en: Now it wants to "keep" us.

dialogText.cn: 或者说“最终的告别”。
dialogText.en: Perhaps we can treat it as our "final goodbye".

dialogText.cn: 现在只需要做一件事——
dialogText.en: We just need to do one thing —

dialogText.cn: 把记忆的残渣切断，点燃，直到化为灰烬。
dialogText.en: Sever all ties to the residues of the past, set them alight till they become ash.

dialogText.cn: 这下面是……
dialogText.en: {F}What's at the bottom of this...?{M}What's at the bottom of this...?
