dialogText.cn: 迷宫的尽头。
dialogText.en: End of the maze.

dialogText.cn: 以及这里剩余记忆的集合。
dialogText.en: And a confluence of all remaining memories.

dialogText.cn: 那就盛大一点。
dialogText.en: Well then, let's make this a worthy spectacle.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你觉得……再旅者为什么需要过去另一个人的记忆？
dialogText.en: Endmin, why do reconveners need another person's memories from the past...?

dialogText.cn: 那么我呢？我的记忆呢？
dialogText.en: Then what about me? What about my memories?

dialogText.cn: 这就是独属于我的特殊意义吧。
dialogText.en: That's probably a reason exclusive to me.

actorName.cn: 热情的工人{c17m1-热情的工人}

dialogText.cn: “超级迭代人”？有印象，应该就在<@qu.key>后面这些货物里。</>
dialogText.en: Super Iterator? I think I saw it. That package should be in that <@qu.key>stack behind me</>.

actorName.cn: 热情的工人{c17m1-热情的工人}

dialogText.cn: 之前积压的包裹今天全涌过来了，目前所有人员都在分拣……麻烦您先自己找一下吧，不好意思……
dialogText.en: All the packages that got held up came in today. We got no one to spare because everyone's busy sorting the deliveries ... so I guess you'll have to find it yourself. Real sorry about this.

actorName.cn: 热情的工人{c17m1-热情的工人}

dialogText.cn: 这么快就找到了？
dialogText.en: Found it? Already?

actorName.cn: 热情的工人{c17m1-热情的工人}

dialogText.cn: 伊冯……？这是她的包裹？！
dialogText.en: Yvonne...? Is that package hers?

actorName.cn: 热情的工人{c17m1-热情的工人}

dialogText.cn: 那……那您可一定要轻拿轻放，千万小心。
dialogText.en: Well ... be extra, extra careful when moving it around. Don't bump it against anything.

actorName.cn: 热情的工人{c17m1-热情的工人}

dialogText.cn: 我先去忙别的了！您最好再检查一下，包装上有没有“静态侵蚀样本”的标志……！
dialogText.en: I gotta work on something else! And I suggest you check the package for labels or descriptions of "Static Blight Samples"...!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？什么风把你吹来了！
dialogText.en: Endmin? I am totally surprised to see you here!

dialogText.cn: 啧，安德烈又在偷懒！
dialogText.en: Tsk. Andre is being a big lazy owl again!

dialogText.cn: 有次他打赌输了，说今年要替我跑腿取所有的包裹……没想到他会支使管理员！回头我找他算账去。
dialogText.en: He made a losing bet and promised to pick up all my deliveries for this year... I can't believe he's bossing you around, Endmin! I'll make sure he gets a friendly reminder of his place.

dialogText.cn: 唉……取包裹真的很麻烦……太感谢你啦！
dialogText.en: Ugh... Picking up packages is such a hassle... Anyways, thanks a mill!

dialogText.cn: 噢，这个……
dialogText.en: Oh, well...

dialogText.cn: 因为之前的事，货物一直送不进来……现在已经用不上了。
dialogText.en: Previous troubles held up delivery... And now I got no use for it anymore.

dialogText.cn: 这个嘛……虽然包裹迟到了，但管理员来得正好！我的计划是——
dialogText.en: Yeah ... even though the package arrived late, you came at just the right time, Endmin! My plan is —

dialogText.cn: 跟我来，管理员！
dialogText.en: Hehe. Just follow me!

dialogText.cn: 不是研究样本，就是些普通颜料。
dialogText.en: Newp. Not research samples. Just some ordinary paint.

dialogText.cn: 别愣着呀，管理员，一起画！
dialogText.en: Don't just stand there, Endmin! Grab a brush!

dialogText.cn: 怎么，管理员，你怕被柯林斯兄妹抓走不成？
dialogText.en: Yeah, so? Endmin, don't tell me you're scared of the Collinses.

dialogText.cn: 而且园区被破坏成这个样子，迟早要重建的。不如在这片废墟上留下一点痕迹，也算是纪念啦。
dialogText.en: The Science Park is really banged up so they'll start rebuilding it eventually. I say we leave our signature on the ruins to commemorate this entire mess.

dialogText.cn: 呼……好久没——这么——爽快了！
dialogText.en: Phewie...! I haven't felt this great for QUITE — A — WHILE!

dialogText.cn: 其实，我以前一直觉得传说中的终末地管理员会是个特别严肃的人！
dialogText.en: Actually, I always thought the legendary Endministrator of Endfield Industries would be a super stuck-up serious person!

dialogText.cn: 喂！伊冯——怎么又是你！
dialogText.en: HEY! YVONNE —! YOU AGAIN!

dialogText.cn: 糟糕，快跑！
dialogText.en: Uh-oh. We gotta run!

dialogText.cn: 别担心，我会罩着你的！
dialogText.en: You got nothing to fear! I'll cover you!

dialogText.cn: 要么就像秦主管那样忙得团团转，总是板着脸，不停地给堆成山的报表咻咻咻地盖章！
dialogText.en: ...or someone like Director Qin, always rushing around with a stern face, stamping piles of reports with the Endfield seal.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿。管理员喜欢的图案跟我很像，意外地——很有品位！
dialogText.en: Heheh. Our pattern souls are vibrating! Endmin, your aesthetic is so my vibe!

dialogText.cn: 解决技术难题跟画画本质上是一样的，都是在无数可能性里选择最令人满意的方案……
dialogText.en: Drawing is essentially the same as solving technical problems. You simply choose the most satisfying solution out of countless possibilities...

dialogText.cn: 唉，这些颜料暂时也没什么用了。就拿来给这面墙添点美丽的颜色吧！
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Since I have no use for the paint, we might as well add a splash of beautiful color on this boring wall!

dialogText.cn: 我还记得小时候看关于你的科普读物……里面的你，要么像克劳老师，是那种老学究……
dialogText.en: When I was a kid, I read about you in those educational science books... They either described you as an old academic like Professor Crowe...

dialogText.cn: 所以我偶尔也会画点东西，找找灵感。
dialogText.en: I would occasionally draw a few things while looking for inspiration.

dialogText.cn: 好险，差点就被抓个正着。
dialogText.en: That was real close. Almost caught us red-handed.

dialogText.cn: 还好来的不是他妹妹，不然我们就完蛋了。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness it wasn't his sister, or we'd both be toast.

dialogText.cn: 唉，刚才那幅涂鸦……有没有感觉少了些主题？
dialogText.en: *Sigh* So, what do you think about our graffiti...? Think we're missing a theme?

dialogText.cn: 我以前见过好多厉害的涂鸦。比如在黑曜石音乐节……每一幅都是那些艺术家的“呐喊”。
dialogText.en: I've seen plenty of awesome graffiti. Like at the Obsidian Festival... Every piece is a "scream" from the artist who drew it.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……管理员会想通过涂鸦表达什么？
dialogText.en: So... What do you want to express with your graffiti, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 一段情绪？一个故事？还是别的什么？
dialogText.en: The vibes you're feeling? A story you wanna tell? Or is it something else?

dialogText.cn: 无论答案如何，从创作者内心最深处爆发出来的声音才是“呐喊”。
dialogText.en: No matter what your answer is, the "scream" must be an eruption! An explosion right from the deepest recess of the creator's heart!

dialogText.cn: 我吗？
dialogText.en: Me?

dialogText.cn: 唔，枢纽区基地啊……那正好可以顺路去找安德烈！
dialogText.en: Hmm. The Hub Base... Well, I can also visit Andre along the way!

dialogText.cn: 我听说锚点就砸在他实验室头上，他还真是命大……嗯，也很久没见了，去慰问一下他好啦。
dialogText.en: I heard an Ankhor fell right on his lab. Old boy got really lucky with that one... And yeah, since I haven't seen him for quite a while, I suppose I can swing by, you know. Give him my best wishes.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，终末地干员伊冯申请征用你今天的时间！趁现在有灵感，我想尽快完成这幅涂鸦！不准拒绝哦。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Endfield Operator Yvonne is requesting the reservation of your time today! I must complete this graffiti while my muse is still knocking! I refuse to take no for an answer.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，就知道管理员也有兴趣！
dialogText.en: Heheh. I knew you'd be interested, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 想临阵脱逃？太晚啦！墙上的涂鸦，可有你一半“功劳”哦。
dialogText.en: Thinking of backing out? TOO LATE! You're at least fifty percent responsible for this wall graffiti.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们现在是共犯——是一条绳上的源石虫，绑得死死的。
dialogText.en: We're in the same boat now, Endmin — like Originium Slugs on the same leash. There's no getting away.

dialogText.cn: 你得陪我一起画完这幅涂鸦，别想跑哦！
dialogText.en: You gotta stay with me and complete this graffiti. And you better not think about escaping!

dialogText.cn: 不过，创作最重要的还是灵感。管理员醒来后一直在东奔西走，肯定去过一些难忘的地方吧！快给我推荐几个！
dialogText.en: Nevertheless, inspiration remains the heart of any creation. And since you've been all over the place after waking up, you must've found some truly inspiring spots! Come on, share a few with me!

dialogText.cn: 发自内心的、最想要去表达的东西，像是有声音一样，气势汹汹地扑到观众脸上！
dialogText.en: It's something from their heart, something they truly wanna express! A raging voice that wants out, that wants to be plastered all over the viewers' faces!
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 我还不知道啦！一个人想，就是很容易陷入瓶颈……
dialogText.en: I don't know yet! Brainstorming things on your own often lands you straight in a bottleneck...

dialogText.cn: 这个叫随机应变！
dialogText.en: Well, I gotta respond quickly, right?

dialogText.cn: 咳咳咳。这不是带你躲过去了嘛。
dialogText.en: Ahem. I did, in a way. Even found you a hiding spot, right?

dialogText.cn: 从印象深刻的记忆入手吗？这个挺不错。
dialogText.en: You wanna start with the memories most deeply etched within your mind? That sounds great.

dialogText.cn: 管理员的故人……我有点好奇！
dialogText.en: An old friend of the Endmin...?! You've made me quite curious.

dialogText.cn: 哇！我喜欢这个回答，不愧是管理员！
dialogText.en: Wow! I LURRRV that answer! That's why you're the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员已经有自己的答案了，好羡慕你。
dialogText.en: I really envy you, Endmin. You seem to have it all figured out.

dialogText.cn: 可恶，明明就差一点！我要去给速冻仔装上裂兽透视眼……下次我可不会再输给管理员了！
dialogText.en: Hrrngh! I was so close! I gotta slap a manglerbeast see-through vision mod on my Frost-e-Bytee... I won't lose to the Endmin next time!

dialogText.cn: 赢啦赢啦！果然我才是最强大的裂兽，管理员要努力追上我哦——
dialogText.en: I WON! Hah! I'm the most powerful manglerbeast ever! You got a lot of catching up to do, Endmin —

actorName.cn: 工团的男孩{c17m2-工团的男孩A}

dialogText.cn: 好好玩！再玩一次嘛！
dialogText.en: This is so fun! Can we play again?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……现在不行！愿赌服输，你们要先告诉我阿丽娅去哪儿了。
dialogText.en: Hmm... Not now! You gotta keep your word, kiddo. Now, tell me where Alia went.

actorName.cn: 工团的男孩{c17m2-工团的男孩A}

dialogText.cn: 好吧……
dialogText.en: Fine...

actorName.cn: 工团的女孩{c17m2-工团的女孩A}

dialogText.cn: 阿丽娅姐姐说待会儿大家都要去<@qu.key>世代摇篮</>，所以她肯定提前去了那里！
dialogText.en: Miss Alia said everyone's heading to the <@qu.key>Cradle of the Ages</>. So she definitely went there early!

dialogText.cn: 这样啊。谢谢啦，小驮兽们。等我下次来，带你们和小暴鸰一起玩“堡垒守御”！
dialogText.en: Is that so? Well, thank you very much, my baby burdenbeasts. Next time, we'll play some serious Bastion Defense with my Tweety-Bombs!

actorName.cn: 小孩子们{c17m2-工团的女孩A、c17m2-工团的女孩B、c17m2-工团的男孩A、c17m2-工团的男孩B}
actorName.en: Children {c17m2-UWST Girl A, c17m2-UWST Girl B, c17m2-UWST Boy A、c17m2-UWST Boy B}

dialogText.cn: 好！
dialogText.en: YAYYYY!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 是我疏忽了……没想到天使又开始四处游荡了，我得赶紧通知其他人。
dialogText.en: This was my mistake... I didn't expect the Aggeloi to be crawling all over the place again. I must warn the others quickly.

dialogText.cn: 总之现在暂时安全了！
dialogText.en: At least the place is safe for now!

dialogText.cn: 对了，我有件事想请你帮忙。管理员说你对这里最熟悉了，这附近有什么你印象深刻的地方么？
dialogText.en: Before I forget, I need your help with something. The Endmin said you're super familiar with this area. Is there any place that looks particularly impressive?

dialogText.cn: 要是在过去，我能带你去很多地方……
dialogText.en: I actually could have taken you to quite a few places ... if you'd come earlier...

dialogText.cn: 但现在……锚点的震荡波，还有天使的袭击，把这里的一切都破坏得乱七八糟。那些我熟悉的地方，全都变了样……
dialogText.en: But now ... everything here has been wrecked by Ankhor shockwaves and Aggelos attacks. Even my favorite spots have changed ... completely...

dialogText.cn: 我们想把这一切恢复原样，但……不知道要多久……
dialogText.en: We want to restore this place to its former glory, but ... I don't know how long that would take.

dialogText.cn: 你叫阿丽娅，对吧？这个给你。
dialogText.en: Your name is Alia, right? This is for you.

dialogText.cn: 这是？
dialogText.en: What is this?

dialogText.cn: 是……颜料，我打算用它来画一幅作品。我订了很多，这一罐送你。
dialogText.en: It's... It's just paint. I wanted to use it for a painting and ordered plenty of cans. You can have one.

dialogText.cn: 来想象一下重建之后的样子吧——飞驰的矿车、来回旋转的塔吊，还有源石结晶反光洒在墙上的光点……
dialogText.en: Just picture how this place would look after it's rebuilt — mining trucks cruising along the roads, tower cranes swiveling about, and glittering Originium crystals showering the entire place with reflected light...

dialogText.cn: 等到那时候，你就用这罐颜料，画出那棵很漂亮的大树吧！
dialogText.en: When that happens, just use this can of paint and draw that beautiful-looking oak!

dialogText.cn: 嗯！这个我收下了，谢谢你。
dialogText.en: Sure! Thank you for the gift.

dialogText.cn: 不过……说到源石晶体的反光……我想起来有一个地方，你说不定会感兴趣。
dialogText.en: Now that you've mentioned ... reflections from Originium crystals... It reminds me of a place that might interest you.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？说来听听！
dialogText.en: Oh? Tell me about it!

dialogText.cn: 世代摇篮，管理员战胜巨大天使的地方！
dialogText.en: The Cradle of the Ages. That's where the Endmin fought and defeated a giant Aggelos!

dialogText.cn: 虽然我们谁都没亲眼见过，但那一定是最该被记录下来的时刻。
dialogText.en: Although none of us witnessed the fight, that moment definitely deserves to be immortalized.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，能带我去看看吗？给我讲讲当时发生了什么！越详细越好！
dialogText.en: Endmin, take me over there, please? And you gotta tell me what happened back then! Gimme as many details as you can!

dialogText.cn: 我带路，咱们一起过去吧。
dialogText.en: We should go there together. I'll lead the way.

dialogText.cn: 正好，我们正在那边筹备一场……仪式。
dialogText.en: The Cradle... That's also where we're going to perform a ... ceremony.

dialogText.cn: 巨大的天使……是三位一体？！
dialogText.en: A giant Aggelos... Would that be the Triaggelos?

dialogText.cn: 矿点、瞭望塔、广场……奶奶说，更早以前，那棵完整的源石大树……也很漂亮。
dialogText.en: The mining spot, the watch tower, and the plaza... Granny said there used to be a Great Originium Oak here ... and it was a beautiful sight.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，刚才一起玩的孩子们……也在那边。
dialogText.en: Endmin, look there... Those are the kids who played games with us.

dialogText.cn: 大家都在祈祷。向牺牲的同伴告别……一起消解悲伤，然后……让他们留在记忆里。
dialogText.en: Everyone's praying and saying farewell to their fallen friends... Let us ease the sadness away, and ... keep them close in our memories.

dialogText.cn: 活下来的人，总是会背负思念和愿景。
dialogText.en: The living shall carry on, and bear the burden of nostalgia and dreams.

actorName.cn: 工团的男孩{c17m2-工团的男孩A}

dialogText.cn: 大家……为什么都不说话？
dialogText.en: Why is everyone so quiet?

actorName.cn: 工团的女孩{c17m2-工团的女孩A}

dialogText.cn: 爸爸妈妈……去哪儿了？呜……
dialogText.en: Mom ... Dad... Where did you go? Hik, hik...

dialogText.cn: 看到这些光了吗？它们曾经属于一棵很高、很高的树。
dialogText.en: Do you see these lights? They were once part of a really, really tall tree.

dialogText.cn: 爸爸妈妈就像那棵树。他们去了另一个世界，但留下了光芒。
dialogText.en: Mom and Dad are just like the tree. They went to another world but left these pretty little lights behind.

dialogText.cn: 这些光会守护你们，就像它们……会守护这棵源石树苗。
dialogText.en: These lights shall protect you, just as they protect this Originium sapling.

dialogText.cn: 偷偷告诉你们。等矿区重建好了，阿丽娅姐姐会在那边的墙上画一棵大大的源石树。
dialogText.en: I got a secret to share. Once the mines are rebuilt, Miss Alia will draw a GIGANORMOUS Originium Oak on the wall over there.

dialogText.cn: 阿丽娅姐姐有一罐特别鲜艳的颜料，绝对能画出跟这里一样漂亮的光芒。
dialogText.en: Miss Alia has a can of super bright paint. She can definitely draw a tree sparkling with lights, just as beautiful as these.

dialogText.cn: 到时候，你们要帮她一起画，然后在那棵源石大树下面快快长大！好不好？
dialogText.en: When she starts painting, you'll help her complete the drawing. And then you'll grow up nice and well underneath the new Originium Oak! Okay?

actorName.cn: 小孩子们{c17m2-工团的女孩A、c17m2-工团的女孩B、c17m2-工团的男孩A、c17m2-工团的男孩B}
actorName.en: Children {c17m2-UWST Girl A, c17m2-UWST Girl B, c17m2-UWST Boy A、c17m2-UWST Boy B}

dialogText.cn: 好！
dialogText.en: OKAY!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我决定好要画什么了。下一站，我们去<@qu.key>超域试验场</>！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I've decided what to draw. Our next stop will be the <@qu.key>Æther Test Site</>!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还好你们及时赶到，不然恐怕会有更多人……
dialogText.en: Thank goodness you came here in time, Endmin. Who knows what would've happened otherwise...

dialogText.cn: 塔塔……保护了大家啊。
dialogText.en: Tata... My baby bot protected everyone.

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师！你这儿还顺利吗？
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe! How are things over here?

dialogText.cn: 托你和塔塔的福，进展良好。虽然最近还是有点不太平……好日子还在后头呢。
dialogText.en: We're making good progress, thanks to you and Tata. There are a few disturbances here and there ... but we're looking at a bright future.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……大家还真是老样子啊！战场都没打扫干净，就已经投入工作了。
dialogText.en: Hmm... I guess the UW hasn't changed a bit. The battlefield is barely cleaned up, yet everyone's already back at work.

dialogText.cn: ……能成功关闭裂隙，也多亏了你们辛苦实验积累下的数据啦。
dialogText.en: ...Anyways, thanks to your efforts and that stash of valuable data, we managed to seal the rift.

dialogText.cn: 研究有了重大突破，有什么比这更令人高兴的呢？
dialogText.en: We made a major breakthrough in our research. Nothing can be better than that.

dialogText.cn: 这里还有些数据，之后发你一份。但老规矩，涉及机密的，还是得走下工团的流程。
dialogText.en: We still have some data here. I'll send you a copy. Old rules, though. It's classified, so you must follow the UWST procedure.

dialogText.cn: 哇，那些流程好麻烦的……算了，找安德烈吧，总有办法的。
dialogText.en: Ugh. The UW procedure is such a hassle... Fine. I guess I'll talk to Andre about this. There's always a way.

dialogText.cn: 总之，多谢了，老师！这些可帮大忙了，说不定哪天……就能复原塔塔了呢。
dialogText.en: Thanks a lot, Professor! This will really help me out. Maybe one day ... Tata can be restored.

actorName.cn: 激动的工人{c17m2-激动的工人}

dialogText.cn: 你……你好！是伊冯前辈吗？可以和您合个影吗？
dialogText.en: Greet ... greetings! Are you Yvonne the genius? Can I take a photo with you?

dialogText.cn: 欸，前辈？合影？我？欸？！
dialogText.en: Huh, g-genius? Me? A photo with you? Seriously?!

actorName.cn: 激动的工人{c17m2-激动的工人}

dialogText.cn: 我读过很多您写的论文！克劳老师总是提起您，没想到今天可以见到本人——
dialogText.en: I've read a lot of your papers! Professor Crowe keeps talking about you. I totally didn't expect to run into the actual you today —

dialogText.cn: 复原么……
dialogText.en: Restore it...?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，伊冯。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Yvonne.

dialogText.cn: 在我手下那会儿，她可没这么开心。之后也要辛苦您照顾了。
dialogText.en: She was never this happy when she worked for me. Sorry to trouble you, Endministrator, but please take care of her.

dialogText.cn: 这孩子……我也说不清楚。她总是独来独往，比起人好像更喜欢机器，不太需要其他人的关心。
dialogText.en: I don't know how to say it ... but the girl is always a loner. She prefers the company of robots, and doesn't really care about the opinions of other people.

dialogText.cn: 伊冯是公认的天才，毕业前就有很多公司向她抛出了橄榄枝。
dialogText.en: Everyone knows Yvonne is a genius. Plenty of companies tried to recruit her, even before she got her diploma.

dialogText.cn: 她先是去了环塔商会，嫌人家眼中只有利益和性价比，厌倦了。后来去宏科院待了两天，又说和那边的人在一起缺乏刺激，待不住。
dialogText.en: She first went to the TGCC but got tired of their relentless pursuit of profit and cost-performance indices. She later went to HAS. It only took her two days to start complaining about the lack of excitement with her peers. She just couldn't stay there.

dialogText.cn: 我倒是有心要留她，可她那行事风格，跟工团的人也八字不合。我们总是吵架，一天也没消停过。
dialogText.en: I wanted to keep her on the team, but her way of doing things really disagreed with the UWST procedure. We argued all the time. There wasn't a single day of peace.

dialogText.cn: 最后她提出要离开。其实伊冯愿意直说，我就很高兴了，但我又不忍心完全放走她。毕竟除了伊冯，原型机这样重要的项目，交给谁都不放心。
dialogText.en: She finally told me she wanted to leave. I was actually happy that she was honest about it, but I couldn't bring myself to let her go completely. The Prototype Project was too important. It was only safe in her hands.

dialogText.cn: 我还问过她，终末地那儿有什么宝贝，让她愿意留下来？
dialogText.en: I did ask her afterwards. What's so nice about Endfield that convinced her to stay?

dialogText.cn: “能让我开心的伙伴”。
dialogText.en: "Friends that make me happy."

dialogText.cn: 只好再辛苦辛苦安德烈喽。
dialogText.en: So in the end, I had to ask Andre to help.

dialogText.cn: 我担心过她是不是太孤僻了，但现在看来，只是缺乏与她步调一致的同伴。
dialogText.en: I used to be worried that she was too isolated. But from what I see now, I think she just lacked a friend who could keep pace with her.

dialogText.cn: 如今看她这样自在地活着，我感到很欣慰。
dialogText.en: Now I feel pretty comforted seeing that she's free at being herself.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔的事情对她影响很大。她从来没有想过要把它当作遏制超域的代价。
dialogText.en: What happened to Tata really affected her. She never intended to make Tata sacrifice itself to stop the Æther.

dialogText.cn: 也许是出于伊冯自身的责任感吧。我能看出来，她还没有做好再次亲手把它造出来的心理准备。还请您——
dialogText.en: Perhaps Yvonne felt responsible for the robot. But I can see she's not mentally prepared to make another unit herself yet. Can you —

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，那我就放心了。
dialogText.en: Haha. Then I can feel at ease.

dialogText.cn: 对了……管理员，刚才伊冯提到了“复原”对吧？
dialogText.en: By the way, Endmin... Yvonne mentioned the word "restore", right?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你可别被他说的话带偏了。取材完毕，咱们回去吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin, don't let this old boy mislead you. Let's head back once we finish collecting what we need!

dialogText.cn: 取材？
dialogText.en: Collecting?

dialogText.cn: 哦……你不想跟我分享一下新作品的灵感吗？
dialogText.en: Oh... Don't you want to share the inspirations for your new work with me?

dialogText.cn: 不想——或者，你要是能忍住不发表意见，我就给你看！
dialogText.en: Not. A. Chance — Well, if you can keep your opinions to yourself, I might consider showing them to you.

dialogText.cn: 好吧，我知道答案了。到时候直接看成品……
dialogText.en: Alright. I think I know what that means. I'll just admire the work once it's finished...

dialogText.cn: 老师——不是就在我身边么？
dialogText.en: Right here all along!

dialogText.cn: 走喽，管理员！我已经迫不及待要去完成作品了！
dialogText.en: Time to go, Endmin! I simply can't wait to finish my work!

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师，你又在跟管理员念叨什么呢？
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe, what are you going on about with the Endmin this time?

dialogText.cn: 对了。伊冯，你找到更多“让你开心的伙伴”了吗？
dialogText.en: By the way, Yvonne, have you found more "friends that make you happy"?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈！
dialogText.en: Hahaha!

dialogText.cn: 实验室……我得适应一阵子了。
dialogText.en: My lab... I think it'll take a while for me to get used to this.

dialogText.cn: 等大树画好了，管理员、伊冯，我邀请你们来看！
dialogText.en: Endmin, Yvonne, once I'm done drawing the Great Oak, I'll invite you over for a look!

dialogText.cn: 里面传来敲敲打打的声音，伊冯正在“重构”实验室……
dialogText.en: Hammering and slamming noises could be heard from inside. Yvonne is giving the lab her "total overhaul"...

dialogText.cn: （还是先不打扰她了。）
dialogText.en: (Better not disturb her.)

dialogText.cn: 供电系统……自控装置……源石供暖系统……全都报废了！还有我的按摩仪……！
dialogText.en: Power system... Auto controls... Originium warmers... They're now completely bust! And my massager as well...!

dialogText.cn: 唉，得修理到什么时候……上次淘来的那幅莱塔尼亚油画……也该找个好地方挂……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* When will I ever finish these repairs... I got myself a Leithanien oil painting online... Now I don't even have a proper place to hang it.

dialogText.cn: 秦主管又在催了……啊！要忙的事情太多了，这实验室再不修一下都快没法用了。
dialogText.en: Director Qin is really on my back... Oh dear! I got too many things on my hands! I must fix this lab or it'll be of no use to me.

dialogText.cn: 我好像听到有人想修理实验室——
dialogText.en: Did someone say something about fixing their lab —

dialogText.cn: 伊冯？还有管理员？你们怎么来了？
dialogText.en: Yvonne? And the Endmin? Why are you here?

dialogText.cn: 等等，难、难道是那个包裹出了什么问题……
dialogText.en: Hold on. Are ... are you saying that there's something wrong with the package...?

dialogText.cn: 嗯哼……看你焦头烂额的，你浪费管理员时间这事儿，我就先不追究了。
dialogText.en: Uh-huh... Since you've got a bigger problem to deal with, I guess I'll overlook your crime of wasting the Endmin's time.

dialogText.cn: 欸，我以为你会更想看到管理员呢，毕竟——
dialogText.en: Hoo? I thought you'd want to see the Endmin. After all, it was —

dialogText.cn: 嗯、咳！我听说你的实验室被锚点砸到，特地来慰问一下！你还不快谢谢我？
dialogText.en: Ahem! I decided to pay you a visit 'cos I heard your lab got struck by an Ankhor. You should be thankful!

dialogText.cn: 这装潢不管看多少次，都好没品位……
dialogText.en: Hmm... No matter how many times I look at your decor, I find it simply tasteless...

dialogText.cn: 没事，既然来了，我就顺手帮你“重构”一下。放心，我不像你这么犹犹豫豫，重构效率绝对翻三倍！
dialogText.en: No matter. Since I'm already here, I'll help you "transform" this dump. Unlike you, I'm decisive, which makes me three times more efficient.

dialogText.cn: 不过先说好，这可不是免费的。请客——就算了，把蚀刻机借我玩一个月。
dialogText.en: Quick clarification: I'm not doing this for free. Free dinners — Nope. Lend me your etching machine for a month.

dialogText.cn: 好说好说……那这里就先交给你？刚才电机外廊又停摆了，秦主管找我帮忙，我得过去看看。
dialogText.en: Of course! Definitely... So I'll hand this place over to you. We got a generator gangway malfunction and Director Qin wants me to help. I gotta head over quickly.

dialogText.cn: 对了！管理员，这事恐怕得请您搭把手。电机外廊会影响集成工业研究所的供电，为了保证能彻底排除故障，还得靠您的源石技艺……
dialogText.en: Oh, right! Endmin, we might need your help with this. The generator gangway issue might affect the power supply for the AIC Research Center. To completely fix this issue, we'll need your Originium Arts...

dialogText.cn: 唉，既然管理员愿意……安德烈，现在蚀刻机我要借用两个月了！但你们快点哦，管理员还得陪我去其他地方呢。
dialogText.en: But since the Endmin agreed to help you... Andre, this means I'll be playing with your etching machine for two months! And you best hurry up! I have plans to take the Endmin to other places.

dialogText.cn: 至于这里，就交给我吧！你们回来前，保证焕然一新！
dialogText.en: And don't you worry about your lab. I'll take care of it! Be ready to see something fantastic when you get back!

dialogText.cn: 伊冯啊，我给你交代一声。这实验室我用了快十年，哪儿放了什么我闭着眼都知道，动太多我会不习惯的……！
dialogText.en: Uhm... about my lab, Yvonne. I've been using it for nearly a decade, and I can find everything I need — even with my eyes closed. A total overhaul might get me confused...!

dialogText.cn: 快去吧快去吧，别磨蹭，放心交给我！
dialogText.en: Stop dilly-dallying and get going already. Your lab's in my super capable hands!

dialogText.cn: 哎，这丫头——管理员，我去拿点工具，咱们在<@qu.key>电机外廊</>那边会合。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* She's quite a handful, isn't she? Endmin, I gotta pick up some tools. Let's meet at the <@qu.key>generator gangway</>.

dialogText.cn: 来找你算算支使管理员跑腿的账呀！你还别说，这锚点的破坏力真惊人……
dialogText.en: I'm here to settle the score for making the Endmin run errands! Speaking of which, this Ankhor did quite a number on this place...

dialogText.cn: 塔塔之前就停放在这里？那岂不是差点就……
dialogText.en: Wasn't Tata parked here before? That means it was really close to...

dialogText.cn: 那确实……呃，但不会占用你太多时间吧？
dialogText.en: Uh, absolutely... But ... wouldn't this take up a lot of your time?

dialogText.cn: 你的实验室确实得翻修。这方面我可是行家，全四号谷地最好看又最实用的房间是哪间，你心里有数吧？
dialogText.en: Your lab needs a total makeover, and I happen to be an expert in that. Bet you know who has the most stylish, practical room in Valley IV, right?

dialogText.cn: 好狡猾！管理员的时间可是被我预订了欸！
dialogText.en: That's really low, Andre! I booked the Endmin's schedule ahead of time!

dialogText.cn: 哎，对了……我偷偷问一句。那个包裹……伊冯收到后，没事吧？
dialogText.en: Ah, yeah... I, uh, got a secret question to ask. When Yvonne received that package ... how did she react? Is she alright?

dialogText.cn: 欸？！她居然拿去涂鸦了……
dialogText.en: What?! She used it for graffiti...?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，咱们上去吧。
dialogText.en: Let's head up, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 确实是伊冯能干出来的事。嗯，好像也不坏！
dialogText.en: Hmm. Yvonne is the sort who would do that. And it doesn't sound like a bad thing!

dialogText.cn: 哦……原来如此，怪不得您跟她东跑西跑的。
dialogText.en: Oh... Is that so? No wonder you're tailing her all over the place.

dialogText.cn: 那管理员，这件事就麻烦您多操心了。
dialogText.en: Well then, Endmin, I'll leave everything in your capable hands.

dialogText.cn: 这个事……我也不好多说什么，还是等伊冯自己告诉您吧。
dialogText.en: Ah, the paint... I can't really tell you much about it. It's better for Yvonne to tell you herself.

dialogText.cn: 厉害！管理员，您这效率……跟当年一个样儿。
dialogText.en: Superb, Endmin! You still got that incredible efficiency from all those years ago.

dialogText.cn: 不知道伊冯那边怎么样了。我的实验室……唉，要是大变活屋可怎么办啊！
dialogText.en: I wonder how Yvonne's doing. My poor little lab... What if it turns into a house of horrors?

dialogText.cn: 那孩子的创造力就像脱缰的驮兽。要拦住她，得先能跑得过她。唉，能让她开心点，也没什么不好的。
dialogText.en: She has the creativity of a burdenbeast that broke free of its reins. You gotta run faster if you wanna stop her. Well, if it makes her happy, I might as well go along.

dialogText.cn: 行了，先不说这些，咱们赶紧回去吧？
dialogText.en: Okay. Let's hold that thought and head back to my lab. What do you say?

dialogText.cn: 好，那就走，咱们抓紧！
dialogText.en: Alrighty. Let's be off, and quickly too!

dialogText.cn: 成，差不多了，您来叫我就行。
dialogText.en: Sure. Just let me know when you're ready.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？管理员？搞定了咱就回实验室吧，我还有一堆事要处理呢。
dialogText.en: How's it going, Endmin? Let's get back to the lab if we're done. I got tons of work to do.

dialogText.cn: 好，那就走，咱们抓紧！
dialogText.en: Alrighty. Let's be off, and quickly too!

dialogText.cn: 我的宝贝机器又要被绑架了……管理员，动作快点啊。
dialogText.en: My precious machinery is about to get kidnapped... Endmin, we gotta hurry.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈，你的实验室安全评级为——不合格！不过，我都帮你搞定了，还省下了不少空间哦。
dialogText.en: Andre, I reviewed the safety measures of your lab and the result is — MAJOR NON-CONFORMANCE! But I fixed everything and even freed up a lot of clutter for you.

dialogText.cn: 桌子也升级了一下。之后你请大家吃饭的时候，“啪、啪”按两下按钮，就能直接变成派对模式啦。
dialogText.en: I also upgraded your lab bench. When you have people over for dinner, just WA-PAP the button twice and it'll auto-transform to party mode.

dialogText.cn: 还有那个自动按摩仪？里面的电机比我太爷爷的年纪都大，早就停产了！我给你勉强接通了，之后申请个新的吧。
dialogText.en: As for that auto-massage machine? FFFF. The motor is even older than my great grandfather. They don't make it anymore! BUT! I managed to get it working again. Please, just apply for a new one.

dialogText.cn: 全都修好了？！太利索了……不愧是伊冯！
dialogText.en: You fixed them all?! By Talos... You're awesome, Yvonne!

dialogText.cn: 对了，刚才法比安那边发通信，好像在找你，是不是出什么事儿了？
dialogText.en: Oh, Fabian just messaged us and asked where you are. Did something happen?

dialogText.cn: 我跟管理员打算一起完成一幅伟大的作品，在园区那儿做了点实验……你可别告诉他我们在哪儿啊。
dialogText.en: The Endmin and I are planning to create something spectacular. So, we experimented with some ideas at the Park... Don't tell him where we are, Andre.

dialogText.cn: 不过……作品还缺点灵感，你最近有没有看到什么印象深刻的事物？
dialogText.en: Anyway ... my spectacular extravaganza still lacks inspiration. Seen anything impressive or stimulating recently?

dialogText.cn: 你突然这么问……哦！有了，要不去看看我们刚修好的电机外廊？
dialogText.en: Now that question came out of nowhere... Oooh! I got it! Try visiting the generator gangway we just fixed.

dialogText.cn: 听着不错，我们走！去欣赏下你们的劳动成果。
dialogText.en: Sounds interesting. Let's be off! Time to admire the fruits of your labor.

dialogText.cn: 这……这都是什么？！咕啊——！
dialogText.en: WHA... WHAT IS ALL THIS?! SQUAAAWWWK —!

dialogText.cn: 一会儿会进行电力恢复测试，所有灯都会亮起来，特别漂亮！
dialogText.en: We'll be running a power restoration test soon. All the lights will come back on. You're in for a very pretty sight.

dialogText.cn: 对了，管理员。关于伊冯，还有件事……
dialogText.en: By the way, Endmin. There's just one more thing about Yvonne...

dialogText.cn: 原型机的项目是成功了，但关于伊冯未来的打算，我还不知道她是怎么考虑的……
dialogText.en: Our Prototype Project was a success, but I still know nothing about her plans for her own future...

dialogText.cn: 别看伊冯那么随性，其实她挺仰慕您的。有空帮我打听一下吧？
dialogText.en: Now Yvonne might seem like the happy-go-lucky type, but she really looks up to you. Would you mind asking her about this?

dialogText.cn: 对了，安德烈，记得看看实验室，我给你准备了惊喜！
dialogText.en: By the way, Andre, don't forget to check your lab. I left you a surprise!

dialogText.cn: 算啦！也挺好看的！就当换换口味，旧的不去新的不来……倒也不坏。
dialogText.en: It's alright! As long as it's good-looking enough! You gotta trash the old to take on something new. This change of style ... isn't that bad. Really.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我有一些关于画面的想法了！但……好像还是不太够。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I got some ideas about the graffiti! But ... I don't think they're enough.

dialogText.cn: 除了这里和源石实验园区，还有什么比较特别的地方吗？
dialogText.en: Are there any other special places besides the Hub and the Originium Science Park?

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>矿脉源区</>……好，就决定是那儿了！下一站，出发出发！
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Origin Lodespring</>... Alright. That'll be our next stop! To the Lodespring we go!

dialogText.cn: 我的实验室……
dialogText.en: My lab...

dialogText.cn: 伊冯，快看，灯亮了！
dialogText.en: Yvonne, look! Lighting is back online!

dialogText.cn: 我不常来这边，但……和之前相比，变化也太大了。
dialogText.en: I didn't come here often, but ... I'm struck by how different it is from before.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……的确。这里遭遇了很可怕的事，但大家都还在努力……总有希望的！
dialogText.en: Yeah... that's true. It was a terrible event, but everyone's still working hard to turn it around... There's always hope!

dialogText.cn: 阿丽娅？走，我们去找人问问！
dialogText.en: Alia? Alright. Let's ask about her whereabouts!

dialogText.cn: 管理员的熟人在哪儿？
dialogText.en: So, where is this friend of yours, Endmin?

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m2-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你也是……来参加“送别仪式”的吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin? Are you ... are you here to take part in the Send-Off?

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m2-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 嗯。有几位同伴在这次事故中牺牲了，我们想向他们正式道别。
dialogText.en: Yeah. A few fellow crew mates passed away during this incident. We're giving them a formal send-off.

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m2-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 虽然……更多是为了抚慰生者吧。
dialogText.en: But it's actually more like ... helping us, the living, to cope with the reality.

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m2-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 阿丽娅应该在照看那些失去了父母的孩子。
dialogText.en: Alia should be looking after the children who lost their parents.

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m2-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 但现在人手紧张，她也可能被临时调去别的岗位，巡逻、善后、打扫战场……都有可能。
dialogText.en: We're really short on people so she might be reassigned to another role. Patrolling, cleanup, battlefield salvage ... anything's possible.

actorName.cn: 焦急的工人{c17m2-焦急的工人}

dialogText.cn: 那边怎么有这么多天使……欸，管理员？
dialogText.en: Why are there so many rock bugs...? Oh, Endmin?!

actorName.cn: 焦急的工人{c17m2-焦急的工人}

dialogText.cn: 没，你找她？我刚跟巡逻队从旧矿区回来。
dialogText.en: No. You looking for her? I just came back from a team patrol in the Old Mines.

actorName.cn: 焦急的工人{c17m2-焦急的工人}

dialogText.cn: 多亏了管理员和洛茜，我们才能夺回那片区域。
dialogText.en: We were only able to retake that area thanks to you and Rossi.

actorName.cn: 焦急的工人{c17m2-焦急的工人}

dialogText.cn: 我们等这一刻太久了……现在，我们要祭奠这些牺牲者们。
dialogText.en: We've been putting off this moment for far too long... Now's the proper time to honor our fallen.

dialogText.cn: 好吧好吧！我陪你们玩！
dialogText.en: Alright, alright! I'll play with you!

dialogText.cn: 我是裂兽！而你们，是一群小驮兽！
dialogText.en: I'm a manglerbeast! And you ... are a bunch of baby burdenbeasts!

dialogText.cn: 赶快躲好哦，被抓到的小驮兽会被裂兽无情地吃掉！吼——
dialogText.en: Now go and hide. The baby burdenbeast caught will be torn to pieces! RAAARGH —

actorName.cn: 工团的男孩{c17m2-工团的男孩A}

dialogText.cn: 呀——裂兽来啦！大家快藏起来！
dialogText.en: AAAH —! The manglerbeast is coming! Hide yourselves!

actorName.cn: 工团的女孩{c17m2-工团的女孩A}

dialogText.cn: 要是你抓到我们，我们就告诉你阿丽娅姐姐在哪儿！
dialogText.en: If you catch us, we'll tell you where Miss Alia is!

dialogText.cn: 没想到吧，裂兽也有伙伴！我们是——“裂兽双煞”！
dialogText.en: Never expected a manglerbeast to have a pal, right? We are the — Double Manglers!

dialogText.cn: 所以你们可得藏好了，被抓到就算输哦！
dialogText.en: Better hide yourselves well. If we find you, you lose!

dialogText.cn: 快点快点，管理员，给这群小鬼头点颜色……咳咳，不对，游戏赢了，就能知道阿丽娅在哪儿了！
dialogText.en: Hurry up, Endmin! Teach these munchkins a good... Ahem. I mean, if we find them all, they'll tell us where Alia is.

dialogText.cn: 全、全部吗？嗯——哦！
dialogText.en: You mean ... all of you? Hmm — Oh!

actorName.cn: 工团的男孩{c17m2-工团的男孩A}

dialogText.cn: 可恶，被找到了……
dialogText.en: Aww, you found me...

actorName.cn: 工团的男孩{c17m2-工团的男孩B}

dialogText.cn: 哇，不要吃我！
dialogText.en: Whoah! Don't eat me!

actorName.cn: 工团的女孩{c17m2-工团的女孩A}

dialogText.cn: 你赖皮！你一定用裂兽透视眼了吧！
dialogText.en: You're cheating! You're using the manglerbeast see-through vision!

actorName.cn: 工团的女孩{c17m2-工团的女孩B}

dialogText.cn: 呜……被抓到了。
dialogText.en: Hngh... I got caught.

dialogText.cn: 这边是我设计的防卫系统，专门用来保护生产线的……超级可靠！
dialogText.en: Heh. You're looking at a defense system that I specifically designed to protect our production lines... It's super reliable!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……这个嘛……我要想一想。
dialogText.en: Ah... Well, yeah... Let me think for a moment.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……因为经费有限，应急功能被砍掉了。现在没办法一键关闭……
dialogText.en: Heheh... So there was this ... budgetary issue that prevented us from slapping on an emergency kill switch. Yeah ... we probably can't switch it off...

dialogText.cn: 别慌！我有主意了。
dialogText.en: Have no fear! I got an idea.

dialogText.cn: 我想着，如果有扇门，会跟来上班的你打招呼，心情都会变得更好啦。
dialogText.en: I thought about having a gate that greets you when you report to work. It'd start your day with a morale boost.

dialogText.cn: 而且有时候我会想……说不定这扇门期待着跟我见面，期待着跟我问好——
dialogText.en: Sometimes I would think ... that the gate actually looked forward to seeing and greeting me —

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你会有类似的想法吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, do you have similar ideas as well?

dialogText.cn: 如果机械也有自己的情绪……我们就有双倍的开心了！
dialogText.en: If machines had emotions ... we'd get a double dose of happiness!

dialogText.cn: 对，是我做的哦！这个笑脸像是打招呼一样，很不错吧？
dialogText.en: Absolutely correct! The smiley looks like a greeting. Not bad, right?

dialogText.cn: 嗯嗯……这样……搞定！
dialogText.en: Hmmhmm... That's it... Done!

dialogText.cn: 早安、午安、晚安！所以我也会笑着跟它说“嗨嗨”。
dialogText.en: Good morning! Good afternoon! And good evening! I'd also smile and respond with: "Hi there!"

dialogText.cn: 呃……这个……它很壮观嘛！
dialogText.en: Welp ... yeah... But look at it! It's bedazzling, right?

dialogText.cn: 不过，别看它阵仗这么大，其实也有弱点，想办法从中间通过吧！
dialogText.en: It may look super impressive, but it's got a design weakness. Let's find a way through the middle!

dialogText.cn: 怎么过去……有办法了！
dialogText.en: How should we get across... Ah, I got it!

dialogText.cn: 这里是仓库？有了！管理员，你等我一下。
dialogText.en: Is this the warehouse? Oh, I got it! Endmin, wait here for me.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，等等就知道了，我有一个绝佳的点子！
dialogText.en: Heheh. You'll see soon enough. I just got a perfect idea!

dialogText.cn: 我搞定前进的通路，你搞定外面的天使？传说中的管理员，一定能做到的！加油加油！
dialogText.en: I'll handle the path and you'll take care of the Aggeloi outside. The legendary Endmin can definitely pull it off! Go! Go! Go!

dialogText.cn: 好吧……
dialogText.en: {F}Fine...{M}Fine...

dialogText.cn: 怎么你也和安德烈一样，问我这种问题……
dialogText.en: Why do you sound like Andre? You're both asking me the same questions...

dialogText.cn: 其实……我也不知道！有很多计划，但是都没想好。
dialogText.en: Truth be told... I got no idea! Sure, I made plenty of plans but I didn't think any of them through.

dialogText.cn: 但要先说好，如果我之后的计划遇到什么阻碍，管理员可得站在我这边哦。
dialogText.en: But I gotta make this clear. If my projects get into trouble, Endmin, please promise me you're on my side.

dialogText.cn: 管理员也帮了我很多，不用这么见外啦。
dialogText.en: Enough with the niceties. You've been a great help to me as well, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗，那你可得有点心理准备哦！
dialogText.en: Really? Then you better be mentally prepared.

dialogText.cn: 好了！咱们走吧！
dialogText.en: Great! Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 天哪，比我预估的还厉害……居然消灭了这么多天使！
dialogText.en: Oh my goodness. You're far more powerful than I expected... That's a lot of Aggeloi you defeated.

dialogText.cn: 真的？那你要一直保护下去哦！
dialogText.en: Really? Then promise you'll protect me forever!

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，不闹啦，等它们部署好地板，我们就能过去了。
dialogText.en: Ahem. Enough games for now. Once the drones finish laying down the boards, we'll be able to cross.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……有了！我现在是终末地的干员，所以还是先听管理员的命令咯！
dialogText.en: Oh... Got it! I'm an Endfield operator now, so I guess I'll be following your orders for a while, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 真的好久没回来了。事情一桩接一桩，都对时间没感觉了……
dialogText.en: I really haven't been back for a while. The problems kept coming, and I totally lost track of time...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，那你呢？
dialogText.en: Endmin, what about you?

dialogText.cn: 唉……我都快忘了。我们不一样的地方太多了。你毕竟是终末地的管理员啊——
dialogText.en: *Sigh* I almost forgot about all that. We're just too different. After all, you're the Endministrator of Endfield Industries —

dialogText.cn: 你是塔塔的好朋友、众多传说的主角、大家的希望……
dialogText.en: You're Tata's friend, the protagonist of numerous legends, the hope of the people...

dialogText.cn: 是背负着那么多沉重的事，却还会抽时间陪我跑来跑去，一起完成涂鸦的人。
dialogText.en: And despite all these super heavy responsibilities ... you still ran all over ... just to do graffiti with me.

dialogText.cn: 那——一定要和我一起把那幅作品完成哦！
dialogText.en: Well ... pinky promise! Let's complete that masterpiece together!

dialogText.cn: 一言为定。
dialogText.en: Mmhmm. It's a deal, then.

dialogText.cn: 打算啦，打算！这一切结束之后，你又打算去哪儿？
dialogText.en: Your plans. For the future. When this is all over, where are you headed next?

dialogText.cn: 每次醒来都有无数的事情等待你去解决。
dialogText.en: You got a blightload of problems to solve every time they wake you up.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会有这么大的天使——？！管理员，当心！
dialogText.en: How did this huge guy get here?! Endmin, watch out!

dialogText.cn: 在爆炸的最后一刻，塔塔回传了部分数据。如果加上克劳老师的部分……
dialogText.en: Tata uploaded some data at the moment of the explosion. This, together with the files from Professor Crowe...

dialogText.cn: 组成它“记忆”的会是什么呢？语言模型、认知算法……如果能搞明白，再移植到一个新的机体上……
dialogText.en: What exactly comprises its "memories"? Language models, cognitive algorithms... If I figure this out and transfer it to a new chassis...

dialogText.cn: 可惜的是……最后塔塔为了完成它的使命，没有来得及上传备用模型……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Unfortunately ... Tata was trying to complete its mission ... and didn't have time to upload the backup model...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你说如果塔塔回来了，却忘记了我们一起走过的路，它还能算是塔塔吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, if Tata came back but forgot everything about its journey with us, would it still be Tata?

dialogText.cn: 管理员和塔塔可不太一样……噗，好像也没那么不一样！
dialogText.en: You're not the same as Tata, Endmin... Fff. I guess you're not that different actually!

dialogText.cn: 都是在瞬息万变中最独特的显现……最特别的连续迭代。
dialogText.en: You're both a unique phenomenon in this ever-changing world... A novel form of continuous iteration.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我有个新想法！来成为杰作的另一位作者吧！
dialogText.en: I got a new idea, Endmin! Wanna be a co-artist of yet another magnificent work?

dialogText.cn: 不对。不是杰作。这一次是最重要的，我们的同伴！
dialogText.en: No. This isn't just a work. It's our greatest undertaking! Our very own companion!

dialogText.cn: 管理员刚才说的，遥远的目的地……
dialogText.en: Endmin, that faraway destination you just mentioned...

dialogText.cn: 我们会一起抵达那里。有我，有大家，还有——
dialogText.en: We'll reach it together. Me, you, everyone, and of course —

dialogText.cn: 塔塔！
dialogText.en: Tata!

dialogText.cn: 这个大家伙废弃了太久，权限被锁，得先重启控制主板，然后……
dialogText.en: This big fella has been abandoned for way too long. Access is locked. We need to restart the control panel and...

dialogText.cn: 欸，他们好像把启动口令换掉了。管理员，能麻烦你帮我去找一下吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm... I think they changed the activation command. Endmin, can you help me look for it?

dialogText.cn: 如果附近有语音日志之类的东西，应该会记录下新的口令……让速冻仔跟着你吧，它能找到。
dialogText.en: Check for things like audio logs nearby. They should have the latest command... And let Frost-e-Bytee tag along. It should help you find it.

dialogText.cn: 要照顾好管理员哦——
dialogText.en: Take good care of the Endmin —

dialogText.cn: 我先破解主板，口令就拜托你们啦！
dialogText.en: I'll hack the control panel. You find the command!

dialogText.cn: 没错，是工团多年来对抗侵蚀的努力……
dialogText.en: That's right! The UWST spent years figuring out how to beat the Blight...

dialogText.cn: 看这些大家伙。不知道该说是严谨还是死板……不过工团的设计总会派上用场。
dialogText.en: Look at these big fellas. I don't know if I should call them rigorously robust or ponderously inflexible... In any case, UWST designs will always do the job.

dialogText.cn: 唯一可惜的是，工团太追求实用性，设计上总是少点人情味……
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, the UW-style focuses too much on practicality. Their designs lack that dash of human touch...

dialogText.cn: 锵锵——管理员，看我的设计，和工团完全不是一种风格吧？
dialogText.en: TADA — And this is my design, Endmin! Look! Couldn't be more different from the UW approach, don't you think?

dialogText.cn: 因为长期跟机械打交道，可能会孤独、空虚吧？我不希望自己的造物给人这种感受。
dialogText.en: People who work with machines for years... Well, they probably feel a little lonely and empty inside. I definitely don't want my machines to feel that way.

dialogText.cn: 好啦，我们继续走吧！
dialogText.en: That's that. Let's keep moving!

dialogText.cn: 他去巡逻了，平时忙得很，没有空一直盯着我们啦。
dialogText.en: He's out on patrol. The dude's pretty busy and doesn't have time to keep his eyes on us.

dialogText.cn: 在那家伙回来前，我们把最后一部分搞定，然后溜之大吉！
dialogText.en: We'll finish the final part of the graffiti and get out of here before Mr. Fabian comes back!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，画是画完了……但总觉得差了一口气，还是不够完美……
dialogText.en: Hmm. I finished the painting but ... it lacks the final breath of life. It's not perfect enough...

dialogText.cn: 好像……少了点什么。管理员，你觉得呢？
dialogText.en: I think ... it's missing something. What do you think, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 那……管理员——
dialogText.en: So ... Endmin —

dialogText.cn: 最后陪我去一个地方吧。
dialogText.en: Join me. We got one last place to visit.

actorName.cn: 悠闲的工人{c17m3-悠闲的工人}

dialogText.cn: 伊冯是不是忘记把东西都清走了……嗯？怎么是个礼物盒？
dialogText.en: Did Yvonne forget to clean out these stuff... Hmm. Is that a giftbox?

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m3-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 这边贴了个纸条，写着“离别礼物”。
dialogText.en: There's a memo sticker on the side. Reads: "Parting gift."

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m3-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 唉……那丫头个性太强，之前我们总吵架。但她走了居然还有点舍不得。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* The girl really has an attitude and we never stopped arguing. But now that she's gone, I feel like I kinda miss her.

actorName.cn: 悠闲的工人{c17m3-悠闲的工人}

dialogText.cn: 别哭啦，之后还要合作，她还会回来的。给她留个门，新口令就叫<@qu.key>“超级迭代人”</>吧！
dialogText.en: Stop crying. She'll be back if we got another joint project going. Let's leave a backdoor and change the command to <@qu.key>"Super Iterator"</>!

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{c17m3-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 谁哭了？！
dialogText.en: Me? Crying? Stop imagining things!

dialogText.cn: 一则工团成员的语音日志。
dialogText.en: A UWST crew mate's audio log.

dialogText.cn: 解析超域能量可是个大工程……
dialogText.en: Decrypting the Æther energy was a massive undertaking...

dialogText.cn: 为了抑稳测试，光是计算一个新常量，我就喝了整整十箱气泡咖啡！
dialogText.en: I emptied ten crates of bubble coffee just to compute a new constant for the depth stability tests!

dialogText.cn: 从总部寄来的材料样本……一般的D64钢可扛不住那种源石结构的冲击力。
dialogText.en: Material samples mailed from the Commandery... Impacts from our Originium structures were too strong for conventional D64 Steel.

dialogText.cn: 工团的申请流程有点麻烦，要不是买不到，我都想自费解决了。
dialogText.en: UWST application procedures can be a real hassle. I would have paid for it out of my own pocket if it'd been available on the market.

dialogText.cn: 喔，这个……他们没擦掉啊。
dialogText.en: Oh. That... I'm surprised they didn't erase it.

dialogText.cn: 我想在这儿写个座右铭，纠结了好多天。
dialogText.en: I wanted to write a motto here, but got stuck for days.

dialogText.cn: 最后决定还是写一句简单点的，提醒自己把设计做好看点。
dialogText.en: In the end, I decided to write something simple. Just a self reminder that designs must look good.

dialogText.cn: 从方案到实际落地，中间费了多少素材，我都记不清了。
dialogText.en: Project inception to physical prototyping... I can't remember how many types of material I used during this process.

dialogText.cn: 我带着塔塔换了好多地方，见了好多人。在大家的帮助下才顺利造了出来。
dialogText.en: I brought Tata to plenty of places and met a lot of people. Everyone helped. That's how I got to successfully build Tata.

dialogText.cn: 因为韧性不足而被淘汰的材料……当时留了一块当纪念。
dialogText.en: I disqualified this material because of insufficient toughness... Kept a piece as a memento.

dialogText.cn: 啧，这群天使把出口堵住了。
dialogText.en: Tsk. The Aggeloi are blocking the exit.

dialogText.cn: 一般的攻击手段碰不到那些高台上的天使……
dialogText.en: Our weapons probably won't hit those Aggeloi on the high platforms...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我来解决高处的！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'll take out the one perched up high.

dialogText.cn: 你打算怎么做？
dialogText.en: {F}What are you planning?{M}What are you planning?

dialogText.cn: 来了！
dialogText.en: Incoming!

dialogText.cn: 老式系统就是麻烦……管理员，帮我找下启动口令吧。
dialogText.en: Legacy systems are such a hassle... Endmin, just find that command for me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我又有个新想法，申请征用——
dialogText.en: Got a new idea, Endmin! I'm reserving a bit of your time —

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，开玩笑的啦！
dialogText.en: Heheh. I was just joking!

dialogText.cn: 这次多谢你啦。你要是有什么需要帮忙的，或者想去玩的话，我随叫随到哦！
dialogText.en: Well, thanks a million for everything this time. If you need help, or if you're just looking for fun, give me a call. I'll be there!

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀区移动载具的展品说明——
dialogText.en: Blighted Zone Vehicle Exhibit Guide:

dialogText.cn: “为了方便深入侵蚀区域，采集数据而设计的移动载具。因造价高昂、报废率高等问题，目前已停产。”
dialogText.en: "Designed for deep incursions into Blighted Zones to gather data. Production discontinued due to high costs and frequent decommissioning."

dialogText.cn: 初代原型机的展品说明——
dialogText.en: First-Gen Prototype Exhibit Guide:

dialogText.cn: “初代原型机因体型较大、散热性较差及供能困难，无法投入实际使用，已经报废。”
dialogText.en: "The first-gen prototype was decommissioned due to its large size, poor heat dissipation, and power supply issues, making it unfit for practical use."

dialogText.cn: 它进行过成千上万次的测试，为工团积累下了宝贵的资料。每一道伤痕都是它努力的证明。
dialogText.en: It underwent thousands of tests, gathering invaluable data for the UWST. Every scar is proof of its effort.

dialogText.cn: 咦，那不是工团的……怎么啦，这里发生什么了吗？
dialogText.en: Wait. I see UWST crew mates... Did something happen?

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工人{c17m3-沉稳的工人}

dialogText.cn: 伊冯？还有管理员？你们怎么来了？
dialogText.en: Yvonne? And the Endmin? Why are you here?

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工人{c17m3-沉稳的工人}

dialogText.cn: 有天使闯进了地下车间，而且，我们现在无法确认天使的数量……
dialogText.en: A few Aggeloi busted their way onto the underground production floors. We don't know how many rock buggers there are...

dialogText.cn: 这样啊，没事，区区天使！反正我们本来就要下去一趟，顺手用迷你暴鸰解决掉就好了。
dialogText.en: Fff. Aggeloi? Since we're going down there anyways, my Mini-Bombtails will take care of them for you.

actorName.cn: 冷静的工人{c17m3-冷静的工人}
actorName.en: Calm Crew Mate {c17m3- Calm Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 真的不等等吗？工团的援兵很快就到。
dialogText.en: Shouldn't we wait for a while? UW reinforcements are arriving soon.

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，别磨磨蹭蹭的！要是天使把那里面的设备搞坏，可就麻烦啦。
dialogText.en: Come on, stop being so wishy-washy! Things will get a lot worse if the Aggeloi start breaking apart the machinery downstairs.

actorName.cn: 冷静的工人{c17m3-冷静的工人}
actorName.en: Calm Crew Mate {c17m3- Calm Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 可是……
dialogText.en: But...

dialogText.cn: 听见了吧，管理员都这么说了！总之别担心，交给我们吧。
dialogText.en: Heard that! Thus spake the Endministrator! Leave your problems in our capable hands and worry no longer.

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工人{c17m3-沉稳的工人}

dialogText.cn: 既然如此，那我们保持联络。我会通知安全局你们下去了。
dialogText.en: Then we should stay in touch. I'll notify our Security Bureau that you're heading down.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，去打扫咯！
dialogText.en: Alright, Endmin. Time for a cleanup job!

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工人{c17m3-沉稳的工人}

dialogText.cn: 这下麻烦了……
dialogText.en: Now we got trouble on our hands...

dialogText.cn: 速冻仔，准备完毕。小暴鸰，参数正常。还有我的铳……弹药很充足。
dialogText.en: Frost-e-Bytee is prepped. Tweety-Bomb readings look normal. And my pewpews ... have plenty of ammo.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，咱们出发！
dialogText.en: Let's go, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 好。那你可得跟紧我，别掉队！
dialogText.en: Great. Now, stay really close, and try not to get lost!

dialogText.cn: 行，那你快点，时间不等人！
dialogText.en: Fine. Just hurry up because time doesn't wait for anyone!

dialogText.cn: 那个组装模块是克劳老师匀给我的。大家的预算都很紧张，所以只能用二手设备。
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe divvied out that assembly module for me. Funding was pretty scarce so we had to make do with second-hand machines.

dialogText.cn: 不过，别小看它们。工团很多最新科技都是在这里诞生的。只要有理念跟技术，无论是什么工具，都能“画”出完美的作品。
dialogText.en: But don't belittle them. Plenty of new UWST tech came from here. Your tools don't matter much. As long as you got the vision and technique, you can "paint" the perfect work.

dialogText.cn: 我想去更下面找找灵感。我们的大作能不能完成，就看这一回了！
dialogText.en: Now I'm itching to head to the lower floors for more inspirations. This is it! Time to finish our magnum opus.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，跟之前一样——欸？！
dialogText.en: Hmm. Just like before — Huh?!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，是天使！它们在扎堆行动呢！
dialogText.en: Endmin, it's those Aggeloi! They're moving as a cluster!

dialogText.cn: 速冻仔，让它们凉快凉快！
dialogText.en: Frost-e-Bytee! Let's ice these rocky crawlies!

dialogText.cn: 那边的警报灯亮了！
dialogText.en: That alarm light has been activated!

dialogText.cn: 入侵者可能在那边，管理员，让速冻仔去探探路吧。
dialogText.en: The intruders might be over there. Endmin, we should let Frost-e-Bytee scout the way for us.

dialogText.cn: 有自己的实验室之前，我就在这里工作。
dialogText.en: I worked here before I got my own lab.

dialogText.cn: 我已经接管了电梯的控制权，输入口令就能启动啦。
dialogText.en: I've acquired controls of the elevator. Now I just need a command to activate it.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿。其实这个片区几乎只有我在用……对设备跟存放的东西都比较熟悉啦。
dialogText.en: Heheh. I was probably the only one using this area... So I'm actually quite familiar with the machinery and where everything's stored.

dialogText.cn: 咱们走吧？
dialogText.en: Let's keep going, shall we?

dialogText.cn: 跟紧我。
dialogText.en: Follow me close.

dialogText.cn: 那你可以多欣赏一会儿我放在这儿的杰作。
dialogText.en: Go ahead. Admire all the fabulous works I've stored here.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我比较习惯一个人。虽然工团的人都挺不错的，但是理念这方面，合不来就是合不来。
dialogText.en: Hmm. I feel better alone, though. UWST crew mates are decent company, but when your visions don't match, you just don't get along.

dialogText.cn: 我有小暴鸰跟速冻仔，所以不会觉得孤独。何况现在——也有你们啦！
dialogText.en: I got my Tweety-Bombs and Frost-e-Bytee. So, I never felt lonely. Heck, I even have you people around nowadays!

dialogText.cn: 那些是废弃的方案……但都是有可行性的，说不定哪天还能翻出来用上，就一直留着了。
dialogText.en: Just a few discarded plans... But they're feasible, you know. Maybe they'll become useful one day. That's why I kept them around.

dialogText.cn: 我从来不想没意义的方案。
dialogText.en: I'll never work on meaningless design plans.

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，这些家伙，真是的……
dialogText.en: Aww... These guys are just...
Su ... per ... ite ... rator...

dialogText.cn: 嗯哼，天使的派对结束了。
dialogText.en: Mmmh-ahhh. The Aggeloi party is finally over!

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 和你一起找灵感很开心，我觉得……到这里已经足够了。
dialogText.en: Feels great finding inspiration with you, Endmin. I think ... this should be far enough for us.

dialogText.cn: 我们回去吧！
dialogText.en: Time to head back!

dialogText.cn: 那……就一起去吧！
dialogText.en: Okay... Then let's head in together!

dialogText.cn: 识别成功，门锁已打开。
dialogText.en: Identification success. Locks disengaged.

dialogText.cn: 没错，这里……是我最早开始研究塔塔的地方。
dialogText.en: That's right. This ... is where I first started working on Tata.

dialogText.cn: 直到最后……保护伙伴，保护大家平静的生活，它替我做到了。
dialogText.en: In the end ... it did everything for me. It protected my friends ... and ensured everyone lived peacefully ever after.

dialogText.cn: 用它保护巫术时刻的新款时装、流行的音乐专辑、新蓝卡坞还没上映的电影续集……保护所有人的家。
dialogText.en: I wanted it to protect the latest Witching Hour fashion, popular music albums, and upcoming movie sequels from New Wrankwood... Something capable of keeping everyone safe.

dialogText.cn: 但也不知道什么时候开始，我希望它能走得更远……或许哪一天，它也能够跟上我的步调，成为我独一无二的伙伴呢？
dialogText.en: I don't know when it changed for me. I just wanted Tata to do more than that... I was hoping for a day when it could level with me ... and maybe even become my one and only companion?

dialogText.cn: 它是这世界上最棒的宝贝小车……但我……我却没能知道它在想什么，也没能保护好它……
dialogText.en: It was the best baby bot in the world... But ... I ... I never knew what it was thinking about... I even failed to protect it...

dialogText.cn: 最初，我只是把它当做一个能用来承载我的天才想法，能粉碎超域威胁的杰作。
dialogText.en: Initially, I treated it as a vessel for conveying my ingenious ideas, a masterpiece capable of ending the Ætherside threat.

dialogText.cn: 我输入了好多、好多四号谷地的数据进去……是这些推动它做出了选择吗？还是因为我强加给了它我的愿望？
dialogText.en: I uploaded a massive amount of data about Valley IV into Tata... Was it the data that drove its final choice? Or the wishes that I forced it to take on?

dialogText.cn: 那个时候……我甚至不在它的身边……
dialogText.en: And when it made its choice... I ... I wasn't even there...

dialogText.cn: 这些涂装颜料也用不上了。
dialogText.en: I got no use for these coating paints. Not anymore...

dialogText.cn: 是啊，用来给塔塔做新涂装的。它们到得……太迟了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. New coating for Tata. But they ... they arrived a little too late.

dialogText.cn: ……差不多该走了。
dialogText.en: ...It's time to go.

dialogText.cn: 这里……确实让我想起了很多回忆。不过……已经没事啦，别担心。
dialogText.en: This place...? Yeah. It brought back plenty of memories. But ... I'm alright. No need to worry about me.

dialogText.cn: 我准备好上去了。你呢，管理员？
dialogText.en: I'm ready to head up. How about you, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 好，那就走吧，别让他们等太久了。
dialogText.en: Good. Let's get going. Better not leave the crew mates waiting for too long.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……那你注意安全。
dialogText.en: Sure... Just try to be safe, k?

actorName.cn: 冷静的工人{c17m3-冷静的工人}
actorName.en: Calm Crew Mate {c17m3- Calm Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: {F}她们上来了！{M}他们上来了！
dialogText.en: {F}They're coming back up!{M}They're coming back up!

dialogText.cn: 就知道你们不会出事。
dialogText.en: Hooo. I knew you'd be alright.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，帮大忙了。这段时间真的麻烦您太多次了。
dialogText.en: Much appreciated. Seems like we're racking up a serious debt of gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 对了，伊冯。那幅涂鸦……
dialogText.en: Oh, Yvonne, about that graffiti...

dialogText.cn: 我承认涂鸦是我画的……按照之前的规矩，我会清理干净。
dialogText.en: Okay, okay. I confess. I drew that thing... And I'll clean it up according to procedure.

dialogText.cn: 不，不……虽然是有这条规定，但是……我们知道那是你画的，艾莱扎说大家看到了都很喜欢。
dialogText.en: No, that's not what I was trying to say... Sure we have our SOPs ... and everyone knows you drew it. But Aleeza told me that everyone kind of likes it.

dialogText.cn: 那幅涂鸦其实还没有完成对吧？
dialogText.en: So, that graffiti is half-done, right?

dialogText.cn: 我来是想问你，能不能把它画完？
dialogText.en: I was about to ask if you could finish it.

dialogText.cn: 你、你没事吧？！是不是之前裂地者袭击你的时候，砸到脑袋了……
dialogText.en: Wha? Are you alright?! Did some Landbreaker knock you on the head during their attack...?

dialogText.cn: 唉，艾莱扎也说过同样的话。我有这么古板吗？
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Aleeza said the same thing. Do you really treat me as a tedious bore?

dialogText.cn: 园区因为那场袭击损失惨重，大家最近的情绪很低迷。
dialogText.en: The attack really devastated the Park. Morale is at rock bottom.

dialogText.cn: 你找我就是为了……这个？
dialogText.en: You've been looking for me ... just to tell me this?

dialogText.cn: 嗯。啊……！我先声明，这个只是例外，并不代表你之后可以想怎么做就怎么做！
dialogText.en: Of course. Ah...! But I must remind you. This is an exceptional case. It doesn't give you permission to do whatever you want!

dialogText.cn: 但……毕竟，之前你跟塔塔救了园区的大家，也为我们做了这么多……
dialogText.en: Nevertheless... You and your TA-TA saved everyone in the Park, and did so many things for us...

dialogText.cn: 很多人都希望能亲眼见一见你，和你说一声谢谢。
dialogText.en: Everyone else hopes to see you and offer their gratitude in person too.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我、我不太擅长应对这样的场面——救命！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I ... I'm not really good at handling a situation like this — HELP!

dialogText.cn: 欸？
dialogText.en: Really?

dialogText.cn: 但那幅作品很漂亮，大家很开心，想看到它完成的样子。你给现在的园区带来了生气，谢谢。
dialogText.en: But that work of yours is a true spectacle. People are really happy to see it and hope it can be completed. Your work has breathed life into the Park and everyone's thankful.

dialogText.cn: 我怎么又哭鼻子了……呜……
dialogText.en: Why am I sniveling again ... hngh...

dialogText.cn: 我也会有这样的时候。
dialogText.en: {F}It also happens to me from time to time.{M}It also happens to me from time to time.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗……我不信……
dialogText.en: *Sniffs*... Really...? I don't believe it...

dialogText.cn: 那是一段很遥远的梦。醒来时总是忘记，梦到底对我说了什么。
dialogText.en: {F}It's a distant dream. And when I wake, I always fail to remember what the dream was trying to tell me.{M}It's a distant dream. And when I wake, I always fail to remember what the dream was trying to tell me.

dialogText.cn: 但泪水不会说谎。每时每刻，我都能感觉到有什么人在等我……
dialogText.en: {F}But the tears never lie. I constantly feel that there's someone out there ... waiting for me...{M}But the tears never lie. I constantly feel that there's someone out there ... waiting for me...

dialogText.cn: ……不要说这种话。
dialogText.en: ...Stop saying things like that.

dialogText.cn: 就好像你迟早会去很远的地方，再也不回来一样。
dialogText.en: It sounds like you'll be heading somewhere far away ... and never come back.

dialogText.cn: 不是我，是终末地。我们正朝着一个遥远的目的地前进。
dialogText.en: {F}Not just me. The entirety of Endfield. We're all headed towards a faraway destination.{M}Not just me. The entirety of Endfield. We're all headed towards a faraway destination.

dialogText.cn: 没错，才不会让你一个人去。有我，有大家，还有——
dialogText.en: That's right. No one's gonna let you do this alone. There's me and everyone else. And —

dialogText.cn: 还剩下点时间，管理员，跟我来！
dialogText.en: Oh, we got some time left. Follow me, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，管理员……其实我拿到涂料时，就想到要画塔塔了。
dialogText.en: Sorry, Endmin... I actually thought about drawing Tata when the paints arrived.

dialogText.cn: 明明我收集了四号谷地所有人的笑脸，亲手给它雕琢了最完美的笑容……我不可能忘记的……
dialogText.en: I collected all the smiles in Valley IV and, with my own hands, gave it the perfect smile emote... There's no way I could forget...

dialogText.cn: 我才没同意让塔塔离去！不许乱说！
dialogText.en: Left us?! What do you mean?! I won't allow that!

dialogText.cn: 我要复原它！这一次，我一定会保护好它，不会再让它离开……呜！
dialogText.en: I'm gonna restore it! And this time, I'll protect it! I won't let it leave me again... *hik*!

dialogText.cn: 但我好怕画出来的东西跟我的记忆有偏差……好怕画得不像塔塔……
dialogText.en: But I was scared that my drawings wouldn't match my memories... Scared that my drawings wouldn't look anything like Tata...

dialogText.cn: 没回？唉……黑面煞，我就跟您说实话吧，大当家确实嘱咐过，谁来了也不见。
dialogText.en: Didn't toast you back? *Sigh*... I'll just tell you the truth, Darkmask. Chief gave her orders. She does not want to see anyone.

dialogText.cn: 如果有人来找，要么帮忙干活，最起码采上九万九千九百九十九个琼叶参。
dialogText.en: She said if anybody comes asking, get them to help. And that means gathering at least ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred and ninety-nine Redjade Ginseng.

dialogText.cn: 要么去仓库拿面锣，绕着寨子一直喊：“一支穿云箭，汤汤大当家来相见！”
dialogText.en: That, or grab a gong from the warehouse and bang it as loud as you can while walking round the Stockade, shouting: "Fire the fiery flare! Tangtang the Supreme Chief, come meet us here!"

dialogText.cn: 等到诚意打动了大当家，她自然会出来踹你两脚。
dialogText.en: And if you're sincere enough with the noise you make, Chief Tangtang will be there to give you a kick or two.

dialogText.cn: 您就别问我了，我是真不想被大当家踢屁股。
dialogText.en: Please don't make it hard for me. Nobody wants the Chief to plant her boot in our faces.

dialogText.cn: 唉……这样吧。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Fine.

dialogText.cn: 我不能和您说，但您自己听到了，那就是另一回事。
dialogText.en: I can't tell you how, but I can't stop you from accidentally overhearing things.

dialogText.cn: 喏，这附近啊……有人才见过大当家。
dialogText.en: Here goes. Someone actually saw the Chief recently ... near these parts.

actorName.cn: 神色有异的寨民{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 东西做好了，就等着往武陵运了，弟兄们已经……
dialogText.en: Job's done. Gotta carry this to Wuling. The Fam is...

actorName.cn: 小心谨慎的寨民{c27-小心谨慎的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 我总觉得背着二姑娘做这事，有点……
dialogText.en: Doing this behind the Younger Dame's back feels a little...

actorName.cn: 神色有异的寨民{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 我看这份大礼也该送她一份，给阮哥出口恶气！
dialogText.en: We should also give her a serving of this good stuff. That'll do Big Bro some well-deserved justice!
{F}(Good stuff...){M}(Good stuff...)

dialogText.cn: （我得赶紧找到汤汤。）
dialogText.en: {F}(I must find Tangtang quickly.){M}(I must find Tangtang quickly.)

actorName.cn: 神色有异的寨民{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 二姑娘……你还叫她二姑娘！
dialogText.en: Younger Dame?! Why are you still calling her that?

dialogText.cn: 咳咳……大当家最近实在是太辛苦了！整天不见人影。
dialogText.en: AHEM... Chief is really working herself to the bone! Hardly see her nowadays.

dialogText.cn: 没办法，阮一的手下在招揽人手，说要报复咱们……她心里烦啊。
dialogText.en: Chief's got no choice, bro. Ruan Yi's underlings are recruiting more to their side. Said they wanted revenge... That's some serious trouble on her hands.

dialogText.cn: 要是有个人能陪大当家说说话就好了！
dialogText.en: If only there was someone to keep her company and talk with her!

dialogText.cn: 是啊，有这样的人，大当家也不至于一个人孤零零待在水车边上了！
dialogText.en: Yeah. If someone like that were around, Chief wouldn't be all alone on her own near the waterwheel!

dialogText.cn: （水车……谢了。）
dialogText.en: {F}(The waterwheel... Thanks.){M}(The waterwheel... Thanks.)

actorName.cn: 收拾东西的寨民{c27-收拾东西的寨民}
actorName.en: Stockade Resident Packing Things Up{c27-Stockade Resident Packing Things Up}

dialogText.cn: 留着有什么用呢，阮哥一死，人心都散了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Why bother staying? Big Bro is dead. There's nothing to care about anymore.

actorName.cn: 收拾东西的寨民{c27-收拾东西的寨民}
actorName.en: Stockade Resident Packing Things Up{c27-Stockade Resident Packing Things Up}

dialogText.cn: 这要走的事，我也不好和大当家提啊……
dialogText.en: Talk to the Chief? I can't just go up to her face and tell her we're leaving...

actorName.cn: 语气忧伤的寨民{c27-语气忧伤的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 而且……想说也抓不到她啊，这几天我就没见她能坐下歇会儿。
dialogText.en: Yeah... And we could hardly talk to her anyway. I barely see her taking any breaks recently.

actorName.cn: 脸色严肃的寨民{c27-脸色严肃的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 是啊，这节骨眼上，他们不仅不帮忙，还会添乱。
dialogText.en: Yeah. These are hard times. Not only did they refuse to help, but they're also trying to mess things up.

actorName.cn: 垂头丧气的寨民{c27-垂头丧气的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 知道啊。有时我看大当家一个人，耷拉着头，挺沮丧的。
dialogText.en: Of course she does. Sometimes I see her all alone, head hung real low, looking sad and all.

actorName.cn: 垂头丧气的寨民{c27-垂头丧气的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 唉，她发现我看到她了，就没再去那个地方了。现在我也不清楚。
dialogText.en: Well ... when she realized that I saw her, she no longer went there anymore. I don't know where she is.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞……您怎么来了？
dialogText.en: Darkmask...? Why are you here?

dialogText.cn: 唉，出事后大当家整天忙得不见人影，有时我们也不清楚她在哪里。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*. After that incident, the Chief became really busy. Sometimes even we don't know where to find her.

dialogText.cn: 那她有主动联系过您吗？
dialogText.en: Did she holler you?

dialogText.cn: 这下难办了。
dialogText.en: Now that'd make things difficult.

dialogText.cn: 要不……您先问一下大当家，看看情况？
dialogText.en: Say, why don't you ... send a message to the Chief? See how she's doing?

dialogText.cn: 听到没！阮一你个大混蛋！！
dialogText.en: You hear that? YOU ARE A BLIGHTED BASTARD, BIG BRO!

dialogText.cn: 让我带你的角去武陵！带个屁！我不去！你说什么我就干什么！凭什么！
dialogText.en: Take your horn to Wuling? To the Blight with that! I'm not taking your order! NEVER!

dialogText.cn: 以后姑奶奶每天带着你的角上这儿来骂你！不服也给我生生受着！
dialogText.en: I'm gonna bring this silly big horn of yours here! And cuss you out TILL YOU FRIGGIN ROT!

dialogText.cn: 呸，死死受着！
dialogText.en: PTUI! TILL YOU FRIGGIN CRY!

dialogText.cn: 你要是能……你也骂我啊……
dialogText.en: But if you're upset ... you can cuss back too ... you know...

dialogText.cn: 小心！
dialogText.en: WATCH OUT!

dialogText.cn: 你来得正好，省得我跑武陵城里去拿你的脑袋！
dialogText.en: So nice of you to show up! Almost thought I had to visit Wuling to murk you!

dialogText.cn: 兄弟们，宰了这两人给阮哥报仇！
dialogText.en: Alright, FAM! Let's kill these two and avenge our Big Bro!

dialogText.cn: 有种现在杀了我！嘿，就像你杀了我阮哥一样！
dialogText.en: Hah! Go ahead! Kill me now! Just like how you butchered my Big Bro!

dialogText.cn: 洗浊，看在过去的情分上，我不想对你动手。
dialogText.en: You were part of the Fam, Dirt Rinser. And that means I'm letting you off.

dialogText.cn: 还不滚！
dialogText.en: NOW GET OUT!

dialogText.cn: 呸，叛徒！
dialogText.en: *Ptui* Traitor!

dialogText.cn: 叛徒……你们跟着我哥把裂地者引进寨子，还有脸说我是叛徒。
dialogText.en: Traitor...? You ganged up with Big Bro and sneaked the breakers into our Stockade! How dare you call me a traitor!

dialogText.cn: 再让我看见你，就别想全乎着回去！给你扒光了……吊树上！
dialogText.en: I'll rip you apart if I ever see you again! RIP YOU BLOODY RAW ... AND HANG YOU FROM A TREE!

dialogText.cn: 少给我戴高帽子，我还没问是谁放你过来的。
dialogText.en: Drop the flattery. I should probably ask who let you through.

dialogText.cn: 谁把你放过来的？我先把他吊树上！
dialogText.en: Who the hell let you in? I'm gonna hang that scum from a tree!

dialogText.cn: 我说这几天<@qu.key>商叔</>他们藏起来搞七搞八的，原来不只是要针对我，还在惦记武陵……
dialogText.en: Is that why <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</> and his peeps started sneaking around these days...? I'm not their only target. They're after Wuling too...

dialogText.cn: 他失去了孩子，我哥失去了父亲。后来，他就把我哥当成了自己的孩子。
dialogText.en: And my Bro lost his dad. Uncle Shang thus started treating Big Bro like his own.

dialogText.cn: 如今我哥死了，<@qu.key>商叔</>肯定不会放过杀他的人，尤其是……咱们。
dialogText.en: Now that Big Bro has died, <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</> is gonna settle the score... And that means us. Especially us.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你回去吧。
dialogText.en: You should head back, Darkmask.

dialogText.cn: 我真没事儿，就是这几天忙得脚都快长头上了，实在顾不上看消息。
dialogText.en: I'm totally alright. Just swamped lately, so I haven't been on Baker, you know.

dialogText.cn: 够了，别跟来！
dialogText.en: Enough, leave me alone!

dialogText.cn: 原来是偷听到的，到底是谁嘴巴漏风……什么事？你赶紧说。
dialogText.en: Eavesdropped? Tsk, those idiots couldn't shut up. Alright, what's this emergency?

dialogText.cn: 但给姑奶奶记住，不该碰的人别碰！
dialogText.en: But get this straight, loser! NO ONE TOUCHES MY FAM!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，是我哥手底下一个主事的，他的孩子也死在了十年前那场冲突里……
dialogText.en: Yeah. One of my Bro's advisors. He lost his kid in that scuffle ten years ago...

dialogText.cn: 呵，他已经死了……是谁的选择，真的还重要吗？
dialogText.en: Hur. He's died... Does it really matter who made the choice?

dialogText.cn: 记得帮我告诉红脸婆，这事儿我会收拾好的，她少插手。
dialogText.en: Don't forget to tell that mad woman to keep her stinky hands out of this. I'll be taking care of it.

dialogText.cn: 行了行了，我这人内里外里都是一套，说了没事儿就是没事儿。
dialogText.en: Enough talking already. I'm a terrible liar, so when I say I'm OK, it means I'm A-OK!

dialogText.cn: 有事儿……那也是我自己的事儿……
dialogText.en: And if I got problems ... they're really personal problems...

dialogText.cn: （唉……算了，先回武陵城吧。）
dialogText.en: {F}(*Sigh*... Time to return to Wuling, I guess.){M}(*Sigh*... Time to return to Wuling, I guess.)

actorName.cn: 远处的声音{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 送给……搞定……走，回内寨……
dialogText.en: ...We delivered... Let's go and return to the Stockade fort.

dialogText.cn: 混账东西！遛了姑奶奶半天，站住！
dialogText.en: Stop right there, scumbag! Had fun making your Chief chase you?

dialogText.cn: 这……这是……
dialogText.en: What...? Da hell is this...?

dialogText.cn: 起爆器……*清波寨俚语*！
dialogText.en: A detonator...?! *Qingbo Stockade expletive"!

dialogText.cn: 得找人帮忙……谁来……
dialogText.en: Gotta holler for help ... but who...

dialogText.cn: 鬼鬼祟祟的，干什么呢？​
dialogText.en: What are you doing sneaking about down there?​

dialogText.cn: 你、你……你怎么……姑奶奶现在急着逛街，没空理你！
dialogText.en: W-Wha...? Why are you here...? I'm busy shopping. Got no time for you!

dialogText.cn: 逛街逛到水渠里，你当我是三岁小孩？说实话！
dialogText.en: Oh? 'Cos we have fancy boutiques in the drainage canal? Don't treat me as stupid, little kitty! Out with it!

dialogText.cn: 我、我……
黑面煞……！
dialogText.en: Darkmask...!

dialogText.cn: 对！就是这样，你听到了吧，快走，别碍事！
dialogText.en: Yeah! Heard that, Captain Mi? Now go and fine your silly Wulingers and don't get in my way!

dialogText.cn: 她明明是来……算了，既然管理员你心里有数，那你来处理。
dialogText.en: Endmin, she's obviously here to... Hmph. Whatever. If you got it figured out, I'm sure you're on top of it.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞！快来！下面有个炸弹！
dialogText.en: Darkmask! Quick, get down here! I found a bomb!

dialogText.cn: 处理好了，记得来找我说一声，谢了。
dialogText.en: And I'd appreciate it if you'd call me once you're done. Thanks in advance.

dialogText.cn: 今天多亏有你，欠你个人情，下次肯定还。
dialogText.en: But thankfully you showed up today. Owe you big time, Darkmask. I'll make it up to you.

dialogText.cn: 对了，和我说实话……你到底是怎么找到这里的哇？
dialogText.en: Before we forget, just tell me the truth... How did you know I was here?

dialogText.cn: 嘁！你这人，是不是比别人多长了一个脑子？
dialogText.en: Meh! I'm starting to suspect you're a different species, Darkmask. Maybe they built you with an extra brain.

dialogText.cn: 这家伙！都说别告诉你了！
dialogText.en: That little beady turnip?! URGH! I thought I told her to keep this from you!

dialogText.cn: 武陵跟清波寨好不容易停战，勉强相安无事了，我不想多惹事……
dialogText.en: The Stockade finally entered a truce with Wuling. Peace isn't easy, you know, and I don't want to mess things up...

dialogText.cn: 可……这是清波寨自己的事儿，我不想再把你卷进来。
dialogText.en: But ... this is Stockade business. I didn't want you to get involved again.

dialogText.cn: 那、那我……破例允许你来帮我下！
dialogText.en: Alright, then I guess I'll ... bend the rules a bit and let you help me out!

dialogText.cn: 我们循着他们的踪迹，把<@qu.key>商叔</>藏身的地方找出来，彻底阻止他们袭击武陵城。
dialogText.en: Let's track them down, find <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</>'s hiding spot, and friggin destroy all their plans to attack this city.

dialogText.cn: 我先去瞧瞧，你等我消息！
dialogText.en: I'll do some scouting. Wait for my news!

dialogText.cn: 到时候联系你！
dialogText.en: I'll holler you once I'm done!

dialogText.cn: 你叫我一声大当家，几次三番伸手帮我，但我却总是连累你。
dialogText.en: You keep calling me Chief and helping me out again and again. But I gave you nothing but trouble.

dialogText.cn: 到现在，我也想为你和终末地做些什么，就算做不了，也不该给你们添麻烦。
dialogText.en: I just wish I could do something for you and your Endfield right now. If I couldn't do that, at least I shouldn't be getting in your way.

dialogText.cn: 你说什么？
dialogText.en: What ... did you just say?

dialogText.cn: 家人……是啊……
dialogText.en: The Fam... That's right...

dialogText.cn: 那几个混蛋跑了，但肯定是回<@qu.key>商叔</>那儿了。
dialogText.en: SO! Those stinking losers got away! They definitely scampered back to <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</>.

dialogText.cn: 呼……还以为姑奶奶要交待在这儿了。
dialogText.en: Hooo... Almost thought I was going down with that blasted bomb.

dialogText.cn: 我还想，不然就告诉红脸婆，总不能让它炸了。
dialogText.en: I even thought about telling the mad woman everything! Can't just watch the bomb go off.

dialogText.cn: （先去找弭弗吧。）
dialogText.en: {F}(I'll look for Mi Fu first.){M}(I'll look for Mi Fu first.)

dialogText.cn: 那四个潜入武陵城的家伙在哪儿？还没给姑奶奶惹出事吧？
dialogText.en: Alright. Tell me about the four who sneaked into Wuling. I hope those losers haven't caused any trouble yet.

dialogText.cn: 放心，我们已经查到踪迹了。市民广场有一个，还有三个，好像带着什么去那条商店街了。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. I found their trail. Got one at Citizen Square. The other three brought something to that big shopping road.

dialogText.cn: *清波寨俚语*！行，我先去逮那个落单的。
dialogText.en: *Qingbo Stockade expletive*! Fine. I'll grab that loner loser.

dialogText.cn: 不用我帮忙？
dialogText.en: Need help with that?

dialogText.cn: 我们这次悄悄进武陵城，本来就是不想被人注意。要是聚在一起把红脸婆引过来，她肯定要带着巡卫满城抓人！
dialogText.en: We sneaked into Wuling 'cos we didn't want to attract attention. If we move as a team, that mad woman is gonna notice and she's gonna start cuffing people with her watchguards!

dialogText.cn: 我才不会给她机会插手清波寨的事！
dialogText.en: Mad woman doesn't get to intervene in Stockade biz! And that's final!

dialogText.cn: 行，那我先藏起来继续探查，等大当家吩咐了。
dialogText.en: Sure. I'll snoop around and continue with my investigations. Holler me if you got new orders, Chief.
Hoooooo...

dialogText.cn: 多亏你来了，黑面煞……不然……不过，你怎么会在这儿？
dialogText.en: Thank Talos you're here, Darkmask. They'd have... Wait. Why are you here in the first place?

dialogText.cn: 哼，谁信你。走……这里待着太憋屈，出去以后我们好好说说。
dialogText.en: Hmph. I don't buy it. Let's ditch this stuffy place... We'll have a proper talk outside.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，事情结了吗？
dialogText.en: How was it? Everything going well?

dialogText.cn: 那汤汤她……算了，既然她愿意让你帮忙，说明心里还有数，没再逞强了。
dialogText.en: Then Tangtang...? Hmph. Whatever. If she agreed to let you help, she probably knows how serious this thing is ... and how it has grown out of her petty competition.

dialogText.cn: 有你在她旁边，我没什么不放心，但如果……
dialogText.en: I know I need not worry about Tangtang if you're around her, but...

dialogText.cn: 总之，需要我出手你就说一声，随时都在。
dialogText.en: ...Just give me a call should the need arise. I'm always on Baker.

dialogText.cn: 大当家，有弟兄看见他们拎着行李，进选剑局旁的地下水渠了。
dialogText.en: Chief! Some Fam reported seeing the gang with some luggage. They just entered the underground canal near the Bureau of Swordmancers.

dialogText.cn: 我这就把位置发给你。
dialogText.en: I'm sending you the location.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你来拿大当家的礼物吗？我放在旁边了。
dialogText.en: Darkmask, here for the Chief's present? I placed it on the side.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤券代表大当家的看重与信任，我都没收过呢。
dialogText.en: Tangtang Certs represent our Chief's appreciation and trust. I haven't even managed to earn one yet.

dialogText.cn: 既然东西交给你啦，我还有事，就……
dialogText.en: Alright. Handover complete. Gotta run. I have biz —

dialogText.cn: 要不是怕被大当家揍，我都想偷偷拿一张了……
dialogText.en: Would've sneaked one for myself if the Chief didn't beat people up for that...

dialogText.cn: 那你可得好好保管，要是丢一张，大当家肯定饶不了你。
dialogText.en: Then you better take proper care of them. The Chief won't forgive anyone who loses her special cert.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，大当家要是知道你丢了一张，肯定饶不了你。
dialogText.en: Yeah. The Chief won't forgive you if you lose her special cert.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳……那个……没什么，小事小事，我真得走了。
dialogText.en: Ah... Well... You know ... just doing some errands. I really gotta run.

dialogText.cn: 婆婆，扫听个事儿！你有没有看见可疑的人哇？
dialogText.en: Hey, can I ask you something? See anyone who's super suspicious?

actorName.cn: 耳背的老人{c27-耳背的老人}
actorName.en: Old Lady with Bad Hearing{c27-Old Lady with Bad Hearing}

dialogText.cn: 啥——你要扫地？
dialogText.en: Huh —? Again? What's so auspicious?

dialogText.cn: 啊？不是！我是说，打听个事情！
dialogText.en: Huh? No! It's suspicious! Saw anyone sneaking around?

actorName.cn: 耳背的老人{c27-耳背的老人}
actorName.en: Old Lady with Bad Hearing{c27-Old Lady with Bad Hearing}

dialogText.cn: 你这么漂亮的小姑娘，可不能打人啊。
dialogText.en: Come now, young miss. A pretty girl like you shouldn't be snooping around.

dialogText.cn: 我在找可疑的人！
dialogText.en: I said! I'm looking for PEOPLE who are SNEAKING around!

actorName.cn: 耳背的老人{c27-耳背的老人}
actorName.en: Old Lady with Bad Hearing{c27-Old Lady with Bad Hearing}

dialogText.cn: 哦！可疑的，今天就见着你一个……
dialogText.en: Ah! Sneaking around. Oh yes, I did. You're the only sneaky one I saw today...

dialogText.cn: 我？！我、我哪里可疑了！
dialogText.en: ME?! Sneaky?! How?!

actorName.cn: 耳背的老人{c27-耳背的老人}
actorName.en: Old Lady with Bad Hearing{c27-Old Lady with Bad Hearing}

dialogText.cn: 你不可疑，为什么刚才有人看到你就跑？
dialogText.en: Oh, you are very sneaky, young miss. I saw people scampering away when they saw you.

dialogText.cn: 跑？往哪里跑了？！
dialogText.en: SCAMPER?! Where did they go?

actorName.cn: 耳背的老人{c27-耳背的老人}
actorName.en: Old Lady with Bad Hearing{c27-Old Lady with Bad Hearing}

dialogText.cn: 喏，往那边去了。
dialogText.en: There, they went that way.

dialogText.cn: （那条商店街……难道他是找同伴会合去了？）
dialogText.en: (That's the big shopping road... Did he run off to meet his gang?)

dialogText.cn: 谢了婆婆！
dialogText.en: THANK YOU VERY MUCH, MA'AM!

dialogText.cn: 咳、咳咳！你……这位兄弟！
dialogText.en: Ahem. AAAHHHEM! You there ... my good man!

actorName.cn: 困惑的天师{c27-困惑的天师}

dialogText.cn: 噫……！你、你是来催我交终稿的吗？再宽限几天……我的数据对不上啊！
dialogText.en: Huh...? Are you here to rush my final draft? I just need a few more days...! I NEED TO FIX THE GOODNESS OF FIT!

dialogText.cn: 什么糕？我不吃糕。我来问你有没有瞧见过奇怪的家伙？
dialogText.en: Goodness of fit? Sure. Exercise a bit more, I guess? Anyway! Did you see anyone acting all weird and sus?

actorName.cn: 困惑的天师{c27-困惑的天师}

dialogText.cn: 奇怪……没有啊？不如我帮你问问那边的巡卫。
dialogText.en: Weird and sus...? Not really. But I can ask that watchguard for you.

actorName.cn: 困惑的天师{c27-困惑的天师}

dialogText.cn: 哎……人呢？
dialogText.en: Huh...? Where did she go?

dialogText.cn: 不是，你别……
dialogText.en: No, no. Please don't...

actorName.cn: 困惑的天师{c27-困惑的天师}

dialogText.cn: 李惴！这边有个小姑娘要找人。
dialogText.en: Li! We got a young miss looking for someone!

dialogText.cn: 什么事？
dialogText.en: What's going on?

actorName.cn: 困惑的天师{c27-困惑的天师}

dialogText.cn: 刚还在这里啊……奇怪……
dialogText.en: She was here just a second ago... Now that's really weird and sus...

dialogText.cn: 老板，你有没有瞅见几个走在一起，看起来怪怪的家伙？
dialogText.en: Hey, boss. Seen a bunch of weirdos hanging out together and behaving really sus?

dialogText.cn: 这么巧！刚过去四个，其中一个提着行李。我问他们吃不吃饭，没理我。
dialogText.en: And I was wondering if anyone would ask me that! Saw a group of four dragging some luggage who went past my place. I asked if they needed some food, but they ignored me.

dialogText.cn: 他们在跟着一个……好像是……穿着黑衣服的人！走得太快，我也没看清楚。
dialogText.en: I think they were trying to follow ... someone who's... Ah! Yes! Someone dressed in black! They were walking super fast, too! I could hardly see them clearly.

dialogText.cn: 黑衣服？！
dialogText.en: Dressed in black?!

dialogText.cn: 坏了，难道是冲黑面煞来的？！
dialogText.en: Curses! Are they after Darkmask?

dialogText.cn: 黑面？脸确实蛮黑的……
dialogText.en: Darkmask? Yeah. There was someone with some darkness on their face.

dialogText.cn: 他们往哪边去了？
dialogText.en: Where did they go?

dialogText.cn: 火锅店，我亲眼看到他们进去了。
dialogText.en: The hot pot eatery. Saw them go in.

dialogText.cn: 多谢了，老板。
dialogText.en: Thanks a million, boss.

actorName.cn: 火锅店服务员{c27-火锅店服务员}

dialogText.cn: 您里边儿坐啊！还有的是位置——您一个人？
dialogText.en: Come on in! We got plenty of seats! Dining alone or with a group?

dialogText.cn: 不、不必！你有没有，看见一个遮住眼睛的人……还有四个人……跟着……
dialogText.en: Hoo. No, thanks! I'm good! Hooo. Did you see a person wearing some eye cover... And a group of four... They're following —

actorName.cn: 火锅店服务员{c27-火锅店服务员}

dialogText.cn: 遮住眼睛的……
dialogText.en: Some eye cover...?

dialogText.cn: 对！
dialogText.en: THAT'S RIGHT!

actorName.cn: 火锅店服务员{c27-火锅店服务员}

dialogText.cn: 呃，穿着一身黑，嘴里面不是这个工程就是那个技术？
dialogText.en: Hmm. And is this someone dressed in black? And keeps talking about engineering and tech?

dialogText.cn: 对对！完全就是本人！
dialogText.en: Exactly! That's the perfect description!

actorName.cn: 火锅店服务员{c27-火锅店服务员}

dialogText.cn: 就在后面！
dialogText.en: And right back there too!

dialogText.cn: 什么……不会被下锅里了吧？！
dialogText.en: WHAT?! Are they dunking Darkmask into the hotpot?!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，我来救你了！
dialogText.en: Darkmask! I'm here to save you!

dialogText.cn: 哎哟，脑瓜子疼……
dialogText.en: Aiyo… My head! Ow!

dialogText.cn: 哪儿来的小丫头？
dialogText.en: Where did this little girl come from?

dialogText.cn: 谁！呃……你谁啊？
dialogText.en: What the...! Huh ... who are you?

dialogText.cn: 我听说有人找我，是你吗？
dialogText.en: Heard someone's looking for me. Is it you?

dialogText.cn: 不是，你不是，我不是……谁找你了！
dialogText.en: No! You're not... I'm looking... Hey, nobody's looking for you!

actorName.cn: 火锅店服务员{c27-火锅店服务员}

dialogText.cn: 来砸场子的？
