dialogText.en: Is she here to wreck our store?

dialogText.cn: 就一个小丫头……去去，回去干活去！凑什么热闹！
dialogText.en: Just a little girl... It's okay! Get back to work! No big deal!

dialogText.cn: 人呢……跑这么快啊？
dialogText.en: She's gone already? That girl's fast.

dialogText.cn: 着什么急？
dialogText.en: Patience, little one!

dialogText.cn: 要想掏到羽兽巢里的蛋，你就得跟着受惊的羽兽走，它自然能把咱们引到巢里。
dialogText.en: If you want eggs, spook a fowlbeast and follow it back to its roost.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>商叔</>的人一般都是结伴行动的，他现在肯定正找人接应自己回去。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</>'s gang often acts in groups. He's definitely trying to find his people and get back home.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，他们一个个都说我是被我哥保护着长大的。
dialogText.en: Heheh. But those losers think I grew up pampered and spoiled by my brother.

dialogText.cn: 可谁也不说，姑奶奶也是他亲自培养的继承人。
dialogText.en: They're friggin wrong. I'm his best apprentice and next-in-line. Now, why won't anyone mention that?

dialogText.cn: 算了……不提他了，咱们去看看这小羽兽扑棱到哪儿了。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Enough about this. Let's find where that little tweety-fowl ran off to.

dialogText.cn: 瞧，叫姑奶奶说中了！
dialogText.en: See! Your Chief got it all figured out!

actorName.cn: 神色有异的寨民{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 咋这么慢……啊？你这手咋了？
dialogText.en: Took you long enough, slow poke... Geez! What happened to your hand?!

dialogText.cn: 没事，碰上了那丫头片子……
dialogText.en: It's nothing. Just ran into that little whiny snot...

actorName.cn: 神色有异的寨民{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>商叔</>都叫咱们先别管她了，你还去，回头他抽你。
dialogText.en: Why the hell mess with her? We were told to leave her alone. <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</> will flog you raw.

actorName.cn: 神色有异的寨民{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 一会儿还得划筏子，你这手伤了，回去可麻烦了。
dialogText.en: And we got a fair bit of punting after this. I don't know if your messed-up hand is up for the job.

dialogText.cn: 我单手也能划，别废话。
dialogText.en: Cut the crap. I can punt just as well with one arm.

actorName.cn: 神色有异的寨民{c27-神色有异的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 就逞能吧你，今天河面上起了大雾，小心祖泉把你收了！
dialogText.en: One-arm punting? Gimme a break. River fog is thick as porridge today. The Ancestral Spring will swallow you whole if you aren't careful.

dialogText.cn: 大雾……筏子……我知道在哪里了！我哥这家伙……
dialogText.en: The fog... And the raft... OH! I know where the place is! Ugh. That's why Big Bro...

dialogText.cn: 跟我走！
dialogText.en: Follow me!

dialogText.cn: 都快到时间了……汤汤怎么还没来？
dialogText.en: {F}It's almost time... Why isn't Tangtang here yet?{M}It's almost time... Why isn't Tangtang here yet?

dialogText.cn: 脚印很凌乱，像发生过打斗……她这是遇上埋伏了！
dialogText.en: So many footprints, and in such a mess. Looks like a fight... Tangtang has been ambushed!

dialogText.cn: 得赶紧找到她！
dialogText.en: I must find her quickly!

dialogText.cn: 靠你们几个就想杀你姑奶奶？呸，再活八辈子也做不到！
dialogText.en: Trying to take me down?! Not in this lifetime, losers! Not even in eight friggin lifetimes!

dialogText.cn: 别挣扎了，二姑娘，今天就是你给阮哥偿命的日子！
dialogText.en: Quit struggling already, little dame. This is the day you pay for Big Bro's death!

dialogText.cn: 没事没事，闪躲时太着急，不小心摔到膝盖了，揉一揉就没事了。
dialogText.en: I'm alright. I rushed a dodge, but tripped and scraped my knee. A gentle rub should fix it.

dialogText.cn: 唉，就是因为这一摔，才落了下风。
dialogText.en: Ugh. If it weren't for that fall, I would've dominated the battle.

dialogText.cn: 要不然他连我的衣角也摸不——哎哟！
dialogText.en: Like, I'd be totally untouchable — OUCH! Sssss!

dialogText.cn: 不用不用，走一走就好了！
dialogText.en: No, it's okay! I can just walk this off!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你现在不怎么叫我大当家了不说，还想命令我！
dialogText.en: Darkmask, where's your manners?! I'm your Chief, you don't order me around!

dialogText.cn: 嘶……疼疼疼……！那混蛋算计姑奶奶！
dialogText.en: HSSSS... It burns! Urrrggh! Those little shits ambushed me!

dialogText.cn: 一时大意，被这群混账围了……
dialogText.en: I got a bit careless. Those bastards caught me off guard...

dialogText.cn: 欸！没那么疼了……不错！
dialogText.en: Wow! It's not hurting anymore... Not bad!

dialogText.cn: 那混蛋肯定是缩回老巢了，我们快跟上！
dialogText.en: That bastard's probably in his hideout. Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，这件事就先到这儿了。
dialogText.en: No matter what happens... This settles our biz for now.

dialogText.cn: 我们走吧。
dialogText.en: Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 身为清波寨的二把手，你害得整个寨子四分五裂，按理说……不配埋在祖泉旁。
dialogText.en: You were the second-in-command of our Stockade, yet you broke our Fam apart. If we stuck to the rules ... you don't deserve to rest next to the Ancestral Spring.

dialogText.cn: 偷偷把你埋在这里，是我作为妹妹，最后一点私心。
dialogText.en: But I bent the rules and secretly buried you here ... only 'cos I'm your baby sis.

dialogText.cn: 算是报答你，剩最后一口气了，还想着我的未来。你辜负了很多人，却独独没有辜负我。
dialogText.en: Take it as payment for being concerned about my future ... even in your final moments. You let a lot of people down ... except me.

dialogText.cn: 所以我还愿意……再叫你一声哥。
dialogText.en: And that's why I'll still call you ... my brother.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你觉得刚刚是他在回应吗？
dialogText.en: Darkmask, was that his reply?

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: {F}Yes.{M}Yes.

dialogText.cn: 那你有没有听到……他说了什么？
dialogText.en: So did you hear ... what he said?

dialogText.cn: 哥，我不恨你了……可以后，也不会再念着你了。
dialogText.en: Big Bro, I don't hate you anymore... But ... I won't miss you either.

dialogText.cn: 肯定是这里……怪不得这么久都没找到他们藏在哪里。
dialogText.en: This must be the place... This is why nobody found their hidey-hole.

dialogText.cn: 这里雾气重，要是贸然闯进去，肯定会迷失在河面上。
dialogText.en: This fog is way too thick. We'll definitely lose our way if we go in blind.

dialogText.cn: 我以为我哥再三警告我不要靠近，是怕出事，想不到还和我藏了一手。
dialogText.en: To think that Big Bro kept warning me for "safety" reasons. Turns out to be his little secret.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你有法子进去吗？
dialogText.en: Darkmask, figured out a way to get in?

dialogText.cn: 成，那我们就追进去！
dialogText.en: Great. Time to start our chase!

dialogText.cn: 支支吾吾干嘛呢？害怕了？
dialogText.en: Stop being so wishy-washy. You scared?

dialogText.cn: 我既然做了当家主事的，就要有担当，手底下还有人呢，别想了，走不脱。
dialogText.en: I can't ignore my Chief-ly duties. Got a Fam to look out for. So newp. Gotta stick around.

dialogText.cn: 更何况，我生在这里，根在这里，去不了别的地儿。
dialogText.en: Plus, I was Stockade-born and raised. I don't think I'd make it at other places.

dialogText.cn: 朋友之间，你来我往，很常见的事。
dialogText.en: {F}Friends usually meet up and visit each other often.{M}Friends usually meet up and visit each other often.

dialogText.cn: 呸，谁和你是朋友？没大没小！
dialogText.en: Ffft. The Chief is not your bestie! Try to behave!

dialogText.cn: 你不是我朋友吗？
dialogText.en: {F}Oh. I thought we were cool.{M}Oh. I thought we were cool.

dialogText.cn: 我是你大当家！
dialogText.en: I'm your Supreme Chief!

dialogText.cn: 咳咳。既然咱们知道了他们藏在哪儿，准备好后就出发吧！
dialogText.en: Ahem. Now that we know where they're hiding, let's prepare and go after them!

dialogText.cn: 准备好了吗？该出发了。
dialogText.en: Are you done yet? It's time to go.

dialogText.cn: 满墙的清波寨面具，但不知为何，还混杂了几个裂地者的。
dialogText.en: An entire wall covered in Stockader masks. For reasons unknown, a few Landbreaker masks made their way onto the wall.

dialogText.cn: 从武陵“拿来”的仪器，寨内能源不足，很少被使用。
dialogText.en: An instrument "taken" from Wuling. However, it has been rarely used given the lack of power sources in the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 他们要关门，我先冲进去！
dialogText.en: They're closing the gates! I'll charge right in!

dialogText.cn: 随处可见的爆炸物，昭示了清波寨民对武陵的刻骨仇恨。
dialogText.en: There are explosives everywhere. They only reveal the deep-seated hatred that the Qingbo Stockaders have against Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 你能不能……陪我做件事？
dialogText.en: Can you stay a bit ... and help me with something?

dialogText.cn: 你说。
dialogText.en: {F}Sure. What is it?{M}Sure. What is it?

dialogText.cn: 我哥的角，我想埋在祖泉附近，你可以和我一起去吗？
dialogText.en: I want to bury my brother's horn near the Ancestral Spring. Could you keep me company while I do that?

dialogText.cn: 好。
dialogText.en: {F}Of course.{M}Of course.
*Sigh*...

dialogText.cn: 我老觉得我哥和我之间，也隔着一片雾啊。
dialogText.en: I think there's a thick fog between me and my Big Bro too.

dialogText.cn: 他心里藏了一堆事儿，从不和我讲……我也很识趣，从来也不问。
dialogText.en: He kept secrets and never told me anything... I was being nice, so I never asked.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，如果这层雾揭开后……算了，无论是什么，我是他妹，都该认了吧。
dialogText.en: Darkmask, once the fog lifts... Blight it. Whatever. I'm still his baby sis. I gotta live with it.

dialogText.cn: 大当家，无论是什么，我都会陪你一起的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Chief. I'll be with you, no matter what we find.

dialogText.cn: 天师仪上的清波寨纹饰似乎是后来加上的。仔细检查之后，发现天师仪上还镌刻着小字——“大炎尚蜀天师府制”。
dialogText.en: The carvings of Qingbo Stockade on this Tianshi apparatus seem to be added later. Closer inspections of the minute inscriptions reveal these words: "Manufacturer: Tianshi Bureau of Shangshu, Great Yan".

dialogText.cn: 等等……这些人……
dialogText.en: Wait... These people...

dialogText.cn: 先别出头……
dialogText.en: Gotta stay slow...

actorName.cn: 嚣张的裂地者{c27-嚣张的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 愿意和……我们走的，站过来，窝在这里……没用。
dialogText.en: Those who ... wanna join, stand with us. There's no future ... hiding in this place.

dialogText.cn: 我看谁敢？和这群人为伍，寨子的脸都要丢光了。
dialogText.en: I DARE YOU! No true Stockader will ever join the blighted scum! We're an honorable lot!

actorName.cn: 嚣张的裂地者{c27-嚣张的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 这群人……*咕哝*别忘了，我们*咕哝*阮一自己请来的。
dialogText.en: "Blighted scum"...? *Mumble*. Don't forget ... Ruan Yi himself ... *mumble* ... invited us here.

actorName.cn: 嚣张的裂地者{c27-嚣张的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 阮一要报仇*咕哝*指望我们，别说你们，这些喽啰。
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi ... *mumble* ... himself had to come to us for vengeance. Do his minions think they're any better?
WHY YOU —!

actorName.cn: 犹疑的寨民{c27-犹疑的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 是啊……大哥死了，光凭<@qu.key>商叔</>，斗得过武陵吗？
dialogText.en: Yeah... Big Bro's dead. <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</>'s no match for Wuling on his own.

actorName.cn: 果断的寨民{c27-果断的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 不管是谁，只要能带我向武陵复仇，我就跟他走。
dialogText.en: I don't give a damn. I'll join anyone who'll help me make Wuling bleed.

dialogText.cn: 你们这些混账……
dialogText.en: You spineless turncoats...

actorName.cn: 犹疑的寨民{c27-犹疑的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 洗浊哥……怎么办？又一批人和他们走了。
dialogText.en: What should we do, Rinser? They just walked away with another bunch of our people.

dialogText.cn: 当时阮哥去见他们时，我和<@qu.key>商叔</>就不赞同……哼，清波寨和武陵的事，不需要外人来掺和。
dialogText.en: Hrrmph. <@qu.key>Uncle Shang</> and I disagreed with Big Bro when he wanted to meet them... The Stockade don't need no blighted outsiders! Our biz with Wuling is personal!

dialogText.cn: ……黑面煞，你知道吗？
dialogText.en: ...Darkmask, did you know...

dialogText.cn: 我最恨我哥的，是他为了仇恨，拆散了自己的寨子，自己的家。
dialogText.en: ...the thing I hate most about my Bro is that he tore our Stockade apart! Our home! And he did that because of hate!

dialogText.cn: 还说让我拿着角去找武陵……去找庄方宜要出路……
dialogText.en: And then he told me to take his horn to Wuling ... and beg Zhuang Fangyi to take me in...

dialogText.cn: 可笑，他觉得我会抛下寨子，抛下自己的家，抛下自己的家人吗？
dialogText.en: Did he think I'm a joke? That I'd abandon our Stockade, our home, and our Fam?

dialogText.cn: 他觉得我这大当家的身份是儿戏吗？！
dialogText.en: Did he believe that being a Chief is just a fun little game to me?

dialogText.cn: 想都别想，他拆散的……我会一块块都拼回来。
dialogText.en: He's friggin wrong! I'll fix everything he broke... I'll bring every last piece back together!

dialogText.cn: 这些裂地者，可恶……
dialogText.en: To hell with these breakers...

dialogText.cn: 你们是怎么溜进来的？
dialogText.en: How the hell did you slip into our place?

dialogText.cn: 不是你为了报答我们好心放过你，才好心为我们引路的吗？
dialogText.en: Thought you wanted to repay our kindness for sparing you. That's why you led us here, right?

dialogText.cn: 哼，既然来了，就别回去了，我会让商叔摆好“宴席”等你们。
dialogText.en: Hmph. You might as well forget about leaving. I'll let Uncle Shang know. He'll set up a proper "feast" for you.

dialogText.cn: 可恶，他往里面去了……
dialogText.en: Dammit. He went deeper into the place...

actorName.cn: 犹疑的寨民{c27-犹疑的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 二姑娘，急什么？先和我们过过招吧。
dialogText.en: What's the rush, Younger Dame? Come on. Let our weapons do the talking.

dialogText.cn: 哼，难怪他留在寨子里的东西这么少，原来是另外有“家”。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Big Bro actually has another "crib". This explains why he hardly kept anything at the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 没错，我能闻出来，是他那股子死倔死倔的味儿。
dialogText.en: Yeah. It's the smell. That stubborn and Forte-headed stink of his.

dialogText.cn: 那个……黑面煞，你能等我一会儿吗？
dialogText.en: Erm ... Darkmask? Can you ... wait for a bit?

dialogText.cn: 嘴巴严的人，心里的事儿就多，可人的心就一个拳头大，肯定有兜不住的。
dialogText.en: Tight-lipped people got a lot of stuff in their chest. But no one can hold everything in. Some secrets are bound to spill.

dialogText.cn: 我还是想看看……他都藏了什么在这里。
dialogText.en: I wanna take a closer look ... see what he kept at this place.

dialogText.cn: 这都是……爹爹的遗物？
dialogText.en: Are these ... dad's stuff?

dialogText.cn: 哦，说不定是我爹从哪个天师那里缴来的，那时候天天和武陵人干仗，总带回来一堆有的没的。
dialogText.en: Oh. My dad probably picked it up from a Tianshi. We were fighting Wulingers almost every day. Got ourselves a load of loot.

dialogText.cn: 我绝不要做那样的大当家。
dialogText.en: That's definitely not the type of Chief I wanna be.

dialogText.cn: 绝不。
dialogText.en: Never.

dialogText.cn: 难道是从别的地方带来的……我爹也没去过外面啊？
dialogText.en: Did it come from somewhere else...? But my old man never left this region.

dialogText.cn: 你的意思……这是他自己的东西吗？
dialogText.en: What do you mean...? Is this actually ... his?

dialogText.cn: 不可能，我爹怎么可能……是天师。
dialogText.en: Impossible. My dad is a Tianshi...? No way.

dialogText.cn: ……行了，黑面煞，我知道你还想说什么，我不是真傻。
dialogText.en: ...That's enough, Darkmask. I know what you're gonna say. I'm not stupid.

dialogText.cn: 是，武陵和我们之间，许多债、许多仇、许多结，缠在一起，剪不断也扯不清楚。
dialogText.en: Sure, our Stockade got a super complex, rough, angry, and crazy relationship with Wuling. It's a real big mess that no one could really figure out.

dialogText.cn: 可我也明白，我们说一样的话，有相似的传统……以前，或许真有关系。
dialogText.en: But I also know that we share the same lingo and traditions... Maybe we were all part of a bigger Fam before.

dialogText.cn: 我没那个脑子，想来想去，怎么也搞不懂。
dialogText.en: I kept thinking about it, but I don't think I'm wise enough to figure it out.

dialogText.cn: 到最后，只想问一件事，如果我们真是一家，那当时我们的大当家到底在干什么？
dialogText.en: I got only one question in mind. If we were part of a bigger Fam, what was our Supreme Chief doing back then?

dialogText.cn: 他怎么能放任自己的家，就这么散了。
dialogText.en: How could the Chief let their Fam split in two?

dialogText.cn: 商叔，那丫头来了……
dialogText.en: Uncle Shang, that little snot is here...

dialogText.cn: 她当然会来，阮一带大的孩子不会那么没胆子。
dialogText.en: Of course she is. The girl's no coward. Ruan Yi raised her himself.

dialogText.cn: 商叔，好久不见啊，身子骨还硬朗吗？
dialogText.en: It's been quite a while, Uncle Shang. I hope you're doing alright.

dialogText.cn: 承二姑娘的福，老了许多，不大好了。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Younger Dame. I'm getting old ... and doing worse.

dialogText.cn: 那就回清波寨吧，商叔，我哥走了，还有我陪着你。
dialogText.en: Then let's return to the Stockade, Uncle Shang. My brother might be gone, but I'm still around.

dialogText.cn: 炸弹我们处理了，没炸。外边儿的东西我也毁了，酿不成大祸。
dialogText.en: We found the bomb. Disarmed it. I also smashed the things outside. It's time to end this.

dialogText.cn: 咱们还是一家……
dialogText.en: We're still fam —

dialogText.cn: 是啊，你也是我看着长大的孩子。可你却没站在我们一边，而是和那家伙一起，站在我们对面。
dialogText.en: Of course. I knew you since you were a baby. But you didn't stand with your Fam. You took their side and stood against us.

dialogText.cn: 你们已经杀了阮一，现在来杀我，正好！
dialogText.en: You murdered Ruan Yi. And now you've come to end me too. Couldn't ask for more!

dialogText.cn: 清波寨里没你说话的份！
dialogText.en: You don't get to speak about the Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞是我的人，那就是清波寨的人！
dialogText.en: Darkmask is a Stockader 'cos your Chief said so!

dialogText.cn: 阮一为了自己的私心，拖着整个寨子向武陵复仇。
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi was the selfish one! He dragged the Stockade into his war of vengeance!

dialogText.cn: 问我对不对得起他前，先问问他对不对得起寨子！对不对得起大家！对不对得起……
dialogText.en: You said I betrayed my Bro. But did he do the Stockade justice? Or the Fam? Or...

dialogText.cn: 那二姑娘来这里做什么呢！
dialogText.en: Then why are you here, Younger Dame?

dialogText.cn: 我只是想看看，咱们能不能过回以前的日子……
dialogText.en: I just wanna try ... bring things back to the way they were...

dialogText.cn: 可笑！阮一怎么把大当家的位置让给你个糊涂孩子，可笑至极！
dialogText.en: Blightery! Why did Ruan Yi ever name you the Stockade Chief? Foolish girl, you make me laugh!

dialogText.cn: 都到这个地步了，你还是拎不清吗？
dialogText.en: Haven't you figured it out yet?

dialogText.cn: 回不去了！二姑娘！
dialogText.en: There's no going back now, Younger Dame!

dialogText.cn: 好身手！不愧是那小子教出来的。
dialogText.en: Impressive! My boy taught you well.

dialogText.cn: 二姑娘……赶紧动手吧，我现在上路，说不定还能追上那小子。
dialogText.en: Get it over with, Younger Dame... Just send me off... Hopefully I'll catch up with my boy on the path to the afterlife.

dialogText.cn: 商叔，我不是来干这个的。
dialogText.en: I'm not here to do that, Uncle Shang.

dialogText.cn: 我哥临死前，把他的角折断了给我，让我拿着去武陵，给自己谋条生路。
dialogText.en: My brother gave me his horn before he passed away. He wanted me to bring it to Wuling and find a way to make a living.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，自始至终，他也只是把我当个孩子。
dialogText.en: Yeah. He was like that at the beginning. He always treated me as a kid.

dialogText.cn: ……真是混账……我们打定主意跟着他起事，最后竟然是他先放弃。可笑，还真是可笑。
dialogText.en: ...Blasted shit... We're all ready for war but he became the first to throw in the towel. Turned us all into laughingstocks. Pathetic! This is so pathetic!

dialogText.cn: 商叔，回来吧。
dialogText.en: Just come back to us, Uncle Shang.

dialogText.cn: 放弃吧，泻水平地各自流。清波寨与武陵，新仇旧恨夹在一起，本就是不死不休。
dialogText.en: Give up and let the waters flow their own courses... Yet Qingbo and Wuling are trapped in feuds both old and new. One must fall for this to end.

dialogText.cn: 可现在最大的敌人，不在武陵，而是在寨子里。
dialogText.en: But our greatest enemy is not in Wuling. They're right in our Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 商叔，咱们得一起先把那些裂地者，有一个算一个，全都清理出寨子。
dialogText.en: Uncle Shang, we must work together and run those breakers out of our home. Every last one of them.

dialogText.cn: 这话是没错，但二姑娘不怕等到裂地者都走了，我们再反水吗？
dialogText.en: Wise words, but I wonder if our Younger Dame considered this. We might revolt again once the breakers are gone.

dialogText.cn: 不怕！
dialogText.en: I'm not worried about that!

dialogText.cn: 哼，孩子话而已。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Childish talk.

dialogText.cn: 就算是孩子话，我也说话算话！之后你们谁要是想当着我背着我搞东搞西，就等着吃我巴掌。
dialogText.en: It is childish talk but I keep my words! And if anyone tries to be a clown, they're in for a beating!

dialogText.cn: 一次不服就再吃一顿，吃到服为止。
dialogText.en: If one beating won't work, I'll give him another.

dialogText.cn: 反正……日子还很长，这事儿，姑奶奶磕到底了。
dialogText.en: We got ... plenty of time. I can do this all day till you're convinced.

dialogText.cn: 只要我还在，只要我还是清波寨的大当家，这清波寨就别想散！
dialogText.en: As long as I'm here, and as long as I'm your Chief, no one's breaking my Stockade!

dialogText.cn: ……事关寨子中的裂地者，我愿意听你差遣。
dialogText.en: If it's about the Landbreakers in our Stockade, I'll follow your orders.

dialogText.cn: 但之后……无论如何，我希望你记得自己今天说过的话。
dialogText.en: But once that's done... I hope you remember the words you said today, no matter what happens.

dialogText.cn: 二姑娘，阮一最后……当真是这么说的吗？
dialogText.en: My Younger Dame, are those really ... Ruan Yi's final words?

dialogText.cn: 就算你们觉得我这大当家的身份是场儿戏，我也不会轻易撂挑子。
dialogText.en: Maybe everyone thinks I'm a joke at being a Chief, but I'm not quitting this easily.

dialogText.cn: 这角我是用不到了，留着也只是念想。
dialogText.en: I got no use for this horn. And seeing it makes me miss him.

dialogText.cn: 商叔，我知道你们也放不下他。所以，角……你带走吧。
dialogText.en: I know you and your people really look up to him, Uncle Shang. So his ... horn ... you can have it.

dialogText.cn: 商叔……
dialogText.en: Uncle Shang...?

dialogText.cn: 这角我不要，你拿走。
dialogText.en: I won't take this horn. Have it back.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你送我到这里就好了，我好多了，能自己回寨子。
dialogText.en: This is it, Darkmask. I'm feeling much better already. Don't worry, I can walk myself back to my Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 那她和我说的，十年前的事故……他们也牺牲了好些人，不是在骗我？
dialogText.en: She said Wuling also lost plenty of people in that incident ten years ago... Was she lying to me?

dialogText.cn: 你不会在帮她说话吧？
dialogText.en: You ... are not trying to defend her, right?

dialogText.cn: ……我最近一直在想，为啥好多事情一夜之间都变了？
dialogText.en: ...I can't help but keep thinking about this. So many things have changed overnight. Why?

dialogText.cn: 对的变成错的，真的变成假的，爱的变成恨的……
dialogText.en: Right things start going wrong. Real stuff starts feeling fake. Even love got turned into hate...

dialogText.cn: 我是大当家，一步也不会离开清波寨的。嗐，不成不成——
dialogText.en: I'm a Chief. And that means I can't leave my Stockade. Ffft. This won't work —

dialogText.cn: 你耍赖皮！
dialogText.en: You're cheating!

dialogText.cn: 汤汤，你只有见过足够多，走得足够远，才能回答这个问题。
dialogText.en: {F}To answer your question, Tangtang, you must embark on a long journey of learning and first-hand experiences.{M}To answer your question, Tangtang, you must embark on a long journey of learning and first-hand experiences.

dialogText.cn: 终末地会告诉我答案吗？
dialogText.en: Will Endfield give me that answer?

dialogText.cn: 如果……如果我不想回答这个问题呢？
dialogText.en: But what if ... if I didn't really feel like answering the question?

dialogText.cn: 我知道自己一根筋，花一辈子只能回答一个问题。
dialogText.en: I know I'm not that bright. I can spend an entire lifetime pondering, and only end up answering a single question.

dialogText.cn: 就算走了很远，见了够多，脑子里还是只有这小小的清波寨。
dialogText.en: And even if I traveled a bit, saw plenty of stuff, and earned tons of experience ... I'll still carry the Stockade in my mind.

dialogText.cn: 姑奶奶要让“终末地”也改名叫“清波地”！到时候我还是你大当家，一天是老大，一辈子是老大！
dialogText.en: I will rename Endfield as Qingbo-Field! And I'll be your Chief Endmin! Once your Chief, ALWAYS your Chief!

dialogText.cn: 黑面……哎，叫你一声管理员好了！
dialogText.en: Dark... Ugh. Welp, I guess I'll call you Endmin. For once!

dialogText.cn: 唉，你们聪明人都是那么说话的吗？感觉和你们聊天比打架都累。
dialogText.en: Ooof. Do clever people always talk like that? Sounding smart is so tiring. It feels worse than getting into a fight.

dialogText.cn: 每一句我都得寻思，这真的假的？是不是在骗我啊？
dialogText.en: I gotta think about Big Madam's every word. Is she for real? Is she out to rip me off?

dialogText.cn: 我能看到的，永远只是一点点，换个角度看，就不是原来的样子了。
dialogText.en: No matter how I try, I could only see a tiny part. If I look at the same thing from somewhere else, it turns into something super different.

dialogText.cn: 不过嘛，去终末地还是要去的。
dialogText.en: But ... Endfield is definitely on my list of destinations.

dialogText.cn: 我要把终末地的东西都学会，然后好好发展清波寨！
dialogText.en: I'll buff my Stockade with Endfield tech!

dialogText.cn: 明天见了，管理员。
dialogText.en: See you tomorrow, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 小孩儿，我拿这张符和你换这个气球！
dialogText.en: Hey, kiddo! See these super runes? I'll trade them for the balloon!

dialogText.cn: 不要，它画得好丑。
dialogText.en: No way! Your runes are super buggly.

dialogText.cn: 你这就是不懂行了！这张符能保平安的，很贵重！
dialogText.en: 'Cos you got no idea what it can do! These are runes of protection! They're real expensive, you know!

dialogText.cn: 妈妈说，无事献殷勤，非奸即盗。
dialogText.en: Mama warned me about nice strangers! Thieves and cheats!

dialogText.cn: 胡说！我可是清波寨大当家！光明磊落！
dialogText.en: Your Mama is wrong! I'm the Chief of Qingbo! A true hero!

dialogText.cn: （嘀咕）……我有那么讨人厌吗？明明黑面煞看着比我凶多了，凭什么那家伙就那么受欢迎。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Am I that bad? And why does Darkmask get more popularity points while wearing that mean-looking mask?

dialogText.cn: 你什么时候来的？
dialogText.en: When did you arrive?!

dialogText.cn: 你还是我手下呢，就光看着，也不帮帮我！
dialogText.en: You're supposed to be my underling! How could you just stand by and watch?

dialogText.cn: 哼。
dialogText.en: Hmph.

dialogText.cn: 谢啦，黑面煞！我早就瞅这小玩意儿可爱了，以前来武陵城，一直想偷一只回去。
dialogText.en: Thanks a lot, Darkmask! I already got my eyes on this cute chubby thing! Always wanted to steal one for myself whenever I visit the city.

dialogText.cn: 今天可不是我偷跑来的，是红脸婆请我进来的。
dialogText.en: Hee. I didn't sneak here. I actually got an invite from the mad woman.

dialogText.cn: 对啊，红脸婆今天要请我办件要紧的大事！
dialogText.en: Yes she did. Mad woman got some really important biz for me!

dialogText.cn: 但我来得急……没吃饭……
dialogText.en: I ... uh ... rushed here ... and skipped my lunch...

dialogText.cn: 不过……头一次来这儿不用偷偷摸摸的，噫——
dialogText.en: But ... this is also my very first time not sneaking around the city. BRRR —

dialogText.cn: 好啊，弭弗说我吃什么记她账上。今天我非给她吃成穷光蛋。
dialogText.en: YEH!! Mi Fu told me everything's on her tab! Let's grab a real feast and bankrupt that angry pink mop!

dialogText.cn: 还真有点不自在。
dialogText.en: This doesn't feel right at all.

dialogText.cn: 等、等等等！我不去这家——
dialogText.en: WAIT! No! NONONO! Not this place —

dialogText.cn: 管理员，呦，您这次又带客人来啦。
dialogText.en: Endmin! Oh ho! And you brought guests again!

dialogText.cn: 咦？这小丫头看着眼熟……想起来了，是上次找错人那个！
dialogText.en: Hmm. I think I saw this girl before... AH! She's the one who mistook me for someone else!

dialogText.cn: 呃呃呃，我才没来过……不是我……
dialogText.en: NO! It's not me! I was never here... NEVER...!

dialogText.cn: 就是你！你还说黑面煞什么的……原来是管理员啊！
dialogText.en: It was you! You also mentioned the Darkmask too... Now I know you were talking about the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 得嘞，里面坐，马上上菜。
dialogText.en: Let's not keep you waiting. Come on in! I'll serve you in an instant.

dialogText.cn: 香啊！
dialogText.en: *Sniff*! DELISH!

dialogText.cn: 正合我意！弭弗能吃辣，那我也不会输给她！
dialogText.en: PERFECT! Mi Fu is a spice-simp, but I'm a Super Spice Chief!

dialogText.cn: 瞧不起谁呢，红锅朝我！
dialogText.en: I'm not a baby! Give me the spicy side!
Hssss... Whoo... Weee... Hssss...

dialogText.cn: 好辣啊！！！
dialogText.en: I'M BURNING!!!

dialogText.cn: 红脸婆你骗我！
dialogText.en: Damn you, mad woman! You lied to me!

dialogText.cn: 嘶哈——嘶哈——
dialogText.en: Hssaaa — Hssaaa —

dialogText.cn: 不是说武陵辣是微微辣吗！！
dialogText.en: Who told me that Wuling Heat is child-friendly?!

dialogText.cn: 姑奶奶一定……嘶哈……嘶哈……要去找她算账……
dialogText.en: *Glug-glug* I'm gonna ... hssss — hssaa — Beat up that evil woman...

dialogText.cn: 呜……怎么这么辣……
dialogText.en: Hnggh... It still burns...

dialogText.cn: 武陵人的舌头都尝不出味道的吗？
dialogText.en: Are Wulingers built different? What's wrong with their taste?

dialogText.cn: 都怪你老穿一身黑！回头我要把你那面具漆成红的！
dialogText.en: It's all because you're always dressed in black! Once we get back, I'll paint your mask red!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，商叔的事解决了，该骂骂，该打打，姑奶奶终于得了空——
dialogText.en: Yeah. I took care of Uncle Shang's biz. Did some yelling and some beating. The Chief finally got some time for herself —

dialogText.cn: 也该和武陵的人好好谈谈了。
dialogText.en: Phew... Time to actually talk with some Wulingers.

dialogText.cn: 走，陪我会会那姓庄的。
dialogText.en: Alright. Let's go and meet the one they call Madam Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 怎么可能，你见我怵过谁吗？！
dialogText.en: What da hell? I'm afraid of nobody!

dialogText.cn: 我叫你是因为……
dialogText.en: I called you up 'cos...

dialogText.cn: 我怕那姓庄的说话不算话，拉你帮我做个证。
dialogText.en: I need a witness. Just in case that Madam Zhuang does not keep her words.

dialogText.cn: 嘶……现在鼻子火烧火燎的……嘶……老板，再给我来份糖油粑粑！
dialogText.en: Hssss... It got to my nose as well... Hnggh... Hey, boss! Gimme some sweet rice cakes!

dialogText.cn: 好嘞，您稍等。
dialogText.en: Alright. Coming right up.

dialogText.cn: 让我看看，一个龙泡泡气球，再加上一份糖油粑粑，也不算两手空空了。
dialogText.en: Let me see. A Chubby Lung balloon and sweet rice cakes. At least I got something out of this visit.

dialogText.cn: 呃……我、我听弭弗说你喜欢龙泡泡，就给你带了气球。还有一份糖油粑粑，也是弭弗推荐的。
dialogText.en: Eh... I, uh, heard Mi Fu saying that you like Chubby Lung so I got this nice balloon. Plus some sweet rice cakes. Mi Fu recommended the resto.

dialogText.cn: 多亏你及时制止那些寨民袭击武陵城，为了感谢你们，我想回赠一些物资。
dialogText.en: I have you to thank for foiling the Stockade residents' attack on Wuling. I intend to provide some supplies as a token of our gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 而且，我能保证这期间，绝不会有不长眼的家伙来添乱。
dialogText.en: I'm also promising to keep my people in line. No more stupid idiots are gonna cause any more trouble.

dialogText.cn: 我不想放弃他们……在我的记忆里，他们不是叛徒，而是我的家人。
dialogText.en: I don't intend to give up on them... And I don't remember them as traitors, but people of my Fam.

dialogText.cn: 就算和武陵有天大的仇，对我来说，也比不上一家子好好在一起。
dialogText.en: Even if we got a ton of bad blood against Wuling, the only thing I want is the entire Stockade to live together as a fam.

dialogText.cn: 我答应你，汤汤。
dialogText.en: I accept your terms of parley, Tangtang.

dialogText.cn: 你是在施舍我们吗？
dialogText.en: Are you treating us as a charity case?

dialogText.cn: 不……我只是想示好。清波寨有人愿意来到武陵城，好好聊聊，我很开心。
dialogText.en: No... Just a gesture of my goodwill. I'm extremely happy that someone from Qingbo Stockade visited Wuling City for an amiable discussion.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……听起来是个减轻工作量的好办法。
dialogText.en: Hmm... If that does happen, my job might get a lot easier.

dialogText.cn: 言至于此，我也想听听大当家对清波城的想法……茶已经泡好了，大当家请坐。
dialogText.en: That being said, I'm actually very curious about your views on Qingbo City... Please have a seat, Chief. The tea has been brewed.

dialogText.cn: 那个姓庄……呃不，庄管代，姑奶奶……不是，呸呸呸，汤汤我……
dialogText.en: Big Madam... I mean ... Big Zhuang... Pffft. Viceroy! Yes! Viceroy Zhuang! Your Chief... PFFFFFT! Ahem. Your humble and nice little Tangtang...

dialogText.cn: 咳咳……
dialogText.en: Ahem...

dialogText.cn: 弭弗和我说，你就是个孩子，但今天一见，还是很有大当家的风范嘛。
dialogText.en: Mi Fu told me you're just a child. But I see instead someone with the dignity and bearings of a true leader.

dialogText.cn: 怪不得你能当她的头儿，你比她有眼光。
dialogText.en: That's why you're Mi Fu's Chief. She lacks your vision and foresight.

dialogText.cn: 物资什么的，你愿意给，我也没什么不好意思收的。
dialogText.en: Supplies? If you're willing to give, then I don't see any problem taking some.

dialogText.cn: 但我今天来，是想和你商量些别的东西。
dialogText.en: But I'm here to parley about some serious biz.

dialogText.cn: 请讲。
dialogText.en: I'm listening.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，你们最近养精蓄锐，就等着好好干场大事。
dialogText.en: I know you've been raising an elite force for some major fight.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者把寨子搅得一团糟，就算你们不说，我身为大当家，也要揍他们一顿。
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers messed up my place. I'm the Chief, so I'm gonna thrash them really hard. You don't even have to ask.

dialogText.cn: 作为交换，你……你能不能放过那些犯错的糊涂蛋，交给我，让我来收拾他们。
dialogText.en: So in exchange, can you ... let those stupid Stockaders go? I'll knock some sense into them.

dialogText.cn: 那些跟着裂地者走的寨民？可他们这么做不是对你和清波寨的背叛吗？
dialogText.en: Are you talking about the Stockade residents who joined the Landbreakers? But didn't they just betray you and Qingbo Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 他们会叫我二姑娘、汤汤、小丫头。从外面回来时，会给我糖果、玩具和小红鳞……
dialogText.en: They called me Younger Dame, Tangtang, and baby girl... And they always had something for me when they came back to the Stockade. Candies, toys, and little red fins...

dialogText.cn: 清波寨与武陵的仇恨，真的能轻易地放下吗？
dialogText.en: Can you really bury the hatred between Qingbo Stockade and Wuling?

dialogText.cn: 你居然这么爽快，我还以为……你会坐地要价呢？
dialogText.en: Did you just accept everything? I thought you'd ... start haggling like an angry skinflint or something!

dialogText.cn: 不仅如此，武陵还愿意主动为清波寨提供技术与物资帮助……
dialogText.en: Wuling is a lot more generous than that. We are willing to provide the Stockade with both technology and supplies...

dialogText.cn: 你就不怕有本大当家坐镇，再发展几年，你们武陵城就得转头求我们庇护——改叫清波城！
dialogText.en: But aren't you worried about me? Give Chief Tangtang a few years and Wulingers like you would be begging my Stockade for protection! When that day comes, I'll name this place as Qingbo City!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有什么收获吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, found anything?

dialogText.cn: 难道样本已经被转移了？
dialogText.en: Hmm, perhaps the sample has been moved somewhere else.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还请仔细搜索一下四周，如果转移时间不长的话，附近或许还有痕迹残留。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's do a thorough search of the surroundings. If the transfer was recent, we might find some residual traces.

dialogText.cn: （嗅嗅）不对，不是这个味道。
dialogText.en: *Sniff, sniff* No. This is not the smell.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？有股很独特的气味……好像有点熟悉。
dialogText.en: Hmm? What's this special scent... Smells familiar.

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员！您怎么会在这里！！
dialogText.en: Eh?! En-En-Endmin?! Why are you here?

dialogText.cn: 我刚才，没有冒犯到您吧？！
dialogText.en: I hope I did not offend your honor, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？管理员也是为了侵蚀提取物样本的事来的吗？
dialogText.en: Mm? Are you also here for the Blight extract sample, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 我接到菲奥娜姐姐的联络之后赶过来了，不过哪里都没有发现样本。
dialogText.en: I rushed here immediately after Fiona contacted me. But I didn't find the sample anywhere.

dialogText.cn: 这里有些奇怪的味道……别小看我哦，我的嗅觉可是狼群中最灵敏的，牙齿也是最锋利的！
dialogText.en: There is a funny smell here... Trust me, Endmin. In the pack, I am the one with the sharpest nose and the sharpest fangs!

dialogText.cn: 唔……四周的气味很杂乱……好像来来回回经过了许多人……
dialogText.en: Hmm... The air is full of odors... A lot of people must have walked by.

dialogText.cn: 那里倒是有一些异样……那些光亮，看起来不像是自然形成的。
dialogText.en: Something's suspicious over there... Those lights. They do not look natural.

dialogText.cn: 对哦！看来提取物样本确实经过了这里……
dialogText.en: Oh yeah! The extract sample must have passed through this place...

dialogText.cn: 管理员身上是不是有那种，能到处扫描，然后“啪”的一下把东西标记出来的装置？
dialogText.en: Ah! Endmin, you have that special device, no? The one that scans, makes the *smack* sound, and highlights the thing?

dialogText.cn: 居然有机会和管理员一起行动！天哪！我这是在做梦吗？
dialogText.en: Mamma mia! I get to team up with the Endmin. Am I dreaming right now?

dialogText.cn: 帮……帮手！我有机会帮到管理员的忙吗？真的假的？
dialogText.en: H-help?! Does that mean I get to help the Endmin? Is this real?!

dialogText.cn: 我不太会用那个……要不要一起行动？
dialogText.en: I'm not really good at using that... Maybe we should team up?

dialogText.cn: 呜，好疼！看来是真的……那、那我必须得好好表现……让管理员对我刮目相看！
dialogText.en: Ouch! Looks like this is real... Then I must work super hard ... and impress the Endmin with my performance!

dialogText.cn: 管理员！我们再多找找吧，沿着这条路看看，说不定还能发现类似的痕迹。
dialogText.en: Endmin! Heehee, let's keep searching. Maybe we'll find similar traces along the way!

dialogText.cn: 你们是什么人？为什么要闯进骑士的要塞！
dialogText.en: Who are you? How dare you trespass on the Castle of the Knights!

dialogText.cn: 红色的斗篷……利爪和武器……呜啊……你、你就是赤红怪物！！你、你是不是赤红怪物的同伙？
dialogText.en: Red cape ... claws, weapons... EEEK! Y-You are that Red Monster! And ... you must be her wicked companion!

dialogText.cn: 你才是小孩子呢！快说，你们是哪里来的？
dialogText.en: Wait, you're also a kid! Now talk — from whence did you come?!

dialogText.cn: 啊……追查了半天，怎么追查到一帮小屁孩这里了！
dialogText.en: *Uffa*... This is absurd. We tracked all the way here, only to find some kids!

dialogText.cn: 你不是和我们差不多大嘛。你怎么说话这么凶，你就是<@qu.key>赤红怪物</>！
dialogText.en: You're just around our age, but you're so mean. You surely are <@qu.key>the Red Monster</>!

dialogText.cn: 我才不是什么“赤红怪物”呢！我可是狼群的代理领袖！
dialogText.en: I am not the Red Monster! I am the temporary leader of the Pack!

dialogText.cn: *略略略*听不懂！你们就是坏人。快离开这！
dialogText.en: Nah! Never heard of it! You're just baddies! Now shoo!

dialogText.cn: 不行了……管理员，我们走吧，这会儿可没时间和他们胡闹。
dialogText.en: What a mess... Endmin, let's just go. We don't have time to play with them.

dialogText.cn: 可他们只是一群孩子，而且还把我们当成了坏人。我们问不到什么的。
dialogText.en: But they are just kids. And they see us as baddies. I don't think they're gonna tell us anything.

dialogText.cn: 他们的方式？
dialogText.en: Play by their rules?

dialogText.cn: 啊？管理员，你怎么可以对小孩子这么……
dialogText.en: Wha? Endmin?! Why are you being so nice to these little...

dialogText.cn: 哼，没错，骑士都是宽宏大量的！不会计较你们的无礼。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Indeed. We knights are forgiving and generous! We shall overlook your unruliness.

dialogText.cn: 对不起……我们是来找东西的。
dialogText.en: Apologies... We are just trying to look for something.

dialogText.cn: 原谅你们了！不过，你们是什么人，是不是赤红怪物和它的同伴？
dialogText.en: Pardon granted! But who may you be, if you are not the Red Monster and its wicked companion?

dialogText.cn: 不，我们来自终末地，这位是终末地的管理员。
dialogText.en: No! We come from Endfield! And this is the Endmin, head of the Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？我知道！阿丽娅姐姐说过，是管理员救了营地的大家！
dialogText.en: Endmin? Oh, I heard of you! Alia told us that the Endmin saved everyone in the camp.

dialogText.cn: 看来你们不是坏人。你们是在找什么东西啊？
dialogText.en: So I guess you're not baddies. What are you looking for?

dialogText.cn: 呃，一个……装在容器里的，放着样本的……
dialogText.en: Err… it's a ... jar with some ... sample thing...

dialogText.cn: 听不懂。
dialogText.en: What is that?

dialogText.cn: 没见过。
dialogText.en: Never seen it.

dialogText.cn: 闪闪发光的红色……啊，是<@qu.key>红色钻石</>吗？
dialogText.en: Red glowing thing... OH! You mean the <@qu.key>Red Diamond</>?

dialogText.cn: 红色钻石的话，我们已经进贡给<@qu.key>国王</>陛下了。
dialogText.en: We've offered it already. His Majesty the <@qu.key>King</> has it now.

dialogText.cn: 国王陛下？他在哪里？
dialogText.en: His Majesty the King? Where is he?

dialogText.cn: 国王当然在他领土上啦。
dialogText.en: The King is in his kingdom.

dialogText.cn: 从这里过去就能见到我们的国王了。
dialogText.en: Take this path and you'll be able to meet our King.

dialogText.cn: 居然把那么危险的东西当成玩具了……你们知道那是什么吗？
dialogText.en: That thing is dangerous and you treat it like a toy...? Do you even know what it is?

dialogText.cn: 宝石会很危险吗……？
dialogText.en: The Diamond is dangerous...?

dialogText.cn: 算了……你们根本不知道自己在做什么……
dialogText.en: Forget it... You do not know what you're doing...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们得尽快把样本拿回来。它落在一群孩子们手上，可能会比在裂地者手中更危险……
dialogText.en: Endmin, we gotta be quick and take the sample back! It might be more dangerous in the kids' hands than in the hands of Landbreakers...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们去会一会那位“国王大人”吧。
dialogText.en: Alright, Endmin. Let's go and meet "His Majesty the King".

dialogText.cn: “赤红怪物”？说什么呢，真是一群小孩子。
dialogText.en: "Red Monster"? Come on, don't be ridiculous, kids!

dialogText.cn: 你是管理员，你是好人！
dialogText.en: Endmin, right? You're one of the good guys!

dialogText.cn: 我们是积木王国的骑士！是来外面收集宝物的。
dialogText.en: We are knights serving the Kingdom of Brickyland! We are on a quest to find treasure in the outer realms.

dialogText.cn: 宝物？可这些都是……
dialogText.en: Treasure? But these are just a pile...

dialogText.cn: 哼哼，说出来可能吓你们一跳，国王的宝库里可是有着堆成山的宝藏！
dialogText.en: Hmph. Do not be envious of our riches. We have a great mountain of treasure in the vault of our King!

dialogText.cn: 有传说中的宝剑，有守护者的坚盾，还有……还有象征王权的权杖！
dialogText.en: We have the Holy Sword of Legend, the Strong Shield of the Defender, and ... And the Royal Scepter of Power!

dialogText.cn: 你确定？可这里明明都是些被丢掉的垃圾。
dialogText.en: Are you sure? But all I see is just ... junk. Junk that people threw away.

dialogText.cn: 才不是垃圾呢！哼！！
dialogText.en: This is not junk! HMPH!!

dialogText.cn: 当然都是我们狩猎回来的！
dialogText.en: From our mighty quests of treasure hunting!

dialogText.cn: 骑士的任务就是去收集宝物，我们看见坏家伙们出去干坏事，就拿走了一大堆宝物！
dialogText.en: The knight's quest is to gather riches. Whenever the baddies go out to do bad things, we loot their camp of their treasure!

dialogText.cn: 什么？这些东西是你们从碾骨营地里拿回来的？
dialogText.en: WHAT?! You actually took these from the Bonekrusher camp?

dialogText.cn: 那些坏家伙们总做坏事！正义的骑士当然要惩罚他们！
dialogText.en: They are evil villains! The knights of justice have no choice but to punish them!

dialogText.cn: 你们知道这有多危险吗……要是一个不小心……
dialogText.en: Do you know how dangerous your game is...? If you make a mistake...

dialogText.cn: 放心，我们都是身经百战的骑士。
dialogText.en: Have no fear. We are knights, veterans of one hundred battles.

dialogText.cn: 那些武器太重了……而且大人们说过，武器都很危险。
dialogText.en: Yeah. But they are really heavy... And the grown-ups told us that weapons are dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 还有那个面具，感觉有点臭臭的……我们就不要了。
dialogText.en: The mask also smells pretty bad... So we threw it away.

dialogText.cn: 确实！碾骨氏族身上的味道太糟糕了！
dialogText.en: I totally agree! The Bonekrushers smell like puke!

dialogText.cn: 我们带回来了一个旧轮胎和红色钻石，这一次可算是满载而归。
dialogText.en: And so we returned with an old tire and the Red Diamond. It was a great hunt.

dialogText.cn: 你们不是赤红怪物的同伴，太好了！
dialogText.en: I'm so happy you're not the wicked companions of the Red Monster!

dialogText.cn: 你们不知道赤红怪物吗？大家都传遍了！
dialogText.en: Don't you know who it is? Everyone here is talking about the Red Monster!

dialogText.cn: 有人看到一个红色的怪物，有着可怕的面目和锋利的牙齿。
dialogText.en: Someone saw a monster that's totally red. It has a terrifying face and super sharp teeth.

dialogText.cn: 它一口能吞下好几个人！大家都说，它专挑小孩子吃……
dialogText.en: It could swallow several people in a mouthful! And, and they say ... children are its favorite food...

dialogText.cn: 这种事肯定都是骗人的。
dialogText.en: Meh. Just a made-up story.

dialogText.cn: 可是真的好吓人嘛……大家都不敢走太远，只能在这里玩了。
dialogText.en: But it's really scary... Nobody dares to head out anymore. This is the only place we could play safely.

dialogText.cn: 是我们伟大的积木王国！有国王，有公爵，还有骑士！
dialogText.en: It's the Great Kingdom of Brickyland! A land of our King, our Dukes, and our Knights!

dialogText.cn: 我们有一个超——级大的宫殿！还有宝库！但我不会告诉你们要怎么进去的！
dialogText.en: And we got a super HUUUGE palace! And a treasure vault! But I'm not telling you how to get in!

dialogText.cn: 原来是过家家，小孩子能建起来多大的“王国”嘛。
dialogText.en: Pffft. Just a make-believe game for the children. You can't really build a proper "Kingdom".

dialogText.cn: 等你们真的见到我们的王国，一定会大吃一惊的！
dialogText.en: Hmph. The sight of our actual Kingdom will shock you!

dialogText.cn: 那是我们在坏家伙们的地盘发现的，可好看了。
dialogText.en: We found it in the baddies' territory. It's so pretty too.

dialogText.cn: 我也好想要那块红色钻石，但还是上供给国王了。
dialogText.en: I really wanted to keep that Red Diamond for myself. But still, we offered it to our King as tribute.

dialogText.cn: 既然你也喜欢，为什么情愿交给国王呢？
dialogText.en: If you like it so much, why do you give it up to the King?

dialogText.cn: 因为现在的国王是个很好的人，而且，下周就轮到我当国王啦，那个时候也可以玩红色钻石。
dialogText.en: Because we have a good King right now. And I'll get to be Queen next week. When I become Queen, I'll get to play with the Red Diamond too.

dialogText.cn: 真期待呀。
dialogText.en: I really want to be Queen.

dialogText.cn: 这么多小孩，围在一起做什么呢？
dialogText.en: So many children. What are they doing here?

dialogText.cn: 这就是象征王权的权杖！红钻石权杖！
dialogText.en: This is the Scepter of High Royalty! The Scepter of the Red Diamond!
WOWWW —!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，快看，那上面是什么！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Look! The top of that scepter.

dialogText.cn: 那不就是我们要找的样本吗？
dialogText.en: It's the sample we are looking for, right?

actorName.cn: 拿着权杖的孩子{“积木国王”}
actorName.en: Child with a Scepter{"King of Brickyland"}

dialogText.cn: 你们是什么人？！
dialogText.en: And who might you be?!

dialogText.cn: 快把你手上的样本……那个红色的东西给我们，它很危险！
dialogText.en: Kid! That sample ... uh, I mean, that red thing is dangerous. Hand it over!

actorName.cn: 拿着权杖的孩子{“积木国王”}
actorName.en: Child with a Scepter{"King of Brickyland"}

dialogText.cn: 你们……你们是来抢红色钻石的吗？卫兵们，快把他们赶走！
dialogText.en: Are you here to ... steal the Red Diamond? Guards! Chase these trespassers away!

dialogText.cn: 你们……等等！那个真的很危险……他要逃走了……
dialogText.en: Hey... WAIT! That's really dangerous! Ugh, he's getting away...

actorName.cn: 拿着权杖的孩子{“积木国王”}
actorName.en: Child with a Scepter{"King of Brickyland"}

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，没错！我就是积木王国的国王，你们都要听从于我！
dialogText.en: Ahem! Yes! I am the King of Brickyland. You will do as I command!

dialogText.cn: 交换……你们想用什么交换？
dialogText.en: Trade…? What exactly are you offering to trade?

dialogText.cn: 可……他要是提出什么不得了的要求可怎么办？
dialogText.en: But ... what if he asks us for something really impossible?

dialogText.cn: 那……那我……
dialogText.en: Then I ... I want...

dialogText.cn: 那我要你把我们王国的两件宝物拿给我！
dialogText.en: I want you to bring me TWO Treasures of the Kingdom!

dialogText.cn: 用两件宝物来换才行！
dialogText.en: It must be TWO pieces of Treasure!

dialogText.cn: 什么？要二换一？
dialogText.en: WHAT?! Two for one?

dialogText.cn: 嗯！那等你把宝物们都取回来，我再把红色钻石交给你们。
dialogText.en: Well said! And once you bring the Treasures, I shall give you the Red Diamond.

dialogText.cn: 宝物在<@qu.key>风铃公爵</>和<@qu.key>发条公爵</>的领地，他们是王国的两大公爵，负责镇守南方和北方。
dialogText.en: The Treasures are located in the domains of the <@qu.key>Duchess of Windbell</> and the <@qu.key>Duke of Clockwork</>. The two grand dukes of this Kingdom defend our Southern borders and Northern marches.

dialogText.cn: 国王英明！国王英明！
dialogText.en: Wise words, my King! Wise words!

dialogText.cn: 这个红色钻石是王国的宝物，绝对不会交给你们的！
dialogText.en: This diamond is a Treasure of the Kingdom. You cannot have it!

dialogText.cn: 凭你们的本事是取不回来的！
dialogText.en: You might not have the skills to take those Treasures!

dialogText.cn: 其实冲过去把样本抢回来不是更直接吗，为什么还要陪他们胡闹？
dialogText.en: We can just take the sample from him. Why are we even playing their game?

dialogText.cn: 年龄小不是可以任性的理由……
dialogText.en: Being a child is no excuse for being spoiled and selfish...

dialogText.cn: 我知道啦，既然管理员这么说，那肯定是有所考量的。
dialogText.en: Okay then. If the Endmin had spoken, then there's definitely a very good reason for it.

dialogText.cn: 我……我只是觉得管理员肯定有自己的想法，不然，我才不想跟那些小孩子们瞎闹呢！
dialogText.en: I ... I just think you have your reasons, Endmin. I'd never play such a stupid game with these children otherwise.

dialogText.cn: 我们去找他们说的“公爵”吧，看看这帮孩子还能弄出什么花样。
dialogText.en: Let's go find their Duke and Duchess. We'll see what other tricks they've got.

dialogText.cn: 你们之中哪位是风铃公爵？
dialogText.en: Which one of you is the Duchess of Windbell?

dialogText.cn: 你……你是什么人！
dialogText.en: Huh...? Who are you?!

dialogText.cn: 咳……我们是应国王陛下的命令，前来拜访尊……尊敬的风铃公爵大人，不知道公爵大人现在何处？
dialogText.en: Ahem... We have orders from His Majesty the King to visit the ... Her Grace, the Duchess of Windbell. May we know where the good Duchess may be found?

dialogText.cn: 啊，原来和国王做交易的使者就是你们啊。我就是风铃公爵，准确的说，本应该是……
dialogText.en: Ah. So you are the ones trying to trade with our King. I'm the Duchess of Windbell... Actually, I should say I was supposed to be the Duchess...

dialogText.cn: 本应该是？
dialogText.en: What do you mean?

dialogText.cn: 嘘——别吓到这孩子。
dialogText.en: Shhh — Don't scare this kid.

dialogText.cn: 我们的规则是拥有宝物的人才能被称作贵族，但是，宝物<@qu.key>圣剑</>被上一任公爵插在了危险的地方。
dialogText.en: According to our laws, only those who own Treasure can be Nobles. But the last Duke of Windbell stuck the treasured <@qu.key>Holy Sword</> in a dangerous place.

dialogText.cn: 我必须拿到那把剑！你们能帮帮我吗？
dialogText.en: I must have that sword! Can you help me?

dialogText.cn: 那你愿意把剑借给我们吗？
dialogText.en: Can you lend us the sword?

dialogText.cn: 那是我的剑，先帮我取下来！不然免谈！
dialogText.en: That sword is mine! Get it down for me or I'm not talking anymore!

dialogText.cn: 好吧……我们这就去。
dialogText.en: Fine... We'll get your sword right now.

dialogText.cn: 我们谁也拿不到……
dialogText.en: None of us could get the blade...

dialogText.cn: 听到了吗？我们有办法了。
dialogText.en: Hear that? We found a way.

actorName.cn: 哭泣的小男孩{c28m2-哭泣的小男孩}

dialogText.cn: 原来那就是你们说的宝物，“圣剑”啊……
dialogText.en: So that's your treasure... What a "Holy Sword"...

dialogText.cn: 哇！你们真的做到了！！
dialogText.en: Amazing! You really did it!

dialogText.cn: 快看，你的花环取回来了哦，所以别哭啦，开心一点。
dialogText.en: See, we found your floral wreath. There's no need to cry. Cheer up.

actorName.cn: 哭泣的小男孩{c28m2-哭泣的小男孩}

dialogText.cn: 啊……真的拿回来了，这是妈妈最喜欢的花。呜呜……谢谢公爵大人。
dialogText.en: Oh... You got it back! They're Mama's favorite flowers. *Hikhik*... Thank you so much, Your Grace.

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，你怎么又哭了。
dialogText.en: Oh dear. Why are you crying again?

dialogText.cn: 她这么着急要这把剑，原来是为了这个花环吗……
dialogText.en: Turns out she only wants the sword for the floral wreath around it...

dialogText.cn: 你们把剑拿去吧，其实它对我也没那么重要。
dialogText.en: Here. Have the sword. It's not that important to me.

dialogText.cn: 你看，即便我没有这把剑，他们还是把我当作公爵大人。
dialogText.en: As you can see, even without the sword, my subjects still treat me as their Duchess.

dialogText.cn: 那当然了，您可是名副其实的“公爵”。
dialogText.en: Of course, my lady. You are a true "Duchess".

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，天色不早了，你们也早点回去吧。最近可是有赤红怪物在游荡喔。
dialogText.en: Heh. It's getting late too, so you should start heading back. Be careful. There's a Red Monster roaming about nearby.

dialogText.cn: 我从小握着的剑，都是真正的剑。
dialogText.en: I've been swinging real swords since I was a baby.

dialogText.cn: 我的生命是族人们用牺牲换来的，我不能像个小孩子一样只想着玩闹。
dialogText.en: Many of the Pack sacrificed themselves so that I may live. I cannot behave like a child ... and think about playing games all the time.

dialogText.cn: 就剩一个“宝物”了，管理员，我们走吧，去“发条公爵”的“领地”！
dialogText.en: Anyway, one more "Treasure", Endmin. Let's go to the "Duke of Clockwork's domain"!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，不自量力的挑战者，公爵之位还是我的！
dialogText.en: Hah! Lousy losers! I am still the Duke!

dialogText.cn: 管理员只是不想和小孩子一般见识，如果管理员认真起来，随时都可以超过你！
dialogText.en: The Endmin is just trying to have fun with you, kiddo. We can beat you any time we want to.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这次让他好好看看我们的实力！
dialogText.en: Alright, Endmin. Fun's over. Time to show them our true power!

dialogText.cn: 我的纪录是不会有人能打破的！
dialogText.en: No one can ever beat my record!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，该让他见识见识我们的厉害了！
dialogText.en: Endmin, time to show him our true power!

dialogText.cn: 好耶——哼哼，等你输的时候可不要哭鼻子哦。
dialogText.en: Yeah! Let's go!— Well, well, my Duke. Just don't start crying if you lose the game.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，他的纪录是在5分钟内抓到了5只源石虫，我们必须在相同时间抓到6只才算胜利。
dialogText.en: Endmin, his record is 5 Originium Slugs in 5 minutes. We must catch 6 in the same time to win!

dialogText.cn: 那些源石虫很胆小，一靠近，它们就会逃走，很难抓到。
dialogText.en: Originium Slugs are very timid. They'll start running away if you get close. Catching them can be difficult.

dialogText.cn: 但它们也会有累的时候，等源石虫躲在源石附近休息的时候，就是抓住它们的好机会！
dialogText.en: But they take breaks too, usually near Originium formations. That is the best time to catch them!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还请您一定要赢下来！
dialogText.en: You must win this game, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 等着吧，这场比拼我们赢定了！可别临阵逃跑！
dialogText.en: Watch us beat you in your own game, Duke! Don't you run away!

dialogText.cn: 怎……怎么可能？你们怎么捉到这么多源石虫的……一定是作弊了！
dialogText.en: Im ... impossible! How could you catch so many slugs...?! You were definitely cheating!

dialogText.cn: 怎么？输了想不认账？
dialogText.en: Oh? Are you being a sore loser now?

dialogText.cn: 你们、你们作弊了，这不算！
dialogText.en: You ... you cheated! This doesn't count!

dialogText.cn: 他们没有作弊！你才是耍赖的人！
dialogText.en: They're not cheaters! You're just a sore loser!

dialogText.cn: 我们受够了！你一直霸占着“坚盾”，还天天用“公爵”的名义让我们陪你抓源石虫。
dialogText.en: We've had enough of you! You never let us touch the Shield! And as "Duke", you kept forcing us to catch slugs with you all day.

dialogText.cn: 现在有人在捕虫竞技场超过了你，你却说话不算话！我们不想再和你玩了！
dialogText.en: And when you're finally beaten in the Arena, you can't even keep your word! We're not playing with you anymore!

dialogText.cn: 等等……你们……
dialogText.en: Wait...! Stop! Come back...

dialogText.cn: 看来你这个“公爵”做得不太像样啊，即使拿着盾牌，其他人也不认为你是“公爵”了。
dialogText.en: It seems you've been a poor "Duke", Your Grace. You may hold the Shield, but no one sees you as a true "Duke".

dialogText.cn: 我……我只是想让他们都和我一起玩……
dialogText.en: I ... I just want them to play with me...

dialogText.cn: 你连诚信都不想遵守，那就不会有人陪你玩了。
dialogText.en: If you can't keep your word, how can you keep your friends?

dialogText.cn: 别走，你们等等我啊……是我不好，我的“水晶锤”给你们玩，等等我嘛……
dialogText.en: Guys, come back! It's all my fault! I'll let you play with my "Crystal Hammer"! Just don't go!

dialogText.cn: 这盾……我不想要了，你们拿走吧！
dialogText.en: I ... I don't want the Shield anymore. Just take it!

dialogText.cn: 没想到同龄人之间也有这么多麻烦的事。
dialogText.en: Sheesh! How could hanging out with kids be this complicated?

dialogText.cn: 卡特洛算吗？我和他一起在狩猎场捕过猎……
dialogText.en: Does Catello count? I once hunted with him in the hunting grounds...

dialogText.cn: “宝物”已经凑齐了，该去换回我们的样本啦。
dialogText.en: Anyway, we now have all the "Treasures". Time to trade them in for our sample.

dialogText.cn: 站住！你们是干什么的？
dialogText.en: STOP RIGHT THERE! Who are you?

dialogText.cn: 你好，我们是国王的使者，来拜访尊贵的发条公爵，不知道他现在人在何处？
dialogText.en: Greetings. We are envoys from His Majesty the King, and we are here to meet the honorable Duke of Clockwork. Please tell us where he is.

dialogText.cn: 国王那个软蛋让你们来的？哈哈哈！他一定是看上了我手上的坚盾，却不敢自己来！
dialogText.en: The crybaby King sent you here? Hahah! I think he wants my Strong Shield, but got too mighty-scared to come himself.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？那个盾就是第二件宝物吗？这么说，你就是发条公爵？
dialogText.en: Oh? So the Shield is the second Treasure? Then you are the Duke of Clockwork himself?

dialogText.cn: 什么发条公爵！我不要叫这么孩子气的名字，我要改名叫野兽公爵！
dialogText.en: Don't call me that! It's so stupid and childish. I am changing my title to the "Duke of Savage Beasts".

dialogText.cn: 那好，野兽公爵，可以请您把手中的<@qu.key>盾牌</>交给我们吗？
dialogText.en: Very well, my lord Duke. Now, may we have the honor of taking your <@qu.key>Shield</>?

dialogText.cn: 那可不行！我们的规则是公爵必须拥有宝物，那拥有宝物的人就应该是公爵！
dialogText.en: OF COURSE NOT! Our law says one must own a Treasure to become a Duke! That makes me the only rightful owner of the Shield!

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>坚盾</>一直在我手上，那我就一直是公爵了，谁也别想抢走！
dialogText.en: As long as I hold the <@qu.key>Shield</>, I am forever the Duke. No one shall take it!

dialogText.cn: 这可不行，公爵不应该轮流担任吗？
dialogText.en: That sounds unfair. I thought everyone could take turns to be a Duke or Duchess.

dialogText.cn: 哼，想要我的盾牌，除非在捕虫竞技场超过我！
dialogText.en: Hmph. If you want my Shield, you gotta beat me in the Slug-Catching Arena!

dialogText.cn: 所以，我们只要在<@qu.key>捕虫竞技场</>抓到比你更多的源石虫，就可以拿到盾牌了对吗？
dialogText.en: So if we catch more Originium Slugs than you in the <@qu.key>Arena</>, we get the Shield, right?

dialogText.cn: 那是不可能的，我的纪录是不会被人打破的！
dialogText.en: That's impossible. My record is unbeatable!

dialogText.cn: 那可不好说，这对管理员来说简直小菜一碟。
dialogText.en: We shall see. The Endmin is quite an expert in this.

dialogText.cn: 那你们是想挑战我？
dialogText.en: Are you challenging me?

dialogText.cn: 先说好，我的纪录可是5分钟内抓住了5只源石虫，你们必须在相同的时间里抓住6只才算赢过我！
dialogText.en: Here are the rules. My record is 5 Originium Slugs in 5 minutes. You gotta catch 6 slugs in the same time to win!

dialogText.cn: 还有！必须在我划定的范围内才能抓源石虫，跑到范围外面可不能算数！
dialogText.en: One more thing! You can only catch the Originium Slugs in the area I marked out. Those caught outside won't count!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，那些源石虫很胆小，一靠近，它们就会逃走，很难抓到。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Originium Slugs are very timid. They'll start running away if you get close. Catching them can be difficult.

dialogText.cn: 但它们也会累，等源石虫躲在源石附近休息的时候，就是抓住它们的好机会！
dialogText.en: But they take breaks too, usually near Originium formations. That is the best time to catch them!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，看来得超过他的纪录，才能拿到盾牌了！
dialogText.en: Endmin, we'll have to beat his record to get the Shield!

dialogText.cn: 好耶——哼哼，等你输的时候可不要哭鼻子哦。
dialogText.en: Yeah! Let's go!— Well, well, my Duke. Just don't start crying if you lose the game.

dialogText.cn: 等着吧，这场比拼我们赢定了，可别临阵逃跑！
dialogText.en: Watch us beat you in your own game, Duke. Don't you run away!

dialogText.cn: 我的纪录是不会被人打破的！
dialogText.en: No one can beat my record!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，该让他见识见识我们的厉害了！
dialogText.en: Endmin, time to show him our true power!

dialogText.cn: 好耶——哼哼，等你输的时候可不要哭鼻子哦。
dialogText.en: Yeah! Let's go!— Well, well, my Duke. Just don't start crying if you lose the game.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，他的纪录是在5分钟内抓到了5只源石虫，我们必须在相同时间抓到6只才算胜利。
dialogText.en: Endmin, his record is 5 Originium Slugs in 5 minutes. We must catch 6 in the same time to win!

dialogText.cn: 那些源石虫很胆小，一靠近，它们就会逃走，很难抓到。
dialogText.en: Originium Slugs are very timid. They'll start running away if you get close. Catching them can be difficult.

dialogText.cn: 但它们也会累，等源石虫躲在源石附近休息的时候，就是抓住它们的好机会！
dialogText.en: But they take breaks too, usually near Originium formations. That is the best time to catch them!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还请您一定要赢下来！
dialogText.en: You must win this game, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 等着吧，这场比拼我们赢定了，可别临阵逃跑！
dialogText.en: Watch us beat you in your own game, Duke. Don't you run away!

dialogText.cn: 啊，终于解决了，大家都平安无事吧？
dialogText.en: Ah, it's finally done. Is everyone alright?

dialogText.cn: 姐姐太厉害了！她变成了赤红色的影子，唰的一下就把坏人……
dialogText.en: Miss Red Cape is so incredible! She turned into a red flash and took out all the baddies!

dialogText.cn: 赤红色的……啊，该不会赤红的怪物就是……
dialogText.en: Red flash... Wait. Is the Red Monster actually...?

dialogText.cn: 不，这是我们的英雄！
dialogText.en: No! She is our hero!

dialogText.cn: 对，她是英雄！……是她救了我们！
dialogText.en: Yeah! A hero...! She saved us!

dialogText.cn: 这个，红色钻石应该是属于你们的。
dialogText.en: Here... This Red Diamond now belongs to you.

dialogText.cn: 请拿去吧。
dialogText.en: Please take it.

dialogText.cn: 这可不行，我们说好了要拿两件宝物来换的。
dialogText.en: That won't do. We promised to trade two treasures for it.

dialogText.cn: 给你，这是王国的圣剑和盾牌。
dialogText.en: Here you are. The Holy Sword and the Strong Shield of the Kingdom.

dialogText.cn: 哇，宝物真的拿回来啦！
dialogText.en: Wow! They really brought the treasures back!

dialogText.cn: 我们一直拿不回来宝物，好几任国王都没有想到办法……
dialogText.en: We just couldn't bring them back. Many Kings and Queens tried, but all of them failed...

dialogText.cn: 太好了！有了这两件宝物，我们又可以像过去一样册封公爵了！
dialogText.en: Wonderful! I now have two treasures! We can once again name the Dukes of this Kingdom!

dialogText.cn: 原来你是为了这个目的，才让我们去拿这两件宝物的啊。
dialogText.en: Oh, so this is the reason why — you sent us to retrieve the two treasures.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……我自己有点胆小，但我也想帮大家要回宝物……
dialogText.en: Heheh... I'm not very brave, but I also want to get the treasures back for everyone...

dialogText.cn: 咳咳！这两个人完美完成了我们积木王国的考验，取回了王国的宝物。我作为积木王国的第二十七任国王……
dialogText.en: Ahem! These two heroes have completed the Brickyland trials, and retrieved our treasures. As the twenty-seventh King of Brickyland —

dialogText.cn: 是第二十九任。
dialogText.en: Twenty-ninth.

dialogText.cn: 总、总之……本王册封你们二人为积木王国骑士团团长！分别为<@qu.key>红骑士</>和<@qu.key>黑骑士</>！
dialogText.en: Ah-Anyways... We hereby name you Grandmasters of the Order of Brickyland! Rise! <@qu.key>Red Knight</>! Rise! <@qu.key>Black Knight</>!

dialogText.cn: 团长！团长！
dialogText.en: Hail the Grandmasters!

dialogText.cn: 哼哼，多谢国王的恩典。
dialogText.en: Hehe. Thank you for your generous boons, Your Majesty.

dialogText.cn: 我宣布，今天就是积木王国新的纪念日，大家一起去玩吧！
dialogText.en: I hereby name this day ... a new Brickyland Memorial Day! Time to play, everyone!

dialogText.cn: 好耶！
dialogText.en: YAY!!!

dialogText.cn: 那要看国王愿不愿意把宝物交给我们了。
dialogText.en: Then we should ask if the King wishes to grant us a treasure.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，如果大家都同意的话……
dialogText.en: Ahem. If everyone agrees...

dialogText.cn: 我、我、我的任期还没结束呢！
dialogText.en: Wha? But... but my reign isn't over yet!

dialogText.cn: 不行，大家都要排队，不过……管理员可以排在我前面。
dialogText.en: Ehm ... maybe we should form a queue for that... But Endmin ... I'll let you queue in front of me.

dialogText.cn: 怪物、怪物出现了，是赤红怪物！！
dialogText.en: Monster! It has appeared! The Red Monster!!

dialogText.cn: 受到惊吓的小狼哪受到过这样的藐视，它发出一声愤怒的嘶吼。
dialogText.en: The wolf cub had never been belittled like this. It unleashed an angry howl. Awooo —

dialogText.cn: 但很快，比它骇人数倍的吼声从四面八方席卷而来，仿佛山洞内还有着不止一只如此巨大的怪物。
dialogText.en: But then, fearsome howling responded from all sides of the cave. It seemed more than one great monster lived in this cave.

dialogText.cn: 小狼害怕了，它慌乱地逃离了山洞。
dialogText.en: Scared, the wolf cub fled the cave in panic.

dialogText.cn: 小动物都学会了用山洞里的怪物来吓唬小狼。小狼想起张牙舞爪的巨大身影，就不敢再捕猎了。
dialogText.en: The little critters learned to scare the wolf cub with the cave monster. Whenever it remembered the howling shadow, it would lose the courage to hunt.

dialogText.cn: 那之后呢……
dialogText.en: What happened next...?

dialogText.cn: 没有食物的小狼越来越饿，直到它饿得眼冒金星，不知不觉又走到了山洞里。
dialogText.en: Well, the wolf cub was starving. Its steps grew unsteady, swaying as it moved. Soon, it found itself walking back to that cave.

dialogText.cn: 它再一次看到了那个巨大的影子，影子不断晃动着，像在做狩猎前的准备。
dialogText.en: The wolf cub saw it again, that great, moving shadow. It poised like it was ready to hunt.

dialogText.cn: 看来我们这里的小国王陛下也被吓得不轻。
dialogText.en: Heh, our little king's shaking just like that wolf cub.

dialogText.cn: 你们、你们不害怕吗……
dialogText.en: But ... aren't you scared...?

dialogText.cn: 怕什么，如果真的有怪物出来，我就嗷呜一口咬死它！
dialogText.en: Not at all. If a monster comes out, I'll bite its head off!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗……？
dialogText.en: Really...?

dialogText.cn: 这下安心一些了吗？还要继续听故事吗？
dialogText.en: Really. So, feeling better already? Shall we continue the story?
Yes, please...

dialogText.cn: 小狼的愤怒到达了极点，比起饿死，不如死在强者的利爪下。
dialogText.en: Anger filled the wolf cub's heart. It would rather die fighting than die of hunger!

dialogText.cn: 它不顾一切，疯了似的扑向了黑影。
dialogText.en: Casting all thoughts aside, it pounced at the shadow in fury.

dialogText.cn: 结果，小狼的身体从“墙壁”里穿了过去，“墙壁”破开了一个巨大的洞。
dialogText.en: To its surprise, its body tore right through the "wall" and made a huge hole in it.

dialogText.cn: 原来，那只是一张普通的白布……而那些嘶吼声是山洞里的回声。
dialogText.en: After all, the "monster" was just a piece of white cloth... The howls? Nothing but cave echoes.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……
dialogText.en: Wait ... what?

dialogText.cn: 是啊，怎么会这样呢，小狼一直害怕的野兽，原来根本就不曾存在过。
dialogText.en: Yeah. If you look back right now, the beast the wolf cub feared for so long — it never existed.

dialogText.cn: 前面走不通了……这些往外喷气的气孔是……
dialogText.en: The trail has ended... I see holes on the ground jetting out gas.

dialogText.cn: 啊，你们一定是找到了我们的<@qu.key>超级熔岩蹦床</>！
dialogText.en: Ah! You must have found our <@qu.key>Super Lava Trampolines</>!

dialogText.cn: 熔……熔岩？哪里有熔岩？
dialogText.en: Lava...? I don't see any lava here.

dialogText.cn: 地上是不是有很多格子？格子之外的地方都是熔岩，我们的规则是得在不碰到熔岩的情况下跳到最高处！
dialogText.en: There are boxes on the ground, yes? So everything else outside the boxes is lava. The rule is simple. Reach the highest place without touching the lava!

dialogText.cn: 按格子的顺序就能跳得很高了。
dialogText.en: Follow the correct sequence of boxes to jump and reach higher places.

dialogText.cn: 真不愧是“勇者之路”。
dialogText.en: No wonder they call it "Trail of the Brave".

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们应该尽快行动，“国王”可能有危险！
dialogText.en: Quickly! The "King" might be in danger! We must move, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？是不是一点都不可怕？
dialogText.en: How was that? The monster wasn't scary at all, right?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……姐姐还有管理员，都好帅气！
dialogText.en: Right... You and the Endmin are both so cool!

dialogText.cn: 都、都是管理员的功劳啦，我还差得很远呢！
dialogText.en: Ah, all credit goes to the Endmin! I-I still have so much to learn!

dialogText.cn: 前面就是出口了！这个缆车还可以用吗？
dialogText.en: The exit is up ahead! Can we use this cable car?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这是我们的“勇敢者号”！
dialogText.en: Yeah. This is "Courageous", our royal vehicle!

dialogText.cn: 那，勇敢的国王陛下，带我们离开这里吧。
dialogText.en: Alright, Your Courageous Majesty! Please lead us away from this place.

dialogText.cn: 这几个入口看上去怎么都一模一样……怎么办，要全都试一遍吗？
dialogText.en: All these entrances look exactly the same... So what now? Do we just try them all?

dialogText.cn: 那样太花时间了……
dialogText.en: That will take too much time...

dialogText.cn: 一样的入口？我知道了！你们一定是被我们的<@qu.key>真假藏宝室</>困住了！
dialogText.en: Entrances that look the same? You're trapped by our <@qu.key>True and False Treasure Chamber</>!

dialogText.cn: 我记得正确的路是……是什么来着？
dialogText.en: I remember the correct path being... Erm, what's the correct path again?

dialogText.cn: 是一只黄色的长耳兽吗？那是我们的<@qu.key>黄金小伯爵</>，它可喜欢待在厨具附近玩了。
dialogText.en: Jumped out? Is it a yellow long-ear? That's our <@qu.key>Little Golden Count</>. It loves playing around the cooking pots.

dialogText.cn: 它是大家最好的朋友，说不定能够帮助到你们。
dialogText.en: It's a good friend to everybody. Maybe it can help you.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您来决定往哪里走吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you choose the direction. I'll follow your lead.

dialogText.cn: 等等，什么东西从锅里窜出来了？
dialogText.en: Wait. Something jumped out of a pot!

dialogText.cn: 国王还在里面……
dialogText.en: Our King is still in there...

dialogText.cn: 快去喊大人们来吧！！
dialogText.en: We should go and tell the grown-ups!

dialogText.cn: 这里发生了什么？
dialogText.en: What happened here?

dialogText.cn: 啊，是你们！你们是国王的使者！
dialogText.en: Ah, it's you! The envoys of our King!

dialogText.cn: 快救救国王，有……有好多坏人……
dialogText.en: Please save our King... They came... A lot of baddies came to our place...

dialogText.cn: 坏人？
dialogText.en: Baddies?

dialogText.cn: 他们一定是赤红怪物的帮凶……
dialogText.en: They must be the wicked companions of the Red Monster...

dialogText.cn: 有好多戴着面罩的人……他们突然闯了进来。我们绕小路跑了出来，但是……国王还留在里面。
dialogText.en: All of them wore masks ... and they suddenly charged into our place. We escaped using our secret trail, but ... but our King is still inside.

dialogText.cn: 戴面罩……难道是碾骨氏族？国王没和你们一起出来吗？
dialogText.en: Masked baddies? Could it be the Bonekrushers? And why didn't your King escape with you?

dialogText.cn: 他拿着权杖往宫殿里跑了……坏人们都跟了进去，我们才有机会逃出来……
dialogText.en: He took the scepter and ran for the palace... And all the baddies followed him... That's why all of us got to escape...

dialogText.cn: 拜托你们了，快去救救他吧！
dialogText.en: Please, good envoys! Go and save our King!

dialogText.cn: 这些损坏的痕迹……确实像碾骨那些家伙留下的……
dialogText.en: All this damage... Sure looks like the Bonekrushers' doing...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，不好了！“国王”随时可能陷入危险！
dialogText.en: This is really bad, Endmin! The "King" might be in danger!

dialogText.cn: 通信器？好主意！
dialogText.en: Comm device? That's a good idea!

dialogText.cn: 来，拿好这个。里面的情况你们最熟悉了，我们需要你们的帮助。
dialogText.en: Kids, take this. You know the place really well, so we're counting on you for help.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我也想帮忙救出国王……
dialogText.en: Okay. I want to save our "King" too...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，开始营救吧！
dialogText.en: Let's go, Endmin. We've got a rescue to run!

dialogText.cn: 黄色的长耳兽……这就是“黄金小伯爵”吗？
dialogText.en: A yellow long-ear... Are you the Little Golden Count the children mentioned?

dialogText.cn: 好可爱……管理员，我们能摸摸它吗？
dialogText.en: It's so cute, Endmin... Can we pet it?

dialogText.cn: 啊，它跑了！管理员，快跟上它。
dialogText.en: Ah! It ran away! Let's go after it, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这边……好像上不去。
dialogText.en: Hmm... I don't see a way up.

dialogText.cn: ……应该还有其他路，那边空气流过的感觉……
dialogText.en: *Sniff*... There should be another path. I can feel the air moving...

dialogText.cn: （嗅嗅）
dialogText.en: *Sniff*... *Sniff, sniff*...

dialogText.cn: 这里，这里！管理员！
dialogText.en: Here! Over here, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，我的鼻子灵吧！
dialogText.en: How's that? I got a keen smell, just so you know!

dialogText.cn: 唔……不过管理员好像没法从这里过去。
dialogText.en: Hmm… This tube's a bit cramped. I don't think you can get through, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 没关系，交给我吧！我去看看有没有其他的路。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Leave it to me! I'll look for other paths.

dialogText.cn: 啊！哪来的坏东西，它把钥匙叼走了！！
dialogText.en: *Gasp* That wicked long-ear took our key!!

dialogText.cn: 一定是<@qu.key>红宝石大盗</>！那只坏长耳兽，它老是抢走我们的东西！
dialogText.en: It must be the <@qu.key>Ruby Rogue</>! That cheeky one loves stealing our stuff!

dialogText.cn: 快，管理员，别让它跑了！
dialogText.en: Quick, Endmin! Don't let it escape.

dialogText.cn: 找到啦！管理员，钥匙就在它身上！
dialogText.en: Aha! Endmin, the key's right here!

dialogText.cn: 样本终于到手了，还挺费工夫的。
dialogText.en: Sample retrieved. It took us a really long time.

dialogText.cn: 哼，过家家什么的，太小孩子气了，一点也不适合我！
dialogText.en: Hmmph. Make-believe kingdom. So childish! I'm way beyond that!

dialogText.cn: 不过……
dialogText.en: But...

dialogText.cn: 还算挺开心的……
dialogText.en: It was pretty fun...

dialogText.cn: 那个……管理员。
dialogText.en: Umm... Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 我稍微，想多在这里留一会儿，可以吗……
dialogText.en: I want to ... stay for a while longer. Can I do that...?

dialogText.cn: 就、就一小会儿，我有些放心不下这些小孩子们，万一还有其他危险呢？
dialogText.en: J-just for a short while. I am worried about the kids. There might be other dangers.

dialogText.cn: 真的只是这个原因，我……
dialogText.en: I really meant that... I...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……那，我们晚点再见咯，黑骑士。
dialogText.en: Thank you... Then, we'll meet later, Black Knight.

dialogText.cn: 不，才不是这样！
dialogText.en: No! It's not like that...!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？不过……不过样本得先拿回去才行。我可以在这儿等管理员回来！
dialogText.en: Really? But we still need to return the sample. Heehee, Endmin. I'll wait for you here!

dialogText.cn: 这里是……
dialogText.en: Wow ... this is...

dialogText.cn: 里面就是我们的秘密基地，<@qu.key>积木王国</>！
dialogText.en: It's our secret base! The <@qu.key>Kingdom of Brickyland</>!

dialogText.cn: 是大家用捡回来的东西一起搭建起来的！
dialogText.en: We built this place together with the things we found!

dialogText.cn: 这里的缆车被破坏了……
dialogText.en: That cable car there looks busted...

dialogText.cn: 啊……那我们以后该怎么进去？
dialogText.en: Oh no... How are we supposed to get back in now?

dialogText.cn: 其实……我们还有一条“<@qu.key>勇者之路</>”……
dialogText.en: Wait... There's another way. The <@qu.key>"Trail of the Brave"</>...

dialogText.cn: 是在缆车旁边吗……
dialogText.en: Is it next to the cable car...?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，据说第一任国王，就是通过这条路发现了我们的秘密基地。
dialogText.en: Oh yes. Legends say the very first King of Brickyland took this trail and discovered our secret base.

dialogText.cn: 可那条路太危险了，没人敢通过那里……
dialogText.en: But the trail is really dangerous. No one dares to use it anymore...

dialogText.cn: 救人要紧，我们试试。
dialogText.en: The trail it is. We gotta give it a shot.

dialogText.cn: 这是什么？用矿车拼起来的转盘？
dialogText.en: What is this? A turn table for mining carts?

dialogText.cn: 不是转盘，是我们的<@qu.key>旋转木马</>！
dialogText.en: It's NOT a turn table! It's our very own <@qu.key>"swiftbeast carousel"</>!

dialogText.cn: 那不是一回事吗？
dialogText.en: I don't see the difference.

dialogText.cn: 才不是呢，转盘就只是个转盘，旋转木马可是浪漫的……呃，转盘。
dialogText.en: Ugh! Because a turn table is a ... a table that turns! And our "swiftbeast carousel" is a ... a romantic ride!

dialogText.cn: 先不管它是什么，但看上去像是没电了。
dialogText.en: Let's skip the details. I don't think it has any power.

dialogText.cn: 旋转木马经常会没电……得按顺序打开通电开关才能让它转起来。
dialogText.en: The "Swiftbeast" ride is often out of power... You need to flip the power switches in the correct sequence to make it turn.

dialogText.cn: 想通过这里，得按他们说的来做了。让“旋转木马”重新转起来的线索，似乎就在附近的墙上。
dialogText.en: Looks like we gotta follow their instructions to get through this place. The hint for rotating the "swiftbeast carousel" should be on a nearby wall.

dialogText.cn: 顺序和图案我们都画下来了！唔……顺序是什么来着……
dialogText.en: And we drew out the correct sequence already! Psst ... What's the sequence again...?

dialogText.cn: 好像……有个口诀，是大人们常说的话。我想想……
dialogText.en: Erm... It's a rhyme. A grown-up rhyme, I think...

dialogText.cn: “长耳兽捕虫，牙兽在身后”！
dialogText.en: "A long-ear hungers for a juicy slug, but the tuskbeast's right behind the long-ear's butt!"

dialogText.cn: 哇——真的转起来了！
dialogText.en: Wow — The whole thing is turning!

dialogText.cn: 管理员！
dialogText.en: Endmin!
Ah...

dialogText.cn: 我、我我我我我的意思是，赶快上去才能穿过这里！
dialogText.en: I, uh, I'm just, you know... telling you we have to get on so we can ... quickly get through this place!

dialogText.cn: 我真的是这个意思！
dialogText.en: But it's the truth! That's really what I'm trying to say!

dialogText.cn: 我们站上去试试！
dialogText.en: Come on, let's hop on it!

dialogText.cn: 这里……怎么看着和迷宫一样，绕来绕去的？
dialogText.en: Whoa ... so many cargo containers! It's like a maze in here.

dialogText.cn: 迷宫？你是说我们的<@qu.key>宝库</>吧？
dialogText.en: A maze? Oh, are you talking about our <@qu.key>Vault</>?

dialogText.cn: 那可是我们王国的大宝库！存放着国王和臣民们最贵重的宝藏！据说还藏有第一任国王的秘宝！
dialogText.en: You have entered the Great Vault of our Kingdom! It's where we store the most valuable treasures of the King and the royal subjects! And also the Secret Treasure of the First King!

dialogText.cn: 没想到一群小孩子，能弄出这么多好玩的。
dialogText.en: Never expected the children to come up with so many fun things.

dialogText.cn: 是吗……认真地玩……我没有过那样的体验。
dialogText.en: Really...? Playing seriously...? I never had that experience before.

dialogText.cn: 我不能把时间放在玩闹上面……
dialogText.en: I cannot afford to spend time on playing...

dialogText.cn: 狼群不能忘记身上的责任。现在，救出“国王”就是我的责任。
dialogText.en: Members of the Pack must remember their duty. And my duty right now ... is to save the "King".

dialogText.cn: 问题来了，我们该怎么通过这里？
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, how are we supposed to get through here?

dialogText.cn: 周围可能会有一些我们平时走的路，可你们的话……你们太高了……
dialogText.en: You might find a path that we usually take... But you are probably ... too tall for it...

dialogText.cn: 先找找看。
dialogText.en: Let's find it first.

dialogText.cn: 这里居然还藏着这么大一块空间。那些箱子是做什么用的？
dialogText.en: This place is huge! What are those crates for?

dialogText.cn: 箱子？啊，是<@qu.key>箱子士兵</>吧？那可是我们积木王国引以为豪的军阵，<@qu.key>积木大军</>！
dialogText.en: Huh? Oh! The <@qu.key>Crate troops</>! That's the <@qu.key>Bricky Legion</> — Brickyland's proud soldiers!

dialogText.cn: 它们的背后就是王国宫殿，想要穿过宫殿大门，就得击败这支军队，从守卫的将军那里拿到<@qu.key>钥匙</>。
dialogText.en: The Bricky Legion guards the Kingdom Palace. To pass through the palace gates, you must defeat the army and find the <@qu.key>key</> from the defending general.

dialogText.cn: 呃……具体做法是？看上去不止一个将军呢。
dialogText.en: Okay... How do we do that? I'm seeing more than one general.

dialogText.cn: 总共有三个将军，只有一位守护着前往宫殿的电梯钥匙。不过……我也不记得他的位置了……
dialogText.en: There are three generals in total. Only one of them has the elevator key to the palace. But ... I don't remember where he is...

dialogText.cn: 不会吧，这里有这么多箱子呢……
dialogText.en: Not again... There are so many crates here...

dialogText.cn: 好了，该去找“宫殿”的钥匙了！
dialogText.en: Alright. Time to find the key to the "Palace"!

dialogText.cn: 才、才没有！我只是担心“国王”的安危！
dialogText.en: O-o-o-of course not! I'm just worried about the "King's" safety!

dialogText.cn: 我们快打倒这些箱子，找到钥匙吧！
dialogText.en: Let's defeat these crates and find the key!

dialogText.cn: 别担心，将军和普通士兵可不一样，红色的才是将军。只要看看钥匙在哪一位将军那里就行！
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Generals are different from ordinary soldiers. They are red, you know. And the key is in one of them.

dialogText.cn: 没办法，只能一个一个找了。
dialogText.en: Fine. We'll look through all the generals.

dialogText.cn: 你们看到宫殿大门了吗？再往前就是<@qu.key>王国宫殿</>啦！
dialogText.en: Are you at the entrance? Keep moving and you'll reach the <@qu.key>Kingdom Palace</>!

dialogText.cn: 宫殿也是我们的议事厅！公爵和国王的就任仪式都要在宫殿里举行。
dialogText.en: The Palace is also where all our Dukes and Kings assume their official positions!

dialogText.cn: 平时大家都会在那里集合玩游戏，不知道现在宫殿变成什么样了……
dialogText.en: Everyone usually gathers there to play games. I hope nothing bad happened to our palace.

dialogText.cn: 找出来……杀光……
dialogText.en: Find them all ... and kill them...
Phooo... Hrrggghh...

dialogText.cn: 看起来……不太像你们形容的样子。
dialogText.en: This palace ... isn't quite like what you just described.

dialogText.cn: 国王呢？不在那里吗？
dialogText.en: Do you see our King there?

dialogText.cn: 这些碾骨的人看上去也在找他，他应该还算安全。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers are also looking for him, so I believe he's still safe.

dialogText.cn: 那么……准备好来一场狩猎游戏了吗，管理员？这才是狼群的娱乐活动！
dialogText.en: Alright... Ready for a real hunt, Endmin? You're to witness the Pack's kind of fun.

dialogText.cn: 让我闻到你们的鲜血……
dialogText.en: Let me smell your freshly spilled blood...

dialogText.cn: 红色的……赤红怪物！啊，救命！！
dialogText.en: It's red... The Red Monster! AAAH! HELP!!

dialogText.cn: 什么“赤红怪物”，真没礼貌，你看清楚，是我们！
dialogText.en: "Red Monster"? That's so rude, boy. Look closely. It's us!

dialogText.cn: 赤红色的是我的斗篷！战斗的时候，它就会变得更加鲜红。
dialogText.en: The red you saw? That's just my cape! And fighting makes its color even brighter.

dialogText.cn: 呜呜……他们、他们突然闯进来，我好害怕……
dialogText.en: T-those baddies suddenly broke into our place. I-I was so scared...

dialogText.cn: 是你把他们引到这里，让其他人有机会逃走的吧？你已经很勇敢了。
dialogText.en: You lured them here so that the others could escape, right? That was brave.

dialogText.cn: 我……我的腿已经吓软了，他们好像是来找红色钻石的，所以我……
dialogText.en: I ... my legs can't stop shaking. I think they were after the Red Diamond, so I...

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，还站得起来吗？
dialogText.en: Alright, boy, just breathe. You okay to stand?

dialogText.cn: 我、我试试……
dialogText.en: I ... I'll try...

dialogText.cn: 别怕，如果他们再来，我和管理员都会狠狠地教训他们的。
dialogText.en: Don't be afraid. If the baddies come again, the Endmin and I will teach them a real lesson.

dialogText.cn: 旁边……有一条路，可是……
dialogText.en: There's ... a path nearby, but...

dialogText.cn: 那还等什么，我们一起去吧？
dialogText.en: So what are we waiting for? Let's head there together.

dialogText.cn: 但是……这条路很黑很黑……大家都不敢走。
dialogText.en: But the ... the path is super dark... No one dares to take that path.

dialogText.cn: 你是勇敢的孩子，怎么会怕黑呢？
dialogText.en: You are a brave child, and brave people are not afraid of the dark.

dialogText.cn: 我一点也不勇敢……
dialogText.en: I'm not brave at all...

dialogText.cn: 我和管理员会牵着你一起走的，怎么样？还害怕吗？
dialogText.en: How about letting me and the Endmin take your hand? Will you still be afraid with us around you?
Okay... I'll try...

dialogText.cn: 那、那我们走吧……你们可不要丢下我……
dialogText.en: Al-alright then, I'll go with you... Just don't leave me behind...

dialogText.cn: 那我们出发吧。
dialogText.en: No problem. Let's go together.

dialogText.cn: 只是落石的声音，别怕，没事的。
dialogText.en: It's okay, just some falling rocks. Don't be scared.

dialogText.cn: 前面一定有赤红怪物在……是它打碎了石头……
dialogText.en: It's up ahead... The Red Monster must be the one who broke the rocks...

dialogText.cn: 那、那一定是那些坏人！一定是那些坏人又来了！
dialogText.en: Then ... then it must be the baddies! They're here again!

dialogText.cn: 有坏人在的话，我们会把他们都打跑的。
dialogText.en: If the baddies come, we'll just knock them down!

dialogText.cn: 我不要……坏人会把我抓走，送给赤红怪物当晚餐……
dialogText.en: No... The baddies will take me away ... and feed me to the Red Monster...
Hmmm...

dialogText.cn: 管理员……他不愿意继续走了。
dialogText.en: Endmin... The boy refuses to move.

dialogText.cn: 鼓励……
dialogText.en: Encouragement...

dialogText.cn: 获得勇气……我知道了。
dialogText.en: Courage... Aha!

dialogText.cn: 那我们就休息一会儿。你喜欢听故事吗？
dialogText.en: How about we rest a little? You like stories?

dialogText.cn: 是我小时候第一次狩猎训练，罗赞爷爷给我讲的故事。小狼的故事。
dialogText.en: During my first hunt training, Nonno Rozzan told me a story about a wolf cub.

dialogText.cn: 国王陛下听了故事，就要跟我们一起上路哦。
dialogText.en: So, Your Majesty, once we finish the story, we shall keep traveling.

dialogText.cn: 这是一个在狼群流传很久的故事。
dialogText.en: This is a very old story told in the Pack.

dialogText.cn: 一头小狼独自在林间里长大，它是山林王者。它饿了，就捕食林间的小动物；渴了，就喝点河水。活得好不自在。
dialogText.en: Once upon a time, a wolf cub grew up alone in the forest. It ruled the woods. The little critters were all its prey. The river was all there for it to drink. It lived a carefree life.

dialogText.cn: 就这么过了许多年……小狼觉得山林中没有动物能比得过自己。
dialogText.en: Many years passed ... and the wolf cub felt that no forest beast was its equal.

dialogText.cn: 更可怕的野兽……
dialogText.en: A fiercer beast...

dialogText.cn: 是啊，小狼半信半疑：“我才是这里最强大的生物！”
dialogText.en: Oh yes. But the wolf cub growled back, "I'm the strongest here!"

dialogText.cn: 它跟着长耳兽来到了一个山洞外……
dialogText.en: So the wolf cub followed the long-ear to a cave...

dialogText.cn: 我不信，哪会有那样的野兽……
dialogText.en: I don't believe it. There are no beasts like that...

dialogText.cn: 一只误入山林的长耳兽成了小狼的猎物，在命悬一线之际，长耳兽告诉小狼，它见过一只更加凶猛可怖的野兽。
dialogText.en: Then a long-ear entered the forest and fell into the wolf cub's jaws. But right before it was eaten, the long-ear blurted out that it had seen an even fiercer beast.

dialogText.cn: 长耳兽说：“那家伙有着巨大的身形，恐怖的叫声，它的身体能遮住太阳，它的嘶吼能震撼大地。”
dialogText.en: The long-ear said, "Its shape and voice are terrifying. Its form can hide the sun, and its roar can shake the lands."

dialogText.cn: 能站起来了吗？我继续讲小狼的故事。
dialogText.en: Oh, you can stand now. Good. I'll continue the wolf cub's tale.

dialogText.cn: 嗯！
dialogText.en: Please go on!

dialogText.cn: 啊……不要，我不要走这条路了！
dialogText.en: AAHHH... No! I don't want to go this way no more!

dialogText.cn: 哪里有什么赤红的怪物，这里只有赤红的洛茜。
dialogText.en: There's no Red Monster here. Only Red Rossi.

dialogText.cn: 没想到，那个藏在地下的营地居然在这里……
dialogText.en: Didn't think the hidden underground camp was here...

dialogText.cn: 你们来过这儿？那还需要我继续带路吗？
dialogText.en: You've been here before? So, still need me to guide you around?

dialogText.cn: 需要。这里相比我们上次来的时候，已经变了不少。
dialogText.en: We do. This place has changed quite a bit since we last came.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，他们甚至重启了巢雕……我很难忽视那股刺鼻的味道。
dialogText.en: Yeah. They even reignited the denstack... I can hardly ignore that biting stench.

dialogText.cn: 情况或许比我们预想的更糟糕。管理员，我们得抓紧时间了。
dialogText.en: The situation might be worse than we think. Endmin, we should hurry up.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，那边好像有几个工团的人，要去问问情况吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, I think I see a few UWST crew mates over there. Should we ask them about the situation?

dialogText.cn: 工、工团的人？那我就不过去了吧？你看，我这个打扮……过去根本就是找打嘛！
dialogText.en: The UW? Woosters?! I ... I better not let 'em see me. Look at my stupid outfit... The woosters will beat me on sight!

dialogText.cn: 我还是去另一边看看吧，说不定能逮到碾骨里哪个落单的家伙，让我好好套点话呢！
dialogText.en: I should probably check the other side. Maybe I'll corner a Bonekrusher straggler and pry a few secrets loose.

dialogText.cn: 卡特洛，管理员，我们回头见咯！
dialogText.en: Catello, Endmin! I'll see you later!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们也走吧。
dialogText.en: Let's go, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 情况掌握得差不多了……失踪的工团成员大概是被碾骨的人抓了。虽然不清楚他们抓人的动机，但如果真是他们，找起来应该不费事。
dialogText.en: The picture's coming together. The missing UWST crew mates were likely captured by the Bonekrushers. Their motive's a mystery, but if the raiders are really behind this, tracking them down should be easy.

dialogText.cn: 至于营地的具体位置，现在也有了点眉目。我猜，和重启的巢雕脱不开关系。
dialogText.en: Now that we have more clues about their camp's location, I'm guessing it's tied to the rekindled denstack.

dialogText.cn: 不管他是不是叛徒……都不会希望我们在这里浪费时间。
dialogText.en: Traitor or not ... the last thing he wants is us wasting time up here.

dialogText.cn: 我们只需要看清楚他的意图，见机行事就好。
dialogText.en: We just need to see through his plans and improvise accordingly.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我发现了。管理员的反应速度，和我们最敏锐的狼群成员不相上下……目前毫无破绽。
