dialogText.en: And I agree. You're almost as quick as our sharpest Pack members, Endmin... Impeccable — for now.

dialogText.cn: ……该走了，“搭档”。先去找工团那个失踪的研究员吧。
dialogText.en: ...Alright, "partner", time to go. Let's find our missing UWST scientist first.

dialogText.cn: 根据他们的说法，现场应该会留有一些痕迹，我们可以试着<@qu.key>扫描</>一下。
dialogText.en: According to what the crew told us, we should find some clues at the site. Try <@qu.key>scanning</> the place.

actorName.cn: 激动的工团成员{c6-激动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Excited UWST Crew Mate {c6-Excited UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 绝对是有预谋的！附近一定有他们的营地！
dialogText.en: This is definitely planned! They must have a camp nearby!

actorName.cn: 激动的工团成员{c6-激动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Excited UWST Crew Mate {c6-Excited UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 对，这么想就都说得通了！
dialogText.en: That's right! It explains everything!

actorName.cn: 冷静的工团成员{c6-冷静的工团成员}
actorName.en: Calm UWST Crew Mate {c6-Calm UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 咳，抱歉，两位……我的同事有点太激动了。最近工团在谷地通道的驻扎点总出状况，我们一直在寻找原因……
dialogText.en: Ahem, apologies... My fellow crew mate can get carried away at times. The UWST post at the Valley Pass has had several disruptions lately. We're trying to find out why...

actorName.cn: 激动的工团成员{c6-激动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Excited UWST Crew Mate {c6-Excited UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 肯定的！哪有什么别的可能？这些破坏分子真不让人省心。要是让我找到他们那营地，我可不会放过他们！
dialogText.en: Of course! I can't see anyone else doing this! These vandals won't stop harassing us! Once I find that camp of theirs, I'll make those pipefaces pay!

actorName.cn: 冷静的工团成员{c6-冷静的工团成员}
actorName.en: Calm UWST Crew Mate {c6-Calm UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 关键是位置。目前我们依然没找到他们营地的位置……或许得换换思路了。
dialogText.en: Location is key. We still haven't been able to find the exact place of their camp... Perhaps we need another approach.

actorName.cn: 激动的工团成员{c6-激动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Excited UWST Crew Mate {c6-Excited UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 那些无故丢失的物资，被人破坏的装置，还有突然冒起烟的怪塔……估计都是裂地者为了建营地干的好事！
dialogText.en: The missing supplies, the sabotaged machines, and that weird tower suddenly belching out foul smoke... I bet the Landbreakers did everything! They're rebuilding their camp!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们救了我。我叫尤利，是工团的研究员……之前巡逻的时候，我撞见了一个裂地者，他好像正和一个避难者打扮的人在做什么交易……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Thanks for saving me. I'm Yuley ... a UWST scientist... I ran into a Landbreaker during my patrols. He seemed to be trading with someone dressed like a refugee...

dialogText.cn: 然后……然后我就被他们敲晕了过去，醒来后就被关在这儿了……
dialogText.en: And then ... well ... they knocked me out. When I came around, I found myself trapped in this place...

dialogText.cn: 避难者打扮的人？
dialogText.en: Someone dressed like a refugee?

dialogText.cn: 对……那人手上，一直把玩着一柄<@qu.key>短刀</>……我印象很深……
dialogText.en: Yeah... That guy kept fiddling with a <@qu.key>dagger</>... The way it flashed really stuck with me.

dialogText.cn: 这个，好像有说“地底下”“营地”“埋伏”什么的……哦对，还提了一个词好几次！叫什么“狼群”的，也不知道是什么意思……
dialogText.en: I think I heard them mention something about the underground, some camp, and ... an ambush...? Oh! They also kept saying the "Pack". I don't really know what that means...

dialogText.cn: 看来我猜得没错。
dialogText.en: Just as I figured.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这场戏……想必会在碾骨这个地下营地中落幕。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this show of ours ... might be reaching its finale at the Bonekrushers' underground camp.

dialogText.cn: 线索收集得差不多了……
dialogText.en: We have found enough clues...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，该和乔万尼会合，继续陪他演下一幕了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, the next act's about to start. Let's go find Giovanni.

actorName.cn: 打起精神的工团成员{c6-疲惫的工团成员}
actorName.en: Energized UWST Crew Mate {c6-Exhausted UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 哎，平安回来就好！这下我总算能给老罗伯特一个交代了！你可是他好不容易带出来的徒弟……
dialogText.en: Oh! I'm so glad you're back in one piece! I finally got some good news for Old Robert! He trained you well, and he'd be devastated if anything happened to you...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，让你们担心了……还是我太大意了。幸亏被那两个终末地的朋友救了，不然真是……
dialogText.en: Sorry for making you worry... I was careless. If those two Endfielders hadn't found me in time, things could've been...

actorName.cn: 急躁的工团成员{c6-焦躁的工团成员}
actorName.en: Frustrated UWST Crew Mate {c6-Frustrated UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 这怎么能怪你呢！要怪就怪那些裂地者！
dialogText.en: Stop beating yourself up! The Landbreakers are to blame for all of this!

dialogText.cn: 你们来得真是时候！我刚从那小子嘴里套出点有用的！可不容易了！
dialogText.en: Eyyyy, perfect timing! I just coaxed the key clue from that squirming whelp. Wasn't easy, y'know!

dialogText.cn: 是吗？说说看？
dialogText.en: Really? Tell us about it.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，他把营地的位置告诉我了，就在前头那堵墙的后面——有个能下去的大洞。
dialogText.en: Heheh. The clueless runt spilled the camp's location. It's right behind that wall up ahead — there's a big hole we can slip through.

dialogText.cn: 那个位置已经被碾骨的人包围了，要想过去估计要费点功夫。
dialogText.en: That location is already surrounded by Bonekrushers. Getting there might be troublesome.

dialogText.cn: 我有个主意……要不然干脆我们三个一起上？直接冲到最里面去？
dialogText.en: Okay, hear me out... We charge as one — fast and relentless. No delays, just hit 'em and push through.

dialogText.cn: 对！别想那么多！直接过去把那群碾骨的全打飞！怎么样？
dialogText.en: Yeah! Ditch the plans! Go straight up to their pipefaces and smash 'em in! How does that sound?

dialogText.cn: 是个好主意。
dialogText.en: Sounds like a good idea.

dialogText.cn: 总之，团队作战更适合突破眼下的困境。
dialogText.en: In any case, fighting as a team will solve our current predicament.

dialogText.cn: ……我们或许比对手更需要节省时间。
dialogText.en: ...We might need to act faster than our adversaries.

dialogText.cn: 时间……对，说得没错！是该节省时间！
dialogText.en: Act faster... Ah, yes! Of course! Speed's our best ally.

dialogText.cn: 好了好了！那就这么说定了！走吧！
dialogText.en: Okay, then! That's our next move! Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 可、可以啊……卡特洛，你现在可比以前懂变通多了！
dialogText.en: Wha...? Of course, Catello...! You've turned into quite a decent team player!

dialogText.cn: 呼……呼……总算结束了。我敢打赌，这比当年我们俩打三十个商会保镖的时候还刺激！
dialogText.en: Hooo ... hoo... It's finally over. Mark my words. This was way more exciting than that fight we had with thirty Cartel bodyguards!

dialogText.cn: 商会的保镖惜命，碾骨的人就不一样了。
dialogText.en: The Cartel guards wanted to stay alive. The Bonekrushers are different.

dialogText.cn: 你带着的那把<@qu.key>短刀</>，难道是……
dialogText.en: That <@qu.key>dagger</> you're carrying. Is it...?

dialogText.cn: 嚯，这你都看出来了？眼力还跟当年一样好嘛！
dialogText.en: Oho. Catello, sharp and steady as always!

dialogText.cn: ……是我后来按你教的那些法子，专门找人定做的一把刀！哈哈，用得可顺手了！
dialogText.en: ...I followed the tricks you've taught me, and got someone to custom-forge this blade! Hah! The handling and balance are awesome!

dialogText.cn: 是吗？顺手就好。
dialogText.en: Really? I'm glad you like it.

dialogText.cn: 看着……是把好刀。
dialogText.en: It looks like ... a fine piece.

dialogText.cn: 洛茜，幸好有你在，及时把那几只天使干掉了！不然那些设备肯定保不住了……
dialogText.en: Thank Talos you took out those Aggeloi, Rossi! Those rock buggers would have destroyed our machines if you hadn't been around...

dialogText.cn: 都是我该做的啦！鲁德爷爷，你回去路上小心点喔！
dialogText.en: Just part of my job, Grandpa Ruud. Be careful on your way back!

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员！您来了！
dialogText.en: Ah ... Endmin! You're here!

dialogText.cn: 本来、本来我还想，等矿区营地安定下来，我帮工团的大伙儿把问题都解决了……再去找您的。谁知道……
dialogText.en: I was thinking that once the Mining Camp settles down, and I've taken care of the problems for the UW crew ... I'll go looking for you. I didn't expect that...

dialogText.cn: 对啊，都怪我那个不靠谱的老哥。
dialogText.en: Nope, and it's all the fault of my unreliable brother.

dialogText.cn: 昨天他收了个包裹，整个人就不对了，到了早上连影子都找不见了，还压根儿联系不上！
dialogText.en: He started behaving strangely after receiving some package yesterday. I didn't see him the entire morning! He wouldn't even pick up my calls!

dialogText.cn: 唉，卡特洛这家伙是问题一大堆，整天独来独往的，给大家添了好多麻烦，但总不能放着他不管吧……
dialogText.en: Ugh. Catello is a huge bag of problems. Worse, he's always doing things on his own and creating trouble for everyone. But what can I say? Can't just ditch him...

dialogText.cn: 可是矿区营地还有好多事，我一时走不开……只好找最最靠谱的管理员帮忙了。
dialogText.en: I can't leave the Mining Camp — there's still so much to take care of. And ... you're the most reliable person I can count on, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢您，管理员——对了，这个给您！
dialogText.en: Grazie, Endmin! Ah yes, this is for you!

dialogText.cn: 对！是我以前做的小玩意！
dialogText.en: Yeah! It's a gadget I made a while back!

dialogText.cn: 它可以追踪到卡特洛身上的骨牌——那是我们家传的护身符，我也有一个。
dialogText.en: It can track Catello's bone charm — y'know, our family talisman. I've got one myself.

dialogText.cn: 只要照着追踪器指引的方向走，就可以找到他啦！
dialogText.en: Just follow the direction pointed out by the tracker and you'll find him!

dialogText.cn: 啊，差点忘了——我听工团的缪拉大哥说，他在<@qu.key>供能高地</>看到过一个很像卡特洛的家伙。管理员，您先从那里开始？
dialogText.en: Ah! Almost forgot! Murat of the UW said he saw someone who looks like Catello at the <@qu.key>Power Plateau</>. You might want to start the search there, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 卡特洛平时没什么在乎的东西，也就这个会随身带着！
dialogText.en: Catello doesn't care about much else. The bone charm's the only thing he's always got with him.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，卡特洛就交给您啦！至于矿区营地这边，只管包在我身上！您放心好了！
dialogText.en: I trust Catello in your capable hands, Endmin! And I'll keep the Mining Camp safe! Don't you worry!

dialogText.cn: 那个隐藏的营地入口就在这边，管理员，走吗？
dialogText.en: This is the entrance to the hidden camp. Shall we, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 这地方应该不是碾骨自己造的，估计是工团废弃的地下厂房。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers didn't build this place themselves. This seems like an abandoned underground factory of the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 呵，也就碾骨的人爱干这种事！等于是空手捞了个营地嘛！
dialogText.en: Hah! Typical Bonekrusher behavior. Well, they practically got a camp for free!

dialogText.cn: 或许会有碾骨改建留下的机关……乔万尼，你走前面。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers may have modified the local machines or facilities... Giovanni, lead the way.

dialogText.cn: 啊？为、为什么是我——
dialogText.en: Huh? M-me again?

dialogText.cn: 好、好吧……走前面就走前面……
dialogText.en: O-okay... sure, I'll lead the way...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这场戏还没到落幕的时候。
dialogText.en: Yes. The show has yet to reach the final act.

dialogText.cn: 况且以我对他的了解，他应该按捺不了太久了……
dialogText.en: Besides, from what I know about him, he's very close to his breaking point...

dialogText.cn: 啧啧，这也能算埋伏吗？比我们遇到过的可差远了！
dialogText.en: Pfft. They call this an ambush? We've been through worse.

dialogText.cn: 是他们太过自信了。
dialogText.en: They were overconfident.

dialogText.cn: 应该有别的机关，管理员，去前面找找看吧，说不定有什么线索。
dialogText.en: There should be other mechanisms, Endmin. Let's press on and look around. Perhaps we'll find a clue.

dialogText.cn: 这是碾骨的标记……我记得，他们很喜欢拿这种标记作为暗号。
dialogText.en: Bonekrusher glyphs... I remember that they like using these glyphs to pass on secret messages.

dialogText.cn: 大致上可以……
dialogText.en: Most of them, yes...

dialogText.cn: 卡特洛，原来你还懂这个？我可一个都不认识。
dialogText.en: You actually know this, Catello? I recognize none of this.

dialogText.cn: 但光知道意思，恐怕还开不了这机关。
dialogText.en: But knowing what the glyphs mean won't get this machine to work.

dialogText.cn: 这么麻烦？那还是靠你们吧……
dialogText.en: That sounds like a real hassle! I should leave you two to this job...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，关于图案排列的顺序，<@qu.key>线索</>应该就在附近。
dialogText.en: Yes. The correct sequence of the glyphs. I believe the <@qu.key>clues</> should be somewhere nearby.

dialogText.cn: 欸！等等……那边的家伙是？！托马索！是你吗！
dialogText.en: Eh? Wait... Who's there?! Tommaso?! Is that you?

dialogText.cn: 乔万尼！回来！
dialogText.en: Giovanni! Come back!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你还好吗？是我大意了，乔万尼他果然……
dialogText.en: You alright, Endmin? I slipped. Giovanni... I knew it...

dialogText.cn: ……那就好。
dialogText.en: ...Good.

dialogText.cn: ……你看出来了？
dialogText.en: ...You saw it?

dialogText.cn: ……被你看穿了。
dialogText.en: ...I guess you saw right through me.

dialogText.cn: 就像你说的那样，管理员。
dialogText.en: Just like you said, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我确实……犹豫了。
dialogText.en: I did ... hesitate.

dialogText.cn: 过去，我在狼群里只有两个朋友，一个是托马索，一个……是乔万尼。
dialogText.en: Back then, I had only two friends in the Pack — Tommaso ... and Giovanni.

dialogText.cn: 而这一路的遭遇让我确信，尽管他看起来没什么变化，实际上……早与过去判若两人。
dialogText.en: The encounters we had on this mission showed me one thing: he might look the same, but ... the Giovanni I knew is gone.

dialogText.cn: 我本该独自承担所有的后果，但还是连累了你……管理员。
dialogText.en: I should be the one bearing the consequences, but I got you involved ... Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……你说得没错。无论如何，在乔万尼的事上，我不会再重蹈覆辙。
dialogText.en: ...You're right. When it comes to Giovanni, I won't make the same mistakes again, no matter what.

dialogText.cn: 总之，先想办法离开这里吧，搭档。
dialogText.en: Anyway, we should figure out a way to leave this place, partner.

dialogText.cn: 附近应该有机关在控制这些装置。
dialogText.en: These devices should be controlled by a mechanism nearby.

dialogText.cn: 你提醒我了，去找<@qu.key>接了油管的装置</>，管理员——那应该就是关键。
dialogText.en: Good reminder. Let's find a <@qu.key>device connected to a fuel pipe</>, Endmin — that should be key.

dialogText.cn: ……这样应该就解决了。
dialogText.en: ...That should do it.

dialogText.cn: 过奖了……成熟的猎手，理应挑选自己最趁手的猎具。
dialogText.en: You flatter me... Experienced hunters would always select their best hunting tools.

dialogText.cn: ……咳，好了，现在我们该去最深处看看了。
dialogText.en: ...Ahem. Since we're good, let's head for the deepest part of this place.

dialogText.cn: ……出来吧。
dialogText.en: ...Show yourself.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，你们都在这里。
dialogText.en: I know you're here.

dialogText.cn: 一个个解决未免太浪费时间，还是一起上吧。
dialogText.en: Taking you down one at a time will drag on. Throw it all at me!

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{c6-裂地者头目}

dialogText.cn: 口气真大啊……狼群的小崽子！哼，今天你们就别想出这个大门了！
dialogText.en: Big, strong words from a ... tiny runt of the Pack! The exit's closed — and so is your fate!

dialogText.cn: 乔万尼在哪里？
dialogText.en: Where is Giovanni?

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{c6-裂地者头目}

dialogText.cn: 乔万尼？什么乔万尼？我不认识！
dialogText.en: Giovanni? What Giovanni? Don't know anybody with that name!

dialogText.cn: ……谁让你们守在这里的？
dialogText.en: ...Who put you on guard here?

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{c6-裂地者头目}

dialogText.cn: 哼，还不是你们狼群的大叛徒？自己不肯露面，就派了个小喽啰——
dialogText.en: Hmph. It's the traitor of that Pack of yours! Wouldn't show up himself, so your big wolf sends a little runt — *URK*

dialogText.cn: 呵，废物……给了你这么好的机会也没把人干掉。
dialogText.en: Hur. Useless... It was the perfect ambush, and you still failed.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，别大意。
dialogText.en: Keep your guard up, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 啧，卡特洛，之前不还演得好好的吗？怎么？现在知道怕了？
dialogText.en: Hmph. Catello, you were giving a pretty good show. What happened? You scared?

dialogText.cn: ……杀死托马索的也是这把刀。
dialogText.en: ...The blade that killed Tommaso.

dialogText.cn: ……是又怎么样？他信了你说的那些屁话，甚至还想出卖我！当然该死！
dialogText.en: ...Yeah? So what?! He believed in your blighted ideas and tried to sell me out! He deserved it!

dialogText.cn: 是你先背叛了氏族。
dialogText.en: You're the one who betrayed the clan.

dialogText.cn: 呵，我背叛了氏族？真正的狼群氏族，重视事业，崇尚荣耀……决不会为了一点佣金，就让大家给那些公司卖命！叛徒明明是你们！
dialogText.en: Hah! I betrayed the clan? Please. The true Pack lives by purpose and honor... We don't sell out our own for some measly creds, trading blood and sweat to those companies! The real traitor here ... is YOU!

dialogText.cn: 想要更多人过上好日子，有时必须抛下一些传统……不管是为了过去，还是为了未来。
dialogText.en: Some traditions must be set aside if we want more people to lead decent lives... We have to do this for our past, as well as our future.

dialogText.cn: 未来？我可不觉得那样能有什么未来！首领说得没错，你早就无可救药！唯有首领才能带领“新狼群”，带领我们重回应有的辉煌……
dialogText.en: Future? That path of yours leads to no future! The Alpharion is right! You're hopeless! Only the Alpharion could lead the New Pack to the glory we deserve...

dialogText.cn: “新狼群”？
dialogText.en: The New Pack?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈！没错！如果你觉得我是叛徒，那你要抓的“叛徒”可太多了！真以为“新狼群”只是个刚冒头的小组织吗？
dialogText.en: Hahaha! That's right! If I'm a traitor in your eyes, then you're gonna find a whole army of traitors out there! Did you really think that the New Pack is just a little club that came out of nowhere?

dialogText.cn: 你就继续抱着那些不切实际的想法，做你的美梦吧，狼卫！
dialogText.en: Have fun with your la-la land fantasies and stupid dreams, Wulfgard!

dialogText.cn: 你们的首领是谁？
dialogText.en: Who is your Alpharion?

dialogText.cn: 哈，卡特洛，你不会觉得我会说吧？
dialogText.en: Hah! Catello, do you really think I'll break my omertà?

dialogText.cn: 虽然我没法干掉你，但带走一个垫背的也是好的——
dialogText.en: I probably can't kill you, but it'd be nice ... to take someone down with me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！
dialogText.en: ENDMIN!

dialogText.cn: 首领到底是谁？！
dialogText.en: Who's the Alpharion?!

dialogText.cn: ……卡特洛，这么关键的答案……
dialogText.en: ...Catello, this ... key answer...

dialogText.cn: 还是你自己……去找吧……
dialogText.en: It's ... yours ... to discover...

dialogText.cn: 大错特错！我们才是狼群真正该有的面貌！而你们，会成为我们的第一批猎物！
dialogText.en: WRONG! We are what the Pack was supposed to be! And you ... you'll be our very first prey!

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{c6-裂地者头目}

dialogText.cn: 事情终于告一段落……叛徒也得到了应有的下场。可喜可贺，不是吗？
dialogText.en: The incident is now over ... and the traitor got what he deserved. We should celebrate, no?

dialogText.cn: 没事，管理员，不必担心我……
dialogText.en: I'm alright, Endmin. No need to worry about me...

dialogText.cn: 我做出了这个决定，便有承担这个结果的准备。
dialogText.en: It was my choice. And I'm prepared for the consequences.

dialogText.cn: 乔万尼……也一样。
dialogText.en: The same rule applies ... to Giovanni.

dialogText.cn: ……嗯，我等下就来。
dialogText.en: ...Sure. I'll be right with you in a moment.

dialogText.cn: 管理员。
dialogText.en: Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我想我可能要先走一步。
dialogText.en: I may need to excuse myself for now.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，他现在依然是狼群的一员，理应照狼群的规矩来。
dialogText.en: Yes. He remains a Pack member. His final rites should follow the code of the Pack.

dialogText.cn: 办法……你不是已经学会了吗？管理员。
dialogText.en: ...I thought you knew already, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 那是我们头一回任务失败……为了填上契约金，托马索什么话都没说，直接把他妈妈留下的这枚银胸针卖了。
dialogText.en: That was the first time we botched our job... We had to pay the fine. Tommaso sold the silver brooch his mother left him without a word.

dialogText.cn: 后来……乔万尼花了三个月的工夫，硬是在艾什柏环岛的地下市场找到了它，花了两倍的价钱才买回来——用完了他一整年的佣金，他还叫我别告诉托马索。
dialogText.en: Giovanni then spent three months looking for it... He paid double the price to buy it back from the underground market at Asphalt Roundabout — that was all his commission for the entire year. He told me not to tell Tommaso about it.

dialogText.cn: 猜错了，是我送的。
dialogText.en: No. It was from me.

dialogText.cn: 给他的……二十岁生日礼物。
dialogText.en: It was a gift ... for his twentieth birthday.

dialogText.cn: 洛茜挑的款式，我只负责出钱还有送过去。
dialogText.en: Rossi picked it. I was in charge of payment and delivery.

dialogText.cn: 至于它……
dialogText.en: As for this one...

dialogText.cn: 就留在这里吧。
dialogText.en: {F}We should leave it here.{M}We should leave it here.

dialogText.cn: 这下……就真的结束了。
dialogText.en: And now ... it's really over.

dialogText.cn: 乔万尼所说的“新狼群”确实超出了我的预期……他们的规模、他们的目的，以及最重要的……他们的首领，都还是谜。
dialogText.en: I did not expect to hear about this New Pack from Giovanni... I know nothing about the size of this operation, their goals, and most importantly ... their Alpharion.

dialogText.cn: 或许就像洛茜常说的那样……现在的狼群和过去的每个狼群都不同，无论是她还是我，想要改变现状，就必须付出更多代价。
dialogText.en: Rossi often mentions it, and maybe she's right... The Pack of today is different from every Pack of the past. She, I, anyone really ... we'd all bear heavier prices to make changes.

dialogText.cn: 但……在那之前，我要先确认一些事，再和洛茜一起做一些准备。
dialogText.en: But ... before that happens, I must verify something and make a few preparations with Rossi.

dialogText.cn: 如果可以，管理员，我希望你把这次经历的一切……看作是我们之间的“秘密”。
dialogText.en: If possible, I hope you treat everything that happened here ... as a secret between us, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 不，我会亲口告诉她。
dialogText.en: I'll tell her myself.

dialogText.cn: 但肯定不是现在，也不该是现在……
dialogText.en: Now's definitely not the time, as it shouldn't be.

actorName.cn: 疲惫的工团成员{c6-疲惫的工团成员}
actorName.en: Exhausted UWST Crew Mate {c6-Exhausted UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 那群裂地者到底是从哪里冒出来的……现在打也打不完。难道只能等支援了吗？
dialogText.en: Where did those pipefaces come from...? There is no end to them. Do we have to wait for reinforcements again?

actorName.cn: 焦躁的工团成员{c6-焦躁的工团成员}
actorName.en: Frustrated UWST Crew Mate {c6-Frustrated UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 支援请求早发过去了！问题是，昨天又失踪了一个工友，这样下去可不是办法啊！
dialogText.en: We've already called for support! Problem is, another one of ours went missing yesterday. Things can't go on like this!

actorName.cn: 疲惫的工团成员{c6-疲惫的工团成员}
actorName.en: Exhausted UWST Crew Mate {c6-Exhausted UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 这个标志是……终末地？你们也收到我们的支援请求了？
dialogText.en: What's that badge you're wearing...? Endfield? You also received our call for support?

dialogText.cn: 不，我们只是刚好路过。听起来，你们有同伴失踪了？
dialogText.en: No. We were just passing by. I heard you got a missing crew mate?

actorName.cn: 焦躁的工团成员{c6-焦躁的工团成员}
actorName.en: Frustrated UWST Crew Mate {c6-Frustrated UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 是、是的！一个叫尤利的研究员，戴眼镜，和我差不多高！他是昨天轮班巡逻的时候失踪的。
dialogText.en: Oh, yeah! It's Yuley! A scientist! He's about as tall as I am and wears glasses. He went missing when we were changing our patrol shifts yesterday.

actorName.cn: 疲惫的工团成员{c6-疲惫的工团成员}
actorName.en: Exhausted UWST Crew Mate {c6-Exhausted UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 唉……这已经是最近失踪的第三个工友了……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* That makes three gone, just recently...

dialogText.cn: 他们都是在附近失踪的？
dialogText.en: And all happened in this very area?

actorName.cn: 焦躁的工团成员{c6-焦躁的工团成员}
actorName.en: Frustrated UWST Crew Mate {c6-Frustrated UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 对，而且都是在换班前后。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Right before or after we changed our patrol shifts.

dialogText.cn: 很可能是碾骨的手笔……他们经常挑这样的时机下手。
dialogText.en: Sounds like Bonekrushers' work... They often attack at times like this.

dialogText.cn: 一顶印有工团标志的工程帽，底部的标签上有一个手写的人名——“尤利”。
dialogText.en: An engineer's hat with the UWST logo. The label underneath has a handwritten name: Yuley.

dialogText.cn: 一张纸条，上面依稀可以分辨出“巡逻真无聊啊……还是想回研究所做研究……”的字迹。
dialogText.en: A note with legible scribbles that read: "Patrols are boring... I hope I'm back at the Research Center and get back to my science project..."

dialogText.cn: 大门似乎被锁住了，暂时无法打开。
dialogText.en: Looks like the gate's locked. Can't open it right now.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你怎么会来这里……
dialogText.en: Endmin? Why are you here...?

dialogText.cn: ……果然是她。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Rossi... I knew it.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，抱歉，我暂时还不能回去。
dialogText.en: Apologies, Endmin. I cannot head back just yet.

dialogText.cn: 看来洛茜都说了……那包裹里放了一份名单、一张地图和一张纸条。
dialogText.en: Since Rossi already told you... There's a list of names, a map, and a note in that package.

dialogText.cn: 名单上写的——是狼群最近几个月任务失败的成员，而地图和纸条上的内容……
dialogText.en: The names — they are Pack members who failed their missions in the past few months. As for the map and the note...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你可以看看——
dialogText.en: You can take a look at it, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: （纸条上写着“卡特洛，想知道他们是怎么失败的吗？这里有你要的答案。”）
dialogText.en: (NOTE writes: "Catello, interested in knowing how they failed? The answers are here.")

dialogText.cn: 失败的任务都是狼群和终末地的合作委托，牺牲的也都是狼群里的佼佼者……
dialogText.en: All the failed missions are partnership contracts between the Pack and Endfield. And those who died ... were some of the best members of the Pack...

dialogText.cn: 几天前，我还收到了一名狼群成员的死讯……他叫托马索，是我为数不多的挚友。
dialogText.en: A few days back, I got word that a Pack member had died... Tommaso. He was one of the very few true friends I had.

dialogText.cn: 没错。无论是不是陷阱，为了揪出叛徒，给托马索一个交代，我都必须来这里看看……
dialogText.en: That's right. I don't care if it's a trap. I had to come here and investigate. I'll hunt the traitors down and make them pay. For Tommaso.

dialogText.cn: 是的。但说到底，这些只是我们狼群内部的事情……
dialogText.en: Yes. However, this is housekeeping for the Pack...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你没必要被牵扯进来，更不该为此涉险。
dialogText.en: There's no need to get yourself involved or face risks for our sake, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……好吧。我尊重你的选择。
dialogText.en: ...Fine. I respect your choice.

dialogText.cn: 但管理员，这也意味着你将安全托付给了我。
dialogText.en: But this also means you've entrusted your safety to me, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 所以接下来的行动，希望你能尽量按我的安排来，可以吗？
dialogText.en: For this joint operation, I might need you to stick to my arrangements if you can. Okay?

dialogText.cn: 如果是其他氏族挑事，不至于每次都能得手。
dialogText.en: If the meddlers were other Landbreaker clans, they wouldn't be foiling us every time.

dialogText.cn: 前不久他给我传过信，说狼群氏族中出了叛徒，想破坏我们与终末地的合作。
dialogText.en: Just not too long ago he sent me a message, saying that there are traitors in the Pack. They're trying to sabotage our partnership with Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 结果如你所见，被一群碾骨的家伙伏击了。好在，我也从他们那里拿到了新的线索。
dialogText.en: As you can see, I ended up being ambushed by a Bonekrusher mob. Good news is, I got fresh leads from them.

dialogText.cn: 小心，别放松警惕。
dialogText.en: Careful. Don't let your guard down.

dialogText.cn: 我的天！那是什么？！
dialogText.en: By Talos! What the blight is that?!

dialogText.cn: 该你倒下咯，大块头！
dialogText.en: Eat the dirt, brute!

dialogText.cn: 别、别动手！“双月终将合二为一”！
dialogText.en: Nononono! Don't shoot! "The Twin Moons shall be one!"
You...

dialogText.cn: 卡特洛！是我啊，乔万尼！你不会忘了我吧？我们以前出过那么多趟任务，搭档过那么多回……
dialogText.en: Catello! It's me! Giovanni! My friend, did you forget about me? We were tight — best partners on so many missions...

dialogText.cn: ……以你当年的表现，确实很难忘记。
dialogText.en: ...Your performance was indeed rather ... unforgettable.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，我就知道！好了好了，这里可不安全，我们还是换个地方说话吧……
dialogText.en: Heheh! I knew it! Alright, friends. This isn't a safe place. Let's talk somewhere else...

dialogText.cn: 呼……行了，这位置应该够安全了，继续聊吧。
dialogText.en: Hooo... Okay. This spot looks nice and private. Let's get back to our little chat.

dialogText.cn: 乔万尼，你为什么……会来这里？
dialogText.en: Giovanni, why are you ... here?

dialogText.cn: 就知道你第一句肯定是问这个……唉，但我猜你肯定是想不到的——
dialogText.en: I knew that would be your first question... *Sigh* But trust me, you won't expect what I've got to say.

dialogText.cn: ……我记得。他怎么了？
dialogText.en: ...I do. What happened to him?

dialogText.cn: 这个……我就是听说……只是听说啊……他好像和碾骨的人，混到一块儿去了……
dialogText.en: Okay ... don't take my word for it — I'm just passing along whispers... Sounds like Tommaso's gotten cozy with the Bonekrushers...

dialogText.cn: 你确定？
dialogText.en: You sure?

dialogText.cn: 当然不确定啊！所以我才跑过来了嘛！还专门整了套碾骨的衣服。
dialogText.en: Of course I'm NOT sure! That's why I came all the way here. Even got myself an entire set of the Bonekrusher outfit.

dialogText.cn: 对了，说到这个，卡特洛你又为什么来这里啊？
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, Catello, my man, why are you here?

dialogText.cn: 氏族里出了叛徒，托马索嫌疑最大，我现在……也在找他。
dialogText.en: There are traitors in the Pack and Tommaso's our biggest suspect. I'm ... also looking for him.

dialogText.cn: 什么？托马索是叛徒？不、不会吧……说不定只是个误会呢……对，误会……
dialogText.en: What?! You really think so? N-no way... Tommaso wouldn't... Maybe it's just some — some mix-up. Yeah, yeah, it's gotta be.

dialogText.cn: 知道了，得你追查完了才清楚是吧，还是这么死脑筋……哎，你身边这位是……？看着也不像什么一般人嘛！
dialogText.en: Got it. You need to wrap up your little investigation before calling it, right? Classic you... Oh, who's this sharp one next to you...? Looks like some serious brainiac!

dialogText.cn: {F}她是……{M}他是……
dialogText.en: {F}She's... {M}He's...

dialogText.cn: 我是狼卫现在的搭档。
dialogText.en: I'm Wulfgard's current partner.

dialogText.cn: {F}对，我们一般叫她“管理员”。{M}对，我们一般叫他“管理员”。
dialogText.en: {F}Indeed. We usually call her the Endmin. {M}Indeed. We usually call him the Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 呃……好了！还是换个话题吧——那卡特洛，管理员，你们现在是打算……？
dialogText.en: Err... Okay! Let's change topic. So, Catello and Endmin, what are your plans...?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我也想看看……“叛徒”在那里做什么。
dialogText.en: Hmm. I also want to see what our traitor ... is doing there.

dialogText.cn: 怎么这就叫上了……不是还没确定吗……
dialogText.en: Jumping straight to "traitor," huh? Aren't we a bit quick to judge?

dialogText.cn: 有意见吗？
dialogText.en: Got a problem with that?

dialogText.cn: 呃，当、当然没有！对了，根据情报，碾骨那个营地被他们藏在了地下……入口就在<@qu.key>谷地通道</>那里。
dialogText.en: Oh, of course not! By the way, according to my intel, the Bonekrushers hid their camp underground... The entrance is at the <@qu.key>Valley Pass</>.

dialogText.cn: 先去那里看看吧？怎么样？
dialogText.en: Let's go there to take a peek. What do you say?

dialogText.cn: 可以，你带路。
dialogText.en: Sure. Lead the way.

dialogText.cn: 行，行，我带路就我带路……看来我这身行头还得再穿好一阵子咯……
dialogText.en: Alright, alright. I'll lead the way... Guess I'll have to put up with this outfit for a little longer...

dialogText.cn: “管理员”？听听！多好一代号！等下，卡特洛……你居然把授名拿来当代号？哈哈哈！真受不了你！
dialogText.en: Endmin? That's a catchy name. Hold on, Catello... What's your codename again? Wulfgard? Awww, that's almost cute — like a puppy pretending to be a wolf.

dialogText.cn: 因为托马索，就是我们那个差点就考进宏科院的好哥们儿，你应该还记得他吧？
dialogText.en: I'm here for Tommaso. That smart brother of ours who almost got admitted to HAS. Remember him?

dialogText.cn: 我打扮成这样，就是想溜进他们的营地，看看能不能找到托马索！万一真找到了，这不是还能劝劝他吗？
dialogText.en: I'm all decked out for slipping into their camp. Plan is to find Tommaso ... and if I do, he's in for a talk. Y'know, maybe I'll knock some sense into him.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳……
dialogText.en: Ahem...

dialogText.cn: 要不要也和我一起去碾骨的营地看看？以我收集到的情报，托马索肯定在那里！
dialogText.en: How about you join me on a trip to the Bonekrusher camp? The intel I've gathered tells me that Tommaso might be there!

dialogText.cn: 呼，几年不见，卡特洛这人怎么还是这副臭脾气……就没人管管他吗？
dialogText.en: Hoo. Haven't seen Catello in years, but he's still got that blighted temper... Someone should teach him manners.

dialogText.cn: 也差不多十几年了？哈哈，我们认识的时候，他还是个连匕首都拿不稳的小屁孩呢！
dialogText.en: Way more than a decade! Hah. When we first met, he was still a little rascal who couldn't even hold his dagger!

dialogText.cn: 但卡特洛这小子，从小就和我这种家伙不一样，什么武器拿到手稍微摸两下就会用……啧啧，当年可羡慕死我了……
dialogText.en: But the kid was different from people like me. Catello picked up every weapon like it was second nature... Man, I was downright jealous of his skills back then...

dialogText.cn: 于是整天找他问诀窍，缠得连洛茜小妹都嫌我烦了哈哈！不过嘛，最后还是被我学会了几手。
dialogText.en: So I begged him to teach me the ropes. Even his sister Rossi got fed up with my pestering! But I kept at it and snagged a handful of his slick moves myself.

dialogText.cn: 哎，他啊……是个怪人……明明在狼群长大，却只在念书上有天赋，被人欺负了从来都是我和卡特洛帮他出头……
dialogText.en: Well, Tommy... He's a weird one... Grew up in the Pack but he got really good with books and reading. Whenever he got roughed up, it was always Catello and me who stood up for him.

dialogText.cn: 结果都这样了还从不记仇……呵呵，连害他考不了试的家伙都能原谅……真的是没救了……
dialogText.en: Yet he forgave every last one ... including those who botched his shot at the exam. Can you believe that? What a hopeless case...

dialogText.cn: 你说，他这么个人……怎么会和碾骨的人混到一起呢？该不是被胁迫了吧？
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Why would a person like Tommy ... end up with the Bonekrushers? Y'think they strong-armed him?

dialogText.cn: 不就是一群空有蛮力的疯子嘛！
dialogText.en: A bunch of lunatics with zero brains but plenty of muscle!

dialogText.cn: 我们狼群现在也是沦落到要和这些家伙打来打去了……
dialogText.en: Even the Pack, where I'm from, can't dodge throwing down with these crazies...

dialogText.cn: 哼，要是换到几十年前……不提这些了，反正现在是惹不起咯。
dialogText.en: Hmph. If they were dealing with the Pack from decades ago... Welp, let's change the topic. Not like we can afford to poke the beasts right now, huh?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，刚才你配合得很好……看来我们的默契还不错。
dialogText.en: That was well played, Endmin... Our teamwork was pretty good.

dialogText.cn: 还不能断言。
dialogText.en: It's still too soon to tell.

dialogText.cn: 托马索的死早就在氏族里传遍了，而他对此一无所知……要么是装的，要么就是太久没回去了。
dialogText.en: Everyone in the Pack knows Tommaso's dead, but Giovanni claims to know nothing... He's either pretending or just hasn't been back for a while.

dialogText.cn: 无论是哪种，都意味着他与叛徒的关联不会弱。况且叛徒……未必只有一个。
dialogText.en: No matter what, his ties to the real traitor should be strong. Talking about traitors ... we might have more than one of them.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，乔万尼很适合作为这个突破口，他向来不太擅长掩饰自己，从过去就是。
dialogText.en: Yes, and Giovanni is our perfect lead into the place. He's not very good at disguising himself, not even back then.

dialogText.cn: 所以，管理员，之后还请继续配合我……演完这出戏，如何？
dialogText.en: So, Endmin, please help me carry this show to its conclusion. Will you?

dialogText.cn: ……谢了。
dialogText.en: ...Grazie.

dialogText.cn: 托马索吗……我们认识很多年了。
dialogText.en: Tommaso...? We've known each other for years.

dialogText.cn: 相比我和乔万尼，他在狼群里确实更像个异类，总是乐观过头，也总是充满善意……但事情往往难以如他所愿。
dialogText.en: When compared to Giovanni and myself, Tommaso was really the odd one in the Pack. He was too optimistic ... and too kind... But things often ended up in ways he didn't like.

dialogText.cn: 我和乔万尼都帮他处理过一些琐事，但他帮我们的次数其实更多。
dialogText.en: Giovanni and I did take care of some business for him, but we actually owe him way bigger favors.

dialogText.cn: 我希望不是。
dialogText.en: I hope not.

dialogText.cn: 但……这么多年过去，没人能一成不变。
dialogText.en: But ... many years have already passed. Time changes everyone it touches.

dialogText.cn: 现在就可以，管理员，准备好了吗？
dialogText.en: We can go now. Endmin, are you ready?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，感觉怎么样？
dialogText.en: How did that feel, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 您进入之后不久，仪器捕捉到了新的能量变化，一些基础读数也出现了变动。
dialogText.en: Our instruments picked up new energy changes shortly after you dove in. Some basic readings shifted as well.

dialogText.cn: 我推测这是谷地像差在“适应”您的存在。有趣，又一种从没出现过的现象。
dialogText.en: I believe the Valley's Aberrants is "adapting" to your presence. Very interesting. This is a phenomenon that I've never seen before.

dialogText.cn: 您帮忙收集的物质样本也许能改变现状。我打算对比它们和现实物质的区别，分析特征。
dialogText.en: The material samples you collected might turn that around. I plan to compare them against their real world counterparts and analyze their unique properties.

dialogText.cn: 然后，这台仪器就可以在更危险的深度维持通信，这能变相延长探索时间。
dialogText.en: Next, this particular device can maintain a comm channel in more dangerous Depths. It'll extend your exploration dive.

dialogText.cn: 当然，这台仪器可是协议空间研究领域的尖端成果。工程中心花了不少力气才把它从地面搬上来。
dialogText.en: Of course. This is the work of the best minds in Protocol Space research. The Engineering Division spared no expense to move it from planetside.

dialogText.cn: 目前收集的样本足够进行一次解析了，现在就来升级最基础的辅助探测技术吧。
dialogText.en: The collected samples should be enough for a deciphering run. Now let's try upgrading the most basic exploration support tech.

dialogText.cn: 行动刻度量化完成……如您所见，还有不少工作要做。
dialogText.en: Operation metrics quantified... As you can see, there's a huge amount of work ahead of us.

dialogText.cn: 扫描您在里面见到过的“重点目标”，我需要一次持续、稳定的扫描。
dialogText.en: Scan the "key target" that you've already seen in the place. I need an extended and stable scan.

dialogText.cn: 当然，前提是您能设法靠近它。
dialogText.en: Of course, this is assuming that you can get close enough to it.

dialogText.cn: 先前实践过的办法应该还能奏效……不论如何，总得试试看。
dialogText.en: The thing we did in the previous attempt might work... No matter what, we should give that a try.

dialogText.cn: 出发吧，找到更多能量反应，用它们当“钥匙”来解除阻碍，靠近我们的“重点目标”。
dialogText.en: Let's go. Find more energy reaction sites, use them as "keys" to take down the obstacles, and get close enough to our "key target".

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您得来看看这个。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you should come and look at this.

dialogText.cn: 这……从来没发生过这种现象。请您来协助探索果然是正确的选择。
dialogText.en: Well ... this has never happened before. Securing your assistance in our exploration efforts proves to be the correct choice.

dialogText.cn: 好在仪器没有受到太大影响。初步判断，它依然还具有连通空间的特性。一些信息还匹配得上。
dialogText.en: Thankfully the device isn't too affected. After a cursory analysis, we believe it still has the ability to maintain an interspatial comm channel. Some of the data still match.

dialogText.cn: 不如说，可识别的信息甚至还变得更稳定了一些……我马上调整参数，维持对这个入口的侦测。
dialogText.en: I can even say that certain pieces of identifiable data have become more stable... I'll adjust the parameters and continue to record readings from this portal.

dialogText.cn: 它甚至对能量输入有回应，难道……啊，抱歉。
dialogText.en: It's even responding to energy inputs... Does that mean... Ah! Apologies.

dialogText.cn: 是的，请试试在我们已知的区域附近多转一转。虽然只是我的猜测，但也许那里会发生一些变化。
dialogText.en: Yes, of course. And please look around the known zones more carefully. I speculate that they have underwent a few changes.

dialogText.cn: 这样应该就完成了……比想象中顺利一些。
dialogText.en: We should be done... It went smoother than I expected.

dialogText.cn: 得进入谷地像差才能看到，我只是利用了这个入口先前发现的一些小特性。
dialogText.en: It should be visible after you enter the Valley's Aberrants. I only utilized a few minor properties previously discovered about this portal.

dialogText.cn: 您会在里面发现所需的爆炸物，就像协议空间中出现的其他物质一样，它被“生成”了。
dialogText.en: You'll find the explosives you need in the place. They will be "generated", just like how the Protocol Space generates other types of matter.

dialogText.cn: 前提是我们还能获得更多有价值的物质样本。说实话，我也只是刚摸到一点规律……
dialogText.en: Well, this is assuming we can still recover more of those valuable material samples. Truth be told, the patterns I discovered are still very rudimentary...

dialogText.cn: 总之，掌握的数据越多，能做的事就越多。我们继续吧。
dialogText.en: And in any case, the more data we have, the more we can achieve. Let's continue.

dialogText.cn: 最新区域的探索也完成了，还好侵蚀似乎没有对侦测造成太多影响。
dialogText.en: We've done exploring the newest zone. Thankfully the Blight has hardly messed with our monitoring sensors.

dialogText.cn: 不过，检查影像之后，有一点让我很在意……
dialogText.en: But after checking the video feeds and images, there's something that I'm really concerned about...

dialogText.cn: 请回想一下，您在里面见到的东西，不管存在合理与否，是不是全都在四号谷地见过？
dialogText.en: Try remembering everything you encountered in the Aberrants. It doesn't matter if they make sense or not. You actually saw all of them in Valley IV, right?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我有预感，接下来还会有更多有价值的发现。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I have a feeling that we'll discover something even more valuable.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……也就是说，里面确实只出现了您最近认知的事物，没想到这个临时代号意外地准确。
dialogText.en: Hmm... That means the Valley's Aberrants only contained things from your recent experiences. Our temporary name for it just happens to be exceedingly accurate.

dialogText.cn: 很不寻常。协议空间的构成有一定随机性，而谷地像差里却无比“秩序”。
dialogText.en: Very unusual. The structure of the Protocol Space should be random, yet the insides of the Valley's Aberrants seem extraordinarily "ordered".

dialogText.cn: 好比一头云兽在钢琴上恰好踩出一首曲子，正常本身就是最大的异常。
dialogText.en: It's like a cloudbeast stomping around on piano keys and somehow composing a proper melody. That itself is extremely strange.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，准备好开始探索了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, ready to start exploring?

dialogText.cn: 到底是什么在影响这里……
dialogText.en: So why did it affect this place...?

dialogText.cn: 已经识别出部分数据特征……很好，我这就调整仪器的参数。
dialogText.en: Several data properties have been identified... Excellent. I'll start adjusting device parameters.

dialogText.cn: 既然初期尝试还算顺利，我们可以聊聊接下来的整体规划了。
dialogText.en: Since our first dive proved to be quite successful, we can talk about our overall plan.

dialogText.cn: 那些沉积结核具有很高的研究价值，它们能给解析协议空间提供大量参数样本。
dialogText.en: The precipitation nodules are extremely valuable for research. They offer plenty of parametric samples for deciphering Protocol Spaces.

dialogText.cn: 除了沉积结核，我还设立了更多的探索目标，已经按照委托的形式整理完毕。
dialogText.en: I've also established other exploration objectives besides the precipitation nodules. All of them have been organized into various commissions.

dialogText.cn: 收集沉积结核，或者完成委托，都可以为研究作出贡献。当然，这是有偿的。
dialogText.en: Collecting precipitation nodules and completing the commissions will all contribute towards our research. Of course, you'll be compensated for your efforts.

dialogText.cn: 合理的资源置换而已，您会替这个项目节约许多预算的。
dialogText.en: It's a very reasonable exchange of resources. After all, your involvement will save this project a lot of money.

dialogText.cn: 总之，先把我们这次探索的成果记录进去吧。
dialogText.en: In any case, let's tally the results of this exploration dive.

dialogText.cn: 检测读数无异常，能量活动模式A。好，接下来试试……
dialogText.en: No anomalous readings. Energy activity fits model A. Good, now it's time to test the...

dialogText.cn: 稍等，我先记完这些数据……
dialogText.en: Hold on. Let me jot down these numbers first...

dialogText.cn: 稍等，我先记完这些数据……是的，我前不久刚向技术总务委员汇报过。
dialogText.en: Hold on. Let me jot down these numbers first... And yes, I just reported to the General Technological Committee.

dialogText.cn: 阿奎多，高等源石物理研究专家，如您所见，正在进行研究工作。
dialogText.en: Aquito. Senior Originium Physicist. As you can see, I'm conducting research work right now.

dialogText.cn: 最近几天，帝江号的主体协议源石出现了规划外的活性化现象。随后，一位干员就发现了这个入口。
dialogText.en: The main Protocol-Originium structure of Dijiang recently exhibited an unexpected jolt of activation. Shortly afterwards, one of our operators found this portal.

dialogText.cn: 它的各项数据都十分……奇特。截至目前，我们已经发现了至少三十多种前所未见的信号规律。
dialogText.en: The readings we're getting from it are extremely ... interesting. As of now, we have discovered at least thirty signal patterns never recorded before.

dialogText.cn: 这正是我邀请您来的主要原因——我们需要探索者，没有人比您更合适。
dialogText.en: And this is exactly why I invited you here. We need an explorer to investigate this, and none is more suitable than you.

dialogText.cn: 无人探测装置有去无回，毕竟是协议空间，干扰非常严重。
dialogText.en: None of our scouting drones made it back. Interference is just too strong. It's a Protocol Space, after all.

dialogText.cn: 基于同样的原因，技术总务委员会判断它极可能会成为帝江号的安全威胁。
dialogText.en: And due to this very reason, the General Technological Committee has determined that it is very likely to pose a safety hazard to Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 考虑到您与协议源石之间的……密切联系，也许这反而是最安全的办法。
dialogText.en: Now, given your ... intimate connection to Protocol-Originium, your involvement might be the safest option available to us.

dialogText.cn: 感谢理解。请放心，我会在外面随时监视谷地像差的状态。
dialogText.en: Thank you for your understanding. Don't worry. I'll be right here monitoring the status of the Valley's Aberrants.

dialogText.cn: 必要时，我可以执行紧急引导程序帮助您脱离。我们这就试一试？
dialogText.en: If things get too hot, I'll execute an emergency bootloader and extract you from the Protocol Space. So, why don't we get started right now?

dialogText.cn: 基于目前的观测成果，我们暂时将这个协议空间命名为“谷地像差”——许多景象在现实中似曾相识，但又截然不同。
dialogText.en: Given our current observations, we have given this Protocol Space a temporary name: "Valley's Aberrants". Many of the things within it might look similar to those in the real world, but they are wholly different as well.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有什么事吗？
dialogText.en: You need anything, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您来看看！又是一组有趣的新数据！
dialogText.en: Endmin, come take a look at this! We got a new set of interesting data!

dialogText.cn: 哦，对。您没事吧？
dialogText.en: Oh, that's true. Endmin, are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 刚才扫描的时候，这里甚至观测到了一次入口的消失，但它随即又恢复成了原状。
dialogText.en: The scan we made even detected a temporary disappearance of the portal, but it quickly reverted to its original form.

dialogText.cn: 能被仪器稳定识别的信息量也增加了……管理员，我有一些想法。
dialogText.en: The device can now reliably identify more types of data... Endmin, I think I got some ideas.

dialogText.cn: 谷地像差当中应该还有更多类似“重点目标”的存在，它们就像周边空间信息的“索引”。
dialogText.en: There might be other entities similar to the "key target" in the Valley's Aberrants. They probably serve as the "index" for the zones around them.

dialogText.cn: 我会利用收集的物质样本，试着影响这个入口，改变空间的状态，为您提供需要的支援。
dialogText.en: I'll use the material samples we gathered and try to influence this portal, transform the Protocol Space, and provide you with necessary support.

dialogText.cn: 关于这点，这台仪器安装了一些实验性的能量干涉手段，我认为，也许可以利用它来进行一些“改造”。
dialogText.en: I got something for that. This device has been furnished with some experimental energy interference measures. I believe we can use it to "restructure" the place.

dialogText.cn: 了解……应该没问题，我们这就开始升级相应的辅助探测技术。
dialogText.en: Understood... We should be able to take care of that. Let's start upgrading a few specific exploration support tech.

dialogText.cn: 暂时就叫它们“像差核心”吧。只要解析了它们，我就能用仪器拓展您的可探索区域。
dialogText.en: Let's call them the "Aberrant Cores". Once we decipher them, my device should help expand the zones you can explore.

dialogText.cn: 谷地像差的入口面积刚才扩大了百分之零点三，干得不错。
dialogText.en: The size of the Valley's Aberrants portal has just increased by 0.3%. Well done.

dialogText.cn: 并不是说里面没有被超域干涉过，但如此剧烈的波动之后数据全无变化，这本身就很奇怪。
dialogText.en: I'm not saying the place has been affected by the Æther, but it seems odd when the readings could return to the same initial ranges after such extreme fluctuations.

dialogText.cn: 也许所谓的“污染”只是某种状态转化，也许我们从没真正接近它，每次都只是进入了它的某个副本……
dialogText.en: Perhaps the "contamination" is just a change of state. Perhaps we never truly approached it, and only entered a specific instance of it...

dialogText.cn: 实在太神奇了，它既稳定又活跃，既危险又安全。
dialogText.en: This is simply amazing. An entity that is stable yet active, dangerous yet secure.

dialogText.cn: 我会给您提供更多研发委托，协助辅助探测技术进一步升级。让我们加快探索的节奏吧。
dialogText.en: I'll be giving you additional research commissions to help upgrade our exploration support tech. Time to hasten our exploration efforts.

dialogText.cn: 我对比了数据。即使紊乱值到达危险范围，您离开之后，环境参数也会迅速恢复到初始状态。
dialogText.en: I compared the data. Even when Derangement reached dangerous levels, ambient readings quickly dropped back to the initial baseline after you left.

dialogText.cn: 如果充分利用这些特性，我们绝对大有可为。
dialogText.en: We can definitely achieve something substantial if we could leverage these properties.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？！管理员？你还好吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin?! Endmin! Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 我刚刚经过这里，正巧看到你冒着烟砸到了阿奎多身上……你的抑制器似乎短暂过载了。
dialogText.en: I was just walking by when I saw you giving off a lot of smoke and collapsing on Aquito... Your suppressor seems to have experienced a temporary overload.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，刚才深度波动的频率比前几次加起来还高，我必须用最大功率尽快把您撤离出来。
dialogText.en: Apologies. The Depth levels gave off fluctuation frequencies even higher than the sum of all our previous attempts. I had to extract you with max power.

dialogText.cn: 但里面似乎没出现什么特别状况，为什么这一次的反应会这么大……
dialogText.en: But nothing out of the ordinary took place inside. Why did it react so strongly in this dive...?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督。紧急状况。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, Supervisor Perlica, there is an emergency.

dialogText.cn: 工程中心在动力舱段检测到了一次异常能量波动，帝江号舰体可能发生了一次整体的微幅震颤。
dialogText.en: The Engineering Division has detected an abnormal energy fluctuation in the engine room sections. The entire hull of Dijiang may have experienced a slight tremor.

dialogText.cn: ……明白了。请到总控中枢来，我们一起排查这个问题。
dialogText.en: ...Understood. Please head to the Control Nexus. We'll troubleshoot this together.

dialogText.cn: 赛希，情况怎么样了？
dialogText.en: What's the situation, Xaihi?

dialogText.cn: 态势已经平息，但我们还没有找到震颤的原因。
dialogText.en: Calm has returned, but we have yet to identify the cause of the tremor.

dialogText.cn: 全舰系统自检均汇报正常。能量波动发生前，动力舱段的日志没有出现任何不良记录。
dialogText.en: Self-diagnostic results of every vessel system are normal. Dataloggers of the engine room sections registered zero non-conforming readings prior to the occurrence of the energy fluctuation.

dialogText.cn: 如果内部设施没有发生状况，难道问题出在别处……
dialogText.en: If none of our internal machineries were at fault, does that mean the problem lies elsewhere...?

dialogText.cn: 能量波动发生前十五分钟，帝江号开始按月度计划进行塔卫二的全境观测扫描。
dialogText.en: Fifteen minutes before the energy fluctuation, Dijiang was starting a total Talos-II environment scan of our monthly plan.

dialogText.cn: 为了协助遥感阵列完成指向，飞船按预定参数调整了姿态，将船体长轴对准扫描路径，直到事件发生。
dialogText.en: To help direct our telemetric arrays, the vessel adjusted its orientation so that its length is aligned with the scanning path. This process continued till the occurrence of the incident being discussed.

dialogText.cn: 当时我们扫描的位置是哪里？
dialogText.en: And what was the location we were scanning when the incident took place?

dialogText.cn: 正在回溯……12时3分56秒，扫描目标：北极极光圈。
dialogText.en: Regression analysis under way... Incident took place at 1203 hours 56 seconds. The target of the scanners was ... the north polar Aurora Circle.

dialogText.cn: 极光圈所在的地区是文明环带以北的危险区域，是铁誓军驻守的最前线。
dialogText.en: The Aurora Circle is located in the most dangerous areas north of the Civilization Band. It is also the very frontlines garrisoned by the Order of Steel Oath.

dialogText.cn: 在极光圈之内，超域压倒现实。对我们来说，那就是禁区。
dialogText.en: The Ætherside dominates the realspace within the Aurora Circle. The entire region is extremely hostile to us.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请把这个消息告诉阿奎多吧。我和赛希会继续监视舰体情况，确保没有后续风险。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we should inform Aquito of this. Xaihi and I will continue to monitor the vessel and ensure there are no further risks.

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样，这就说得通了……
dialogText.en: Really? That really helped to explain things...

dialogText.cn: 帝江号的核心是一整块巨大的协议源石。舰体指向极光圈时，飞船质心也向那里稍微接近了一些。
dialogText.en: The core of Dijiang is a single, massive formation of Protocol-Originium. When the vessel aligned itself at the Aurora Circle, its center of mass also got closer to that location.

dialogText.cn: 也许就是这一点偏移对谷地像差造成了影响，从而导致空间内部迅速崩溃。
dialogText.en: This slight shift might explain the interference of the Valley's Aberrants and caused the Protocol Space to rapidly collapse from within.

dialogText.cn: 扫描计划是规律的，可以主动规避。不过，谷地像差极易受影响也是事实。
dialogText.en: The planet scanning plan runs on a schedule and we can simply avoid those scanning days. However, there's no denying that the Valley's Aberrants is extremely vulnerable to external interference.

dialogText.cn: 真讽刺。平时我们都在苦恼怎么处理位置危险的协议空间，现在反而在想尽办法保住它。
dialogText.en: How ironic. We spent all our time figuring out how to handle this dangerous Protocol Space ... only to end up brainstorming for solutions to keep it safe.

dialogText.cn: 根据先前的扫描数据，我推断谷地像差应该还有一个像差核心。
dialogText.en: I referenced data from our previous scans. There should be one more Aberrant Core in the Valley's Aberrants.

dialogText.cn: 下次探索前，我会准备好应对方案。请帮忙取回那里的数据，我需要一次更彻底的全面扫描。
dialogText.en: I will have a proper solution ready for our next exploration dive. Please help retrieve the data. I need a total scan that is more thorough and comprehensive.

dialogText.cn: 不保证一定能起作用，但如果成功应验……我们可能真的发现了一座宝库。
dialogText.en: I cannot guarantee that the solution would work, but if it did ... it would mean we have struck the jackpot and found the treasure vault.

dialogText.cn: ……不，暂时还只是一些没依据的想象。
dialogText.en: ...Ah, just a temporary metaphor for describing my baseless imaginations.

dialogText.cn: 总之，等您准备完毕，我们就开始这最重要的一次探索吧。
dialogText.en: In any case, we'll get started once you're ready. This will be the most important exploration attempt of all.

dialogText.cn: 我会的。如果假设被验证，我甚至希望能用经费申请一支香槟。
dialogText.en: I will. And if my hypothesis gets validated, I hope I could use the budget and apply for a bottle of champagne.

dialogText.cn: 现在，等您准备完毕，我们就开始这最重要的一次探索吧。
dialogText.en: Now, we can get started once you're ready. This will be the most important exploration attempt of all.

dialogText.cn: 检测到同类型波动变化，匹配度97%……成功了！我果然是这个领域的天才！
dialogText.en: The same fluctuation curve has been detected, and with a 97% match... Success! I am truly a genius in this field of science!

dialogText.cn: 通过刚才的扫描，我们终于得到了能建立谷地像差模型的必要数据。
dialogText.en: The scan we just did gave us the essential data we need to construct the Valley's Aberrants algorithmic model.

dialogText.cn: 根据模拟结果，我试着让仪器输入了一段完全虚构的能量脉冲。结果，谷地像差真的出现了预期内的反应。
dialogText.en: I referenced the simulation results, then made the device provide a data feed of a completely artificial energy pulse. The Valley's Aberrants actually responded in kind and within my expectations.

dialogText.cn: 这条路线行得通！只要继续完善模型，我们有机会通过这个入口来“操纵”整个谷地像差！
dialogText.en: We're definitely on the right way! All we need is to keep perfecting the model! We'll eventually find a way to use this portal and "manipulate" the entirety of the Valley's Aberrants!

dialogText.cn: 那只是最小的目标。结构、能量、物理性质……各种法则都可以通过影响协议空间的入口来改变。
dialogText.en: That's the least minimum we can do. Various laws and models can now be used to influence the Protocol Space portal ... and change the structure, energy, and physical nature of the Aberrants.

dialogText.cn: 这个空间有机会成为绝佳的实验场所——安全、自由、无懈可击，一个只属于终末地的“小世界”！
dialogText.en: Every Protocol Space now has the potential to become the perfect experimental site — a "pocket realm" that is safe, unrestricted, impeccable, and wholly owned by Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，目前的建模只是个粗浅的框架。您随时可以继续探索，积累实地数据。
dialogText.en: Endmin, our spatial construction model is just a very rudimentary framework right now. You can keep exploring the place to acquire more field data.

dialogText.cn: 研究之路才刚刚开始，让我们一起揭开协议空间的所有秘密吧！
dialogText.en: This is just the beginning of our research. Let us work together and unveil all the secrets of the Protocol Space!

dialogText.cn: 扫描数据正在回传……我们成功了？
dialogText.en: I'm receiving the scanning data... Did we just succeed?

dialogText.cn: 数据重合度确实在变高，看来应该没错……稍等，这就开始执行既定程序。
dialogText.en: Data overlapping is indeed increasing. You might be right... Hold on and let me initiate the usual executables.

dialogText.cn: 区域一，对比验证完成……
dialogText.en: Zone 1 comparative verification complete...

dialogText.cn: 阶段性完成，管理员。数据处理还没结束，但我有预感，我们正在迈出一大步。
dialogText.en: For this particular phase, Endmin. Data processing isn't complete yet. But I've a feeling we just took a major leap forwards with this endeavor.

dialogText.cn: 请尽快返回吧，我们现实里再见。
dialogText.en: Head back ASAP, Endmin. See you in realspace.

dialogText.cn: 区域二，对比验证完成……
dialogText.en: Zone 2 comparative verification complete...

dialogText.cn: 区域三、四、五，特征记录中……很好，符合预期。
dialogText.en: Properties of Zones 3, 4, and 5 are being recorded... Good. Things are in line with my expectations.

dialogText.cn: 已经确认到未知阻碍消失，我的猜想果然没错。
dialogText.en: Disappearance of the unknown obstacle confirmed. My hypothesis is indeed correct.

dialogText.cn: 正在扫描新环境……很好，在远处检测到了同样的信号特征。
dialogText.en: Scanning the new environment... Great. I've picked up a reading with similar signal properties some distance away.

dialogText.cn: 重复一次先前的流程吧，应该能收集到更多有用的资料。
dialogText.en: Let's repeat the steps we used before. Try to gather as much useful data as we can.

dialogText.cn: 这个区域……许多环境参数和先前检测到的不太一样。
dialogText.en: This zone... Its ambient readings are quite different from those we detected before.

dialogText.cn: 小心点，里面可能会出现新类型的敌人。
dialogText.en: Careful. You might run into new types of enemies in this place.

dialogText.cn: 我还侦测到了一些结构坚固的障碍，应该能利用爆炸物解决。
dialogText.en: I also detected the presence of strong barriers. Explosives should take care of them.

dialogText.cn: 太过凑巧了，也许这里面存在一定联系……总之，开始探索吧。
dialogText.en: I don't think this is a coincidence. There must be some sort of link between them... Anyway, we should start exploring.

dialogText.cn: 已到达新区域。空间结构变得更复杂了，这样的规模真是罕见。
dialogText.en: We've reached a new zone. The spatial layout is a lot more complicated. Protocol Spaces of such scale are rare indeed.

dialogText.cn: 像差核心的信号离这里很远，路上的阻碍不少。
dialogText.en: The signal of the Aberrant Core is pretty far off. We'll run into plenty of obstacles.

dialogText.cn: 和往常一样，没必要一口气完成探索。规划好节奏，稳步推进吧。
dialogText.en: Like before, there's no need to completely explore everything in a single attempt. Plan your moves and progress accordingly.

dialogText.cn: 已到达新区域。嗯……这里的路似乎没那么好走。
dialogText.en: We've arrived at a new zone. Hmm... Moving around this place might be a challenge.

dialogText.cn: 没错。问题在于如何抵达那边……
dialogText.en: That's right. The question is, how do we get there...?

dialogText.cn: 先进入最近的设施开始探索吧。利用建筑和连通结构，应该能找到合适的路径。
dialogText.en: Let's start exploring the nearby facilities. Try using the buildings and connecting the structures. Perhaps we'll come up with a proper path.

dialogText.cn: 已到达新区域……暂时检测不到更多连通的空间。
dialogText.en: We've reached a new zone... No other connected zones have been detected.

dialogText.cn: 如果计算没有错误，这里就是谷地像差的“最深处”。
dialogText.en: If my calculations are correct, this should be the deepest part of the Valley's Aberrants.

dialogText.cn: 全靠你了，管理员。协议空间始终蒙着一层神秘的面纱，现在，我们也许已经站在了揭开它的边缘。
dialogText.en: I'm counting on you, Endmin. Protocol Spaces have always been veiled in mystery. We might have reached the very threshold to reveal their underlying truth.

dialogText.cn: 让我们完成最后的工作吧。
dialogText.en: Time to finish our final task.

dialogText.cn: 通信频道已建立。管理员，我需要一些目视信息。
dialogText.en: Comm channel established. Endmin, I need some visual data.

dialogText.cn: 不过，还是得注意紊乱值的变化情况，我也会随时准备紧急撤离程序。
dialogText.en: Nevertheless, we should keep an eye on changes to Derangement levels. I also have the emergency evac program ready at all times.

dialogText.cn: 也许是我们在里面的行动造成了一些影响……还算符合预期。
dialogText.en: Perhaps our activities in the place have exerted some influence... That is also within our expectations.

dialogText.cn: 接下来的任务就是解除先前遇到的阻碍，靠近“重点目标”。
dialogText.en: Your next objective is to eliminate the previous encountered obstacle and approach the "key target".

dialogText.cn: 如果扫描信息没错，附近应该会有和上次一样的能量反应，要把它们都找出来。
dialogText.en: If the scanning data is correct, we should find an energy reaction site nearby, similar to the one we found before. Gotta find them all.

dialogText.cn: 辅助探测技术应该已经起作用了，我们可以在里面停留更长的时间。
dialogText.en: The exploration support tech should be working right now. We should be able to stay inside for a while longer.

dialogText.cn: 情况就是这样，不浪费时间了，开始正式探索吧。
dialogText.en: That's it for the sitrep. Let's not waste time and begin our formal exploration efforts.

dialogText.cn: 总算有机会扫描它了……稍等，正在处理数据。
dialogText.en: We finally earned a chance to scan it... Hold on. I'm organizing our data right now.

dialogText.cn: 是吗……这倒是能解释一些东西。毕竟，您当初就是最了解协议空间秘密的人。
dialogText.en: Really...? That might explain a few things. After all, you were the one who knew most about the secrets of the Protocol Space.

dialogText.cn: 不，没事，我很安全，但……
dialogText.en: No, it's nothing. I'm safe, but...

dialogText.cn: 数据已接收，可以——等等，怎么回事？！
dialogText.en: Data received. We can — WAIT! What's going on?!

dialogText.cn: 外面出现了奇怪的现象。管理员，尽快返回吧，您应该需要看看这边的情况。
dialogText.en: Something weird just happened outside. Come back quickly, Endmin. You must take a look at this.

dialogText.cn: 信号已回传，环境状态稳定……很好，看来仪器参数的调整没有造成意外。
dialogText.en: Picked up the return signal. Ambient status looks stable... Good. Adjusting device parameters did not trigger any unexpected changes.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？您发现什么了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin? Did you find something?

dialogText.cn: 是吗？基础扫描数据上看不出什么迹象。
dialogText.en: Oh? I can't really tell from the data acquired from the basic scans.

dialogText.cn: 明白，我们开始吧。
dialogText.en: Understood. Let's get started.

dialogText.cn: 管理……信号，……险！
dialogText.en: Endmin ... signal ... gerous!

dialogText.cn: 通信状况良好，装置读数……承受范围内。
dialogText.en: Comm signals are stable. Device readings are ... within tolerance limits.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 震动？数据暂时还是正常的，但您的感知向来很有价值。
dialogText.en: Tremor? Data readings look normal so far, but your senses have always been valuable to us.

dialogText.cn: 应该加快动作了。您觉得最后的像差核心会在哪里？
dialogText.en: We should get moving. Where do you think the last Aberrant Core will be?

dialogText.cn: 明白。我要准备一次特别的扫描，路上的威胁就交给您了。
dialogText.en: Understood. I'll get a special scan prepped. Please handle the obstacles along the way, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 通信传输正常，影像接收正常。管理员，感觉怎么样？
dialogText.en: Signal transmission nominal. Video feed reception looks good. Endmin, how are you feeling?

dialogText.cn: 谷地像差的实体部分会呈现出各种样貌，也许刚好是些您熟悉的东西。
dialogText.en: The manifestations of the Valley's Aberrants can be anything, actually. They might be things that you're familiar with.

dialogText.cn: 请记住，不管它们变成什么形态，都只是一种似是而非的内容物。
dialogText.en: Remember, it doesn't matter what they turn into. The contents of this Protocol Space can be rather deceptive.

dialogText.cn: 有些信号干扰……深度开始变得不稳定了。和无人探测装置进入时一样，超域在影响这里。
dialogText.en: We have some signal interference... Depth readings are getting unstable. This also happened when we were using the exploration drones. The Æther is affecting the area.

dialogText.cn: 附近应该有一些结核物质，是很容易识别的大块晶体。
dialogText.en: There should be nodular matter nearby. It will look like big, conspicuous, rocky crystals.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请设法采集一些回来，它们对我的分析工作很有帮助。
dialogText.en: Endmin, try to gather some and bring it back to me. It'll be really helpful for my analysis.

dialogText.cn: 看那里，前面就是我们先前调查中发现的“重点目标”。
dialogText.en: Look. The "key target" we found in our last exploration attempt is up ahead.

dialogText.cn: 那附近的能量流动十分异常，我认为是个绝佳的观测样本。
dialogText.en: Local energy flow doesn't look very normal. This, I believe, will be an excellent observation sample.

dialogText.cn: 但无人探测装置在附近遇到了阻碍，没法靠近进行扫描分析。
dialogText.en: But there's also an obstacle nearby interfering with our observation drone. We can't get close enough to make an analytical scan.

dialogText.cn: 周边环境里有些信号特征相似的能量反应，这也许是个突破口。
dialogText.en: There are energy reactions nearby that exhibit similar signal patterns. They look like a potential lead.

dialogText.cn: 但我不知道它的载体会是什么，可能是静物，也可能是活动个体……
dialogText.en: But I don't know what they would be manifested. They could be anything, from inanimate objects ... to active entities...

dialogText.cn: 我来指示方向，把那附近可疑的东西都调查一遍吧。
dialogText.en: I'll plot out the route for you. Help me investigate the suspicious objects nearby.

dialogText.cn: 能量反应消失了……
dialogText.en: The energy reaction has disappeared...

dialogText.cn: 这……好吧，在协议空间领域，您的直觉一向很准确。
dialogText.en: Wha... Fine. When it comes to Protocol Spaces, your intuitions have proven to be very accurate.

dialogText.cn: 那面“墙”的阻碍减弱了，应该行得通。不过，看起来只触碰一次还不够。
dialogText.en: The "wall" is weaker now, so that probably worked. But I don't think touching it once is enough.

dialogText.cn: 不确定，但紊乱值已经逼近极限了，现在的第一要务是离开谷地像差。
dialogText.en: I'm not sure, but we're getting really close to our Derangement limit. Our top priority is to get you out of the Valley's Aberrants.

dialogText.cn: 请回来吧，管理员。我们需要重新规划一下探索计划。
dialogText.en: Head back, Endmin. We'll need to reorganize our exploration plan.

dialogText.cn: 你记不起这些名字，但悲伤令你胸口微痛。你努力去回想，只能得到一些零星的画面。
dialogText.en: You cannot remember these names but they trigger a sense of sorrow that brings slight pain to your chest. You try to think back but only recall fragmented images.

dialogText.cn: 那是一艘摇摇欲坠的船舶，正远离火光连天的大地，航行于沉默。
dialogText.en: You see a crumbling ark, silently steering away from the ravaged land.

dialogText.cn: 薄纱般的思念笼罩着你，某一个声音唤起了名讳……
dialogText.en: A gossamer of nostalgia envelops you. A voice stirs a list of names...

dialogText.cn: 凯尔希、特蕾西娅、特雷西斯……
dialogText.en: Kal'tsit, Theresa, Theresis...

dialogText.cn: Scout、Ace、Outcast、Whitesmith……
dialogText.en: Scout, Ace, Outcast, Whitesmith...

dialogText.cn: 博卓卡斯替、叶莲娜、克丽斯腾·莱特、雷尔金……
dialogText.en: Buldrokkas'tee, Yelena, Kristen Wright, Rankin...

dialogText.cn: 绵延的声音仍想要继续，却突然像雪花融化般消失不见。
dialogText.en: The voice intends to continue, but it suddenly disappears like melting snow.

dialogText.cn: 唯有你脚下的道路十分厚实，呼吸冰冷。
dialogText.en: Only that every step you take is still planted upon solid ground, and every breath an inhalation of frigid air.

dialogText.cn: 不同语言的文字在墓碑表面重叠在一起。你试图辨认，却发现文字在流动，在碰撞，在厮杀，令你头昏脑涨。
dialogText.en: Words of different languages overlap upon this tombstone. You try to make out the letters but you realize that they are flowing, colliding, and fighting each other. Your head hurts from this attempt.

dialogText.cn: 这是无数的历史，也是同一段故事。但现在它们都被埋葬于此。你得前进了。
dialogText.en: This is the history of countless individuals and it recites the same tale. Everyone now rests in this place. You must press forward.

dialogText.cn: 这块墓碑从正中间裂开了，碑文模糊不清。你注视着裂缝间跳动的阴影。
dialogText.en: This tombstone has been split through the middle. Its words are barely legible. You notice a shadow dancing in the cracks.

dialogText.cn: 它或许本属于你，你突然想到，属于你的命运。
dialogText.en: It could've been yours all along — you suddenly recall — a fate meant just for you.

dialogText.cn: 没事的……我们在安全的地方。
dialogText.en: It's alright... We're at a safe place.

dialogText.cn: 这里是……？
dialogText.en: {F}Where am I...?{M}Where am I...?

dialogText.cn: 这里是<@qu.key>O.M.V.帝江号</>，终末地工业的基地——也是我们的“家”。
dialogText.en: This is the <@qu.key>OMV Dijiang</>, the base of Endfield Industries — and our home.

dialogText.cn: 帝江号，终末地工业……
dialogText.en: {F}Dijiang...? Endfield Industries...?{M}Dijiang...? Endfield Industries...?

dialogText.cn: 请深呼吸，慢慢来。
dialogText.en: Take a deep breath. We can work through this at your pace.

dialogText.cn: 这个抑制器可以帮你稳定体征，你已经沉睡了十年，身体状况很不稳定。
dialogText.en: This mask is a suppressor for stabilizing your vitals. You've slept for ten years, and your conditions aren't exactly stable yet.

dialogText.cn: ……我好像，忘记了很多事情。
dialogText.en: {F}I can hardly recall anything.{M}I can hardly recall anything.

dialogText.cn: 你是……？
dialogText.en: {F}Who are you...?{M}Who are you...?

dialogText.cn: ……我叫佩丽卡。
dialogText.en: My name is Perlica.

dialogText.cn: 我是终末地工业的监督。在你熟悉这里之前，我也会负责照顾你。
dialogText.en: I am the Supervisor of Endfield Industries. While you get re-acquainted with this place, I will also be in charge of your well-being.

dialogText.cn: 你也许不记得了，一直以来，你都是终末地工业的领导者，也是我们最重要的伙伴。
dialogText.en: You might not remember this either, but you've always been the leader of Endfield Industries. You are the paragon and most important companion of every Endfielder.

dialogText.cn: ……我确实什么也想不起来了。
dialogText.en: {F}*Sigh* Apologies, my mind's completely blank...{M}*Sigh* Apologies, my mind's completely blank...

dialogText.cn: 你的体征监控流程已经结束，我们现在可以四处转转了。
dialogText.en: Your physical examinations are complete. We can now take you on a tour.

dialogText.cn: 这就是我们的总部，人类科学技术的至高结晶，源石动力空天作业船——“帝江号”。
dialogText.en: This is our HQ. She is the pinnacle of human science and technology. Originium-powered Multi-surface Vessel — Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 大家都习惯了“星球”这个称呼……严格来说，它是一颗卫星。
dialogText.en: Everyone calls Talos-II a planet, but truth be told, it's actually the second moon of the planet named Talos.

dialogText.cn: 对我们而言，塔卫二上仍然有许多未解之谜，还有曾经威胁到整个文明的敌人……
dialogText.en: Much about Talos-II remains a mystery to us. We're also facing enemies that once threatened our entire civilization...

dialogText.cn: 但是，只要有你在，我相信终末地能够战胜这些困难。
dialogText.en: But since you're here, I believe that Endfield is capable of overcoming these challenges.

dialogText.cn: 这是你曾经一直随身携带的源石。
dialogText.en: You once carried this piece of Originium with you everywhere.

dialogText.cn: 特种技术部门的干员都会配置一枚协议源石，用来辅助传送定位。
dialogText.en: Every Specialist Tech Division Operator carries a piece of Protorig. The mineral helps tele-protocol triangulation.

dialogText.cn: 而属于你的这一枚协议源石，有一些只有你本人才知道的秘密……
dialogText.en: This is your very own Protorig, and it carries secrets only privy to you...

dialogText.cn: 它在……响应我的呼唤。它似乎很……了解我。
dialogText.en: {F}It's ... responding to my call ... and it seems to know me really well.{M}It's ... responding to my call ... and it seems to know me really well.

dialogText.cn: 没有源石，就没有我们赖以生存的一切。它为我们的机器提供动力，为人们的法术提供根基。
dialogText.en: Everything we need for our survival would be impossible without Originium. The mineral powers our machines and is the basis of the Arts we wield.

dialogText.cn: 来到塔卫二时，我们在这颗星球种下了源石，用故乡的火种开拓新的家园。
dialogText.en: When we first arrived at Talos-II, we planted Originium upon this new world. The spark from our distant origins was meant to create a new place to call home.

dialogText.cn: 但是，战争摧毁了最初的根据地。我们艰难取胜，却也伤痕累累。
dialogText.en: But war destroyed our first landing. Though we achieved victory, we paid a bloody toll that left us battered and ruined.

dialogText.cn: 为了重振文明，你带领终末地研发了协议源石技术，以及它的终极形态——协议核心。
dialogText.en: To revive our civilization, you led Endfield and developed the Protorig technology as well as its ultimate evolution — The Protocol Automation-Core.

dialogText.cn: 这是……我们的成果。
dialogText.en: {F}The fruits ... of our labor.{M}The fruits ... of our labor.

dialogText.cn: 是的，按计划，协议核心将被部署到整个文明环带。除了推进工业生产，它还有一项特殊的使命。
dialogText.en: Yes. Our plan is to deploy Automation-Cores throughout the Civilization Band. This will boost our industrial capacity and fulfill its special mission.

dialogText.cn: 特殊的使命？
dialogText.en: {F}Special mission?{M}Special mission?

dialogText.cn: “重启生命”。
dialogText.en: Reboot of Life.

dialogText.cn: 包括将你唤醒在内，这些使命和计划，都来自一位重要委托人留下的“零号委托”。
dialogText.en: Someone very important commissioned us with the Zeroth Directive. Your awakening as well as the mission and plan I mentioned are part of it.

dialogText.cn: 那个委托人是谁？
dialogText.en: {F}So, who commissioned it?{M}So, who commissioned it?

dialogText.cn: 你自己。
dialogText.en: You did.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，有新情况。现在管理员在你身边吗？
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, we got a situation! Is the Endministrator by your side?

dialogText.cn: 在。怎么了，菲奥娜？
dialogText.en: Yes. The Endmin is with me. What's happening, Fiona?

dialogText.cn: 最高预警。预定着陆点……不，整个四号谷地都有危险。
dialogText.en: We got a max level alert. Our planned landing zone... No, the entirety of Valley IV is in danger!

dialogText.cn: 校准开始，目标四号谷地。
dialogText.en: Initiating alignment. Target: Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 着陆准备就绪！
dialogText.en: All systems green for landing!

dialogText.cn: 出发吧。
dialogText.en: Fire away.

dialogText.cn: 去塔卫二。
dialogText.en: Destination: Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 为什么这么问？
dialogText.en: What makes you say that?

dialogText.cn: 当然有好好休息，状态不好，工作也会有纰漏。
dialogText.en: I am properly rested. Exhaustion will lead to mistakes at work.

dialogText.cn: 现在可容不得我们再出差错了。
dialogText.en: And mistakes are something we can ill afford right now.

dialogText.cn: 是有关武陵损失的统计，比我预计的好些。
dialogText.en: A tally of losses incurred by Wuling. It's better than my estimates.

dialogText.cn: 我们赶紧去研究所拿枢壤仪吧。
dialogText.en: Let's head to the Research Center and get the Xiranite Nexus.

dialogText.cn: 葛天师，怎么回事？我以为<@qu.key>息壤炉</>已经打开了。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Ge, what's going on? I thought the <@qu.key>Xiranite Forge</> would be open by now.

dialogText.cn: 息壤炉的压力阀出了些问题，无法泄压，导致枢壤仪怎么也没办法取出来。
dialogText.en: The forge's pressure valve is malfunctioning and can't vent at all. We can't take out the Xiranite Nexus.

dialogText.cn: 让我看看……确实，是控制压力阀的指令出了问题……覆写难度很大啊。
dialogText.en: Let me see... Yes. There's a problem with the pressure valve control script... Overwriting it will be difficult.

dialogText.cn: 直接叫工程专业的来拆不行吗？
dialogText.en: Can't we just get the engineers to take this apart?

dialogText.cn: 反正都是要淘汰的型号，总不能为了它耽误后面的实验。
dialogText.en: The forge is obsolete anyway. We can't let it delay our subsequent tests.

dialogText.cn: 唉，拆了也太可惜了，即便是旧型号，也有很大的研究价值和再利用价值。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*. It'd be such a waste to take it apart. It might be old, but it's still useful in research and it still works.

dialogText.cn: 更何况，这么多年风风雨雨，都是它陪着我们过来的……算了，眼前事要紧，请人来拆吧。
dialogText.en: This little old engine kept us company for quite a few years... But our need is urgent. Just get a team to dismantle it.

dialogText.cn: 先别着急，或许……我可以尝试调整指令。
dialogText.en: No rush. Perhaps ... I can try adjusting the command script.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，可以帮我个忙吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, can you lend me a hand?

dialogText.cn: 要不是项目停滞，或许我们还能把它迭代得更小、更便携。
dialogText.en: If only we continued the project. The next iteration could have miniaturized it further for portability.

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？
dialogText.en: Ask away.

dialogText.cn: 枢壤仪虽有潜力，但也有无法克服的缺陷。
dialogText.en: The Xiranite Nexus has great potential, but also problems that cannot be overcome.

dialogText.cn: 一来，使用它会消耗大量息壤，不过如今息壤产量提升，暂且不用担心。
dialogText.en: It consumes vast amounts of Xiranite to work. But that's no longer an issue since we're making a lot more Xiranite.

dialogText.cn: 但它对抗裂隙的方式……称得上“以暴制暴”。
dialogText.en: Another problem is the way it fights the rift — it's essentially "brute-forcing".

dialogText.cn: 嗯，瞬间释放的息壤能量与超域能量相互作用，会造成无法预计的损失。
dialogText.en: Yes. Sudden release of Xiranite energy will react with Æther and lead to unpredictable losses.

dialogText.cn: 我知道短时间内攻克有难度。
dialogText.en: Solving its issues within short notice will be challenging.

dialogText.cn: 但有你的帮助，一定能将伤害范围缩到最小，不波及武陵城。
dialogText.en: But with your help, the damages can be minimized and Wuling City would hardly be affected.

dialogText.cn: 当然有，只是最近的数据还未导出，得跑一趟<@qu.key>观测站</>。
dialogText.en: Of course, but the latest data has yet to be exported. This warrants a trip to the <@qu.key>monitoring center</>.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，等事情结束，我马上去观测站找你。
dialogText.en: Sure. Once I'm done, I'll go find you at the monitoring center.

dialogText.cn: 可我还有些事……要和葛天师交代。
dialogText.en: But I have a few things ... to entrust Tianshi Ge with.

dialogText.cn: 以前只在图纸上见过，现在可算是看到实物了。
dialogText.en: I only saw this on a design drawing before.

dialogText.cn: 唉……上次见它，都是许多年前了。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Years have passed since I last saw this thing.

dialogText.cn: 一瓶十年前的竹露，直到现在，庄方宜都舍不得打开。
dialogText.en: A ten-year old vintage Bamboo Brew. It must be very precious to Zhuang Fangyi, because she has not even touched its seal.

dialogText.cn: 我只是来送文件，不用管我。
dialogText.en: Just delivering some files. Feel free to ignore me.

dialogText.cn: 一会儿还有事，等头儿看完文件我就走。
dialogText.en: I got things to deal with. I'll be gone once the boss finish reading the documents.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？哦……没关系，我也是刚来。
dialogText.en: Hmm? Well ... it's alright. I just arrived, too.

dialogText.cn: 你呢？怎么满头是汗？匆匆跑来的？
dialogText.en: And you? All drenched in sweat. Did you come rushing here?

dialogText.cn: ……骗人。
dialogText.en: ...Liar.

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯留下的烂摊子可不少……我只是因为忙不过来，有些累。
dialogText.en: Nefarith left quite a mess... There's a lot on the agenda and it's a little tiring.

dialogText.cn: 有了集成工业系统，息壤产量迅速补足灾后空缺，天师桩阵列也顺利恢复运转。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory has quickly restored our post-disaster Xiranite production. The Tianshi Pillar Array is also working properly again.

dialogText.cn: 城内的修复工作，弭弗做得很好，清波寨中又有汤汤打理，我本不该来麻烦你，可是……
dialogText.en: As for city repairs, Mi Fu is handling it well. And Tangtang is taking care of her Stockade. I shouldn't be asking you, but...

dialogText.cn: 唉，三言两语说不清，还是直接带你去比较好。
dialogText.en: Words won't explain it. I should just show you myself.

dialogText.cn: 是的，管理员，武陵地下……新出现了一道裂隙。
dialogText.en: Indeed, Endmin. A new rift ... has appeared under Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 哎，你又拽我！
dialogText.en: {F}Hey, not again...{M}Hey, not again...

dialogText.cn: 按理说，聂菲斯死去，风波平息，这盏代表武陵安全的灯会重新亮起。
dialogText.en: Technically, the fall of Nefarith should have brought peace. The lantern that symbolizes the peace of Wuling should be lit again.

dialogText.cn: 但直到现在，它仍是无法点亮。
dialogText.en: But even now, the lantern remains dark.

dialogText.cn: 没有的事。不过，我平时事情连着事情，确实没有慢慢走的工夫。
dialogText.en: Definitely not. But my schedules are packed. A leisurely walk is a luxury I can't afford.

dialogText.cn: 习惯成自然，一着急就拉着你跑起来了。
dialogText.en: It's second nature to me. The matter is urgent so I just dragged you along without thinking.

dialogText.cn: 虽然我挡下了聂菲斯的一击，但余波导致息壤堰受损，出现了<@qu.key>新的裂隙</>。
dialogText.en: Though I blocked Nefarith's hit, the aftershocks have compromised the Xiranite Dam. <@qu.key>A new rift</> has appeared.

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 认证通过，最高权限，通道开启。
dialogText.en: Identity verified. Highest authority level confirmed. Access granted.

dialogText.cn: 现在地下空间情况复杂，一会儿进入后，可要跟好我。
dialogText.en: Layouts of the underground area are quite complex. Stay close when we get there.

dialogText.cn: 小心！
dialogText.en: Careful!

dialogText.cn: 至少现在息壤充足，能够支持天师桩满功率运转，遏制裂隙进一步扩张。
dialogText.en: Thankfully we have enough Xiranite here to keep the Tianshi Pillar running at full power, which stops the rift from getting bigger.

dialogText.cn: 但……只要裂隙仍在这里，武陵就不算安全。
dialogText.en: But ... as long as the rift remains, Wuling will not be safe.

dialogText.cn: 我们曾经研发过一种用于闭合裂隙的装置——<@qu.key>枢壤仪</>。
dialogText.en: We once developed a device capable of sealing the rift. It's called the <@qu.key>Xiranite Nexus</>.

dialogText.cn: 但其后种种原因，研发停滞，导致它有许多地方不完善，需要你的帮助。
dialogText.en: But things got in the way and development has been stalled. The device is still incomplete. We need your help.

dialogText.cn: 为了应对裂隙，我们决定重启当年中止研究的裂隙闭合装置——<@qu.key>枢壤仪</>。
dialogText.en: To counter the rift, we have decided to restart R&D for our rift sealing device, the <@qu.key>Xiranite Nexus</>.

dialogText.cn: 因为研发过程中断，目前只有一个不完善的原型机，还需要你的帮忙。
dialogText.en: However, the project was interrupted. What we have right now is an incomplete prototype. That's where you come in.

dialogText.cn: 拉你来地下阵列，也是想带你近距离观测裂隙，好为后续的工作提供支持。
dialogText.en: I dragged you to the Underground Array to let you observe the rift up close, and assist you with your work.

dialogText.cn: 超域能量现在处于谷值，我们得在它回升前赶紧拿到数据。
dialogText.en: Æther energy levels are now very low. We must retrieve the data before it climbs back up.

dialogText.cn: 观测点就在前面，跟我走时，脚下小心。
dialogText.en: The observation point is up ahead. Follow me and watch your step.

dialogText.cn: 如今我们决定取出枢壤仪，正是因为有你在，我们或许能在短时间内完善它。
dialogText.en: We only decided to retrieve the Nexus because you are with us. We now stand a chance to complete the project quickly.

dialogText.cn: 也不奇怪，毕竟当年项目停滞后，枢壤仪被改造成了息壤炉的核心部件。
dialogText.en: It's not surprising. After the project was stalled, the Nexus became a key component of the Xiranite Forge.
Yes...

dialogText.cn: 十年前。
dialogText.en: Ten years ago.

dialogText.cn: 画卷中保存的，正是当年武陵科考站所留下的……一些痕迹。
dialogText.en: The scroll preserves what the Wuling Science Station had left behind back then... Just a few traces...

dialogText.cn: 等这里恢复正常，我会带你去看看。
dialogText.en: Once the dust settles at this place, I'll take you there for a tour.

dialogText.cn: 但……你可能会失望，里面的东西实在过于陈旧。
dialogText.en: But ... you might be disappointed. The things inside are really old.

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 传输已完成。
dialogText.en: Transfer completed.

dialogText.cn: 不好，超域能量正在回升，快走！
dialogText.en: Not good. Æther energy levels are rising. We must go!

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 数据正在传输中。
dialogText.en: Data transfer in progress.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你介意等我一会儿吗？有几份文件，我得看看。
dialogText.en: Endmin, would you mind waiting for a bit? There are a few files that need my attention.

dialogText.cn: 头儿，照你说的，文件我放在桌子上了。
dialogText.en: Boss, I put the files on your desk like you said.

dialogText.cn: 一份日历，上面的日程一直排到深夜。
dialogText.en: A calendar. The work agenda goes deep into the night.

dialogText.cn: 一份弭弗写的便签。
dialogText.en: A note written by Mi Fu.

dialogText.cn: “需要处理的事情很多，要是等到处理完才吃饭，下辈子才有可能吃上。”
dialogText.en: "Things are hectic but if you only eat when you're free, then you're never gonna eat."

dialogText.cn: 一份功能饮料的订单，一批二十四罐。而上一批饮料的订单时间就在几天前。
dialogText.en: An order for a pallet of energy drinks, totaling 24 cans. The last order made was only a few days ago.

dialogText.cn: 我们的工作应该很快就结束，不会影响这里的清理任务吧？
dialogText.en: Our work won't take too long. I hope we're not disrupting the cleanup.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会？不过，观测点附近还有些侵蚀。
dialogText.en: Of course not! However, we still have some Blight nearby.

dialogText.cn: 成，那我也过去看看能不能帮上忙。
dialogText.en: Sure. Guess I'll tag along as well and try to be helpful.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会？观测点附近的侵蚀已经清理得差不多了。
dialogText.en: Of course not! In fact, most of the Blight masses nearby have been cleared.

dialogText.cn: 我和你们一道去，看看能不能帮些忙。
dialogText.en: Let me tag along. I'll see if I can be helpful.

dialogText.cn: 这不是就来了，弭弗。
dialogText.en: I'm right here, Mi Fu.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你怎么来了？观测站的侵蚀清理工作有我盯着呢。
dialogText.en: Endmin? Why are you here? I'm still monitoring the Blight cleanup at the monitoring center.

dialogText.cn: 头儿也来？没看到她啊。
dialogText.en: The boss is coming too? Don't see her anywhere.

dialogText.cn: 头儿，怎么样，仪器没有受损吧？
dialogText.en: What of it, boss? Hope the instruments aren't damaged.

dialogText.cn: 没有，里面的数据也保存完好。
dialogText.en: No. The data stored within is intact as well.

dialogText.cn: ……分析来看，数据还挺乐观。
dialogText.en: ...Analysis of the data looks rather promising.

dialogText.cn: 有些大胆……但值得一试……这样一来，消耗的息壤还能更少！
dialogText.en: A little bold ... but worth a try... This solution will further reduce Xiranite consumption!

dialogText.cn: 弭弗，你……觉得行不通吗？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu ... did you see something that won't work?

dialogText.cn: 没，我哪懂这些？
dialogText.en: No. I don't know science.

dialogText.cn: 我还有工作，就留你们两个在这里大胆设想了。
dialogText.en: Gotta work on something. I'll leave you two to your wild brainstorming.

dialogText.cn: 没什么……只是想起以前，科考站的大家讨论问题，也是这样你一句我一句……
dialogText.en: Nothing... Just thinking about the past, how the Science Station people used to discuss questions. Like what we're doing now...

dialogText.cn: 是啊……当时的想法一个比一个大胆，讨论一次比一次激烈。
dialogText.en: Yes... Every idea was bolder than the last. We got more intense with every discussion.

dialogText.cn: 我第一次见他们讨论，甚至以为是在吵架呢。
dialogText.en: When I first heard their argument, I thought they were fighting.

dialogText.cn: 没，我进科考站时年纪不大，哪里插得上嘴。
dialogText.en: No. I was young when I joined the Science Station. It wasn't my place to talk.

dialogText.cn: 不过，就算旁听，我也能学到许多，帮前辈整理文件，也会有收获。
