dialogText.en: But, listening in the discussions taught me a lot. I learned a great deal as I sorted files for my peers.

dialogText.cn: 不是受前辈们青睐，是受前辈们照顾。
dialogText.en: They didn't simply like me. They took care of me.

dialogText.cn: 谁说不是呢。
dialogText.en: Perhaps I was.

dialogText.cn: 既然有完善思路，不如带着枢壤仪，实地试验下看看？
dialogText.en: Now that we have a working idea, why don't we use the Xiranite Nexus for a field test?

dialogText.cn: 实验有风险，让我想想……城外有个名为<@qu.key>弃剑台</>的小岛，空旷，人也少，不如去那里？
dialogText.en: The test is risky. Let me think... <@qu.key>Qijian Dais</> is an islet outside the city. It's pretty much empty. What do you say?

dialogText.cn: 只是第一次见有人能这么快跟上你的想法。以前有人和我讲，你的想法太大胆，根本接不住。
dialogText.en: It's just the first time I saw someone keeping pace with you. People once told me your ideas are too wild and impossible.

dialogText.cn: 这倒是从没人和我说过……
dialogText.en: Oh, nobody told me that before...

dialogText.cn: 想那么多干嘛，能有个和你想到一起去的人，挺好。
dialogText.en: No need to overthink it. It's great we got someone who thinks like you for once.

dialogText.cn: 那我能帮上什么忙吗？
dialogText.en: Is there anything I can do to help?

dialogText.cn: 你能帮我们守在渡口提醒大家不要靠近吗？
dialogText.en: Could you guard the raft station and tell people to stay away?

dialogText.cn: 多谢，不过……你是来找黎天师留在这里的剑吗？
dialogText.en: Much appreciated. So ... are you here for the sword Tianshi Li left behind?

dialogText.cn: 很久以前，妈妈、爸爸偶尔会带我来这里练武。大战结束后，有些话想和他们说，所以就来了。
dialogText.en: When I was a kid, my mom and dad would bring me here for training. Once the battle was over, I wanted to come and pay my respects.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，结果一来，还没说上话，野兽就先扑上来了。
dialogText.en: But upon arrival, I didn't get a chance to say anything before the beasts pounced at me.

dialogText.cn: 我知道你们的事要紧，能不能，就给我一小会儿……几句话，很快就能讲完。
dialogText.en: I know you're on urgent business, but can you give me a while... Just a short while to say a few words.

dialogText.cn: 妈妈、爸爸……
dialogText.en: Mom... Dad...

dialogText.cn: 经历这次危机，我才理解，你们身上不只有为人父母的职责。
dialogText.en: This crisis taught me something. You were more than my parents. You performed your duty.

dialogText.cn: 身为天师，需要你们的不仅是我，还有更多人。而我，却总想要你们能时时刻刻都陪着我。
dialogText.en: As Tianshi, it was not only I who needed you, but also many others. Yet, I was just a clingy kid ... who always wished you could be by my side at all times.

dialogText.cn: 对不起……是我的想法太自私了。
dialogText.en: Sorry... I was really selfish back then.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，就、就这些了……
dialogText.en: Ahem. Well, that's it from me...

dialogText.cn: 因为这只是孩子对父母的想念。
dialogText.en: {F}It's only natural for children to miss their parents.{M}It's only natural for children to miss their parents.

dialogText.cn: 明知道没有回应，却还是一直放在心里，时常想起，不曾忘记……
dialogText.en: {F}You knew they wouldn't reply, yet you kept your message to heart. Always remembering, and never forgetting...{M}You knew they wouldn't reply, yet you kept your message to heart. Always remembering, and never forgetting...

dialogText.cn: 怎么会是自私的想法呢？
dialogText.en: {F}That is definitely not selfish.{M}That is definitely not selfish.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢您……管理员。
dialogText.en: Thank you ... Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我、我不打扰你们的实验了。放心，有我守着，不会有人乱闯进来的。
dialogText.en: I, uh, I shouldn't get in the way of your test. No worries. I'll make sure nobody barges into the place.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，实验危险，得找个没人的地方，想来想去，还是这里合适。
dialogText.en: Yes. It's a dangerous test and we need an uninhabited area. This islet is the best option available.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，庄天师……你们怎么也来岛上了？
dialogText.en: Endmin? Tianshi Zhuang...? Why are you on the islet as well?

dialogText.cn: 我还以为路上的野兽已经清理干净了，没想到还漏了几个。
dialogText.en: I thought I cleaned up all the beasts along the way. Turned out I missed a few.

dialogText.cn: 当然没问题！
dialogText.en: Of course!

dialogText.cn: 多谢啦。
dialogText.en: Thanks a mil.

dialogText.cn: 算吗……也不算啦。
dialogText.en: I guess so ... but not really.

dialogText.cn: ……小心。
dialogText.en: ...Careful.
Hngh...

dialogText.cn: 放心，不是问题。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. I got it.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我已经准备好了。
dialogText.en: Sure ... I'm ready.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？
dialogText.en: How did it go?

dialogText.cn: 可……我还是有些……
dialogText.en: But... I'm still a little...

dialogText.cn: 可以开始了，管理员。
dialogText.en: We can begin, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 他一直想来看看，好不容易等到机会，所以第一时间就过来了。
dialogText.en: He always wanted to be here. When the opportunity came, he took it without hesitation.

dialogText.cn: 黎天师夫妇还在的时候，偶尔也会邀请我来，那会儿黎风只比我膝盖高。一转眼，已经是大孩子了。
dialogText.en: When Tianshi Li and his wife were around, they'd invite me too. Lifeng barely reached my knees back then. Time really flew past me. The kid's a big boy now.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，明明还是孩子，但他对责任的理解，比许多成年人都更深刻。
dialogText.en: Yes. He's just a teen, but he knows far more about duty than many adults.

dialogText.cn: 和父母一样……他也是尽职尽责、无私无畏的人。
dialogText.en: He takes after his parents... Dutiful, selfless, and utterly without fear.

dialogText.cn: 看报告数据，还有余地。我和你先去趟选剑局，来得及。
dialogText.en: The reports show that it's not that urgent yet. We should head to the Bureau of Swordmancers while there's still time.

dialogText.cn: 不，是弭弗，她说……伤患终于都苏醒了。
dialogText.en: No, it's from Mi Fu. She told me that ... our injured are coming around.

dialogText.cn: 我得去见见他们。
dialogText.en: I have to see them.

dialogText.cn: 好……等到结束，你可以直接来中心实验室找我……
dialogText.en: Alright... Once you're done, meet me at the Central Laboratory...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……不见不散。
dialogText.en: Okay... See you later.

dialogText.cn: 裂隙就在城内，这个时候防护系统升级失败……万一出了差错，我们未能成功关闭裂隙，恐怕后果不堪设想。
dialogText.en: The rift is in the city. If the defense system upgrade fails ... or encounters an error, and if the rift could not be closed, the outcomes would be devastating.

dialogText.cn: 出发前，我们需要做好前期记录。
dialogText.en: Before I go, we'll need to do some preliminary datalogging.

dialogText.cn: 可是……
dialogText.en: But...

dialogText.cn: 没关系，放心交给我就好。
dialogText.en: {F}It's alright. Leave it to me.{M}It's alright. Leave it to me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们得尽快赶过去看看。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we should get there ASAP.

actorName.cn: 焦急的天师{e10m2-焦急的天师}

dialogText.cn: 管理员来了！
dialogText.en: It's the Endmin!

actorName.cn: 慌乱的天师{e10m2-慌乱的天师}

dialogText.cn: 抱、抱歉，我们在部署的时候，不知道出了什么问题，突然间就开始报错。
dialogText.en: So sorry about this. It happened during deployment. We don't know why, but we're getting error messages.

actorName.cn: 慌乱的天师{e10m2-慌乱的天师}

dialogText.cn: 我猜是工程模块出了问题，就叫了同事来。
dialogText.en: The engineering module ... something might be wrong with it. I've got my colleagues to help.

actorName.cn: 冷静的天师{e10m2-冷静的天师}

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我在报错的传递扭矩模块处听到了异常摩擦声。
dialogText.en: Endmin, the torque transmission module that reported the error is giving off strange grinding noises.

actorName.cn: 冷静的天师{e10m2-冷静的天师}

dialogText.cn: 但……终末地的技术和武陵的还是有区别，为避免设备损伤，我们也不方便直接处理。
dialogText.en: But ... we couldn't simply fix it because Endfield tech differs from that in Wuling, and we don't want to break anything.

actorName.cn: 好奇的天师{e10m2-冷静的天师}

dialogText.cn: 原来还可以这么做……有意思。
dialogText.en: Never thought we could do that... Interesting.

actorName.cn: 兴奋的天师{e10m2-焦急的天师}

dialogText.cn: 这个能量回溯的方式……感觉也可以运用在我的项目里。
dialogText.en: This energy feedback system... I think I can use it in my own project.

actorName.cn: 冷静的天师{e10m2-冷静的天师}

dialogText.cn: 嗯，已经恢复了。
dialogText.en: Well, it's working as intended.

actorName.cn: 兴奋的天师{e10m2-焦急的天师}

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您要是有空，可以再留一会儿吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, if you have time, would you mind staying for a bit?

actorName.cn: 兴奋的天师{e10m2-焦急的天师}

dialogText.cn: 我们都有好多问题想问您。
dialogText.en: We got so many questions to ask you.

dialogText.cn: （过了这么长时间，得赶紧去实验室……庄天师应该早就到那里了。）
dialogText.en: {F}(That took me quite a while. Gotta hurry to the lab... Tianshi Zhuang should be there already.){M}(That took me quite a while. Gotta hurry to the lab... Tianshi Zhuang should be there already.)

dialogText.cn: （希望没让她等太久。）
dialogText.en: {F}(I hope I didn't keep her waiting for too long.){M}(I hope I didn't keep her waiting for too long.)

actorName.cn: 冷静的天师{e10m2-冷静的天师}

dialogText.cn: 庄天师的事一定是要事，管理员，你赶紧过去，剩下的交给我们就好。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang's work does take top priority. Don't let us keep you, Endmin. We'll take care of the rest.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您和庄天师的实验结果如何？我刚刚听到好大的动静……很担心。
dialogText.en: Endmin, how was that test you performed with Tianshi Zhuang? I heard something really loud ... it got me worried.

dialogText.cn: 要不是你们叮嘱过，我差点儿就上去了。
dialogText.en: If you never told me to stay put, I would've rushed in at once.

dialogText.cn: 那就好……
dialogText.en: That's great...

dialogText.cn: 庄天师做事，我很少见到她向人求助。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang hardly asks anyone to assist her work.

dialogText.cn: 唉，我能力有限，能做的不多，想帮她也帮不到。
dialogText.en: It's just ... that area's not really my specialty. I couldn't help even if I wanted to.

dialogText.cn: 不过，幸好还有您在她身边。多谢您能帮她，管理员。
dialogText.en: But we're so lucky to have you around, Endmin. Thanks a lot for helping her.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师这些年对我照顾有加嘛……都是我应该的。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang has taken care of me for years... It's the least I could do.

dialogText.cn: 既然实验已经结束，那我就先走了，回见了。
dialogText.en: Since the test is over, I think I should get going. See you later.

dialogText.cn: 管理员……我们不见不散。
dialogText.en: Endmin... I'll see you later.

dialogText.cn: 《实验安全知情同意书》
dialogText.en: Informed Consent Form for Test Safety

dialogText.cn: 实验名称：使用枢壤仪实地进行裂隙闭合测试
dialogText.en: TITLE OF TEST: Field Trial for Rift Sealing with the Xiranite Nexus

dialogText.cn: 研究机构名称：武陵材料研究所
dialogText.en: Research Center Title: Wuling Institute of Materials Science

dialogText.cn: 主要研究者：庄方宜
dialogText.en: PRIMARY INVESTIGATOR: Zhuang Fangyi

dialogText.cn: 实验目标：测试升级后的枢壤仪应对裂隙的具体表现，以及评估闭合裂隙过程中，枢壤仪所造成的能量碰撞与冲击的危险程度。
dialogText.en: GOALS OF TEST: Performance assessment of the upgraded Xiranite Nexus against an actual rift; and evaluate the levels of potential hazards resulting from energy collisions and shockwaves generated by the Xiranite Nexus during the rift sealing process.

dialogText.cn: 风险须知：本次实验需要参与人员尽可能靠近裂隙进行操作，承受高强度超域能量冲击。
dialogText.en: RISK REMINDERS: Participants must be as close as possible to the rift to conduct this test, and will therefore be exposed to powerful pulses of Æther energy.

dialogText.cn: 参与实验人员签字：
dialogText.en: RESEARCHER SIGNATURE:

dialogText.cn: 随行实验人员：无
dialogText.en: ADDITIONAL INVESTIGATOR(S): None

dialogText.cn: 《武陵科学发展区管代工作交接书》
dialogText.en: Work Handover Document for the Viceroyalty of Wuling Scientific Developmental District

dialogText.cn: 若有意外，武陵城中行政事务暂交予巡卫队队长弭弗处理，学院事务则交由天师葛一朴负责。
dialogText.en: If an accident were to occur, the handling of all administrative affairs of Wuling City shall be handled by Watchguard Captain Mi Fu, while Academy and campus matters shall be handed over to Tianshi Ge Yipu.

dialogText.cn: 签字：
dialogText.en: Signature:

dialogText.cn: 管理员：
dialogText.en: Endministrator:

dialogText.cn: 当你看到这封信，我应该已经离开。
dialogText.en: By the time you read this letter, I will have already left.

dialogText.cn: 有你帮忙，枢壤仪确有改进，不再对武陵造成威胁，但强行关闭裂隙，总会有代价。
dialogText.en: Your assistance has improved the Xiranite Nexus, and it no longer poses a threat to Wuling. But an attempt to forcibly seal the rift would not be without consequences.

dialogText.cn: 不论如何，我确信自己一人能够关闭裂隙。至于代价……也只我一人。
dialogText.en: However, I do know, with certainty, that I can seal the rift on my own. As for the price ... I alone should suffice.

dialogText.cn: 我已留书，将武陵各项事务暂交由葛一朴与弭弗……最终，武陵会继续往前。
dialogText.en: I have penned a letter to grant Ge Yipu and Mi Fu temporary authority over matters of the city... In the end, Wuling will endure and move on, as it has always done.

dialogText.cn: 曾几何时，我以为离去的人今生也无缘再见，回忆，也只是回忆。
dialogText.en: There was a time when I thought I would never see the departed, that memories would remain as they are — things that linger in our minds.

dialogText.cn: 可当你出现，那些离去的面容与眼前的相叠，回忆被再次点亮，一一重现。
dialogText.en: But you appeared, and the faces of the departed overlapped with the sights. Memories were reignited, one after another, they replayed themselves.

dialogText.cn: 记得你刚来到科考站，我站在人群中望着你，期待终有一天也能与你谈论自己的观点与想法。
dialogText.en: I remember when you first visited the Science Station. I stood in the crowd and gazed at you from afar. I hoped there would be a day when I could share my perspective and ideas with you.

dialogText.cn: 可真有机会与你说话时，我却磕磕巴巴，一句话也讲不清……所以我想，若你还记得我，恐怕只会想起一个总莫名其妙躲着你的后辈。
dialogText.en: When I finally got my chance, I found myself stuttering and unable to form a coherent sentence... I thought you would probably remember me as a young girl who just kept avoiding you for reasons unknown.

dialogText.cn: 十年晃眼过，当日的喧闹人群，也只剩下你我。
dialogText.en: A decade has gone by. You and I are the only ones left from the crowd of yesteryear.

dialogText.cn: 但至少你还在，还能让我觉得，那段美好的时光仍尚存一息，并未彻底离我远去。
dialogText.en: But you still walk amongst us, and you have made me feel that a figment of the beautiful times has remained instead of leaving me completely.

dialogText.cn: 这就够了……
dialogText.en: And that is enough...

dialogText.cn: 你是终末地的管理员，我是武陵的管代。
dialogText.en: You are the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, while I am the Viceroy of Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 武陵是我的责任，而你，却注定要前往更远的前方，承担更重要的责任。
dialogText.en: Wuling is my responsibility, while you are destined to push further into the frontiers and to shoulder burdens of far greater import.

dialogText.cn: 恳求你与我同去，是将我的责任强加在你身上，更何况，你已为武陵做了许多。
dialogText.en: Asking you to join me on this mission is akin to me forcing you to take on my duties, and you have already done so much for Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 所以……
dialogText.en: So...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你怎么才来啊？
dialogText.en: Endmin? You're here!

dialogText.cn: 她已经离开了！匆匆忙忙带着枢壤仪走了。
dialogText.en: She left already. In a rush, too. She also brought the Xiranite Nexus along.

dialogText.cn: ……我也不清楚啊，我还问了一句你的事。
dialogText.en: ...I'm not sure. I did, in fact, ask her about you.

dialogText.cn: 但她只是摇了摇头……说你有自己的事情要忙。
dialogText.en: But she shook her head ... said you were too busy with something else.

dialogText.cn: 不过，庄天师走之前，给你留了封信，放在楼上。
dialogText.en: Oh, before she went, she left you a letter. It's upstairs.

dialogText.cn: 伤患情况如何？
dialogText.en: How are the patients?

dialogText.cn: 伤员都已经苏醒，慢慢休养，日后都能恢复健康，除了……那孩子。
dialogText.en: The injured are coming around. Give them some time and they'll be back on their feet. But ... the young girl...

dialogText.cn: 她的伤势太重，恐怕以后要落下残疾……这才刚刚成年。
dialogText.en: Her injuries are grave. It might affect the rest of her life... A tragedy for one so young.

dialogText.cn: 好……我这就去看看。
dialogText.en: Thank you... I'll take a look.

dialogText.cn: 赵叔……
dialogText.en: Uncle Zhao...

actorName.cn: 神色悲戚的天师{e10m3-神色悲戚的天师}

dialogText.cn: 庄天师……你、你来了……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang... You ... you're here...

dialogText.cn: 我也来看看她。
dialogText.en: I came to see her too.

actorName.cn: 神色悲戚的天师{e10m3-神色悲戚的天师}

dialogText.cn: 好，她刚刚睡下，要是知道你来了，肯定高兴。
dialogText.en: Good. She just fell asleep. If she knew you came, she'd be very happy.

actorName.cn: 神色悲戚的天师{e10m3-神色悲戚的天师}

dialogText.cn: 之前，这丫头就说要投在你门下，到第一线与侵蚀潮抗争。可惜，是她没福气……
dialogText.en: Our girl dreamed of training under you. She wished to fight the Blight Tide on the frontlines. But fortune did not smile on her...

dialogText.cn: 别这么说，赵叔。这孩子很好，是我没福气才对。
dialogText.en: I'm sorry, Uncle Zhao. She's a good young lady. Fortune did not smile on me either.

dialogText.cn: 您也……多保重，有事随时可以来找我。
dialogText.en: And ... look after yourself. Please, talk to me if you need anything.

actorName.cn: 神色悲戚的天师{e10m3-神色悲戚的天师}

dialogText.cn: 大战过后……庄天师你肯定也有得忙，不用为我费心……
dialogText.en: It was a great battle... You must be busy too, Tianshi Zhuang. There's no need to worry about me...

dialogText.cn: 赵叔……
dialogText.en: Uncle Zhao...

actorName.cn: 神色悲戚的天师{e10m3-神色悲戚的天师}

dialogText.cn: 没事……你去吧。能好的……会好的。
dialogText.en: It's okay. Just go ahead and do what you need to do. We'll get by. Things will get better... They always do.

dialogText.cn: 不该……不该这么自私的。
dialogText.en: Shame on me... How could I have acted with such selfishness?

dialogText.cn: 需要你的……明明还有更多人，更多事。
dialogText.en: So many people, so many things ... all of them could use your help.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，你要的文件，我都放在楼上了。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, the file you wanted is upstairs.

dialogText.cn: 怎么只有你一个人？管理员呢？
dialogText.en: You're here on your own? Where's the Endmin?

dialogText.cn: {F}管理员，有她自己的事情……{M}管理员，有他自己的事情……
dialogText.en: {F}The Endmin... She's needed elsewhere...{M}The Endmin... He's needed elsewhere...

dialogText.cn: 这次你一个人去地下，能行吗？
dialogText.en: That means you'll head down there yourself. Are you really sure about this?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，枢壤仪的改进已经完成，风险程度降低很多，我一个人就够了。
dialogText.en: Yes. We've upgraded the Xiranite Nexus. The risks are much lower now. I can do this on my own.

dialogText.cn: 那……你还有其他事情要我帮忙吗？
dialogText.en: Okay ... so anything else I might assist you with?

dialogText.cn: 没有了，葛天师，你忙吧。
dialogText.en: That'll be all, Tianshi Ge. Carry on.

dialogText.cn: 好，文件签署完我会记得归档，辛苦你帮我跑这一趟了。
dialogText.en: Good. I'll get it signed and archived. Thank you for taking the trip for me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，很抱歉没能遵守约定。
dialogText.en: Endmin, apologies for reneging on my promise.

dialogText.cn: 同为领导者，我希望你能理解我做出的选择。
dialogText.en: As a leader yourself, I hope you can understand the choice I made.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟，是我的失察，才让武陵陷入危险，让人们承受损失……
dialogText.en: After all, it was my negligence that placed Wuling in danger. The suffering of the people and the city is my responsibility...

dialogText.cn: 更何况，能亲眼见证一项跨越十几年的项目收获成果，是一位天师的毕生所求。
dialogText.en: Furthermore, witnessing a project spanning more than a decade fulfilling its purpose... That is the lifetime wish of any Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 在求索的道路上，一个人的终点，往往是另一人的起点。
dialogText.en: On this quest for discovery, one's final stop is often the starting point of another.

dialogText.cn: 如果这是我的终点，我希望它会成为你们再次向北部禁区进发的起点。
dialogText.en: If this becomes my final stop, then use it as your starting point ... for our push towards the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.

dialogText.cn: 你帮我完善枢壤仪已经足够，不应再和我一同承担。
dialogText.en: You've helped me repair the Xiranite Nexus. That is already more than enough. I shouldn't ask for anything beyond that.

dialogText.cn: 既然是朋友，遇到事你就该和我说说。
dialogText.en: If we're friends, you should at least share your problems.

dialogText.cn: 唉，庄天师，我就真没什么能再帮你的了？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, are you sure there really isn't anything else I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 阿庄……你何苦一人撑着呢？
dialogText.en: Fangyi... You shouldn't be doing this alone.

dialogText.cn: 头儿，我一直都在啊。
dialogText.en: Boss, I'm always here.

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 认证通过，最高权限，通道开启。
dialogText.en: Identity verified. Highest authority level confirmed. Access granted.

dialogText.cn: 你来了。
dialogText.en: {F}You've arrived.{M}You've arrived.

dialogText.cn: 你说在实验室不见不散，却一个人先走了。
dialogText.en: {F}You told me to meet at the lab, but then you got a head start.{M}You told me to meet at the lab, but then you got a head start.

dialogText.cn: 所以，就只好来这里等你了。
dialogText.en: {F}That's why I decided to beat you to it.{M}That's why I decided to beat you to it.

dialogText.cn: ……你在这里等多久了？
dialogText.en: ...How long have you been waiting here?

dialogText.cn: 哦，没关系，我只是刚来。你呢？
dialogText.en: {F}Oh, not too long. Just arrived. What about you?{M}Oh, not too long. Just arrived. What about you?

dialogText.cn: 为什么……没有等我？
dialogText.en: {F}Something happened...? Why didn't you wait for me?{M}Something happened...? Why didn't you wait for me?

dialogText.cn: 我一个人就够了。
dialogText.en: I can do this on my own.

dialogText.cn: ……骗人。
dialogText.en: {F}...You're lying.{M}...You're lying.

dialogText.cn: 不过也没什么，至少我等到你了。
dialogText.en: {F}But it's alright. I waited for you, and you're here with me.{M}But it's alright. I waited for you, and you're here with me.

dialogText.cn: 要一起走吗？
dialogText.en: {F}We do this together.{M}We do this together.

actorName.cn: 严肃的声音{e10m3-严肃的声音}

dialogText.cn: 小庄，你们研究组现在就剩你一个人了，任重而道远啊。
dialogText.en: Zhuang, you're the only one left in the science team. The path will be long and hard.

actorName.cn: 诚恳的声音{e10m3-诚恳的声音}

dialogText.cn: 管代的位置除了你还有谁能胜任？武陵落成对宏科院至关重要，你得挑起这担子来啊。
dialogText.en: You're the only one who can be the viceroy. The completion of Wuling is essential to the Academy. You've got to take on the responsibility.

actorName.cn: 激昂的声音{e10m3-激昂的声音}

dialogText.cn: 为了武陵的安全，这点困难算什么？更何况有庄天师您在后面顶着，我不怕！
dialogText.en: I'll take on anything if Wuling's safety is at stake. I know you'll always be there and have my back. That gives me confidence!

dialogText.cn: 不过是司其职，尽其职。
dialogText.en: Just fulfilling my roles and performing my duties.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，可以了，我们出发吧。
dialogText.en: Of course, Endmin. Together.

dialogText.cn: 好。
dialogText.en: Good.

dialogText.cn: ……谢谢。
dialogText.en: ...Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 和我预计的一样，因为超域能量的影响，画卷内的场景也变得混乱了。
dialogText.en: Just as I expected. Æther energy has changed this place. The area within the scroll is in chaos.

dialogText.cn: 似曾相识……却也面目全非……
dialogText.en: Familiar ... yet completely transformed...

dialogText.cn: 这些石块并非科考站的建材，反倒更像……地下阵列中的息壤。
dialogText.en: The stones don't look like Science Station building materials. They look like ... Xiranite of the underground array.

dialogText.cn: 这两处场景相互融合地出现在画卷里，还是第一次碰见……不过，画卷中的息壤似乎失去了能量。
dialogText.en: The two spaces have blended within the scroll. This is my first time seeing it... But the Xiranite in here looks inert.

dialogText.cn: 但既然是息壤，只要能将能量导入其中，我就可以操纵它们移动。
dialogText.en: But if it's Xiranite, we can simply energize it and I'll be able to move them.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，交给你了。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'm leaving it to you.

dialogText.cn: 重温过往事，最后一笔也该落下了。
dialogText.en: The time to reminisce is over. Now it's time to make the final stroke.

dialogText.cn: 那儿就是出口了。
dialogText.en: That's the exit.

dialogText.cn: 你每次进入地下阵列……都会进来看看吗？
dialogText.en: {F}So when you visit the Underground Array ... would you enter this place?{M}So when you visit the Underground Array ... would you enter this place?

dialogText.cn: 偶尔……想回到过去的时候，就会走进来。
dialogText.en: Occasionally... Whenever I think about the past, I'd enter the scroll.

dialogText.cn: 只不过，我也不知道代理人会将哪段回忆展现给我。或喜或悲，都是看了才知道。
dialogText.en: However, I never knew what memories the Proxy would show me. Sad or joyful, I'd only know when I see them.

dialogText.cn: ……十年前，科考站多数建筑被毁，这里是唯一保留下来的监测站。
dialogText.en: ...Ten years ago. Multiple buildings at the Science Station were destroyed. This is the only monitoring station left.

dialogText.cn: 当时搜救人员来到这里，还心存期待，以为会有人幸存。
dialogText.en: When the SAR team arrived, they were positive about finding survivors.

dialogText.cn: 直到大家继续深入，见识到真正的惨状，才知道……幸运从一开始，就未曾光顾。
dialogText.en: But the tragedy only revealed itself when they delved downwards. They learned that ... fortune had never paid a visit.

dialogText.cn: 黎天师夫妇……？
dialogText.en: {F}Both Tianshi Lis...?{M}Both Tianshi Lis...?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，就是黎风那孩子的父母。
dialogText.en: Yes. They were Lifeng's parents.

dialogText.cn: 被损坏的通讯器不停播放着一段破碎的录音。
dialogText.en: The damaged communicator keeps replaying the same, distorted audio recording.

dialogText.cn: “庄……天师，息壤……只……你……拜托了。”
dialogText.en: "Tianshi ... Zhuang, Project Xiranite ... only one left ... counting ... on you."

dialogText.cn: 一沓文件，放着几份签署过的知情书与交接书，还有一份实验风险的评估报告。
dialogText.en: A stack of documents that include a few signed letters of informed consent, letters of delegation, and a report for evaluating the risks of some experiment.

dialogText.cn: 报告最后一页有庄方宜的批注——
dialogText.en: Zhuang Fangyi left some comments at the last page of the report.

dialogText.cn: “两人同去虽能相互照应，但危险也需两人共同承担。”
dialogText.en: "Two can look out for each other, yet both will bear the same risks."

dialogText.cn: “枢壤仪已经改进，我会确保武陵安然无恙。”
dialogText.en: "The Xiranite Nexus has been improved. I'll make sure that Wuling is safe."

dialogText.cn: 竹露的瓶子，里面新添了武陵今年的新茶。
dialogText.en: A bamboo brew gourd, filled with the year's first tea leaves of Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 超域能量更加猛烈了。
dialogText.en: The Æther energy is getting more powerful.

dialogText.cn: ……这可是在天师桩阵列之中。
dialogText.en: ...And this is within the Tianshi Pillar Array itself.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们先尽量靠近裂隙吧。
dialogText.en: True. Let's try to get closer to the rift.

dialogText.cn: 厚厚的论文册，曾被频繁翻阅，每一页都留有详细的笔记，看得出阅览者十分用心。
dialogText.en: A thick compilation of scientific theses. Someone has flipped through it religiously. Detailed notes have been left at every page. The reader really got into the details.

dialogText.cn: 书页中还夹着一枚书签，上面绘了只胖乎乎的羽兽。
dialogText.en: There is also a bookmark with a chubby fowlbeast drawn on it.

dialogText.cn: 厚实的文件袋，里面是庄方宜近期的体检报告。
dialogText.en: A thick document holder with Zhuang Fangyi's recent health examination reports.

dialogText.cn: 与聂菲斯的战斗、近日的辛劳已令她心力交瘁，报告中许多指标都低于标准。
dialogText.en: The recent battle against Nefarith and constant exhaustion has taxed her health gravely. Many indicators are below healthy standards.

dialogText.cn: 医生留下的建议有满满一页纸，但她从未遵循过。
dialogText.en: The doctor has written a full page of prescriptions that she never followed.

dialogText.cn: 一份有关枢壤仪的请示报告。
dialogText.en: An application for the usage of Xiranite Nexus.

dialogText.cn: 武陵城地下的裂隙正在扩张，因位置特殊，种种应对方案均不理想，可能造成严重后果。
dialogText.en: The underground rift beneath Wuling City is expanding. Given the nature of its location, various rift-sealing measures have been deemed less than ideal as the consequences might be severe.

dialogText.cn: 最终，天师们只能决定取出枢壤仪强行关闭裂隙。可操作枢壤仪需使用者靠近裂隙，异常危险。
dialogText.en: The Tianshi has finally decided to use the Xiranite Nexus to seal the rift. But the user of the Xiranite Nexus must be in close proximity to the rift. Risk levels are exceptionally high.

dialogText.cn: 知晓此事后，虽有许多天师自告奋勇，但前往人选至今未确定。
dialogText.en: Despite knowing the dangers involved, many Tianshi still volunteered. The candidates have yet to be finalized.

dialogText.cn: 庄方宜只留下简单批示——
dialogText.en: To that, Zhuang Fangyi has left a simple comment.

dialogText.cn: “我去。”
dialogText.en: "I'll go."

dialogText.cn: ……前面的路彻底断了，附近也没有能利用的息壤。
dialogText.en: ...The path ahead is completely destroyed, but there are no Xiranite we can use nearby.

dialogText.cn: 事到如今，我们只能借助这些<@qu.key>画卷通道</>了。
dialogText.en: It would seem that ... our only way forward is the <@qu.key>scroll portal</>.
Yes...

dialogText.cn: 确切来说，是科考站在我记忆中留下的痕迹。
dialogText.en: More accurately, it contains impressions that the Science Station left in my memories.

dialogText.cn: 说到底，还是要感谢代理人的能力，替我好好保管着这段经历……数年过去，都不曾褪色。
dialogText.en: And this is thanks to the Proxy. Her power preserved these experiences... Despite the years, none of them have faded.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，管理员，我带你回到那个属于我的“十年前”。
dialogText.en: Let's go, Endmin. I'll take you to my experiences "ten years ago".

dialogText.cn: 大家好，我的名字是庄方宜。
dialogText.en: Hi everyone, my name's Zhuang Fangyi.

dialogText.cn: 真是稚嫩……
dialogText.en: Young and inexperienced...

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 本部说给我们派了一位年轻有为的天师……这也太年轻了。
dialogText.en: HQ said they're sending us a young and gifted Tianshi... But you're even younger than we expected.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 没有没有，我那些成果……哪里称得上有为。
dialogText.en: Ah, you flatter me. My work is ... hardly worth mentioning.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 妄自菲薄……身为宏科院最年轻的天师，你愿意来科考站工作，是我们面子上有光。
dialogText.en: Nah, don't sell yourself short! You're the youngest Tianshi of HAS! We're really honored to have you here at the Science Station!

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，我们发给你的报告都看了吗？
dialogText.en: So, did you read the papers and reports we sent your way?

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 你师姐一直等着你来，想听听你的看法呢。
dialogText.en: Your senior has been waiting. She's interested in your views.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的师姐{e10m4-回忆中的师姐}
actorName.en: Senior from the Memories {e10m4-Senior from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 是啊是啊，快说说！
dialogText.en: Of course I am. Out with it!

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 看了好几遍，有些论点很精彩……
dialogText.en: I've read it quite a few times. Some points are very exciting...

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 不过，为什么第二十六页和第二十七页的夹缝里，加了一小段长尾羽兽和短尾羽兽产蛋量的对比？
dialogText.en: But something was tucked between pages 26 and 27. A comparison of eggs laid by short-tailed and long-tailed fowlbeasts.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 我怎么都没想明白……还查了师姐的其他文献，整理了一些问题。
dialogText.en: I don't know why it's there... I also read your other papers and listed a few questions.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的师姐{e10m4-回忆中的师姐}
actorName.en: Senior from the Memories {e10m4-Senior from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈……你这孩子，也太老实了，那是、那是我……哈哈哈……
dialogText.en: HAHAHAHAHA... You're too honest, girl. That's my, my... HAHAHAHA!

dialogText.cn: 后来我才知道，那是师姐故意留下的纰漏。
dialogText.en: It was only later that I learned ... she left it there on purpose.

dialogText.cn: 是想看我有没有仔细钻研过这些资料。
dialogText.en: It was a little trick of hers ... to see if I'd read her data thoroughly.

dialogText.cn: 不许笑。
dialogText.en: Stop laughing.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这间会议室……就是宣布息壤诞生的地方……
dialogText.en: Endmin, this meeting room ... was where we announced the birth of Xiranite...

dialogText.cn: 你当时还有其他工作，并不在科考站内……
dialogText.en: You weren't at the Science Station. You were taking care of something else...

dialogText.cn: 不过，我们第一时间将好消息告知你，你也向我们传达了祝贺。
dialogText.en: But we notified you of the news at the first opportunity. You also congratulated us.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 这息壤可算是让我们搓出来了，关键一步跨出去，之后很多设想都能实现了。
dialogText.en: Hahaha! We finally made our first Xiranite. The crucial step has been taken. Plenty of ideas can finally be achieved.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的师姐{e10m4-回忆中的师姐}
actorName.en: Senior from the Memories {e10m4-Senior from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 是啊……小庄不还说要建一座息壤的城市！看你这第一块“砖”怎么样？
dialogText.en: Yeah... Zhuang said she wanted to build a Xiranite city! Look. What do you think of our first "brick"?

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 那还远着呢，师姐。
dialogText.en: That ... would take many more bricks...

actorName.cn: 回忆中的师姐{e10m4-回忆中的师姐}
actorName.en: Senior from the Memories {e10m4-Senior from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 不远不远，有了息壤，咱就有底气了。
dialogText.en: We'll make them. This Xiranite just opened up opportunities for us.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的师姐{e10m4-回忆中的师姐}
actorName.en: Senior from the Memories {e10m4-Senior from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 对了，你这城里……有没有火锅炸串冒菜汉堡冰激凌啊？
dialogText.en: Oh, this city of yours... It's got hotpot, fried skewers, burgers, maocai, and ice cream, right?

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 有的。
dialogText.en: It does.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 你怎么还许上愿了？
dialogText.en: Hoho, you're already making a wish list?

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 庄，别听她的，我和你张叔觉得，身体是科研的本钱。
dialogText.en: Don't spoil her, Zhuang. Good health is what you really need to do solid scientific work. Uncle Zhang feels the same too.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的同僚{e10m4-回忆中的同僚}
actorName.en: Colleague from the Memories {e10m4-Colleague from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 记得先给规划一片锻炼身体的地方嗷。
dialogText.en: So don't forget to set aside a place for exercising, okay?

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 有，有广场。
dialogText.en: Okay. There'll be a plaza.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的老师{e10m4-回忆中的老师}
actorName.en: Mentor from the Memories {e10m4-Mentor from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 你看看你们一个个……都忘了说最重要的。学校，得有座学校。
dialogText.en: Can't believe it... No one mentioned what really matters. Schools. Make sure you have one.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的老师{e10m4-回忆中的老师}
actorName.en: Mentor from the Memories {e10m4-Mentor from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 息壤项目的成功，代表一项新学科的成立，以后这里会来更多天师，继续我们的研究。
dialogText.en: The success of Project Xiranite has created a new science. More Tianshi will continue our research.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 嗯，老师，我把它放在城中重要的位置了。
dialogText.en: Of course, my mentor. It's at the most important location of the city.

dialogText.cn: 都有的……武陵现在什么都有的。
dialogText.en: It's all there... Everything is now in Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 对，很大一片。
dialogText.en: Yes ... and it's a really big one.

dialogText.cn: 那时……我刚刚得知，科考站的前辈全部牺牲在事故中。
dialogText.en: It was the time ... when I just learned that all my seniors and peers had died in the accident.

dialogText.cn: 一切发生得都太快，他们离开时，还是满腔热血壮志。一张张面孔……鲜活生动。
dialogText.en: It all happened so quickly. They were filled with hope and ambition mere moments ago. Every face ... was once so vivid and alive.

dialogText.cn: ……再也见不到了。
dialogText.en: ...All of them were gone.

dialogText.cn: 永远也见不到了。
dialogText.en: Never to be seen again.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 为什么……为什么……
dialogText.en: Why...? Why...

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 不、不……我不能再把时间浪费在眼泪上。
dialogText.en: No, no... I can't waste my time on tears.

dialogText.cn: 没关系，就好好哭一场吧。
dialogText.en: It's alright. Just let it all out.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 没有时间了……我还有很多事要做。
dialogText.en: I've got no time... There's too much to do.

dialogText.cn: 过了今天，还有明天……你还有时间。
dialogText.en: You have today, and tomorrow... You have plenty of time.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 可……只剩我一个，怎么办？
dialogText.en: But ... how...? I'm the only one left...

dialogText.cn: 别担心……会有其他人来到你的身边，你不会独行。
dialogText.en: {F}Fear not... Others will be joining your side. You will not be alone.{M}Fear not... Others will be joining your side. You will not be alone.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 我该怎么做……谁能告诉我，我该怎么做……
dialogText.en: What should I do...? Somebody please ... what should I do...

dialogText.cn: 你做得很好，刚开始……难免会有磕绊，但你能坚持下来。
dialogText.en: {F}You've done well. Things were hard at the beginning, but you persevered.{M}You've done well. Things were hard at the beginning, but you persevered.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 不……我得坚持……无论如何，我得坚持……
dialogText.en: No... I must be strong... No matter what happens, I must keep going...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，让你看到这样狼狈的我。
dialogText.en: Apologies, it's embarrassing that you had to see me in such a mess.

dialogText.cn: 我……没什么不好，这都是过去的事情了。
dialogText.en: I'm ... not feeling terrible. This was all in the past.

dialogText.cn: 在我们眼前的，也仅仅是一段回忆……一段早已度过的岁月。
dialogText.en: What we saw was but a fragment of memories... A moment that had long passed us by.

dialogText.cn: 我们走吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Let's go, Endmin.

actorName.cn: 回忆中的庄方宜{e10m4-回忆中的庄方宜}
actorName.en: Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories {e10m4-Zhuang Fangyi from the Memories}

dialogText.cn: 我愿意……
dialogText.en: I will...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢……管理员。
dialogText.en: Thank you ... Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……为什么？
dialogText.en: ...Why?

dialogText.cn: 一想到沉睡期间，还有许多人仍在继续前进，坚守着这条道路……
dialogText.en: {F}Knowing that while I slept, many continued to forge on and stayed true to the path...{M}Knowing that while I slept, many continued to forge on and stayed true to the path...

dialogText.cn: 就算回想起来一片空白，但因为见到仍在坚守着的你、大家——
dialogText.en: {F}Though I woke without any memories, seeing you and everyone who persisted—{M}Though I woke without any memories, seeing you and everyone who persisted—

dialogText.cn: 我就不那么害怕了。
dialogText.en: {F}—my fears would subside.{M}—my fears would subside.

dialogText.cn: 原来……你也会害怕，管理员。
dialogText.en: So you can feel fear as well, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 是的，我会害怕那些曾与我同行的人，最终却离我而去。
dialogText.en: {F}Yes. I fear that those who once walked with me ... will end up leaving.{M}Yes. I fear that those who once walked with me ... will end up leaving.

dialogText.cn: 我答应你……不会轻易离开。
dialogText.en: I promise you... I won't leave that easily.

dialogText.cn: 裂隙已经稳定下来……界石坪上的灯，也该亮了。
dialogText.en: The rift has stabilized... The light of the Marker Stone Flats should be back on.

dialogText.cn: 一起回去吧。
dialogText.en: Let's head back together.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，你……会离我而去吗？
dialogText.en: {F}Tianshi Zhuang, tell me ... will you leave me?{M}Tianshi Zhuang, tell me ... will you leave me?

dialogText.cn: ……当年科考站制作的竹露，我将它带来了。
dialogText.en: ...Bamboo Brew. It was made by the Science Station team back then, and I brought it along.

dialogText.cn: 前辈们都已经离开，我不知道，还能与谁一起喝……所以一直未曾打开。
dialogText.en: Since my seniors are no longer around, I don't know who to share this with... And so I never opened it.

dialogText.cn: 但你来了。故人重逢……也该共饮一杯。
dialogText.en: But now you're here. An old friend coming to visit ... such a moment calls for a drink.

dialogText.cn: 以前大家制作时，为节约还添了很多农业实验室的边角料，顾不得什么味道了。
dialogText.en: To save resources, we fermented leftovers and scraps from the agro-lab. Taste wasn't on the agenda.

dialogText.cn: 不过，这味道我很喜欢。
dialogText.en: But, this is a flavor ... I'm quite fond of.

dialogText.cn: 还真是从前的味道……
dialogText.en: Truly, the flavors from the past...

dialogText.cn: 品味出什么了吗？
dialogText.en: Taste anything peculiar?

dialogText.cn: 是啊……这不就是从前的味道？
dialogText.en: That's right... Flavors of the past.

dialogText.cn: 很荣幸，接下来的路，能与你同行，管理员。
dialogText.en: It would be my great honor to walk the same path with you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 原来不知不觉间，在武陵的十年就这么过去了……
dialogText.en: Time truly flies... I barely realized a whole decade in Wuling has slipped by...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，武陵对我来说，早已割舍不下。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Wuling has become a part of me.

dialogText.cn: 就算未来真有什么，令我不得不离开，我也终将回到这里。
dialogText.en: No matter what the future holds, even if fate forces me to leave ... my path will always lead me back here.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，和我东奔西跑一整天，你应该也累了，我还是早点送你回去休息吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin, we have been running around all day. I imagine you are exhausted. Shall I see you back so you can rest?

dialogText.cn: 那不如……再一起走走？
dialogText.en: Then ... shall we walk a little more together?

dialogText.cn: 不过，请你放心……武陵和我永远与你同在，我们有着共同的使命。
dialogText.en: But rest assured... Wuling and I will always be with you. We are united by the same cause.

dialogText.cn: 啊，各位来得正好。
dialogText.en: Ah, Endmin, Supervisor Perlica. You came at the right time.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们刚刚进行了一次测试，结果良好，可以开始后续流程。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we just ran another test. Results are quite stellar. We can now progress to the next step.

dialogText.cn: 请在这里使用您的协议同步器连接帝江号，我们会根据请求，校准协议传送的落点。
dialogText.en: Kindly connect your Protocol Synchronizer with OMV Dijiang. We shall, upon your request, proceed to reference it and calibrate the tele-protocol site of the TP-Point accordingly.

dialogText.cn: 是赛希干员吗？很高兴这么快就能听到你的声音。
dialogText.en: Operator Xaihi? I'm glad to hear from you so quickly.

dialogText.cn: 我也很高兴能恢复与枢纽区基地的常规联络。如果占用专线太久，菲奥娜会不开心的。
dialogText.en: Greetings, Supervisor Perlica. I am pleased to re-establish conventional communication with the Hub Base. Had we been forced to rely on the exclusive channel any longer, Communication Officer Fiona might have been displeased.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您可以参考在地面进行协议传送的方式来操作。我们有许多工作需要向各位报告。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, you may reference the use of planetside TP-Points to tele-protocol to Dijiang. We have many work reports to present to you.

dialogText.cn: 工作报告是指……帝江号的修复工程有进展了？
dialogText.en: Work reports...? Are we making progress in the repairs of OMV Dijiang?

dialogText.cn: 比您预期的更快。那么，请各位开始协议传送吧，我们帝江号上见。
dialogText.en: Yes, it is advancing more swiftly than anticipated, Supervisor. Now, please proceed with initiating the tele-protocols. I look forward to our meeting aboard Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 也辛苦你配合校准工作。管理员，赛希是<@qu.key>寂语修会</>向终末地派遣的修会成员，目前也在工程中心执行任务。
dialogText.en: And thank you for helping us with the calibration work. Endmin, Operator Xaihi is the resident liaison from the <@qu.key>Cabal of Tranquility</>. She is currently performing various tasks at our Engineering Division.

dialogText.cn: 我们认为信息与技术最终将为人类带来必要的联系。显然，修理也是一种修行。
dialogText.en: We firmly believe that information and technology will, in time, establish the vital connections that preserve human unity. Equally, we recognize that repair work is also a form of meditative training.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，帝江号上此前空余的舱室，工程中心已经重整完毕，可以投入使用。
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, the Engineering Division has readied the empty cabins aboard Dijiang. They stand prepared for your occupancy.

dialogText.cn: 我们可以优先启用一部分功能。另外，帝江号总控中枢的控制权限也将恢复，请管理员接管。
dialogText.en: We may commence activation of several cabins forthwith. In the meantime, access to the Dijiang Control Nexus will soon be restored. Kindly assume command upon its readiness, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 制造舱的受损程度最低，请各位从这里开始统筹工作吧。
dialogText.en: For the present, we may begin our earnest work from the least compromised Manufacturing Cabin.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎回来，管理员，佩丽卡监督。地天协议传送运作正常，值得祝贺。
dialogText.en: Welcome back, Endministrator, Supervisor Perlica. The surface-to-orbit tele-protocol seems to be operating smoothly. Truly, this calls for a celebration.

dialogText.cn: 是的，帝江号目前还存在许多需要修复的部分。作为寂语修会派遣的合作干员，我有职责对它们进行维护。
dialogText.en: Yes. Many parts of Dijiang are in need of repairs. Cabal of Tranquility is a partner of Endfield. As a liaison from the Cabal, I am duty-bound to carry out the aforementioned repairs.

dialogText.cn: 那座<@qu.key>操作台</>就是这间制造舱的主脑。您可以通过与它交互来完成舱室的人员调配，或者制定生产规划。
dialogText.en: This <@qu.key>control panel</> serves as the main controller of the Manufacturing Cabin. Kindly interact with it to designate personnel or to stipulate production plans.

dialogText.cn: 这个程序似乎与之前的相比优化了不少。
dialogText.en: It seems the software has undergone significant optimizations.

dialogText.cn: 我按照古代知识的遗存，对其进行了一些修改……啊，如果这超出了权限，稍后再给检讨书可以吗？
dialogText.en: Ah, yes ... a few changes were enacted in compliance with the relic scripts of ancient knowledge... Um, if I have transgressed my authorized boundaries, may I submit my written confessions afterwards?

dialogText.cn: 没关系，我是在夸奖啦……
dialogText.en: That ... that won't be necessary, Xaihi. What I meant was that the UI has been improved...

dialogText.cn: 那么，我会等候各位完成设置，请随意使用。
dialogText.en: That is most reassuring to hear... I shall await the completion of your configuration setup. Please feel free to utilize it at your discretion.

dialogText.cn: 核心区的一些舱室也已经完成清理，我们可以使用会客室进行更多情报交流工作了。
dialogText.en: Several cabins within the Kernel Sector of Dijiang have been cleaned up. The Reception Room is now available for Clue Exchange.

dialogText.cn: 另外，我对静滞核心的设备进行了维护，希望能对您有帮助。
dialogText.en: I have also carried out maintenance routines for facilities furnished with the Stasis Core. I pray this may be of help to your endeavor.

dialogText.cn: 只是一个提醒。接下来，我将带您去会客室看看。
dialogText.en: Just a simple reminder, Endministrator. Now, allow me to lead you to the Reception Room.

dialogText.cn: 这里就是会客室。
dialogText.en: This is the Reception Room.

dialogText.cn: 情报区整合了S.O.W.从各种渠道收集的线索，您可以决定如何处理它们——将其汇总，或是分享给有必要的合作者。
dialogText.en: The Intel Section has synthesized clues gathered by the SOW from multiple channels. You may now choose how to manage them — either compile them, or extend them to partners who may benefit.

dialogText.cn: 这些线索交流工作可以给我们带来诸多益处，S.O.W.和管理中枢会将其量化为“信用”，方便你进行资源管理。
dialogText.en: Clue Exchange will give us plenty of benefits. The SOW and Management Axis will quantify them into credits. You can then use this currency for resource management.

dialogText.cn: 另外，展示区的修理也完成了。您可以在这里展示终末地的一些成就。寂语大教堂里就镶嵌了一只天使，效果很好。
dialogText.en: We have also repaired the Display Section. This is where you can showcase the various achievements of Endfield. The Sanctilamina Cathedralis Tranquillae has an embedded Aggelos and it has exerted rather impressive effects.

dialogText.cn: 那样还是有点太……前卫了。不过你说得对，恰当的展示可以让访客们更容易理解我们正在推进的工作。
dialogText.en: That might be a little ... too avant-garde for us. But you are right. A good Display Section will be effective. Visitors will get a better understanding of our work at Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 会客室的所有功能已经准备就绪，您可以直接尝试一下。
dialogText.en: The Reception Room is now prepared for use in full. You are welcome to explore its functions at your convenience.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>总控中枢</>就在前面。
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>Control Nexus</> is just ahead.

dialogText.cn: ——嗯？奇怪……不是刚重置过么……
dialogText.en: ——Hmm? Strange... It was reconfigured just a short while ago...

dialogText.cn: 没关系，赛希干员，去处理你的任务吧。
dialogText.en: That's alright, Operator Xaihi. You are always free to work on your mission.

dialogText.cn: 技术总务委员会的那位萨卡兹在找我，还请允许我暂离片刻。
dialogText.en: The Sarkaz from the General Technological Committee seeks my presence. Please allow my temporary absence.

dialogText.cn: 你曾经和寂语修会共享过许多重要资料，他们的技术进步与你直接相关。因此，我们能够分享一些关键的技术任务。
dialogText.en: You once shared numerous critical data with the Cabal of Tranquility. Their technological achievements are directly tied to your actions. This is why we could share a number of key technical projects with them.

dialogText.cn: 施予信任，收获帮助。终末地和文明环带的其他成员就是这样互相扶持至今的。
dialogText.en: Sow the seeds of trust and reap a harvest of friendship. This is how Endfield and the other factions of the Civilization Band have supported each other to this day.

dialogText.cn: 总控中枢就在前面，我们走吧。
dialogText.en: The Control Nexus is before us. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 它始终都是只有你才能完全驾驭的航船。这一天，帝江号已经等待了十年。
dialogText.en: Only you can truly command Dijiang. The ship has waited ten years for this very moment.

dialogText.cn: 请相信自己，管理员。你亲手完成了它，事实不会改变。
dialogText.en: Have faith in yourself, Endmin. You were the one who built this ship. There is no changing this fact.

dialogText.cn: 帝江号控制权限已经成功开启。
dialogText.en: Dijiang control authority level has been successfully activated.

dialogText.cn: 现在，你可以在这里看到整个帝江号的运行状况了。
dialogText.en: You can now monitor the entire operations of Dijiang at this very place.

dialogText.cn: 各位，后续的扩建发展规划也会在舰桥进行，我们会在这里进行全部的升级工作。
dialogText.en: Endfielders, the next step of our expansion and growth shall be directed from the Bridge. All upgrades shall be carried out right here.

dialogText.cn: 能听见你这句话，我们追随的，就不再是一个虚影了。
dialogText.en: Hearing those words from you is enough for us. They prove that we're no longer chasing after a shadow.

dialogText.cn: 这些年来，石棺里的那个人和所有的传说故事一样，都开始变得模糊了。我很怕忘记你的模样。
dialogText.en: In recent years, the one in the Sarcophagus has gradually faded from people's memory, along with those legends. I was afraid of forgetting who you really are.

dialogText.cn: 但我现在真的非常庆幸，能再一次见到你，和你并肩作战。
dialogText.en: But now ... how fortunate we are ... to finally see you again and fight by your side.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，S.O.W.已经搜集到了一些信息。
dialogText.en: Endmin, the SOW has gathered some clues.

dialogText.cn: 在你恢复记忆之前，我本来不希望你以这种形式了解这个世界……但现在，根据“零号委托”的条款，我不得不提前让你知道这一切。
dialogText.en: I was hoping that before your memory recovers, you would learn about this world through experience rather than my faint words... But given the provisions of the Zeroth Directive, I must now simply share the essential information.

dialogText.cn: 请随我来。
dialogText.en: Please follow me.

dialogText.cn: 沉睡之前，你也喜欢在这里看着塔卫二。
dialogText.en: You enjoyed looking at Talos-II from this place before your slumber.

dialogText.cn: 我们漫长的旅途。以及在旅途中发现的，新的威胁。
dialogText.en: Our long journey, what we found out, and the new threats we face.

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯是个危险的预兆，我们必须保持警惕，不能让历史重演。
dialogText.en: Nefarith is a dangerous sign of what is to come. We must be alert or history may repeat itself.

dialogText.cn: ……在她之前，已经很久没有出现了。
dialogText.en: ...None appeared for many years, until she did.

dialogText.cn: 如果提前知情，我一定不会同意你离开帝江号的。不能用你的安危当赌注，也许——
dialogText.en: If I had known about her, I would have never agreed to let you leave Dijiang. Your safety is our top priority. Maybe we could...

dialogText.cn: 明白了。我……终末地工业就在这里，我们和你在一起。
dialogText.en: Understood. I will... Endfield Industries will always stand by you. We're all with you.

dialogText.cn: 回来的感觉真好。
dialogText.en: {F}Feels good to be back.{M}Feels good to be back.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我现在这么说好像有点奇怪……
dialogText.en: {F}Apologies. Probably not the best time to say that...{M}Apologies. Probably not the best time to say that...

dialogText.cn: 没关系，这里一直都是你的家。
dialogText.en: It's okay. This place has always been your home.

dialogText.cn: 休息一会儿吧。等大家都休整完毕之后，我们就再次前往四号谷地。
dialogText.en: Let's take a break. Once everyone's fully rested, we will return to Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！你还好吗？有没有伤到哪里？
dialogText.en: Endministrator! You alright? Are you hurt?

dialogText.cn: 我也没事，但剩下的路只能步行了。
dialogText.en: I'm okay, but we'll have to walk the rest of the way.

dialogText.cn: 天使竟然已经深入到了这里，现场形势比评估中的还要严峻。
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi even managed to reach this place. The situation in the field is far more severe than our previous estimates.

dialogText.cn: 真希望欢迎的热情能减退一些……
dialogText.en: I actually hoped for a gentler reception than this...

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督！你们来得太及时了！我们的临时防线出现了缺口，要不是有你们……
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica! You arrived at just the right time! Our temporary defenses have been breached. If you weren't here...

dialogText.cn: 你们没事就好，现在情况如何？
dialogText.en: And I'm glad that you're alright, Director Qin. I believe you have a sitrep for me.

dialogText.cn: 有个<@qu.key>锚点</>突然坠入了基地内部，正在不断制造天使……
dialogText.en: Yes. An <@qu.key>Ankhor</> fell right into the Base. The thing won't stop spawning the Aggeloi...

dialogText.cn: 伤员们都安置在中控塔，但是天使数量太多，防卫科就快顶不住了。
dialogText.en: We've sent all our injured personnel to the Control Tower. There are just too many Aggeloi and they will overrun our Security Division eventually.

dialogText.cn: 得想办法让锚点停下……
dialogText.en: We must find a way to stop the Ankhor...

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，这位是？
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, may I ask who this...

dialogText.cn: 啊……这位就是管理员。
dialogText.en: Ah, of course... This, is our Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？这就是那位传闻中的管理员？！
dialogText.en: Endministrator!? Are we talking about THE Endministrator!?

dialogText.cn: 啊……抱歉，四号谷地有很多干员都没有见过管理员，听说了您苏醒的消息，难免有些猜想。
dialogText.en: Ah ... apologies. Many operators in Valley IV have never seen you before, Endmin. News of your awakening gave rise to plenty of gossip and rumors.

dialogText.cn: 接到帝江号通知时，大家还想准备一个迎接仪式，结果没过几天就发生了袭击……没想到你们还是来了。
dialogText.en: When we received the message from Dijiang, the entire crew tried to plan a welcoming ceremony. But just a few days later, we were suddenly attacked... I didn't expect you to arrive here in the midst of the battle.

dialogText.cn: 秦工程师，其他失散人员情况怎么样，还有多少人在外面？
dialogText.en: We're here to help, Director Qin. Do we have any news about the missing personnel? How many of our people are outside the Base?

dialogText.cn: 很难确定，天使源源不断，防卫科也只能保证这附近的安全……
dialogText.en: It's hard to say. The Aggeloi just kept attacking. Security Division can only maintain a limited security perimeter...

dialogText.cn: 危机迫在眉睫，原定安排就推后吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: People here are in danger. I suggest we delay our earlier arrangements, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，管理员，我就知道你会这样说……
dialogText.en: Good, Endministrator. I knew you would say that...

dialogText.cn: 秦工程师，我们会帮忙解决敌人的，也会让失散的工人们来中控塔避难。
dialogText.en: Director Qin, we'll handle the hostiles in the Base and direct any of your missing staff to the Control Tower for safety.

dialogText.cn: 太好了……这样我就放心多了，麻烦你们了。
dialogText.en: Wonderful... Your help will set my mind at ease. Good luck out there.

dialogText.cn: 另外，我没有看到<@qu.key>安德烈</>先生，他在哪儿？
dialogText.en: By the way, I'm not seeing Mr. <@qu.key>Andre</> anywhere. Where is he right now?

dialogText.cn: ……啊啊！这老头，估计又去逞英雄了！
dialogText.en: ...ARRGGH! That silly old man! He went off trying to be a hero again!

dialogText.cn: 他总是这样，觉得工作成果能比自己的老命还重要！
dialogText.en: That fool never stops treating his projects with far more respect than his own feathery hide!

dialogText.cn: 要是你们见到他，就立刻把他绑回中控塔来！整个基地里……现在就这里最安全了。
dialogText.en: Anyway, if you see that old fool, tie him up and haul him back to the Control Tower... This might be the only safe place left in the Base.

dialogText.cn: 请放心，我们会找到他的。
dialogText.en: We'll find him. Have faith in us.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>旧工厂区</>的锚点还在制造天使，必须先解决这个威胁。出发吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: The Ankhor at the <@qu.key>Old Factory</> is still spawning Aggeloi. We must first eliminate this threat. Time to initiate our mission, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有什么需要了解的信息吗？
dialogText.en: Endministrator, is there anything you wish to know?

dialogText.cn: 锚点是从天而降的构造体，它们会抽取附近的地下矿物，制造危险的天使……我们从过往经验中总结出了一系列应对方式，但至今不知道锚点的源头。
dialogText.en: Ankhors are constructs that fall from the sky. After landing, they extract soil minerals to create the Aggeloi... We figured out how to take out the Ankhors, but we still have no idea where they come from.

dialogText.cn: 当然，组成天使的物质十分多样。极端情况下，它们甚至会用周围的生物质组装天使……那样的情形不多见了，但还是让人毛骨悚然。
dialogText.en: Of course. The Aggeloi are composed of a wide range of materials. In extreme scenarios, Ankhors can even use nearby biomass to build new Aggeloi... Though such incidents are rare, they can be horrifying to behold.

dialogText.cn: 只有破坏锚点，才不会出现新的天使。这样，枢纽区基地的重建工作才可以开展。
dialogText.en: The Ankhor must be taken out to stop the Aggeloi from spawning. This must be done before we can start rebuilding the Hub Base.

dialogText.cn: 中控塔的应急屏障还在运作，安保人员尽全力抵挡住了几波攻击，但也只是堪堪守住。
dialogText.en: The emergency barrier of the Control Tower is still working. Our security team did their best and fought off a few attacks, but they're barely holding on.

dialogText.cn: 暂时还没有死亡报告，但有许多人受伤，各处设施也损毁严重。大部分干员都集中到了中控塔一楼，至于安德烈……我希望他没事……
dialogText.en: No deaths have been reported so far but we have plenty of injuries and our facilities took heavy damage. Most of our staff evacuated to the first floor of the Control Tower. As for Andre ... I just hope he's alright...

dialogText.cn: 这种僵持不可能一直持续下去，如果你们没有及时赶到……我都不敢想象……现在，终于可以松一口气了。
dialogText.en: There's no way we can outlast the Aggeloi. I can hardly imagine what would happen if you weren't here... But since you are, the worst is finally behind us.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，请务必注意安全。如果见到失散的干员，就让他们也来中控塔避难。
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, Endministrator ... please be careful out there. If you see any scattered personnel, tell them to evac to the Control Tower.

dialogText.cn: 这就是锚点……但<@qu.key>核心</>并不在这里。
dialogText.en: This is the Ankhor... But its <@qu.key>core</> is not here.

dialogText.cn: 不，那只是锚点在运作的正常反应……锚点扎入了地下，看来核心在更下方。
dialogText.en: No. All active Ankhors give off that light... This Ankhor plunged itself deep underground. That's where its core should be.

dialogText.cn: 我曾经看过枢纽区基地的结构图，旧工厂区的下方应该有可通行的地下区域。
dialogText.en: I've seen the Hub Base building plans. This Old Factory should have an underground floor that we could reach.

dialogText.cn: 只要结构稳定，我们就可以直接去摧毁锚点的核心。走吧，管理员，应该是这条路。
dialogText.en: If this basement area is stable, we should be able to reach and destroy the Ankhor core. Let's go, Endmin. This should be the way.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督？万幸，你们总算来了。
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica? Thank goodness, you're finally here.

dialogText.cn: 锚点坠落后，我们集合在室内，勉强守住了这里……好吧，五分钟前还能守住。
dialogText.en: We assembled here after the Ankhorfall and managed to hold on to this place... Okay, I guess we held on to this place until five minutes ago.

dialogText.cn: 我明白，但我得先照顾好这里的伤员……等等，你们也受伤了？
dialogText.en: I understand, but I must tend to the wounded... Wait. You're injured as well.

dialogText.cn: 你们没事吧！
dialogText.en: Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 这里就是<@qu.key>荞花</>的种植点，<@qu.key>荞花粉末</>是常见的药品原料，制作也很简单。带上一些吧，会有用的。
dialogText.en: This is where we grow <@qu.key>Buckflowers</>. <@qu.key>Buckflower Powder</> is a common pharmaceutical ingredient and it's easy to make. Take some. They'll come in useful.

dialogText.cn: ……这样我就放心些了。
dialogText.en: ...This will give me a peace of mind.

dialogText.cn: 我会留在这里照料伤员，然后尽可能和秦主管会合。期待你们的好消息。
dialogText.en: I'll stay here and care for the injured for now, and then join up with Director Qin when we could start moving again. I look forward to your good news.

dialogText.cn: 哼哼！怎么样，刚才那招是不是还不赖？
dialogText.en: Hehe! Awesome, right? What do you think of that move?

dialogText.cn: 嘿，下次给你看看更厉害的，保证一剑一个！
dialogText.en: Heh. I'll show you an even deadlier killer move next time. A single swing will take anything out! Guaranteed!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我是<@qu.key>陈千语</>！往后遇到什么不好搞定的对手，尽管交给我。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, I'm <@qu.key>Chen Qianyu</>, or Chen for short! If you got a problem you need trimming, my blade is yours to command.

dialogText.cn: 哦？还挺有眼光的嘛。刚才出剑慌了一点。
dialogText.en: Oh. So you are familiar with swordmancy. Yeah, I swung it a little too fast.

dialogText.cn: 没事，下次让你看看更厉害的！
dialogText.en: Anyways, I'll show you an even deadlier move next time!

dialogText.cn: 言归正传！管理员，我是<@qu.key>陈千语</>。往后遇到什么不好搞定的对手，尽管交给我。
dialogText.en: Back to business! Endmin, I'm <@qu.key>Chen Qianyu</>, or Chen for short! If you got a problem you need trimming, my blade is yours to command.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡也和我提过你！她每次一讲起管理员的故事就完全停不下来——
dialogText.en: Perlica also told me about you! Every time she mentions the Endmin, she just goes on and on and on —

dialogText.cn: 咳！总之，先确认一下安德烈先生的情况……
dialogText.en: Ahem! We ... should check on Mr. Andre...

dialogText.cn: 嗯唔……呃……痛痛痛……
dialogText.en: Hnggg... Hrrk... This hurts...

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生，你还好么？
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre, are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 实验室……原型机……敌人呢，你们把敌人都赶跑了？你们——
dialogText.en: The lab ... the Prototype... Enemies?! Did you fight them off? You, you are—

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员？！您真回来了？
dialogText.en: End — ENDMIN?! You're really back!

dialogText.cn: 没伤着哪儿吧？预定时间不是十天后吗？您怎么戴着这东西？
dialogText.en: I thought you'd be here ten days later! You're not hurt, are you? And what's with the mask?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这位安德烈先生是终末地的常驻技术专家，也是集成工业系统的总工程师。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this is Mr. Andre, our resident Endfield technical expert at this site. He is also the chief engineer of the Automated Industry Complex.

dialogText.cn: 我一看到旧工厂区被锚点击中了，就赶紧跑过来检查<@qu.key>原型机</>有没有事。喏，就是它。
dialogText.en: Ah ... that's because I saw the Ankhor crashing into the Old Factory, so I rushed over here to check if the <@qu.key>Prototype</> was alright. Look, here it is.

dialogText.cn: 就是你刚才保护的设备吗？这么宝贝，它一定费了你不少心血……
dialogText.en: Is this the contraption you were protecting? It looks really expensive! You must have spent quite a bit of time on it...

dialogText.cn: 不完全是我的作品，这是我的一个朋友留下的原型机，还好有你们出手。
dialogText.en: It would be unfair to say that this is my work. A friend of mine left this Prototype to me. I'm very grateful that you came here and saved it.

dialogText.cn: 现在……锚点是破坏掉了，附近应该不会有新的天使出现了，我们得尽快恢复基地运作才行。
dialogText.en: Now that the Ankhor has been taken out ... there shouldn't be any more Aggeloi around. We should quickly get our base back up and running.

dialogText.cn: 交给我们吧。另外，秦工程师让你立刻回中控塔。
dialogText.en: Leave it to us. By the way, Director Qin requests your immediate return to the Control Tower.

dialogText.cn: 她找我的时候……啥表情啊？很生气吗？
dialogText.en: Oh. So ... what was she like when she asked about me? Was she angry?
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 唉……完了。
dialogText.en: Oh dear... I'm finished.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了，管理员。也幸亏你及时赶到，陈。
dialogText.en: Nicely done, Endmin. And thank goodness you arrived on time, Chen.

dialogText.cn: 总之，人来了就好。管理员，我们成功了！十年，整整十年，您留下的课题终于有突破了！
dialogText.en: Never mind that — thank goodness you're back. Endmin, it's been ten years! We finally did it! We cracked the project you left behind!

dialogText.cn: 普契尼和波波夫可算能瞑目了，他们最后还在遗憾，没能把方案亲手提交给您——
dialogText.en: Puccini and Popov can finally rest in peace. During their final moments, they lamented that they couldn't deliver this solution into your hands—

dialogText.cn: 咳咳……
dialogText.en: Ahem...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？佩丽卡监督，你突然这么正式介绍我干什么？
dialogText.en: Uh, what's with the formal intro, Supervisor Perlica?

dialogText.cn: 等等，难道管理员已经忘记……
dialogText.en: Wait. Did Endmin really forget...

dialogText.cn: ……这不公平！为什么最后遭罪的总是……唉。
dialogText.en: ...This isn't fair! Why?! Why does suffering always happen to... *Sigh*.

dialogText.cn: 稍后再详细说明吧。安德烈先生，你为什么会冒险赶到这里来？
dialogText.en: We should set aside the details for later. Now, Mr. Andre, why did you risk your safety to rush to this place?

dialogText.cn: 全频道广播，全频道广播。
dialogText.en: This is an all-channel broadcast. I repeat. This is an all-channel broadcast.

dialogText.cn: 防卫科全部武装人员，尽快向基地入口集结。重复，尽快向基地入口集结。完毕。
dialogText.en: All Security Division combatants are to assemble at the base entrance ASAP. I repeat. Assemble at the base entrance ASAP. Over.

dialogText.cn: 看来秦工程师那里也需要帮助。
dialogText.en: I believe Director Qin needs help at her place.

dialogText.cn: 你们赶紧去会合吧，我再检查检查机器，马上就到。
dialogText.en: Go and assemble. I'll be with you shortly once I'm done checking the machines.

dialogText.cn: 外面这些损伤不好评估……我得检查下内部结构。
dialogText.en: Assessing exterior damage is difficult... I also need to check the interior structure.

dialogText.cn: 先不着急去见秦主管……
dialogText.en: Gotta figure out a way to delay the meeting with Director Qin... Oh dear...

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？还是伤到哪里了吗？
dialogText.en: Doing okay? Did you get hurt?

dialogText.cn: 刚、刚才晕过去的时候崴着脚了……老了，真是老了。
dialogText.en: I ... uh ... probably sprained my ankle when I passed out... Ughhh... Age is really catching up on me.

dialogText.cn: ……唉！管理员，佩丽卡，你们先走吧，我照顾一下这位胖——安德烈先生。
dialogText.en: ...Okay... I guess you can leave first, Endmin and Perlica. I'll watch over the Big Owl—I mean ... Mr. Andre.

dialogText.cn: 秦工程师，出什么事……
dialogText.en: What's going on, Director Qin...

dialogText.cn: 裂地者……这么多？
dialogText.en: Landbreakers ... and so many of them.

dialogText.cn: 恐怕这还不算最麻烦的，你看。
dialogText.en: This isn't the worst of it. Look over there.

dialogText.cn: 那个方向……是协议核心的预定部署区。
dialogText.en: That place... It's the deployment area we reserved for the Automation-Core.

dialogText.cn: 狼烟规模不小，部署区附近已经被完全占领。
dialogText.en: From the scale of the rising smoke columns, the deployment area has completely fallen.

dialogText.cn: 明明周围全都是天使，他们还是渗透到这里了……为什么我们一点征兆都没发现呢？！
dialogText.en: This area was completely surrounded by Aggeloi, yet these bandits still got through... How did they manage to slip in without anyone noticing?

dialogText.cn: 看来刚才的裂地者只是先头部队……秦工程师，有什么我们能利用的吗？
dialogText.en: Those Landbreakers we encountered were probably just their vanguard... Director Qin, is there anything we can use?

dialogText.cn: 防卫科尽可能收集了一些信息，这就同步给二位。
dialogText.en: Security Division gathered as much intel as they could. I'll sync it with you.

dialogText.cn: 不是有我们在嘛。管理员，你也看到了，我对付这些裂地者可是得心应手。
dialogText.en: You got a team of pros, Director Qin. Endmin, you saw what I did, right? I know tons about fighting these scummy LBs!

dialogText.cn: 这把老骨头实在没法舞刀弄棒了……不过协议核心的事情，我还是帮得上忙的。
dialogText.en: I'm afraid my creaky bones won't let me swing a weapon... But I can still offer plenty of help with the Automation-Core.

dialogText.cn: 但是……是不是再计划一下？外面那么多敌人……
dialogText.en: But ... should we come up with a more ... foolproof plan? There are just so many LBs outside...

dialogText.cn: 放心吧，秦工程师。
dialogText.en: Have faith in us, Director Qin.

dialogText.cn: 我不只是终末地的监督，同时，我也是终末地危机处理小组的一员。
dialogText.en: I'm not just the Supervisor of Endfield Industries. I'm also the acting lead of the Endfield Crisis Team.

dialogText.cn: 现在我也是啦，正式打个招呼——管理员，请不吝赐教！
dialogText.en: I'm part of it too! Excited to work with you, Endmin! I'm sure there's a lot I can learn from you.

dialogText.cn: 好嘞，让我们去教训一下那些不知天高地厚的面具土匪吧。
dialogText.en: Alrighty! Now let's go and teach those pipefaces what happens when you mess with Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我其实希望你能留在这里。裂地者和天使截然不同，你现在的状态……
dialogText.en: Endministrator, I ... I'd actually prefer it if you can just stay and rest here. Fighting the Landbreakers is very different from fighting the Aggeloi. The conditions of your health...

dialogText.cn: ……谢谢你。
dialogText.en: ...Much appreciated, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 就是这样，秦工程师。我们会尽可能解除敌人的力量，在指定地点降下协议核心，通过中继器运输电力，恢复基地运转。
dialogText.en: So we have a conclusion, Director Qin. The Crisis Team will whittle down enemy forces, deploy the PAC at the designated site, and transmit power back to Base with relay towers to restore Base operations.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生，等确保路线安全，我会再联系你。抱歉让你深入荒野，但我们需要你的帮助。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre, I'll contact you once the roads are clear. Apologies for forcing you to travel into the wildlands, but we will need your help.

dialogText.cn: 没问题，不如说能帮得上忙，我心里还舒坦些呢。
dialogText.en: No problem! I feel so much better knowing I can finally help everyone properly this time!

dialogText.cn: 先不说这个逞能的老头，管理员，陈千语干员，佩丽卡监督，你们可要万分小心。
dialogText.en: Stop puffing up your feathers, old man. Endministrator, Supervisor Perlica, and Operator Chen, do be careful out there.

dialogText.cn: 对了，协议传送点独立于电力系统运作，如果你们遇到危机，不要勉强，可以回到这里多做整备。
dialogText.en: Before I forget, the TP Point is not part of the Base's power system. If there's something more than you can handle, just head back to Base and rest.

dialogText.cn: ……就交给你们了。
dialogText.en: ...We're counting on you.

dialogText.cn: 哎哟！管理员！还有什么事情吗？……我就是再看看，有小千语在这儿，不会有意外的！
dialogText.en: Whoa, Endministrator! Is there anything else? I ... I have to take a closer look at this. It won't take long! Chen will keep me safe, don't worry!

dialogText.cn: 锚点……它们从北方飞向各地，在落点制造天使。对我们来说，它就像自然灾害一样危险。
dialogText.en: Ankhors... From the north they come, flying to various spots of the world, and spawning the Aggeloi where they land. In our eyes, they seem just as dangerous as natural disasters.

dialogText.cn: 现在我们还很难预判锚点的出现时机和位置，如果来不及拦截它，就只能等落地后直接破坏核心，阻止它继续活动。
dialogText.en: We still have trouble predicting the appearance of Ankhors and their landing sites. If we fail to intercept them and let them land, our only option is to destroy their cores and stop their activities.

dialogText.cn: 话说回来，已经很久没见过这么大规模的锚点袭击了，到底是怎么回事……
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, we haven't seen an Ankhor strike of such a scale for a really, really long time. What on Talos is happening...?

dialogText.cn: 这是我一个朋友留下的装置。我正在给它加装隔热涂层和运动拓展模块，还有其他一些东西。
dialogText.en: A machine that a friend of mine left here. I'm giving it a heat insulation coating and an expanded mobility module, amongst other modifications.

dialogText.cn: 就在刚才，我眼看着锚点直直砸到了这儿，可把我吓坏了！
dialogText.en: I literally saw how that Ankhor plunged into this place with my own eyes just a while ago. Hoooo. It got my feathers all ruffled up and I totally freaked out!

dialogText.cn: 要是它坏在我手里，真不知道要怎么跟<@qu.key>伊冯</>交代。
dialogText.en: If the Prototype got destroyed under my care, I wouldn't know how to tell <@qu.key>Yvonne</> the bad news.

dialogText.cn: 看来您确实还没有恢复过来。虽然佩丽卡监督提到过这种可能性，但……唉，太可惜了！
dialogText.en: Well, it seems your recovery isn't complete. Supervisor Perlica did mention this possibility, but ... *Sigh*. This is such a shame!

dialogText.cn: 咱们以前合作过不少项目呢，从协议传送设备的系统化到在地部署方案的集成改良，还有集成工业——
dialogText.en: We worked on plenty of projects! Systematization of the tele-protocols, overall optimization to local deployment plans, and the AIC Factory itself ——

dialogText.cn: 算了，先不说这个。总之，这里到处都是您带领我们一起努力的结晶。哪怕人忘记了，数据和设备也不会忘的。
dialogText.en: Let's not dwell on the past for now. In any case, everything you see here is the fruit of your leadership. Together, we made this happen. People might forget, but data and machinery would retain records and logs.

dialogText.cn: 线路接口正常，我之前还担心新旧设备的匹配问题……
dialogText.en: Good, connection interfaces look normal. I was worried about compatibility issues between our old and new equipment.

dialogText.cn: 看你们终末地鼓捣了这么多年，没想到用起来真就是一眨眼的工夫……这技术太厉害了。
dialogText.en: I thought you Endfielders would never finish that project of yours. But you just deployed it in a flash... This tech is incredible.

dialogText.cn: 只消一夜，荒野里也能建起庇护所——这就是集成工业技术想要达成的未来。
dialogText.en: We now only need a single night to construct a proper shelter in the wildlands — This is the future that we want to achieve with our AIC Factory technology.

dialogText.cn: 干得不错嘛，胖大鸟……呃……安德烈先生！
dialogText.en: You did a great job, Big Owl ... oh, uh, I ... I mean, Mr. Andre.

dialogText.cn: 千语大侠今天怎么这么有礼貌，我都不习惯了。除了刚见面那会儿，你总共喊过我几次“先生”？
dialogText.en: Oh ho, why so polite today, Master Chen? You got my feathers tingling and fluffed. I can hardly recall the last time you called me Mister Andre.

dialogText.cn: ……我没有！
dialogText.en: Uh ... I've always been like this!

dialogText.cn: 我们刚开始修理通讯节点，暂时无法联络其他区域，枢纽区也到处都人手不足。
dialogText.en: Yes, we could definitely use the support. The comms node is still under repair, so we can't contact other regions yet. And we're short-handed across the entire Hub.

dialogText.cn: ……我们当年的梦想，终于又迈出了一大步。
dialogText.en: What was once our dream ... has finally made a major stride forward.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，枢纽区基地已经恢复供电了，非常感谢各位！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Supervisor Perlica! Power is back online at the Hub Base! Thank you so much!

dialogText.cn: 收到。秦工程师，协议核心运作状况良好，也许我们可以进行更多的测试。还有什么需要帮忙的地方吗？
dialogText.en: Roger that, Director Qin. The Automation-Core is working well. Perhaps we can run a few more tests. Is there anything else we can help with?

dialogText.cn: 眼下最麻烦的是源石副产物中心。如果那里出现意外，后果不可估量……我这就把现场资料传给大家。
dialogText.en: Right now, the biggest problem is the Originium Byproduct Processing Center. If anything happens to that place, the results could be disastrous... I'm forwarding information on the site to you.

dialogText.cn: 还好……我还不至于被这么几个裂地者打垮。等等，你们是终末地的人！太好了，我看到锚点落到你们基地里，还在想要不要去帮忙呢。
dialogText.en: Hooo... I'm okay. Those LB scab eaters won't beat me that easily. Wait. You're Endfielders! I saw that Ankhor fall right into your Base. I was just thinking about helping you out!

dialogText.cn: 天使和裂地者接二连三地往这儿跑，实在招架不住。他们一路破墙拆窗的，我们只能边打边撤……
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi and LBs kept trying to get into this place while tearing apart everything we built. We could barely hold them, and had no choice but to beat a fighting retreat...

dialogText.cn: 总之，谢谢你们！我得先修好这里的设施，然后回去敲死这群土匪强盗。
dialogText.en: Anyway, appreciate the help! I gotta fix our facilities here. Once I'm done with that, I'll go bandit-smashing with my hammer right here.

dialogText.cn: 我还有两个兄弟，要是你们在路上见到一个埃拉菲亚和一个丰蹄，记得让他们带上家伙什儿，我先准备起来！
dialogText.en: I still have two buddies out there. If you see an Elafia and Forte, tell them to bring their arsenal. I'll get myself ready for a major slugfest!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们……真丢脸……竟然被这些小毛贼抓起来羞辱……
dialogText.en: Thank you so much... I got jumped by these pipefaced rascals... Darn it, that was embarrassing.

dialogText.cn: 小毛贼……裂地者对于普通人而言，还是挺危险的一群人吧……
dialogText.en: Rascals...? Well, Landbreakers can be rather dangerous to the ordinary folk, you know...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？看模样，你们是终末地的人？那看来锚点的事儿解决了？
dialogText.en: Dangerous indeed. You look like Endfielders. I guess you ... took care of your Ankhor problem.

dialogText.cn: 基地暂时安全。不过裂地者的入侵仍是意料之外，我们正是来解决这个问题的。
dialogText.en: Our Base is safe for now. However, we also had to fight off an unexpected Landbreaker raid. We're out here to solve the issue.

dialogText.cn: 干掉所有裂地者？
dialogText.en: Solve the issue? That means every last one of those breaker scum, right?

dialogText.cn: 这我倒是没意见……不过当务之急是确保路线安全。基地里现在到处都是伤员，我们得赶紧恢复基地运作。
dialogText.en: I am totally for that, but ... I guess our priority is to secure the roads. Since so many of our people are injured, we should restore Base operations first.

dialogText.cn: ……好。丢了一次脸，这次不能再给你们添麻烦了。
dialogText.en: ...Agreed. You bailed me out of a bad sitch. I won't let that happen again.

dialogText.cn: 等我确认设施没事，就立刻回去。路上见到我其他两个兄弟的话，就喊他们找我。
dialogText.en: I'll head back once I've verified the facilities are alright. If you see my two other brothers out there, tell 'em to look for me.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？我还以为是他们两个……你们是终末地的人？
dialogText.en: Joining the party...? Oh... You're Endfielders. I thought you're with them.

dialogText.cn: 是，你受伤了……这是你干的？
dialogText.en: Yes, we're Endfielders. You're wounded... And ... did you do all this?

dialogText.cn: 算是吧。天使我对付不来，但这些流寇空有一身蛮力，还不如在艾什柏环岛打黑拳的。
dialogText.en: I probably did. I got no ideas on fighting the buggerloids, but these raiders? Pfft. All muscle but no brains. I fought worthier opponents in the underground arenas of the Asphalt Roundabout.

dialogText.cn: 我们会确保一条相对安全的路线通向枢纽区基地。你可以回到那里接受治疗。
dialogText.en: We're trying to create a safe route to the Hub Base. You can go there to receive medical treatment.

dialogText.cn: 对了，这家伙晕过去前我问了他两句，他话都说不清楚，但似乎是从北边来的。
dialogText.en: Great. Oh, by the way, I kindly asked this pipeface here a few questions before he passed out. Blightbrain could hardly form a coherent sentence, but he sounds northern.

dialogText.cn: 北边好像隐隐能看到些什么。不过现在我可管不了了……
dialogText.en: I could faintly make out signs of trouble up north, but I have other business to take care of here...

dialogText.cn: 这些家伙好像都不知道害怕……你们没事吧？
dialogText.en: These LBs really aren't scared of anything, huh? Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 有点奇怪。裂地者已经在这里扎了营，但附近区域还有很多东西没被搬走。
dialogText.en: This is strange. The Landbreakers have built a camp here, but they did not loot the nearby areas.

dialogText.cn: 损失变小了，这不是好事吗？
dialogText.en: That means we kept most of our stuff, right? Sounds like good news to me.

dialogText.cn: 但不合常理。这些流浪匪帮往往是为了掠夺生存物资才入侵聚居地，我本以为会看到更糟糕的情景。
dialogText.en: But it makes no sense. These raiders often raid various sites and settlements for essential resources. I was expecting to see devastation.

dialogText.cn: 也就是说，他们放着附近的好东西不管，也要守住这里……比起“掠夺”，更像在“占领”。
dialogText.en: So you're saying that they left most of the loot nearby but stayed put here... It's not raiding, more like occupying!

dialogText.cn: 占领……？
dialogText.en: Occupying...?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督！我和清理队伍已经上路了，你们先等等！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Supervisor Perlica! I'm on my way with a cleanup crew! Please wait for us!

dialogText.cn: 啊，是胖大鸟——他怎么光提你们俩呢？
dialogText.en: Oh, it's Big Owl! Wait, he didn't mention my name?

dialogText.cn: 裂地者的事稍后再说吧，部署协议核心要紧。安德烈先生和工人们马上就会赶到，我们可以一起清理这片……违章建筑。
dialogText.en: We'll talk about the Landbreakers later. Our priority is to deploy the Automation-Core. Since Andre and his crew are arriving soon, we can clean this site of their ... illegal and unwanted structures.

dialogText.cn: 了解，我和管理员马上准备部署工作。
dialogText.en: Understood. The Endmin and I shall initiate deployment at once.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，<@qu.key>协议核心</>受到最高加密保护，只有你的权限才能引导它降落。
dialogText.en: Endmin, the <@qu.key>PAC</> is protected by the highest levels of encryption. Only you can authorize its deployment.

dialogText.cn: 哎哟……腿脚没以前利索了，这点活差点没累死我。
dialogText.en: Hooo... My legs are giving out. This physical work almost got me killed.

dialogText.cn: 总算把场地清理干净了。朋友们，事不宜迟，我们这就开始吧！
dialogText.en: Anyway, This place is cleaned up. No time to lose now. Let's get started!

dialogText.cn: 慢点慢点，你今天似乎格外积极啊。
dialogText.en: Wow, let's just take it easy. You seem super excited today.

dialogText.cn: 那当然了，我们最开始来枢纽区基地，就是为了筹备集成工业系统的生产和测试工作！
dialogText.en: Of course I am! Our goal in coming to the Hub Base is to prepare the AIC Factory! We gotta run it through a field test and production trials!

dialogText.cn: 当然，没想到最后会在这种情况下进行……
dialogText.en: Though I must admit ... I never expected to do it under such dire circumstances.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，你们的协议申请已收到。权限复核完毕，随时可以进行<@qu.key>协议核心</>的投放。
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, we've received your Protocol application and verified all access authority levels. You may issue the order for <@qu.key>PAC</> deployment any time now.

dialogText.cn: 一切已经准备就绪……让我们开始吧。
dialogText.en: Everything is now in place... Let us begin.

dialogText.cn: 从前就听佩丽卡反复讲起协议核心，我还蛮好奇会是什么样子。
dialogText.en: Perlica has always been harping on about the Automation-Core. I'm actually curious about what it looks like in real life.

dialogText.cn: 不多，平常都是佩丽卡和研发中心的人在研究这些。
dialogText.en: Not much. Perlica and the people in the R&D Center are the ones working on it.

dialogText.cn: 除了我们常用的协议传送，协议核心还能做到更重要的事情。
dialogText.en: We often use the tele-protocol, but they say the Automation-Core will give us even more important functions.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡经常说，有了协议核心和集成工业系统，我们就能改变这颗星球的未来。
dialogText.en: Perlica always says that the Automation-Core and the AIC Factory are going to help us change the future of this planet. And now ... it's finally happening.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我等这一天已经很久了。
dialogText.en: Hohoho! Endministrator, you can't imagine how long I've been waiting for this day to come!

dialogText.cn: 那是当然，这是终末地的一小步！但是意义深远！
dialogText.en: Of course. This is one small step for Endfield, but a meaningful leap for our civilization!

dialogText.cn: 协议核心是集成工业系统的基础，有了它，只要接上能源，我们就能从零在荒野上构建<@qu.key>完整的工业体系</>！
dialogText.en: The PAC is the heart of the AIC Factory. Once connected to power, it will let us build <@qu.key>entire production lines</> out of nothing in the wilderness!

dialogText.cn: 这可是我们把文明的血液带回开拓区的象征！咳咳……说远了。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory will be a symbol of our endeavors in bringing the lifeblood of civilization into the frontiers! Ahem... I think I got ahead of myself.

dialogText.cn: 啊……！真是太棒了，和预想的完全一致，这下往更北边的地方投放协议核心也完全没问题……
dialogText.en: Woohoo! It's wonderful! It's just like what I've envisaged! We can totally deploy the PAC further north and push into the frontiers...

dialogText.cn: 咳咳。
dialogText.en: Ahem.

dialogText.cn: 啊，抱歉，有点太激动了，哈哈……
dialogText.en: Ah, sorry. I just got a little too excited. Haha...

dialogText.cn: 我来调试协议核心，麻烦各位把中继器架设到协议共振塔，这样就能强行启动基地内的源石能源了。
dialogText.en: I'm gonna give the Automation-Core a few tweaks. Just deploy the Relay Towers and transmit power to the Protocol Resonance Tower. This will let us force restart the Originium power facilities within the Hub Base.

dialogText.cn: 我已经协调了一批中继器的储备。现在，我们随时可以在需要的位置建造这些设备。
dialogText.en: I've allocated a batch of Relay Tower from our stockpile. We can now deploy these facilities any time at the required locations.

dialogText.cn: 这么厉害？什么原理？
dialogText.en: Wow! That sounds awesome! How does it work?

dialogText.cn: 呃，你可以理解为基于源石特性的一种“打印”行为。不过，这只是协议核心的冰山一角。
dialogText.en: Oh, you can treat it as a form of facility "printing" based on the properties of Originium. As for what the Automation-Core can really do — this is just the tip of the iceberg.

dialogText.cn: 利用这些戗性内化技术，协议核心还能完成更重要的使命……不过先解决眼下的问题吧。
dialogText.en: By using the reverse internalization technology, the Automation-Core can serve even greater purposes... But right now, let's focus on the problem at hand.

dialogText.cn: 部署协议核心之后，这里已经成为了<@qu.key>集成核心区域</>，开始建立协议传送网络。
dialogText.en: With the Protocol Automation-Core deployed, this place is now the <@qu.key>Core AIC Area</>. We can begin setting up our tele-protocol network.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统依托集成核心区域进行生产运作，能第一时间支援所在地区的各项需求。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory will need the Core AIC Area to perform production work. It will also be able to support and satisfy resource needs in its area.

dialogText.cn: “已经仰望过星空，更应该脚踏实地。”这是你曾经反复叮嘱我们的。
