dialogText.en: "Now that we've seen the stars, we should plant our feet on solid ground." You reminded us with this line on more than one occasion.

dialogText.cn: 请放心，管理员，我们从没忘记这一点。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Endmin. We have not forgotten your lesson.

dialogText.cn: 从协议核心，以及它支撑起的整套<@qu.key>集成工业系统</>当中，会诞生出新的希望。
dialogText.en: The Protocol Automation-Core and the entire <@qu.key>AIC Factory</> it supports will give rise to new hope.

dialogText.cn: 看来协议核心和中继器都能够顺利运作，接下来只要<@qu.key>一路铺设中继器</>，把电力输送给协议共振塔，就大功告成了。
dialogText.en: Both the PAC and relay tower seem to be in working order. Now we just need to <@qu.key>deploy more relay towers</> and transmit power to the Resonance Tower.

dialogText.cn: 这里好像暂时不需要我了。佩丽卡监督，我先去那边帮忙做点检查工作。
dialogText.en: Well, looks like my work here is done! Supervisor Perlica, I guess I'll head over there to do some inspection work.

dialogText.cn: 用协议共振塔强行激活源石容易损伤设备。要是不做好准备，我们会把整个地区的源石设备都烧坏的。
dialogText.en: Using the Protocol Resonance Tower to force-activate Originium might damage our facilities. If we're not careful with this, we might fry every Originium facility in the area.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，那我们就分头行动吧。
dialogText.en: Okay, then. Time to split our forces.

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m2-神秘的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 向头领报告*咕哝*，终末地来了。
dialogText.en: Tell the boss... *swallows*... Endfield has arrived.

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m2-神秘的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: “管理员”确实注意到了我们。头领的预测，全部应验。
dialogText.en: Their Endministrator has taken notice of us. All of the boss's predictions have come true.

dialogText.cn: 喂，你没事——
dialogText.en: Hey, you alright—?

dialogText.cn: 呼吸正常，未见显著创口。可能是被冲击后昏过去了。
dialogText.en: Breathing is stable, no external injuries detected. He's likely unconscious from the blast.

dialogText.cn: 看工牌，他的名字是谢苗。基本生命体征无碍，把他喊起来吧。等等，陈，温柔点。
dialogText.en: Work ID says Semyon... His vitals look stable. Let's wake him up. Wait, Chen — go easy on him, alright?

dialogText.cn: 确实有一声巨响，然后天摇地动，有什么东西砸到了我的头……
dialogText.en: There was this very loud explosion and the entire place shook like jelly. Something then probably hit my head...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，感谢你们的搭救，但我必须回到岗位上了……呃——
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endministrator and Supervisor Perlica. You saved my life. I must return to my post... Hngghh...

dialogText.cn: 幸好军械库没受太多损失。请带上一件吧，我得保证各位手里的武器是最可靠的。
dialogText.en: Fortunately ... this arsenal still seems intact. Take a piece or two. It's my duty to make sure you're wielding the best weapons we have.

dialogText.cn: 什么？！你说……锚点袭击了基地？……等等……我想起来了。
dialogText.en: Wh... WHAT?! An Ankhorfall struck our Base...? Wait... Yeah. It's all coming back to me.

dialogText.cn: ……好，能帮上点忙，我也算安心了。
dialogText.en: ...Good. It puts my mind at ease knowing I could help.

dialogText.cn: 我这还有些库存。如果你们有需要，随时可以来采买装备。
dialogText.en: I still have some gear in stock. Come find me if you need anything.

dialogText.cn: 哦！顺利启动了……听得见我说话吗？嘿，你好？TA-TA？
dialogText.en: Hoo! Activation success...! Can you hear me? Helloooo? Are you there, my little buddy? TA-TA?

dialogText.cn: （高兴的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 哦！太好了，看来修复工作很顺利。
dialogText.en: Absolutely wonderful! This proves my repair work was a success!

dialogText.cn: 这位是陈千语，这位是佩丽卡监督，而这位，就是管理员。
dialogText.en: This here is Operator Chen. This is Supervisor Perlica. And this ... is our Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 这小家伙的智能模块是伊冯的余兴作品，功能有限得很，只能逗着玩玩。
dialogText.en: This little buddy's smart module is what Yvonne slapped together in her spare time. Though it might offer a bit of fun, the module's functions are rather limited.

dialogText.cn: （疑惑的表情）
dialogText.en: *Confused emote*
*Embarrassed whimpering*

dialogText.cn: 管理员！佩丽卡监督！你们可一定要为我作证！我真的尽力了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Supervisor Perlica! YOU MUST BE MY WITNESSES! I did nothing wrong! I did my best!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，感谢！
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you so much, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 怎么这样！
dialogText.en: *Gasp* That's cruel...

dialogText.cn: 不过，我确实有必须重启它的理由。
dialogText.en: Hooo... In any case, I have plenty of legitimate reasons to reactivate the Prototype.

dialogText.cn: 锚点袭击发生前不久，谷地要塞方向有过几次异常能量波动。它们发生的间隔和锚点抵达的间隔几乎一模一样。
dialogText.en: Ok, listen. I found abnormal energy fluctuations coming from the Valley Fort. They appeared shortly before the Ankhorfall. The intervals between these fluctuations are nearly identical to the intervals between the Ankhors' arrival.

dialogText.cn: 我很难不把两者联系起来。虽然还不明白其中的具体原理，但这应该是个有价值的突破口。
dialogText.en: They are just too similar so I have to conclude there's a link between them. I don't know about the details or principles of how it happened, but this feels like a valuable finding we should look into.

dialogText.cn: 原型机即使在维护模式也持续监控着周围的环境数据。多亏你们找回来的零件，这些数据已经被顺利解析了。
dialogText.en: Even in maintenance mode, the Prototype can still monitor and log ambient data of its surroundings. Thanks to the parts you retrieved, these datalogs have now been successfully decrypted.

dialogText.cn: 所以你才让我们过来的？别卖关子了，快说说你都发现了什么。
dialogText.en: Is that why you told us to come over? Alright, stop hoarding the info to yourself. Tell us what you discovered.

dialogText.cn: 必须尽快和那边取得联络……我们去中控塔看看吧，也许能用通讯节点做些什么。
dialogText.en: Then we should try to contact the Valley Fort quickly... Let's head to the Control Tower. We can probably use the comms node there.

dialogText.cn: 中控塔接到了基地各方面的汇报，管理员，你们做得很完美！
dialogText.en: The Control Tower received plenty of great news from around the Base! Stellar work out there, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 枢纽区的各项基础功能已经恢复。眼下，我们还剩一个核心问题要解决。
dialogText.en: Basic amenities of the Hub area are working again. There's only one core issue that we still need to fix right now.

dialogText.cn: 它属于重要保密元件，仅存的备件也在袭击中损失了。管理员，我知道很为难，但是……
dialogText.en: It's a top-secret component and the backup part has been lost during the attack. Endmin, I know I've already asked a lot from you, but...

dialogText.cn: 关于源石设备，有一些只有您才能引发的奇迹。现在我们只能依仗您的“奇迹”了。
dialogText.en: Legends speak of your miraculous work with Originium equipment. We desperately need some of those miracles right now...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你曾经可以直接感应运行中的源石设备。
dialogText.en: Endmin, there was a time when you could directly sense the operations of Originium machinery.

dialogText.cn: 但管理员才刚刚苏醒，高强度使用源石技艺会给身体增添负担。让我来帮忙吧，总有其他办法……
dialogText.en: But the Endmin has just been awakened recently ... and wielding powerful forms of Originium Arts will affect anyone's health. Let me try something else. We can always find another way...

dialogText.cn: 好吧……一旦感觉有什么不适，请立刻停下。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Fine... But if you feel any discomfort, stop immediately.

dialogText.cn: 拜托了，管理员！
dialogText.en: We're all counting on you, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 总通讯节点无法运作。我拆解其他设备修复了它的大部分结构，但核心部分出现了致命损坏。
dialogText.en: Our main comms node is currently inoperable. I've taken parts from other machines and got most of the node fixed, but the core component has suffered devastating damage.

dialogText.cn: 同时，你也能主动调整源石电路，改造或修复设备……过去你经常使用这项技艺。
dialogText.en: You could even fine-tune Originium circuits on the fly — modify gear, repair machines... You used this special form of Arts often.

dialogText.cn: 源石的用途十分广泛，借助源石技艺和工业技术，我们不仅能用它获得能源，还能加工各种材料。
dialogText.en: Originium has a wide range of applications. We used both the Originium Arts and industrial technology for power production and the processing of various materials.

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二到处都有源石种植与开采基地。可以说，我们就是一个站在源石肩膀上的文明。
dialogText.en: Talos-II has plenty of Originium cultivation sites and mines. In fact, we can call ourselves a civilization that stands atop the shoulders of Originium.

dialogText.cn: 历史上，开采源石曾经带来过一系列环境和社会问题。即便如此，我们还是只能继续……这是我们赖以生存的重要资源。
dialogText.en: At one point in our history, Originium mining led to a series of environmental and social issues. However, we had no choice but to press forward... Originium is a resource essential for our survival.

dialogText.cn: ……看来谷地要塞已经被占领了。
dialogText.en: ...The Valley Fort seems to have fallen.

dialogText.cn: 那个裂地者，他在……挑衅我们？
dialogText.en: That Landbreaker... Was he trying to taunt us?

dialogText.cn: 潜入安德烈地下实验室的人，攻击源石副产物中心的人，还有这一批……
dialogText.en: An LB mob raided Andre's basement labs. Another group attacked the Originium Byproduct Processing Center. And then there's this group...

dialogText.cn: 看来，就在我们通信系统停转的时候，四号谷地的许多关键位置都同时遭到了裂地者的攻击……我会让通信组持续关注。
dialogText.en: It seems like while our comms were down, the Landbreakers launched simultaneous attacks at multiple key locations throughout Valley IV... I'll have our comms team keep constant tabs on the situation.

dialogText.cn: ……裂地者素来缺乏组织，这么步调一致的袭击，绝对不是他们能够做到的。
dialogText.en: ...Simultaneous attacks across an entire region... This doesn't make sense. The Landbreakers lack the organizational capacity to pull this off.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们需要行动。
dialogText.en: Agreed. We need to act and respond in kind.

dialogText.cn: 那么，该反击了？
dialogText.en: Hell yeah! I say it's time for the Endfield counterattack!

dialogText.cn: 来到地表前，我从帝江号上对周边地区的所有干员发送了信息，让他们前来支援。
dialogText.en: Before we made our landing, I had Dijiang contact all combat operators in the surrounding regions to reinforce our position.

dialogText.cn: 其中，有一位“裂地者专家”……他最后的定位信息就在附近。我们将在去谷地要塞的路上与他会合。
dialogText.en: One of them is a Landbreaker specialist... His last reported position is just nearby. We shall rendezvous with him on our way to the Valley Fort.

dialogText.cn: 等等，管理员！出发前，这个东西也得交给您。
dialogText.en: Wait, Endmin! Before you set off, I actually have something for you.

dialogText.cn: 防卫科和工人们刚刚找回了一些库存装备。虽然规格不高，总比没有踏实一些。
dialogText.en: The Security Division and the crew mates managed to find some pieces of gear from our stockpile. Though they're not top notch, equipping them is at least better than nothing.

dialogText.cn: 锚点落下的时候，我虽然强装镇定，但心里真的一团乱麻。
dialogText.en: When the Ankhor came crashing down on us, I did my best to keep my cool and soldier on. But truth be told, my mind turned into a total mess.

dialogText.cn: 但是在各位的帮助下，我们不仅平稳渡过了难关，修复工作甚至比预期更快地展开……
dialogText.en: Your intervention helped us through the worst of this crisis. You also sped up our recovery and post-disaster relief work...

dialogText.cn: 我很想代表枢纽区基地，正式向各位道谢。
dialogText.en: It is my genuine wish, on behalf of the Hub Base and all site personnel, to express our everlasting gratitude for your help.

dialogText.cn: 啊，当然，本来安排的接待也搁置了。等到一切恢复正常，一定要给我机会补上。
dialogText.en: Oh and by the way, I actually planned a nice little reception for you. Once things get back on track at the Base, I'll try to organize another party for you.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，陈千语干员。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Supervisor Perlica, and Operator Chen...

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，不要勉强自己。你们已经做到了很多，穷寇莫追，过犹不及。这里还有人等着你们回来。
dialogText.en: Never bite more than you can chew, and do not press a desperate foe. It's always better to be safe than sorry. You already did a lot for us and people at the Hub Base only wish to see you return safely.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。我们明白。
dialogText.en: I understand, Director Qin. We all do.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，您就放心吧！
dialogText.en: Heheh. You can count on me!

dialogText.cn: 那，祝你们一切顺利。
dialogText.en: Alright, then. Good luck out there.

dialogText.cn: 经受了猛烈的攻击，裂地者暂时失去了意识。
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers have been knocked out by the fierce attack for now.

dialogText.cn: 各类机械设备最常用到的材料就是<@qu.key>晶体外壳</>，由于源石的特殊属性，它们堪称机械的万金油啊。
dialogText.en: I recommend the <@qu.key>Origocrust</>. It's the most common material for producing all kinds of machinery and equipment. The very nature of Originium makes it the quintessential material for industry and engineering.

dialogText.cn: 既然常用，怎么没多备着点儿？
dialogText.en: Wow. If it's that useful, I'm guessing we've got a whole warehouse full of it — right?

dialogText.cn: 这不是正好……刚才……用光了……谁也没想到锚点会扎进基地中央啊！突然造成那么多破坏！
dialogText.en: Ah, yeah... We ... uhm ... just happened to have ... used up the local stash. Nobody expected that Ankhorfall to hit right in the middle of our Base. There was so much damage that we needed to fix.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳。总之现在得从搜集源矿开始了，你们整理原材料的时候，我来准备集成工业系统的设备。
dialogText.en: That being said, we ... have to start from square one and do some manual mining. I'll prep various AIC facilities while you head out there and gather some Originium Ore.

dialogText.cn: 光看源石副产物中心大门的样子，里面的设备说不定也被破坏了，我们需要准备一些应急修补材料。
dialogText.en: Judging by how bad that gate looks, the facilities inside are probably damaged too. We must prepare some materials for carrying out emergency repairs.

dialogText.cn: 这个数量的源矿足够了。管理员，我们可以开始制作晶体外壳了。
dialogText.en: Good! We have enough Originium Ore, Endmin! Now let's get started making Origocrusts.

dialogText.cn: 我准备好了对应的设备，把它们部署在协议核心附近，就能开工了。
dialogText.en: I've readied the facilities! We should deploy them near the PAC to start our work.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，学得很快嘛！这些都是集成工业系统的基础操作方式，只要记住了，今后就会不断派上用场。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're an incredible learner! So, these are the basics of using the AIC. Keep them in mind, and they'll come in handy.

dialogText.cn: 不，不应该说“学得快”，说到底当初还是管理员……算了。
dialogText.en: Oh, hmm... Perhaps "incredible learner" would be the wrong way to put it. After all, it was you who... Uh... Forget it.

dialogText.cn: 准备好之后，就可以动身了。有了这些材料，只要源石设备不是彻底报废就能想办法，我们最好赶紧……
dialogText.en: Anyway, you can start moving again once you're ready. Now that we have these materials, we can still salvage the Originium machinery ... as long as it's not completely destroyed. We better hurry...

dialogText.cn: ……胖大鸟，是不是除了电池之外，你还特别记挂副产物中心的什么东西啊？
dialogText.en: Umm... Big Owl, besides those batteries, is there *something else* you're worried about in the processing center?

dialogText.cn: 呃！哈哈……小千语啊，你的直觉不要总是用在这种地方……
dialogText.en: Ah! Haha... Yeah, Chen... You got really sharp senses... Please direct them somewhere else next time...

dialogText.cn: 其实有一批跟原型机升级有关的加工零件和资料放在了那里，要是弄丢了什么，后面可不好收拾。
dialogText.en: I ... actually left a set of parts and some key documents for the Prototype's upgrades. If I lose them, I won't be able to wrap up my work on the Prototype.

dialogText.cn: 如果是重要的资料，安德烈先生完全可以在秦工程师那儿就向我们……啊。
dialogText.en: Important documents? Mr. Andre, you could have told us earlier. Director Qin would've... Oh.

dialogText.cn: 我明白了——你没过秦主管审批就直接开工了，对吧？
dialogText.en: Ooooh, you started the project without Director Qin's approval, didn't you?

dialogText.cn: 不是的！……不完全是。好吧。
dialogText.en: No! It's not like that! It's... Ugh... Fine.

dialogText.cn: 但就这么让原型机的进度被耽误，实在太可惜了！管理员！佩丽卡监督！你们、你们一定能理解吧！
dialogText.en: But I can't just delay the progress of the Prototype project! It will be such a waste! Endmin! Supervisor Perlica! Please! You must understand!

dialogText.cn: 评估流程太折腾了，我自己掏腰包找外面定做了“特种设备”，其实就是广域施术单元的改装零件，让她知道又得念叨我半天……
dialogText.en: The evaluation process can be a real bummer. So, I spent my own money and got someone to custom build a set of "special equipment"... These are actually modification parts for a large-area Arts unit. Oh dear, if Qin learns of this, she's going to have a really long talk with me...

dialogText.cn: 明白了。管理员，我们尽快出发吧。
dialogText.en: We understand. Let's move out as soon as we can, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 太感谢了！刚才正好有干员在这里设置了一些滑索，应该能给你们省些赶路的工夫。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! By the way, some operators just set up a few ziplines in this area. Use them. They'll help you get around faster.

dialogText.cn: 你们看，裂地者把这里全翻了一遍。他们好像是在找些什么……
dialogText.en: Look. The Landbreakers really turned this place upside down. They seem to be looking for something...

dialogText.cn: 难道真是冲着零件来的？那些东西裂地者拿着也没用吧？
dialogText.en: Wait. Don't tell me that the LBs are really after the parts. What would they use them for?

dialogText.cn: 希望他们已经提前撤离了……保险起见，我们最好再搜索一遍。
dialogText.en: I hope they have evacuated to safety... Perhaps we should do another sweep, just to be sure.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请使用扫描功能检查周边环境，也许能找到更多有用的信息。
dialogText.en: Give the area a scan, Endmin. The scanner might be able to locate some useful information.

dialogText.cn: 别紧张，我们是终末地危机处理小组。你们现在安全了。
dialogText.en: Don't be afraid. We're the Endfield Crisis Team. You're now safe.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者已经被赶跑，你们不用再担心了！
dialogText.en: Yeah. We totally defeated those Landbreakers. They'll trouble you no more!

dialogText.cn: 这可……太谢谢了！终于得救了！
dialogText.en: Oh... Thank you all! We're finally safe!

dialogText.cn: 我们从监控里看到有裂地者朝这里来，就赶紧丢下手里的活，先搬走了这套设备和它边上的资料。
dialogText.en: Our security cameras found the Landbreaker mobs heading this way. We stopped our work immediately, then took this set of equipment and the accompanying technical documents with us.

dialogText.cn: 我们不知道它是做什么用的，但它的包装上备注着很高的优先等级，还有终末地的标志。你们就是为了它来的吧？我们是不是立功了？
dialogText.en: We got no idea what it's for, but the packaging label says it's top priority. It's covered in Endfield logos. You came for this, right? Guess we really did save something important.

dialogText.cn: ……确实是安德烈先生提到的<@qu.key>原型机零件</>。
dialogText.en: ...This is it. This is the set of <@qu.key>prototype parts</> that Mr. Andre mentioned.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了二位及时应变。这套设备现在由终末地接收了，我会把二位的事迹转告给基地负责人。
dialogText.en: Thank you. The two of you acted in a decisive and timely manner to save a key asset of Endfield Industries. Now that it's been recovered, I shall relay your actions to the site director.

dialogText.cn: 对了，我们还找到了别的几样东西……这些作战记录各位也许用得上，请收下吧。
dialogText.en: Great! Oh, we also found a few other things... These combat records might be useful to you. Please take them.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者都被打败了，这样我们就可以做一些应急修复。接着就等基地再送点人手和材料过来……
dialogText.en: Since the Landbreakers are gone, we should start the emergency repairs. They should last until the Base sends more people and materials for a proper makeover...

dialogText.cn: 我们这里没问题了。各位也继续自己的任务吧。感谢你们。真的，感谢你们。
dialogText.en: You know, we really appreciate all the help you gave us, my Endfielder friends. Things look good for now.

dialogText.cn: 呼……真是没完没了。怎么了，佩丽卡？在想什么？
dialogText.en: Hoo... They just won't give up. What is it, Perlica? Thinking about something?

dialogText.cn: 裂地者。你们刚刚应该也听到了，他们的首领在寻找这些零件和资料。
dialogText.en: Those Landbreakers... You heard what they said. Their leader is looking for the parts and the documents.

dialogText.cn: 可这些东西对他们来说，不是比无字天书还天书么？
dialogText.en: But why would the LBs want the documents? I mean, can they even understand this stack of technobabble?

dialogText.cn: 之后再调查吧。无论如何，我们确保了副产物中心的安全，也找到了零件和资料。先回安德烈先生那里吧。
dialogText.en: We'll get to the bottom of this afterwards. The good news is that we successfully secured the processing center and recovered the parts and the documents. We should head back to Mr. Andre.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生更清楚相关细节。终末地和工团合作了很长时间，经常彼此分享一些工程任务。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre should know more than us. Endfield has worked together with the UWST for quite a while. We often carry out joint engineering projects together.

dialogText.cn: 联盟工团过去一直在对四号谷地的超域裂隙进行研究，供能高地就有工团建设的超域试验场。
dialogText.en: The UWST has spent years researching the Æther Rift of Valley IV. They have constructed an Æther Test Site at the Power Plateau for this purpose.

dialogText.cn: 虽然听起来很不可思议，但裂地者似乎真的在寻找我们的技术产物。
dialogText.en: Though it does make little sense, I have a feeling that these Landbreakers are indeed looking for our technology and products.

dialogText.cn: 而且，安德烈先生说过，这些源石改装零件是他自掏腰包订购的，裂地者怎么会连这种信息都知道……
dialogText.en: What's even more suspicious is... Mr. Andre mentioned that he ordered and paid for the Originium modification parts himself. How would the Landbreakers acquire such information...?

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生，我们把你要的东西找回来了。那里还有几位幸存的工人，他们正在根据应急预案准备修复工作。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre, we found the things you need. We also met a few fortunate UWST crew mates who survived. They're now carrying out repairs in accordance with their contingency plans.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，管理员，佩丽卡监督！我稍后就把那里的情况汇总给秦主管。
dialogText.en: Wonderful, Endmin and Supervisor Perlica! I'll give Director Qin an update regarding the situation at the processing center.

dialogText.cn: 就像你们看到的那样，枢纽区还有许多损坏的设备，它们大都可以用<@qu.key>晶体外壳</>应急修理。
dialogText.en: Oh, by the way, you probably saw plenty of damaged facilities in the Hub area. Most of them can be fixed with <@qu.key>Origocrusts</>.

dialogText.cn: 不过，为了替千语大侠节约几把“绝世好剑”，各位出任务的时候，我已经准备好了自动采矿的设备……
dialogText.en: And that will mean we need to gather a lot more Originium Ore. Now I don't want to dent Master Chen's legendary Hongshan blades, so I prepped a few auto-mining rigs while you carried out your mission...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，终末地的<@qu.key>便携源石矿机</>只要部署在矿点上就会全自动运作。去附近的矿点试试吧！
dialogText.en: This, Endmin, is the Endfield <@qu.key>Portable Originium Rig</>! Just deploy it on a mining spot and it will mine the ore automatically for you! Go ahead and try it out on a nearby mining spot!

dialogText.cn: 对，就是这个数！材料齐全了，原型机的维修工作就交给我。管理员，你一定要来见证它“苏醒”的时刻！一定！说好了啊！
dialogText.en: Fabulous! I now have everything I need to start repairing the prototype! Endmin, make sure you're here to witness its "awakening"! Don't miss it! Promise you'll be here to see it!

dialogText.cn: 裂地者？他们怎么会盯上这些东西？
dialogText.en: Landbreakers? Why would they want these things?

dialogText.cn: 别的不细说，就说这批T11型源石棱镜和精细烧结核凝晶，落在普通人手里，可能一碰就报废。
dialogText.en: T11 Originium prisms are highly fragile. Same goes for the high-precision nucleic crystal sinters. If handled by untrained personnel, they can be easily damaged.

dialogText.cn: 原型机是针对超域开发的实验性技术，对裂地者来说，这些东西应该和废铁没区别吧。
dialogText.en: The Prototype is an experimental tech we developed for the Ætherside. To the Landbreakers, it's probably just a hunk of scrap.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……确实有点蹊跷。但也可能只是裂地者觉得值钱，准备去黑市倒卖罢了。
dialogText.en: Yeah... Quite odd, indeed. Maybe some Landbreakers thought "hey, that looks expensive," and figured they could flip it on the black market.

dialogText.cn: 既然东西都拿回来了，还是把注意力放在眼下的事情上好。如果有什么线索，咱们第一时间联系。
dialogText.en: Anyway, since we've retrieved the crucial items, let's focus on the matter at hand. We should also update each other if we find anything new.

dialogText.cn: 源石粉末啊，没事，胖大鸟一定能搞定，对吧？
dialogText.en: Originium Powder? I am sure Big Owl knows how to make it, right?

dialogText.cn: 当然，现在轮到<@qu.key>粉碎机</>登场了！几乎所有原材料它都能处理，矿石、药草，只要你能叫上名字的，全都能碎成粉末。这就是终末地设计的通用解决方案！
dialogText.en: Of course I do! It's time to reveal the <@qu.key>Shredding Unit</>! Mineral ores, metals, plants, it doesn't matter! You name it, it *sshhrreeds* it! This is your penultimate shredding solution, proudly designed by Endfield Industries!

dialogText.cn: 前往协议核心就可以制造粉碎机了。协议核心的功能如预期般强大……不过还缺乏实地数据，希望管理员多多留意。
dialogText.en: Head to the PAC and use it to construct a Shredding Unit. The PAC is meeting all our expectations so far ... we just don't have a lot of numbers from field operations. We're counting on you to generate the data, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 你们到了！情况没有变化，还是和之前说的一样。
dialogText.en: You're here! Our high payload situation hasn't changed at all!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，<@qu.key>源石炸药桶</>已经可以使用了。只要在这样的炸药桶附近，就可以简单方便地进行爆破、拆除、清障工作！
dialogText.en: Hohoho. Endmin, this <@qu.key>barrel of Originium bombs</> is ready for use. Blasting, demolishing, and rubble-clearing work has never been easier!

dialogText.cn: ……她好像真的很喜欢爆炸物。
dialogText.en: She ... really likes explosives.

dialogText.cn: 对了，集成工业系统已经投入使用了吧？管理员也可以通过集成工业系统批量生产爆炸物！嘿嘿！
dialogText.en: Oh, and our AIC Factory has been deployed, right? Endmin, you can totally use the Factory to make *even more* explosives! Heehee!

dialogText.cn: 我能处理好爆炸物，也确定好了爆破点，没有殉爆风险，就等你们的源石粉末来制作炸药了！
dialogText.en: I've prepped the explosives and marked the detonation site. Don't worry, there's no risk of sympathetic detonation. I just hope you have the Originium Powder to make the bombs!

dialogText.cn: 这么多裂地者……连营地都建好了。
dialogText.en: So many Landbreakers... They even built a camp.

dialogText.cn: 他们挡在前往谷地要塞的必经之路上。我看，就是要挡住救兵。
dialogText.en: They're sitting on the only way to the Valley Fort. I think they're here to block reinforcements.

dialogText.cn: 只有这条路可走了。陈，动手。
dialogText.en: They are blocking our only way. Take them down, Chen.

actorName.cn: 慌张的裂地者{e1-慌张的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 求、求求你！再给我——
dialogText.en: Please! Don't kill me! Just gimme another——

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m4-残忍的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 新生的氏族不需要这样的懦夫。
dialogText.en: Our rising clan does not need gutless cowards.

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m4-残忍的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 头领需要战士，需要纪律，不服从的人都会是这个下场。
dialogText.en: The baws wants warriors. Disciplined warriors. Disobey, and you DIE — like this one!

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m4-残忍的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: *咕哝*敌人？
dialogText.en: *Mumbles*. ENEMIES?

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m4-残忍的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 干掉他们！证明氏族的力量！
dialogText.en: THERE! KILL THEM! SHOW THEM THE POWER OF THE CLAN!

dialogText.cn: 的确胆识过人。看来，你就是传闻中的那位管理员。
dialogText.en: A brave one. Impressive. You must be the legendary Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>卡特洛·狼卫·卢皮诺</>，正式向管理员报到。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Catello Wulfgard Luppino</>. Formally reporting for duty, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督经常这样介绍我，这个解释最简单。
dialogText.en: That's how Supervisor Perlica usually introduces me. Two words that go straight to the point.

dialogText.cn: 狼卫是终末地特种技术部门的干员，精通隐匿作战和单人行动，尤其擅长解决裂地者问题，能力值得信赖。
dialogText.en: Wulfgard is an Endfield Specialist Tech Division operator. He's an expert in covert combat, solo operations, and ... Landbreaker issues. You can trust his skills.

dialogText.cn: ——但，狼卫，“铳口不能朝着队友”，我们应该反复强调过。
dialogText.en: Listen, Wulfgard, pointing your gun at a fellow Endfielder is never acceptable. Have I made myself clear?

dialogText.cn: 收到，佩丽卡监督。情况紧急，没能确认管理员的身份，是我的疏忽。
dialogText.en: Apologies, Supervisor Perlica. It was an emergency and I failed to notice the Endministrator. It won't happen again.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地处于紧急状态，危机处理小组需要你一起配合行动。
dialogText.en: I will hold you to that. Valley IV is in a state of emergency, and the Crisis Team requires your assistance.

dialogText.cn: 正有此意。碾骨氏族已经破坏了大桥的控制设备，同时切断了供电线路。
dialogText.en: I'm on it. The Bonekrushers have sabotaged the devices for controlling the bridge and severed the power cables.

dialogText.cn: 太有条理了。他们以前只知道掠夺，这不是他们的风格。
dialogText.en: These raiders only focused on raiding and looting in the past. Such actions are too well thought out. This isn't their style.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这个控制台……刚才的裂地者身上，似乎有从这儿卸下来的零件？
dialogText.en: Hmm. This control panel's busted... Those LBs might have stripped its parts off.

dialogText.cn: 至于电力问题，就交给我们吧。有协议核心在，很快就能解决。
dialogText.en: The power issue is something we can handle. The Automation-Core will give us an easy fix.

dialogText.cn: 这开关……按不动，已经没电了。
dialogText.en: The switch isn't working... It's out of juice.

dialogText.cn: 我们得给它通电——用协议核心的电力。
dialogText.en: We must reconnect it to an electrical grid — like the one provided by the PAC.

dialogText.cn: 这样一来，前往谷地通道的路就通了。
dialogText.en: We now have a road to reach the Valley Pass.

dialogText.cn: 在行动之前，我希望先尽可能了解谷地通道的情况。
dialogText.en: Before we go, any intel on the Valley Pass?

dialogText.cn: 菲奥娜，请给我们最新的形势评估。
dialogText.en: Fiona, please update us on the latest situation.

dialogText.cn: 稍等，我把推演模型发送过去。
dialogText.en: Give me a moment. I'm sending you the algorithmic model.

dialogText.cn: 我刚在附近救出了一些平民。根据描述，似乎有碾骨氏族的核心成员在活动。
dialogText.en: I've rescued a number of civilians nearby. From what they told me, key leaders of the Bonekrushers might be active in this area.

dialogText.cn: 还有连我也无法辨别的一些踪迹。夜里附近偶尔会有异样的火光照亮天空，他们在利用我不熟悉的力量。
dialogText.en: There are also tracks even I do not recognize. Such as strange-looking flames illuminating the skies at night. They are using some power I am not familiar with.

dialogText.cn: 阵仗还真大啊，咱们得赶快了。
dialogText.en: Whatever they're up to, it's big. We better hurry.

dialogText.cn: 这些烟雾……给人的感觉很压抑。远处那个大东西是什么？
dialogText.en: *Cough* This haze ... seems really dark and depressing. And what's that large thing way over there?

dialogText.cn: ……巢雕。
dialogText.en: ...A denstack.

dialogText.cn: 巢雕是碾骨氏族的标志性建筑，在其他裂地者氏族里也很有名气。
dialogText.en: Denstacks are structures that mark Bonekrusher territories. The other Landbreaker clans also know them well.

dialogText.cn: 各级头目都把它作为身份象征，它也是区分领地的图腾。碾骨氏族会烧尽自己掠夺不走的东西，傲慢地留下痕迹。
dialogText.en: Bonekrusher chiefs also use these territorial furnaces as symbols of their power. They would burn everything they can't pillage and leave their brutal mark upon the land.

dialogText.cn: 巢雕几乎什么都能烧，碾骨氏族会借火焰和烟雾来宣告自己的临时统治。当他们在开拓区横行时，大部队行进路线上总是点缀着一串燃尽的废墟。
dialogText.en: Denstacks can consume almost everything. Bonekrushers would use the haze to herald their invasion. Their rampage through the frontiers always leaves a trail of smoking ruins.

dialogText.cn: 这烟雾可别有毒吧？
dialogText.en: Ugh... This haze better not be poisonous... It's not, right?

dialogText.cn: 巢雕能散布雾状侵蚀物质，遏制源石装置运行。这些雾是碾骨氏族的伪装，也是武器。
dialogText.en: It's aerosolized Blight materials released by the denstack. It messes with Originium devices. The Bonekrushers use it to hide their advances. It's part smokescreen, part weapon.

dialogText.cn: 不过这样的浓度……甚至会对人体产生显著的危害。超域能量本身就极不可控，碾骨氏族比过去更加激进了。
dialogText.en: But haze this dense and concentrated ... it can definitely pose serious risks to the human body. Æther energy is already uncontrollable. Looks like the Bonekrushers are getting more aggressive with their tactics.

dialogText.cn: 有办法穿过去或者绕道吗？
dialogText.en: So what's the plan? Push through or find another way around?

dialogText.cn: 暂时不清楚里面的状态，我们最好找找其他机会。
dialogText.en: We still don't know what's going on inside. I say we look for other options.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀是一种由超域引起的危险灾害，它们之间的关系就像岩浆和火山。
dialogText.en: The Blight is a form of hazard caused by the Æther. Their relationship is like lava to a volcano.

dialogText.cn: 如狼卫所说，它会造成许多破坏性影响，对人和源石设备都十分危险。
dialogText.en: What Wulfgard said is true. Blight is extremely destructive. It is also very hazardous to both people and Originium equipment.

dialogText.cn: 快找！这么久了！他会失去耐心的！
dialogText.en: Find 'em! Quick — 'fore he gets real mad!

dialogText.cn: *咕哝*那个佩洛，那些人，藏到哪儿去了？
dialogText.en: *Grumble* Where the hell is that Perro? Where are those cursed fools?

dialogText.cn: 他们再也没有机会了。
dialogText.en: They won't have the chance to.

dialogText.cn: 那边。
dialogText.en: Over there.

dialogText.cn: 敌人的搜索队伍应该不止一支，形势很严峻。
dialogText.en: The enemy probably has more than one search party. I got a bad feeling about this.

dialogText.cn: 真的有人？快，跟上他！
dialogText.en: Not an LB? Quick! After him!

dialogText.cn: 谁……找死！
dialogText.en: Who's that...? I'll krush you!

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m5-残忍的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 是狼群的臭味……
dialogText.en: This stink! I smell the Pack...

dialogText.cn: 哦？知道狼群？
dialogText.en: You know us? The Pack says hello.

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m5-残忍的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 文明人的爪牙……不配做裂地者。
dialogText.en: Barking pets of the civilized... You are no Landbreaker.

dialogText.cn: 哼，尝尝狼的獠牙吧！
dialogText.en: Hmph. Then feel the fangs of the wolf.

actorName.cn: 裂地者头目{e1m5-残忍的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>聂菲斯</>会在这里……把你们都碾碎！
dialogText.en: Nef ... <@qu.key>Nefarith</> ... she'll kkrruuush you all...!

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯……果然是她。
dialogText.en: Nefarith... I knew it.

dialogText.cn: 一个不折不扣的疯子。
dialogText.en: A demented lunatic.

dialogText.cn: 她以不择手段而闻名，几乎破坏了裂地者氏族间的每一条规矩。
dialogText.en: Nefarith is notorious for her willingness to commit all sorts of madness. She has broken every single Code of every Landbreaker clan.

dialogText.cn: 所以说是这个家伙在捣鬼？
dialogText.en: So she is the one behind everything?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这附近应该还有潜藏的裂地者。
dialogText.en: Careful, Endmin. There may be Landbreaker traps around here.

dialogText.cn: 为了确保安全，我建议立即用燃烧弹把周围肃清一遍。
dialogText.en: Better safe than sorry — I say we use incendiary weapons to burn this area clean.

dialogText.cn: 啊！别——
dialogText.en: W-WAIT! PLEASE! Please don't—

dialogText.cn: 别……别放火，我在这儿！
dialogText.en: I-I'm right here!

dialogText.cn: 我真的只是路过，其他的什么都不知道……
dialogText.en: I ... I was just walking by. I dunno anything ... and I certainly didn't hear anything...

dialogText.cn: 你都快跑去敌人鼻子底下了，就这么急着躲我们吗？
dialogText.en: So you've got the guts to stroll past the pipefaces, but when it's us, you run and hide?

dialogText.cn: 他……他好像是裂地者……
dialogText.en: 'Cos ... 'cos this one looks like ... like one of 'em...

dialogText.cn: 你的观察力很敏锐。
dialogText.en: You got good eyes, boy.

dialogText.cn: 别担心，他和那些裂地者不一样，不会伤害你的。
dialogText.en: There's no need to be afraid. He's not like the others. You'll be safe around him.

dialogText.cn: 你是生活在这一带的居民吧？知道终末地工业吗？
dialogText.en: Do you live in this area? Have you heard anything about Endfield Industries?

dialogText.cn: 工……工团？不，你们不像工团的人。
dialogText.en: Industries...? Factory people? You ... you're from the U-double-U? But you don't look like no wooster to me.

dialogText.cn: 工团是我们的合作伙伴。不用害怕。
dialogText.en: Relax. We're a trusted partner of the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 那、那你们是好人了？谢天谢地！
dialogText.en: That ... that means you're the good guys! Thank Talos...!

dialogText.cn: 别激动，慢慢来……你妹妹怎么了？这里到底发生了些什么？
dialogText.en: Calm down, Mr. Karja... How's your sister? And what happened here?

dialogText.cn: 裂地者抓走了好多人，大家都躲了起来。
dialogText.en: Those evil breakers nabbed most of our people... The rest of us had no choice but to hide.

dialogText.cn: 但我妹妹病得很重，工团给的药都用完了！我只好跑出来，想着……想着去那边……桥那边的工厂找找……
dialogText.en: My baby sis is real sick. B-but we ran out of the U-double-U medication...! There's a factory across the bridge. So I-I snuck out, tried to find my way over...

dialogText.cn: 这段路现在十分危险，你不可能安全通过。
dialogText.en: That path is too dangerous. You'll never make it across with your life.

dialogText.cn: 我知道！但阿吉等不下去了……我不能……我不能眼睁睁地看着……
dialogText.en: I know! But ... Ginny... She can't wait no longer! I ... I can't see her ... can't see her... hnggghh...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，嗯！管理员说得对！确实得帮！
dialogText.en: YEAH! The Endmin's right! We gotta help these people!

dialogText.cn: 那就请卡贾先生带路吧，我们去看看你妹妹的病情和大家的情况。
dialogText.en: Well, then, Mr. Karja, please lead the way. Let's see if we can help your sister and your people.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，太好了！避难所在那边，跟我来！
dialogText.en: You'll help me?! Really? Th-that's awesome! Follow me! Our shelter is over there!

dialogText.cn: 小心被跟踪，我殿后。
dialogText.en: I'm taking the rear. Gotta make sure we are not followed.

dialogText.cn: 能够统合内部长期混乱的碾骨氏族，已经证明了她的实力。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers were a mess constantly at war with themselves. But she managed to unite them all. This alone proves her power.

dialogText.cn: 她的突然出现至今都是个谜，但显然，聂菲斯确实有独到的手段……和头脑。
dialogText.en: The sudden appearance of Nefarith is a mystery. But it is obvious that she has her own special skills ... and intellect.

dialogText.cn: 我叫卡贾。请救救我妹妹！求你们了！
dialogText.en: My name's Karja — please, I'm begging you! You have to save my baby sis!

dialogText.cn: 我们到了——
dialogText.en: This is the place—

dialogText.cn: 卡贾，你小子跑哪儿去了？你妹妹病成这样，外面又到处都是裂地者，还乱跑？！
dialogText.en: Karja! Why did you run off again? Your sister is sick and we got breakers crawling all over the place! Your place is by her side, dammit!

dialogText.cn: 索、索斯先生……
dialogText.en: Soth... I mean, Mr. Soth...

dialogText.cn: 跟着你的这些人又是谁？你怎么什么人都敢往回带？
dialogText.en: Who are these people behind you? You grew some nerves Karja. You're now bringing every outsider you meet back to our place!

dialogText.cn: 他们不是坏人，他们刚才打败了裂地者……他们是来帮忙的！
dialogText.en: No, Mr. Soth. These are the good guys. They're here to help us! They even destroyed a band of breaker scum, I swear...!

dialogText.cn: 打了裂地者？你还把他们带回来，是生怕麻烦找不上门吗？！
dialogText.en: They fought the breakers? And you brought them here? Boy! You're gonna lead the breakers to us and they'll take revenge on us!

dialogText.cn: 哥哥……？哥哥回来了？
dialogText.en: Karja...? Is that you...?

dialogText.cn: 阿吉，阿吉！我回来了！哥哥带着帮手回来了！
dialogText.en: Ginny! GINNY! I'm back! And I brought some extra hands!

dialogText.cn: ……索斯先生，我们是终末地工业的人。卡贾告诉我们，这里需要帮助。
dialogText.en: ...Mr. Soth, we're from Endfield Industries. Karja told us that you might need some help.

dialogText.cn: 终末地工业？我是这里管事儿的。我知道你们，听几个工团人提到过。你们是来干什么的？
dialogText.en: Endfield, you say? Hmph. I'm in charge of this place and I know you. Some of those UWST people mentioned your company. What is your purpose here?

dialogText.cn: 别紧张，别紧张，我们不是坏人……卡贾，她就是你的妹妹吧？她得了什么病？
dialogText.en: Easy there, old man. We're really the good guys... Karja, that girl's your baby sis, right? Tell us about her illness.

dialogText.cn: 她不知道什么时候得了矿石病。现在手上的药也用完了，我、我不知道该怎么办……
dialogText.en: She... We didn't know when the Oripathy got to her, and we're out of meds. I ... I don't know what to do...

dialogText.cn: 感觉怎么样？哪里疼吗？
dialogText.en: How are you feeling? Can you tell me where it hurts?

dialogText.cn: 姐姐……我……
dialogText.en: Hi, miss ... I ...

dialogText.cn: 她……她这几天说身上的石头在痛，肚子也在痛，吃东西的时候痛得更厉害。
dialogText.en: Ginny ... she told me that the rocks on her body hurt and her belly's hurting too. The pain gets even worse when she tries to eat.

dialogText.cn: 听起来很严重啊。
dialogText.en: Her condition sounds really serious.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……很典型的矿石病症状，体表有结晶，内脏受到压迫，不受控的施术行为……还来得及。
dialogText.en: Hmm... surface crystal formations, visceral compression, and uncontrolled sparkling of the Arts... These are typical symptoms of Oripathy... But we still have time.

dialogText.cn: ——她有多长时间没有用药了？
dialogText.en: ...How long has she been without medication?

dialogText.cn: 唉……快两周了……
dialogText.en: Nearly two weeks ... uggh...

dialogText.cn: 我们原本都会去工团那里领一些药。后来，裂地者开始袭击我们，剩下的人逃到了这里，药都用光了……阿吉的病情也急转直下。
dialogText.en: We usually get our meds from the woosters. But the raider scum started attacking our place. Those of us who survived escaped to this shelter. Unfortunately, we ran out of meds ... and Ginny's health turned for the worse.

dialogText.cn: 救人要紧，我这还有几份矿石病抑制剂，应该能让病症缓解一些。
dialogText.en: Saving lives is our priority. I have a few doses of Oripathy suppressants. They should alleviate Ginny's symptoms.

dialogText.cn: 昨晚阿吉发了高烧，身边有电火花噼里啪啦直冒，我、我吓坏了……
dialogText.en: Last night Ginny's temperature went feverish, and sparks were going off next to her. It ... it got me real scared...

dialogText.cn: 太感谢你们了！太感谢你们了！我就怕阿吉有个三长两短。终末地是我们兄妹俩的大恩人……
dialogText.en: Thank you! Thank you so much! I was worried sick about my sis... You Endfielders have been a blessing to us. We both owe you our lives...

dialogText.cn: 不用谢。虽然矿石病不能完全治愈，但只要定期使用抑制剂，大部分症状都可以控制。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Karja. There is no permanent cure for Oripathy, but regular use of the suppressants will keep most symptoms under control.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，感觉好些了吗？
dialogText.en: How is it, Ginny? Feeling better?

dialogText.cn: 好像没有那么疼了，谢谢姐姐……
dialogText.en: My pain isn't as bad any more... Thank you, miss...

dialogText.cn: 多谢谢你哥哥吧，是他为了你不顾危险跑出去找药的。
dialogText.en: You should also thank your brother, Ginny. Karja risked his life to look for help outside.

dialogText.cn: 好好休息，你现在身体很虚弱，还需要休养一阵子。
dialogText.en: Your body still needs rest. You should go get some sleep.

dialogText.cn: 好……我也感觉有点困……
dialogText.en: Okay... I actually do feel quite ... sleepy...

dialogText.cn: 矿石病是人们开采与利用源石需要面对的风险之一。如果防护不当，活性源石会通过血液进入循环系统，造成侵害。
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, yes... When mining and using Originium, Oripathy is one of the hazards we must face. Active Originium can infect and harm an improperly protected victim, usually through the bloodstream and the circulatory system.

dialogText.cn: 我们一直都没能找到根治矿石病的方法。但至少现在，高效的抑制剂已经相对可靠廉价了。
dialogText.en: We haven't found a way to completely cure Oripathy. However, at least we now have highly effective suppressants at affordable costs.

dialogText.cn: 以前听历史老师说过，矿石病感染者在泰拉许多地方都被歧视……很多社会问题也是因为矿石病引起的。
dialogText.en: My history teacher told me that ... Oripathy positives were once ostracized in numerous places on Terra... Many social issues were also caused by Oripathy.

dialogText.cn: 虽然人与人的关系不再被源石感染撕裂，但在塔卫二上，矿石病依然是一种常见的疾病。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Although Originium infection no longer leads to stigmatization or social problems today, Oripathy remains a common disease in Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，不要多想。
dialogText.en: Don't stress over it, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 请相信我，无论是否记得起过去的事情，源石……你和源石，始终在为塔卫二的生存而战。
dialogText.en: Even if you can't remember the past, know that both you and Originium have always been fighting for our survival on Talos-II. You can trust me on that.

dialogText.cn: 那个……之前太激动了，实在是不好意思。感谢终末地的各位救了阿吉。你们要是有什么需要，我一定尽力帮忙。
dialogText.en: Apologies ... I ... I didn't mean to be so harsh towards you Endfielders. Thank you for saving Ginny's life. I'll do whatever I can to help you out.

dialogText.cn: 你们能留下来保护我们吗……？这个要求可能有些过分，但……
dialogText.en: Can ... can you stay and protect us...? I know it's too much to ask, but...

dialogText.cn: 我们有更重要的任务，留下来肯定不现实。
dialogText.en: We're on an important mission. We can't stop here.

dialogText.cn: 也不能就这样丢下人家不管吧？
dialogText.en: But we can't just leave these people behind.

dialogText.cn: 我明白了。索斯先生，附近有能容下所有人的空地吗？
dialogText.en: I understand. Now, Mr. Soth, is there an empty plot of land nearby that can accommodate everyone?

dialogText.cn: 但那里已经到处都是裂地者了，那些家伙根本就没有人性……你们千万不能去啊。
dialogText.en: But it's now completely infested by the breakers. Those blighted scum ain't human... Don't risk your life for this!

dialogText.cn: 不用担心，请为我们带路吧。
dialogText.en: There's no need to worry about us. Please lead the way.

dialogText.cn: 这就给那里做个大！扫！除！
dialogText.en: Yeah! Time to make your place breaker-free!

dialogText.cn: 锚点砸到附近之后，裂地者就突然在谷地要塞周围出现了，工团甚至没来得及拉警报！
dialogText.en: When that Ankhor fell not too far from us, those breaker scum started showing up all over the Valley Fort. Them woosters didn't even have time to sound their alarms!

dialogText.cn: 这一定是规划好的袭击。
dialogText.en: They must have planned this attack ahead of time.

dialogText.cn: 他们现在已经霸占了整个谷地要塞。唉，我都不敢想里头的人现在怎么样了。
dialogText.en: They've taken over the entire Valley Fort. Ugh. I can't even imagine what happened to the crew mates inside that place.

dialogText.cn: 附近有个工团的自动肉联厂，我之前在那里干活。
dialogText.en: The woosters built an auto meat-packing plant nearby. I used to work there.

dialogText.cn: 前一阵，厂子突然被侵蚀灾害毁了。我逃了很久才找到离那里最近的工团属地。
dialogText.en: Some time ago, the plant was suddenly destroyed by a Blight disaster. I left, spent a long while on the road, and finally reached the nearest wooster territory.

dialogText.cn: 这里的卫生状态不利于病人恢复，也很难补充食物和水。
dialogText.en: The state of hygiene and sanitation here won't help the sick get better. You'll also have trouble getting more food and water.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，可……没有更好的办法。大家都累透了，也对付不了那么多裂地者。
dialogText.en: I know, but ... we don't have any other options. Everyone's exhausted. There's no way we can deal with that mob of breakers out there.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我想到一个方案。不过……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I have a plan, but...

dialogText.cn: 我们还不清楚袭击的全貌，贸然部署更多的协议设备，可能会增加行动的风险，甚至适得其反……
dialogText.en: We don't have enough information about this attack. Deploying more Protocol facilities without this knowledge can increase the risk of our mission ... or even jeopardize the entire operation...

dialogText.cn: 我们会承担这个风险。
dialogText.en: We would shoulder the risk.

dialogText.cn: 从山洞这边上去，倒是有一处工团的集散货场。我们本来打算在那里扎营。
dialogText.en: Heading up through this cave tunnel will take us to a wooster container park. In fact, we actually wanted to pitch our camp there.

dialogText.cn: 这里还有几个其他来路的人……算了，反正现在大家都一样。
dialogText.en: We got people from other places as well, there's... Ah, forget it. Everyone of us is the same now.

dialogText.cn: 就是他们，又多又凶残，你们千万要小心。
dialogText.en: That's them! Be careful! These monstrous scab eaters brought all their blighted cousins with 'em.

dialogText.cn: 有一定数量和规模，而且正在建造小型巢雕。
dialogText.en: A sizable breaker band. Bigger than a typical raiding party. They're building more of the smaller denstacks.

dialogText.cn: 战斗风险如何？
dialogText.en: Can we risk a direct engagement?

dialogText.cn: 只要动作够快，就不会有问题。
dialogText.en: If we strike quickly enough, we'll be done before they realize what hit them.

dialogText.cn: 那就速战速决！
dialogText.en: Alright! Let's make that happen!

dialogText.cn: 都清理干净了！
dialogText.en: Done and dusted!

dialogText.cn: 你们……这么厉害！
dialogText.en: You ... you're incredible!

dialogText.cn: 我跟你说过，他们能把裂地者都打跑！
dialogText.en: See! I told you, Mr. Soth! Them breakers got nothing on these heroes!

dialogText.cn: 唉，一团糟……先看看这里有哪些东西还能用吧。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Those breakers really messed up this place... I gotta see if there's anything we can still salvage and use.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，正好可以用集成工业系统的相关技术，为你们建造一个据点。
dialogText.en: Yes. We can use the AIC Factory and its technologies to build an outpost for you.

dialogText.cn: 据点是终末地设计的，依靠协议网络联系的支援节点。有协议核心在，我们马上就能进行实地运用。
dialogText.en: The Endfield-designed outpost is a support node linked to the Protocol network. Since we have a Protocol Automation-Core, we can commence field deployment at once.

dialogText.cn: 这个位置不错，就在这里投放次级核心吧。
dialogText.en: This location seems decent. Let's deploy a Sub-PAC here.

dialogText.cn: 是<@qu.key>次级核心</>，协议核心的子设备。我们能在它的范围内部署集成工业设备。
dialogText.en: This is a <@qu.key>Sub-PAC</>. We can build another AIC Factory around it, and support the growth of the actual outpost.

dialogText.cn: 至于精炼炉……后续建设需要将大量矿石精炼成材料，所以我就一并申请了。
dialogText.en: I've applied for an additional Refining Unit since we'll need plenty of processed ore to set up our outpost.

dialogText.cn: 不愧是佩丽卡！考虑得真周到！
dialogText.en: Incredible, Perlica. Always three steps ahead!

dialogText.cn: ……这是我应该做的。
dialogText.en: Just ... doing my job...

dialogText.cn: 这、这是什么法术？我只是眨了眨眼啊？
dialogText.en: What type of Arts is this? I just blinked, and it appeared out of nowhere!

dialogText.cn: 这个大家伙，它是你们说的“据点”吗？
dialogText.en: This thing is huge! Is this the outpost you're talking about?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……第一步完成了，接下来还有很多工作要做。
dialogText.en: Alright... This is just our very first step. We've got more to do.

dialogText.cn: 我刚刚进行了侦察，看来在这里建造巢雕，扩散烟雾，是碾骨氏族的目标。他们不会善罢甘休的。
dialogText.en: I made my recon run. The Bonekrushers are building more denstacks to spread their haze. They won't give up their objectives that easily.

dialogText.cn: 那边的山后有一条通道，他们应该会从那条路不断侵入。
dialogText.en: There's a trail behind the hill over there. The raiders would probably attack again from that direction.

dialogText.cn: 那……裂地者要是再来……
dialogText.en: W-what if those Landbreakers come back.....

dialogText.cn: 下一步就是建造作战设备，提供一些自动化的火力支援——以后，这样的作战设备可以出现在整个开拓区的前线上。
dialogText.en: Our next step is to construct some combat facilities. They will give us automatic fire support. In the future, these combat facilities can be used to fortify our entire frontier.

dialogText.cn: 我们先从最基础的作战设备开始。唔……得先准备一些晶体外壳。
dialogText.en: Let's start with the most basic combat facilities. Hmm... I believe we'll need some Origocrusts to start constructing.

dialogText.cn: 提醒一句，生产晶体外壳需要源矿，而现在缺乏足够的库存。
dialogText.en: We need Originium Ore to make Origocrusts. I don't think we have enough ore.

dialogText.cn: 那怎么办？难道要我现教他们几招剑术？
dialogText.en: What? That means we won't be getting any combat facilities! Or should I teach them some swordmancy...?

dialogText.cn: 终末地工业的物流技术可以解决这个问题。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Chen. Endfield logistics technology got that covered.

dialogText.cn: 枢纽区基地的伙伴们已经将一些源矿存入仓库中，我们可以通过次级核心远程取出这些源矿。
dialogText.en: Fellow Endfielders at the Hub Base have stashed some of our Originium Ore stockpile into the Depot. Our Sub-PAC can remotely access this Depot to acquire the ore.

dialogText.cn: 去次级核心底座的取货口看看吧。
dialogText.en: Let's go and take a look at the output port of our Sub-PAC.

dialogText.cn: 这是什么……铳械塔？还会转？
dialogText.en: These are ... Gun Towers? And they can rotate?

dialogText.cn: 靠这就能挡住裂地者吗？
dialogText.en: Can these turrets really stop the LBs?

dialogText.cn: 山那边有些动静。他们来了。
dialogText.en: There's movement on the hills. They're coming.

dialogText.cn: 什么？他们……也有这么一天？
dialogText.en: I ... I can't believe this. We ... we actually defeated the LBs...

dialogText.cn: 哈哈！我们赢了！那些混蛋再也不能欺负我们了！
dialogText.en: HAH! We won! Those scum sucking scab eaters will never hurt us again!

dialogText.cn: 只要掌握了可靠的手段，猎物也能在掠食者面前翻身。
dialogText.en: With the proper tools, even the prey can turn the tables against the predator.

dialogText.cn: 作战设备的表现达到预期。管理员，我们会把这里逐步建设成真正的据点。
dialogText.en: Performance of our combat facilities has reached our expectations. Endmin, we'll eventually turn this place into a proper outpost.

dialogText.cn: 只要确保物资供应，这里就能获得基本的生活维持能力。如果有人协助实地维护，我们的集成工业系统还能发挥更多作用。
dialogText.en: Providing a steady supply of resources will grant this place basic subsistence. If we assign an Endfielder to offer on-site support, the AIC Factory can operate more effectively and handle more tasks.

dialogText.cn: 据点，物资……各位，我们能先把这里当暂居处借用一阵子吗？
dialogText.en: The outpost ... and resources... Dear Endfielders, can you let us stay here for a while? We really need the shelter.

dialogText.cn: 索斯先生，你能作为联络人帮我们留意据点的状态吗？
dialogText.en: Mr. Soth, can I ask you to be our local liaison? We need someone to help us monitor the outpost's conditions.

dialogText.cn: 听起来就像过去在城市里处理订单一样……我大概清楚了。
dialogText.en: Gotcha ... it feels like filling out a catalog order form in the cities. I got this.

dialogText.cn: 附近的裂地者不少，聚在一起能安全些。如果谷地通道还有其他失散的难民，至少能在据点把人先安顿下来。
dialogText.en: Given the number of breakers nearby, people will feel a lot safer living as a community. Other straggling refugees in the Valley Pass can also find their way to this outpost.

dialogText.cn: 这本身就是设计据点的目标所在。虽然这里不是开拓区，它也理应在需要时成为可靠的庇护所。
dialogText.en: Indeed. This is what we aimed for when we designed the outpost. Although the place isn't exactly the frontiers, our outposts should also serve as a reliable shelter when necessary.

dialogText.cn: 我们可以利用次级核心提供支持。只要你定期列好清单，剩下的事情，终末地工业会帮忙解决。
dialogText.en: We can use the Sub-PAC to offer you support. Just give us a list of what you need on a regular basis. Endfield will take care of the rest.

dialogText.cn: 要不我们现在就试试？
dialogText.en: Why don't we give it a try right now?

dialogText.cn: 已经成功收到请求了。现在能调度的物资种类还有限，将来我们会扩充供应范围的。
dialogText.en: Request successfully received. The types of supplies we can allocate right now are still rather limited, but more would become available as we progress.

dialogText.cn: 只要这样配合你们的工作，就能把这里扩建成庇护所……多谢，我心里总算踏实些了。
dialogText.en: So by supporting your work, this place can become a proper shelter... Thank you so much. Feels like a huge rock being lifted off my chest.

dialogText.cn: 但危险依旧存在。你对这一带应该很熟悉，有没有通向裂地者聚集地的小道？
dialogText.en: But we still have potential threats lurking around. You seem familiar with this area. Know any secret trail to get inside the Landbreaker camp?

dialogText.cn: 什么？你们要去他们老窝？
dialogText.en: What? You're going to the breakers' lair?

dialogText.cn: 我们有自己的任务。
dialogText.en: We're on a mission.

dialogText.cn: ……我知道了。有个地下的通风管道或许能通到你们要去的地方。我们就是从那里逃过来的。
dialogText.en: ...I see. There's an underground ventilation shaft. We used it once to escape the raiders. It might get you there.

dialogText.cn: 丹尼尔，你们几个去把洞里的障碍物移开吧。有这几位在，该担心的是裂地者。
dialogText.en: Daniel, run along and remove the barricade in the tunnel. Now we got some serious professionals on our side, them pipefaces better start praying for their lives.

dialogText.cn: 好嘞，提心吊胆这么久，也该让他们尝尝“惊喜”了！
dialogText.en: Alrighty, sir. Those blighted scum terrorized us for long enough. Time for us to give 'em a nasty surprise!

dialogText.cn: 嗨，管理员！有点事要拜托你们。
dialogText.en: Hi, Endmin! I wonder if you can help me out with something.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地各处出现了一些奇怪的源石反应，你们现在的位置附近就有一个，能帮个忙吗？
dialogText.en: Strange Originium reactions have started to appear in various locations in Valley IV. There's one pretty close to your current location. Can you take a look at it?

dialogText.cn: 协议空间？刚刚出现的吗？
dialogText.en: A Protocol Space? Did it just appear?

dialogText.cn: 了解不多。我们偶尔会发现类似的现象。
dialogText.en: Not really. We just occasionally come across such phenomena.

dialogText.cn: 我也知道这个地方，以前我和阿吉在这里玩过捉迷藏……
dialogText.en: I know this place. Ginny and I used to play hide and seek here...

dialogText.cn: 裂地者来了之后，索斯先生担心他们偷袭，就带我们把附近的所有小路都堵上了。
dialogText.en: When those Breakers came, Soth had us block every path and trail. Don't want no raiders to sneak up on us.

dialogText.cn: 从这里往前就是裂地者扎堆的地方了……接下来，我们就帮不上忙了。
dialogText.en: Breaker central is up ahead... But I'm afraid we won't be much help beyond this point.

dialogText.cn: 阿吉？
dialogText.en: Ginny?

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡姐姐要走了……我有一个礼物要送给你们。
dialogText.en: Is Miss Perlica leaving...? I ... I got a small present for you.

dialogText.cn: 阿吉！不是让你躺着休息吗？
dialogText.en: Ginny! Weren't you supposed to be resting?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……抑制剂见效很快，太好了。阿吉，病情好转是好事，但是每天还是要多休息，不要勉强自己。
dialogText.en: Good to see you back on your feet, Ginny. Looks like the suppressants are doing their job. But make sure you get plenty of rest to fully recover.

dialogText.cn: 卡贾，这阵子你要多照顾下妹妹，尤其是留心她的身体状况。我把药剂和说明书都留下了，你要是看不懂，可以请索斯先生讲给你听。
dialogText.en: Take care of Ginny, Karja. Keep a close eye on her condition. I've left you a prescription and more medication. Ask Mr. Soth if there's anything you don't understand.

dialogText.cn: 好的，好的！我一定记住！
dialogText.en: Yes! Definitely! I'll keep that in mind. Thank you so much!

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡姐姐，这是我的画，送给你们。希望你们可以顺利！
dialogText.en: Please have this, Miss Perlica. I drew it myself. Wish you the best!

dialogText.cn: 画得真好看！阿吉，谢谢你。
dialogText.en: This is such a beautiful drawing! Thank you so much, Ginny.

dialogText.cn: 记住，家人是不可放弃的珍宝。做个好哥哥。
dialogText.en: Remember, boy — family is a treasure. Be a good brother to her.

dialogText.cn: 通风管道就在这边。
dialogText.en: Alright, guys. This is the ventilation shaft.

dialogText.cn: 哥哥，你们找到马克叔叔了吗？
dialogText.en: Karja, did you find Uncle Mark?

dialogText.cn: ……还没找到，阿吉。我们一定会再想办法的。
dialogText.en: Not yet, Ginny... But we'll try our best to find him.

dialogText.cn: 马克是帮助我们逃到这里的几位工团朋友之一。阿吉是被他一路抱来的，应该很担心他吧。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Mark was a good wooster crew mate. He helped us escape to this place and carried Ginny the whole way. That's why she's so worried about him.

dialogText.cn: 那马克他去哪儿了？人没事吧？
dialogText.en: So where did Mark go? Is he ... safe?

dialogText.cn: 我……我不知道。马克把我们安顿进来，就和其他人一起又出去了，再没来过洞里。
dialogText.en: I ... I don't know. Mark helped us settle in, then headed out with the others. He never came back to the cave.

dialogText.cn: 继续在这里担心也没什么意义，我们可以去裂地者的地盘找人。
dialogText.en: Standing around guessing won't get us anywhere. We should try our luck in the Landbreakers' territory.

dialogText.cn: 希望不要真的在那里找到……我们尽快出发吧。
dialogText.en: And I hope we don't find Mark there. It's too risky for non-combatants.... Let's move out ASAP, team.

dialogText.cn: 这地方有点阴森……裂地者在这里做过什么？
dialogText.en: This place feels a little creepy... What have the Landbreakers been doing here?

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀废料？狼卫，这也是碾骨氏族的习惯吗？
dialogText.en: Blighted waste? Wulfgard, is this part of the Bonekrushers' culture?

dialogText.cn: 他们点燃巢雕时确实会用到侵蚀物质。但很显然，这里没有巢雕。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers would use Blighted materials when igniting their denstacks. But clearly, there isn't any denstack here.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀几乎会干扰一切源石活动。直到现在，我们也只知道几种“利用”它的方法。
dialogText.en: The Blight can interfere with all sorts of Originium activities. As of now, we only know of a few ways of "utilizing" it.

dialogText.cn: 对碾骨氏族来说也一样。过去，这些人只会把巢雕淤积的侵蚀废料丢掉，而不是像这里一样摆起来。
dialogText.en: The same should apply to the Bonekrushers. In the past, they would simply discard Blighted waste that built up in their denstacks. But this place seems to be stockpiling the material.

dialogText.cn: 难道裂地者发明了新的用法？他们在搞研究？
dialogText.en: So the LBs came up with a new way of using it? They're actually doing science?

dialogText.cn: 所以……有结论吗？
dialogText.en: So... Any conclusions?

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀自超域中诞生，敬仰它的起源并不奇怪。
dialogText.en: The Blight arises out of Æther. It is natural for them to worship the birthplace of the Blight.

dialogText.cn: 如此说来，这个裂地者吸收侵蚀，是想要“拥抱”超域？
dialogText.en: That being said, since this Landbreaker was trying to absorb the Blight ... could it be an attempt to "embrace" the Æther?

dialogText.cn: 裂地者里不缺疯子……但超域和源石不同，并不能直接成为武器，至少我不知道这样的方法。
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers are never short on crazies... But the Æther isn't like Originium. It can't be used directly as a weapon — at least, not that I know of.

dialogText.cn: 他们在尝试吸收侵蚀……我从未见过这种疯狂的举动，看来聂菲斯给他们带来了很大的变化。
dialogText.en: They're trying to absorb the Blight... Darn it. I've never seen anything this crazy. Nefarith has turned the Bonekrushers into something very different.

dialogText.cn: 碾骨氏族以前不会这么做，也许我们不能只把他们当强盗军阀看了。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers never did this before. Maybe we should stop treating them as a warlord faction of bandits.

dialogText.cn: 在其他裂地者看来，狼群跟终末地的合作应该更加可恨。
dialogText.en: Other Landbreakers probably hate the Pack more, since we work with you, Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 不过，哼，随他们怎么想。
dialogText.en: But, heh. Who cares what they think?

dialogText.cn: 现在只能去亲眼确认了。走吧走吧，夜长梦多啊。
dialogText.en: I say we go see for ourselves what they're really up to. Let's go — no point wasting time in guesswork.

dialogText.cn: 狼卫，碾骨氏族的“深渊”是指什么？
dialogText.en: Wulfgard, what does "the Deep" mean to the Bonekrushers?

dialogText.cn: 超域。他们一直崇拜超域，所以才不使用源石造物，只接触巢雕这种传承下来的巫术装置。
dialogText.en: The Ætherside. They have always worshiped the Æther — that's why they avoid using Originium. They would only use devices based on witchcraft, such as denstacks.

dialogText.cn: 整片区域都被烟雾封锁了，还好有这条暗道。
dialogText.en: They sealed off this entire place with their haze. Fortunately we still have this secret tunnel.

dialogText.cn: 那些就是用来供能的小型巢雕。只要破坏它们，让大巢雕熄火，我们就能顺利前往谷地要塞。
dialogText.en: Those smaller denstacks are used for powering the central furnace. Take them out to extinguish the giant denstack, end the haze, and give us a way to reach the Valley Fort.

dialogText.cn: 事不宜迟，赶紧开工吧。
dialogText.en: Alright. Time to demolish some stacks!

dialogText.cn: ——我们是大地的弃子。
dialogText.en: ——The land abandoned us.

dialogText.cn: 哪来的声音？
dialogText.en: What was that?

dialogText.cn: ……聂菲斯。
dialogText.en: ...Nefarith.

dialogText.cn: 不要受到法术的影响，继续前进。
dialogText.en: Don't be affected by her Arts. Let's keep going.

dialogText.cn: 救救我！拜托！救命啊！
dialogText.en: Help me! Please! Get me out of here!

dialogText.cn: 那是工团的工服。
dialogText.en: She's in UWST outfit.

dialogText.cn: 动手，解决下面的敌人！
dialogText.en: Let's clear out the scum below her!

dialogText.cn: 你们是终末地的人吗？天啊，我还以为死定了……我一直能听到那个女人的声音……
dialogText.en: Are you Endfielders? Thank goodness, I thought I was going to die here... I keep hearing that woman's voice in my head...

dialogText.cn: 你为什么会被他们关在这里？
dialogText.en: Why are you locked in here?

dialogText.cn: 我是工团的施工队长肖娜。四号谷地被袭击后，许多工友失散了。我打听到裂地者在抓人，就想着这里会不会也有……
dialogText.en: I'm Shawna... I lead a UWST construction crew. Many of my crew went missing after the attack on Valley IV. When I heard the Landbreakers were hunting people down, I thought I might find some of my crew here...

dialogText.cn: 除了我们刚才干掉的人，还有其他看守吗？
dialogText.en: Do they have other lookouts besides the ones we just took out?

dialogText.cn: 本来不止这些人，但他们似乎是收到了什么命令，有一半人进到了要塞里。我看到了你们，这才敢试着呼救。
dialogText.en: There used to be more Landbreakers here ... but then they got some kind of order, and half of them went into the Fort. I only dared scream for help when I saw you.

dialogText.cn: 说起来，你有看到马克吗？他应该和几个工人一起在疏散难民。
dialogText.en: I see... Any other people held here? We're looking for Mark. He was helping evacuate the refugees with his crew mates.

dialogText.cn: 马克？我刚刚看着他跟裂地者一起去了要塞！真是个懦夫……
dialogText.en: Mark? I saw him following the Landbreakers to the Valley Fort... Damn coward...!

dialogText.cn: 这……难道他投降了？
dialogText.en: Wha... Did he surrender?

dialogText.cn: 马克……你叫肖娜，对吗？要塞那边就交给我们了，你先回基地待命，那边已经安全了。
dialogText.en: Surrendered...? Your name is ... Shawna, right? Leave the Fort to us. You should head back to the base — it's safe now.

dialogText.cn: 我先去找找附近还有没有其他幸存者，然后尝试返回基地，希望你们一路顺利。
dialogText.en: Okay ... but I'm going to look for other survivors first, then make my way back to the base. Good luck, you guys.

dialogText.cn: 我们走吧，去要塞，不能再拖了。
dialogText.en: No more delays. Let's head straight into the Fort.

dialogText.cn: 工人遍体鳞伤，已然不再呼吸。
dialogText.en: The UWST crew mate is covered in wounds and no longer breathing.

dialogText.cn: 最后时刻，他手中仍紧紧握着一支矿石病抑制剂。
dialogText.en: In his dying moments, he still clenches an Oripathy suppressant in his hand.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，谷地要塞的情况怎么样？刚才的动静是……
dialogText.en: Endmin, Supervisor Perlica! What happened at the Valley Fort? We just heard something...

dialogText.cn: 碾骨氏族的首领就在谷地要塞。她临走前破坏了大桥，我们晚到一步。
dialogText.en: The chief of the Bonekrushers was at the Valley Fort. She blew up the bridge before she left. We were right behind her, but it was too late.

dialogText.cn: 那条路是我们支援供能高地的最短路线。现在空中载具受锚点干扰，难以提供支援……这些人的意图很明显。
dialogText.en: That road is our shortest way to support the Power Plateau. Air support would be difficult as our flying vehicles would be affected by the Ankhors... These people have made their goals quite clear.

dialogText.cn: 希望狼卫能及时回报裂地者的动向……秦工程师，我们还有其他道路能够通往供能高地吗？
dialogText.en: I hope he can stay safe and keep us updated on the landbreakers' movements... Director Qin, is there any other way to reach the Power Plateau?

dialogText.cn: 我们还可以穿越源石研究园前往供能高地，但那条路更花时间，而且……
dialogText.en: We can reach the Power Plateau by going through the Originium Science Park... But that is the longer route, and...

dialogText.cn: 锚点坠落时引起了大片区域的塌方，清障工作难度很大。安德烈，现场的情况怎么样？
dialogText.en: The Ankhorfall triggered a huge landslide. Cleaning it up will be difficult. Andre, report — what's the situation in the field?

dialogText.cn: 路全被山石挡住了，还真有点棘手。我让勘测员把详细情况发出来，你们先看看！
dialogText.en: It's bad. The road is completely blocked by a significant buildup of rocks and rubble. Our surveyors just sent us the details. Take a look!

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，基地的恢复工作还很繁重，恐怕组织清障大队要多花一些时间。
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, we are currently occupied with the Hub Base recovery. Organizing the landslide-clearing team may take a while.

dialogText.cn: ——现场的迹象符合特征，但聂菲斯为什么……
dialogText.en: Traces at the scene match the patterns. But how did Nefarith...?

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督？
dialogText.en: Uh, Supervisor Perlica?

dialogText.cn: ……啊，不好意思，我分神了。请务必尽快准备，我们得快点查清他们的目的。
dialogText.en: Oh ... apologies. I was a little distracted. Please, make haste with the preparations. The true objectives of our opponents must be identified quickly.

dialogText.cn: 我明白。这些裂地者不同寻常。
dialogText.en: I understand. These Landbreakers are far beyond ordinary bandits.

dialogText.cn: 秦工程师，四号谷地过去有观测到任何……能够直接操纵超域现象的人类吗？
dialogText.en: Director Qin, have we ever detected any individual in Valley IV who is ... capable of manipulating the Æther directly?

dialogText.cn: 什么？
dialogText.en: What?

dialogText.cn: 不，当然不可能。由于超域的危险性，相关研究一直受到严重阻碍，人类根本不可能直接安然无恙地接触超域……
dialogText.en: No, such abilities are not possible. The Æther is simply too dangerous. Our attempts to study the Æther are severely hampered by its lethality. No human individual can make direct contact with the Æther safely...

dialogText.cn: 毕竟，超域是“生命诞生的反面”……不是吗？
dialogText.en: After all, the Æther is the "side opposing the origins of life"... right?

dialogText.cn: 我们都知道课本上对这句话的批注。泰拉人还没有完全解明这颗星球上的所有奥秘。
dialogText.en: Yes, but we're all familiar with the textbook footnote on this quote. The Terrans did not have a full understanding of the secrets held by this planet.

dialogText.cn: ……好吧。总之，我们还有很多眼前的事要关注。
dialogText.en: ...That's true. In any case, there are plenty of matters on our hands that we must deal with.

dialogText.cn: 有什么我们能帮上忙的吗？
dialogText.en: Okay, is there anything we can do to help?

dialogText.cn: 请到集成核心区域帮助安德烈吧，我们直接在那里准备物资。
dialogText.en: Yeah... Please help Andre at the Core AIC Area. We'll be preparing our supplies at that place.

dialogText.cn: 按照规划蓝图，这个集成工业系统片区目前还处于早期建设阶段。
dialogText.en: According to our grand development strategy, this AIC sector is still in its infancy.

dialogText.cn: 正常来说，搭建工业流水线不是一朝一夕的事。我们在四号谷地做了许多技术积累，所以可以很快发展起来。不过，由于环境不同，其他地方可能没有这样的速度。
dialogText.en: Usually, production lines can't be built overnight. But technological advancements we made in Valley IV can now speed things up. Well, things can be faster at this place, at least. The other sites might not have our more conducive environment.

dialogText.cn: 除此之外，想要生产大型设备还需要准备不少能源……
dialogText.en: We'll also need plenty of electricity and power to manufacture large machinery and equipment...

dialogText.cn: 清障车队会配置多功能钻探器，那些大家伙需要消耗大量源矿燃料。
dialogText.en: The landslide-clearing crew will be assigned a multi-purpose drill. This big boy will need plenty of Originium Ore as fuel.

dialogText.cn: 我们必须提高采集矿物的效率。要先在工业发展规划中<@qu.key>升级</>相关的工业技术。
dialogText.en: We must boost our mineral mining efficiency. To do that, we should first <@qu.key>research</> the right tech upgrades in our AIC Factory Plan.

dialogText.cn: 你好，管理员！
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 容我自我介绍一下，我是工程中心外派技术员波可丝，也是集成工业系统的运维人员！
dialogText.en: Let me introduce myself. I am technician Pocus from the Endfield Engineering Division. I'm also a technical ops for the AIC!

dialogText.cn: 如你所见，我在附近部署了很多协议采录桩。就绪之后，它们会像现在这样提醒大家进行回收。
dialogText.en: As you can see, I've deployed plenty of Protocol Dataloggers in this area. Once enough data has been gathered, they'll behave like this — it's a special signal to retrieve the data.

dialogText.cn: 这台已经可以对接回收了，请试试看吧。在一些更复杂的环境里，它还可能一口气生成好几个<@qu.key>工业点数</>呢。
dialogText.en: This particular datalogger is ready for interaction and retrieval. Go ahead and try it out. In more complex environments, a single datalogger might generate multiple <@qu.key>AIC Index</> points at once.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，准备好源矿和紫晶矿了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, do we have the required Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore?

dialogText.cn: 干得漂亮，这样能源问题就解决了。
dialogText.en: Nicely done. Our energy problem is now history.

dialogText.cn: 清障大队已经集合完毕，等整备完成之后就可以开始动工了。
dialogText.en: The landslide-clearing team has been assembled. Once the preparations are complete, the team can begin their work.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了，我们还剩哪些物资有缺口？
dialogText.en: Good job. Is there anything else we're short on?

dialogText.cn: 装备、工具、大修套件……很多，但都能搞定。万尼科夫负责现场的指挥调度，您可以向他了解情况。
dialogText.en: A lot. Gear, tools, overhaul kits ... but we should be able to take care of them. Vannikov is responsible for directing the work on the site. You can talk to him to learn more about the situation.

dialogText.cn: 不着急，我们还有时间。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. We still have time.

dialogText.cn: 原来您真的就是管理员啊！多谢你们帮了我们这么多工友，大伙都等着开工了，不过现在有点犯愁……
dialogText.en: So you really are the Endministrator! Thank you so much for helping our crew mates out there. Everyone's ready to get some work done but we ... got a small problem...

dialogText.cn: 不必拘谨，现在事态紧急，有什么困难尽管告诉我们。
dialogText.en: There's no need for such formalities here. Given the urgency of our situation, just go ahead and tell us what you need.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生坚持要让我们带上超域能量探测装置。但它产生的负荷很大，普通的工服很难快速完成改装。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre insists that we equip Æther counters during work. The issue is, these devices have quite a heavy load, and we haven't had time to modify our standard coveralls.

dialogText.cn: 我能理解安德烈先生在担心什么。万尼科夫先生，如果改装实在困难，我们可以重新生产一批防护服。
dialogText.en: I understand Mr. Andre's concerns. Mr. Vannikov, if modifying your standard crew coveralls is a problem, we can produce new protective suits for your crew.

dialogText.cn: 这……咱们总不能现在开始建一整个厂区出来。
dialogText.en: What...? But I don't think we can just build a garment factory right now...

dialogText.cn: 终末地有一整套配合协议核心进行精细生产的方案，我们马上开始准备吧。
dialogText.en: Endfield has a comprehensive plan for precision manufacturing, centered around our Protocol Automation-Core. We can get started on it right away.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样了？我们可以开工了吗？
dialogText.en: Hey friends, how's it going? We're almost ready — just wrapping things up.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！这些装备都能用得上！非常感谢。
dialogText.en: Oh! They look wonderful! We can definitely use them! Thank you so much, Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 这些都是现造的？这就是集成工业系统？有点厉害啊。
dialogText.en: Brand new gear out of thin air... Incredible. You made all these with your AIC system?

dialogText.cn: 以前听说过很多终末地工业的故事，百闻不如一见，要是以后都这么方便，那可省事了。
dialogText.en: I heard so many stories about you Endfielders but the real deal is just ... impressive! If things were always this effortless, life would be a breeze!

dialogText.cn: 准备开工！
dialogText.en: Alright! I'm ready for the job!

dialogText.cn: 大家信心满满啊，管理员！
dialogText.en: Everyone seems pretty pumped, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 人员的准备完成了，下一步就是对车辆进行修复和改装。
dialogText.en: Now that the crew is ready, our next step is to repair and modify a suitable vehicle.

dialogText.cn: 部件拆解和更换就交给现场的工人吧，我得定制一批零件，给车辆做些必要升级。
dialogText.en: The field crew can take care of the disassembly and replacement of parts. I gotta work on a suite of customized components. They will give the vehicle some essential upgrades.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，研究工业发展规划中的“零件制造”，获得<@qu.key>配件机</>，我们就万事俱备啦。
dialogText.en: Endmin, research the <@qu.key>Parts Fitting</> tech on our AIC Factory Plan. After that, we'll be all set.

dialogText.cn: 行，那我们再等等！
dialogText.en: Okay, then. We'll be waiting for your good news.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，咱们的升级零件怎么样啦？
dialogText.en: Endmin, how are we doing with the upgrade parts?

dialogText.cn: 就是它！太好啦！
dialogText.en: This is it! Wonderful!

dialogText.cn: 倒车，固定限位器，准备信号测试……好！
dialogText.en: Reverse gear. Check. Stabilizing outriggers. Check. Initiating signal testing... All good!

dialogText.cn: 工程车辆升级完毕，能动的全在这儿了——效率高得简直像做梦！
dialogText.en: Construction vehicle upgrades are complete. All the moving parts are in place — This efficiency is miraculous! It's like a dream!

dialogText.cn: 不远了，不远了。集成工业系统的运作状况比想象中还好，我们应该把量产计划再扩大一些……
dialogText.en: A dream that's coming true! The AIC Factory is working far better than I expected. We gotta expand our mass production plans...

dialogText.cn: 你最好也在第一时间把更新后的预算方案提交给我。
dialogText.en: And make sure you give me the new budget as soon as you have it.

dialogText.cn: 终末地制造过许多大型工业设备，但通过集成工业系统来“速成”，这还是头一回。
dialogText.en: Endfield has constructed many large industrial machines, but this is our first time using the AIC to build one on the fly.

dialogText.cn: 这是一个向着远大愿景前进的起点……管理员，想象一下，我们的建设将会改变多少人的生活！
dialogText.en: This is a first step towards our grand vision... Endmin, just imagine how many lives we can improve with our construction capacity!

dialogText.cn: 看来准备工作相当顺利，总算能听见点好消息了。
dialogText.en: Prep work seems to be going well. We finally have some good news for a change.

dialogText.cn: 采石场的受损情况比较严重，我们接收到了不少工人的求救信号。
dialogText.en: The Quarry suffered significant damage. We received multiple distress calls from the crews there.

dialogText.cn: 我们已经派遣了救援队，不过当时出发得仓促，总会有顾虑不全的地方。如果您还有余力的话，可以过去看看。
dialogText.en: We've dispatched a rescue team but it was hastily prepared. They might not be able to cover all scenarios. I hope you can check the area if you have the time to spare, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这样的准备应该足够了，但……
dialogText.en: Um... Our preparations seem complete, but...

dialogText.cn: 不，抱歉，没什么。
dialogText.en: No, sorry. It was nothing.

dialogText.cn: 总之，先把能做的工作都做好吧。遇到任何需要集成工业系统的地方，我和波可丝随时都能帮忙。
dialogText.en: In any case, we should make sure all preparation work is carried out accordingly. Pocus and I are ready to help if you have questions about the AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 如果你们希望扩展集成工业系统的功能，也可以用上这个拓展核心，它能够实现更复杂的工业发展规划。
dialogText.en: If you want to add more features to our AIC, you can use this Expansion Core. It will provide a more advanced factory development plan.

dialogText.cn: 建设集成工业系统，帮助其他地方的工人，我们能做的事情还有很多。
dialogText.en: There are many things we can do — expand our AIC Factory, help crew mates in the other areas, and much more.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，由你来做决定吧。
dialogText.en: The decision is yours, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 不急，您先忙别的。
dialogText.en: No rush. Go ahead and do your thing.

dialogText.cn: 秦主管，工程车辆已经部署完成了，周边的清理工作也已经告一段落，现场的工人们都做好了准备，只剩下一些调试工作了。
dialogText.en: Director Qin, the construction vehicle has been deployed. We also cleared away the surrounding debris. Our crew is ready to go once we're done with fine-tuning the vehicle.

dialogText.cn: 好的，接下来的工作就等管理员……看来他们已经到了。
dialogText.en: Good job. Now we'll wait for the Endmin to... Ah, looks like they've arrived.

dialogText.cn: 是管理员和佩丽卡监督，多谢你们之前救了我！
dialogText.en: Endministrator! Supervisor Perlica! Thank you so much for saving my life out there!

dialogText.cn: 各位进攻谷地要塞后，我们找回了许多失散的工人，也救出了一些还被关着的幸存者。
dialogText.en: While you launched the attack on the Valley Fort, we found many lost crew mates. We also freed some imprisoned survivors.

dialogText.cn: 我们能顺利脱困，多亏了终末地派来的援助！
dialogText.en: It's all thanks to Endfield that we managed to escape!

dialogText.cn: 放心，每个四号谷地的人都知道那里有多重要。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Everyone in Valley IV knows how important the Power Plant is.

dialogText.cn: 自从那个罗丹被击败，裂地者似乎放缓了脚步……至少我们能期待局面继续改善了。
dialogText.en: At least the defeat of that Rhodagn forced the other breakers to slow down... We can actually start hoping for the situation to get better.

dialogText.cn: 好了，先聊点眼前的。管理员，清障工作即将完成，可以开始准备下一步行动。
dialogText.en: Yeah, but now we should focus on the work at hand. Endmin, we're almost done clearing away the landslide. The next step of our operation may begin.

dialogText.cn: 很遗憾，目前我们还是没联系上工团在供能高地的负责人。派往那个方向的无人机全数坠毁，通信干扰依旧严重。
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, we cannot get in touch with the UWST site directors of the Power Plateau. We lost every drone we dispatched to that area. Severe radio interference is denying our efforts to call them.

dialogText.cn: 碾骨氏族显然掌握了一些干扰技术。但他们如此大费周章，到底想得到什么呢……
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers clearly possess some radio interference equipment. But why would they do all this? What are they after...?

dialogText.cn: 供能高地的源石发电站承担了整个四号谷地的主要发电任务，一直都被联盟工团重点管控。
dialogText.en: The Power Plateau has an Originium Power Plant. It's the primary source of power in Valley IV and has been closely monitored by the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 那里还有联盟工团的超域试验场。先不论裂地者想得到什么，我们的损失一定会很大。
dialogText.en: The UWST also has an Æther Test Site at the plateau. I don't know what the Landbreakers are looking for, but losing the place would deal a grievous blow to our side.

dialogText.cn: 没错。四号谷地有一处长期维持的超域裂隙，很早就被纳入监控管理了。
dialogText.en: That's right. There is a quasi-permanent Æther rift in Valley IV. The Test Site has been monitoring this phenomenon for quite a while.

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二地表有不少这样的超域裂隙。即使肉眼无法观测，它们也会给周遭空间带来侵蚀灾害或其他影响。
dialogText.en: There are plenty of such Æther rifts throughout Talos-II. Most are undetectable to the unaided eye, and they often bring about Blight disasters or affect the vicinity in various ways.

dialogText.cn: 总之，联盟工团在供能高地投入了许多力量，他们应该能争取一些时间。
dialogText.en: Suffice to say, the UWST has deployed sizable defenses to the Power Plateau. They should be able to hold out for a while.

dialogText.cn: 希望他们多留意源石发电站，聂菲斯一直在指挥手下优先破坏电力系统呢。
dialogText.en: I just hope they can defend the Originium Power Plant properly. Nefarith has been making her underlings sabotage the power systems.

dialogText.cn: 欸，那个方向不就是……
dialogText.en: Holy?! Isn't that the direction of...

dialogText.cn: 超域裂隙被撕开了？怎么会？
dialogText.en: An Æther rift has opened? How did this happen?

dialogText.cn: 喂……呼叫……理员……
dialogText.en: Come in, Endmini ... you copy?

dialogText.cn: 管理员！！佩丽卡监督！！
dialogText.en: Endministrator!! Supervisor Perlica!!

dialogText.cn: 哈……哈……供能高地出大事了，侵蚀反应到处都是！所有仪表都快被撑报废了！
dialogText.en: Hooo... The Power Plateau! Something terrible's happened there! Blight reactions everywhere! All readings are going beyond the threshold!

dialogText.cn: 秦工程师，我们需要一个避难方案。
dialogText.en: Director Qin, we need an evacuation plan.

dialogText.cn: 枢纽区基地暂时还是安全的，但超域活动这么剧烈，侵蚀很快就会蔓延过来。
dialogText.en: The Hub area is safe for now, but with such violent Æther activities going on, the spreading Blight might soon reach this place.

dialogText.cn: 如果更多道路被侵蚀切断，后果不堪设想……
dialogText.en: If the Blight destroys more of our roads and transport routes, the results would be disastrous...

dialogText.cn: 对、对了！还有办法！你们还记得<@qu.key>TA-TA原型机</>吗？
dialogText.en: Hold! HOLD ON! I got a solution! Do you remember the <@qu.key>TA-TA Prototype</> we were working on?

dialogText.cn: 它可以中和超域能量的波动。只要离那道裂隙够近，也许能把扩张控制住！
dialogText.en: The Prototype can stabilize Æther energy fluctuations. If we can get it close enough to the rupture rift, we might contain its spread!

dialogText.cn: 秦主管，去源石研究园的路已经挖通了，但那边的情况也不妙！
dialogText.en: Director Qin, we've cleared the road to the Originium Science Park. The situation at that place isn't looking too good either.

dialogText.cn: 没时间挑剔了，请安排工人把原型机运过去。
dialogText.en: Time is critical. Have your crew move the Prototype there, now.

dialogText.cn: 如果超域和现实空间接触，就会制造裂隙，引发侵蚀。
dialogText.en: When the Ætherside comes in contact with realspace, it creates a rift and triggers a Blight reaction.

dialogText.cn: 现在的情况就像死火山喷发，但侵蚀可比岩浆危险多了！
dialogText.en: What we're seeing right now is similar to an eruption of a dormant volcano! Except this one spits the Blight, and it's way more dangerous than lava!

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯可能激化了供能高地那条稳定的超域裂隙……这是早有预谋的破坏。
dialogText.en: Nefarith may have energized the previously stable Æther rift at the Power Plateau... She has planned this deliberate act of sabotage.

dialogText.cn: 我还可以调整它的广域施术单元，局部消除侵蚀现象……嗯，应该能做到！
dialogText.en: I can even adjust its large area Arts Unit. This will let the Prototype get rid of localized Blight... Oh yes, this is totally doable!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？！那台机器这么厉害？
dialogText.en: Really?! That chunky bot can do that?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，我们直接在万尼科夫那里和你们会合。
dialogText.en: Endministrator! Supervisor Perlica! We'll meet up with you at Vannikov's site.

dialogText.cn: 你们怎么样？刚才的超域爆发对你们有什么影响吗？
dialogText.en: How are you doing? Is the crew affected by the Æther rupture that just took place?

dialogText.cn: 我们没事，刚才进行了紧急避险，好在这一带没有出什么意外。
dialogText.en: Everyone's fine. We followed the rules and evacuated for a bit. Thankfully, nothing too serious happened around here.

dialogText.cn: 不过对面情况很糟。有几个兄弟先带着最急用的物资过去了，侵蚀太多，大家也不敢再妄动。
dialogText.en: But there's major blightery on the other end of this road. A few crew mates are already off to deliver the most essential supplies to the place. But there's just too much Blight. We can't afford to risk our lives.

dialogText.cn: 谨慎行动是对的，专业工作还是需要专业工具。
dialogText.en: Being cautious is the right move. You need professional tools to handle professional work.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了集成工业系统和基地的工程师们，还好在极限时间里赶上了！
dialogText.en: We managed to make the Prototype work on time. All thanks to the AIC and our Hub Base engineers!

dialogText.cn: （高兴的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 在侵蚀严重地区开启TA-TA原型机的主动干涉功能，它能让侵蚀核心暴露出来。然后，需要你们动手对核心进行物理干预。
dialogText.en: Once you're in a severely Blighted area, activate the Prototype's active interference function. This should expose the Blight Core. Then you'll have to manually inflict some physical interference to the exposed core.

dialogText.cn: 当然，不要忘了TA-TA原型机的本职功能，请诸位务必将它安全送到供能高地。我们需要用它阻止超域裂隙继续扩张，这关乎到四号谷地的生死存亡。
dialogText.en: Of course. But don't forget about the Prototype's true function. Do whatever you can to escort it safely to the Power Plateau. We must use it to stop the expansion of the Æther rift. Your mission will determine the survival of everything in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这一路上需要保护好原型机。只要原型机还在，我们就还有机会。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, we'll keep the Prototype safe. It is our chance to avert this crisis.

dialogText.cn: 时间不多了，我们走吧！
dialogText.en: Let's not dally, team. Time to go!

dialogText.cn: 也就是砍侵蚀核心一顿咯？行吧，至少这个比上理论课容易。
dialogText.en: You mean some chopping and slashing? Yeah, I can do that. This is way easier than a class on theoretical blightery.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 等等！前面的区域处于紧急状态，现在禁止通行，你们得去那边的哨站登记身份！
dialogText.en: Stop! The area up ahead is under a state of emergency. No one is allowed to enter! Head over to the sentry post and register your identities!

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 我看看，三个人和一个古怪机器，一个黎博利……一个瓦伊凡……呃，你是……阿戈尔？
dialogText.en: Let me see. Three individuals and a strange machine. We have a Liberi ... a Vouivre... And you're an ... Ægir?

dialogText.cn: 你认错了！看清楚，我才不是瓦伊凡！我是龙。
dialogText.en: You got it wrong! Look closely! I'm not a Vouivre! I'm a Lung.

dialogText.cn: 我们来自终末地工业，秦工程师应该和工团提前同步过我们的信息。
dialogText.en: We are from Endfield Industries. Director Qin should have synced our information with the UWST already.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 终末地工业？嗯……等等，我核查一下身份库。
dialogText.en: Endfield Industries? Hmm... Let me check our personnel information database.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 你不在终末地提供的档案里……你是？
dialogText.en: You're not in the Endfield personnel database... Identify yourself.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 管理员？那就不奇怪了……
