dialogText.en: Endmin? I guess that explains it...

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 已确认身份。佩丽卡监督，陈千语干员，袭击发生得突然，我们不得不谨慎。
dialogText.en: Identity verified. Supervisor Perlica and Operator Chen, we have to be extremely circumspect given the sudden nature of the attack.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 还有……管理员，安全局知道您的到来意味着什么。
dialogText.en: And ... Endministrator, the Security Bureau knows what your presence means for our situation.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 工团安全局也没有您的认证信息，但终末地的这份档案通过了我上级部门的认证，我相信您的身份。
dialogText.en: The UWST Security Bureau has no records of your information, but this Endfield file has been approved by my superiors. I have faith in your identity.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 你们想必是因为头顶那裂隙而来吧？
dialogText.en: I believe you're here for that rift in the sky, right?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们在调查超域试验场发生的灾害，需要立刻前往那里。
dialogText.en: Yes. We're still investigating the Æther Test Site disaster and must reach the place quickly.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 按《公约》条例，我们工团应当援助几位的行动。
dialogText.en: Pursuant to the provisions of the Accord, the UWST is obliged to lend you assistance in your operations.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 但我现在的首要目标是搜救幸存者，实在抽不开身，抱歉。
dialogText.en: But my primary task is to search and rescue local survivors. Apologies, but I'm afraid I must stay at my post.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 沿着这条路走，就能到超域试验场，沿途可能被侵蚀阻碍。
dialogText.en: Keep going down this road and you'll reach the Æther Test Site. However, you might encounter masses of Blight on your path.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你提供的信息，我们还不知道你的名字。
dialogText.en: Thank you for sharing this information. How should we address you?

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 法比安·柯林斯。
dialogText.en: Fabian Collins.

dialogText.cn: 看你的神情，研究园里的受灾情况很严重吗？
dialogText.en: Mr. Fabian, you look troubled. Has the Science Park suffered major damage?

dialogText.cn: 不能再好了。天使、侵蚀、裂地者……谁知道接下来还有什么“惊喜”？
dialogText.en: I don't think the show could get any better. We've already got the Aggeloi, the Blight, and breaker scum in the mix... Who knows. Perhaps another "surprise" is waiting around the corner.

dialogText.cn: 你们来了，说明路通了。今天的第一条好消息。
dialogText.en: But the fact that you're here proves the road to the Hub is open. That's my first good news of the day.

dialogText.cn: 枢纽区基地现在相对安全，你们可以过去避难。
dialogText.en: The Hub Base is relatively safe for now. You can evacuate to that place for shelter.

dialogText.cn: 我还不能撤，现在疏散出来的只是少数人。
dialogText.en: I can't leave my post just yet. We only managed to evacuate a fraction of our crew.

dialogText.cn: 安全局有一个名单，上面有研究园里所有人的名字。
dialogText.en: The Security Bureau has a list of names of everyone in the Science Park.

dialogText.cn: 我会一个一个确认研究园内的人员情况，他们还等着我们去救援。
dialogText.en: I've got to verify the status of their personnel, one by one. Plenty of them are still in need of help and rescue.

dialogText.cn: 对了，我有个同事在前方搜救，她叫艾莱扎。如果有困难，可以找她。
dialogText.en: One more thing. There's a colleague of mine conducting SAR operations up ahead. Her name's Aleeza. You might want to talk to her if you run into trouble.

dialogText.cn: 祝你们好运。
dialogText.en: Good luck out there.

actorName.cn: 年轻的男性工人{法比安·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 那你是宏科院的人？怎么会来这儿？
dialogText.en: Does that mean you're from the Hongshan Academy of Sciences? Why are you here?

dialogText.cn: 好，这里就辛苦你了。我们得赶紧出发。
dialogText.en: Alright, then. I'll leave this place in your hands. We must be off.

dialogText.cn: 看你们的了……管理员。
dialogText.en: We're counting on you to see this through, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 我从来没见过那样的裂隙……那附近的深度肯定已经远超安全阈值。
dialogText.en: I've never seen a rift like that before... The depth readings around there must be way beyond the safety thresholds.

dialogText.cn: 裂隙的下方就是供能高地，那里还留守着几位工团的负责人。如果他们还活着……就一定会采取行动。
dialogText.en: The Power Plateau is right underneath the rift. A few UWST site monitors are keeping the place secure. They'll definitely do something about this ... if they're still alive.

dialogText.cn: 等研究园的搜救工作告一段落，我也会去那边。
dialogText.en: Once we wrap up our SAR operations at the Science Park, I'll be heading over to the Plateau as well.

dialogText.cn: 该死的裂地者……
dialogText.en: It's those damn breakers...

dialogText.cn: 早看出他们有问题。当时哪怕是冒点险，也该处理掉！
dialogText.en: I knew there was something wrong about them. We should have taken the risk and got rid of them early on!

dialogText.cn: 裂地者居然攻到了这么深的地方。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Who would've thought they'd fight their way here...

dialogText.cn: 之前他们都在四号谷地的外围活动，借他们十个胆儿，也不敢招惹工团。
dialogText.en: Those breakers used to be active around Valley IV. They used to be cowards who wouldn't dare to step onto UWST turf.

dialogText.cn: 但裂隙出现后，设备瘫痪，通信中断……他们趁乱闯了进来，打了我们一个措手不及！
dialogText.en: But the appearance of the rift busted all of our gear and facilities. The radio was out... And the pipefaces took advantage of the situation. They barged in and took us all by surprise!

dialogText.cn: 这批裂地者……很不寻常。我遇到了一群疯子，他们硬扛下了防御无人机的能量炮……而且毫发无损。
dialogText.en: They ... don't look normal to me. I ran into a band of those loonies. They tanked energy cannon fire from our defense drones ... and survived without a scratch.

dialogText.cn: 这绝对不对劲。我要尽快完成救援目标，然后和总部联络。
dialogText.en: Nothing about this feels right. I've got to complete my SAR objectives and get in touch with HQ.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 塔塔，你能搞定天上的大麻烦吗？
dialogText.en: Well, Tata, do you have what it takes to fix that serious blooper in the skies?

dialogText.cn: （不悦的表情）
dialogText.en: *Displeased emote*

dialogText.cn: 哎，塔塔生气了！
dialogText.en: Wow, Tata's upset!

dialogText.cn: 原型机真能听得懂你说的话吗……
dialogText.en: Are you sure the Prototype knows what you're talking about...?

dialogText.cn: （不悦的表情）
dialogText.en: *Displeased emote*

dialogText.cn: 你看，它在抗议呢！别叫“原型机”了，叫塔塔！
dialogText.en: Look! It's protesting! Stop calling it the Prototype! Its name is Tata!

dialogText.cn: 好了，别生气了，塔塔。
dialogText.en: Sorry, Tata, I didn't mean to upset you.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: （享受的表情）
dialogText.en: *Enjoyment emote*

dialogText.cn: 它看起来很高兴呢。
dialogText.en: It looks really happy.

dialogText.cn: （紧张的表情）
dialogText.en: *Nervous emote*

dialogText.cn: 一切正常。希望接下来会顺利。
dialogText.en: Everything looks normal. I hope everything will work out for us.

dialogText.cn: （坚定的表情）
dialogText.en: *Determined emote*

dialogText.cn: 这条路堵死了。我们是不是得想办法绕过去？这绕得过去吗？
dialogText.en: This path is blocked. We might have to find another way around... I mean, do we have another way around to start with?

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀……在这么短的时间里就成形了。
dialogText.en: The Blight... Can't believe it has taken hold so quickly.

dialogText.cn: 不要靠近！它们……非常危险。
dialogText.en: Don't get too close! They're extremely dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 看样子，供能高地上方的裂隙已经造成了严重的后果……剧烈的超域活动留下了这些痕迹，这片区域将持续笼罩在超域能量下，所有的生物都面临着生存危机。
dialogText.en: The rift above the Power Plateau seems to be exerting rather horrendous effects... These scars upon the land can only be inflicted by violent Æther activities. The area will be continuously exposed to Æther energy. The survival of all living beings will be jeopardized.

dialogText.cn: 那……我们要怎么通过这里？
dialogText.en: So ... how are we supposed to get through this place?

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 差点把你忘了。
dialogText.en: We almost forgot about you.

dialogText.cn: 希望伊冯的设计能起作用……
dialogText.en: Let's hope Yvonne's designs can work...

dialogText.cn: 准备<@qu.key>启动原型机</>。
dialogText.en: Prepare to <@qu.key>activate the Prototype</>.

dialogText.cn: 哇，启动了！佩丽卡，看！
dialogText.en: WHOA! It worked! Perlica, take a look at this!

dialogText.cn: 等一下，塔塔的样子好像有些不对，机身的温度好高！
dialogText.en: Wait, Tata's not looking good. I think it's ... heating up!

dialogText.cn: （难受的表情）
dialogText.en: *Pained emote*

dialogText.cn: 看着像有点难受……
dialogText.en: It seems to be in pain...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，破坏暴露出的<@qu.key>侵蚀核心</>，就可以继续前进了。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, please destroy the exposed <@qu.key>Blight Core</>. That should clear the way for us.

dialogText.cn: 加油，塔塔！接下来就全靠你了。
dialogText.en: Go for it, Tata! We're all counting on you.

dialogText.cn: （坚定的表情）
dialogText.en: *Determined emote*

dialogText.cn: （困惑的表情）
dialogText.en: *Confused emote*

dialogText.cn: 没反应？！不会是胖大鸟说错了按钮吧！
dialogText.en: Nothing happened?! Maybe Big Owl told me the wrong button.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生不会在这种地方出现失误的。也许是实验室频率没法模拟意外情境……
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre is unlikely to make mistakes in technical issues like this. Perhaps the experimental frequencies failed to simulate unexpected scenarios like...

dialogText.cn: 成功了。这个就是侵蚀核心！
dialogText.en: Success. That's the Blight Core!

dialogText.cn: 这次紧急行动对塔塔来说，或许还是太早了……看来广域施术单元不能随便启用。
dialogText.en: This emergency operation might be a little too early for Tata... We must be very cautious in deploying its large area Arts Unit.

actorName.cn: 年轻的女性工人{艾莱扎·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 好险……差点就没命了，谢谢！你们是？
dialogText.en: Phew... I thought I was done for. Thank you so much! And you are?

dialogText.cn: 我们是终末地危机处理小组。
dialogText.en: We're the Endfield Crisis Team.

actorName.cn: 年轻的女性工人{艾莱扎·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 终末地？哈……看来枢纽区基地的情况已经稳定了。
dialogText.en: Endfield? Ohhh... I guess you people got your sitch at the Hub Base under control.

dialogText.cn: 你还好吗？需要什么帮助吗？
dialogText.en: Are you alright? Need any help?

actorName.cn: 年轻的女性工人{艾莱扎·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 不用，我没有大碍。我正打算把伤员们带去哨站。
dialogText.en: Thank you but I'm totally alright. In fact, I'm planning to take our wounded to the sentry post.

actorName.cn: 年轻的女性工人{艾莱扎·柯林斯}

dialogText.cn: 对了，我叫艾莱扎·柯林斯，隶属联盟工团安全局。很高兴见到你们！
dialogText.en: By the way, I'm Aleeza Collins. UWST Security Bureau. Pleased to meet you!

dialogText.cn: 柯林斯？刚才我们遇到了一位安全局的人，叫法比安·柯林斯。
dialogText.en: Collins? We just met someone from the Security Bureau called Fabian Collins.

dialogText.cn: 啊，还顶着一副臭脸对吧？那是我哥，但他总是管我叫“同事”。
dialogText.en: Ah? Fabian the Stinkface? That's my brother. He always calls me his "colleague" for some reason.

dialogText.cn: 那看来没错了！
dialogText.en: Then that's definitely him!

dialogText.cn: 你们走这条路，是想要去超域试验场吧？
dialogText.en: I'm guessing you're taking this road to reach the Æther Test Site.

dialogText.cn: 没错，我们原本打算沿着公路走……
dialogText.en: That's right. We actually wanted to keep going down the road, but...

dialogText.cn: ……看来你们得找一条新路了。
dialogText.en: But it seems you'll need to find another way.

dialogText.cn: 先去<@qu.key>崖边</>看一下情况吧。
dialogText.en: Let's get closer to the <@qu.key>cliff edge</> and take a look.

dialogText.cn: 刚才多谢你们了！
dialogText.en: I must thank you again for saving us, Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 是的，那场面……我这辈子估计都忘不掉了。
dialogText.en: Yes ... I did. It was a horrible sight that I'll never forget.

dialogText.cn: 超域试验场的方向传来了一声巨响，甚至影响到了研究园这里，破坏力太大了……
dialogText.en: The huge explosion came from the Æther Test Site. It even shook the Science Park. The entire event was too awful for words...

dialogText.cn: 随后，天空出现异象，到处都开始爆发侵蚀。你们也要小心。
dialogText.en: And the sky itself seemed to go mad right afterwards. Blight masses started to rupture all over the place. I'd be careful if I were you.

dialogText.cn: 这个方向的搜救已经结束了，我得去和哥……法比安会合。
dialogText.en: We've completed all our SAR objectives in this area. I've got to meet up with my bro... I mean, time to rendezvous with Fabian.

dialogText.cn: 这里只有我们两个有战斗能力，我们必须确认所有人的情况……
dialogText.en: Fabian and I are the only two proper combatants in this place. We've got to stay on top of things and check on everyone...

dialogText.cn: 就像父亲常说的，“生要见人，死要见尸”。
dialogText.en: Just like my old man used to say: "Find and evac all the living, bag and tag all the bodies."

dialogText.cn: 看，管理员。这破坏场景就像刚才我说的一样……让人只觉得触目惊心。
dialogText.en: Look, Endministrator. The destruction caused by the Blight is ... truly a terrifying sight.

dialogText.cn: 我刚才听到你们说要穿过源石实验园区？
dialogText.en: I heard that you're looking for a way through the Originium Science Park.

dialogText.cn: 这个，可以借给你们。
dialogText.en: I can lend this to you. It will help.

dialogText.cn: 这是权限卡，你知道怎么用吧？大门打开的时候，小心裂地者。
dialogText.en: This is an access card. I'm sure you know how to use it. Just watch out for the Landbreakers when you open the gate.

dialogText.cn: 当然，谢谢。
dialogText.en: We will. Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 还有件事，伤员们说是伊冯……就是研究所的那位研究员，多亏伊冯拖住了裂地者，不然很多人连撤离的时间都没有。
dialogText.en: Oh, one more thing. Some of our injured crew said Yvonne ... that scientist in the Research Center, managed to hold off the breaker scum. Most wouldn't have made it out in time otherwise.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，剩下的事交给我们，你先护送伤员。
dialogText.en: Got it. Please help evac the injured. We'll take care of the rest.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，也替我们对伊冯说句谢谢。虽然那个人平时有点……特立独行，但这次无疑成了我们的英雄。
dialogText.en: Will do. And pass my thanks to Yvonne. They can be ... a little strange. But in tough times like these, Yvonne really stepped up and became everyone's hero.

dialogText.cn: （难受的表情）
dialogText.en: *Pained emote*

dialogText.cn: 塔塔的表情病恹恹的，刚才的扫描肯定造成了很大负担。
dialogText.en: Tata looks quite sick. The scan we performed may have overworked its systems.

dialogText.cn: 我没法诊断不熟悉的设备，只能从它的表情和声音来判断了。
dialogText.en: I can't diagnose an unfamiliar device. We could only make our best guesses from its emotes and sounds.

dialogText.cn: （愉悦的表情）
dialogText.en: *Joyous emote*

dialogText.cn: 它好像很喜欢管理员你呢。
dialogText.en: Wow. I think it likes you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 它看起来心情好多了，管理员使用了能力吗？
dialogText.en: It seems much better now. Did you just use your powers, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 我也来，我也来试试。
dialogText.en: Let me do that too! I give very nice rubs.

dialogText.cn: （抗拒的表情）
dialogText.en: *Rejection emote*

dialogText.cn: 哇，区别对待！
dialogText.en: Wha?! Now you're being unfair!

dialogText.cn: （可爱的表情）
dialogText.en: *Cute emote*

dialogText.cn: 这才对嘛，乖。
dialogText.en: That's more like it. Be nice!

dialogText.cn: 既然塔塔好一些了，我们就继续上路吧。
dialogText.en: Now that Tata is feeling better, we should start moving again.

dialogText.cn: 启动不了……是断电了。
dialogText.en: It won't budge... Its power is out.

dialogText.cn: 根据设计规划，这个大门是靠附近的三个发电机供能的，我们逐一检查过去吧。
dialogText.en: According to the design plans, this gate is powered by 3 electric generators nearby. We should look around.

dialogText.cn: 你什么时候连工团的规划图都拿到啦？
dialogText.en: Since when did you get your hands on UWST blueprints?

dialogText.cn: 这种大门是工团在开拓区的标准设计，终末地也帮助建设过一些。
dialogText.en: This gate features a standard UWST architecture for frontier facilities. In fact, Endfield also constructed a few of these for them.

dialogText.cn: 我们自己的部分设施也是这样的结构。
dialogText.en: Some of our own facilities are built with the same designs.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的各位……看来，这一路并不太平。
dialogText.en: Endfielders... I guess this hasn't been the smoothest of your journeys.

dialogText.cn: 法比安，他们刚才消除了侵蚀，把我们救了出来。
dialogText.en: Come on, Fabian. They just eliminated the Blight and got us out safely.

dialogText.cn: 消除了侵蚀？终末地的技术我倒是有所耳闻，没想到还能……总之，还是谢谢你们了。
dialogText.en: Eliminated the Blight? Well, I've heard about Endfield tech, but didn't expect them to... In any case, you have my most sincere gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 也谢谢你们的权限卡。
dialogText.en: And thank you for the access card.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我们这一路上没有遇到多少幸存者。
dialogText.en: Yeah, but ... we didn't run into many survivors along the way.

dialogText.cn: 能撤到哨站的只是少数……园区内……恐怕情况并不乐观。
dialogText.en: Only a few successfully evacced to the sentry post... The sitch in the Park ... is probably not too pretty.

dialogText.cn: 工人们说，一部分人逃往了基建前站，还有一部分人被困在了地下区域。
dialogText.en: The crew mates told us that some escaped to the Infra-Station, while others were probably trapped in the underground areas.

dialogText.cn: 地下？可裂地者也在里面……
dialogText.en: Underground? But the breakers are down there too...

dialogText.cn: 只能指望那些被改造过的装置能派上用场了。
dialogText.en: Well, we can only hope those modified devices do their job.

dialogText.cn: 在这里祈祷也没什么用，我们走。
dialogText.en: Staying here and praying won't do anything. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 你们还要回实验园区？
dialogText.en: You're heading back to the Park?

dialogText.cn: 截至目前，还有一半人没确认状态。
dialogText.en: As of now, half of our people are still unaccounted for.

dialogText.cn: 活着的，带走；倒下的，背回去。联盟工团没人会被落下。
dialogText.en: If they live, we guide them out. If they fall, we carry them back. The United Syndicates leaves no one behind.

dialogText.cn: 不，这是我们的任务。你们的使命更重要，整个四号谷地的命运……现在都握在你们手上。
dialogText.en: No. This is our mission. You carry a far greater responsibility — we can't afford to hold you back. The fate of Valley IV ... rests in your hands.

dialogText.cn: 我们会尽可能清理掉园区里的裂地者。
dialogText.en: Then we'll do our best to clear out the Landbreakers in the Park.

dialogText.cn: 那再好不过了，我们会紧盯着你们的行进路线，优先搜寻你们途经的区域。
dialogText.en: That will definitely help us a lot. We'll be right behind your team and search the areas you've passed through.

dialogText.cn: 这条路不好走，务必小心。
dialogText.en: Try to stay on guard. The road ahead isn't easy.

dialogText.cn: 前面就是伊冯所在的研究所了。
dialogText.en: That's the Research Center. Yvonne should be inside.

dialogText.cn: 到处都是涂鸦，里面肯定挤满了裂地者。这得心眼多大，才会觉得躲在里面很安全？
dialogText.en: I see graffiti everywhere. The place must be stuffed with Landbreakers. You gotta be super deluded to think you're safe with these blighted housemates.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……但谁也不能保证还能守多久，加上塔塔现在这个样子，我们可拖不得。
dialogText.en: Indeed... But we don't know how long Yvonne can hold out. Tata is in bad shape. We can't afford to delay its repairs.

dialogText.cn: （痛苦的表情）
dialogText.en: *Painful emote*

dialogText.cn: 走吧，研究所正面的<@qu.key>侵蚀核心</>已经暴露了，清除那些侵蚀，我们从正面冲进去！
dialogText.en: Let's go. The <@qu.key>Blight Core</> on the front side of the Research Center has been exposed. Remove the Blight and clear a way through the front doors!

dialogText.cn: 当心！
dialogText.en: Careful!

dialogText.cn: 伊冯，我们到研究所里了。
dialogText.en: Yvonne, we're inside the Research Center.

dialogText.cn: 这栋楼里面有不少极度危险的裂地者，你的实验室还安全吗？
dialogText.en: There are a lot of extremely dangerous Landbreakers in this building. Is your lab safe?

dialogText.cn: 放心，他们攻不进来，我有的是办法——现在最要紧的是TA-TA原型机！
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Those Blighted fools can't reach my place because I got my gadgets. Fixing my Prototype is the top priority now!

dialogText.cn: 你们要把它带去供能高地吧？那就得赶快了！
dialogText.en: You need to take it to the Power Plateau, yeah? Well, then. You better hurry!

dialogText.cn: 我们这就到<@qu.key>二楼</>去——跟着你的指引无人机，对吧？
dialogText.en: We're making our way to the <@qu.key>second floor</>. We should follow your guide drone, right?

dialogText.cn: 这个表情图案有点眼熟，是不是有点像塔塔？
dialogText.en: These emotes look rather familiar. Don't they remind you of Tata?

dialogText.cn: （自然的表情）
dialogText.en: *Homely emote*

dialogText.cn: 嗯……在这些小细节上，制作者的个人风格体现得还真是明显。
dialogText.en: Hmm... The creator does leave a rather obvious signature in these tiny details.

dialogText.cn: 你们这些入侵者都给我听好了！这里是我的地盘！我在这里布置了天罗地网，还有新研发的最强防御系统——
dialogText.en: Intruders! Listen up! This is my turf! I've prepared some serious hell for all of you, furnished with my latest and most powerful defense system!

dialogText.cn: 重制版第六代铁誓军型……无知又狂妄的入侵者们！等着被烧成灰吧！
dialogText.en: Generation 6 Order of Steel Oath REMAKE... So, for all you dumb-dumb crazies messing up my place! Incineration awaits!

dialogText.cn: 这是……
dialogText.en: What was that...?

dialogText.cn: 进入园区之后，塔塔的表情一直很兴奋呢！可能是快见到伊冯了，毕竟——
dialogText.en: Tata keeps showing excited emotes since we entered the Park! Maybe it knows it's going to meet Yvonne. After all...

dialogText.cn: （兴奋的表情）
dialogText.en: *Excited emote*

dialogText.cn: 怎么？害羞了？
dialogText.en: What is it? Are you shy?

dialogText.cn: 我甚至能感觉到它在微微颤抖……
dialogText.en: I can even feel it trembling slightly...

dialogText.cn: （雀跃的表情）
dialogText.en: *Overjoyed emote*

dialogText.cn: 是故障反应吗……又不像。难道说塔塔有自己的情绪？
dialogText.en: Is the damage causing the vibrations...? Doesn't seem like it. But does this mean Tata actually has emotions?

dialogText.cn: （轻松的表情）
dialogText.en: *Relaxed emote*

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀流堵塞了大多数去路。
dialogText.en: The Blightflood clogged most of our paths.

dialogText.cn: 看，我们要去的那栋楼，门口完全没法通行了。
dialogText.en: Look. That's the building we're trying to reach, but there's no way of us getting through that door.

dialogText.cn: 只能让塔塔多扫几次了，现在好像也冷却下来了……
dialogText.en: Looks like we'll need Tata to run a few more scans. I think it has cooled down enough...

dialogText.cn: （抗拒的表情）
dialogText.en: *Rejection emote*

dialogText.cn: 欸？……塔塔你还好吗？
dialogText.en: Huh...? Tata, are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 它看起来有些抵触……刚才扫描后就有些过热了，一路扫过去的话，多半是撑不住的。
dialogText.en: It seems a little hesitant... The previous scan overheated Tata, and it might not hold up if we use it over and over again.

dialogText.cn: 得想办法提升扫描效率，减少扫描的次数。比如……找到更好的位置，一次解决多个核心？
dialogText.en: We need to improve our scanning efficiency to reduce the number of scans. Maybe we can ... find a better position and locate multiple Blight Cores at once?

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀影响太严重，又联系不上安德烈了。
dialogText.en: The Blight is messing up the radio comms. We lost Andre again.

dialogText.cn: 园区内有协议通讯信号塔，我们可以用它放大信号。
dialogText.en: There's a Protocom Signal Tower in the Park. We can use it to amplify our signals.

dialogText.cn: 怎么了，管理员？
dialogText.en: What is it, Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 嗯？管理员的意思是？
dialogText.en: Hmm? So you're saying...

dialogText.cn: 管理员对源石电路的理解比任何人都更深刻，相信管理员的判断吧。
dialogText.en: The Endmin has a far better understanding of Originium circuitry compared to anyone else. Let's have faith in the Endmin's judgment.

dialogText.cn: 从这里就能看到信号塔。看上去地面已经走不通了，我们从<@qu.key>地下</>过去吧。
dialogText.en: We can see the signal tower from here, but the surface roads are blocked. Let's try our luck going through the <@qu.key>underground</> path.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你是回想起了什么吗？就像……之前修东西时那样？
dialogText.en: Endmin, did you just remember something? Like you did when you were ... repairing stuff earlier?

dialogText.cn: 这些无人机对塔塔没有反应。
dialogText.en: These drones seem to be ignoring Tata completely.

dialogText.cn: 既然出自同一个人之手，它们应该有自己的识别系统。
dialogText.en: Since they're designed by the same person, they should have their own friend or foe identification system.

dialogText.cn: （轻松的表情）
dialogText.en: *Relaxed emote*

dialogText.cn: 不过，就算触发设置是安全的，我们也得小心，别让塔塔被爆炸波及。
dialogText.en: But even if Tata is identified as a friendly, we should remain cautious and keep Tata away from the explosions.

dialogText.cn: 啊！
dialogText.en: WHOA!

dialogText.cn: 你们、你们不是裂地者吧？
dialogText.en: You ... you're not Landbreakers, right?

dialogText.cn: 你看我们这样子也不像啊。
dialogText.en: None of us look like Landbreakers, okay?

dialogText.cn: 我们是终末地危机处理小组，你为什么会躲在这种地方？
dialogText.en: We're the Endfield Crisis Team. Why are you hiding here?

dialogText.cn: 然后……伊冯的通信就来了，让我们立刻在这里集合。
dialogText.en: And then ... we started hearing Yvonne's broadcasts, telling us to assemble here immediately.

dialogText.cn: 人刚到齐，那些机关就开始发射激光。裂地者是被挡在了外面，我们也……一时半会儿出不去了。
dialogText.en: Once everyone got here, those special mechanisms started firing lasers. I know they helped keep the Landbreakers out ... but they also kept us in this place.

dialogText.cn: 确实是伊冯的风格……
dialogText.en: Well, that does sound like Yvonne...

dialogText.cn: 现在外面……还安全吗？
dialogText.en: So how are things outside...? Is it safe?

dialogText.cn: 地面上目前有大量裂地者，而且还有侵蚀。
dialogText.en: There are still plenty of Landbreakers on the ground floor. There is the Blight as well.

dialogText.cn: ……那看来地下反而更安全，伊冯是对的。
dialogText.en: I guess the underground is safer for now. Yvonne was right.

dialogText.cn: 法比安和艾莱扎也在找你们，他们应该不久后就到。
dialogText.en: Fabian and Aleeza are also looking for you. They should be here soon enough.

dialogText.cn: 他们……安全局果然没有抛下我们！
dialogText.en: They're here... The Security Bureau have never left us behind!

dialogText.cn: 有他们在，说明其他人也都得救了吧！太好了……
dialogText.en: If they're around, the others are likely safe too, right? This is great news...

dialogText.cn: 看来你很信任他们嘛。
dialogText.en: You seem to believe in them.

dialogText.cn: 安全局对于工团人来说就是“安全”二字的象征，只要他们开始行动了，事情总会好起来的。
dialogText.en: As crew mates of the UWST, we treat the Security Bureau as the provider of security itself. Things always get better once the bureau takes action.

dialogText.cn: 那就好，不用那么紧张，他们会带你们去避难的。我们还有任务在身，要继续前进。
dialogText.en: That's great. You can relax a little — the Collinses will take you all to safety. We'll have to keep moving to carry out our mission.

dialogText.cn: 是那群裂地者……警报响起的时候，我们还在园区里进行实验……
dialogText.en: It's those Landbreakers... We were still running our tests in the Park when the alarms sounded...

dialogText.cn: 柯林斯一家从上一辈就在谷地工作，老柯林斯还参与了研究所大楼的建设。这里的人都很信赖这两兄妹。
dialogText.en: The Collinses have worked in the Valley for two generations. Old man Collins even took part in the construction of the Research Center. Everyone here has faith in the young Collins siblings.

dialogText.cn: 信号塔没有受损，直接就能启动。但以塔塔的状态，能行吗……
dialogText.en: The signal tower is undamaged. We can activate it straight away, but ... I don't know if Tata can pull it off in its current state...

dialogText.cn: （可靠的表情）
dialogText.en: *Reliable emote*

dialogText.cn: （难受的表情）
dialogText.en: *Pained emote*

dialogText.cn: 太好了！你做到了！太棒了！
dialogText.en: Incredible! You did it! You're the best!

dialogText.cn: （痛苦的表情）
dialogText.en: *Painful emote*

dialogText.cn: 糟糕，这样下去外壳都会烧坏的，得赶紧联系伊冯——
dialogText.en: This isn't good. This overheating will burn through the chassis. We should call Yvonne.

dialogText.cn: 伊冯就是这个性格。
dialogText.en: That's Yvonne for you.

dialogText.cn: 这位伊冯……先生？究竟是……？
dialogText.en: What's this Mr. Yvonne like...? I'm so confused.

dialogText.cn: 算了，等我搞定了，再找他算账！这次维护手册他来写，赖不掉了！
dialogText.en: Okay, I'll fix this first and settle the scores later! That silly owl gotta write that maintenance manual now. He's got no more excuses!

dialogText.cn: 你们赶紧来我的实验室找我！还有，别再用那个功能！
dialogText.en: Come find me at my lab! Quickly! And don't use that function again!

dialogText.cn: 明白。路上有什么要注意的吗？
dialogText.en: Got it. Is there anything we should look out for along the way?

dialogText.cn: 小心沿途的裂地者……等等，不应该是你们担心我吗？
dialogText.en: Watch out for the Landbreakers along the way... Wait. Aren't you even worried about me?

dialogText.cn: 其他地方不好说，这里不是你的地盘吗？
dialogText.en: I might be concerned if you were somewhere else. But I thought the Park is your territory.

dialogText.cn: 哼，那是。别看他们来势汹汹，其实早就掉进我的陷阱了。“迎宾队”马上就到，顺便让你们开开眼界。
dialogText.en: Hmph, obviously. Don't be fooled by the breakers and their ridiculous posturing — they've walked right into my trap. My welcoming party is en route. Keep your eyes peeled for a spectacle.

dialogText.cn: 等你见到就明白了……
dialogText.en: You'll understand once you meet Yvonne face to face...

dialogText.cn: 我们到二楼了，接下来怎么走？
dialogText.en: We reached the second floor. Which way should we go?

dialogText.cn: 实验室在右边，但通道被侵蚀堵塞了——
dialogText.en: The lab is to our right, but the Blight clogged the way—

dialogText.cn: 走另一条路！我派了新的指引无人机，跟着它们的灯光走就好啦。
dialogText.en: So take the path with no Blight, durh! I've sent new guide drones to your place. Just follow their lights.

dialogText.cn: 那个……你好？
dialogText.en: Uhm ... hello?

dialogText.cn: 对了，佩丽卡监督，戴着面具的这一位是？
dialogText.en: Oh, by the way, who's behind the mask, Supervisor Perlica?

dialogText.cn: 是管理员，我们现在一起行动，来解决四号谷地的头号问题。
dialogText.en: This is our Endministrator. We're working as a team to resolve the most pressing issue of Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 管理员……？事情已经闹到这么大了？
dialogText.en: The Endministrator...? Does that mean things are looking ultra-bad right now?

dialogText.cn: ……在我知道的管理员故事里，需要您出面解决的都不是小事。
dialogText.en: ...From the stories I've heard about you, Endmin, if something needs you to step in, it must be huge.

dialogText.cn: 伊冯……小姐？你和我想象中完全不一样，你刚才……是在做什么？
dialogText.en: Miss ... Yvonne? I was really expecting someone completely different. What were you doing ... just now?

dialogText.cn: 威慑，威慑！稍微用了点有威慑力的声音。我把那些有点不正常的裂地者都关在了研究所里，如果他们跑出去，外面的人可就危险了。
dialogText.en: Ahem. I was striking fear into those LBs — had to sound a little more intimidating! I also tried to keep the freakish breakers in the Research Center. If any of them got out, people outside would be in serious trouble.

dialogText.cn: 和裂地者锁在一栋楼里，你自己不危险吗？
dialogText.en: But won't those Landbreaker housemates ... make you uncomfortable?

dialogText.cn: 也不看看这里是谁的地盘？我对这个园区了如指掌，在这里比在自己家里还安全！这个研究所的许多门禁也能从我这里控制，他们进不来这个房间的。
dialogText.en: Well, this turf isn't theirs. I know the Park like the back of my hand. Honestly, this place might be even safer than my actual home! I can also control door locks and room access from here. They'll never get into this bunker.

dialogText.cn: 只是外面的侵蚀一时半会儿解决不了，不过这不是我的宝贝小车来了嘛，这下就有办法了！
dialogText.en: My only problem is the Blight masses outside. They will be sticking around for a while. Now that my baby bot's here, I believe I have a solution!

dialogText.cn: 我刚才远程调取了参数记录，还好，核心模块没有受损，但修起来也不容易。
dialogText.en: I've just remotely acquired data from the Prototype. The core modules are still intact, but repair work will be extensive and challenging.

dialogText.cn: 供能高地的事故和裂隙我都看到了，就和我跟安德烈以前的预想差不多……确实只有TA-TA原型机能挽回局面，但你们也太乱来了！
dialogText.en: I've witnessed the Power Plateau incident and the rift, and they're not too different from the scenarios that Andre and I cooked up... The Prototype is indeed our only way to turn things around, but you really made a mess of it!

dialogText.cn: 原型机的本质是一个特殊的自主施术单元，通过释放被编译在内的特定源石技艺来引发源石能量脉冲——
dialogText.en: The Prototype is essentially a specialized automated Arts Unit. It is programmed with a special suite of Originium Arts that it can cast. Its Arts are designed to trigger an Originium energy pulse ——

dialogText.cn: 从而使物质宇宙下的小规模裂隙，在构造上发生瓦解，直到完全崩溃。这有多危险，你们明白吗？
dialogText.en: The pulse would then cause small rifts in the material universe to structurally disintegrate and collapse completely. Now, do you have any idea how dangerous this process is?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……没明白……？
dialogText.en: Uhm... No... You used some really hard words...

dialogText.cn: 意思就是！操作不当的情况下，非但裂隙解决不了，原型机自身还可能损坏解体。你们的胆子是真的大。谁想出来的用法啊？
dialogText.en: Sigh... I'll translate that for you. Improper use won't solve your rift problem. In fact, you might end up damaging or even destroying the Prototype. Are you nuts or what? Seriously, who came up with this crazy idea?!

dialogText.cn: 既然是管理员……唉，算了。小车没出事就好，帮上了你们的忙也很好。我修好它之后，不要再这样用了！
dialogText.en: If it's the Endministrator, then ... well. I'm glad that the Prototype is alright and managed to help you out. I'll get it fixed, but don't do that again, please!

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督……唉，算了。小车没出事就好，帮上了你们的忙也很好。我修好它之后，不要再这样用了！
dialogText.en: If it's Supervisor Perlica, then ... well. I'm glad that the Prototype is alright and managed to help you out. I'll get it fixed, but don't do that again, please!

dialogText.cn: 陈千语干员——！不是所有问题都能靠正面的拳脚功夫解决啦！这种时候得靠巧劲，巧劲！
dialogText.en: Ahem... OPERATOR CHEN —! You can't solve every problem by swinging at it! Can't you at least use some finesse and brains?!

dialogText.cn: ……你是不是刚刚还在移动终端上看我的人事信息啊？
dialogText.en: Wha...? Were you spying on my profile data from your palm terminal?

dialogText.cn: ……唉，算了。小车没出事就好，帮上了你们的忙也很好。我修好它之后，不要再这样用了。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Forget it... I'm just glad that the Prototype is alright and managed to help you out. I'll get it fixed, but don't do that again, please.

dialogText.cn: 总之，在这个实验室里没办法展开修理，需要带到研究所后门的检修平台上处理。既然你们几位来了，就还要麻烦你们把大楼里的裂地者清理一下。
dialogText.en: Anyway, this lab is too cramped for carrying out the repairs. We gotta take the Prototype to the repair platform at the back gate. And since you're here anyway, I'd appreciate it if you'd be nice enough to clean up my unwanted LB housemates.

dialogText.cn: 你们进来的时候，我就在调校替换零件的功率，马上就做完了。
dialogText.en: I was calibrating the power output of the replacement parts when you came in. And I'm almost done.

dialogText.cn: 你做事挺有条理嘛，跟这个房间的风格还挺不一样。
dialogText.en: You seem like someone who works in organized ways. But your room looks completely different.

dialogText.cn: 有什么不一样的？这个房间的每一个角落都是我精心布置的。就像捕捉研究时的灵感一样，靠的都是直觉！
dialogText.en: Looks completely different? I've carefully set up every corner of this room. It's like catching a moment of inspiration during science! It's all about intuition and instincts!

dialogText.cn: 你们在这里休息一会儿吧，记得不要乱碰东西……稍后我们一起下去。
dialogText.en: You may rest here. Just don't poke around my stuff... We'll head down once you're ready.

dialogText.cn: 你们进来啦？好快！
dialogText.en: Oh, ah-ha. You got in. That's quick.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀……会一点点浸透你们的全身。你们的皮肤会先烂掉！然后恶心，呕吐……还会拉肚子！
dialogText.en: Blight... That stuff will eat its way through your system. Your skin will rot away! And then you'll feel real sick, puke all over the place ... and suffer some serious mud butt!

dialogText.cn: 感受到了吗？深度正在升高哦，你们会……那个，呃……那个……对了！你们的手指会一点点变得……
dialogText.en: Hehehe... Feel that? Ooh, Depth readings are rising. You'll be ... that. Yeah, that... Oh, by the way, one by one your fingers will start going... Uhh...

dialogText.cn: 呜，佩丽卡监督，你怎么才到！怎么只有你们和我的宝贝小车在一起？安德烈呢？
dialogText.en: Nm-hmm! Supervisor Perlica! You're finally here! What took you so long... Oh, just you guys? Where's Andre?

dialogText.cn: 他还在基地。安德烈先生告诉我们，关闭天上的裂隙需要用到你的这台设备，我们正要赶过去。
dialogText.en: He's still at the Hub Base. Mr. Andre told us that we need to use your machine to seal the rift in the sky, and we must get there quickly.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？其实你在一边休息就好啦……不过非要说的话……
dialogText.en: Well, you can actually hang around and stretch your legs... But since you said that...

dialogText.cn: 管理员！那边的架子上有一堆唱片，你帮我选首音乐吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I got a stack of vinyls over there. Pick a nice song for me!

dialogText.cn: 试试看，能不能选中我最爱的那首。选对的话，说不定我的工作效率会直线飙升哦！
dialogText.en: Let's see if you can pick out my favorite song. If you hit the mark, you might even make my work productivity skyrocket!

dialogText.cn: 我看好你哦！
dialogText.en: I'm betting on you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 安德烈！那个家伙，上次打的赌他还没结清。他说好要帮我设计法术扩散器，这样一路上护送你们的就会是超级暴鸰！
dialogText.en: Hmph! Andre! He still owes me for that bet. He promised to design the Arts dissemination device. If he'd pulled that off, you'd have Super-Bombtails as your armed escorts!

dialogText.cn: 但——他已经拖了六！个！月！啦！
dialogText.en: But he's delayed that module for SIX! FRIGGIN'! MONTHS!

dialogText.cn: 为伊冯挑选一张唱片——
dialogText.en: Pick a vinyl for Yvonne ——

dialogText.cn: 哇！你的口味怎么跟安德烈一模一样！这张还是他落在这儿的呢。
dialogText.en: Wow! Your taste is exactly the same as Andre's! He's the one that left that vinyl here.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈提起他过去的“英雄事迹”，三句话离不开你，说你们俩当年对集成工业系统的讨论如何如何……看来他还真没吹牛。
dialogText.en: Andre couldn't stop talking about you, especially when he started going off on his "heroic achievements". He kept squawking about how the two of you planned out the AIC Factory blahblahblah... And it seems like he wasn't exaggerating.

dialogText.cn: 这音乐确实跟你们俩的年纪很搭。不会是你们当年一起听的吧！
dialogText.en: This music really does fit someone your age. Did you and Andre listen to this together?

dialogText.cn: 但……跟工作氛围太不搭了！还是换一首吧！
dialogText.en: Buuut ... it's not the best music for work! Can we switch to something else?

dialogText.cn: 哦？这是上周刚到的，我还没听过呢。
dialogText.en: Ooh! That one was delivered last week! I didn't even have a chance to listen to it yet.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……确实蛮好听的，但也太沉闷了吧！我的小暴鸰听到这个估计都会直接睡着！
dialogText.en: Hmm... It's pretty nice, but also a little boring! My Tweety-Bombs would probably switch to sleep mode immediately if they listen to this!

dialogText.cn: 不过……应该是佩丽卡喜欢的类型。
dialogText.en: But then again ... this might be Perlica's kind of music.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡喜欢什么风格的音乐？
dialogText.en: What type of music does Perlica like again?

dialogText.cn: 跟她本人一样，安安静静的那种。而且她翻来覆去就听那几首，听说以前是管理员——
dialogText.en: Music that's just like her. Quiet and serene. Her playlist is just a couple of the same old songs. People say that the Endmin ——

dialogText.cn: 我确实挺喜欢的。会想起过去的景色。
dialogText.en: The music is certainly something I prefer. It reminds me of the past.

dialogText.cn: 就说吧？但这节奏实在太慢了，听这个我工作进度都要降速一半！还是换一首吧！
dialogText.en: See? I'm right! But this music is a little slow. Having this as the work-BGM is gonna halve my work performance! Let's switch to something else!

dialogText.cn: 就它了！就它了！
dialogText.en: This is it! PURR-FECT!

dialogText.cn: 这是我最喜欢的一张！管理员你果然懂我！你怎么猜到的？
dialogText.en: Oh, this is my absolute favorite! You know me so well, Endmin! How did you even guess?!

dialogText.cn: 我组装小车的时候，听的就是这首，好怀念。
dialogText.en: I listened to this song while building the baby bot. It really brings back the good ol' memories.

dialogText.cn: 那倒不是，它体积太大了。安德烈帮了很多忙，无论是技术验证，还是最后的组装。
dialogText.en: Not exactly. Baby bot is really big. Andre helped a lot in technical verification and validation, as well as final assembly.

dialogText.cn: 但我对他选的涂装颜色非常不满意！
dialogText.en: Nevertheless, I am completely disappointed by the colors he chose for the coating!

dialogText.cn: 他跟工团那群人一样，审美太过时了！做出来的东西都闷闷的，感受不到激情！
dialogText.en: He's just like those woosters. Their outdated taste makes their work dull. I can't feel passion in it!

dialogText.cn: 不过……“塔塔”这个名字很好！我很喜欢！
dialogText.en: Anyway ... Tata sounds like a pretty name! I like it!

dialogText.cn: 进度比我想象的快很多，也有你的功劳哦，管理员！
dialogText.en: My progression is faster than expected! You helped a lot, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你的音乐。我也搞定了，出发出发！
dialogText.en: Thanks for the music! And VOILA! Job done! Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 楼里还有一些裂地者，要小心哦！
dialogText.en: Just be careful. There are still Landbreakers in the building.

dialogText.cn: 好，我等你！
dialogText.en: Okay. I'll wait for you!

dialogText.cn: 工具就位，零件就绪。我的宝贝小车马上要脱胎换骨啦！
dialogText.en: The tools are set, and the parts are ready. My baby bot is gonna get a complete makeover!

dialogText.cn: 楼里还有一些裂地者，要小心哦！
dialogText.en: Just be careful. There are still Landbreakers in the building.

dialogText.cn: 好，我等你！
dialogText.en: Okay. I'll wait for you!

dialogText.cn: （嗯，这应该是伊冯喜欢的类型……）
dialogText.en: (Hmm. Looks like something Yvonne might prefer...)

dialogText.cn: 啊！操作台在那里！这边这边！
dialogText.en: There's the control panel! Come on, let's go!

dialogText.cn: （期待的表情）
dialogText.en: *Hopeful emote*

dialogText.cn: 来，让我检查一下。问题不大……都在我预料之中。
dialogText.en: My baby bot! Oh, let me take a look at you... Mhm, not too serious. All within expectations.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 不愧是我的设计。安德烈增加了很多东西，但最核心的架构仍然在起作用。
dialogText.en: Such a marvelous design, made by me! Andre added plenty of stuff, but the core architecture is doing its job nicely.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……过载是小事，我有很多种办法增加稳定性。准备好试试新组件的性能了吗？
dialogText.en: Overload? Minor hiccup. I got plenty of ways to boost its stability. So, my baby bot, ready to run a performance test of the new components?

dialogText.cn: （期待的表情）
dialogText.en: *Hopeful emote*

dialogText.cn: 你们还真的是……感情很好呢。
dialogText.en: You seem ... pretty close to Tata.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 总算搞定了。
dialogText.en: Ta-ta! All good!

dialogText.cn: 塔塔没事了吗？
dialogText.en: Is Tata okay now?

dialogText.cn: （雀跃的表情）
dialogText.en: *Overjoyed emote*

dialogText.cn: 好有精神，看来是完全恢复了呢！
dialogText.en: Haha, look at Tata buzzing with energy! It's totally recovered!

dialogText.cn: （雀跃的表情）
dialogText.en: *Overjoyed emote*

dialogText.cn: 不多说了，你们赶紧上路吧！赶在超域裂隙进一步扩大之前，行动！
dialogText.en: Alright, guys. I guess it's time for you to hit the road. Now, go for it! Seal that Æther rift before it gets any bigger.

dialogText.cn: 千万注意安全啊，别再把我的宝贝小车搞坏了！
dialogText.en: So, play it safe, okay? Don't break my baby bot again!

dialogText.cn: 你自己看嘛！来，给大家打个招呼。
dialogText.en: Take a look for yourself! Come on, baby bot. Say "hello world".

dialogText.cn: 眼下这里还不安全，你确定不和我们一起走？
dialogText.en: This place isn't exactly safe right now. Are you sure you won't be coming with us?

dialogText.cn: 手头还有一大堆活。这些数据太珍贵了，最好马上开始分析！我要记录下宝贝小车第一次大规模扫描的成效。
dialogText.en: I got plenty of work on my hands. All these data are highly valuable and require immediate analysis! The first large-scale scan of my baby bot. Its effectiveness must be properly documented.

dialogText.cn: 况且裂地者所剩无几，研究所里其实更安全。
dialogText.en: Plus, there are hardly any Landbreakers left. The Research Center is actually a lot safer now.

dialogText.cn: 但你一个人——
dialogText.en: But you'll be here alone ——

dialogText.cn: 好啦好啦，我有办法！先回了，慢走不送！
dialogText.en: Relax, I got it all covered! The lab calls. See you around!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？恢复得还好吗？
dialogText.en: Tata, how are you doing? Feeling great already?

dialogText.cn: （亲昵的表情）
dialogText.en: *Cuddly emote*

dialogText.cn: 哇！好热情！
dialogText.en: Wow! You're all full of energy!

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 可能是刚刚跟伊冯重逢的缘故吧，它和自己的创造者很亲呢。
dialogText.en: Tata probably enjoyed its reunion with Yvonne. It's really close to its maker.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，但我还是觉得“塔塔”这个名字最好！
dialogText.en: Yeah, but I think Tata is the best!

dialogText.cn: 这一路到处都是裂地者的痕迹……
dialogText.en: I keep seeing breaker vandalism and signs along the way...

dialogText.cn: 恐怕前面也会有一场恶战。管理员，我们最好先做足准备。
dialogText.en: Endmin, a tough battle may lie ahead. We'd best be ready.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔的状态也才刚恢复，我们需要休整一下。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Tata just got a little better. We could really use a break.

dialogText.cn: （疲惫的表情）
dialogText.en: *Tired emote*

dialogText.cn: 前面就是矿脉源区了……它距离超域试验场很近，受侵蚀影响可能会更严重。
dialogText.en: The Origin Lodespring lies before us... It's quite close to the Æther Test Site, but this also means it might be severely affected by the Blight.

dialogText.cn: ……对，我们到了，情况有点复杂……之后再详细和你说。
dialogText.en: ...Yes. We've arrived. The situation is quite complicated... I'll give you the details later.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？我刚刚在和秦工程师确认枢纽区基地周边最新的情况。
dialogText.en: Endmin? Director Qin and I were going over the situation in the areas near the Hub Base.

dialogText.cn: 目前没有发现天使和裂地者有什么新的动向……我们可以先专注完成这边的任务。
dialogText.en: Neither the Landbreakers nor Aggeloi made any further moves as of yet... We can fully focus our efforts on this mission.

dialogText.cn: 哎，还是塔塔你最靠谱啦！
dialogText.en: Awww. You're always the best, Tata!

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 来，我们就先一起守在这里，以免有什么坏人突然冒出来！
dialogText.en: Alright. Let's guard this place, just in case bad people show up!

dialogText.cn: （不安的表情）
dialogText.en: *Scared emote*

dialogText.cn: 放心！打架的活当然由我来啊！你好好待在这儿就行啦！
dialogText.en: Don't be scared! And I'll definitely take care of the fighting! Just stay behind me and be safe!

dialogText.cn: 已经做好准备了吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: Ready to go, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 我也是！现在一口气能打十个天使！
dialogText.en: Me three! I'm totally ready to take on ten Aggeloi in a single battle!

dialogText.cn: 塔塔呢？你也恢复得差不多了吧？
dialogText.en: What about you, Tata? Fully rested?

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 好，那我们就出发吧。
dialogText.en: Alright, then. Let's move out, team!

dialogText.cn: 你是越医生吗？我是终末地的监督佩丽卡。听阿丽娅说，现在这里主要由你指挥工作。
dialogText.en: Are you Medical Officer Yue? I'm Supervisor Perlica of Endfield Industries. Alia told me that you're in charge of directing work at this place.

dialogText.cn: 是我……你们是终末地的人？太好了，既然你们能来到这儿，那就说明其他区域的形势已经有所好转了？
dialogText.en: I am... So you're Endfielders? Good. Since you managed to reach this place, can I assume that situations in other areas are getting better?

dialogText.cn: 可以这么说……但只要头顶上的裂隙依然存在，危机就尚未解除。
dialogText.en: That is a safe assumption to make... But as long as that rift stays in the sky, we remain in a state of crisis.

dialogText.cn: 超域裂隙……唉……
dialogText.en: The Æther Rift...

dialogText.cn: 矿区营地的情况现在也很不乐观，说是由我指挥……但当一个医生接任指挥位置时，就已经能说明很多了。
dialogText.en: The situation at the Mining Camp is less than optimistic. They say I'm in charge ... but when a surgeon is running the show, it says a lot about the place.

dialogText.cn: 虽然能力有限，但如果有什么能帮上你们的，尽管告诉我。
dialogText.en: I may not have the best skills for the job, but feel free to let me know if there's anything I can help you with.

dialogText.cn: 他就在里面，二楼靠里的位置。他的伤不算重，但是……情绪才刚刚稳定，你们注意不要刺激到他。
dialogText.en: You'll find him in the clinic, second floor, the bed further in. Not too hurt physically, but... he's pretty shaken up. Try not to say or do anything that might set him off.

dialogText.cn: 多谢了，放心，我们会注意的。
dialogText.en: Thank you. Don't worry, we'll keep your words in mind.

dialogText.cn: 那我先继续工作了，有需要帮助的地方再来找我就好。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'll get back to work. Talk to me any time if you need help.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的诸位，还有什么事吗？
dialogText.en: Anything I can help you with, friends from Endfield?

dialogText.cn: 不太好，灾难面前，我深感自己能力的渺小。虽然大家很信任我，但我自认不是一个好的领导者。
dialogText.en: Not too good. The disaster exposed my limitations. The people trust me, but I don't think I'm giving them the proper leadership demanded by this crisis.

dialogText.cn: 你已经做得很好了，营地里的工人们都在有条不紊地组织救援工作。
dialogText.en: From what I see, you've made the best of the situation. The crew mates of this camp are conducting rescue operations in an organized fashion.

dialogText.cn: 这是我们能够做到的极限了，那些诡异的震荡波不知道什么时候还会再出现，不能让前去搜救的人自身也陷入危险。
dialogText.en: Yeah, but everyone's overstretched. I don't know if those strange shockwaves would hit us again. I couldn't let our SAR crew mates endanger themselves.

dialogText.cn: 我们只能规定好行动时限，轮流派出探查队和搜救队，一点点扩大范围。但就算是这样，依然有一支小队失去了联络……
dialogText.en: We have no choice but to schedule and rotate our survey and SAR operations, and expand our search area slowly. Even after doing everything we could, we lost contact with one of our teams...

dialogText.cn: 长时间的搜救任务，还要看着身边的亲人饱受伤痛折磨，工人们的身体和精神也都临近极限了。
dialogText.en: The strain from hours of SAR operations ... made worse by the sight of friends and families in pain... The crew is reaching their physical and mental breaking points.

dialogText.cn: 好在狼群的小姑娘接手了很多危险的工作，帮大家分担了很多。
dialogText.en: We're fortunate to have the young girl from the Pack. She took the most dangerous tasks and significantly eased our burdens.

dialogText.cn: 我们见过她了，营地的具体位置就是她告诉我们的。
dialogText.en: We've met her already. She's the one who told us where the camp is.

dialogText.cn: 危难时刻，我们能依赖的只有彼此。
dialogText.en: In times of crisis, friends and allies are all we can count on.

dialogText.cn: 你们还有自己的任务吧？我还要继续照顾伤员，希望我们彼此的工作都能顺利吧。
dialogText.en: I believe you must carry on with your own mission. My place is here to take care of the wounded. Let's hope things turn out better for our endeavors.

dialogText.cn: 一起加油吧。
dialogText.en: They will. We shall soldier on together.

dialogText.cn: 我吗？我来这里已经差不多十年了。
dialogText.en: My work? I've been here for about a decade...

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地有我的老朋友，他们在供能高地工作，也是他们推荐我来这里就职的。
dialogText.en: I have old friends at Valley IV who work at the Power Plateau. In fact, they were the ones who recommended the Valley as a place to work.

dialogText.cn: 但我没有去枢纽区和供能高地……这里的人更需要我。
dialogText.en: But I didn't go to the Hub nor the Power Plateau... The locals in this area needed my services more.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地不是一个安逸的地方。我们营地里的居民很多都是当年旧矿区的老工人。
dialogText.en: Valley IV isn't exactly a peaceful place. Most of the camp residents are veterans of the Old Mines.

dialogText.cn: 年轻人陆续离开了这里，前往工团所属的城镇，或是更远的地方。渐渐地，这里就只剩下了一些老人和孩子。
dialogText.en: The youths gradually left for other UWST towns and cities, or places further away. Eventually, old people and young children became the only residents here.

dialogText.cn: 我很喜欢这里，大家把身边的人都当作亲人一般对待，他们需要一名医生，而我就是一名医生。
dialogText.en: I like this place. The locals treat their neighbors like family. They needed a surgeon, and that is my role.

dialogText.cn: 他们接纳了我，所以我希望能和他们一起渡过难关。
dialogText.en: They've accepted me, so it is my wish to see them through this crisis.

dialogText.cn: 她呀，她是和我们的一支搜救队一同回来的。
dialogText.en: She actually arrived here with one of our SAR teams.

dialogText.cn: 她一直念叨着要去枢纽区基地见见什么管理员……结果一直留到了现在。
dialogText.en: She kept talking about meeting the Endministrator at the Hub Base ... but ended up staying here.

dialogText.cn: 我们本来不想麻烦她太多，但她执意要留下来帮助我们，说是见死不救会让卢皮诺的姓氏蒙羞。
dialogText.en: We tried not to give her too much work, but she insisted on helping us. "Letting people suffer and doing nothing will tarnish the honor of the Luppino Family." Her words.

dialogText.cn: 队员们没多久就被她的能力和作风所折服，现在危险的搜救工作都由她负责。
dialogText.en: Rossi quickly impressed the crew with her skills and her way of doing things. She's now in charge of the riskier SAR operations.

dialogText.cn: 这也帮我分担了不少压力，大家都很感谢她。虽然有些人也称她为裂地者……但谁是敌人谁是朋友，大家都是分得清的。
dialogText.en: She took on a significant share of my workload and everyone is thankful. A few still call her a Landbreaker ... but people know who our enemies are, and who we can count on as a friend.

dialogText.cn: 我先走了，伤员还等着我呢。
dialogText.en: I'll take my leave. The wounded require my tending.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！你们来啦。
dialogText.en: Endmin! You're here.

dialogText.cn: 这位是罗伊尔，这位就是我提到过的管理员。你把情况再说一遍吧，管理员肯定能帮上忙！
dialogText.en: This is Royle, and this is the Endmin I've mentioned before. So, Royle, go ahead and tell us what happened. The Endmin can definitely help!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？你能把我的队友们带回来吗？
dialogText.en: Really? Endmin, will you go and save my friends in the team?

dialogText.cn: 好的……是这样的，我们是最早被派出去搜索幸存者的探查队之一，连我在内一共有三个人。
dialogText.en: Okay, okay... So this is what happened. We were one of the first survey teams to be sent out there to look for survivors... There were three of us, me included.

dialogText.cn: 由于有震荡波的威胁，我们只有二十分钟的行动时间。重点是探查危险，开拓路线，方便下一批搜救队进行搜索。
dialogText.en: We knew the shockwave was a threat, so we got ourselves a twenty-minute window of opportunity. Our task was to identify the danger zones, clear a path, and make things easier for the SAR crew and their rescue work.

dialogText.cn: 但……我们有点太心急了，深入到了锚点附近……
dialogText.en: But ... we were too impatient and pushed too deep... We got really close to an Ankhor.

dialogText.cn: 锚点附近？
dialogText.en: Close to an Ankhor?

dialogText.cn: 对……队里有位前辈说，他上次出来探查的时候，亲眼看到了锚点坠落。
dialogText.en: Yes... A senior mate of the crew said he saw an Ankhorfall with his own eyes in his last survey run.

dialogText.cn: 世代摇篮入口处的屏障是在锚点坠落后才出现的……我们怀疑二者之间有所联系。
dialogText.en: The barrier blocking the way to the Cradle of the Ages appeared after the Ankhorfall... We thought these two events were related.

dialogText.cn: 但没等我们靠近，锚点就释放出了震荡波……
dialogText.en: But then, the Ankhor started giving off shockwaves before we could even get close enough...

dialogText.cn: 震荡波？你居然毫发无伤地挺过来了？是怎么做到的？
dialogText.en: Shockwaves? But you got back without a scratch. How did you pull that off?

dialogText.cn: 这就是关键了，罗伊尔，你把那个拿给他们看看。
dialogText.en: That's your key finding, Royle. Show our friends what you've found.

dialogText.cn: 我也不知道发生了什么……当时情急之下，我抓住了一旁的树枝……就是这个！
dialogText.en: I don't know what exactly happened... I just grabbed this branch in a moment of desperation... Here, this one!

dialogText.cn: 源石结构的树枝……
dialogText.en: An Originium formation shaped like a branch...

dialogText.cn: 这根树枝突然发出了光，周围就闪了一下……我没看清楚，但确实挡住了震荡波。
dialogText.en: This branch suddenly glowed and everything around me flashed... I didn't get a clear look of what exactly happened, but it managed to block the shockwave.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？那我们是不是可以借助它去解决锚点？
dialogText.en: Really? Does that mean we can use this thing to get rid of the Ankhor?

dialogText.cn: ……不行，看上去它已经失去活性了。
dialogText.en: Hmm... No. This branch has gone inert.

dialogText.cn: 我们逃了一路，但震荡波直接摧毁了路面，只有我跑了回来……只有我一个……
dialogText.en: We just kept running and running, but the shockwaves demolished the road... I-I was the only one ... who made it back...

dialogText.cn: 但我相信他们还活着！或许他们能找到别的树枝呢？管理员，请、请一定要救救他们！！
dialogText.en: But... But I believe they're still alive! Perhaps they found other branches! Endmin! PLEASE! Please head out there and save them!

dialogText.cn: 我理解你的心情，但我们先得找到能够抵御震荡波的方法……
dialogText.en: I understand how you feel, but we must find a way that can reliably negate the shockwave...

dialogText.cn: 这种源石树枝十分特殊，能把源石重塑到这种程度的……
dialogText.en: This Originium branch has a very unique structure. The only one capable of molding the crystal into this form is...

dialogText.cn: 管理员还没有恢复记忆，我们没办法确认其中的联系。
dialogText.en: The Endmin's memories have not returned. There is no way for us to verify this link.

dialogText.cn: 关于这树枝，我在我们营地里见到过一样的东西！
dialogText.en: I believe I saw something like this branch! Right in our very own camp!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？如果有替代品的话，可能就有办法接近锚点了。
dialogText.en: Really? If we can get a replacement, we'll be able to get close to the Ankhor.

dialogText.cn: 营地里有一棵活着的源石树苗，就生长在那边的高台上。詹娜奶奶照料了它二十年，她一定知道些什么。
dialogText.en: There is a living Originium sapling in the camp, growing on that platform over there. Granny Jenner has been taking care of it for twenty years. She definitely knows something.

dialogText.cn: 活着的源石树苗……事不宜迟，我们去问问那位詹娜奶奶吧，这些树枝会是我们接下来行动的关键。
dialogText.en: A living Originium sapling... Team, there's no time to waste. Let's talk to Granny Jenner. The sapling and the branches will be crucial for our subsequent actions.

dialogText.cn: 我先送他去越医生那里检查。
dialogText.en: I'll take Royle to Surgeon Yue for his checkup.

dialogText.cn: 拜托你们了！请一定要找到我的同伴们！
dialogText.en: Please! People! Please find my friends out there!

dialogText.cn: 这就是……源石树苗？
dialogText.en: Is this ... the Originium sapling?

dialogText.cn: 没有错。这种性质的源石技艺，是管理员你的手笔。
dialogText.en: It is. An Originium Arts of such nature... This is your work, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这只是一点点残存的纪念，它还过于幼小，不足以像过去那样保护我们。
dialogText.en: Just a fragment of a legacy from a time gone by. It is still too young and delicate. It won't give us the protection that it had once offered.

dialogText.cn: 年轻人们很少来这里照看它了，对他们而言，可能体会不到这棵树苗对于我们来说意味着什么吧。
dialogText.en: The youths hardly look at it anymore. They probably couldn't appreciate what this sapling meant to us.

dialogText.cn: 你们好，我是詹娜，是负责照看这棵树苗的人。
dialogText.en: Greetings, I'm Jenner, and I'm the one raising this little sapling.

dialogText.cn: 这棵树苗……难道是……
dialogText.en: This sapling... Is it from...?

dialogText.cn: 历史只留在我们这些老家伙的记忆之中。渐渐地，已经鲜有人记得隔离区里有着什么，那里又为何会被称为“世代摇篮”了。
dialogText.en: History only remains in the memories of old folks like us. Time goes on and barely anyone remembers what lay in the Containment Zone, or why it was called the Cradle of the Ages.

dialogText.cn: 是否还有人记得那里曾生长着一棵参天大树？那棵树通体闪烁着暗淡的光辉，扎根在土壤里。种下它的人曾说过，这里，将会成为我们新的家园……
dialogText.en: Does anyone remember the massive Great Oak that grew at that place? Oh, how it sparkled with gentle glows as it sank its roots deep into the soil. The one who planted it told us this very place would become our new home...

dialogText.cn: 后来却又不得不亲手将它摧毁……
dialogText.en: But then came the time when there was no choice but to destroy the Oak ourselves...

dialogText.cn: 那一天，黑色的“星体”降临在谷地，数百枚“躯体”扭曲成一个燃烧着的黑色漩涡，它掠过的土地被无形的冲击撕扯着……
dialogText.en: It was the day when dark Astarron fell upon the Valley. Hundreds of "bodies" twisted into a burning maelstrom that tore through the land. In its wake lay only desolation...

dialogText.cn: 那是工团有记录以来目击过的最大型的天使……人们在绝望中抗争着，眼睁睁看着“星体”落下，闭上眼迎接黑色的死亡。
dialogText.en: It was the largest Aggelos ever witnessed in the records of the UWST... The people fought a hopeless battle as they witnessed the unstoppable descent of Astarron. There was nothing to do but close their eyes ... and prepare themselves for the shadow of death.

dialogText.cn: 居然是……天使？
dialogText.en: Really? An ... Aggelos?

dialogText.cn: 人们最终还是胜利了，但也献出了一切。他们引爆了源石大树——那棵给予他们新家的大树。
dialogText.en: Yet the people achieved final victory, and the price they paid ... was everything. They detonated the Great Originium Oak — the giant tree that once gave them their homes.

dialogText.cn: 源石大树的碎片刺破“星体”的核心，原本巨大的树干只剩下了一个空洞，破碎的“星体”沉眠于此，曾经的“摇篮”如今只埋葬着两具“尸骸”。
dialogText.en: The shards of the Great Originium Oak tore through the core of Astarron. Of the massive trunk of the Oak, only an empty hollow remains. The shattered Astarron now sleeps within it. What was once our Cradle became a tomb for two "bodies".

dialogText.cn: 只有一些年迈的矿工还在担忧，或许哪天会有锚点从天而降，唤醒破碎的天使……
dialogText.en: Only the old miners still worry ... fearful for the day when Ankhors come screaming down ... and wake the shattered Aggelos...

dialogText.cn: 黑色的“星体”因为遥远的呼唤破土而出，再度现身，把自己残缺不全的尸骸拼凑起来。谷地再一次被死寂的红光所吞没……
dialogText.en: A day when dark Astarron answers the distant call, rises from its tomb, reassembles its broken body ... and cloaks the Valley once again in a deathly shroud of red...

dialogText.cn: 不会吧？那些锚点的中间……那片隔离区下，埋着一只巨大的天使？
dialogText.en: So ... The Containment Zone between those Ankhors ... is a tomb for a giant Aggelos...?

dialogText.cn: ……如果这个故事是真的，别说天上的裂隙了，那只天使就足以将四号谷地毁灭。
dialogText.en: ...If this story were true, we would need to contend with more than that rift in the sky. That Aggelos alone would destroy the entirety of Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 所以我们日复一日地照看着这棵树苗，那棵大树最后的分身。这片土地上有着许许多多大树留下的痕迹，但只有这一小株活了下来。
dialogText.en: And that is why we spent all these years taking care of this sapling. It is the only scion of the Great Oak. The Oak once left many of its fragments and traces, but this tiny thing is the only one that survived.

dialogText.cn: 或许它能够再一次拯救我们……
dialogText.en: Perhaps it could save us again...

dialogText.cn: 这棵树会保护你们。
dialogText.en: This tree shall protect you.

dialogText.cn: 终有一天，这里会成为你们的家园。
dialogText.en: A day will come when this land becomes your home.

dialogText.cn: 人们依靠着它生活、战斗，享用着它的根脉带来的源石矿脉，真的围绕着它建立了据点——
dialogText.en: We depended on the Oak to make our living and win our battles. The Originium Veins created by its roots brought wealth, and an outpost started growing around it as prophesied...

dialogText.cn: 管理员！你怎么了？你还好吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin? Endmin! Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你的脸色好差，发生什么了？
dialogText.en: You don't look so good... Do you need rest?

dialogText.cn: 不好！那些锚点变得活跃起来了！
dialogText.en: Stay alert! Those Ankhors have been activated!

dialogText.cn: 天使？突然出现这么多天使……
dialogText.en: Aggeloi?! How did so many of them show up in such a short time...?

dialogText.cn: 这不是好兆头，我们不能再耽搁了。天使和震荡波，不管哪一个都可能把这里夷为平地！
dialogText.en: This is a very bad sign. We must act right now. Otherwise, the Aggeloi or even just the shockwaves could raze this place to the ground!

dialogText.cn: 是啊……我已经很多年没看过这么多的锚点了。
dialogText.en: Indeed... It's been years since I last saw this many Ankhors.

dialogText.cn: 我们走吧，管理员！相信这里的人们！
dialogText.en: Let's go, Endmin! We must have faith in these people!

dialogText.cn: 也已经很多年没见到种下大树的那个人了。
dialogText.en: Or the planter of the Great Oak.

actorName.cn: 瘦小的男孩{e2m6-工团的男孩}

dialogText.cn: 这是什么啊？
dialogText.en: What is this?

actorName.cn: 乖巧的女孩{e2m6-工团的女孩}

dialogText.cn: 好奇怪啊，从来没见过！大姐姐，我们能和它一起玩吗？
dialogText.en: It's so weird-looking! I've never seen anything like this before! Can we play with it?

dialogText.cn: （害怕的表情）
dialogText.en: *Scared emote*

dialogText.cn: 别担心，他们只是对你有些好奇，勇敢点。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Tata! Be brave! The children are just curious about you!

actorName.cn: 瘦小的男孩{e2m6-工团的男孩}

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们不会弄疼你的。
dialogText.en: Yeah. We won't hurt you! Promise!

dialogText.cn: （犹豫的表情）
dialogText.en: *Hesitant emote*

dialogText.cn: （认真的表情）
dialogText.en: *Serious emote*

dialogText.cn: 它说可以陪你们玩哦。
dialogText.en: And it just said yes to having fun with you!

actorName.cn: 乖巧的女孩{e2m6-工团的女孩}

dialogText.cn: 太好啦！
dialogText.en: That's awesome!

dialogText.cn: 让塔塔先留在这里吧，有工团的人帮忙看着，应该不会出问题。
dialogText.en: I say we leave Tata here for now. The UWST crew will help us look after it and make sure nothing bad happens.

dialogText.cn: 不能通过！还没到下一组搜救队的出动时间，而且你们几个也不是搜救队的吧？
dialogText.en: Halt! You can't go this way. It's too early to dispatch the next SAR team, and you definitely don't look like no SAR crew mates to me.

dialogText.cn: 外面不久前出现了诡异的震荡波，被波及的人没一个活下来的！不想白白送命就老实待在营地里。
dialogText.en: Strange shockwaves started going off outside not too long ago, and killed everyone they hit! If you wanna stay alive, behave and keep yourself safe in the camp.

dialogText.cn: 那些震荡波不知道什么时候还会再出现，我们只能严格控制放行间隔，派遣少数探查队和搜救队去寻找幸存者。希望你们理解和配合。
dialogText.en: I don't know when these shockwaves might start again. We have no choice but to apply strict limits to anyone heading outside, and only send out small survey or SAR teams to look for survivors. Please understand why we're doing this and follow the rules.

dialogText.cn: 上一批探查队还没回来吗……已经快超过二十分钟的时限了。
dialogText.en: The last survey team isn't back yet... But it's been over twenty minutes already.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，矿区营地外的情况不容乐观，我们先在这里收集一些情报再做行动吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, things don't look very good outside the Mining Camp. We should gather some intel from this place before making our next move.

dialogText.cn: 这营地目前还算安全，我们走吧。
dialogText.en: The camp looks safe for now. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔保护了他们呀，干得真棒！
dialogText.en: Great job, Tata! You protected these kids!

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 还好没有发生意外，陈，我们要更关注塔塔的安全。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness nothing terrible happened. Chen, we must pay attention to Tata's safety.

dialogText.cn: 交给我吧！
dialogText.en: OK! Leave that to me!

dialogText.cn: 我们到了！这里就是矿区营地的诊所。
dialogText.en: We're here! This is the clinic of the Mining Camp!

dialogText.cn: 这个小诊所平时见不着什么人，可现在，伤员多得已经挤不下了。
dialogText.en: The clinic used to be pretty empty with hardly any visitors. But it's now filled with injured people and we're running out of beds.

dialogText.cn: 可以想象，枢纽区基地的医护人员压力也很大……他一个人能应付得过来吗？
dialogText.en: I can imagine. Our medical staff at the Hub Base also have their hands full... Can your surgeon handle all this work on his own?

dialogText.cn: 越医生在这里很多年了，他说自己可以解决，大家也都相信他。他是从宏科院来的医生，经验丰富，总是药到病除。
dialogText.en: Surgeon Yue has been here for years and he hasn't asked for help. He's an experienced medical officer from the HAS (Hongshan Academy of Sciences) and his treatments always work. We have faith in him.

dialogText.cn: 他就在诊所里！我打算留在这里帮护士小姐的忙。多一个人多一份力量。
dialogText.en: You can find him in the clinic right now! I'm gonna stick around and help our nurse. Extra hands will help get things done.

dialogText.cn: 没问题，我们分开行动，有什么情报随时同步。
dialogText.en: No problem. We'll split our forces, and share any new findings we come across.

dialogText.cn: 嗯！佩丽卡姐姐，陈千语姐姐，还有……管理员，那我们等会儿见咯。
dialogText.en: Of course, Perlica, Chen, and ... Endministrator. Catch you later.

dialogText.cn: 你们回来啦！太好了，看上去没有人受伤。
dialogText.en: You made it back! And there's not a scratch on you! Wonderful!

dialogText.cn: {F}嘿嘿，多亏了管理员她们。{M}嘿嘿，多亏了管理员他们。
dialogText.en: {F}Heheh. All thanks to our Endmin and friends. {M}Heheh. All thanks to our Endmin and friends.

dialogText.cn: 越医生在里面吗？
dialogText.en: Is Medical Officer Yue inside?

dialogText.cn: 他刚休息了五分钟，现在又回到岗位上了……
dialogText.en: He just took a five-minute break, and he's already back at work...

dialogText.cn: 伤员就全靠你们了！
dialogText.en: Okay, get to it. The people here need your help.

dialogText.cn: 那……你们先进去问问看吧，我还要去接一下刚刚获救的工人们，说不定也能问到一些外面的线索。
dialogText.en: Alright then, you guys head in and ask around. I will talk to the crew mates we just saved. They probably have some clues about what's going on outside.

dialogText.cn: 有什么事吗？啊……你是终末地的……管理员？
dialogText.en: Do you need something? Ah... Are you the ... the Endministrator of Endfield Industries...?

dialogText.cn: 我是看洛茜这么称呼你，洛茜说多亏了……是管理员对吧？多亏管理员及时出现，她才能顺利解决敌人。都是你的功劳。
dialogText.en: I heard how Rossi addressed you. She said we're lucky to have the ... uhm ... the Endmin, right? Anyway, you showed up in time and gave her a chance to take down the enemies. We have you to thank!

dialogText.cn: 她还告诉了我很多关于管理员的传闻，每次说到这些事她就显得很兴奋，还说什么……这次没有白跑一趟。
dialogText.en: Rossi also told me many stories about you, and she would get really excited during the process. She also said something like ... how this wasn't a wasted trip.

dialogText.cn: 大家看她乐在其中的样子，就一直没有提醒她，虽然都已经听她说过好几遍了。
dialogText.en: And she couldn't stop talking about it over and over again. But she seemed to be enjoying herself, so none of us pointed it out.

dialogText.cn: 洛茜可是帮了我们不少忙。
dialogText.en: Of course. Rossi has been a great help to everyone.

dialogText.cn: 起初有些人担心她裂地者的身份，但看着她忙上忙下，很快就都愿意信任她了。
dialogText.en: People were initially worried about her Landbreaker background. But she busied herself helping us out and quickly earned our trust. Everyone would vouch for her now.

dialogText.cn: 她好像很不喜欢和那些面罩上插着管子的人一样被称作裂地者。她和那些坏人也完全不同。
dialogText.en: Rossi doesn't like being called a breaker or getting associated with the wackos who stick pipes on their masks. She's really different from those raiders as well.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的诸位，还有什么事吗？
dialogText.en: Anything I can help you with, friends from Endfield?

dialogText.cn: 他就在里面，二楼靠里的位置。他的伤不算重，但是……情绪才刚刚稳定，你们注意不要刺激到他。
dialogText.en: You'll find him in the clinic, second floor, the bed further in. Not too hurt physically, but... he's pretty shaken up. Try not to say or do anything that might set him off.

dialogText.cn: 多谢了，放心，我们会注意的。
dialogText.en: Thank you, sir. Don't worry, we'll keep your words in mind.

dialogText.cn: 那我先继续工作了，有需要帮助的地方再来找我就好。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'll get back to work. Talk to me any time if you need my support.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，好久不见，情况还算顺利吗？
dialogText.en: It's been a while, Endmin. Are things working out for you?

dialogText.cn: 那还算及时！你们还记得塔塔的使用说明吧？
dialogText.en: Good. Then I caught you in time! I hope you still remember the user instructions for Tata.

dialogText.cn: 你也开始用这个称呼啦？塔塔这个名字特别可爱，对不对？
dialogText.en: You're calling it Tata too?! It's a super cute and lovely name, right?

dialogText.cn: 还不是跟你学的……说正事，虽然之前的用法有些危险，但那些数据十分关键。我在维修的时候调整了几项效能参数，算是升级啦。
dialogText.en: Your habit just rubbed off on me... Back to business. You used Tata in dangerous ways, but that data proved crucial. I tweaked a few performance parameters during repairs. Let's just say, I gave it an upgrade.

dialogText.cn: 这样一来，塔塔就可以正常扫描侵蚀核心了。但它毕竟只是台诞生没多久的原型机，你们还是得当心——多当点儿心！
dialogText.en: You can now use Tata normally to scan for Blight Cores. Now I'll remind you that my baby bot is a delicate prototype, so you better take care of it — Do whatever you can to keep it safe!

dialogText.cn: 太好了，这下再也不用担心侵蚀拦路了。
dialogText.en: Great. Now we don't have to worry about the Blight blocking our path anymore.

dialogText.cn: 别光顾着高兴！为了保障安全，避免不必要的能源损耗，你们还是得像在园区里那样，通过连接协议通讯信号塔，来扫描整片区域的侵蚀核心。
dialogText.en: Don't celebrate just yet! We should play things safe and avoid unnecessary power consumption. First connect Tata to a Protocom Signal Tower before scanning the entire area for Blight Cores, just like what you did at the Science Park.

dialogText.cn: 我记得前方的矿脉源区也部署过相同参数的信号塔。
dialogText.en: I remember that a Signal Tower with the same parameters has been deployed in our next destination, the Origin Lodespring.

dialogText.cn: 没错，就是想提醒你们这件事。你们可一定一定一定要照顾好塔塔喔，我还有好多测试计划等着塔塔呢！
dialogText.en: That's right. I was just about to tell you that. Please, please, please, take proper care of Tata. Maker mommy's got a ton of tests in store for her wuvly baby bot!

dialogText.cn: 放心吧，我们会保护好它的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. We'll definitely keep it safe.

dialogText.cn: 动身前先确认一下前方的地图信息吧。
dialogText.en: Let's confirm the map data for the next area before we start moving.

actorName.cn: 无助的病人{e2m6-无助的病人}

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀……好像刻在我的眼睛里……
dialogText.en: The Blight... It's eating right through my eyes...

actorName.cn: 无助的病人{e2m6-无助的病人}

dialogText.cn: 我不要待在那种地方……快逃吧……啊啊……
dialogText.en: Get me out of the place... Run, you fools... AAAARRGGH...

dialogText.cn: ……是应激反应，让他冷静一会儿吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: A traumatic stress reaction... Just leave him by himself for now, Endministrator.

actorName.cn: 痛苦的病人{e2m6-痛苦的病人}

dialogText.cn: 疼，疼啊……好疼……
dialogText.en: Hngh ... it hurts ... it really, really hurts...

actorName.cn: 护士{越医生诊所的护士}

dialogText.cn: 我已经忙不过来了……一整天什么也没吃。
dialogText.en: Can't you see I'm busy...? Didn't even find a chance to eat something.

actorName.cn: 护士{越医生诊所的护士}

dialogText.cn: 病人们才是最难受的，我还能坚持……但伤员还在源源不断地送过来。我们现在太缺受过医疗培训的人了。
dialogText.en: I can manage, but my patients are having it worse... And the injured and wounded keep coming in. We're desperately short on trained medical staff.

actorName.cn: 护士{越医生诊所的护士}

dialogText.cn: 希望能顺利撑到救援赶到。
dialogText.en: I really hope we'll live till help arrives.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 塔塔这么兴奋呀？是因为刚升级了功能，有些跃跃欲试吗？
dialogText.en: Why is Tata so excited? Is it because of its functional upgrade? Do you want to try it out?

dialogText.cn: （乖巧的表情）
dialogText.en: *Sweet emote*

dialogText.cn: 我懂你的感觉！每次学到新的剑招，我也想找个高手好好练练。
dialogText.en: I totally understand how you feel! Every time I learn a new move, I start itching for my next fight with a true master!

dialogText.cn: 可不是嘛。塔塔的表情还是有很多细微差别的。来，塔塔，表现一下。
dialogText.en: Of course I can. Tata's emotes convey a rich variety of fine emotions, you know. Come on, Tata, show us what you've got.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: “很开心又能继续上路了！”是这个意思，对吧塔塔？
dialogText.en: You're happy to be traveling again! That's what you're trying to tell us, right, Tata?

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 顺便，佩丽卡现在的表情，是在催促我们，“差不多了，继续赶路吧”。
dialogText.en: Ooh. And I think Perlica's emote is trying to tell us this: "Enough, team. We should get moving."
Ahem...

dialogText.cn: 这些伤口……动手的人是用剑的高手。
dialogText.en: These wounds... They were made by a master of the blade.

dialogText.cn: 用剑？让我想想……
dialogText.en: Blade wounds? I'll need to think about this...

dialogText.cn: 好多锚点……我还以为只有北方才有这样的景象……
dialogText.en: So many Ankhors... I thought you'd only see something like this up north...

dialogText.cn: 锚点……
dialogText.en: Ankhors...

dialogText.cn: 菲奥娜，告诉我前方区域的扫描结果，尤其是天使集群的分布情况。
dialogText.en: Fiona, give me a scan of the area ahead of us. Focus on the distribution of Aggeloid hosts and clusters.

dialogText.cn: 我正在看……等等，数据是不是哪里出错了？这片区域……只有这么点天使？
dialogText.en: I'm reviewing the data as we speak... Wait. Is there something wrong with the readings? There ... isn't a lot of Aggeloi in this area.

dialogText.cn: 怎么了，佩丽卡？
dialogText.en: What is it, Perlica?

dialogText.cn: 仅一枚锚点，就让枢纽区基地遭受重创。这里足足有三枚，天使的数量却只有这些！
dialogText.en: It only took a single Ankhor to deal a major blow to our Hub Base. This area has three... The low local Aggeloid count hardly makes sense!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们可能遇上大麻烦了。
dialogText.en: We might be running into a serious problem, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 前面到底有什么？
dialogText.en: What are we up against, exactly?

dialogText.cn: 那些锚点破坏了运输区的公路，各位要去供能高地，得另找路线。
dialogText.en: Those Ankhors took out the freight road of the Logistics Area. We need to find another way to reach the Power Plateau, team.

dialogText.cn: 工团的记录里提到，世代摇篮内有一条垂直索道，可以抵达供能高地，但那里已经封锁了二十年……
dialogText.en: UWST logs mention a vertical shaft in the Cradle of the Ages. It should grant passage to the Power Plateau, but the Cradle has been sealed away for twenty years...

dialogText.cn: 世代摇篮……那里曾经是管理员——
dialogText.en: The Cradle of the Ages... That was where the Endmin—

dialogText.cn: 你们……你们是终末地的人吗？
dialogText.en: You ... you're Endfielders, right?

dialogText.cn: 是的。看你的神色，是遇到了什么事情吗？
dialogText.en: Yes, we are. You seem troubled, do you need help?

dialogText.cn: 我……我叫阿丽娅，我们原本是外出回收一些物资，可没想到遇见了很多裂地者！
dialogText.en: I'm ... I'm Alia. We were supposed to salvage the area for supplies. Then all those Landbreakers showed up out of nowhere!

dialogText.cn: 还好有一位狼群的裂地者救了我们，但……但要面对那么多敌人……我找机会跑了出来，想试试看能不能找到帮手……
dialogText.en: We were lucky that a breaker from the Pack saved us, but ... but the enemy still outnumbered us... I found a chance to make my way here, and I wanted to see if I can find help...

dialogText.cn: 帮助工团的裂地者？该不会是……
dialogText.en: A breaker helping the UWST? Can it be...?

dialogText.cn: 有可能。别担心，告诉我们怎么抵达你们遇险的位置，我们这就去帮忙。
dialogText.en: It's quite possible. Take a breath, young lady. Tell us how to reach the rest of your group. We'll head over there immediately.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！从那边的升降机可以过去。战斗方面我只会添乱……但我熟悉地形，会想办法先回营地求援，拜托你们了！
dialogText.en: Oh, thank Talos! Use that elevator over there to reach them. I'll probably get in your way during battle ... but I know this place pretty well. I'll figure out a way to return to camp and get more reinforcements. Please go and save the rest of the crew!

dialogText.cn: 嗯。还得搞清楚前面到底发生了什么，先去救人吧。
dialogText.en: Hmm. We'll need to find out what actually happened. Let's focus on rescuing the others first.

dialogText.cn: 他们还活着，有人留了他们一命。
dialogText.en: They're still alive. Someone spared them.

dialogText.cn: 狼卫居然还会手下留情？
dialogText.en: Spared them? That doesn't sound like Wulfgard to me.

dialogText.cn: 你们认识？阿丽娅不是说是狼群的人吗？这么小的孩子……
dialogText.en: You know each other or something? Didn't Alia mention someone from the Pack? It can't be this teensy weensy girl, right...?

dialogText.cn: 在你面前的是洛茜娜·狼珀·卢皮诺——狼群的精锐！未来族长的左膀右臂！给我记好了！
dialogText.en: I am Rossina Wulfperl Luppino — Prima Elite of the Pack, future Capo, and strongarm of the Don! Remember this well!

dialogText.cn: 这是<@qu.key>洛茜</>，狼卫的妹妹，同样是狼群的一员，和我们有着长期合作关系，不过大多数时间都在狼群处理家族事务。
dialogText.en: This is <@qu.key>Rossi</>, Wulfgard's younger sister. Both are members of the Pack and long-time partners of Endfield. Rossi usually spends most of her time at the Pack dealing with family issues.

dialogText.cn: 还不是因为那个不靠谱的老哥！家族的事他从来不管不问，各种麻烦事就只能由我……啊！
dialogText.en: It's all because of my unreliable brother who neglects family duties. Someone had to clean up all the mess... AH!

dialogText.cn: 对不起！管理员，卡特洛那家伙没给您添麻烦吧？要是让我逮到的话……
dialogText.en: I'm so sorry, Endmin! I hope Catello didn't give you any trouble! If I ever got my hands on him...

dialogText.cn: 多亏了你帮助这些工人们。不过你为什么在这里？我印象里没有向狼群发送……
dialogText.en: Thank you for helping the local crew. But why are you here? I don't remember asking the Pack...

dialogText.cn: 我有一些……对了！有一些……私事！要找卡特洛！Z7小队的人告诉我他来了四号谷地。
dialogText.en: Well... It's uh... Oh! Right! It's private business...! I got some private business with Catello! People from Op Team Z7 told me he came to Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 而且、而且……我听说管理员在这里。
dialogText.en: And also 'cos I ... uh ... I heard the Endmin's around.

dialogText.cn: 结果发现这里的人们需要帮助，卢皮诺家族不会对此坐视不管。
dialogText.en: But then I found that the locals here needed help. Hmph! The Luppino Family won't just stand by and do nothing.

dialogText.cn: 我、我有很多事想问管理员……不过……管理员，您难道真的失忆了吗？
dialogText.en: I, uh ... I got a lot of questions to ask, Endmin... But ... did you really ... lose your memories?

dialogText.cn: 是吗，那……那些传说中的事迹您也不记得了？
dialogText.en: It's all true, then? You really ... can't remember those legendary things ... you did before?

dialogText.cn: 怎么会……不不不不，管理员平安无事才是最重要的！
dialogText.en: How could this be...? Uh, no, no, no. Sorry, just ignore what I said. The most important thing is that you're safe, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员的事稍后再说，洛茜，这里现在是什么情况？
dialogText.en: We can talk about the Endmin later, Rossi. Can you give us a sitrep?

dialogText.cn: 我看到锚点坠落就往这儿赶，正好遇见一群工团的人，于是和他们一同回到了营地。
dialogText.en: I rushed to this place when I saw the Ankhorfall, and ran into a UWST crew on the way. I joined them and went to their camp.

dialogText.cn: 有几个外出回收物资的工人一直没回来，我放心不下就来找找。结果……喏，就是你们看到的样子。
dialogText.en: But a few of the salvaging crew didn't return. I got a little worried so I came out here to look for them. And ... you saw what happened next.

dialogText.cn: 营地的人们现在忙得不可开交！到处都缺人手。他们要是知道你们来了，心里一定也会踏实一些。
dialogText.en: Things are super duper busy at camp! The locals really need all the help they can get with everything. Once they learn you're here, they'll definitely feel a lot safer.

dialogText.cn: 你了解矿脉源区整体的情况吗？连这里也没多少天使，这太过反常了。
dialogText.en: Do you have anything on the overall situation of the Origin Lodespring? There aren't that many Aggeloi here. Something doesn't add up.

dialogText.cn: 对了！诊所里有个搜救队的谁来着……好像叫艾尔法斯？他的队伍搜索过整片旧矿区，应该了解很多信息。
dialogText.en: Ah, just remembered something! There's a search and rescue crew mate at the clinic... I think he's called Alfass. His SAR team combed through the Old Mines, so he should have plenty of intel to share.

dialogText.cn: 我正好要帮工人们把物资带回去，不如我带你们一起回营地？
dialogText.en: I'm about to help the crew mates move the supplies back to camp. I can take you there.

dialogText.cn: 那再好不过了。
dialogText.en: That'd be great.

dialogText.cn: 听说管理员您醒过来了嘛，所以偷偷……不是，所以想来拜访一下。
dialogText.en: I heard something about the Endmin's awakening, so I sneaked... I mean, I intended to pay you a visit.

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二的极光是管理员百年前施展源石技艺的痕迹，这也不记得了吗？
dialogText.en: You unleashed your Originium Arts a hundred years ago and left the Aurora of Talos-II. You forgot about that too?

dialogText.cn: 塔卫五破碎的真相是管理员将它丢进了超域……那这个呢？
dialogText.en: They say Talos-V shattered because you threw it into the Ætherside... You remember that?

dialogText.cn: 管理员孤身深入地下，一击捣毁两千枚锚点，在地表留下深坑的传闻也无从考证了？
dialogText.en: Do you recall going deep underground alone, wiping out two thousand Ankhors in one strike, and leaving a massive crater on the surface?

dialogText.cn: 这么说，您是真的……
dialogText.en: That means ... you really forgot...

dialogText.cn: 小孩子？
dialogText.en: Teensy weensy?!

dialogText.cn: 呜呃……管理员怎么来了！
dialogText.en: Kyaaa... Why is the Endmin here?

dialogText.cn: 我刚到的时候，这里就已经变得乱七八糟的了。至于天使的事……我也很纳闷。
dialogText.en: This area was already a total mess when I arrived. As for your concerns about the Aggeloi... It baffles me as well.

dialogText.cn: 请问你是搜救队的艾尔法斯先生吗？
dialogText.en: Excuse me, are you Mr. Alfass from the search and rescue team?

dialogText.cn: 是我的错……都是我的错……
dialogText.en: It's my fault ... it's all my fault...

dialogText.cn: 就在世代摇篮那边……那个女人……她一挥手，锚点就……
dialogText.en: We were in the Cradle of the Ages... That woman... She just flicked her hand and the Ankhors...

dialogText.cn: 我从没见过那样的锚点……他们被一股震荡波扫到，然后、然后……
dialogText.en: I've never seen Ankhors of that sort... The shockwave hit the crew like a train... And then ... and then...

dialogText.cn: 就那么一瞬间，他们全都倒下了，一个都没有救回来……都怪我说想去世代摇篮看看！
dialogText.en: They crumpled over in an instant... Never got back to their feet... It's all my fault... I was the one who wanted to check out the Cradle of the Ages!

dialogText.cn: 不要责怪自己，你不可能预见到所有意外的。
dialogText.en: Don't blame yourself. No one could have seen that coming.

dialogText.cn: 我只是觉得那附近有些不对劲……锚点制造的天使都在往那里挤，但路口被屏障一样的东西挡住了，我们过不去……
dialogText.en: It's just ... something about that place felt wrong... The Aggeloi made by the Ankhors kept swarming over there, but the path was blocked by a strange barrier. We couldn't get to it...

dialogText.cn: 所以其他地方的天使才这么少……
dialogText.en: So that's why we aren't seeing that many Aggeloi in the other parts of this area...

dialogText.cn: 我被天使伤到了，没有跟他们一起深入，等到震荡波出现的时候已经来不及了……
dialogText.en: I was injured by some Aggelos, so the rest of the team went on without me. It was too late when the shockwaves were suddenly triggered...

dialogText.cn: 那震荡波的范围越来越大，我只能跑……一个人不停地跑……
dialogText.en: And the shockwaves got bigger with every pulse... I had to run... I kept running and running ... all by myself...

dialogText.cn: 你能平安回来已经是不幸中的万幸了，你带回来的信息能拯救许多人！
dialogText.en: The silver lining is that you made it back safely. What you learned out there will save many lives!

dialogText.cn: 可我……我什么都……
dialogText.en: But I ... I didn't save any...

dialogText.cn: 你的当务之急是养好伤，这里还有许多人需要你。
dialogText.en: Focus on getting better, Alfass. Plenty of people here need your help.

dialogText.cn: 你说得对，我不能让他们白白牺牲……
dialogText.en: You're right. I won't let their sacrifices be in vain...

dialogText.cn: 震荡波……我们的数据库里没有收录过能释放震荡波的锚点。
dialogText.en: Shockwaves... Our database has no entries of any Ankhor-type entities capable of emitting them.

dialogText.cn: 他提到了“那个女人”，该不会是……
dialogText.en: He mentioned seeing a woman... Could that be...

dialogText.cn: 如果聂菲斯真的能控制锚点的坠落位置，她为什么要大费周章地把三枚锚点都砸在这里……
dialogText.en: Nefarith... Even if she's capable of directing the site of Ankhorfalls ... why did she go out of her way to strike this place with three Ankhors...?

dialogText.cn: 搞定了！
dialogText.en: Nailed it!

dialogText.cn: 路上有一道“<@qu.key>光墙</>”……是罗伊尔提到过的屏障吗？
dialogText.en: There's a <@qu.key>wall of light</> blocking the way... Is this the barrier Royle was talking about?

dialogText.cn: 应该没错。
dialogText.en: You're probably right.

dialogText.cn: 我们破坏刚才那个锚点的时候，屏障好像有变化。
dialogText.en: When we destroyed the Ankhor, that barrier seemed to change as well.

dialogText.cn: 对，上面的图案明显缺了一块！锚点和这里的屏障是有关的。
dialogText.en: Yeah. A piece is obviously missing from the symbols! These Ankhors definitely have something to do with this barrier.

dialogText.cn: 是的，不能掉以轻心，我们对里面的情况还没有任何了解。
dialogText.en: Indeed. We know little about the situation in this area. Stay vigilant, team.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，先处理掉剩下的锚点。
dialogText.en: Let's go and take out the remaining Ankhors.

dialogText.cn: 锚点在阻挡我们前往世代摇篮……
