dialogText.en: The Ankhors are slowing our progress to reach the Cradle of the Ages...

dialogText.cn: 比想象中还要麻烦……多亏了这些源石树枝。
dialogText.en: This is such a hassle... Luckily we have these Originium branches.

dialogText.cn: 不过，为什么只有这些源石树枝能够抵挡震荡波？它比起普通源石有什么特别之处？
dialogText.en: But how do these Originium branches block the shockwave? Are they any different from the usual Originium ore?

dialogText.cn: 这些树枝像是在回应管理员……毕竟，大树也和管理员有渊源。
dialogText.en: These branches seem to respond to our Endministrator... After all, the Great Oak does owe its existence to the Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我们一路上接触的其他源石都没有这样的结构特质，等管理员恢复记忆后，我们就能知道更多了。
dialogText.en: The other Originium formations we found along the way do not share such structural properties. Perhaps we'll know more once we restore the Endmin's memories.

actorName.cn: 慌乱的探查队队员{e2m7-女探查队员}
actorName.en: Panicked Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (F)}

dialogText.cn: 我、我不知道该怎么表达谢意，我以为我们要死在这里了……
dialogText.en: I ... I don't know how to th-thank you. I thought we were all going to, to, to die here...

actorName.cn: 冷静的探查队队员{e2m7-男探查队员}
actorName.en: Calm Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (M)}

dialogText.cn: 真不敢想如果没有你们会怎么样……是你们拯救了我们。
dialogText.en: Things would've ended horribly for us if wasn't for you... You saved us all.

dialogText.cn: 这是我们该做的。你们还好吗？有没有哪里受伤了？
dialogText.en: It's what we do. Are you alright? Is anyone hurt?

actorName.cn: 冷静的探查队队员{e2m7-男探查队员}
actorName.en: Calm Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (M)}

dialogText.cn: 我们都没事，这些发光的树枝保护了我们，詹娜奶奶讲的故事是真的！
dialogText.en: Everyone's alright! The glowing branches saved us! All the stories that Granny Jenner told us are true!

dialogText.cn: 那就好。现在震荡波已经停止了，你们能自己返回矿区营地吗？
dialogText.en: Good. The shockwaves have ended. Can you make it back to the Mining Camp on your own?

actorName.cn: 慌乱的探查队队员{e2m7-女探查队员}
actorName.en: Panicked Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (F)}

dialogText.cn: 等、等等，我们刚才……
dialogText.en: Wait! Hold on! We, we, we were... Hngh..

dialogText.cn: 冷静一点，放心吧，已经没事了。
dialogText.en: Just breathe easy. Relax. Things have settled down already.

actorName.cn: 慌乱的探查队队员{e2m7-女探查队员}
actorName.en: Panicked Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (F)}

dialogText.cn: 我们逃到这里之前，看到了一个奇怪的身影……我从来没在谷地见到过阿达克利斯……
dialogText.en: Okay... We saw a strange figure while escaping to this place... I-I've never seen an Archosauria in the Valley...

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯……
dialogText.en: Nefarith...

actorName.cn: 慌乱的探查队队员{e2m7-女探查队员}
actorName.en: Panicked Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (F)}

dialogText.cn: 她在屏障出现后就突然不见了，我甚至以为是自己出现了幻觉……我的直觉告诉我，她很危险……
dialogText.en: She suddenly disappeared when the barrier showed up. I thought I was seeing things... My gut tells me that she's dangerous...

dialogText.cn: 没事的，别去想这些了。回到营地好好休养一段时间，我们会处理好一切的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. There's no need to think about this right now. Just return to camp and rest well. We'll handle things from here.

actorName.cn: 冷静的探查队队员{e2m7-男探查队员}
actorName.en: Calm Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (M)}

dialogText.cn: 是你们救了我，我相信你们。
dialogText.en: You're my saviors. I believe in you.

actorName.cn: 冷静的探查队队员{e2m7-男探查队员}
actorName.en: Calm Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (M)}

dialogText.cn: 前面的路被破坏了，我们调试一下那边的吊车，或许能够帮上你们一些忙。
dialogText.en: The road ahead is out. Perhaps we can help you out a bit by using that crane over there.

actorName.cn: 慌乱的探查队队员{e2m7-女探查队员}
actorName.en: Panicked Survey Team Member {e2m7-Survey Team Member (F)}

dialogText.cn: 祝愿你们一切顺利。
dialogText.en: Good luck out there.

dialogText.cn: 果然那些锚点和屏障都是聂菲斯留下的。
dialogText.en: I knew it! Nefarith was the one who left the barrier and all those Ankhors.

dialogText.cn: 不论她打算唤醒什么，是时候粉碎她的阴谋了，我们走！
dialogText.en: It doesn't matter what she's going to leave behind. We must end her schemes. Let's go, team!

dialogText.cn: 太好了，你们都平平安安的！我正担心着呢！
dialogText.en: Thank goodness you're alright! I was getting worried about you!

dialogText.cn: 最后一个锚点应该是在运输区那边。你们稍微休息一下，路障就交给我来处理。
dialogText.en: The last Ankhor should be in the Logistics Area. Go ahead and take a short break. I'll clear the roads for you.

dialogText.cn: 把塔塔连到协议信号塔里，就能和之前一样进行大范围扫描了。
dialogText.en: We can connect Tata to the signal tower and perform another regional scan like we did before.

dialogText.cn: 完成扫描之后，塔塔就先留在这里吧。
dialogText.en: Once the scan is complete, we'll park Tata at this place.

dialogText.cn: 这就是最后一个锚点了。
dialogText.en: This is the last Ankhor.

dialogText.cn: 世代摇篮……还不知道那里面现在变成了什么样。
dialogText.en: Cradle of the Ages... I wonder what it's like inside right now.

dialogText.cn: 工团不惜引爆源石大树来对抗的天使……管理员，接下来无论遇到什么，都要以自身安全为最优先事项。陈，拜托你了。
dialogText.en: To take down the Aggelos inside there, the UWST was forced to detonate the Great Originium Oak... Endmin, your top priority is to keep yourself safe, no matter what happens. Chen, I'm counting on you as well.

dialogText.cn: 世代摇篮入口的屏障应该消失了，我们回去吧。
dialogText.en: The barrier to the Cradle of the Ages should be gone. Let's head back.

dialogText.cn: 交给我吧。
dialogText.en: Leave it to me.

dialogText.cn: 在我们查明内部情况前，塔塔先留在这里吧。
dialogText.en: I think it's better to park Tata here before we figure out what's going on inside.

dialogText.cn: （乖巧的表情）
dialogText.en: *Sweet emote*

dialogText.cn: 看，地里钻出了树苗！
dialogText.en: Look. A sapling just sprouted from the ground!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，就和营地里，詹娜照顾的树苗一样有生机呢。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Just like the sapling nurtured by Granny Jenner in the camp.

dialogText.cn: 它是在大树残骸正中央破土而出的。管理员，我想，这是大树对你的回应。
dialogText.en: It sprouted from the heart of this Great Oak's stump. I believe the tree has answered your call, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 就像是大树重生了，这肯定是个好兆头！营地的大家都会很高兴的。
dialogText.en: Does that mean the Great Oak lives again? This is like the best thing ever! It's gonna make everyone in Camp so happy!

dialogText.cn: 总算到头了！
dialogText.en: We've finally reached the end of it!

dialogText.cn: 哇！这里的景色……
dialogText.en: Wow! Just look at this place...

dialogText.cn: 根据先前传回的报告，这恐怕都是那场爆炸的残留。
dialogText.en: According to the earlier records, these formations were probably created during that explosion.

dialogText.cn: 一次无奈的选择，为这块土地留下了至今未愈的伤口。
dialogText.en: It was the only option they had. It left a wound that never healed, even to this day.

dialogText.cn: 这就叫“机缘巧合”吧。
dialogText.en: I guess fate brought everything together!

dialogText.cn: 时节轮转，这里又回到了不曾拥有那棵源石大树的样子。这是谁也没有设想过的。
dialogText.en: After all these years, this place has returned to what it looked like before the Originium Oak. No one could have foreseen this.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，过去的你在这里留下了一个选择。
dialogText.en: Endmin, your past self left a choice here.

dialogText.cn: 但那时的你应该也不曾想到，多年之后，那个选择会为如今的我们开辟道路……
dialogText.en: That past self probably did not realize that, after all these years, the same choice would create a path for us on this day...

dialogText.cn: 这确实是一种“机缘巧合”。
dialogText.en: So yes, fate has indeed brought everything together.

dialogText.cn: 不过……有时我又觉得，或许一切都是……
dialogText.en: But ... there were times when I felt that everything was just...

dialogText.cn: 不，没什么。
dialogText.en: Well, nothing much, I guess.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们走吧。
dialogText.en: Let's get moving, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 谁也没想到，疤痕之下，还有着这般炫目的景色。
dialogText.en: Simply unimaginable... To think that such resplendent beauty lies beneath the scar.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们距离聂菲斯已经越来越近了……
dialogText.en: Endmin, we're getting closer to Nefarith...

dialogText.cn: 到时候与她必定又有一场大战……还是做足准备再出发吧。
dialogText.en: A terrible battle may be inevitable... We should be fully prepared before we approach the Landbreakers.
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: ……嗯？管理员？抱歉，我刚刚……在思考一些事。
dialogText.en: ...Oh, Endmin... I'm sorry. I was just ... thinking about a few things.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我在想之后怎样才能不让你涉险……
dialogText.en: Yes, I was... I was thinking about how to dissuade you from taking on further risks...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，之后或许会遇到类似的强敌……我在想该如何应对，才能尽力保证你的安全。
dialogText.en: Yes... And we might be facing powerful enemies like that in the future... I'm trying to think of a way to guarantee your safety.

dialogText.cn: 虽然还没思考出什么结果……不过，还是等解决了这里的难题再继续考虑吧。
dialogText.en: I don't have any ideas right now... But I'll try to come up with one after we solve the crisis on our hands.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔！你是不是已经充好电了？来一起合个影怎么样？
dialogText.en: Tata! Are you fully juiced and ready to go? Let's take a photo together!

dialogText.cn: （疑惑的表情）
dialogText.en: *Confused emote*

dialogText.cn: 当然有意义啊！你看，难得到了这么漂亮的地方，不拍照留个念，岂不是亏了？
dialogText.en: Of course it's meaningful! Look at this place! It's like the prettiest place for miles around! We gotta take a picture or this would be one wasted trip!

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 对吧！让我想想摆个什么姿势……嗯……这个手势不错……这个站姿也可以试试……
dialogText.en: Totally! Now let me think of a proper pose... Hmm. This gesture looks great... Maybe I can use another pose...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你已经做好准备了吗？
dialogText.en: Ready to go, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 好，那我们这就出发。
dialogText.en: Alright then. Let's roll, team.

dialogText.cn: 没事，我们也需要在这里休整一下，等万事俱备后再继续前进吧。
dialogText.en: Sure. I also believe we should rest here for a while. Let's move out once everyone's ready.

dialogText.cn: 我们到了。这里就是工团的<@qu.key>电力中心</>，四号谷地跳动的能源心脏。
dialogText.en: We've arrived. This is the <@qu.key>power generation center</> of the UWST, the literal beating heart that keeps the entirety of Valley IV powered.

dialogText.cn: 那便是悬在四号谷地头上的利剑，它关系着无数人的安危。
dialogText.en: A grave threat that hangs above Valley IV. It will determine the fate of countless lives.

dialogText.cn: 成败在此一举，管理员。
dialogText.en: This is the place where we decide our victory, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉让你以身犯险，不过……整个谷地，还有我们，都需要你。
dialogText.en: I'm sorry that you have to endanger yourself, but ... the entirety of Valley IV needs you. We need you too.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们得把塔塔带到那里。
dialogText.en: Yes. And we must bring Tata to that place.

dialogText.cn: 这就是最后一段路了……
dialogText.en: This is the final stretch of the road...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉让你以身犯险，不过……整个谷地，还有我们，都需要你。
dialogText.en: I'm sorry that you have to endanger yourself, but ... the entirety of Valley IV needs you. We need you too.

dialogText.cn: 放心吧，我们都在呢。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Your entire team is right by your side.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们走吧。管理员，带领我们结束这一切。
dialogText.en: That's right. Let's go, Endmin. It's time to put an end to this.

dialogText.cn: 这是工团的<@qu.key>源石发电站</>，它是四号谷地的开拓象征，经历过漫长的岁月。
dialogText.en: This is the <@qu.key>UWST Originium Power Plant</>. It has stood for many years, and serves as the symbol of humanity's pioneering efforts in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 穿过发电站，我们才能抵达超域试验场……也就是裂隙所在之处。
dialogText.en: We must make our way through the Power Plant to reach the Æther Test Site... That is where the rift is located.

dialogText.cn: 这两座建筑分别代表了四号谷地的过去和未来。它们对于工团而言都很重要。
dialogText.en: One stands as the past of Valley IV, the other a symbol of its future. They are both important to the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 但眼下，它们都面临着威胁。
dialogText.en: But right now, they're both facing a serious threat.

dialogText.cn: 周围到处都有破损的痕迹，看来裂地者曾大举进攻过这座发电站。
dialogText.en: I see signs of damage all over the place. Those breakers must have launched a major assault on this power plant.

dialogText.cn: 他们来势汹汹，工人们恐怕难以抵挡。
dialogText.en: With an attack force this size, the crew can barely hold them off.

dialogText.cn: 里面可能都是敌人，要做好最坏的打算。
dialogText.en: We must assume the worst, team. Expect hostile forces in this facility.

dialogText.cn: 喂……？能听到吗？……是什……该死……
dialogText.en: Hello...? Do you copy? ...What the ... suck a ...

dialogText.cn: 通信器？有人在联络我们？
dialogText.en: Was that a radio message? Someone's trying to hail us.

dialogText.cn: 先别轻举妄动，有未知身份的讯号接入了我们的内部频段。陈，警戒一下周围。
dialogText.en: We should be cautious. An unidentified signal is trying to get into our internal channel. Chen, I need you to secure our perimeter.

dialogText.cn: 连这里都有裂地者，看来里面的情况不容乐观。
dialogText.en: Those breakers are here as well! Things aren't looking too good for the people inside.

dialogText.cn: 会不会是个陷阱？
dialogText.en: Could it be a trap?

dialogText.cn: 这不像是碾骨氏族的作风。菲奥娜，声纹比对的结果如何？
dialogText.en: No. It doesn't seem like something that the Bonekrushers would do. Fiona, anything from voice fingerprinting and analysis?

dialogText.cn: 和工团同步给我们的档案一致，可以确认对方是<@qu.key>麦斯·克劳</>本人。
dialogText.en: There's a match with the files that UWST synced with us. We're certain that the caller is indeed <@qu.key>Matz Crowe</> himself.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我也认为应该去一趟，或许那里还有其他工团的幸存者。
dialogText.en: I agree... I believe we should indeed meet him face-to-face. Perhaps we'll find other UWST survivors there.

dialogText.cn: 坐标已经收到了，那我们走吧。
dialogText.en: And we have the coordinates, right? Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 别怕，我们是终末地的人，附近的裂地者已经被我们解决了。
dialogText.en: Don't be afraid. We're Endfielders. We got rid of the breakers nearby.

dialogText.cn: 终末地……太好了！我正发愁该怎么应对他们。
dialogText.en: Endfield...? Oh, wonderful! I couldn't figure out how to deal with these LBs.

dialogText.cn: 这儿不是个避难的好地方，你在这里干什么？
dialogText.en: Why are you here? This doesn't seem like a good hiding place.

dialogText.cn: 就只差一步了，我不能搞砸克劳老师交给我的任务。
dialogText.en: I'm on a mission from Professor Crowe. Almost done, can't afford to screw this up now.

dialogText.cn: 任务？
dialogText.en: Mission?

dialogText.cn: 我要解除这一片区储能池的安全装置，做最后的准备。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I have to dismantle the safety devices of the energy reservoir for the final preparation.

dialogText.cn: 解除安全装置？等等，克劳先生到底打算做什么？
dialogText.en: Disable the safety? Hold on. Can you tell me what Mr. Crowe is planning?

dialogText.cn: 这座发电站没有配备太多作战武器。但是，只要完全释放储能池的电能，就能产生足以夷平整个供能高地的能量冲击……
dialogText.en: We don't have many weapons at this power plant. But ... we can unleash the electrical power stored in the reservoir. This will generate an energy pulse capable of flattening the entire Power Plateau...

dialogText.cn: 等一下，我没听错吧？什么能量冲击？夷平哪里？
dialogText.en: Wait, wait, wait! I'm not hearing things, right? An energy pulse? To flatten the entire place?

dialogText.cn: 不用担心，这是最终手段，我们会先找机会把幸存者送出去，再作下一步打算。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. This is our ultimate counter. We'll evac the survivors first before continuing with this operation.

dialogText.cn: 你先冷静！这……是克劳先生的计划吗？他打算和裂地者同归于尽？
dialogText.en: Please calm down. Think carefully: is this really Mr. Crowe's plan? Does he intend to take the Landbreakers down with him?

dialogText.cn: 我们没能阻止裂地者占领整个供能高地，有很多人牺牲了……这是我们的责任。
dialogText.en: We failed to fight off the LBs and they took the entire Power Plateau. So many have died... This is our responsibility.

dialogText.cn: 这是一场意外，你们不需要自责，也不需要用这么极端的方式解决问题。现在我们来了，把后续都交给我们好吗？
dialogText.en: It's an accident and none of you should be blaming yourselves. And we certainly don't need to go to such extreme lengths to solve the issue. We're here, and we can take care of the rest.

dialogText.cn: 可是……
dialogText.en: But...

dialogText.cn: 我们收到了克劳先生的联络，正打算去找他。至少先等我们汇总完彼此掌握的情报之后，再做决断也不迟。
dialogText.en: We received a call from Mr. Crowe and we're planning to look for him. Perhaps we should decide upon our next move after we exchange our intel with each other.

dialogText.cn: 那……好吧。克劳老师就在不远处的操作间。不过，我还是得守在这里。一旦确认计划需要继续执行，就必须有人立刻做出反应。
dialogText.en: Okay ... fine. Professor Crowe is in the control room not too far away. But I must stay at my post. Someone has to be here and act quickly once we get a greenlight for the plan.

dialogText.cn: 那你千万要小心，如果发现了裂地者，就立马呼救。我会第一时间赶来。
dialogText.en: Well, be safe out here. Call for help if you see the breakers. I'll be with you in a flash.

dialogText.cn: 难道说克劳先生的警告指的就是这个吗……管理员，我们快去找他吧。
dialogText.en: Perhaps this is what Mr. Crowe warned us about... Endmin, we should look for him quickly.

dialogText.cn: 克劳先生？
dialogText.en: Mr. Crowe?

dialogText.cn: 啊……佩丽卡监督？你们总算来了。
dialogText.en: Ah... Supervisor Perlica? You're finally here.

dialogText.cn: 我还在担心你们能否安全找到这里，看来是我多虑了。
dialogText.en: I was afraid you couldn't get here safely. Looks like I worried too much.

dialogText.cn: 这两位可没在终末地的资料上看到过。如果我没猜错，这位就是管理员吧？
dialogText.en: I haven't seen you two from the Endfield data. If I'm not mistaken, this one here must be your Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 我听过您的故事。
dialogText.en: I know stories about you.

dialogText.cn: 可惜事态紧急，不然真想借此机会跟您坐下来喝上两杯，好好聊聊。
dialogText.en: In a less urgent situation, I would use this opportunity to have a nice chat with you over a few drinks.

dialogText.cn: 哦？你们见到安格鲁了吗？看来那小子的任务办得还算顺利。
dialogText.en: Oh. That means you've met Angro. I knew that kid has what it takes to successfully complete his mission.

dialogText.cn: 什么叫“顺利”？你真打算炸平这里？
dialogText.en: "Successfully"? Seriously now, are you planning to flatten this entire place?

dialogText.cn: 有什么问题吗？关于这点，我也有事想要拜托你们。
dialogText.en: I don't see any problem with that. In fact, I have something I need your help with.

dialogText.cn: 拜托我们？
dialogText.en: Our help?

dialogText.cn: 裂地者突袭了这里，我们付出了很大代价，好不容易救下来的人还在避难处躲着。
dialogText.en: We paid a bloody price when the Landbreakers attacked this place. The crew fought hard to get the survivors to the shelters.

dialogText.cn: 只是这样根本解决不了问题。不搞定天上的裂隙，我们想逃都逃不掉！
dialogText.en: But this will not solve the issue. We must seal that rift in the sky or there is no escape for anyone!

dialogText.cn: 这帮裂地者，是他们捣毁了一切。他们闯了进来，把我们逼上绝路，还想要就这么扬长而去吗？
dialogText.en: These breaker scum invaded this place, destroyed our hard work, and left us no choice. We cannot simply let them leave in peace.

dialogText.cn: 绝不可能！四号谷地是联盟工团的属地，可不是他们想来就来，想走就走的地方！既然横竖都是死，我们绝不会让他们就这么轻易达到目的！
dialogText.en: The Valley IV is UWST territory. They won't just come and leave as they please! Not a chance! Since we're all going to die anyway, we shall make it impossible for them to achieve their goals!

dialogText.cn: 冷静点！既然我们来了，肯定有别的解决办法……
dialogText.en: Oh, come on now. We're here, and we can definitely figure something out...

dialogText.cn: 不，他们必须付出代价，这没得商量。
dialogText.en: No. They must pay the price! This is not for negotiations.

dialogText.cn: 只是在那之前，我想拜托你们把幸存者带到安全的地方。你们既然能来到这儿，就说明你们找到了一条安全的撤退路径。
dialogText.en: But before we take the invaders down with us, I need your help to get the survivors to a safe place. The fact you're here means you have already secured a safe route of evacuation.

dialogText.cn: 即便要牺牲，留我这一个老东西就够了。
dialogText.en: One old man is sufficient for our final sacrifice.

dialogText.cn: 我们做不到。
dialogText.en: That is something we cannot do.

dialogText.cn: 做不到？你们就算打得赢裂地者，也来不及关闭超域裂隙了！
dialogText.en: You cannot do that? Even if you defeat the Landbreakers, there is no way you can seal that Æther rift quickly enough!

dialogText.cn: 我们的目标就是关闭裂隙，为此，我们一路把塔塔带到了这里。
dialogText.en: Sealing the rift is our mission objective. It is why we brought Tata all the way to this place.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔？……等等……
dialogText.en: Tata...? Now hold on...

dialogText.cn: 这是我交给伊冯的原型机？她真的做出来了？有些地方很奇怪……但是……
dialogText.en: Is this the Prototype I handed over to Yvonne? Did she really complete the project? It looks ... rather unique at some places, but...

dialogText.cn: 别光盯着它看啊，怎么样，塔塔能解决那个巨大的超域裂隙吗？
dialogText.en: Don't just stare at it. So, can Tata take care of that huge Æther rift?

dialogText.cn: 如果是这样计算的话……伊冯那小丫头在这里做得很好，嗯……她怎么做到的……
dialogText.en: So this is the algorithmic model... Yvonne did well here. Hmm... How did she pull this off...?

dialogText.cn: ……不。虽然理论上有可行性，但时间来不及了。敌人那么多，你们只有几个人，要怎么才能杀出一条血路？
dialogText.en: ...No. This is only feasible on a theoretical level, but we're running out of time. You only have a single team against a huge force of breakers. There's no way you could reach the place.

dialogText.cn: 我们可是终末地！再说，有管理员在这里，一定会有办法的！
dialogText.en: C'mon, we are the Endfielders! And we got our Endministrator with us, so we'll definitely figure something out!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……或许还有另一个办法。
dialogText.en: Hmm... Perhaps there is another way.

dialogText.cn: 呃，不会还是……
dialogText.en: Erm, are you still trying to...

dialogText.cn: 这次和自爆没关系。怎么，当我只是个想不开去送死，一把年纪沽名钓誉的蠢材？
dialogText.en: The new plan has nothing to do with flattening this place. What? You think I'm some old suicidal fool chasing after medals or glory?

dialogText.cn: 不、不敢！
dialogText.en: Eh, no! Definitely not, sir!

dialogText.cn: 跟我来。
dialogText.en: Follow me.

dialogText.cn: 我相信克劳老师，也相信你们。但……我们也需要留有后手。
dialogText.en: I believe in Professor Crowe and you. But ... we must have a backup solution.

dialogText.cn: 一旦到了无法挽回的局面，我会继续克劳老师给我的任务……
dialogText.en: If things reach the point of no return, I'll continue carrying out Professor Crowe's mission...

dialogText.cn: 工团对意外情况并非毫无准备，像四号谷地这样的资源产地，都会配置一套施术单元，用来发送特殊指令。
dialogText.en: The UWST actually has measures in place to handle various contingencies. All of our resource extraction sites, like Valley IV, are furnished with a set of Arts Unit for issuing special orders.

dialogText.cn: 我们称之为<@qu.key>“烙铁指令”</>。
dialogText.en: We call this the <@qu.key>Utjug Order</>.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>“烙铁指令”</>的意义重大，无论何时发送指令，都会被视作遭受毁灭性军事打击。工团各个军事基地会立刻向发信源进行军事资源投放。
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>Utjug Order</> is not something to trifle with. Any area that issues the Utjug would be considered "under destructive military assault". All UWST military facilities will then begin to deploy military resources to the source of the Utjug signal.

dialogText.cn: 这么厉害？那为什么一开始没打算使用它呢？
dialogText.en: That sounds awesome! Why didn't we send it out in the beginning?

dialogText.cn: 这种战略手段根本不是用来对付裂地者的……除了特殊的发信器，两枚权限钥匙卡也会交由两名指挥权限最高的成员保管。
dialogText.en: Because the strategic measure was not meant for dealing with Landbreakers... Activating it requires more than just a special signal emitter. You'll also need two authorization keycards — each held by one of the highest ranking commanders.

dialogText.cn: 自从矿脉源区的那只巨型天使被炸碎后，我们从未考虑过使用它。如今，当我们想发送<@qu.key>“烙铁指令”</>时……嗯，这里的指挥官已经只剩下我一人了。
dialogText.en: We've never considered using this, ever since we blew up that giant Aggelos at the Origin Lodespring. Now that we're considering using the <@qu.key>Utjug Order</> ... the only high ranking commander left ... is me.

dialogText.cn: 我派了一些人去回收发信器和另一枚权限钥匙卡，但他们都没有回来，也失去了联络。
dialogText.en: I've sent several crew mates to recover the signal emitter and the other keycard, but none of them returned. We also lost contact with them.

dialogText.cn: 他们可能找到了，只是还没回来，又或者已经回不来了。不论如何，我想拜托你们找到他们。
dialogText.en: They might have recovered the items, but maybe they're trapped outside, or could no longer make it back. I hope you can help us find our people, no matter what happened to them.

dialogText.cn: 我就知道您会答应我的请求！
dialogText.en: Great! I knew you would agree to my request!

dialogText.cn: 发电站里的传输管道受到了不同程度的破坏，蒸汽喷涌而出，阻断了很多通路。
dialogText.en: One more thing. The power plant steam pipes have been damaged. The leaking steam might have blocked many passages.

dialogText.cn: 入料用的传送带也被蒸汽阻隔了……监控器上是他们可能会在的位置。
dialogText.en: The transport belt for the material feed has also been blocked by steam... These monitoring screens show the potential locations of my crew.

dialogText.cn: 那些燃料箱或许能帮我们躲过蒸汽……
dialogText.en: That fuel tank might help us avoid the steam...

dialogText.cn: 我需要留下来检查原型机的情况，等会儿它会派上大用场。
dialogText.en: I may have to stay to check on the Prototype. It will need to perform a crucial function later on.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>“烙铁”</>？好特别的名字。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Utjug</>? Now that's an interesting name.

dialogText.cn: 不过是残忍的“止血”手段罢了……
dialogText.en: Just an extreme measure to "stop the bleeding"...

dialogText.cn: 还有什么问题吗？
dialogText.en: Do you have any questions?

dialogText.cn: 很简单，发送<@qu.key>“烙铁指令”</>，呼叫支援。如果做不到，那就拉他们在这里陪葬——
dialogText.en: Simple. Send out the <@qu.key>Utjug Order</> and call for backup. Failing that, I'll just take as many of these blighted scum with me —

dialogText.cn: 通过多种手段引爆整个供能高地。储能池的爆炸也会影响超域试验场内的能源装置。
dialogText.en: We have plenty of measures to detonate the entirety of the Power Plateau. The energy reservoir explosion also has enough yield to affect the power facilities within the Æther Test Site.

dialogText.cn: 哪怕遍体鳞伤，工团也决不允许敌人那么轻易地离开！
dialogText.en: We have been dealt a severe blow, but the UWST will not let the enemy leave this place without paying the price!

dialogText.cn: 如果放任不管，或许他们的下一个目标就是我们的孩子，爱人。
dialogText.en: If we let them do as they please, their next victims would be our children and loved ones.

dialogText.cn: 我不想连累那些年轻人，他们还有未来。而我这个老家伙，人生中的大半时光都在这里度过，我理应和这座发电站埋在一起。
dialogText.en: The young should not suffer this fate because they have a future. I've spent half of my life at this place. This power plant is a fitting tomb for an old man like me.

dialogText.cn: 好在你们来了，等你们取回要准备的东西，就轮到我们来反击了。
dialogText.en: And it's a good thing you're here. Once you retrieve the things, the United Workers will be ready to retaliate.

dialogText.cn: 一场突袭。裂地者随着一片黑雾冲进了发电站。
dialogText.en: They took us by surprise. A huge band of Landbreakers rushed into the power plant under the cover of a dark haze.

dialogText.cn: 那些混蛋迅速地压制了发电站的控制区域，但他们的目标似乎不在这里。
dialogText.en: The blighted bastards overran the control area of this power plant fast, but I don't think that was their real target.

dialogText.cn: 他们在这儿时，看见人就会毫不犹豫地痛下杀手，好像得到的命令就只有一个……
dialogText.en: When they were here, they killed anyone they saw without hesitation. That seemed like their only order...

dialogText.cn: 我们拼尽全力，利用这里的地形，才保护了一些人。
dialogText.en: We fought back as hard as we could and used the terrain to our advantage. Even then, we only managed to save a handful of people.

dialogText.cn: 但更多人……丹尼尔斯，希望你还活着……
dialogText.en: But many more went ... ugh... I just hope Daniels is still alive...

dialogText.cn: 原型机吗？伊冯对它进行了多次大型迭代，看起来她还装配了情绪模拟模组。
dialogText.en: You're talking about the Prototype? Yvonne gave it quite a few major upgrades. And it seems she also added an emotional emulator module.

dialogText.cn: 我不觉得这有什么必要，模拟的情绪并不能称之为真正的情绪，只是信号灯的切换。
dialogText.en: I personally don't find that necessary. Simulated emotions do not represent true feelings. They are just different patterns of signal lights.

dialogText.cn: 但伊冯乐在其中，这是她的项目了，她可以做她想要做的任何事。
dialogText.en: But Yvonne seems to enjoy the work. It's her project now, so she's free to do whatever she likes.

dialogText.cn: 我很高兴她能把项目完成，让我相信自己的选择是正确的。
dialogText.en: I'm just glad she completed the project. It proves that I made the right choice back then.

dialogText.cn: 我可能需要花点时间研究一下现在的原型机。
dialogText.en: I might need more time to study the current version of the Prototype.

dialogText.cn: 我会在这儿等你们的消息，工团的反击刻不容缓。
dialogText.en: I'll wait here for your news. The UWST retaliation can afford no delays.

dialogText.cn: 我们会想办法和剩下的裂地者周旋，拖到支援抵达。但裂隙就全靠你们了。
dialogText.en: We will figure out how to fight off these Landbreakers and hold out till reinforcements arrive. We're counting on you to deal with that rift.

dialogText.cn: 用信标可以标记那些巢雕的位置，工团的人会去处理，能帮你们省下不少时间。那些年轻人虽然不中用，但关键时刻还是得靠他们。
dialogText.en: Use these beacons to mark the denstacks. Our UWST crew will take care of them and save you a great deal of time. The young crew mates may still be a bit green, but in time like this, we can count on them.

dialogText.cn: 您曾经拯救过这里一次，我们才得以在这里建设、发展。
dialogText.en: You once saved this place. It's the only reason why we could start building and developing this area.

dialogText.cn: 眼下又要拜托您，拯救这片无数人曾洒下心血的土地。
dialogText.en: We now need your assistance again. Countless souls have devoted entire lifetimes to this land. Please help us save it.

dialogText.cn: （谨慎的表情）
dialogText.en: *Cautious emote*

dialogText.cn: （乖巧的表情）
dialogText.en: *Sweet emote*

dialogText.cn: 你们快去帮一帮克莱维尔吧，他不擅长面对危险情况。
dialogText.en: Go and help Clavell. He's not good at handling dangerous situations.

dialogText.cn: 我本来计划送回权限钥匙卡就去帮他的……
dialogText.en: I was planning to go and help him once I deliver the authorization keycard...

dialogText.cn: 希望一切尽早结束……
dialogText.en: Hope all this mess can end soon...

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地承受不了更大的破坏。我们需要很久的时间来让这里恢复如初……
dialogText.en: Valley IV can ill afford more destruction. It will take us a really long time to completely remediate this region...

dialogText.cn: 工团不会放过这些疯子的……
dialogText.en: The UWST will make these lunatics pay...

dialogText.cn: “烙铁”既是我们止血的手段，也是我们复仇的铁锤……
dialogText.en: "Utjug" is our solution to stop the bleeding, and the hammer of our vengeance...

dialogText.cn: 你们击败了那些裂地者……你们是？
dialogText.en: You just wrecked those breakers... Seriously, who are you?

dialogText.cn: 别怕，自己人，是克劳让我们来的！
dialogText.en: Chill, buddy. We're allies. Crowe told us to come here!

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师……他有吩咐什么吗？
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe...? Did he have any instructions for me?

dialogText.cn: 你是负责回收<@qu.key>权限钥匙卡</>的吗？我们来接应你。
dialogText.en: Are you tasked with recovering the <@qu.key>keycard</>? We've been told to rendezvous with you.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>权限钥匙卡</>……嗯，在我这里。
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>authorization keycard</>... Yeah. I have it with me.

dialogText.cn: 就是这个吗……上面为什么会有血迹？你从哪里找到它的？
dialogText.en: Is this it...? Why is there blood on it? Where did you find this?

dialogText.cn: 我是从……你们别问了，现在说这些也没有意义。
dialogText.en: I got it from... Ugh. I don't think you need to know this. It no longer matters.

dialogText.cn: 我只想帮克劳老师完成要做的事，然后……让这帮裂地者血债血偿。
dialogText.en: My only wish is to complete Professor Crowe's task for me, and ... make those breakers pay for what they've done.

dialogText.cn: ……我知道了。
dialogText.en: ...I understand.

dialogText.cn: 接下来的任务交给我们，别做冲动的事，克劳先生还需要你。
dialogText.en: Leave the mission to us and avoid doing anything rash. Professor Crowe needs your help.

dialogText.cn: 放心吧，我知道自己该怎么做。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. I know what I'm supposed to do.

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师还需要<@qu.key>发信器</>。它一直放在站长和老师的实验室里，从这里穿过去就是。克莱维尔已经去回收了。
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe still needs the <@qu.key>signal emitter</>. It's kept at the Professor and the Site Director's lab. You'll reach the lab by going through this place. I believe Clavell is already trying to retrieve it.

dialogText.cn: 只是……这么多裂地者，估计他也被困住了。
dialogText.en: But ... with so many breakers around, he's probably trapped somewhere.

dialogText.cn: 他随时可能会遇到危险，我们得抓紧时间。
dialogText.en: He might have run into danger. We must hurry up.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的人？你们来的时候见到过丹尼尔斯站长吗？
dialogText.en: Endfielders? Did you see Site Director Daniels on your way here?

dialogText.cn: 站长？我们是受克劳先生之托来找你，还有他要的<@qu.key>发信器</>。
dialogText.en: Site Director? No. Mr. Crowe told us to come here and find you, as well as the <@qu.key>signal emitter</>.

dialogText.cn: 不是站长吗……
dialogText.en: You're not here because of the site director...?

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师还好吗？邓恩有把<@qu.key>权限钥匙卡</>带回去吗？
dialogText.en: Is Professor Crowe alright? Did Dean manage to head back with the <@qu.key>authorization keycard</>?

dialogText.cn: 他和邓恩都没事，<@qu.key>权限钥匙卡</>现在在我们手上，他告诉我们，你可能遇到了危险。
dialogText.en: Both Crowe and Dean are alright and we have the <@qu.key>authorization keycard</>. Crowe also told us that you might be in danger.

dialogText.cn: 你有拿到那个<@qu.key>发信器</>吗？话说回来，为什么你把自己锁在这里？
dialogText.en: Did you find that <@qu.key>signal emitter</>? Speaking of which, why did you lock yourself up in this place?

dialogText.cn: 等一下，外面有什么？
dialogText.en: Wait. What's out there?

dialogText.cn: 是裂地者……我来回收<@qu.key>发信器</>，但裂地者跟了进来！情急之下，我只能关上了大门，把他锁在了实验室里。
dialogText.en: A Landbreaker... I came here to retrieve the <@qu.key>signal emitter</> but the damn LB followed me! I had no choice but to lock the gate and trap him in the lab.

dialogText.cn: 亏你还能这么淡定，你就不担心出不去了吗？
dialogText.en: Aren't you worried about being trapped here as well? You got some nerves of steel.

dialogText.cn: 我更担心到现在我还没完成任务，要是断送了大家逃生的机会，我……
dialogText.en: I'm more worried about my incomplete mission. If I messed up the evac plan for everyone, I would...

dialogText.cn: 现在不是自责的时候，外面的裂地者交给我们。
dialogText.en: This isn't the time to blame yourself. We'll handle the Landbreaker outside.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>发信器</>应该还在实验室里，希望它没有被裂地者刚才的破坏波及……
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>signal emitter</> is still in the lab. Fingers crossed that stupid breaker didn't wreck it...

dialogText.cn: 不能再耽搁了，我们上吧！
dialogText.en: Alright, let's go get him! Chop chop!

dialogText.cn: ……果然，裂地者全部聚集在了这里。
dialogText.en: ...Turns out all the Landbreakers have gathered here.

dialogText.cn: 那些是……巢雕？不摧毁它们的话，又会出现那些毒雾。
dialogText.en: Are those ... denstacks? We'd better take them down ASAP, or they'll start making the toxic haze again.

dialogText.cn: 各位，发送<@qu.key>“烙铁指令”</>的准备工作都已经完成了。
dialogText.en: Crew, we have completed our preparations for sending out the <@qu.key>Utjug Order</>.

dialogText.cn: 这就是工团的最终手段……如果指令成功发出的话，会发生什么？
dialogText.en: So this is the ultimate retaliation of the UWST... What's going to happen if the order is successfully sent out?

dialogText.cn: 不知道，能查到的<@qu.key>“烙铁指令”</>记录屈指可数……
dialogText.en: I don't know. I tried searching for <@qu.key>Utjug Order</> and got barely any hits...

dialogText.cn: 肯定会派些不得了的支援吧。全域轰炸？还是传说中的蒸汽骑士？
dialogText.en: It's gotta be serious reinforcements. Full regional bombardment? Or the legendary Steam Knights?

dialogText.cn: 别废话了，都站开点。
dialogText.en: Enough talk. Keep a safe distance, crew.

dialogText.cn: 看着这些入侵者，他们践踏了我们的家园，摧毁了我们的工厂，残害了我们的同胞。
dialogText.en: Take a good look at these invaders. They came and smashed our homes, destroyed our factories, and killed our people.

dialogText.cn: 看着他们，记住他们的样子，然后让他们知道，自己招惹了一帮什么样的人！工团绝不会就此作罢，让他们见识一下，工人们的反击！
dialogText.en: Look at them! Remember their faces! Then let them know who they're messing with! The United Workers never surrender! Show them how we strike back!

dialogText.cn: 滋……克劳？是你吗？你又搞砸了什么？就这么一瞬间的信号谁他妈看得到啊！
dialogText.en: *Brzzazzz*... Crowe? Was that you? What did you screw up this time? That blip you sent was tiny as hell — I almost missed it!

dialogText.cn: 别废话了，你这不就看到了吗？那就别磨磨叽叽的，有什么都往这里砸！
dialogText.en: Enough words. You saw that blip so stop wasting time. Unload everything you got on my coordinates!

dialogText.cn: 你疯了？那你们怎么办？
dialogText.en: You're mad, Crowe! What about your people?

dialogText.cn: 该做的准备我们自己会想办法，哪儿那么多怎么办？
dialogText.en: We'll just get prepared and figure our way out.

dialogText.cn: 我告诉过你别意气用事，支援部队已经在路上了！
dialogText.en: I've always told you to keep your impulses in check! Reinforcements are already on their way!

dialogText.cn: 听好了，你们现在的任务就是保护好自己，我们不允许再出现任何伤亡。
dialogText.en: Listen to me, Crowe. Your new mission is to protect your people. No more casualties, you hear me?

dialogText.cn: 你把<@qu.key>“烙铁加热”</>了，你做得很好，你的工作完成了。所以剩下的交给我们，听懂了吗？
dialogText.en: You've done well by <@qu.key>heating up the Utjug</>. Your job's done. Just leave the rest to us. Understood?

dialogText.cn: 谁这么教你的？你知道<@qu.key>“烙铁”</>代表的意义吗？
dialogText.en: You little brat, what the heck are you talking about? Do you even know what <@qu.key>Utjug</> means?

dialogText.cn: 代表着工人兄弟姐妹们需要我们拯救，时代不一样了，克劳老师。
dialogText.en: It means that we have more crew brothers and sisters to save. Times have changed, Professor Crowe.

dialogText.cn: 如果你们需要定点的火力支援，就在目标位置留下<@qu.key>“信标”</>。除此之外，相信我们。
dialogText.en: If you need artillery support, plant a <@qu.key>beacon</> at the target coordinates. In any case, have faith in us.

dialogText.cn: 等下次见面再跟你算账。
dialogText.en: Damn it... We'll settle this when we next meet.

dialogText.cn: 那再好不过了。
dialogText.en: I look forward to that.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，如你所见，年轻人们懈怠了，我们的人还要迟一点。
dialogText.en: Endmin, as you can see, the younger generation is made of softies. It'll take a while for our reinforcements to arrive.

dialogText.cn: 让那些裂地者多苟延残喘一会儿，但这并不是关键。
dialogText.en: We'll let those Landbreakers live for a little while longer. But that's beside the point.

dialogText.cn: 裂隙，头顶上那片恐怖的裂隙才是危险的源头。四号谷地没有其他选择，只能相信原型机能够做到……
dialogText.en: It's the rift. The terrifying rift that hangs above our heads. That's the source of danger. Valley IV has no other option but to place its faith in the Prototype...

dialogText.cn: 这副样子……我们不剩多少时间了。
dialogText.en: Judging by what I see ... we don't have much time left.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，在需要支援的地方使用<@qu.key>信标</>吧。整个四号谷地的生死就托付给你们了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, use these <@qu.key>beacons</> if you need fire support. The survival of Valley IV rests upon the shoulders of your team.

dialogText.cn: 这就是最后的冲刺了。我们走，管理员。
dialogText.en: This is our final push. Let's go, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我从来没见过这样混乱又有序的算法，是伊冯的手笔吗？不对……这不是她的风格，况且即使是她也不可能做到这一步……
dialogText.en: I've never seen such a mess of algorithms perform with such order. Did Yvonne do this? No... This isn't like her. Even if it were, this would have been impossible for someone of her skill...

dialogText.cn: 这已经不算是普通的情绪模拟了……这是什么？
dialogText.en: This isn't a run-of-the-mill emotional emulator... What exactly is it?

dialogText.cn: 到底是什么原因让它变成了这样，是自我学习吗？……但这真的是可能的吗？
dialogText.en: What are the causative factors that led to this outcome? Self-learning? ...Is this even remotely possible?

dialogText.cn: 克劳先生，我们回来了，塔塔出了什么问题吗？
dialogText.en: We're back, Mr. Crowe. Is there something wrong with Tata?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……没事，只是一点我个人的猜想，但这不重要。邓恩他们都平安回来了，你们取回发信器了吗？
dialogText.en: Oh... Nothing's wrong. Just making a few personal postulations. Anyway, Dean and the crew mates are back. Did you retrieve the signal emitter?

dialogText.cn: 丹尼尔斯，这是你们用血换回来的……睡吧，老朋友。
dialogText.en: Sleep well, Daniels. Old friend, know that your sacrifices are not in vain...

dialogText.cn: 我们需要空旷一点的场地，走吧，我们到外面去。
dialogText.en: We need a place with bigger space. Come, let's head outside.

dialogText.cn: 你们回来了，看来<@qu.key>发信器</>的回收很顺利。
dialogText.en: You're back! And you have retrieved the <@qu.key>signal emitter</>.

dialogText.cn: 我在帮克劳老师记录一些参数，有什么事吗？
dialogText.en: I'm helping Professor Crowe record the figures of a few parameters. Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 我们没得选择，要么发送<@qu.key>“烙铁指令”</>呼叫支援，要么看着天上的裂隙把整个四号谷地变成地狱……
dialogText.en: We have no other option. We either send out the <@qu.key>Utjug Order</> and call for support, or see that rift in the sky turn Valley IV into a blighted hellscape...

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师有时看起来偏执、疯狂，但我们知道他所有的决定都是经过深思熟虑的。
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe may seem like a stubborn and obsessed maniac... But everyone of us knows he only makes a decision after careful deliberation.

dialogText.cn: 他承受的压力超乎我们想象，如果这个时候没人能替他分担的话……唉……
dialogText.en: We can barely imagine the amount of stress he's been getting. If none of us were around to share the burden... Ugh...

dialogText.cn: 我找到了丹尼尔斯站长的尸体。
dialogText.en: I found Site Director Daniels... His body, actually...

dialogText.cn: 他牺牲前和几个幸存的工人在一起，我本以为他会留在实验室里等待我们的联络，但他没有坐以待毙。
dialogText.en: He was with a few surviving crew mates before he fell. I thought he would stay in the lab and wait for us ... but he decided to strike back.

dialogText.cn: 他是这个发电站里我最尊敬的人，他教会了我太多太多……
dialogText.en: Site Director Daniels is the person I respect the most in this entire power plant. He taught me everything...

dialogText.cn: 我知道这种危急关头不应该让情绪影响我，但……我……
dialogText.en: I know times are desperate, and I shouldn't let my emotions get the better of me. But ... but I ...

dialogText.cn: 我还有一些准备工作要做，等下见。
dialogText.en: Yeah... I've got some preparations to do. See you around.

dialogText.cn: 这些机关与那些<@qu.key>符号</>之间……似乎有什么关联。
dialogText.en: Can there be any connections between these mechanisms ... and those <@qu.key>symbols</>?

dialogText.cn: 刚才在雾气里，墙上的<@qu.key>符号</>就突然浮现了出来……
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>symbols</> suddenly appeared on the wall when we were in the haze...

dialogText.cn: 那些符号……难道说受到雾气的影响才能看见那些<@qu.key>符号</>？
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>symbols</>... Maybe we have to be affected by the haze to see them...

dialogText.cn: 我们试试看吧。
dialogText.en: Let's give it a try.

dialogText.cn: 前面就是裂隙所在之处了，聂菲斯可能就在那里。
dialogText.en: The location of the rift is up ahead. There's a good chance that Nefarith is there.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们此行并非是要和聂菲斯决一死战，想办法关上裂隙，才是最终目的。
dialogText.en: Endmin, the purpose of our mission is not to defeat Nefarith or die trying. Our objective is to find a way to seal the rift.

dialogText.cn: 所以，如何把塔塔送到裂隙中心是最重要的问题。我有一个想法……
dialogText.en: That's why moving Tata to the epicenter of the rift will be a key challenge. I have an idea to make that happen...

dialogText.cn: （担忧的表情）
dialogText.en: *Worried emote*

dialogText.cn: 没错，放轻松。我们跨过那么多艰难险阻，都走到这一步了，一定会有好结果的。
dialogText.en: Relax, Tata. We've survived so many dangers together and made it this far already. I'm sure this is going to end well.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: 你说得对，终末地曾克服过比现在还要艰难得多的险境……而现在，我们终于能再次和管理员并肩作战。
dialogText.en: You're right. Endfield once overcame tribulations far more terrible than this... Today, we shall fight alongside our Endministrator once again.

dialogText.cn: 做好最后的准备吧，四号谷地也该恢复平静了。
dialogText.en: Make your final preparations. We shall restore peace to Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 结束这一切的时刻就在眼前，准备好了吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: The time has come to end this. Are you ready, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，决战之前，不能有任何疏忽。
dialogText.en: I agree. We cannot afford any lapse for the final battle.

dialogText.cn: 结束这一切的时刻就在眼前，准备好了吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: The time has come to end this. Are you ready, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，决战之前，不能有任何疏忽。
dialogText.en: I agree. We cannot afford any lapse for the final battle.

dialogText.cn: （开心的表情）
dialogText.en: *Happy emote*

dialogText.cn: （担忧的表情）
dialogText.en: *Worried emote*

dialogText.cn: 塔塔它……去哪儿了？
dialogText.en: Tata..? Where did it go?

dialogText.cn: 它……和裂隙一起消失了。
dialogText.en: It's ... gone. Gone with the rift.

dialogText.cn: 如果，如果我再强一点……是不是塔塔就不会——
dialogText.en: If ... if I were a little stronger ... Tata wouldn't——

dialogText.cn: 塔塔……本来就是带着帮助大家的使命来到这里的。
dialogText.en: Tata... It came here to help us carry out our mission.

dialogText.cn: 克劳、伊冯、安德烈，他们创造塔塔的时候，一定也希望它能为塔卫二的人们排忧解难。
dialogText.en: Chen, I think that when Crowe, Yvonne, and Andre built Tata, they sincerely believe it could help the people of Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔关闭了裂隙，没有辜负大家的期望。它保护了我们，保护了四号谷地。
dialogText.en: Tata lived up to everyone's expectations and sealed the rift. It protected us ... and Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 所以，也轮到我们去拯救更多的人了。
dialogText.en: Right now, it is our turn to step up and save more people.

dialogText.cn: ……我明白。
dialogText.en: ...I understand.

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯离开时说的那些话……管理员，她好像对你很了解。
dialogText.en: Endministrator ... what Nefarith said before she left... Judging by the content, we can only assume she knows you pretty well.

dialogText.cn: 你的记忆尚未恢复，而敌人还藏在暗处。我们必须更加小心。
dialogText.en: You have yet to recover your memories, and the enemy is still in the shadows. We must be more cautious.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！佩丽卡监督！你们能听到吗？
dialogText.en: Endministrator! Supervisor Perlica! Do you copy?

dialogText.cn: 供能高地的深度正在快速回落……裂隙已经稳定了？
dialogText.en: The depth readings at the Power Plateau are dropping fast... Have we stabilized the rift?

dialogText.cn: 都结束了，但我们没能留住聂菲斯。
dialogText.en: It's over. However, we failed to apprehend Nefarith.

dialogText.cn: 你们平安无事比什么都重要。基地的支援马上就到，请各位回来休整吧。
dialogText.en: Your safety is far more important than anything else. Help should be arriving soon from the Hub. Time to head back to base and get some well-deserved R&R.

dialogText.cn: 我只是……
dialogText.en: I'm just...

dialogText.cn: 不，这不怪管理员！
dialogText.en: No, I'm not blaming you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 各位，一路辛苦了！供能高地的其他朋友也刚回来，我们终于胜利了！
dialogText.en: Everyone! Oh, it's so nice to see you back! Our friends from the Power Plateau just arrived too! Victory is finally ours!

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，这场胜利是所有人的功劳。
dialogText.en: {F}This victory belongs to everyone. That is for sure.{M}This victory belongs to everyone. That is for sure.

dialogText.cn: 收复供能高地之后，四号谷地的威胁就算暂时解除了。
dialogText.en: Now that we've reclaimed the Power Plateau, the threat to Valley IV has been temporarily lifted.

dialogText.cn: 当初说好的迎接仪式到现在都没机会安排……值得庆祝的事情倒是越来越多了。
dialogText.en: Back then, I promised you a welcome party, but never found the time to arrange it ... and now we've got even more to celebrate.

dialogText.cn: 几十年了，管理员您一直这样，每次都闷头扑在最危险的地方。
dialogText.en: After all these years, Endmin, you are still diving straight into the thickest of dangers. Just like before.

dialogText.cn: 不能总把负担全抛给您，接下来的统筹工作就交给我们吧。还有那么多侵蚀要清理，这是个大工程。
dialogText.en: Your burden is way too much. Now let us take care of the remaining work. It will be a major undertaking, given the amount of Blight we need to clean up.

dialogText.cn: 这话可是你说的，安德烈。一会儿来跟我参加简报会。
dialogText.en: Major undertaking indeed, Andre. Ahem. You'll be attending that presentation meeting with me shortly.

dialogText.cn: 啊？
dialogText.en: Oooo?!

dialogText.cn: 呵呵……不过现在，还是让我们放松片刻吧。
dialogText.en: Heheh... But for now, let's set aside some time for a little break.

dialogText.cn: 您能平安回来真是太好了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I'm so happy to see you return safe and sound!

dialogText.cn: 设备投放强度比预计高了不少……幸好系统全都扛住了。
dialogText.en: Facility deployments exceeded our design thresholds... Fortunately, the system accommodated the additional load.

dialogText.cn: 不过，侵蚀干扰还是给协议容量造成了不小的压力。如果接下来要经常接触类似环境，一定得解决这个问题……
dialogText.en: But Blight interference put a major strain on Protocol capacity. If we have to constantly deal with similar environments, we need to figure out how to solve this problem...

dialogText.cn: 没事，我来搞定！总会有办法的！
dialogText.en: No worries! I'm on top of it! There's always a way!

dialogText.cn: 一言为定！
dialogText.en: You have my word!

dialogText.cn: 事情总算告一段落了，管理员。
dialogText.en: Things are finally settling down, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 秦工程师，枢纽区基地突然又忙碌起来了呢。
dialogText.en: And the Hub Base looks busy again, Director Qin.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，危机已经解除，有一大堆事情要和工团商量着处理。
dialogText.en: Yeah. The worst of the crisis is now behind us. There's a lot of work we need to sort out with our friends at the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 你们来之前，我已经把报告都看完了。如果管理员还有什么想了解的问题，都可以来问我。
dialogText.en: I read all the reports before you arrived. Feel free to talk to me if you have any questions, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 根据各区域的侦察结果来看，大量碾骨氏族成员已经撤出了四号谷地。
dialogText.en: According to scouting reports in various areas, many Bonekrushers have left Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 超域试验场和研究所附近还有小部分敌人残留，我们的人会配合工团一起加强戒备。
dialogText.en: But there are still pockets of enemies near the Æther Test Site and the Research Center. We Endfielders will work with the UWST to strengthen local security measures.

dialogText.cn: 联盟工团是支撑起整个文明环带的庞然大物，消息抵达工业母舰之后，这里很快就会被各种支援填满。
dialogText.en: The UWST is a massive organization that sustains the Civilization Band. Once the Industrial Mothership hears about Valley IV, the place will quickly receive all sorts of aid and support.

dialogText.cn: 不过……裂地者竟然和超域有关……联盟工团和环塔商会都不会坐视不理。
dialogText.en: However ... now that we know the Landbreakers got themselves involved with the Æther ... I'm afraid both the UWST and TGCC will start looking into this.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地的复兴是个大课题，光靠终末地可能力有不逮。等工团方面恢复过来后，再找他们高层讨论吧。
dialogText.en: The rebuilding of Valley IV is a major undertaking. Endfield can't do this alone. We should wait for the UWST to catch their breath before talking to their lead monitors.

dialogText.cn: 我也是这么想的。得益于管理员搭建的集成工业系统，枢纽区基地的生产和研究已经恢复得差不多了，我们可以先从修缮枢纽区基地做起。
dialogText.en: I agree. Thanks to the AIC Factory built by our Endmin, production and scientific research throughputs have been restored at the Hub Base. Our major undertaking shall begin at this very site.

dialogText.cn: 这边有一份安德烈提交的报告，是针对枢纽区基地及周围地区的重建计划书。
dialogText.en: Here. Take a look at this. It's Andre's Rebuilding Management Plan for the Hub Base and the surrounding areas.

dialogText.cn: 按他的分析，有集成工业系统的支持，只需要一个季度，便能将这儿恢复到受灾前的状态。
dialogText.en: His analysis is very optimistic. With AIC support, restoring the Hub Base will be fast. A single season will get us back to pre-disaster capacities.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，管理员，我建议你们先稍作休息。就算有再多问题要解决，也不能先把自己累垮了，对吧？
dialogText.en: Endministrator, Supervisor Perlica, I recommend taking a short break for now. It's true we have many problems, but we shouldn't exhaust ourselves, right?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，现在方便吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, do you have a minute?

dialogText.cn: 我想……和你一起出去透透气。
dialogText.en: Maybe we can take a breath together ... just us.

dialogText.cn: 唉，本来还以为能和管理员并肩作战……
dialogText.en: Ugh. I thought I could fight alongside the Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员？！
dialogText.en: End... ENDMIN?!

dialogText.cn: 啊——我就知道！
dialogText.en: ARGH — I knew it!

dialogText.cn: 他们正在撤出四号谷地……非常有效率，很难称之为溃散。
dialogText.en: They are withdrawing from Valley IV ... but they're moving out fast and efficiently. I do not believe that they've been routed.

dialogText.cn: 不管怎样，狼会咬住他们的脖颈。我会时刻和终末地保持联络。
dialogText.en: It doesn't matter. The wolves shall grip them by their necks. I will keep in touch with Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，交给我吧。
dialogText.en: Hmm. You can count on me.

dialogText.cn: 我不是在说自己要……不过……但是……我真的能加入危机处理小组吗？
dialogText.en: I didn't really say I want it ... but ... if it's possible ... can I really be part of the Crisis Team?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多谢您帮忙守住了供能高地！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Thanks to you, we held on and defended the Power Plateau with great success!

dialogText.cn: 现在不比当年了，小崽子们伤了不少，还动用了“烙铁指令”，总部那帮家伙肯定还要唠叨。
dialogText.en: Things have changed. Plenty of little brats got themselves hurt. We even had to resort to the Utjug Order. HQ is definitely going to keep complaining about this.

dialogText.cn: 但……管他呢，这次肯定值！不止供能高地，研究园和矿脉源区的各位也都干得漂亮。
dialogText.en: But ... they can gripe all they want! We made it! And it's not just at the Power Plateau! Everyone performed well at the Science Park and the Origin Lodespring too!

dialogText.cn: 危机能让人爆发潜力，也容易让事情办得过火。最危险的时刻已经过去，该给一些“应急手段”踩踩刹车了。
dialogText.en: A crisis can ignite our true potential, but it may lead us to hit back with excessive force. The worst is already behind us. It is time to ease off some of our emergency measures.

dialogText.cn: 无论怎样，四号谷地欠您一个大人情，管理员。
dialogText.en: No matter what, Valley IV owes you a big one, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……我还在想刚才的事情。
dialogText.en: ...I'm still thinking about what happened back then.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Yeah.

dialogText.cn: 被佩丽卡叫来四号谷地的时候，我其实没想过会发生这么多事。碾骨氏族……巨型天使……还有塔塔。
dialogText.en: When Perlica called me to rendezvous at Valley IV, I never expected to run into so many things. The Bonekrushers ... that giant Aggelos ... and Tata.

dialogText.cn: 到现在我才有了一些实感。看来，我们确实拯救了四号谷地。
dialogText.en: I'm only starting to realize the reality of what we've been through. It seems that we did save Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了塔塔，也多亏了管理员和佩丽卡，对吧？
dialogText.en: All thanks to Tata ... as well as Perlica and you, Endmin. Am I right to say that?

dialogText.cn: 它是我的伙伴。你也是，管理员。
dialogText.en: Tata is a friend and companion, and so are you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 嗯！
dialogText.en: Alright...

dialogText.cn: 管理员果然不只是个“传说里的英雄”。
dialogText.en: Endmin! You turn out to be more than just a hero from the legends.

dialogText.cn: 我们是听着您的故事长大的，历史课上可没少讲天使战争的内容。
dialogText.en: We grew up listening to stories about you. Our history textbooks devote plenty of pages to the Aggeloi War.

dialogText.cn: 哥哥他决心加入安全局，也是因为想和您一样，力挽狂澜，当个英雄！
dialogText.en: Fabian decided to join the Security Bureau because he wanted to be someone like you! A hero who can turn things around!

dialogText.cn: 下一轮巡逻什么时候开始？
dialogText.en: Aleeza, when is our next patrol scheduled?

dialogText.cn: 嗯？啊……随时可以。
dialogText.en: Ah? Oh... We can start any time.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们先告辞。
dialogText.en: I'm afraid we'll have to take our leave, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……谢谢。
dialogText.en: ...Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 天上那个可怕的裂痕终于消失了。
dialogText.en: That terrible rift in the sky is finally gone.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你的身体状况还好吗？
dialogText.en: How's your body holding up, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 你太勉强自己了。
dialogText.en: You're pushing yourself too hard.

dialogText.cn: 从苏醒到现在，你一直都在战斗。不仅是记忆，你的身体状况本就……
dialogText.en: You've been fighting ever since your awakening. It's not just your memories. Your body's struggling too...

dialogText.cn: 每一次苏醒，你都在当英雄。可是大家其实很少想到，你是“为何而沉睡”的。
dialogText.en: Every time you wake, you would lead us as a true hero. But most people fail to realize *why* you would always return to hibernation.

dialogText.cn: ……我怎么能不担心呢？
dialogText.en: ...How could I not worry?

dialogText.cn: 只有你自己知道“零号委托”的全貌。但现在，我们别无他法，只能尽力执行各自知晓的部分。
dialogText.en: You're the only one who knows the entirety of the Zeroth Directive, but right now ... we have no choice but to execute the parts we grasp to the best of our abilities.

dialogText.cn: 我曾经想过很多很多次，我的判断会不会打乱了你的计划，我要怎样把那些复杂的情况再传达给你……一切都发生得太仓促了。
dialogText.en: I kept questioning myself if my decisions would disrupt your plans ... or how I should explain the complexities of the situation to you... Everything happened so fast and so suddenly.

dialogText.cn: 天使、裂地者、侵蚀……它们给四号谷地留下的伤痕，需要很长时间去抚平。
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi, the Landbreakers, and the Blight... The scars they left on Valley IV will take quite a while to heal.

dialogText.cn: 如果没有协议核心的帮助，这场危机只会更加可怕……幸好我们坚持推进了计划。
dialogText.en: If we hadn't deployed the Protocol Automation-Core, this crisis would have dealt us a far more terrible blow... Fortunately, we insisted on pushing the project forward.

dialogText.cn: 你曾经说过，满目疮痍的胜利不是你追求的结果。
dialogText.en: You once mentioned that victory with devastating costs is not what you seek.

dialogText.cn: 战斗中损坏的，我们恢复；灾难里失去的，我们重建。协议核心会成为这一切的基础，帮助我们连接彼此，凝聚力量。
dialogText.en: We shall restore what was damaged in battle, and rebuild what was lost in disaster. The Protocol Automation-Core shall provide the foundation we can build upon. We shall build bridges to each other and unite our strengths.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地只是协议核心的第一站。终末地会带着它走遍文明环带，走遍塔卫二的每个角落。
dialogText.en: Valley IV is just the first step of the PAC deployment program. Endfield shall bring it along as we traverse the Civilization Band and explore every corner of Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 不过，至少现在……哪怕只有这一时半刻的安宁，请和我一起眺望这片方兴未艾的土地吧。
dialogText.en: This peace might not last... But for now, let's just gaze upon this burgeoning land.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡、管理员？我正要去找你们呢。
dialogText.en: Perlica? Endmin? I was about to head out and look for you.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地现在还有不少活跃的动态侵蚀，我们想听听你的意见。
dialogText.en: There are still plenty of Active Blight patches in Valley IV. We would like to hear your opinions on dealing with this.

dialogText.cn: 啊……那也是个问题！不过还有更急的事儿要先搞定。
dialogText.en: Ah... Yeah, Active Blight can be a real bummer! But we got a bigger problem.

dialogText.cn: 我在四号谷地范围内侦测到了一个超域能量信号。很微弱，但绝对存在。
dialogText.en: I detected an Æther energy signal in the vicinities of Valley IV. It's weak, but there's no mistake about its existence.

dialogText.cn: 裂隙刚刚关闭，还存在一些环境干扰。那个信号混在一堆噪声里，我需要更精确的识别手段。
dialogText.en: The rift has just disappeared, so we're getting some ambient disruptions. We got plenty of noise in that signal. I need a reading that's cleaner and more precise.

dialogText.cn: 其实塔塔搭载的侦测模块最符合需求。
dialogText.en: Tata's onboard detection module happens to be the best tool for the job.

dialogText.cn: 伊冯，关于塔塔……
dialogText.en: Yvonne, the thing about Tata is that...

dialogText.cn: 既然塔塔不在身边，没事，我早就准备了别的办法！
dialogText.en: Well, it's alright if Tata isn't here. Don't worry, I've figured out an alternative!

dialogText.cn: 听好了，协议通讯信号塔里应该会有塔塔的扫描日志。我能做个对比验证，尽量把干扰都排除掉。
dialogText.en: Listen up. The Protocom Signal Towers should have Tata's scanning log. I can use that data to compare and filter out interference and noise.

dialogText.cn: 但得麻烦你们帮我接通信号塔了，扫描位置应该也会对结果有影响，两座信号塔的数据我都需要。
dialogText.en: However, I'll need your help connecting to the Signal Towers. The positions of the scanning will also affect the results. Hence, I'll need data from both towers.

dialogText.cn: 伊冯！其实塔塔已经……
dialogText.en: Yvonne! Tata is...

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，别磨磨蹭蹭啦！协议同步器能处理现场传输，时间不等人，赶快赶快！
dialogText.en: Aw, come on! Stop being so wishy-washy. Your Protocol Synchronizers can handle field data transfers just fine. Get going, chop chop!

dialogText.cn: 莱西娅……
dialogText.en: Lycia...

dialogText.cn: 你认识她？终末地的人？
dialogText.en: You know her? Is she an Endfielder?

dialogText.cn: 过去是。现在，她只是我的……老熟人。
dialogText.en: She was. Now, she's just ... an old acquaintance.

dialogText.cn: 那就是说，她之前是终末地的干员？只看一眼也知道，她是个使剑的高手。真想和她切磋几招。
dialogText.en: That means she's an ex-Endfielder? Just a single glance and I can definitely tell she's a master with the blade. I really hope I can spar with her.

dialogText.cn: 管理员。我刚收到报告，你们去源石发电站了？
dialogText.en: Endministrator! I just received a report. Are you at the Originium Power Plant?

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师，发电站这是怎么回事？！你们还好吧？
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe? The Power Plant is a total mess! Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 我刚把人都安顿好。这帮裂地者真是阴魂不散，那带头的大个子瓦伊凡比门都高，工人们大老远看见就拉警报了。
dialogText.en: I managed to find safe places for everyone, but these Landbreakers just won't quit. The Vouivre leading them is a giant, bigger than the gate itself. The patrolling crew mates sounded the alarm when they saw him from afar.

dialogText.cn: 不过那些裂地者没冲进去……好像有人阻止了他们。那个大个子也跑了。
dialogText.en: But the LBs didn't make it inside... Someone stopped them. That big fella also ran for his life.

dialogText.cn: 超域能量信号……莫非是罗丹？
dialogText.en: Æther energy signal... Could it be Rhodagn?

dialogText.cn: 怎么信号最后就消失了呢……我再去实验室分析一下数据，你们要帮忙的时候喊我！
dialogText.en: Why did the signal disappear...? I gotta run back to my lab and analyze this data. See you later, guys. Call me if you need help!

dialogText.cn: 这丫头……我还得去照看一下伤员。管理员，谢谢你们的支援。
dialogText.en: Ah, that little girl... Well, I gotta check on the wounded. Thank you for lending us your support, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 是的，我们曾经一起行动。
dialogText.en: Yes. We once worked as a team.

dialogText.cn: 莱西娅在进行一场只属于她的狩猎。对她来说，超域活动就是猎物留下的踪迹。
dialogText.en: Lycia is pursuing her own hunt. She regards Æther events as tracks left by her prey.

dialogText.cn: 为了完成这个使命，她离开终末地独自行动，只和其他人维持极其有限的联系。
dialogText.en: She left Endfield and has since operated solo, keeping communication with others to a minimum.

dialogText.cn: ……因为，她要完成一个约定。
dialogText.en: ...Because she intends to keep a promise.

dialogText.cn: 你和她亲口做的约定。
dialogText.en: A promise that you personally made with her.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……总之，她会突然闷声不响地跑过来，也是因为超域活动咯？听起来可真辛苦。
dialogText.en: Hmm... So she just popped out of nowhere because of the Æther activity, right? Her hunt sounds like a real hassle.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，紧急通信，代号U3。
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, we have an emergency call. Code U3.

dialogText.cn: 是文明环带三大阵营的联络。他们已经得到了管理员苏醒的消息。
dialogText.en: The three major factions of the Civilization Band are calling. They've received news of the Endmin's awakening.

dialogText.cn: 了解，让帝江号开始准备，我们尽快回去。
dialogText.en: Understood. Get Dijiang prepped and ready. We'll head back ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地被闹成这样，算算也是时候来问话了。
dialogText.en: Finally! Valley IV got really messed up. About time someone called to show their concern.

dialogText.cn: 我们回帝江号吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's head back to Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 不必担心，只是例行流程……这一次，我就在你的身边。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. This is just part of the procedure... And this time, I'll be standing right by your side.

dialogText.cn: 伊冯，我们已经接上信号塔了。
dialogText.en: Yvonne, we've connected to the Signal Tower.

dialogText.cn: 马上马上，同步时钟，重设信号编码……得花点时间，你们保持连接。
dialogText.en: I'm on it. Synchronizing timestamps and resetting the signal codes... This will take a while. I'll need you to maintain the connection for a bit.

dialogText.cn: 当时侵蚀和裂地者一起出现在这里，如果没有阻止侵蚀蔓延，我们对其他地区的支援都会被掐断。
dialogText.en: Back then, the Blight and Landbreakers showed up here. If we'd failed to stop the creeping Blight, it would have blocked our access and support to the other areas.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔差点就宕机了，多亏你及时帮忙，不然我们可到不了供能高地。
dialogText.en: Tata almost shut down here. Thank goodness you helped out on time. We wouldn't have made it to the Power Plateau otherwise.

dialogText.cn: 那是因为安德烈他乱调……算了，反正他还欠我好几顿饭呢。
dialogText.en: And it's all because Andre messed up with the... Tsk. I'll let it go. That old boy owes me a lot of lunches.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，我就是……行吧，听你的。
dialogText.en: I know. I'm just ... ugh. Fine. You're right.

dialogText.cn: 接下来是矿脉源区的那座信号塔，辛苦你们再跑一段路了。
dialogText.en: The next step is to connect to the Signal Tower at the Origin Lodespring. Really appreciate your field work out there.

dialogText.cn: 啊，是你们几位。太好了，我还没来得及当面和你们道谢，多谢你们救了我的队友！
dialogText.en: Ah! You're back! Wonderful. I never had the chance to properly express my gratitude. Thank you for saving my friends!

dialogText.cn: 这才过去多久，你确定不先休养一阵子？
dialogText.en: It's only been a short while. You sure you don't need more R&R?

dialogText.cn: 矿脉源区被震荡波和天使破坏得一塌糊涂……我们得尽早把基础设施修好，起码要先疏通出一条方便物资运输的路。
dialogText.en: I'm okay for now. The shockwaves and Aggeloi made a royal mess of the Origin Lodespring... We gotta fix the infrastructure, and clear the roads for the supply trucks at the very least.

dialogText.cn: 全靠你们消除了这一带的侵蚀，我们才得以立刻投入到重建工作里。在这里生活了这么久，我从来没有见过有人能这么快地消除掉侵蚀。
dialogText.en: Thanks to you neutralizing the local Blight, we were able to jump right into rebuilding! I've lived here for ages, but I've never seen anyone wipe out the Blight like that!
Ah, yeah...

dialogText.cn: 不过也是，想必这种技术也不是这么快就能投入量产的，希望工团多加强跟你们的合作。
dialogText.en: Uh... In any case, such advanced tech wouldn't reach mass production any time soon. I just hope the UWST can strengthen its partnership with you, Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 再次谢过几位了！我还得去其他地方看看，你们先忙。
dialogText.en: Once again, thank you for everything you've done for us! I gotta run and check on a few other places. Feel free and do your thing.

dialogText.cn: 大家都很好奇你们是怎么做到的。如果有了这种技术，以后进行探查和搜救可就没那么危险了。
dialogText.en: Everyone's real curious on how you pulled that off. Having tech like yours would make our survey and SAR work a lot easier.

dialogText.cn: 各位辛苦啦！我这儿马上就好。
dialogText.en: Good work out there, people! I'm almost done here.

dialogText.cn: 成功！这次我加了点之前没尝试过的新设计。
dialogText.en: SUCCESS! This time, I've added a novel design feature that I've never tested before.

dialogText.cn: 时间有限，我省略了几个校验环节，你们可以把它理解成一个临时的试验组件。
dialogText.en: Time is short, so I skipped a few verification steps. You can treat this as a temporary test component.

dialogText.cn: 新的思路带来新的变革！它直接用协议源石供能，通过同步器增幅，达到<@qu.key>扫描侵蚀</>的功效。
dialogText.en: Because I applied a new, game-changing idea! The component is directly powered by the Protocol-Originium, while amplification by the Protosync would achieve the desired <@qu.key>Blight scanning</> feature.

dialogText.cn: 我还优化了能量传输流程，去掉了许多冗余部分。面对几十或几百平米左右的中小型侵蚀区，它还是能应付得了的。
dialogText.en: I also optimized the power conduction process and eliminated the overly bloated redundancy. For blight patches about fifty to several hundred square meters, this should totally work.

dialogText.cn: 有预先收集的特征数据在，协议同步器也能负担基础功能，但别指望它还能对付裂隙。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Okay, it isn't capable of dealing with rifts. But with the characteristic data sets we collected, the Protosync can now perform some basic functions.

dialogText.cn: 行了，说再多也不如上手试试。我们到楼下去吧。
dialogText.en: Well, I guess I've spoken more than enough. The best validation is through proper hands-on experience. Let's head downstairs.

dialogText.cn: 还在处理分析数据，一会儿就能完成过滤。
dialogText.en: Still analyzing and sorting out the data. Filtering will be done in a bit.

dialogText.cn: 趁这段时间，我先帮你们解决动态侵蚀的问题。唉，要是平时的项目也能这样先斩后奏就好了……
dialogText.en: I also used the time to come up with a solution to your Active Blight problem. Oh, if only I could kick off projects first and worry about approvals later...

dialogText.cn: 接下来，我会把它搭载到你们的协议同步器上。
dialogText.en: I'll load this up to your Protosyncs.

dialogText.cn: 这是一台通过模拟侵蚀波长，在短时间内形成侵蚀的特殊装置。
dialogText.en: This device is special. It simulates Blight wavelengths to quickly make glops of Blight.

dialogText.cn: 小心点哦！虽说是模拟，但侵蚀这玩意儿的性质难以预测。出于安全考虑，我一直将它安置在这儿，没想到有再次启动它的一天。
dialogText.en: Careful now! I did say "simulate" but Blight glops is unpredictable. So, I kept the simulator here for safety considerations. Heh, never thought I would be activating it today.

dialogText.cn: 事前检查我已经做完了。在我启动后，你们就可以测试试验组件的扫描功能，看看是否能找出侵蚀核心。
dialogText.en: I've completed all the pre-operational checks. I'll activate the simulator and let you test out the component's scanning feature. Let's see if you can locate the Blight Core with the new component.

dialogText.cn: 反正别离开这个隔离区域就行。有我在，不会有事的。
dialogText.en: Just stay in the containment zone and you'll be safe. I'm here so there's no need to be afraid.

dialogText.cn: 试验组件的功效验证完成，接下来我会进行封装。之后根据返回的日志，我会定期迭代稳定版本的。
dialogText.en: Test component feature V&V complete. Leave the packaging to me. I'll also refer to your usage logs and regularly iterate on stable releases.

dialogText.cn: 顺便，我核对了这次侵蚀的特征，那个聂菲斯利用的是超域裂隙的既存能量，她还做不到凭空制造新的裂隙。
dialogText.en: I also verified the properties of this Blight incident. Nefarith was using existing energy pools of the Æther rift. She can't create new rifts out of nothing, at least for now.

dialogText.cn: 但这依旧是四号谷地近十年来最严重的一次裂隙活动。要是真让聂菲斯得逞，半个谷地估计就消失了吧。
dialogText.en: Nevertheless, this remains the most severe Blight incident in Valley IV in the last ten years. If we'd let Nefarith have her way, half the entire Valley would've been gone.

dialogText.cn: 可惜没能留住她。我们能搞定四号谷地的裂隙，很大程度上是超域试验场积累的资料在起作用。
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, she slipped through our fingers. Now, we managed to seal the Valley IV rift mainly because we have plenty of data from our Æther Test Site.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔关闭裂隙的方式属于特例中的特例……
dialogText.en: Tata's sealing of the rift is a very, very rare exception...

dialogText.cn: 塔塔……其实在最后的决战中牺牲了……
dialogText.en: Actually ... during our last battle ... Tata sacrificed itself...
...*Sigh*.

dialogText.cn: 裂隙消失的时候，读数很不正常……其实我已经猜到了。
dialogText.en: I thought as much ... when I saw the anomalous readings after the rift disappeared.

dialogText.cn: 你们不会是觉得我会大吵大闹，所以一直不知道怎么跟我开口吧？
dialogText.en: You didn't really think I'd throw a grief tantrum, do you? Is that why you were so measured and hesitant when talking?

dialogText.cn: 没有！只是，你也好，安德烈也好，克劳也好，大家为塔塔付出了那么多心血，我们却……
dialogText.en: No, it's not like that. It's just ... you did so much to build Tata. So did Andre and Crowe. But we...

dialogText.cn: 别这样，各位。
dialogText.en: Come on, guys, don't be so hard on yourselves.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地那么多人，都是因为塔塔才能活下来。作为研究者，我其实很高兴，很高兴它完成了自己的使命。
dialogText.en: Tata's sacrifice saved countless lives at Valley IV. As a scientist, I'm genuinely happy about this, and I'm glad that it completed its duty.

dialogText.cn: 我们当然会惋惜，会想念它。但更该做的，是记住塔塔拯救了多少人，是利用好塔塔为我们留下的数据。
dialogText.en: It's natural for us to miss Tata and feel sad. But what we should do is remember how many lives it saved, and make full use of all the data it provided for us.

dialogText.cn: 然后努力避免下一次危机，对吧？
dialogText.en: And then we'll do our best to avert the next crisis, right?

dialogText.cn: 这就对啦！不愧是管理员，真有气魄！
dialogText.en: Absolutely! Such panache and confidence! No wonder you're the Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 总之，数据拟合应该已经完成了。赶紧把那个信号给揪出来吧，我可受不了再多几次超域爆炸啦！
dialogText.en: Alright, we should be done with the data simulation. Now, run along and chase down that signal for me. I would be very upset if we had to endure more Æther eruptions!

dialogText.cn: 菲奥娜，能协助伊冯完成追踪吗？
dialogText.en: Fiona, can you help Yvonne trace that signal?

dialogText.cn: 已确认源石研究园的数据链请求。没问题，随时可以提供指引。
dialogText.en: Originium Science Park data link request verified. Zero issues. We can now input our directives.

dialogText.cn: 当前目标位置……供能高地，接近源石发电站。
dialogText.en: The target's current location is ... the Power Plateau, near the Originium Power Plant.

dialogText.cn: 好，实地测试这就开始。我倒要看看，那个讨厌的怪信号到底是谁在捣鬼！
dialogText.en: Okay. Time to start our field test! I need to find out which punk is responsible for that annoying blip on my radar!

dialogText.cn: 唉，真想看看它见到四号谷地脱离危险以后会是什么小表情——
dialogText.en: Now I wonder ... what emotes would Tata use when it sees the crisis ending in Valley IV—

dialogText.cn: 尽管数据可以成为宝贵的经验，但我们短期内恐怕无法复现了。
dialogText.en: Although the datasets offer valuable references, I'm afraid we can't replicate that rift sealing measure any time soon.

dialogText.cn: 我还以为信号只是在发电站边上呢……伊冯，定位没错吧？
dialogText.en: I thought the signal was next to the Power Plant... Yvonne, you sure you gave us the right coordinates?

dialogText.cn: 回传读数很稳定，应该不会有问题……
dialogText.en: Data feedback looks stable. There shouldn't be any problems...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？设备出故障了？不像啊？
dialogText.en: What's that? Did some machine just explode?

dialogText.cn: 不对，是战斗！
dialogText.en: No. It's a battle!

dialogText.cn: 啊？！你们快去看看，我马上就到！
dialogText.en: What?! You gotta go and check it out! I'll be with you in a bit!

dialogText.cn: 通信加密已完成，联络代号U3，确认。接入通信。
dialogText.en: Channel encryption completed. Contact code U3 verified. Initiate connection to the channel.

dialogText.cn: 这里是O.M.V.帝江号。各位代表，音频通信还稳定吗？
dialogText.en: This is OMV Dijiang. Is the audio channel stable for our three honorable representatives?

dialogText.cn: ——以上就是终末地工业在四号谷地的行动概要。书面报告已经同步发送给各位。
dialogText.en: This concludes the operational summary of Endfield Industries in Valley IV. The digital report has been distributed to all delegates simultaneously.

dialogText.cn: 基于本次协议核心部署过程中发生的危险，我们认为“零号委托”遭到了针对性阻挠。
dialogText.en: Given the threats encountered during our deployment of the Protocol Automation-Core, we conclude that the Zeroth Directive is being targeted and obstructed with deliberate intent.

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多有冒犯，我必须确认会前报告中与您记忆状况相关的那部分——
dialogText.en: Pardon if I offend, Endministrator, but I must verify the sections in the report regarding the current state of your memory faculties...

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: ……好吧，至少情况没有变得更糟。愿您早日康复。
dialogText.en: ...At least your condition has not deteriorated. I offer you my sincere wish for your speedy recovery.

actorName.cn: 商会发言人{e4m1d5-商会发言人}
actorName.en: Spokesperson of the TGCC {e4m1d5-Spokesperson of the TGCC}

dialogText.cn: 克服困难不仅需要勇气和团结，更需要计划和预案。很幸运，我们至少不缺后者。
dialogText.en: We need more than just courage and unity to overcome challenges. Planning and contingent alternatives are far more important, and these are the elements that we do not lack.

actorName.cn: 工团工人代表{e4m1d5-工团工人代表}
actorName.en: Representative of the UWST {e4m1d5-Representative of the UWST}

dialogText.cn: 言归正传。对四号谷地民众的伤害等同于触动工团核心利益，碾骨氏族将受到全域搜捕，无需通报，直接击杀。
dialogText.en: To refocus on the issue: the harm caused to the people of Valley IV constitutes a serious breach of UWST's core interests. The Bonekrusher Clan will face region-wide pursuit, with authorization granted for immediate neutralization without prior notice.

actorName.cn: 商会发言人{e4m1d5-商会发言人}
actorName.en: Spokesperson of the TGCC {e4m1d5-Spokesperson of the TGCC}

dialogText.cn: 虽然某位先生已经开始兴奋了，我们还是得同步一些坏消息。
dialogText.en: Although a particular gentleman in our midst is getting excited about certain prospects, we must update all attendants with bad news.

actorName.cn: 商会发言人{e4m1d5-商会发言人}
actorName.en: Spokesperson of the TGCC {e4m1d5-Spokesperson of the TGCC}

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地事件期间，铁誓军在北方前线一处裂隙周围侦测到了天使之外的活动信号。
dialogText.en: During the Valley IV incident, the Order of Steel Oath picked up signals of non-Aggeloid activities. The location is near a rift along the Northern Front.

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 与此同时，一位师者在南方发现了前所未见的足迹——直到现在，上面的超域能量都没有消散。
dialogText.en: Also during this time, an Aldertone traveling in the south found tracks that we've never seen before — and these tracks are still giving off Æther emissions as we speak.

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 如各位所想，按照最坏假设，百年前的大敌正谋划着东山再起，而他们的先锋已经和我们打了照面。
dialogText.en: I believe everyone knows what this is about. If we were to assume the worst, the great enemy from a century ago is planning a return. Its vanguard has already paid us a visit.

actorName.cn: 工团工人代表{e4m1d5-工团工人代表}
actorName.en: Representative of the UWST {e4m1d5-Representative of the UWST}

dialogText.cn: 面对现实吧，各位。形势不允许我们慢吞吞地做判断了。
dialogText.en: Everyone, let us confront the reality before us. The gravity of the situation leaves no space for delayed or indecisive responses.

actorName.cn: 工团工人代表{e4m1d5-工团工人代表}
actorName.en: Representative of the UWST {e4m1d5-Representative of the UWST}

dialogText.cn: 基于《环带公约》，缔约方即刻起正式重启终末地工业的全文明环带特别权限。
dialogText.en: Pursuant to the Band Accord, the Accordatories shall restore the special authority level of Endfield Industries regarding the entirety of the Civilization Band, effective immediately.

actorName.cn: 商会发言人{e4m1d5-商会发言人}
actorName.en: Spokesperson of the TGCC {e4m1d5-Spokesperson of the TGCC}

dialogText.cn: 协定范围内，恢复管理员的优先通行权和现场处置权，缔约方将支援终末地工业在管辖区域开展危机处理行动。
dialogText.en: Priority access and authority to execute on-site disposition shall be restored to the Endministrator in the agreed-upon regions. The Accordatories shall support Endfield Industries in executing crisis management operations within territories under Accord jurisdiction.

dialogText.cn: 感谢各位。我方希望尽快开展针对当前事件的后续调查，由帝江号向文明环带无保留同步。
dialogText.en: We deeply appreciate your support. Endfield intends to initiate a post-incident investigation at the earliest opportunity. Dijiang shall report all investigative findings to the Civilization Band in full.

actorName.cn: 商会发言人{e4m1d5-商会发言人}
actorName.en: Spokesperson of the TGCC {e4m1d5-Spokesperson of the TGCC}

dialogText.cn: 气氛开始有点像十年前了。管理员，佩丽卡女士，我很期待能在菈梵朵玛自由市接待二位。
dialogText.en: This vibe reminds me of that meeting ten years ago. Endministrator and Supervisor Perlica, I hope to host you both in the free city of La Fantoma.

dialogText.cn: ……了解，我们会严肃考量此事。
dialogText.en: ...Understood. We shall address this matter with the gravity it demands.

dialogText.cn: 这些新线索把大家的弦都绷得很紧……不论如何，总归要开始的。
dialogText.en: These new findings have everyone on edge... We must begin resolving the matter right away.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，宏山科学院发来一组高密级授权协议，您现在方便处理么？
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica, the HAS has sent a set of highly classified authorization protocols. Do you have the time to process them right now?

dialogText.cn: 好的。管理员，我们稍后再会。
dialogText.en: Okay, Endmin. I'll talk to you later.

actorName.cn: 沉稳的嗓音{e4m1d5-工团工人代表}

dialogText.cn: 这里是全联盟工团中央部长委员会，通信清晰。
dialogText.en: Central Ministerial Committee of the United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II speaking. Channel is clear.

actorName.cn: 清晰的嗓音{e4m1d5-商会发言人}

dialogText.cn: 环塔卫二企业联合商会发言人代表已在线，通信清晰。
dialogText.en: The representative spokesperson of the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce, now connected. Channel is clear.

actorName.cn: 坚毅的嗓音{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 大炎天师府附属宏山科学院，通信清晰。
dialogText.en: Affiliated Hongshan Academy of Sciences of Tianshi Bureau of Great Yan. Link verified, channel is clear.

dialogText.cn: 事不宜迟，请允许我——终末地监督佩丽卡，迅速为各位整理现状。
dialogText.en: Without further delay, I am Supervisor Perlica of Endfield Industries. I respectfully request the assembly's attention as I brief the current situation.

dialogText.cn: 出于对《环带公约》的考量，我们——
dialogText.en: Pursuant to our considerations of the Band Accord, we —

actorName.cn: 工团工人代表{e4m1d5-工团工人代表}
actorName.en: Representative of the UWST {e4m1d5-Representative of the UWST}

dialogText.cn: 不止一次了。超域蔓延的速度开始显著加快。
dialogText.en: This is not an isolated incident. The spread of Æther has gained significant speed.

actorName.cn: 工团工人代表{e4m1d5-工团工人代表}
actorName.en: Representative of the UWST {e4m1d5-Representative of the UWST}

dialogText.cn: 工业母舰会优先驰援铁誓军。敌人必须被扼杀在摇篮里。
dialogText.en: Supporting the Order of Steel Oath is the priority for our Industrial Mothership. We must crush the enemy threat in its infancy.

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 宏科院辖区内的武陵科学发展区近期发现了一系列可疑迹象，已提前告知联盟工团及环塔商会。
dialogText.en: Suspicious signs have been identified in the Wuling Scientific Developmental District under HAS jurisdiction. We have proactively conveyed this information to the UWST and the TGCC.

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 考虑到和四号谷地事件存在多处相似，我们希望终末地优先处理此事项。
dialogText.en: Our findings at Wuling share many similarities to the incident at Valley IV. We kindly request that Endfield representatives visit our facility soon to prioritize this matter.

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: ……若无其他事项，本次临时会议到此结束。期待与管理员的正式会面。再会。
dialogText.en: If there are no further matters, this ad hoc meeting is hereby adjourned. We anticipate the forthcoming formal meeting with the Endministrator. Until we reconvene.

dialogText.cn: 相似……您的意思是，超域裂隙？
dialogText.en: Similarities...? Do they include ... Æther rifts?

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 消息来自武陵科学发展区，也是各位当前计划的目标地点之一。
dialogText.en: The sighting was reported by the Wuling Scientific Developmental District. It is also one of the target locations of our current plan.

actorName.cn: 宏科院天师{e4m1d5-宏科院天师}

dialogText.cn: 以武陵与终末地的联系，相信各位能理解它对文明环带有多重要……请务必给予帮助。
dialogText.en: Given the ties between Wuling and Endfield, I believe everyone understands its importance to the Civilization Band... We kindly request your aid.

dialogText.cn: 可是管理员已经失忆了不是吗？让一个溺水的人尝试学会游泳自救，是不是有点强人所难？
dialogText.en: But our Endmin's lost all memory. We can't force a drowning person to learn to swim. It makes no sense.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统可不是为了生产瓶瓶罐罐创造出来的，只要协议源石能重新找到内化宇宙的……
dialogText.en: Now, now, we didn't come up with the Automated Industry Complex to make bottles and jars. Remember the Assimilated Universe? If the Protocol-Originium can find...

dialogText.cn: 那说明你精神还不错。让佩丽卡陪着你，对你的恢复或许真有帮助。
dialogText.en: That means you're doing fine. Letting Perlica hang around with you seems pretty helpful for your recovery.

dialogText.cn: M3，这是管理员“第一次”见到你。管理员，也许你不记得了，但你苏醒的时候，她就在我身边。
dialogText.en: M3, I believe this is the Endmin's "first" meeting with you. And Endmin, you might not remember this, but M3 was right next to me during your awakening.

dialogText.cn: ——以及，给宏科院的特别委托添点情报。佩丽卡，出事的果然是“武陵甚大裂隙”。
dialogText.en: I'm *also* here to feed you additional intel about that special request from HAS. Perlica, the source of trouble is the Wuling Very Large Rift.

dialogText.cn: 那是文明环带最大的超域裂隙。不幸的是，我们在它附近发现了异常的超域能量活动——和四号谷地的样本完全一致。
dialogText.en: It's the largest Æther rift of the Civilization Band. Unfortunately, we picked up traces of Æther energy activities at that place — traces that are completely identical with the signal samples of Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 整个终末地都在为此努力，我其实不太担心这点风浪。我担心的是你，管理员。
dialogText.en: Every Endfielder is working hard to solve this issue, so I'm not too worried about it. What makes me really concerned is you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 如果超域里的某些东西还在挣扎，想要回到这颗星球，那聂菲斯可能只是那个吸引注意力的无名小卒罢了。
dialogText.en: If something within the Ætherside is still struggling to return to this planet ... then Nefarith is just a small-timer meant to divert our attention.

dialogText.cn: 他们和超域关系密切，协议核心会成为他们的眼中钉……敌人不会因为你缺失记忆就放慢手脚。
dialogText.en: Our enemies are closely tied to the Æther. The Protocol Automation-Core will be a thorn in their eyes... But they won't slow down just to cater to your memory loss.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，和以往一样。我就说佩丽卡过于担心了。
dialogText.en: Good. You're still your old self. I knew Perlica worried too much.

dialogText.cn: 我很想和你们一起去武陵，但其他地方的麻烦更大。聂菲斯就交给你们了，相信我们很快会再见的。
dialogText.en: I really want to be a part of your Wuling trip, but we got bigger problems at other places. Go and deal with Nefarith. I believe we will meet again soon.

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: ……这和石棺没有关系，源石的受损是概念性的，管理员的身体情况“只能”随着每一次苏醒恶化。
dialogText.en: ...It's got nothing to do with the Sarcophagus. The damage dealt to the Originium is metaphysical in nature. The Endmin's health will *only* get worse with every awakening.

dialogText.cn: 修复工作只有管理员自己能完成，我们要做的就是创造条件。
dialogText.en: The repairs can only be performed by the Endmin. Our mission is to create favorable conditions.

dialogText.cn: 哟，醒啦？刚说到你呢。
dialogText.en: Yo. Just woke up? We were talking about you just now.

dialogText.cn: 失忆症状意味着我们没有太多机会了。
dialogText.en: But the memory loss means we're running out of time.

dialogText.cn: 那就相信管理员。
dialogText.en: Then you should have faith in the Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，确实。自我介绍一下，我是M3。至于身份……我是你的朋友，知道这点就够了。
dialogText.en: Yes, I was. Allow me to introduce myself. I'm M3. As for who I am... I'm your friend. That should suffice.

dialogText.cn: M3也是“零号委托”的执行人之一。这次特地回帝江号，就是为了确认管理员的状态。
dialogText.en: M3 is also one of the executors of the Zeroth Directive. She specifically made this trip back to Dijiang in order to verify your status, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯，她根本没有隐藏自己的下一个目标，基本是在挑衅。
