dialogText.en: Nefarith, I bet. She's not even trying to hide her next objective. I think she's doing this on purpose to taunt us.

dialogText.cn: M3是我们的一位精英干员，主要负责执行最高密级、最高危险度的战斗任务。
dialogText.en: M3 is one of our elite operators. She is responsible for carrying out combat missions of the highest secrecy and utmost danger.

dialogText.cn: 虽然文明环带在两次天使战争中成功保卫了生存权利，各类残余势力依旧没有打消毁灭我们的野心。
dialogText.en: Although the Civilization Band secured our right of survival during the two Aggeloi Wars, many factions and their stragglers have not given up their dreams of our destruction.

dialogText.cn: 她为终末地清理了无数或明或暗的阻碍。因为M3的行动，我们才有机会坚持到协议核心准备完成。
dialogText.en: M3 has removed many obstacles, both overt and covert, for Endfield. Her actions gave us the chance to complete our preparations for the Protocol Automation-Core.

dialogText.cn: 武陵城是宏山科学院的重点科研基地，与终末地素有合作。也因此，陈千语才和终末地结下了缘分。
dialogText.en: Wuling City is a key center of science and research of the Hongshan Academy of Sciences. The HAS is a long-time partner of Endfield. It's also why Chen got involved with Endfield in the first place.

dialogText.cn: 他们在监管武陵甚大裂隙的同时，也给武陵地区增添了许多生活气息。
dialogText.en: In addition to monitoring the Very Large Rift, Wuling City also built plenty of living amenities in the region.

dialogText.cn: 那是一座在灾难上重建的家园，激励了许多宏山人。
dialogText.en: The city is a home they rebuilt atop a disaster site. It is an inspiring symbol for the people of Hongshan.

dialogText.cn: 另外，武陵有一项名为“息壤”的特殊研究项目，目的就在于克服超域灾害。
dialogText.en: Wuling is also pursuing a special research project on something called Xiranite. Their aim is to overcome Ætherside disasters.

dialogText.cn: 我们原本就打算在武陵城部署协议核心，搭建集成工业系统。这次行动也算跟计划不谋而合。
dialogText.en: Endfield already has plans to deploy an Automation-Core in Wuling City and set up our AIC Factory over there. This operation happens to work in favor of our plans.

dialogText.cn: 陈千语对武陵城很熟悉，我们可以和她一起行动。
dialogText.en: That's right. And Chen is quite familiar with Wuling City. We can count on her help for this operation.

dialogText.cn: 我们不知道聂菲斯还剩多少底牌，最好进行充分准备。等你认为一切就绪，我们就从帝江号上出发。
dialogText.en: Since we're unsure how many cards Nefarith has on her hands, we should be as fully prepared as possible. Once you believe everything is set, we shall depart for our mission from Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 有帮手，硬茬儿啊！
dialogText.en: Got helpers, eh? A tough nut to crack!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我来对付她……欸？
dialogText.en: Leave this one to me, Endmin... Huh?!

dialogText.cn: 等下，这眼罩……
dialogText.en: Wait a minute. That eye patch...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？
dialogText.en: Hmm?

dialogText.cn: 青龙角，马尾辫，两把傻不愣登的剑——
dialogText.en: Greenish horns. Lung girl. Silly braids. And the dumb-looking swords—

dialogText.cn: 陈、千、语，倒是没想到会在这儿再见到你！
dialogText.en: MASTER CHEN! Hah! I never expected to see you show up here!

dialogText.cn: 汤——大当家！
dialogText.en: CHIEF TANGTANG!

dialogText.cn: 嗯！懂事！准了！
dialogText.en: Hah! You behaved well! Approved!

dialogText.cn: 他们也算当地人，只是会干些小偷小盗的勾当……
dialogText.en: Yeah... Though they count as local Wulingers, many of them are petty thieves and criminals...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，没事吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin, you alright?

dialogText.cn: 啊——陈千语？！
dialogText.en: AAAH — CHEN QIANYU?!

dialogText.cn: 汤汤？！
dialogText.en: AH! TANGTANG?!

dialogText.cn: 行不更名，坐不改姓，姑奶奶我就是<@qu.key>清波寨</>的大当家——汤汤！
dialogText.en: Behold! You are addressing the SUPREME CHIEF of <@qu.key>Qingbo Stockade</> — Tangtang!

dialogText.cn: 这个叫汤汤的，以前是清波寨的小老大，我们算是不打不相识的孽缘吧。
dialogText.en: Tangtang used to be an underchief of the Stockade. Our blades clashed before, and that's how I met her.

dialogText.cn: 你不是被武陵城赶走了吗？怎么跑回来了？
dialogText.en: I thought Wuling dragged you out by your tail! What brings you back?

dialogText.cn: 还有，你们是怎么掉到这里来的？刚才的动静和你们有关吗？
dialogText.en: And how did you fall into this place? You responsible for that blight-a-trophic racket up there?

dialogText.cn: 既然落到了清波豪杰的手上，于情于理，我们都应该按规矩办事！
dialogText.en: Since we've stumbled on the turf of your mighty Stockade, it's only fair we play by your rules!

dialogText.cn: 只是，毕竟我的同伴初来乍到……能不能让我们借一步说话？
dialogText.en: But ... my companion's never been here before... Can you give us a private moment, puh-lease?

dialogText.cn: 但是，可别想开溜。
dialogText.en: But ... don't even try to run.

dialogText.cn: 这里是我的地盘！
dialogText.en: *Giggle* This is my turf!

dialogText.cn: 终于又见面了。
dialogText.en: We finally meet again.

dialogText.cn: 你倒是游刃有余的样子……怎么找到路的？
dialogText.en: You look totally unfazed by this entire thing... How did you find your way out?

dialogText.cn: 运气罢了。我们分开之后，道路就从未变化过。
dialogText.en: I believe fortune was on my side. After our separation, the path I was on remained unchanged.

dialogText.cn: 这还真是新奇的体验……
dialogText.en: This has proven to be quite an enlightening experience so far...

dialogText.cn: 虽然刚开始吓了一跳，但现在回过头再看，总觉得这片竹林别有韵味。
dialogText.en: It succeeded in startling me at the beginning. But now that I look back at it, my brief jaunt through this bamboo grove actually feels rather intriguing.

dialogText.cn: 你还真是有闲情。
dialogText.en: You sure live a life of leisure.

dialogText.cn: 先出去再说吧。
dialogText.en: Let's continue our discussion outside.

dialogText.cn: 你刚刚在这里与阿达希尔分别。
dialogText.en: You just bid farewell to Ardashir at this place.

dialogText.cn: 可转眼的工夫，他去哪儿了？又是怎么离开的？
dialogText.en: But he was gone in an instant. Where did he go? And how did he leave the place?

dialogText.cn: 加入终末地之后，这还是我第一次回武陵呢……
dialogText.en: This is the first time I'm heading back to Wuling, since I signed up with Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，刚好有些新情况。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we just received a situation update.

dialogText.cn: 情报办公室获取了一些关于碾骨氏族的情报。他们正在向武陵转移，聂菲斯无疑与此有关。
dialogText.en: The Intel Office sent an update on the Bonekrushers: they are moving towards Wuling. There's no doubt that Nefarith is involved.

dialogText.cn: 整个星球的超域深度都在产生变化……其他基地的报告……也不乐观。
dialogText.en: Æther depth readings are changing throughout the entire world... Reports from other sites ... do not look very optimistic.

dialogText.cn: 不是还有我们吗？
dialogText.en: Come on, there's us, right?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，着陆程序准备就绪了！
dialogText.en: Endmin, Supervisor Perlica! Your landing protocol is ready to go!

dialogText.cn: 投放点就设置在武陵城内。你们随时可以出发。
dialogText.en: We've established the drop point inside Wuling City. You may set off anytime.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你了，菲奥娜。
dialogText.en: Understood. Well done, Fiona.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我不会坐视四号谷地的事在武陵重演。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I won't allow the Valley IV Incident to happen again in Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，此外，与武陵当局的合作也是本次行动的重中之重。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Additionally, our partnership with the Wuling leadership is crucial to our cause.

dialogText.cn: 但是这样的话，人手方面……
dialogText.en: But this also means ... we're short on people...

dialogText.cn: M3说过，这些事情的背后一定有一个巨大的意志。她必须时刻关注北方的动向。
dialogText.en: M3 said that powerful individuals or minds are behind these incidents. She must focus on activities in the north.

dialogText.cn: 更详细的情报，我会同步到你们的终端。
dialogText.en: I will be syncing additional details to your terminals.

dialogText.cn: 我们此行的对接人，是武陵的现任负责人——
dialogText.en: The liaison of our operation is the current leader of Wuling—

dialogText.cn: 大炎天师，<@qu.key>庄方宜</>。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Zhuang Fangyi</>, one of the Tianshi of Great Yan.

dialogText.cn: 准备好了吗？
dialogText.en: Ready yet, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 这次，绝不再让聂菲斯得逞。
dialogText.en: Alright. Nefarith will not get away this time.

dialogText.cn: 虽然我只在那里待了一年多，但武陵是我见过最美的城市。
dialogText.en: I've only stayed at Wuling for a year or so, but it's the prettiest city I've ever seen.

dialogText.cn: 是一种侵蚀现象。武陵傍水而生，那里的侵蚀形态也和水高度相关。这和我们在四号谷地遭遇的侵蚀现象不太一样。
dialogText.en: It's a form of Blight. Wuling is built next to lakes and rivers. So, the local Blight tends to be associated with water, and will look a little different from the Blight we see in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 加之毗邻江河，周期性的潮水也会加剧武陵的侵蚀活跃程度。不过当地人早就习以为常，不算是一件大事。
dialogText.en: And since Wuling is close to rivers, the regular tides also intensify Blight activity in the city. But it's no big deal to the locals. They're used to it.

dialogText.cn: 以前在武陵驻扎训练的时候，我远远地见过她几回……
dialogText.en: I saw her from afar a couple of times when I was assigned to Wuling for my training...

dialogText.cn: 只知道，她是宏科院最年轻的发展区管代。
dialogText.en: The only thing I know about her is that she's the youngest Viceroy in charge of an HAS developmental district.

dialogText.cn: 至于其他的嘛……都是些坊间传闻。
dialogText.en: As for other things... They're mostly gossip and hearsay.

dialogText.cn: 比如，说她从不睡觉，一生气天上就会打雷，还有说她其实是大炎天师府的隐藏魁首什么的……
dialogText.en: People say she never sleeps. If she gets angry, the skies will darken with booming thunderclouds. Some even claim that she's a secret chief leading the Tianshi Bureau of Great Yan...

dialogText.cn: 我……毕竟只在那里待过一年多，还没有我在终末地的时间长嘛！
dialogText.en: I, uh... I was only there for around a year! I've actually been an Endfielder for longer than that!

dialogText.cn: 都是些过去的事了，其实也没什么好说的。
dialogText.en: And it was a while ago. There's really nothing much to say.

dialogText.cn: 我不想看见那片桃花源被敌人荼毒……我们可得赶紧了，管理员。
dialogText.en: I can't stand the thought of this peachy sanctuary getting attacked... Endmin, we gotta hurry.

dialogText.cn: 学生们都很崇拜她，所以也越传越玄乎了。
dialogText.en: Her students really worship her. That's why the stories keep getting crazier.

dialogText.cn: 事不宜迟，我们这就出发吧。
dialogText.en: Let's not dally, then. Time to move out.

dialogText.cn: 啊呀，感受到这湿漉漉的空气，我就知道回来了。
dialogText.en: Oh my. Feeling this nice, moist air tells me I'm back at home.

dialogText.cn: 管……信号……干扰……你们到了……我……
dialogText.en: Endmin ... our signals ... interference... We're trying...

dialogText.cn: 通信还是一直断断续续的。
dialogText.en: Radio is still intermittent.

dialogText.cn: 我们已经徒步了十五分钟，依然没有离开这片区域。
dialogText.en: We've been walking for fifteen minutes ... but we have yet to reach the end of this area.

dialogText.cn: 暂时联系不上菲奥娜，也无法通知庄管代。继续前进吧。
dialogText.en: We can't get in touch with Fiona or Viceroy Zhuang at the moment. Let's keep moving for now.

dialogText.cn: 只是这里有点儿太安静了，不够热闹。
dialogText.en: But this place is a little too quiet. I prefer things lively and noisy.

dialogText.cn: 不过<@qu.key>侵蚀潮</>应该不在汛期，为什么通信会被干扰呢……
dialogText.en: Weird. The <@qu.key>Blight Tide</> shouldn't have risen yet. Why would our radio comms get interrupted...?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，我对武陵城还算熟悉，毕竟在那儿生活过一段时间。
dialogText.en: Heheh. I'm quite familiar with Wuling. I *did* live in the city for a while, you know.

dialogText.cn: 我预先看过许多关于武陵的调研报告，但所有影像都远不如亲眼所见。
dialogText.en: I've read plenty of investigative reports about Wuling, but they pale against the actual place.

dialogText.cn: 只是……S.O.W.系统还是很不稳定。
dialogText.en: Yes, but ... we're experiencing an unstable SOW system here.

dialogText.cn: 现在导航失效，陈，你认识路吗？
dialogText.en: Its navigation function is out. Chen, do you know the way?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……为了方便行商、信使和游客，武陵城在这附近布置了一些动力竹筏。找到那些竹筏，就有引路标识了。
dialogText.en: Hmm... To help traveling peddlers, messengers, and tourists, Wuling City has deployed a number of powered rafts nearby. We just need to find these rafts to get our road markers.

dialogText.cn: 走，我们顺路找找。
dialogText.en: Time to roll! Let's follow this trail and look around.

dialogText.cn: 看来坐标偏差比想象中大，可能已经超出了预定范围……
dialogText.en: Landing coordinates deviation seems larger than I thought. We may have landed outside the expected zone...

dialogText.cn: 那当然了，青草的气味，涓流的声响，武陵美景可不光靠看，得用五感体会！
dialogText.en: Of course! The grassy fragrance, the rippling of creeks. You can't take in their beauty just by looking. You gotta experience it with every sense!

dialogText.cn: 这个<@qu.key>炎国</>字到底是什么意思……
dialogText.en: What does this <@qu.key>Yanese</> character mean...?

dialogText.cn: 啊，总算见到其他旅客了。
dialogText.en: Ah. Finally. Other fellow travelers.

dialogText.cn: 我们……只是顺着风景走过来的。你不是本地人吧？
dialogText.en: We-uh ... we came here for the scenery. You're not local, right?

dialogText.cn: 你是独自一人？
dialogText.en: Are you here by yourself?

dialogText.cn: 目前是这样。
dialogText.en: Yes, it seems that way for now.

dialogText.cn: 这附近可不算太平，你就一个人旅行，没问题吗？
dialogText.en: This place is getting pretty unsafe. Are you sure you'll be alright roaming around on your own?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，最开始，我也是有很多同伴的。
dialogText.en: Hahah. Well, I did have quite a few companions at the beginning.

dialogText.cn: 只是……最后只剩下我一个人了。
dialogText.en: But in the end ... I was the only one left.

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，各位也是要去武陵城的吧？
dialogText.en: No matter. I assume you are heading towards Wuling City as well?

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 太好了，我也很高兴能有几个人一路上说说话。
dialogText.en: Most gladdening. It will be delightful to converse with fellow travelers along the way.

dialogText.cn: 啊，请原谅，我好像还没有做过自我介绍。
dialogText.en: Ah. Apologies. I am afraid I have yet to fully introduce myself.

dialogText.cn: 我是一名旅客，来自……<@qu.key>耶尔什</>。
dialogText.en: I am a traveler who hails from ... <@qu.key>Kjersch</>.

dialogText.cn: 耶尔什自由市？那座被雪山环抱的城市？
dialogText.en: The Free City of Kjersch? The one bound by a ring of snow-capped mountains?

dialogText.cn: 哦？你居然知道？
dialogText.en: Hmm. You actually know the place.

dialogText.cn: 能教教我怎么启动这个竹筏吗？我对炎国的技术并不是很了解。
dialogText.en: Will you kindly instruct me on how to activate this raft? I am afraid my knowledge of Yanese technology is rather limited.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……那我们就同行一阵吧。
dialogText.en: It is agreed then... We shall travel together.

dialogText.cn: 我的名字是<@qu.key>阿达希尔</>。如你们所见，是一名环游世界的旅行者。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Ardashir</> is my name. As you can see, I am a traveler who intends to visit every corner of this world.

dialogText.cn: 你们也要渡河吗？我实在不知道怎么启动它……
dialogText.en: Are you also trying to cross the river? I honestly don't know how to activate this...

dialogText.cn: 我本想着渡水去武陵城游览，却没想到此处连交通工具都是无人管理的……
dialogText.en: My intent was to cross this river and visit Wuling City. I did not expect the vehicles here to be completely unmanned...

dialogText.cn: 这条小道似乎很久没有人造访了。
dialogText.en: It seems this trail has not been used for some time.

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔先生，我们可能想在这里休息一下。
dialogText.en: Mr. Ardashir, we might need to rest here for a while.

dialogText.cn: 好吧。确实是我叨扰了各位，感谢你们刚才的帮助。
dialogText.en: Of course. I apologize for intruding, and I truly appreciate your assistance.

dialogText.cn: 但愿我没有冒犯到各位……
dialogText.en: I pray that I have not inconvenienced anyone...

dialogText.cn: 不过，路似乎只有这一条，也许我们还会再见的。
dialogText.en: Yet this seems to be the only path. So my dear friends, perhaps we shall have the opportunity to meet again.

dialogText.cn: 啊……我从没见过这么茂盛的竹林。
dialogText.en: I've never seen a bamboo forest with such verdance and lushness.

dialogText.cn: 没什么……只是第一次这么清晰地听见风吹过竹林的声音。
dialogText.en: Nothing... This is my first time listening to a rustling in such clarity. The sound of wind brushing itself against a grove.

dialogText.cn: 这小哥倒是友善，就是总让人觉得哪里别扭。
dialogText.en: He looks friendly, but I just feel there's something weird about him.

dialogText.cn: 我在数据库中检索了“阿达希尔”这个名字……
dialogText.en: I queried the name "Ardashir" in the database...

dialogText.cn: 除了萨尔贡几位同名历史人物外，其他都是在塞什卡和工团登记过的普通雇员，年龄也对不上号。
dialogText.en: The only hits are figures of Sargonian history, and other common employees registered at Seš'qa and the UWST. None of them matched his age, though.

dialogText.cn: ……倒是没从他身上感受到敌意。
dialogText.en: ...Well, I didn't sense any hostility from him.

dialogText.cn: 陈，还有多久能到武陵城？
dialogText.en: Chen, how long would it take us to reach Wuling City?

dialogText.cn: 很快。穿过这片区域，之后我就轻车熟路了。
dialogText.en: Won't be long. Once we get through this place, I'll know the rest like the back of my hand.

dialogText.cn: 不过眼前的确只有一条路，我们迟早还是会遇上那小哥。
dialogText.en: But this really is the only path. We will run into that young man eventually.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……首要目的还是尽快到达武陵城。出发吧。
dialogText.en: Indeed... Our primary objective is to reach Wuling City ASAP. Time to move, team.

dialogText.cn: 这里的景色跟刚才完全一样，我似乎迷路了……
dialogText.en: Once again I find myself in a similar scene as before. I seem to be lost...

dialogText.cn: 太好了，我知道你不会抛下我的。
dialogText.en: And it gladdens me so. I knew you would not abandon me.

dialogText.cn: 啊！谢天谢地……我就知道你们会追上来的。
dialogText.en: Ah! My prayers have been answered... I knew you would eventually catch up to me.

dialogText.cn: 难道我没有看错，竹子真的会动……？这是某种法术吗？
dialogText.en: Perhaps I was not seeing things. The bamboo trees can actually move... Is it some kind of Arts?

dialogText.cn: 竹林开始变得稀疏了，就快到尽头了。
dialogText.en: The grove is thinning out. The exit must be near.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！终于能离开这里了！
dialogText.en: Great! We can finally leave this place!

dialogText.cn: 已经耽误了不少时间，得快点和庄管代会合。
dialogText.en: This took longer than expected. We must meet up with Viceroy Zhuang quickly.

dialogText.cn: “管理员”……这似乎是个职称，但她们对你的信任是不加掩饰的。
dialogText.en: "Endmin"... Sounds like a position in an office. Their trust for you is more than obvious.

dialogText.cn: 在分别之前，我其实有一个问题想问问你……
dialogText.en: Before we go our separate ways, I do have a question to ask...

dialogText.cn: “管理员”！
dialogText.en: "Endmin".

dialogText.cn: 能再聊两句吗？一路上，你都有些沉默寡言。
dialogText.en: Might we share a few more words? You have been rather quiet and taciturn throughout our journey.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟她们是这么称呼你的，可没避讳。
dialogText.en: That is how the other two addressed you. They were not trying to hide anything.

dialogText.cn: 你现在……
dialogText.en: As of now...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？
dialogText.en: Hmm?

dialogText.cn: 认可自己做的事吗？
dialogText.en: ...do you approve of your endeavor?

dialogText.cn: 当然。
dialogText.en: {F}Of course I do.{M}Of course I do.

dialogText.cn: ……看来要下雨了。这天气，真是……
dialogText.en: ...The sky is heavy with rainclouds. This weather is most fickle...

dialogText.cn: 管理员！这边！这条路肯定能到武陵城！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Over here! I found the road to Wuling City!

dialogText.cn: 我该出发了。
dialogText.en: I'll take my leave.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Mmhmm.

dialogText.cn: ……看来你确实忘记了。
dialogText.en: ...You truly have forgotten everything.

dialogText.cn: 那想必，你也不会原谅我们了吧。
dialogText.en: Then it is inevitable. You will not forgive us.

dialogText.cn: 大桨！？你怎么伤这么重！
dialogText.en: Da Jiang! How'd you get so banged up!?

dialogText.cn: 咳咳……大当家……水花子……
dialogText.en: *Cough* Argh... Chief... Those splatters...

dialogText.cn: 先不要说话！你需要紧急治疗。
dialogText.en: Shhh, save your strength! Let's get you treated first.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们上。
dialogText.en: Endmin, time to put them down!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，看来我们在想同一件事。
dialogText.en: Seems like we're thinking the same thing.

dialogText.cn: 相比四号谷地，这儿显得太平静了……
dialogText.en: Compared to Valley IV, it's way too peaceful here...

dialogText.cn: 你是说，清波寨背后潜藏着危险？
dialogText.en: You mean ... there's danger lurking behind Qingbo Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 喂，黎博利，你还真有一手！我就知道你能派上用场！
dialogText.en: Hey, Liberi, you really got skills! Knew you'd be useful!

dialogText.cn: 我让大桨先去歇着了，修桥我来就行。
dialogText.en: I told Da Jiang to get some rest. I'll handle the bridge repairs.

dialogText.cn: 或许我们也能帮上忙。
dialogText.en: Perhaps we can lend a hand too.

dialogText.cn: 没有巢雕，没有营地。
dialogText.en: Not a single denstack or camp.

dialogText.cn: 那……我记得把清水放进那边机关里，桥就能动……用湖水行不行呀？
dialogText.en: Nice! I'm sure that we just need to ... pour some clean water into that mechanism there, then the bridge moves... Think we can use lake water?

dialogText.cn: 拿着，这儿有几个蓝铁瓶，可以用来装水。
dialogText.en: Here, take these Ferrium Bottles and fill them up with water.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会有这么多天使？
dialogText.en: Why are there so many Aggeloi here?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我去帮她！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'll go help her!

dialogText.cn: 寨内很乱，容易走错。我带路。
dialogText.en: The Stockade's in a mess and it's easy to get lost. I'll show you the way.

dialogText.cn: 可恶，该死的水花子……！
dialogText.en: Tch... Freaking splatters!

dialogText.cn: 有劳各位了。
dialogText.en: Thank you in advance, everyone.

dialogText.cn: 食物都保住了，还能不好吗！
dialogText.en: The food's safe, so yeah, I'm fine!

dialogText.cn: 阮哥！我在这儿！
dialogText.en: Big Bro! I'm here!

dialogText.cn: 不是叫你最近不要出来捕鳞吗？
dialogText.en: Didn't I tell you to lay off the fin-hunting lately?

dialogText.cn: 寨里粮仓见底，我堂堂“浪里鳞”，总得做点什么！
dialogText.en: Our food supplies are runnin' low. I'm Fin of the Waves after all — gotta do somethin' for the fam!

dialogText.cn: 受伤了少说话。这里交给我们。
dialogText.en: You're hurt, try not to talk so much. Leave this to us.

dialogText.cn: 阮哥！你说会不会是武陵城的那帮孙子……
dialogText.en: Big Bro, think them Wuling City clowns are behind all this...?

dialogText.cn: 谁知道呢！寨子里谁没被武陵城那帮孙子害惨过，都说不准！
dialogText.en: Uh-uh, don't say that too soon! Everyone here's been ruined by those Wuling City fools, so I'm skeptical!

dialogText.cn: 石牙，先跟着二姑娘回去，帮忙照顾其他弟兄姐妹。
dialogText.en: Stonefang, go with Younger Dame and help look after the others.

dialogText.cn: 成，阮哥，听你的。
dialogText.en: Okay, Big Bro.

dialogText.cn: 再说，这水连着祖泉，哪能说不要就不要。
dialogText.en: Plus, this water flows from our Ancestral Spring. I can't pretend it doesn't exist.

dialogText.cn: 别害怕，已经没事了。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, you're safe now.

dialogText.cn: 啊，看衣服，你……是城里来的人？
dialogText.en: Ah, your clothes ... are you from the city?

dialogText.cn: 阿青，多亏你机灵。怎么想到带着大家躲在这种地方？
dialogText.en: Qing, you made a really clever move! How'd you figure out to bring everyone here for shelter?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，之前有在天师府学过紧急避险的办法……
dialogText.en: Heheh. I learned about emergency survival tactics at the Tianshi Bureau...

dialogText.cn: 不愧是我们的“玲珑子”！
dialogText.en: That's our Delicate Bead, never fails to impress!

dialogText.cn: 大、大当家，别再说这种羞人的称号啦！我先带着大家回去。
dialogText.en: P-Please, Chief, no more embarrassing nicknames! I'll take everyone back now.

dialogText.cn: 别瞎说，阿青离开武陵城投奔我们可都好多年了！
dialogText.en: Don't be silly. Qing's been with us for years since she left Wuling City!

dialogText.cn: 城里来的？你看着也和其他寨民不太一样……难道你也是新加入的？
dialogText.en: From the city? You don't look like the others around here either... Are you new as well?

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，嗐，这些水花子，我的拳脚功夫根本用不上！
dialogText.en: Thank you. Ugh, my fists were totally useless against those splatters!

dialogText.cn: 你这边情况怎么样？
dialogText.en: How are things here?

dialogText.cn: 按你说的，我把内寨的门关好了，水花子和那些怪人应该进不去了。
dialogText.en: I got all gates shut tight, just like you told me. Those splatters and freaks shouldn't be getting through.

dialogText.cn: 怪人？
dialogText.en: Freaks?

dialogText.cn: 好！
dialogText.en: No problem!

dialogText.cn: 也许是裂地者……
dialogText.en: Possibly the Landbreakers...

dialogText.cn: 外面先交给我们，你找个安全的地方。
dialogText.en: Leave the outside to us. You go find somewhere safe.

dialogText.cn: 耍剑的姑娘，看你对付水花子有一手，有空我“镇山石”可得跟你讨教讨教！
dialogText.en: Hey, sword girl! You totally crushed those splatters. I'm Mountain Guardian, let's have a spar when you got the time!

dialogText.cn: 幸好我们动作够快，兄弟姐妹都在这儿了。
dialogText.en: Good thing we moved fast. Everyone's safe and here.

dialogText.cn: 实话说吧，我原本只不过想抓几个苦力，替寨子打打杂。
dialogText.en: Honestly, when I took you in, I just wanted some free labor to help with Stockade chores.

dialogText.cn: 但没想到你们既能救人，又能修桥，还能打水花子……可真是太了不起了！
dialogText.en: Didn't expect you to rescue my fam, fix the bridge, and take down splatters... Gotta admit, you're really good!

dialogText.cn: 哈！姐妹弟兄们，都听好了！
dialogText.en: Alright, listen up, folks!

dialogText.cn: 这个黑面煞，名字叫“管理员”，是终末地的老大。
dialogText.en: This one here is Darkmask, aka the Endministrator, aka the boss of Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 从现在开始，我清波寨和终末地就联上绺子了！他们的事，就是我的事！
dialogText.en: From now on, Qingbo Stockade and Endfield are united! Their problems are my problems!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈……哈，哎呀，咱们是不是有点太投入了？
dialogText.en: Haha... Oh well, maybe we went a little overboard with the act?

dialogText.cn: 能得到更多本地人的支持算是意外之喜，走一步看一步吧。
dialogText.en: It's a surprising development to get local backing. Let's take it step by step.

dialogText.cn: 大当家，大当家——！
dialogText.en: Chief! Chief! We found them—

dialogText.cn: 失踪的那几个人有消息了，他们躲水花子被困在小礁。
dialogText.en: The missing group, they ... they're trapped at a small reef, hiding from the splatters.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤，寨民们有难，交给我们！
dialogText.en: Tangtang, these folks in trouble. We can help!

dialogText.cn: 没有没有，我们只是……
dialogText.en: No no, we were just doing our part...

dialogText.cn: 汤汤没说错。
dialogText.en: Tangtang's right.

dialogText.cn: 我们都知道这个世界是什么模样。很少有人对我们这么亲切。
dialogText.en: We all know what this world is like. Not many have shown us such kindness.

dialogText.cn: 这是终末地的信念，我们绝不会抛下各位。
dialogText.en: Such is the belief of Endfield: we shall never forsake anyone.

dialogText.cn: 终末地……终末地是做什么的？
dialogText.en: Endfield...? What exactly does Endfield do?

dialogText.cn: 只要还在清波寨这块地，我罩着他们！
dialogText.en: So long as they're on my turf, I got them covered!

dialogText.cn: 还没……我醒来后只找到了你。
dialogText.en: No ... I only found you after I woke up.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤本性不坏，就是有点贪财。毕竟寨民的日子一直都不算好。
dialogText.en: She's not a bad person, just ... a bit money-minded. Can't blame her, though — her people have it tough.

dialogText.cn: 她既然已经当上大当家了，附近少不了她的同伙。
dialogText.en: If she's made it to the top, her people are bound to be nearby.

dialogText.cn: 将计就计。
dialogText.en: We play along — and flip the script.

dialogText.cn: ……没事的，以佩丽卡的能耐，她一定还安全。
dialogText.en: I'm sure Perlica's fine... She's tough and skilled.

dialogText.cn: 她啊，她是我以前在武陵城外练剑散心的时候认识的。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I first met her when I was practicing swordmancy outside Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 那会儿她非要来干扰我，还在那儿瞎指点。一来二去，我们就成了比武的对手。
dialogText.en: She kept butting in, throwing advice everywhere. One thing led to another, and we became sparring partners.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我有个办法。
dialogText.en: Wooo, I got an idea...

dialogText.cn: 如果这儿真是清波寨的领地，我们最好别贸然行动。
dialogText.en: Anyway, if this really is Qingbo Stockade's turf, we better play it safe.

dialogText.cn: 那、那个啊，其实算不上是被赶走的……是我自己没能通过……
dialogText.en: Ah! That? Well, I didn't really get dragged out... It's more like me failing the trials...

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，之后有空再说我，当务之急是找人！
dialogText.en: Aiyo. Let's just leave talking about ME for another day. Our top priority is to look for Perly!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你们要是早投我清波寨多好！
dialogText.en: Haha! Darkmask, why didn't we have you at the Stockade earlier!

dialogText.cn: ……你今天笑得很多。
dialogText.en: ...You've been smiling a lot today.

dialogText.cn: 能帮上你们就行。其实，我们也有很多疑惑……
dialogText.en: I'm glad we could help. To be honest, we have plenty of questions and doubts too...

dialogText.cn: “裂地者”……那些怪人是最近才出现的，我们也摸不清他们藏在哪儿。
dialogText.en: "Landbreakers" ... those freaks only started showing up recently, and we don't really know where they are hiding.

dialogText.cn: ……无论如何，清波寨不怕他们。
dialogText.en: Whatever their plan is, Qingbo Stockade won't be scared off.

dialogText.cn: 虽然往年也有，但最近它们活动得越来越频繁。
dialogText.en: They've caused trouble over the years, but lately, they've been way more active.

dialogText.cn: 好在我常年和它们打交道，有些保命的诀窍能派上用场。
dialogText.en: I've been dealing with them for quite some time, and I picked up a few life-saving tricks along the way.

dialogText.cn: 欸，黑面煞，还记得我们先前的交易吗？
dialogText.en: Oi, Darkmask, remember our deal from earlier?

dialogText.cn: 喏，你们看到那些水车了吧？
dialogText.en: Well, you probably seen those waterwheelies, right?

dialogText.cn: 它们连着去武陵城那条路的门。但前一阵子不知怎的，一个两个都停了摆。
dialogText.en: They run the gate to the path going to Wuling City. But lately they been acting up one after another.

dialogText.cn: 我们也不是没去修过，就是摸不清要领。
dialogText.en: We tried fixing them, but never got it done.

dialogText.cn: 先带我们去看看吧。
dialogText.en: Please take us to the place. We'll have a look.

dialogText.cn: 啊？你说我吗？
dialogText.en: Ha? Really?

dialogText.cn: 自从寨子里情况变糟之后，你就老是愁眉苦脸了。
dialogText.en: Ever since things went downhill in the Stockade, you've been frowning nonstop.

dialogText.cn: 瞎说！我不是天天都——
dialogText.en: That's so not true! I ALWAYS—

dialogText.cn: 你骗不了我，我是你哥。
dialogText.en: You can't fool me. I'm your brother.

dialogText.cn: 感谢各位了。
dialogText.en: Thank you for everything. I really appreciate it.

dialogText.cn: 他们没太大动作，像是在等什么。数量也少，这么点人掀不起什么风浪。
dialogText.en: They haven't made any major moves yet, like they're waiting for something. And with their limited numbers, the Landbreakers don't pose a real threat for now.

dialogText.cn: 水花子会躲藏在被污染的水里，它们出现的时机也摸不着规律。
dialogText.en: The splatters love to lurk in polluted waters and strike out of nowhere.

dialogText.cn: 商量完了？清波寨讲规矩——留得青山在，不怕没柴烧。
dialogText.en: Done jawing? Qingbo Stockade's all about survival — as long as the hills stay green, there'll always be firewood to burn.

dialogText.cn: 而你们呢，就是我的“青山”。留下点值钱的东西，我就放你们走，倒也不至于吃干抹净——
dialogText.en: You two are my "green hills," alright? Drop me some good loot, and I'll let you walk. Not gonna gut you dry. Ain't my style.

dialogText.cn: 大当家！
dialogText.en: Supreme Chief!

dialogText.cn: 啊？
dialogText.en: Nyaa?

dialogText.cn: 大当家，你还记得吧，我当年被赶出了武陵，丝毫情面都没给我留下！
dialogText.en: Chief, you know it, right? How Wuling threw me out cold and callously, without any mercy!

dialogText.cn: 我这次回来，就是为了向武陵证明——他们当年的决定大错特错！
dialogText.en: Well now I'm back. I'm back to show them Wulingers — they were wrong, that decision was utterly, completely wrong!

dialogText.cn: 当年之耻，至今难忘！我离开之后，就遇见了现在的老大——
dialogText.en: I've never forgotten the shame. It still haunts me. Luckily, I ran into my new boss.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的老大——管理员！
dialogText.en: The one and only Endministrator of Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 管什么的？哎呀，没听过没听过。这不重要。
dialogText.en: En-end what? Never heard of it. Whatever.

dialogText.cn: 所以你这次回来，是特地找武陵麻烦的？
dialogText.en: So you rolled back in here just to give Wuling hell?

dialogText.cn: 没错！
dialogText.en: You bet I did!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，好你个陈千语！果然是个硬骨头！
dialogText.en: Hehheh. But look at you now, Chen. Full of fire! You're one tough cookie!

dialogText.cn: 哼！那当然了！
dialogText.en: Hmph! Well said. Can't deny that!

dialogText.cn: 嚯，你们俩这一来一回的，原来是这么个打算。
dialogText.en: Ah, now I get it. So this is what you are up to.

dialogText.cn: 大当家，实不相瞒，我们还有一个同伴，名叫佩丽卡，一个白色头发的黎博利！只是现在下落不明……
dialogText.en: Chief, actually we are looking for a girl. Please — you've got to help us. She's a white-haired Liberi. Name's Perlica. She's one of us.

dialogText.cn: 她是……是我最大的帮手！她运筹帷幄，心思缜密，是对付弭弗和巡卫的重要底牌！
dialogText.en: She ... she's a smart one. She's got tricks and knows tactics. She could be our trump card against Mi Fu and her watchguards!

dialogText.cn: 就这么定了！找人是吧？轻而易举！
dialogText.en: Hmph, consider it done! Finding your little pal is child's play for me.

dialogText.cn: 过奖过奖，但——我觉得，大当家比我们更有胆气！
dialogText.en: Oh, stop it, Chief. I'm nothing in front of YOU. You're tougher than any of us here!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，没了我，想在这地方找人可就麻烦咯。
dialogText.en: Hehheh, tracking folks isn't easy around here. You're lucky I'm on it.
Wha...?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……也是，当时瞧你一路上边走边哭，我都怕你变失心疯。
dialogText.en: Hmm ... thinking back, you were totally bawling your eyes out when you left. I almost thought you'd lose it.

dialogText.cn: 那是——啊？你怎么——
dialogText.en: That was... Wait, how did you...

dialogText.cn: 这附近敢跟武陵城叫板的，确实也只有我们清波寨了！
dialogText.en: You made the right choice! Around here, only we Qingbo Stockaders have the guts to go head-on with Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 你是说，弭弗？
dialogText.en: Did you just say, Mi Fu?

dialogText.cn: 没错！
dialogText.en: Exactly!

dialogText.cn: 那个脸色一变动手没轻没重前个月还把我最喜欢的手铳没收了的红脸婆？
dialogText.en: You mean that rude, rough, mad woman who nicked my favorite handcannon like it was nothing?

dialogText.cn: 正是！
dialogText.en: Absolutely!

dialogText.cn: 那好！我帮了！
dialogText.en: Okay! I got you covered!

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡！
dialogText.en: Perlica!

dialogText.cn: 自己人？看他们这一身，可不像什么“自己人”。
dialogText.en: With us? Look at how they're dressed. They don't look like one of us.

dialogText.cn: 我说过，我们来自终末地，并不代表武陵，也不想和你们发生冲突。
dialogText.en: As I have explained, we are not part of Wuling. We are from Endfield. We do not want to start any conflict with you.

dialogText.cn: 正当防卫而已，他们一会儿就会醒来。
dialogText.en: That was legitimate self-defense. They should be regaining consciousness soon.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，不错！真不错！
dialogText.en: HAHA! Good! I'm impressed!
...*Sigh*.

dialogText.cn: 你又偷偷来溶洞。我提醒过你，最近不要往寨子外跑。
dialogText.en: Sneaking off to the limestone cave again, huh? Told you to stick to the Stockade these days.

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，我憋得慌嘛！
dialogText.en: Aiyo, girl needs some fresh air!

dialogText.cn: {F}正好遇上这些人准备去找武陵城的麻烦，我就直接把她们收入麾下了！{M}正好遇上这些人准备去找武陵城的麻烦，我就直接把他们收入麾下了！
dialogText.en: {F}I ran into these guys on the way. Told me they're fixing to mess with Wuling City, so I stepped in and brought them under! {M}I ran into these guys on the way. Told me they're fixing to mess with Wuling City, so I stepped in and brought them under!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，哥，这回听我的……
dialogText.en: Aiya, just trust me on this, bro...

dialogText.cn: ……所以，现在是什么情况？
dialogText.en: So ... what's happening now?

dialogText.cn: 哥！
dialogText.en: Bro!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，陈……你们没事，太好了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Chen... I'm so glad you're both alright.

dialogText.cn: 这里交给我们。
dialogText.en: Leave this to us.

dialogText.cn: ……汤汤？你怎么来了？
dialogText.en: Tangtang...? What are you doing out here?

dialogText.cn: 哥，别动手，都是自己人。
dialogText.en: Put your fist down, bro. They're with us.

dialogText.cn: 但你打伤了我的手下。
dialogText.en: But you just injured my men.

dialogText.cn: 本以为只是脑子灵光，没想到还是个术师，确实能派上用场！
dialogText.en: Thought you just had brains, but you're an artful caster — could be a big help for sure!

dialogText.cn: 汤汤……
dialogText.en: Tangtang...

dialogText.cn: 哥，不碍事儿。这几个都跟我混，一点儿误会。
dialogText.en: Chillax, bro. Let me clear up this little mix-up for you. These guys roll with me.

dialogText.cn: 看这只傻龙，有印象不？陈千语！她之前被赶走，现在回来踢场子，这热闹我得凑！
dialogText.en: Look at this goofball — ring any bells? She's Chen Qianyu! She got kicked out before, now she's back to shake things up. I can't miss that!

dialogText.cn: 你们几个，也别傻愣着。
dialogText.en: Hey, quit standing there like a bunch of goobers.

dialogText.cn: 这位就是清波寨的二当家，也是我大哥，<@qu.key>阮一</>！
dialogText.en: This is my big brother, Qingbo Stockade's first mate — <@qu.key>Ruan Yi</>!

dialogText.cn: 因为水花子，咱们已经多久没开张了？
dialogText.en: Think, how long's it been since we last opened for biz? All thanks to those splatters.

dialogText.cn: {F}别管她们是不是真打算去踢馆，眼下总能指使她们干点活儿！{M}别管他们是不是真打算去踢馆，眼下总能指使他们干点活儿！
dialogText.en: {F}Don't matter if they're serious about throwing down. For now, we can boss them around a bit! {M}Don't matter if they're serious about throwing down. For now, we can boss them around a bit!

dialogText.cn: 寨子里的水车，不找这些人，难不成去找武陵城那帮天师吗？
dialogText.en: If we don't get these folks to fix our waterwheelies, what, we gonna run crying to the Wuling City Tianshi?

dialogText.cn: 别的我都支持你。但让外人干涉寨里的事……
dialogText.en: I'm with you on most things. But ... bringing outsiders into Stockade affairs?

dialogText.cn: 哥，别犟丰蹄脾气啦！日子一天比一天不好过，我也得想想办法不是？
dialogText.en: C'mon, bro, don't be so rockheaded! Times're getting tougher — we gotta do something, right?

dialogText.cn: 我没事，管理员。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Endmin. I'm alright.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢……
dialogText.en: I ... appreciate it.

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯确实身在武陵，还有了一个神秘帮手……事态开始脱离控制了。
dialogText.en: Nefarith really is in Wuling, and she has found herself a mysterious ally... Things are getting out of control.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，得尽快进武陵城，通知庄管代。
dialogText.en: Mhm, we must hurry to Wuling City and tell Viceroy Zhuang about this.

dialogText.cn: 不过这个叫汤汤的人刚才说，我们是一伙的……
dialogText.en: That girl, Tangtang, why did she say we are with her...

dialogText.cn: ……好吧，虽然有些不妥当，但确实是脱身的办法。
dialogText.en: Hmm... Slightly improper, but an effective exit strategy.

dialogText.cn: ……按陈的说法，附近都是清波寨的势力范围。既不好起冲突，又很难摆脱他们。
dialogText.en: ...Like Chen said, we are operating on Qingbo Stockade's territory. Neither confronting them directly nor sneaking past them seems viable.

dialogText.cn: 喂，黑面煞，快过来！
dialogText.en: Hey, Darkmask! Listen up!

dialogText.cn: 咳，我们聊定了！
dialogText.en: Ahem, deal's settled!

dialogText.cn: 哼哼——你们想去武陵城对吧？可惜去那儿的路早断了。
dialogText.en: Hmph. You wanna go to Wuling City, right? Too bad the way's been cut off.

dialogText.cn: 断了？
dialogText.en: Cut off?

dialogText.cn: 只是寨子最近出了点小麻烦，想借道过去，可能要费点功夫……
dialogText.en: Only problem is, our Stockade has some little troubles recently, so taking that path may take some effort...

dialogText.cn: 你们懂吧？
dialogText.en: See where I'm getting at, right?

dialogText.cn: 决定好了就来找我！
dialogText.en: Decide quick, then come knocking!

dialogText.cn: ……我要是没听错的话，还要找武陵城的麻烦？
dialogText.en: And unless I misheard, she also said we're to stir up trouble in Wuling City. What's that about?

dialogText.cn: 既然聂菲斯已经有所行动，寨民生活在这里，也许会有线索。
dialogText.en: And since Nefarith has already made her move, the locals might provide some clues.

dialogText.cn: 入伙可以，但你们初来乍到，还打伤了自家兄弟，我们可没理由白白信任你们。
dialogText.en: You can roll with us, but you're fresh meat and you roughed up our brothers — gotta earn our trust first. No freebies.

dialogText.cn: 不过我们清波寨，自有门道！
dialogText.en: Relax, Qingbo's got tricks up its sleeve!

dialogText.cn: 挺快呀！决定好了？
dialogText.en: Oh, that was fast! You in?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，那就跟紧喽，可别掉队！
dialogText.en: Okie dokie! Now, tail me tight!

dialogText.cn: 喏，看见那儿没，走过这段就是我们寨子了。
dialogText.en: See that? Our Stockade's right up ahead past this part.

dialogText.cn: 本来从那儿就能去武陵城——可惜最近路断了。
dialogText.en: You could've rolled straight into Wuling City from there. Too bad the way was cut off lately.

dialogText.cn: ……什么时候的事情？
dialogText.en: When did that happen...?

dialogText.cn: 大概几周前？
dialogText.en: Uh, couple of weeks back?

dialogText.cn: 两周前。
dialogText.en: Two weeks.

dialogText.cn: 反正现在是没法儿走啦，跟我来！
dialogText.en: Whatever, the way's blocked for now. C'mon, follow me!

dialogText.cn: 你知道吗，现在我有点不愿意放你们走了。
dialogText.en: Know what? I kinda wanna keep you peeps around.

dialogText.cn: 喏，收好这个，就当是我给你的信物。
dialogText.en: Oh, right... Here. Take this. My token for the lot of you.

dialogText.cn: 我哪儿识字啊！识那玩意儿有什么用？
dialogText.en: Think I can write? I see no point in that.

dialogText.cn: 我哥托人给我写了一张，说是我名字，我原模原样照着画的。
dialogText.en: My brother had someone write me this. Told me it's my name. So I made an artsy copy.

dialogText.cn: 收好喽，以后拿着这东西找我办事，包妥！
dialogText.en: Keep it safe with ya. Show that to me when you need help. It shall be done.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，有血性！想要和武陵城叫板，就得拿出这股劲儿！
dialogText.en: Ha! That's more like it! That's the energy we need to take on Wuling!

dialogText.cn: 择日不如撞日，看来今天就是那武陵城的倒霉之日！
dialogText.en: Waiting gets us nowhere. Let's make it happen. Wuling shall remember today!

dialogText.cn: 喊上几个好手，打秋风去了！
dialogText.en: Call up the muscle! Time for a major hustle!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢。
dialogText.en: Thank you very much.

dialogText.cn: 要不别管武陵城的事儿了，我们先回寨里吧！
dialogText.en: That Wuling biz can wait. Let's head back to the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 今天开始，你坐第三把交椅！什么“天王”“护法”，随你当！
dialogText.en: Anyway, Darkmask, the Third Seat of the fam is now yours. Pick yourself a title — Juggernaut, Nightshade, you decide.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，客气啥。
dialogText.en: Heh. You're welcome.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，这次你做主，你们是先去武陵城解决恩怨，还是陪我回寨子里见见兄弟姐妹？
dialogText.en: So, Darkmask. You go settle your biz at Wuling City? Or meet my Stockade Fam? You call the shots.
*Sigh*.

dialogText.cn: 到地儿啦！
dialogText.en: WE! ARE! HERE!

dialogText.cn: 欸，这不是一堵墙吗？
dialogText.en: Okay... But "here" looks like a wall to me.

dialogText.cn: 墙，炸开，不就是路了吗？
dialogText.en: Pfft. Blow the wall to pieces, and you have a road.

dialogText.cn: 炸、炸开？！等等——
dialogText.en: Wha? Blow it to pieces?! Hold on—

dialogText.cn: 看好咯！
dialogText.en: WATCH ME!

dialogText.cn: 陈千语。
dialogText.en: Chen Qianyu.

dialogText.cn: 我可以解释——
dialogText.en: I can explain —

dialogText.cn: 不必，我知道你们的情况。
dialogText.en: Unnecessary. I know your situation.

dialogText.cn: 欸？
dialogText.en: Wha?

dialogText.cn: 着陆时出现了意外，我们错误地降落在了偏远的地点。
dialogText.en: There was an accident during landing. We went off course and landed at a rather remote location.

dialogText.cn: 如你所见，来的路上有点波折，我们有些关于碾骨氏族的消息需要尽快告知庄管代。
dialogText.en: As you can see, our journey here was rather tumultuous. We have information about the Bonekrushers. Viceroy Zhuang must know immediately.

dialogText.cn: 行，等我一下，我去给头儿汇报你们的情况。
dialogText.en: Understood. Wait for me. I'll report your situation to my superior.

dialogText.cn: 叫我<@qu.key>弭弗</>。
dialogText.en: The name's <@qu.key>Mi Fu</>.

dialogText.cn: 有陈千语陪同，你们应该都是终末地的人了。二位，谁是管理员？
dialogText.en: I assume the two of you are also Endfielders since you're with Chen. Now which would be our Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 那你就是佩丽卡监督了。我们突然失去了你们降落舱的信号，发生了什么？
dialogText.en: Then you must be Supervisor Perlica. We suddenly lost contact with your drop pod. What exactly happened?

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，那汤汤她怎么办？
dialogText.en: So, Mi Fu... What should we do about Tangtang?

dialogText.cn: 她？再抓她一遍就是了，等着吧。
dialogText.en: Heh. We'll throw that brat into the slammer again. Just you wait.

dialogText.cn: 在！
dialogText.en: Yes, ma'am!

dialogText.cn: 和汤汤那帮沧贼混在一起，委屈你们了。
dialogText.en: You got mixed up with Tangtang and her pirates. Must have been a harrowing experience.

dialogText.cn: 武陵城似乎还没受到什么影响……聂菲斯究竟在筹划什么？
dialogText.en: Wuling City doesn't seem to be affected at all... What is Nefarith planning?

dialogText.cn: 就是庄管代。弭弗姐是武陵巡卫负责人，一直都是庄管代的直接下属。
dialogText.en: Viceroy Zhuang. Mi Fu is in charge of the Wuling Watchguards and has always reported to the Viceroy directly.

dialogText.cn: 只有弭弗姐会这么称呼她。
dialogText.en: Mi Fu is the only one who calls her that.

dialogText.cn: 她俩的宿仇无人不知。不过，具体结过什么梁子，我也不清楚。
dialogText.en: Everyone knows about their feud. But I don't really know how this all started.

dialogText.cn: 两人只要碰上，一点就炸。打架向来都是下死手。
dialogText.en: A fight always breaks out when they see each other. And it's *never* just an ordinary fight. They're really trying to scratch each other's eyes out.

dialogText.cn: 而且，回忆一下当时的情形，阿达希尔的身份似乎还在聂菲斯之上……
dialogText.en: And from what I recall, Ardashir seems to exercise authority over Nefarith...

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，武陵城近在眼前了。要尽快准备应对措施。
dialogText.en: Regardless, Wuling City is within reach. We must prepare our countermeasures quickly.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗抓，汤汤跑，一直都这样，不过我总觉得其实……
dialogText.en: Mi Fu is always trying to chase Tangtang down. But I think...

dialogText.cn: 就像是武陵城对待清波寨那样，从没真想过要赶尽杀绝。
dialogText.en: ...they're just like Wuling City versus Qingbo Stockade. No one's really trying to get rid of each other.

dialogText.cn: 啧，麻烦了……那个小猫崽子……
dialogText.en: Tsk. Damn it... That frigging kitty...

dialogText.cn: 弭弗……队长，出了什么问题吗？
dialogText.en: Captain Mi Fu ... is there something wrong?

dialogText.cn: 刚才的爆炸把这里的防御工事震开了，导致这道门从里面打不开。
dialogText.en: The explosion shook and displaced the defense works. The gate can no longer be opened from inside.

dialogText.cn: 可以强行破开吗？
dialogText.en: Could we bring it down by force?

dialogText.cn: 底下的结构都是十年前的，那时候的防御工事设计得比较野蛮、原始……坚不可摧。
dialogText.en: These subterranean structures date back from a decade ago. Defense works back then were more brutalist and primal... They were designed to be indestructible.

dialogText.cn: 不过我很喜欢。
dialogText.en: I like it though.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡，这和帝江号上的一些设计很像呀。
dialogText.en: Perlica, the design looks pretty similar to the stuff we have on Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，是宏科院和终末地早年间合作的产物。
dialogText.en: Yes. It's something jointly produced by HAS and Endfield many years ago.

dialogText.cn: 如果安德烈先生在这里，也许他能够提供更详尽的说明。
dialogText.en: If Mr. Andre were here, he might have additional details for us.

dialogText.cn: 不过整体的设计思路是通用的，只要有办法让轴承持续转动，就能开启这扇门。
dialogText.en: Anyway, the overall design approach is similar. We just need to get the bearings into a continuous rotation to open the gate.

dialogText.cn: 持续转动？
dialogText.en: Continuous rotation?

dialogText.cn: 你们跟我来。
dialogText.en: Mmm... Follow me.

dialogText.cn: 我们互相扶持的岁月，可能比这座城市本身的历史还要悠久很多很多。
dialogText.en: Our partnership goes way back. Probably much longer than the history of Wuling city.

dialogText.cn: 这是<@qu.key>射流无人机</>……甲型？
dialogText.en: A <@qu.key>jet drone</>... Jia-type?

dialogText.cn: 你连型号都知道……能用上吗？
dialogText.en: You even know the model...? So, can we use this?

dialogText.cn: 是汰换掉的型号，而且已经报废了一段时间了……
dialogText.en: An obsolete model. This particular unit has been retired for quite a while...

dialogText.cn: 不试试怎么知道！
dialogText.en: I say we give it a try to find out!

dialogText.cn: 没想到真的有用！
dialogText.en: Whoa, it really worked!

dialogText.cn: 它本身是一款特制的施术单元，施术者可以借助它把液体转化成能量束。
dialogText.en: The drone is actually a specialized Arts Unit. A caster can use it to convert liquids into an energy beam.

dialogText.cn: 以管理员的源石技艺，想必能更高效地使用它。
dialogText.en: I believe the Endmin's Originium Arts can further boost its performance.

dialogText.cn: 这一堆死气沉沉的废铁里，还能唤醒一架状态奇佳的无人机……我也真算长见识了。
dialogText.en: I never thought someone could revive a drone from a pile of scrap, and have it in such good shape... You really opened my eyes.

dialogText.cn: 她会在办公室等你们，陈千语知道怎么过去。
dialogText.en: She's waiting for you at the office. Chen knows how to get there.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐呢？
dialogText.en: What about you, Mi Fu?

dialogText.cn: 呵……我不是还有个人要抓吗？
dialogText.en: Well... I still have an arrest to make.

dialogText.cn: 从这儿出去你们就能看到武陵城。
dialogText.en: Anyway, head out here and you'll see Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，这边的事都解决了，总算可以去见庄管代了。
dialogText.en: Great. I guess this settles our business here. We can finally go and meet Viceroy Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 顺带提一句，头儿不习惯别人叫她“管代”。她更喜欢“天师”这个身份。
dialogText.en: Got a pointer for you. My superior doesn't like people calling her a viceroy. She prefers the title of "tianshi" instead.

dialogText.cn: 前面的路你们能应付得了，放心走吧。
dialogText.en: Go with peace. You should be able to handle the rest of the journey.

dialogText.cn: 听弭队说，你们只要有了水，就能帮我们打开那些门？我这儿有，都拿去，多拿点！
dialogText.en: Hoo... Captain told us ... hoo ... you need water ... to get the gate open? I got some. Here. Take as much as you need.

dialogText.cn: 拿好了，大伙儿都指望你们了！
dialogText.en: Don't spill it. Everyone's counting on you!

dialogText.cn: 你们的行囊看起来都装满了啊，这些水你们可能装不下。
dialogText.en: Your backpack looks stuffed. It might not carry all the water here.

dialogText.cn: 够了够了！多谢啦！
dialogText.en: Oh! That's more than enough! Thanks a mill!

dialogText.cn: 咦，整个武陵城都在上面吗？
dialogText.en: Whoa ... does this show all of Wuling?

dialogText.cn: 对。近几个月超域活动异常，大潮叠加而来，城外数个区域严重受淹。
dialogText.en: Correct. Over the past few months, unusual Æther activities have caused multiple huge tides to overlap, flooding several zones outside the city badly.

dialogText.cn: 天师桩虽能保卫武陵，但消耗的息壤也急遽增多……如今，息壤储量几乎告罄。
dialogText.en: While the Tianshi Pillars can protect Wuling, they use up Xiranite very quickly... In fact, our supply is nearly exhausted.

dialogText.cn: 管理员说得对。利用集成工业系统，我们就有机会做到。
dialogText.en: The Endmin's point is valid. With the Automated Industry Complex, we stand a good chance of making it happen.

dialogText.cn: 希望真能如此……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* I truly hope so...

dialogText.cn: 如果有需要，我们能看到武陵城范围内的所有细节。
dialogText.en: Yes, if necessary, we can zoom in to see every detail inside Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 所有？那我之前和驮兽在草地打滚的事岂不是……
dialogText.en: Everything?! Then that time I was wrestling with burdenbeasts in the meadow...

dialogText.cn: 倒也不会刻意去看那么细致。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, nobody's going to look that closely.

dialogText.cn: 深度读数甚至还在持续升高，估计……不足三个月。
dialogText.en: Depth readings are still rising. Supplies won't last long. We've got at most three months.

dialogText.cn: 如果能得到终末地的帮助，就算情况恶化，应该也能多撑几个月。
dialogText.en: If Endfield could provide assistance, we should be able to sustain ourselves for a few more months, even if conditions deteriorate.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统基于协议源石技术，是唯一能短时间内量产息壤的手段。
dialogText.en: The AIC is based on Protorig technology. It's the only way to mass-produce Xiranite in a short time.

dialogText.cn: 呵……我都快忘了，管理员能做到的事，多到不可思议。
dialogText.en: Heh... I'd almost forgotten, just how many impossible things the Endministrator can pull off.

dialogText.cn: 看方位，这四周此起彼伏的，是<@qu.key>侵蚀潮</>？
dialogText.en: Looking at the simulation, are those undulating structures around Wuling the <@qu.key>Blight Tide</>?

dialogText.cn: 告罄？
dialogText.en: Nearly exhausted?

dialogText.cn: 我看城里一切正常啊！大家也都——等等，是您……？
dialogText.en: But the city and the people look normal! Wait, is that why...?

dialogText.cn: 那么，巡卫和您亲自去阵列外解决天使也是因为这个原因。
dialogText.en: I see. That's why the watchguards and you have personally gone beyond the perimeter to handle the Aggeloi.

dialogText.cn: ……总要想办法缓解压力。
dialogText.en: Yes... We had to find ways to reduce the strain.

dialogText.cn: 这些粒子束与天师桩内部的<@qu.key>息壤</>相连。管理员，您可以尝试着碰触。
dialogText.en: These particle beams are connected to the <@qu.key>Xiranite</> inside the Tianshi Pillars. Endministrator, you can try touching them.

dialogText.cn: 奇怪……怎么我碰到就没反应。
dialogText.en: Weird... How come nothing happens when I touch them?

dialogText.cn: 因为息壤依然“记得”您。
dialogText.en: That's because Xiranite still "remembers" you.

dialogText.cn: 它诞生自您和宏科院的大胆设想。
dialogText.en: It was created from the bold vision you shared with HAS.

dialogText.cn: 息壤是协议源石技术的衍生，管理员自然参与过。陈，你是不是没看过技术中枢的简报……
dialogText.en: Xiranite is an offshoot of the Protorig technology, so of course the Endmin was involved. Chen, didn't you read the reports from the Technical Axis?

dialogText.cn: 当年的设想中，息壤可以遏制裂隙，阻止侵蚀，甚至能够净化被污染的土地与水源。
dialogText.en: Xiranite was first envisioned as a way to seal rifts, stop the Blight from spreading, and cleanse polluted land and water.

dialogText.cn: 我们花费十数年才将制作工艺简化，让息壤得以规模生产，并成为这座城市的核心……
dialogText.en: It took us over a decade to simplify the manufacturing process, so Xiranite could be mass-produced and become the city's core...

dialogText.cn: 啊？管理员是“息壤计划”的开创者？！
dialogText.en: Wait — the Endmin actually started Project Xiranite?!

dialogText.cn: 我当然看了！……但做不到像你一样把过往三十年的信息全记住嘛。
dialogText.en: Of course I read it! …But I can't magically memorize thirty years' worth of reports like you!

dialogText.cn: 不过，我不想破坏惊喜。
dialogText.en: That said, I'd rather not ruin the surprise.

dialogText.cn: 息壤……
dialogText.en: Xiranite...

dialogText.cn: 我在城郊早早留了一块未开发的区域作为工业用地。
dialogText.en: I had already designated a plot on the city's outskirts for industrial use.

dialogText.cn: 是我该谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: I should be the one thanking you.

dialogText.cn: 有你们在，我觉得……
dialogText.en: With all of you here, I feel...

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endministrator...

dialogText.cn: 希望武陵能让您回忆起些什么，人也好，事也好……
dialogText.en: I hope Wuling invokes your memories — its people, its stories...

dialogText.cn: 什么都好。
dialogText.en: Or anything lingering in your heart.

dialogText.cn: 我安排了一位向导，协助诸位前往。
dialogText.en: I have also arranged for a guide to assist you on the way there.

dialogText.cn: 是让我觉得好像回到了从前。
dialogText.en: Like stepping back into the past.

dialogText.cn: 那时，大家都还在，您也在。
dialogText.en: Yes. When everyone was still around, including you.

dialogText.cn: 每个人都充满信心，以为世上没有无法攻克的难题，不会有人失望，不会有人离开。
dialogText.en: Back then everyone was full of hope. We all believed that every problem had a solution — that no one would lose hope or walk away.

dialogText.cn: 大哥！发生啥了，要帮忙吗？
dialogText.en: Hey! What's going on? Need a hand?

dialogText.cn: 帮什么忙？还不快走！天使随时会再次袭击！
dialogText.en: A hand? What I need is for you to scram! Those Aggeloi could hit again any minute!

dialogText.cn: 货！我的货还没拿呢！
dialogText.en: Oh no, no! My goods!

dialogText.cn: 哎！你要真想帮忙，就拉他进城！
dialogText.en: Tch! If you really wanna help, then drag his ass into the city!

actorName.cn: 慌张的职农{e6m1-慌张的职农}

dialogText.cn: 警报声又响了！
dialogText.en: The alarm's going off again!

actorName.cn: 焦急的职农{e6m1-焦急的职农}

dialogText.cn: 快走！
dialogText.en: Hurry!

dialogText.cn: 刚才多亏几位出手相助。
dialogText.en: Thanks again for stepping in back there.

dialogText.cn: 举手之劳罢了。你呢，也要回城里吗？
dialogText.en: Ah, no biggie. Aren't you gonna head back to the city?

dialogText.cn: 我还有巡逻任务，有机会一定要谢谢诸位。
dialogText.en: No, I still have patrol duty. But I really do owe you all one.

dialogText.cn: 既然有迎宾客来接应各位，跟着它一路走就行了。
dialogText.en: Since the receptionist bot's here to escort you, just follow it and you'll be fine.

dialogText.cn: 那哪行，这可是救命的恩情。
dialogText.en: Nonsense! This was life-saving kindness!

dialogText.cn: 我叫蒲元，平时做些小本生意。刚才慌了神，各位见笑。
dialogText.en: My name's Pu Yuan and I run a small business. I was a bit shaken up earlier — sorry about that.

dialogText.cn: 有需要随时可以来找我啊，有好东西都给各位留着！
dialogText.en: Anytime you need help, just come find me! I'll save all the good stuff for you!

dialogText.cn: 晓雾姐！其实我们也是刚到武陵。
dialogText.en: Awww, Xiaowu! We actually just got to Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 你们是小陈的朋友？那跟着她一起叫我晓雾姐就行。
dialogText.en: Oh, are you Chen's friends? Please just call me Xiaowu like she does!

dialogText.cn: 回来得正好！一起跟我去选剑局试试新一批刀剑。
dialogText.en: Back just in time! Let's go to the Bureau of Swordmancers. We should test the new batch of swords together!

dialogText.cn: 求之不得——啊，不对，我们还要先去见庄天师。有公务。
dialogText.en: Would love to — ah, wait, no, we've got to meet Tianshi Zhuang first. Work stuff.

dialogText.cn: 啧，阿庄又和我抢人……算了算了。
dialogText.en: Tch. Fangyi stealing my people again... Whatever, fine.

dialogText.cn: 之后可别忘记来，我这里可有不少好东西。
dialogText.en: Don't forget to swing by later! I've got some real goodies to show you.

dialogText.cn: 陈，这位天师怎么称呼？
dialogText.en: Chen, could you please introduce this Tianshi to us?

dialogText.cn: 葛天师？你怎么又在挨学生批评啊？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Ge? Getting flak from your students again?

dialogText.cn: 咳，怎么是批评！这都是学术交流……
dialogText.en: Ahem, how is this... This is purely academic exchange...!

dialogText.cn: 不对，小陈？！你怎么回武陵来了？
dialogText.en: Hold on, Chen?! What brings you back to Wuling?

dialogText.cn: 我这次是代表终末地来的。
dialogText.en: I'm here on behalf of Endfield this time.

dialogText.cn: 终末地？你加入终末地工业了？
dialogText.en: Endfield? You joined Endfield Industries?

dialogText.cn: 走走走，正好去研究所帮我看看项目进展！
dialogText.en: Come on, come on, perfect timing! You can help me check on the project progress at the Research Center!

dialogText.cn: 唉，可惜了……
dialogText.en: Ah, what a shame...

dialogText.cn: ……那可太好了！
dialogText.en: ...Oh, I'm so happy for you!

dialogText.cn: 有空了记得来看看啊。
dialogText.en: Alright, be sure to drop by when you have time.

dialogText.cn: 我们殿后，你们就先避难去吧！
dialogText.en: We got this. Go, get inside the city!

dialogText.cn: 好、好吧！你们保重！
dialogText.en: O-Okay... Stay safe out here!

dialogText.cn: 警报还没解除？
dialogText.en: Why's the alarm still going?

dialogText.cn: 深度没有恢复正常，可能还会有危险……
dialogText.en: The Depth readings haven't stabilized. There might be more trouble coming...

dialogText.cn: ……是武陵区管代，<@qu.key>庄方宜</>。
dialogText.en: She's <@qu.key>Zhuang Fangyi</>, the Viceroy of Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 那一手天师府雷法，整个宏科院，没几个人能出其右！
dialogText.en: That Tianshi Bureau Lei Fa (Thunder Arts) — barely anyone in the entire HAS can match her!

dialogText.cn: 身份识别无误——终末地来客，三位，数据同步完成。
dialogText.en: Identity confirmed. Three guests from Endfield. Data sync complete.

dialogText.cn: 迎宾客！好久没见过了！
dialogText.en: It's the receptionist bot! Awww, I've missed you!

dialogText.cn: 欢迎回到武陵，陈千语小姐。以及，欢迎佩丽卡监督，欢迎管理员。
dialogText.en: Welcome back to Wuling, Miss Chen Qianyu. Welcome, Supervisor Perlica. And welcome, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 请随我来，庄天师会在<@qu.key>总桩</>正式会见各位。
dialogText.en: Please follow me. She will meet with you formally at the <@qu.key>Main Pillar</>.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，S.O.W.有她的基本信息。只是没想到她的源石技艺这么地……壮观。
dialogText.en: Truly exceptional. I have reviewed her basic information in SOW, but I did not realize her Originium Arts could be so ... remarkable.

dialogText.cn: 话说回来，阵列在正常运作，而且还有巡卫在。居然需要庄天师亲自出手吗？
dialogText.en: Wait, if the array's working and watchguards are out, why would Tianshi Zhuang step in herself?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……也许武陵的情况并没有表面上那么乐观。
dialogText.en: Hmm... Perhaps things in Wuling are not as stable as they appear.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师已经知悉各位的到来。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang has been informed of your arrival.

dialogText.cn: 真没想到我又回到武陵城了……
dialogText.en: Never thought I'd be back in Wuling City again...

dialogText.cn: 您的请求无法受理——未查询到此项功能。
dialogText.en: Unable to process your request — feature not found.

dialogText.cn: 没事，管理员。城里还有其他载具。
dialogText.en: It's okay, Endmin. There will be vehicles in the city.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳！武陵还是这么繁华！还多了……那么大的龙泡泡！
dialogText.en: *Cough*Cough* Wuling's just as bustling as ever! And now there's even... Oh my! That's a ginormous Chubby Lung!

dialogText.cn: ……说真的，那个龙泡泡有点可爱，好想戳一下。
dialogText.en: Seriously it's kinda cute. I wanna poke it so bad...

dialogText.cn: 那我就把购买龙泡泡加入与庄天师的合作计划中了？
dialogText.en: Hmm ... guess I'll add procuring a Chubby Lung to our cooperation plan with Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 诸位请随我穿过方兴衢，前面就是总桩。
dialogText.en: Distinguished guests, kindly follow me through Fangxing Avenue. The Main Pillar is just ahead.

dialogText.cn: 武陵——！我又回来啦——！！
dialogText.en: Wuling — I'm back!!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，陈，我刚才也有点紧张，现在是彻底不担心了。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Chen. I was a bit nervous myself earlier, but now I feel completely at peace.

dialogText.cn: 如果你还是感觉不自在，可以转移一下注意力。
dialogText.en: If you are still unsettled, a distraction might help.

dialogText.cn: 转移注意力？
dialogText.en: Distraction?

dialogText.cn: 有、有必要吗？
dialogText.en: Uh... Do I have to?

dialogText.cn: 试试吧。总不能愁眉苦脸地去见庄天师。
dialogText.en: Give it a try. It's better than arriving tense and downcast before Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 那、那好吧！
dialogText.en: Alright, here I go!

dialogText.cn: 爸、爸爸——！
dialogText.en: P-PAPAAAA!

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐！事儿办完了？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu! Did you get everything settled?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，听说你们在城外还搭了把手，多谢了。
dialogText.en: Yeah, I heard you guys even pitched in outside the city. Thanks for that.

dialogText.cn: 按理说不该让客人亲自动手，但……算了。让他们见识一下管理员的力量，也是好事。
dialogText.en: We usually avoid letting guests deal with trouble, but … never mind. Those buggerloids got a taste of the Endministrator's power, it's a good thing.

dialogText.cn: 伸手试试。
dialogText.en: Put your hand out.

dialogText.cn: 是去头儿办公室的钥匙。
dialogText.en: It's the key to the boss' office.

dialogText.cn: 各位来宾，总桩到了。
dialogText.en: Distinguished guests, we've arrived at the Main Pillar.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，我带你们去见头儿。
dialogText.en: Alright, come with me. I'll take you to meet the boss.

dialogText.cn: 本次行程已结束，期待各位在武陵过得开心。
dialogText.en: This concludes our journey. I hope you enjoy your time in Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 我在外面等你们。
dialogText.en: I'll wait out here.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师的办公室……总桩的核心！有点期待呢！
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang's office ... the very heart of the Main Pillar! I'm getting a little excited!

dialogText.cn: 这地方可不是谁都能进的，嘿嘿，算是沾了管理员的光啦！
dialogText.en: Heh! Not just anyone gets to waltz in here! I got lucky riding the Endmin's coattails!

dialogText.cn: 是个天才。临危受命，鞠躬尽瘁。
dialogText.en: An absolute genius. She took command in crisis and gave everything right till the end.

dialogText.cn: 只不过……
dialogText.en: However...

dialogText.cn: 你见到她就会知道了。
dialogText.en: You'll understand once you meet her.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这也是我们代表终末地，和武陵的正式会面。别让她等太久。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this also serves as Endfield's formal meeting with Wuling. Don't keep her waiting.

dialogText.cn: 还有别的事？
dialogText.en: Can I help you?

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，刚才抓到汤汤了吗？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu, did you catch Tangtang?

dialogText.cn: 中途过来个急事，只能先放她一马。
dialogText.en: I got caught up by something urgent midway, so I had to let her off the hook.

dialogText.cn: 你们记得少跟汤汤来往，她坏心眼很多。
dialogText.en: You'd better keep your distance from Tangtang. She's full of nasty tricks.

dialogText.cn: 看来是给汤汤跑掉了。
dialogText.en: Looks like Tangtang got away.

dialogText.cn: 紧张？放心吧，她又不会吃人。
dialogText.en: Are you nervous? Don't worry, she won't bite.

dialogText.cn: 去吧。
dialogText.en: Go.

dialogText.cn: 那就赶紧去吧。头儿见到你们，应该挺高兴的。
dialogText.en: Then hurry along. My boss will probably be quite pleased to see you.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，管理员，之前情况特殊，实在不方便待客——
dialogText.en: Apologies, Endministrator. Things have been complicated, and we didn't show you the proper hospitality.

dialogText.cn: 不用太拘谨，像从前一样随意称呼就好。
dialogText.en: Please skip the formality. Just speak to me as casually as you used to.

dialogText.cn: 这话倒的确像是您从前会说的。
dialogText.en: Now that ... really does sound like the old you.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，管理员刚苏醒不久，还在康复中。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, the Endmin has only recently awakened and is still recovering.

dialogText.cn: ……您的记忆果然尚未恢复。
dialogText.en: ...So your memories haven't fully returned after all.

dialogText.cn: 当年您来过武陵科考站交流，我作为见习天师随老师一起，和您短暂共事过。
dialogText.en: Back then, you came to the Wuling Science Station for an exchange... I was just a Tianshi Intern shadowing my mentor, but we briefly worked together.

dialogText.cn: 那时您还亲自指点过我。
dialogText.en: You even gave me personal guidance.

dialogText.cn: 短短几句，获益匪浅。
dialogText.en: Brief, but deeply insightful.

dialogText.cn: 叙旧留待以后吧。
dialogText.en: Let us leave the reminiscing for another time.

dialogText.cn: 时间匆忙，没来得及整理。
dialogText.en: Please excuse the mess. I didn't get a chance to tidy up.
Eh!?

dialogText.cn: 只是……
dialogText.en: But...

dialogText.cn: 谈正事之前，我得确保您了解武陵目前的状况。
dialogText.en: Before we proceed, allow me to brief you on Wuling's current situation.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？
dialogText.en: Hmm?

dialogText.cn: 不止聂菲斯，还有一个叫阿达希尔的也在帮她！
dialogText.en: She's not alone this time — A man named Ardashir is with her!

dialogText.cn: 碾骨氏族的先头部队已经来到武陵。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers have arrived in Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 一墙之外，就是翻滚的侵蚀潮水，武陵城能有这样的安宁，实在是了不起。
dialogText.en: With the Blight Tide rolling relentlessly just outside ... it is truly impressive that Wuling City manages to maintain such peace.

dialogText.cn: 只可惜这份安宁的背后，敌人在蠢蠢欲动。
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, while everything seems quiet, the enemies are already stirring behind the scenes.

dialogText.cn: 这一周内，有多处天师桩被损毁，虽无法直接动摇阵列，但他们无疑在威胁城市的安定。
dialogText.en: Several Tianshi Pillars have been destroyed over the past week. The array still holds, but these losses are clearly threatening the city's stability.

dialogText.cn: 是聂菲斯的帮凶？
dialogText.en: Is he one of Nefarith's allies?

dialogText.cn: 如果仅仅是“帮凶”，那反倒好办了。
dialogText.en: If he was really just her ally, things would be more simple.

dialogText.cn: 当下我们唯一能做的，只有尽快提升息壤产量，确保天师桩阵列照常运行。
dialogText.en: For now, all we can do is increase Xiranite output to keep the array stable.

dialogText.cn: 的确，杞人忧天也是无用，还是先做好准备吧。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Worrying gets us nowhere. Let's focus on what we can prepare.

dialogText.cn: 我听说了。但根据工团同步的情报，她在武陵的行动似乎和先前大不相同。
dialogText.en: I've been informed. But based on the UWST's updates, her activity in Wuling is quite unlike before.

dialogText.cn: 他使用的法术不吻合当代源石技艺理论，以及，他似乎懂得一门少见的语言……
dialogText.en: His Arts do not align with any modern Originium Arts framework. And ... he seems fluent in a language we barely recognize.

dialogText.cn: “阿达希尔”，古萨尔贡语？
dialogText.en: Ardashir... Hmm ... could it be ancient Sargonian?

dialogText.cn: 不，更古怪。
dialogText.en: No, it's more esoteric.
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 各位留步，城郊天使频出，此处禁止通行。
dialogText.en: Please halt. There have been frequent Aggeloi sightings outside the city. No one's allowed through right now.

dialogText.cn: 如有事务，请出示安全通行证。
dialogText.en: If you're here on official business, please present your passes.

dialogText.cn: 没事，都没受伤，小状况。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, just small scratches.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，水泵和给水器的制作方法，已经附在武陵工业计划里了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, production details for Fluid Pump and Fluid Supply Unit have been attached to the Wuling AIC Plan.

dialogText.cn: 塌方……还堵上了水渠！这里是为试验田供水的，有点棘手呀。
dialogText.en: A landslide? And it took out the irrigation channels too. This feeds the experimental fields... This is quite a headache.

dialogText.cn: 你别急，我先联系纪叔，看能不能从城里请几位工程天师过来。
dialogText.en: Let me call Uncle Ji. Hope he can get Tianshi Engineers from the city to help us.

dialogText.cn: 别，大家都忙得够呛。我们自己想办法吧。
dialogText.en: Don't. Everyone's busy enough as it is. Let's handle this ourselves.

dialogText.cn: 白霜，回单位换个天师仪，就用你刚才那股傻劲儿，清理起来应该不难——
dialogText.en: Bai Shuang, go get another Tianshi apparatus. After that stunt you just pulled, clearing this mess should be no problem.

dialogText.cn: 不过，清理要花不少时间吧。
dialogText.en: But ... won't that take a really long time?

dialogText.cn: 那还能怎么办？放着这条干水渠不管？职农们不会乐意的。
dialogText.en: You got a better idea? Just leave this dry canal as is? The farmers won't be happy.
*Weep*

dialogText.cn: 啊！协议核心！
dialogText.en: Ah, the Automation-Core!

dialogText.cn: 对呀，还有集成工业系统呢！正好见识见识庄天师所说的“无中生有”！
dialogText.en: That's right! We can use the AIC Factory. Time to see what Tianshi Zhuang meant by "creating something out of nothing"!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……深度读数没有恢复正常，确实不能浪费时间……
dialogText.en: Hmm... The Depth readings still haven't stabilized. We really can't afford to waste any time...

dialogText.cn: 没想到竟然要反过来请求各位的帮助，终末地的诸位，就麻烦你们了。
dialogText.en: Never thought we'd be the ones asking for help... Endfielders, we're counting on you.

dialogText.cn: 彦宁姐！小霜！你们没事吧？
dialogText.en: Yan Ning, Shuang, are you guys okay?

dialogText.cn: 对、对不起，刚才有一只小蟠兽，我以为是天使，下意识就……
dialogText.en: S-sorry, I got jump-scared by a pantailbeast... I thought it was an Aggelos so...

dialogText.cn: 我、我没有在怪你！你们没事就好！只是这里的水转眼就被耗空了，得赶紧补上才行。
dialogText.en: I-I'm not blaming you! Glad you're safe. But this water will be gone soon if we don't act fast.

dialogText.cn: 我们开始吧。
dialogText.en: Let us begin.

dialogText.cn: 要是不尽快恢复，不仅他们的基础用水会受影响，连给水系统的末端监测都会受阻。
dialogText.en: If we don't fix it soon, it won't just affect the water supply, but it'll also disrupt monitoring at the far end of the system.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，息壤相关的工业技术还在准备中，也许我们可以先把——
dialogText.en: The Xiranite-related AIC technologies are still in preparation. Perhaps we could first...
AHHHHH!

dialogText.cn: 小霜？！发生什么了？！
dialogText.en: That's Shuang! What happened?!

dialogText.cn: ……先去看看吧。
dialogText.en: Let's go check on her...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……虽然有临时的供能方案，但可能要花点时间……
dialogText.en: Hmm... We have temporary power supply solutions, but they will take time to implement...

dialogText.cn: 正好，见识过终末地的技术，也该武陵显显身手了。
dialogText.en: Heh, now that we've seen what Endfield can do, it's time for Wuling to shine a little.

dialogText.cn: 白霜，我们之前不是准备过最后一批息壤中继器和供电桩吗？
dialogText.en: Bai Shuang, didn't we prepare a final batch of Xiranite Relays and Electric Pylons before?

dialogText.cn: 啊！我明白了，老师！
dialogText.en: Ohhh, that's right! I get it now!

dialogText.cn: 在息壤匮乏的现在，这些已经算是奢侈的消耗品了。就算执行关键任务，配额也少得可怜。
dialogText.en: With Xiranite this scarce, these are practically luxury items. Even critical operations get limited quota.

dialogText.cn: 但是比起我，终末地工业一定能更好地运用。
dialogText.en: But I'm sure Endfield Industries can make better use of them than I could.

dialogText.cn: 所以，别客气。
dialogText.en: So please, go ahead.

dialogText.cn: 如果要做到自动化的源石工业……那能源怎么处理？
dialogText.en: If we want to automate the Originium industry ... how should we handle the power issue?

dialogText.cn: 它们可以自动连接周围的息壤电力设备，应该能帮上忙。
dialogText.en: They can automatically connect to nearby Xiranite power facilities. Should be able to help.

dialogText.cn: 都通了都通了！老师，给水器运转正常！
dialogText.en: It's working! Ma'am, the Fluid Supply Unit's working!

dialogText.cn: 原来这就是集成工业系统，不仅胜在便利性，其生产的设备还有很高的源石适应性……
dialogText.en: So this is the AIC Factory... Not just convenient, but its facilities show remarkable Originium compatibility...

dialogText.cn: 老师，下次做实验，我们能不能也带一套这种新设备过去？
dialogText.en: Ma'am, next time we do field experiments, can we bring a set of this equipment with us?

dialogText.cn: 呵呵，一套可不够。
dialogText.en: Heh, we're gonna need more than one set.
Huh...?

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？
dialogText.en: What's wrong?

dialogText.cn: 深度读数在缓慢升高……也许前面就是侵蚀覆盖区。
dialogText.en: Depth readings are gradually increasing... We might be approaching the Blighted zone.

dialogText.cn: 那好说，来都来了，帮人帮到底！
dialogText.en: Well then, since we're already here, we'll help all the way!

dialogText.cn: 嗯。既然武陵的天使依水而生，前方说不定会出现天使。
dialogText.en: Given how Wuling's Aggeloi are waterborne, we may encounter some further in.

dialogText.cn: 那我也……
dialogText.en: Then I'll...

dialogText.cn: 不，你得留下看着集成工业系统。万一天使出现在这里怎么办？
dialogText.en: No. You stay and keep an eye on the AIC Factory. What if the Aggeloi show up here instead?

dialogText.cn: 刚刚落地的重要设备，再有闪失，我可真承担不起。
dialogText.en: The factory is crucial and we just got it running. We can't afford any damage to it.

dialogText.cn: 可我……
dialogText.en: But I...

dialogText.cn: 好吧。你们先去，我留着照看这里。
dialogText.en: Alright, fine. I'll stay and watch over everything here.

dialogText.cn: 还有什么事情吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: Is there anything else I can help you with, Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 因为这是我们的生活方式。
dialogText.en: Because this is our way of life.

dialogText.cn: 什、什么？难道是抽屉里的油焖笋罐头……我记得关好了呀……
dialogText.en: R-really? Could it be the canned bamboo shoots in the drawer… I remember I closed it properly...

dialogText.cn: 咳。加班的时候我很少离开这个房间，弭弗准备了一些方便食品。
dialogText.en: Ahem. I rarely leave this room when working late... So Mi Fu stocked some instant food for me.

dialogText.cn: 不过，还是去方兴衢逛逛吧，那里的美食更多。
dialogText.en: But we should head over to Fangxing Avenue. That's where the real food is.

dialogText.cn: 当然可以！盒蛋、水杯、玩偶……您想要哪些？
dialogText.en: Absolutely! Gacha, mugs, plushies ... which ones are you interested in?

dialogText.cn: 还有今年刚出的限量贴纸，我特地多收了一套……
dialogText.en: Oh, there's a limited-edition sticker set released this year. I managed to secure an extra set...

dialogText.cn: 选剑局就在总桩斜对面，您出去就能看到。
dialogText.en: It's right across from the Main Pillar. You will see it when you step outside.

dialogText.cn: 只是晓雾她……想法跳脱，除了好东西，怪东西也不少，您最好……注意点。
dialogText.en: Ah, it's just that Xiaowu... her ideas can be quite... unconventional. Alongside the brilliant stuff, there's also the downright bizarre. You'd best... keep an eye out.

dialogText.cn: 在塔卫二，任何一块宜居区域都是难能可贵的。
dialogText.en: On Talos-II, every habitable zone is precious. Hard-won, harder to keep.

dialogText.cn: 武陵科考站确实建立在危险的边陲，可靠着一代人的努力，它已经变成了如今的面貌。
dialogText.en: The Wuling Science Station was built on the edge of danger. But thanks to a generation's sweat and stubbornness, look at what it's become.

dialogText.cn: 既然如此，大炎人就不会放弃生活……不会放弃对美食，对商贸，对文化的追求。
dialogText.en: Such is the Yanese spirit. We won't surrender our way of life... Not our food, our trade, our culture. None of it.

dialogText.cn: 哪怕是在侵蚀潮的正中心。
dialogText.en: Not even when living at the heart of the Blight Tide.

dialogText.cn: 当然……武陵城的诞生，还有更多的意义。
dialogText.en: Of course... Wuling City's birth carries far greater significance.

dialogText.cn: 不过，这就不是现在应该向您谈及的了。等您更了解这座城市的时候，我会告诉您的。
dialogText.en: But that's not a story for now... I will tell you when you've learned this city properly.

dialogText.cn: 啊。如果您指的是商业方面的合作，武陵也可以向终末地工业授权使用龙泡泡形象。
dialogText.en: And if you are referring to a business collaboration, Wuling can grant Endfield licensing rights to use Chubby Lung's IP.

dialogText.cn: 好……我会等着您的好消息。
dialogText.en: Very well... I will await your good news.

dialogText.cn: 谈妥了？我就说她很好说话吧。
dialogText.en: Sealed the deal? I told you, she won't bite.

dialogText.cn: 行了，别八卦了。你们不是还要去办事吗？快出发吧。
dialogText.en: Alright, gossip time's over. Don't you have things to handle? Off you go then.

dialogText.cn: “亲近”……也可以这么说吧。我只是觉得头儿很厉害。
dialogText.en: Close...? I guess? I do look up to her though.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我从来不懂她在想啥。其实我也不需要弄懂，只要听她的就行。
dialogText.en: But honestly, I've never been able to figure out what she's thinking. I guess I don't really have to. I just do what she says.

dialogText.cn: “信任”？
dialogText.en: Trust?

dialogText.cn: 我觉得，我和她之间已经没必要谈论“信任”这个话题了。
dialogText.en: Honestly, between her and me, that topic's long past needing discussion.

dialogText.cn: “诸位，我是庄天师安排……”
dialogText.en: "Hello everyone, I was assigned by Tianshi Zhuang to..."

dialogText.cn: 请干什么？
dialogText.en: Please what?

dialogText.cn: 终末地的客人是吧？
dialogText.en: Oh, you must be the guests from Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 不对，不该先报庄天师的名号。
dialogText.en: Wait, no. I shouldn't mention Tianshi Zhuang first.

dialogText.cn: “我是武陵巡卫……见习巡卫黎风……”
dialogText.en: "I'm a Wuling Watchguard... Hmm... I'm Trainee Watchguard Lifeng..."

dialogText.cn: 应该先打招呼，对方可是贵宾……
dialogText.en: Maybe I should start with a proper greeting since they're VIPs...

dialogText.cn: “终末地的管理员，佩丽卡监督，陈千语女士，诸位贵客请……”
dialogText.en: "Distinguished guests from Endfield, Endministrator, Supervisor Perlica, Miss Chen Qianyu, please..."
WHOA!

dialogText.cn: 你好，你是在等我们吗？
dialogText.en: Greetings. Are you waiting for us?

dialogText.cn: 正、正是！
dialogText.en: Y-yes, Ma'am!

dialogText.cn: 诸位好！我是见习巡卫庄天风，负责带各位前往预留地点！
dialogText.en: Greetings! I'm Trainee Watchguard Zhuang Tianshi. Please allow me to lead you to the designated spot.

dialogText.cn: 好的，庄天风先生——
dialogText.en: Sure thing, Mr. Zhuang Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 不对！是<@qu.key>黎风</>，我叫黎风！
dialogText.en: Wait, no! It's <@qu.key>Lifeng</>. My name's Lifeng!

dialogText.cn: 不好意思，今天是我第一次执行公务……
dialogText.en: Sorry, this is my first time on duty...

dialogText.cn: 理解理解，你这个年纪就能在弭弗姐手底下见习，已经很不错啦。还有，叫我千语姐就好。
dialogText.en: Hey, relax! You serve under Mi Fu, right? That's impressive for your age! And please, just call me Qianyu.

dialogText.cn: 谢、谢谢！诸位的通行证件已经办好，请随我来。
dialogText.en: T-thank you! Your passes are all set, please follow me.

dialogText.cn: 纪叔，我带——
dialogText.en: Uncle Ji! I'm back with...

dialogText.cn: 庄天师的消息传这么快吗？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang's message sure travels fast, huh?

dialogText.cn: 昨天黎风念叨了一下午，我还能记不住？
dialogText.en: Oh, come on. Lifeng was going on about it all afternoon yesterday.

dialogText.cn: 这么敬业呀！
dialogText.en: Wow, such dedication!

dialogText.cn: 只、只是不想出错……
dialogText.en: I-I just don't want to mess things up...

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，年轻人，脸皮这么薄可当不成巡卫！
dialogText.en: Kiddo, if you're this easy to fluster, you'll never make it as a watchguard!

dialogText.cn: 行了，证件都没问题，干活去吧。
dialogText.en: Alright alright, take these passes and get going.

dialogText.cn: 是！
dialogText.en: Yes, Sir!

dialogText.cn: 诸位，这边请。
dialogText.en: Right this way, everyone.

dialogText.cn: 那边不是小霜和彦宁姐吗？
dialogText.en: Isn't that Shuang and Yan Ning?

dialogText.cn: 熟人？要去打个招呼吗？
dialogText.en: You know them? Wanna go say hi?

dialogText.cn: 呃，不用，她们应该在处理侵蚀——
dialogText.en: Uh, it's fine. They're probably busy dealing with the Blight...

dialogText.cn: 黎风！黎风！！
dialogText.en: Lifeng! Lifeng!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 好的！老师！
dialogText.en: Okay! Got it!

dialogText.cn: 不对劲！快后退！水下有东西！
dialogText.en: Contact below! Fall back NOW!

dialogText.cn: 不错嘛，第一次执行公务，像模像样的。是不是过几天就能跟着弭长官威风凛凛地到处“救火”了？
dialogText.en: Not bad at all! First official duty, and you already look the part! What's next? Tagging along with Captain Mi in a blaze of glory, putting out "fires" all over the place?

dialogText.cn: 我当巡卫又不是为了耍威风……
dialogText.en: Look, I didn't become a watchguard to show off...

dialogText.cn: 好了，别一见面就斗嘴，集成工业系统事关重大，先忙正事。
dialogText.en: Alright, you two. The Automated Industry Complex is important business. Stay focused.

dialogText.cn: 大家伙儿盼星星盼月亮，可算盼到你了。
dialogText.en: Everyone's been counting the minutes, and finally, here you are!

dialogText.cn: 自我介绍一下，我是武陵息壤应用与技术生产单位的负责人彦宁，这是我的学生白霜。
dialogText.en: Let me introduce myself. I'm Yan Ning, head of the Wuling Xiranite Application and Tech Production Unit. And this is my student, Bai Shuang.

dialogText.cn: 我们负责这附近的灾害预警任务，正在收集数据，看看是否需要现场采取措施。
dialogText.en: Right now, we're handling hazard monitoring for this area, gathering intel to see if we need to roll out boots-on-the-ground measures.

dialogText.cn: 听说管理员已经抵达武陵，所以我想提前……白霜，天师仪往右三度！
dialogText.en: I heard the Endmin was here in Wuling, so I got things prepped early... Bai Shuang, turn the apparatus, three degrees to the right!

dialogText.cn: 有一些关于天使和侵蚀的情况，需要知会一下各位……
dialogText.en: There's something about the Aggeloi and the Blight that you should know...

dialogText.cn: 天使怎么会侵入阵列内？
dialogText.en: How did Aggeloi breach the array?

dialogText.cn: 可是彦宁姐，之前不是说都在控制之内……情况到底有多糟？
dialogText.en: Yan Ning, you said everything was under control... How bad is it really?

dialogText.cn: ……为此，我必须向终末地的各位道歉。
dialogText.en: Well... I must apologize to everyone from Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 息壤储量告急，为了优先保证城区安全，我们关闭了这里的部分天师桩，导致侵蚀出现在了阵列内。
dialogText.en: With Xiranite reserves running low, we prioritized the safety of the city proper by deactivating some of the Tianshi Pillars here. That's why the array was compromised.

dialogText.cn: 本来，我们打算在各位抵达前重启天师桩，尽可能解决掉侵蚀和天使……
dialogText.en: We planned to reactivate them before your arrival to clear out the Blight and Aggeloi, but...

dialogText.cn: 我们知道具体状况，你们不用自责。
dialogText.en: Don't blame yourselves. We understand what you are going through.

dialogText.cn: ……谢谢。看来阿庄有告诉你们现在的情况。
dialogText.en: Thank you... Fangyi must have briefed you.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师和武陵城面对的压力，恐怕比她自己说的还要大。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang and Wuling City are shouldering more than she has admitted.

dialogText.cn: 得尽快降下协议核心了……
dialogText.en: We need to deploy the PAC as soon as possible...

dialogText.cn: 千语姐，庄天师和我说，你们会建一个比现在所有息壤生产设施都厉害的“工厂”，对吧？
dialogText.en: Qianyu, Tianshi Zhuang said you're going to build a "factory," and it'll top every other Xiranite production facility. Is that true?

dialogText.cn: 也就是说，以后天师们不再需要在研究所里日以继夜，它就可以自动生产息壤了？
dialogText.en: Does this factory support automatic Xiranite production, so the Tianshi won't have to work day and night in the lab anymore?

dialogText.cn: 这就是集成工业系统的目标！
dialogText.en: Yes. That's exactly what we want to achieve with the AIC Factory!

dialogText.cn: 那走吧，诸位，可以加紧脚步了！
dialogText.en: Alright then, everyone, let's pick up the pace!

dialogText.cn: 武陵的天使来自于侵蚀潮深处的一根锚点，有侵蚀潮的地方，天使就会席卷过来……
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi in Wuling come from an Ankhor deep within the Blight Tide. Wherever the tide flows, they follow...

dialogText.cn: 但实在不好意思！我和老师现在已经捉襟见肘了！
dialogText.en: We're truly sorry... Every resource is stretched thin!

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，我们会在各位前往预留地点的同时，继续设法遏制侵蚀灾害。
dialogText.en: While you head to the reserved site, we'll continue doing everything we can to contain the Blight disaster.

dialogText.cn: 既然交代完了，我们还要赶去下一个地点……黎风，继续带路吧。
dialogText.en: Now if you'll excuse us, we have to hurry to the next location... Lifeng, please take care of them.

dialogText.cn: 确认符合部署条件，已上传坐标位置。
dialogText.en: Conditions met. Coordinates uploaded.

dialogText.cn: 准备就绪。管理员，下达指令吧。
dialogText.en: We are good to go, Endmin. Please issue the command.

dialogText.cn: 轨道空投……第一次亲眼见到。
dialogText.en: Wow, orbital drop ... never seen it before.

dialogText.cn: 所以，要不要和天上的干员们打个招呼？他们能看到哦！
dialogText.en: Wanna wave to our operators up there? They can see us, you know!

dialogText.cn: 心急吃不了热豆腐，我们还有一些准备工作需要做。
dialogText.en: Not so fast. We've got prep work first.

dialogText.cn: ……别把我当小孩啊！我结业的时候，动力学和中级物理课程都是第一名！
dialogText.en: Hey! Don't treat me like a kid! I aced Dynamics and Intermediate Physics. Top of my class!

dialogText.cn: 第、第一？动力学课程不是天书吗……
dialogText.en: T-top?! But Dynamics was practically written in eldritch runes...!

dialogText.cn: ……嘿，你终于笑了。对嘛，放松点，有终末地在，都会好起来的。
dialogText.en: ...Heh. There you go, finally smiling. Just relax a little! Our Endmin's here, everything will work out.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，亲眼见识到协议核心，我也开始有信心了……那接下来呢？
dialogText.en: Yeah, seeing the PAC myself really gives me hope... So, what's next?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们先看看武陵的工业计划吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's review the Wuling AIC Plan.

dialogText.cn: 我们得尽快过去。
dialogText.en: We must hurry over.

dialogText.cn: 数据是采完了，只是……
dialogText.en: I got the data, but...

dialogText.cn: 结果不乐观？
dialogText.en: Are the results unfavorable?

dialogText.cn: 我们眼前这块侵蚀……在扩大。
dialogText.en: The Blight ahead of us is ... spreading.

dialogText.cn: 是的，放在以往，侵蚀不可能以这样的速度扩散。
dialogText.en: Yes. Normally, there's no way it would spread this fast.

dialogText.cn: 所以……我先前的计算……
dialogText.en: Which means my earlier calculations were...

dialogText.cn: 各位，集成工——
dialogText.en: Everyone, the AIC Factory...

dialogText.cn: 三个月，对吧？
dialogText.en: Three months, right?

dialogText.cn: 阿庄，你就说实话吧，息壤的量现在是不是连三个月都撑不住？你连自己人都要虚报吗？
dialogText.en: Fangyi, level with us. Do we even have three months' worth of Xiranite left? You wouldn't falsify reports to your own people, would you?

dialogText.cn: 此消彼长，难道真有一天，你要拿自己的血肉之躯充当息壤？！
dialogText.en: Bit by bit, we're losing ground. Until what? You start feeding your own flesh and blood into the production of Xiranite?!

dialogText.cn: 我会处理好。我也更需要你们坚守在自己的岗位上。
dialogText.en: I will handle everything. But I do need all of you to stay focused on your own posts.
Fine...

dialogText.cn: 你干你的，我干我的。我就不该担心你会把自己累死。
dialogText.en: You do your job. I'll do mine. Should've known better than to worry you'd work yourself to death.

dialogText.cn: 白霜，拿好数据，按照常规流程，递交息壤中心实验室，给“庄管代”。
