dialogText.en: Bai Shuang, take the data and submit it to the Xiranite Central Laboratory. And do follow the standard procedure, address it to Viceroy Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 嗯。通行权限已解锁。烦请诸位，来息壤中心实验室找我。
dialogText.en: Mm. Access permissions have been granted. Please go to the Xiranite Central Laboratory. I will see you there.

dialogText.cn: 彦宁天师，白霜天师，我们先行一步啦。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Yan Ning, Tianshi Bai Shuang, bye-bye for now!

dialogText.cn: 唉……真难看。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* That was pathetic...

dialogText.cn: 管理员……也就只有你们能帮她了。
dialogText.en: Endmin ... you're the only ones who can help her now.

dialogText.cn: 什、什么？但阵列内就算出现侵蚀，遍布武陵的息壤应该也会降低它的活性……
dialogText.en: W-what? But even if there's Blight inside the array, shouldn't the widespread Xiranite across Wuling reduce its activity...?

dialogText.cn: 时间急迫，诸位如果要去实验室的话，从居民区过去更快！
dialogText.en: The clock's ticking. Quickest path to the lab's through the housing blocks!

dialogText.cn: 好啦！事情都告一段落了，赶紧去找庄天师商量一下息壤生产的事情呗。
dialogText.en: Alright! Now that things have settled down, let's go find Tianshi Zhuang and figure out our Xiranite production plan.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，出发吧。
dialogText.en: Mm... Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 对了，管理员，如果有一天，武陵的情况没有那么紧急了……我也能去帝江号上看看吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, after things calm down in Wuling ... could I please have a tour of Dijiang?

dialogText.cn: 嗯？还没正式当上巡卫就想跳槽啦？
dialogText.en: Whoa, you're not even a full-time watchguard yet, and you're already thinking about job hopping?

dialogText.cn: 没有！
dialogText.en: That's not what I meant!

dialogText.cn: 我是觉得……我还有很多需要学习的东西。
dialogText.en: It's just that ... I still have a lot to learn.

dialogText.cn: 那，约好了啊！诸位，回见！
dialogText.en: It's a promise then! See you around, everyone!

dialogText.cn: 之后要是顺路的话，再去趟选剑局吧。
dialogText.en: And we can swing by Hongshan Swordmancers later.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，眼瞅着要干不少架，看看能不能捞点更趁手的新装备……
dialogText.en: Yeah, might as well go there and grab sharper toys. We've got plenty of fights ahead...

dialogText.cn: ……佩丽卡？
dialogText.en: Perlica...?

dialogText.cn: 我试试看。
dialogText.en: I'll try.

dialogText.cn: 那就再好不过了。
dialogText.en: Really? That's good.

dialogText.cn: 惹了这么多麻烦，福波可得好好反省一下……
dialogText.en: The drone caused a serious mess. Fu Bo needs to review this properly...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，突然就把你扯进这种事来。
dialogText.en: Sorry for suddenly involving you in this.

dialogText.cn: 方兴衢经常为武陵居民准备各种活动。在危机四伏的武陵，这些活动是很能鼓舞士气的。
dialogText.en: Fangxing Avenue often hosts events for Wuling's residents. In a city encircled by threats, these gatherings do wonders for morale.

dialogText.cn: 而这个小家伙……是今天最重要的演员之一。
dialogText.en: And this little thing ... is one of the most important performers we have for today.

dialogText.cn: 我不希望你在履行终末地那些宏大使命的时候，却对你身后的人和事一无所知。
dialogText.en: The world-changing missions of Endfield may call. But if you become blind to those who support you, that would be a shame...

dialogText.cn: 只不过……看到那台跌跌撞撞，不知道要飞去哪里的天桩……
dialogText.en: But ... when I saw that malfunctioning sky pole ... darting about without a goal in mind...

dialogText.cn: 庄天师！你们也来看演出呀！
dialogText.en: Ah, Tianshi Zhuang? Here to watch the performance?

dialogText.cn: 竹沥奶茶新品！第二杯半价……哎！最后两杯送你们得了！
dialogText.en: New Bamboo Dew Milk Tea! Second cup half price!... Here! Just take the last two! On the house!

dialogText.cn: 一杯独饮开怀，两杯开启幸福！
dialogText.en: One for solitary joy, two to unlock happiness!

dialogText.cn: 总算卖完了！！那我就先收工了，拜！
dialogText.en: Finally sold them all! Time to call this shift! BYE!

dialogText.cn: 现在，你眼中的武陵是什么样的？
dialogText.en: Tell me, what is the Wuling you see?

dialogText.cn: 啊，快到时间了。
dialogText.en: Oh, it's almost time.

dialogText.cn: 回到你该去的地方吧。
dialogText.en: Time to take your proper spot.

dialogText.cn: 偶尔散散步……倒是能记起很多平时无暇去想的事情。
dialogText.en: An occasional walk ... does help with remembering things we barely think about when busy.

dialogText.cn: 之后可得给大家好好赔个礼。
dialogText.en: I'll find a way to make it up to everyone.

dialogText.cn: 你忘记过它，但它还记得你。
dialogText.en: Memory might have faded for you, but never for the city that waited.

dialogText.cn: 所以你是故意忙里偷闲，离开实验室的。
dialogText.en: So, you did plan this from the start, and gave yourself an excuse to leave the lab.

dialogText.cn: 本来，我安排了带你参观武陵的行程，做了详细的编排。
dialogText.en: My original plan involved a proper tour of Wuling with a rather detailed itinerary.

dialogText.cn: 我突然更希望，你能以更寻常的视角，体验一下这里的街道。
dialogText.en: ...I suddenly wanted you to walk these streets of Wuling not as a strategist, but as a wanderer.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，确实很突然。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Very sudden indeed.

dialogText.cn: 那这次突然的待客，武陵……表现得怎么样？
dialogText.en: So for this unexpected reception, how would you rate Wuling's ... performance?

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 有点累了？
dialogText.en: Tired?

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，刚才有点吵，我没有听清。
dialogText.en: I'm afraid I didn't really catch it back then because of the noise. Sorry.

dialogText.cn: 但我已经得到了想要的答案。
dialogText.en: But I already have the answer I need.

dialogText.cn: 其实从宏科院说你们会重返武陵起，我就期待着能给你讲讲这十年来的事。
dialogText.en: The moment the Academy told me about your return, I began rehearsing a decade's worth of stories.

dialogText.cn: 只是要做的太多，能讲的……反而太少。
dialogText.en: But there's too much to be done, and the stories worth sharing are few.

dialogText.cn: 那你想听些什么呢，管理员？
dialogText.en: Anything you feel like hearing, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 多到让人手足无措。
dialogText.en: I was completely overwhelmed.

dialogText.cn: 直到某天，我在一堆旧书中，读到一个土木天师留在扉页上的自问。
dialogText.en: Until one day, I read a question on the title page of an old book. It was a self-reflection written by a Tumu Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 我问了自己相同的问题，之后才终于下定决心提出申请……
dialogText.en: I asked myself the same question, and only submitted my applications after some deliberation...

dialogText.cn: “孩子们还能看见青山碧水吗？”
dialogText.en: "Will the young still see the verdant hills and rivers?"

dialogText.cn: 关于这个答案，就留给未来吧。
dialogText.en: One day, time will write that reply for us.

dialogText.cn: 此刻更重要的是眼前的威胁。
dialogText.en: But at this moment, the looming threat is what matters most.

dialogText.cn: 那我得好好想一想……
dialogText.en: That's ... something I need to think about...

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Mmm.

dialogText.cn: 在参加武陵科考团之前，我的选择有很多，问题也有很多。
dialogText.en: Before I joined the Wuling Science Expedition, I had many options ... and problems as well.

dialogText.cn: 就是这么简单的问题。
dialogText.en: It's just a very simple question.

dialogText.cn: 但在这片野蛮的土地上，这个问题突然抓住了我的心。
dialogText.en: But in this untamed land, that question claws at my chest. Unexpectedly, unrelentingly.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我很高兴你回到武陵。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'm truly happy to see you back.

dialogText.cn: 准备好去看看了吗？
dialogText.en: Ready to head over?

dialogText.cn: 请。
dialogText.en: This way, please.

dialogText.cn: 没问题，我在这里等你。
dialogText.en: Of course. I'll be waiting here.

dialogText.cn: 面板并未受损，请不要乱碰。
dialogText.en: Chassis undamaged. Please keep your paws off the hood.

dialogText.cn: 路径受阻，请及时清理。
dialogText.en: Path obstructed. Please clear the roads ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 需要协助！
dialogText.en: Assistance required!

dialogText.cn: 怎、怎么样了？
dialogText.en: So? Is it working?

dialogText.cn: ……加油？
dialogText.en: Er ... we've got this?

dialogText.cn: 成、成了！等下，数据！我去确认数据！
dialogText.en: It ... worked! Wait! Let me check the data!

dialogText.cn: 我也去！
dialogText.en: Me too!

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，虽然只是阶段性的成果。
dialogText.en: Yes, though it's just a first step.

dialogText.cn: 我们在寻找合适的参数，保证新的息壤生产设备能够适配协议核心。
dialogText.en: We're looking for a set of suitable parameters. They'll ensure the Xiranite production facilities are PAC-compatible.

dialogText.cn: 现在，我们已经完成了第一步，可以开始设计息壤生产设备的蓝图了。
dialogText.en: With the success of our first step, we can start designing the blueprints of said facilities.

dialogText.cn: 这……确实比预想的更快，辛苦各位天师了。
dialogText.en: Impressive ... and faster than expected. This could have only been achieved thanks to the Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，可得犒劳犒劳他们……
dialogText.en: Indeed. We should really give them some time to rest...

dialogText.cn: 我们的研发中心已经收到了来自天师们的数据。
dialogText.en: Our research center has just received data from the Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 不过，得到研发中心返回的蓝图，还需要些时间……
dialogText.en: However, it'll take a while to get the completed blueprints from them...

dialogText.cn: 这段时间，不如让我带管理员在中心实验室参观一番？
dialogText.en: While we wait, perhaps I can take the Endmin on a tour of the Central Laboratory.

dialogText.cn: 我一个人留在这里就够了。陈，你陪着管理员一起去吧。
dialogText.en: I can handle things on my own. Chen, why don't you join the tour as well?

dialogText.cn: 欸，不是有庄天师陪着吗？我也插不上话，不如……
dialogText.en: Me? Tianshi Zhuang has our Endmin covered. I can't add much. Maybe I should...

dialogText.cn: 千语刚回武陵，也有许多地方要去看看吧。
dialogText.en: Since Chen just returned to Wuling. Maybe there are places that she wants to visit again.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……城市变化太大了，我有点心痒痒……
dialogText.en: Heheh... Yeah, this city's changed a lot. I really wanna do some exploring...

dialogText.cn: 好吧……那就拜托庄天师了。
dialogText.en: Okay ... then I'm leaving our Endmin in your hands, Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Mmm.

dialogText.cn: 按照刚才的参数，再试一次！
dialogText.en: One more run. Same parameters.

dialogText.cn: 我吗？我没事的。
dialogText.en: Me? Thank you, but I'm alright.

dialogText.cn: 比起从几个月前就开始不断尝试的葛一朴、常沄他们，我的付出不足挂齿。
dialogText.en: Ge Yipu and Chang Yun spent months on this project without a break. Compared to them, my contributions pale.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢关心……
dialogText.en: I appreciate your concern.

dialogText.cn: 不过，真没想到管理员会对我说这句话。当年的您可是有过之而无不及啊。
dialogText.en: I never thought I'd hear you say this to me. The Endmin from my memories never showed restraint.

dialogText.cn: ……佩丽卡监督。
dialogText.en: ...Supervisor Perlica.

dialogText.cn: 科考站落成以来的报告资料，都存放在这儿。
dialogText.en: All reports and data generated since the founding of the Science Station are stored in this place.

dialogText.cn: 小庄，正好！我刚准备把这些材料给你……
dialogText.en: Zhuang! Just at the right time! I was about to give you these data reports...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？管理员？！
dialogText.en: Oh? The Endmin's here too?

dialogText.cn: 我陪管理员来找找以前的资料。
dialogText.en: I'm with the Endmin. We're looking for information from the past.

dialogText.cn: 那你直接告诉我，我给你们取来就好了呀！
dialogText.en: Oh, you should have told me, girl. I can easily retrieve them for you!

dialogText.cn: 没事，我都知道在哪儿。
dialogText.en: It's alright. I know where the records are.

dialogText.cn: 这些材料直接帮我送到佩丽卡监督那儿就行。
dialogText.en: As for these reports, please deliver them to Supervisor Perlica. Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，好，听你的。
dialogText.en: Haha. Alright, girl. I'll do as you say.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，走吧，应该就在这边。
dialogText.en: Let's go, Endmin. They should be over here.

dialogText.cn: 唉，难免有记混的时候嘛，帮我一起找找。
dialogText.en: Ah, well, there are moments when memories fail. Let's look for it together.

dialogText.cn: 资料室里还有一些，不再看看了？
dialogText.en: Don't you want to spend more time here? There are still some documents in the data room.

dialogText.cn: 说起来，一直都是我拉着你介绍这介绍那，都没来得及听听你对这座城市的感受。
dialogText.en: That being said, I was busy showing you around the place. I didn't even ask you how you felt about the city.

dialogText.cn: 倒是显得我有些不近人情。
dialogText.en: That was pretty rude of me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你觉得这里如何？
dialogText.en: So, Endmin. What do you think about this place?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，那你会喜欢上这里吗？
dialogText.en: Haha. Do you think you'll like this place?

dialogText.cn: 我没怀疑过这一点。
dialogText.en: Never doubted it.

dialogText.cn: 之所以想带你来这里，也只是分享一些当年的回忆。
dialogText.en: I brought you here because I wanted to share a few moments from the past.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督那边好像还得花些时间，我们去外面等等吧。
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica might need a while to get things done. Let's just wait outside.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，管理员，息壤生产设备的蓝图已经准备完毕，随时可以推进下一步的合作。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, Endmin, the blueprints for the Xiranite production facilities are ready. We can now progress to the next phase of our collaboration.

dialogText.cn: 好，我已经通知陈前往集成核心区域，我们在那里会合！
dialogText.en: Good. I've notified Chen to make her way to the Core AIC Area. Let's rendezvous there!

dialogText.cn: 不了……既然忙里偷闲过了，我也得回到材料研究所，再回总桩监控天师桩阵列。
dialogText.en: Thank you, but no... I've already taken my break, so it's time to get myself back to the Institute of Materials Science. Then I'll head to the Main Pillar and monitor the Tianshi Pillar Array.

dialogText.cn: 我也想。
dialogText.en: Me too.

dialogText.cn: 我随时就绪。
dialogText.en: I'm all ready.

dialogText.cn: 不过……让我最后道一声谢吧。
dialogText.en: Nevertheless ... do allow me to express my gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 很久很久了……我从未像现在这样心怀希望。
dialogText.en: An eternity passed... Yet now, hope stirs again.

dialogText.cn: 但其实从刚才开始，常沄就一直在给我发数据，看来是按捺不住了。
dialogText.en: But Chang Yun has been sending me data for quite a while. The situation is getting a little hot.

dialogText.cn: 不过，下次再见，我就能见识到终末地的奇迹了吧？
dialogText.en: Next time we meet, I'll get to see the technological wonders of Endfield, right?

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 陈千语更新信息已录入，认证通过，通道开启。
dialogText.en: Personal information updates recorded for Chen Qianyu. Identity verified. Access granted.

dialogText.cn: 哎……我不是那个意思啊！给我重来！
dialogText.en: Wha...?! No-no-no, that's not what I meant! Hey redo that!

dialogText.cn: 为什么！
dialogText.en: Why...!

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 认证通过，最高权限，通道开启。
dialogText.en: Identity verified. Highest authority level confirmed. Access granted.

dialogText.cn: 这都能过？！那就不是人脸识别咯！
dialogText.en: You passed the check? This thing's definitely not scanning faces!

dialogText.cn: 要是说……
dialogText.en: Then if I do this...

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 认证未通过，认认证未未通过！
dialogText.en: Biometric verification failed. Bio-biometric veri-verification ... failed!

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: 认证通过，最高权限，通道开启。
dialogText.en: Identity verified. Highest authority level confirmed. Access granted.

dialogText.cn: 陈，庄天师还等着我们呢。
dialogText.en: Chen, Tianshi Zhuang is still waiting for us.

actorName.cn: 系统语音{宏山工业系统}
actorName.en: Operating System Robot Voice {Hongshan AIC System}

dialogText.cn: T-15分钟至临界状态，一级冷却系统压力正常。
dialogText.en: T-15 minutes to threshold. Class one cooling system reports normal pressure.

dialogText.cn: 进行第三次息壤能量注入，监测器准备记录。
dialogText.en: Initiate third Xiranite energy injection. Monitoring instruments, prepare for datalogging.

dialogText.cn: B-34通道的数据出现偏差，超出预运行模拟范围。
dialogText.en: Readings from channel B-34 are exceeding the expected range from the pre-test simulations.

dialogText.cn: 尝试校准，排除干扰。
dialogText.en: Attempt recalibration. Try to minimize the interference.

dialogText.cn: ……没用，老样子，和应龙那边给的数值完全对不上。
dialogText.en: ...It's not working. I'm getting the same thing. None of my numbers match those from Yinglung.

dialogText.cn: 干扰排除，再试一次。
dialogText.en: Interference eliminated. Let's go for another run.

dialogText.cn: 继续，进行第四次息壤能量注入。
dialogText.en: We continue. Initiate fourth Xiranite energy injection.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，这轮数据调整幅度是不是太大了，可能会……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, data adjustments for this run look pretty big. We might...

dialogText.cn: ……啊！暂停、暂停！
dialogText.en: ...Ah! STOP THE RUN! STOP IT!

dialogText.cn: 唉……常沄啊，这都第几次了？
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Chang Yun, how many runs have we had at this?

dialogText.cn: 我去吧。你们把这几次的数据都整理好，喘口气，然后继续……
dialogText.en: Let me do it. But I need you to sort out the readings from the runs. Take a short break, and we'll continue after that...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 好……那就麻烦管理员您来做这件小事了。
dialogText.en: Okay then... Since the Endmin volunteered, I'll let you handle this little task.

dialogText.cn: 别抱怨了。先去接盆水，给稳定桩降降温，冷却系统又罢工了。
dialogText.en: Stop whining. Get some water and cool off the stabilizing rod. The cooling system's down again.

dialogText.cn: 每次都靠水，效率也太低了吧。你师哥学的源石技艺不是能结冰吗，让他来？
dialogText.en: Water? That's like baseline cooling efficiency. Your senior knows ice-making Originium Arts, right? Maybe we should get him instead.

dialogText.cn: 楼上是行政区域与专业实验室。
dialogText.en: The area upstairs is the administrative office and labs for various fields of science.

dialogText.cn: 不过，也许你会对资料室更感兴趣。
dialogText.en: However, I believe you'll be more interested in the data room.

dialogText.cn: 里面还保存着你以前留下的文件，想去看看吗？
dialogText.en: Some of your old files and documents are stored there. Would you like to have a look?

dialogText.cn: 请。
dialogText.en: This way, please.

dialogText.cn: 老师，老师，不……不好了！哈……我……我……
dialogText.en: Ma ... ma'am ... we've got ... bad news! I ... I...

dialogText.cn: 慢慢说。
dialogText.en: Take a breath. And then go on.

dialogText.cn: 有一台演出用的天桩……刚才在试飞……
dialogText.en: One of the sky poles we're using for the performance ... we're just test flying the unit...

dialogText.cn: ……信号在方、方兴衢上方，丢了……
dialogText.en: ...but the signal went out above ... Fangxing Avenue... We lost it...

dialogText.cn: 方兴衢……
dialogText.en: Fangxing Avenue...

dialogText.cn: 咦，梨花已经开了？
dialogText.en: Oh. The pear blossoms are blooming already...

dialogText.cn: 弭弗说得对，不能总是闷在实验室里。差点又错过了一个春天……
dialogText.en: Mi Fu's got a point. This lab's swallowing whole seasons. There goes spring again.

dialogText.cn: 你喜欢？
dialogText.en: You like it?

dialogText.cn: 嗯。我肯定还在哪儿闻到过这股梨花香。
dialogText.en: Hmm. This pear blossom aroma... I know it from somewhere.

dialogText.cn: 你想起来什么了吗？
dialogText.en: Did you just remember something?

dialogText.cn: 当年你拜访科考站时就带着一盆梨花，还说终有一日要在武陵的土地上栽培出梨花。
dialogText.en: You actually brought a pear blossom sapling during your last visit to the Science Station. You even said a day will come when you'll raise a blooming orchard in Wuling.
A blooming orchard...

dialogText.cn: 在侵蚀泛滥的土地上，一定很难。
dialogText.en: That must have been rather difficult in a place overrun by the Blight.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，在那些困难的岁月里，想留住这样美好的花蕊，的确不易。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Preserving beautiful flowers like these is never easy, especially in those difficult times.

dialogText.cn: 但你看，我还是做到了。
dialogText.en: But look, I have succeeded.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，跟我来！
dialogText.en: Come with me, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，一时着急，拉着你跑了一路。
dialogText.en: Sorry ... for dragging you all along. I got a little carried away. Hope you don't mind...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，很要紧。我不想让一会儿的活动被影响。
dialogText.en: Yes. It matters a lot, actually. I don't want this to spoil the event later on.

dialogText.cn: ……那再好不过了。
dialogText.en: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogText.cn: 为了不辜负你的期待，我们得赶快解决问题才行。
dialogText.en: So, in order to live up to your expectations, we should address this issue quickly.

dialogText.cn: 看起来天桩明明还在正常飞行……是传感器的问题吗？
dialogText.en: This sky pole seems to be flying normally... Maybe there's something wrong with its sensors.

dialogText.cn: 奇怪……
dialogText.en: Odd...

dialogText.cn: 嗯！
dialogText.en: Mm!

dialogText.cn: 呜——呜，我的龙泡泡……
dialogText.en: Waaa —! My chubby lung...! *Sniff*...

dialogText.cn: 小橡？别哭，怎么了？
dialogText.en: Xiao Xiang? It's alright. Tell me what's wrong.

dialogText.cn: ……坏机器……哇——！坏机器把我的龙泡泡带走了！
dialogText.en: ...It's the bad machine... WAAA —! A bad machine took my chubby lung!

dialogText.cn: 它们去哪里了？
dialogText.en: There, there. Now where did this machine go?

dialogText.cn: 那边……呜，飞到那边去了……
dialogText.en: Over there... *Sniff* It flew over there...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你告诉我，我再给你买一个龙泡泡好不好？
dialogText.en: Thank you for telling me that. Let's buy you another chubby lung, okay?
Really...?

dialogText.cn: 好，我要商会联动限定款！
dialogText.en: Then ... then I want the special TGCC crossover exclusive!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，说好了。
dialogText.en: Okay. The special crossover exclusive it shall be.

dialogText.cn: 哎哟，这些事情我们来就行！
dialogText.en: No worries. Just let us handle this.

dialogText.cn: 车子没什么大问题。一会儿就把它挪开，别影响到演出。
dialogText.en: The truck looks alright. We'll move it out of the way. Can't afford to let it affect the performance event.

dialogText.cn: 还有什么要帮忙的吗？
dialogText.en: Got anything else I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 小沈！庄天师！你们堵这头，我堵那头，咱们围攻它！
dialogText.en: Shen! Tianshi Zhuang! Let's surround this thing! Block that path! I'll cover here!

dialogText.cn: 多谢了，各位。
dialogText.en: Thank you, everyone.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！
dialogText.en: Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 嘿，好家伙，我来堵那边。
dialogText.en: Hah. This one's slippery. I'll block that side.

dialogText.cn: 哎……哎！别动了！可恶！
dialogText.en: Oh... OI! QUIT MOVING! Bloody machine!

dialogText.cn: 继续追吧？
dialogText.en: Shall we continue the chase?

dialogText.cn: 得把那个天桩拦下来。
dialogText.en: We've got to stop that sky pole.

dialogText.cn: 马上就要开幕了，怎么和客人交代！
dialogText.en: The performance's about to start. How am I supposed to serve anyone with this mess...

dialogText.cn: 潘工，对不住，是我回收不及时。
dialogText.en: My deepest apologies, Engineer Pan. I should have retrieved it sooner.

dialogText.cn: 呦，庄天师……您还亲自跑腿呢？
dialogText.en: Oh ho-ho, Tianshi Zhuang... Can't believe you're personally running this errand.

dialogText.cn: 底料而已，不值几个钱。要不干脆留下撮一顿？正好，演出马上要开始了！
dialogText.en: Worry not. It's just cheap soup base. How about grabbing a meal? The performance is about to start!
WHA?! Geez!

dialogText.cn: 啊——我刚洗的白衬衫！
dialogText.en: ARRRGH — My shirt!

dialogText.cn: 沾头发上了！
dialogText.en: IT'S ALL OVER MY HAIR!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，好帅！
dialogText.en: HAHAHA! So cool!

dialogText.cn: 呃啊！辣油进眼睛了！
dialogText.en: AAARGGHGH! CHILI OIL! MY EYES BURNING!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，诸位！
dialogText.en: Terribly sorry, people!

dialogText.cn: 糟了……
dialogText.en: Oh dear...

dialogText.cn: 哎，管理员，您也在？
dialogText.en: Ah, Endmin! You're here as well.

dialogText.cn: 至于这天桩，看一眼频率就知道是福波——
dialogText.en: As for this sky pole... Its frequency readings have Fu Bo's —

dialogText.cn: 你们……算了，来就来吧！
dialogText.en: You guys... Fine. I could use some help!

dialogText.cn: 把它牵制住，别让它接近观测站的<@qu.key>核心设备</>！
dialogText.en: Distract it. Don't let it get too close to the <@qu.key>core facilities</> of the monitoring center!
Uh...

dialogText.cn: 哈，这下能打个痛快了！
dialogText.en: HAH! Time to get in a real fight!

dialogText.cn: ……多亏你们赶过来了，这玩意儿解决后，观测站就能重启了。
dialogText.en: Hooo. Thanks for swinging by... Since we've squished this thing ... we should be able to restart the monitoring center.

dialogText.cn: 设备应该保下来了吧？嘶——
dialogText.en: Hope the instruments are undamaged. Ssss—

dialogText.cn: 弭弗，你受伤了，先别乱动。
dialogText.en: You're injured, Mi Fu. Try not to move too much.

dialogText.cn: 小伤，痛快得很。
dialogText.en: Just a flesh wound. Ain't that bad, really.

dialogText.cn: 我应该带了药……
dialogText.en: I got some meds on me...

dialogText.cn: 别它没宰了我，你给我治死了。
dialogText.en: It'd be a joke if my headstone reads: "Killed by Tangtang's Medical Malpractice."

dialogText.cn: ……的确是我太莽撞。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*. I was reckless back then.

dialogText.cn: 这个天使太危险了。之前也伤了我不少部下……没忍住。
dialogText.en: That Aggelos was a serious threat and wounded many of our guards... I lost my cool.

dialogText.cn: 少找借口，你分明就是想和这个水花子打一架，手痒痒得忍不住吧。
dialogText.en: Cut your excuses, warmonger! You were just itching for a fight with a big, bad splatter!
...Hmph.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤，都解决了，没事。
dialogText.en: It's over, Tangtang. We're all safe.

dialogText.cn: 我、我才不是在怕……你受伤了？
dialogText.en: I ... I wasn't being scared... You're hurt?!

dialogText.cn: 胡说什么呢！黑面煞，你你你……你到底跟谁一拨的！
dialogText.en: I never did that! Wh-whose side are you on, Darkmask...?

dialogText.cn: 就是啊！你出了什么事，武陵城还有谁认账？！
dialogText.en: Yeah! If anything happens to you, no Wulinger is gonna pay back your serious debt!

dialogText.cn: 至少八成的设备恢复了工作。
dialogText.en: At least eighty percent of the facilities are back online.

dialogText.cn: 多谢，头儿知道一定很开心……
dialogText.en: Really appreciate your help. Boss will be pleased to hear about this...

dialogText.cn: 不过，我受伤的事情，可以帮我向她保密吗？
dialogText.en: Can I ask you for a favor? Don't tell her that I've been wounded in this mission.

dialogText.cn: 再说，你在武陵城天天打黑工，连命都不要，姓庄的担心担心你怎么了？
dialogText.en: Look at you! Slogging for those Wulingers all day! Almost got yourself killed! Zhuang should be worrying about you more.

dialogText.cn: 她和你不一样，事情已经够多了。
dialogText.en: Unlike you, she actually has plenty of other things to worry about.

dialogText.cn: 算了！随你便。答应的活儿替你干完了，这次就算平手！
dialogText.en: Whatever! Since I finished what you've asked, I believe we're even!

dialogText.cn: 观测站能重新监测武陵的侵蚀动向，展开后续的调查了。
dialogText.en: The monitoring center is now assessing and monitoring Blight activities for Wuling again.

dialogText.cn: 你怎么又这么安静？真被吓破胆了？
dialogText.en: So, little kitty. Why so quiet? That thing got your nerves?

dialogText.cn: 突然没心情了。
dialogText.en: I just don't feel like talking.

dialogText.cn: 城主、寨主，区别没你想得那么大……
dialogText.en: City Viceroy and Stockade Chief aren't that different, you know...

dialogText.cn: ……谢了，“黑面煞”。
dialogText.en: Thanks, Darkmask.

dialogText.cn: 我现在就回去打点！等我消息！
dialogText.en: I'll get my Fam sorted! Stay tuned!

dialogText.cn: 一言为定！
dialogText.en: Then it's a deal!

dialogText.cn: 要和我一起回去找头儿吗？
dialogText.en: Wanna head back with me and talk to the boss?

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，弭弗姐，汤汤她……
dialogText.en: Ahem. Mi Fu ... Tangtang is...

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞！！
dialogText.en: DARKMASK!

dialogText.cn: 啧，给了她机会溜，反倒蹬鼻子上脸了。
dialogText.en: Tsk. I gave her a chance to slip away. Yet she's back for more.

dialogText.cn: 不错嘛黑面煞，最后还是选了我！
dialogText.en: Nice, Darkmask. You ended up choosing my side!

dialogText.cn: 行，那如果寨子有难，你的这个终末地帮不帮？
dialogText.en: So, if something bad happens to the Stockade, will your Endfield Fam help us?

dialogText.cn: 清波寨出事了？
dialogText.en: Something happened to Qingbo Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 呸呸呸，寨子还好好的！我是操心兄弟姐妹的未来！
dialogText.en: NO! Pffft. The Stockade is fine! It's about the Fam's future safety!

dialogText.cn: 只要有了那什么“继承系统”，啥都不是麻烦……
dialogText.en: If I can get some of your ICY CREAMY Factory, everything will be super fine...

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀和水花子的影响还在扩大，寨子迟早撑不住——而且我还没拿到那一千斤粮食！
dialogText.en: The Blight and splatters are getting worse every day. My Stockade won't hold out forever — And someone owes me a thousand catties of FOOD!

dialogText.cn: 所以你们也需要集成工业系统。
dialogText.en: Looks like you need our ... AIC Factory solution.

dialogText.cn: 可要说服寨子里其他人，还有我哥……很多人其实都讨厌外来人……
dialogText.en: Yeah. But I gotta convince everyone in the Stockade first. My Bro and ... many in the Fam don't like outsiders...

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，佩丽卡，你是不是早就打算帮汤汤了？
dialogText.en: Heheh. Perlica, you were planning to help Tangtang all along, right?

dialogText.cn: 第一次见到他们的时候，我就在考虑这件事。
dialogText.en: Indeed. It's been on my mind ever since our first meeting.

dialogText.cn: 他们已经在这片土地上找到了自己的生活方式，但如今，敌人在这片地区蠢蠢欲动，如果聂菲斯有下一步行动……
dialogText.en: They've found a way to survive upon these lands. Alas, the enemy has arrived. If Nefarith makes her next move...

dialogText.cn: 是啊……先回去见庄天师吧。
dialogText.en: Agreed... Let's head back and talk to Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 我就先回去，找头儿汇报。
dialogText.en: I'll head back first. Gotta report to the boss.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了你们，我们可以着手调查侵蚀潮异动和聂菲斯活动的痕迹。
dialogText.en: Thank you for helping out. We can now investigate the Blight Tide anomalies and trace Nefarith's activities.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你认为他们的下一步计划是什么？
dialogText.en: Endmin, what do you think their next step is?

dialogText.cn: 弭弗，汤汤这次也帮了忙，对吧？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu, Tangtang supported our last operation, didn't she?

dialogText.cn: 眼下本就应该是同舟共济的时候。
dialogText.en: This is the time we should be rowing the same boat.

dialogText.cn: 但从十年前的灾难以来，寨民与我们结怨已久，并不信任我们。
dialogText.en: Ten years later, the scars from the disaster still divide us from the Stockade residents. Trust was the first casualty.

dialogText.cn: 啊？我还以为你会瞒着庄天师呢！
dialogText.en: Wow. I thought you wouldn't tell Tianshi Zhuang about that!

dialogText.cn: 有必要吗？
dialogText.en: Why wouldn't I?

dialogText.cn: 不过，终末地已经带来了另一种可能。
dialogText.en: However, Endfield presents us with another opportunity.

dialogText.cn: 别担心，我们会找到那个答案的。
dialogText.en: Set your worries aside. We will get through this together.

dialogText.cn: 是啊。
dialogText.en: Indeed we shall.

dialogText.cn: 一切才刚刚开始。
dialogText.en: This is just the beginning.

dialogText.cn: 终末地会在武陵城和清波寨之间寻得平衡。
dialogText.en: Endfield will seek balance between Wuling City and Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 我们现在需要更多帮手，而不是敌人。
dialogText.en: What we need is more allies, not adversaries.

dialogText.cn: ……庄天师！
dialogText.en: ...Tianshi Zhuang!

dialogText.cn: 武陵城和清波寨都已经这样了，那她……
dialogText.en: What about her? If both Wuling City and Qingbo Stockade are in trouble, then she's...

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>北部禁区</>才是<@qu.key>应龙特勤队</>的任务目标，再者，他们人手太少。不过他们也承诺过尽可能支援武陵。
dialogText.en: The primary objective of <@qu.key>Yinglung Special Task Force</> remains in the <@qu.key>North Wuling Exclusion Zone</>. Though understaffed, they did promise to offer any help they could afford to Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 宏科院已经在尽力调度人手，不过眼下，整个塔卫二的情况都不乐观……
dialogText.en: HAS is already doing its best to reinforce this city. However, the overall situation on Talos-II isn't looking too good...

dialogText.cn: 就好像十年前那时候……
dialogText.en: This is starting to feel like what happened ten years ago...

dialogText.cn: 一个侵蚀观测站，却连预警都没发出就被侵蚀淹没……
dialogText.en: A Blight monitoring center suddenly gets overwhelmed by the Blight without giving off any warning...

dialogText.cn: 不确定……进入武陵城之后，他们就从我们的视野里消失了。
dialogText.en: I'm not sure... They completely dropped off our radar after we entered Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 但侵蚀活动加剧，必然和天师桩的受损有关。
dialogText.en: However, the intensifying Blight activities must be a direct consequence of the damaged Tianshi Pillar.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我和白霜会照看这里。
dialogText.en: Mm. Bai Shuang and I will take care of this place.

dialogText.cn: 你们就安心地去观测站吧！
dialogText.en: You just head to the monitoring center!

dialogText.cn: 那还说什么，赶紧出发吧！
dialogText.en: 'Nuff talking already! Let's go and deal with the problem! Now!

dialogText.cn: 观测站重新开始工作了，她应该能轻松些了。
dialogText.en: The monitoring center is working again. That'll put her mind to ease.

dialogText.cn: 在想头儿，这次回去有借口催她休息一下了。
dialogText.en: Thinking about my boss. Now I got a good reason to persuade her to take a break.

dialogText.cn: 呵，看着你比我还急呀？我倒是也想。
dialogText.en: Hah. I wish. You sound even more desperate than I do.

dialogText.cn: 啧，是那个小猫崽子喊得太夸张了。
dialogText.en: Tsk. That lil' Feline made it sound like I lost the entire arm.

dialogText.cn: 生产息壤的计划成功了吧？观测站的问题也解决了……
dialogText.en: The Xiranite production project worked out, right? And the monitoring center is taken care of too...

dialogText.cn: 城里的情况，你也清楚。如果不取得一些战果，她不会放过自己的。
dialogText.en: You know the sitch inside the city. She won't give herself a break unless we achieve something positive.

dialogText.cn: 不过，也真得谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: In any case, I sincerely appreciate your help back there.

dialogText.cn: 只是，汤汤的状态不太对劲……或许是寨子出了什么问题。
dialogText.en: However, I can't help but feel something's wrong with Tangtang... Maybe it has to do with the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 有时间，去问问她在想啥。
dialogText.en: Try asking what's on her mind, if you have the time.

dialogText.cn: 有些忙，我帮不上她，但“黑面煞”一定能。
dialogText.en: There are things I can't help her with. Darkmask, on the other hand, might work wonders.

dialogText.cn: 我以前天天挑衅头儿找架打，受的伤可比这重多了！
dialogText.en: There was a time when I kept ticking off the boss to battle things out. I endured far worse than this.

dialogText.cn: ……那时候，和我打架，也算是她能抛开所有包袱发泄情绪的法子。
dialogText.en: ...Sparring with me was probably her only way to blow off some steam ... and forget everything else.

dialogText.cn: 啊……真怀念啊。也不知道我现在抓不抓得住她的雷法呢。
dialogText.en: Ah... Really miss those days. I wonder if I'm still able to catch her Lei Fa Arts (Thunder Arts).

dialogText.cn: 我们得尽快部署<@qu.key>息壤生产线</>，解武陵燃眉之急。
dialogText.en: We must deploy the <@qu.key>Xiranite production line</> ASAP to resolve the Wuling urgency.

dialogText.cn: 见证全新的息壤生产方法，也是难得的学习机会。白霜，好好看着！
dialogText.en: And we shall observe a brand new method for Xiranite production. This learning opportunity doesn't come often. Pay close attention, Bai Shuang!

dialogText.cn: 是，老师！
dialogText.en: Yes, ma'am!

dialogText.cn: 开始吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Let's begin, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，彦宁天师和白霜天师已经来了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Tianshi Yan Ning and Bai Shuang are here!

dialogText.cn: 又见面了，我会协助你们排除意外，确保一切正常。
dialogText.en: We meet again. I'll offer assistance and troubleshooting to ensure the success of this operation.

dialogText.cn: 大、大家好！
dialogText.en: H-hi, everyone!

dialogText.cn: 最近已经频繁到习以为常了，还是先专注天有洪炉的制造吧。
dialogText.en: The tides are so frequent it almost feels like a constant thing. Let's focus on constructing the Forge of the Sky first.

dialogText.cn: 他似乎被弭长官叫走了，好像又有一轮侵蚀潮出现……
dialogText.en: I think he got some new orders from Captain Mi. Another Blight Tide has emerged...

dialogText.cn: 如果城里人都到这个地步了……
dialogText.en: Even the city folks are in danger...

dialogText.cn: 想寨子里的事……不过看红脸婆他们也不好过，心理平衡了些。
dialogText.en: The Stockade, that's what...! But seeing that Mad Woman getting the short end of the stick got me feeling better.

dialogText.cn: 这些水花子连武陵城的人都要头疼，那要是以后寨子也遇上——
dialogText.en: Yeah. If those blighted splatters pose a serious problem to the Wulingers, I don't think the Stockade —

dialogText.cn: 不是你还被她扣着吗？
dialogText.en: She's still keeping you captive.

dialogText.cn: 正在想办法把黑面煞从她手上救出去嘛！
dialogText.en: I gotta figure out how to free Darkmask from her evil hands!

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀潮明显比以前更厉害了，清波寨迟早躲不过去。
dialogText.en: The Blight Tide is worse than before. Qingbo Stockade will have to deal with it some day.

dialogText.cn: 我们可没有武陵城那些柱子挡着……他们也不肯分给我们！
dialogText.en: Unlike the city, we got no artsy pillars to keep out the Tide... And they're not sharing their fancy tech with us!

dialogText.cn: 我哥也不会同意找武陵城的帮手，还得我们自己想办法。
dialogText.en: My brother refuses to ask Wuling for help. We gotta figure out our own solutions.

dialogText.cn: 真头疼啊，你说是吧，黑面煞！
dialogText.en: This is makin' my head hurt. How's your head, Darkmask?

dialogText.cn: 我溜进城的确是想去确认你们的安全，不过我看到了些更厉害的玩意儿……
dialogText.en: So, I tried sneaking into the city to make sure everyone's treated properly. But I discovered something even more amazing...

dialogText.cn: 终末地是吧……以前光顾着黑面煞厉害，小瞧你们其他人了。
dialogText.en: You got an Endfield Fam, right...? I thought you're pretty good, Darkmask. But your Fam is solid, too.

dialogText.cn: 老师，真的成功了！
dialogText.en: Ma'am, it's working!

dialogText.cn: 息壤……居然只需要最基本的材料就能……？！
dialogText.en: Did this just make Xiranite ... with the most basic raw materials...?!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……息壤说到底也是一种源石产物，是因为协议源石加上“洪炉”本身的特性……确实高效……
dialogText.en: Hmm... Xiranite is an Originium derivative. It's basically Protocol-Originium with additional properties imbued by the Forge itself... This process is truly effective...

dialogText.cn: 啊。抱歉，各位，接下来，我们还得验证这些息壤的功效。
dialogText.en: Ah, sorry. I got a little carried away. Our next step is to verify the effectiveness of the newly produced Xiranite.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还记得之前发现侵蚀的地方吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, remember the place where we found the Blight?

dialogText.cn: 如果这些息壤能够重启整个<@qu.key>息壤控流节点</>……
dialogText.en: If this batch of Xiranite can reset the entire <@qu.key>Xiranite flow control node</>...

dialogText.cn: 息壤控流节点？
dialogText.en: Xiranite flow control node?

dialogText.cn: 还是到了再和你们解释吧。
dialogText.en: I'll explain it to you once we get there.

dialogText.cn: 警报……？
dialogText.en: The alarms...?

dialogText.cn: 这玩意儿有这种能耐，以前怎么从没见启用过？
dialogText.en: This device is so effective! So ... why didn't we use it before?

dialogText.cn: 管理员的这台射流无人机……之前也是报废的状态吧？
dialogText.en: Well, the Endmin's jet drone used to be ... malfunctioning as well.

dialogText.cn: 自从息壤入不敷出，除了天师桩外的其他设施，基本都被放弃了。
dialogText.en: Our Xiranite production was barely enough to cover the Tianshi Pillar. We were forced to abandon the others.

dialogText.cn: 就像是溪流穿过田野，整片沃土都会被水分滋养。
dialogText.en: It's just like a creek flowing past the fields, irrigating the fertile earth.

dialogText.cn: 也许……终末地真能帮我们——
dialogText.en: Perhaps ... Endfield can truly help us to—

dialogText.cn: ……但现在不同了。哪怕只是注入了一点息壤，各种息壤设施就都有了复苏的可能。
dialogText.en: But things are different now... Injecting bits of Xiranite into these Xiranite facilities can bring them back up and running.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你来了！快，趁她双拳难敌四腿——唔……
dialogText.en: ...Darkmask! Quick! There's plenty of you against her — Hngh...!

dialogText.cn: 弭队，这是……？
dialogText.en: Captain Mi, what's happening...?

dialogText.cn: 快点开工，赶紧干完，我还得回寨子里呢……
dialogText.en: The sooner we get this done the better. I gotta head back to the Stockade after this...

dialogText.cn: 汤汤，你怎么自己到武陵城来了？
dialogText.en: So why are you headed to Wuling City on your own, Tangtang?

dialogText.cn: {F}还不是担心我的结拜好姐妹！{M}还不是担心我的结拜好兄弟！
dialogText.en: {F}'Cos I'm worried about my sworn sister! Can't I do that? {M}'Cos I'm worried about my sworn brother! Can't I do that?

dialogText.cn: 怎么听着你也已经习以为常……
dialogText.en: Why do I get the feeling that you're always getting...

dialogText.cn: 放我下来！
dialogText.en: PUT ME DOWN!

dialogText.cn: 这家伙打架不算赖，正巧送上门儿来，就被我抓过来帮忙清理天使。
dialogText.en: This kitty punk's not bad for a combatant, so I'm considering recruiting her to fight the Aggeloi.

dialogText.cn: 她这么对我，你就干看着吗？
dialogText.en: Hey! You just gonna stand there and watch her brutalize me?!

dialogText.cn: 怎么连你也输了？！还拉你来打白工？！
dialogText.en: You got thrashed too?! Is that why she's having you work for free?

dialogText.cn: 嘁！下作！喂，我帮忙还不行吗！
dialogText.en: Tsk! Dirty cheats! HEY! I agree to help! Hello?!

dialogText.cn: 既然人都到齐了，直接出发。
dialogText.en: Alright. We got everyone already. Let's set off.

dialogText.cn: 不过她也没把你怎么样……留得青山在，不怕没柴烧！忍了！
dialogText.en: At least she didn't hurt you... Where there's life, there's hope! Chin up!

dialogText.cn: 但事情结束以后，你们别为难黑面煞！
dialogText.en: But once this is over, you gotta let Darkmask off!

dialogText.cn: 啊？这……大仇得报，你还替仇人做事？而且他们还真愿意？
dialogText.en: What? You avenged yourself...? But now you're working for the enemy ... AND THEY AGREED?

dialogText.cn: ……嘿嘿！黑面煞，看不出来你心胸如此辽阔，反正你都是要进寨子的，就当我帮你了！
dialogText.en: Heh! Darkmask, you have a heart of gold! Since you're gonna be part of the Stockade fam, I guess I'll help you out this time!

dialogText.cn: 哎哟……武陵城外怎么也这么多水花子？
dialogText.en: Oh dearie me... So many splatterlings! And right outside Wuling as well!

dialogText.cn: 嘀咕什么呢？赶紧干活，不然你还得去巡卫队宿舍擦窗户。
dialogText.en: Stop mumbling and get to work. Otherwise I'll make you wipe the watchguard dorm windows afterwards.

dialogText.cn: 喂，要不，让黑面煞做个见证，我俩再比划比划！
dialogText.en: Hey! Why don't we have a proper duel! Darkmask will be the judge.

dialogText.cn: 哈？！我才是胜多败少，你少当着黑面煞的面胡说八道！
dialogText.en: Hah! I won more battles than I lost. Stop feeding Darkmask with your nonsense!

dialogText.cn: 这是正事，没心思跟你闹。
dialogText.en: Don't have time for your games. We're trying to carry out a proper mission.

dialogText.cn: 怕啦？不比就是输，那你得答应我一件事儿！
dialogText.en: Oooh, you scared? If you refuse, you concede defeat! That means you owe me a DARE!

dialogText.cn: 哼！少埋汰人！
dialogText.en: Hmph! Never! I'm no window wiper!

dialogText.cn: 第七次？还是第八次？你输太多，巡卫养的驮兽都认得你了。
dialogText.en: Oh, but you're pretty good at losing and wiping. How many times already? Seven? Eight? The Watchguard burdenbeasts know your face already.

dialogText.cn: 这次，你要是输了，就亲自给我扛粮食去寨里！三百斤！不，五百斤！
dialogText.en: And if you lose this fight, you'll carry food to my Stockade! Three hundred catties! NO! Make that FIVE HUNDRED! ON YOUR OWN!

dialogText.cn: 哼……要我把首墩扛过去都没事。
dialogText.en: Hmph... I can even carry the marker stone to your place if that's what you want.

dialogText.cn: 反正，你输定了。
dialogText.en: Anyway, you've set yourself up to fail.

dialogText.cn: 欸！喂！
dialogText.en: HEY! HEEEEY!

dialogText.cn: 就算你不说我输了要干嘛，赌局也成立了啊！
dialogText.en: The bet is on already! Even if you didn't say nothing about my DARE if I lose!

dialogText.cn: 你又跑不掉，等我想起来再说。
dialogText.en: You won't be running away. I'll think of something proper. Eventually.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，庄……那个窜天雷天师想要你们干嘛？
dialogText.en: Darkmask, what is Tianshi Zhuang ... I mean, what is the walking lightning rod asking you to do?

dialogText.cn: 你还敢去那儿？！我眼瞅着多少天师差点死那边！
dialogText.en: You're going where?! The monitoring center?! Tons of Tianshi almost got themselves killed at that place!

dialogText.cn: 你要是死了，岂不就分不出胜负了？继续比！要一千斤！要有米有油有鳞有肉！
dialogText.en: I can't win this duel if you get yourself killed! And I demand ONE THOUSAND CATTIES! Plus rice, oil, fins, and steaks!

dialogText.cn: 今儿个姑奶奶赢定了！喂，红脸婆，你收拾了多少水花子？
dialogText.en: Absolute pawnage! Chief's got the final laugh today! Mad woman! How many splatters did you squish today?

dialogText.cn: 五个。
dialogText.en: Five.

dialogText.cn: 一、二、三……哎哟，怎么是平手？！
dialogText.en: One, two, three... AIYO! It's a TIE!

dialogText.cn: 算了，好歹这条路也清出来了。
dialogText.en: Well, at least this road is safe to travel again.

dialogText.cn: ……随你便。
dialogText.en: Whatever.

dialogText.cn: 我之前见到武陵城里砸下来个大流星，是你们搞的吧？那是做啥用的……
dialogText.en: I saw a burning comet smash into the city. You did that, right? What's that for...?

dialogText.cn: 正相反，我们现在要去观测站办正事儿，顾不上你。要溜就麻利点回去。
dialogText.en: The opposite. We're headed to the monitoring center on official business. I can't spare anyone to keep their eyes on you. So go on, scamper back home.

dialogText.cn: 喂，小猫崽子。
dialogText.en: Oi! Lil' Feline!

dialogText.cn: 呀！你要暗算我？！
dialogText.en: KYA! You wanna backstab me?!

dialogText.cn: 从侵蚀的程度来看……像是有意要摧毁这里。
dialogText.en: From the severity of the Blight ... it's like it was meant to destroy this place.

dialogText.cn: 观测站里面……有什么东西在搞拆迁吗？
dialogText.en: Erm ... is something trying to dismantle the monitoring center from the inside?

dialogText.cn: 一个比较麻烦的天使，我们叫它“<@qu.key>破潮之像</>”。先前巡卫被迫撤离观测站，也是因为那玩意儿。
dialogText.en: We call it the <@qu.key>Tidalklast</>. It's an annoying Aggelos. That thing was the reason why the watchguards were forced to flee the monitoring center.

dialogText.cn: 嘶……听上去是个硬点子，那咱们绕着点？
dialogText.en: Ssss... Sounds like a big, bad, buggerloid. Maybe we should just skirt around it.

dialogText.cn: 重启观测站，不能放着它不管。我去了结它。
dialogText.en: No. We can't leave it in peace if we want to restart the monitoring center. I'll go and terminate it.

dialogText.cn: ……撤离前天师们启动了紧急预案，封住了通路，多少能挡它一阵子。
dialogText.en: ...The Tianshi initiated their contingency plan and sealed the exit before withdrawing. The thing should be trapped for a while.

dialogText.cn: 这里的构造我熟，先去看看情况。
dialogText.en: I know the architecture. I'll go take a look.

dialogText.cn: 你们打正面过。至于被封住的地方，肯定有办法开路。
dialogText.en: You take the front approach. We'll figure out how to get into the sealed sections.

dialogText.cn: 等等——你怎么又一个人冲——
dialogText.en: HEY! WAIT —! Why are you doing this on your own again —?

dialogText.cn: 这水花子好厉害，黑面煞，我们得快点跟上她！
dialogText.en: This splatter sounds really angry. Darkmask, we best catch up to her!

dialogText.cn: 我、我更在乎那一千斤粮食！
dialogText.en: I ... I just want that one thousand catties of food!

dialogText.cn: 没想到它还盘踞在这儿……
dialogText.en: I didn't expect it to settle down here...

dialogText.cn: 你要怕了，就回去。这儿也用不着你。
dialogText.en: If you're scared, you can go home.

dialogText.cn: 谁怕？！不就是个大点儿的水花子！行啊，我们就来比谁先收拾了它！
dialogText.en: I'm scared? Pfft. Just a plus-sized splatter! Alright, it's on! We'll see who squishes this one first.

dialogText.cn: 有可能，不过——
dialogText.en: It's possible, but —

dialogText.cn: 唔……这么大动静吗？
dialogText.en: Nyaa?! Uh... That's a bit terrifying.

dialogText.cn: 这么快，那些机关果然难不倒管理员。
dialogText.en: You're fast. Seems like you can handle all the devices easily, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 喂！
dialogText.en: HEY!

dialogText.cn: ……没空等你们一起了，我先过去。
dialogText.en: Can't afford to wait for the rest of you. I'm heading over.

dialogText.cn: 哼，就知道你皮糙肉厚的，不会有事……
dialogText.en: Hmph. Guess your thick skin and hard fur saved you...
Sssss—

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，快，我们得帮她！
dialogText.en: Darkmask! Quick! We gotta help her!

dialogText.cn: 说什么呢，这不是放心不下你们吗？
dialogText.en: Of course not! Look, I'm GENUINELY concerned for all of you!

dialogText.cn: 我可不想被那些巡卫撞见！
dialogText.en: I don't wanna be seen by those pesky watchguards!

dialogText.cn: 汤汤？
dialogText.en: Tangtang?

dialogText.cn: 欸——我、我正准备来接你们呢！
dialogText.en: Oh — Ah. I, uh ... I'm here to pick you up!

dialogText.cn: 你不会又有什么鬼点子吧？
dialogText.en: This isn't another trick of yours, right?

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，快把桥连通，我们直接去<@qu.key>寨子</>吧！
dialogText.en: Ahem. Get this bridge fixed, then we'll head to the <@qu.key>Stockade</> together!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，动作快点！
dialogText.en: Come on! Just get moving already!

dialogText.cn: 大当家回来了！还有……
dialogText.en: The Supreme Chief is back! And...

dialogText.cn: 是你们！
dialogText.en: It's you!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞……没想到你这么受欢迎啊。
dialogText.en: Darkmask... I never knew you were so popular here.

dialogText.cn: 听大当家说，你们不光狠狠抽了武陵城的脸，他们还得乖乖听话求你们帮忙呢！
dialogText.en: Chief told us how you totally embarrassed the Wulingers, and they got down on their fours to beg you for help!

dialogText.cn: 行了行了，听好了！这次我专程召黑面煞回来，就是过来帮忙修寨子的！
dialogText.en: Alright, Fam! Settle down and LISTEN UP! I have specifically SUMMONED Darkmask home to help repair our Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞的能耐你们都清楚。
dialogText.en: Everyone knows that our Darkmask is a true professional.

dialogText.cn: 以后管他什么水花子还是侵蚀，全都不是事儿！
dialogText.en: Splatters? Blight? PFFFT! With Darkmask around, they'll be gone in a POOF!

dialogText.cn: 我也有点好奇……汤汤到底编了什么故事。
dialogText.en: This is actually making me curious... Now I really want to hear Tangtang's stories about you.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，先确认地点吧。
dialogText.en: Of course. The first step is to verify the deployment site.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统能帮助你们建设所需的设施。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory will help you construct the facilities you need.

dialogText.cn: ……我知道，比起武陵城，我们给不了多少贵重的东西，不过收下吧。
dialogText.en: ...I know we ain't as loaded as Wuling. We don't really have much to offer. But here! Take these!

dialogText.cn: 有了集成工业系统和你们在，我也可以放心把这里交给他们了……
dialogText.en: With you and the AIC Factory around, I can finally let the Fam handle themselves...

dialogText.cn: 有问题就找河佬！
dialogText.en: Just talk to He Lao if you got problems!

dialogText.cn: 嗐，寨子里最近老有人偷偷溜出去，啥也没干就又回来了，搞得神神秘秘的。
dialogText.en: Well, some of our people have been sneaking in and out of the Stockade. Something funny is going on.

dialogText.cn: 得了，真有什么麻烦，我一定第一个通知你们。
dialogText.en: Whatever. If something's up, I'll holler at you at once.

dialogText.cn: 就从一座复合式农场开始吧。
dialogText.en: Let's start with a farm complex.

dialogText.cn: 我哥又没空，还是得我去查查怎么回事。
dialogText.en: My Bro's always busy, so I gotta look into it myself.

dialogText.cn: 寨子里情况不好，大家都在自谋生路吧。
dialogText.en: They probably have side jobs or something. The Stockade isn't doing too well, you know.

dialogText.cn: 等我把内寨打点好了，也顺便带你们去逛逛<@qu.key>祖泉</>！
dialogText.en: And once I get the fort tidied up, I'll take you on a tour of our <@qu.key>Ancestral Spring</>! Promise!

dialogText.cn: 他接受了，但他并没有答应。
dialogText.en: He accepted, but he did not agree.

dialogText.cn: 那接下来，我们要如何避免太多的牺牲呢……管理员？
dialogText.en: Now, how can we proceed without incurring too many sacrifices ... Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈！
dialogText.en: Hahahaha!

dialogText.cn: 呃，那汤汤这边？
dialogText.en: So, what about Tangtang?

dialogText.cn: ……也只好这样了。
dialogText.en: Guess that's our only option...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，准备好就直接过去吧。
dialogText.en: Alright, team. We should head over once we're ready.
*Sigh*

dialogText.cn: 你受伤了吗？
dialogText.en: You hurt?

dialogText.cn: 不，只是这次没出什么力……
dialogText.en: No. Just that I hardly did anything in this fight...

dialogText.cn: 回头又要被弭队罚跑五十圈了……
dialogText.en: Captain Mi is probably gonna make me run fifty laps again...

dialogText.cn: 我就说不能指望一帮做贼的知恩图报，队长还总帮他们说好话……
dialogText.en: I knew we had to keep an eye out for those dirty criminals, yet the captain kept defending them...

dialogText.cn: 趁着我们轮班的工夫，他们溜进来破坏了通信设备和监测设备。
dialogText.en: Those dirty sneaks slipped inside when we were changing shifts. They sabotaged our comms and monitoring facilities.

dialogText.cn: 幸好有你们出手，局面才能这么快稳定下来。
dialogText.en: Thankfully, you intervened quickly and prevented things from getting worse.

dialogText.cn: 没问题。
dialogText.en: Of course.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多谢你们的帮忙。不过……
dialogText.en: Thank you for your help, Endmin. But...

dialogText.cn: 对。弭弗刚刚报告，同一时间还有寨民在突袭储备站，试图靠近武陵城。
dialogText.en: We do. Mi Fu just reported a new group of Stockade residents attacking the Field Logistics Depot. They're trying to get close to Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 我会暂时让武陵城保持克制，其他的……就拜托各位了。
dialogText.en: I'll preach calm and restraint in Wuling City for now. As for the rest ... we'll be counting on you.

dialogText.cn: 她知道我们和汤汤的关系，也许只是不想我们为难。
dialogText.en: She knows that we're on good terms with Tangtang, and doesn't want us to be caught in a dilemma.

dialogText.cn: 寨民不只是想瘫痪我们的监测系统。
dialogText.en: The Stockade residents did more than just disable our monitoring systems.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的人……外面那帮沧贼呢？
dialogText.en: Endfielders...? Are the Cangzei pirates still out there?

dialogText.cn: 唔，那些袭击者一看我们动真格，就全溜了。
dialogText.en: Well, those attackers ran away once they saw how good we are at fighting.

dialogText.cn: 唉，武陵城对他们的好意全被糟蹋了！
dialogText.en: Ugh. They spat on Wuling's goodwill and generosity...

dialogText.cn: 难道还有其他情况？
dialogText.en: Do we have another situation?

dialogText.cn: ……嗯，我知道。
dialogText.en: ...Hmm. I know.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，就等你这句话！
dialogText.en: Heh! I was hoping you'd say that!

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐肯定有汤汤的消息，我们赶紧去<@qu.key>储备站</>吧！
dialogText.en: Mi Fu definitely has news about Tangtang. Let's head to the <@qu.key>Field Logistics Depot</> right now!

dialogText.cn: 感觉庄天师是在暗示我们什么……
dialogText.en: I get the feeling that Tianshi Zhuang is trying to give us a hint...

dialogText.cn: 我们会尽快重启观测站，可以帮忙告知庄天师吗？
dialogText.en: We'll get the monitoring center back online shortly. Can you tell Tianshi Zhuang what happened here?

dialogText.cn: 撤得很快，一看局势不对就全散了。
dialogText.en: They packed up and ran at the first sign of trouble.

dialogText.cn: ……这次突袭显然是有预谋的。
dialogText.en: Someone definitely planned this attack...

dialogText.cn: 但是……单凭寨民，真能躲开巡卫和天师的视线吗？
dialogText.en: But ... could the Stockade residents have avoided those Watchguards and Tianshi on their own?

dialogText.cn: 有人在帮他们……还是对这里很熟悉的人。
dialogText.en: They probably had help ... maybe from someone who knows this place very well.

dialogText.cn: 还不能确定，得再找到些其他线索。
dialogText.en: Nothing is certain so far. We must find more information and intel.

dialogText.cn: 还有其他人？
dialogText.en: I think I heard someone.

dialogText.cn: ……我不会放弃……
dialogText.en: I'll never quit...

dialogText.cn: 那就好……我就说嘛，这观测站还是汤汤帮我们抢回来的呢。
dialogText.en: That's great... After all, it was Tangtang who helped us retake the monitoring center last time.

dialogText.cn: 可她终归还是清波寨的大当家……无论她知情与否，这都不是什么好消息。
dialogText.en: But Tangtang is the Chief of Qingbo Stockade... It doesn't matter if she knows of this incident. It won't bode well for her.

dialogText.cn: 不是我们认识的那些人。
dialogText.en: None of them are people we knew.

dialogText.cn: 应该没有我们认识的人。
dialogText.en: I don't think we know any of them.

dialogText.cn: 清波寨……到底发生了什么？
dialogText.en: Did something happen ... at Qingbo Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 呵，只抓不杀？
dialogText.en: Hurh. Just gonna throw us in a cage?

dialogText.cn: 啧，哪来这么多废话。配合调查就行。
dialogText.en: Tsk. Chatty. Just do your part in the investigation.

dialogText.cn: 清波寨想要什么，你还不清楚吗？
dialogText.en: You should know exactly what Qingbo Stockade wants.

dialogText.cn: ……把他们带回武陵城看着。
dialogText.en: ...Bring this lot to Wuling and keep them there.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐！
dialogText.en: Mi Fu!

dialogText.cn: 你们怎么来了……？
dialogText.en: Why are you here...?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这次“黑面煞”的面子也不好用了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'm afraid the "Darkmask" card won't work this time.

dialogText.cn: 头儿把事情交给我，也是希望我能控制住事态。
dialogText.en: Boss got me on this because she wants the situation contained.

dialogText.cn: 你们愿意蹚这趟浑水？
dialogText.en: So... You're willing to step into this mess?

dialogText.cn: 呵……也难怪头儿和汤汤都喜欢绕着你转了。
dialogText.en: Hah...! I see why my boss and Tangtang both enjoy your company so much.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会！汤汤……大当家是不会这么做的！
dialogText.en: No way! Tangtang... The Supreme Chief would never do that!

dialogText.cn: “大当家”……
dialogText.en: "Supreme Chief"...

dialogText.cn: 说到这个，我也很担心……
dialogText.en: Now that you've mentioned it, I'm getting worried myself...

dialogText.cn: 如果你想进<@qu.key>寨子</>确认情况，终末地会全力提供协助。
dialogText.en: If you intend to enter the <@qu.key>Stockade</> and investigate, Endfield will offer full support.

dialogText.cn: 我没工夫关心那个小猫崽子……我更关心，她到底管不管得住她的人。
dialogText.en: I don't have time to worry about that little kitty... But her ability to keep her people in check worries me.

dialogText.cn: 其他天师觉得相比天使，清波寨不算难缠，但我不这么想……
dialogText.en: The other Tianshi treat Qingbo Stockade as less of a concern than the Aggeloi, but I don't agree...

dialogText.cn: 多谢，是头儿让你们来的吧。
dialogText.en: Much appreciated. Did my boss send you here?

dialogText.cn: 汤汤？哼，我正想找她。
dialogText.en: Tangtang? Hmph. I've been meaning to find her.

dialogText.cn: 滚出我们的地盘……滚出去！
dialogText.en: THIS IS OUR LAND! GET OUT!

dialogText.cn: 这次的情况不太一样，得真刀真枪地打一场了。
dialogText.en: Situation has changed. Time for an actual battle with actual weapons.

dialogText.cn: 这次不同以往，寨民伤了我的人，还意图破坏储备站。
dialogText.en: Her Stockaders wounded my people and tried to burn down the Field Logistics Depot.

dialogText.cn: 清波寨和武陵城不对付了近十年，再闹下去，两边都收不了场。
dialogText.en: There's been bad blood between the Stockade and the City for a decade. If this continues, nothing good will come of it.

dialogText.cn: 那我们出发吧。
dialogText.en: Alright. Then let's be off.

dialogText.cn: 欸，是庄天师？
dialogText.en: Oh, it's from Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 应该是为了阻挡危险——侵蚀、裂地者、天使，甚至是……武陵城。
dialogText.en: It's supposed to keep out dangers that include the Blight, Landbreakers, Aggeloi ... and even Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: ……还是没有回应吗？
dialogText.en: ...No response?

dialogText.cn: 这里是去<@qu.key>内寨</>的路吧，之前就一直关着。
dialogText.en: This is the way into the <@qu.key>fort</>, right?

dialogText.cn: 这扇门，就像是把隔阂具象化了一样。
dialogText.en: This gate feels like a physical manifestation of the gulf of misunderstanding.

dialogText.cn: 明明我见过的寨民，都很好相处……但是这么多年，两边一直没法和谐共处。
dialogText.en: But the Stockaders I've met are pretty friendly... The Stockade and the City just don't get along, despite all these years.

dialogText.cn: 还是别想太多了，再联系一下<@qu.key>汤汤</>吧。
dialogText.en: Don't think too much of it. Let's call <@qu.key>Tangtang</> again.

dialogText.cn: 的确，她可不是闲得住的性格……
dialogText.en: That's true. Tangtang does not seem like the quiet and passive type...

dialogText.cn: 这些人晕过去了。看笼子上的痕迹，他们被暴力拖拽过。
dialogText.en: These people have passed out. Judging from the marks on the cages, they've been forcibly dragged and thrown inside these cells.

dialogText.cn: 不像裂地者的手段。可要是寨民的话，为什么要袭击自己人？
dialogText.en: This doesn't look like the Landbreakers' work. But why would the Stockade residents attack their own?

dialogText.cn: ……也许是有人下定决心了。
dialogText.en: Looks like someone finally made a decision...

dialogText.cn: 情况很复杂……
dialogText.en: It's a complicated story...

dialogText.cn: 就连文明环带都算不上铁板一块，何况这里的寨民。
dialogText.en: Even people in the Civilization Band aren't rock-solid. What makes the Stockaders so different?

dialogText.cn: 十年前，武陵科考站遭遇了一场超域灾害……头儿应该和你们简单说过。
dialogText.en: The Wuling Science Station was hit by an Ætherside disaster ten years ago... My boss probably told you about that.

dialogText.cn: 那个时候，清波寨同样遭到了侵蚀潮和天使的袭击，死伤惨重。当年的寨民认为，是这些外来人引发了灾难……
dialogText.en: The Stockade also had to face the Blight Tide and Aggelos attacks. Many lost their lives. The Stockaders back then believed the outsiders were responsible for starting the disaster...

dialogText.cn: 怎么会？！
dialogText.en: What?!

dialogText.cn: 清波寨和武陵城……应该都是炎国后裔，很难想象天师会真的对寨民下死手。
dialogText.en: But people in Qingbo and Wuling are both of Yanese descent... It's hard to believe the Tianshi would kill the Stockade residents.

dialogText.cn: 是啊……
dialogText.en: Yeah...

dialogText.cn: “我们在这里生活了几十年都相安无事，那些天师到底做了什么”，这样的仇恨自然而然弥漫在寨民之间。
dialogText.en: "We've lived here peacefully for decades. What are those Tianshi doing?" — such hate grew amongst the Stockaders.

dialogText.cn: 从那时候起，两边起了很多冲突。阮一的生父，听说也是死在天师的手上。
dialogText.en: Since then, conflicts erupted between Wuling and Qingbo. They told me that Ruan Yi's father was killed by the Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 小猫崽子，你可千万别出事……
dialogText.en: Stupid kitty ... you better not get yourself killed...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢，但请先别打扰我做研究。
dialogText.en: Thank you, but I'd appreciate it if you didn't interrupt my research.

dialogText.cn: 在、在笼子里做研究吗？真是个怪人。
dialogText.en: Is she doing research in a cage? That's so weird.

dialogText.cn: 看上去她暂时不会有事，先做正事吧。
dialogText.en: She looks alright for now. Let's focus on our task.

dialogText.cn: 墙上有一行被涂抹过的字迹，但内容仍然隐约可见……
dialogText.en: Someone has deliberately painted over the writings on the wall, but the words are still legible...

dialogText.cn: “别想了，这儿被我封死了。”
dialogText.en: "Too bad. No passage. I've sealed this place."

dialogText.cn: （寨民们都昏过去了，清波寨的情况似乎正变得更加棘手……）
dialogText.en: (The Stockade residents have passed out. The situation in Qingbo Stockade has become quite complicated...)

dialogText.cn: （想从根源解决问题，还是得先救出汤汤和阮一。）
dialogText.en: (Saving Tangtang and Ruan Yi is the first step to addressing the root cause of this problem.)

dialogText.cn: （寨子里发生的事……应该能找到些线索。）
dialogText.en: (We should be able to find clues ... to explain what happened in the Stockade.)

dialogText.cn: 就是这儿了。
dialogText.en: This is it.

dialogText.cn: 这里……有什么？看上去只是一堵墙。
dialogText.en: But ... there's nothing here. All I see is a wall.

dialogText.cn: 是扇暗门……只有轻微的使用痕迹。
dialogText.en: This is a secret door... And it looks little used.

dialogText.cn: 没几个人知道这里。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Not many people know about it.

dialogText.cn: 从这儿过去就是<@qu.key>内寨</>了。
dialogText.en: This path takes us directly to the <@qu.key>fort</>.

dialogText.cn: ……也不知道寨子里面是什么情况。
dialogText.en: ...But I have no idea what's going on inside.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Sure.

dialogText.cn: 所以才不对劲，安静过头了。
dialogText.en: And that's why it's weird. It's too quiet.

dialogText.cn: 没有巢雕，没有裂地者的营地，甚至没有发生过激烈冲突的迹象。
dialogText.en: There are no denstacks or breaker camps, and no signs of any physical altercations.

dialogText.cn: 难道碾骨氏族还没控制这里？
dialogText.en: Maybe the Bonekrushers haven't gotten hold of it.

dialogText.cn: 不，那刚才我们遇到的裂地者就说不通。
dialogText.en: Unlikely. That doesn't explain the Landbreakers we ran into back there.

dialogText.cn: 麻烦事越来越多了……还是得快点找到汤汤。
dialogText.en: Trouble just keeps piling up... We really need to find Tangtang quickly.

dialogText.cn: 说得对，抓个人来问问就知道了。
dialogText.en: That's right. We should nab someone for questioning.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐在清波寨，多少也算个名人了吧？
dialogText.en: I bet a lot of Stockaders know your face, Mi Fu.

dialogText.cn: 抓人的事情，还是交给我们吧。
dialogText.en: So let us handle the nabbing part, okay?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……虽然阮一和汤汤认识你们，但直接和你们打过照面的人，确实不多。
dialogText.en: Hmm... That's true. Ruan Yi and Tangtang might know you, but not every Stockader has seen your face.

dialogText.cn: 行，小心点。
dialogText.en: Go ahead, then. Just be careful.

dialogText.cn: 与其说“藏”，更像是在暗中积蓄力量。
dialogText.en: Rather than hiding, I believe she's secretly preserving and building up her forces.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟，无论聂菲斯吞并了多少裂地者氏族……她也不可能与武陵城正面为敌。
dialogText.en: After all, no matter how many Landbreaker clans she controls ... she has no hope of winning a direct confrontation against Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 有可能。
dialogText.en: That's possible.

dialogText.cn: 但他的动机又是什么呢？阿达希尔明显不是碾骨氏族的成员，甚至能够指挥聂菲斯的行动……
dialogText.en: But what is his motive? Ardashir is obviously not a member of the Bonekrushers. He can even order Nefarith around...

dialogText.cn: 怎么感觉……一片祥和？
dialogText.en: Everything looks ... quite peaceful.

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯在武陵的行动方式明显和过去不同。她就像是受到了什么牵制……或是有了更具体的目标。
dialogText.en: Nefarith has adopted very different strategies in Wuling. She seems to be subject to a higher command ... or she might be working towards a more concrete goal.

dialogText.cn: 还没准备好？
dialogText.en: Are you done yet?

dialogText.cn: 她也不容易。毕竟她以前……
dialogText.en: Chen had it hard. After all, she was...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？她没和你们说过应龙特勤队的事？那就轮不到我多嘴了。
dialogText.en: Hmm? I guess she never told you about Yinglung Special Task Force. Well, then. I'll let her tell you about it herself.

dialogText.cn: 总之，她这种人本来就合我胃口——爽快，而且能打。
dialogText.en: In any case, she's very frank and open. Plus she's good with blades. Qualities that I like.

dialogText.cn: 没错，小猫崽子也没少拿我的身世找茬。
dialogText.en: That's right. And the little kitty never fails to take advantage of that.

dialogText.cn: 只不过，我在寨子里的时候也一直独来独往，只和几个人聊得来。
dialogText.en: I usually minded my own business when I was a Stockader. I didn't make many friends back there.

dialogText.cn: 后来……呵，因为一些孽缘，被头儿带去武陵城了。
dialogText.en: But then... Hur. Fate acted in mysterious ways and my boss took me to Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 我以为，在我加入巡卫队以后，他们就会把那儿烧了。
dialogText.en: I thought they'd burn the place after I joined the watchguards.

dialogText.cn: 没想到他们还留着。
dialogText.en: I never expected them to keep those things.

dialogText.cn: 也许是汤汤她……算了，没什么。
dialogText.en: Perhaps Tangtang... Ugh. Forget it. It's not important.

dialogText.cn: 嚯……我还以为会是裂地者，原来是寨民啊。
dialogText.en: Hur... I was expecting a breaker, not a Stockader.

dialogText.cn: 呵，既然是清波寨的人，那就按清波寨的规矩办。
dialogText.en: Hah. He's a Stockader, then we play by Stockade rules.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗果然在寨子里声名远扬……
dialogText.en: Mi Fu really does have quite the reputation in the Stockade...

dialogText.cn: 是啊，如果弭弗姐出身清波寨，那她对待汤汤和寨子的态度，倒也说得通了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. If Mi Fu's from the Stockade, then her attitude toward Tangtang and the others makes perfect sense.

dialogText.cn: 只是没想到雷厉风行的弭弗姐也有不想提起的过去。
dialogText.en: Didn't think Captain Mi Fu the Decisive had a past she'd rather not talk about.

dialogText.cn: 这也是她能成为武陵城和清波寨之间缓冲的原因。也许庄天师正是看中了这点，才让她陪同我们。
dialogText.en: That's why she can be the buffer between the City and the Stockade. Tianshi Zhuang probably assigned her to help us for this strength.

dialogText.cn: 聊什么呢？我这边都搞定了。
dialogText.en: Talking about something? I'm done working the grill.

dialogText.cn: 吓唬了他一下，很快就配合了，没什么难度。
dialogText.en: Barely a challenge. Threatened to turn up the grilling heat and he got cooperative.

dialogText.cn: 我顺手在地上砸了个坑，把他嘴堵上插地里了。
dialogText.en: I also fed him some mud pie, punched a hole in the ground, and stuck him there for his well-being.

dialogText.cn: 按他的说法，<@qu.key>汤汤</>大概被关在那边。其他事情，他也不够格知道。
dialogText.en: According to him, they kept <@qu.key>Tangtang</> somewhere over there. But that's all the small-timer knows.

dialogText.cn: 她被控制起来了。
dialogText.en: They have her detained.

dialogText.cn: 没有，他都没和裂地者说过话，只敢在远处看着。
dialogText.en: No. The lad only looked at them from afar. He didn't have the guts to talk to them.

dialogText.cn: 够干脆，走吧！
dialogText.en: Decisive. Let's move.

dialogText.cn: 你、你们要干嘛？！
dialogText.en: Wha ... what do you want?!

dialogText.cn: 弭、弭弗？！你要做什么？！我是被逼的，你别吓我！
dialogText.en: Mi Fu?! Don't! PLEASE DON'T! They forced me! They totally did!

dialogText.cn: 承认和裂地者有勾结了？小猫崽子太好说话，让你们都忘了当叛徒的下场。
dialogText.en: So you confessed to working with the breakers, huh? Little kitty's too soft on you people that you forgot what happens to traitors.

dialogText.cn: 还是我来帮你回忆一下。
dialogText.en: Time to help you remember.

dialogText.cn: 而且清波寨这样规模的聚集地，绝非一朝一夕能够建成。
dialogText.en: And there's no way that a community the size of Qingbo Stockade is built overnight.

dialogText.cn: 我不想看到数代寨民留下的心血毁于一旦……
dialogText.en: I do not wish to see generations of hard work being reduced to ruins...

dialogText.cn: 这已经不算吓唬了吧……
dialogText.en: Sounds like you deep-fried the poor boy...

dialogText.cn: 差点死在自己家里，多谢了，黑面煞！
dialogText.en: Almost died at my own place. You're a lifesaver, Darkmask!

dialogText.cn: 啧，得先安顿好他们，再去救汤汤——
dialogText.en: Tsk. We gotta get them to safety before trying to save Tangtang.

dialogText.cn: 你们要去救大当家？我偷听到她就被关在水车背后的新牢房里！
dialogText.en: Are you busting the Chief out? I heard they've locked her up in a new cell! The one behind the waterwheel!

dialogText.cn: 还有阮一哥……他被裂地者打伤，然后就被带走了，我要去找他……
dialogText.en: And there's Brother Ruan as well... The breakers hurt him badly and took him away. I must find him...

dialogText.cn: 你一个人……？
dialogText.en: On your own...?

dialogText.cn: 有胆量，我信你。
dialogText.en: Gutsy. I like that.

dialogText.cn: 你们也小心！寨里我们很熟，知道该躲在哪里。
dialogText.en: The Stockade is our home, so we know where to hide. You be careful out there.

dialogText.cn: 我还等着看她被我救出来的脸色呢。
dialogText.en: I really want to see the looks on her face when I bust her out of prison.

dialogText.cn: 你们也被寨里人袭击了？
dialogText.en: Have you been attacked by the Stockaders too?

dialogText.cn: 看来你们见到其他遭难的人了……
dialogText.en: You probably saw other victims...

dialogText.cn: 变故很突然，一帮弟兄趁夜袭击我们……一定是那些裂地者做了什么！
dialogText.en: A bunch of our guys took us by surprise! We got jumped in the middle of the night... The blighted breaker scum definitely got a hand in this!

dialogText.cn: 这太危险了，我们还是一起行动，说不定汤汤知道阮一在哪儿……
dialogText.en: This is too dangerous. We should move as a team. Tangtang might know where Ruan Yi is...

dialogText.cn: 我怕他也撑不了太久……大当家就拜托你们了，这样的自相残杀，只有大当家能制止！
dialogText.en: I don't think he's gonna last that long... Please go and save our Chief... Only she could stop this stupid war amongst ourselves!

dialogText.cn: 既然小猫崽子暂时没事，那准备一下，就赶紧行动吧。
dialogText.en: Good to know that the little kitty is in no immediate danger. We should prep quickly and move out.

dialogText.cn: 他们突然闯进来，打赢了阮哥，然后就出现各种怪事！
dialogText.en: They barged into our turf and even defeated Big Bro! Then all sorts of weird stuff started happening!

dialogText.cn: 不过，寨子的近况很糟……加上大当家和武陵城的合作，本来就有一帮孙子看我们眼红。
dialogText.en: Our Stockade wasn't doing too good... When the Chief started partnering with Wuling and making serious bank, them friggin' wretches got jealous.

dialogText.cn: 我们被扔在这里，什么情况也不知道！
dialogText.en: We got locked up here and are totally in the dark!

dialogText.cn: 自从外来者出现，寨里原本不安分的人就更躁动了，还总是在半夜谋划对武陵城动手！
dialogText.en: Those Stockade wretches ... they started acting up ever since those outsiders arrived! They got these night meetings for their big move against the City!

dialogText.cn: 水铃打小仰慕阮一，又擅长独自行动，说不定她真能行。
dialogText.en: Waterbell likes Big Bro, and she's actually pretty good in solo jobs. Maybe she can do it.

dialogText.cn: ……我会小心的，就让我一个人去吧。
dialogText.en: ...Just let me handle this myself. I'll be extra careful.

dialogText.cn: 不愿意配合的，他们全抓了！
dialogText.en: And anyone who refused to go along got thrown behind bars!

dialogText.cn: 我估计那些不赞同他们想法的，全被抓了。
dialogText.en: Darn it... I guess they slammed up every Fam who refused to go along.

dialogText.cn: 我、我了解阮一哥。他虽然从来不把对武陵城的恨挂在嘴边，好像十年前的事情从未发生一样……
dialogText.en: And I ... I know Brother Ruan really well. He hardly speaks about hating Wuling. He even acts as though that disaster from ten years ago never happened...

dialogText.cn: 但实际上，他只是在忍！他只是在迁就大当家……那些裂地者，我有不祥的预感，我必须去找他……
dialogText.en: But he's keeping everything to himself! He's only playing along with the Chief for now... I fear those breakers... Oh no, I must go and find him...

dialogText.cn: 虽说寨子里到处都是热血上头的混蛋，但毕竟过去都是兄弟姐妹……
dialogText.en: The Stockade is now filled with wretches and hotheads, but they were all our brothers and sisters once...

dialogText.cn: 不可能真一路打杀过去。
dialogText.en: I don't think they're really out for our blood.

dialogText.cn: 墙壁上画满了涂鸦，上面有些熟悉的面孔……
dialogText.en: The wall is covered with drawings. The characters look quite familiar...

dialogText.cn: （中间看上去是汤汤和阮一？）
dialogText.en: (Those in the middle look like Tangtang and Ruan Yi?)

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，这扇门也是你安的？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu, did you install this gate as well?

dialogText.cn: 是汤汤干的，哼……小孩子脾气。
dialogText.en: This is Tangtang's work. Hmph ... such a little kid.

dialogText.cn: 等等，用射流无人机足够启动开门的机关。
dialogText.en: Hold on. Our jet drone should be able to activate the gate-opening mechanism.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>物资箱</>？又是她偷来的……管理员，那里面应该有能用的东西。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Supply crate</>? She's been stealing again... Endmin, they might give us something useful.

dialogText.cn: 你们之前到底发生过啥？而且，弭弗姐，你是清波寨出身？
dialogText.en: So what happened between you two, Mi Fu? And ... are you originally from Qingbo Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 先站远点，我来把门砸开——
dialogText.en: Stand back a little. I'll smash the gate open —

dialogText.cn: 这样动静也小些……
dialogText.en: It'll also make less noise...

dialogText.cn: ……好吧。
dialogText.en: Hmm. Go ahead.

dialogText.cn: ……我没说过吗？很多人都知道。
dialogText.en: Haven't I told you before? I thought everyone knew about it.

dialogText.cn: 看那边！你的无人机应该能够到。
dialogText.en: Look over there! Your drone should be able to reach that.

dialogText.cn: 那边有一个机关，用你的无人机试试！
dialogText.en: I spy a mechanism over yonder! Try using your drone again!

dialogText.cn: 你们……我认得，我见过二姑娘和你们一起。
dialogText.en: You... I know you. I saw the Younger Dame hanging out with you people.

dialogText.cn: ……一个白头发的外来者，就连阮哥都不敢违逆他。
dialogText.en: ...Some white-haired outsider. Even Big Bro doesn't dare cross him.

dialogText.cn: 只要我们乖乖听话，他肯定会帮我们，也就不用去送死了……
dialogText.en: Told us he'll help, as long as we obey. That means we won't have to get ourselves killed...

dialogText.cn: 叛乱？你是说不服二姑娘的那些人？
dialogText.en: Traitors? Are you talking about those who refuse to obey the Younger Dame?

dialogText.cn: 人都有点自己的想法，不用把话说这么难听。
dialogText.en: Traitor's a really harsh word, friend. Everyone's free to think for themselves.

dialogText.cn: 不清楚……我不想掺和他们的事。
dialogText.en: Not really... I don't want to get involved in their business.

dialogText.cn: 不管你们是来找谁的，赶紧走吧……
dialogText.en: I don't care who you're looking for. Just get out of here...

dialogText.cn: 等等，这些东西拿着，别告诉其他人见到了我们。
dialogText.en: Hold on. Here. Take these. And don't tell anyone that you saw us...

dialogText.cn: 反正那位大人物看不上这个，也用不上了……
dialogText.en: This failed to impress the real big shot. It's useless to me now...

dialogText.cn: 戴面具的，一看你就是有想法的人！
dialogText.en: You! Masked one! I see you are amongst those who can think for themselves!

dialogText.cn: 现在帮老子出来，清波寨大护法就是你！
dialogText.en: Free your lord and master from this place, and I shall name thee... High Protector of Qingbo Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 听着，老祖宗托梦给老子，要解决寨子的麻烦，非老子不可！
dialogText.en: Hark! Your lord speaketh! The ancestors have spoken to me in a dream! ONLY I can end the troubles of the Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 阮一、汤汤都不得行，就得来硬的！
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi and Tangtang are LOSERS! We must be HARD and MERCILESS!

dialogText.cn: 别废话，放不放！
dialogText.en: END THE FOOLISH TALK! RELEASE ME!

dialogText.cn: 好！
dialogText.en: I AM FREE!

dialogText.cn: 寨子乱成这样，那些煽风点火的裂地者头罪！阮一、汤汤当软蛋同罪！
dialogText.en: DEATH to the blighted breakers who triggered the war and ruined our Stockade! Ruan Yi and Tangtang shall also be judged for being spineless, stupid LOSERS!

dialogText.cn: 老子先去干裂地者，再去掀了阮一、汤汤！
dialogText.en: I shall rain divine punishment on the breakers! Then I shall overthrow Ruan Yi and Tangtang!

dialogText.cn: 周围被关的，愿意跟着干的，老子也一并救了！
dialogText.en: And I shall ALSO liberate every prisoner who follows my lead!

dialogText.cn: 戴面具的，老子珍藏的东西……提前赏你了！等当了大当家，老子再回来封你大护法！
dialogText.en: Masked one! Here is my special relic... TAKE IT! Once I become Supreme Chief, you shall become the High Protector of my realms!

dialogText.cn: 停下，你们要去哪儿？怎么溜到这里来的？
dialogText.en: Stop! Where do you think you're going? And how did you get in?

dialogText.cn: 好，那我就当没见过你们。
dialogText.en: Fine. If anyone asks, we never met.

dialogText.cn: 大家都是一个寨子的人，本来就不该非要分个你我他。
dialogText.en: We're all part of the Stockade Fam. I don't know why we split ourselves into different factions.

dialogText.cn: 只是事已至此，我也无能为力。
dialogText.en: But things have happened, and I'm powerless to stop it.

dialogText.cn: ……我能猜到你们想干嘛，我会当没见过你们。
dialogText.en: ...I think I know your plans, but I'll pretend I've never seen you.

dialogText.cn: 找我的宝贝，它逃了。
dialogText.en: Finding my little pet. It ran away from home.

dialogText.cn: 一头百眼彪兽。
dialogText.en: Yes. It's a spotted rakerbeast.

dialogText.cn: 我打小爱和野兽打交道，阮一就让我试着驯服些野兽，看能不能替我们守家。
dialogText.en: I've been pretty good with beasts since I was a little girl. So, Ruan Yi made me tame a few beasts to help guard our homes.

dialogText.cn: 对……我根本劝不动他。
dialogText.en: Yeah... I couldn't persuade him otherwise.

dialogText.cn: 而且寨子刚闹过一波，彪兽受了点惊，就往山上跑了。
dialogText.en: The Stockade got itself into a big mess recently. The fight spooked the rakerbeast, and it fled for the hills.

dialogText.cn: 你们要是撞见它，千万小心。
dialogText.en: If you run into it, be extra, extra careful.

dialogText.cn: 大、大当家……你、你你……怎么出来了？
dialogText.en: S-S-Supreme Chief...?! W-Why are you h-here?

dialogText.cn: 阮、阮哥不是说你病了吗？
dialogText.en: I-I thought B-B-Big Bro said you're s-s-sick.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，有你出面支持阮哥，那、那些还摇摆不定的人，就能放下心找、找武陵城报仇了……
dialogText.en: This is great! If you support Big Bro, the w-wishy-washy people will finally go along... We can finally get revenge on W-W-Wuling!

dialogText.cn: 我娘的仇，总算能报、报了。
dialogText.en: I can finally a-a-avenge my Ma!

dialogText.cn: 哥，是被逼的……
dialogText.en: They forced Big Bro to do this...

dialogText.cn: 跟我来，还有一条路能去<@qu.key>祖泉</>！
dialogText.en: Follow me! There's another path to the <@qu.key>Ancestral Spring</>!

dialogText.cn: 你们要干嘛？离远点，你们也是碾骨氏族的——
dialogText.en: Who the hell are you? Get lost, you Bonekrusher bast —

dialogText.cn: 陈，拦住他！
dialogText.en: Stop him, Chen!

dialogText.cn: ……哼，几日不回清波寨，阵仗倒是变大了。
dialogText.en: ...Hmph. Stepped away for a few days, and the rabble just got bigger.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，一半归我，一半归你们。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you can have half of these rascals.

dialogText.cn: 等等……你……粉白头发的萨卡兹……你是弭弗？！武陵的人已经来了？
dialogText.en: Hold on... You... Pink-haired Sarkaz... You're Mi Fu?! Are the Wulingers here already?

dialogText.cn: 认得我就好办了，什么情况？
dialogText.en: Good. You know me. What's going on here?

dialogText.cn: 那些裂地者……不知道向这些家伙许诺了些什么……
dialogText.en: It's those pipefaces... They promised these idiots something...

dialogText.cn: 他们公开反抗大当家，说要把清波寨变成他们的堡垒，然后把武陵人从这片土地上赶出去！
dialogText.en: They launched a full-on power grab, saying they'd make Qingbo Stockade their stronghold and boot every Wulinger off these lands!

dialogText.cn: 以卵击石。
dialogText.en: Hmph. They've got a death wish.

dialogText.cn: 就是说啊，我们怎么可能打赢武陵的天师？他们那些装备，还有那个装清高的庄方宜……
dialogText.en: That's what I said. There's no way we can defeat the Tianshi of Wuling. Look at their gear ... and that pretentious Zhuang Fangyi...

dialogText.cn: ……够了。
dialogText.en: ...Enough.

dialogText.cn: 只是“打不赢”，而不是不想打，嗯？
dialogText.en: So you're just waiting for a war you can win, huh?

dialogText.cn: ……随、随便你怎么说。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Say whatever you want.

dialogText.cn: 嘿……以前饿过肚子的孩子，都会这么想。无非是……有的人想当懦夫罢了。
dialogText.en: Heh... That disaster left orphans thirsting for Wuling blood. Shame we've got some gutless cowards!

dialogText.cn: 闭嘴！
dialogText.en: Shut yer trap!

dialogText.cn: 你们没必要对武陵有这么大的敌意吧……
dialogText.en: All this hating on Wuling is really unnecessary...

dialogText.cn: 我不是有敌意……我……
dialogText.en: I'm not a hater... I'm just...

dialogText.cn: 弭弗，你能不能答应我？哪怕对这些叛徒，也留他们一条命！
dialogText.en: Gah, Mi Fu, listen to me. They're traitors, yes, but please spare them!

dialogText.cn: 我知道这是强人所难，但这段时间，侵蚀潮泛滥成灾，大当家也好，我们也好，心里都没底。
dialogText.en: I know I'm asking a lot, but the recent Blight Tides are devastating. No one knows if we'll survive this — not even the Chief herself.

dialogText.cn: 他们大多在当年的事故里失去了亲朋好友，现在又撞上灾年，走投无路，才会被蛊惑！
dialogText.en: Many Stockaders lost family or friends in that disaster. This year's been brutal. People are desperate, which is why they fell for those lies!

dialogText.cn: 所以——
dialogText.en: That's why — HNGH!

dialogText.cn: ——去你妈的亲朋好友！死的是咱俩亲娘！
dialogText.en: Screw you! You blighted ingrate! THEY KILLED OUR MA!

dialogText.cn: 呃！
dialogText.en: Urk!

dialogText.cn: ——活该！怂货！
dialogText.en: Friggin' coward! You deserve this!

dialogText.cn: 啧！
dialogText.en: Ngh!

dialogText.cn: 梁子孙淌来了！并肩子，伏点儿！
dialogText.en: TIME FOR REVENGE! ME FAM! MURK 'EM!

dialogText.cn: 各位……都没事吧？
dialogText.en: Is everyone alright?

dialogText.cn: ……都、都结束了吗？
dialogText.en: Is it ... all over?

dialogText.cn: 水铃？你不是去找阮一了吗？
dialogText.en: Waterbell? Weren't you trying to find Ruan Yi?

dialogText.cn: ……阮一哥，应该，就在前面。
dialogText.en: Brother Ruan should be up ahead...

dialogText.cn: 前面的看守越来越严密，我正愁过不去，你们就杀出来了。
dialogText.en: But they also posted stronger guards. I was worried about not getting past them when you started a battle here.

dialogText.cn: 如果是这样，你不能再独自深入了。
dialogText.en: This also means that you won't get in on your own.

dialogText.cn: ……可是刚才打那一架动静不小，我担心更多援兵已经在路上了。
dialogText.en: ...Yeah, that battle raised quite a commotion. Their reinforcements are probably on the way.

dialogText.cn: 这样……我来带路，尽量避开他们的注意，先去确认大当家的安危，然后再见机行事！
dialogText.en: What about this... I'll lead the way and try to avoid alerting them. We'll first check on the Chief and then decide on our next move!

dialogText.cn: 避开正面冲突，也能保证人质的安全……麻烦你带路了。
dialogText.en: Avoiding direct encounters will also keep the hostages safe... We'll follow your lead.

dialogText.cn: 这些家伙的身手，真不算赖，我还以为汤汤和弭弗姐算是特例。
dialogText.en: I'm okay. Hmph, they're actually pretty good at fighting. I thought Tangtang and Mi Fu were the only great warriors round here.

dialogText.cn: 呃……嘶——这都是为了活命，口口相传的把式，差不到哪里去。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Ssss —! It's all about survival. Our fighting skills have been passed down for generations. They could hold their own.

dialogText.cn: 我那个傻兄弟……
dialogText.en: So what about my fool of a baby brother...?

dialogText.cn: ……不知道。也许趁乱溜走了。
dialogText.en: ...No idea. Maybe he sneaked away during the chaos.

dialogText.cn: ……唉，我去找他……还是得去找他。
dialogText.en: Ugh... I should go... He must be found.

dialogText.cn: ……啊啊！憋屈死了！那个聂菲斯，她到底想把清波寨怎么样啊？！
dialogText.en: ...Grrrr! Sheesh! This is so frustrating! What is Nefarith planning to do to Qingbo Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 利用仇恨，把这儿变成武陵城躲不开的一根刺……无论如何，必须马上救出汤汤。
dialogText.en: She is manipulating hate ... and turning this place into a permanent thorn in Wuling's side... We must find Tangtang.

dialogText.cn: 而且看刚才的阵势，叛徒们都聚在了这附近。
dialogText.en: Judging from that mob we just fought, I believe most of the Stockade traitors have gathered nearby.

dialogText.cn: 难怪清波寨外围这么安静……他们一定在前方密谋着什么。
dialogText.en: That's why areas outside the Stockade have been so quiet... These traitors must be planning something up ahead.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，只是不知道前方的路上还会有多少敌人……
dialogText.en: Yes, but we don't know how many enemies we'll be facing next...

dialogText.cn: 有敌人，说明路是对的。
dialogText.en: Since there are enemies up ahead, this path must be the right one.

dialogText.cn: 只要她还安全，其他我都无所谓。
dialogText.en: Her safety is the only thing I care about.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，去祖泉。你还没有完全掌握新的力量。
dialogText.en: Go forth to the Ancestral Spring. You have yet to master the new powers.

dialogText.cn: 先救<@qu.key>汤汤</>！
dialogText.en: Save <@qu.key>Tangtang</> first!

dialogText.cn: 可你的选择，已经让她失望了。
dialogText.en: But your choice has already disappointed her.

dialogText.cn: 别走……别走……
dialogText.en: No... Don't go...

dialogText.cn: 是阿达希尔和阮一！
dialogText.en: Look... It's Ardashir and Ruan Yi.

dialogText.cn: 不要沉浸在复仇里，你和你的寨民，应该参与到真正的宏图伟业中来。
dialogText.en: Do not wallow in hatred. You and your people deserve to be part of a truly grand enterprise.

dialogText.cn: 复仇，算不上什么伟业。
dialogText.en: Hatred ... never builds anything great.

dialogText.cn: 他们要走了！
dialogText.en: They're leaving!

dialogText.cn: 放开！
dialogText.en: LET GO!

dialogText.cn: 冷静点，小猫崽子，我可以帮你！
dialogText.en: Calm down, kitty! I can help you!

dialogText.cn: ……那如果我哥真的干了错事，你会救我哥吗？
dialogText.en: ...If Big Bro really did something wrong, will you still save him?

dialogText.cn: 那就给姑奶奶我让开！
dialogText.en: Then let go of me!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞……连你也要拦我？
dialogText.en: Darkmask...? You wanna stop me too?

dialogText.cn: 我就知道你会帮我！
dialogText.en: I knew you would help me!

dialogText.cn: 不说话，那就当你支持我了！
dialogText.en: No objections? Then I'll take that as a yes!

dialogText.cn: 这里，我知道怎么<@qu.key>追上他们</>。
dialogText.en: Come with me. I know how to <@qu.key>catch up to them</>.
*Sigh*

dialogText.cn: 别冲动，你能做什么？
dialogText.en: Don't be rash. What can you do?

dialogText.cn: 看，临时搭的，没那么牢固。走吧。
dialogText.en: Here. Built this in a rush, so it's not so stable. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 别走……
