dialogText.en: Don't go...

dialogText.cn: 有点低烧，其他没什么大碍。可能只是精神太紧绷，做噩梦了。
dialogText.en: Mild fever, nothing life-threatening. She's probably just having a bad dream from all the stress.

dialogText.cn: 别走……
dialogText.en: Don't go...

dialogText.cn: 汤汤，等我和爹从武陵城把粮食弄回来，就没人会饿肚子了。
dialogText.en: Tangtang, father and I will return with food from Wuling. No one will starve anymore.

dialogText.cn: 而且你还得替大伙儿守着家呢。我们很快就回来。
dialogText.en: But right now, I need you to look after our homes. We'll be back soon.

dialogText.cn: 爹……撑住，求你了……那些该死的天师……
dialogText.en: Father ... please don't die... PLEASE...! Those blighted Tianshi...

dialogText.cn: 哥哥，你在哪儿……我看不清你……
dialogText.en: Where are you, Big Bro...? I can't see you...

dialogText.cn: 你的眼睛，你受伤了？！疼吗？
dialogText.en: Your eye! Who did this?! Does it hurt?

dialogText.cn: 汤汤……汤汤……
dialogText.en: {F}Tangtang... Tangtang...{M}Tangtang... Tangtang...

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞……？你怎么……我好像又梦到以前的事了……
dialogText.en: Darkmask...? It's you... I was dreaming about the past again...

dialogText.cn: 等等，我哥呢？！
dialogText.en: Wait! Where's my Big Bro?!

dialogText.cn: 那我、我也要帮忙！
dialogText.en: Then ... let me help too!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，等你能拿稳手铳的那天，我都听你的！
dialogText.en: Hehe, once you're old enough to hold handcannons steady, I'll let you call the shots!

dialogText.cn: 汤汤？！你怎么跟来了——
dialogText.en: TANGTANG?! Why are you here —

dialogText.cn: 先睡吧，睡吧。等你醒了，我们就到家了……
dialogText.en: It's okay, baby sis. Just sleep. We'll be home when you wake up...

dialogText.cn: 我哥有危险！
dialogText.en: Big Bro's in danger!

dialogText.cn: 不疼了，就是好困……
dialogText.en: It's not hurting anymore, but I'm so sleepy...

dialogText.cn: 阮一……已经决定站在阿达希尔那边了吗？
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi ... has he decided to stand with Ardashir?

dialogText.cn: 他是为了汤汤……还是连汤汤都一起骗了？
dialogText.en: Did he do this for Tangtang ... or has he deceived her as well?

dialogText.cn: 你赢不了他，追上去也只是送死。
dialogText.en: You can't beat him. He'll just kill you even if you catch up to him.

dialogText.cn: 我会把事情全部汇报给头儿，她肯定有办法……
dialogText.en: Hmph. I'll report all this to my boss. She'll figure something out...

dialogText.cn: 没必要！你这个叛徒！
dialogText.en: Shove it! You traitor!

dialogText.cn: 现在阮一更适合这个名头。
dialogText.en: Tell that to Ruan Yi. He totally fits.

dialogText.cn: 我没时间和你争，这是我的职责！
dialogText.en: I'm done bickering with you. I have duties to fulfill!

dialogText.cn: 我哥才是需要被帮助的那个人！只要把他救出来——
dialogText.en: My Bro is the one who needs help! We just gotta rescue him —

dialogText.cn: ……不关你事！
dialogText.en: ...Just stay out of this!

dialogText.cn: 汤汤。
dialogText.en: Tangtang.

dialogText.cn: ……什么？
dialogText.en: ...What?

dialogText.cn: 如果你非要去……遇到危险就给我逃。你不是最擅长这个吗？
dialogText.en: If you really wanna go ... just run if things get out of hand. You're good at that, right?

dialogText.cn: 管理员！你还好吗？有没有伤到哪里？
dialogText.en: Endmin! Are you alright? Are you hurt?

dialogText.cn: 是啊……
dialogText.en: Yeah...

dialogText.cn: 和你没关系！
dialogText.en: It's none of your business!

dialogText.cn: 那你的职责呢？！你不是大当家吗？！
dialogText.en: So what about *YOUR* job, Supreme Chief?!

dialogText.cn: 你要是把自己的命也搭进去，谁来帮助浪头他们，谁来保证寨子的安全？！
dialogText.en: If you get yourself killed, who the hell's gonna defend the Stockade or people like Lang Tou!
I —

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，我哥刚才……
dialogText.en: Darkmask, my Bro is being...

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞……你愿意帮我吗？
dialogText.en: Darkmask... Will you still help me?

dialogText.cn: 不管是关于阿达希尔还是聂菲斯，阮一肯定有我们想要的情报。
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi definitely has intel we need about Ardashir or Nefarith.
...Heh.

dialogText.cn: 他肯定是被胁迫了，我得把他救出来……对，救出来……
dialogText.en: They must've forced him. We gotta get him out... We must save him...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，汤汤不会轻易放弃的……
dialogText.en: Endmin, Tangtang is not the type to give up so easily...

dialogText.cn: 我会帮你的，大当家。
dialogText.en: {F}I shall assist you, Chief.{M}I shall assist you, Chief.

dialogText.cn: ……那黑面煞也觉得，我哥是叛徒吗？
dialogText.en: ...Do you also think that my Bro turned traitor, Darkmask?

dialogText.cn: 抱歉。
dialogText.en: {F}I'm sorry.{M}I'm sorry.

dialogText.cn: 我只能向你保证，无论真相是什么……
dialogText.en: {F}But I can assure you, no matter what the truth may be...{M}But I can assure you, no matter what the truth may be...

dialogText.cn: 当你面对它的时候，我清波寨第三把交椅黑面煞，一定会站在大当家这边。
dialogText.en: {F}...I, Darkmask of Qingbo Stockade and Occupant of the Third Seat, shall stand with my Chief.{M}...I, Darkmask of Qingbo Stockade and Occupant of the Third Seat, shall stand with my Chief.

dialogText.cn: 那也够了，黑面煞。
dialogText.en: That's all I need, Darkmask.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Hmm.

dialogText.cn: 来得刚好。
dialogText.en: You came at the right time.

dialogText.cn: 算是吧。
dialogText.en: You can say that.

dialogText.cn: 考虑到最坏的情况，武陵城会进入戒备状态。
dialogText.en: We must assume the worst. Wuling City will declare a state of readiness.

dialogText.cn: 只是……
dialogText.en: But...

dialogText.cn: 你放心不下汤汤？
dialogText.en: You're worried about Tangtang, right?

dialogText.cn: 对……而且头儿愿意我陪你们来，就是为了不大动干戈。
dialogText.en: Tsk. That's right... The boss let me tag along with you because she wanted me to keep a lid on the pot.

dialogText.cn: 但事态如此，我不得不履行……巡卫的职责。
dialogText.en: But the entire thing is boiling over. I must fulfill my duty ... as a watchguard.

dialogText.cn: 但你不一样……“黑面煞”。
dialogText.en: But you're different... "Darkmask".

dialogText.cn: 哈，能够同时与管理员和黑面煞并肩作战，好像也挺畅快的。
dialogText.en: Heh. Imagine fighting alongside the Endministrator *and* Darkmask. Sounds like real fun.

dialogText.cn: 打不打得赢，都活着回来。
dialogText.en: I don't care if you win or lose. Just survive this.

dialogText.cn: 我等你们。
dialogText.en: I'll be waiting for you.

dialogText.cn: 我已经把目前的情报全部汇报给了头儿。
dialogText.en: I reported everything about the current situation to my boss.

dialogText.cn: 头儿可没机会见识黑面煞的风采。
dialogText.en: My boss will probably miss her chance to witness the Darkmask in glorious action.

dialogText.cn: 怎么囤了这么多武器炸药……
dialogText.en: Why are there so many weapons and explosives here...?

dialogText.cn: 这是什么？计划图？
dialogText.en: What's this? A plan?

dialogText.cn: 看结构像是武陵城，之前的袭击果然是有预谋的。
dialogText.en: Looks like Wuling from the layouts and shapes. So that attack was planned in advance.

dialogText.cn: 陈，给她一点时间吧。
dialogText.en: Try to give her some time, Chen.

dialogText.cn: 也许，阮一从来都没放弃报仇。
dialogText.en: Perhaps Ruan Yi never gave up vengeance.

dialogText.cn: 我们很快就知道了。
dialogText.en: We'll learn soon enough.

dialogText.cn: ……麻烦你了。
dialogText.en: ...Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 走。现在我和他，有账要算了。
dialogText.en: Let's go. Now I got a score to settle with him.

dialogText.cn: 这里怎么会变成这样……
dialogText.en: What happened to this place...?

dialogText.cn: 像是某种力量失控导致的。难道是阿达希尔提到的“力量”……
dialogText.en: Seems like some kind of power gone rampant. Could this be the "new powers" that Ardashir mentioned...?

dialogText.cn: 等等，那边！
dialogText.en: Wait. Look over there!

dialogText.cn: 水铃！
dialogText.en: Waterbell!

dialogText.cn: 大、大当家……你没事……就好……
dialogText.en: Chief... So glad ... you're alright...

dialogText.cn: 好重的伤……陈，帮我一把，得为她止血。
dialogText.en: She's grievously wounded... Chen, help me. We must stop her bleeding.

dialogText.cn: 是谁干的？！谁打伤了你，阿达希尔，还是——
dialogText.en: Who did this to you?! Was it Ardashir...? Or was it —

dialogText.cn: ——是、是我哥？
dialogText.en: My ... Big Bro?

dialogText.cn: ……别……别恨他……他不是故意的……
dialogText.en: Don't ... hate him... He didn't ... mean to.

dialogText.cn: 只是我……想让他……想让清波寨……回到……
dialogText.en: I tried ... to talk him back ... so the Stockade ... could return...

dialogText.cn: 她的伤势太重了。
dialogText.en: Her injuries are too severe.

dialogText.cn: 我已经尽可能采取措施了，现在只能靠她自己了……
dialogText.en: I've done all that I can. Now it's up to her body and will.

dialogText.cn: 我先把她抱去安全的地方……等我一会儿。
dialogText.en: I need to carry her to somewhere safe... Wait for me.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤……
dialogText.en: Tangtang...

dialogText.cn: 出来，别等我动手。
dialogText.en: Come out, or you'll be sorry.

dialogText.cn: 我就说不该躲在桶里！
dialogText.en: I told you not to hide in barrels!

dialogText.cn: 别瞎动。我先出去。
dialogText.en: Stop moving! I'll go first.

dialogText.cn: 巡卫大人，我认识您这身衣服。别动手，我投降！
dialogText.en: Miss Watchguard! I know you are kind! Don't kill me! I surrender!

dialogText.cn: 锚儿哥，快滚出来！
dialogText.en: Bosun! Get outta there, now!

dialogText.cn: ……我、我卡住了！
dialogText.en: I... I'm stuck!

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，我们躲这儿是想找机会从寨子里逃出去！
dialogText.en: Ahem. We're uh... We've been hiding here 'cause we wanna ditch the Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 那些想找武陵报仇的人越来越疯了，大伙儿迟早都要被他们害死。
dialogText.en: Some of the Fam have gone crazy messing with Wuling. They're gonna get everyone killed someday.

dialogText.cn: 连大当家都被他们关在前面，我们很担心她——
dialogText.en: They even threw our Chief into the brig! We're so worried about her that we...

dialogText.cn: 哼，担心她的表现就是开溜吗？
dialogText.en: Hmph, so worried about her that you ran off?

dialogText.cn: 那、那我可以先带你们去救大当家！
dialogText.en: W-we could lead you to our Chief and save her!

dialogText.cn: 只要到时候各位能放我们离开就行！
dialogText.en: Just let us go when you free the Chief! Please!

dialogText.cn: 咳，还有一件事……能不能帮我兄弟出来？
dialogText.en: Ahem ... sorry to ask, but could you get my brother out of his barrel?

dialogText.cn: 这个好办！
dialogText.en: That's easy!

dialogText.cn: 这桥的转动机关有点生锈，只要让它们转起来，就能正常使用了。
dialogText.en: Serious rust has jammed the bridge actuators. You gotta get them turning to make the bridge work again.

dialogText.cn: 快、快憋不住了——
dialogText.en: Hngh! Running out of air —

dialogText.cn: 谁？
dialogText.en: Who's there?

dialogText.cn: 感谢恩人！
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you! Thank you so much!

dialogText.cn: 哈、哈哈，能保住命就行。
dialogText.en: Ha, haha... Gotta do anything to save my skin.

dialogText.cn: 听上去用射流无人机就能搞定。
dialogText.en: Sounds like job for our jet drone.

dialogText.cn: 那太好了。你们先让这个机关转起来，我们去<@qu.key>桥上</>等你们。
dialogText.en: So you've got the tools. Great, turn the mechanisms first. We'll wait for you <@qu.key>on the bridge</>.

dialogText.cn: 成了，那俩家伙确实没骗我们……
dialogText.en: It's working. Those two didn't lie to us...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？他们人呢？
dialogText.en: Hm? Where did they go?

dialogText.cn: 趁现在！
dialogText.en: NOW!

dialogText.cn: 扯呼！
dialogText.en: RUN FOR IT!

dialogText.cn: 算了，弭弗姐，先<@qu.key>救汤汤</>要紧。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Mi Fu. We gotta <@qu.key>save Tangtang</> first.

dialogText.cn: 怎么只有他一个人？
dialogText.en: Why is he alone?

dialogText.cn: 这是聂菲斯和阿达希尔设下的埋伏？
dialogText.en: This might be an ambush laid by Ardashir and Nefarith.

dialogText.cn: 但现在看来，没这个机会了。
dialogText.en: Seems it's already too late for that.

dialogText.cn: 走远一点？
dialogText.en: Go somewhere far away?

dialogText.cn: 现在你还要装作可怜我？
dialogText.en: Now you act like you still care about me?

dialogText.cn: 够了，你现在还能离开……
dialogText.en: Enough. There is still time for you to leave...

dialogText.cn: 去哪儿？去武陵城，还是去我都没听过的地方？！
dialogText.en: Leave? To where? Wuling? Or somewhere I've never heard of?

dialogText.cn: 哥……去他的武陵……去他的阿达希尔、聂菲斯！我们自己的账，我们自己算！
dialogText.en: Bro... To hell with Wuling ... and to hell with Ardashir and Nefarith! This is our mess, and it's ours to clean up!

dialogText.cn: 你的命……是欠兄弟姐妹，还有我的。
dialogText.en: You owe your life ... to the Fam ... and me.

dialogText.cn: 我不求你理解——
dialogText.en: I don't deserve your understanding...

dialogText.cn: 但能向武陵报仇的唯一机会……我不能错过。
dialogText.en: But this is my only chance of revenge against Wuling... I cannot miss it.

dialogText.cn: 那你一开始就找错人了，阿达希尔！
dialogText.en: Blame yourself for finding the wrong person, Ardashir!

actorName.cn: 阿达希尔的声音{阿达希尔}

dialogText.cn: 你还没有做好准备，你会死在这里。
dialogText.en: You are not yet ready. You will die here.
...HAH!

dialogText.cn: 大当家，回头吧。
dialogText.en: Chief, turn around and leave.

dialogText.cn: ……这次，我不会听你的。
dialogText.en: ...I have to say no this time.

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔说得没错，你们果然来了……
dialogText.en: Ardashir was right. You came...

dialogText.cn: 是你让大伙儿挑起战争！
dialogText.en: You pushed the Fam to war!

dialogText.cn: 是你放任裂地者接管寨子！
dialogText.en: You let the Landbreakers seize our Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 是你……背叛我们……
dialogText.en: You ... betrayed us...

dialogText.cn: 这里就是我家！你是我唯一的家人！
dialogText.en: This is my home! You're my only family!

dialogText.cn: 只要我能彻底掌握这份力量……
dialogText.en: Once I master this power...

dialogText.cn: 你的手……！
dialogText.en: Your arm...!

dialogText.cn: ……我本来希望，你们能陪着汤汤，走得远一点。
dialogText.en: ...I was hoping you could take Tangtang with you, and go somewhere far away.

actorName.cn: 阿达希尔的声音{阿达希尔}

dialogText.cn: 放弃复仇，跟我走，你既然已经被选中，就应该参与更伟大的事业……
dialogText.en: Abandon your vengeance. Follow me. You have been chosen for a greater enterprise...

dialogText.cn: 自以为是——他凭什么觉得这样对我更好？！他为什么这么不负责任地一死了之？！
dialogText.en: How dare he...? What made him think he knew what's best for me? How could he just bail out like that...?

dialogText.cn: 明明临到死前，他也在害怕……
dialogText.en: He was scared ... right until the very end...

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡，也许是我的错觉，阮一……他最后是不是放弃了挣扎……
dialogText.en: Maybe it's just me, Perlica, but Ruan Yi... I feel like he gave up at the final moment...

dialogText.cn: 汤汤……我们该走了。
dialogText.en: Tangtang ... we should go.

dialogText.cn: 能让我自己待一会儿吗？
dialogText.en: Can I be alone for a while?

dialogText.cn: 我们等你。
dialogText.en: {F}We'll wait for you.{M}We'll wait for you.

dialogText.cn: 明明……早就已经天晴了……不用再想着复仇的事了……
dialogText.en: Why...? The rain ended so long ago... Why seek revenge when the sun's out...?

dialogText.cn: ……但愿今天之后，那段往事不再是清波寨和武陵之间的隔阂。
dialogText.en: ...I just hope that after today, the Stockaders and Wulingers can put that incident behind them.

dialogText.cn: 我是来吊唁朋友的。
dialogText.en: I am here to pay my last respects to a fallen friend.

dialogText.cn: 你并不相信我……
dialogText.en: You do not believe me...

dialogText.cn: 也别把她逼得太紧。相信她吧。
dialogText.en: Don't push her too hard. We should have faith in her.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤是放不下清波寨的……原本追随阮一的寨民估计也乱成一团了。
dialogText.en: Yeah, Tangtang won't abandon the Stockade... And those who followed Ruan Yi are probably in a total mess right now.

dialogText.cn: 先离开这里吧。我们要告知弭弗和庄天师所有的事情，还有……
dialogText.en: Let's leave. We need to report the situation here to Mi Fu and Tianshi Zhuang. And then...

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔！
dialogText.en: Ardashir!

dialogText.cn: 不就是你干的吗！
dialogText.en: You did this to him!

dialogText.cn: 在你眼里，现在的我是什么模样呢？
dialogText.en: How do you regard me at this moment?

dialogText.cn: 伪善？狡诈？残忍？是造成这一切的罪魁祸首？
dialogText.en: Pretentious? Cunning? Cruel? The malevolent puppeteer behind it all?

dialogText.cn: ——无论你怎么想，我都承认。
dialogText.en: However you perceive me, I shall accept it all.

dialogText.cn: 我们已经站在对立面了，我说什么都是苍白的辩词。
dialogText.en: We are now on opposing sides. Everything I say will be taken as feeble excuses.

dialogText.cn: 仇恨的双方是很难互相理解的。那么，捕食者与被捕食者呢？造物主与造物呢？
dialogText.en: When two factions steeped in hatred can scarcely understand each other, what hope lies between predator and prey, or creator and creation?

dialogText.cn: 请原谅，管理员，我会继续与你为敌，也可能会伤害到你珍视的人和事。
dialogText.en: Forgive me, Endministrator. I will continue to oppose you, and those you care for may become my targets.

dialogText.cn: 只是，至少请你相信……
dialogText.en: However, please do believe that...

dialogText.cn: 我所做的一切，都是为了文明的存续。
dialogText.en: ...every action I take is for the survival of Civilization.

dialogText.cn: 我没想好该和你们说什么……我也以为我做好了准备，可……
dialogText.en: I ... I don't know what to say to you... I thought I was ready, but...

dialogText.cn: 再给我点时间……我得先收拾好他留下的烂摊子，安顿好寨里的兄弟姐妹。
dialogText.en: Gimme a bit more time... I gotta clean up Big Bro's mess ... and help my Fam back in the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉黑面煞，你帮了我这么多，但我却失约了……
dialogText.en: Sorry, Darkmask. You helped me out so much, but I kept breaking my promise...

dialogText.cn: 他一直很爱寨里的所有人，从我记事起就是这样……
dialogText.en: For as long as I can remember, he loved and cared for everyone in the Stockade Fam...

dialogText.cn: 对我们的照顾，是装不出来的！
dialogText.en: It wasn't an act, I know it wasn't!

dialogText.cn: 我只是，我只是……不懂为什么他为了报仇，要把大伙儿都搭上……
dialogText.en: I just... I just don't know why he must drag everyone in ... and pursue his plan for revenge...

dialogText.cn: “相信我会一直站在你身边”。
dialogText.en: {F}"Trust me. Because I'll always be on your side."{M}"Trust me. Because I'll always be on your side."

dialogText.cn: 还是说，大当家你忘了我们的约定？
dialogText.en: {F}Or should I assume that our Chief forgot about the promise she made?{M}Or should I assume that our Chief forgot about the promise she made?

dialogText.cn: ……姑奶奶我是堂堂清波寨大当家，说到做到，怎么会忘——
dialogText.en: ...I'm the Chief of Qingbo Stockade. I keep my word, never break it!

dialogText.cn: 呜，如果、如果他真的变了……如果他从一开始就在骗我……
dialogText.en: But ... but if he really changed ... or has been lying to me from the very beginning...

dialogText.cn: 我该怎么办？
dialogText.en: What should I do?

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 交给我吧。
dialogText.en: {F}Don't worry. I'll handle this.{M}Don't worry. I'll handle this.
Hooo...

dialogText.cn: 嗯！谢谢……管理员。
dialogText.en: Yeah! Thank you... Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 如果，他真的只是为了报仇……那我是不是也有责任？
dialogText.en: And if he's doing this for vengeance ... perhaps I'm responsible as well.

dialogText.cn: ……汤汤？
dialogText.en: ...Tangtang?

dialogText.cn: ……我是爹收养的，但哥是他亲生的。
dialogText.en: ...I was adopted, but my Bro was a real son of my father.

dialogText.cn: 十年前，清波寨的日子过得比现在还苦。那个时候真的饿死过人。
dialogText.en: Things were really bad at Qingbo Stockade ten years ago. People actually died from hunger.

dialogText.cn: 为了我，也为了其他人，爹和哥，决定冒险……去抢武陵的物资车队。
dialogText.en: My Bro and my father ... risked everything for me and everyone else ... by raiding a Wuling supply convoy.

dialogText.cn: 放在平时，这种小打小闹根本不算什么！但那些天师……他们也没有从北部禁区的惨剧中回过神来……
dialogText.en: A convoy raid is often just a scuffle! But the Tianshi... They were very affected by the disaster in the Exclusion Zone...

dialogText.cn: 那天下雨，夜里又看不清……他们就失手把爹给……
dialogText.en: It was raining that night, and people could hardly see anything... Father accidentally got...

dialogText.cn: 我的眼睛也是在那晚伤的……
dialogText.en: That was also when I got hurt in my eye...

dialogText.cn: 这么多年了，我竟然从来都不知道……原来哥一直留在那个雨夜。
dialogText.en: It's been so many years, yet I knew nothing about how he felt... My Bro never left that rainy night.

dialogText.cn: 大当家，你还记得这个吗？
dialogText.en: {F}Hey, Supreme Chief. Do you remember this?{M}Hey, Supreme Chief. Do you remember this?

dialogText.cn: 这、这是我的“汤汤券”……
dialogText.en: This... this is my Tangtang Cert...?

dialogText.cn: 现在我想用掉，换一份你的承诺。
dialogText.en: {F}I'm going to exchange it right now for a promise from you.{M}I'm going to exchange it right now for a promise from you.

dialogText.cn: ……我明白了。
dialogText.en: ...I got it.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞！我既然是清波寨大当家，就不能对这次的事置之不理！
dialogText.en: Darkmask! As the Chief of Qingbo Stockade, I gotta settle this business!

dialogText.cn: 我们去见他吧……
dialogText.en: Let's go see him...

dialogText.cn: 阮一的复仇，清波寨和武陵的矛盾，都只是过去那场灾难的余波吗……
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi's quest for vengeance, the conflicts between Qingbo and Wuling... Are they truly just aftershocks of that past disaster?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你还在想阮一的事情吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, are you still thinking about Ruan Yi?

dialogText.cn: 他们的目的到底是什么？
dialogText.en: What the hell are they trying to achieve?

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，阮一的死只会让清波寨的境遇变得更糟。
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi's fall made things worse for her, and for Qingbo Stockade as well.

dialogText.cn: ……还有聂菲斯和阿达希尔。
dialogText.en: ...And we got Nefarith and Ardashir to deal with.

dialogText.cn: 我不会去说“冤冤相报何时了”这样的话……毕竟我不是当事人。
dialogText.en: It's not for me to judge how vengeance can blind a person... It wasn't me who lost family or friends.

dialogText.cn: 十年前……是极点远征的时间，也是管理员你上一次苏醒的时间。
dialogText.en: Ten years ago... The disaster coincided with the Polar Expedition. It was also the time when you last awakened, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤……也许比她此刻表现的还要煎熬。
dialogText.en: Tangtang may be in greater pain than she seems...

dialogText.cn: 冲动最终葬送了阮一的性命，还让清波寨四分五裂。
dialogText.en: Ruan Yi's impulsiveness killed him and fractured the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 他伤害了太多信任他和爱戴他的人。
dialogText.en: His actions hurt too many people, especially those who trusted and loved him.

dialogText.cn: 有时候，保护自己所爱的，比一时冲动去破坏点什么要更困难，也更崇高。
dialogText.en: There are times when protecting a loved one is more difficult, and far more noble, than unleashing destruction in a moment of rage.

dialogText.cn: 但是，聂菲斯应该很乐于利用他的冲动，她甚至不需要亲自动手就能控制清波寨。
dialogText.en: But Nefarith was more than happy to manipulate his rage. She took over Qingbo Stockade without getting personally involved.

dialogText.cn: 我很清楚，对于整个文明环带而言，那是一段怎样艰苦的时期……
dialogText.en: I knew very well how difficult things were for the entire Civilization Band...

dialogText.cn: 灾难把人们逼到了绝境，阮一这样的悲剧，曾经在文明环带比比皆是。
dialogText.en: Disaster pushed people to desperation. Plenty of tragedies like Ruan Yi's were reported throughout the Band.

dialogText.cn: 但阮一为了自己的仇恨，伤害了更多的人，我也无法同情他。
dialogText.en: But Ruan Yi chose to pursue vengeance — and ended up hurting even more people. I cannot sympathize with his actions.

dialogText.cn: 我们一直为之奋斗的未来……不该建立在循环往复的暴力之上。
dialogText.en: The future we are fighting so hard for ... must not be built on a never-ending cycle of violence.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多照顾照顾她吧。
dialogText.en: Please take good care of her, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 都准备好了？
dialogText.en: Is everything ready?

dialogText.cn: 没什么需要准备的。
dialogText.en: There is nothing to prepare.

dialogText.cn: 让你的人别再躁动。
dialogText.en: Leash your subjects.

dialogText.cn: 杀戮不是目的，只要让息壤堰瘫痪，一样能完成任务。
dialogText.en: Killing is not our objective. Disabling the Xiranite Dam will accomplish our mission.

dialogText.cn: 我会想办法尽快做到，我不想再看见管理员的那副表情了。
dialogText.en: I will see it done quickly. It pains me to witness that expression on the Endmin's face again.

dialogText.cn: 当然，我也随时能动手撕开甚大裂隙。
dialogText.en: Of course. I can tear open the Very Large Rift at any moment.

dialogText.cn: 多年前阮一指导汤汤射击时留下的弹痕犹在，但如今两人却已阴阳两隔。
dialogText.en: The bullet holes from Ruan Yi's handcannon shooting lessons for Tangtang have survived all those years, but one of the siblings has departed.

dialogText.cn: 汤汤得到“大当家”名头的那天，阮一也把自己父亲的铳交到了她的手上。
dialogText.en: When Tangtang became Chief of the Stockade, Ruan Yi also gave her his father's handcannon.

dialogText.cn: 他希望汤汤能用它保护寨民，而汤汤的确兑现了承诺……
dialogText.en: He hoped that Tangtang could protect the Stockade Fam with the weapon, and Tangtang lived up to her promise...

dialogText.cn: 我们去见他吧……
dialogText.en: Let's go see him...

dialogText.cn: 嗯！谢谢……管理员。
dialogText.en: Yeah! Thank you... Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 你们尽管行动，这颗巨兽心脏交给我。
dialogText.en: Just get on with your mission. I can take care of the Feranmut Heart.

dialogText.cn: 放心，没那么容易伤到我，至少现在我保护巨兽心脏的力气还是有的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. I won't go down that easily. I've got enough fight in me to protect the Feranmut Heart.

dialogText.cn: 不过，刚才多谢你们出手。
dialogText.en: Still, I must thank you for your timely intervention.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师已经让大部分人撤出去了。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang ordered most of them to evac.

dialogText.cn: 但奇怪的是，撤离刚完成，阿达希尔就截断了进入首墩区域的通路……
dialogText.en: Strange thing is, we just completed the evac when Ardashir cut off all roads into the Marker Stone area...

dialogText.cn: 他似乎完全没准备对我们动手。
dialogText.en: It seems he's not planning to target any of us.

dialogText.cn: 这也是我在意的地方。
dialogText.en: That's bugging me too.

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔显然用某种手段极大影响了首墩的稳定，里面的情况恐怕比我们预想的还要糟糕。
dialogText.en: Ardashir likely used some trick to destabilize the Marker Stone. The situation in there might be worse than we think.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，首墩就拜托你们了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we're counting on your team at the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 你的心意我领了，但首墩的安危关系到整个息壤堰的稳定和武陵遏制甚大裂隙的努力。
dialogText.en: Much appreciated, but the Marker Stone is crucial to the integrity of the entire Xiranite Dam, and Wuling's efforts in containing the Very Large Rift.

dialogText.cn: 相比于我自己的安全，眼下还有更多事情值得关注。
dialogText.en: My personal safety pales in comparison to the gravity of our situation right now.

dialogText.cn: 你们和诀放手去解决阿达希尔就行。剩下的，我来想办法。
dialogText.en: You and Arcane should wholly focus on dealing with Ardashir. I'll figure out the rest.

dialogText.cn: 再会。
dialogText.en: Farewell.

dialogText.cn: 你们来了。
dialogText.en: You're here.

dialogText.cn: 宏科院说服了一位<@qu.key>巨兽代理人</>在首墩内留下造物。靠着一代又一代天师呕心沥血，才有了如今的首墩。
dialogText.en: The HAS convinced a <@qu.key>Feranmut Proxy</> to leave a creation within the Marker Stone. Generations of Tianshi worked hard to complete the great structure we see today.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，面对阿达希尔那样的敌人，我们应该更加谨慎。
dialogText.en: Endmin, when facing a foe like Ardashir, we should practice caution.

dialogText.cn: 当然，我也不会让管理员孤军奋战的。
dialogText.en: Of course, I won't let the Endmin fight alone.

dialogText.cn: 她会在首墩附近接应你们。
dialogText.en: She shall meet up with you near the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 呃！不会是……
dialogText.en: Uh! Could she be...?

dialogText.cn: 应龙特勤队。他们已经离开北部禁区，开始着手干预武陵周遭的异常。
dialogText.en: The Yinglung Special Task Force. They have left the North Wuling Exclusion Zone and are ready to handle the anomalies around Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 刚才介绍过了，<@qu.key>首墩</>是息壤堰的起点，也是现在这座武陵城的起点。
dialogText.en: As I've said earlier, the <@qu.key>Marker Stone</> is the origin of the Xiranite Dam. It is also the origin of Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 计划是什么？
dialogText.en: What is the plan?

dialogText.cn: 我不能离开武陵城，而巡卫也已经分不出更多人手……
dialogText.en: I can't leave Wuling City, and I'm afraid I can't spare any of the watchguards...

dialogText.cn: 所以，我希望终末地能全面接管首墩区域。
dialogText.en: This is why I hope Endfield can assume full control over the Marker Stone area.

dialogText.cn: 全、全面接管？
dialogText.en: Full ... full control?

dialogText.cn: 我们当然会参与行动，但全面接管的意思是？
dialogText.en: We will definitely help, but what exactly do you mean by "full control"?

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔的身份和动机都不明朗，但我有一个预感……也许只有管理员能够破解他身上的谜题。
dialogText.en: Ardashir's identity and motives are unclear. But I have a feeling that the Endmin may help elucidate these mysteries for us.

dialogText.cn: 我相信管理员，现场的一切都交给管理员决断，责任我来担。
dialogText.en: I have faith in you, Endmin. I grant you full authority in the field. The outcomes will be my responsibility.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 事关武陵城安危，首墩不能出现任何闪失。
dialogText.en: This is key to the survival of Wuling. Nothing must happen to the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 不会让你失望的。
dialogText.en: {F}You'll not be disappointed.{M}You'll not be disappointed.

dialogText.cn: 我不希望你像面对聂菲斯时那样，过度伤害自己的身体。
dialogText.en: I don't want this to be yet another battle against Nefarith where you end up hurting yourself.

dialogText.cn: 虽然眼下捉襟见肘，但我还是为终末地准备了一位攻坚战与超域处理专家……
dialogText.en: Though resources and personnel are limited, I have prepared an expert in offensive battles and the Ætherside for Endfield...

dialogText.cn: 而负责支援你们的那位特勤队成员，可大有来头。
dialogText.en: The YSTF member assigned to your support has quite the reputation.

dialogText.cn: 她是武陵现役最年轻的少校，也是应龙至今最年轻的队长……
dialogText.en: She is the youngest major currently in service to Wuling, and also the youngest task leader of YSTF...

dialogText.cn: 她的代号是……
dialogText.en: And her codename is...
<@qu.key>"Arcane"</>.

dialogText.cn: 虽然清波寨的动荡刚发生不久，但敌人没有给我们喘息的机会。
dialogText.en: It hasn't been long since the disturbance at Qingbo Stockade, but the enemies aren't giving us any rest.

dialogText.cn: 我们终于要直面阿达希尔了。
dialogText.en: We're finally going to face Ardashir.

dialogText.cn: 是啊。但以终末地在《环带公约》内的权限，都找不到关于他的线索……
dialogText.en: True. But even with Endfield's clearance levels provided by the Band Accord, we've still found nothing on him...

dialogText.cn: 也许，他是近些年才出现的危险分子，和聂菲斯一样。
dialogText.en: Perhaps he only appeared recently, just like Nefarith.

dialogText.cn: 不好说，至少目前，他们毫无疑问联手了，都觊觎着甚大裂隙。
dialogText.en: It's hard to say. But for now, there is no question that they are allies and have their gaze set upon the Very Large Rift.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，在面对聂菲斯的时候……你强行驱使了自己尚未恢复的力量。
dialogText.en: I am. When facing Nefarith ... you forcibly used your powers that weren't fully recovered.

dialogText.cn: 要不是抑制器限制了你，你很可能……很可能会和她同归于尽。
dialogText.en: Thankfully the suppressor restrained you. Otherwise, you ... it was likely that you might have gone down with her.

dialogText.cn: 又或者，他是蛰伏已久的敌人……久到比文明环带本身还要古老。
dialogText.en: Or maybe he's been lurking for ages... And has been around longer than the Civilization Band itself.

dialogText.cn: 不过我真正疑惑的……是他们对超域的执着。
dialogText.en: And this is what truly confounds me ... their obsession with the Ætherside.

dialogText.cn: 这不是终末地想要的结果……我也不希望你继续铤而走险，管理员。
dialogText.en: This definitely isn't what Endfield wants ... and I really hope you can avoid these risks moving forward, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 而且他们能借助一些手段利用超域，这点令人很不安。
dialogText.en: The fact that they have means of manipulating Æther is very disturbing as well.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，要行动了吗……？
dialogText.en: Endmin. Ready to move...?

dialogText.cn: 总而言之，或许，大概，我和那个人认识，只是这样而已！
dialogText.en: Anyways, it's just that, uh, I think I might know them. That's all!

dialogText.cn: 见面了就知道了！哎呀，船到桥头自然直嘛！
dialogText.en: I guess we'll know when we meet! Aiyo, things will always straighten themselves out.

dialogText.cn: 赶紧出发吧，任务紧要！
dialogText.en: Let's just set off already! Our mission won't wait!

dialogText.cn: 哪、哪有，哈哈……
dialogText.en: Of ... of course I am! Haha...

dialogText.cn: 过节？那倒算不上……就是……哎呀，说不定我认错了人呢！
dialogText.en: Not friends? That's not true... It's just ... well... Maybe I was thinking about someone else!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，前面就是首墩区域了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this is the Marker Stone area.

dialogText.cn: 唔，不是说她会来接应我们吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm. Didn't they say she was gonna meet up with us?

dialogText.cn: 她是那种会提前几个小时就在这里等着的性格才对……难道真不是她？
dialogText.en: She's the type of person who'd arrive hours ahead of time and wait... Or maybe it's not her after all.

dialogText.cn: ……不管了！
dialogText.en: ...Welp. Not my problem!

dialogText.cn: 我认识路，先进去再说！
dialogText.en: I know the way. Let's just head in already!

dialogText.cn: 就是从这里开始，息壤堰沿着裂隙的方向延伸下去，缝补大地的创口……
dialogText.en: The very beginning of the Xiranite Dam. The structure then extends downwards along the rift to mend the gaping wound of the land...

dialogText.cn: 陈，你嘀咕什么呢？
dialogText.en: Chen, what are you mumbling about?

dialogText.cn: 这是……<@qu.key>沉积酸</>？
dialogText.en: Is this ... <@qu.key>Precipitation Acid</>?

dialogText.cn: 能出现沉积酸池，就意味着这里曾堆积了大量的天使残骸。
dialogText.en: Precipitation acid pools... This place was once stacked with Aggeloid remains.

dialogText.cn: 当初武陵科考团面对的威胁，恐怕远不止裂隙和侵蚀潮。
dialogText.en: The threats faced by the Wuling Science Expedition were more than just the rift and the Blight Tide.

dialogText.cn: 等我把你们全劈了，看它还能躲去哪儿——嗯？
dialogText.en: Once I cut these to pieces, we'll see how well you hide — Hmm?

dialogText.cn: 哼，找死！
dialogText.en: Hmph. You're finished!

dialogText.cn: 先帮天师解围！
dialogText.en: Let's help the Tianshi first!
Okay...

dialogText.cn: 奚天师，我说过让你撤离的。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Xi Mo, my orders were to evac.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉……我以为就是几个破烂天使，我能搞得定……
dialogText.en: Apologies... I thought they were just trash Aggeloi that I could take care of...

dialogText.cn: 宏科院的特殊部门，是应龙特勤队的直属上级，和泰拉的神秘生物“巨兽”有着密切关系。
dialogText.en: A special organization of the HAS that is directly above the YSTF. The Sui Regulator is closely associated with mysterious Terran entities called "Feranmuts".

dialogText.cn: 还有……别离我太远，管理员。
dialogText.en: And ... don't stray too far from me, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 确保你的人身安全也是我的任务。
dialogText.en: Your personal safety is also part of my mission objectives.

dialogText.cn: 已经要你出手了吗？那北部禁区咋办？敌人……不是就一个而已吗？
dialogText.en: And if you're here, what about our North Wuling Exclusion Zone? Aren't we ... just dealing with a single enemy?

dialogText.cn: 先去控制区的保卫科吧，那里还有<@qu.key>司岁台</>留下的一颗<@qu.key>巨兽心脏</>。我们需要做好准备。
dialogText.en: Our first step is to join the Security Section in the restricted area. The <@qu.key>Sui Regulator</> has left a <@qu.key>Feranmut Heart</> at that location. We must be prepared.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡，你现在相信我说的话了吧！这个家伙就是很难相处啊！
dialogText.en: Do you see what I mean, Perlica? She really is just impossible to deal with!

dialogText.cn: 特勤队行动队长，诀，已与终末地会合，行动指挥权移交给管理员。
dialogText.en: YSTF task leader, Arcane. Rendezvous with Endfield is a success. Handing field command authority over to the Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 李织烟……不对，诀……
dialogText.en: Li ... I mean ... Arcane...

dialogText.cn: 我会为各位提供等同于整支小队的火力支援，并提供必要的战术支持与超域灾害处理意见。
dialogText.en: I shall support your forces with squad-level firepower, as well as any essential tactical support and advice for handling Ætherside disasters.

dialogText.cn: 有疑问吗？
dialogText.en: Any questions?

dialogText.cn: 没有。
dialogText.en: {F}Nope.{M}Nope.

dialogText.cn: 很高兴认识你，诀。
dialogText.en: {F}Pleased to meet you, Arcane.{M}Pleased to meet you, Arcane.

dialogText.cn: ……我也一样，管理员。
dialogText.en: ...Likewise, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 还有，终末地的佩丽卡监督。
dialogText.en: And to you as well, Supervisor Perlica of Endfield Industries.

dialogText.cn: ……以及，干员陈千语。
dialogText.en: ......And of course, Operator Chen Qianyu.

dialogText.cn: 敌人很特殊。
dialogText.en: This enemy is something else.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏作为保存巨兽权能的容器，是宏科院最高的技术结晶之一。
dialogText.en: The Feranmut Heart is a vessel capable of preserving the Feranmut's power. It is one of the crowning scientific achievements of HAS.

dialogText.cn: 也是我能调用的力量。要对抗阿达希尔，我们需要更多底牌。
dialogText.en: The very same power that I can allocate. To fight Ardashir, we need all the cards we can get.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏是保存巨兽权能的容器，首墩也依赖那股力量建成。
dialogText.en: A vessel for preserving the Feranmut's power. The Marker Stone was built with that same power as well.

dialogText.cn: 我的直属上级司岁台，提供过调用巨兽心脏力量的技术。是时候用上了……
dialogText.en: My direct superior, the Sui Regulator, has provided a technology for accessing that power. It's now time to use it...

dialogText.cn: 面对阿达希尔这样的特例，我们理应准备更多后手。
dialogText.en: To handle a special foe like Ardashir, it is only reasonable to have more than a single solution.

dialogText.cn: 确实是个很有个性的人。
dialogText.en: Well, she has quite the personality.

dialogText.cn: 不过，明明和我们年龄相差不大，我却能从她身上感觉到一种特别的气质……
dialogText.en: Though Li is someone around our age, she does give off this rather special vibe...

dialogText.cn: 和庄天师、弭弗给我的感觉都不太一样。
dialogText.en: And it's different from what I felt with Tianshi Zhuang and Mi Fu...

dialogText.cn: 只是没想到，“诀”真的是她……
dialogText.en: I just never expected her to be "Arcane"...

dialogText.cn: 不管怎样，现在我们的合作很重要……陈，你可能得忍一忍。
dialogText.en: Nevertheless, it is also important that we work together... Chen, be strong and just put up with it for now.

dialogText.cn: 我倒是……早就不在意了。
dialogText.en: Well, I ... I don't care anymore anyway.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，陈一直不太愿意主动提及这段往事……
dialogText.en: Endmin, this might be something that Chen doesn't really want to talk about...

dialogText.cn: 没事的，佩丽卡！之前只是不想因为我的私事干扰终末地在武陵的行动。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Perlica! Until now, I just haven't wanted my personal business to hamper Endfield operations in Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我以前的确是应龙特勤队的预备役……
dialogText.en: So, Endmin, I actually was a YSTF reservist...

dialogText.cn: 之前，佩丽卡说我近乡情怯，其实没说错。只不过那不是乡情，是一点……哈哈，不甘心？
dialogText.en: Remember when Perlica said how I'm a little nervous about home? She's right, but it's not just being nervous. It's me ... haha ... being disappointed in myself.

dialogText.cn: 从谈剑堂毕业后，我就选择了应龙特勤队。我想，也许成为特勤队的一员，就能更好地帮助别人，保卫家园……
dialogText.en: After graduating from Tanjian Hall, I chose YSTF as my career. I thought joining the task force would allow me to help more people and defend my home...

dialogText.cn: 就能成为像我母亲那样的，有责任、有担当的大侠。
dialogText.en: I thought I could be someone like Mom, a responsible and truly heroic master fighter.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，不过我没能通过考核，甚至还和当时最优秀，也最让人讨厌的候补大吵了一架。
dialogText.en: Heh, but I didn't pass the exams, and even got into a super big fight with the best and most annoying reservist ever.

dialogText.cn: 你们看看她，一点没变！就这种性格，吵起来也不能怪我吧？！
dialogText.en: Look at her. Nothing's changed! You saw her personality. I shouldn't be blamed for getting into a fight.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏，泰拉时期的技术产物，经过与协议源石技术的融合，才有了今天的形态。
dialogText.en: The Feranmut Heart is a technological product from the Age of Terra. Integration with Protocol-Originium tech created the form we see today.

dialogText.cn: 我们在首墩内部，同样设置了数个巨兽心脏来维持稳定。
dialogText.en: The Marker Stone itself is also furnished with several hearts to keep it stable.

dialogText.cn: ……好了，我需要借用这颗巨兽心脏的力量。
dialogText.en: ...Alright, I must borrow the power within the Feranmut Heart.

dialogText.cn: 目标阿达希尔已经占领了首墩区域，推测其目的为瘫痪首墩。
dialogText.en: The target, Ardashir, has taken the Marker Stone area. We suspect his aim is to disable the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 我在战斗时收集了它的数据，深度读数异常，其性质和侵蚀类似。
dialogText.en: I gathered its data during combat. It exhibits abnormal Depth readings and Blight-like properties.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀……那我的力量就更能发挥作用了。
dialogText.en: The Blight... My powers will indeed play a significant role.

dialogText.cn: 仅凭刚才的短暂接触就能完成分析？
dialogText.en: A thorough analysis? During that brief encounter?

dialogText.cn: 我知道暂未发现过这样的先例。
dialogText.en: I know there are no precedents on the record.

dialogText.cn: 会倒是会，不过我现在没有权限，估计会被它排斥……
dialogText.en: Kinda, but I'm not authorized to do so. It would probably reject my attempt...

dialogText.cn: 是没有发现……还是他别有所求？
dialogText.en: Really...? Or maybe he's aiming for something else.

dialogText.cn: 我们是被动的一方，真令人不适。
dialogText.en: The enemy has the initiative, and it is very unsettling.

dialogText.cn: 充能还需要一点时间，分享一下情报吧。
dialogText.en: The charge up will take some time, which we can use to share intel.

dialogText.cn: 目标法术留下的火焰不吻合源石技艺理论，且存在超域能量的特征。
dialogText.en: The target's Arts created fire that does not match Originium Arts Theory, and actually exhibits Æther energy properties.

dialogText.cn: 以及，在目标出现后的三十分钟内，周遭区域开始生成异常能量体。我还不能确定……
dialogText.en: And within thirty minutes of his appearance, anomalous energy entities began appearing nearby. I'm still unsure...

dialogText.cn: 但你说它是侵蚀，会行走的侵蚀……
dialogText.en: But you mentioned Blight-like... A walking Blight-form...

dialogText.cn: 但是结合聂菲斯在四号谷地的表现……阿达希尔极可能掌握了更高级的方式来“操纵”侵蚀。
dialogText.en: But when analyzing this together with Nefarith's actions in Valley IV ... Ardashir is likely to have mastered more advanced means of "manipulating" the Blight.

dialogText.cn: 充能就快完成了，管理员，我们的下一步行动？
dialogText.en: Charge up is almost complete, Endmin. What is our next course of action?

dialogText.cn: ——突入首墩，抓住阿达希尔。
dialogText.en: {F}—Push into the Marker Stone, and capture Ardashir.{M}—Push into the Marker Stone, and capture Ardashir.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: Roger.

dialogText.cn: 敌袭？是栖云林地的方向……
dialogText.en: Hostile activity? It's coming from the Cloudrest Woods...

dialogText.cn: 那里有什么？
dialogText.en: What's over there?

dialogText.cn: 一座天师桩，和刚派去的应急维修小组。
dialogText.en: A Tianshi Pillar, and an emergency repair team deployed just moments ago.

dialogText.cn: 现在首墩同样危急，不排除这是敌人拖延时间的把戏。
dialogText.en: But the situation at the Marker Stone is just as desperate. This might be an enemy's attempt to delay us.

dialogText.cn: 但我们不能放任不管。
dialogText.en: We cannot let this go unchecked.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你是指挥。
dialogText.en: Endmin, it's your call.

dialogText.cn: 先救人。
dialogText.en: {F}We'll save the people first.{M}We'll save the people first.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，行动真要这么多人吗？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu, do you really need an entire army for this operation?

dialogText.cn: 不，他们是负责加强守备的。巡卫的第一使命，还是确保城市的安全。
dialogText.en: No. Their job is to shore up our defenses. The watchguard's most important duty is to keep the city safe.

dialogText.cn: 会有其他几支精锐小队在城外行动，锁定敌人的位置。
dialogText.en: Other elite squads will be operating outside the city to locate the enemy.

dialogText.cn: ……不，负责斩首的，是<@qu.key>应龙特勤队</>。
dialogText.en: ...No. Decapitation is a job reserved for the <@qu.key>Yinglung Special Task Force</>.

dialogText.cn: 不会是她的小队吧……
dialogText.en: Wait, isn't that her task force...?

dialogText.cn: 应龙特勤队是宏科院的特殊武装力量之一，这些少数精锐应该分布在各个裂隙灾害的要地才是……
dialogText.en: Yinglung Special Task Force is an elite unit under HAS. They should be stationed at various key locations and hazardous rifts...

dialogText.cn: 紧急通信……看来头儿那里已经发现什么了。
dialogText.en: An emergency call... The boss probably found something.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？只是索敌吗？还不打算主动出击？
dialogText.en: Wha? Locate the enemy? Why not just seize the initiative and attack them already?

dialogText.cn: 应龙特勤队？
dialogText.en: Yinglung Special Task Force?

dialogText.cn: 啊……不是，没什么。
dialogText.en: Ah... Never mind, I didn't say anything.

dialogText.cn: 只是我以前认识的一个……呃，有点难打交道的老朋友。
dialogText.en: Uh, it's someone I knew before ... just some old friend who's kinda hard to deal with.

dialogText.cn: 真没什么啦，就是听说她可能会来，有点惊讶。
dialogText.en: It's nothing, really. I was just a little surprised to hear she might be coming, is all.

dialogText.cn: 对，把他们从北部禁区调回，也足够说明情况紧急了。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Moving them from their North Wuling Exclusion Zone posts also highlights the urgency of the local situation.

dialogText.cn: 我们的确需要重新掌握主动权。
dialogText.en: We must take back the initiative.

dialogText.cn: 终末地有什么能帮上忙的吗？
dialogText.en: Is there anything Endfield can do to help?

dialogText.cn: 这就是阿达希尔的力量……好诡异的颜色……而且，那是……裂隙？
dialogText.en: Is this Ardashir's power... The color is just so weird... And is that ... a rift?

dialogText.cn: 等等，不能再靠近了——
dialogText.en: Wait! Don't get any closer —

dialogText.cn: 应龙特勤队。这里交给我们。
dialogText.en: YSTF. We'll handle this.

dialogText.cn: 必须想办法遏制裂隙扩大。
dialogText.en: A way to contain the rift must be found.

dialogText.cn: 天师桩！它本身就可以镇压裂隙——呃，如果它还能撑住的话……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Pillar? It can keep the rift contained — Err, I mean, if it still works...

dialogText.cn: 我、我有办法强制重启——
dialogText.en: I, I know a way to restart the Pillar —

dialogText.cn: 你们先撤回城内。
dialogText.en: Get back to the city.

dialogText.cn: 贸然接触裂隙对你们来说太危险了。
dialogText.en: Direct contact with the rift is too dangerous for you.

dialogText.cn: ……那就劳烦你们了。
dialogText.en: ...Much appreciated. Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 如果指挥官的期望是保证她们的安全，她们就应该离开，仅此而已。
dialogText.en: If the commander's aim is to keep them safe, then they should leave. It's as simple as that.

dialogText.cn: 而且，重启天师桩，有我和陈千语，足够了。
dialogText.en: Restarting the Tianshi Pillar can be achieved with just Chen and I.

dialogText.cn: 你最好没忘了过去的训练。
dialogText.en: I hope you have not forgotten the training you had.

dialogText.cn: 少、少来！我的成绩没比你差多少！
dialogText.en: Hey, stop saying that! My grades were just as good as yours!

dialogText.cn: 看来是的……深度读数极度异常。天师桩被破坏后，裂隙开始生成，毫无疑问，这是超域的力量。
dialogText.en: Seems like it... Depth readings are extremely abnormal. When the Tianshi Pillars were damaged, rifts began to appear. This is definitely the power of Æther.

dialogText.cn: 这是阿达希尔的法术撕开的裂隙……他真能做到这个地步吗？
dialogText.en: Is this the work of Ardashir's Arts...? Is he now capable of tearing new rifts?

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我们本来也想帮上忙的。
dialogText.en: Sorry about this. We wanted to help too.

dialogText.cn: 我清楚裂隙的危险……太清楚了。当年的灾难，绝不能再次发生。
dialogText.en: I know the dangers of the rift ... too well, in fact. The disaster from the past must not strike again.

dialogText.cn: 啊？
dialogText.en: Wha?

dialogText.cn: 裂隙就交给我。
dialogText.en: I'll handle the rift.

dialogText.cn: 应龙特勤队是专攻超域灾害的特殊部队……对她来说，这应该是小菜一碟。
dialogText.en: YSTF is your go-to specialist for handling Ætherside disasters... This should be a piece of cake for her.

dialogText.cn: 是阿达希尔的法术——！
dialogText.en: It's Ardashir's Arts—!

dialogText.cn: 打碎就是。
dialogText.en: I'll break it.

dialogText.cn: ……结束了。
dialogText.en: ...It's done.

dialogText.cn: 不管怎样，只要能抢先解决阿达希尔，武陵就还能掌握先机。
dialogText.en: No matter. Just move fast and neutralize Ardashir. That will help Wuling regain the initiative.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，去湖心岛。
dialogText.en: Let's go to the Lake Islet.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。如果这真是他拖延时间的伎俩……
dialogText.en: Hmm. If this is his attempt to delay us...

dialogText.cn: 也许我和庄天师先前的想法是对的。这只是一场佯攻，是把我们诱骗至此的阳谋。
dialogText.en: Then perhaps Tianshi Zhuang and I made the right guess. This is just an obvious feint to lure us to this place.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟事关首墩和裂隙，我们不可能放着不管……
dialogText.en: But his feint hit the Marker Stone and made a rift. We can't just ignore it...

dialogText.cn: ……我总觉得，他似乎就是为了引管理员来这里。
dialogText.en: ...I have a feeling that he's doing it to get the Endmin to come here.

dialogText.cn: 等等，有情况。
dialogText.en: Hold on. Contact.

dialogText.cn: 你来了。
dialogText.en: You are here.

dialogText.cn: 它……会说话？！
dialogText.en: This thing...?! It talks?!

dialogText.cn: 像在清波寨说的那样，我们又见面了。
dialogText.en: Just as I've said at Qingbo Stockade. We meet again.

dialogText.cn: 管理员——
dialogText.en: Endministrator—

dialogText.cn: 聒噪。
dialogText.en: Quiet.

dialogText.cn: 我先上。
dialogText.en: I'll lead the way.

dialogText.cn: 真是没耐心啊……
dialogText.en: An impatient one...

dialogText.cn: 超域竟然被塑形了……形成了“剑”和“墙壁”……
dialogText.en: The Æther has acquired a visible form... It has become "sword" and "wall"...

dialogText.cn: 这些幻影，又围过来了！
dialogText.en: These phantoms are closing in on us!

dialogText.cn: 你们应该能猜到，我的目标只是甚大裂隙……以及你，管理员。
dialogText.en: You should have guessed that my objectives are the Very Large Rift ... and you, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 到我这里，领受你我必然的厮杀……
dialogText.en: Come and face me. Accept our inevitable battle...

dialogText.cn: 又或者，回武陵城，带着那些无辜的人离开甚大裂隙的范围。
dialogText.en: Or head back to Wuling, and bring the innocent away from the vicinity of the Rift.

dialogText.cn: ……那我只好在首墩内静候诸位了。
dialogText.en: ...Then I shall patiently wait for you at the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 说到这儿……重逢至今，还没有亲自确认过你究竟保留了几成力量。
dialogText.en: That being said ... I have yet to personally assess the extent of your vestigial powers.

dialogText.cn: 先解决这些幻影！打开入口！
dialogText.en: {F}Take out these phantoms. Then open the entrance!{M}Take out these phantoms. Then open the entrance!

dialogText.cn: 原谅我的冒犯吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Forgive my trespasses, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 我似乎……曾经见过这些……
dialogText.en: {F}I think I've ... seen these before...{M}I think I've ... seen these before...

dialogText.cn: 只要你点头，我会说服聂菲斯放弃暴力。对泰拉人的杀戮本就对计划百害无益。
dialogText.en: If you comply, I shall persuade Nefarith to abandon violence. Killing the Terrans will only impede our enterprise.

dialogText.cn: 你没有权利让他们放弃自己的家园。
dialogText.en: {F}You have no right to tell people to leave their homes.{M}You have no right to tell people to leave their homes.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！
dialogText.en: Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 要不还是先回水里躲着……
dialogText.en: I say we should keep hiding in the water...

dialogText.cn: 能躲多久？出这么大事，武陵肯定不会放过我们——
dialogText.en: We can't hide forever! The entire thing blew up in our faces. Wuling is gonna make us pay —

dialogText.cn: 沧贼？不识好歹！
dialogText.en: Cangzei pirates? Up to no good again.

dialogText.cn: 等等，等等！我们是在帮忙！
dialogText.en: HOLD ON! We're just trying to help!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？好像有点眼熟……啊，是你们！在清波寨跑了的那对兄弟！
dialogText.en: Hmm. You look familiar... Oh! It's you! The pair of sneaks who ran away from Qingbo Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔的同伙？
dialogText.en: Working for Ardashir?

dialogText.cn: 啊？谁是阿达希尔……
dialogText.en: Huh? Arda who...?

dialogText.cn: 没有审问的时间了，先排除变数吧。
dialogText.en: Got no time to question them. I'll just eliminate the risks.

dialogText.cn: 先别动手！他们不可能是同伙！
dialogText.en: Just, don't! They're definitely not working for him!

dialogText.cn: 我、我们也是被困在这儿！
dialogText.en: Yeh-YEAH! We're trapped here too!

dialogText.cn: 本来顺着密道进来，想找爷爷留下的东西……
dialogText.en: We sneaked through the secret tunnel to find our grampa's stuff...

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，就、就之前寨子里想袭击武陵城的时候，大家伙儿挖的……
dialogText.en: Ahem, yeah, we, uh, dug that tunnel back when the Stockade Fam planned to raid Wuling...

dialogText.cn: 呃……哈哈……你们不相信，我也没有办法……
dialogText.en: Err... Hah... It's hard to believe, but I can't do nothing about it...

dialogText.cn: 我们打算远走高飞之前……来拜拜爷爷，真是倒大霉……
dialogText.en: We were trying to visit grampa one last time ... before we hightail out of this place. Curse our luck...

dialogText.cn: 所以你们刚才是在尝试启动辅桩？
dialogText.en: So you were trying to activate the auxiliary pillar?

dialogText.cn: 我见过天师鼓捣过差不多的东西！只要启动它，肯定有路！
dialogText.en: And I saw Tianshi fiddling with something similar! If we switch it on, a path will definitely appear!

dialogText.cn: 你……这么干脆就放人了？以前你可没这么好说话……
dialogText.en: Did you... just let them go like that? You used to be way less forgiving...

dialogText.cn: 我不会质疑管理员的命令。
dialogText.en: I do not question the Endmin's orders.

dialogText.cn: 咳，管理员，先激活辅桩吧。
dialogText.en: Ahem. Endmin, let's activate the auxiliary pillar.

dialogText.cn: 等等！
dialogText.en: Wait, wait, wait!

dialogText.cn: 这些玩意没启动，我们也不知道怎么出去啊！
dialogText.en: We gotta make it work or there'll be no way out!

dialogText.cn: ……往我们来的方向找，有一个渡口。竹筏应该还在那儿。
dialogText.en: ...Head down the way we came from. There will be a raft station. The raft should still be there.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢恩人！谢谢恩人！
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you so much! We mean it!

dialogText.cn: 你们又救了我们两兄弟一命！
dialogText.en: Once again you've saved our lives!

dialogText.cn: 喂！管理员都夸你了，你就不能坦率一点吗？
dialogText.en: Hey! Our Endmin just commended you. A bit of honest appreciation doesn't cost much, you know!

dialogText.cn: 首墩已经在眼前了，下令吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: The Marker Stone is just ahead. Your orders, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……只是完成了你的命令。
dialogText.en: ...I only fulfilled your command.

dialogText.cn: “打开入口”，仅此而已。
dialogText.en: "Open the entrance". That's all.

dialogText.cn: 我很坦率。
dialogText.en: I am being honest.

dialogText.cn: 那些脆弱的法术残留竟也能拖住你的脚步吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: I suppose those fragile traces of the Arts slowed you down, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 真可怜……你如此虚弱，何必还要承担泰拉的命运呢。
dialogText.en: How pitiful... You are but a weakened shadow. Why then do you still cradle the fate of Terra?

dialogText.cn: 已锁定。
dialogText.en: Target locked.

dialogText.cn: 不过，现在还不晚，管理员。
dialogText.en: But it is not yet too late, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 来顶层阻止我，或者，带着所有人逃走吧。
dialogText.en: Either stop me at the top, or ... take everyone and flee.

dialogText.cn: 目标丢失……嘁，又是传送法术。
dialogText.en: Target lost... Tsk. Teleportation arts again.

dialogText.cn: 我会破坏这座首墩，失去了息壤堰的压制，甚大裂隙自会展现超域的全貌。
dialogText.en: I shall destroy this Marker Stone. Freed from the Xiranite Dam's suppressive forces, the Very Large Rift shall reveal the entirety of the Ætherside.

dialogText.cn: 不，通道应该在我们眼前。
dialogText.en: No, I see a passage right before us.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏……其他的心脏可能也被他破坏了。
dialogText.en: A Feranmut's Heart... He might have taken out the other hearts.

dialogText.cn: 没这么简单，阿达希尔可能摧毁了沿途的巨兽心脏。
dialogText.en: It's not that easy. Ardashir may have destroyed all the Feranmut Hearts along the way.

dialogText.cn: 那要怎么追上他？周围似乎没有楼梯之类的……
dialogText.en: Then how are we supposed to catch up? I don't see any way to get up there nearby...

dialogText.cn: 让壤心玉归位，通道就能重新打开……
dialogText.en: Just put the Xirancore Jades back in their place to re-open the channel...

dialogText.cn: 看来你还没忘。
dialogText.en: Seems you have not forgotten.

dialogText.cn: 就在两边。
dialogText.en: Located at two sides of the place.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，搭把手！
dialogText.en: Endmin, gimme a hand!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？画卷里是不是有什么……啊！
dialogText.en: Hmm. Is there something in the scroll...? WOW!

dialogText.cn: 不，这是她的<@qu.key>“墨魉”</>……巨兽代理人的信使。
dialogText.en: No. They're her <@qu.key>"ink spirits"</>... Messengers of the Feranmut Proxy.

dialogText.cn: 飞走了？
dialogText.en: Are they flying away?

dialogText.cn: 她说了什么？
dialogText.en: What did she say?

dialogText.cn: ……她察觉到了入侵，帮我们定位了壤心玉的位置。
dialogText.en: ...She sensed the intrusion and is helping us to locate the Xirancore Jades.

dialogText.cn: 我能感应到墨魉的位置，跟我来吧。
dialogText.en: I can sense the ink spirits' locations. Follow me.

dialogText.cn: 这是你弄出来的？
dialogText.en: Did you make these?

dialogText.cn: 同时附上了一大段抱怨。
dialogText.en: And she complained. A lot.

dialogText.cn: 祂们不可以常理度之。再者，首墩本就独一无二，她有所感应也在意料之中。
dialogText.en: Their abilities cannot be measured by mortal means. The Marker Stone is also one of a kind. She'd naturally sense things that happen to it.

dialogText.cn: ……代理人也有七情六欲。不如说，她反而比凡人更孩子气。
dialogText.en: ...Proxies have feelings too. Perhaps it's better to say she's more child-like than ordinary people.

dialogText.cn: 可惜她的本体离武陵太远，赶不过来……
dialogText.en: But her physical form is too far away to reach Wuling on time...

dialogText.cn: 至少，她能以这种方式提供些帮助。
dialogText.en: At least she's still helping us in her own way.

dialogText.cn: 原来如此……通过画卷展开通道，真是稀奇的手段。
dialogText.en: That's how it works... The scroll opens up the channel. How interesting.

dialogText.cn: 多说无益，抓住他才能知道答案。
dialogText.en: Let's not speculate. Capture him and we'll have our answers.

dialogText.cn: 说得对，做好准备吧。
dialogText.en: Agreed. Make ready.

dialogText.cn: 若非阿达希尔能力特殊，就算他入侵了首墩，也没那么容易在其中移动。
dialogText.en: Ardashir better have some tricks. Even if he were to breach the Marker Stone, moving around won't be easy.

dialogText.cn: 但是……
dialogText.en: But...

dialogText.cn: 但是他在有意识地破坏巨兽心脏，似乎对首墩十分了解。
dialogText.en: But he is intentionally sabotaging the Feranmut's Heart and seems to know the Marker Stone really well.

dialogText.cn: 是壤心玉，果然在这里！
dialogText.en: The Xirancore Jade! It's really here!

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔彻底破坏了这里……
dialogText.en: Ardashir completely destroyed this place...

dialogText.cn: 因为息壤储备在这附近。
dialogText.en: Because the Xiranite stockpile is just nearby.

dialogText.cn: 息壤就是为了填平裂隙，中和超域而设计的……二者本就水火不容。
dialogText.en: Xiranite is designed to fill the rift and neutralize the Æther... They literally cancel each other out.

dialogText.cn: ……但这团火却在首墩之内燃烧。
dialogText.en: ...But he managed to start this fire in the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 它真的来自裂隙那头吗？
dialogText.en: Did it really come from the other side of the rift?

dialogText.cn: 他真的还是人类吗？
dialogText.en: Is he really human?

dialogText.cn: 就如同侵蚀的形态多样，超域能量也会有很多的表现形式。这火焰毫无疑问是其中一类。
dialogText.en: The Blight has various shapes and forms, so it is natural for Æther to behave the same. This fire is just one type of Æther energy.

dialogText.cn: 先回收壤心玉。
dialogText.en: We should retrieve the Xirancore Jade first.

dialogText.cn: 但我从未听说过人类可以像使用源石那样利用超域……
dialogText.en: But I've never heard of anyone who could wield Æther like Originium Arts...

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，这团火都绝不能烧到首墩之外。
dialogText.en: No matter what, this fire must not spread beyond the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: ……即使必须不择手段。
dialogText.en: ...Even if extreme measures must be taken.

dialogText.cn: 李织烟……
dialogText.en: Li...

dialogText.cn: 路被堵死了……
dialogText.en: The road is out...

dialogText.cn: 让开点，用非常规手段解决。
dialogText.en: Clear the way. This calls for an unconventional solution.

dialogText.cn: 代理人的墨魉……？
dialogText.en: The Proxy's ink spirit...?

dialogText.cn: ……把你的力量借给我？好吧，我明白你的意思。
dialogText.en: ...Borrow your powers? Alright. I know what you're trying to do.

dialogText.cn: 你能控制这些息壤块了？！
dialogText.en: Did you just move those Xiranite blocks?!

dialogText.cn: 代理人加强了我对首墩的控制力。
dialogText.en: The Proxy strengthened my control over the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 决战不远了。
dialogText.en: The final battle awaits.

dialogText.cn: 是壤心玉！
dialogText.en: It's the Xirancore Jade!

dialogText.cn: 近在眼前了……
dialogText.en: It's within reach...

dialogText.cn: 不过，他也没想轻易放我们过去。
dialogText.en: But he's not going to make things easy for us.

dialogText.cn: 完工，巨兽心脏应该重启了！
dialogText.en: Job done! That should restart the Feranmut's Heart!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……也许这次穿过画卷，面对的就是阿达希尔本人了。
dialogText.en: Yes... When we step through the scroll, we might be facing Ardashir himself.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，接下来的行动……
dialogText.en: Endmin, for our next course of action...

dialogText.cn: 如果需要我执行危险任务，别迟疑……
dialogText.en: If you need me for something dangerous, do not hesitate...

dialogText.cn: 我是你的底牌。
dialogText.en: I am your trump card.

dialogText.cn: 而你只需打出底牌，不必亲自参战。
dialogText.en: You just need to play the card to stay out of the fight.

dialogText.cn: 根据分享的情报，你此次苏醒，并未能恢复到巅峰状态。
dialogText.en: From the intel you shared, you have yet to reach your optimal form after your awakening.

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔把你当作目标，必然是有信心对付现在的你。
dialogText.en: If Ardashir is treating you as a target, he has absolute confidence in facing you in your current state.

dialogText.cn: 更何况，他似乎很了解你。
dialogText.en: Furthermore, he seems to know you very well.

dialogText.cn: 你胡说什么——！
dialogText.en: THAT'S JUST NONSENSE—!

dialogText.cn: 这不奇怪，管理员曾经是一个任人解读的符号，对敌人来说也不例外。
dialogText.en: There are merits to it. The Endministrator was once a symbol that meant different things to different people. Enemies included.

dialogText.cn: 但他不了解我。
dialogText.en: But he knows nothing about me.

dialogText.cn: 既然代理人的小伎俩能妨碍到他，那么，借用了代理人权能的我，也能对他产生威胁。
dialogText.en: If the Proxy's tricks can hamper his plans, then I, having borrowed the Proxy's power, will pose a threat to him.

dialogText.cn: 我一人足矣。
dialogText.en: I alone shall suffice.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟保证你的安全……也是最重要的任务。
dialogText.en: After all, your personal safety ... is also my most important mission.

dialogText.cn: 成功率有多高？
dialogText.en: What are the chances of success?

dialogText.cn: 不低。
dialogText.en: Not too bad.

dialogText.cn: ……那你全身而退的机会？
dialogText.en: ...And for extraction?

dialogText.cn: ……也不高。
dialogText.en: ...Not too good either.

dialogText.cn: 李织烟！你为什么还是总抱着牺牲这牺牲那的态度战斗？！
dialogText.en: LI!! You're still so hung up about sacrificing this and that for the sake of battle?!

dialogText.cn: 那庄天师为什么只派我一个人来？
dialogText.en: Then why would Tianshi Zhuang send me here alone?

dialogText.cn: 她清楚我能做到什么，也相信我能做到。
dialogText.en: She knows what I'm capable of, and believes I can do it.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我想得到你的承诺……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I hope you can give me your word...

dialogText.cn: 你的安危比我重要——
dialogText.en: Your safety is worth more than my life —

dialogText.cn: ……真的吗？
dialogText.en: {F}...Really?{M}...Really?

dialogText.cn: 我不希望你以牺牲自己为前提战斗。
dialogText.en: {F}I don't want you to go into a fight expecting to get yourself killed.{M}I don't want you to go into a fight expecting to get yourself killed.

dialogText.cn: 但我也相信你的判断。
dialogText.en: {F}But I also trust in your judgment.{M}But I also trust in your judgment.

dialogText.cn: 至少，让我们并肩作战吧。我不想再后悔了。
dialogText.en: {F}Just let us face the enemy together as a team. I don't want to have any regrets this time.{M}Just let us face the enemy together as a team. I don't want to have any regrets this time.

dialogText.cn: 这算命令吗？
dialogText.en: Is that an order?

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: {F}Yes.{M}Yes.
...Understood.

dialogText.cn: 真放弃了？不会再有什么出格的举动吧？
dialogText.en: Really? Well, I hope you're not doing anything crazy again.

dialogText.cn: 如果这就是管理员的命令，我不会质疑。
dialogText.en: If such is the Endmin's order, I will not question it.

dialogText.cn: 那颗巨兽心脏是怎么回事……
dialogText.en: {F}What's wrong with that Feranmut's Heart...?{M}What's wrong with that Feranmut's Heart...?

dialogText.cn: 这里是哪儿……佩丽卡？陈？诀？
dialogText.en: {F}What is this place...? Perlica? Chen? Arcane?{M}What is this place...? Perlica? Chen? Arcane?

dialogText.cn: 终于安静了。现在……只剩你我。
dialogText.en: Finally quiet. Now ... it's just you and me.

dialogText.cn: 来吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Come, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 在这里，我们都毫无保留。
dialogText.en: Here, we keep nothing from each other.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽“岁”的力量确实了得。我也很幸运，能看见管理员的梦境。
dialogText.en: The power of Feranmut "Sui" is remarkable. I am honored to witness your dream, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我说了很多次了，只是想和你好好聊聊。
dialogText.en: I said it many times. A proper conversation with you.

dialogText.cn: ……聊什么？
dialogText.en: {F}...About what?{M}...About what?

dialogText.cn: 记得我给你的那个选择吗？
dialogText.en: Remember the choices I gave you?

dialogText.cn: 带着武陵人离开，我只需要打开甚大裂隙。
dialogText.en: Bring the Wulingers and leave. My aim is just to open the Very Large Rift.

dialogText.cn: 为了在超域中找到“被放逐者”。
dialogText.en: To find the "Exiles" in the Ætherside.

dialogText.cn: 谁是“被放逐者”？
dialogText.en: {F}Who are the "Exiles"?{M}Who are the "Exiles"?

dialogText.cn: 和我走吧，回到极光的王冠之下，回到万物发源之地。那里有你想要的一切真相。
dialogText.en: Come with me. Return to the place 'neath the aurora's crown, the origin of all life. There lies the truth you seek.

dialogText.cn: 如果徒增了你的困扰，我很抱歉。
dialogText.en: If my words caused you grief, then I shall apologize.

dialogText.cn: 留下这枚第纳尔吧。
dialogText.en: Keep this dinar.

dialogText.cn: 我忘了它来自哪个被我征服的王酋金库，但我记得最后一位拥有它的朋友……
dialogText.en: The conquered lord whose hoard I acquired escapes my memories, but not the friend who last held it...

dialogText.cn: 它一直是我最喜欢的一枚。
dialogText.en: It's always been my favorite dinar.

dialogText.cn: 我最后侍奉的王啊……
dialogText.en: O the final lord I served...

dialogText.cn: ……希望你能回心转意。
dialogText.en: ...I beseech thee, change thy ways.

dialogText.cn: 极少部分见过他们的泰拉人，称他们为……
dialogText.en: The very few Terrans who witnessed the Exiles call them...

dialogText.cn: 这里是……我在梦里见过的？
dialogText.en: {F}This place... I saw it in a dream.{M}This place... I saw it in a dream.

dialogText.cn: 你想要做什么？
dialogText.en: {F}What do you want?{M}What do you want?

dialogText.cn: 我不知道。也许，再聊聊我自己？我和你说过我在耶尔什的家吗？
dialogText.en: I do not know. Perhaps I should talk about myself again. Did I tell you about my home in Kjersch?

dialogText.cn: 我住在一处山崖边，能眺望整座白雪皑皑的山谷。我很中意那里。
dialogText.en: I lived by a cliff where I could gaze upon a valley completely covered in snow. It was a place that delighted me.

dialogText.cn: 而那座山谷里，铺满了闪亮的墓碑……像是藤壶。他们都为我而死，只有风雪呼啸着主持他们的葬礼。
dialogText.en: The valley was filled with shiny headstones ... they were like barnacles. They died for me. The wind and snow hosted their funerary rites.

dialogText.cn: 哦，对了，我还有一个家，在星门那头。那里黄金遍地，风沙遮日……
dialogText.en: Oh, yes, I had another home on the other side of the Cosmic Gate. A place of gold and windswept sands...

dialogText.cn: 我曾在彼岸被称为“帕夏”。
dialogText.en: Beyond the gate they called me "Pasha".

dialogText.cn: 呵，仿佛是上辈子的事了，那傲慢的帝国估计早已分崩离析……
dialogText.en: Heh. It felt like a lifetime ago. That arrogant empire is probably broken to pieces...

dialogText.cn: 等等，星门那头？你从一百多年前活到现在？
dialogText.en: {F}Wait. The other side of the Cosmic Gate? Have you lived for more than a hundred years?{M}Wait. The other side of the Cosmic Gate? Have you lived for more than a hundred years?

dialogText.cn: 是啊。你终于对我感兴趣了。
dialogText.en: Yes. So, you are finally interested in me.

dialogText.cn: 但生命是公平的，我只是卑鄙地窃取了我所爱之人的性命……换来了残酷的长生。
dialogText.en: But life is fair. I only performed the despicable theft of lives from those I held dear ... for the cruel torture of my own longevity.

dialogText.cn: 你现在明明威胁着更多无辜的生命……
dialogText.en: {F}And now you threaten even more innocent lives...{M}And now you threaten even more innocent lives...

dialogText.cn: 选择？
dialogText.en: {F}Choices?{M}Choices?

dialogText.cn: ……为了什么？
dialogText.en: {F}...For what?{M}...For what?

dialogText.cn: 他们曾是你绝望的源头，当然，你最终也成了他们的梦魇。
dialogText.en: They were once the source of your despair. Of course, you also became their nightmare.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>基石</>。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>The Foundation</>.

dialogText.cn: ……基石，你们背后的意志。
dialogText.en: {F}...The Foundation. The force that backs the likes of you.{M}...The Foundation. The force that backs the likes of you.

dialogText.cn: 瞧，你还是听得懂这门语言。
dialogText.en: See. You still understand this tongue.

dialogText.cn: 到那时，你自可以判断我的性命该如何处置。
dialogText.en: Once we return, my life is yours to dispose, however you wish.

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: ……我会找到你……
dialogText.en: ...I will find you...

dialogText.cn: 我拒绝。
dialogText.en: {F}I refuse.{M}I refuse.

dialogText.cn: ……好吧。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Alright, then.

dialogText.cn: 就算没有恢复记忆，你也确实不会因为一席话就自乱阵脚。
dialogText.en: Even without memories, your judgment remains unclouded by an alluring offer.

dialogText.cn: 刚才发生了什么……
dialogText.en: What just happened...?

dialogText.cn: 这就是她所谓的底牌？把自己和阿达希尔困在一起？！她觉得自己很强吗？！
dialogText.en: That's her trump card?! Trapping herself with Ardashir?! Does she think playing the hero is cool?!

dialogText.cn: 我们得帮她！
dialogText.en: We have to help her!

dialogText.cn: 可我们没有办法借用巨兽的权能，要怎么才能……
dialogText.en: But we can't use the Feranmut's power. How could we...

dialogText.cn: 目标已确认清除？
dialogText.en: Do we have confirmed elimination of the target?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我知道让你们暂时抛下诀是一个残酷的决定……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I know it is cruel to make you leave Arcane on her own for now...

dialogText.cn: 好……事态紧急，奚墨天师会暂时协助你们。
dialogText.en: Good... Given our urgency, Tianshi Xi Mo shall offer you support for now.

dialogText.cn: 李织烟也和他一起被封进了画卷……
dialogText.en: But Li got herself trapped with him inside the scroll...

dialogText.cn: ……代理人？
dialogText.en: ...The Proxy?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们成功了？首墩的深度读数突然开始恢复正常。
dialogText.en: Endmin, is the operation a success? Depth readings at the Marker Stone are reverting to nominal levels.

dialogText.cn: ……还是走到这一步了。
dialogText.en: ...So she chose that option anyway.

dialogText.cn: 诀的实力我很清楚。陈千语，我相信她能坚持到司岁台介入。武陵城也会尽全力提供一切协助。
dialogText.en: I know Arcane's powers. Chen, I believe she'll last till the Sui Regulator interferes. Wuling City will do anything it can to help.

dialogText.cn: 我知道……她付出了这么多，不能白费她替我们争取的喘息之机！
dialogText.en: I know... She paid a heavy price for this. We can't waste the time she bought for all of us!

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，首墩的损伤依旧存在，不能放任不管。我们还能做些什么？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, we can't just leave the Marker Stone in its damaged state. Is there anything we can do?

dialogText.cn: 能量的逸散速度远超估值，受损的巨兽心脏已经无法维持首墩正常运转。
dialogText.en: Energy dissipation is far higher than expected. The damaged Feranmut's Heart can no longer keep the Marker Stone working properly.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，是代理人对你说了什么吗！
dialogText.en: Endmin, did the Proxy tell you something?

dialogText.cn: 我只感觉到……一种令人安心的情绪。
dialogText.en: {F}I only felt ... a gentle calm washing over me.{M}I only felt ... a gentle calm washing over me.

dialogText.cn: 这本就是她的权能，也许，她会有办法的。
dialogText.en: {F}This has always been her power. Perhaps she knows a way.{M}This has always been her power. Perhaps she knows a way.

dialogText.cn: ……难道要干等着？
dialogText.en: ...But we can't just wait around!

dialogText.cn: 他的确被抓住了，但……
dialogText.en: {F}He is indeed contained, but...{M}He is indeed contained, but...

dialogText.cn: 所以我们必须马上修复巨兽心脏。
dialogText.en: {F}So, we start repairing the Feranmut's Heart at once.{M}So, we start repairing the Feranmut's Heart at once.

dialogText.cn: 你们回来了！我听庄天师讲了里面发生的事……
dialogText.en: You're back! I heard from Tianshi Zhuang about what happened in there...

dialogText.cn: 她嘴巴虽然硬了点，但是实力毋庸置疑。不会有事的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. She actually has the power to back up her tough talk. She'll be alright.

dialogText.cn: ……但愿吧。
dialogText.en: ...Let's hope so.

dialogText.cn: 说回来，管理员，我们有一系列迭代巨兽心脏的想法，但只能靠<@qu.key>重息壤</>才有可能实现。
dialogText.en: Now, Endmin, we actually have several proposals for improving the Feranmut's Heart. But we need <@qu.key>Heavy Xiranite</> to make them happen.

dialogText.cn: 配方已经同步给你们了。
dialogText.en: The formula has been synced with you.

dialogText.cn: 附近有一片区域很适合部署集成工业系统，我先过去等你们。
dialogText.en: We have a site nearby that's perfect for AIC Factory deployment. I'll wait for you there.

dialogText.cn: 奚天师，你有没有见过一对清波寨的兄弟……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Xi Mo, have you met the two brothers from Qingbo Stockade...?

dialogText.cn: 哼，说什么祖上是天师，我看就是两个脑子不好使的呆瓜。
dialogText.en: Hmph. They claim to have descended from Tianshi. I only saw a pair of idiots.

dialogText.cn: 对了，我还找到了他们所谓的密道，居然就在我们的眼皮子底下！
dialogText.en: Oh, I also found their secret tunnel. Can't believe they dug it right under our noses!

dialogText.cn: 有空你们自己去看吧，先干正事。
dialogText.en: Feel free to talk to them when you have time. Now, let's focus on actual work.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我都安顿好了……看起来也没犯什么大错，不会拿他们怎么样。
dialogText.en: But I found a place for them... They're not guilty of major crimes, so nothing's gonna happen to them.

dialogText.cn: （嗯……先去控制区的空地部署集成工业系统吧。）
dialogText.en: {F}(Hmm... Better go to that empty plot in the Restricted Area to deploy the AIC Factory.){M}(Hmm... Better go to that empty plot in the Restricted Area to deploy the AIC Factory.)

dialogText.cn: 就是这儿。
dialogText.en: Here it is.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，交给你了。
dialogText.en: All yours, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 有了集成工业系统，巨兽心脏的修复工作总算可以开始了。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory will now let us begin work on repairing the Feranmut's Heart.

dialogText.cn: 研究所已经把蓝图同步给帝江号。查看一下你们的终端，应该已经准备就绪了。
dialogText.en: Our Research Center has synced the blueprint to Dijiang. Check your terminal. It should be ready.

dialogText.cn: 我先在这儿帮你们守着，眼下所有事都得给你们修复巨兽心脏让路。
dialogText.en: I'll look after this place for you. Everything must give way to your mission of repairing the Feranmut's Heart.

dialogText.cn: 多谢奚天师了。
dialogText.en: Much appreciated, Tianshi Xi Mo.

dialogText.cn: 你们才是全权负责首墩区域的人，一切以你们优先。
dialogText.en: You have full command over the Marker Stone area. Your command takes top priority.

dialogText.cn: 我已经联络了葛一朴，再往后的工作他会继续配合你们。
dialogText.en: I've contacted Ge Yipu. He'll be working with you afterwards.

dialogText.cn: 对了，陈千语一直在保卫科查司岁台留下的内部资料……按理说我是该阻止她的……
dialogText.en: Chen keeps trying to access Sui Regulator-only files at the Security Section... I should stop her, but...

dialogText.cn: 是因为诀的事情吧？
dialogText.en: It's about Arcane, right?

dialogText.cn: 宏科院会想办法救她的。
dialogText.en: Hoo. HAS will figure out a way to save her.

dialogText.cn: ……到头来，诀还是按照她的想法，封印了阿达希尔。
dialogText.en: ...In the end, Arcane went ahead with her own plan and sealed Ardashir.

dialogText.cn: 她一开始就是抱着这样的想法参与任务的，我们……
dialogText.en: It was her plan from the very beginning of this operation. We...

dialogText.cn: 她会没事的。
dialogText.en: {F}She'll be alright.{M}She'll be alright.
I hope so too.

dialogText.cn: 在首墩里，我们有一小段时间失去了联系……阿达希尔做了什么？
dialogText.en: Back in the Marker Stone, we temporarily lost contact with each other... Did Ardashir do anything?

dialogText.cn: 没什么。他再次邀请了我，但我拒绝了。
dialogText.en: {F}Not really. He tried persuading me again, but I refused.{M}Not really. He tried persuading me again, but I refused.

dialogText.cn: 我还以为……
dialogText.en: I thought...

dialogText.cn: 不会的。
dialogText.en: {F}It won't happen.{M}It won't happen.

dialogText.cn: 但既然诀阻止了他破坏首墩的计划……
dialogText.en: {F}But if Arcane stopped his plan to destroy the Marker Stone...{M}But if Arcane stopped his plan to destroy the Marker Stone...

dialogText.cn: 那就该轮到聂菲斯登场了。
dialogText.en: {F}Then it's time for Nefarith to take the stage.{M}Then it's time for Nefarith to take the stage.

dialogText.cn: 各位，抱歉来迟了。
dialogText.en: Sorry for being late, people.

dialogText.cn: 刚刚好！
dialogText.en: Yeah, just on time!

dialogText.cn: 那太好了，研究所的修复计划我也带来了。但我还要实地看一眼数据，完善细节。
dialogText.en: Terrific news. I have the Research Center's repair plan, but I require a site survey to complete the details.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，你们刚经历了一场激战，就先休息一下吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Supervisor Perlica, you just fought a hard battle. Please, rest a while.

dialogText.cn: 这里有我们。
dialogText.en: We can take care of this place.

dialogText.cn: 无论聂菲斯做何打算，诀都已经替我们争取了更多的胜算。
dialogText.en: Whatever Nefarith is planning, Arcane has shifted the odds in our favor.

dialogText.cn: 只是陈她……
dialogText.en: But Chen...

dialogText.cn: 诀的事让她很难受，我们去保卫科看看她吧。
dialogText.en: {F}She's upset about Arcane. Let's go talk to her at the Security Section.{M}She's upset about Arcane. Let's go talk to her at the Security Section.

dialogText.cn: ……没提怎么进入画卷啊，那有什么用！
dialogText.en: ...Ugh. This is friggin' useless. Not a single word on getting inside scrolls.

dialogText.cn: 除了司岁台，没人能妥善处理这件事……
dialogText.en: I guess only the Sui Regulator can. No one else knows how this works...

dialogText.cn: 确实算不上好。我们以前一直不对付。
dialogText.en: We're not on the best of terms. Things were a little bad back then.

dialogText.cn: 但现在我不是那个和她争来争去的特勤队的候补了……我是终末地的干员。
dialogText.en: But I'm not a YSTF reservist trying to one-up her anymore... I'm an Endfielder now.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我想救她。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I wanna save her.

dialogText.cn: 但那个阿达希尔也在画里……我很担心她的安全……
dialogText.en: And that Ardashir is also inside the scroll... I'm really worried about her safety...

dialogText.cn: ……嘿嘿，管理员这么说，说服力还真的不一样。
dialogText.en: ...Heheh. Things sound super convincing when you're the one saying it.

dialogText.cn: 她一定没事的。
dialogText.en: Yeah ... she'll be alright.

dialogText.cn: 我还以为，离开应龙特勤队之后再也见不到她了。没想到这次重逢的结果会是这样……
dialogText.en: And I never thought I'd see her again after leaving YSTF. I didn't expect our reunion to end up like this...

dialogText.cn: 为什么我没能通过应龙特勤队的考核，对吧？
dialogText.en: You mean why I failed the YSTF trials, right?

dialogText.cn: 那场考核我和李织烟都完成了，但教官给我的结论是……心性不合格。
dialogText.en: Li and I both completed those trials, but the instructor disqualified me ... due to "immaturity of mind".

dialogText.cn: 虽然我很不服气，也提起过申诉，但于事无补。
dialogText.en: Naturally, I felt pissed and launched a formal complaint. But it didn't work.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，离开武陵那天，我真的很伤心……
dialogText.en: Endmin, when I left Wuling that day, I felt so terrible...

dialogText.cn: 等等，汤汤也提过她看到了我哭着离开武陵……她怎么知道的？
dialogText.en: Wait... Tangtang said she saw me crying when I left Wuling... How did she find out?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，毕竟是打出来的交情嘛……
dialogText.en: Heheh. Ours is a friendship built by fighting...

dialogText.cn: 说起来，当时还在应龙特勤队的时候，我和李织烟也打过不少架。
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, back in the YSTF, I actually fought with Li quite a few times too.

dialogText.cn: 头领，他的计划失败了。
dialogText.en: Baws, his plan has failed.

dialogText.cn: 那开始吧。
dialogText.en: Then let us begin.

dialogText.cn: 你们回来了！核心已经修复，这里勉强还顶得住……你们有见到常沄吗？
dialogText.en: You're back! The core's repaired, and this side should hold... By the way, have you seen Chang Yun?

dialogText.cn: 放心吧！能过几招的街坊邻居都还在往这儿赶呢！
dialogText.en: Don't worry! Every neighbor who can throw a punch is on their way!

dialogText.cn: 雷声……？
dialogText.en: Thunder...?

dialogText.cn: ……庄管代的雷法！
dialogText.en: That's Viceroy Zhuang's Lei Fa...!

dialogText.cn: 在正门那边！
dialogText.en: It's coming from the main gate!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，出发吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, it's time to make our move.

dialogText.cn: 她在和巡卫并肩作战。
dialogText.en: She's fighting alongside the watchguards.

dialogText.cn: 那好，我也不能拖了后腿。这里就交给我们。
dialogText.en: Glad to hear. I must do my part as well. We will keep this area secure.

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯就在里面……
dialogText.en: Nefarith is right in there...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，陈，准备好了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, Chen, are you ready?

dialogText.cn: 好消息是，宏科院在通信中断的前一刻收到了我们的讯息。
dialogText.en: The good news — HAS received our message just before the signal dropped.

dialogText.cn: 他们会想办法远程干涉首墩画卷，协助诀追捕阿达希尔。
dialogText.en: They'll attempt to interfere with the Marker Stone Scroll remotely and help Arcane chase down Ardashir.

dialogText.cn: 司岁台自有手段，我们要相信他们，也要相信诀。
dialogText.en: The Sui Regulator has its ways. We must trust them and Arcane.

dialogText.cn: 那坏消息呢？
dialogText.en: Then what's the bad news?

dialogText.cn: ……或者说，是整个文明环带的天敌。
dialogText.en: ...or, more broadly, one to the entire Civilization Band.

dialogText.cn: 必须在这里击溃她。
dialogText.en: We must stop her here.

dialogText.cn: 你似乎很有信心。
dialogText.en: {F}You sound confident.{M}You sound confident.

dialogText.cn: 这一次，我们同舟共济。
dialogText.en: This time, we are in this together.

dialogText.cn: 核心的位置？
dialogText.en: Where are the Array Cores?

dialogText.cn: 三处，已经同步到各位的终端。
dialogText.en: There are three in total. Their coordinates have been synced to your terminals.

dialogText.cn: 那聂菲斯呢？她完全可以隔岸观火呀！
dialogText.en: What about Nefarith? I don't think she's gonna sit back and watch!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们回来了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you are back.

dialogText.cn: 有一个好消息和一个坏消息，先听哪个？
dialogText.en: I have good news and bad news. Which do you want to hear first?

dialogText.cn: 我希望你们利用重息壤强化天师桩阵列核心，以阻挡侵蚀。
dialogText.en: I'd like you to reinforce the Tianshi Pillar Array Cores with Heavy Xiranite. It's an essential move to stop the Blight.

dialogText.cn: 武陵城现在孤立无援。
dialogText.en: Wuling City is on its own.

dialogText.cn: 虽说裂地者不足为惧，但聂菲斯能够操控侵蚀，直接对息壤堰施压……
dialogText.en: The Landbreaker mobs are not much of a threat, but Nefarith commands the Blight itself. She can strike directly at the Xiranite Dam...

dialogText.cn: 从这个方面来看，裂地者头目聂菲斯，是武陵城的天敌……
dialogText.en: From this perspective, the Landbreaker leader is an inherent adversary to Wuling...

dialogText.cn: 这一次和十年前不同了。
dialogText.en: This time it's different from ten years ago.

dialogText.cn: 真能做到吗？！
dialogText.en: Really? That's possible?!

dialogText.cn: 如果天师桩阵列最终抵挡住了侵蚀潮……聂菲斯的脚步就会被拖延。
dialogText.en: If the Tianshi Pillar Array can hold back the Blight Tide ... her advance will be delayed.

dialogText.cn: 而首墩则有足以封印阿达希尔的巨兽权能。变数太多，想必她不敢冒险。
dialogText.en: And the Marker Stone contains enough Feranmut power to seal Ardashir. She won't dare take the risk with so much uncertainty.

dialogText.cn: 如果此时，终末地的管理员和武陵的天师们都出现在了远离总桩的战场之上……她最好的选择是什么？
dialogText.en: Imagine this: the Endmin and Wuling Tianshi are on the battlefield, far from the Main Pillar ... then, what would be the best move for her?

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，这太冒险了……！
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, that is far too risky...!

dialogText.cn: 诀在冒险，天师们在冒险，你们也在冒险，我就不能冒险了吗？
dialogText.en: Arcane, the Tianshi, you ... everyone is taking a risk. Why should I hold back...?

dialogText.cn: 这里是总桩的“心脏”，也是息壤的宫阙……
dialogText.en: This place is the heart of the Main Pillar, the palace of Xiranite...

dialogText.cn: 更是我为聂菲斯准备的，最有效、最昂贵的陷阱。
dialogText.en: ...and the most effective, most expensive trap I set for Nefarith.

dialogText.cn: 看吧，她上钩了。
dialogText.en: See? She's taken the bait.

dialogText.cn: 在集成核心区域的附近，她想先从破坏息壤源头入手……意料之中。
dialogText.en: She's now near the Core AIC Area, trying to destroy the source of Xiranite ... just as I anticipated.

dialogText.cn: 大闹一场吧，管理员，让敌人见识一下你们的风采。
dialogText.en: Time to unleash mayhem, Endmin. Show our enemies what you are capable of.

dialogText.cn: 嘁，真不尽兴……乌合之众，连自己为什么要挑战武陵都没弄明白。
dialogText.en: Tch, barely a warm-up... These clowns don't even know why they're fighting. How dare they challenge Wuling!

dialogText.cn: 头儿……
dialogText.en: Boss...

dialogText.cn: 你们先把注意力放在阵列核心上。
dialogText.en: No. Keep your focus on the core.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，可……
dialogText.en: Mi Fu... But...

dialogText.cn: ……我明白了。
dialogText.en: ...I got it.

dialogText.cn: 那就好，巡卫会重新集结阵型，帮你们拖住敌人。
dialogText.en: Good. I'll regroup the watchguards. We'll buy you time.

dialogText.cn: ——是聂菲斯！
dialogText.en: It's Nefarith!

dialogText.cn: 庄天师的计划成功了！
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang's plan worked!

dialogText.cn: 我们是不是应该去帮庄天师……
dialogText.en: Should we go help Tianshi Zhuang...

dialogText.cn: 快去，天师桩阵列维系的是武陵百姓的安危，这才是她真正在乎的。
dialogText.en: The safety of every Wulinger depends on the Tianshi Pillar Array. That's the cause she's defending.

dialogText.cn: ……头儿比你们想的要强。
dialogText.en: ...Boss is stronger than you think.

dialogText.cn: 如果这就是她的计划，我会无条件相信她。
dialogText.en: If this is her plan, then I'm fully with her.

dialogText.cn: 敌人还有余力，在下一轮进攻到来前，我们先修复阵列核心！
dialogText.en: The enemies are holding back forces. We must repair the core before they hit us again!

dialogText.cn: 换人，我们俩联手撑得住！
dialogText.en: Switch! We'll hold the line here!

dialogText.cn: 去阵列核心，天师桩的事更要紧！
dialogText.en: Head to the Array Core! The Tianshi Pillars are more important!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，快去吧！红脸婆看起来还是有力气打架的！
dialogText.en: Go, Darkmask! Mad woman looks like she's got some fight in her!

dialogText.cn: 天师桩阵列恢复运作了……
dialogText.en: Looks like the Tianshi Pillar Array's running again...

dialogText.cn: 这下侵蚀潮应该威胁不到城市了……哪怕只是暂时。
dialogText.en: That should shield the city from the Blight Tide ... at least for a while.

dialogText.cn: 但还有最后一件事……聂菲斯就在那儿。
dialogText.en: But this isn't over yet... Nefarith is right there.

dialogText.cn: 管理员……只有你能帮头儿。
dialogText.en: Endmin ... you're the only one who can help the Boss.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。
dialogText.en: {F}Don't worry.{M}Don't worry.

dialogText.cn: 我不会让她孤身一人的。
dialogText.en: {F}I won't let her fight alone.{M}I won't let her fight alone.

dialogText.cn: 谢了。
dialogText.en: Thanks.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞！那个聂菲斯折走我们这么多弟兄姐妹，你可别放过她！
dialogText.en: Darkmask! That Nefarith owes us a blood debt! You go bring her down!

dialogText.cn: 告诉她，她惹了清波寨，惹了阮一的妹妹，惹了你黑面煞的大当家！
dialogText.en: Tell her she picked the wrong fight with Qingbo Stockade. Nobody messes with you, or your chief, who's Ruan Yi's sister!

dialogText.cn: 快去吧！
dialogText.en: Now go get her!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多亏了你们，我们挡住了敌人的突袭，但阵列的情况很不乐观。
dialogText.en: Endmin, thanks to you we held them off, but the array's now in terrible condition.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀潮滚滚而来，加上裂地者的破坏……阵列核心已经过载。
