dialogText.en: The surging Blight Tide and the rampaging Landbreakers are too much for the Array Cores ... they are overloaded.

dialogText.cn: 重息壤？是庄天师的安排吧……
dialogText.en: Heavy Xiranite? This must be Tianshi Zhuang's arrangement...

dialogText.cn: 阵列都是基于息壤建造，重息壤能够强化阵列核心……应该也能修复它。
dialogText.en: The arrays are Xiranite-based. If Heavy Xiranite can reinforce Array Cores ... it should be able to repair the damage as well.

dialogText.cn: 失控的天师桩坠地后，可能会爆发震波，各位可要小心啊。
dialogText.en: Careful out there. If one of those Tianshi Pillars falls to the ground, it causes a shockwave.

dialogText.cn: 那阵列核心的维修权限就同步给你们了。
dialogText.en: Alright, I've just synced the Array Core repair access with you.

dialogText.cn: 奏效了！这回侵蚀潮绝对破不开这一侧的阵列。
dialogText.en: It's working! The Blight Tide can't breach this side now.

dialogText.cn: 剩下的就交给我们，管理员，去更需要你们的地方吧。
dialogText.en: We've got the rest. Endmin, go where you're needed!

dialogText.cn: 那是……研究所的方向！
dialogText.en: That's ... the Institute's direction!

dialogText.cn: 但现在没法通过帝江号确认坐标啊……
dialogText.en: But we can't verify the coordinates with Dijiang now...

dialogText.cn: 部署集成工业系统的时候，我记下了协议核心的坐标。
dialogText.en: When we deployed the AIC, I memorized the PAC's coordinates.

dialogText.cn: 这也行？！佩丽卡……有你在，真的还需要帝江号吗？
dialogText.en: You made it?! Nice, Perly. With you around, we might not even need Dijiang!

dialogText.cn: 得想办法快速通过城区，协议核心就在附近，用滑索吧。
dialogText.en: We need a quick way through the city. The PAC is close. Let's use the ziplines to get across.

dialogText.cn: 靠一点运气。管理员，出发吧。
dialogText.en: Just a bit of luck. Endmin, let's get going.

dialogText.cn: 只要心算出几个坐标点，直接投放多个滑索架的话……来得及，我试试。
dialogText.en: I just need to calculate a few points and set up multiple Zipline Pylons... Hm, there's still time. Let me try this.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们总算来了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Finally, you're here!

dialogText.cn: 我已经安排天师去稳住核心，但聂菲斯阻断了各处的道路……
dialogText.en: I've assigned Tianshi to secure the core, but Nefarith's blocked every path...

dialogText.cn: 她降下了这种特殊的火焰，将阵列地面整个覆盖，短时间难以处理。
dialogText.en: She set the array floor ablaze with these special flames. It's impossible to deal with them quickly.

dialogText.cn: 这些超域能量形成的火焰……和首墩的情况类似，很难熄灭。
dialogText.en: These flames are created out of Æther energy ... just like those at the Marker Stone. They are nearly impossible to put out.

dialogText.cn: 用不着灭火，我们搭条新路，来支援的潘师傅已经准备妥了。
dialogText.en: No need to extinguish them. We'll just make a new path. Master Pan and his crew are on their way.

dialogText.cn: 让一让！让伙计们开进来！
dialogText.en: Make way! Big guys coming through!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您也来了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! You're here too!

dialogText.cn: 潘叔！还有你们。你们没去避难吗？
dialogText.en: Uncle Pan! And you guys... Shouldn't you be in a shelter?

dialogText.cn: 避难？聂菲斯都把武陵折腾成这样了，我们还避什么难？
dialogText.en: Shelter? Hmph, Nefarith's already turned Wuling upside down. Hiding won't do us any good.

dialogText.cn: 我来帮忙！你们就放心上吧！
dialogText.en: We've got your backs! Just go ahead and do what you need to do!

dialogText.cn: 呼……辛苦各位了，陪我跑这一趟。
dialogText.en: Whew... Thank you for joining me on this inspection tour, everyone.

dialogText.cn: 还有集成工业系统的帮助，相信武陵很快就能恢复过来。
dialogText.en: And with the AIC's support, Wuling should recover pretty soon.

dialogText.cn: 不知道李织烟看到这个结果，会不会欣慰一点……
dialogText.en: I hope this brings some peace to Li Zhiyan...

dialogText.cn: 谁？
dialogText.en: Who's there?

dialogText.cn: 还有一事。司岁台已知悉首墩发生的战斗，并向武陵派来增援。
dialogText.en: One more thing. The Sui Regulator has learned about the battle at the Marker Stone. Reinforcements to Wuling are on the way.

dialogText.cn: ——寨民如同弃子一般，裂地者的撤退则有条不紊。
dialogText.en: Right. The Stockaders were left behind like pawns, while the Landbreakers withdrew in an orderly fashion.

dialogText.cn: 推测敌人仍有指挥官存在。但我们离开北部禁区已久，职责所在，不能深追。
dialogText.en: An enemy commander likely remains active. However, further pursuit was not possible. We must return to the North Wuling Exclusion Zone immediately.

dialogText.cn: 此事涉及管理员与息壤计划的推进，希望管理员能再在武陵逗留几日。
dialogText.en: Given this involves the Endministrator and Project Xiranite, we must request that the Endministrator remain in Wuling for a few more days.

dialogText.cn: 看见城内的情况比想象中好，我们也松了一口气呀。
dialogText.en: It's a relief to see the city holding up. Things look better than we thought.

dialogText.cn: 请不要说得像是队长已经死了一样。
dialogText.en: Let's not talk about the Captain like she's already dead.

dialogText.cn: 你是应龙特勤队的……
dialogText.en: You are from the Yinglung Special Task Force...

dialogText.cn: 峰，来向庄天师汇报。
dialogText.en: Summit. Here to report to Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 终末地危机处理小组应该有权在场，请直说吧。
dialogText.en: The Endfield Crisis Team's cleared to listen. Go ahead.

dialogText.cn: ……敌人已在我们的追击中溃逃。
dialogText.en: ...The enemy forces were routed under our pursuit.

dialogText.cn: 其中十七位小头目就地伏法，剩余俘虏已由一人押赴宏山。
dialogText.en: Seventeen leaders down, the rest captured — one of ours is escorting them to Hongshan now.

dialogText.cn: 交战的敌人中，沧贼多投降，裂地者则且战且退。被俘者中也是沧贼居多——
dialogText.en: Among the enemy forces we engaged, most of the Cangzei Pirates surrendered, while the Landbreakers fought as they retreated. Most of the captives are also Cangzei Pi —

dialogText.cn: 是寨民。
dialogText.en: They are Stockaders.

dialogText.cn: 穷寇莫追，只要他们不再威胁武陵就好。
dialogText.en: No need to. As long as they stay away from Wuling, that's enough.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦各位了。
dialogText.en: Your service is noted.

dialogText.cn: 涉及管理员和息壤计划？来的是哪位天师？
dialogText.en: Involves the Endministrator and Project Xiranite? May I ask which Tianshi is being sent?

dialogText.cn: 只有一个人，不是天师。
dialogText.en: Only one person. And not a Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 她抵达武陵仍需数日，不过她已通过首墩画卷残留的力量，救出了队长。
dialogText.en: She won't arrive in Wuling for a few days. However, she's already used the residual power within the Marker Stone Scroll to rescue the Captain.

dialogText.cn: 李织烟她没事？！这么大的事情你怎么不一开始就说！
dialogText.en: Wha?! Li Zhiyan's fine?! Why didn't you say so from the start! This is huge!

dialogText.cn: 队长既然没事，还算大事？
dialogText.en: How is it huge if she's fine?

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，你讲话还是这么急死人，她在哪儿？
dialogText.en: Ahhh, the way you talk is killing me. Just tell me where she is.

dialogText.cn: 陈，这位毕竟是刚从前线回来的战士……
dialogText.en: Chen, ease up. Summit has just returned from the front lines...

dialogText.cn: 咳，你倒是还像以前那么关心她……
dialogText.en: Ahem... It seems you remain as concerned for her as ever...

dialogText.cn: ……但实话说，也不算没事，至少性命无碍。
dialogText.en: Honestly, "fine" is an overstatement. Her life is not in danger, at least.

dialogText.cn: 请随我来。
dialogText.en: Please follow me.

dialogText.cn: 李织烟……她这是怎么了？
dialogText.en: Li Zhiyan... What happened to her?

dialogText.cn: 队长的源石技艺很强大……同样，对身体的负荷也是难以想象的。
dialogText.en: The Captain's Originium Arts are incredibly strong ... but the strain on her body is equally unimaginable.

dialogText.cn: 即使各位能在首墩击败阿达希尔，但付出巨大的代价，又如何从聂菲斯手中保护武陵？
dialogText.en: Defeating Ardashir at the Marker Stone would've cost you dearly. Even if you had won, what strength would you have had left to protect Wuling from Nefarith?

dialogText.cn: 是的，诀几乎没有外伤。
dialogText.en: I agree. Arcane has no visible injuries.

dialogText.cn: 卷内时间流速与外界不同，我也不清楚队长究竟战斗了多久。
dialogText.en: Time flows differently within the scroll. It's hard to say how long the Captain fought.

dialogText.cn: ……你老是这样。
dialogText.en: You never change...

dialogText.cn: 呼……原来只是累睡着了……
dialogText.en: ...So she's just exhausted and asleep...

dialogText.cn: 以我的视角看，队长的选择十分正确，各位最终也不负所托。
dialogText.en: From my perspective, the Captain's choice was sound. And you ultimately proved her right.

dialogText.cn: ……有些古怪。
dialogText.en: ...Something isn't right.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？还真是欸……
dialogText.en: Huh? You're right...

dialogText.cn: 过度施法，透支了体力，现在已经脱离危险期了。
dialogText.en: She overexerted herself with her Arts, but she's out of danger now.

dialogText.cn: 墨魉将队长从画卷中送出的时候，她已经几近昏迷。
dialogText.en: When the Ink Spirit brought her out of the scroll, she was barely conscious.

dialogText.cn: 总不能说……阿达希尔在画卷内，完全没有还手吧？
dialogText.en: Don't tell me ... Ardashir didn't even fight back inside the scroll? This is strange.

dialogText.cn: 我见过队长精疲力竭的时刻，唯有一次，当时天使的残骸足以铺满整座武陵城。
dialogText.en: I've seen the Captain pushed to her limit only once. The Aggeloi remains that day could've covered the entire Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 不知道阿达希尔是否已经……
dialogText.en: Could Ardashir truly be...

dialogText.cn: 多想无益。现在只能等待队长醒来了。
dialogText.en: Speculation is pointless. We can only wait for the Captain to wake up.

dialogText.cn: 说得也是。
dialogText.en: You have a point.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们换个地方，让诀好好静养吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's move elsewhere. Arcane needs to rest.

dialogText.cn: 那是……黎风？
dialogText.en: Is that ... Lifeng?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我没事，只是把伤员送到这里而已。
dialogText.en: Yeah... I'm fine. I just came to help bring the wounded here.

dialogText.cn: 今天……是我头一回上战场，多亏是和纪叔他们并肩作战。
dialogText.en: Today ... was my first time on a real battlefield. I'm just glad I was fighting alongside Uncle Ji and the others.

dialogText.cn: 放心吧。
dialogText.en: No need to worry about that.

dialogText.cn: ……是吗？
dialogText.en: ...Really?

dialogText.cn: 可我今天第一次感觉到，对那些活生生的人施展招式，和训练有多大的差别……
dialogText.en: But today, I finally understood how different it is to fight a real person compared to training... The difference is night and day...

dialogText.cn: 黎风……
dialogText.en: Lifeng...

dialogText.cn: 其他地方？好吧……我听庄天师和管理员的。
dialogText.en: The rest of the city...? Roger... If you say so, I'll just do it then.

dialogText.cn: 如果这就是我习武的目标，那爸爸妈妈，会希望看到这样的我吗……
dialogText.en: If this is what I'm training for ... would Mom and Dad want to see me end up like this...?

dialogText.cn: 巡卫的前辈们都很照顾我，希望我这次没有拖大家后腿……
dialogText.en: The senior watchguards really watched out for me. I only hope I didn't disappoint them...

dialogText.cn: 看到并肩作战的前辈们受伤流血，我心里更是难受。
dialogText.en: And seeing my seniors get wounded like that ... I just felt awful.

dialogText.cn: 对了，也许阵列附近还有人需要帮助，我就去那里看看吧。
dialogText.en: Oh, right. There might be people near the array who need help. I'll go take a look.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，加油。
dialogText.en: Good luck.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师！还有管理员！
dialogText.en: Ah! Tianshi Zhuang! And the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 你也受伤……哎，看起来没大碍嘛。
dialogText.en: Are you hurt...? Wait, you seem fine.

dialogText.cn: 你好像没什么精神。
dialogText.en: You look like you've lost your spark.

dialogText.cn: 其他巡卫看你的眼神，只有欣慰和雀跃，或者……一点儿小嫉妒。
dialogText.en: When they look at you, their eyes spark with nothing but pride and thrill. Maybe even ... a little jealousy.

dialogText.cn: 继续烦恼吧。
dialogText.en: Go ahead and keep your doubts.

dialogText.cn: 每一位天师，每一位巡卫，都是在这样重新审视自己的责任之后成长的。
dialogText.en: Every Tianshi, every watchguard, grows by taking a hard look at their own responsibilities.

dialogText.cn: 大家都愿意相信你，不过也许……你该离开这儿，去城里其他地方看看。
dialogText.en: Everyone believes in you. But perhaps ... it's time you left this place and check out the rest of the city.

dialogText.cn: 没事了李惴，都过去了，现在很安全了……
dialogText.en: It's all over, Li Zhui... We're safe now...

dialogText.cn: 是庄天师！李惴，快别念了，你把庄天师和管理员都念来了！
dialogText.en: Ah! It's Tianshi Zhuang! Li Zhui, stop chanting, you've called both Tianshi Zhuang and the Endmin here!

dialogText.cn: 管理员……庄天师！
dialogText.en: Endmin... Tianshi Zhuang!

dialogText.cn: 我、我守住了！没让那些天使冲进选剑局……
dialogText.en: I-I held them off! None of the Aggeloi got into the Bureau of Swordmancers...

dialogText.cn: 刚才李惴一个人单挑三只天使，救下了两位受困市民！
dialogText.en: Just now, Li Zhui took on three Aggeloi alone and saved two trapped citizens!

dialogText.cn: 都、都是巡卫职责所在，没关系！
dialogText.en: It... It was nothing! Any guard would've done the same!

dialogText.cn: 你做得很好，好好休息吧。
dialogText.en: You did very well. Now, get some rest.

dialogText.cn: 欸，瞧瞧是谁来了？
dialogText.en: Yo! Look who's here!

dialogText.cn: 武陵城的大英雄，管理员，佩丽卡，陈千语！
dialogText.en: The heroes of Wuling City — Endmin, Perlica, Chen Qianyu!

dialogText.cn: 哪儿的话，当时也多亏了潘叔帮忙呀。
dialogText.en: Oh, please. We couldn't have done it without your help.

dialogText.cn: 您这是在打扫门面？需要我们搭把手吗？
dialogText.en: I see you're cleaning up. Do you need any help?

dialogText.cn: 哎，不用。只是想着能不能提前开业，大家伙儿紧张那么久，该吃好喝好，放松放松。
dialogText.en: Nah, it's okay. Just thinking of opening early. Everyone's been on edge for so long, they deserve good food and a proper break.

dialogText.cn: 你真该问的也不是我，是武陵城百姓，是清波寨寨民，是你自己。
dialogText.en: Honestly, you shouldn't be asking me. Ask the citizens of Wuling. Ask the Stockaders. Ask your own heart.

dialogText.cn: ……潘工，真不用帮忙？摆摆桌椅的时间还是有的。
dialogText.en: ...Engineer Pan, you really don't need a hand? Surely moving the tables and chairs won't take long.

dialogText.cn: 当然还有咱们的庄管代。
dialogText.en: And let's not forget our pillar, Viceroy Zhuang!

dialogText.cn: 潘天师。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Pan.

dialogText.cn: 可别，你这么喊我，准没好事。
dialogText.en: Uh-oh, easy with that title. Nothing good ever follows.

dialogText.cn: 我就是想问问……你觉得我这次选对了吗？
dialogText.en: I just wanted to ask ... did I make the right choice this time?

dialogText.cn: 这次？要我说，你没得选。无论你做什么，敌人都会闻着味儿来祸害武陵。
dialogText.en: This time? If you ask me, girl, you never had a choice. Our enemies would've come for Wuling regardless of the course of action you chose.

dialogText.cn: 但或许我可以更好地处理清波寨，或许聂菲斯本来不该有这么多机会……
dialogText.en: But maybe I could've handled the Qingbo situation better. Maybe Nefarith wouldn't have had the chance if I'd...

dialogText.cn: 庄方宜，你得记得，没有那么多或许。当年没有，现在也没有。
dialogText.en: Zhuang Fangyi, drop the "maybes". They never existed back then, and they sure don't exist today.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，那可太抬举我了。
dialogText.en: Ah, you flatter me! I was just doing my bit.

dialogText.cn: 真要捧场，你们干脆留下吃一顿？
dialogText.en: If you really want to help, why not stay for a meal?

dialogText.cn: 实在不行，你问管理员吧！
dialogText.en: Or better yet, ask the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，别看她平时那样，她其实很需要一些……同路人的帮衬。
dialogText.en: Listen, Endmin. She may look strong, but deep down ... she needs someone to walk the path with her.

dialogText.cn: 不用！忙你们的去吧！
dialogText.en: Nah, you've got bigger things to do!

dialogText.cn: ……那我们回去吧，管理员。接下来，还有一些事务要和终末地商讨。
dialogText.en: ...Very well. Endmin, we should head back. I still have things to discuss with Endfield.

dialogText.cn: 那再见啦，潘叔！
dialogText.en: Bye then, Uncle Pan!

dialogText.cn: 重新开业有折扣活动，可别错过啊！
dialogText.en: See ya! And make sure you come back. We've got grand reopening deals!

dialogText.cn: 既然诀也安然无恙，那么这次，真算暂告一段落了。
dialogText.en: Now that Arcane is also safe, we can truly consider this chapter closed.

dialogText.cn: 感觉——发生了好多事情啊！
dialogText.en: Feels like so much has happened!

dialogText.cn: 不过至少，从四号谷地至今的恩怨，算是做了个了断了！
dialogText.en: At least the feud from Valley IV is finally put to rest!

dialogText.cn: 终末地的使命还没有结束。
dialogText.en: Endfield's mission, however, is not over.

dialogText.cn: 我们来这儿的最终目的，是推进息壤计划，遏制武陵甚大裂隙。
dialogText.en: Our ultimate goal here is to advance Project Xiranite and contain the Wuling Very Large Rift.

dialogText.cn: 嗯！刚才峰也说了，宏科院也派来了帮手嘛！
dialogText.en: Exactly! Summit also said HAS sent reinforcements!

dialogText.cn: 那么事不宜迟……
dialogText.en: Then let's not waste any time...

dialogText.cn: 息壤计划的确很重要，但研究也不是一蹴而就的。
dialogText.en: Project Xiranite is important indeed, but progress cannot be forced.

dialogText.cn: 各位初抵武陵就遇到各种事情，又一路为武陵战斗至今，也该放松一下了。
dialogText.en: You have been helping Wuling non-stop since your arrival. Some downtime is not only deserved ... it's also necessary.

dialogText.cn: 你们总不能只劝我多休息吧？
dialogText.en: Feels unfair that I'm the only one being told to rest.

dialogText.cn: 那你会照顾好自己吗？
dialogText.en: {F}Alright, but will you promise to take care of yourself?{M}Alright, but will you promise to take care of yourself?

dialogText.cn: 一定会的。
dialogText.en: I promise.

dialogText.cn: 至少今天……或者这几天，各位就在武陵城住下，给自己放个假吧。
dialogText.en: So, for today at least ... or the next few days, I ask you to remain in Wuling City as guests. Consider it a brief respite.

dialogText.cn: 方兴衢的大家一定很愿意招待各位，等息壤研究有了进展，我们再动工就是。
dialogText.en: Everyone at Fangxing Avenue would be delighted to host you. We can resume work once research on Xiranite has progressed.

dialogText.cn: 既然庄天师这么说了，那也好，我也确实需要一些时间整理报告……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang has a point. Well, I suppose I could use the time to organize my reports...

dialogText.cn: 你这不还是工作吗……
dialogText.en: Mmm... That still sounds like work to me...

dialogText.cn: 如果需要帮忙，随时找我。
dialogText.en: {F}If you need help, just say the word.{M}If you need help, just say the word.

dialogText.cn: 一言为定。
dialogText.en: Then it's a deal.

dialogText.cn: ……还来得及。
dialogText.en: ...There is still time.

dialogText.cn: 看，侵蚀潮退去了！
dialogText.en: Look, the Blight Tide has ebbed away!

dialogText.cn: 是我们赢了，管理员。
dialogText.en: We did it, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 是啊……从四号谷地开始的漫长追击，终于结束了。
dialogText.en: It's over... This long hunt that began in Valley IV has finally come to an end.
Mmm...

dialogText.cn: 不是怕输……其实聂菲斯攻向总桩的时候，我反而放下了心。
dialogText.en: My fear wasn't of defeat... In fact, when she attacked the Main Pillar, I felt a measure of relief.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……潮水已退，息壤堰仍旧屹立不倒。
dialogText.en: Mmh ... the Blight Tide has subsided, and the Xiranite Dam still stands strong.

dialogText.cn: 那你自己呢？
dialogText.en: {F}And what of yourself?{M}And what of yourself?

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯死后，碾骨氏族和叛离的清波寨寨民，也迟早会作羽兽散吧。
dialogText.en: Now that Nefarith has fallen, those Bonekrushers and Stockade turncoats are bound to disperse. It's only a matter of time.

dialogText.cn: 她和阿达希尔……究竟是为了什么才对超域如此执着？
dialogText.en: Nefarith and Ardashir ... just why are they so obsessed with the Ætherside?

dialogText.cn: 您独自调度息壤，加上刚才的鏖战……庄天师，您该休息了。
dialogText.en: You've been directing the Xiranite alone, and you just fought a fierce battle... Tianshi Zhuang, you should get some rest.

dialogText.cn: 不打紧，这也不是第一次了。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. This isn't the first time.

dialogText.cn: 只是突然放松下来……有些后怕。
dialogText.en: It's just that looking back at what happened feels chilling, especially after I let my guard down.

dialogText.cn: 我只是怕武陵受到太多伤害。
dialogText.en: My only real fear was for Wuling and the harm it might suffer.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，您受伤了？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, are you hurt?

dialogText.cn: 没有，只是，有点疲惫了……
dialogText.en: It's okay. I'm just ... a bit tired.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……聂菲斯确实是个强敌。
dialogText.en: {F}Hmm... Nefarith really was a powerful enemy.{M}Hmm... Nefarith really was a powerful enemy.

dialogText.cn: 我？
dialogText.en: Myself?

dialogText.cn: 我知道你们就在这里，那我想……“总有办法的”。
dialogText.en: I knew you stood with me. So I believed ... "There would be a way".

dialogText.cn: 头儿。
dialogText.en: Boss.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？怎么板着脸？
dialogText.en: Hm? Why the serious face?

dialogText.cn: 我只是觉得，如果你要以身犯险做诱饵，至少应该叫上我。
dialogText.en: I just feel ... if you were gonna risk yourself as bait, you could've at least taken me with you.

dialogText.cn: 说回来吧，这里情况如何？
dialogText.en: Let's focus. How are things here?

dialogText.cn: 自然也没什么问题，就是以这些家伙为对手，打得不够尽兴。
dialogText.en: Perfectly fine. Just fighting these guys wasn't satisfying enough.

dialogText.cn: 此次大战，有不少“民间义士”出手相助……我很感谢他们，愿意冒这个险。
dialogText.en: Many "civilian volunteers" stepped up during the battle... I'm grateful they were willing to take the risk.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗，你说呢？
dialogText.en: What do you think, Mi Fu?

dialogText.cn: 既然已经来了这儿，再去方兴衢看看吧。
dialogText.en: Since we are here, we might as well stop by Fangxing Avenue.

dialogText.cn: 没什么。
dialogText.en: It's nothing.

dialogText.cn: ……巡卫的职责不是保护城市吗？
dialogText.en: Isn't a watchguard's duty to protect the city?

dialogText.cn: 我记得我的职责是保护你。
dialogText.en: My duty is to protect you.

dialogText.cn: 你们刚才动手的动静很大……真没事？
dialogText.en: You just went through an intense fight ... are you sure you're okay?

dialogText.cn: 如你所见，完全没问题。
dialogText.en: As you can see, I'm completely fine.

dialogText.cn: 也多亏了终末地的各位从旁协助。
dialogText.en: And I must thank the Endfielders. I wouldn't have made it alone.

dialogText.cn: 好吧……
dialogText.en: Fine...

dialogText.cn: 只是有些乏而已，别太在意。
dialogText.en: I'm just a bit tired, nothing to worry about.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者就是一群行尸走肉，没什么精气神可言。
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers are like walking corpses. All dead inside, no spark at all.

dialogText.cn: 是啊。不过，再过一会儿，巡卫也该恢复巡逻班次了。
dialogText.en: Indeed. And by the way, the watchguards will resume patrol rotations soon.

dialogText.cn: 到时候，可得找“民间义士”好好道个谢。
dialogText.en: We'll be sure to properly thank ... these "volunteers".

dialogText.cn: 巡卫们在引导市民回到正常生活。
dialogText.en: The watchguards are helping citizens resume their lives.

dialogText.cn: 你自己呢？
dialogText.en: And how are you holding up?

dialogText.cn: 至于那些叛逃的寨民……还不如那个小猫崽子。拳头都不会说话。
dialogText.en: As for the traitorous Stockaders ... they're just pathetic. Can't even use their fists to do the talking like that little kitty.

dialogText.cn: 方宜，快过来！没受伤吧？
dialogText.en: Fangyi, quick, come here! You're not hurt, are you?

dialogText.cn: 你们有没有哪里不舒服？
dialogText.en: Is anyone hurt?

dialogText.cn: 我们没事，好好的呢。
dialogText.en: We're fine, really.

dialogText.cn: 你啊，总说没事。现在腾不开手，那就明天再过来，我给你排个检查。
dialogText.en: You always say you're fine. We're stretched thin today, but come see me tomorrow. I'll schedule a full check-up for you.

dialogText.cn: 我会记着的。崔大夫……现在伤亡情况如何？
dialogText.en: I will keep that in mind. Physician Cui ... how are the casualties?

dialogText.cn: 伤者不少，但还在我们承受范围内。我们都是这十年一路熬过来的，应对手段很成熟了。
dialogText.en: There are quite a few injured, but it's still manageable. We've been through this for ten years, so our procedures are solid.

dialogText.cn: 如果有其他需求，随时联系我。麻烦，我来替你解决。
dialogText.en: Alright, if anything comes up, contact me. I will take care of any problems for you.

dialogText.cn: 放心。去其他地方看看吧！救治伤员的事情交给我们。
dialogText.en: I will. Go check the other areas! We've got the wounded covered.

dialogText.cn: 刘巡卫，这边没有受灾吧？
dialogText.en: Any damage here, Watchguard Liu?

dialogText.cn: 一点儿问题也没出！咱们这么多年时时想，天天练，可算给它防住了。
dialogText.en: Not a scratch! All those years of training really came through for us.

dialogText.cn: 其他人的情况还好吧？
dialogText.en: How about everyone else?

dialogText.cn: 有点太好了，田阿姨他们已经凑齐一桌麻将了。
dialogText.en: Oh, better than fine! Aunt Tian and the others have already got a mahjong game going.

dialogText.cn: 当然啦，咱们这儿的人，最不怕的就是折腾。
dialogText.en: Uh-huh. For people around here, chaos is hardly something to fear.

dialogText.cn: 真是有活力啊。
dialogText.en: Hehe, what a lively bunch.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，到时候城内的损失清点完了，队长会一并给您报上去的。
dialogText.en: Oh, Tianshi Zhuang, once the damage assessment is complete, the captain will submit the full report to you.

dialogText.cn: 有劳了。
dialogText.en: Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 苦叶椒……全没了。
dialogText.en: My tartpepper plants... They're all gone.

dialogText.cn: 没错，你是？
dialogText.en: Yeah. And you are...?

dialogText.cn: 哦，我想起来了，终末地的管理员。
dialogText.en: Ah, I remember. You're the Endministrator of Endfield Industries.

dialogText.cn: 情况……你也知道了。都怪我，我至少应该把种子带走的……
dialogText.en: Well, my situation ... is pretty obvious. It's my fault, really. I should have taken the seeds with me...

dialogText.cn: 我没想到裂地者会来这么偏僻的地方洗劫，他们带走了所有作物，连种子都没放过。
dialogText.en: I didn't expect the LBs to raid a backwater place like this. They took all the crops *and* the seeds.

dialogText.cn: 倒是可以先采一些应急……
dialogText.en: Yeah. We can gather some to meet our most urgent needs...

dialogText.cn: 苦叶椒在野外很稀少，据我所知，对面的<@qu.key>山崖</>上有一些，但那边可不好上去。
dialogText.en: But tartpepper plants aren't easy to find in the wilderness. I know a few bushes grow on the <@qu.key>cliffs</> on the other side. Getting there won't be easy, though.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你了。
dialogText.en: Counting on you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 还是我们在后续植物改良研究中的关键作物……
dialogText.en: They're also key crops for our ongoing plant improvement research...

dialogText.cn: 我正忙着呢，没工夫闲聊。
dialogText.en: Shoo. Go away. I'm busy. Got no time to talk.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？你认识我？我从你这里收过东西？
dialogText.en: Oh. You know me. Have I taken anything from you?

dialogText.cn: 买种子？可以倒是可以……但先说好了，一口价，概不还价，这些都是我辛辛苦苦收集来的！
dialogText.en: Seeds to sell? Sure ... but no haggling. Seed gathering is no easy work, you know.

dialogText.cn: 先给你看看吧。
dialogText.en: Here. Take a look at my collection.

dialogText.cn: 没错，你在塔卫二找不到第二个像我这么懂植物的人。
dialogText.en: That's right. Nobody on Talos-II knows more about botanicals than me.

dialogText.cn: 那些穿白大褂的专家根本不懂。他们去过荒地吗？在侵蚀覆盖的地区采过标本吗？
dialogText.en: You'd rather believe in scientists wearing silly white drapes? Did those eggheads ever explore the wildlands? Did they collect any samples from places blanketed by the Blight?

dialogText.cn: 每天都有不同的植物物种灭绝，这些人还在那里做着不痛不痒的研究。
dialogText.en: Plants are going extinct with every passing day but those eggsperts would rather work on their senseless lab projects.

dialogText.cn: 而我，维尔莫林，会给后人留下塔卫二最全的种子库。
dialogText.en: But I, Wellmorin, will build Talos-II's most complete seed bank!

dialogText.cn: 我在收集种子啊。我发现了很多只有四号谷地才有的植物，得想办法把它们加进种子库里。
dialogText.en: I'm looking for seeds. I found many plants that only grow in Valley IV and I intend to add them to the seed bank.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了那些身上插着管子的人，否则光靠我一个人怎么收集得过来。
dialogText.en: Luckily, I met a few pipefaces who are willing to part with some of the good stuff. Or I wouldn't be able to collect everything on my own.

dialogText.cn: 哦，对对，就是他们。
dialogText.en: Right, right. Yeah, them.

dialogText.cn: 至于偷嘛……从那些人手上拿东西，算哪门子偷？
dialogText.en: And what do you mean steal? They're LBs!

dialogText.cn: 我的时间很宝贵！要收咨询费的！
dialogText.en: My time is valuable! Consultation isn't free!

dialogText.cn: 什么事？我的时间可是很宝贵的哦。
dialogText.en: What is it? My time is precious. I don't intend to waste it on meaningless chit-chat.

dialogText.cn: 买种子？可以倒是可以……但先说好了，一口价，概不还价，这些都是我辛辛苦苦收集来的！
dialogText.en: Seeds to sell? Sure ... but no haggling. Seed gathering is no easy work, you know.

dialogText.cn: 先给你看看吧。
dialogText.en: Here. Take a look at my collection.

dialogText.cn: 我的时间很宝贵！要收咨询费的！
dialogText.en: My time is valuable! Consultation isn't free!

dialogText.cn: 你拿到种子啦！但你需要先把它们简制成<@qu.key>田块</>。
dialogText.en: Great, you got the seeds! Our first step is to use crafting and make growing <@qu.key>plots</> with them.

dialogText.cn: 想要试试吗？
dialogText.en: Wanna give this a shot?

dialogText.cn: 除了种子，你还需要<@qu.key>碳块</>，我这里有一些，你可以拿去用。
dialogText.en: You'll need some <@qu.key>carbon</> in addition to the seeds. I got some right here. Take them.

dialogText.cn: 现在我们有了苦叶椒田块。
dialogText.en: We now have a Tartpepper Plot.

dialogText.cn: 可以在生态种植区里进行下一步操作了，去试试吧。
dialogText.en: Perform the next step at the Eco-Farm. Go on, try it out!

dialogText.cn: 干得不错，你已经很熟练了。
dialogText.en: Nicely done. You're really getting the hang of it.

dialogText.cn: 但是想要收获作物，还需要精心培育。等到丰收的时候，你会发现这一切都值得。
dialogText.en: Raising a crop requires some tender loving care. But when harvest time comes, you'll realize that everything is really worth its while.

dialogText.cn: 你是说终末地一直在测试的那些设备？我见过几次，确实很厉害。
dialogText.en: You mean those things Endfield has been testing? I've seen them a few times. They're impressive.

dialogText.cn: 如果有任何想种植的作物，欢迎随时过来。不过，你得先有种子。
dialogText.en: You can always return to the Eco-Farm to grow any crop you like. Just make sure you got the seeds.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，性价比更高的方式是保留一些作物用来自己采种。
dialogText.en: Hah. That's true. The most cost-effective way is to save some of the gathered plants and use your AIC seed-picking units to make your own seeds.

dialogText.cn: 不过植物的脾气没那么容易对付呢，我猜有些作物暂时还只能在自然环境里生长。
dialogText.en: But plants aren't so easily tamed. I reckon some crops can only thrive in natural environments for now.

dialogText.cn: 你回来了！采到了吗？
dialogText.en: You're back. Gathered any tartpeppers so far?

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你！这些我可以先送去应急……
dialogText.en: Thank you! I'll deliver this batch first for our most urgent needs...

dialogText.cn: 但总是这样出去采集也不是长久之计。我们还是要想办法找到<@qu.key>种子</>，重新开始种植。
dialogText.en: But we can't keep exploring and foraging for tartpeppers forever. We must get some <@qu.key>seeds</> and start growing a new crop of tartpepper plants.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢，你真的帮了我大忙。
dialogText.en: Really appreciate this, Endmin. You're a lifesaver.

dialogText.cn: 对了，我避难时遇到了一个自称“植物学家”的人，名叫<@qu.key>维尔莫林</>……
dialogText.en: While I was in the evacuation shelters, I met a self-proclaimed botanist named <@qu.key>Wellmorin</>.

dialogText.cn: 他看起来有些古怪，不像本地人。他说自己在建立种子库，难以找到的种子可以向他购买。
dialogText.en: He was rather eccentric and didn't look like a local to me, but he also mentioned that he was creating a seed bank. The man might have some rare plant seeds to sell.

dialogText.cn: 应该就在基建前站附近，他好像是在那里采集标本。
dialogText.en: He should be near the Infra-Station. I think he's out there collecting plant samples.

dialogText.cn: 拿到种子后，就来生态种植区的入口吧，我在那里等你。
dialogText.en: In any case, meet me at the Eco-Farm entrance once you've found the seeds.

actorName.cn: 神情疲惫的农业天师{田悯}

dialogText.cn: 人手完全不够啊……这下肯定来不及了……
dialogText.en: We're completely understaffed... There's no way we'll make it in time...

actorName.cn: 神情疲惫的农业天师{田悯}

dialogText.cn: 对，我是这个实验作物试点区的负责人……有什么事吗？
dialogText.en: Yeah. I'm in charge of this Agricultural Test Site... Can I help you?

dialogText.cn: 等一下，这身打扮我似乎有见过……啊，难道菲奥娜女士说的“帮手”就是管理员？
dialogText.en: Wait, that outfit... I think I've seen it before. Ah! Don't tell me you're the help Ms. Fiona mentioned, the Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 太好了！这下说不定能赶上！
dialogText.en: Excellent! Now we might actually make it!

dialogText.cn: 噢，忘了和你解释，其实我们本来是打算在试验田上种一批<@qu.key>金石稻</>，用于专门的研究。
dialogText.en: Oh right, before I forget. We were planning to grow a batch of <@qu.key>Amber Rice</> in the test fields for specialized research.

dialogText.cn: 结果在运输途中，我们的种子有一大半都被卷进了侵蚀潮。
dialogText.en: But during transport, over half our seeds were lost to the Blight Tide.

dialogText.cn: 目前农业天师的人手也严重不足，原计划眼看就要泡汤了……
dialogText.en: Right now, the Nongye Tianshi are critically short-handed. Our plan is on the verge of collapse...

dialogText.cn: 对，就在这些试验田上。要是管理员你愿意帮忙，可以问问那边那个植物学家，他那里有不少种子。
dialogText.en: Yes, right here on these test fields. If you're willing to help, you could ask that botanist over there. He has plenty of seeds.

dialogText.cn: 是的，他叫<@qu.key>维尔莫林</>，好像是从四号谷地那边来的，带了好多种类的种子。
dialogText.en: Yeah, that's <@qu.key>Wellmorin</> over there. He seems to have come from Valley IV and brought all sorts of seeds.

dialogText.cn: 就是脾气有些古怪，之前只肯让我买那么一点……
dialogText.en: Though he's a little ... particular. Last time, he'd only sell me a handful.

dialogText.cn: 那就辛苦你了，管理员。
dialogText.en: We'll leave it to you then, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这是我们种的金石稻，如果你有采种用的设备，可以拿它采些种子。
dialogText.en: This is our Amber Rice. If you've got machines for seed-picking, feel free to harvest some seeds.

dialogText.cn: 总算能安心了，接下来只要继续收集作物的样本，再推进后续的研究工作就好了……
dialogText.en: We can finally catch a breath. Now we just need to keep collecting crop samples and push forward with the research.

dialogText.cn: 哼哼，真是大丰收，我的种子库又能变丰富一些了。
dialogText.en: Hah! What a haul. My seed vault's about to get a lot more diverse.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？原来是你啊！
dialogText.en: Oh? It's you!

dialogText.cn: 先等下，让我收集完这些驮兽粪便里的种子……这可是珍贵的样本。
dialogText.en: Hold on, let me finish collecting these seeds from the Burdo-Muck... They're valuable samples.

dialogText.cn: 很好，这样就差不多了……所以说，你又是来买种子的？
dialogText.en: Good, that should just about do it... So, you're here to buy seeds again?

dialogText.cn: 当然有！我这一路又收集了不少新种子！
dialogText.en: Of course! I've gathered plenty of new seeds along the way!

dialogText.cn: 没想到这里也有裂地者，但既然遇到了，不从他们手上拿一点也说不过去嘛！
dialogText.en: Didn't expect Landbreakers here. But since we ran into them, might as well take a little something from them, right?

dialogText.cn: 咳，不说这些了，你不是要种子吗？自己看吧。
dialogText.en: Ahem, enough about that. You're here for seeds, right? Take a look yourself.

dialogText.cn: 还是老规矩——一口价，概不还价！
dialogText.en: Same as always. Fixed price, no haggling!

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？又来买种子了？
dialogText.en: What's up? Here for more seeds?

dialogText.cn: 行，你也算老顾客了，直接看吧，全是我这回好不容易才收集来的。
dialogText.en: Alright, you're a regular by now. Go ahead and look. Everything here was hard to collect this time.

dialogText.cn: 规矩没变，还是一口价，概不还价啊。
dialogText.en: Rules haven't changed alright. Still fixed prices, no bargaining!

dialogText.cn: 驮兽粪便？没想到你还对这个感兴趣……
dialogText.en: Burdo-Muck? Didn't expect you to be interested in that...

dialogText.cn: 先说好，这是我费了点功夫才打探到的“机密”，看在你是老顾客的分上，我就不额外收费了。
dialogText.en: Just so you know, this "intel" took some effort to dig up. But since you're a regular, I won't charge extra.

dialogText.cn: 这驮兽粪便可是好东西，不仅里面藏的种子都更有活力一些，它们本身也很适合做肥料。
dialogText.en: This Burdo-Muck is the real deal. Not only are the seeds inside more vibrant, but the waste itself makes excellent fertilizer.

dialogText.cn: 不信你回头可以试试，保证有用。
dialogText.en: Go ahead and try it later if you don't believe me. Guaranteed to work.

dialogText.cn: 那就不和你多说了，我等下还有种子要收集呢！
dialogText.en: Won't keep you then. I've got more seeds to collect!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你已经把作物都种好了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, have you finished planting all the crops?

dialogText.cn: 真不愧是管理员，这速度也太快了！
dialogText.en: Excellent! No wonder you're the Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 原来如此，那我还真是找对人了！
dialogText.en: I see. Then I've definitely come to the right person!

dialogText.cn: 说起来，因为这批作物需水量大，得一直补充水分。放在往常，这活计实在太累人了。
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, these crops need a lot of water, so they require constant hydration. Normally, this kind of work can be quite exhausting.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>洒水机</>？我好像听说过……说是用起来灵活还便捷，确实可以用来灌溉试验田。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Sprinklers</>? I think I've heard of those... They're supposed to be flexible and convenient. They could definitely work for irrigating the test fields.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你之后可以试试看。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you should give it a try later.

dialogText.cn: 不知道你们终末地有没有什么解决的法子……
dialogText.en: I wonder if Endfield has any solutions for this...

actorName.cn: 神情疲惫的农业天师{田悯}

dialogText.cn: 希望一切顺利，不然我们这次关于作物生长的课题研究就……
dialogText.en: Let's hope everything goes smoothly. Or I wouldn't know what to do about our crop research.

dialogText.cn: 有了管理员帮忙，这次的课题研究说不定能正常推进了……
dialogText.en: With the Endmin's help, this research project might actually stay on track.

dialogText.cn: 这么快！您果然想到办法了。
dialogText.en: That's quick! You actually figured it out.

dialogText.cn: 当初浪头的大哥更胡闹，拿个弹弓往人身上打，非说那也算碰到了。
dialogText.en: Cheated? No. Lang Tou was even worse. He pelted the poor guy standing here with a slingshot. Said it also counts as "touching".

dialogText.cn: 这么一想，还得谢谢您手下留情呢……咱们去找浪头吧，这下他肯定没话说了。
dialogText.en: Honestly, I got lucky it was you and your zipline... Time to talk to Lang Tou. He has no choice but to let you win.

dialogText.cn: 您是要看那什么“数据”对吧？正巧，青芜刚刚帮我整理好了。
dialogText.en: Here for the "data", right? Came at the right time. Qingwu just got them all sorted out for me.

dialogText.cn: 呔！休要聒噪！今天你们便是千军万马，也别想过爷爷我这一关！
dialogText.en: ARGGH! Shut that trap of yours, kiddo! Come at me with all your cronies! Nobody's getting past me today.

dialogText.cn: 无、无理取闹！快让开！
dialogText.en: Please, sir! Cease this nonsense and kindly step out of the way!

dialogText.cn: 嗬，来劲了？都看到了啊，武陵城又来欺负人了啊！
dialogText.en: Oh! Ho! Lil' squirt is trying to fight me! WOULD YOU LOOK AT THAT! The Wulingers are stomping all over us again!

dialogText.cn: 唉，那个天师今天跑来，说是要帮忙建那什么农场，浪头当时就不乐意了。
dialogText.en: Ugh. That Tianshi came here today, saying he's here to help build some farm. Lang Tou got pissed off right away.

dialogText.cn: 可汤汤不是答应让咱们收拾这儿吗……你们要变卦？
dialogText.en: But Tangtang agreed to let us clean and organize this place... Did you change your minds?

dialogText.cn: 当然没有！不过，终末地是终末地，武陵城是武陵城呀。大家服终末地，可不见得服他们。
dialogText.en: We always honor our words, but Endfield is Endfield. Wuling is another matter entirely. You earned our trust, but they don't deserve nothing.

dialogText.cn: 没人要他们来啊！以前闹灾不来，前阵子闹水花子不来，你们把事都摆平了，他们倒来了！
dialogText.en: Nobody asked for no Tianshi. They didn't bother to show during the disaster or splatter attacks. But once you did your thing, they started arriving in droves!

dialogText.cn: 这不就是势利眼嘛，我都替你们不值！
dialogText.en: They're stealing your show and credit! This blighted thievery shall end on my watch!

dialogText.cn: 是的，管理员。庄天师得知您在这里建设了据点，特别派我来提供协助。
dialogText.en: Of course, Endministrator. Tianshi Zhuang heard about your project to set up an outpost here. She sent me here to assist you.

dialogText.cn: 我们宏科院有不少农植方面的工程项目，她希望能在这座复合式农场进行一些测试。
dialogText.en: The HAS has plenty of horticultural projects. She hopes that a few of them could be carried out in the farm complex.

dialogText.cn: 各位，洪波天师这次来访，是想要协助终末地工业完善工作。
dialogText.en: Good people, Tianshi Hong Bo is making his visit today to help the work of Endfield Industries.

dialogText.cn: 你们帮过寨子里的忙，这个我认。但武陵城的天师……我信不过。
dialogText.en: I'm all for Endfield since you helped our Stockade. But these Wulingers and Tianshi? Ffft. I won't give them the same treatment.

dialogText.cn: 不公平！这明摆着就是针对我们啊！
dialogText.en: This isn't fair! It's just your personal grudge against us!

dialogText.cn: 哼，这么多年的旧账摆着，我就是念着公平，现在才没把你们轰出去！
dialogText.en: Grudge? I call it years of bad blood, Wulinger. I'm already being fair. If I had things my way, I would have shoved the lot of you out.

dialogText.cn: 对啊！浪头，你不信天师可以，总得给大当家一个面子吧。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Lang Tou, I know you don't like the Tianshi, but you should at least honor the words of your Chief.

dialogText.cn: 大当家那天提过，黑面煞坐咱们第三把交椅。哪天她问起这事儿，我可照实说了？
dialogText.en: That's very true. Our Chief even gave the Seat of the Third to Darkmask. And if Chief starts asking about this, I'll just go ahead and tell her what actually happened.
Hrnngngh...

dialogText.cn: 还是不行！这玩意儿建在寨子里，就得按咱们的规矩来！
dialogText.en: Consensus?! NO! This entire setup is gonna be built in our Stockade. You'll play by our books!

dialogText.cn: 河佬，既然黑面煞非要护着天师，那……我要他们过“三大难”！
dialogText.en: Fine, He Lao... Since Darkmask wants to protect that Tianshi, then ... then they better beat the Three Super Dares!

dialogText.cn: 过“三大难”？唉，你这家伙……
dialogText.en: Beat the Three Super Dares?! Ugh, the wave really got into your head...

dialogText.cn: 为了办大事能服众，寨子里是有这么条规矩，但已经很久没有人把它搬出来了。
dialogText.en: A challenge for those who want the entire Stockade to support them for major undertakings. It is a part of the Stockade code, but we haven't used it for quite a while.

dialogText.cn: 那是因为自己人信得过！怎么样，书呆子，黑面煞，敢不敢接我三题？
dialogText.en: Because we have absolute faith in the Stockade fam! What say you, Darkmask and Dorknerd? Are you up to the Three Super Dares?

dialogText.cn: 好，有种！咱们寨里见真章！
dialogText.en: Good. Your kind finally grew a spine. We'll see what you're truly made of at the Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 嘿，那边几个，吵架呢，严肃点！
dialogText.en: Oi! You there! Trying to start a fight here! This is not a joke!

dialogText.cn: 我们已经约定帮大家建设寨子，既然大前提还在，能否稍作通融？
dialogText.en: We have given our word to help rebuild the Stockade. So, can you make the appropriate accommodations to support this endeavor?

dialogText.cn: 书呆子？！行，接就接，我倒要看看你能耍多少花招。
dialogText.en: Dorknerd?! Sheesh. Fine. Bring them on. I'll take a look at your tricks.

dialogText.cn: 准备好了？那就——开始！
dialogText.en: Ready, boys? Tighten those grips and — GO!

dialogText.cn: 怎、怎么会……你这厮，力气怎么这么大！
dialogText.en: What the... HOW?! IMPOSSIBLE! Why are you so strong?

dialogText.cn: 胳膊是费力杠杆，我的阻力臂比你的短，那还不是轻轻松松？
dialogText.en: The antebrachium is a 3rd class lever. Incidentally, my resistance arm is shorter than yours, giving me a definitive advantage.

dialogText.cn: 杠、杠杆？阻力臂？那是什么？
dialogText.en: Anti ... brakee-uhm? Resistance arm? What the hell?

dialogText.cn: ……唉，手离人越近越好发力，我把手偷偷往回拽点不就行了。
dialogText.en: ...I'll say it plainly. It's easier to win when your elbow is closer to yourself. I just nudged it back a little.

dialogText.cn: 哦，原来说的是这意思——不对，你小子耍诈！
dialogText.en: Oh, so that's what you're trying to say — HOLD ON! It means you've cheated!

dialogText.cn: 你不是说只管使招嘛。怎么，反悔了？
dialogText.en: You yourself said it's alright if I use my flashy tricks. Or are you not a man of your words?

dialogText.cn: 哼，有点本事，下一场！
dialogText.en: Hmph. You got some tricks, I give you that. NEXT!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，这一场考你的“身手”。从这儿开始跑，我数到二十，能碰到河佬就算通过。
dialogText.en: This is a trial of agility, Darkmask. You start here. I'll count to twenty and you'll pass if you touch He Lao.

dialogText.cn: 爽快，你一动身，咱们就数数。
dialogText.en: That's more like it. We'll start the count down once you start moving.

dialogText.cn: 还记得有水车的那个瀑布吗？他就在上面。
dialogText.en: Remember that waterfall with the waterwheels? He Lao is up there.

dialogText.cn: 水车，瀑布……不对，这点时间，谁能跑那么远哪！
dialogText.en: The waterwheel at the waterfall... Gosh! It's way over there! No one can cover all that distance in twenty seconds!

dialogText.cn: 见识少了吧？当年寨子里有位轻功高手，不光能做到，还有空回来洗澡换衣服呢。
dialogText.en: 'Cos you're ignorant, kid. We used to have a master leapmancer who reached the place, ran home, showered, and changed into new clothing within the same time limit.

dialogText.cn: 你就吹吧，我才不信。
dialogText.en: You're exaggerating. I'm certain this is impossible.

dialogText.cn: 没错，我们不讲那些小气规矩，你就是用飞的也行！
dialogText.en: That's right! No restrictions, no pointless rules. You can even fly there if you want — just make it before the time runs out.

dialogText.cn: 好！这样就赢两场了。怎么样，服不服？
dialogText.en: Alright, sir! We got two victories in our pocket. Convinced now?

dialogText.cn: 可、可恶……我还得准备准备！好生等着！
dialogText.en: Wha... CURSES...! I got some prep work to do! Just you wait!

dialogText.cn: 唉，寨子里不待见我们天师是不奇怪。可这浪头，劲也铆得太足了点。
dialogText.en: Ugh. I know the Stockade residents don't really like Tianshi, but Mr. Lang Tou is going way overboard with this hate.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，反正他这会儿不在，要不我们先开工？
dialogText.en: Endmin, maybe we should just start our work. He's not around to stop us anyway.

dialogText.cn: 而且，这“三大难”也算一个机会。我们按寨子的规矩办事，想必浪头也很难再找理由反对。
dialogText.en: I agree. The Three Super Dares are an opportunity. Lang Tou will find it hard to go against us if we show that we respect the rules of the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 各、各位！机会，机会啊！
dialogText.en: People! We got a chance! A big, fat opportunity!

dialogText.cn: 怎么了这是？什么机会？
dialogText.en: What's happening? What opportunity?

dialogText.cn: 快跟我来，没准这下能让浪头心服口服了！
dialogText.en: Follow me! This is our one chance to truly get Lang Tou convinced!

dialogText.cn: 呜哇哇……你赔！你赔！
dialogText.en: WAAAAAAAAAHHH... I DON'T CARE! YOU LOST IT!

dialogText.cn: 大哥给你想办法，肯定找回来，咱们拉钩……哎哟，你看看大哥呀……
dialogText.en: I'll definitely get it back, kiddo! Promise! Let's pinky swear, okay... Oh man. Come on, just look at me, lil' bro...

dialogText.cn: 浪头借了小宝的风筝，结果收线的时候太着急，把风筝线弄断了。
dialogText.en: Lang Tou borrowed Bobo's kite but got too hasty and snapped the string.

dialogText.cn: 他是想用风筝来出题？话说回来，这个小宝还真放心把东西给他呀。
dialogText.en: Is this kite part of his weird super dares? Speaking of which, Bobo is really brave to let that angry dude play with his stuff.

dialogText.cn: 那孩子天天在附近跑，经常偷偷钻进寨子里玩，大家也没什么辙。总不能跟小娃娃过不去吧。
dialogText.en: The kid frequents this place and often sneaks into the Stockade to play with the others. Nothing much we can do, you know. We don't bully kids.

dialogText.cn: 浪头平时没少给他做玩具，小宝当然会答应。
dialogText.en: And Lang Tou keeps making all sorts of toys for him. Maybe that's why Bobo agreed to let him play with the kite.

dialogText.cn: 原来如此……哈，看不出来浪头还是个孩子王。
dialogText.en: Is that so...? Hah. I never expected Lang Tou to be popular with children.

dialogText.cn: 让我看看风筝到底飘哪儿去了……哦，在那儿呢。
dialogText.en: Let me see where that kite floated off to... Oh. It's right there.

dialogText.cn: 这可不好办啊。
dialogText.en: Oh dear. This won't be easy.

dialogText.cn: 周围有这么一滩侵蚀，真得要对翅膀才能够得着风筝了。
dialogText.en: Surrounded by a marsh of Blight. Someone needs to grow a pair of wings to grab that kite.

dialogText.cn: 乖，乖，先歇会儿。我给你再做个会自己飞的，好不好？
dialogText.en: Come on, boy. Stop crying already. I'll make something that can fly on its own. What do you say?

dialogText.cn: 不要！我就要原来那个！哇啊啊啊……
dialogText.en: NOOOOO! I WANT MY KITE BACK! WAAAAAAAAA...

dialogText.cn: 好好好，就要那个，就要那个……乖孩子，咱们别哭了，别哭了……
dialogText.en: Okay, okay, lil' bro. We'll get you that kite... Be a good boy! Let's try to take a deep breath...

dialogText.cn: {F}哦！小宝你看谁来了，是黑面煞、白面书生和小青龙！她们肯定有办法！{M}哦！小宝你看谁来了，是黑面煞、白面书生和小青龙！他们肯定有办法！
dialogText.en: {F}Oh! Bobo! Look! It's Darkmask, Pale-Faced Scribe, and Green Scales! They'll definitely get your kite back!{M}Oh! Bobo! Look! It's Darkmask, Pale-Faced Scribe, and Green Scales! They'll definitely get your kite back!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？现在想起我们了？
dialogText.en: Oh. Now you're being nice to us. Ugh.

dialogText.cn: 先别管那个，这孩子哭起来没完的……欸，咱们肯定能把风筝拿到的，对、对吧？
dialogText.en: Come on, let's set that aside for now. The kid won't stop crying... Ahem. SO! The kite is gonna go home safely, right? Endmin...?

dialogText.cn: 呼……哈哈，我没说错吧，肯定会有办法的！
dialogText.en: Phewie... HAHA! See, kiddo! You shall get your kite back!
WHA?!

dialogText.cn: 他这样子看起来都有点可怜了……
dialogText.en: Oh no. Now you're gonna make the big meanie booboo cry...

dialogText.cn: 还是帮一把浪头吧，息壤控流节点能处理那些侵蚀，我们正好也可以展示这方面的技术。
dialogText.en: Perhaps we should assist Lang Tou. The Xiranite flow control nodes will help us handle the Blight. We can also use this opportunity to showcase Endfield technology.

dialogText.cn: 哦哦！风筝！风筝回来了！太好啦！
dialogText.en: WOW! It's my kite! My kite is back! YAAAY!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，我们够“有能耐”了吧？
dialogText.en: What do you think? Passed your trial of skills?

dialogText.cn: 这、这不算！我还没出题呢！
dialogText.en: No! Of course not! That wasn't part of the Super Dares! I haven't told you about the challenge.

dialogText.cn: 浪头，别闹太过了。先打过水花子，现在又消了侵蚀，这几位的本事是大是小，你心里有数。
dialogText.en: You've made enough trouble already, bro. They defeated the Splatters and got rid of the Blight. You definitely know what they're made of.

dialogText.cn: 这样的人乐意主动帮咱们，你梗着脖子硬找茬，不是寒人家的心吗？
dialogText.en: And these Endfielders are out to help us. Can't believe you're acting like a stiff-necked nuisance. You don't throw our friends in a cold shower like this.

dialogText.cn: 如果有什么顾虑，复合式农场的建设工作也可以交给清波寨执行。
dialogText.en: If you have other concerns, we can also choose to assign Qingbo Stockade for the construction of the farm complex.

dialogText.cn: 过程中哪个环节有问题，你们都随时可以介入。各位看，这样如何？
dialogText.en: Should the Stockade notice any issues during construction, you are free to intervene as well. Now, do we have a consensus for this?

dialogText.cn: 咋了，说两句呗？
dialogText.en: Come on, old boy. Say something.

dialogText.cn: 大哥，我想去放风筝……
dialogText.en: Big bro, please... I wanna fly my kite...

dialogText.cn: 行了，行了！大、大不了这“第三难”我先欠着，等想好了咱们再比过！
dialogText.en: Okay, fine! I'll set the Third Dare aside! FOR NOW! But you'll face it eventually! When I get it all figured out!

dialogText.cn: 小宝，这里地方太小，施展不开。咱们换个地方，我给你放得高高的！
dialogText.en: Okay, Bobo. This place is a little cramped. Let's find somewhere open and let that kite really fly!

dialogText.cn: 唉，我过来之前什么都准备了，没想到还会有这么一出。
dialogText.en: Ugh. I thought I had everything prepared before coming here. Never expected to run into this.

dialogText.cn: 就像您说的，见招拆招吧。实在不行，我先跟小宝混熟再说。
dialogText.en: Let them bring it on, just like you said. Meanwhile, I'll try to get on Bobo's friendly side, in case all else fails.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，看不出来你心眼还挺多的。
dialogText.en: Heh. I see. A master schemer.

dialogText.cn: 这、这叫抓准要害……说正经的，只要接下来别再折腾，应该还能赶上下一季的农收。
dialogText.en: Well, I call it tackling a problem where it matters... Let's get back to business. If everything goes smoothly, we should be in time for the upcoming harvest season.

dialogText.cn: 我代表武陵感谢各位的协助，我们马上就开始施工！
dialogText.en: And you have my most sincere gratitude, on behalf of all of Wuling. Our work shall commence at once!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，准备好了吗？
dialogText.en: What say you? Ready?

dialogText.cn: 好！那我可准备发令了！
dialogText.en: Great! I'll sound the signal!

dialogText.cn: 预备——开始！
dialogText.en: READY — GOOOO!

dialogText.cn: 哼，好好准备吧。
dialogText.en: Hur. Just get yourself ready.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，就说没那么容易呢！
dialogText.en: Hah. Told you this wasn't easy!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这都不肯认怂？底气很足嘛。
dialogText.en: Oh? Not giving up yet? A persistent one, aren't ya.

dialogText.cn: 看在大当家的面子上，让你多玩儿几次，输也输个心服口服。
dialogText.en: I'll give you a few more tries since the Chief likes you. Can't let a sore loser go around saying how unfair we are.

dialogText.cn: 预备——开始！
dialogText.en: READY — GOOOO!

dialogText.cn: 哈，你想准备多久都行，我等着就是了！
dialogText.en: Sure! Take as long as you want! I'll be waiting right here!

dialogText.cn: 没想到……还有这种招数……
dialogText.en: Well... Never expected to see a move like that...

dialogText.cn: 压力感应回路没信号，泵机当然会过载了……你一个大字不识，怎么会改源石电路的？
dialogText.en: The pump got overloaded because it wasn't getting any signals from the pressure-sensitive circuit... Say, who taught you how to rig Originium circuitries? You barely know how to read.

dialogText.cn: 嗐，武陵城那些废品里面多的是好材料，我每年都得处理百来个呢。
dialogText.en: Ffft. The city dumpsite is full of useful stuff. I dismantle hundreds of them every year.

dialogText.cn: 我是不识字，可寨子里一直有传口诀啊。打铁、织布、造机器，清波寨有自己的路子。
dialogText.en: I might be unlettered, but the Stockade has a collection of wisdom rhymes. We have our own tricks for metal smithing, weaving, and machine cobbling.

dialogText.cn: 寨子里的口诀……莫非，是当初大炎开拓者留下的基础知识？
dialogText.en: Wisdom rhymes of the Stockade... They might be basic knowledge and science left behind by the Yanese pioneers.

dialogText.cn: 那又不是齿轮曲轴，是源石术式和数字信号啊！见鬼，不会真让我找着天才了吧……
dialogText.en: We're not just talking about cogwheels, axles, or other mechanical analogs... These are Originium formulas and digital signals! By Talos, is this guy a natural or what...?

dialogText.cn: 现在这儿是……没事了？
dialogText.en: So I guess ... we're all safe for now?

dialogText.cn: 虽然很不想承认这堆违章设备真的在起作用，但……好吧，至少跑得挺利索。
dialogText.en: I really don't want to accept this contraption of questionable components. But ... I gotta state the obvious. It's actually running pretty well.

dialogText.cn: 废话少说，现在东西转起来了，记得愿赌服输啊！
dialogText.en: Enough with yer nonsense! It works. It runs. And it's reminding someone to call me his grandsire.

dialogText.cn: 嘿？！要是刚才没我帮你擦屁股，咱们已经都被炸上天了！按赌约，你叫我一声爷爷还差不多！
dialogText.en: Excuse me?! Need I remind you that I had to save your sorry arse! It was me who prevented us from being blown to pieces? You say the magic words now!

dialogText.cn: 那啥，要不……你们都退一步，各喊各的？
dialogText.en: Well, how about some compromising ... You could adopt each other!

dialogText.cn: 哼，谁要认他这孙子！
dialogText.en: Like hell I'd claim him as family!

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么说，现阶段的建设算是完成了。
dialogText.en: Regardless, we can finally conclude this phase of the construction project.

dialogText.cn: 但我还是有些不放心，到底是什么造成了那些破坏……
dialogText.en: However, I'm still a little concerned. Those construction materials ... what could've sabotaged them...?

dialogText.cn: 即便如此，它能够保持和传承得这么久，还是很不可思议。
dialogText.en: Even then, the fact that they have survived all those years as an oral tradition... It's a remarkable achievement.

dialogText.cn: 你们看，这里有不少痕迹。
dialogText.en: Look. Plenty of things to investigate here.

dialogText.cn: 可恶，地面实在太乱了，认不出是车辙还是脚印啊。
dialogText.en: Sheesh! The ground is an entire mess of tire tracks and footprints.

dialogText.cn: 有一道拖痕特别深，像是箱子被拖拽留下的。
dialogText.en: There's a very deep and long mark, possibly left by dragging some crates.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，东西拿来了吗？
dialogText.en: Darkmask, got the stuff?

dialogText.cn: 行了！今天我就露一手，让你们好好开开眼！
dialogText.en: Great! Time to give you a show. Trust me. It's gonna floor you all!

dialogText.cn: 完了，全完了……
dialogText.en: It's over ... it's all over...

dialogText.cn: 天哪，这里是让什么东西炸过了？
dialogText.en: Goodness gracious me! Did you guys detonate a huge bomb or something?

dialogText.cn: 昨天大半夜，这附近有阵骚动，我们过来一看，就已经成这样了。
dialogText.en: There was some noise during the wee hours at this place. We came here and ... this is what we found.

dialogText.cn: 建材储备、预制件，十箱坏了八箱！这要怎么接着动工啊！
dialogText.en: Eighty percent of our construction material stockpile and pre-fabs have been damaged! How are we supposed to build anything?

dialogText.cn: 心放宽点嘛，书呆子。城外山高路野的，折点东西多正常。误工夫就误吧，你们头子还能怪罪谁去？
dialogText.en: Look on the bright side of life, dorknerd. We're in the wild hilly countryside. Things get broken all the time. Tell your bosses you'll have major delays. They won't blame anyone.

dialogText.cn: 这下开心了？浪头，实话实说，是不是你干的？
dialogText.en: Happy now, Mister Lang Tou? Speaking of which, this sabotage looks pretty familiar to me.

dialogText.cn: 我费那劲干什么，多糟践东西！
dialogText.en: You're accusing me? Why would I even move my bum and break your scrap? Blighted waste of stuff!

dialogText.cn: 先说好，这农场建在清波寨，将来受益的肯定也是你们。现在捣乱痛快一时，将来可没得后悔。
dialogText.en: Maybe someone needs a reminder. Building the farm at Qingbo Stockade is going to benefit his people. This isn't just a prank. It's an act of malice that someone will regret later.

dialogText.cn: 要是趁早交代，这事儿咱们就——欸，你上哪里去？！
dialogText.en: Now if someone confesses, we'll — HEY! Where are you going?!

dialogText.cn: 帽子都扣脑壳上了，我还听啥，你直接打报告去呗！
dialogText.en: Sod it! Saw that coming from a mile away. Your accusations are friggin' old and obvious. Just go and type your report, dork.

dialogText.cn: 哼，鼻孔朝天，果然没一个讲道理的。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Snobbish stuck-ups... Can't talk no sense to 'em.

dialogText.cn: 走远了欸……管理员，我们先去跟河佬说说情况？
dialogText.en: Uh-oh. There he goes... Endmin, maybe we should talk to He Lao about this sitch.

dialogText.cn: 这不会就是“第三难”吧？先弄出点麻烦，再看我们能不能有办法搞定，也算考“能耐”了。
dialogText.en: Maybe this is the Third Dare. He makes some trouble for us and see if we can solve it. That would be a test of our skills.

dialogText.cn: 他真敢这么糟蹋东西，大当家可要生气了。而且，以浪头的脾气，不该闷头就走啊。
dialogText.en: If Lang Tou really wasted stuff like this, our Chief would have more than a word with him. But he's acting weird. A good fellow of his temper wouldn't just walk away and brood.

dialogText.cn: 残存的货箱外壳遭到了外力扭曲，上面隐约有顶撞、剐蹭的痕迹。
dialogText.en: The remaining crates look deformed due to external forces. Faint signs of blunt impacts, collisions, and scratches are visible on them.

dialogText.cn: 看痕迹的凹陷情况，货箱好像被某种带尖刺的东西顶过。
dialogText.en: Look at the dents and marks on the crates. They were probably rammed aside by something with spikes.

dialogText.cn: 货物已经倾倒，横移了数米之远。
dialogText.en: Crate contents have been spilled out and dragged to several meters away.

dialogText.cn: 它的一角微微凹陷，显然承受了巨大的力量。
dialogText.en: One of the corners is slightly dented. It must have been hit by a powerful force.

dialogText.cn: 可能是什么大家伙推开了这些货物，难道有人开车到这儿撞上了？
dialogText.en: Maybe some tough guy tried to push the crates aside. Or maybe someone drove a truck and rammed them.

dialogText.cn: 瞧，最后一箱物资在这儿呢。人力肯定搞不成这个样子。
dialogText.en: See that? The last crate of goods. No human could have pulled this off.

dialogText.cn: 见鬼，怎么偏偏是这些设备被弄坏了……
dialogText.en: The devil's work! It's the equipment... They broke all of it...

dialogText.cn: 一些打算装给复合式农场的组件，我们特地加了低频声波驱兽装置，得再去订一批。
dialogText.en: Components for assembling the farm complex. We furnished them with low frequency acoustic emitters. They're meant to deter beasts. Gotta order another batch of them.

dialogText.cn: 算了吧，它都被叼到这里来了，还驱兽呢？我看是招兽装置还差不多。
dialogText.en: Deter beasts? Is that a joke? They dragged the stuff all the way here. I think it does a better job as a beast lure.

dialogText.cn: 你不会想说，刚才路上那些天使也是它招来的吧？不可能，不懂原理就少操点心。
dialogText.en: Oh, I guess you're also going to say that it lured in all those Aggeloi, right? People who don't know how things work should keep their unscientific opinions to themselves.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，出事的又不是你家后院，你倒是心宽。
dialogText.en: Tch. Easy for you to say that, since this isn't your turf.

dialogText.cn: 唉……好好说话。专业知识很复杂的，别搞得这么夸张。
dialogText.en: Dude... This is nothing personal. The scientific principles of acoustic deterrents are quite complicated.

dialogText.cn: 又想拿“专业知识”糊弄我了！敢情没把清波寨的人命放心上呗？
dialogText.en: Trying to mislead me with your scientific mumbo-jumbo? AGAIN? Bet you never cared if the Stockade lives or dies.

dialogText.cn: 当初也是，现在也是。你们武陵城果然说一套，做一套，压根没想过别人怎么样。
dialogText.en: Typical Wuling buggercrap. I smelled it once and remembered the stink. You double-crossing stuck-ups never cared about the smallfolks.

dialogText.cn: 少、少来这套！还说当初，天师们两手空空来武陵建城的时候，清波寨不也在袖手旁观么？
dialogText.en: You're making ... baseless accusations! You know what happened back then? The Tianshi came here to build a city with zero support. You Stockaders just stood by and watched.

dialogText.cn: 十年前那场大灾，天师们自己撑下来了，可没亏欠清波寨半点！现在好心谈合作，怎么这么不识趣呢！
dialogText.en: We don't owe your Stockade anything! In fact, we Tianshi endured and defeated that disaster ten years ago on our own! We've been most accommodating in this joint project, but I guess asking someone for common decency is too much!

dialogText.cn: 哼，知不知道那会儿寨子里没了多少人？你们不去瞎折腾，大灾会自己跑出来吗！
dialogText.en: Endured the disaster on your own, eh? You know how many of our fam died that time? I wonder how that calamity blew up in our face. Oh, it's the friggin' Tianshi and their crazy-ass experiments! You brought it upon us!

dialogText.cn: 行，就你年纪大，记性好。我们天师又要防灾又要防贼，哪里顾得上？
dialogText.en: Whatever, old man. Guess you have a book of grudges. Look, we Tianshi have to keep both disasters and bandits at bay. We can't spread our forces everywhere.

dialogText.cn: 贼？！怎么，防我们？你们那城头立起来之前，这里就没人用过“贼”这个字眼！
dialogText.en: Bandits?! Dork, you talking about us? Nobody ever calls us bandits. Not until you raised that silly wall of yours.

dialogText.cn: 不是那个意思……嗐，跟你说不通道理！
dialogText.en: No, that's not what I... Ugh. Why do I even bother? You're so unreasonable.

dialogText.cn: 眼下正好也要重新筹备物资，大家还是暂缓一步，稍作休息，再来商讨该怎么办吧。
dialogText.en: Well, this seems like a good time to restock our key materials. Let's settle down and rest before we discuss the next steps of our operation.

dialogText.cn: 哼，看在黑面煞的面子上先放你一马。但是别忘了，咱们这“第三难”还没过呢！
dialogText.en: Hmph. I'm letting you off this time 'cos Darkmask. Remember! The Third Dare isn't over yet!

dialogText.cn: 怎么会闹到这个地步……
dialogText.en: How did it all end up like this...?

dialogText.cn: 我明白。唉，庄天师见我了解过本地民俗，特意安排我来，没想到现在矛盾反而全在我身上。
dialogText.en: I know. Ugh. Tianshi Zhuang assigned me to this project ... precisely because of my understanding of the local customs. Great. Now all the local bad blood and history are on me.

dialogText.cn: 过去那场大灾搞出了一堆烂账，城里城外都不好过。
dialogText.en: Yeah. That disaster left a terrible taste in everyone's mouths. Inside and outside the city.

dialogText.cn: 我明明清楚不该说赌气话，结果还是没控制住。唉，冲动误事啊……
dialogText.en: I know I shouldn't have let anger get the better of me, but I... Man... Impulse is such a terrible thing...

dialogText.cn: 要不，你姿态放低点，去跟浪头好好道个歉？
dialogText.en: Have you considered, you know, using some humbleness ... and giving Lang Tou a proper apology?

dialogText.cn: 这样也许还不太够。他原本就不信任天师们，今天只是不幸又加强了这个印象。
dialogText.en: That probably won't be enough. The man has a strong distrust of Tianshi. What happened today might have reinforced his skewed perspective.

dialogText.cn: 各位，这次是我不对。能帮忙再想想办法吗？
dialogText.en: I really messed up this time. Endfielders, can you help me come up with a plan?

dialogText.cn: 这任务意义重大，我事后怎么被庄天师处置都行，不能让大好机会就这么被耽误了。
dialogText.en: This mission means a lot to me. I don't care if I get censured by Tianshi Zhuang afterwards, but we can't afford to miss this wonderful opportunity.

dialogText.cn: 哎！浪头，你小心点！
dialogText.en: Oi! Lang Tou! Don't get yourself killed!

dialogText.cn: 河佬，这是怎么了？
dialogText.en: What's going on, He Lao?

dialogText.cn: 浪头刚回来就带着一堆破烂儿上去了，说是要自己把缺的部分搞定……这家伙，怕是犟脾气又上来了。
dialogText.en: Lang Tou found himself a bunch of scraps right after he came back. Told us he'll take care of the rest of the building project... A wave of stubborn prolly hit him in his head again.

dialogText.cn: 书呆子那堆物什招脏东西，我才不让他接着动呢。
dialogText.en: Dorkhead's trash machines are luring beasts into our turf. I won't let him build our farm with his stupid toys.

dialogText.cn: 算懂一点儿吧……寨子里不少东西都是他和大伙儿一起建的，连那水车也是。
dialogText.en: A bit, I guess... He and his crew fixed and built plenty of stuff in the Stockade. Even the waterwheels.

dialogText.cn: 你可别乱动啊！外头建成这样就算了，里头的泵机和发电机组都是技术活！
dialogText.en: Hey! Stop fooling around with it! Machine housing can be anything you like ... but we need a true technician to work on the pumping and power generator modules!

dialogText.cn: 瞧不起谁呢？不就是一个浇水施肥的东西嘛，有什么难的？
dialogText.en: You trying to discredit me? This is just a pump for sprinkling water and poop. How hard can it be?

dialogText.cn: 木匠活好跟这是两码事，农场架子修得再利索，跟源石设备可没关系啊。
dialogText.en: Carpentry is a totally different field of expertise. You've built some impressive farm houses, but Originium machines are an entirely different matter!

dialogText.cn: 啊？管理员，我真没有……
dialogText.en: What?! Endmin, that's not what I...

dialogText.cn: 书呆子，打个赌。要是我自个儿搞定了，你今后就得喊我爷爷！倒过来也一样，怎么样，敢不敢？
dialogText.en: Dorknerd! If I get this done on my own, I'll adopt you as my grandkid and treat you like one. And vice versa! Game enough for this dare?

dialogText.cn: ……爷、爷爷？
dialogText.en: ...G-grandkid?

dialogText.cn: 行啊，把东西给我准备准备，你们就瞧好吧！
dialogText.en: Alright! Prep the stuff. Watch and learn, kid!

dialogText.cn: 嘿，我们又不是只会吃生肉的野人，为什么一个两个都这么虚呢？
dialogText.en: What? You think we are cave people who can't even make fire? Your lack of faith is insulting!

dialogText.cn: 是啊，你赶紧——等会儿，我没说啊？！
dialogText.en: Exactly! You should — WAIT! Hold on! I didn't say that!

dialogText.cn: 什么？！好嘛，瞧不起我是吧？
dialogText.en: WHAT?! Ahhh... Are you making fun of me?

dialogText.cn: 这……但浪头还在上面呢，你这么激他，会不会真弄出个好歹来？
dialogText.en: But ... Lang Tou is still up there. Keep poking the manglerbeast and he might just snap!

dialogText.cn: 他可能是有点技术，不过事关重大，我们是不是再想想……
dialogText.en: Sure, he might have certain skills, but this is a major project. Maybe we should discuss...

dialogText.cn: 嘿，我还真不信了！你只管动手吧，今天我非收个孙子不可。
dialogText.en: Hah! You? I think you're bound to fail. Go ahead and do your stuff, son. I mean, grandson.

dialogText.cn: 浪头，真没问题吗？
dialogText.en: Lang Tou, you sure you can do this?

dialogText.cn: 老实等着吧，我什么时候玩砸过？
dialogText.en: When did I ever mess up, huh? Keep your eyes peeled.

dialogText.cn: 唉，我算是明白第一次下厨那会儿，我妈为什么是那副表情了……
dialogText.en: Oh man. Now I know why Mom gave me that look when I attempted to cook my first meal...

dialogText.cn: 喂，浪头，你爬这么高不要紧吧？
dialogText.en: Hey! Lang Tou! You okay up there? You're really far off the ground.

dialogText.cn: 哈，哪、哪儿高啦？上面这小风吹得，凉快着呢！
dialogText.en: Hahah. Oh? This? Far? If you wanna know, I'm enjoying the cool, refreshing breeze.

dialogText.cn: 不，我是说，你好像忘记带扳手了！
dialogText.en: No! It's just that ... I think you left your wrench here!

dialogText.cn: ……我自有办法！黑面煞，这里头的东西得先调调状态，我给你数，你帮我在底下弄弄！
dialogText.en: My... I don't need no wrench! Darkmask! I gotta fix up the insides of this contraption. I'll give you the numbers. You do the tweaking for me!

dialogText.cn: ……红线、蓝线、黄绿线，这怎么还有根灰的？
dialogText.en: Red wire, blue, yellow-green... What the hell? A gray one?!

dialogText.cn: 行了！泵机转了！怎么样，没话说了吧！
dialogText.en: GOT IT! The pump is running! Alright, baby boy! Got anything to say?

dialogText.cn: 发电机居然在正常供能……你都做了些什么？
dialogText.en: The generator is actually supplying power... What did you do?

dialogText.cn: 书呆子，你们的布线怎么又换了，能不能讲点信用啊？
dialogText.en: Dorknerd, since when did you guys change the cable layouts? Are you trying to cheat us again?

dialogText.cn: 信用你个头，那是我们做了技术升级……不对，你到底在拆什么呢？！
dialogText.en: Cheat? What on earth — It's just a technical upgrade... HOLD ON! What did you dismantle? What are you looking at?!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，要是今天浪头打算在里面打地铺，我们还要这么盯着他吗？
dialogText.en: So, Endmin... if Lang Tou is planning to work through the night, do we have to keep our eyes on him?

dialogText.cn: 接管子，拉线头呗。看到没有，我们自己也能行！
dialogText.en: Pipe and wire connections. See? We can build our own stuff.

dialogText.cn: 没想到你还藏了两手。见鬼，再怎么说那也是自动化控制芯片啊……
dialogText.en: Can't believe you have all these tricks up your sleeve. Dang ... that was an automated control chip...

dialogText.cn: 对了，“压力感应回路”是什么？
dialogText.en: Hah. Yeah. So, what's the "pressure-sensitive circuit" for?

dialogText.cn: ……你不会……没接吧？
dialogText.en: Wha...? Don't tell me you didn't ... connect that...

dialogText.cn: 喂！冒汽啦！我怎么感觉地都在晃呢！
dialogText.en: Wow. That's a lot of steam! The entire place is shaking too!

dialogText.cn: 啊？怎、怎么会……
dialogText.en: WHA?! HOW? WHY...?

dialogText.cn: 这么下去就全完蛋了。我先上去，你们在底下看好机器！
dialogText.en: The entire thing will be utterly destroyed if this goes on. I'm heading up. Stay here and keep your eyes on the machines and facilities!

dialogText.cn: 别！我给你飞了好几条线，乱动还要出大事！
dialogText.en: No! STOP! I made a few improvised connections! It might get worse if you make changes to them!

dialogText.cn: ……那你跟我一起修！
dialogText.en: THANKS, GENIUS! NOW HELP ME GET IT FIXED!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请再去终端机帮我们一起调整参数，拜托了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I need your help — check the terminal and adjust the parameters! PLEASE!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，就在这附近了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we're close.

dialogText.cn: 哇，是要我们拍龙泡泡啊！
dialogText.en: Wow. Are we gonna photograph these chubby lungs?

dialogText.cn: 韩天师觉得龙泡泡代表年轻人对新事物与新潮流的向往。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Han believes these chubby lungs symbolize youthful tastes and trends.

dialogText.cn: 错，不只年轻人哦。我认识的好多老师傅也喜欢龙泡泡！
dialogText.en: Newp! Not just the youths. I know plenty of old masters who can't get enough of chubby lungs!

dialogText.cn: 就在那边，管理员！
dialogText.en: Over there, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 要拍摄迁徙的羽兽……这和武陵城的人群活动有什么联系吗？
dialogText.en: A photo of migrating fowlbeasts... Does this have anything to do with crowd activities of Wuling?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……非要说的话，前几年好像没这么多羽兽飞到武陵城来。
dialogText.en: Hmm... If anything's related, there didn't seem to be this many fowlbeasts in Wuling several years ago.

dialogText.cn: 原来如此，羽兽迁徙代表武陵人通过行动改善了自然环境吧。
dialogText.en: Is that so? Then the migrating fowlbeasts are proof that the Wulingers made improvements to the natural environment.

dialogText.cn: 欸，是天师府学院的考校挂幅啊。这边老师太多，以前我都会绕着走……
dialogText.en: Oh. Exam blessing banners for the Academy. I used to avoid this place due to the number of instructors here...

dialogText.cn: 每一届考校都是武陵城的大事，天师们都会来现场观看报名情况。
dialogText.en: Every exam season is a major event in Wuling. Many Tianshi would visit the place to check on the registrations.

dialogText.cn: 这也是武陵城勃勃生机的一部分，代表了武陵天师的一脉相承。
dialogText.en: This is also proof of the city's dynamic growth and the heritage of the Wuling Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 这张就取名叫“苦恼的天师”吧？
dialogText.en: Gotta title this: "The Perplexed Tianshi".

dialogText.cn: 以前练剑的时候，动作一旦不得要领，师父就叫我照着水看一看倒影，再挥剑时就能发现问题。
dialogText.en: Back when I trained in swordmancy, if there was a move I didn't get, my mentor told me to study my reflections in the water. It really helped me spot my mistakes.

dialogText.cn: 让韩天师他们看看自己苦恼时的样子，说不定就有新思路了！
dialogText.en: We should show Tianshi Han how troubled they look. Perhaps it would give them new ideas!

dialogText.cn: 说不定真的可以。陈，多亏你心细，察觉到了盲点。
dialogText.en: Maybe this will work. I think you found the missing piece, Chen.

dialogText.cn: 欸，怎么突然夸人啊？
dialogText.en: Oh, why is everyone saying nice things about me?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，就用这张“苦恼的天师”试试看吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we'll try things out with "The Perplexed Tianshi".

dialogText.cn: 管理员……你说，天师们是不是从来没想过拍摄自己的影像。
dialogText.en: Endmin... Maybe it's just me, but the Tianshi never thought about taking selfies.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有反应了！成像仪的校验进度开始增长了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! It's responding! We're getting actual progress for Imager calibration!

dialogText.cn: 突破百分之七十了，还在涨，到百分之八十了！
dialogText.en: Seventy percent and rising ... and it just hit eighty percent!

dialogText.cn: 欸，这么快就有进展了吗？
dialogText.en: Wow. That progressed really fast!

dialogText.cn: 我们的思路是正确的，校验进度直接涨到百分之九十五了。
dialogText.en: Our approach is correct. Progress for calibration leaped to ninety-five percent in one shot.

dialogText.cn: 马上就能成功了！
dialogText.en: We're almost there!

dialogText.cn: 不对，校验进度怎么只涨到百分之九十九？
dialogText.en: Wait. Why is the calibration progress stuck at ninety-nine percent?

dialogText.cn: 不应该啊，我们穷举了几乎所有的可能性……
dialogText.en: It shouldn't happen. We exhausted nearly every single possibility...

dialogText.cn: 难道说，我还漏掉了什么关键点？
dialogText.en: Maybe I ... missed something crucial?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，快试试下一张吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Let's try the next photo!

dialogText.cn: 韩天师对待学术研究非常认真，只是……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Han is incredibly committed to academic research, but...

dialogText.cn: 他也很容易陷入和自己较劲的状态，忽略周围的情况。
dialogText.en: He has a habit of disagreeing with himself, and he ignores everything else when that happens.

dialogText.cn: 已经穷尽了所有可能的地点，这回应该没问题吧？
dialogText.en: I think I covered every site to my best knowledge. Things should work this time.

dialogText.cn: 唉，不知道卜圆天师他们那组的拍摄情况怎么样……
dialogText.en: Hmm. Wonder how Tianshi Bu Yuan's team is doing about the photographs...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，辛苦你们专程过来。
dialogText.en: Endmin, thank you for making this trip.

dialogText.cn: 如你所见，首墩残层的<@qu.key>巨兽心脏</>已经在这里了。
dialogText.en: As you can see, the <@qu.key>Feranmut Heart</> from the Marker Stone Ruins is here.

dialogText.cn: 它在阿达希尔的袭击中受损最为严重……
dialogText.en: It suffered the worst damages during Ardashir's attack...

dialogText.cn: 看上去，它的状况没那么糟糕？
dialogText.en: But it looks ... kinda okay to me?

dialogText.cn: 多亏了你们提供的重息壤，它的主体结构才能维持稳定。
dialogText.en: All thanks to the Heavy Xiranite you supplied. It's how we maintained primary structural stability.

dialogText.cn: 但它原本的协议源石模块受损，对此我们确实束手无策。
dialogText.en: But its initial Protorig module has been damaged. We could do nothing about that.

dialogText.cn: 我们会尽力而为。
dialogText.en: We'll do our best.

dialogText.cn: 除了要修复受损的协议源石模块，我们还需要完成巨兽心脏的初始化。
dialogText.en: In addition to repairing the damaged Protorig module, we must re-initialize the Feranmut Heart as well.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟，能深度参与修复巨兽心脏的机会可是千载难逢啊。
dialogText.en: After all, it's a rare honor to take part in extensive repairs of the Feranmut Heart.

dialogText.cn: 又是天使……
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi...

dialogText.cn: 庄天师委派了我来援助，修缮面临的问题比较复杂，需多方协同。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang assigned a supporting role for me. Repair work will be facing complex issues, so we must work together.

dialogText.cn: 首墩中的巨兽心脏，最初是由<@qu.key>代理人</>亲自配合完成首次激活的。
dialogText.en: For the Marker Stone Feranmut Heart, the first activation was personally carried out by the <@qu.key>proxy</>.

dialogText.cn: 这之后，它便能持续采集环境参数，自行调整能量外溢的强度。
dialogText.en: Since then, the Heart would continuously collect ambient data and auto-adjust the magnitude of its own energy dissipation.

dialogText.cn: 代理人不在，我们只能利用仪器采集巨兽心脏可感知的环境参数，从而激活它。
dialogText.en: But the proxy is not with us. We must now use various instruments to collect tangible ambient data for the Feranmut Heart to activate it.

dialogText.cn: 为了解决这个问题，心脏修缮站的负责人<@qu.key>韩方</>天师带头设计了<@qu.key>巨兽成像仪</>来辅助工作。
dialogText.en: To address issue, Cardiac Remediation Station director, Tianshi <@qu.key>Han Fang</>, designed the <@qu.key>Feranmut Imager</> to support this work.

dialogText.cn: 还有一位<@qu.key>卜圆</>天师，她在研发的<@qu.key>巨兽心音仪</>则是为了保证初始化后的巨兽心脏能够稳定进行能量外溢。
dialogText.en: We also have Tianshi <@qu.key>Bu Yuan</>. The <@qu.key>Feranmut Cardiograph</> she developed is to ensure that the initialized Feranmut Heart is capable of sustaining stable energy dissipation.

dialogText.cn: 葛天师，天使在首墩区域内的活动还是很频繁吗？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Ge, are you still getting frequent Aggeloid activities in the Marker Stone area?

dialogText.cn: 对，但天使本身不足为惧。
dialogText.en: Yes, but the Aggeloi are hardly a concern.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏受损之后，首墩对裂隙的压制有所减弱。这才是我们真正要解决的问题。
dialogText.en: Damages to the Feranmut Heart weakened Marker Stone's suppression of the rift. This is the issue we need to address.

dialogText.cn: 韩方天师正在校验成像仪。至于卜圆天师……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Han Fang is calibrating the Imager. As for Tianshi Bu Yuan...

dialogText.cn: 咳，她应该在某个地方喝茶。
dialogText.en: Ahem. She should be enjoying tea somewhere.

dialogText.cn: 喝、喝茶？
dialogText.en: Huh?! Tea?!

dialogText.cn: 科研陷入瓶颈的时候，总得想点办法寻找灵感。
dialogText.en: When science runs into a bottleneck, one must find a fount of inspirations.

dialogText.cn: 哦？是韩天师的信息，他好像又在和自己较劲了。
dialogText.en: Oh. Tianshi Han Fang is calling. He's having an inner disagreement again.

dialogText.cn: 葛天师，如果有需要，我们可以协助。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Ge, if you need something, we can always help.

dialogText.cn: 也好，他就在武陵城外的<@qu.key>天师桩阵列</>附近。
dialogText.en: Good to hear. Han Fang is near the <@qu.key>Tianshi Pillar Array</> outside Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 这数据，还是不对……
dialogText.en: The data ... doesn't look right...

dialogText.cn: 刚才那么危险，你怎么不撤？
dialogText.en: Things were so dangerous back then. Why didn't you evac?

dialogText.cn: 一些天使而已，翻不出什么浪。而且刚刚绕城找拍摄地，确实跑不动了……
dialogText.en: These Aggeloi won't stop me... And I just ran around the city to photograph a nice place ... I can't run anymore...

dialogText.cn: 多谢你们帮忙。对了，老葛应该介绍过我？韩方，正在进行巨兽成像仪的校验工作。
dialogText.en: Thank you for helping. Old Ge introduced me, right? Name's Han Fang. I'm calibrating the Feranmut Imager.

dialogText.cn: 不过，他怎么还让管理员亲自过来……
dialogText.en: But, why did he ask you to come here personally, Endmin...?

dialogText.cn: 前辈们留下的初始化相关资料中，只笼统强调了巨兽心脏对环境的感知要讲究<@qu.key>“济事人为本”</>。
dialogText.en: Initialization data handed down by our mentors only emphasized that ambient senses of the Feranmut Heart must be <@qu.key>"people-oriented"</>.

dialogText.cn: 可最近，我反复试了十几组不同的影像，校验进度却停了下来，毫无进展！
dialogText.en: However, I recently tested more than a dozen photos but calibration progress didn't even budge! Not one bit!

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么忙活，校验进度都卡在百分之七十不动，我觉得该换个思路了……
dialogText.en: No matter what I did, progress is now stuck at seventy percent. Maybe I should try a different approach...

dialogText.cn: 我和卜圆天师讨论过，武陵城日新月异……
dialogText.en: I talked about this with Tianshi Bu Yuan. Wuling is a dynamic and changing city...

dialogText.cn: 环境参数应该把之前未有过的新事物也囊括进来……
dialogText.en: Ambient data should also include new things that never existed before...

dialogText.cn: 只是新事物太多了，即便算上卜圆天师和一些学生，想要拍遍全城的新事物也还是人手不够啊。
dialogText.en: But this is too much work. Even if Tianshi Bu Yuan and the disciples help out, we don't have enough people to photograph every new stuff.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，我把可能与新事物有关的一些地点都标好了，这几处就拜托各位了。
dialogText.en: Awesome. I've marked every place associated with novelties. We really need all the help we can.

dialogText.cn: 我会去材料研究所，利用成像仪终端进行参数处理，各位拍摄结束后可以直接在那儿与我会合。
dialogText.en: I gotta run to the Institute of Materials Science and process the data with the Imager terminal. Meet me there once you're done photographing.

dialogText.cn: 经过几轮实验后，我们发现环境参数与人群活动有关……
dialogText.en: After several rounds of testing, we discovered that ambient data are related to crowd activities...

dialogText.cn: 在拍摄了更多有关人群活动的影像后，我们利用成像仪把影像处理为能够被巨兽心脏感知的环境参数。
dialogText.en: We took photos of various crowd activities. The Imager then converts them into ambient data tangible to the Feranmut Heart.

dialogText.cn: 最后把参数与首墩顶层中正常巨兽心脏所采集的参数进行对比，来完成巨兽成像仪的校验。
dialogText.en: Lastly, we'll compare them against data collected by the normal Feranmut Heart in the Marker Stone Zenith to finish calibrating the Feranmut Imager.

dialogText.cn: 人们的生活方式和对待事物的态度也改变了很多。
dialogText.en: The way people live and their perspectives have changed.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>方兴衢</>离此地最近，你们可以先去那里。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Fangxing Avenue</> is closest. I advise going there first.

dialogText.cn: 遗憾的是，里面并没有提及代理人的具体做法。
dialogText.en: Disappointingly, it mentions nothing about what the proxy actually did.

dialogText.cn: “苦恼的天师”？原来我一直忽视了一件显而易见的事情……
dialogText.en: "The Perplexed Tianshi"? Turns out I've been neglecting the most obvious thing...

dialogText.cn: 心里一直念着“济事人为本”，却遗漏了身边这群默默付出，低头耕耘的人。
dialogText.en: I thought I kept "people-oriented" to heart, but I never realized that I missed every quiet and hardworking soul around me.

dialogText.cn: 差点辜负了大家的苦心，我得郑重道谢，谢谢你们！
dialogText.en: I almost let everyone down. My utmost thanks to you!

dialogText.cn: 有了这次的成像仪校验做基础，巨兽心脏可感知的环境参数很快就能提取出来，等我的好消息吧！
dialogText.en: This Imager calibration will serve as our basis for extracting tangible ambient data for the Feranmut Heart. Wait for my good news!

dialogText.cn: 如果需要帮忙，就来找我喝杯茶聊聊。
dialogText.en: And if you need help, we can talk about it over some tea.

dialogText.cn: 你再想唠叨，我也忍了。
dialogText.en: Feel free to share everything on your mind. I'm all ears.

dialogText.cn: 韩天师在调整成像仪了，我们先去看看修缮站的进展吧。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Han is adjusting the Imager. Let's check the progress at the Remediation Station.

dialogText.cn: 济事济人，却唯独没有<@qu.key>自我</>的位置……要不是这次项目，我究竟得多久才能发现啊。
dialogText.en: I left <@qu.key>myself</> out when I focused on people helping people... And I might never have realized this were it not for this project.

dialogText.cn: 怪不得庄天师她要把这个任务交给我，还告诫我谨记前辈们留下的理念……
dialogText.en: No wonder Tianshi Zhuang handed this mission to me. She even reminded me to think about our mentors' lessons...

dialogText.cn: 天师、巡卫、职农、职工……大家都在默默践行理念，但在这些身份下，我们首先是人群的一员。
dialogText.en: Tianshi, watchguards, farmers, and laborers... Everyone tacitly upheld these tenets. But set aside the roles and we're just people.

dialogText.cn: 前辈们留下的这句话，我理解得过于片面，单纯以为这些只是对修缮巨兽心脏的提示。
dialogText.en: I only knew the literal meaning of our mentors' wisdom. I treated them as mere instructions for repairing the Feranmut Heart.

dialogText.cn: 卜圆天师，你们这组影像，怎么会有这么多新样式的菜品和点心啊？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Bu Yuan, why does your team take so many photos of novel dishes and desserts?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我是在探索新的可能性，快上传到终端试试，说不定进度就能继续增长了！
dialogText.en: Hmm... I am exploring new possibilities. Upload it and see. Maybe it'll progress it a little.

dialogText.cn: 行吧，我先试试看……嗯？是有一丝波动，但完全可以忽略不计。
dialogText.en: Sure, I'll try... Hmm. There's a pulse, but it is absolutely negligible.

dialogText.cn: 果然，烹饪之道发展的年头太久，单纯的样式变化不能算是新事物，得换个思路……
dialogText.en: I knew it. The history of cooking is just too long. Stylistic changes do not constitute a novelty. Another approach is required...

dialogText.cn: 太好了，就差你们这组了，这几处的影像更符合要求，希望能推动校验进度！
dialogText.en: Great! Just the set I need. Your photos are more compliant to my requests. I hope they can push the calibration along!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，影像需要上传到这个终端，我来把它们处理成环境参数！
dialogText.en: Endmin, just upload the images to this terminal and I'll convert them to ambient data!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？没想到葛天师说的帮手是你们！
dialogText.en: Endmin? Tianshi Ge never told me that you'll be helping us in person!

dialogText.cn: 太好了，有你们在……我也更有把握些。等结束之后，我请大家喝茶。
dialogText.en: But this is most wonderful... Your presence is very reassuring. Everyone will be getting some nice tea from me.

dialogText.cn: 卜天师，大概的情况葛天师已经说明过。你现在正在用心音仪确定新的频率？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Bu, Ge briefed us. You're validating a new frequency with the Cardiograph.

dialogText.cn: 对，庄天师调派了许多天师学徒过来，协助我完成<@qu.key>循声扫描</>和样本采集。
dialogText.en: Yes. Tianshi Zhuang assigned plenty of disciples to help me with <@qu.key>audio scans</> and sample gathering.

dialogText.cn: 不同事物的声音频率差异较大，想提高心音仪输出结果的准确性，我们得缩小样本的范围。
dialogText.en: Different things have very different audio frequencies. To improve Cardiograph output accuracy, we must narrow the sample scope.

dialogText.cn: 要是能找到<@qu.key>最合适</>的声音样本，一劳永逸地让巨兽心脏稳定运行下去就好了。
dialogText.en: If only we could find the <@qu.key>perfect</> audio sample, and keep the Feranmut Heart running stably in perpetuity.

dialogText.cn: 唉，如果真有一劳永逸的方法就好了，当年宏科院定下的标准……已经不能用了。
dialogText.en: Oh, I really hope for a permanent solution. The old HAS standards ... are no longer usable.

dialogText.cn: 眼下，参与过巨兽心脏设计的老前辈都不在这里，我无从交流经验，而那位点活了心脏的代理人也行踪不定……
dialogText.en: Right now, none of the mentors who designed the Feranmut Heart are here, so I've got no one to discuss it with. A proxy did activate the Heart but no one can get a hold of her...

dialogText.cn: 终末地也可以帮忙采集样本。卜天师，介意我们用协议技术来调整心音仪吗？
dialogText.en: Endfield can help with the sample collection. Tianshi Bu, mind if we use Techno-Protocol to adjust the Cardiograph?

dialogText.cn: 之前了解到这些仪器时，我就着手进行了相关研究，也许能再帮你屏蔽一些干扰数据。
dialogText.en: I did my own research when I learned about these instruments. Perhaps I can help you filter out the noise.

dialogText.cn: 那再好不过了！完成之后，你们也可以尝试在周边进行循声扫描来寻找目标。
dialogText.en: Music to my ears! Once you're done, try some audio scanning nearby to find the target.

dialogText.cn: 这是心音仪的循声终端。
dialogText.en: This is the audio scanner of the cardiograph.

dialogText.cn: 至于合适的地方……就定在<@qu.key>集成核心区域</>、<@qu.key>技术生产办公室</>和<@qu.key>天师桩阵列</>三处吧。
dialogText.en: Now for the best locations... Let's go for these three: the <@qu.key>Core AIC Area</>, the <@qu.key>Technological Production Office</>, and the <@qu.key>Tianshi Pillar Array</>.

dialogText.cn: 这三处是我通过推导计算后，确定最符合标准的地方，应该更容易采集到合适的声音样本……
