dialogText.en: My deductive algorithms came up with these locations. They're the closest to the standards and should be the easiest for collecting suitable audio samples...

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏运行时会有能量外溢，这种能量波动会与不同的声音频率产生共鸣。
dialogText.en: The Feranmut Heart dissipates energy while operational. Such energy fluctuations can resonate with different audio frequencies.

dialogText.cn: 心音仪能分析声音样本，输出一个特定的声音频率，从而对巨兽心脏的能量波动施加良性影响。
dialogText.en: Audio samples are analyzed by the Cardiograph, which then outputs a special sound frequency that positively influences the Heart's energy dissipation.

dialogText.cn: 卜天师，声音频率的研究进行得怎么样了？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Bu, how's your audio frequency research going?

dialogText.cn: 心音仪已经输出了一组理论可行的频率，刚刚交给葛天师验证了。
dialogText.en: The Cardiograph generated a set of theoretically feasible frequencies. I just submitted them to Tianshi Ge for validation.

dialogText.cn: 这么快……
dialogText.en: That was really quick...

dialogText.cn: 科研上遇到瓶颈时，我都会找个地方喝杯茶，放松下来后总会有灵感的。
dialogText.en: Whenever I hit a scientific bottleneck, I'd just find a nice place for tea. Inspirations tend to hit me when I'm relaxed.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们也可以尝一尝武陵的新茶。
dialogText.en: Endmin, your team should try the new blends of Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 卜天师，是验证出了问题吗？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Bu, is there a problem with validation?
Yes...

dialogText.cn: 葛天师验证过了，我提供的那组固定声音频率的确让巨兽心脏稳定地进行能量外溢了。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Ge tested it. The fixed audio frequency I gave did keep the Feranmut Heart energy dissipation stable.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏确实运行了一段时间，但十分钟后便开始出现能量外溢异常……
dialogText.en: The Heart did run for a while, but we got anomalous energy dissipation after ten minutes...

dialogText.cn: 可问题究竟出在哪儿呢？
dialogText.en: Where exactly is the problem?

dialogText.cn: 卜天师，怎么了？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Bu, you alright?

dialogText.cn: 雨水……雨声？
dialogText.en: Rain ... the splattering rain?

dialogText.cn: 我小时候很喜欢雨声，它时强时弱，随云而动，变化无穷。
dialogText.en: I loved the sound of rain when I was a child. It moves with the clouds, and can be anything from soft to loud.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏真正需要的也许不是一个固定频率，而是一组包含<@qu.key>变化</>的频率……？
dialogText.en: Perhaps the Feranmut Heart doesn't need a fixed frequency. What about a bundle of <@qu.key>changing</> frequencies...?

dialogText.cn: 我需要马上验证！
dialogText.en: I must validate this right now!

dialogText.cn: 只要能找到某种更具持续性的变化……
dialogText.en: I just need to find something that keeps changing...

dialogText.cn: 连绵的雨滴构成了最具持续性的变化，我相信这份样本就是我们一直在找的答案。
dialogText.en: The constant rainfall provided an extended duration of constant changes. This, I believe, is the sample we've been looking for.

dialogText.cn: 我有把握这次一定能成。
dialogText.en: I am confident that this will work.

dialogText.cn: 也许维持巨兽心脏运行的关键不该是那个恒定不变的“一”。
dialogText.en: Perhaps the key to sustaining the Feranmut Heart isn't the "one" unchanging element.

dialogText.cn: 武陵地区一直在变化，这座城市也一直在变化……
dialogText.en: The region of Wuling is always changing. The same can be said of the city...

dialogText.cn: 唔，总觉得还是有点玄而又玄……
dialogText.en: Yeeeah... that's a lot of very hard science...

dialogText.cn: 虽然有些意外，但不妨尝试一下，看看最后的结果如何。
dialogText.en: Quite unexpected, but worth a try. I'm curious to see the result.

dialogText.cn: 意外也是研究工作的一环。
dialogText.en: The unexpected is also a part of scientific work.

dialogText.cn: 请等待我的好消息吧。
dialogText.en: Wait for the good news.

dialogText.cn: 心音仪也该拥有随着变化调整能量外溢强度的能力，这样巨兽心脏才能长久稳定运行。
dialogText.en: The Cardiograph should be capable of dynamic modulation of energy dissipation amplitudes. This is the only way to sustain Feranmut Heart operations.

dialogText.cn: 循声终端有反应了！
dialogText.en: The audio scanner is responding!

dialogText.cn: 我收到你们刚刚采集的声音样本了，像微风拂过稻田，太阳落在心间……
dialogText.en: I received the audio sample you collected. It feels like a breeze brushing against fields of rice, like the heartfelt warmth of sunshine...

dialogText.cn: 这些声音样本……没想到机器中也有迸发的热情。
dialogText.en: These audio samples... I did not expect machines to emit bursts of passion.

dialogText.cn: 就像工业的引擎在合奏，有一种稳定的力量。
dialogText.en: A symphony of industrial engines, a stabilizing force that sings.

dialogText.cn: 这段很特别，不像声音样本，倒像一幅画：轻的风，绿的息壤，蓝到浓郁的天空。
dialogText.en: This is unlike any audio sample. Feels more like a painting of light winds, green Xiranite, and a sky so saturated with blue.

dialogText.cn: 让我想起了工作之余，闲暇时分，独自喝茶的夏日午后……有生命的充实感。
dialogText.en: A reminder of recess, of idle time, of tea time for myself on a summer afternoon... It vibes with wholesome life.

dialogText.cn: 我还是个学徒时，一直有个浪漫的想象——声音的频率中或许藏着城市的悲欢。
dialogText.en: I was quite a romantic during my disciple days, and had this fantasy — The audio frequency may carry the city's joys and sorrows.

dialogText.cn: 等毕业后自己开始主导研究，才发现并没有什么悲欢，只有数不尽的计算与推导……
dialogText.en: After graduating and starting my own projects, I realized there was neither joy nor sorrow. Reality is just an endless bunch of algorithms and deductions...

dialogText.cn: 小陈？我刚还想着你什么时候过来，我这里这么多好东西，你不来可不行！
dialogText.en: Chen? Took you some time to show up, huh? I've got so many good things here, you really can't afford to miss them!

dialogText.cn: 阿庄那边的公务忙完了？
dialogText.en: Done with your duties over at Fangyi's?

dialogText.cn: 当然，晓雾姐！我们一忙完就过来了。
dialogText.en: Yup! We came straight over as soon as we finished!

dialogText.cn: 你们来得正好！刚好锻造了一批装备，小陈，要试试“那个”吗？
dialogText.en: Then you came at the perfect time! I just finished forging a batch. Chen, want to try that thing?

dialogText.cn: 欸，晓雾姐，你真的完成“那个”了？
dialogText.en: Hmm? You actually finished that thing?

dialogText.cn: 抱歉抱歉，在说<@qu.key>装备精锻</>的事。
dialogText.en: Haha, my apologies. We're talking about <@qu.key>gear artificing</>.

dialogText.cn: 以前选剑局跟终末地工业在武器装备研发方面有些合作，做了一些尝试。
dialogText.en: Back when Hongshan Swordmancers and Endfield Industries were working together on weapons research, we tried a few things.

dialogText.cn: 我自己从中受到启发，总结出了一种装备的改装方法。目前还在验证阶段，只能用在品质最高的装备上。
dialogText.en: I was inspired and came up with my own method for modifying gear. It's still in the testing phase and only works on top-quality gear.

dialogText.cn: 虽然不具备推广条件，但供个人使用绰绰有余。
dialogText.en: It's not ready for large-scale use yet, but it works perfectly for personal gear customization.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，晓雾姐你看，我们终末地危机处理小组不是刚好符合这个条件嘛！
dialogText.en: Ohhhh, I think the Endfield Crisis Team could really benefit from this! Alright, go ahead and enlighten us!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，你这丫头，刚回来就打起我这儿的主意了！
dialogText.en: *Chuckle* Aren't you the sneaky one! Just got back and already eyeing my stuff!

dialogText.cn: 正好我这儿给你们准备了<@qu.key>实验用的样品</>，我来直接展示一下。
dialogText.en: Lucky for you, I prepared some <@qu.key>test samples</>. I'll show you right now.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢晓雾姐！
dialogText.en: Hehe, thank you, Xiaowu!

dialogText.cn: 当然，阿庄刚才还和我说，终末地派到武陵的危机处理小组成员会来找我。
dialogText.en: Mmm-hmm. Fangyi mentioned that the Endfield Crisis Team would be here any moment.

dialogText.cn: 这不，消息刚收到没多久，你们就来了……
dialogText.en: Not long after I read her message, you showed up...

dialogText.cn: 总之，选好<@qu.key>要精锻的装备</>，再挑选另一件<@qu.key>同类装备当作素材</>，加入<@qu.key>精锻助剂</>，然后就可以等待结果了。
dialogText.en: Anyway, select the <@qu.key>gear for artifice</>, choose another <@qu.key>piece of the same type as material</>, add <@qu.key>Artificing Catalyst</>, and then just wait.

dialogText.cn: 百闻不如一见，我们直接试试吧。
dialogText.en: It's actually not that complicated. Give it a shot.

dialogText.cn: 欸，小陈！
dialogText.en: Hey, Chen!

dialogText.cn: 晓雾姐，好久不见！
dialogText.en: Xiaowu! It's been a while!

dialogText.cn: 好久不见！
dialogText.en: Yeah, it's been a while!

dialogText.cn: 话说回来，小陈你这丫头！之前在路边叫你，结果你一溜烟就跑没影了！
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, Chen, I called your name back on the road, and you vanished like smoke!

dialogText.cn: 啊？什么时候，我都没注意到……
dialogText.en: When was that? I didn't even hear a thing...

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，我们当时正急着去找庄天师。不好意思晓雾姐……
dialogText.en: Hehe, oops. Sorry, Xiaowu, we were in a hurry to find Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 唉，阿庄又和我抢人……算了算了，你们来得正好！刚好锻造了一批装备，小陈，要试试“那个”吗？
dialogText.en: Aww, Fangyi's trying to steal people from me again... Ah, it's fine. Anyway, you came at the perfect time! I just finished forging a batch. Chen, want to try that thing?

dialogText.cn: 欸，晓雾姐，你真的完成“那个”了？
dialogText.en: Hmm? You actually finished that thing?

dialogText.cn: 抱歉抱歉，在说<@qu.key>装备精锻</>的事。
dialogText.en: Haha, my apologies. We're talking about <@qu.key>gear artificing</>.

dialogText.cn: 以前选剑局跟终末地工业在武器装备研发方面有些合作，做了一些尝试。
dialogText.en: Back when Hongshan Swordmancers and Endfield Industries were working together on weapons research, we did a couple of experiments.

dialogText.cn: 我自己从中受到启发，总结出了一种装备的改装方法。目前还在验证阶段，只能用在品质最高的装备上。
dialogText.en: I was inspired and came up with my own method for modifying gear. It's still in the testing phase and only works on top-quality gear.

dialogText.cn: 虽然不具备推广条件，但供个人使用绰绰有余。
dialogText.en: It's not ready for large-scale use yet, but it works perfectly for personal gear customization.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，晓雾姐你看，我们终末地危机处理小组不是刚好符合这个条件嘛。
dialogText.en: Ohhhh, I think the Endfield Crisis Team could really benefit from this! Alright, go ahead and enlighten us!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，你这丫头，刚回来就打起我这儿的主意了！
dialogText.en: *Chuckle* Aren't you the sneaky one! Just got back and already eyeing my stuff!

dialogText.cn: 正好我这儿给你们准备了<@qu.key>实验用的样品</>，我来直接展示一下。
dialogText.en: Lucky for you, I prepared some <@qu.key>test samples</>. I'll show you right now.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢晓雾姐！
dialogText.en: Hehe, thank you, Xiaowu!

dialogText.cn: 当然，阿庄刚才还和我说，终末地派到武陵的危机处理小组成员会来找我。
dialogText.en: Mmm-hmm. Fangyi mentioned that the Endfield Crisis Team would be here any moment.

dialogText.cn: 这不，消息刚收到没多久，你们就来了……
dialogText.en: Not long after I read her message, you showed up...

dialogText.cn: 总之，选好<@qu.key>要精锻的装备</>，再挑选另一件<@qu.key>同类装备当作素材</>，加入<@qu.key>精锻助剂</>，然后就可以等待结果了。
dialogText.en: Anyway, select the <@qu.key>gear for artifice</>, choose another <@qu.key>piece of the same type as material</>, add <@qu.key>Artificing Catalyst</>, and then just wait.

dialogText.cn: 百闻不如一见，我们直接试试吧。
dialogText.en: It's actually not that complicated. Give it a shot.

dialogText.cn: 不错嘛管理员，上手这么快。
dialogText.en: Not bad, Endmin! You're a quick learner.

dialogText.cn: 这品质，要是没有亲眼看见，我可不信这是第一次精锻的装备！
dialogText.en: If I hadn't seen it myself, I wouldn't believe it's your first time artificing gear!

dialogText.cn: 唉，不像我那几个学生，要精锻好几次才能有一件看上去还行的。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Unlike my other students ... most of them have to make multiple artificing attempts before they could arrive at anything even mildly satisfactory.

dialogText.cn: 如果没有一下就完成精锻强化的话也没事，滴水成河嘛，只要尝试得够多，就一定能完成。
dialogText.en: It's alright if it doesn't work on your first try. Every drop of rain shall merge into a river. Try and try again till completion comes your way.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，学会装备精锻以后就不愁没有趁手的装备了！
dialogText.en: Hehe, with gear artificing under our belts, we'll never be short on good gear again!

dialogText.cn: 哎，说起装备，管理员，那个项目怎么样了？
dialogText.en: Ah, speaking of gear... Endmin, how's that project going?

dialogText.cn: 没事没事，不是什么大事，不用放心上。等项目完成后，终末地的干员肯定会来找你汇报的。
dialogText.en: Oh, no biggie. It's nothing important. Once the project is done, I'm sure operators at Endfield will report to you.

dialogText.cn: 你们来得这么匆忙，想必还有公务在身，我就不留你们了。
dialogText.en: You must still have business to attend to, so I won't keep you.

dialogText.cn: 等后面有空了记得来找我，我这儿可还有不少好东西呢。
dialogText.en: Come find me when you're free. I've got plenty more good stuff here.

dialogText.cn: 你来啦，是要精锻装备吗？
dialogText.en: Hey! Are you here for gear artificing?

dialogText.cn: 好吧，随时欢迎过来找我，我这儿可有不少好东西呢。
dialogText.en: No problem. Come find me when you're free. I've got plenty more good stuff here.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎回来，管理员。新的扩容演算芯片已经准备完毕，我们现在就可以开始。
dialogText.en: Welcome back, Endmin. The new Algorithm Expansion Chip is fully prepared. We can start immediately.

dialogText.cn: 本次升级之后，帝江号的动力输出和主控系统兼容性都会增强，我们可以建造更多的舱室。
dialogText.en: This upgrade will improve power output as well as system mainframe compatibility. It will let us construct additional cabins.

dialogText.cn: 另外，我们的<@qu.key>培养舱</>也可以进一步升级，<@qu.key>会客室</>也将开放更多功能。
dialogText.en: We can also upgrade our <@qu.key>Growth Chamber</>. The <@qu.key>Reception Room</> will be getting more features as well.

dialogText.cn: 帝江号永远都会是您可靠的助力，很高兴我能为唤醒它提供支持。
dialogText.en: Dijiang shall always serve as your capable support. I am pleased to be the one waking it to serve its functions.

dialogText.cn: 那么，和上次一样。请前往<@qu.key>总控中枢</>安装芯片，完成本次升级。
dialogText.en: So, as before, please proceed to the <@qu.key>Control Nexus</>, install the chip, and complete this upgrade.

dialogText.cn: 数据更新已确认，新增区域接管成功。
dialogText.en: Data upgrade verified. New areas have been connected to the administrative system.

dialogText.cn: 已经与您同步了基建区扩展的舱室位置。我们可以在那里完成后续工作。
dialogText.en: I have synced the locations of Working Sector cabins that can be expanded. We can now proceed to the said locations to continue our work.

dialogText.cn: 本次升级增加了可用<@qu.key>舱室</>的数量，您可以使用资源建造更多合适的舱室。
dialogText.en: This upgrade has added more <@qu.key>functional cabins</>. You can use resources to construct cabins that fit your needs.

dialogText.cn: 另外，如刚才所说，我们可以对这些舱室进行<@qu.key>进一步升级</>。
dialogText.en: And in accordance to what I mentioned earlier, we can also <@qu.key>further upgrade</> these cabins.

dialogText.cn: 至于如何分配建造资源，以及生产的优先级，就交给您来判断了。
dialogText.en: As for the priorities of the construction sequence and allocation of construction resources, I shall leave those to your capable decision.

dialogText.cn: 舱室建造工作完成之后，请您前往<@qu.key>会客室</>一趟。我会在那里向您介绍更多信息。
dialogText.en: Once the cabin is constructed, please head to the <@qu.key>Reception Room</>. I shall provide you with more information at that location.

dialogText.cn: 新舱室已上线，动力负载状况稳定。或许我们不久之后就能修复更多的设施。
dialogText.en: New cabin online. Drivetrain load status is stable. Perhaps we will soon be able to repair other facilities.

dialogText.cn: 帝江号的各个区域均能独立连接总控中枢，因此我们才会在飞船运行时隔离或修理各区域。
dialogText.en: Every sector of Dijiang is independently connected to the Control Nexus. This allows us to isolate or repair various sectors while keeping the vessel operational.

dialogText.cn: 在您建造新舱室的同时，会客室的情报区也已经恢复了功能。
dialogText.en: While you were constructing the new cabin, the Reception Room Intel Section has restored its functions.

dialogText.cn: 是的，会客室与其他新建造或升级的舱室都需要更多干员进驻。
dialogText.en: Yes. Additional operator assignments are required for the Reception Room as well as other new or upgraded cabins.

dialogText.cn: 请留意调整干员分配方案，以免出现空缺情况。
dialogText.en: Please pay attention to operator assignments and avoid the transgression of idleness.

dialogText.cn: 情报区整合了S.O.W.从各种渠道收集的线索，您可以将其汇总，分享给其他合作者。
dialogText.en: The Intel Section has synthesized clues gathered by the SOW from multiple channels. You may compile them, and even share them with your partners.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>情报交流</>可以带来诸多益处，对我们的物资筹集工作提供帮助。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Clue Exchange</> offers significant benefits and is conducive towards our supplies gathering operations.

dialogText.cn: 那么，这里的进驻安排就交给您了。愿知识庇护您的道路。
dialogText.en: Good. I shall leave the arrangements and assignments to your discretion. May Veritas watch over thy path.

dialogText.cn: 没问题，我会帮助您将帝江号上的一切调整到最佳的状态。
dialogText.en: My pleasure. I shall assist you and optimize every onboard routines of Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 那么，这里的进驻安排就交给您了。愿知识庇护您的道路。
dialogText.en: Good. I shall leave the arrangements and assignments to your discretion. May Veritas watch over thy path.

dialogText.cn: 得、得救了……
dialogText.en: I- I'm safe now...

dialogText.cn: 是……管理员！感谢你的出手相救！叫我邦妮就好。
dialogText.en: You're ... the Endministrator! Thank you for saving me. Please, just call me Bonnie.

dialogText.cn: 我正在撤离的时候，发现这帮裂地者正在破坏咱们终末地快送的仓储节点！我绝不允许！
dialogText.en: I was evacuating when I spotted these Landbreakers attacking our Endfield Express depot node! I couldn't just stand by and let that happen!

dialogText.cn: 虽然我只是一名普通干员啦，嘿嘿。幸好有你。
dialogText.en: Though I'm just a regular operator, heh. Good thing you were here!

dialogText.cn: 是终末地快送在各地区设立的物资仓库，作为Delta型机器人紧急物资运输网络的中转站！
dialogText.en: They're supply warehouses set up by Endfield Express across various regions, serving as relay stations for the Delta Bot emergency logistics network!

dialogText.cn: 不过，虽然没被破坏，但是仓储节点启动了安全模式，重新锁定了。我并没有那么高的权限解锁它。
dialogText.en: But even though it wasn't damaged, the depot node activated its safety protocols and relocked itself. I don't have the authority to override the lockdown.

dialogText.cn: 以管理员的权限，一定可以重新解锁的！
dialogText.en: With your authority, you should definitely be able to reactivate it!

dialogText.cn: 对了，管理员，我听说，按照先前运输网络的迭代计划，现在可以将仓储节点接入集成工业系统了。
dialogText.en: By the way... I've heard that according to the earlier iteration plan for the transport network, the depot node can now be integrated into the AIC.

dialogText.cn: 我在这里等你的好消息！
dialogText.en: I'll be waiting for your good news!

dialogText.cn: 已经解锁仓储节点了？不愧是管理员！
dialogText.en: You've already unlocked the depot node? As expected of the Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 系统显示这个节点已经正式接入集成工业系统了！你应该发现本地库存上限也提升了吧！
dialogText.en: The system shows this node is now fully integrated into the AIC! You must have noticed the local depot capacity has been upgraded as well!

dialogText.cn: 接下来就可以调度Delta型机器人将节点里的紧急物资送给需要的人了！
dialogText.en: Now we can dispatch Delta Bots to deliver emergency supplies from this node to those in need!

dialogText.cn: 如果我记得没错的话，指令应该是这样……咦？怎么会这样？
dialogText.en: If I remember correctly, the command should be... Huh? Why is this happening?

dialogText.cn: 调度失败……可能是许多Delta型机器人由于超域灾害的影响失联了……
dialogText.en: Dispatch failed... It's likely because many Delta Bots have gone offline due to the Ætherside disaster...

dialogText.cn: 这种情况下只能启动人力运输了，但……
dialogText.en: In that case, we'll have to initiate manual transport, but...

dialogText.cn: 紧急物资运输路线大多凶险，依照规定，像我这样没有接受过特种技术部门训练的普通干员不能承担运送工作……
dialogText.en: Most emergency supply routes are highly dangerous. According to regulations, regular operators like me who haven't received specialized training from the Specialist Tech Division aren't authorized to handle deliveries...

dialogText.cn: 对呀！是管理员的话一定可以……
dialogText.en: That's right! You can definitely do it. You're the Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 请先提升仓储节点的操作等级吧，它会对你开放有关货物装箱、调度申请和运送的高级操作权限。
dialogText.en: Please prioritize elevating the operations level of the depot node. Doing so will grant you advanced authority for packing goods, redistribution bids, and logistics coordination.

dialogText.cn: 终末地快送，以你为荣！
dialogText.en: Endfield Express — your success, we profess!

dialogText.cn: 没想你这么快就将操作等级提升了，太好了！
dialogText.en: I didn't expect you to increase the operations level so quickly. That's fantastic!

dialogText.cn: 这批物资可以更快地送到有需要的人手里了！
dialogText.en: These supplies can reach those in need even faster now!

dialogText.cn: 事不宜迟，赶紧进行货物装箱、调度申请和运送吧。
dialogText.en: No time to waste. Let's proceed with packing goods, redistribution bids, and initiate delivery!

dialogText.cn: 终末地快送，以你为荣！
dialogText.en: Endfield Express — your success, we profess!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你为终末地快送作出的贡献，管理员。
dialogText.en: Thank you for all you've done for Endfield Express, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我也会以你为榜样，继续努力的！
dialogText.en: I'll keep striving to follow your example!

dialogText.cn: 无误。
dialogText.en: Flawless.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？辛苦管理员跑一趟了，这些货物没问题。
dialogText.en: Endmin? Thanks for making the trip! These goods look good to go.

dialogText.cn: 仓储节点就像是桥梁一样，将整个四号谷地再次凝聚成了一个整体。谢谢你，管理员。
dialogText.en: This depot node's like a bridge connecting the entire Valley IV as one cohesive unit. Thanks, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 又见面了，管理员，你每次送的货物都能帮到我们。
dialogText.en: Good to see you again, Endmin. Your deliveries always come through for us.

dialogText.cn: 先放这里就好，等我忙完手头的活就来入库。我清点下，嗯，数量和种类没问题。辛苦了。
dialogText.en: Just set it here. I'll log it in once I finish what I'm working on. Let me check... Yep, quantities and categories all correct. Thank you so much!

dialogText.cn: 货物无误，感谢……你是……管理员？
dialogText.en: Goods confirmed... Thanks- wait, are you ... the Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 从小就听长辈提起你的名字，前段时间听说你在超域试验场的事迹，还想着能不能见到，这下真的见到本人了！
dialogText.en: I've heard your name since I was a kid from the elders! When I caught wind of your exploits at the Æther Test Site recently, I wondered if I'd ever get to meet you... And now here you are in the flesh!

dialogText.cn: 那管理员，谢谢你亲自送货过来，下次再见啦。
dialogText.en: Well then, thanks for delivering in person, Endmin! See you next time.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！又见到你了，我刚还在想这次还会不会是你送货，能再见到你真是太好了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! It's you again! I was just wondering if you'd be making this delivery. So glad to see you once more!

dialogText.cn: 稍等，我清点下货物……嗯，一如既往的没问题！那管理员，期待下次再见啦！
dialogText.en: Let me check these goods real quick... Yep, flawless as always! Well then, looking forward to seeing you next time, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？您不是管理员吗？前段时间看到支援部队来了，我和其他几个工友也跟着一起上，那时候看到过您！
dialogText.en: Huh? Aren't you the Endministrator? I saw you with the support troops a while back. I joined the effort with some other workers and spotted you then!

dialogText.cn: 哦对了，稍等，我清点下……货物没问题！谢了，管理员，再见。
dialogText.en: Oh right, let me give it a check... They're all good! Thanks Endmin, see ya.

dialogText.cn: 您好，管理员。稍等，我清点下……货物没问题，再见啦。
dialogText.en: Hi, Endmin. Hold on, give me a second... Perfect! Catch you later.

dialogText.cn: 货物和订单一致，辛苦你送这一趟。
dialogText.en: The goods match the order perfectly. Appreciate you making this delivery.

dialogText.cn: 等等，怎么看你有点眼熟……欸，你不是管理员吗？怎么是你亲自送货。
dialogText.en: Wait, you look familiar... Hey, aren't you the Endministrator? Why are you delivering personally?

dialogText.cn: 无论是救了我们，还是送这些东西过来，谢谢你。
dialogText.en: Whether it's saving us or delivering these supplies, thank you.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……货物没问题，状态都不错。管理员，辛苦你把货物送过来。
dialogText.en: Well ... looks good to me, all in great condition. Appreciate you hauling this up here, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？阿庄那里的事情办完……
dialogText.en: Endmin? You all done with Fangyi's...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这些货物，你亲自送来的吗？货物没问题，太感谢了，管理员。
dialogText.en: Wait... You delivered these goods personally? Everything's in order. Thanks a ton, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？您来找我是有什么……
dialogText.en: Endmin? Anything I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 这是……居然是管理员你亲自送过来？货物没问题，只是没想到会是你亲自送来。那再见了。
dialogText.en: This is ... wait, you delivered this personally? The goods are fine, just never expected you'd be the delivery person. Well ... see you around.

dialogText.cn: 太感谢了管理员，又麻烦你亲自送货。嗯……货物没问题，放我这儿就好了，待会儿我叫白霜过来整理。
dialogText.en: Thanks so much, Endmin. And sorry to trouble you with personal delivery again. Well ... the goods are all correct, just leave them with me. I'll have Bai Shuang come organize them later.

dialogText.cn: 货物没问题。真没想到会是你亲自送过来，辛苦了，管理员。
dialogText.en: They're all good. Never imagined you would deliver personally. Thanks for your hard work, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 太好了，正等着这批货物做实验呢。谢啦管理员。
dialogText.en: Perfect, was just waiting on these supplies for my experiment. Thanks, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来了，观测站的清理工作进行得很顺利……
dialogText.en: You're here, Endmin. The observation post cleanup is going smoothly...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？太感谢了，麻烦管理员亲自送过来，货物没问题。
dialogText.en: Oh? Thank you so much for delivering this personally, Endmin. The goods are perfect.

dialogText.cn: 十分感谢，管理员。我正等着这批货物来修复观测站呢。我看看，货物没问题，辛苦了。
dialogText.en: Many thanks, Endmin. I was counting on these supplies to fix up the observation post. Let me check ... goods are perfect. Appreciate the hard work!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来得正好，我发现了控制模块失效的原因，就差……
dialogText.en: Perfect timing, Endmin! I've pinpointed why the control module failed, just waiting on...

dialogText.cn: 这些货物，谢谢你帮忙送过来，管理员。这批都是用来实验的材料，状态很完美，辛苦你了。
dialogText.en: Thanks for delivering these goods, Endmin. They're all experimental materials, and in perfect condition. Appreciate your hard work!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，重建工作很艰巨，各种矿物需求都很大……管理员，你每次送的物资都帮了我大忙，谢谢你。
dialogText.en: Yeah, reconstruction's no joke. The mineral demands are insane... Endmin, these supplies you keep delivering are a lifesaver. Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 又见面了，管理员。上次研究资料的事还没机会好好感谢你。
dialogText.en: Good to see you again, Endmin. Never properly thanked you for the research materials last time.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这不是我下单的货物吗，管理员……居然亲自送货？我看看……所有货物都在这里了，谢谢你！
dialogText.en: Wait. Isn't this the order I placed? The Endministrator ... making deliveries in person? Let me check... Yep, everything's here. Thank you!

dialogText.cn: 研究需要的材料差不多又用完了，幸好管理员你每次送的都很及时……嗯，所有货物都在这里，谢谢你！
dialogText.en: Research materials are running low again... Good thing your deliveries always arrive right on time. Yep, everything's accounted for. Thanks!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……每次您送来的货物都没问题，一如既往的可靠。
dialogText.en: Ah... Your deliveries are always flawless, reliable as ever.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，根据安全局物资管理规范，我的清点工作已经完成，那再见了。
dialogText.en: Per Security Bureau material management protocols, my inventory check is complete. Well then, goodbye Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 你好，管理员，我在等预订的货物。
dialogText.en: Hello Endmin. I'm waiting for some scheduled goods.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这些……和我的订单能对上，没想到是你亲自送货，谢谢你，医疗站里正缺这些东西。
dialogText.en: Huh? These ... match my order perfectly. Didn't expect you'd deliver personally. Thank you, the medical station's been running low on these.

dialogText.cn: 货物没问题，辛苦你了，管理员。要不是你每次送得都这么及时，医疗站里的物资早就见底了。
dialogText.en: The goods are perfect. Thanks for your hard work, Endmin. If it weren't for your always timely deliveries, the clinic would've run out of supplies long ago.

dialogText.cn: 那我先继续工作了，有需要的地方再找我就好。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'll get back to work. Talk to me any time if you need help.

dialogText.cn: 善。
dialogText.en: Good.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来得刚好。
dialogText.en: You're here, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 来替阿庄把这个拓展核心交给你们。
dialogText.en: Fangyi told me to give this expansion core to you.

dialogText.cn: 你们不是在附近部署了集成工业系统，帮寨民渡过难关吗？
dialogText.en: You deployed an AIC Factory nearby to help the Stockaders through tough times, right?

dialogText.cn: 材料研究所有些新的工业技术突破，应该也能帮上忙。
dialogText.en: The Institute of Materials Science made a few breakthroughs in industrial technology. They should be able to help.

dialogText.cn: 城外的情况还没完全好转，寨民的压力恐怕不小……放在以前，我们也不好直接出手帮忙。
dialogText.en: The city outskirts haven't recovered. Things aren't easy for the Stockaders... And we couldn't really intervene in the past either.

dialogText.cn: 幸好现在有你们在中间协调，阿庄也能松口气。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness we got you as our go-between. Fangyi can finally breathe easy.

dialogText.cn: 东西送到，我也该回去找她汇报了。
dialogText.en: Alright, signed and delivered. I gotta head back and report to Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，好。回见，管理员。
dialogText.en: Haha. I will. See you soon, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我有个好消息要告诉你们！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I have some great news!

dialogText.cn: 现在我已经正式成为净水节点的项目负责人啦！以后会继续做污水处理装置的研究！
dialogText.en: I've officially been appointed the project lead for the Purification Node! I'm going to keep researching water treatment systems from now on!

dialogText.cn: 最近我还发现了这个——
dialogText.en: And I recently discovered this —

dialogText.cn: 欸？这个是？
dialogText.en: Wait! What's this?

dialogText.cn: 对，他们在论文里提过一套可行性很强的污水处理提效方案！虽然已经有点过时了……但确实启发了我！
dialogText.en: Yes! They mentioned a highly feasible efficiency enhancement plan for water treatment in their thesis! It's a bit outdated now ... but it's really inspiring!

dialogText.cn: 按照这个方案改良的装置，不仅能处理污水，还能从中提取一些有价值的材料噢！
dialogText.en: A device modified according to this plan wouldn't just process polluted water, it could even extract some valuable materials from it!

dialogText.cn: 不过整体还处在摸索阶段……估计要再调整几次，改良工作才能全部完成。
dialogText.en: The whole thing is still in its experimental phase, though... I'll probably need a couple more rounds of adjustments before the modifications are fully complete.

dialogText.cn: 我已经在装置上做了一些新尝试。管理员，你等下可以试试看！
dialogText.en: I've already implemented some new modifications to the device. Endmin, you're welcome to come and test it out anytime!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，要试试净水节点的最新改良版本吗？
dialogText.en: Interested in trying the latest iteration of the Purification Node, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我又在净水节点改良版的基础上加了一些功能，现在应该能处理更多的污水啦！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I've added a feature upgrade to the improved Purification Node. It can now process even more sewage!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，那这回你要试用下吗？
dialogText.en: Heheh. Interested in trying in out?

dialogText.cn: 没关系，不用着急！这段时间我都在这附近，有需要直接来找我就好！
dialogText.en: Of course. No rush! I'll be here for a while. Come talk to me if you need anything!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，经过刻苦钻研，我终于把净水节点改良成目前为止最高效的版本啦！
dialogText.en: Endmin, after many hours of hard work, I've finally upgraded the Purification Node to the highest performance possible!

dialogText.cn: 当然可以啊！你要是想用，我现在就可以给你看最新的装置。
dialogText.en: Goes without saying! If you want, I can even show you the latest version right now.

dialogText.cn: 好的，那等你想尝试了再来，随时都行！
dialogText.en: Sure. Talk to me any time once you're ready for a trial run!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，研究总算告一段落了，不过你要是想看净水节点目前的情况也随时欢迎！
dialogText.en: Endmin, my research has finally reached its conclusion. Feel free to check on the Purification Node any time!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您这是来……嗯？这是我们订购的货物吗？嗯……货物没问题，谢谢您专程跑一趟。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here to...? Oh. Are these the goods we ordered? Hmm... They look great. Thanks for making the delivery.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……货物没问题，放在这儿，我来搬就好。辛苦您了，管理员，专程跑这么一趟。
dialogText.en: Hmm... The goods look alright. Just plop them here. I'll carry them from here. Really appreciate the delivery, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 您好，管理员。此次前来，可是有事务要处理？没想到是您亲自送来的……嗯，货物无误，不胜感激。
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endmin. Here for official business...? Oh, I didn't expect you to deliver the goods personally... Yes. Everything is accounted for. Thank you very much.

dialogText.cn: 货物无误，试验正好缺了这些东西，感激不尽。
dialogText.en: Checked and verified. These are just what we were missing for the test. Thanks a lot.

dialogText.cn: 嗨，管理员！你是来视察工作的吗？目前的净水效率又提高了哦。
dialogText.en: Hi, Endmin! Here to audit the work? We managed to improve water purification efficiency.

dialogText.cn: 欸？这些是你亲自送过来的吗！太感谢了！我看看啊……没问题！
dialogText.en: Oh? Did you actually deliver these yourself? Thank you so much! Let me see... Perfect!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，又见面啦。嘿嘿，辛苦啦，谢谢你送过来的货物，回见！
dialogText.en: We meet again, Endmin. Heheh, thanks so much for the delivery. Catch you later!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，您可算来了。我在这里等了好久呢。
dialogText.en: Ah, you're finally here! I've been waiting quite a while.

dialogText.cn: 您在说什么呢，我就是终末地干员呀！
dialogText.en: What do you mean? I am an Endfield operator!

dialogText.cn: 终末地工业物资调度员“幸运萝卜”，向您报到！
dialogText.en: Endfield Industries Stock Redistributor, Lucky Carrot, reporting for duty!

dialogText.cn: 形象工程是很重要的！紧急状况发生时，终末地有义务参与协调当地资源，帮助那些身处困境的人。
dialogText.en: Image-building matters! During emergencies, it's Endfield's duty to help coordinate local resources and assist those in need.

dialogText.cn: 比起板着一张脸去提要求，肯定还是笑着谈合作比较好嘛。
dialogText.en: It's always better to negotiate with a smile than to make demands with a stern face.

dialogText.cn: 不过，现在四号谷地还有很多地方都没恢复联系，好担心大家啊……
dialogText.en: But so many parts of Valley IV are still cut off. I'm really worried about everyone out there...

dialogText.cn: 由您授权后，我们会使用《环带公约》认可的<image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2><@qu.key>调度券</>进行物资调配，协调本地供需。
dialogText.en: Once you authorize it, we'll use Band Accord-approved <image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2><@qu.key>stock bills</> to manage supplies and balance local demand.

dialogText.cn: 另外，我也会替管理员留意一些合适的货物，您只要用<image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>调度券来兑换就好了。
dialogText.en: I'll also keep an eye out for suitable goods on your behalf, Endmin. Just use your <image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>stock bills to claim them.

dialogText.cn: 没错！等情况好转一些，这套系统还能做到更多事。
dialogText.en: Exactly! Once things stabilize, this system will be capable of much more.

dialogText.cn: 我在货物清单里准备了一些<@qu.key>小惊喜</>。如果您现在打算授权的话，就来和我确认吧！
dialogText.en: I've tucked a few <@qu.key>little surprises</> into the cargo manifest. If you're ready to authorize now, just confirm with me!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，要进行物资调度了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, interested in some stock redistribution?

dialogText.cn: 哦……好吧，我会继续在这里等您！
dialogText.en: Oh ... alright then. I'll be here!

dialogText.cn: 嗯嗯……购买“兰姆先生”的订单已确认。
dialogText.en: Mhm... Order confirmed for Mr. Rammu's purchase.

dialogText.cn: 您随时都能通过物资调度系统下达订单，是不是挺方便的？
dialogText.en: You can place orders anytime through the stock redistribution system. Pretty convenient, right?

dialogText.cn: 当然，这只是一种协调手段，不会阻碍正常的经济活动。
dialogText.en: Well, this is just a coordination tool. It won't disrupt normal economic activity.

dialogText.cn: 如果有人利用这点来囤货居奇，那就另当别论了……如果发现这种情况，请您务必告诉我哦！
dialogText.en: If anyone tries to exploit this to hoard and manipulate prices, that's another matter entirely... If you see it happening, please be sure to tell me!

dialogText.cn: 啊，还有，您可以投入更多<image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>调度券，<@qu.key>升级</>这片地区的物资调度系统。
dialogText.en: Ah, also, you can invest more <image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>stock bills to <@qu.key>upgrade</> the stock redistribution system in this area.

dialogText.cn: 这样一来，我就可以给您提供更多种类的货物了。请留意，我们在四号谷地只能使用<image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2><@qu.key>谷地调度券</>哦。
dialogText.en: That way, I can offer you a wider variety of goods. Just remember, here in Valley IV, we only use <image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2><@qu.key>Valley Stock Bills</>.

dialogText.cn: 没错，不过那就要花更多时间来给您解释了。
dialogText.en: That's right, but that would take more time to explain.

dialogText.cn: 如果感兴趣的话，欢迎您随时来找我！
dialogText.en: If you're interested, feel free to come find me anytime!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这片区域也可以进行物资调度了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, stock redistribution is now available in this area too.

dialogText.cn: 不过……您还没有给我升级相关的权限。
dialogText.en: But ... you haven't granted me authorization yet.

dialogText.cn: 如果您想要恢复这里的物资调度工作，我们可以先回<@qu.key>枢纽区基地</>做好升级授权。
dialogText.en: If you want to restore stock redistribution here, we should head back to <@qu.key>the Hub base</> first to handle the upgrade authorization.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我已经和附近的联系人恢复联络了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I've reestablished contact with nearby affiliates.

dialogText.cn: 如果您想要恢复这里的物资调度工作，我们现在就可以开始。
dialogText.en: If you want to restore stock redistribution here, we can begin right now.

dialogText.cn: 如果您想要恢复这里的物资调度工作，我们可以先回<@qu.key>枢纽区基地</>做好升级授权。
dialogText.en: If you want to restore stock redistribution here, we should head back to <@qu.key>the Hub base</> first to handle the upgrade authorization.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，果然在这里也见到您啦！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I knew I'd find you here too!

dialogText.cn: 根据您的权限，本地的物资调度系统也已经<@qu.key>可以启用</>了。
dialogText.en: Based on your authorization, the local stock redistribution system is now <@qu.key>ready for activation</>.

dialogText.cn: 如果您想要在这里开展相关工作，我们现在就可以开始。
dialogText.en: If you'd like to begin operations here, we can start right away.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，要进行物资调度吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, interested in some stock redistribution?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，果然在这里也见到您啦！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I knew I'd find you here too!

dialogText.cn: 如果您想要恢复这里的物资调度工作，我们需要先做好系统的<@qu.key>升级授权</>。
dialogText.en: If you want to restore stock redistribution here, we'll need to complete the system <@qu.key>upgrade authorization</> first.

dialogText.cn: 还有更多小技巧没教给您呢，我们一步一步来吧。
dialogText.en: There's still more to show you. Let's take it step by step.

dialogText.cn: 哦？看来您对物资调度的工作很感兴趣呢。
dialogText.en: Oh? You seem genuinely interested in stock redistribution.

dialogText.cn: 很好，很好……既然如此，我来和您详细说说怎么继续<@qu.key>增加供货种类</>吧。
dialogText.en: Excellent. In that case, let me walk you through how to further <@qu.key>diversify our supplies</>.

dialogText.cn: 需要！但<image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>调度券不是现在的关键啦。
dialogText.en: I do! But <image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>stock bills aren't the main issue right now.

dialogText.cn: 当然不会，不如说我们要做大好事呢。
dialogText.en: Of course not. If anything, we're about to do some real good.

dialogText.cn: 现在的情况很混乱，许多区域都还没能恢复联络。
dialogText.en: We've got a messy situation right now. Many areas still haven't reestablished contact.

dialogText.cn: 如果您能重新联系这些区域，再给我一些<image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>调度券，我就可以恢复更完整的物资网络，增加供货种类。
dialogText.en: If you can reconnect those areas and give me more <image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>stock bills, I'll restore the full supply network and diversify our inventory.

dialogText.cn: 另外，根据实地情况，我们管理的物资可以被分为“稳定需求物资”和“弹性需求物资”。
dialogText.en: Also, given conditions on the ground, our managed supplies fall into two categories: staple goods and elastic goods.

dialogText.cn: 因为供需情况经常变化，<@qu.key>“弹性需求物资”</>的价格一直都不稳定，这也是一个机会。
dialogText.en: Since supply and demand fluctuate constantly, <@qu.key>elastic goods</> always have volatile pricing — which also presents an opportunity.

dialogText.cn: 当然，不过还是以<image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>调度券的形式，任何收益最终都会回归到本地经济循环中。
dialogText.en: Naturally, though it'll still be handled through <image="WalletIcon/item_domain_tundra_coupon" scale=2>stock bills. Any proceeds will ultimately flow back into the local economy.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟，这是由《环带公约》认可的风险保障机制，急人所急，各取所需。
dialogText.en: After all, this is a risk-mitigation mechanism endorsed by the Band Accord. Meeting urgent needs where they arise, for mutual benefit.

dialogText.cn: 另外，我会留意地区的运作状态，给弹性需求物资设置交易次数限额，避免产生过大的影响。
dialogText.en: I'll also monitor regional operations and set transaction limits on elastic goods to prevent excessive impact.

dialogText.cn: 重启各地联系，升级调度系统，扩大调度范围，再留心弹性需求物资的<@qu.key>行情</>——就是这样。
dialogText.en: Reconnect the areas, upgrade the stock redistribution system, expand its reach, and keep an eye on elastic <@qu.key>market trends</>. That's the plan.

dialogText.cn: 将来我们还能在更多地区进行物资调度。现在，让我们先在四号谷地一起加油吧！
dialogText.en: Someday we'll manage supplies across even more areas. For now, let's give it our all here in Valley IV!

dialogText.cn: 想看看这里的情况？没问题，我这儿刚更新数据。
dialogText.en: Need a rundown on the local area? No problem. I just punched a few numbers into the system.

dialogText.cn: 罐子、药瓶、水壶、面包……
dialogText.en: Cans, medicine bottles, water canteens, bread...

dialogText.cn: 发生什么事了，阿吉？
dialogText.en: What happened here, Ginny?

dialogText.cn: 外面、外面找到好多人！
dialogText.en: We found a lot of people! From all over the place!

dialogText.cn: 流血，生病……丹尼尔叔叔让我拿东西！
dialogText.en: They are bleeding or sick... Uncle Daniel told me to grab stuff!

dialogText.cn: 优先处理紧急情况。阿吉，把东西分我们一些，我们分头去帮忙吧。
dialogText.en: Let's handle the emergency quick, Ginny. Be a good helper and hand us some of your stuff — we'll split the work, okay?

dialogText.cn: 天哪，太谢谢了。
dialogText.en: Thank Talos, really appreciate this.

dialogText.cn: 我们的人在附近摸索情况，结果发现了这些可怜人。
dialogText.en: We were scouting the local environment and discovered these poor souls.

dialogText.cn: 他们刚从裂地者那儿逃出来，有几个伤得太重，还没到这里就……唉，我再打点水来。
dialogText.en: They just escaped the damn Landbreakers... Some of them were badly hurt and didn't make it here... Ugh. I need to get more water for the rest.

dialogText.cn: 总算有人来帮忙了，东西还有多少？
dialogText.en: We're finally getting some help. How are the stockpiles looking?

dialogText.cn: 急救包可能不顶用了。镇痛剂、抗生素，再给我拿点！
dialogText.en: The first-aid kits won't be enough. Get me more sedatives and antibiotics!

dialogText.cn: 见鬼，这么下去会没救的。这里也没人懂医疗法术啊！
dialogText.en: Damnation. People are gonna die on our hands. None of us knows any healing Arts!

dialogText.cn: 行行行，我给我给，再这么下去我也得躺下了。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Fine. You can have it. This old boy's gonna starve and die soon.

dialogText.cn: 可恶，为什么非得遭这罪……
dialogText.en: Blasted blightery. Why do we have to go through this...

dialogText.cn: 阿杜！把东西拿出来，我看见你往口袋里塞了！
dialogText.en: Dewey! I saw that! Take that thing out of your pocket!

dialogText.cn: 等等，不是药，我就留一口吃的……
dialogText.en: Hey, I didn't steal no meds... Just wanted to save a bite for myself...

dialogText.cn: 那也不可以，这是要给伤员的！
dialogText.en: You can't steal food either! We're saving it for the injured!

dialogText.cn: 你们能再匀我几份吗？我这儿全用光了！
dialogText.en: Can you give me a few of those supplies? I'm already out!

dialogText.cn: 不光急救用品，食物和其他物资也完全不够……这里只是仓促建立的据点，各种准备还很不足。
dialogText.en: Not just the first-aid supplies. This shelter also lacks sufficient food and other materials... It's hastily built and isn't really prepared to handle situations like this.

dialogText.cn: 总不能就这么看着吧！我们不能用集成工业系统再做一些吗？
dialogText.en: But we can't just stand around and do nothing! Maybe the AIC Factory can help?

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统能生产的品类暂时还有限。但现在什么都缺，临时改建产线也满足不了所有需求。
dialogText.en: The current product range of the AIC Factory is limited, and we're facing shortages across the board. Even if we retrofit the production lines now, it still won't meet all the demand.

dialogText.cn: 伤脑筋……嗯？你们有看到过<@qu.key>卡贾</>么？
dialogText.en: This is a real bummer... Hmm. Did anyone see <@qu.key>Karja</>?

dialogText.cn: 卡贾？我还以为你们见到了。有人说他刚刚去了裂地者聚集的地方，难道还没回来？
dialogText.en: Karja? I thought you've seen him already. I heard someone mention how he went to the Landbreakers' gathering place. Has he not returned?

dialogText.cn: 不行，我们得赶紧过去瞧瞧！
dialogText.en: Something's wrong. We gotta find him now!

dialogText.cn: 你没事吧？有没有什么地方受伤？
dialogText.en: Are you alright? Have you taken any injuries?

dialogText.cn: 差、差点就小命不保……他刚才痛得哼哼，我们一下子就暴露了。
dialogText.en: Gosh, I almost lost my life... This dude grunted in pain and gave us away.

dialogText.cn: 没错，又有新的伤员……唉，先送去暂居处再说吧。
dialogText.en: Yeah. We found more who got hurt... Ugh. Let's take them back to the camp first.

dialogText.cn: 这里确实不是说话的地方，我们先回去。
dialogText.en: I agree. This isn't a place to hold discussions. We should head back first.

dialogText.cn: 又来一个？！索斯，你冷静点！真要顾不过来了！
dialogText.en: Another mouth to feed?! Calm down already, Mr. Soth! We can barely feed ourselves!

dialogText.cn: 伤员说的你们没听到吗？还有更多人在外面！
dialogText.en: Didn't you hear what the injured said? There are more of them outside!

dialogText.cn: 裂地者还没全完蛋呢。回枢纽区的路那么远，你想在他们眼皮底下把人都送过去？
dialogText.en: Well, there are more of them Landbreakers outside as well! And there's a long road between us and the Hub Base. How are you supposed to send all these wounded people over there?

dialogText.cn: 那也不能见死不救！想想这里是怎么来的！
dialogText.en: That's no excuse to leave anyone out there to die! Take a look around! How do you think we managed to get all this?

dialogText.cn: 《环带公约》要求各方尽可能救助受灾群体，现在正是履行承诺的时候。
dialogText.en: The Band Accord requires all Accordatories to do whatever they can to relieve disaster victims. It's time to fulfill our obligations.

dialogText.cn: 只要坚持到枢纽区基地缓过来就行。在那之前，我们来想办法！
dialogText.en: Just need to keep this place running till the Hub Base recovers. Before that happens, we'll try to think of something.

dialogText.cn: 工人之家有位<@qu.key>罗曼</>先生以前管过物资。我帮肉联厂给四号谷地运过几次货，他应该还记得我。
dialogText.en: Hmm... When I worked at the meat-packing plant back in the days, I was trucking supplies to Valley IV. I know this Mr. <@qu.key>Roman</> at the Worker Dorms who did supply management. He should remember me.

dialogText.cn: 各位不怕路上的裂地者，能帮忙联系罗曼先生，调运一些最急需的物资来么？
dialogText.en: My friends, you're way stronger than those LBs out there. If possible, could you contact Mr. Roman for us? Ask him if he could allocate some supplies that we desperately need.

dialogText.cn: 工人之家，罗曼……好，交给我们吧！
dialogText.en: Mr. Roman in the Worker Dorms... Alrighty. Leave it to us!

dialogText.cn: 没有马克他们帮忙，谁都逃不回洞里。事情轮到别人头上就装聋作哑，你对得起马克吗？
dialogText.en: Mark and his crew were the ones who got us safely to the cave. These people need our help, and if we sit on our hands and pretend they don't exist, we'd be disgracing Mark's memory!
Ugh...

dialogText.cn: 少做好过不做。卡贾，去把我那份物资全拿出来，看看还有没有用得上的。
dialogText.en: Trying is at least better than doing nothing. Karja, bring out my supply stash. Maybe there's something useful in there.

dialogText.cn: ……真见鬼，豁出去了，也算我一个。
dialogText.en: ...Ugh, screw it. Count me in. Take my stash as well.

dialogText.cn: 就算能再凑点数出来，又够撑多久呢？
dialogText.en: But even if we squeeze something extra out of our stuff, how long is it gonna last?

dialogText.cn: 确实是有急事。抱歉，在这种时候还要麻烦你们。
dialogText.en: There is something rather urgent on our hands. Apologies, but we might need your assistance now.

dialogText.cn: 原来如此。想不到索斯竟然也在，他这运气真是……
dialogText.en: Ah. Didn't expect Soth to be there. The luck of that old knob...

dialogText.cn: 你亲自去啊？路上多危险，你说说要做些什么，我们替你弄呗。
dialogText.en: You're heading out there on your own? It's dangerous outside. Maybe just tell us what you need, and we'll get it for you.

dialogText.cn: 哪有这么方便的事。谷地附近的苦叶椒有四种，你知道哪种不能生吃么？
dialogText.en: It's not that simple. The Valley is home to four variants of tartpeppers. One of them can't be eaten raw. Know which one that is?

dialogText.cn: ……啊？原来有四种？
dialogText.en: ...Four variants? Really?

dialogText.cn: 我先张罗最紧要的物资。不过，他们暂时还得就地取材解决一部分问题。
dialogText.en: Yep, really. I'll go gather some of the most needed supplies, but that won't be enough for the folks at the outpost. They'll need to learn how to live off the land.

dialogText.cn: 刚来的那几年，工团的大伙儿也吃了不少苦头。我不是动植物专家，但“错题本”还挺厚。
dialogText.en: After arriving at the Valley, we UWST crew mates had it real tough for a few years. Now I'm no botanist, but I jotted down a rather thick book of all the mistakes we made.

dialogText.cn: 这事来得太急，我手上还缺一些<@qu.key>柑实</>和<@qu.key>荞花</>当样本，得辛苦各位帮忙找找。
dialogText.en: This assignment came out of the blue, so I'm still missing some <@qu.key>citromes</> and <@qu.key>buckflowers</> for my samples. I'm wondering if you could find some for me.

dialogText.cn: 哦，培育室还有本<@qu.key>应急经验笔记</>。如果方便，劳烦一并拿去他们那儿吧。
dialogText.en: Oh, and there should be a notebook in the cultivation chamber. It's got <@qu.key>notes on the handling of emergencies</>. Take the notes to them if you can.

dialogText.cn: 放心，笔记和样本都给你弄来。我这剑吹毛断发，保证裁枝裁得齐整。实在不行我就连根一起挖——
dialogText.en: Don't worry. We'll get your notes and your plant materials. My blade can even cut a strand of hair in half. So get ready for the prettiest harvest you've ever seen. And if that doesn't work, I'll just uproot the entire bush.

dialogText.cn: ……我们先去把东西找来吧。
dialogText.en: ...We will retrieve the items you requested.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？终末地的各位，跑得这么急，有什么事吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm, you seem to be in a rush, Endfielders. Anything I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 现在确实不好大量送货。这样吧，我准备准备，一会儿咱们就去找索斯。
dialogText.en: This isn't exactly the best time for bulk transport. I'll tell you what. Let me get the things set up and we'll go looking for Soth together.

dialogText.cn: 罗曼师傅，情况是这样的——
dialogText.en: Mr. Roman, let me explain the situation...

dialogText.cn: 罗曼先生，我们把笔记和样本都带来了。
dialogText.en: Mr. Roman, we're back with your notes and plant samples.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦各位，我正打算开始呢。
dialogText.en: Good job, everyone. I'm about to start.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，别那么生分！都凑近点，远了看不清。
dialogText.en: Hey, don't be shy. Come closer and gather 'round for a better look.

dialogText.cn: 常见作物在野外的种粒会更小一些，但也能吃。我们可以通过茎秆的形状识别它，这有条细线，看见没有？
dialogText.en: Wild variants of common crops tend to make smaller seeds, but these are still edible. They can be identified with the shape of the stalk. Can you see this fine line?

dialogText.cn: 看到了看到了……我们要开始种它了？
dialogText.en: Yeah, I saw it, mister... Are we gonna grow 'em?

dialogText.cn: 不，但是本地柑实的汁水配合草药处理一下，能用来冲洗伤口。这是以前灰医生们找到的方子。
dialogText.en: No. But you can juice the local citromes and mix them up with some herbs. It'll give you something capable of treating wounds. The Dusthairs were the ones who came up with this formula.

dialogText.cn: 注意，如果叶子背后有倒刺，那就是另一种毒草。吃了会喘不上气，千万要扔掉。
dialogText.en: Be careful, though. If you see leaves with barbs on the underside, it's a different toxic plant. Toss it away because eating it will cause shortness of breath.

dialogText.cn: 原来如此……
dialogText.en: So that's what happened...

dialogText.cn: 我知道罗曼先生很有经验，但还是没想到他懂这么多。
dialogText.en: I know Mr. Roman is experienced, but I didn't expect him to be so knowledgeable.

dialogText.cn: 刚认识罗曼那会儿，他还在要塞附近的中转站工作。
dialogText.en: Back when I met Roman, he was working at the transfer station near the fort.

dialogText.cn: 罗曼经常给车队塞自己做的粗粮饼，估计那也是他就地取材想的办法……一晃都这么多年了。
dialogText.en: Roman would often give the truckers his special bran cake. The man probably gathered whatever was around... How the years have gone by.

dialogText.cn: 索斯先生，如今四号谷地形势复杂，我们必须谨慎鉴别所有人的身份。以现在的条件，这需要一些时间。
dialogText.en: Mr. Soth, the situation in Valley IV is complicated. Everyone needs to be properly identified. This will take a while given our current circumstances.

dialogText.cn: 如果罗曼先生能为你的身份担保，就可以优先把你和伤情最重的几人送回基地。也许……
dialogText.en: If Mr. Roman is willing to vouch for you, we can send you and the most injured cases to the Hub Base. Perhaps...

dialogText.cn: 各位的好意我心领了。这里好不容易开始有转机，我肯定不能一走了之。
dialogText.en: Really appreciate your kindness. I really do. But we're starting to turn things around. There's no way I'll just pack up and leave.

dialogText.cn: 就算物资运输还很困难，有罗曼帮忙，我们总能应付。这里会继续寻找失散难民，帮大家一起渡过难关。
dialogText.en: Supplies transport might be an issue, but with Roman's help, our people will manage. We'll keep looking for the victims and the refugees. Together, we'll get through these hard times.

dialogText.cn: 终末地也会加快推进这里的建设。我们一定能在这里建立一个让人安心的家。
dialogText.en: Endfield will try to speed up our support in expanding this outpost. We can build a home where everyone feels safe.

dialogText.cn: 马克留下的接力棒，一定会被传下去……我会努力的。
dialogText.en: We must carry Mark's torch and pass it on... I'll do whatever I can to make that happen.

dialogText.cn: 在说什么悄悄话呢？大家要给伤员做营养粥和敷料了，不来帮忙吗？
dialogText.en: What are you whispering about? We're gonna make some nutritious porridge and dressing salves for the wounded. Come and give us a hand?

dialogText.cn: 好，我们这就去。
dialogText.en: Okay. We'll head right over.

dialogText.cn: 那个鞋印明明就是工团靴子踩出来的，假不了，我亲眼看见了！还有工团的包！
dialogText.en: Those footprints were definitely made by wooster boots! There's no faking that! I saw it myself! Along with wooster bags and satchels!

dialogText.cn: 听我的，我知道怎么摸过去。给我七天……不，三天干粮就行！
dialogText.en: Just trust me. I know how to sneak my way there. Give me rations for seven days... No! Just three days! That'll work for me!

dialogText.cn: 不行，应急物资是给搜救队准备的。那边有伤员提供的情报，已经找到两个人了，而你只有口头证据。
dialogText.en: No. Emergency supplies are reserved for the search and rescue teams. The SAR received updates from the injured and already found two people. All I have from you is a hunch.

dialogText.cn: ……说到底还是区别对待，没打算信我，对吧？
dialogText.en: Okay, you're just giving me the cold shoulder... You never really trusted me, did you?

dialogText.cn: 我得对大家挤出来的资源负责。
dialogText.en: Everyone worked real hard to scrape these resources together. I gotta be responsible for them.

dialogText.cn: 嘁，我就知道。
dialogText.en: Tsk. I knew it.

dialogText.cn: 索斯先生，发生什么事了？
dialogText.en: What's happening, Mr. Soth?

dialogText.cn: 唉，阿杜这小子，情况刚刚好点，又说自己找到了幸存者，想找借口骗东西。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Just when things are looking up, Dewey claims he's found more survivors. He's just coming up with an excuse to get more supplies.

dialogText.cn: 我在洞里的时候就发现了，这人总是想办法偷懒，手还不太干净……特殊时期，没犯大错就忍他一时，但拿人命关天的事撒谎可不行。
dialogText.en: Back when we were still in the cave, I heard he was always trying to find excuses to slack off. And he ain't too clean... Times were rough then, so we let him off because it was nothing serious. But now, I won't forgive anyone lying about matters of life and death.

dialogText.cn: 多谢你对这里的事务尽心尽责。说回正事，我们想办法给暂居处腾出了一些重要资源，希望和你商议一下输送的优先级。
dialogText.en: Thank you for dutifully managing this outpost. To the business at hand. We're thinking about allocating key resources for the camp. I wonder if we can discuss transportation priorities with you.

dialogText.cn: 那太好了，正巧我也想咨询一些问题。
dialogText.en: Of course! Wonderful! I was about to ask you the same thing.

dialogText.cn: 看来得花些时间啊。
dialogText.en: This might take a while.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，<@qu.key>阿杜</>刚才走的时候表情不太对劲，我有点不放心……要不，我们去看看他吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin, <@qu.key>Dewey</> seemed a little off when he left just now. I'm a bit worried... Should we ... check on him a bit?

dialogText.cn: 阿杜，你这是要干啥？
dialogText.en: What are you doing, Dewey?

dialogText.cn: 准备出去。
dialogText.en: Preparing to head out.

dialogText.cn: 那可不行，物资很宝贵的，索斯也说——嗯？准备出去？
dialogText.en: You can't do that! The camp really needs the resources and Soth said... Wait, did you say you're heading out?

dialogText.cn: 怎么，不让？我可没拿谁的东西，随你们检查。
dialogText.en: Yeah, I did. Is that illegal too? I didn't take nobody's stuff. Go on. You can search me if you want.

dialogText.cn: 我的天，你就想两手空空往外跑啊？！
dialogText.en: By Talos! Are you going to head out there empty-handed?

dialogText.cn: 随你们怎么说，反正我得走。
dialogText.en: I don't care. I gotta go.

dialogText.cn: 那人我是救定了。有工夫管我，不如多去帮帮索斯。
dialogText.en: I'm definitely going to save those people. Hey, since you got time to harass me, why don't you go and help Soth instead?

dialogText.cn: 哎哟，怎么就不听劝呢……不行，哪能眼睁睁看着你犯蠢！
dialogText.en: Aiya, this dude is so stubborn... No! I won't just stand around seeing you do stupid things!

dialogText.cn: ……随你们便吧。
dialogText.en: ...Whatever.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者已经回来了……你之前一个人走了这么远，真的很危险。
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers are back already... It was dangerous enough last time when you made that solo trip.

dialogText.cn: 随你们怎么说吧。人多半还在里面，上不上？
dialogText.en: Say what you like, but we got people trapped in the place. Are we doing this or not?

dialogText.cn: 还好地方不大，我们还可以利用扫描协助搜索，速战速决吧。
dialogText.en: Lucky for us, this isn't a big place. We can run a quick scan for clues. It'll help us end this battle quickly.

dialogText.cn: 接下来肯定免不了有战斗，阿杜，等这里安全了你再上来。
dialogText.en: We can't avoid battle. Stay here, Dewey. Come out only when it's safe.

dialogText.cn: ……我帮你们看着后面，谢谢各位。
dialogText.en: ...I'll keep my eyes on your six, I guess. Really appreciate this.

dialogText.cn: 老先生，你还好吧？
dialogText.en: You alright, old man?

dialogText.cn: 其他裂地者可能马上就会回来，阿杜，你能把他背回去吗？
dialogText.en: The other Landbreakers might be here any moment. Dewey, can you carry him back?

dialogText.cn: 啊，好，交给我吧。
dialogText.en: Ah, alright. Leave it to me.

dialogText.cn: 阿杜，管理员？你们可算回来了。
dialogText.en: Dewey! Endmin! You're back!

dialogText.cn: 说过了，我没骗你。
dialogText.en: See? I've been telling you the truth.

dialogText.cn: 你真的在救人……这次是我不对。
dialogText.en: You're really trying to save people... I misjudged you.

dialogText.cn: 哼，少做好过不做。一条烂命换个机会，够赚了。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Trying is at least better than doing nothing. Trading a scoundrel's life for a chance. I say it's a win.

dialogText.cn: 不，情况我自己清楚。只要据点接回几个认识我的人，早晚会瞒不住的。
dialogText.en: I know what's going to happen. Once the outpost starts taking in people who know me, everyone's gonna find out.

dialogText.cn: 我以前没正经工作，在附近常干些小偷小摸的事。裂地者闯进来的时候，我还在监管室里关着呢。
dialogText.en: I never had a proper job so I survived on stealing stuff from people. I was still in a detention cell when the LBs busted into the place.

dialogText.cn: 但……你还是坚持去救人了？
dialogText.en: But ... you still insisted on heading out and saving them?

dialogText.cn: 上次去仓库捞点东西，不小心碰坏了货架。我不懂要领，越救越乱。等工人们赶过来，一大缸特种切削原液已经全完蛋了。
dialogText.en: I once sneaked into the depot to steal stuff but I knocked over a shelf. I tried to steady it but the mess got bigger. When the crew mates arrived, I'd already spilled a huge vat of specialized cutting fluid solution.

dialogText.cn: 真要按损失价值量刑，我肯定得在牢里老死。但都快两个月了，他们还没把我转移走。我想，工团的人应该一直没把案子往上报。
dialogText.en: All the damage I caused in that crime will probably keep me behind bars for life. But they just kept me in a local detention cell for nearly two months. I wasn't relocated. The woosters probably never escalated this incident.

dialogText.cn: 算上洞里那次，我欠工团两条命。话说完了，之后想怎么处置就随你们吧。
dialogText.en: And yeah, the woosters also saved my life last time at the cave. So I guess I owe them twice. I've said my piece. Now do what you gotta do.

dialogText.cn: 但也真的很危险，你和陈应该先喊上我的。
dialogText.en: What you did was very dangerous. You or Chen should have called me.

dialogText.cn: 唉，还是先处理正事吧，得先把这位先生安顿好。
dialogText.en: We should focus on this serious matter first. Let's get this poor man settled down properly.

dialogText.cn: 先生，你是四号谷地的工人吗？这里会定期向枢纽区基地转移伤员，请不必担心，我们会优先处理身份明确的——
dialogText.en: Sir, are you a crew mate of the Valley? Our camp regularly moves the injured to the Hub Base. So don't worry. We'll move those who've been verified first.

dialogText.cn: 不了，我在这里就好。
dialogText.en: No. I'll be good at this place.

dialogText.cn: 咦？可这里毕竟是临时建的，条件可能不适合您这样的年纪……
dialogText.en: But ... this is a temporary shelter. The limited amenities might not be suitable for someone your age...

dialogText.cn: 看衣服，你们应该是终末地的人？能帮忙联系一下那位<@qu.key>安德烈</>工程师么？就说斯托布想在这里搭把手。
dialogText.en: Your outfits tell me you're Endfielders. You have an engineer named <@qu.key>Andre</>, right? Can you give him a call? Tell him that Staub wants to help at this camp.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生？好吧，我们会联系的。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre? Okay. We'll contact him.

dialogText.cn: 我就在这儿待着，多谢你们了。
dialogText.en: Thank you. I'll be waiting here.

dialogText.cn: 这位难道也是安德烈先生的朋友吗……总之，我们联系他问问情况吧。
dialogText.en: Perhaps he's a friend of Mr. Andre... Well, we should call our Hub Base engineer and find out.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生，这是你需要的零件。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre, here are the parts you need.

dialogText.cn: 多谢多谢。正好赶上库存不够，还得占用各位的产线。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much. Stocks are running low, so we have no choice but to borrow your production line for a while.

dialogText.cn: 不过，这些零件看着还挺精密的，暂居处有什么东西用得上它们吗？
dialogText.en: These parts look really intricate. Is there anything in the camp that can use them?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，一会儿就知道啦。咱们这就过去吧。
dialogText.en: Heheh. You'll find out soon enough. Let's head over right now.

dialogText.cn: 朋友们，材料来啦。
dialogText.en: Alright, friends! Here comes the materials.

dialogText.cn: 东西都在这儿了，这边习惯用的规格不太一样，螺丝的直径要小一点点。
dialogText.en: We brought all sorts of stuff. Building specs are quite different here. Look. These screws have a slightly narrower diameter.

dialogText.cn: 难怪，修那拖车的时候，总找不到零件……专业的是不一样，一眼就能看出来了。
dialogText.en: No wonder we couldn't find any spare parts to repair that trailer... See, we need a professional for jobs like this. They can spot the problem instantly.

dialogText.cn: 小事一桩，人安顿好了，毁掉的东西也要重新建起来。技术都用得上。
dialogText.en: Don't say that. At least we got everyone settled down. It's time to rebuild what was destroyed. All this tech will come in useful.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈，你让人把东西送来就行，怎么自己还要来一趟？
dialogText.en: Andre my man, why did you make this trip? Just sending the parts and materials over would've been enough.

dialogText.cn: 哈，我还不知道你想干什么吗？
dialogText.en: Hah! You silly old man, I know what you're up to.

dialogText.cn: 既然有你在，我就把这些小家伙也派来了，多少能提供一点运输能力。
dialogText.en: Now that you're around, I've brought these little buddies along. They'll give you some logistics capacity.

dialogText.cn: 这东西看着挺稀罕啊，还有那些零件……你们想在这里做什么？
dialogText.en: These machines look pretty expensive ... and the parts as well... What are you planning to do with them?

dialogText.cn: 在这干等物资太耽误事儿了。这里挺宽敞，我弄个工作台，好歹能处理一些零碎需求。
dialogText.en: I don't intend to just sit around and wait for the supplies to arrive. Since we've got plenty of space, I'm going to set up a proper workbench. This will let us make some simple tools and take on minor repair jobs.

dialogText.cn: 这点零件够给机器人修修补补了。闲着也是闲着，顺便给人教点手艺，将来用得上。
dialogText.en: We got enough parts to fix and repair the bots. Since I got all this time on my hands, I can probably take an apprentice. A skilled assistant might be helpful later on.

dialogText.cn: 教手艺？斯托布，你难道是想让阿杜……
dialogText.en: An apprentice? Staub, are you going to make Dewey...

dialogText.cn: 说实话，工团之前对他很失望。快十年了，这小子一直没个正形，每次有点改进，很快就又自己放弃。
dialogText.en: Just to lay it straight with you, the UW was quite disappointed in the brat. For ten years he was nothing but trouble. And every time he made an improvement, he would quickly lose patience and give up.

dialogText.cn: 如果这人一点教训都不吃，那就没什么可说的。但既然他还知道什么是好，什么是坏，就当我也给他还一条命，再试一次吧。
dialogText.en: There's no salvaging a hopeless wreck. But Dewey can still tell good from evil. I owe him for saving my life, so I guess he deserves another chance.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，好事好事！闲话少说，我们这就开工吧！
dialogText.en: Hah! To a good beginning! Alright, let's end the chit-chat and start working already!

dialogText.cn: ……你都不怕有个混混徒弟，我还多嘴什么。
dialogText.en: ...If the old man isn't bothered by having a scoundrel apprentice, then I've got nothing to say.

dialogText.cn: 所以……嗯，谢谢。
dialogText.en: So ... yeah... I'll ... take the offer. Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 您来啦，不好意思，还得请您来帮忙。
dialogText.en: You're here! Sorry about calling you here again. Kinda need your help.

dialogText.cn: 不不不，没出状况。我是想请您帮忙打听点消息。
dialogText.en: No, no, no! We don't have a situation here. I just need your help to get some intel.

dialogText.cn: 我听索斯先生说，等四号谷地完全恢复和平，工团会帮忙把大家都送回原来的居住地。
dialogText.en: I heard Mr. Soth mention that once peace returns to Valley IV, the woosters will start moving everyone back to their hometowns and villages.

dialogText.cn: 我和阿吉的爸爸妈妈来自耶尔什自由市。他们一直教育我，耶拉冈德的子民必须知恩图报。在离开之前，我们必须好好表达谢意。
dialogText.en: Mom and Dad came from the free city of Kjersch. They taught me that the children of Kjeragandr must be thankful. We gotta offer our proper thanks before leaving.

dialogText.cn: 我打算送些大家喜欢的礼物，可不好当面问<@qu.key>罗曼</>先生和<@qu.key>安德烈</>先生。有劳您多留意，尽量别把计划提前透露给他们。
dialogText.en: I wanna give people gifts they really like ... but it feels a bit awkward to ask Mr. <@qu.key>Roman</> or Mr. <@qu.key>Andre</> directly. Could you ask them for me? And please don't tell them it's me who asked.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢！我先去做些准备。等您有收获了，我们再碰个头。
dialogText.en: Thank you! I'll make the preparations. We'll catch up once you have their answers.

dialogText.cn: 这不是管理员嘛，您想来个面包吗？
dialogText.en: Ah, Endmin. Hungry for some bread?

dialogText.cn: 要是不喜欢，这份工作可做不长久。不提那些工序复杂的，光烤面包一项，天天都要起早贪黑做准备。
dialogText.en: You gotta love cooking to stay in this trade. Forget about those banquet dishes. Baking bread is hard enough. A good baker is always up before sunrise to start kneading the dough.

dialogText.cn: 苦是苦了点，可大家能不能吃饱了去干活，全看我的手勤不勤。这份工作责任大得很啊。
dialogText.en: Oh yes, a tough trade indeed. But a tough chef will keep everyone fed and ready for work. The trade is essential in keeping things running.

dialogText.cn: 而且时间久了，大家会习惯你做的食物的味道，把你当成朋友。我很喜欢这种感觉。
dialogText.en: And once you've been in this business long enough, people will become attached to your dishes and take you as a friend. I like that feeling.

dialogText.cn: 现在也成了大家庭啦！就是这一大家子照顾起来可不容易，累出我一身毛病。
dialogText.en: And now we're all part of a big family. Not gonna lie, baking for so many people is pretty tiring. All that overtime even made me sick.

dialogText.cn: 习惯啦。干这行的，有个<@qu.key>腰酸腿疼</>都不算什么。
dialogText.en: I've grown used to the chronic condition. If you work this business, you'll get used to <@qu.key>waist pains, leg cramps</>, and all sorts of problems.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？您刚才说什么了吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm? Did you just say something?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来找安德烈吗？
dialogText.en: Looking for Andre, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 他呀，刚走没多久。多半是又在这里熬夜了，眼睛都睁不开。
dialogText.en: Well, dude just left a while ago. He probably pulled an all-nighter again. Big Owl could hardly keep his eyes open.

dialogText.cn: 以我的经验，这人一时半会儿回不来。你得等好久啦。
dialogText.en: From my experience, he's gonna be gone for quite a bit. You might need to wait for a really long time.

dialogText.cn: 喜欢什么？除了工程技术还能有啥，这不是天天在实验室泡着嘛。
dialogText.en: What does Andre like? Engineering and tech, of course. He bathes himself in technical blueprints every day.

dialogText.cn: 那就难说喽。安德烈平时除了吃饭、睡觉，全在鼓捣机器，连那两样也是凑合就行。
dialogText.en: Hard to say. He eats and sleeps just enough to stay alive and sane, then spends the rest of his time working on machines.

dialogText.cn: 有一次，他干脆在工作间趴着睡了一整晚。秦主管早上去找他的时候，差点以为他心梗去世了，那叫一阵闹腾——
dialogText.en: There was this time when Andre fell asleep in his workshop. Director Qin looked for him the next morning and found him lying face flat on the ground. She thought Big Owl died of a heart attack and absolutely panicked. Let's just say ... it wasn't a quiet morning.

dialogText.cn: 等会儿，管理员，你为什么突然这么在意安德烈的喜好？
dialogText.en: Hold on, Endmin. Why are you suddenly so interested in what Andre likes?

dialogText.cn: 行吧，我倒觉得你来枢纽区基地之后，他心情一直都挺好，说不定这也算一项？
dialogText.en: That's true. But Andre's been pretty happy ever since you arrived at the Hub Base. Maybe that's what Big Owl likes.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？你刚才在嘀咕啥？
dialogText.en: Oh. Did you just mumble something?

dialogText.cn: 如果我是他，大概早就想把那副呆眼镜给换了。不过，他自己好像一直都不是很在意……
dialogText.en: If I were him, I would probably replace his silly-looking glasses. But I guess he doesn't mind looking silly...

dialogText.cn: 如果有什么东西能让他熬完夜之后早些<@qu.key>恢复精神</>，他应该会很感激吧。
dialogText.en: Maybe something <@qu.key>revitalizing</>. Something that can cure his post-all-nighter hangover? If such a thing exists, Big Owl might be super grateful.

dialogText.cn: 咦？
dialogText.en: Huh?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我在这里！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'm here!

dialogText.cn: 罗曼先生肌肉酸痛，安德烈先生经常熬夜……我明白了。
dialogText.en: Mr. Roman got muscle ache and Mr. Andre is always pulling all-nighters... Got it.

dialogText.cn: 我家有几个传下来的老方子，和罗曼先生教的东西很像，应该能帮到两位。
dialogText.en: I got a few family recipes. They're kinda like the stuff Mr. Roman taught us. I think they will help.

dialogText.cn: 让我想想……最近帮大家准备草药，还剩下一些没用完，我把它们也都给您。
dialogText.en: Let me think... I was preparing some herbs for the folks and got some left over. I can give them to you.

dialogText.cn: 配方不复杂，只是还缺了几种材料。请您帮忙准备一些吧，按方子做的药效果很好，也许将来您也能用得上。
dialogText.en: The formula isn't that hard, but I'm missing a few ingredients. I wonder if you can find some. If the formula makes some effective meds, you can use it on yourself as well.

dialogText.cn: 对了，暂居处的各位听了我的打算，也想参与进来。
dialogText.en: Oh, the people in the camp also caught wind of my plans. They wanna chip in as well.

dialogText.cn: 大家准备在这里办个小聚会。等礼物准备好，我们就邀请各位来参加庆祝吧！
dialogText.en: We're going to prepare this place for a party. Once we have the gifts, we'll invite everyone here for a celebration!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，礼物的情况怎么样了？
dialogText.en: Endmin, how goes the gifts?

dialogText.cn: 太好了，谢谢您帮忙！
dialogText.en: Awesome! Thank you so much for helping!

dialogText.cn: 陈千语小姐听说了我们的想法，主动帮我们联系那几位去了。我们这就开始庆祝吧！
dialogText.en: We also spoke to Miss Chen about our plans. She's gone to invite our two VIPs. We can begin with our celebrations!

dialogText.cn: 慢点跑！别着急，东西还有的是！
dialogText.en: Ho! Slow down! There's no need to rush, we got plenty of stuff!

dialogText.cn: 罗曼先生收到药膏之后很开心，虽然很多药材还是他教我们收集的。
dialogText.en: Mr. Roman is really happy about the salve. He was the one who taught us how to forage for the herbs.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生也挺喜欢大家准备的醒神茶，好像还打算在自己屋子边上种一点。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre also seems to be enjoying the stimulating tisane we prepared. I think he has plans to grow the herbs at his place.

dialogText.cn: ……秦工程师接下来又要头疼了。
dialogText.en: ...I guess Director Qin has one more thing to worry about now.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，不止这些，我们还准备了别的礼物。
dialogText.en: Haha! These aren't the only gifts we prepared. We got more.

dialogText.cn: {F}管理员姐姐，给你这个！我把大家在这里盖房子的样子画下来啦！{M}管理员哥哥，给你这个！我把大家在这里盖房子的样子画下来啦！
dialogText.en: {F}Miss Endmin! Please take this! I made a drawing of everyone building our home! {M}Mister Endmin! Please take this! I made a drawing of everyone building our home!

dialogText.cn: 说来实在惭愧，我们也想给您准备礼物，可对您还……不够了解。
dialogText.en: We wanted to prepare a gift for you, but we have to admit we don't know enough about you, Endministrator. It's kind of a shame, really...

dialogText.cn: 我们思来想去，还是觉得遵循自己的想法来准备更合适些。
dialogText.en: We tried to come up with something. But then we decided it might be better to just let everyone follow their own ideas.

dialogText.cn: 那我总算安心些了……我不耽误您更多时间了，您也和其他几位聊聊吧！
dialogText.en: Well, you've put my mind at ease... I won't take up any more of your time, Endmin. Feel free to chat with the others.

dialogText.cn: 还得多谢各位帮忙，这里总算熬过了最困难的日子。来，我有一样东西想送给您。
dialogText.en: We managed to survive the most trying times. This couldn't have been possible without your help. Thank you so much. Here, I got something for you.

dialogText.cn: 柑实罐头？这里不是有一大堆嘛，虽然都挺好吃的……
dialogText.en: A can of citromes? But we've got plenty of this delish stuff right here...

dialogText.cn: 这是我们自己成功采收、制作的第一个罐头。糖和盐都不太够用，制作的时候调整了好几次方案。
dialogText.en: This is the very first can we made with our own harvest. Since we're running low on sugar and salt, we had to adjust the recipe a few times.

dialogText.cn: 听说阿杜和斯托布修好了烧水的炉子，又重新设计了封口，总算能用最老的办法做些罐头了。
dialogText.en: I heard that Dewey and Staub fixed up a sterilizing autoclave and re-designed the sealing lid. We made these preserves with the most traditional way of canning.

dialogText.cn: 嗬，这么一看，它还和不少东西有关联呢。
dialogText.en: Oh wow. Making this simple can actually involve plenty of processes.

dialogText.cn: 如果一切都从零开始，肯定什么都办不到。还好有那么多人愿意留下来帮忙。
dialogText.en: We couldn't do anything if we had to start from zero. Thankfully, plenty of people stayed around to help.

dialogText.cn: 这么多物资，看来暂居处已经不缺补给了。
dialogText.en: Supplies seem well-stocked. I don't think the camp will run out any time soon.

dialogText.cn: 说到底，还是团结力量大啊。
dialogText.en: What can I say? United we are strong.

dialogText.cn: 嘿，你们几个，拿着。
dialogText.en: Hey, team. Take these.

dialogText.cn: 我们在废品堆里翻到过一台老式录像机。阿杜把它给修好了，又用那几台运输机器人排了支舞，说是要当个礼物。
dialogText.en: I found an old recorder in the pile of salvage. Dewey fixed it. We also programmed the logistics bots to dance. Dewey wants to give you a performance as a gift.

dialogText.cn: 哦？挺有能耐嘛，他真是刚开始上手的？
dialogText.en: Oh? That's pretty amazing. Is that boy really as inexperienced as you claim?

dialogText.cn: 说是以前懂点破解电子锁的窍门，不像话……但也算有基础了。
dialogText.en: The scoundrel has some skills in cracking electronic locks, and that is pretty illegal... But maybe that's where he got his basics from.

dialogText.cn: 他给这里做了不少贡献，我打算回头给他写个申请，也许能减轻一些处罚。
dialogText.en: He contributed his fair share to this community. I intend to write up an application for him — it might help reduce the penalties.

dialogText.cn: 唉，等外面安定些，他是不是又要被关起来了？
dialogText.en: What? So once things settle down, Dewey's gonna get locked up again?

dialogText.cn: 问这个做什么。自己惹的麻烦就该自己负责，很正常吧？
dialogText.en: Why bother asking that? I have to reap what I sow. That goes without question.

dialogText.cn: 你小子现在倒老实。接着学吧，真把这门技术全学会了，将来总能再好好开始的。
dialogText.en: Can't believe you're behaving for once. Keep it up, boy. Once you master this skill, you'll be getting a fresh new start.

dialogText.cn: 有空我也来帮忙。怎么样，这机会可不是随时都有哦？
dialogText.en: Hoohoo, let me help when I find the time. What do you think? This chance doesn't come around very often.

dialogText.cn: 行了行了，知道了……
dialogText.en: Ugh, fine. I heard ya...

dialogText.cn: 大、大家能这么团结，真是太好了……
dialogText.en: Seeing everyone united like this... It's wonderful ... truly wonderful...

dialogText.cn: 别哼哼唧唧了。今天是个开心的日子，咱们得高兴起来！
dialogText.en: C'mon now! It's a happy day — no time for getting all emo. Let's party hard and loud!

dialogText.cn: 我、我就是……太高兴……你别……
dialogText.en: I'm ... I'm just overwhelmed with joy... Don't call me out.

dialogText.cn: 真不好意思，说是庆祝会，其实能用的东西不多，只能做到这个份上了。
dialogText.en: I know this is a party, but we're sorry there isn't much we can celebrate with. This is the best we can do.

dialogText.cn: 这个嘛……我找罗曼先生问过了。根据文明环带对难民援助的规定，阿吉其实能申请在四号谷地学习和生活，她也很乐意留在这里。
dialogText.en: Well, I asked Mr. Roman about this... He told me that the Civilization Band has rules for helping refugees. Ginny can apply to study and live in Valley IV. And I think she's really happy about staying here.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？真奇怪，卡贾你应该也有资格吧？
dialogText.en: Oh? You should be qualified as well, Karja. What happened?

dialogText.cn: 不不不，你理解错了。我也收到通知了，但是……我不能留在这里。
dialogText.en: No, no. You misunderstood. I got the letter of notification as well, but ... I can't stay here.

dialogText.cn: 我们和父母是跟着商队旅行时被劫匪打散的。我和阿吉逃了很久很久，这才来到四号谷地。已经过去了这么久，我不能再等下去了。
dialogText.en: We were traveling with my parents in a caravan, when suddenly a raider ambush tore us apart. Ginny and I ran for our lives for what felt like forever, and finally made it to Valley IV. It's been a while since then, but I just can't wait any longer.

dialogText.cn: 你打算自己一个人去找他们吗？我的天……是很了不起啦，但……真能行吗？
dialogText.en: Are you going to find them on your own? By Talos... I mean, it's pretty brave of you, but ... are you sure you can do it?

dialogText.cn: 我们不是常说一句话嘛，“少做好过不做”，就算希望再渺茫，也还没到放弃的时候。
dialogText.en: We got this saying: "Trying is at least better than doing nothing." I know chance is slim, but this isn't the time to give up.

dialogText.cn: ……这样根本就是在糊弄自己。卡贾，你才这点岁数，人生地不熟，一个人办不到的。
dialogText.en: ...Stop fooling yourself, Karja. You're too young and inexperienced. You can't do this alone.

dialogText.cn: 阿杜说得对。你一个人办不到的——我们一起帮忙去找。
dialogText.en: Dewey's right. You can't do this alone. We should help you in your search.

dialogText.cn: 卡贾，你的爸爸妈妈叫什么名字，之前是在哪里工作？
dialogText.en: Karja, boy, tell me the name of your parents. Do you know where they work?

dialogText.cn: 还有商队的名字，把知道的都告诉我们，工团肯定能帮上忙。
dialogText.en: And give us the name of the caravan. Tell us everything you know. The UWST will help however we can.

actorName.cn: 痊愈的伤员{f1m4d3-痊愈的伤员}
actorName.en: Injured Crew Mate Who Recovered {f1m4d3-Injured Crew Mate Who Recovered}

dialogText.cn: 算我一个！我从合金萝卜城来的，那里车队多，消息灵通！
dialogText.en: Add me! I'm from Alloycarrot, where caravans are everywhere and news travels fast!

actorName.cn: 年长的难民{f1m4d3-年长的难民}

dialogText.cn: 我的单位在特里格拉夫，回去就能帮你登记。
dialogText.en: My crew is stationed at Triglava. I'll register your search ticket once I get back.

actorName.cn: 年轻的难民{f1m4d3-年轻的难民}

dialogText.cn: 我在宏科院认识人，我也去打听打听，没准他们被哪个天师救去了呢！
dialogText.en: And I know people in HAS. I'll go ask around. Perhaps some Tianshi already rescued your parents, Karja!

dialogText.cn: 还有我……我也试试……多一个人多点机会……放心，肯定会有办法的……
dialogText.en: I'm in too...! I'll try asking as well...! Every bit of help you get will improve your odds...! Don't worry, we'll find a way...! Yeah! I have plenty of connections!... I'll take part as well!

dialogText.cn: 哇，这么一看，搜索范围快有小半个文明环带了！
dialogText.en: Wow. From the looks of it, I believe our search radius nearly covers half of the Civilization Band!

dialogText.cn: 这……我、我要怎么……谢谢，谢谢各位！
dialogText.en: I ... I ... How should I thank you all...? I really appreciate this, everyone!

dialogText.cn: 虽然早晚都要各奔东西，可这些日子下来，我们……现在也算一家人了。
dialogText.en: I know we'll soon go our separate ways, but this temporary community ... is like a big family now.

dialogText.cn: 我……不管了，总之也把我算上。
dialogText.en: I... Well, whatever. Count me in.

dialogText.cn: 丹尼尔，在愁什么呢？
dialogText.en: Wassup, Daniel! You don't look happy.

dialogText.cn: 缺人手。附近不太平，我想多组织点巡逻的人，这事儿一直没个着落。
dialogText.en: This place isn't safe and I need more muscle on patrols. I couldn't put a serious crew together.

dialogText.cn: 索斯说现在能匀出的人力太少，不能轻易冒险……但我实在放心不下。
dialogText.en: Soth keeps telling me how he's got nobody to spare and how we should avoid risks... But I'm worried that trouble will come looking for us.

dialogText.cn: 确实还有裂地者在附近流窜，你有发现什么迹象吗？
dialogText.en: Yeah, we do have Landbreakers prowling near this place. Found anything suspicious?

dialogText.cn: 一些脚印，还有吃剩的骨头。关键是那气味！唉，我总觉得……
dialogText.en: A few footprints and pieces of bone that someone gnawed on. And the smell! Gah! I really think...

dialogText.cn: 喂！丹尼尔！不好啦！
dialogText.en: HEY! DANIEL! We got an emergency!

dialogText.cn: 裂地者来了，就在外头呢！三五成群的，看着不好对付啊！
dialogText.en: Them friggin' LBs are here! A mob of 'em! They are definitely up to no good!

dialogText.cn: 什么？这么快？！你快带大家躲起来！
dialogText.en: WHAT?! So soon?! Quick! Take the people and hide!

dialogText.cn: 不能让他们再靠近了，快带我们过去！
dialogText.en: We can't let those LBs get any closer! Take us to the battle!

dialogText.cn: 你们没事吧？有伤着没有？
dialogText.en: You alright?! Are you hurt?

dialogText.cn: 该死，之前打跑了裂地者一次，他们竟然还知道换法子偷袭了！
dialogText.en: Damn! We chased off those pipefaces before, and now they're pulling this sneaky trick on us!

dialogText.cn: 索斯，实在不行，我先自己去放点陷阱，这么耗着和等死没区别。
dialogText.en: Soth, if we got no other solutions in mind, I'm heading out to lay a few traps. I won't die holed up in a cave.

dialogText.cn: 那不一样！我当过军人！哪怕现在退伍了，也不能放着一帮土匪在头上作威作福！
dialogText.en: It's not the same! I'm ex-military! I may have been discharged, but I won't sit on my hands while these blighted raiders mess up my place!

dialogText.cn: 我知道，我知道……丹尼尔，你前前后后帮忙操心了那么多工作，我看得见！
dialogText.en: I know how you feel ... Daniel. I know. I've seen all the hard work you've put in to everything here.

dialogText.cn: 大家都看得见，所以才不能把困难都交给你一个人扛啊。
dialogText.en: Everyone knows how important you are. That's why we can't afford to let you handle the toughest jobs alone.

dialogText.cn: ……好吧，你说得对。
dialogText.en: ...Ugh. Alright. Fine. You're right.

dialogText.cn: 但这样下去的确不是个办法。对了，之前那些铳械塔呢？能派上用场吗？
dialogText.en: But we can't let this go on forever. Oh, what about those Gun Towers we constructed last time? Can we use them?

dialogText.cn: 那些设备毕竟是固定装置，现在裂地者变得十分狡猾，很难完全应对各种情况。
dialogText.en: Those are stationary defense facilities. The LBs are getting smart, and I don't think we can get enough towers to handle every situation.

dialogText.cn: 对哦，我们有协议技术嘛。只要提前知道敌人从哪里来，随时更改布置就好了！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah, we got our flashy Techno-Protocol! If we know where the enemy is coming from, we can just re-arrange our defenses!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……协议设备有基础传感组件与数据链，如果整合一片区域的实时信息，就能提供一定程度的预警。
dialogText.en: Hmm... All protocol facilities are furnished with basic sensors and datalinks. Real-time processing of signal feeds from facilities in the whole area ... should give us the early warning we need.

dialogText.cn: 我们会在这里设置一个<@qu.key>预警终端</>，它会侦测周围一切正在酝酿的攻势，便于我们组织防御。
dialogText.en: We will place an <@qu.key>early warning terminal</> here. It will monitor the surroundings for a potential attack, and help us organize our defenses.

dialogText.cn: 那些设备可以提供不少援助火力，也可以单独防守大家顾不过来的路线……
dialogText.en: Indeed. Those facilities offer plenty of support fire. They can hold off an entire attack route if we're spread too thin...

dialogText.cn: 嘿，这么一想，好像挺靠谱啊？
dialogText.en: Hey, come to think of it, this approach sounds pretty promising.

dialogText.cn: 预警终端状况良好。如果威胁超出了自动防御模式能处理的范畴，我们会尽快返回协助防御的。
dialogText.en: The early warning terminal seems to be working well. If threat level exceeds the scope of the auto-defense mode, we'll be back here and offer our support in the defense operations.

dialogText.cn: 天哪……肯定会有很多地方需要这套东西。
dialogText.en: By Talos... We can definitely use this tech at a lot of places!

dialogText.cn: 这套系统依赖的许多技术暂时没办法大规模推广。
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, many of the technologies in this system aren't ready for large-scale deployment yet.

dialogText.cn: 不过，在次级核心的支持下，至少还能给几个地方提供一些防御协助。
dialogText.en: But since we have the Sub-PAC, we can at least deploy these to support our defenses at several locations.

dialogText.cn: 唉，就是老得麻烦各位……我们只能两手一摊，实在太惭愧了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. But this places us further in your debt... We can hardly offer any help. It's such a shame.

dialogText.cn: 自力更生固然重要，但也不能本末倒置，勉强大家挑战难以克服的困难。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Self-sufficiency is important, but forcing people to take on impossible challenges will defeat the entire purpose.

dialogText.cn: ……确实，你们说得对。哈，预警终端的日常维护就交给我们吧，这点活总还干得来。
dialogText.en: ...Words of true wisdom. You're right. Hah. Leave the maintenance of the early warning terminal to us. We can definitely handle a job like that.

dialogText.cn: 我可以多来几趟，教教大家怎么防身。
dialogText.en: I can totally visit the camp and teach everyone some self-defense skills.

dialogText.cn: 在情况好转之前，这里的危险就交给我们吧！
dialogText.en: And before peace returns, we'll help you handle the local threats and hazards!

dialogText.cn: 辅助模式测试完成……嗯，这样应该行得通。
dialogText.en: Support module testing complete... Hmm. This should work.

dialogText.cn: 这些装置还真管用！只要放置得巧妙，我们几个人就能收拾一大片！
dialogText.en: These things are awesome! Just place them at the right places, and they'll help a small team like ours take down entire enemy mobs!

dialogText.cn: 如果敌人趁你们不在的时候进攻该怎么办？真打起来，我们这儿没几个能帮上忙的。
dialogText.en: So what should we do if the enemy attacks when you're not around? Our community doesn't have enough fighters.

dialogText.cn: 请放心，完成配置后，作战设备可以自动运行。没有我们参与，它们也能处理一定规模的敌人。
