dialogText.en: Be rest assured. Once properly deployed, the combat facilities will work automatically. They can handle decent-sized enemy forces in our absence.

dialogText.cn: 预警终端可以评估所在地的威胁等级……实际演示一遍会更方便，让我们开始吧。
dialogText.en: The early warning terminal can evaluate the local threat level... An actual demonstration will better explain how it works. Let us begin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，总控中枢的扩容升级准备已经完成了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we have completed preparations for the Control Nexus expansion upgrades.

dialogText.cn: 本次升级后，总控中枢将接入一批修缮完毕的辅助运算组件。
dialogText.en: This upgrade will connect the Control Nexus to a suite of auxiliary algorithmic modules that we just finished repairing.

dialogText.cn: 因此，我们可以进行更深入的调整控制，从而解锁制造舱的升级，提升工作效能。
dialogText.en: This will allow us to fine tune system controls, unlock Manufacturing Cabin upgrades, and improve our work performance.

dialogText.cn: 同时，一个空间更大的中型舱室将恢复使用，<@qu.key>培养舱</>的建设和管理也将解锁。
dialogText.en: A larger, mid-sized cabin will also be restored for our utilization. Construction and management of the <@qu.key>Growth Chamber</> will become available.

dialogText.cn: 扩容演算芯片已经由工程中心准备就绪，不过安装工作需要您亲手授权执行。
dialogText.en: The Engineering Division has prepared an Algorithm Expansion Chip. However, you must personally authorize its installation.

dialogText.cn: 请前往<@qu.key>总控中枢</>安装芯片，更新系统框架。
dialogText.en: Please go to the <@qu.key>Control Nexus</> to install the chip and update the system framework.

dialogText.cn: 已经确认到总控中枢的数据更新。接下来，我们可以在基建区建设<@qu.key>培养舱</>了。
dialogText.en: Control Nexus data updates verified. We can now construct a <@qu.key>Growth Chamber</> at the Working Sector.

dialogText.cn: 当然可以，如果您需要的话。
dialogText.en: Of course, if that is what you need.

dialogText.cn: 培养舱能利用素材中提取的基核，培养更多<@qu.key>菌类</>质料、<@qu.key>晶植</>质料和<@qu.key>矿物</>质料。
dialogText.en: Seed materials extracted from various resources can be cultivated into mature <@qu.key>fungal matter</>, <@qu.key>vitrified plants</>, and <@qu.key>rare minerals</>.

dialogText.cn: 虽然这需要一些时间，但胜在稳定。
dialogText.en: Cultivation takes time, but it offers a steady supply of these resources.

dialogText.cn: 培养舱需要设置在基建区的中型待建舱室上。管理员，我们现在就可以进行尝试。
dialogText.en: The Growth Chamber must be constructed at an available mid-sized empty cabin in the Working Sector. Endmin, I believe we can start constructing one right away.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我看到培养舱已经开始输出运行记录了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I am receiving operational log from the Growth Chamber.

dialogText.cn: 野外采集这些贵重材料时，请您留心<@qu.key>节余一些</>用于提取基核，实现正向循环。
dialogText.en: Indeed. When gathering rare materials from the outdoors, <@qu.key>keep some at hand</>, and extract seed materials from them. This will generate a positive feedback loop.

dialogText.cn: 将来，我们会进一步升级培养舱，扩大它的生产规模，增加可培养的材料种类。
dialogText.en: We can also upgrade the Growth Chamber to expand its scale of production, as well as the type of materials it can cultivate.

dialogText.cn: 是的，工程中心的规划已经排到了两年之后，我们将以支援危机处理小组为优先进行工作。
dialogText.en: Yes, we do. In fact, the Engineering Division has already made a two-year schedule. We have prioritized certain tasks to better support the Crisis Team.

dialogText.cn: 那么，我就不再占用您更多时间了。当修复工作取得新的重要进展，我再来告知您。
dialogText.en: I shall not take up any more of your time. You shall be notified once our repair work makes important new progress.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，真乖真乖，看上去你已经恢复精神了嘛。
dialogText.en: Aww, good little buddy! Feeling lively and chipper again, huh?

dialogText.cn: 下一次可要小心哦，不要再受伤了，现在外面可是很危险的。
dialogText.en: Just be careful, and don't get hurt again. Things are really dangerous outside.

dialogText.cn: 咦？前辈您来了呀？您还好吗？
dialogText.en: Oh?! Professor! You're here! How have you been?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，我是来帮忙的。前辈的状态好像还不错。您失忆了，我原本还有些担忧……
dialogText.en: Heheh. I'm here to help. You seem to be doing pretty well, Professor. I was a little worried when I heard about your amnesia...

dialogText.cn: 管理员的身体情况……还在观察中。管理员，我们的工作需要擅长灾害研究和<@qu.key>地质勘探</>的干员提供支援，我就想到了<@qu.key>艾尔黛拉</>。
dialogText.en: We are still ... observing the Endmin's physical condition. Endmin, our operation here needs the support of an operator skilled in disaster research and <@qu.key>geological prospecting</>. <@qu.key>Ardelia</> is the first that came to mind.

dialogText.cn: 收到克劳先生的联络后，我就通知了她，我们接下来要进行的项目很需要她的经验和技术。
dialogText.en: I notified her right after we received Mr. Crowe's call. Her experience and expertise will be crucial for this project.

dialogText.cn: 这里的情况……很不好。我稍微勘察了一下四周，超域裂隙泄露的能量已经渗入了地下……到处都是侵蚀，危险随处可见……
dialogText.en: The situation here is ... not very good. I did a quick survey of the vicinity. Energy leaking from the Æther rift may have seeped into the ground... The Blight is everywhere. This place is obviously dangerous grounds...

dialogText.cn: 不过……四号谷地的生物都在努力地试图活下去，哪怕自身很弱小，也在尝试彼此依靠来渡过难关……
dialogText.en: But ... the wildlife of Valley IV are doing their best to survive. They might be weak, but they're helping each other to endure this hardship...

dialogText.cn: 我很高兴能来到这里帮助它们，还有和前辈一起工作。
dialogText.en: I'm happy to be here and help these little creatures. And I'm definitely happy to be on your team, Professor.

dialogText.cn: 这里的<@qu.key>负责人</>就在前面，我带前辈过去吧。
dialogText.en: The local <@qu.key>site monitor</> is right ahead. I'll take you to him.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您终于到了，贸然请求你们，没添麻烦吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're finally here! I hope I didn't trouble you with this sudden request.

dialogText.cn: 不要紧的，克劳先生，这是我们合作的一部分。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Mr. Crowe. This is all part of our partnership.

dialogText.cn: 看上去你们已经聊过了。管理员，还记得我在通信里提到的计划吗？
dialogText.en: It seems you have discussed this already. Endmin, remember the project I mentioned in my message?

dialogText.cn: 如今四号谷地满目疮痍，供能高地更是直接被超域裂隙所影响，侵蚀遍地，还产生了很多异常的区域……
dialogText.en: Valley IV has taken a serious beating. The Power Plateau itself is directly affected by the Æther rift. Blight and anomalous locations are popping up all over the region.

dialogText.cn: 正常情况下，等待超域能量的影响消退，可能要十余年……但我们等不了这么久……
dialogText.en: Under general circumstances, we might have to wait for more than a decade for the Æther energy and its effects to dissipate. But we can't afford to wait that long...

dialogText.cn: 十余年……
dialogText.en: More than a decade...?

dialogText.cn: 一来，这里是我们辛苦建设的新家园，我们不想放弃这里。二来，我们无法预估超域能量对周边生态会产生多大影响，等我们回来时，还不知道这里会变成什么样子。
dialogText.en: Firstly, we worked hard to build our homes here. We are not going to give it up. Secondly, we don't know how the Æther would affect the local ecology. This place might change into something else by the time we return.

dialogText.cn: 所以，我们计划就地取材，在这里搭建一个四号谷地重建指挥部，用于生态实验和<@qu.key>地质勘探</>。我们计划用六年时间，让四号谷地恢复到原来的样子。
dialogText.en: So we plan to construct a Valley IV Reconstruction Headquarters with local materials. This HQ will provide ecological testing and <@qu.key>geological surveillance</> functions. We have a six-year plan to restore Valley IV to its original state.

dialogText.cn: 这是理想情况下，我们能迅速掌握四号谷地被超域能量影响的程度，并顺利完成解析和实验。
dialogText.en: That's assuming everything goes smoothly. It also assumes that we can quickly assess the degrees of Æther impact on Valley IV, and successfully complete all testing and analysis.

dialogText.cn: 即便如此，我们仍需克服众多困难。其中最重要的是……我们需要一个特殊的大型<@qu.key>地质探针</>。
dialogText.en: Even then, we'll still have plenty of difficulties to overcome. The most critical one is that ... we need a specialized large <@qu.key>geological probe</>.

dialogText.cn: 这已经是我们的极限了……被超域能量影响的物质甚至连自身形态都会被改变。六年已经是我们预估的最短时间了。
dialogText.en: That's the best we can do... The properties and even the forms of matter would change when affected by the Æther. Our shortest estimate would be six years.

dialogText.cn: 这一切的前提是，我们能够完全掌握超域能量的渗透情况。为此，我们得建造一个特殊的大型<@qu.key>地质探针</>。
dialogText.en: And that's also assuming that we have full understanding of Æther infiltration in this area. This is why we must construct a specialized large <@qu.key>geological probe</>.

dialogText.cn: 是的，也是因此，我们需要这位卡普里尼……不，这位优秀的灾害研究员提供的技术。
dialogText.en: Indeed. And it's the reason why we need this Caprinae... ahem, I mean this excellent disaster scientist to share her expertise with us.

dialogText.cn: 当然最重要的——还有集成工业系统提供的生产力。
dialogText.en: Finally, the most important key to it all — the productivity offered by the AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 那太好了，管理员，我们这就开始吧。
dialogText.en: Awesome, Endmin. Let's get things started right away.

dialogText.cn: 建设工作已经准备妥当，重建指挥部的位置已经选好了。
dialogText.en: Prep work for the construction is complete. We've also selected our site for the Reconstruction Headquarters.

dialogText.cn: 在这里投下<@qu.key>次级核心</>吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Let's deploy the <@qu.key>Sub-PAC</> here, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这里的人需要我们。
dialogText.en: The people here need us.

dialogText.cn: 准备工作已经在进行了。不过，现在野外的环境还很严峻，有些工作可能需要管理员您出手相助。
dialogText.en: Prep work is underway. The surrounding wilderness, however, remains quite hostile. There is some work that may require your direct assistance, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我们现在急需的是几种类型的<@qu.key>土壤样本</>……不了解土壤性质，我们连最基础的研究都难以展开。
dialogText.en: We desperately need some <@qu.key>soil samples</>... If we know nothing about local soil properties, we won't be able to start even the most basic research.

dialogText.cn: 工人们都忙于建设，他们也都不具备应对紧急情况的能力。所以……
dialogText.en: Our crew is busy with construction work. They're not so good at handling emergencies. That's why...

dialogText.cn: 那再好不过，我把可以采集到<@qu.key>土壤样本</>的区域标记给您。
dialogText.en: Perfect. I'll mark out the locations where you can gather the <@qu.key>soil samples</>.

dialogText.cn: 那我们先专注于建设工作。
dialogText.en: Then we'll focus on the construction first.

dialogText.cn: 这里怎么还有人？等等，你是……之前找发信器时的那位……
dialogText.en: There are still people here? Wait, aren't you ... the one who was looking for the signal emitter before...?

dialogText.cn: 原来是终末地的各位！我是被你们救过的<@qu.key>克莱维尔</>啊，你们怎么会来这里？
dialogText.en: And you're those Endfielders! I'm <@qu.key>Clavell</>! You saved my life back then! So, what made you come back to the Plateau?

dialogText.cn: 我们受克劳先生之托，来取一些<@qu.key>土壤样本</>。
dialogText.en: Mr. Crowe contacted us for help. He wants to gather some <@qu.key>soil samples</>.

dialogText.cn: 是这些对吧？
dialogText.en: You're talking about these, right?

dialogText.cn: 哇……你这瓶瓶罐罐的也太多了吧？而且，克劳不是说你们都在忙着建设吗？
dialogText.en: Wow... You got plenty of jars and bottles here! I thought Mr. Crowe said that you're all busy with construction work.

dialogText.cn: 我负责的建设工作已经完成了，这不是想着克劳老师急着要样本嘛。这里很安全，我这样的普通技术员也足够应付。
dialogText.en: My part of the construction's done. Since Professor Crowe's in a hurry for those samples, and this area looks pretty calm, I figured even a common techie like me could pitch in.

dialogText.cn: 至于这些……别看数量多，每一份都是从不同环境下提取的。比如这个是更接近原本状态的土壤，这一份是从异常区的断面中收集的……
dialogText.en: As for these... Don't let the numbers fool you. Every sample was collected under different environmental conditions. This one here is soil closer to its original status. This one was collected from the fault plane of the anomalous zone...

dialogText.cn: 克劳提供的信息显示，这里需要的土壤类型应该只有一种……
dialogText.en: But Crowe's information tells me that ... we just need a single soil sample from this place...

dialogText.cn: 如果只是满足基础研究工作的话，确实不需要这么多。不过……现在供能高地的情况十分复杂，多一些样本就多一些研究方向。
dialogText.en: True. We won't need that many samples for basic testing. But ... the Power Plateau is a huge mess right now. Getting more samples will give us more options in scientific research.

dialogText.cn: 不细心对待研究的话，很容易漏掉一些关键信息。
dialogText.en: Missing key information is all too easy when research isn't handled carefully.

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师既然托你们来这里，看来他已经等不及了，我先把这些样本带回去！
dialogText.en: Since Professor Crowe asked you to come here, I'm sure it's urgent. I'll take these back right now!

dialogText.cn: 麻烦你了。管理员，我们去另一处地点吧。
dialogText.en: Thank you. Endmin, we can head to the next location.

dialogText.cn: 啊！什么人？你们怎么找到这里的？！
dialogText.en: Ah! Who's that?! How did you find this place?!

dialogText.cn: ……这可怎么办。
dialogText.en: ...What should I do?

dialogText.cn: 咦？你是找权限钥匙卡那个时候的……
dialogText.en: Hmm? Aren't you the one back then when we were looking for the authorization keycard...?

dialogText.cn: 终末地的人？太好了，是你们啊！我是之前受你们关照的<@qu.key>邓恩</>。
dialogText.en: Endfielders? Oh, that's wonderful! It's me — <@qu.key>Dean</>. You really got me out of trouble last time.

dialogText.cn: 我正一筹莫展呢，幸亏你们来了！
dialogText.en: I'm stuck in yet another problem, but thank Talos you're here!

dialogText.cn: 遇到什么问题了吗？
dialogText.en: Is there anything wrong?

dialogText.cn: 是这样的……重建指挥部需要几份<@qu.key>土壤样本</>，有一份在这个区域。
dialogText.en: Well... We need a few <@qu.key>soil samples</> for the Reconstruction Headquarters. One such sample should be collected in this area.

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师不允许我们来这种发生机械故障的危险区域回收样本，但这么拖着也不是办法。
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe wouldn't allow us to collect samples in dangerous zones with faulty machines. But I can't just sit around and do nothing.

dialogText.cn: 如果时机合适，或许能在这里的损坏更严重前，把样本拿回来……
dialogText.en: Gotta find a good chance to snatch a sample before the tech gives out on me...

dialogText.cn: 我猜猜，结果事情不如你想的那么顺利，所以一时间不知道怎么办才好了？
dialogText.en: Let me guess. Things didn't go as you expected, and now you don't know how to handle the situation?

dialogText.cn: 就是这样……但有时候时机稍纵即逝。这些小事如此，研究工作更是如此，不大胆地做一些判断，还怎么得到突破性收获？
dialogText.en: Yeah... Windows of opportunity come and go. It's the same for chores as well as scientific research. You gotta make some bold assumptions to achieve the breakthrough results.

dialogText.cn: 即使上一次失败了，也要相信下一次就能成功……
dialogText.en: Don't worry about past failures — trust that the next trial could yield results.

dialogText.cn: 你说的也没错，不过这里太危险了，后续的工作就交给我们吧。
dialogText.en: You're right, but it's too dangerous here. Leave the rest to us.

dialogText.cn: 你先回去吧，建设工作还需要你。
dialogText.en: Please head back for now. The construction crew still needs you.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢，麻烦你们了。唉……希望克劳老师不要因此发火……
dialogText.en: Alright, thanks a lot for helping. Ugh ... I hope Professor Crowe won't get mad at me...

dialogText.cn: 那，接下来轮到我们了，走吧。
dialogText.en: That means we're doing the work now. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 我们回来了——奇怪，你们怎么都站在这里？
dialogText.en: We're back. Uh... Why are you all standing here?

dialogText.cn: 建设工作都完成啦，等你们回来就正式开始<@qu.key>地质探针</>项目的动员大会了。克劳老师会指派负责这个项目的总工程师，不过……
dialogText.en: Construction work is complete. We're waiting for you to formally kickstart our mobilization for the <@qu.key>geological probe</> project. Professor Crowe will be assigning the lead engineer for this project, but...

dialogText.cn: 没有人比克劳老师更适合了。克劳老师虽然有些……固执，但他是这里最出色的技术专家，有他领导我们，相信很快就能完成工作了。
dialogText.en: No one here's more qualified than Professor Crowe. He can be a little ... stubborn, but he's the best technician we have. With his leadership, I'm sure the project will be completed soon.

dialogText.cn: 你们回来了？<@qu.key>样本</>的事情怎么样了？
dialogText.en: You're back. How about the <@qu.key>samples</>?

dialogText.cn: 这下准备工作就全部完成了，可以正式启动项目了。
dialogText.en: This means all our prep work is done. Time to formally begin the project.

dialogText.cn: 接下来我们要承担的，是一项艰巨且责任重大的项目。它关乎着四号谷地和周边千万生灵的命运。
dialogText.en: The next step of our undertaking will be an extremely challenging and critical project. It will determine the survival of countless lives in Valley IV and the surrounding regions.

dialogText.cn: 重建家园，恢复生态，把创伤从我们挚爱的土地上抹除……建造大型<@qu.key>地质探针</>的这份工作……
dialogText.en: We shall rebuild homes, restore ecologies, and erase the scars from our beloved land... The construction of the large <@qu.key>geological probe</>...

dialogText.cn: 我将全权交给<@qu.key>克莱维尔</>和<@qu.key>邓恩</>负责！
dialogText.en: I hereby grant <@qu.key>Clavell</> and <@qu.key>Dean</> complete authority over the project!

dialogText.cn: 这才对嘛。
dialogText.en: Hear, hear.

dialogText.cn: 实至名归！
dialogText.en: It goes without saying!

dialogText.cn: 等等！！
dialogText.en: HOLD ON!!

dialogText.cn: 就是这样，下面由新任的项目负责人进行开工动员。
dialogText.en: And that is how things should be. Our new project leads will mobilize the crew and get started with the work.

dialogText.cn: 这……我、我怎么……
dialogText.en: But ... I ... how...?

dialogText.cn: 搞错了吧？我怎么能……
dialogText.en: There must be a mistake! I could never...

dialogText.cn: 啊，看来这下指挥部要有得忙了。
dialogText.en: Well, I guess the crew of the HQ has plenty of work cut out for them.

dialogText.cn: 等一下！！
dialogText.en: WAIT!!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，是来查看重建指挥部的建设进度吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, here to check on the progress of the Reconstruction Headquarters?

dialogText.cn: 发生什么事了？他们两个人在做什么？
dialogText.en: What's going on? What are those two doing?

dialogText.cn: 这……他们保持这个状态已经一个小时了。
dialogText.en: Oh well... They've been doing this for about an hour.

dialogText.cn: 什么？
dialogText.en: WHAT?!

dialogText.cn: 这两个人对<@qu.key>地质探针</>和指挥部的工作方针意见不同。争执了很久也没有吵出结果……
dialogText.en: The two have different ideas about work regarding the <@qu.key>geological probe</> and the HQ. They've argued about it for days. Sadly, no consensus was reached...

dialogText.cn: 我已经尽力劝过他们了，结果一转身，他们又变成这个状态了……
dialogText.en: I did my best to talk to them. But as soon as I turned around, they were back at it again...

dialogText.cn: 指挥工作不能拖延太久，管理员，问问他们怎么回事吧。
dialogText.en: We can't leave this outpost without proper leadership for too long. Endmin, maybe we should ask them what's going on.

dialogText.cn: 好烦……又跑哪里去了？
dialogText.en: Bugger this... Where did it run off this time?

dialogText.cn: 原来你到这里来了，你在找什么吗？
dialogText.en: Here you are. Looking for something?

dialogText.cn: ……是你们啊。我在找一只<@qu.key>长耳兽</>，以前我都会定期来记录它的活动数据。
dialogText.en: Ah, Endfielders. Yeah, I'm looking for a <@qu.key>long-ear</>. I would regularly come here to record its activities and get some data.

dialogText.cn: 长耳兽吗……管理员，我们不妨帮他找找看？
dialogText.en: A long-ear...? Endmin, maybe we can help Dean look for the critter.

dialogText.cn: 或许那之后他会愿意和我们静下心来谈一谈。
dialogText.en: It might convince him to calm down a little and talk to us.

dialogText.cn: 它平时经常在这里活动，今天却没见到它的影子。
dialogText.en: It's usually active around this place, but I don't see it around today.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>米茜</>！太好了，你果然还活着！
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Missy</>! Thank goodness! You're still alive!

dialogText.cn: 感谢你们，我今天一直找不到它，还以为它也……
dialogText.en: Thank you so much. I spent the entire day looking for it and couldn't find anything. I thought it had...

dialogText.cn: 唉……我们失去了太多。
dialogText.en: Ugh... We lost too much.

dialogText.cn: 我……唉，谁会不在乎这些活生生的生命呢？我们和它们一同生活了这么久……
dialogText.en: I ... ugh. Who wouldn't care about these little creatures? We've lived with them for so many years...

dialogText.cn: 只是，我们没有时间。侵蚀依然存在，裂隙造成的影响也随时可能使环境产生新的变化。
dialogText.en: But we're out of time. The Blight persists, and the impact of the rift might introduce new changes to the environment.

dialogText.cn: 哪怕提前一分钟也好……我想尽早带它们远离这场灾难。
dialogText.en: If I could just take them away from this disaster-stricken place ... even just a minute earlier...

dialogText.cn: 我……我只是无法说服自己。
dialogText.en: I ... I just can't persuade myself.

dialogText.cn: 我们失去了太多，尊敬的师长，并肩奋战的友人……如果我们能早一点发现危险，早一步解决问题……
dialogText.en: We lost too much. Respected mentors, fellow crew mates who fought by our side... If we'd known about the dangers and solved the problem beforehand...

dialogText.cn: 我无法原谅自己在灾难面前什么也没做到，我只能在此时尽可能地多做一些……
dialogText.en: I can't forgive myself for being so useless during the disaster. The only thing I can do now is to do as much as possible...

dialogText.cn: 你说得对，管理员。
dialogText.en: You're right, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 灾难当前，我不应该再为这些幼稚的争执烦心。克莱维尔……他和我本质上没有分歧。
dialogText.en: I shouldn't be getting angry about those stupid arguments. We got a disaster to clean up. Clavell ... he and I aren't truly at odds.

dialogText.cn: 我会回去和克莱维尔好好谈谈的。谢谢你让我清醒了过来。
dialogText.en: I'll head back and talk things through with Clavell. Thanks a lot for clearing up my head.

dialogText.cn: 我们并没有做什么，而是你本就认可他的初衷。
dialogText.en: We didn't do much. You actually agree with his intentions and approach.

dialogText.cn: 我记得应该在这里的……
dialogText.en: I remember it being around here...

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？是弄丢了什么东西吗？
dialogText.en: What is it? Did you lose something?

dialogText.cn: 是你们啊……抱歉，我就那样跑了。
dialogText.en: It's you... Sorry for running away like that back then.

dialogText.cn: 我想了很多，或许是我的表达方式有问题，或许是我没有站在邓恩的立场去考虑……他是丹尼尔斯站长生前最器重的学生……
dialogText.en: I thought about it for a while. Perhaps I didn't say it right. Maybe I should think about things from Dean's perspective... He was Site Director Daniels' favorite apprentice before he... Talos rests his soul...

dialogText.cn: 我在找一个<@qu.key>档案箱</>，里面……是我们过去的一些<@qu.key>实验报告</>。
dialogText.en: I'm looking for a <@qu.key>box of documents</>. It contains ... <@qu.key>logs and reports of the tests</> we ran in the past.

dialogText.cn: 不如我们帮帮他吧，这些报告听起来对他很重要。
dialogText.en: Let's help him. Those reports sound important to Clavell.

dialogText.cn: 就是这个！太好了，里面的报告都还在……
dialogText.en: This is it! Phew ... all the reports are still inside.

dialogText.cn: 什么报告这么重要啊？
dialogText.en: What are these reports? They sound pretty important.

dialogText.cn: 其实……也就只是一些动植物群落的研究报告。
dialogText.en: Well... They're just research reports about several wildlife populations.

dialogText.cn: 不过，这是邓恩做的。
dialogText.en: But Dean ... he's the one who wrote the reports.

dialogText.cn: 邓恩做的？
dialogText.en: Dean wrote these reports?

dialogText.cn: 是的，别看他那么急着深度采掘侵蚀相关的物质……实际上，他也只是方式有些激进。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Don't get fooled by his eagerness for deep excavations and Blighted materials... The only problem is his methods. They can be quite extreme at times...

dialogText.cn: 这些报告里，都是曾被他用那些激进的方式拯救过的生物……它们有的差点陷入灭绝的危机……
dialogText.en: These reports document the organisms he managed to save ... with his extreme measures... Some of them were on the brink of extinction...

dialogText.cn: 不，我并不认可他很多做法……但我必须承认，有时候他那套做法是有效的。
dialogText.en: No, not really. I don't agree with many of his methods... But I must admit that his methods are sometimes rather effective.

dialogText.cn: 他有时会忘乎所以，但……他从没忘记过自己投身科研的初衷。
dialogText.en: He might get carried away at times, but ... he's never forgotten why he became a scientific researcher in the first place.

dialogText.cn: 这是我曾经钦佩过他的地方，但现在情势所迫，他的做法会严重破坏生态，我依然这么认为……
dialogText.en: I used to admire that about him. However, situation has changed. His methods will seriously impact the local ecology. I still stand by my views...

dialogText.cn: 这也是我们能共事这么多年的原因。
dialogText.en: And that is why we got along all these years as fellow researchers.

dialogText.cn: 我尽可能保障实验环境的稳定性，但……有时确实比他缺了那么一点冒险精神。
dialogText.en: I do my best to ensure the stability of the testing environment. But ... I'm also aware that I sometimes lack his adventurous spirit.

dialogText.cn: 总有人要考虑失败的后果，承担起失败的责任，我必须要考虑每一步。
dialogText.en: Nevertheless, someone must assess the outcomes of failures and be responsible for cleaning things up. It is my job to consider every step of the process.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我们还是应该讨论一下是否存在更两全其美的方法。
dialogText.en: Right now, we should be working toward a consensus that both sides can agree on.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，看到这些报告，我更加坚信了这一点。
dialogText.en: Thank you for finding these reports for me. Reading through them has convinced me to do just that.

dialogText.cn: 我要回去找<@qu.key>邓恩</>聊聊，我们不应该像这样争吵。
dialogText.en: I'm heading back to talk with <@qu.key>Dean</>. We shouldn't be arguing like this.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，这才对嘛。
dialogText.en: Aww. That's more like it.

dialogText.cn: 这两个人内心深处还是十分认可对方的，只是突如其来的责任和压力让彼此忽视了这一点。
dialogText.en: Deep down, these two have always shared the same vision. They probably ignored this fact due to their sudden responsibilities and the stressful work.

dialogText.cn: 他们缺的只是个契机。好了，我们也回去吧。
dialogText.en: All they need is an opportunity to come to an agreement. Alright, team. Time to head back.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，我和邓恩商议了一下。保障现有生物的生存环境，和划分区域进行深度采掘，这两件事都势在必行。
dialogText.en: Endmin! Supervisor Perlica! Dean and I had a discussion. We got two essential tasks right now — preserving the local wildlife and their habitats, and marking out areas for deep excavations.

dialogText.cn: 只是以指挥部现在的规模，我们不可能二者兼得。所以我们想……借助你们的力量。
dialogText.en: But our current HQ isn't big enough to carry out both of these jobs. So we're thinking ... if it's possible to borrow your strength.

dialogText.cn: 只要这里变得高效，我们或许有办法让二者一起推进。
dialogText.en: If this place gets an efficiency boost, we might be able to make headway in both tasks.

dialogText.cn: 这正是我们此行的目的，也是<@qu.key>集成工业系统</>存在的意义。
dialogText.en: That's exactly why we're here. It's also the purpose of the <@qu.key>AIC Factory</>.

dialogText.cn: 这里有一张图纸，上面是扩大指挥部规模和提高研究效率的规划……
dialogText.en: Here's a blueprint. It illustrates the plans for expanding the HQ and improving its research efficiency...

dialogText.cn: 这、这是艾尔黛拉小姐做的吗？您想得太周到了！方才我们在您面前那么失礼……真让人无地自容。
dialogText.en: Wait ... Miss Ardelia, did you do this on your own? You're so thoughtful! We really made a fool of ourselves back then... I'm so embarrassed right now.

dialogText.cn: 不，这个是……嗯……算了，就当是这么回事吧……
dialogText.en: No, this is the work... Uh... Forget it... Yeah...

dialogText.cn: 而且……我还差得很远呢，还在不断向前辈学习。
dialogText.en: And truth be told... There's a lot that I have to learn from the professionals.

dialogText.cn: 我们会用<@qu.key>集成工业系统</>帮助你们，进一步推进指挥部的建设工作。
dialogText.en: We will use the <@qu.key>AIC Factory</> to provide assistance and support the expansion of the HQ.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们来了？抱歉，我没留意到，应该去接你们的。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here? Sorry, I should've arranged to receive you properly.

dialogText.cn: 听说你和<@qu.key>邓恩</>有些分歧，发生了什么？
dialogText.en: I heard about your disagreements with <@qu.key>Dean</>. Can you tell me the details?

dialogText.cn: 这个……唉……
dialogText.en: About that ... yeah...

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>地质探针</>本质上是勘探设备，围绕勘探成果进行各种各样的实验，才是解决生态问题的关键。
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>geological probe</> serves as a surveillance tool, and the results it provides must undergo various testing. This process is essential to addressing the ecological devastation in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地的生态面临毁灭性打击。我希望先保障环境稳定性，搭建试验田、人工栖息地，将更多动植物保护起来。
dialogText.en: My priority is to safeguard environmental stability by building test plots and artificial habitats. These will help preserve the local flora and fauna.

dialogText.cn: 可邓恩他不这么想，他坚称什么要趁现在先进行危险的侵蚀研究。
dialogText.en: But Dean doesn't agree. He insists on running the highly dangerous Blight testing first.

dialogText.cn: 这两项研究有什么冲突吗？
dialogText.en: Do the two research projects go against each other?

dialogText.cn: 当然有了！如果现阶段就深度采掘，进行侵蚀相关的物质研究，容易加剧生态系统退化。
dialogText.en: Of course! If we push ahead with deep excavation and start Blight-related material research right now, we risk further degrading the local ecology.

dialogText.cn: 一些动植物群落很可能被人为的环境变化所影响，变得难以生存。
dialogText.en: Human changes to the environment might also affect certain wildlife communities. Their survival might be jeopardized.

dialogText.cn: 我们的初衷是恢复生态、保护生态，现在却要主动去破坏这仅存的稳定环境吗？
dialogText.en: Our vision is to restore and protect the ecology. So why are we actively disrupting the only stable environment we have left?

dialogText.cn: 太过火了，这样做风险太大了，绝对不行的！
dialogText.en: That's going too far. The risks are off the charts! I won't let this happen! Absolutely not!

dialogText.cn: 放松点，我们只是想了解情况。
dialogText.en: Alright. Calm down a bit. We're just trying to get a general picture here.

dialogText.cn: 我们去问问另外一边的想法吧。
dialogText.en: Let's go and ask what the other side thinks.

dialogText.cn: 是管理员？你们什么时候来了，我给你们找地方坐一坐……
dialogText.en: Endmin? When did you arrive? I'll grab a few seats for you...

dialogText.cn: 不用了，我们来主要是听说你们起了争执……
dialogText.en: We're good. Actually, we're here to learn more about your recent disagreements...

dialogText.cn: 不算什么争执，我就是看不太惯<@qu.key>克莱维尔</>那副做事瞻前顾后的样子！
dialogText.en: It's not really a disagreement. I just can't stand <@qu.key>Clavell's</> excessive cautiousness over everything!

dialogText.cn: 我们对四号谷地的受灾情况目前一无所知，尽早弄清楚那些受影响物质的性质，才能更早地解除危机。
dialogText.en: We know nothing about the state of Valley IV after the disaster. Our priority is to quickly figure out the properties of the affected materials. Knowledge will help us solve this crisis.

dialogText.cn: 在这种情况下犹犹豫豫，只会错过研究这些物质的最佳时间。倘若它们出现更复杂的变化，研究只会被拖得更久！
dialogText.en: While we hesitate and squander our time away, we miss perfect opportunities to study these materials! And if they start changing in increasingly complex ways, our research will be further delayed!

dialogText.cn: 好像有点道理。
dialogText.en: Yeah, that kinda makes sense.

dialogText.cn: 但克莱维尔想要先观察和保护供能高地的动植物群落……他没想过这里究竟有多少种生物吗？
dialogText.en: But Clavell wants to observe and protect the wildlife communities of the Power Plateau first... I hope he realizes just how many lifeforms we're talking about here.

dialogText.cn: 等到解救完那些生物后，我们还有没有机会研究清楚那些异常的物质就很难说了。
dialogText.en: Once we're done rescuing all the critters, I doubt we'll still have the chance to study the anomalous materials.

dialogText.cn: 他应该知道时间、机会的重要性才对吧？这么多年真是一点都没变过！
dialogText.en: He should know the importance of timing and opportunity. I guess he's learned nothing after all these years!

dialogText.cn: 冷静一下，我们只是来了解情况的。
dialogText.en: Take it easy. We're just trying to understand the situation.

dialogText.cn: 他们两人似乎都有自己的道理，但事情总不能拖着……
dialogText.en: Both of them make a lot of sense, you know. But we can't let this carry on...

dialogText.cn: 他的道理只是他自己性格导致的，杞人忧天罢了！
dialogText.en: His logic is only driven by his feelings. He's just a paranoid blight-brain!

dialogText.cn: 多做些准备，减少损失，这叫杞人忧天吗？你忘记你那冲动莽撞的方式给克劳老师制造过多少麻烦了吗？
dialogText.en: Paranoid? Being properly prepared can cut your losses! You're always rushing and bumbling into things! Do you know how problematic you've been for Professor Crowe?

dialogText.cn: 你还拿克劳老师压我？那你忘了是谁搞砸了克劳老师最后那场实验吗？
dialogText.en: Oh, now you're trying to bring up Professor Crowe! Well, I hope you didn't forget about the buggerloid who messed up the Professor's last experiment!

dialogText.cn: 再让我回答一百次我也会说我没做错，但你的任性妄为可就不一样了！
dialogText.en: And I'll say it again in your face! I didn't do anything wrong! But you, sir! Your stiff-necked stubbornness to do everything your way is different!

dialogText.cn: 呃……你们都冷静一下。
dialogText.en: Uh-oh... Can we all just take a deep breath?

dialogText.cn: 两位！克劳先生让你们一起领导这个项目，肯定不是希望你们这样吵架的！
dialogText.en: Gentlemen! Please! Mr. Crowe didn't make you project leads just to see you argue all day!

dialogText.cn: ……看在几位终末地朋友的分上，我不和你计较了。
dialogText.en: ...Hrrr. I'm taking a step back, because our Endfielder friends say so.

dialogText.cn: 我还懒得理你呢，哼！
dialogText.en: Whatever, Mister. I'm not paying any attention to you!

dialogText.cn: 如你所见……前辈，我最多只能让他们不吵起来……
dialogText.en: As you can see, Professor... The most I could do is to stop their arguments from getting any worse...

dialogText.cn: 不，你已经很了不起了……
dialogText.en: It's okay... You did good...

dialogText.cn: 这样下去不是个办法，管理员，我们去劝劝他们吧。
dialogText.en: We can't let this go on. Endmin, we should try talking to them.

dialogText.cn: 克劳先生，你在联络中提到有棘手的问题，但你看起来……
dialogText.en: Mr. Crowe, your message said you had a problem, but you seem to be...

dialogText.cn: 看起来不慌不忙是吗？
dialogText.en: Seem to be a little too relaxed, right?

dialogText.cn: 那个邮件是我让学徒帮我发的，没想到他用了那样的措辞。
dialogText.en: I asked my apprentice to send that message. He probably exaggerated the matter a little.

dialogText.cn: 我们确实遇到了一些问题，不过……我以为他们能够自己解决麻烦的。
dialogText.en: We did run into a few issues, and I thought they could handle the problems on their own, but...

dialogText.cn: 他们？你指的是……
dialogText.en: They? You're talking about...

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>邓恩</>和<@qu.key>克莱维尔</>，他俩已经失联了一整天。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Dean</> and<@qu.key> Clavell</>. We couldn't get in touch with them for an entire day.

dialogText.cn: 什么？
dialogText.en: WHAT?!

dialogText.cn: 我不关心他们去做什么了，我只在意指挥部的工作受到了影响。
dialogText.en: I don't care what they are doing. What I care about is work being affected at the HQ.

dialogText.cn: 我把建造地质探针这件事交给他们，并不是希望他俩过多依赖你们的力量。
dialogText.en: I did give them the geological probe construction project, but that doesn't mean I want them to keep asking you for assistance.

dialogText.cn: 工团需要有人挑起大梁……那位灾害研究员……艾尔黛拉小姐已经帮了我们够多了。
dialogText.en: Someone must carry the torch of the UWST... The disaster scientist ... Miss Ardelia ... she has already provided plenty of help.

dialogText.cn: 但眼下建造进度堪忧，他俩又不知所踪。我只能指望你们帮忙了。
dialogText.en: But current progress of the probe is worrying, and the two lads went missing. I have no choice but to request your support.

dialogText.cn: 他们或许陷入了危险……你不担心吗？
dialogText.en: They may be in danger... Aren't you worried about that?

dialogText.cn: 我要担心的事多了。他们不能再把自己当学徒，需要为自己负责。
dialogText.en: I got too many things to worry about. Dean and Clavell should stop treating themselves as apprentices. They must learn to be responsible for their own actions.

dialogText.cn: ……我知道了。
dialogText.en: ...I understand.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们去看看有没有什么线索吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's head over there and see if we can find any clues.

dialogText.cn: 啊，你们来了？
dialogText.en: Ah, you're here.

dialogText.cn: 这张地图的所有人是……<@qu.key>邓恩</>？上面……供能单元的位置画了个圈……
dialogText.en: The owner of this map is ... <@qu.key>Dean</>? There's also a circle drawn around that ... power supply unit...

dialogText.cn: 这是工团的新型号供能单元，超域试验场多年研究的结晶……他打算用这个给地质探针供能吗？
dialogText.en: That's a new UWST power supply unit. The Æther Test Site spent years building this... Is he trying to use it to supply power to the geological probe?

dialogText.cn: 但超域试验场附近被损坏得很严重吧，还能找到供能单元吗？
dialogText.en: But the areas around the Æther Test Site have been seriously devastated. Can anyone still recover the power supply unit?

dialogText.cn: 他标注了<@qu.key>位置信息</>……说明那里可能存在找到的希望。
dialogText.en: He marked the <@qu.key>location</> on the map... It means there's still hope of recovering the facility.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，我们去看看，希望他不要遇到危险。
dialogText.en: Let's head over and investigate. Hope he didn't run into trouble.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！总算……总算找到救兵了……
dialogText.en: Endmin! Oh finally ... someone came at last...

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>克莱维尔</>他……
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Clavell</>... He's...

dialogText.cn: 别急，慢点说。
dialogText.en: Catch your breath first, then tell us what happened.

dialogText.cn: 我们找到了仅剩的新型供能单元，之前为了做数据测试存放在这里。
dialogText.en: We found what's left of our new power supply units. They were stored here for data testing.

dialogText.cn: 我们用了一整天才找到这里，没想到……附近居然还有天使！
dialogText.en: It took us the entire day to reach this place, but ... this area is infested with Aggeloi!

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>克莱维尔</>……他把<@qu.key>天使</>引到了<@qu.key>山崖边</>……
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Clavell</> ... he managed to lure the <@qu.key>Aggeloi</> to the cliff...

dialogText.cn: 天使！就他一个人吗？
dialogText.en: Aggeloi! Is he alone?

dialogText.cn: 对……我突破不了外围的天使……本想着回去喊救援，这才遇见了你们。
dialogText.en: Yeah... I couldn't get through the Aggeloi that got him surrounded, so I rushed back to ask for help ... and then I ran into you.

dialogText.cn: 先不多说了。管理员，我们去救人！
dialogText.en: 'Nuff said. Endmin, we got people to save!

dialogText.cn: 啊……你、你们……
dialogText.en: Oh... It's ... it's you...!

dialogText.cn: 吓死我了，我还以为要死在这里……
dialogText.en: I was so scared! I thought I was going to die here...

dialogText.cn: 你一个人能拖住天使这么久，真应该感慨一下自己命大。
dialogText.en: You distracted the Aggeloi long enough on your own. You should count yourself super lucky.

dialogText.cn: 确实……谢谢，谢谢你们又救了我一命。
dialogText.en: That's true... Well, thank you for saving my life once again.

dialogText.cn: 是<@qu.key>邓恩</>告诉我们你在这里，他很担心你。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Dean</> told us you were here. He's worried about you.

dialogText.cn: 你到底在干什么？
dialogText.en: What by Talos were you doing?

dialogText.cn: 你知道<@qu.key>天使</>有多危险吗？就算真要引开<@qu.key>天使</>，也应该让我来！你知道怎么保护自己吗？知道怎么避开攻击吗？
dialogText.en: Do you know how dangerous the <@qu.key>Aggeloi </>are? If you want to distract <@qu.key>them</>, I should be the one doing it! Do you know self-defense? Do you even know how to dodge incoming attacks?

dialogText.cn: 早知道就该把你留在指挥部，盯着读数表，就不该把你带过来！
dialogText.en: I should never have brought you along! You're better off staying at the HQ and copying numbers off the dials.

dialogText.cn: 你说什么？如果不是我跟过来，你现在已经被天使干掉了吧？
dialogText.en: What nonsense are you talking about? If I hadn't come along, those Aggeloi would have killed you!

dialogText.cn: 我为什么要跟着你过来，不就是害怕你把事情搞砸了吗？结果呢？是不是差点玩儿完？
dialogText.en: I came along because I feared you'd mess things up! And guess what! You almost did, my blightbrained genius!

dialogText.cn: 每次都让你多想一步，多准备一些，但你什么时候听进去过？
dialogText.en: I kept telling you to consider the possible risks and get prepped for them. But you never listened!

dialogText.cn: 好啦好啦，你们都是在为对方考虑，别在这里吵架了。
dialogText.en: That's enough for now, boys. You're just both worried about each other. Let's call it quits and shake hands, okay?

dialogText.cn: 这家伙平时胆子比谁都小，没想到疯起来连命都不要了，谁知道下一次还会不会出类似的事！
dialogText.en: Well, the dude usually avoids dangerous stuff, but this time he went crazy and almost got himself killed. I don't know if he's going to do that again!

dialogText.cn: 只要不是和你这个不靠谱的人搭档，就不可能再有下一次。
dialogText.en: As long as they force me to team up with the least reliable partner in history, you can bet it's gonna happen again!

dialogText.cn: 你们原来在这里啊，大家都没受什么伤吧？
dialogText.en: Ah, everyone's here! No one's hurt, I hope.

dialogText.cn: 艾尔黛拉？你怎么来了？
dialogText.en: Ardelia? I'm surprised you came.

dialogText.cn: 我听说你们来找他们两位了，担心他们又在外面遇到了危险，还好有前辈你们在。
dialogText.en: I heard that you were looking for our two project leads. So, I got a little worried they might run into trouble in the wilderness. I'm so glad you're here to help out.

dialogText.cn: 我们……
dialogText.en: We...

dialogText.cn: 这次主要是……
dialogText.en: So the main problem this time was...

dialogText.cn: 你们两个，先答应我，两个人都别再让自己陷入危险中了，好吗？
dialogText.en: I need you two to promise me, no more running into dangerous trouble, okay?

dialogText.cn: 你说得对……
dialogText.en: Um... Alright...
Okay...

dialogText.cn: 这才对嘛，既然大家都平安无事，其他问题就没什么大不了的了，我们赶紧回去吧。
dialogText.en: Good. Since everyone's safe, I don't think we have other problems to worry about. Let's head back right away.

dialogText.cn: 克劳先生发现你们两个一整天没回来，已经气得胡子都立起来了。
dialogText.en: Mr. Crowe hasn't seen you around for the entire day. Oh, he's so angry his beard is literally quivering with fury!

dialogText.cn: ……我们先回去吧，有什么事回去再说。
dialogText.en: ...Yeah, better head back right now. We'll talk later.

dialogText.cn: 你说得对……
dialogText.en: You're right...

dialogText.cn: 他们两个一不留神就会吵起来，克劳先生可担心他们了。
dialogText.en: Mr. Crowe always worries about these two. They'll start arguing over the smallest things.

dialogText.cn: 是吗？我还以为克劳对他俩吵架都见怪不怪了。
dialogText.en: Really? I thought Mr. Crowe had already grown used to their endless bickering.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会呢，他们两个可是克劳先生最为看重的学徒，克劳先生私下里为他们费了很多心。
dialogText.en: That's not true. They're Mr. Crowe's top apprentices. The old man is secretly working hard to give them the training they need.

dialogText.cn: 大家都平安真是太好了。时候不早，我们也该回去了。
dialogText.en: I'm just glad that nobody's hurt. Anyway, it's getting late. We should be heading back as well.

dialogText.cn: 这……这个能源方案不是失败了吗？
dialogText.en: Wait... I thought this energy supply plan failed and couldn't work.

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事？你们在看什么？
dialogText.en: What's going on? What are you looking at?

dialogText.cn: 大型<@qu.key>地质探针</>的能耗需求非常庞大，我们原先设计的能源方案已经满足不了探针的正常运作……
dialogText.en: The large <@qu.key>geological probe</> is an energy guzzler. The energy supply plan we originally designed couldn't get the thing working properly...

dialogText.cn: 就是为此我们才冒险去回收新型<@qu.key>供能单元</>的，但这……它居然能用了？
dialogText.en: That's why we took the risks and headed outside to salvage the new <@qu.key>energy supply units</>. But ... how? The probe is actually working properly.

dialogText.cn: 看来我们之前的思路是正确的，是你做了什么吧？你调了哪个参数？
dialogText.en: Well, it seems like our approach was actually correct. Or maybe you did something. What variable did you tweak?

dialogText.cn: 不……我还以为是你换了核心元件导致的……
dialogText.en: I didn't tweak anything... I thought it started working because you swapped out a core component...

dialogText.cn: 先别管那么多了，这一趟落下的工作都堆成山了，这下问题解决了，赶紧干活吧！
dialogText.en: Let's just ignore that for now. Work has piled up in our absence. Now that the probe is finally running, we should start our jobs!

dialogText.cn: 别着急，我得先测试一下稳定性……
dialogText.en: Not so fast. I got to run a stability test...

dialogText.cn: 所以这到底是……
dialogText.en: So what really happened...?

dialogText.cn: 解决了能耗问题，地质探针的建设可以进入下一阶段了。
dialogText.en: Since it seems we've solved the energy issue, we can initiate the next phase of the geological probe construction project.

dialogText.cn: 啊，终末地的各位，你们来了。
dialogText.en: Ah, my friends from Endfield. You're here.

dialogText.cn: 我们收到了消息，想来看看<@qu.key>地质探针</>的进展……只是……周围为什么如此混乱？
dialogText.en: We received your message and came to check on the <@qu.key>geological probe's</> progress. But ... the entire work site appears somewhat ... disorganized.

dialogText.cn: 主要是因为……探针的建造工序只差最后一步了，但勘察单元的参数集和信息样本还是没法确定……
dialogText.en: That's primarily because ... probe construction is just one step away from completion. However, we have yet to verify the parameter set and data samples of the surveillance unit...

dialogText.cn: 工人们因为这些事忙坏了……
dialogText.en: The entire crew is exhausted by the task...

dialogText.cn: 那邓恩和克莱维尔他们呢？
dialogText.en: What about Dean and Clavell?

dialogText.cn: 他们……先是在吵架，被大家劝说后就各忙各的去了。
dialogText.en: They ... started arguing first. People got them to cool off before moving on with their jobs.

dialogText.cn: 我就知道。
dialogText.en: I knew it.

dialogText.cn: 发生了这么多事还没长记性，活该他们搞砸。
dialogText.en: The two boys learned nothing from their experiences and made a fool of themselves. They deserve it.

dialogText.cn: 眼下解决勘察单元的问题才是关键。
dialogText.en: Nevertheless, we should try to fix the problems with our surveillance unit.

dialogText.cn: 放心吧，真到收拾不了场面的时候，我会把问题解决的，只不过我现在一点也不想出手帮他们。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Supervisor. If the sitch gets out of control, I'll step in and get it fixed. But now, I don't intend to interfere or help them out of their mess.

dialogText.cn: 原来你一直都有办法啊，那为什么眼睁睁看着他们把事情搞得复杂？
dialogText.en: So you actually know how to get everything done! Then ... why would you just sit around and let them mess things up?

dialogText.cn: 我倒是希望他们能顺顺利利地把问题解决！但是，他们行吗？
dialogText.en: I actually want to let them achieve spectacular success on their own! But look at 'em! Can they pull it off?

dialogText.cn: 不像我们这辈人，有的人从战场上退下来，在原料都没有的车间里，把车床上的零件拆了来做设备。
dialogText.en: My generation was built different. Some of us got back from the frontlines to work floors that had no materials. We ended up making our own equipment by taking parts off the lathe.

dialogText.cn: 遇到问题就吱吱喳喳的，不知道合作，也放不下那没什么用的自尊。
dialogText.en: This generation has a serious problem. They bicker and complain. They don't know how to work as a team. Worse, they strut around with a sense of useless pride.

dialogText.cn: 哼，如果我还年轻，根本不需要这两个学艺不精的蠢学徒来做这些。
dialogText.en: Hrrrmph. I would have taken care of this on my own if I were younger. I wouldn't even need two inept fools of apprentices to take care of this job.

dialogText.cn: 你这口吻和我们谈剑堂的一位师父有点像……
dialogText.en: The way you said that really sounds like a Shifu we had in Tanjian Hall...

dialogText.cn: 哼，但……四号谷地终归会是他们的。
dialogText.en: Hmph. But ... they'll be running Valley IV one day.

dialogText.cn: 这一次的灾难，也改变了我很多……
dialogText.en: This disaster really changed me as well...

dialogText.cn: 真正派上用场的，是像你们这样的年轻人。连“烙铁指令”的方略都变咯。不管我们再怎么逞能，也该把接力棒传下去了。
dialogText.en: Young people like you will be running the show. We even changed the Utjug Order. No matter how hard we try, I guess it's time to pass on the baton.

dialogText.cn: 虽然他们有不少缺点，但都是很有才华的学徒。
dialogText.en: The apprentices may have plenty of issues, but they are gifted in their own right.

dialogText.cn: 他们得自己学会解决问题，要是再面临这样的灾难，还指望去依靠谁呢？
dialogText.en: That said, they must learn to solve problems on their own. If another disaster like the last one strikes again, they'll have no one to count on.

dialogText.cn: 当然，不是要和您这样了不起的人相提并论。
dialogText.en: Ah, what I meant by young people doesn't include you, Endmin. You're a legend...

dialogText.cn: 只是，工团需要这样一拨年轻人，他们得接过<@qu.key>联盟工团</>的重担。
dialogText.en: However, the UWST needs promising youths to shoulder the burden of the <@qu.key>United Syndicates</>.

dialogText.cn: 希望他们能体会到你的良苦用心。
dialogText.en: I hope they will appreciate all the work you've put in for them.

dialogText.cn: 哼，他们？等着吧，一会儿他们就该哭着喊着找咱们帮忙了。
dialogText.en: Them? Appreciate my work? Well, just sit around. They'll be crying for help soon enough.

dialogText.cn: 他们忽略了太多细节，而探针的初次启动工作还伴随着相当程度的危险……但这一次我没有提醒他们。
dialogText.en: They neglected too many details. The first activation of the probe will involve a certain degree of danger... But I didn't remind them this time.

dialogText.cn: 你不怕出什么事故吗？
dialogText.en: Aren't you worried about accidents?

dialogText.cn: 放心，我不会拿人身安全当儿戏，再说了，还有管理员在这儿，等会儿可以再帮他们一把，让他们吃点苦头，长长记性。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. I won't risk this if human safety is involved. Since the Endmin is with us, we can afford to wait before giving them help. Let them have a taste of their mistakes and learn from it.

dialogText.cn: ……嗯，我明白你的意思了。
dialogText.en: Fine... I understand what you're trying to do.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！你们来啦，这……我们遇到了点状况。
dialogText.en: Endmin! You're here! We got a ... um, situation.

dialogText.cn: 勘察单元的几个关键参数出了些小问题……
dialogText.en: There's a minor hiccup with several key parameters of the surveillance unit...

dialogText.cn: 之前他使用的临时数据搞乱了一组对照数值，我们需要把勘察单元恢复到初始状态。
dialogText.en: So, my friend here used a set of temporary data that messed up our control group. We gotta reset the surveillance unit to its default state.

dialogText.cn: 呃……没错，但现在这个机器出现了故障，一时半会儿可能也修不好，我听说管理员的<@qu.key>源石技艺</>……
dialogText.en: Ah... yeah, that's right. But the machine is now malfunctioning. Repairing it will take a while, but I heard about the Endmin's <@qu.key>Originium Arts</>...

dialogText.cn: 没问题，管理员，我们就帮他们一把。
dialogText.en: No problem. Endmin, we can lend them our assistance.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，这下参数应该没问题了……
dialogText.en: Great. These parameters should work now...

dialogText.cn: 终于顺利解决了。等等，什么声音？
dialogText.en: We finally got it done. Wait. What's that noise?

dialogText.cn: 这个震动声是……
dialogText.en: What is this trembling...?

dialogText.cn: 不好，让开！
dialogText.en: Oh dear. Get out!

dialogText.cn: 啊……终末地的各位，谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: Hooo... Thank you, my Endfielder friends.

dialogText.cn: 还好没人受伤！机器！呼……看起来应该没什么问题。嗯，参数集应该也对了。
dialogText.en: I'm so glad nobody's hurt! Oh! The machine...! Phew... The machine looks fine ... and the parameter set looks right as well.

dialogText.cn: 其实……我们还有一事相求。
dialogText.en: We ... actually need help with one more thing.

dialogText.cn: 勘察所需的<@qu.key>生物样本</>出了点问题，我们已经找到了<@qu.key>替代样本</>，只是样本仓突然……
dialogText.en: We got a few problems with the <@qu.key>bio samples</> required for the surveillance. We found a <@qu.key>replacement</>, but the sample bin...

dialogText.cn: 我来说吧，之前的生物样本出错了，样本仓发生了故障，启动不了。我们的样本仓是独立运作的，内部很精密，也不能强行拆开。
dialogText.en: I'll just lay it straight — we got the wrong bio samples. The sample bin is down and can't be activated. It has an independent operation scheme, and the inner workings are pretty intricate. We can't simply take it all apart.

dialogText.cn: 可能需要管理员想办法帮我们把样本放进去了……
dialogText.en: So, Endmin ... we might need your help to put the samples into the bin...

dialogText.cn: 我知道，管理员会帮忙的。
dialogText.en: I understand. The Endmin will help.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！
dialogText.en: Great!

dialogText.cn: 这下样本就……等等，什么声音？
dialogText.en: Alright. The samples are finally... Wait. What's that noise?
WHOAH!

dialogText.cn: 新的样本还算有效……终于赶上了。
dialogText.en: The new samples are effective... Oh, we finally made it.

dialogText.cn: 好险……还好、还好机器没被破坏。
dialogText.en: That was close... Thank goodness the device is undamaged.

dialogText.cn: 让我看看成果……
dialogText.en: Let me check the results...

dialogText.cn: 看起来还挺像模像样的。你们两个，还挺能干的嘛。
dialogText.en: Wow. This actually looks super impressive. You two turned out to be pretty professional at this.

dialogText.cn: 要不是样本出现了问题，根本不会变得这么乱。
dialogText.en: We wouldn't have been in that mess if we'd had proper samples.

dialogText.cn: 什么？不是因为你把参数弄错了吗？
dialogText.en: What? You're the one who messed up the parameters.

dialogText.cn: 我提醒过你样本的实验环境可能存在变化，参数的问题我自己也能解决。
dialogText.en: I reminded you that the testing environment of the samples might change. And I could totally fix the parameter issues on my own.

dialogText.cn: 怪到我身上了？参数最后不是我帮你算出来的？
dialogText.en: And you're blaming me? I was the one who helped you churn out those parameters!

dialogText.cn: 你信誓旦旦地说能搞定样本，结果不是我找来的替换品？
dialogText.en: Well, you promised that you'd find some proper samples. In the end, it was my replacements that solved the crisis!
Why you...

dialogText.cn: 等一下，怎么回事……<@qu.key>地质探针</>一点动静也没有。
dialogText.en: Hold on, what's happening...? The <@qu.key>geological probe</> isn't doing anything.

dialogText.cn: 什么？让我看看！……到底出了什么问题！
dialogText.en: What?! Let me see! ...What by Talos is wrong this time?

dialogText.cn: 不会啊……奇怪，怎么会这样？
dialogText.en: This isn't supposed to happen... Strange. Why? How?

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 够了！这种时候还想着靠别人解决问题？！
dialogText.en: ENOUGH! Both of you! Can't believe you're still asking others to take care of your problems!!

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师……不是这样，我……
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe ... I ... it wasn't like that...

dialogText.cn: 你说够了吗，邓恩？这么多年了，你改过那毛躁的性格吗？
dialogText.en: Done explaining already, Dean? It's been years and you never bothered changing that unruly personality of yours!

dialogText.cn: 做事只知道闷头往前冲，不计后果，虽然收益高，但损失也重。如果只是资产的损失，那都是你运气好，万一真让谁受伤了呢？
dialogText.en: You're always rushing straight into things without thinking about the consequences. True, you might get rewarded if things work, but the losses are just as great. Consider yourself lucky if we only take property damage, because the way you do things has a chance of inflicting serious injuries!

dialogText.cn: 你承担不了后果，没人承担得了。在你真正伤害到同伴之前，必须学会怎么踩刹车。
dialogText.en: You can't bear the losses. No one can. You gotta learn how to smash the brakes before you actually hurt somebody!

dialogText.cn: 您说得对……
dialogText.en: You're right, Professor...

dialogText.cn: 还有你，别光在一边看着。
dialogText.en: And you. Don't just stand there and gawk.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉……
dialogText.en: I'm sorry...

dialogText.cn: 邓恩有时候说得没错，从事科研工作需要学会向前迈步，不能固步自封。未来的命题谁也无法预料，没人能靠老方法解决一切问题！
dialogText.en: There are times when Dean is actually right. You gotta take a bold step forward in scientific research. You can't make progress by dancing around in circles. No one can predict what we'll be looking at in the future. And no one can solve everything with the same old ways!

dialogText.cn: 该保守的时候保守，但到了需要冒险的时候，也绝不能犹豫，机会稍纵即逝。
dialogText.en: Be cautious when you need it. But when you need to be bold, do not hesitate. Windows of opportunity can disappear in an instant.

dialogText.cn: 我知道了……
dialogText.en: I've learned my lesson...

dialogText.cn: 我任命你们俩一同负责地质探针的建设，就是希望你们互相帮助，补上彼此的缺点。就算一个人上不顶用，也能靠两个人一起想出办法。
dialogText.en: I appointed the two of you to lead the geological probe construction project *because* I want you to help each other out. You two should be covering for each other's deficiencies. Alone, you might slip — but together, you should be able to figure it out.

dialogText.cn: 本以为你们有些长进了，结果呢？不是在吵架就是去求管理员帮忙，最后关头了还指望别人帮自己。这让我怎么放心把四号谷地的重建工作交给你们？
dialogText.en: I thought you learned something from the disaster, but what did I see? Boys who won't stop bickering, who go running off to the Endmin for help. This is the final stage and you still want others to clean up your mess. How am I supposed to let you lead the reconstruction of Valley IV?

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师……
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe...

dialogText.cn: 这次还有我，有管理员帮你们收拾烂摊子，以后呢？再遇到像这次一样的灾难呢？你们还能依靠谁？
dialogText.en: You're lucky you still got me and the Endmin around to sort out your blighted mistakes. But what about next time? If you run into another disaster of this scale, who are you going to turn to?

dialogText.cn: 我申请把你们调到<@qu.key>源石发电站</>了，接替我和丹尼尔斯的工作。以后不会再有人帮你们，也不会再有人训你们了。
dialogText.en: I've submitted applications to assign you to the <@qu.key>Originium Power Plant</>. You'll be taking over my job, and that of old Daniels. No one will be around to help you, and you won't be getting any lessons from anyone.

dialogText.cn: 等等……克劳老师，那你呢？
dialogText.en: Wait...! Professor Crowe... What about you?

dialogText.cn: 我们还离不开克劳老师啊！
dialogText.en: We can't do without you, Professor Crowe!

dialogText.cn: 你们这副样子，重建四号谷地的任务怎么可能交给你们？这是我最后的六年了，别让我再逮到你们惹出什么祸！
dialogText.en: Just look at you sorry lot. How am I supposed to hand over the mission of rebuilding Valley IV? I only have six more years to go. Don't let me catch you stirring up trouble again!

dialogText.cn: 这……好的！
dialogText.en: But... Okay!

dialogText.cn: 我们、我们一定会珍惜这六年的时间！
dialogText.en: We'll ... we'll make full use of these six years!

dialogText.cn: 哼，跟我走，地质探针最后的工序还没处理，别让辛苦了这么久的工人们再等了。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Follow me. There's still the final step for constructing the geological probe. The crew really worked hard for this. Don't keep them waiting.

dialogText.cn: 哇哦！动起来了！
dialogText.en: Wow! It's moving!

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>地质探针</>会不断向地下释放各种类型的同位素、声波和渗透液，回收上来的信息能够帮助科研人员更快地恢复这里的生态。
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>geological probe</> will constantly release various isotopes, sound waves, and penetrants underground. The data we gather will help scientists speed up the healing of the local ecology.

dialogText.cn: 有点期待这里恢复成原本的样子了，我们来到供能高地的时候，这里就已经成了一片废墟了。
dialogText.en: I'm really looking forward to seeing this place restored to its former glory. When we first arrived at the Power Plateau, the place was already in ruins.

dialogText.cn: 那可惜了，这里原本可是很壮观的。
dialogText.en: That's a real shame. The Plateau used to be a scenic location.

dialogText.cn: 放心，我们会把这里建设得更加美丽的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. We'll do our best and make the Plateau more beautiful than ever before.

dialogText.cn: 光阴流转，大地总会迎回它本来的样子。
dialogText.en: Mmmh! With time, the land will slowly rejuvenate and remediate itself.

dialogText.cn: 克劳先生，关于四号谷地的未来，你觉得会变成什么样？
dialogText.en: Mr. Crowe, how do you think Valley IV might change in the future?

dialogText.cn: 我能怎么觉得？指望这帮年轻人？够呛！
dialogText.en: How do I think? If these young people are in charge, the future looks bleak!

dialogText.cn: 不过……无论怎样，未来都会由这群年轻人创造。我当然希望四号谷地变得更好……
dialogText.en: But ... no matter what happens, it's the youths who'll be building the future. I myself want to see Valley IV getting better...

dialogText.cn: 只要这里的人们能维持生活的平稳、安定，我觉得也就够了。
dialogText.en: If the people in the Valley live stable and secure lives, that'd be good enough for me.

dialogText.cn: 说不定，用不了多久，他们就会让您刮目相看了，对吧，前辈？
dialogText.en: Perhaps it won't be long before these young people start to impress you. Right, Professor?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈！我倒希望是这样！不过，塔卫二以后会怎么样，还得看终末地的各位啊！
dialogText.en: Hahahaha! I sure hope so! But the future of Talos-II ... now that will be decided by you, Endfielders!

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 这队伍怎么人人都愁眉苦脸的？
dialogText.en: Why's everyone in this queue looking so serious and sad?

dialogText.cn: 人家毕竟是来避难的，难免有些糟心事嘛。
dialogText.en: People came here to escape the disaster. It's no surprise they're still shaken up.

dialogText.cn: 哎，劳驾往边上挪挪，给我腾点地儿。
dialogText.en: Oh, excuse me. Mind if you move a little? I need some room.

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 大叔，您这身板本来就顶俩人，还背着口锅，这下一个人占两个半位子……
dialogText.en: Sir, you're pretty big yourself. And you're carrying a huge wok on your back. You're taking up two-and-a-half spaces already.

dialogText.cn: 这可是我吃饭的家伙！一会儿你就知道它有多重要了。
dialogText.en: The wok puts food on my table! You'll know how important it is soon enough.

dialogText.cn: 话说回来，这里不是避难点吗？怎么连口像样的灶都没有？
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, this is a refuge point, right? Why don't they have a proper stove?

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 唉，这边救援还没结束，只有自热食品和罐头……
dialogText.en: Well, we haven't completed SAR operations in this area. All we have are instant meals and canned food...

dialogText.cn: 虽说现在救援是头等大事，但在吃饭上一样不能随便应付啊！吃好也吃饱了，救援的时候也更使得上劲儿不是？
dialogText.en: I know search and rescue operations are important, but that's no excuse to give people terrible food! A delicious and satisfying meal will get your SAR crew mates moving faster, right?

dialogText.cn: 大叔……您是宏山人吧？怎么称呼？
dialogText.en: Sir ... you're from Hongshan, aren't you? May I ask your name?

dialogText.cn: 在这里还能碰到老乡？叫我大潘就成！
dialogText.en: A fellow compatriot? Here? Just call me Da Pan!

dialogText.cn: 那是，我们宏山人吃饭向来讲究，哪能凑合？等我待会儿砌个灶，给你们露两手。
dialogText.en: Of course. The people of Hongshan never compromise on food. Never! Once I build my stove, I'll show you what I've got.

dialogText.cn: 好嘞！我是陈千语，在终末地工作。这位是我们管理员，还有佩丽卡监督。
dialogText.en: Alrighty! I'm Chen Qianyu and I work at Endfield Industries. This one here is our Endministrator. And that one is Supervisor Perlica.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 哦，终末地，我知道！是那家找宏科院建了艘飞船的公司吧？
dialogText.en: Oh, Endfield? I heard of it. The company that got HAS to build a spaceship, right?

dialogText.cn: 原本我只是路过四号谷地，哪想到给我困在这里了。
dialogText.en: I was just passing by Valley IV. I never expected to become trapped at this place.

dialogText.cn: 好在我这人一向看得挺开的，搭个帐篷露个营，就当休假了。
dialogText.en: But I always look on the bright side of life. Got myself a little camp, and turned the accident into a nice vacation.

dialogText.cn: 大叔你倒是……挺豁达。
dialogText.en: Wow... You really found the silver lining in these clouds.

dialogText.cn: 那你接下来打算怎么办呢？
dialogText.en: Ahem. So, what are your plans?

dialogText.cn: 我在谷地倒是有几个老朋友，可以去投奔他们。有个叫安德烈的工程师，你们认得吗？
dialogText.en: I got some old friends at the Valley. They might give me a roof over my head. Ever heard of an old owl named Andre?

dialogText.cn: 安德烈？你认识安德烈？
dialogText.en: Andre? You actually know Andre?

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生应该在枢纽区基地。但现在……
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre should be at the Hub Base. But right now...

dialogText.cn: 得了，我心里有数。现在谷地这情况，他肯定忙得脚打后脑勺。
dialogText.en: Well, no need to go looking for him. I understand. The Valley is a mess and the old owl probably has his hands full.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>诺夫曼</>啊，他刚带队救援回来。年纪轻轻挑这么重的担子，不容易啊。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Noffman</>? He just returned with his SAR team. They gave the young lad some really difficult responsibilities. He's got plenty of work ahead of him.

dialogText.cn: 这次救援还顺利吗？
dialogText.en: I hope everything's well with the SAR operations.

dialogText.cn: 我没跟去，具体情况也不知道。回来了不少人，好几个还带着伤。你们找诺夫曼有事？
dialogText.en: I wasn't part of the team so I won't know the details. They found plenty of people, some of them wounded. You got business with Noffman?

dialogText.cn: 按照计划，终末地也要参与避难点的建设。
dialogText.en: According to our plans, Endfield will provide assistance in constructing the refuge point.

dialogText.cn: 终末地也要出手？那太好了！诺夫曼就在前面！
dialogText.en: Oh, Endfield is joining the party? Wonderful! Noffman is just ahead over there!

dialogText.cn: 有三个人的信号断了。当时我害怕耽误大部队撤离，没回去找。
dialogText.en: We lost contact with three of our crew mates. I didn't want to risk delaying the whole crew ... so I chose not to double back and look for them.

dialogText.cn: 现在大部分伤员已经转移到安全区域。我觉得……还有一线希望。
dialogText.en: Most of the injured have been relocated to a safe zone. I think ... there's still a chance.

dialogText.cn: 我打算回去再找一趟——我、我自己去！
dialogText.en: So I've decided to head back and look for them. I-I'll do this alone!

actorName.cn: 冷静的工人{f1m9-冷静的工人}

dialogText.cn: 冷静点……他们的定位信号已经中断了，现在回去找，跟大海捞针没什么两样。
dialogText.en: Calm down... We're no longer getting their positioning signals... Searching for them is just like looking for needles in a haystack.

actorName.cn: 冷静的工人{f1m9-冷静的工人}

dialogText.cn: 而且这里还有很多事需要你这个负责人处理。避难点床位不够，裂地者也随时可能来袭……
dialogText.en: And you're the site monitor. There are plenty of things here that need your attention. We don't have enough beds in the refuge point, and the breakers might attack us any time...

dialogText.cn: ……你说得对，可是——
dialogText.en: You're right, but...

dialogText.cn: 你们是……？
dialogText.en: Who are you again...?

dialogText.cn: 我们是终末地危机处理小组。我是监督佩丽卡，这位是我们的管理员。
dialogText.en: We're the Endfield Crisis Team. I'm Supervisor Perlica, and this is our Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？……天哪，真的是你们！
dialogText.en: Endministrator? ...By Talos, you are really here!

dialogText.cn: 还有干员陈千语！我们接到了工团安全局的通信，来看看有什么能帮得上忙的。
dialogText.en: And I'm Operator Chen Qianyu! We've received a call from the UWST Security Bureau. That's why we're here to see if there's anything we can help with.

dialogText.cn: 我是诺夫曼，目前担任基建前站的临时负责人，各位来得可太及时了……
dialogText.en: I'm Noffman, and I'm the temporary site monitor of the Infra-Station. You came at just the right time...

dialogText.cn: 听刚才的讨论，似乎有人员失踪了？如果有需要，我们可以代为寻找。
dialogText.en: We heard something about missing personnel. If you need help, we can assist with the search.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的人我当然信得过……那就……辛苦各位了！
dialogText.en: Of course! You have my trust, Endfielders... Please ... I'm counting on you!

dialogText.cn: 失踪人员最后的信号在<@qu.key>实验园区</>旁的断崖那里。千万要小心，那边还有不少侵蚀……
dialogText.en: The last signals from our missing personnel were sent from the cliffs next to the <@qu.key>Science Park</>. Be careful, though. The place is filled with the Blight...

dialogText.cn: 放心，交给我们吧！
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Leave it to us!

dialogText.cn: 这次救援没能把所有人撤回来，是我一个人的责任。
dialogText.en: It's all my fault. We couldn't get everyone evacced in the SAR operation.

dialogText.cn: 我明白了……你们已经尽力了。
dialogText.en: I understand... You've already done your best.

dialogText.cn: 都是我的错……要是我当时放慢点速度，他们也许就……
dialogText.en: It's all my fault... If I'd slowed down a little, they might have...

dialogText.cn: 不，不对。是我安排得有问题。那时候就该让最有经验的人殿后……
dialogText.en: If only I had arranged it better... I should have placed the best veterans at the rear...

dialogText.cn: 救援的事……面对瞬息万变的情况做决策，很难十全十美。你也别太自责。
dialogText.en: Well, making decisions for SAR operations ... can be tough, especially when the situation keeps changing. Hardly anyone can make the perfect call. Don't blame yourself.

dialogText.cn: 还记得遇见我那会儿吗？当时要不是你眼疾手快把我拉回来，就得是我被侵蚀炖一锅了。
dialogText.en: Remember the time when we met? You reacted quickly and pulled me to safety. You saved my fat Ursus butt from becoming a pot of Blight stew.

dialogText.cn: 现在能有地方落脚，已经谢天谢地啦。嗯，不过，这地儿视野不行，裂地者又不安分，要是连个像样的瞭望塔都没有，往后可不好办……你觉得呢，诺夫曼小兄弟？
dialogText.en: I'm super thankful that I've got some roof over my head. But this place has no vantage. Local Landbreakers aren't very friendly as well. Things might get difficult without a proper watch tower... What do you think, Noffman?

dialogText.cn: 对……对。大潘先生，你说得对。我这就组织人手，先把瞭望塔建起来。
dialogText.en: Yeah... You're absolutely right, Mr. Da Pan. I'll get a crew started on raising that watch tower at once.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>集成工业系统</>可以派上用场，加快基建前站的建设速度。
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>AIC Factory</> might be useful. We can use it to accelerate the construction of the Infra-Station.

dialogText.cn: 那、那太好了！需要我配合你们做些什么吗？
dialogText.en: Oh, that would be great! Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 我们需要一片开阔区域，用于投放<@qu.key>次级核心</>。
dialogText.en: We need some open space for deploying our <@qu.key>Sub-Protocol Automation-Core</>.

dialogText.cn: 我想想……那里应该合适，快跟我来。
dialogText.en: Let me think... I believe we have a place like that. Follow me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们回来了？
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're back.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，你看这片区域怎么样？
dialogText.en: What do you think of this plot of land, Supervisor Perlica?

dialogText.cn: 土地平坦，视野开阔，信号也很好。这里确实很合适。
dialogText.en: It's flat, and offers decent vantage as well as signal connections. This is actually what we're looking for.

dialogText.cn: 只要集成工业系统运作起来，这里就能成为所有受灾人员的庇护所。
dialogText.en: Once the AIC Factory starts working, it'll be churning out shelters for all refugees in this place.

dialogText.cn: 事不宜迟，赶快开工吧！
dialogText.en: We shouldn't waste any time! Let's get things rolling!

dialogText.cn: 快看！<@qu.key>次级核心</>已经放置好了！
dialogText.en: Look! The <@qu.key>Sub-PAC</> has been deployed!

dialogText.cn: 有了它，避难点的建设就有了物资上的保障。
dialogText.en: Now that the Sub-PAC is here, we can finally guarantee supplies for constructing this refuge point.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？有什么事吗？我这边时间有点紧，好多事还等着我处理。
dialogText.en: What is it, Endmin? I'm a little short on time. Plenty of things require my attention.

dialogText.cn: 谈不上顺利，但好在有条不紊地推进着。
dialogText.en: Not as smooth as we like, but we're progressing according to schedule.

dialogText.cn: 说真的，多亏了你们的集成工业系统，不然我们也没法推进得这么顺利。
dialogText.en: Truth be told, your AIC Factory really saved us. It's the only reason we were able to make decent progress.

dialogText.cn: 我打算先扩建安置区，再设一个临时食堂，但最关键的还是瞭望塔。你也看到了，这地方什么都行，就是视野太差了。
dialogText.en: I planned on building the temporary shelter first, and then an improvised canteen. But what we need most is the watch tower. You saw it yourself. This place is great, but the vantage is terrible.

dialogText.cn: 你已经做得够多了，本就是希望渺茫的任务。
dialogText.en: You did more than enough. We all knew the odds.

dialogText.cn: 但……我心里总觉得，他们可能还活着。
dialogText.en: But ... I can't help but feel that they're ... still alive.

dialogText.cn: 那是我第一次带队参与搜救，可能我把太多个人情绪带进去了，没能做得更好……
dialogText.en: It was my first SAR operation. Perhaps I got too emotionally invested in it. I could have done a better job...

dialogText.cn: 好，管理员，之后有什么事我再联系你。
dialogText.en: Sure, Endmin. I'll call you once something comes up.

dialogText.cn: 你们从哪里搞来的这些东西？工团的人呢？
dialogText.en: Where did you get this stuff, breaker? Where are the UWST crew mates?
*Mumbles*......

dialogText.cn: 你说什么？
dialogText.en: What did you just say?

dialogText.cn: 呵呵……捡的……
dialogText.en: Hurk... hurhur... I'se ... picked it up...

dialogText.cn: 捡的？
dialogText.en: Picked it up?

dialogText.cn: 这里离信号最后消失的地点有一些距离。
dialogText.en: We're still quite far from the place where their signals went dark.

dialogText.cn: 如果裂地者没有撒谎，说明那些工人还在附近活动……生还的可能性很大。
dialogText.en: If the Landbreaker wasn't lying to us, it means our missing crew mates might just be around here... There's a good possibility that they are still alive.

dialogText.cn: 我们继续找诺夫曼吧。
dialogText.en: Let's keep looking for Noffman.

dialogText.cn: 这是……工团的设备？
dialogText.en: Wait... This looks like UWST equipment.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你们怎么都来了……
dialogText.en: Endmin? Everyone... You're all here...

dialogText.cn: 我接到消息，说这附近几个裂地者的手上，好像有工团配发的设备，我以为……
dialogText.en: I received reports of a few Landbreakers equipped with UWST gear. I thought...

dialogText.cn: 我以为……也许还有希望。哪怕只有一点点……
dialogText.en: I thought ... there might be a chance. A slim chance ... that they're still...

dialogText.cn: 结果什么也没找到，大家跑了这么一趟，还有人受了伤……
dialogText.en: But we found nothing. The entire SAR crew ran through the place. Some of us even got wounded...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢……至少这趟不是毫无收获。
dialogText.en: Thank you... Well, at least this wasn't a wasted trip.

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼，你没事吧……可算把你找到了。大家都在，人也没少。
dialogText.en: Noffman, you alright...? Finally found you. Looks like the whole team's here — that's a relief.

dialogText.cn: 管理员来之前，就是你们几个在对付那些裂地者？干得漂亮！
dialogText.en: Were you the ones fighting the Landbreakers before the Endmin arrived? Nicely done!

dialogText.cn: ……谢谢，大潘先生。不过……
dialogText.en: ...Thank you, Mr. Da Pan, but...

dialogText.cn: 队伍现在多了伤员，走不快，可他们的伤势拖不起，必须尽早赶回去！
dialogText.en: With so many casualties, moving quickly isn't possible. But their injuries need immediate care. We must head back at once!

dialogText.cn: 欸，从这里往那边看，能看到基建前站！
dialogText.en: Hey! If we look that way, we can see the Infra-Station!

dialogText.cn: 是啊，就隔着一道大裂谷，直线距离其实不远。
dialogText.en: Yes, there's a big chasm in between, but the direct distance isn't actually that far.

dialogText.cn: 你们终末地不是有那个……能在天上“嗖”一下飞过去的设备吗？
dialogText.en: I remember you Endfielders got this ... facility that lets you "SWOOSH" your way across in the mid-air, right?

dialogText.cn: ……你说的是<@qu.key>滑索</>？
dialogText.en: Are you talking about <@qu.key>ziplines</>...?

dialogText.cn: 对对对！就是那个！要不咱们试试？
dialogText.en: Yeah! That's it! Of course! Should we give that a shot?

dialogText.cn: 那就这么定了！我去看看伤员，希望都是些皮外伤。
dialogText.en: Alright, sounds good! I'll go check on the injured while you handle that — fingers crossed it's nothing more than scratches.

dialogText.cn: 这设备……和工团的风格完全不一样。
dialogText.en: These facilities... They look really different compared to UWST machinery.

dialogText.cn: 看着是不是挺纤细？不过你放心，我们的设备可结实着呢。
dialogText.en: They look pretty delicate, right? Appearance can be deceiving. Endfield hardware is built to last.

dialogText.cn: 设备已经就绪了，赶紧开始转运伤员吧。
dialogText.en: The facilities are in place. Let's start moving the injured.

dialogText.cn: ……最近我总睡不好，满脑子都是掉队的人。
dialogText.en: ...I could hardly sleep at night these past couple of days. I can't stop thinking about the crew mates who went missing.

dialogText.cn: 你可能不信，我总觉得……他们也许还活着。
dialogText.en: It may sound hopeful, but I believe they're still out there, alive...

dialogText.cn: 但我不能再拿同伴的命去赌了，不能再这样了……
dialogText.en: But I can't put the team's lives at risk again. Not anymore...

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼小兄弟，你救了我们几十号人，往后你还要去救更多的人。
dialogText.en: Noffman my boy, you saved all of us. You gave dozens of lives a chance. We're counting on you to save more people.

dialogText.cn: ……你说得对。基建前站的人越来越多，我也得……保护好他们。
dialogText.en: ...You're right. We got plenty of people at the Infra-Station. I should ... take proper care of them.

dialogText.cn: 这就对嘛！想明白了就好。走，干活之前先吃饭！
dialogText.en: That's the spirit! I'm glad you sorted it out. I say it's time for a meal! Only work when you got food in the belly!

dialogText.cn: 你们几位，一起来吗？
dialogText.en: Hey, team! You coming along?

dialogText.cn: 你觉得有戏，咱们就继续找！瞭望塔的位置合适，咱们先把信号接收器装上去。只要有风吹草动，我第一个跟你冲！
dialogText.en: If you believe they're still out there, then we should keep looking! The watch tower is perfect for mounting a signal receiver. If we receive anything, I'll be the first to tell you!

dialogText.cn: 多亏了你们，大家总算安全了。
dialogText.en: Oh, thank goodness you're here to help us. Everyone is now safe.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，谢谢你们出手相助。要不是你们帮忙……后果真是不堪设想。
dialogText.en: Thank you for helping us, Endministrator. If it weren't for you ... things would have been disastrous.

dialogText.cn: 大潘先生的话启发了我，我打算给瞭望塔上加装一个信号接收器。
dialogText.en: Mr. Da Pan's words inspired me. I'm going to install a signal receiver on the watch tower.

dialogText.cn: 这样我们就能更快地锁定求援信号，也能提高救援效率。
dialogText.en: This will help us lock on to SOS signals faster. It'll improve the performance of our SAR operations.

dialogText.cn: 我也一直在抽空调查那失踪的三人……可惜，还是没有新线索。
dialogText.en: I'm still trying to track down the three missing crew mates whenever I can, but so far ... no luck.

dialogText.cn: 我也注意到了。虽然研究园内的大批裂地者已经被清理干净，但零星活动的还有不少。
dialogText.en: I've noticed that. Though most of the Landbreakers in the Science Park have been cleared out, we still get reports of isolated LB activities.

dialogText.cn: 我们这边会加强巡逻力度和防御措施，必要时也会主动出击。
dialogText.en: We'll reinforce our patrols and defensive measures. If necessary, we'll take the initiative and attack as well.

dialogText.cn: 好的，管理员。有事我会第一时间通知你。
dialogText.en: Alright, Endmin. You'll be the first to know if anything comes up.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者袭击的时候，大潘师傅这里遭了殃。我们还在打扫……
dialogText.en: Master Da Pan's place got wrecked when the breakers attacked us. We're still cleaning up the mess...

dialogText.cn: 有人见到诺夫曼吗？
dialogText.en: Has anyone seen Noffman?

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 没见到……我们也在找他。
dialogText.en: No... We're also looking for him.

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 他怎么回事？不是说要给塔上加装个“大家伙”吗？到底啥时候开工啊？
dialogText.en: I don't know what's going on with him. He said he'd be installing some "serious hardware" on the tower. When will he get started on that?

dialogText.cn: 能和我们说说当时的详情吗？
dialogText.en: Can you share details about the situation?

dialogText.cn: 潘叔，我们发现诺夫曼还在查那几位失踪人员的线索，该不会他又……
dialogText.en: Uncle Pan, we found out that Noffman is still trying to track down the missing crew mates. Did he just ... go?

dialogText.cn: 不会！那小子心里有数，现在这节骨眼儿上，他不会贸然行动的。
dialogText.en: Impossible! That boy still got sense! Given our current situation, he wouldn't be starting another wild chase.

dialogText.cn: 听工人们说，你们准备在<@qu.key>瞭望塔</>上加装设备？有什么需要我们帮忙的地方吗？
dialogText.en: The crew mates say that you're preparing to install some hardware on the <@qu.key>watch tower</>. Is there anything we can help with?

dialogText.cn: 没错，潘叔，尽管提！
dialogText.en: We can definitely help, Uncle Pan! Ask away!

dialogText.cn: 我想想……小陈就去帮工人们干点体力活吧。
dialogText.en: Let me think... Chen, can you help the crew with the muscle work?

dialogText.cn: 至于佩丽卡监督……辛苦帮忙盯着点集成工业系统？工人们用工团那套设备用习惯了，总想用蛮力操作……
dialogText.en: As for Supervisor Perlica ... can you help monitor the AIC Factory? The crew mates are used to their UWST machinery ... and tend to apply excessive force when operating machines.

dialogText.cn: 没问题。管理员，我们很快就回来。
dialogText.en: No problem. Endmin, we'll be right back.

dialogText.cn: 工团的朋友确实靠谱，干起活来特卖力。这么大个工程，才一会儿工夫就整得像模像样了。
dialogText.en: The UWST crew is a reliable lot and works extra hard. This major undertaking got off to a fast start, and we've already made strong progress.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，就是上次说的，我们打算在瞭望塔上装一个<@qu.key>信号接收器</>……
dialogText.en: Ah yes, it's what we mentioned last time. We plan to mount a <@qu.key>signal receiver</> on the watch tower...

dialogText.cn: 哎呀！我知道他去哪儿了！
dialogText.en: AIYAH! I know where he went!

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼打算把一台老式信号基站里的施术单元拆下来，改造成信号接收器。
dialogText.en: Noffman wants to salvage an Arts Unit from the old base station, and convert it into a signal receiver.

dialogText.cn: 那就对了！现在避难点分不出人手，但这事儿不能再拖了。他八成是一个人跑去<@qu.key>总控中心</>了！他有那儿的钥匙！
dialogText.en: That's right! However, the refuge point has no one to spare, and we cannot afford any more delays. Noffman probably ran off to the <@qu.key>Control Center</> on his own! He's got the keys to that place!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，咱们还是去看看。这玩意儿不是说拆就能拆的，咱们得帮把手。
dialogText.en: Endmin! We better head over and check things out. That thing isn't so easy to dismantle. We gotta give him a hand.

dialogText.cn: 哟，各位来啦？
dialogText.en: Oho. You're all here.

dialogText.cn: 我……该死，我是个废物！什么都做不好的废物！
dialogText.en: I ... dammit! I'm a blasted fool! A blightbrained good-for-nothing!

dialogText.cn: 要是报废了……我、我就再也找不到他们……而且裂地者还在……
dialogText.en: If I break this... I ... I'll never find them... And those Landbreakers are still around...

dialogText.cn: 该死！别烧了，别烧了，给我停下来！
dialogText.en: Blightery! Stop the fire! Stop burning already! BY TALOS, STOP!

dialogText.cn: 先拆最下面那个。
dialogText.en: Disengage the connector at the bottom.

dialogText.cn: 什、什么？
dialogText.en: Wha... WHAT?!

dialogText.cn: 是我的话，就先拆最下面那个。
dialogText.en: If I were you, I would start by disengaging the bottom connector.

dialogText.cn: 但是这三个辅助施术单元明显已经过热——
dialogText.en: But these three supporting Arts Units are obviously overheating...

dialogText.cn: 你现在已经控制住了主施术单元的回路。最下面那个的作用就是控制其他两个的输出波动。
dialogText.en: You already have control of the circuit of the main Arts Unit. The bottom-most unit is used to modulate the output fluctuations of the other two.

dialogText.cn: 是真的……但、但是已经来不及了，还在冒烟，这个温度……
dialogText.en: It's true... But we're out of time. The thing is smoking already. And the heat...

dialogText.cn: 慢慢来，手稳一点，别碰到里面其他的施术单元了，以免回路之间出现干扰。
dialogText.en: Slowly. Steady your hands and avoid touching the other Arts Units. You don't want to cause interfering shorts between the circuits.

dialogText.cn: 对，再慢一点。别慌，冷静点。
dialogText.en: That's right. Slowly. No need to panic. Keep the cool.

dialogText.cn: 真、真的拆下来了！大潘先生，你看，只有辅助单元烧了，主施术单元还好着！
dialogText.en: I ... I really dismantled it! Mr. Da Pan, look! Only the support unit burned out! The main Arts Unit is still intact!

dialogText.cn: 可以用……可以匹配我设想的图纸！
dialogText.en: I can still use this... It's a perfect fit for the blueprints I'm working on!

dialogText.cn: 先别高兴太早，现在只拆掉了三分之一……剩下两个辅助施术单元已经变得不太稳定了！
dialogText.en: Don't celebrate just yet. We only dismantled a third of this piece of hardware... The two support Arts Units have become unstable!

dialogText.cn: 我来修吧！在我修的时候，温度得稳，否则这玩意照样得报废成铁疙瘩。所以，那边的<@qu.key>温控装置</>，得有个人去盯着。
dialogText.en: I'll get it fixed! We need someone to keep their eyes on the <@qu.key>thermostat</>. Temperature must be stable during repairs, or this whole thing will burn itself into slag.

dialogText.cn: 那也是个体力活，诺夫曼一个人，估计顶不住……
dialogText.en: This will be muscle work. Noffman won't be able to pull this off on his own...

dialogText.cn: 成！你们可得帮我控制好。
dialogText.en: Okay! Do anything you can to keep the temperature stable.

dialogText.cn: 啊！糟了！
dialogText.en: AH! Dammit!

dialogText.cn: 大潘先生……你怎么？
dialogText.en: Mr. Da Pan...! Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 果然还是生疏了……快！操作还不能停下！
dialogText.en: Gah, I got slow and clumsy... QUICK! We can't leave this half done!

dialogText.cn: 不行！这样太危险了，不能拿你的命冒险。
dialogText.en: No! That's too dangerous! We can't risk your life for this!

dialogText.cn: 最后一个我来拆！刚才你的操作我都看着呢，没问题的。
dialogText.en: I'll dismantle the last unit! I've studied your moves. I got it all down in my mind.

dialogText.cn: 小兄弟……好！
dialogText.en: Okay, young buddy... Okay!

dialogText.cn: 拿过来我看看！
dialogText.en: Let me have a look at it!

dialogText.cn: 完美！可以用！你收好，后面还要把它装在塔上。
dialogText.en: Perfect! Totally usable! Keep it safe. We still have to mount it on the signal tower!

dialogText.cn: 对了，大潘先生，当时你是怎么一眼就看出来……
dialogText.en: By the way, Mr. Da Pan... How did you, with just one glance, figure out...

dialogText.cn: 嘿——其实我心里也没底。
dialogText.en: HAHA! I actually wasn't so sure back then.

dialogText.cn: 啊？
dialogText.en: Wha?

dialogText.cn: 我已经很久没接触过工团的设备啦……不过，源石信号基站总归是大同小异的。经验，这是经验之谈。
dialogText.en: I haven't handled UWST machines for quite a while... But Originium base stations are rather similar to each other. Experience, boy. It's the experience talking.

dialogText.cn: 再说，我们赶到的时候，你已经拆了一半了，我也只能硬着头皮说下去了。
dialogText.en: Also, you already dismantled half of it when we got here. I just took my chances and gave you my best advice.

dialogText.cn: 无论如何……多亏了你们，我一个人不可能做到。
dialogText.en: Whatever you say... You made this all happen. I wouldn't have done it alone.

dialogText.cn: 大潘先生，其实你不是个普通的厨子吧……
dialogText.en: Mr. Da Pan, you're not just an ordinary chef, right...?

dialogText.cn: 别，我就是个普通厨子。被落在四号谷地的可怜厨子。
dialogText.en: Oh, come on. Of course I'm an ordinary chef! A poor, sad chef stranded in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，大家还等着你呢。
dialogText.en: Let's go. Everyone's waiting for you.

dialogText.cn: 都是小伤，回去吃两顿好的就能养回来！手艺活儿，两天不干手就生！
dialogText.en: Just flesh wounds and scratches. They'll heal with two proper meals! Technical work, you know. You get clumsy without practice!

dialogText.cn: 成功了！拆下来了！
dialogText.en: I DID IT! I DISMANTLED IT!

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 我们都按照你的安排准备好了，加固底座，清理场地，就差最后一步。
dialogText.en: Everything is prepped according to your specifications. We reinforced the base and cleared the site. Now is the time for the final step.

actorName.cn: 冷静的工人{f1m9-冷静的工人}

dialogText.cn: 大潘师傅，管理员，你们也在？……这是去哪儿了？怎么还受伤了？
dialogText.en: Master Da Pan and Endministrator...? You're here. Where were you...? By Talos, you got injured!

dialogText.cn: 去拆施术单元了，东西都带回来了，齐活儿。咱们可以开工了！
dialogText.en: We just dismantled a few Arts Units. Here they are. A full suite. Let's get things rolling, crew!

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 拆施术单元？你说的是旧信号基站那个？
dialogText.en: Dismantled a few Arts Units? You mean the ones at the old base station?

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 里面一堆复杂回路，四个施术单元连环套，谁能拆得开那玩意儿……
dialogText.en: That thing has the worst circuitry ever! Four Arts Units wound up in an interlocking mess! No mortal can ever hope to untangle that nest of chaos...

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 哎，你也不看看是谁带队的？管理员！多复杂的源石设备人家没见过？
dialogText.en: Hey, take a look at who's leading the team! It's the Endmin! The legend has seen the most complicated Originium machinery there is...

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，管理员你太谦虚了！咱们心里都有数！
dialogText.en: Well, Endmin, you're being too humble! Everyone knows what you did!

dialogText.cn: 那还是诺夫曼小兄弟出的力更多。而且我们修理的时候，他还——
dialogText.en: Actually, young Noffman did most of the heavy lifting. While we were working on the repairs, he was...

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 大潘兄弟，你放心！诺夫曼很努力，大伙儿都看在眼里。但咱工团讲规矩，啥事都得就事论事。
