dialogText.en: Don't you worry, Brother Da Pan! The crew knows how hardworking Noffman is. We United Workers are a fair and reasonable lot.

dialogText.cn: 不是，我真没谦虚——
dialogText.en: Ah, no, I wasn't being humble.

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 行啦行啦，大潘师傅您歇口气儿！还有终末地的几位，今晚锅里有肉，管饱！
dialogText.en: Alright, alright. Go and take a break, Master Da Pan! Endfielders, have dinner with us! We got some hearty fillets and no one's leaving till they're stuffed!

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼！你总算回来了，大家都等着你下令开工呢！
dialogText.en: Noffman! You're back! Everyone's waiting for you to hand out the work orders!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？怎么有空来这儿？进来坐坐，歇歇脚？
dialogText.en: Endmin? You're a rare sight indeed. Come on in. Have a seat and rest your legs.

dialogText.cn: 果然瞒不过您这双眼。不过，那都是老早的事儿啦，现在专心做饭喽。
dialogText.en: Keen eyes, Endmin. But that's a long, long time ago. Now I make food for a living.

dialogText.cn: 这次路过，我本打算顺便找几个工团的老家伙叙叙旧的。诺夫曼的老上司我也认识，但他早被调到别处了……
dialogText.en: When I passed by this place, I wanted to find some UWST buddies and talk about the good old times. I know Noffman's boss, but they've assigned him to somewhere else...

dialogText.cn: 不过说正经的，诺夫曼这年纪，能撑起这一摊子事儿，挺有两下子的。
dialogText.en: Getting back to business, Noffman is young for his job, but he's shouldered the burden well. The lad has got the knack.

dialogText.cn: 现在避难点没那么多事了，他可能去忙别的了？
dialogText.en: Things are winding down at the refuge point. He's probably busy with something else.

dialogText.cn: 不过啊，这一路下来，他也算吃了不少苦头，应该学到了不少。
dialogText.en: The boy had a hard time getting things to work. And he probably earned his stripes and plenty of experience.

dialogText.cn: 好嘞！下次来，我给您沏壶好茶。
dialogText.en: Alrighty! I'll give you a pot of freshly brewed tea for your next visit.

dialogText.cn: 我尝试用信号接收器搜索那三个人的设备……我试了很多办法，输入了所有可能的识别码！
dialogText.en: I tried using the signal receiver to search for the equipment of our three missing crew mates... I made plenty of attempts, and entered all the identifying codes I could think of.

dialogText.cn: 但，什么都没有……
dialogText.en: But I found nothing...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，管理员。你不用安慰我。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin. You don't need to comfort me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，快看！有一个信号！
dialogText.en: Endmin, look at this! I see a signal!

dialogText.cn: 欸……怎么消失了？
dialogText.en: Wait... Why did it disappear?

dialogText.cn: 我也看见了，虽然只有一瞬间……位置应该就在山道那边。
dialogText.en: I saw it too. It was a flash signal... And its location should be somewhere around the Mountain Path.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来了……
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我……我刚刚已经提交了申请。现在，我不再是这边的负责人了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I ... I've submitted my resignation. I'm no longer the monitor of this site.

dialogText.cn: 啊？这么突然？你为什么……
dialogText.en: Huh? Why? That's so sudden! Why did you...?

dialogText.cn: 经历了这些事，我觉得自己能力有限。有好几次，我几乎……就要把一切搞砸了。要不是其他人出手相助……
dialogText.en: All the things I've been through made me realize I'm not cut out for this job. And I almost ... screwed up everything, more than once. If no one had been around to help me...

dialogText.cn: 在委员会推选出新负责人之前，就辛苦大潘先生代管一阵了。
dialogText.en: Un ... until the Committee names a new site monitor, we'll be relying on Mr. Da Pan to manage this place in the interim.

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼小兄弟，你——唉。
dialogText.en: Noffman, my boy! You ... ugh.

dialogText.cn: 别管我了。管理员，有什么重要的信息？
dialogText.en: It's my decision alone. Anyway, Endmin, there was something important you wanted to say?

dialogText.cn: 什么？
dialogText.en: What?!

dialogText.cn: 不……可当时明明已经……
dialogText.en: This can't be... I thought ... we lost the signals back there...

dialogText.cn: 而且，他们似乎躲在了裂地者的巢穴附近。因为没有显眼的目标，反而没有被裂地者发现。
dialogText.en: And they seem to be hiding near the Landbreaker lair. The raiders haven't found them because they are not obvious targets.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，我不够自信……也确实没那个能力。我确实可能……做不到那么好。
dialogText.en: I know I lack confidence ... as well as actual skills. And it is true that I ... probably botched up a few jobs.

dialogText.cn: 但是，切断通信，不连累其他人？
dialogText.en: But severing their signals ... so they wouldn't slow us down?

dialogText.cn: 拉梅尔德，奥莉加，帕维尔，他们怎么能这么做？谁允许他们擅自牺牲的？
dialogText.en: Rameld, Olga, and Pavel... How could they do that? Who gave them permission to make such a sacrifice?

dialogText.cn: 我不能接受。他们这样的行为也是对自己生命的不负责！总之这件事，我……我责无旁贷，负首要责任，但他们三个……他们三个……
dialogText.en: I'm not okay with this! Their actions are irresponsible and go against their personal well-being! In any case, I ... I must take full blame for this. The fault is totally mine, but those three... Our three fine crew mates...

dialogText.cn: 他们三个也是混蛋玩意儿！等他们回来了，我非得监督他们抄一千遍《工团四号谷地应急手册》！
dialogText.en: Those three blightbrained fools really got us all worked up! Once they come back, I'll monitor them all to hell! I'll get them to copy the UWST Valley IV Emergency Manual a thousand times!

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 说得对！
dialogText.en: Yeah! That's right!

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 这三个家伙，害我们担心那么久，把他们揪回来，重罚！扫一个月厕所！
dialogText.en: These three damn fools got us all worried for ages! We gotta drag them back and teach them a real lesson! Give them toilet duty for a month!

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 没错！咱们一起把他们揪回来！
dialogText.en: That's right! Let's drag those little brats back home!

actorName.cn: 年长的工人{f1m9-年长的工人}

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼！赶紧下命令，咱们把他们找出来！
dialogText.en: Give the orders, Noffman! The crew will find 'em!

dialogText.cn: 但、但是……这么长时间了，他们还活着，还在四号谷地……那为什么我找不到他们？
dialogText.en: B-But ... it's been such a long time. If they were still alive in Valley IV ... why couldn't we find any traces of them?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，拜托你们，帮帮我。我一定要找到他们！
dialogText.en: Endmin, please ... I need your help. I must find them!

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼！
dialogText.en: Noffman!

dialogText.cn: 尽管搜索到的信号非常微弱，但我们可以给瞭望塔上的信号接收器增幅，调到极限功率。结合上次记录的特征编码，应该就能定位到他们的位置。
dialogText.en: The signal we found was very weak, but we can amplify and max out the signal receiver on the watch tower. We can take characteristic encoding from our previous records, and pinpoint their location.

dialogText.cn: 我们需要把这里的四个<@qu.key>放大器</>全打开，强制接入信号接收器，展开搜索。
dialogText.en: We must activate the four <@qu.key>amplifiers</> on our site, and force connect them to the signal receiver. That will let us initiate the search.

dialogText.cn: 工人们会分成四个小队和你一同行动。完成调整之后，信号接收器会解除锁定，对你开放。
dialogText.en: We'll divide the crew into four teams and work with you. Once we're done with the changes, the signal receiver will be unlocked. You'll be able to use it then.

dialogText.cn: 同时使用四个<@qu.key>放大器</>进行增幅，然后进行信号搜索……我们从没这么操作过，但这是现在唯一可能通过信号进行精准定位的办法。
dialogText.en: Amplifying with four <@qu.key>amplifiers</> at the same time for a signal search... It's something we've never done before. But it is our only way to trace and pinpoint the source of the signal.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，该把我们的同伴带回来了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Time to bring our friends back.

dialogText.cn: 信号越来越明显了，但是还没有锁定！功率还能再加吗？
dialogText.en: The signal is getting stronger, but we don't have a lock-on yet! Can we still increase the power?

dialogText.cn: 找到了！我们做到了！信号坐标就在通往矿脉源区的山道最末段！
dialogText.en: We did it! We found the signal coordinates! It's the final section of the Mountain Path leading to the Origin Lodespring!

dialogText.cn: 没有找到，控制台上没有搜索到相应信号。
dialogText.en: Nothing so far. No relevant signals have been picked up on the control panel.

dialogText.cn: 别急，搜索功率还在加强！已经有信号反应了！
dialogText.en: No need to jump to conclusions. Power of the signal trace is still growing! We're already getting a signal response!

dialogText.cn: 所有设备解除功率限制，全力搜索信号……！
dialogText.en: Unlock all power limits for all devices. Give me a fully powered signal trace...!

dialogText.cn: 定位范围正在缩小——
dialogText.en: We're zeroing in on the location.

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{f1m9-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 现在的输出功率已经接近极限了……
dialogText.en: Power output is already approaching the threshold...

dialogText.cn: 顾不了那么多了！把功率加到最大！三！
dialogText.en: Argh, guess we can't fuss over that right now... Set power to max! THREE!

dialogText.cn: 二！
dialogText.en: TWO!

dialogText.cn: 确认开关切换，开始搜索——
dialogText.en: Verifying switch. Initiating signal trace.

dialogText.cn: 有人来了！
dialogText.en: Someone's coming!

dialogText.cn: 等等……是诺夫曼？真的是你们？
dialogText.en: Wait ... Noffman?! Is that truly you!

dialogText.cn: 你们……你们怎么能随便舍弃自己的生命？！工团从不抛下任何一个人！你们这么做对得起大家吗？
dialogText.en: HOW...?! How could you risk your lives like that?! The UW never leaves anyone behind! Do you know how many crew mates felt betrayed by your actions?!

dialogText.cn: 慢着，诺夫曼，冷静一点！奥莉加的伤还没……
dialogText.en: Slow down, Noffman! And take it easy, would ya? Olga's injuries haven't fully...

dialogText.cn: 我们实在走不动了，太影响队伍的速度了。当时侵蚀不断出现，如果硬要带着我们……所有人都会完蛋的！
dialogText.en: We could barely walk, and we'd end up slowing everyone down. You saw all the Blight gushing out of nowhere. If you'd taken us with you ... no one would've made it out.

dialogText.cn: 如果我们没切断信号，面对那种局面……当时的你会怎么办？
dialogText.en: Well, if we hadn't cut our signals when the Blight flood was upon us ... what would you have done?

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼，我们相信你，你一定会不惜一切代价带我们上路。但以那样的速度……所有人都会被侵蚀吞噬的！
dialogText.en: We have faith in you, Noffman. You probably would try to take us along no matter the cost. But if the crew had to carry us ... everyone would've been overtaken and swallowed by the Blight!

dialogText.cn: 而且……对你来说也太残酷了，我们不想让你面对那个抉择。
dialogText.en: It would be ... too cruel and devastating for you. It's a choice that none of us wants you to make.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，你是临危受命才加入应急委员会，第一次处理这样的情况。
dialogText.en: I know you joined the Emergency Committee during a disaster. It was also your first real trial.

dialogText.cn: 你太善良了，无论是你的上司，还是你上司的上司……应急委员会的任务从来都不是“拯救所有人”。
dialogText.en: You're too kind. The mission from your superiors, and those ordering your superiors ... and even the Emergency Committee... It was never about "saving everyone".

dialogText.cn: 而是“拯救尽可能多的人”。
dialogText.en: It's about "saving as many lives as possible".

dialogText.cn: 对了，大部队怎么样了？
dialogText.en: By the way, how fares the main crew?

dialogText.cn: 不对……你这是诡辩，少看不起人了。
dialogText.en: No ... you're just bending the facts. Stop treating me like a kid.

dialogText.cn: 你看，帕维尔，我找到你了，我还是救了你们“所有人”——没有谁是一定要牺牲的！
dialogText.en: Look, Pavel! I found you! So I did end up saving everyone — no one has to be sacrificed!

dialogText.cn: ……哈哈。是呢，你找到我们了……
dialogText.en: ...Haha. Of course you did. You found us...

dialogText.cn: 谢了……诺夫曼。真的，你很了不起。
dialogText.en: Thank you ... Noffman. I mean it ... you're incredible.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢，队长。
dialogText.en: Thanks, Captain.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢。
dialogText.en: Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 走吧，我们回家。
dialogText.en: Alright, crew. It's time to go home.

dialogText.cn: 大潘先生，辛苦你给他们做点吃的，好好补补。
dialogText.en: Mr. Da Pan, can you cook something nice for them? Some hot food will help them recover.

dialogText.cn: 回去以后，我就监督你们每个人抄一千遍<@qu.key>《应急手册》</>。
dialogText.en: Once we head back, I'll be exercising my monitor rights. You'll each be copying the <@qu.key>Emergency Manual</> a thousand times — by hand!

dialogText.cn: 诺夫曼小兄弟，找到了！
dialogText.en: Noffman my boy! We found them!

dialogText.cn: 拉梅尔德、奥莉加、帕维尔……三个都在，都活着。
dialogText.en: Rameld ... Olga ... Pavel... Everyone's here ... and alive.

dialogText.cn: 下定决心停下后，我们切断了信号，准备接受最后的命运。侵蚀向我们涌来……却在悬崖边停下了！恢复体力后，我们摸出一条小路来到这里。真是天无绝人之路。
dialogText.en: When we finally decided to stop, we cut our signals and prepared to meet our fate. The Blight flood surged towards us... And then it stopped by the cliff! We eventually recovered enough strength to move again, and found this trail that led us here. I guess fate wants us to live.

dialogText.cn: 可切断信号——
dialogText.en: But how could you just cut the signal like that?

dialogText.cn: 避难点已经建起来了！诺夫曼小兄弟把大家安置得好好的，还联系上了终末地！
dialogText.en: The refuge point is complete! Young Noffman got everyone settled in, and he even managed to get in touch with Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 看来我们的选择是对的。
dialogText.en: Seems like we made the right choice.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？好久不见！我们这儿刚开了家小咖啡厅，要不要来一杯？
dialogText.en: Endmin! It's been a while! We just opened a café in the outpost! How about a cup of coffee?

dialogText.cn: 基建前站作为避难点的使命已经完成，现在这里恢复了原定的功能，成了一处生活据点。
dialogText.en: The Infra-Station has fulfilled its function as a refuge point. It is now serving its original purpose as a residential outpost.

dialogText.cn: 不过……大家似乎还是更习惯叫它“前站避难点”。
dialogText.en: Well... People are still calling it the Infra-Station Refuge Point.

dialogText.cn: 这座塔也完成了它的任务，原本计划要拆除的，但大家一致决定留下它，作为我们共渡难关的见证。
dialogText.en: The tower also fulfilled its purpose. The original plan was to take it down, but everyone wanted to keep it as a memorial, for all the troubles we'd been through.

dialogText.cn: 有点不好意思……我现在是这边的安全负责人，继续看护好这里，是我眼下的工作。
dialogText.en: Well, that's a little awkward... I'm now the Security Monitor of this site. My job right now is to keep this place in proper order.

dialogText.cn: 是啊……管理员，真心谢谢你。没有你的帮助，我一个人是做不到这些的。
dialogText.en: Yeah, Endmin... Really appreciate your help back then. I would never have achieved all this alone.

dialogText.cn: 大潘先生他……已经离开了。他原本就只是在这儿落脚。
dialogText.en: Mr. Da Pan has ... left this place. He was just resting his legs for a while back then.

dialogText.cn: 我们本来还想为他办个小型欢送会，委员会甚至打算给他颁一个友谊奖章。
dialogText.en: We were planning to give him a farewell party. The Committee even wants to give him a Medal of Friendship.

dialogText.cn: 可他前一晚留了个包裹和一封信，就悄悄走了。
dialogText.en: But he quietly left the night before. We only found a package and a letter.

dialogText.cn: 包裹里是他做的点心。他还特别叮嘱，要留一份给你。
dialogText.en: The package is filled with desserts he made. He also left us a reminder to set aside a portion for you.

dialogText.cn: 唉，我的罗马诺……你一定要平安无事啊……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Romano ... my love ... please be safe...

dialogText.cn: 我叫罗莎……我的恋人滞留在裂地者占领的区域了，你能帮帮我吗？
dialogText.en: I'm Rosa... Please help me! My poor love is trapped in breaker territory!

dialogText.cn: 他肯定在！信号显示他在那里……
dialogText.en: He's definitely there! Look! These signals pinpoint his location...

dialogText.cn: 他一直发送定位信号给我，我已经跟……不，我找他好几天了。
dialogText.en: He's constantly sending these location signals to me. I've been tracking... Ahem. I've been looking for him for days!

dialogText.cn: 我给你标记在地图上……好心人，请把我的罗马诺带回来……
dialogText.en: Here, I'll mark it on your map... I beg you! Please bring my Romano back to me...

dialogText.cn: 你回来了！怎么样？
dialogText.en: You're back! What happened?

dialogText.cn: 什么……你确定？你真的不是弄错了？
dialogText.en: What...? You can't be serious... Are you sure it's...

dialogText.cn: 这确实是我送他的手表……这怎么可能……这……
dialogText.en: But this is the watch I gave him... No... This can't be happening... Why?

dialogText.cn: 如果是这样的话，那我更不能让他一个人在那边待着。我要去把他的尸体带回来……
dialogText.en: I can't leave him there like this. I'm ... I'm going to bring his body back...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，但我必须亲自去。因为他是我的爱人……我不能就这样抛下他。
dialogText.en: Thank you, but I must do this. He ... he was my love... I can't simply abandon him.

dialogText.cn: 不愿意？怎么会这样？我这么爱他……
dialogText.en: Not coming back? How? But ... but I love him so much...

dialogText.cn: 他情况怎么样？没受伤吧？
dialogText.en: How is he doing? Is he hurt?

dialogText.cn: 那就好，那就好。
dialogText.en: Okay. That's good to hear.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，接下来就是我们两个人之间的私事了，就不麻烦你了。
dialogText.en: Thank you. I won't need anything else. I got a private business to settle with him.

dialogText.cn: 啊啊啊啊！别杀我！
dialogText.en: AAAHHHH!!! DON'T KILL ME!

dialogText.cn: 我是罗马诺，但你说的恋人是？我根本没……等等，是罗莎让你来的？
dialogText.en: Yeah, I'm Romano, but I have a lover? I'm sing... Wait. Rosa! She asked you to come here, right?

dialogText.cn: 她究竟怎么找到我的？我都跑到这种地方来了！
dialogText.en: How did she find me? I thought I'm already out in the middle of nowhere!

dialogText.cn: 她在我身上装了定位器对不对？！我知道了！那块手表！！
dialogText.en: ARGH! Bugger this blight! She must have planted a tracker on me! I knew it! It must be the watch!!

dialogText.cn: 别开玩笑，我就是饿死在这儿，我都不会回去的！
dialogText.en: I'm NEVER GOING BACK! I'd rather starve to death!

dialogText.cn: 你根本不明白她有多疯狂，这种日子我过不下去了，我只是想要过正常一些的生活！
dialogText.en: You don't know how loco she is. I can't live like this anymore! I really need a normal life!

dialogText.cn: 这样吧，你把这个手表还给她，让她不要来烦我了。或者你随便编个理由，比如我被裂地者吃了之类的……
dialogText.en: Erm, just take this watch and tell her to stop looking for me... Give her an excuse ... like ... I got killed by Landbreakers and they ate everything...

dialogText.cn: 能帮帮我吗？我实在是没力气了……
dialogText.en: *Huff* ... *wheeze*... Can you help me ... please? I ... I'm absolutely spent...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你的好意，但在把那些源石虫全找回来前，我还不能走……忘了自我介绍，我叫奥列格，是工团的研究员。
dialogText.en: Thanks, but I can't leave. Not before I find all my Originium Slugs... Oh, self intro! Yes! The name's Oleg. I'm a UWST scientist.

dialogText.cn: 是的，它们都是定向培育的，有很高的研究价值。我离开研究室之前，专门拜托安东尼帮我看管好，现在他人不见了，源石虫也全跑出来了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Those slugs were specifically bred and raised for unique traits with great scientific value! I actually asked Anthony to watch over them before leaving my lab. But the man went missing and all my slugs escaped.

dialogText.cn: 这个……我也不太确定。不过附近应该就有一只，唉，我之前差点就追上它了……
dialogText.en: Oh... I'm not really sure myself. But there's definitely one of them nearby. Ugh. I almost managed to catch that one... Almost...

dialogText.cn: 跟它们比速度确实是不明智的……
dialogText.en: Outrunning them would be quite ... impossible...

dialogText.cn: 如果仔细观察，会发现源石虫的运动轨迹是有规律可循的，或许可以利用这一点。
dialogText.en: But if you look closely, these slugs seem to move along a fixed path. You can try using that to your advantage.

dialogText.cn: 有人帮忙可太好了！谢谢你了。
dialogText.en: Really? You can help? Thank you so much!

dialogText.cn: 还有，这个捕虫网给你，要用这个才能抓到这种源石虫。
dialogText.en: One more thing. Here. A special Originium Slug net. It's essential for catching the slugs.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？
dialogText.en: How goes your slug hunt?

dialogText.cn: 真是太感谢了！这种源石虫虽然不是塔卫二的原生物种，却很适应这里的环境，连奔跑的速度都跟在泰拉时没多大变化。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! This breed of Originium Slugs isn't native to Talos-II, but they're adapting really well. In fact, their running speed hasn't changed much compared to their Terran ancestors.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，源石虫原产于泰拉，当年人们来到这颗星球时，它们也一起被带过来了。
dialogText.en: Well, yeah. Originium Slugs came from Terra. People brought them along when they came to Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 这么多年过去，它们为了适应环境也发生了一些变化。
dialogText.en: Over the years, the slugs also evolved to better adapt to the Talosian environment.

dialogText.cn: 找回这一只，后续的研究就可以先展开了。
dialogText.en: And with this little guy, I can finally continue my research.

dialogText.cn: 如果你在别处发现了它们，也请帮忙抓回来吧，拜托你了！
dialogText.en: Oh, if you come across more slugs at other places, catch them for me! PLEASE!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？有什么收获吗？
dialogText.en: How goes your slug hunt? Caught anything?

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你了！
dialogText.en: Awesome work!

dialogText.cn: 我数了一下，应该还有没抓到的。
dialogText.en: Let me count them. Yeah, we might be missing some.

dialogText.cn: 这些源石虫很会隐藏自己，请你再帮我找找看！
dialogText.en: These Originium Slugs really know how to hide. Please find them for me!

dialogText.cn: 所有的都抓到了，太感谢你了！
dialogText.en: You actually caught them all! Thank you so much!

dialogText.cn: 这些源石虫……对我们的研究非常重要，我以后再不会把它们轻易托付给别人了……
dialogText.en: The slugs... They're important to our research. I'll be extra cautious when hiring my replacement slug-sitter...

dialogText.cn: 源石虫是最合适的实验动物啊，它们繁殖得很快，对环境的适应能力又很强。
dialogText.en: Originium Slugs are perfect lab animals. They reproduce quickly and can literally live anywhere!

dialogText.cn: 人们刚从泰拉来到塔卫二的时候，食物很单一，全靠源石虫解馋。放养之后，它们又迅速适应了塔卫二的环境，演化出了不同的亚种。
dialogText.en: When we Terrans first moved to Talos-II, food options were really limited. The slugs got us covered, you know. We released a few slugs into the wild. They quickly adapted to the Talosian environment and evolved into the many slug breeds we see today.

dialogText.cn: 源石虫已经嵌入了这个星球的生态系统中，研究它们可以帮助我们更好地认识塔卫二……
dialogText.en: These creatures are now a key part of the global biome. Studying the slugs will help us learn more about Talos-II...

dialogText.cn: 呃……可能是酒味吧。
dialogText.en: Oh ... that ... yeah... That's probably ... food-grade kohl.

dialogText.cn: 我之前确实拿它们酿过酒……研究工作很辛苦，搞点酒喝算是犒劳一下自己。嘿嘿。
dialogText.en: Science is not an easy career, my friend... And I was pursuing a rather important side project concerning ethanol and organic substances. Had to test the results myself, you know. Heheh.

dialogText.cn: 其实……源石虫曾经的一个主要用途就是拿来酿酒。源石虫的分泌物可以促使作物转化为酒精和香味物质。
dialogText.en: Truth be told ... Originium Slugs were once widely employed to make fermented beverages. Slug secretions contain enzymes that could catalyze starchy crops into kohl and other aromatic compounds.

dialogText.cn: 说实话，哪里都有可能。源石虫对环境的适应能力很强。
dialogText.en: Well, you can probably find them ... anywhere. Originium Slugs are extremely adaptable and thrive in all sorts of environments.

dialogText.cn: 这些源石虫比较胆小，很可能会躲在洞穴、岩缝，甚至……集装箱挡住的角落里。
dialogText.en: But slugs aren't very brave. Try looking around caves, rock crevices ... or even the tiny spaces hidden behind the containers.

dialogText.cn: 你可以去这些地方找找。
dialogText.en: Look around the spots I mentioned. Good luck.

dialogText.cn: 安东尼是我雇来的一个帮手，我请他帮忙照看源石虫。
dialogText.en: Anthony is a research assistant I hired. I asked him to look after the Originium Slugs.

dialogText.cn: 因为超域爆发的原因，我去别处支援了一阵。走之前特地叮嘱他，不要让源石虫逃出来。
dialogText.en: I was assigned to support another site due to the Æther rupture. Before I left, I specifically told my RA to keep the slugs safely confined.

dialogText.cn: 结果我回来的时候，他跟源石虫都不见了……
dialogText.en: But when I returned, both my RA and the Originium Slugs went missing...

dialogText.cn: 我认识他很久了，他是一个很可靠的人……我也不知道他为什么会不辞而别。
dialogText.en: I knew the lad for quite a while. Anthony's the dependable type... I wonder why he left without telling me anything.

dialogText.cn: 唉……希望他平安无事。
dialogText.en: Yeah... I just hope he's alright.

dialogText.cn: 在哪里？
dialogText.en: You did? Where?

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀……
dialogText.en: The Blight...

dialogText.cn: 到底发生了什么……
dialogText.en: What's going on here?

dialogText.cn: 哇！抱歉，刚才太投入了。
dialogText.en: Whoa! Sorry, I was completely absorbed there.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我叫瑟斯顿，正在协助枢纽区基地确认四号谷地的安全情况。
dialogText.en: Hi there, Endmin. I'm Thurston, currently assisting the Hub Base in assessing safety conditions in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 我正在调查附近裂地者的动向，然后就……发现了这处地方。
dialogText.en: I was investigating nearby Landbreaker movements when I ... stumbled upon this place.

dialogText.cn: 我不确定。如果是防卫科或者工团的工人们做的，基地应该会收到相关的事后报告。
dialogText.en: I'm not sure. If the Security Division or the UWST had done this, the base should've received an after-action report.

dialogText.cn: 而且，这里的样子也实在有点……
dialogText.en: And besides, the state of this place is a bit ... well...

dialogText.cn: 可、可以吗？太感谢了，管理员！
dialogText.en: R-really? Thank you so much, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这里也有裂地者被打倒了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, more Landbreakers have been taken down here too.

dialogText.cn: 我重新调取了各路监控资料，始终没有更多发现。
dialogText.en: I've reviewed all available surveillance footage, but still have no additional findings.

dialogText.cn: 不管袭击者是谁，那人的身手一定很不错。
dialogText.en: Whoever the attacker is, they've got some serious skills.

dialogText.cn: 好的，我先去检查那个大家伙的情况。
dialogText.en: Alright, I'll start by checking that big guy over there.

dialogText.cn: 好利落的手法，战斗可能结束得相当快。
dialogText.en: Such clean technique. The fight probably ended very quickly.

dialogText.cn: 这两天我紧急钻研了情报部门关于碾骨氏族的资料，这家伙可能是“断头台”盖比。
dialogText.en: I've been cramming intelligence files on the Bonekrusher Clan these past few days. This guy might be "Guillotine" Gabbi.

dialogText.cn: 他替许多人做过事，在重点关注列表里的优先级不高，但也不是能随便对付的。
dialogText.en: He's worked for many. Wasn't high priority on the watchlist, but definitely not someone to take lightly either.

dialogText.cn: 这样的一个壮汉和人战斗，身上却几乎没有多余的伤口，处处致命……
dialogText.en: A brute like this in a fight, yet almost no extra wounds ... every injury is lethal.

dialogText.cn: 总之，我先把他的伤情记录下来。
dialogText.en: Anyway, I'll document his injuries first.

dialogText.cn: 这个裂地者只在后颈有一条清晰的伤口，除了尘土几乎没有沾染其他污渍。
dialogText.en: This Landbreaker only has one clean wound on the back of the neck. Aside from dust, there's almost no other staining on the body.

dialogText.cn: 他甚至没能来得及握紧武器，也许是第一个被伏击干掉的倒霉鬼。
dialogText.en: He didn't even have time to grip his weapon properly. Probably the first unlucky soul ambushed.

dialogText.cn: 箱子被巨大的力量摧毁，栏杆上有着细小的切痕。
dialogText.en: Containers were smashed with tremendous force, tiny cut marks are found on the railings.

dialogText.cn: 两处破坏应该不是来自同一种武器，持斧的裂地者在这里发生过激烈战斗。
dialogText.en: The two types of damage likely came from different weapons. The axe-wielding Landbreaker clearly fought fiercely here.

dialogText.cn: 终端机似乎被暴力打砸过，但电源仍然完好。
dialogText.en: The terminal appears to have been violently smashed, but the power supply is still intact.

dialogText.cn: 或许需要绕开一些损坏的源石电路，才能将其启动。
dialogText.en: Might need to bypass some damaged Originium circuits to get it started.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您有什么头绪吗？
dialogText.en: Any ideas, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 这些裂地者似乎收到了什么指令，但没等执行完就被一网打尽了。
dialogText.en: These Landbreakers apparently received some kind of orders, but were wiped out before they could fully carry them out.

dialogText.cn: 而且，他们好像叫那个人“影子”……这是名字还是称号？他们过去就认识吗？
dialogText.en: And they called that attacker "Shadow"... Is that a name or a title? Did they know each other before?

dialogText.cn: 总之，相关数据已经上传S.O.W.，希望后方的专家们能再提供一些分析。
dialogText.en: Anyway, the relevant data has been uploaded to SOW. Hopefully the experts back at base can provide more analysis.

dialogText.cn: 接下来我会格外注意这一类迹象。如果发现了更多踪迹，我就第一时间通知您。
dialogText.en: I'll be keeping a close watch for any similar signs from now on. If I spot more traces, you'll be the first to know.

dialogText.cn: 明白，但放着这么一个危险的家伙不管，我实在不放心基地的安全。
dialogText.en: Understood, but leaving such a dangerous individual unchecked makes me really uneasy about the base's security.

dialogText.cn: 必须把这里发生的来龙去脉给搞清楚。我先继续调查了，请您也务必多多留意。
dialogText.en: We must get to the bottom of what happened here. I'll continue investigating. Please stay alert too.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您有什么头绪吗？
dialogText.en: Any ideas, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 这些裂地者似乎收到了什么指令，但没等执行完就被一网打尽了。
dialogText.en: These Landbreakers apparently received some kind of orders, but were wiped out before they could fully carry them out.

dialogText.cn: 而且，他们好像叫那个人“影子”……这是名字还是称号？他们过去就认识吗？
dialogText.en: And they called that attacker "Shadow"... Is that a name or a title? Did they know each other before?

dialogText.cn: 的确如此……总之，结合其他几处位置的信息，应该已经能得出一些结果了。
dialogText.en: True enough... Anyway, combining intel from the other locations should give us some concrete results now.

dialogText.cn: 我会在枢纽区基地打听有没有更多消息，请您使用协议同步器向S.O.W.提交资料吧。
dialogText.en: I'll ask around the Hub base for more intel. Please use the protocol synchronizer to submit the data to SOW.

dialogText.cn: 后方的专家们应该会再提供一些分析结果，我们可以在情报档案库里接收他们的最终报告。
dialogText.en: The experts back at base should provide further analysis. We can retrieve their final report from the Intel Archive.

dialogText.cn: 连采石场里都出现了……
dialogText.en: Even the Quarry now...

dialogText.cn: 啊！管、管理员？抱歉，刚才想得太入神了。
dialogText.en: *Gasp* E-Endmin? Apologies, I was lost in my thought...

dialogText.cn: 我叫瑟斯顿，正在协助枢纽区基地确认四号谷地的安全情况。
dialogText.en: I'm Thurston, currently assisting the Hub Base in assessing safety conditions in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 我正在调查附近裂地者的动向，然后就……发现了这处地方。
dialogText.en: I was investigating nearby Landbreaker movements when I ... stumbled upon this place.

dialogText.cn: 我还不能确定。附近没有他们聚集地常见的那些破烂，这些人应该也才到不久。
dialogText.en: I can't be sure yet. None of their usual gathering spot junk nearby ... these guys must've arrived recently too.

dialogText.cn: 枢纽区基地没有收到防卫科或者工团工人的事后报告，到底是谁在这里杀死了裂地者？
dialogText.en: The Hub base didn't receive any after-action reports from the Security Division or the UWST. So who exactly took out these Landbreakers here?

dialogText.cn: 而且，还弄成了这副样子……
dialogText.en: And they left the place in this state...

dialogText.cn: 明白，我们还得想办法进去看看。
dialogText.en: Understood. We still need to find a way inside.

dialogText.cn: 连采石场里都出现了……
dialogText.en: Even the Quarry now...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？我现在还没什么头绪，您来得正是时候。
dialogText.en: Endmin? I'm still drawing blanks here. You've perfect timing!

dialogText.cn: 这里没有入侵警报记录，附近也没有裂地者聚集地常见的那些破烂，他们应该才到不久。
dialogText.en: No intrusion alarm records here, and none of the usual Landbreaker camp junk nearby. They must've just arrived.

dialogText.cn: 应该是高压阻拦网把什么点着了……唉，我们先去把人挪挪。
dialogText.en: Must be the high voltage fence setting something on fire... *Sigh* let's move the bodies first.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这不是“鬼火”维奇尔吗？
dialogText.en: Huh? Isn't this "Will-o-Wisp" Vichir?

dialogText.cn: 他是S.O.W.保持关注的危险分子，碾骨氏族里的一位高手。
dialogText.en: He's a dangerous individual kept on SOW's watchlist. He's a real expert among the Bonekrushers.

dialogText.cn: “鬼火”的经验非常老到，随时都在准备使用秘技转移自己，就像真正的鬼火一样飘忽不定。
dialogText.en: "Will-o-Wisp" was extremely experienced, always ready to use secret techniques to reposition himself ... elusive like actual ghost fire.

dialogText.cn: 从来没人成功抓住过他，没想到竟然会栽在这里。
dialogText.en: No one ever managed to catch him before. Can't believe he'd be taken down here.

dialogText.cn: 他们氏族的这些秘传技艺虽然神奇，但失手的代价真大啊。
dialogText.en: These secret techniques of their clan might be miraculous, but the price of failure is steep.

dialogText.cn: 您说得对。我先记录“鬼火”的伤情。
dialogText.en: You're right. Let me document "Will-o-Wisp's" injuries first.

dialogText.cn: 现场能收集到的信息应该只有这些了。
dialogText.en: That's probably all the information we can gather from the scene.

dialogText.cn: 防卫系统在裂地者们抵达之前就被关闭了。
dialogText.en: The defense systems were shut down before the Landbreakers even arrived.

dialogText.cn: 我刚刚检查了记录，负责维护这里的工人确实是一名女性……被谋害的应该就是她。
dialogText.en: I just checked the logs. The worker assigned to maintain this area was indeed a woman... She was likely the murder victim.

dialogText.cn: 入侵系统，伪装身份，伏击目标……这很可能是提前计划过的行动。
dialogText.en: System intrusion, identity disguise, target ambush... This was likely a premeditated operation.

dialogText.cn: 没想到这里真能拦住他……碾骨焰术师的技艺一直很神秘，我们并不知晓它的具体原理。
dialogText.en: Never thought this place could actually stop him... Bonekrusher Pyromancers' arts have always been mysterious. We still don't understand how they work.

dialogText.cn: 战斗发生的时候，防卫系统被重新启动了。估计这里就在那时变成了牢笼。
dialogText.en: The defense systems rebooted mid-fight. Probably turned this place into a cage right then.

dialogText.cn: 实施计划的人一定比我们更了解“鬼火”。到底会是谁呢……
dialogText.en: Whoever carried this out definitely knows "Will-o-Wisp" better than we do.

dialogText.cn: 他们好像要利用这里的仓库藏匿一些武器。不过，碾骨氏族自己就有武器，为什么要藏？
dialogText.en: They seemed to want to use the depot here to stash weapons. But the Bonekrushers already has arms. Why hide more?

dialogText.cn: 或者，藏的不是他们的武器……还有更多？
dialogText.en: Or ... the weapons aren't theirs to begin with. Could there be even more?

dialogText.cn: 而且，这些裂地者还在挑选名单，不让一些人加入。怎么看都像是要做些连自己人都不一定能信任的事。
dialogText.en: Plus, these Landbreakers were vetting people, excluding some from joining. Smells like an operation even their own allies can't be trusted with.

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么样，这个计划最后没能成功。
dialogText.en: Regardless, this plan ultimately failed.

dialogText.cn: 的确如此。唉，可惜没能救下那位工人。
dialogText.en: True enough. *Sigh*, it's a shame we couldn't save that worker.

dialogText.cn: 我得去附近再巡视一圈，也得跟工团……报告这个消息。
dialogText.en: I need to patrol the area once more ... and also report this to the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 如果有更多发现，我会马上告知您的。
dialogText.en: If I find anything else, I'll notify you immediately.

dialogText.cn: 现场能收集到的信息应该只有这些了。
dialogText.en: That's probably all the information we can gather from the scene.

dialogText.cn: 防卫系统在裂地者们抵达之前就被关闭了。
dialogText.en: The defense systems were shut down before the Landbreakers even arrived.

dialogText.cn: 我刚刚检查了记录，负责维护这里的工人确实是一名女性……被谋害的应该就是她。
dialogText.en: I just checked the logs. The worker assigned to maintain this area was indeed a woman... She was likely the murder victim.

dialogText.cn: 入侵系统，伪装身份，伏击目标……这很可能是提前计划过的行动。
dialogText.en: System intrusion, identity disguise, target ambush... This was likely a premeditated operation.

dialogText.en: Never thought this place could actually stop him... Bonekrusher Pyromancers' arts have always been mysterious. We still don't understand how they work.

dialogText.cn: 战斗发生的时候，防卫系统被重新启动了。估计这里就在那时变成了牢笼。
dialogText.en: The defense systems rebooted mid-fight. Probably turned this place into a cage right then.

dialogText.cn: 实施计划的人一定比我们更了解“鬼火”。到底会是谁呢……
dialogText.en: Whoever carried this out definitely knows "Will-o-Wisp" better than we do.

dialogText.cn: 他们好像要利用这里的仓库藏匿一些武器。不过，碾骨氏族自己就有武器，为什么要藏？
dialogText.en: They seemed to want to use the depot here to stash weapons. But the Bonekrushers already has arms. Why hide more?

dialogText.cn: 或者，藏的不是他们的武器……还有更多？
dialogText.en: Or ... the weapons aren't theirs to begin with. Could there be even more?

dialogText.cn: 而且，这些裂地者还在挑选名单，不让一些人加入。怎么看都像是要做些连自己人都不一定能信任的事。
dialogText.en: Plus, these Landbreakers were vetting people, excluding some from joining. Smells like an operation even their own allies can't be trusted with.

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么样，这个计划最后没能成功。
dialogText.en: Regardless, this plan ultimately failed.

dialogText.cn: 的确如此。唉，可惜没能救下那位工人。
dialogText.en: True enough. *Sigh*, it's a shame we couldn't save that worker.

dialogText.cn: 总之，结合其他几处位置的信息，应该已经能得出一些结论了。
dialogText.en: Anyway, combining intel from the other locations should give us some concrete results now.

dialogText.cn: 我会在枢纽区基地打听有没有更多消息，请您使用协议同步器向S.O.W.提交资料吧。
dialogText.en: I'll ask around the Hub base for more intel. Please use the protocol synchronizer to submit the data to SOW.

dialogText.cn: 后方的专家们应该会再提供一些分析结果，我们可以在情报档案库里接收他们的最终报告。
dialogText.en: The experts back at base should provide further analysis. We can retrieve their final report from the Intel Archive.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀都蔓延到这里了……到底是什么时候发生的？
dialogText.en: The Blight has spread even here... When did this happen?

dialogText.cn: 啊！管、管理员？抱歉，刚才想得太入神了。
dialogText.en: *Gasp* E-Endmin? Apologies, I was lost in my thought...

dialogText.cn: 我叫瑟斯顿，正在协助枢纽区基地确认四号谷地的安全情况。
dialogText.en: I'm Thurston, currently assisting the Hub Base in assessing safety conditions in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 矿脉源区的工人们很努力，居住区的情况比想象中要好一些。不过，这里就不一样了。
dialogText.en: The workers in the Origin Lodespring area have been diligent. The residential area's condition is better than expected. But here ... it's different.

dialogText.cn: 比那更复杂——不知什么时候，这里死了好些裂地者。
dialogText.en: More complicated than that. Somehow, a bunch of Landbreakers died here.

dialogText.cn: 混乱刚结束，工人们了解得不多。我刚刚问了，来帮忙的鲁珀小姑娘也没到这里清剿过敌人。
dialogText.en: The chaos just settled, the workers don't know much. I asked around, even the Lupo girl here to help never cleared enemies from this area.

dialogText.cn: 建筑上面还有裂地者的尸体，只是现在很难靠近检查。
dialogText.en: There are more Landbreaker corpses up there, but they're too dangerous to reach for now.

dialogText.cn: 如果想深入确认细节，得先解决这些侵蚀才行。
dialogText.en: If we want to confirm the details, we'll need to deal with this Blight first.

dialogText.cn: 您也要加入调查吗？太好了，那我们这就开始吧！
dialogText.en: You're joining too? Fantastic, let's get started then!

dialogText.cn: 得想个办法上去才行……
dialogText.en: Gotta find a way up there...

dialogText.cn: 我又发现了一些裂地者的遗体，就在靠里一些的地方。
dialogText.en: I found more Landbreaker remains further inside.

dialogText.cn: 矿脉源区的工人们很努力，居住区的情况比想象中要好一些。不过，这里就不一样了。
dialogText.en: The workers in the Origin Lodespring area have been diligent. The residential area's condition is better than expected. But here ... it's different.

dialogText.cn: 混乱刚结束，大家了解得不多。刚才问了问，来帮忙的鲁珀小姑娘也没到这里清剿过敌人。
dialogText.en: The chaos just settled, people don't know much. I asked around, even the Lupo girl here to help never cleared enemies from this area.

dialogText.cn: 平台上面还有个大家伙，只是现在很难靠近检查。
dialogText.en: There's a big one up on the platform, but it's too risky to approach right now.

dialogText.cn: 如果想深入确认细节，得先解决这些障碍才行。
dialogText.en: If we want to verify the details, we'll need to clear these obstacles first.

dialogText.cn: 太感谢了，我们这就开始吧。
dialogText.en: Fantastic. Let's get things started right away.

dialogText.cn: 我和您想到一块去了。
dialogText.en: Great minds think alike.

dialogText.cn: 您看他们倒下的方向，全都朝着高处那个房间。
dialogText.en: Look at how they fell. All oriented toward that high room.

dialogText.cn: 但他们的身体正面没有伤口，致命伤反而在背后。
dialogText.en: But their frontal areas show no wounds. The fatal injuries are all on their backs.

dialogText.cn: 如果他们是在围攻高处时被干掉，正面多少应该受些伤才对。
dialogText.en: If they were storming the high ground, their fronts should've taken some damage.

dialogText.cn: 反过来说，如果是在保卫高处，不应该背对着外面……实在太奇怪了。
dialogText.en: Conversely, if they were defending the high ground, they shouldn't have their backs to the outside... It's just too strange.

dialogText.cn: 的确如此，我们应该再仔细调查一下这些遗体。
dialogText.en: Exactly. We should examine these remains more carefully.

dialogText.cn: 躯体无力地倒在地面上，就像失去了牵绳的提线木偶。
dialogText.en: Bodies lie limp on the ground like marionettes with cut strings.

dialogText.cn: 手腕部位的皮肤隐隐有横向血痕，像是被粗糙的绳索捆绑过。
dialogText.en: Faint horizontal blood marks on the wrists, like they were tied with rough ropes.

dialogText.cn: 致命伤来自背后，狭窄的伤口深入躯干，利刃毫无阻碍地夺取了他们的生命。
dialogText.en: The fatal wounds are from behind. Narrow slits piercing deep into torsos, blades taking their lives without resistance.

dialogText.cn: 这些裂地者似乎都携带着同样款式的项链。
dialogText.en: These Landbreakers all seem to be wearing the same style of necklace.

dialogText.cn: 一只木制的羽兽浑身漆黑，只有眼睛被点成了血红。
dialogText.en: A wooden fowlbeast figurine, entirely black except for eyes painted blood-red.

dialogText.cn: 身形魁梧的裂地者战士孤独地倒在了房间外。
dialogText.en: A burly Landbreaker warrior lies fallen alone outside the room.

dialogText.cn: 战士的身躯上意外地没有太多新鲜的伤痕，只有翻越和磕碰障碍带来的轻微刮擦。
dialogText.en: Surprisingly, the warrior's body shows few fresh wounds, only minor scrapes from climbing and hitting obstacles.

dialogText.cn: 尽管侵蚀就在旁边肆虐，他却似乎并没有受到太多影响。专家们也许能给出更详细的分析。
dialogText.en: Even with the Blight raging nearby, he seems largely unaffected.

dialogText.cn: 战士被利物划过咽喉，造成了致命伤。
dialogText.en: The warrior's throat was slit by a sharp object, causing the fatal injury.

dialogText.cn: 伤口自中间向两侧延伸，似乎是箭矢所为。
dialogText.en: The wound spreads from the center outward, likely caused by an arrow.

dialogText.cn: 但在他的身上并没有发现箭矢或断裂的箭头。
dialogText.en: But no arrow or broken arrowhead was found on his body.

dialogText.cn: 这名战士携带着装饰有黑色羽兽的项链。
dialogText.en: This warrior carried a necklace adorned with a black fowlbeast figurine.

dialogText.cn: 羽兽的眼睛血红，躯体漆黑。
dialogText.en: The fowlbeast figurine has blood-red eyes and a jet-black body.

dialogText.cn: 唔……管理员，有什么结论吗？
dialogText.en: Well... Endmin, any conclusions?

dialogText.cn: 如果我没记错，这代表他们是“血眼”撒萨罗的队伍。
dialogText.en: If I remember correctly, this means they're "Bloodeye" Sazaro's crew.

dialogText.cn: 他们是以集体行动闻名的团体，擅长互相配合，是碾骨氏族里少有的团结群体。
dialogText.en: They're known for moving as a unit. Great at coordination, a rare united front within the Bonekrusher Clan.

dialogText.cn: 不过，至少据我们所知，最近这群人的活动报告似乎变得相当少。
dialogText.en: But based on what we know, this group's activity reports have become pretty sparse lately.

dialogText.cn: 这就不知道了。氏族内部的动向混乱复杂，就算是我们的情报部门也很难接触。
dialogText.en: Hard to say. The clan's internal movements are chaotic and complex. Even our intelligence division struggles to get a clear picture.

dialogText.cn: 据说，“血眼”撒萨罗是位出色的猎手，但比起战士，更像指挥。
dialogText.en: Rumor has it "Bloodeye" Sazaro was a skilled hunter, but more of a strategist than a frontline fighter.

dialogText.cn: 几次战斗记录都表明“血眼”擅长远程狙击，死者该不会就是他吧……
dialogText.en: Several combat records show "Bloodeye" excelled at long-range sniping. The deceased couldn't actually be him, could it...?

dialogText.cn: 如果真是这样，“血眼”和他的队伍恐怕这就算彻底完蛋了。对我们来说也算好事。
dialogText.en: If that's true, then "Bloodeye" and his squad are basically finished. Good news for us, I suppose.

dialogText.cn: 但他不是我们自己人结果的，还是让我很不放心……得把这件事调查清楚。
dialogText.en: But since it wasn't our people who took him out, it still makes me uneasy... We need to get to the bottom of this.

dialogText.cn: 我去整理情报传给S.O.W.分析。如果有更多发现，咱们马上再联系。
dialogText.en: I'll organize the intel and send it to SOW for analysis. If we find anything else, we'll link up immediately.

dialogText.cn: 唔……管理员，有什么结论吗？
dialogText.en: Well... Endmin, any conclusions?

dialogText.cn: 如果我没记错，这代表他们是“血眼”撒萨罗的队伍。
dialogText.en: If I remember correctly, this means they're "Bloodeye" Sazaro's crew.

dialogText.cn: 他们是以集体行动闻名的团体，擅长互相配合，是碾骨氏族里少有的团结群体。
