dialogText.cn: 不过，至少据我们所知，最近这群人的活动报告似乎变得相当少。
dialogText.en: But based on what we know, this group's activity reports have become pretty sparse lately.

dialogText.cn: 这就不知道了。氏族内部的动向混乱复杂，就算是我们的情报部门也很难接触。
dialogText.en: Hard to say. The clan's internal movements are chaotic and complex. Even our intelligence division struggles to get a clear picture.

dialogText.cn: 据说，“血眼”撒萨罗是位出色的猎手，但比起战士，更像指挥。
dialogText.en: Rumor has it "Bloodeye" Sazaro was a skilled hunter, but more of a strategist than a frontline fighter.

dialogText.cn: 几次战斗记录都表明“血眼”擅长远程狙击，死者该不会就是他吧……
dialogText.en: Several combat records show "Bloodeye" excelled at long-range sniping. The deceased couldn't actually be him, could it...?

dialogText.cn: 如果真是这样，“血眼”和他的队伍恐怕这就算彻底完蛋了。对我们来说也算好事。
dialogText.en: If that's true, then "Bloodeye" and his squad are basically finished. Good news for us, I suppose.

dialogText.cn: 但他不是被我们击败的……总之，结合其他几处位置的信息，应该已经能得出一些结论了。
dialogText.en: But he wasn't defeated by us... Anyway, combining intel from the other locations should give us some concrete results now.

dialogText.cn: 我会在枢纽区基地打听有没有更多消息，请您使用协议同步器向S.O.W.提交资料吧。
dialogText.en: I'll ask around the Hub base for more intel. Please use the protocol synchronizer to submit the data to SOW.

dialogText.cn: 后方的专家们应该会再提供一些分析结果，我们可以在情报档案库里接收他们的最终报告。
dialogText.en: The experts back at base should provide further analysis. We can retrieve their final report from the Intel Archive.

dialogText.cn: 到底是谁干的……
dialogText.en: Who did this...

dialogText.cn: 啊！管、管理员？抱歉，刚才想得太入神了。
dialogText.en: *Gasp* E-Endmin? Apologies, I was lost in my thought...

dialogText.cn: 我叫瑟斯顿，正在协助枢纽区基地确认四号谷地的安全情况。
dialogText.en: I'm Thurston, currently assisting the Hub Base in assessing safety conditions in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 虽然供能高地已经被我们夺回来了，但附近暂时还有没能撤走的裂地者在负隅顽抗。
dialogText.en: Although we've retaken the Power Plateau, there are still some stubborn Landbreakers holding out nearby who haven't withdrawn yet.

dialogText.cn: 我担心工人们再出意外，就优先来这里做了调查。然后……就发现了这里。
dialogText.en: I was worried the workers might have more accidents, so I prioritized investigating this area. And then... I found this.

dialogText.cn: 这里不在我们先前的反攻路线上，却有不少裂地者倒在这里。
dialogText.en: This spot wasn't on our original counterattack route, yet there are quite a few Landbreakers down here.

dialogText.cn: 也就是说，他们在我们不知道的时候，被我们不知道的人杀害了。
dialogText.en: So they were killed by someone unknown, at a time we didn't know about.

dialogText.cn: 碾骨氏族被削弱确实对我们有利，但袭击者不一定就和我们站在一边。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers getting weakened is definitely a win for us, but those attackers aren't necessarily on our side.

dialogText.cn: 大战刚刚过去，大家都很疲惫。任何不确定因素都是一种威胁。
dialogText.en: A major battle just wrapped up, and everyone's beat. Any wildcard out there is a straight-up threat.

dialogText.cn: 您说得对，现在大家都很疲惫，我很担心会节外生枝。
dialogText.en: You're right. Everyone's exhausted now. I'm really worried something unexpected might happen.

dialogText.cn: 得再靠近些，确认更多情报。顺便还得想办法通过这些障碍……
dialogText.en: Need to get closer to confirm more intel. And somehow get past these obstacles...

dialogText.cn: 您愿意帮忙吗？太感谢了！那我们这就开始吧！
dialogText.en: You're willing to help? Thank you so much! Let's get started then!

dialogText.cn: 场面越来越夸张了……
dialogText.en: The scene keeps getting more extreme...

dialogText.cn: 这里似乎不在我们的进攻路线上，反攻队伍的战后报告也没有关于这里的记录。
dialogText.en: This area doesn't seem to be on our assault route. The counterattack team's after-action reports don't mention this place either.

dialogText.cn: 事件很可能发生在我们发起反攻之前。但那时候这里应该到处都是碾骨氏族的人……
dialogText.en: The incident likely occurred before we launched our counterattack. But back then, this area should've been swarming with Bonekrushers...

dialogText.cn: 结合先前发现的异状，在我们不知道的地方，一定还发生了许多事。
dialogText.en: Combined with the earlier anomalies, many things must have happened in places we're unaware of.

dialogText.cn: 大战刚刚过去，现在可不能放过任何潜在的威胁。
dialogText.en: A major battle just ended. We can't afford to overlook any potential threats now.

dialogText.cn: 明白，我先找找附近有没有可以通行的路线。
dialogText.en: Understood, I'll check if there's a passable route nearby first.

dialogText.cn: 我的天，他、他难道是……“火山”查查？！
dialogText.en: My goodness, is he... "Volcano" Chacha?!

dialogText.cn: 在最近的大规模内部统合之前，“火山”是碾骨氏族最有影响力的几个领袖之一。
dialogText.en: Before the recent large-scale internal consolidation, "Volcano" was one of the most influential leaders in the Bonekrusher Clan.

dialogText.cn: 他用实力征服了许多氏族内的零散力量，进行了数十次针对小型聚落和商队的袭击。
dialogText.en: He used his strength to conquer many scattered forces within the clan, launching dozens of attacks on small settlements and merchant convoys.

dialogText.cn: 实际上也是。“火山”和“碾骨之拳”的矛盾就连我们都略知一二，两股势力经常发生冲突。
dialogText.en: Actually, yes. Even we knew about the conflict between "Volcano" and "Bonekrushing Fist". Their factions clashed frequently.

dialogText.cn: “火山”号称在大地上没有能与他匹敌的对手，虽然有夸张成分，但实力的确不容小觑。
dialogText.en: "Volcano" claimed no one on earth could rival him. While that's exaggerated, his strength was truly formidable.

dialogText.cn: 如此看来，碾骨氏族几乎在四号谷地倾巢而出了……这个代价可不小啊。
dialogText.en: Looking at it this way, the Bonekrushers practically went all-in in Valley IV... That's a steep price to pay.

dialogText.cn: 一把锐利的短刀落在了地面上，刀刃还沾染着血液。
dialogText.en: A sharp dagger lies on the ground, its blade still stained with blood.

dialogText.cn: 刀身隐隐有些扭曲，似乎抵挡过某种巨大的能量冲击。
dialogText.en: The blade appears slightly warped, as if it blocked some massive energy impact.

dialogText.cn: 附近被超域爆发现象破坏得太严重了，还好您有办法提取终端机的数据。
dialogText.en: The area's too badly damaged by Ætherside bursts. Good thing you managed to extract the terminal data anyway.

dialogText.cn: 一次秘密会晤。“火山”和那个“影子”在这里碰面，然后再也没能离开。
dialogText.en: A secret meeting. "Volcano" and that "Shadow" met here ... and never left.

dialogText.cn: 大地上没有对手的他死在这里……总觉得像是什么恶趣味笑话。
dialogText.en: The man who claimed no rivals on this land died here ... feels like some kind of twisted joke.

dialogText.cn: 失败的计划。他被背叛了，不只是“影子”，还有“影子”口中的那些“朋友”。
dialogText.en: A failed plan. He was betrayed. Not just by "Shadow", but also by those so-called "friends" "Shadow" mentioned.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您觉得那张纸条会是写给谁的？
dialogText.en: Who do you think that note was meant for, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 是吗？总觉得有些对不上号……
dialogText.en: Really? Something still feels off...

dialogText.cn: 按纸条上的口气，能比“火山”更有资格的人确实没有几个。
dialogText.en: Given the tone of the note, there really aren't many people with higher authority than "Volcano".

dialogText.cn: “断头台”“鬼火”“血眼”……还有许多人和这起事件有牵连。
dialogText.en: "Guillotine", "Will-o-Wisp", "Bloodeye"... So many others tied to this incident.

dialogText.cn: 深度分析就交给后方专家们吧，也许四号谷地还有没发现的情报，得把它们全揪出来。
dialogText.en: Let's leave the deep analysis to the experts back at base. There might still be undiscovered intel in Valley IV. We need to dig it all up.

dialogText.cn: 的确如此……
dialogText.en: True enough...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这把刀……有点古怪。
dialogText.en: Huh? This blade ... seems odd.

dialogText.cn: 我没记错的话，这是裂地者里那些精英会用的武器。
dialogText.en: If I remember correctly, this is the type of weapon used by elites among the Landbreakers.

dialogText.cn: 他们几乎从来不会舍弃自己的“第二生命”，竟然就这么抛掉了……
dialogText.en: They almost never abandon their "second life", yet they just tossed it aside like this...

dialogText.cn: 现在还不好判断……我先去前面看看，或许有什么不一样的发现。
dialogText.en: Hard to say for now... I'll check ahead, might find something different.

dialogText.cn: 附近被超域爆发现象破坏得太严重了，还好您有办法提取终端机的数据。
dialogText.en: The area's too badly damaged by Ætherside bursts. Good thing you managed to extract the terminal data anyway.

dialogText.cn: 一次秘密会晤。“火山”和那个“影子”在这里碰面，然后再也没能离开。
dialogText.en: A secret meeting. "Volcano" and that "Shadow" met here ... and never left.

dialogText.cn: 大地上没有对手的他死在这里……总觉得像是什么恶趣味笑话。
dialogText.en: The man who claimed no rivals on this land died here ... feels like some kind of twisted joke.

dialogText.cn: 失败的计划。他被背叛了，不只是“影子”，还有“影子”口中的那些“朋友”。
dialogText.en: A failed plan. He was betrayed. Not just by "Shadow", but also by those so-called "friends" "Shadow" mentioned.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您觉得那张纸条会是写给谁的？
dialogText.en: Who do you think that note was meant for, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 是吗？总觉得有些对不上号……
dialogText.en: Really? Something still feels off...

dialogText.cn: 按纸条上的口气，能比“火山”更有资格的人确实没有几个。
dialogText.en: Given the tone of the note, there really aren't many people with higher authority than "Volcano".

dialogText.cn: 总之，结合其他几处位置的信息，应该已经能得出一些结果了。
dialogText.en: Anyway, combining intel from the other locations should give us some concrete results now.

dialogText.cn: 我会在枢纽区基地打听有没有更多消息，请您使用协议同步器向S.O.W.提交资料吧。
dialogText.en: I'll ask around the Hub base for more intel. Please use the protocol synchronizer to submit the data to SOW.

dialogText.cn: 后方的专家们应该会再提供一些分析结果，我们可以在情报档案库里接收他们的最终报告。
dialogText.en: The experts back at base should provide further analysis. We can retrieve their final report from the Intel Archive.

dialogText.cn: 的确如此……
dialogText.en: True enough...

dialogText.cn: 怎么会找不到了？这下完蛋了！完蛋了！完蛋了！
dialogText.en: Why can't I find it? I'm so finished! It's over! Just my blighted luck!

dialogText.cn: 我真该死！这东西比我的命还重要！
dialogText.en: I doomed my entire career! The thing is way more important than my life!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我同事现在情绪有点激动。我叫<@qu.key>琼</>，他是<@qu.key>林奈</>，我们是这里的研究人员。
dialogText.en: Sorry. My colleague <@qu.key>Linnaeus</> is a little emotional right now. I'm <@qu.key>Joan</>. We're both scientists working in this area.

dialogText.cn: ……我已经快要成功了，都是因为那些该死的裂地者！
dialogText.en: And I was so close...! Those blighted breakers ruined everything!

dialogText.cn: 要不是他们突然袭击，我也不会把药剂弄丢。药剂我一直随身带着的，一定是撤离时弄丢了。
dialogText.en: The raiders suddenly attacked us. I should have been carrying that bottle of medicinal sample ... but I ... I must have lost it during the evac.

dialogText.cn: 我走得晚，当时该先问问你的情况，说不定能帮上忙。唉……一切都太突然了。
dialogText.en: I evacced the place after you left... Ugh. I should have asked you about your situation and maybe found the sample before I left... The LB attack came way out of the blue.

dialogText.cn: 对。林奈主攻植物学，他正在尝试提取植物成分来研制一种能提高生物机能的药剂。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Linnaeus is a plant scientist. He's trying to develop a bio-activity booster agent with plant extracts.

dialogText.cn: 这个研究本来马上就能推进到下一步，经费也快批下来了……偏偏在这个节骨眼儿上……
dialogText.en: He reached a pretty good milestone. His grant for the next phase was even approved... And then he ... well... This couldn't have happened at a worse time.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，琼……说实话，研究评议时，我还把你当作最强劲的竞争对手呢……
dialogText.en: Thank you, Joan... I ... I used to treat you as my worst rival during project review...

dialogText.cn: 但现在……你却一直陪在我身边。
dialogText.en: But now you're ... the only one who's willing to stay and help me out.

dialogText.cn: 别说这些见外的话，做研究有多不容易，我再清楚不过了。为了培育这些长耳兽，我也掉了不少头发。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Linn. I know very well how tough research can be. I myself lost plenty of sleep trying to rear my long-ears properly.

dialogText.cn: 至于研究……我会堂堂正正地在评议中和你竞争。
dialogText.en: As for the grant money... I intend to get my share fair and square, so you'll still see me attending the project reviews.

dialogText.cn: 线索……其实我现在也没什么头绪。
dialogText.en: Leads ... I ... I don't have any leads right now.

dialogText.cn: 我一直把药剂带在身上。当时我正在<@qu.key>公路旁的工作平台</>采集植物样本，裂地者突然来袭，我就逃到<@qu.key>转运枢纽的入口</>避难，谁知那里也被裂地者占领了。
dialogText.en: I always carried a bottle with me. And ... I was collecting plant samples at the <@qu.key>work platform next to the road</> when the LBs attacked. I ran to the <@qu.key>Transport Nexus entrance</> during the evac but the LBs also occupied that place.

dialogText.cn: 估计就是落在转运枢纽了，现在肯定很难找回来了……
dialogText.en: It's probably lost at the Transport Nexus. There's no way I can get it back...

dialogText.cn: 转运枢纽那儿时不时还有裂地者游荡，我差点……嗯，我听别人说那边现在乱糟糟的。
dialogText.en: There might be LB bands roaming around the Transport Nexus. I almost ... well... People say the raiders really messed up the place.

dialogText.cn: 也可能是掉在公路边采集样本的地方了。不过……那边已经被侵蚀覆盖了。
dialogText.en: Perhaps you dropped it by the road where you often gather your samples. But ... the Blight has covered the entire place.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗！那就拜托你了！药剂是橙色的，装在一个圆柱形的瓶子里，很好辨认！我们在实验室也再找找！
dialogText.en: Really? Oh, thank you so much! The medicine is an orange solution contained with a cylindrical bottle! It's really easy to identify! We'll also keep searching the lab!

dialogText.cn: 你来了？找到了吗？
dialogText.en: You're here! Did you find the bottle of meds?

dialogText.cn: 是这个！怎么……怎么只剩下这一点儿了。这点儿量连一轮测试都不够……
dialogText.en: Yeah, this is the bottle! But ... there's hardly anything left! It's not even enough for a single test cycle...!

dialogText.cn: 剩这些至少比没有强……现在再制备药剂还来得及吗？
dialogText.en: At least it's better than nothing... Do we have time to make some more?

dialogText.cn: 来不及了……制备这种药剂还需要一种稀有真菌来催化。
dialogText.en: No, we're out of time... The pharmaceutical formula can only be catalyzed with a special fungus that's really rare.

dialogText.cn: 这种真菌很难在实验室里培养出来，而我从野外采集的样本也用完了……
dialogText.en: I haven't figured out how to culture this fungus in lab conditions ... and I'm almost out of fungal mass collected from the wilderness...

dialogText.cn: 哪有这么容易，这种真菌总是长在隐蔽的角落里，现在也快过季节了……
dialogText.en: It's not that easy! The fungus tends to grow in well-hidden places. Fruiting season is almost over...

dialogText.cn: 况且这附近的应该都被我采完了……
dialogText.en: And ... I'm afraid I picked this place dry too...

dialogText.cn: 别丧气！我倒是有个想法，上一次试验时，我的长耳兽已经具备了初步的追踪能力。
dialogText.en: Don't give up! I just got an idea! During the last test, my long-ears gained the basic ability of tracking various materials.

dialogText.cn: 给它喂一点儿样本，它就可以循着气味找到原料，或者其他相关的材料。
dialogText.en: Feed it something and it'll start tracking the same stuff by smell. Might even work for certain materials.

dialogText.cn: 他们吃太多了！那种真菌确实会让人产生幻觉，甚至癫狂。
dialogText.en: They ate too much of it! The fungus does have mild mind-altering effects and overdosing on it might drive you crazy.

dialogText.cn: 我之前进行过计算，只要控制好药剂的用量，不会有太大影响的。
dialogText.en: I did the maths. Just control the dose and things should be alright.

dialogText.cn: 不过，现在剩余的也只够长耳兽吃一次，这追踪能力才刚刚有突破，万一失败了，我就真的一无所有了。
dialogText.en: But I'm afraid the amount left is only enough for a sip for the long-ears. This tracking ability sounds largely untested. If the critters fail, I would really lose everything.

dialogText.cn: 好歹还能用这一点儿药剂证明我没有白干……
dialogText.en: This little sip is all I have to prove that I actually worked on something...

dialogText.cn: 没问题！但长耳兽跑得太快了，又喜欢钻到一些管道里去，我常常追不上，所以一直没在野外做过实验。
dialogText.en: No problem! But long-ears can be really fast and enjoy squeezing themselves into narrow pipes and tunnels. They're way too fast for me, so I never really performed a field trial.

dialogText.cn: 既然琼都这么说了……不如就试试吧！我相信琼……也相信你！
dialogText.en: Well, Joan's idea seems like the only solution... Let's give it a shot! I believe in Joan ... and you!

dialogText.cn: 好的，我先去准备一下。你们随后过来。
dialogText.en: Great. I'll set things up. Come talk to me when you're ready.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，要是没有琼……和你，我真不知道该怎么办了。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much. I wouldn't know what to do if Joan weren't here. Of course, you're really important too!

dialogText.cn: 不，在我看来不是。你是我的救星！还有，琼……
dialogText.en: No! You're doing more than that! You're saving my entire career! And Joan...

dialogText.cn: 来得正好，我已经准备好了。
dialogText.en: Ah. Perfect timing. I'm all set.

dialogText.cn: 我们可以先试试给长耳兽喂一些常见的东西，你觉得用什么好呢？
dialogText.en: We can try feeding the long-ear with some common plants. Any suggestions?

dialogText.cn: 好的，那就先用荞花！
dialogText.en: Great. We'll let it nibble on some buckflower berries!

dialogText.cn: 第一次在野外试验，一定要顺利……
dialogText.en: The first field trial. Hope this works. Fingers crossed...

dialogText.cn: 你回来了！结果如何？
dialogText.en: You're back! What's our result?

dialogText.cn: 太棒了！野外试验成功，长耳兽真的做到了！
dialogText.en: Oh, wonderful! The field trial is a success! My long-ears did it!

dialogText.cn: 但这只是单次试验的成功，我还是有些担心。不如我们再用别的试试？
dialogText.en: Well, we should play it safe and perform a second trial to verify this ability. Should we use another plant for this test?

dialogText.cn: 说得有道理……好，这次换一种！又要麻烦你了！
dialogText.en: Sounds reasonable... Alright, then. Another test with another plant! We're counting on you!

dialogText.cn: 这次情况如何？
dialogText.en: How did it go?

dialogText.cn: 太好了！林奈，我们快给长耳兽使用药剂吧！
dialogText.en: Wonderful! Linn, let's feed the long-ear with that medicine of yours!

dialogText.cn: 琼，你确定吗？这可是有风险的……我能控制剂量，但万一长耳兽食用后出现了什么问题……
dialogText.en: You sure, Joan? I can prepare a dose to match the weight of your long-ear, but ... if something bad happens to the little critter...

dialogText.cn: 林奈，你是一个为研究付出一切的人。为了你……我是说为了你的研究，我愿意承担这个风险。
dialogText.en: Linn, you're a man who's fully committed to science. I'll do anything for you... Ahem, for your research, I mean. Yes, I'm willing to accept this risk.

dialogText.cn: 琼……我……我不知道该如何感谢你。
dialogText.en: I ... I don't know how to thank you, Joan...

dialogText.cn: 我们得抓紧时间。其他的……等这事结束后再说。
dialogText.en: We must hurry, Linn. We'll ... we'll work out the rest after this is all over.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。看来又要麻烦你一次了……
dialogText.en: Yeah. I guess you gotta do one more round of running for us.

dialogText.cn: 怎……怎么样？
dialogText.en: How ... how did it go?

dialogText.cn: 啊！就是这个！
dialogText.en: Oh! YES! THIS IS IT!

dialogText.cn: 我……我不知道怎么……
dialogText.en: I ... I could never thank you enough for this...

dialogText.cn: 没有你们，我这么多年的努力就要白费了。
dialogText.en: You saved my entire career! Years of hard work salvaged by your miraculous intervention!

dialogText.cn: 而且你找到的这个菌株比我之前那份大得多，这对我的研究会有非常大的帮助！
dialogText.en: And this fungal mass you found is far bigger than the one I had! This is really going to push my project forward!

dialogText.cn: 我……我一定要好好报答你！我要给你最好的谢礼！我先去实验室准备一下！
dialogText.en: I ... I'm definitely giving you something in return! It's going to be the best! I'll go and prepare it in the lab!

dialogText.cn: 好久没见到林奈这么开心了……
dialogText.en: Well, an overjoyed Linn is quite a rare sight...

dialogText.cn: 还好他的研究成果没有被浪费……我也为他高兴。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness his research is saved... I'm very happy for him.

dialogText.cn: 你在说什么……我不太明白。
dialogText.en: What do you mean by that...? I don't understand.

dialogText.cn: 你……你是怎么发现的！
dialogText.en: How...?! How did you find out?

dialogText.cn: 况且我今天帮他找到了真菌，也算是互帮互助了。
dialogText.en: I helped him find his special fungus today, so I believe we're helping each other out.

dialogText.cn: 你看到了终端？看来，你已经知道是怎么回事了……
dialogText.en: And you read its contents? Hmph. So I got found out...

dialogText.cn: 我的研究已经停滞很久了。但在长耳兽误食那些沾染了药剂的青草后，我又重燃了希望。
dialogText.en: My research has bottlenecked for too long. But when my long-ears accidentally ate Linnaeus's medicine, the results gave me new hope.

dialogText.cn: 仅仅是废弃的药剂就能有这样的效果，如果是完善的药剂，我的研究一定能成功。
dialogText.en: If pharmaceutical waste itself gave such stellar performances, the perfected formula is guaranteed to propel my research to success.

dialogText.cn: 我们确实有竞争关系……但我真的只是为了研究能成功。
dialogText.en: I... It's true we're competitors... But all I really care for is the success of my project.

dialogText.cn: 我确实有私心。但私心和真心是可以共存的……不是吗？
dialogText.en: I confess that I had my own goals, but they don't contradict my sincerity in helping Linn. What do you think?

dialogText.cn: 算了，真心无法用言语证明，你自己做判断吧。
dialogText.en: Forget it. Why should I care? You can't prove sincerity with mere words. Do whatever you like with that "finding".

dialogText.cn: 可我也没有别的办法了……要是研究失败……我——
dialogText.en: I was already out of options... If my research flops... I...

dialogText.cn: 也许你觉得我是在给自己找借口，但对我来说，研究确实高于一切。
dialogText.en: You might think I'm just finding excuses for myself, but I'll lay it out in the open. My project is of utmost importance to me.

dialogText.cn: 为了研究的成功，我愿意付出任何代价……哪怕是他的信任。
dialogText.en: I'll sacrifice anything to ensure its success ... even his good faith in me.

dialogText.cn: 你来了？谢礼我已经准备好了！这次多亏了你和琼！
dialogText.en: You've arrived! I got your present right here! You and Joan are my lifesavers.

dialogText.cn: 虽然很不好意思，但我还想拜托你一件事……
dialogText.en: And ... I know this may sound weird, but I wonder if I can ask you something...

dialogText.cn: 这段时间相处下来，我感觉琼和我也蛮合得来的，说不定……
dialogText.en: So I've spent some time with Joan and I think we make a good ... a good match, you know. Maybe...

dialogText.cn: 等事态平息后，你觉得我应该跟她表明心意吗？
dialogText.en: I mean ... when things settle down, maybe I should confess my feelings to her. What do you think?

dialogText.cn: 为什么这么说？是我哪里做得不对吗？
dialogText.en: Wha...? Why? Did I do something wrong?

dialogText.cn: 什么？你一定是在开玩笑。
dialogText.en: What? You gotta be kidding.

dialogText.cn: 我……我不相信。这不可能。
dialogText.en: I ... I can't believe it! She's after my meds ... impossible...

dialogText.cn: 好像是那天晚上……我把她的长耳兽送回去时……把长耳兽吃了沾染废弃药剂的青草这件事告诉了她……
dialogText.en: I guess it happened that night... I sent her long-ears back ... and told her that they nibbled on some grass contaminated by pharmaceutical waste...

dialogText.cn: 还有，这是我给你准备的，你拿去吧。
dialogText.en: Oh, and... This is for you. Take it.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？那就是应该主动出击，对吧！
dialogText.en: REALLY?! Just ask her out, right?

dialogText.cn: 你觉得我还需要准备什么吗？现在一切都乱糟糟的……似乎不是个好时机。
dialogText.en: Don't you think I should prepare something? Things are a real mess right now... Timing seems a little off.

dialogText.cn: 从长耳兽出发吗……我懂了！
dialogText.en: Her long-ears...? Those critters? Oh... I get it!

dialogText.cn: 你真是帮了我大忙！这是我给你准备的，你一定要收下。
dialogText.en: You really are a lifesaver! And yeah, I got this for you! TAKE IT OFF MY HANDS!

dialogText.cn: 对不起，我需要静一静……
dialogText.en: I ... I'm sorry... I gotta calm down for a bit...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你……总算是出来了。
dialogText.en: You freed me from the place... Thank you so much.

dialogText.cn: 我是来修机器人的。这附近之前爆发了侵蚀，我只好进来躲一下，没想到被困住了。
dialogText.en: I came here to fix robots. But a nearby Blight rupture forced me to seek shelter here. Ended up trapping myself in this place.

dialogText.cn: 机器人损坏得很严重，我得抓紧时间修理。
dialogText.en: Our robots got really damaged. I must get them fixed ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 什么？你上手修了？
dialogText.en: What? YOU ... FIXED ... THEM?!

dialogText.cn: 你……你怎么能这样？这些机器人的修理难度很高，万一被弄坏了……
dialogText.en: HOW...?! You are not allowed to do that! These robots are extremely hard to repair. If you break them...

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？可它的源石回路非常复杂，就算是维修专员也需要培训才……
dialogText.en: Really? But its Originium circuitry is super complex! Even a professional needs proper training to...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，管理员，我是布龙泽，刚才没第一时间认出你，才闹了这样的误会。
dialogText.en: I'm really sorry, Endmin. Name's Bronzer. Should've recognized you from the get-go and avoided that misunderstanding.

dialogText.cn: 我叫你帮忙？怎么可能。难不成……你遇到的是库珀？
dialogText.en: Me? Ask you for help? IMPOSSIBLE! Hold on... Maybe Copper was the one who asked.

dialogText.cn: 他是我弟弟，倒是经常有人把我们搞混。
dialogText.en: Copper's my younger twin. Most people can't tell us apart.

dialogText.cn: 本来他要和我一起过来的……但这里太危险了，我就让他在工人之家等我。
dialogText.en: He wanted to join me for this job... But I told him to wait at the Worker Dorms 'cos the place is too dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 他怎么样？还好吗？
dialogText.en: So, how's Copper doing anyway?

dialogText.cn: 什么？他一定是又乱跑了。我早就跟他说了，他还不能独自出任务。
dialogText.en: What? And I thought I told him to avoid solo assignments! Sheesh. He probably ignored my advice and went out on his own.

dialogText.cn: 热心肠是好事，但没有过硬的技术就只会添乱。
dialogText.en: Being helpful is one thing, but if you're unskilled, you'll end up slowing down everyone else!

dialogText.cn: 他肯定是闲不住跑出去了吧？不然也不会遇到你们。
dialogText.en: He probably got bored out of his mind and sneaked off. That's how he met you, most like.

dialogText.cn: 唉……看来你给了他不少帮助。
dialogText.en: Ugh... And it seems you helped him out too.

dialogText.cn: 这是我的一点儿心意，请你一定要收下。
dialogText.en: Here. A small token of my gratitude. Take it.

dialogText.cn: 我要赶紧回工人之家了，还是有点放心不下库珀。
dialogText.en: I gotta head back to the Worker Dorms. Can't afford to leave Copper on his own, you know.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们工人之家再见吧。
dialogText.en: I'll see you again at the Worker Dorms, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 等等……这个装扮，你该不会是……管理员吧？呃，如果是管理员，这种程度的修理工作确实算不上什么……
dialogText.en: Wait... I just noticed your outfit. Are you the ... that ... Endministrator?! Well ... if you're really the Endmin, I think the job is probably super easy for you...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你……总算是出来了。
dialogText.en: You freed me from the place... Thank you so much.

dialogText.cn: 我是来修机器人的。这附近之前爆发了侵蚀，我只好进来躲一下，没想到被困住了。
dialogText.en: I came here to fix robots. But a nearby Blight rupture forced me to seek shelter here. Ended up trapping myself in this place.

dialogText.cn: 机器人损坏得很严重，我得抓紧时间修理。
dialogText.en: Our robots got really damaged. I must get them fixed ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 什么？你上手修了？
dialogText.en: What? YOU ... FIXED ... THEM?!

dialogText.cn: 你……你怎么能这样？这些机器人的修理难度很高，万一被弄坏了……
dialogText.en: HOW...?! You are not allowed to do that! These robots are extremely hard to repair. If you break them...

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？可它的源石回路非常复杂，就算是维修专员也需要培训才……
dialogText.en: Really? But its Originium circuitry is super complex! Even a professional needs proper training to...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我习惯独自出任务了。
dialogText.en: I'm used to doing my missions solo.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我明白的……这次我弟弟库珀本想跟我一起的，最后也被我拒绝了。
dialogText.en: Yeah, I know... My baby twin Copper wanted a piece of the action but I turned him down.

dialogText.cn: 还好没让他跟着，我一个人都搞不定，他来了我还要照顾他。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness I made the right choice. I couldn't handle the mission myself. If he tagged along I would have to take care of him and fail twice as hard.

dialogText.cn: 这……你说得有道理。
dialogText.en: Yeah... You make a good point.

dialogText.cn: 让我看看……确实都修好了。刚才是我太莽撞了。
dialogText.en: Let me take a look... Hmm. The repair work is actually pretty well done. Sorry for being so loud and rude back then.

dialogText.cn: 但这是特殊情况！这里靠近侵蚀爆发的核心区域，我不可能带着一个新手来执行这种复杂任务。
dialogText.en: But this is a special situation! It's too close to the Blight rupture epicenter. I can't bring a noob to a tough job like this!

dialogText.cn: 对了，这些东西你可能用得上，希望你能收下，作为我的一点儿心意。
dialogText.en: By the way, I think you might find these useful. Please take them as my token of gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 等等……这个装扮，你该不会是……管理员吧？呃，如果是管理员，这种程度的修理工作确实算不上什么……
dialogText.en: Wait... I just noticed your outfit. Are you the ... that ... Endministrator?! Well ... if you're really the Endmin, I think the job is probably super easy for you...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，管理员，我是布龙泽，刚才没第一时间认出你，才闹了这样的误会。
dialogText.en: I'm really sorry, Endmin. Name's Bronzer. Should've recognized you from the get-go and avoided that misunderstanding.

dialogText.cn: 好吧，我明白你的意思……唉，我还是赶紧回工人之家吧。
dialogText.en: Okay... I think I know where you're coming from. Ugh ... better start heading back to the Worker Dorms.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你……总算是出来了。
dialogText.en: You freed me from the place... Thank you so much.

dialogText.cn: 我是来修机器人的。这附近之前爆发了侵蚀，我只好进来躲一下，没想到被困住了。
dialogText.en: I came here to fix robots. But a nearby Blight rupture forced me to seek shelter here. Ended up trapping myself in this place.

dialogText.cn: 机器人损坏得很严重，我得抓紧时间修理。
dialogText.en: Our robots got really damaged. I must get them fixed ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 呃……不用了。我自己可以搞定。
dialogText.en: Erm... No, thanks. I can handle this job on my own.

dialogText.cn: 我比较喜欢独自工作。无意冒犯……只是工作习惯。
dialogText.en: No offense... I just prefer working alone.

dialogText.cn: 这些机器人，只有我对它们最熟悉。
dialogText.en: No one knows these robots better than me.

dialogText.cn: 我？拜托你帮忙吗？这怎么可能……
dialogText.en: Me? Ask you for help? That's not possible...

dialogText.cn: 我布龙泽可从不会在工作上麻烦别人，肯定是你弄错了。
dialogText.en: You probably made a mistake. Everyone knows that I, Bronzer, always do my own work.

dialogText.cn: 库珀？啊……看来是误会了。库珀是我的弟弟，倒是经常有人把我们搞混。
dialogText.en: Copper? Ah, bugger this. Copper's my younger twin brother and people can't tell us apart.

dialogText.cn: 该死！我的控制终端坏了。应该是刚才躲避的时候被压坏了。
dialogText.en: Friggin' buggerloids! My control terminal is busted. Prolly sat on it by accident while hiding from the disaster.

dialogText.cn: 好吧……但是你要小心。这里有很强的侵蚀干扰。
dialogText.en: Sure... But be careful. Blight interference is really bad at this place.

dialogText.cn: 居然这么快就修好了……就算是传说中的管理员——等等，你这个打扮……难道说……怎么可能……
dialogText.en: Can't believe the repairs got done so quickly... Even the legendary Endministrator couldn't — Hold on. Judging by your outfit, you're... Sheesh, that's ... impossible...!

dialogText.cn: 唉，是我太迟钝了，不仅没能马上认出你，还让你亲自去修了那么多机器人……
dialogText.en: Ugh. Guess I was a little too slow. Should've recognized you from the get-go. To think that I told you to fix these robots...

dialogText.cn: 本来这个任务我要带他一起的。但这里太危险了，就没让他跟过来。
dialogText.en: I was supposed to take him along for this mission, but I chose not to considering how dangerous this place is.

dialogText.cn: 什么？他一定是又乱跑了。我早就跟他说了，他还不能独自出任务。
dialogText.en: What? And I thought I told him to avoid solo assignments! Sheesh. He probably ignored my advice and went out on his own.

dialogText.cn: 热心肠是好事，但没有过硬的技术就只会添乱。
dialogText.en: Being helpful is one thing, but if you're unskilled, you'll end up slowing down everyone else!

dialogText.cn: 他肯定是闲不住跑出去了吧？不然也不会遇到你。
dialogText.en: He probably got bored out of his mind and sneaked off. That's how he met you, most like.

dialogText.cn: 唉……看来你给了他不少帮助。这里是我的一点儿心意，请你一定要收下。
dialogText.en: Yeah... And you really gave him plenty of help. Take this as a token of my gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 我要赶紧回工人之家了，还是有点放心不下库珀。
dialogText.en: I gotta head back to the Worker Dorms. Can't afford to leave Copper on his own, you know.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，等你回枢纽区了，可以去工人之家找我。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you can come look for me at the Worker Dorms when you return to the Hub.

dialogText.cn: 你是……管理员？
dialogText.en: Are you the ... Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 什么？他也找你修了机器人？这可真是……
dialogText.en: What? He asked you to fix robots too? Ugh. That's ridiculous...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你……总算是出来了。
dialogText.en: You freed me from the place... Thank you so much.

dialogText.cn: 我是来修机器人的。这附近之前爆发了侵蚀，我只好进来躲一下，没想到被困住了。
dialogText.en: I came here to fix robots. But a nearby Blight rupture forced me to seek shelter here. Ended up trapping myself in this place.

dialogText.cn: 机器人损坏得很严重，我得抓紧时间修理。
dialogText.en: Our robots got really damaged. I must get them fixed ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 呃……不用了。我自己可以搞定。
dialogText.en: Erm... No, thanks. I can handle this job on my own.

dialogText.cn: 我比较喜欢独自工作。无意冒犯……只是工作习惯。
dialogText.en: No offense... I just prefer working alone.

dialogText.cn: 这些机器人，只有我对它们最熟悉。
dialogText.en: No one knows these robots better than me.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你的理解……总之，我会尽快修好它们的。
dialogText.en: Thanks for your understanding... In any case, I'll get them back up and running in no time.

dialogText.cn: 该死！我的控制终端坏了。应该是刚才躲避的时候被压坏了。
dialogText.en: Friggin' buggerloids! My control terminal is busted. Prolly sat on it by accident while hiding from the disaster.

dialogText.cn: 好吧……但是你要小心。这里有很强的侵蚀干扰。
dialogText.en: Sure... But be careful. Blight interference is really bad at this place.

dialogText.cn: 对了，还没自我介绍呢，我是终末地工程中心的布龙泽。
dialogText.en: Oh, I should introduce myself. I'm Bronzer from the Endfield Engineering Division.

dialogText.cn: 居然这么快就修好了……就算是传说中的管理员——等等，你这个打扮……该不会……
dialogText.en: Can't believe the repairs got done so quickly... Even the legendary Endministrator couldn't — Hold on. Judging by your outfit, you're ... by Talos...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，本来这个任务是我和我弟弟库珀一组的，但考虑到太危险，就没让他跟着。
dialogText.en: Well, they assigned me with my baby twin Copper, but I chose to come here alone considering how dangerous things could be.

dialogText.cn: 还好没让他跟着。现在这种情况，我连自己都快顾不上了，更别说他了……
dialogText.en: Thank goodness he didn't tag along. I could barely keep myself alive. If he were here...

dialogText.cn: 唉，是的。要不是你，我就交待在这里了。这是我的一点儿心意，请收下！
dialogText.en: Yeah, you're right. I would've died if you never came. Take this. Token of my gratitude!

dialogText.cn: 我要赶紧回工人之家了。很高兴认识你！等你回枢纽区了，可以去工人之家找我。
dialogText.en: I gotta rush back. It's been a pleasure meeting you! If you ever return to the Hub, feel free to look for me at the Worker Dorms.

dialogText.cn: 你就是……管理员？
dialogText.en: Are you ... the Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，总算有人来了！
dialogText.en: Oh finally! Someone's here!

dialogText.cn: 对，我叫瓦利亚，源石副产物中心的物资调度员。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Name's Vallia. I'm the Stock Redistributor at the Originium Byproduct Processing Center.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者袭击的时候，我正好在外头运货。回来一看，这儿都快成废墟了，门口还给堵死了。
dialogText.en: I was out delivering goods when the Landbreakers attacked. When I came back, the whole place was wrecked and the entrance was completely blocked.

dialogText.cn: 我花了大半天才把门口那堆破烂清干净，正准备把物资运进去，结果发现大楼的门压根儿打不开了。
dialogText.en: Took me hours to clear that mess by the door. Just when I was to carry the supplies back in, I realized I couldn't even get the gate to budge.

dialogText.cn: 我猜是裂地者把控制系统给弄坏了。估计他们想强行开门，反倒直接把它搞瘫痪了……这群蠢货当坏人都当得不专业。
dialogText.en: Guess the Landbreakers wrecked the control system. They probably tried to force their way in and ended up breaking the entire thing... Bunch of idiots — even bad at being bad.

dialogText.cn: 果然……但比我想得要好一些。
dialogText.en: Just as I thought ... but it's better than what I expected.

dialogText.cn: 总控开关的保护机制被触发了，现在整个大楼都处在断电状态。
dialogText.en: The main switch activated its safety and disconnected. The entire building is off the grid.

dialogText.cn: 应该不是……从撤离通知看，他们走得还挺匆忙的。
dialogText.en: I don't think so... The evac notice showed that everyone left in a big hurry.

dialogText.cn: 现在裂地者都被赶走了，支援也已经在路上了。这里需要尽快恢复运作，得想办法把总控开关重新打开。
dialogText.en: The LBs are gone and support is on its way, so we gotta get the BPPC back in business. I need to figure out how to turn the main switch back on.

dialogText.cn: 现在箱子处于错位状态，需要将悬浮箱子移动至感应开关上，总控开关才能重启。
dialogText.en: The crates are currently at the wrong positions. Move the floating crates to the pressure switches to re-activate the main switch.

dialogText.cn: 整个大楼的电力系统在逐步恢复，这个过程有点缓慢，因为重启也是一个系统自检的过程。
dialogText.en: Building power system is getting back online. It's a little slow but the system probably has to undergo post-reset self-diagnostics.

dialogText.cn: 奇怪……
dialogText.en: Hold on. Now this is weird...

dialogText.cn: 所有的程序都是正常的，但生产系统的主电源怎么都打不开。
dialogText.en: All the sub-routines are working properly, but the production system power mains are still off the grid.

dialogText.cn: 我需要在这里等待系统自检完成。你能否去二楼查看一下，看看是否有其他地方出现故障？
dialogText.en: I need to stay here and monitor the self-diagnostics process. Can you head to 2F and check if anything broke down at that place?

dialogText.cn: 这个装置好像被人动过……
dialogText.en: I think someone moved this mechanism...

dialogText.cn: 说实话……我也不确定。
dialogText.en: Hmm ... I'm afraid I don't really know.

dialogText.cn: 工团建筑的设计逻辑和终末地的不太一样，只能说这个装置看起来像是某种开关。
dialogText.en: UWST facilities are worlds apart from what we have at Endfield. If I must make a guess, I'd say the device looks like some type of switch.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者都走了？
dialogText.en: Are the LBs gone?

dialogText.cn: 快别提了，我差点儿就没命了……
dialogText.en: Ugh. I dun wanna talk about it. Almost got myself killed...

dialogText.cn: 你是终末地派来支援的？总算等到了。不枉我发了那么多次求助信号……我是兰姆，在这里工作。
dialogText.en: Are you the support from Endfield? Thank goodness you've finally answered all the SOS messages I've spammed into the system... I'm Rammu. I work here.

dialogText.cn: 这是生产系统主电源的开关。如果不把它关上，大楼的自动生产系统就会继续运行，裂地者就能不断从这里获得源石制品的补给……
dialogText.en: It's the switch of the production system power mains. If nobody switches it off, the building's auto-production system will keep working and supplying those blighted LBs with a ton of Originium products...

dialogText.cn: 是的，我把它关上的。关闭整个系统需要很长的时间，我只能让别人先走。当完全关上的时候，大楼外面已经被裂地者占领了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I switched it off. Shutting down the entire system takes a while. The others left first. When I was done, the LBs had completely surrounded this building.

dialogText.cn: 所以我找个地方躲了起来，等待支援。
dialogText.en: That's why I hid myself to await rescue.

dialogText.cn: 这个……可能有些困难。这套系统在完全关闭后会重置成初始状态，我对恢复系统运作的流程不是很熟悉……
dialogText.en: Oh ... that might be a little hard. The system resets to its default settings upon complete shut down. I'm ... uh ... not really familiar about restoring system operations...

dialogText.cn: 你搞定了？我这边显示生产系统主电源已经开启了！
dialogText.en: You got the things to work! I got a notification telling me that the production system power mains are back online!

dialogText.cn: 这里还有人？是他关闭了电源吗？
dialogText.en: Another? Was this crew mate the one who shut down the power mains?

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样……我还以为……
dialogText.en: Is that so...? I thought he...

dialogText.cn: 唉，这么一想，万一真让裂地者占据了这里的生产系统，后果不堪设想。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Come to think of it, if the LBs really took control of this production system, we'll be in for super serious trouble.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，多亏了他……也谢谢你的帮忙，现在这里总算能正常运作了。
dialogText.en: Indeed. We gotta thank the dude ... and you as well, of course. The BPPC is finally back in business.

dialogText.cn: 这是我的一点心意，请你收下。
dialogText.en: Here. Take this. A token of my gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 又见面了，管理员！抱歉……上回没能当场认出你，还是回去后我哥提醒了我……
dialogText.en: We meet again, Endmin! Sorry ... should've recognized you back then. My older twin reminded me after I went back...

dialogText.cn: 咳，这些之后再聊，先说正事……我刚刚清点了一下，有很多机器人还在外面没有回来。
dialogText.en: Ahem. Let's talk about that afterwards. Business first... I made an inventory count and ... many of our robots are still out there.

dialogText.cn: 它们很可能也是坏掉了，你见到后能顺手帮忙修理一下吗？修好后，它们会自己回来的！
dialogText.en: They might have broken down. If you come across any of them, can you repair them for us? They'll make it back on their own.

dialogText.cn: 拜托你了，我会给你报酬的！
dialogText.en: Please help! You'll be fully compensated for your troubles!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来啦。情况如何？
dialogText.en: Ah, you're back, Endmin! How goes our repair work?

dialogText.cn: 它们已经安全回来了！
dialogText.en: I know! And they've returned! Safe and sound!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，这是一点心意。
dialogText.en: Thanks a lot. Take this. A token of our appreciation.

dialogText.cn: 还有一些机器人散落在外面，拜托你继续帮忙修一下！
dialogText.en: A few more robots are still missing. If you run into them, please, fix them for us.

dialogText.cn: 希望它们能平安回来……
dialogText.en: Hope they could find their way home...

dialogText.cn: 所有的机器人都回来了！太感谢你了，管理员。
dialogText.en: All the robots have returned! Thank you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你了。这是说好的报酬，你一定要收下。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! Please take this. The compensation we promised.

dialogText.cn: 这段时间，我沉下心学习了一阵，应该马上就可以独自出外勤了！
dialogText.en: I also got myself to sit down and study for a while. I should be ready for solo field missions soon enough!

dialogText.cn: 所有的机器人都回来了！太感谢你了，管理员。
dialogText.en: All the robots have returned! Thank you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你了。这是说好的报酬，你一定要收下。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! Please take this. The compensation we promised.

dialogText.cn: 对了，我哥哥布龙泽也有维修机器人的任务，不过他去了矿脉源区那边，一直没有回来……
dialogText.en: My older twin, Bronzer, also has a mission for repairing robots. He went to the Origin Lodespring and hasn't returned for a while...

dialogText.cn: 能拜托你去看看吗？但一定要小心！那边很危险。
dialogText.en: Can you help look around that place? Be careful, though! It can be really dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！又见面了。听说库珀给你添了不少麻烦。
dialogText.en: We meet again, Endmin! Heard people saying that Copper gave you plenty of trouble.

dialogText.cn: 还不是因为你不带我，一个人跑去矿区缆车站……
dialogText.en: And that's all because you left me here and ran off to the Mines cable car station on your own...

dialogText.cn: 你还没到能独自出外勤的水平。
dialogText.en: Look now, baby bro. You're not good enough for solo missions yet.

dialogText.cn: 你不也是靠管理员帮忙……
dialogText.en: Whatever. You got the Endmin to help you out as well...

dialogText.cn: 你好啊，管理员。
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 不知道库珀这小子跑哪儿去了，真不让人省心……
dialogText.en: Ugh. Where did Copper run off to again? That boy's always causing trouble...

dialogText.cn: 我和我哥哥布龙泽各有所长。我更喜欢研究新技术和新模块，而他比较擅长修理方面的工作，以及应对突发状况。
dialogText.en: Bronzer and I have different skills. I like playing around with new tech and modules. Bronzer's more skilled in repair work and emergencies.

dialogText.cn: 我重新调试了这些机器人，它们的性能得到了显著提升！
dialogText.en: I tuned these robots again. Their performance should be significantly improved.

dialogText.cn: 总之，非常感谢你，管理员。
dialogText.en: In any case, we have you to thank, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 怎么办……那些都是大家的心血啊……
dialogText.en: What should I do... People really worked hard for this...

dialogText.cn: 是这样的……我刚发现有三份关键的研究资料没带出来……
dialogText.en: Well... I just found out that I left three key research data files behind...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你！那就拜托了……那三份研究资料都存放在便携终端里。
dialogText.en: Really? Thank you so much...! The three data files have been stored in handyterms. Just look for those!

dialogText.cn: 对了，我叫<@qu.key>基特</>，待会儿我会和你通话，告诉你里面的情况。
dialogText.en: Before I forget, my name's <@qu.key>Kitt</>. I'll stay on the comms and try to tell you what I know about this area.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，谢谢你愿意帮忙……
dialogText.en: Thanks for agreeing to help, Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 那些研究资料真的很重要，拜托你进去把它们取回来吧！
dialogText.en: Those research data files are really important! Please help me retrieve them!

dialogText.cn: 好大的机器……
dialogText.en: This machine is huge...

dialogText.cn: 走廊拐角处那个吗？那是用来检测样品辐射强度的。
dialogText.en: Are you talking about the unit at the corridor bend? That's our sample radiation intensity scanner.

dialogText.cn: 平时伊冯一个人在那儿鼓捣的时候，我一直以为她在借用那些装置。没想到她是在装防御激光！
dialogText.en: I often see Yvonne working that machine on her own. Thought she was using it to run some scans. Turns out she was installing defensive lasers all over the place!

dialogText.cn: 伊冯的行动确实不能以常理推断……
dialogText.en: Well, Yvonne does act in mysterious ways...

dialogText.cn: 好多培育中的源石晶簇……
dialogText.en: They're growing so many Originium clusters here...

dialogText.cn: 我采取了一种新的培育方式，调整了一些环境参数。我已经把培育过程写成论文投出去了……但还在评审阶段。
dialogText.en: I adopted a new crystal cultivation approach and tweaked the environmental parameters. I even submitted a paper based on this special cultivation process ... but it's still being peer reviewed by the journal.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，那是我们特别宝贵的研究成果！最大的那丛是我培育的哦。
dialogText.en: Hah! That's the fruit of our project! I actually cultivated the biggest cluster, you know.

dialogText.cn: 你、你是……？
dialogText.en: Who ... who the hell are you...?

dialogText.cn: 管……管理员？谢天谢地，总算是有人来了。我是工团研究员<@qu.key>哈珀</>。
dialogText.en: End... Endministrator...? Oh thank Talos! Someone actually came to this place. I'm <@qu.key>Harper</>, a UWST scientist.

dialogText.cn: 我的心血……我的研究成果都在这里。我不能走。
dialogText.en: My research... A lifetime of blood and sweat... They're all here. I can't leave them unattended.

dialogText.cn: 我已经准备好了，如果裂地者来了，就和他们拼命！
dialogText.en: I'm ready to die for them! If the LBs come here, they'll have to reckon with me!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？那我是不是马上就可以……继续研究了？
dialogText.en: Really? Does that mean that I can get ... started on my research again?

dialogText.cn: 唉，好吧。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Fine.

dialogText.cn: 回收资料？谁让你来回收资料的？
dialogText.en: Retrieve a data file? Who asked you to do that?

dialogText.cn: 我明白了，但我这里的资料你没法儿回收。
dialogText.en: Got it. But you can't retrieve the files from my place.

dialogText.cn: 这个研究资料比较特殊，没办法带离这里。它的保密级别比较高，加密方式也很特殊。
dialogText.en: This research file is quite special. It cannot be removed from this place. It is furnished with special security and encryption measures.

dialogText.cn: 一旦被调出终端，资料就会自动销毁。
dialogText.en: The file will automatically destroy itself when removed from the terminal.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你了，你可以去看看别处有没有资料需要回收。
dialogText.en: Well, thanks for swinging by. Try looking elsewhere. Maybe you'll come across the data file you need.

dialogText.cn: 之前的那些废弃资料，好像与这个研究有一定的相关性。
dialogText.en: The abandoned data we found seems to be related to this research project.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你怎么回来了？
dialogText.en: Endmin, why did you come back?

dialogText.cn: 你说什么？我不太明白。
dialogText.en: What do you mean? I don't understand.

dialogText.cn: 啊……你都知道了？
dialogText.en: Ah ... So you ... found out about it...

dialogText.cn: 我就差一点点了……还有一点点我就成功了。
dialogText.en: I'm so close... SO CLOSE! SO FRIGGIN' CLOSE to success!

dialogText.cn: 我不可能放弃！我已经赌上了自己全部的前途和名誉。
dialogText.en: I cannot give up! I've committed my entire career and reputation on this thing!

dialogText.cn: 求求你……管理员，你会帮我保密，对吧？
dialogText.en: Please, Endmin... Will you ... keep it a secret for me?

dialogText.cn: 太谢谢你了……我保证，我真的就差一点儿了。
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you so much... I promise! I'm really *THAT* close!

dialogText.cn: 我一定不会浪费你给我的这次机会的，一定！
dialogText.en: I won't waste the second chance you gave me, Endmin! I swear!

dialogText.cn: 好吧，所有的资料都在这里了……
dialogText.en: Ugh. Fine. All the data files are here...

dialogText.cn: 我这么多年的心血……
dialogText.en: There it goes... Years of my blood, sweat, and tears...

dialogText.cn: 但愿吧，但愿这个项目不会被封存。
dialogText.en: I hope so. I hope they don't shelve this project.

dialogText.cn: 好的，让我看一看……
dialogText.en: Alright. Let me take a look...

dialogText.cn: 这个原型机……跟我的不一样！我……我怎么没想到呢。
dialogText.en: This prototype... It's really different from what I have in mind! Wha ... Why didn't I think of this?

dialogText.cn: 我可以再试一次！这个原型机给了我灵感！管理员，你可以把这个给我吗？有一些内容我可以作为参考。
dialogText.en: This prototype just gave me a jolt of inspiration! I can totally take another shot at this! Endmin! Can you ... give this to me? I really need it for reference!

dialogText.cn: 废弃资料……可能它的作者也和我一样，卡在一个地方很久很久。唉……
dialogText.en: Scrap data...? The project owners probably ended up like me. The bottleneck probably trapped them for too long...

dialogText.cn: 我的也发给你一份，必须有人把这些资料全带出去。
dialogText.en: I'll also give a copy of my research. Someone must bring a complete backup safely out of this place.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你怎么回来了？
dialogText.en: Endmin, why did you come back?

dialogText.cn: 好的。
dialogText.en: O ... kay...

dialogText.cn: 你、你是……？
dialogText.en: Who ... who the hell are you...?

dialogText.en: End... Endministrator...? Oh thank Talos! Someone actually came to this place. I'm Harper, a UWST scientist.

dialogText.cn: 我的心血……我的研究成果都在这里。我不能走。
dialogText.en: My research... A lifetime of blood and sweat... They're all here. I can't leave them unattended.

dialogText.en: I'm ready to die for them! If the LBs come here, they'll have to reckon with me!

dialogText.en: Really? Does that mean that I can get ... started on my research again?

dialogText.cn: 唉，好吧。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Fine.

dialogText.cn: 回收资料？谁让你来回收资料的？
dialogText.en: Retrieve a data file? Who asked you to do that?

dialogText.cn: 我明白了，但我这里的资料你没法儿回收。
dialogText.en: Got it. But you can't retrieve the files from my place.

dialogText.cn: 这个研究很重要，我给资料上了锁，连我自己都无法把它们拷贝出来。
dialogText.en: This research is really important. I locked the files and even I can't make a copy of them.

dialogText.cn: 一旦被调出，资料就会被毁掉。
dialogText.en: The file will also destroy itself if someone attempts to remove it.

dialogText.cn: 啊……所以你都知道了？
dialogText.en: Ah... So... I guess you sort of ... found out.

dialogText.cn: 我就差一点点了……还有一点点我就成功了。
dialogText.en: I'm so close... SO CLOSE! SO FRIGGIN' CLOSE to success!

dialogText.cn: 我不可能放弃！我已经赌上了自己全部的前途和名誉。
dialogText.en: I cannot give up! I've committed my entire career and reputation on this thing!

dialogText.cn: 求求你……管理员，你会帮我保密，对吧？
dialogText.en: Please, Endmin... Will you ... keep it a secret for me?

dialogText.cn: 太谢谢你了……我保证，我真的就差一点儿了。
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you so much... I promise! I'm really *THAT* close!

dialogText.cn: 我一定不会浪费你给我的这次机会的，一定！
dialogText.en: I won't waste the second chance you gave me, Endmin! I swear!

dialogText.en: Ugh. Fine. All the data files are here...

dialogText.cn: 我这么多年的心血……
dialogText.en: There it goes... Years of my blood, sweat, and tears...

dialogText.cn: 但愿吧，但愿这个项目不会被封存。
dialogText.en: I hope so. I hope they don't shelve this project.

dialogText.en: Alright. Let me take a look...

dialogText.cn: 这个原型机……跟我的不一样！我……我怎么没想到呢。
dialogText.en: This prototype... It's really different from what I have in mind! Wha ... Why didn't I think of this?

dialogText.cn: 我可以再试一次！这个原型机给了我灵感！管理员，你可以把这个给我吗？有一些内容我可以作为参考。
dialogText.en: This prototype just gave me a jolt of inspiration! I can totally take another shot at this! Endmin! Can you ... give this to me? I really need it for reference!

dialogText.cn: 废弃资料……可能它的作者也和我一样，卡在一个地方很久很久。唉……
dialogText.en: Scrap data...? The project owners probably ended up like me. The bottleneck probably trapped them for too long...

dialogText.cn: 我的也发给你一份，必须有人把这些资料全带出去。
dialogText.en: I'll also give a copy of my research. Someone must bring a complete backup safely out of this place.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你的食物，我饿了太久了。
dialogText.en: Thanks for the food. I've been starving for ages.

dialogText.cn: 我是安东尼……我们现在在哪里？
dialogText.en: The name's Anthony... Where are we right now?

dialogText.cn: 刚才我大脑里一片空白，现在……慢慢想起来一些东西。
dialogText.en: My mind completely blanked out just now... I'm ... I'm slowly remembering things.

dialogText.cn: 灾难发生的时候我躲了进来，没想到侵蚀爆发封住了出口……我就被困在这里了。
dialogText.en: I hid in this place during the disaster but the Blight sealed the exit and ... trapped me here.

dialogText.cn: 洞穴……我想起来了！侵蚀爆发后，我就出不去了。
dialogText.en: Cave...?! Oh, I remember! The Blight ruptured and trapped me in this dank place.

dialogText.cn: 我被困了太久，又饿又渴。然后……就什么都记不得了。
dialogText.en: I've been trapped too long and got so hungry and thirsty that I passed out... Maybe things happened but I can't remember any of them.

dialogText.cn: 源石虫呢？我记得我要喂源石虫！
dialogText.en: The Originium Slug! I need to feed my pet slug!

dialogText.cn: 我感觉脑子昏昏沉沉的……
dialogText.en: I still feel kinda woozy right now...

dialogText.cn: 如果不是你帮我，我肯定没命了。谢谢你，陌生人。
dialogText.en: But you came here and saved my life. Thank you so much, stranger.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你怎么在这里？
dialogText.en: Endmin? Why are you here?

dialogText.cn: 当然可以，我也想和你比一比！
dialogText.en: Let's do it. Always wanted to have a race with the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 我提前在山顶设置了一个标记，那里就是我们约定的疏散场地。
dialogText.en: I placed a beacon at the mountaintop to mark out our evacuation assembly site.

dialogText.cn: 不多说了，我们开始吧。
dialogText.en: Enough words. Let's start moving our legs.

dialogText.cn: 最快抵达那里的人就算获胜！
dialogText.en: The first to reach the place wins!

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 你现在有时间吗，要不要一起？
dialogText.en: Say, you free right now? Interested in joining our drill?

dialogText.cn: 加油！管理员！
dialogText.en: Go! Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 我们正在做疏散演练。
dialogText.en: We're conducting an evacuation drill.

dialogText.cn: 这次锚点冲击带来了很大损失，我们要防患于未然。
dialogText.en: This Ankhorfall hit us really badly. We must be prepped and ready for the next one at all times.

dialogText.cn: 矿脉源区的受灾情况非常严重，不仅有锚点的冲击，侵蚀爆发也十分频繁。
dialogText.en: The Origin Lodespring got hit really hard by the disaster. We got Ankhor shockwaves and plenty of Blight ruptures.

dialogText.cn: 幸运的是，在大家的努力下，伤员的搜救工作已经基本完成了。
dialogText.en: Fortunately, all the crews kept it together. SAR is basically done and all the injured are safe.

dialogText.cn: 不过，这里的高架桥被一个天使破坏了，可能需要相当长的时间才能恢复运输。
dialogText.en: And there's a buggerloid that took out an elevated bridge. It would take a while to restore local transport capacities.

dialogText.cn: 管理员最先抵达！看来你的应变能力确实很强。
dialogText.en: You're the first to reach the finishing point! You got some serious SAR skills, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 遇到紧急情况时，你肯定能化险为夷。
dialogText.en: You definitely have what it takes to survive all sorts of emergencies and disasters.

dialogText.cn: 我们现在打算回起点，你要一起来吗？
dialogText.en: We're heading back to the starting point. Wanna join us?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，下次行动要更迅速啊。
dialogText.en: Endmin, try to be faster next time.

dialogText.cn: 在发生灾难的时候，时间就是生命。
dialogText.en: When disaster strikes, a split second can decide who lives ... and who dies.

dialogText.cn: 我们现在打算回起点，你要一起来吗？
dialogText.en: We're heading back to the starting point. Wanna join us?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，管理员！又见面了！
dialogText.en: Hah! Endmin! We meet again!

dialogText.cn: 最近怎么样？要不要再来试试？
dialogText.en: How are things going for you? Interested in another race?

dialogText.cn: 矿脉源区受灾情况非常严重，不仅有锚点的冲击，侵蚀爆发也十分频繁。
dialogText.en: The disaster struck the Origin Lodespring really hard. We got Ankhorfalls and frequent Blight rupture events.

dialogText.cn: 幸运的是，在大家的共同努力下，伤员的搜救工作已经基本完成。
dialogText.en: Fortunately, all of our crews kept it together. SAR is basically done and all the injured are safe.

dialogText.cn: 然而，高架桥被一个天使破坏，导致这里的物资运输需要一段时间才能恢复正常。
dialogText.en: However, the elevated bridge was completely taken out by an Aggelos. It'll be a while before local transport capacities are restored.

dialogText.cn: 还是老规矩，先抵达终点的人获胜。
dialogText.en: Old rules. First one to reach the destination wins.

dialogText.cn: 话不多说，我们开始吧！
dialogText.en: 'Nuff talking. Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！没想到居然会在这里碰到你。
dialogText.en: Endmin! I didn't expect to run into you at this place!

dialogText.cn: 你看看这里，到处都是乱糟糟的。你在附近行动一定要小心。
dialogText.en: Look at this blighted mess. Be extra careful when moving around this place.

dialogText.cn: 救援工作终于告一段落了。我们在做防灾演练，你要和我们一起吗？
dialogText.en: We finally concluded our SAR operations and I'm giving the crew some disaster relief drills. Interested in joining us?

dialogText.cn: 爆炸造成的破坏非常严重。
dialogText.en: The explosion really wrecked the entire place.

dialogText.cn: 虽然我们协助恢复了通信，也重建了必要物资的供应链……
dialogText.en: We re-established comms and rebuilt the logistics infrastructure for essential resources and supplies...

dialogText.cn: 然而，重建工作仍然任重道远。供能高地需要相当长的时间才能从这次袭击中完全恢复过来。
dialogText.en: Rebuilding will be an immense undertaking. It'll take quite a while for the Power Plateau to fully recover from this attack.

dialogText.cn: 好嘞，那我们就开始吧。
dialogText.en: Awesome. Let's begin!

dialogText.cn: 注意远处的那个标记，那里是我们约定的终点。
dialogText.en: See that beacon over there in the distance? That's the finishing point.

dialogText.cn: 加油，管理员！
dialogText.en: May the fastest win, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 最快抵达那里的人获胜！
dialogText.en: The first to reach the beacon wins!

dialogText.cn: 不多说了，我们开始吧。
dialogText.en: Enough words. Let's start moving our legs.

dialogText.cn: 不愧是管理员，你是第一个抵达的。
dialogText.en: You're first! That's some incredible running! No wonder you're the Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你陪我们训练。看来我们还要更加努力。
dialogText.en: Thanks for joining our PT. We really need to step things up.

dialogText.cn: 下次有机会我们再一起训练。
dialogText.en: Train with us again if you have the chance.

dialogText.cn: 我们打算回起点那里，要一起吗？
dialogText.en: We're heading back to the starting point. Wanna come along?

dialogText.cn: 管理员你要加油啊，避险最重要的就是速度。
dialogText.en: You need more workout, Endmin. Disaster prevention is all about speed.

dialogText.cn: 下次再比试的时候，说不定你就是第一。
dialogText.en: Keep it up. You might be the champ in our next race.

dialogText.cn: 我们打算回起点那里，要一起吗？
dialogText.en: We're heading back to the starting point. Wanna come along?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，管理员！又见面了！
dialogText.en: Hah! Endmin! We meet again!

dialogText.cn: 最近怎么样？要不要再来试试？
dialogText.en: How are things going for you? Interested in another race?

dialogText.cn: 还是老规矩，先抵达终点的人获胜。
dialogText.en: Old rules. First one to reach the destination wins.

dialogText.cn: 话不多说，我们开始吧！
dialogText.en: 'Nuff talking. Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 爆炸造成的破坏非常严重。
dialogText.en: The explosion really wrecked the entire place.

dialogText.cn: 虽然我们协助恢复了通信，也重建了必要物资的供应链……
dialogText.en: We re-established comms and rebuilt the logistics infrastructure for essential resources and supplies...

dialogText.cn: 然而，重建工作仍然任重道远。供能高地需要相当长的时间才能从这次袭击中完全恢复过来。
dialogText.en: Rebuilding will be an immense undertaking. It'll take quite a while for the Power Plateau to fully recover from this attack.

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你也来这里了？
dialogText.en: Endmin? I'm surprised to see you here.

dialogText.cn: 正好，我们刚清理出来一条很不错的路线。
dialogText.en: You came at just the right time. We actually cleared the way for a pretty decent racing track.

dialogText.cn: 我打算用这条路线训练一下队员的越野能力。
dialogText.en: I intend to use this track to give my crew some steeplechase training.

dialogText.cn: 你想和我们一起试试吗？
dialogText.en: Wanna give this a shot?

dialogText.cn: 源石研究园的受灾程度并不严重，这里主要的威胁是裂地者。
dialogText.en: The disaster didn't really hit the Originium Science Park that hard. The Landbreakers are the biggest source of problems here.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我们来这边是为了处理几处爆炸造成的问题。
dialogText.en: But my SAR crew is here to handle a few issues caused by the explosion.

dialogText.cn: 研究园与矿脉源区的运输已经完全中断，可能需要相当长的时间才能恢复。
dialogText.en: All transport routes between the Test Site and the Origin Lodespring are down. It will take quite a while to open the roads again.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，我就等你这句话。
dialogText.en: Awesome. I was hoping you'd say that.

dialogText.cn: 我们打算比一比谁的速度更快。
dialogText.en: We really want to see who's faster.

dialogText.cn: 大家一起出发，穿过这条路线一直跑到沉降地带。
dialogText.en: Let's set off together. Run along this route and reach the Depression.

dialogText.cn: 谁先到达标记的位置，谁就是赢家。
dialogText.en: The first one to reach the beacon wins.

dialogText.cn: 你可要尽全力哦，管理员。
dialogText.en: Do your best and show me what you got, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 你的速度好快啊，完全追不上！
dialogText.en: Dang you're fast! You left us all in the dust!

dialogText.cn: 不过我也会带大家继续训练，下次绝不会再输给你。
dialogText.en: I'll toughen up my SAR crew's training. Gotta beat you some day!

dialogText.cn: 我们打算回起点那里，要一起吗？
dialogText.en: We're heading back to the starting point. Wanna come along?

dialogText.cn: 在越野训练里，技巧也很重要哦。
dialogText.en: Technique is also really important for steeplechases.

dialogText.cn: 不过能跑完全程就很厉害了，下次再一起比试！
dialogText.en: This steeplechase track is tough. Completing it is impressive enough. I'm looking forward to our next race.

dialogText.cn: 我们打算回起点那里，要一起吗？
dialogText.en: We're heading back to the starting point. Wanna come along?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，管理员！又见面了！
dialogText.en: Hah! Endmin! We meet again!

dialogText.cn: 最近怎么样？要不要再来试试？
dialogText.en: How are things going for you? Interested in another race?

dialogText.cn: 还是老规矩，先抵达终点的人获胜。
dialogText.en: Old rules. First one to reach the destination wins.

dialogText.cn: 话不多说，我们开始吧！
dialogText.en: 'Nuff talking. Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 源石研究园的受灾程度并不严重，这里主要的威胁是裂地者。
dialogText.en: The disaster didn't really hit the Originium Science Park that hard. The Landbreakers are the biggest source of problems here.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我们来这边是为了处理几处爆炸造成的问题。
dialogText.en: But my SAR crew is here to handle a few issues caused by the explosion.

dialogText.cn: 研究园与矿脉源区的运输已经完全中断，可能需要相当长的时间才能恢复。
dialogText.en: All transport routes between the Test Site and the Origin Lodespring are down. It will take quite a while to open the roads again.

dialogText.cn: 当然，野外就是最好的训练场所！救援队队员要适应各种复杂的环境。
dialogText.en: Of course. The wilderness is the best place for PT! SAR teams must be used to all sorts of places.

dialogText.cn: 你还别说，旧矿车跑得可不慢。
dialogText.en: I won't laugh. Old mining trucks are actually pretty amazing trailblazers.

dialogText.cn: 当然可以，就是得比个高下才有意思。
dialogText.en: Of course. Racing makes this more fun.

dialogText.cn: 我提前在山顶设置了一个标记，那里就是我们比试的终点。
dialogText.en: I placed a beacon at the mountaintop to mark out our destination.

dialogText.cn: 不多说了，我们开始吧。
dialogText.en: Enough words. Let's start moving our legs.

dialogText.cn: 最快抵达那里的人获胜！
dialogText.en: The first to reach the beacon wins!

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 加油！管理员！
dialogText.en: Go! Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 欸？这不是管理员吗！没想到能在这里遇到你……
dialogText.en: Ah? Aren't you the Endmin? I didn't expect to run into you out here...

dialogText.cn: 工团救援队最近人手不足。所以我招募了一些新队员，正在带他们做体能训练。
dialogText.en: The thing is, we've been a bit short-handed lately. So, I recruited a few greenhorns and they're getting a healthy dose of PT.

dialogText.cn: 想和我们一起吗？顺便活动活动筋骨。
dialogText.en: Wanna join us? Gotta get some PT and move those joints, you know.

dialogText.cn: 遥遥领先……不愧是传说中的管理员。
dialogText.en: You're way ahead of us... No wonder you're the legendary Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你陪我们训练。看来我们还需要更加努力。
dialogText.en: Thanks for joining our PT. We really need to step things up.

dialogText.cn: 下次我可不会再输给你了。
dialogText.en: I won't lose next time.

dialogText.cn: 我们打算回起点那里，要一起吗？
dialogText.en: We've decided to head back to the starting point. Interested in racing us back?

dialogText.cn: 虽然没第一个冲线，但你跑得也好快，看得出来是有两下子。
dialogText.en: You weren't the first but you're still pretty fast. That's quite impressive.

dialogText.cn: 熟能生巧，说不定下次你就是第一。
dialogText.en: You'll get better with practice. Perhaps you'll be the champion of the next race.

dialogText.cn: 我们打算回起点那里，要一起吗？
dialogText.en: We've decided to head back to the starting point. Interested in racing us back?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，管理员！又见面了！
dialogText.en: Hah! Endmin! We meet again!

dialogText.cn: 最近怎么样？要不要再比试一场？
dialogText.en: How's it going? Interested in another race?

dialogText.cn: 他们的进步很大，毕竟……实战就是最好的训练。
dialogText.en: They've improved a lot. After all, field missions will give them the best training.

dialogText.cn: 我一直觉得，每个救援队队员都该为不知何时降临的危机提前做好准备，这样才能更好地完成任务。
dialogText.en: I've always believed that every SAR member should be properly prepared for a crisis, whenever it may strike. That's how we can best complete our missions.

dialogText.cn: 还是老规矩，先抵达终点的人获胜。
dialogText.en: Old rules. First one to reach the destination wins.

dialogText.cn: 话不多说，我们开始吧！
dialogText.en: 'Nuff talking. Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 等你有空了，可以随时回来找我们。
dialogText.en: Well, just talk to us when you're free.

dialogText.cn: 你好，你是维修队派来的吗？
dialogText.en: Greetings. Are you from the repair crew?

dialogText.cn: 终末地？等等，难道你就是管理员？太好了，这下升降平台说不定就……
dialogText.en: Endfielders? Wait. That means you're the Endmin, right?! Awesome. This platform lift might just very well...

dialogText.cn: 啊，忘了自我介绍，我叫莱昂，是工团的巡查员。之前的锚点冲击破坏了这玩意儿的控制系统，现在完全没办法启动。
dialogText.en: Ah, sorry for skipping the intro. The name's Leon. I'm a UWST patroler. The Ankhorfall busted the control system of this machine and we couldn't get it to start.

dialogText.cn: 我联系了维修队好几次，他们总说人手紧张，我这里的问题还不算最紧急的。
dialogText.en: I called the repair crew a couple times. They kept telling me they're too busy and my issue doesn't qualify for a top priority ticket.

dialogText.cn: 但这个升降平台是连接两个区域物流的重要环节，不尽快修好的话，这附近的工作都会受影响。
dialogText.en: But my bloody platform lift is the key logistics link between 2 friggin' regions! We gotta get the thing fixed or nothing will ever get done at this place!

dialogText.cn: 而且……我的健康也会受影响！
dialogText.en: And ... phooo ... this problem is affecting my health!

dialogText.cn: 每天中午十二点整，我都要乘坐升降平台，来上层视野最好的地方吃午饭。我干这份工作很多年了，每一天都是这么过来的，不会有一分钟的误差。
dialogText.en: Yes indeed. I take the platform lift to the roof precisely at noon and have my lunch at the place with the best view. I spent years in this career without skipping my rooftop lunch. Even got my bloody schedule down to the minute.

dialogText.cn: 现在，我要绕好大一圈才能上来，生活被彻底打乱了。在别的地方，我完全吃不下午饭。不能按时吃饭，我的胃都开始不舒服了！
dialogText.en: Now, the elevator is broken and I gotta take the long detour to reach the top floor. It messed up my schedule, my appetite, and my life. I'm getting gastric problems because I can't get my bloody lunch on time!

dialogText.cn: 原本我还能用无人机来协助工作，但被罗克那小子一大早借走了，也没还我。今天的计划又被打乱了……
dialogText.en: I thought I could use my drone to help my work, but Rorke borrowed it in the morning and didn't even bother returning it. Bloody greenhorn messed up my schedule for the day...

dialogText.cn: 真的？控制台就在旁边这栋楼上。但……这栋楼的大门现在坏了，一时半会儿没办法上去。
dialogText.en: You will? Nice. The control panel is atop that building. It's just that ... the gate is broken. I can't figure out how to get up there.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你！要是能修好，可真帮了大忙了！
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you! Fixing that thing will really save my life!

dialogText.cn: 你好，又见面了。
dialogText.en: Good to see you again.

dialogText.cn: 现在升降平台能按时升起了，一切照常运行。我的身体状况也稳定了不少！
dialogText.en: The platform lift is now working according to schedule. I'm feeling much better already!

dialogText.cn: 终于……平台又开始运作了。太好了。
dialogText.en: Finally... The platform lift is working again. Wonderful.

dialogText.cn: 太谢谢你了，这些东西是我的一点儿谢意，希望你可以收下。
dialogText.en: Of course it does! Here. Token of my gratitude. Please take it.

dialogText.cn: 对了，你有兴趣的话，可以去上层看看，那边说不定有什么你用得上的东西。
dialogText.en: Before I forget, you can look around the place up there. Perhaps you might find something you could use.

dialogText.cn: 去往那上面的电梯与升降平台共用一套控制系统，现在也能正常使用了。
dialogText.en: The elevator for reaching that place is also linked to the platform lift control system. You can use the elevator now.

dialogText.cn: 摔的时候还听到咔嚓一声，估计两块电池也摔飞了。
dialogText.en: It made this really loud crack during the bad landing. Its 2 batteries probably flew out.

dialogText.cn: 这台无人机是莱昂的宝贝……这可怎么办？
dialogText.en: Leon really loves this drone... The man will kill me for sure...

dialogText.cn: 应该是掉在了比较高的地方——我在附近地面上找了几遍，什么也没有……
dialogText.en: It probably crashed at a pretty high place — I looked around the place and found nothing at ground level...

dialogText.cn: 完蛋了，完蛋了。
dialogText.en: Ugh... blight this friggin' blight...

dialogText.cn: 呃，你好，我叫罗克，是在这附近做环境监测的实验员……早上我借了同事莱昂的无人机，想着用它来收集一些高空数据……
dialogText.en: Oh, hi. I'm Rorke. I'm a scientist doing some environment monitoring work in this area... I borrowed a drone from my colleague, Leon. Planned on using it to gather some high altitude data...

dialogText.cn: 但我操作不熟练，试飞的时候机翼好像撞上了什么东西，然后它就坠落了。
dialogText.en: But I suck at flying drones and I think its wing hit something before it ... landed badly.

dialogText.cn: 唉，都怪我没把莱昂的叮嘱当回事，他都叮嘱过我了，说这台无人机是老型号，没那么好控制，让我注意点……
dialogText.en: Ugh. I should have listened to Leon. He told me to be careful and warned me that the drone is pretty old and a little hard to control...

dialogText.cn: 对了，无人机的两块电池也请你留意一下。
dialogText.en: By the way, try looking for the drone's batteries. There are two of them.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，管理员，找到无人机了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin! How goes your search? Did you find the drone?

dialogText.cn: 应该是掉在了比较高的地方——我在附近地面上找了几遍，什么也没有……
dialogText.en: It probably crashed at a pretty high place — I looked around the place and found nothing at ground level...

dialogText.cn: 无人机的两块电池也请再留意一下，拜托你了。
dialogText.en: Thanks a lot. And don't forget the batteries.

dialogText.cn: 这台无人机是工团的老型号……莱昂用了很多年。他这个人很怀旧，把它当成命根子，还自己画了涂装。
dialogText.en: The drone is an old UWST model... Leon used it for years. The dude likes old stuff and treats the drone like family. Even gave it a custom paint job, you know.

dialogText.cn: 他还特别叮嘱我：老型号不像从终末地订购的那些新款式一样好控制，操控要小心。
dialogText.en: He also told me that his UWST drone is clunkier than the latest Endfield models, and told me to be careful with the controls.

dialogText.cn: 我没当一回事，结果第一次试飞就出事了。唉……
dialogText.en: I ignored his advice and ... yeah ... crashed his drone on my first try. I'm going to be so dead...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你！居然没有摔坏……还可以用！
dialogText.en: Oh! Thank you so much...! WOW! The drone actually survived the crash! The thing probably can still fly!

dialogText.cn: 工团过去都是以扎实耐用为出发点做设计的，操作性上确实差了一些……
dialogText.en: Yeah. UW designs focus on durability and resilience. But the ergonomics and controls, well...

dialogText.cn: 好在无人机没有大碍，我还是赶紧把它还给莱昂吧。
dialogText.en: Thank Talos the drone is alright. I should give it back to Leon ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 真是多亏你了，这是我的一点儿心意！请收下吧！
dialogText.en: Here! Please take this! Token of my sincere appreciation!

dialogText.cn: 天哪，你居然真的找到了！今天遇到你，我真是走了大运。
dialogText.en: By Talos! You found them all! I knew I got super lucky when I ran into you.

dialogText.cn: 累死我了，果然还是用无人机更方便。
dialogText.en: These patrols are wearing me out. Things would be so much easier with drones.

dialogText.cn: 等过了这阵子，我要申请一个新的无人机，终末地产的最新款！
dialogText.en: I'm applying for my own drone once this is over. Gotta get my hands on that latest Endfield model!

dialogText.cn: 这里很危险，请不要在这里停留！
dialogText.en: No loitering here! This is a dangerous place!

dialogText.cn: 我是工团救援队的赫尔曼。你是……那个管理员！
dialogText.en: The name's Hermann. I'm part of the UWST SAR crew. You ... you're the Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 冲击发生的时候有运送货物的车辆在高架桥上行驶，我们接到报告，说有个运输人员被困在上面了。
dialogText.en: There was a supplies truck driving on that elevated bridge when the Ankhorfall happened. We received reports that a trucker is trapped up there.

dialogText.cn: 我原本打算搭绳索上去营救，但难度太高，只能先清理一些有爆炸隐患的货车。
dialogText.en: I wanted to reach that place with ropes but soon realized it's way beyond me. So I decided to clean up the wrecked trucks before they become explosive hazards.

dialogText.cn: 现在搜救工作被卡在这里了，我们在想其他办法。
dialogText.en: My SAR mission is stuck. We're trying to figure something out.

dialogText.cn: 那就有劳了，目前的情况对我们来说也有些棘手，而且人手一直都不太足。如果有终末地帮忙，自然是最好的。
dialogText.en: This situation is way beyond non-specialists like us, plus we've been short on hands. Your help is much appreciated, my Endfielder friend.

dialogText.cn: 应该可以！塔吊可以控制这些集装箱的位置。两个应该就够了！
dialogText.en: Yeah, that should work! The tower crane can be used to move the containers, and 2 of them should be enough!

dialogText.cn: 正好！我们刚刚修复了附近的设备，没想到能派上用场。
dialogText.en: We also just repaired the machinery nearby. Never guessed they would get useful now.

dialogText.cn: 唉，我们实在抽不出更多人手了，现在只能拜托你了。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* We're stretched too thin as it is. We can only entrust this matter to you.

dialogText.cn: 总算是有人上来了！
dialogText.en: Finally! Someone made it up here!

dialogText.cn: 我……我叫斯科特，是工团的运输员。
dialogText.en: I'm ... I'm Scott. I'm a UWST trucker.

dialogText.cn: 我……我的车……
dialogText.en: My ... my truck...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我需要平复一下心情。太可怕了……
dialogText.en: I'm sorry. I really need to take a few deep breaths. Worst day of my life...

dialogText.cn: 啊！对的……检查。我受伤了吗？好像没有……
dialogText.en: Ah! Yeah ... gotta check myself. Am I hurt? I don't think I am...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉……
dialogText.en: I'm sorry...

dialogText.cn: 整个大桥都在摇晃……像被甩动的面条一样。
dialogText.en: The entire bridge shook and flopped like ... like fettuccine...

dialogText.cn: 是的，当时我脑子一片空白。一个巨大的天使出现在路上，把桥都压弯了，我却完全不知道该怎么办……
dialogText.en: Yeah. My mind was totally blank. A giant Aggelos suddenly appeared on the road and buckled the entire bridge. I didn't know what to do...

dialogText.cn: 就在这个时候，后面的车猛地撞了我一下，我被迫停在了路边。
dialogText.en: It was at that moment when some car rammed the back of my truck. I was forced to park it on the side of the road.

dialogText.cn: 然后爆发了侵蚀，我被甩出车外，昏迷了一阵。醒来后……桥已经断掉了。
dialogText.en: Then the Blight rupture took place. It sent me flying out of my truck and knocked me senseless. I woke up and saw that the bridge had been ... destroyed.

dialogText.cn: 现在回想当时的情景……太可怕了。要是再往前开一点，我就没命了。
dialogText.en: Just thinking about this terrible thing gives me the shivers. If I were another yard or two closer, I would be dead for sure.

dialogText.cn: 其实……我不知道。
dialogText.en: I don't really ... know...

dialogText.cn: 那辆车想要超车，司机一直在打灯。但是我……
dialogText.en: That driver was trying to pass me and kept flashing the headlights. But I...

dialogText.cn: 他态度真的非常不好，动不动就按喇叭。他越按，我越是烦躁……
dialogText.en: Well, he was a piece of work and kept spamming his horn. It was getting on my nerves...

dialogText.cn: 我打开无线电把他骂了一顿。结果……我们就这样互相骂了一路。
dialogText.en: I switched on the radio and told him to act civilized. And he ... well ... yeah ... we went back and forth for quite a while.

dialogText.cn: 但天使袭来的时候，他这一撞救了我一命。
dialogText.en: When the Aggelos attacked, he rammed my truck and got me out of the way.

dialogText.cn: 唉……是的。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... I guess I'll never know.

dialogText.cn: 你就是那个管理员吧？我想请你……消灭那个天使。
dialogText.en: You're that legendary Endmin everyone's talking about, right? Can I ask you to ... defeat that Aggelos?

dialogText.cn: 灾难发生之后，它就一直盘踞在那里。一想到这个东西还在，我就……
dialogText.en: That buggerloid stuck around after the disaster. The thought of it still swaggering around the place makes me...

dialogText.cn: 但当务之急还是撤离到安全的地方。
dialogText.en: But ... shouldn't we move our trucker to a safe place?

dialogText.cn: 是啊，有管理员在，肯定没问题的。
dialogText.en: Right, nothing to worry about with the Endmin around.

dialogText.cn: 拜托了！如果还有余力的话，能帮忙回收些货物就更好了，我替工友们谢谢你。
dialogText.en: I'm counting on you! If you can, could you help recover some of the supplies too? It would mean a lot to the team!

dialogText.cn: 可他……
dialogText.en: But he's...

dialogText.cn: 管理员！谢谢你，我已经给他检查过了，没什么大碍。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin! I checked on him and he's alright.

dialogText.cn: 这个人也真的是命大……
dialogText.en: He's one lucky bloke...

dialogText.cn: 他还告诉了我天使的事情，这样就能说得通了，就算是侵蚀洪流……也不太可能会直接把桥截成三段。
dialogText.en: Scott told me about the Aggelos, so it all made sense now. A Blightflood is quite unlikely to ... break the bridge into three sections.

dialogText.cn: 原本可以通过这个伸缩桥过去，但不知怎么回事，它现在失灵了。
dialogText.en: We would use the collapsible bridge to reach the other side. But I don't know what's wrong. It's not working anymore.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……这附近的山坡上倒是堆放着很多物资，里面应该有备用元件。但你要小心，那边现在是裂地者的地盘。
dialogText.en: Okay. I saw plenty of supplies on that hillside nearby. There might be backup parts in there. Be careful, though, the friggin' LBs claimed it as their turf.

dialogText.cn: 你找到所有备用元件了么？
dialogText.en: Did you find all the backup parts?

dialogText.cn: 拜托你了！
dialogText.en: Well, we're still counting on you!

dialogText.cn: 你做到了！
dialogText.en: You did it!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢！真是辛苦各位了！这下我总算能回收这些货物了。
dialogText.en: Thank you for everything! Now I can finally go retrieve those supplies.

dialogText.cn: 这边……布满了侵蚀，我们不敢贸然行动。
dialogText.en: This place is ... really Blighted. We can't risk moving around.

dialogText.cn: 你做到了！你……消灭了天使！
dialogText.en: You did it! You ... you smashed the Aggelos!

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了，管理员。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这件事让我想了很多。不管他本意是不是要救我，我想……我都等同于欠了一笔债。
dialogText.en: This incident really got me thinking. I don't know if the driver was trying to help me, but I ... I think I owe him one.

dialogText.cn: 我会找机会还掉这笔债——在别人需要我的时候。
dialogText.en: I'll look for a chance and help someone in need. That'll help pay off the debt.

dialogText.cn: 这次真是多亏你了！
dialogText.en: Really appreciate this, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 现在我要赶赴下一个任务了。
dialogText.en: I'm heading to our next SAR mission.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你！
dialogText.en: Thank you!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我会的！毕竟接下来我还想参与到重建工作中去呢！
dialogText.en: I will! I've still got work ahead helping with the rebuilding!

dialogText.cn: 这就是S.O.W.的结论……聂菲斯果然比我想象的还要有威胁。
dialogText.en: So this is SOW's conclusion... Nefarith is even more dangerous than I imagined.

dialogText.cn: 但按照专家们的推论，“影子”布兰娜明明捣毁了“火山”的全部计划，为什么还是被攻击了？
dialogText.en: But according to the experts... If "Shadow" Brenna single-handedly wrecked "Volcano's" whole scheme, why would she become a target?

dialogText.cn: 是吗？那再好不过了，不找他搞个水落石出，我实在放心不下。
dialogText.en: Really? That's perfect then. I won't rest easy until we track him down and get to the bottom of this.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这里是狼卫。
dialogText.en: Wulfgard here, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我发现了一处可疑的活动踪迹，也许需要支援。
dialogText.en: I've spotted suspicious activity that might require backup.

dialogText.cn: 脚印很轻巧，是碾骨渗透者的特别步法。那人带着血迹穿过了不少险地，应该是个高手。
dialogText.en: The footprints are light and precise, classic Bonekrusher Infiltrator technique. Moved through multiple hazardous zones while bleeding ... definitely a pro.

dialogText.cn: 我有取胜的自信，但不一定能保证对方活下来……请快一些。
dialogText.en: I'm confident I can win, but keeping the mark alive? That's a different story... Please hurry.

dialogText.cn: 我也去帮忙！
dialogText.en: I'll come with!

dialogText.cn: 你们来得刚好，“影子”刚刚被赶进这里的死路。
dialogText.en: You came just in time. "Shadow" just got cornered in this dead end ahead.

dialogText.cn: 交手之后自然明白，但她的确虚弱得不正常。
dialogText.en: Figured it out after crossing blades with her, but she's abnormally weak.

dialogText.cn: 我已经尽量留手，如果还想问些话出来，最好速战速决。
dialogText.en: I've been holding back as much as possible. If we want to get any information out of her, we'd better make this quick.

dialogText.cn: 起来，没允许你咽气。
dialogText.en: Get up, did I give you permission to die?

dialogText.cn: 没想到……她一直都……看得一清二楚……
dialogText.en: Never thought ... she saw through everything ... all along...

dialogText.cn: 咳咳咳……聂菲斯——唔！！！
dialogText.en: *Cough cough*... Nefarith — UGH!!!

dialogText.cn: “影子”布兰娜倒在地面上，体温正在逐渐离开这副身躯。
dialogText.en: "Shadow" Brenna lies collapsed on the ground, the warmth slowly fading from her body.

dialogText.cn: 除了刚刚添加的几处战伤，这副身体意外地完整，旧疤寥寥无几。
dialogText.en: Aside from the fresh combat injuries recently inflicted, the body remains surprisingly intact with very few old scars.

dialogText.cn: 不难看出，“影子”一直靠着出色的身手和隐秘技术置身于危险之外，因此才甚少受伤。
dialogText.en: It's clear "Shadow" relied on exceptional skills and stealth to avoid danger, which explains her lack of old scars.

dialogText.cn: 黯淡的青瘀从“影子”的左臂蔓延至全身。
dialogText.en: Faded cyan bruising spreads from "Shadow's" left arm across her entire body.

dialogText.cn: 似乎曾有汹涌的能量经过这里缠上了“影子”，最终导致了严重的内出血。
dialogText.en: It appears a surge of energy once flowed through here and entangled "Shadow," ultimately causing severe internal bleeding.

dialogText.cn: 她的躯体散发着令人不适的气息，与聂菲斯发挥能力时给人的印象莫名相似。
dialogText.en: Her body emits an unsettling aura, strangely similar to the impression Nefarith gives when using her powers.

dialogText.cn: 虽然是双刀，“影子”左手持握的武器比右手的要新不少，似乎是临时取得的替代品。
dialogText.en: Though dual-wielding, the weapon in "Shadow's" left hand is noticeably newer than the right, likely a recent replacement.

dialogText.cn: 在一处隐蔽的口袋中，有一封被仔细折叠的名单，以及一个印着粗糙徽记的信物。
dialogText.en: In a hidden pocket lies a carefully folded list and a token bearing a crude emblem.

dialogText.cn: 名单上，“火山”“血眼”等死者被划去，另一些陌生的名字则被画了圈。
dialogText.en: On the list, names like "Volcano" and "Bloodeye" are crossed out, while other unfamiliar names are circled.

dialogText.cn: 信件和通行证……哼，“影子”的手脚也不干净。
dialogText.en: Letters and passes... Hah, "Shadow's" hands weren't clean either.

dialogText.cn: 划掉的已经被“影子”解决，被画圈的那几个都是聂菲斯的骨干，对她相当忠诚。
dialogText.en: The crossed-out ones were handled by "Shadow". The circled names are all loyal followers of Nefarith's.

dialogText.cn: 所以，这封信实际上标记了碾骨氏族现在的状态。哪些大人物死了，哪些已经得势？
dialogText.en: So this list actually maps the Bonekrusher Clan's current power structure. Who's dead, and who's risen to power?

dialogText.cn: 我在其他裂地者手里见过那个徽记。只要拿着它，就能出入氏族的据点，不会被警卫盘问。
dialogText.en: I've seen that emblem on other Landbreakers. With this, you can move freely through clan outposts without being questioned by guards.

dialogText.cn: 这算是一种通行证。有的商人会花大价钱买来保平安，或是做些不见光的生意。
dialogText.en: It functions as a pass. Some merchants pay big money for these to ensure safety ... or conduct shady business.

dialogText.cn: 一个碾骨氏族的精英，却拿着其他氏族的通行证……
dialogText.en: An elite of the Bonekrusher Clan, carrying another clan's pass...

dialogText.cn: 以碾骨的“名声”而言，这几乎是不可能的。
dialogText.en: Given the Bonekrusher's ... reputation, this is practically impossible.

dialogText.cn: 她不仅在替聂菲斯调查部下，也在替其他氏族监视聂菲斯。不折不扣的双面间谍。
dialogText.en: She wasn't just investigating subordinates for Nefarith, but also spying on Nefarith for other clans. A full-blown double agent.

dialogText.cn: 等等……也就是说，聂菲斯在让一个叛徒替她肃反？！
dialogText.en: Wait ... you're telling me Nefarith had a traitor purging other traitors for her?!

dialogText.cn: 用敌人的刀解决敌人，就不用担心刀刃是否会损坏。
dialogText.en: Using your enemy's blade to eliminate other enemies means you never have to worry about damaging your own weapons.

dialogText.cn: 至于这把刀会不会伤害到聂菲斯自己，我们都看到结果了。
dialogText.en: As for whether this blade would harm Nefarith herself ... we've all seen how that turned out.

dialogText.cn: 等聂菲斯清理完组织里的毒血，碾骨氏族只会变得更加危险。
dialogText.en: Once Nefarith finishes purging the poison from her organization, the Bonekrushers will only become more dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 这已经不是裂地者内部简单的势力更迭了。我们必须早做打算，管理员。
dialogText.en: This is no longer just a simple power shift among the Landbreakers. We need to plan ahead, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 重伤偏偏在这时候发作……该死，我们晚来一步。
dialogText.en: Her injuries flared up now of all times... Damn it, we're one step too late.

dialogText.cn: 只能尽可能进行调查了，稍后再埋葬她吧。
dialogText.en: We'll have to investigate what we can now. We'll bury her properly later.

dialogText.cn: 啊……吓死我了，差点儿就没命了。
dialogText.en: Woah... That was a close shave. Those raiders almost got me.
