dialogText.cn: 还好还好，谢谢你。没想到会在这里遇到同事……我是终末地的干员库珀，专门从事现场技术支持相关的工作，目前主要负责维护这些机器人。
dialogText.en: Yearp. Totally fine, thanks to you. Wasn't expecting to get bailed out by a fellow Endfielder out here. The name's Copper. I'm an Endfielder and my job is to perform on-site technical support. The current task is to keep these robots in working shape...

dialogText.cn: 我是收到故障信号后赶过来的。这种时候一个人出外勤实在是太危险了，但是没办法，唉……
dialogText.en: I rushed here when I received repair request signals from them. Solo field work is really dangerous nowadays, but we ... don't really have anyone else to spare... *sigh*...

dialogText.cn: 没想到信号居然是从裂地者的营地附近发出来的，吓死我了。
dialogText.en: I never expected the messages to come from an LB camp. That was a very terrifying encounter.

dialogText.cn: 好在裂地者不知道三脚架才是机器人的本体，把它们拆了丢在一边。
dialogText.en: Thankfully, the LBs didn't know that the tripods housed the main systems. The raiders just ripped apart our robots and chucked the tripods to the side.

dialogText.cn: 这些机器人就像我的孩子一样，每一个我都认得。
dialogText.en: I treat these robots like my own. I recognize every single unit.

dialogText.cn: 这个坏掉的是凯文，那个“断了腿”的是鲍勃。
dialogText.en: This poor disabled unit is Kevin. Bob is the one with broken legs.

dialogText.cn: 我操控它们逃跑的时候惊动了裂地者，最后我们还是被抓住了。
dialogText.en: I tried to remotely control them and escape this place, but it alerted the LBs and all of us were captured.

dialogText.cn: 现在这些机器人几乎都损坏了。只有凯文还能修，但不知道要多久才能修好……
dialogText.en: Many of them are damaged beyond repair. I guess we can only save Kevin, but I don't know how long it's going to take...

dialogText.cn: 外面还有这么多裂地者，唉……
dialogText.en: And there are so many LBs around... Ugh...

dialogText.cn: 本来我是要和布龙泽一起出任务的，他觉得太危险就没带我。
dialogText.en: Bronzer and I were supposed to conduct this mission as a team. But he felt it was too dangerous and left me behind.

dialogText.cn: 谁知道他刚走，我就收到了这里的信号。
dialogText.en: He hadn't gone far when I received the signal sent from this area.

dialogText.cn: 唉……要是布龙泽也在这里就好了，他比我更擅长修理。
dialogText.en: Ugh... If only Bronzer were here. He knows more about repairing robots than me.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？太好了！
dialogText.en: Really? You can?! Awesome!

dialogText.cn: 凯文，凯文好起来了！
dialogText.en: Kevin! You're finally well again!

dialogText.cn: 太好了！真不知道该怎么感谢你！
dialogText.en: Awesome! Oh, I don't know how to thank you!

dialogText.cn: 这些还只是试验机，是当初和工团合作研发的，但是情况紧急只能先拿来用了。它们可以在各种地形上进行运输工作，并根据情况躲避各种敌人。
dialogText.en: These units are just prototypes we jointly developed with the UW. But we were forced to deploy them as things got really desperate. These Deltas feature all-terrain transport capabilities and context-sensitive hostility avoidance.

dialogText.cn: 如果你再见到这样坏掉的小机器人，可以帮它们一把吗？这阵子四号谷地这么危险，像我这样没什么作战能力的干员，估计也没法儿出外勤了。
dialogText.en: But if you run into more broken robots, can you please help them out? Valley IV is really dangerous and a non-combatant like me might have to skip field assignments.

dialogText.cn: 不会让你白干，我会给你报酬！你可以来工人之家找我。
dialogText.en: And I'm definitely gonna pay you for repairing the robots! Find me at the Worker Dorms for the rewards!

dialogText.cn: 啊……吓死我了，差点儿就没命了。
dialogText.en: Woah... That was a close shave. Those raiders almost got me.

dialogText.cn: 我是收到机器人的故障信号后赶过来的。
dialogText.en: I rushed here when I received repair request signals.

dialogText.cn: 这种时候一个人出外勤实在是太危险了，但是没办法，唉……
dialogText.en: Solo field work is really dangerous nowadays, but we ... don't really have anyone else to spare... *sigh*...

dialogText.cn: 没想到信号居然是从裂地者的营地附近发出来的，吓死我了。
dialogText.en: I never expected the messages to come from an LB camp. That was a very terrifying encounter.

dialogText.cn: 好在裂地者不知道三脚架才是机器人的本体，把它们拆了丢在一边。
dialogText.en: Thankfully, the LBs didn't know that the tripods housed the main systems. The raiders just ripped apart our robots and chucked the tripods to the side.

dialogText.cn: 这些机器人就像我的孩子一样，每一个我都认得。
dialogText.en: I treat these robots like my own. I recognize every single unit.

dialogText.cn: 这个坏掉的是凯文，那个“断了腿”的是鲍勃。
dialogText.en: This poor disabled unit is Kevin. Bob is the one with broken legs.

dialogText.cn: 我操控它们逃跑的时候惊动了裂地者，最后我们还是被抓住了。
dialogText.en: I tried to remotely control them and escape this place, but it alerted the LBs and all of us were captured.

dialogText.cn: 现在这些机器人几乎都损坏了。只有凯文还能修，但不知道要多久才能修好……
dialogText.en: Many of them are damaged beyond repair. I guess we can only save Kevin, but I don't know how long it's going to take...

dialogText.cn: 唉……这么大的工作量，要是多点人手就好了。
dialogText.en: Just look at all this work... If only I had a team ... or a partner.

dialogText.cn: 没啊，我很好。
dialogText.en: No. I'm actually doing okay.

dialogText.cn: 性格有了很大变化？我们之前见过吗？
dialogText.en: Personality change? Have we met before?

dialogText.cn: 不习惯别人帮忙？怎么会……我又不是布龙泽……
dialogText.en: Don't like people helping? That's not me... That's Bronzer...

dialogText.cn: 他一个人都没问题，我就……唉，早知道就该听他的，好好在工人之家待着了。
dialogText.en: He always completed jobs on his own. While I ... ugh. Maybe I should've listened to him and stayed at the Worker Dorms.

dialogText.cn: 我的修理水平还是太差了，跑出来也只能添乱。
dialogText.en: I'm just bad at repairing stuff, and often end up causing more trouble.

dialogText.cn: 我知道了！你之前肯定遇到了我哥哥布龙泽。我叫库珀。
dialogText.en: Oh! I know what happened! You were probably talking to my older twin Bronzer. My name's Copper.

dialogText.cn: 确实，经常有人把我们俩搞混。
dialogText.en: Yeah. It's very confusing. Folks often can't tell us apart.

dialogText.cn: 唉，要是布龙泽在这里就好了……还是他更擅长修理。
dialogText.en: Ugh... If only Bronzer were here. He knows more about repairing stuff than me.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？太好了！
dialogText.en: Really? You can?! Awesome!

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>杰里米</>……我的同事可能被困在里面了，我必须想办法救他出来。
dialogText.en: It's <@qu.key>Jeremy</>... Colleague of mine and probably trapped in this place. I need to rescue him.

dialogText.cn: 这里是醇化合物工厂。我是工团的工人，你可以叫我<@qu.key>英格</>。
dialogText.en: This is a Kohl Plant and I am a UWST crew mate. You can call me <@qu.key>Ingol</>.

dialogText.cn: 供能高地那边的爆炸波及了这里……
dialogText.en: The explosion at the Power Plateau did some damage to this place...

dialogText.cn: 他当时说关闭反应炉后就撤离。但之后，我就联系不上他了。
dialogText.en: He told me he evacced the place after shutting down the reactor. But I couldn't get a hold of him since that call.

dialogText.cn: 现在工厂连大门都打不开了……他不会是出事了吧……
dialogText.en: Now I can't even get the plant gate to open... I really hope nothing bad happened to him...

dialogText.cn: 既然大门打不开，只能特事特办了。我打算炸开旁边的墙。
dialogText.en: The gate won't budge so this calls for desperate measure. I'm gonna blast a hole through the side wall instead.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，虽然我也没实际操作过，但之前好歹也是在化工厂工作的，对爆炸物挺熟悉的。只要有足够的<@qu.key>炸药</>，再控制下爆炸规模，应该……没什么问题吧？
dialogText.en: Yeah. Never did demolishing before, but I did work at a chemical plant so I actually know my explosives. So long as we got enough <@qu.key>bombs</>, keep the payload in check, it should be ... alright.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？这可是很危险的……
dialogText.en: Really? It's really dangerous, you know...

dialogText.cn: 好吧，谢谢你。那你等下一定要注意安全，里面可能有坍塌风险。
dialogText.en: Okay then. Really appreciate this. Be safe in there. There's a chance that the plant structure might collapse.

dialogText.cn: 我在总控中心看到工厂的反应炉显示“运转异常”，就才来找杰里米确认情况。
dialogText.en: I saw a malfunction notification of the plant reactor at the control center, so I called Jeremy to verify the sitch.

dialogText.cn: 得想办法进去……
dialogText.en: I gotta get into this place...

dialogText.cn: 之前的爆炸动静不小，里面……现在估计已经乱成一锅粥了。
dialogText.en: There was a pretty bad explosion. The plant is probably a royal mess right now.

dialogText.cn: 好，我们保持联络。
dialogText.en: Sure. Let's keep in touch.

dialogText.cn: 天哪，你真的修好了！希望还来得及！
dialogText.en: My oh my, you actually fixed it! I hope we can make it on time!

dialogText.cn: 快，跟我去控制室！我得立即检查反应炉的状况。
dialogText.en: Quick! Follow me to the control room! I must check the status of the reactor.

dialogText.cn: 我刚看了监控，反应炉上方的<@qu.key>通风井</>被凝胶堵住了，现在完全无法运转。
dialogText.en: I checked the surveillance. We have gel clogging up the <@qu.key>ventilation shaft</> above the reactor. The thing won't work at all.

dialogText.cn: 估计是反应炉运行产生的气体冷凝后结成了凝胶。
dialogText.en: The reactor is probably still running. The gases produced must have condensed and formed a gel.

dialogText.cn: 这些气体本身无毒无害，但凝固后的胶状物会堵塞通风井，而且极易爆炸，相当危险。
dialogText.en: The gases aren't poisonous, but they will condense into a gel that blocks the ventilation shaft. It is also highly explosive. We're sitting on a powder keg here.

dialogText.cn: 正常情况下，不该这样。可能是供能高地出事后，通风井自动关闭了，但反应炉还在运转，才导致凝胶堵住了通风井。
dialogText.en: Normally, this shouldn't be happening. The Power Plateau incident probably automatically switched off the ventilation shaft but kept the reactor running. The result is a gel buildup that clogged the ventilation shaft.

dialogText.cn: 看来杰里米没关掉反应炉，难怪一直显示异常。他人呢？
dialogText.en: Jeremy probably failed to shut down the reactor. That would explain all the error notifications I received. Where is he?

dialogText.cn: 让我想想，我们现在需要关闭反应炉，重启通风井……
dialogText.en: Let me think. Our task right now is to switch off the reactor and restart ventilations...

dialogText.cn: 反应炉……反应炉的控制系统怎么完全失灵了？该死，偏偏在这种时候出问题！
dialogText.en: Come on, shut down already... The reactor control system is not responding at all! Oh, what a lovely pile of blight-turd. Out of all times!

dialogText.cn: 反应炉的控制模块失灵了。这个模块是我设计的，不可能出这种问题的……
dialogText.en: The reactor control module is down. But I designed this module. This shouldn't be happening...

dialogText.cn: 就在通风井下面，那个巨大的筒状建筑里。我在这边盯着，那边就拜托你了！
dialogText.en: It's beneath the ventilation shaft and within that giant cylindrical structure. I'll monitor it from here. Good luck with the reactor!

dialogText.cn: 你一定要小心，记得用通信设备保持联系。
dialogText.en: Be careful, and stay on the radio comms.

dialogText.cn: 通风井已经恢复正常了！现在就差反应炉异常的问题要解决了……
dialogText.en: The ventilation shaft is back up and running! The only thing left to fix is the malfunctioning reactor...

dialogText.cn: 不过，杰里米还是联系不上……
dialogText.en: But I still can't get in touch with Jeremy...

dialogText.cn: 他怎么了？
dialogText.en: What happened to him?

dialogText.cn: 天哪……怎么会这样……
dialogText.en: By Talos... How...? Why...?

dialogText.cn: 都是我的错，反应炉的控制模块是我设计的……如果控制系统没出故障的话，他就不用……
dialogText.en: It ... it's my fault. I designed a faulty reactor control module... If it had worked, he would be...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你帮我，但我……
dialogText.en: Thank you for your help, but I...

dialogText.cn: 是，我要振作起来……
dialogText.en: Yes... I must keep it together...

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样？难道他已经撤离了？
dialogText.en: Really? Strange. Perhaps he evacced the place.

dialogText.cn: 现在通风井重启了，其他问题也好解决一点。
dialogText.en: The ventilation shaft is working again. The other issues are easy to fix.

dialogText.cn: 等我修好控制系统，就能关闭反应炉。
dialogText.en: Once I fix the control system, I'll be able to shut down the reactor.

dialogText.cn: 但愿杰里米平安无事……我会先暂时接管他的工作，等他回来了再交还给他。无论如何，这次都多亏了你的帮助，谢谢你。
dialogText.en: I hope Jeremy is alright... I'll handle the jobs for now and hand over the keys once he returns. In any case, your assistance really turned things around. Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 奇怪……坐标都对得上，怎么就是找不到……
dialogText.en: How strange... The coordinates match perfectly, but I still can't find it...

dialogText.cn: 好不容易到最后一步了，我可不能放弃！
dialogText.en: Ugh, I'm so close to the final step... I can't give up now!

dialogText.cn: 啊，吓我一跳！
dialogText.en: *Gasp* You scared me!

dialogText.cn: 哦！你是终末地的管理员！
dialogText.en: Wait, I know you! You're the Endministrator of Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 千万别误会，我是<@qu.key>天师阿宝</>，我并非于此地行小偷小摸之事……
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>My name's Bao, and I'm a Tianshi</>. I'm not here to steal anything...

dialogText.cn: 我其实是在寻找……我爷爷留下的<@qu.key>宝藏</>！
dialogText.en: Actually, I'm searching for a <@qu.key>treasure</> left by my grandpa!

dialogText.cn: 唉，到最后一步卡住了。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Yeah, I'm stuck at the very last step.

dialogText.cn: 这块地曾是宏科院天师初来乍到之时设立的临时仓库，名为<@qu.key>天井院</>。我爷爷便是其中的工作人员。
dialogText.en: This place was a temporary depot set up by HAS when the Tianshi first arrived. It's called <@qu.key>Tianjing Courtyard</>. My grandpa used to work here.

dialogText.cn: 而他临终前告诉我一个秘密……他在这里留下了珍贵的宝藏！
dialogText.en: And with his dying breath, he told me a secret ... that he left a precious treasure here!

dialogText.cn: 然后我按着他留下的藏宝图，一路寻觅——
dialogText.en: So I followed his treasure map all the way to this very spot...

dialogText.cn: 走到了最后的标记点，眼前除了这一片大水池，啥都没有！
dialogText.en: Now I'm at the last marker, but all I see is this huge pond!

dialogText.cn: 什么？原来如此……我明白了，多谢高人指点！
dialogText.en: What? How did I not think of that... Thanks for the enlightenment!

dialogText.cn: 当年的仓库很可能修在地下，只是时过境迁，被淹没了，如今变成了一汪废池？
dialogText.en: The depot was most likely built underground. But over the years, it got flooded and ended up as nothing but a waste of a pond?

dialogText.cn: 但问题又来了，我可没练过闭气屏息之术，如何潜入这池中呢……
dialogText.en: But now here's another problem ... I've never learned how to hold my breath underwater. How am I supposed to dive into this pond?

dialogText.cn: 什么？那可真是解了燃眉之急了！
dialogText.en: Whoa! That's gonna save me big time!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这样吧，既然你如此仗义……若你帮我寻得宝藏，不论它是什么，我都必有重谢！
dialogText.en: Endministrator, since you're so awesome ... whatever the treasure turns out to be, I promise a big reward!

dialogText.cn: 我爷爷说了，那玩意儿放得越久越值钱！我觉得八成是个古董，说不定能发大财呢！
dialogText.en: My grandpa said the longer it sits, the more valuable it gets! I'm betting it's some kind of fancy antique. Maybe I'll be rich soon!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，管理员，上面写了啥，有宝藏吗？
dialogText.en: So, Endmin, what's it say? Any actual treasure?

dialogText.cn: 杜曲生就是我的爷爷！
dialogText.en: Du Qusheng is my grandpa!

dialogText.cn: 放得越久越值钱……原来是酒啊！还以为是什么稀世珍宝呢！
dialogText.en: Okay... I get what he meant by "the longer it sits, the more valuable it gets"... I was really hoping for some priceless gem!

dialogText.cn: 倒也合理……爷爷生前一直嗜酒如命，还背着我爹教我喝酒呢……
dialogText.en: Fair enough... Grandpa loved his brews, and he even taught me how to tell them apart back then...

dialogText.cn: 总而言之，虽然没有发大财，但了却了我的一桩心愿！
dialogText.en: I might not have gotten wealthy, but I did fulfill my dream of finding Grandpa's treasure!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，管理员。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 我有预感，宝藏就在这扇大门后！但是怎么把大门打开呢……
dialogText.en: I'm sure the treasure's behind this gate! But how do we get it open...

dialogText.cn: 一定和门前这三道机关有联系……让我来找找藏宝图里有什么提示……
dialogText.en: Gotta be linked to these three mechanisms by the gate... Let me see what hints this treasure map's hiding...

dialogText.cn: 看样子需要三个“<@qu.key>钥匙</>”去激活这三道机关。
dialogText.en: Looks like we'll need three <@qu.key>keys</> to activate these mechanisms.

dialogText.cn: 我们去找找吧，管理员！
dialogText.en: Let's go find them, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 这三个“钥匙”，分别散落在地下一、二、三层内。
dialogText.en: These three "keys" are scattered across the underground first, second, and third levels.

dialogText.cn: 噢！果然有！
dialogText.en: Aha! There it is!

dialogText.cn: 我有预感，宝藏就在这扇大门后！但是怎么把大门打开呢……
dialogText.en: I'm sure the treasure's behind this gate! But how do we get it open...

dialogText.cn: 一定和门前这三道机关有联系……让我来找找藏宝图里有什么提示……
dialogText.en: Gotta be linked to these three mechanisms by the gate... Let me see what hints this treasure map's hiding...

dialogText.cn: 我懂了！我们先前捡到的奇怪“<@qu.key>钥匙</>”就是用来激活机关的！
dialogText.en: I get it now! The <@qu.key>keys</> we picked up earlier are used just for this!

dialogText.cn: 三道机关，对应三个“钥匙”！这三个“钥匙”，分别散落在地下一、二、三层内。
dialogText.en: Three mechanisms, three keys! They're scattered across the underground first, second, and third levels.

dialogText.cn: 快去找找剩下的“钥匙”吧，管理员！
dialogText.en: Let's find the remaining keys, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 我有预感，宝藏就在这扇大门后！但是怎么把大门打开呢……
dialogText.en: I'm sure the treasure's behind this gate! But how do we get it open...

dialogText.cn: 一定和门前这三道机关有联系……让我来找找藏宝图里有什么提示……
dialogText.en: Gotta be linked to these three mechanisms by the gate... Let me see what hints this treasure map's hiding...

dialogText.cn: 我懂了！我们之前捡到的三个“钥匙”就是用来激活这三道机关的！
dialogText.en: I get it now! The keys we picked up earlier are used just for this!

dialogText.cn: 宝藏近在咫尺，快去激活<@qu.key>机关</>吧！
dialogText.en: The treasure's right within reach! Let's activate the <@qu.key>mechanism</>!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？怎么没反应？
dialogText.en: Huh? Why isn't it working?

dialogText.cn: 难道是残余的水影响了这些机关的运作？
dialogText.en: Could leftover moisture be messing with these mechanisms?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们等<@qu.key>水被抽干</>再来看看吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's wait for the water to <@qu.key>drain completely</> and check again.

dialogText.cn: 啊，欢迎终末地专家莅临指导！我是值班天师陆欣……
dialogText.en: Ah! Welcome, my Endfielder pro! I'm Lu Xin, the Tianshi on duty...

dialogText.cn: 等等……您的面具！这质量也太好了吧，这色彩，这光感！专家您一定就是……
dialogText.en: Wait...! Your mask! Just look at this quality! The color, coating, and glowing effects! My expert pro, you must be...

dialogText.cn: 您一定就是终末地管理员的资深粉丝啊！想不到啊，竟还能遇到同好！
dialogText.en: ...a SUPER FAN of the Endministrator of Endfield Industries! I can't believe I'd meet a fellow fan!

dialogText.cn: 我也是管理员的粉丝！您看看我这个面具，自己手工涂装的，绝对独一无二！
dialogText.en: I'm a super fan of the Endmin myself! Check out my Endmin mask! Primed, painted, and finished it myself. Definitely one of a kind!

dialogText.cn: 啊！差点忘了正事……出问题的是息壤能量定型装置，我们已经找到症结所在了。
dialogText.en: Ah! Almost forgot about the actual business... Yeah. The Xiranite Energy-Fixing Facility. We identified the root cause.

dialogText.cn: 之前的大战中，技术开发局的设施紧急关机。这次重启后，定型装置中的导流轨系统自动复位出了问题……
dialogText.en: During that huge battle, all Applied Tech facilities underwent emergency shutdown. We tried to start them up again, but the Moulder's Xiranflow Track couldn't auto-reset properly...

dialogText.cn: 得有技术精湛的专家操作射流无人机，以液化息壤引导息壤滑块，将其逐步推入导流扣。
dialogText.en: We need a true professional to pilot a jet drone, use Liquid Xiranite to guide the Xiranite Sliding Block along, and push the Block into the Block Slot.

dialogText.cn: 不好意思，光顾自己说了，专家您随我来……我带您亲自去看看。
dialogText.en: Ooops. I'm afraid that might be too much information. Just follow me, my expert Endfielder... I'll show you the entire setup.

dialogText.cn: 在终末地的专家来之前，我得抓紧熟悉下息壤导流轨道系统的操作……
dialogText.en: Before that Endfield pro arrives, I gotta know how to really operate the Xiranflow Track System...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……等所有息壤滑块被推回导流扣，我们就能重启能量定型装置。
dialogText.en: Yeah... Push all the Xiranite Sliding Blocks into the Block Slots, then we'll be able to restart the energy fixer.

dialogText.cn: 这次重启成功，后续技术开发局的生产计划便能提速了……
dialogText.en: A successful reboot will help speed up production plans assigned to the Bureau of Applied Technologies.

dialogText.cn: 定型后的息壤块，是咱们武陵城对抗侵蚀潮的关键！
dialogText.en: The Xiranslabs produced are key to Wuling's fight against the Blight Tide!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……等这期计划完成，我就能休假去参加同好会活动了！
dialogText.en: Heheh... Once this production plan is met, I'll get my leave and join my Endmin Fan event!

dialogText.cn: 专家，快！一起看看息壤块的定型过程，这可是难得一见的奇观！
dialogText.en: Endfielder pro! Quick! See how Xiranite energy is fixed and shaped into Xiranslabs! You don't see this anywhere!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，专家，息壤块完美定型，我们成功了！
dialogText.en: Haha! Look at that my Endfielder friend! Perfectly fixed and shaped Xiranslabs. We did it!

dialogText.cn: 多亏了你们终末地的技术协助，不然在资深的天师们都缺席的情况下，重启装置不知要浪费多少时间。
dialogText.en: The reboot would have taken ages as all of our senior Tianshi are absent. Thankfully we got some serious Endfield tech support.

dialogText.cn: 其实，我还有一个不情之请。和工作无关……我超想知道怎样才能入手专家您戴着的同款面具！
dialogText.en: Well, I actually have a small favor to ask. It's not related to work... But I really got to know how to get that super-realistic Endmin mask you're wearing!

dialogText.cn: 虽然自己手工制作面具有独一无二的浪漫感，但没人能拒绝高质量的好物……
dialogText.en: My handcrafted version is indeed unique and romantic in its own way, but I can't say no to premium top-notch cosplay merch...

dialogText.cn: 您这款面具的用料和做工太帅了，简直是我等粉丝收藏必备！
dialogText.en: Your mask is definitely made with super-awesome materials and skills. Any true fan of the Endmin must get their hands on one!

dialogText.cn: 欸，不会吧，你这面具不会是真品吧？这怎么可能呢！等等……难道专家您就是……终末地的管理员？！
dialogText.en: Wha? For real? Wait, is your mask the actual thing? How is that possible?! Wait, my Endfielder pro... Are you... No way, are you THE Endministrator of Endfield Industries?!

dialogText.cn: 天哪！我真是太蠢了……我……我竟然指挥管理员帮自己干了这么多活儿……
dialogText.en: BY TALOS! I'm such an idiot... I ... I can't believe I ordered the Endmin around to do my work...

dialogText.cn: 糟了，签名板没带在身边……不对，能有机会和管理员一起工作还要什么签名啊！
dialogText.en: Blighted heavens, I didn't even bring my autograph book with me... Wait. Why would I even need an autograph?! I partnered up with the actual Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您简直就如传闻中一样完美，不！您比传闻中还要完美，技艺超俗，还如此平易近人……
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're just as perfect as every legend claims! NO! You're even perfect-er than the legends. Your skills are friggin' uber and you're so friendly too...

dialogText.cn: 不愧是文明环带的大英雄！能亲眼见到您一面，我陆欣这辈子都值了！
dialogText.en: That's why you're the Hero of the Civilization Band! Oh... I actually saw the Endmin with my own eyes. I can finally die in peace now!

dialogText.cn: 让那些同好会的朋友知道我这回的好运后，他们都会羡慕到发狂的……这件事能够我吹一辈子了！
dialogText.en: I gotta tell my Endmin Fan Group about this! They'll be Xiranite-green with envy... This story will carry me to my grave!

dialogText.cn: 天哪，我被管理员亲口夸赞了，这句话我得记下来，告诉同好会的所有人！
dialogText.en: No way, the Endmin just praised me in person! Gotta memorize every word and tell everyone in the Fan Group!

dialogText.cn: 这是一本未完成的书稿，书名有些模糊，但落款处写着“刘协”两个字，非常清晰。
dialogText.en: An incomplete draft for a book. The name looks a little smudged, but the author signed his name very clearly: Liu Xie.

dialogText.cn: 这份名为《北方教师》的草稿，描述了宏山城出身的主角，前往文明环带以北支教，卷入了工团和裂地者纷争。
dialogText.en: A draft of a novel titled Teaching in the North. It follows a protagonist from Hongshan who left the Civilization Band and went on a northward trip to educate the people he met. He then found himself engaged in a conflict between the USWT and Landbreakers.

dialogText.cn: 彼时工团和裂地者的战争结束，工团为防范裂地者死灰复燃，决定把荒野上的其他居民纳入保护……
dialogText.en: The war between the UWST and Landbreakers had just ended. To ensure that the raiders do not make a comeback, the UWST decided to include other communities of the wildlands in their protection...

dialogText.cn: 为了甄别藏在居民中的裂地者，工团特意挑选一些常识问题进行问答筛选。主角的学生被选中去回答问题。
dialogText.en: The UWST also created a general knowledge quiz to identify Landbreakers who might be hiding amongst the common folk. The protagonist's student had to face this quiz.

dialogText.cn: 学生在问答中想起了主角的谆谆教导，想起自己从一名无知裂地者到拥抱文明的变化，最终通过筛选。
dialogText.en: The student thought about the protagonist's lessons, recalled how he transformed from an ignorant Landbreaker to a defender of civilization, and successfully passed the quiz.

dialogText.cn: 最后面还有另一种笔迹的试阅批注——全是空想！你既不懂裂地者，也不懂工团！
dialogText.en: "Pure fantasy! You know nothing about the Landbreakers or the UWST!" Words scribbled in another hand could be found at the last page set aside for the readers' feedback.

dialogText.cn: 这一句结尾，是用“致岁月”好，还是“致文明”更好……感觉都不错。
dialogText.en: This final line. Should I use "To the Years" or "To Civilization"... Both sound good to me.

dialogText.cn: 啊！今天的活，我完成了……
dialogText.en: WHOA! Yes! I completed every work today, yes sir...!

dialogText.cn: 欸？不是领导啊，吓死我了。咳咳……这个打扮，您是终末地的管理员！
dialogText.en: Oh. You're not my team lead. Scared the blight out of me. Ahem... From the way you dress, you must be the Endministrator of Endfield Industries!

dialogText.cn: 我……我叫刘协。从小就看您的故事，那时我就立志要成为著作等身的大文学家。没想到……还有见到您真人的一天。
dialogText.en: I ... I'm Liu Xie. I've read your story since I was a kid and swore to become a great writer. I never knew I'd see ... the actual legend in person.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，如今我的爱好就是写故事，啊——
dialogText.en: Heheh. Writing stories is my current hobby. Oh—

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我可以向您请教一下不？您那些传奇的冒险经历，一定能成为我创作的灵感素材……
dialogText.en: Endmin, can I ask you for a tiny favor? Your legendary adventures will definitely spark my creativity...

dialogText.cn: 而且，别小瞧我，在校技术培训时我可是尖子生，经过千挑万选到望楼蓄水站任职的，这点事我手到擒来。
dialogText.en: I might not look like it, but I actually topped my vocational training class. They carefully chose me to work at the Watchtower Reservoir Station. This is just a walk in the park.

dialogText.cn: 这个岗位的前任职工也是我们学校的优秀校友，如今在宏科院都鼎鼎有名的一位老学长。
dialogText.en: The previous dude who worked here is a distinguished alumnus of my school. He's now an Old Legend at HAS itself.

dialogText.cn: 对我来说，蓄水站几乎是完美的工作环境了，但学校里一直流传着关于此地的传说……
dialogText.en: I treat the Reservoir Station as the perfect place to work. But back in school, everyone heard a campus myth...

dialogText.cn: 传说老学长在蓄水站留了一份宝物——可让人工作效率倍增的百宝工具箱！
dialogText.en: Our Old Legend hid a treasure at the Reservoir Station — the Omni-Functionable Toolkit that can boost work efficiency beyond measure!

dialogText.cn: 欸，这您就不懂了，都是咱们技术职工的浪漫！
dialogText.en: Oh, this is something you gotta brush up on. Functionable is the romantic ideal for tech laborers like us!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我已经把工具箱位置锁定到三号蓄水池周围了。老学长还在岗时，有频繁出入那里的记录。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I've marked the potential locations of the Toolkit near Reservoir 3. Access logs showed that our Old Legend frequented that place when he worked here.

dialogText.cn: 可如今那里还有残留的天使……拜托您！请帮我找到传说中的百宝工具箱吧！
dialogText.en: But we got a cluster of straggling Aggeloi at that place... Please! I really need to find that legendary Omni-Functionable Toolkit!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，<@qu.key>蓄水站</>中仍有天使活动的报告。对普通职工而言，那里的环境确实很危险……
dialogText.en: Endmin, we're still getting reports of Aggelos activity at the <@qu.key>Reservoir Station</>. The site is indeed dangerous for ordinary laborers.

dialogText.cn: 您可不要误会，我今天的工作都完成了，是在合理利用闲暇时间。
dialogText.en: Ah, no need to worry. My work is done for today. This break time is legit.

dialogText.cn: 等找到百宝工具箱，我就有大把时间搞文学创作了！
dialogText.en: Once I find the Omni-Functionable Toolkit, I would finally get enough time to pursue my literary ambitions!

dialogText.cn: 老学长，可千万不要骗我啊……
dialogText.en: I hope our Old Legend didn't lie to me...

dialogText.cn: 欸，这扇门需要通行指令。
dialogText.en: Hey. We need a pass phrase to open this gate.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，是弱指令锁定，应该不难解开。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this seems like a weak pass code that we can easily crack.

dialogText.cn: 或许这附近会有老学长留下的东西，我们找找有什么线索吧……
dialogText.en: The Old Legend might have left something nearby. Let's look around for clues...

dialogText.cn: 咦，没有路了？
dialogText.en: Hey. It's a dead end.

dialogText.cn: 我来联系他！
dialogText.en: I can ask him now!

dialogText.cn: 咦，只有一本小册子？
dialogText.en: What? It only contains a booklet.

dialogText.cn: 《致后来人》，宝物原来不是什么工具箱吗？
dialogText.en: To Posterity? I guess that phat lewt is not a toolkit.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们回控制区的保卫科吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we should head back to the Restricted Area Security Section.

dialogText.cn: 多谢管理员了，让我先看看……《致后来人》？
dialogText.en: Thank you so much, Endmin. Let me see... To Posterity?

dialogText.cn: 欸，里面不只有老学长的记录，还有这个岗位第一任前辈的记录……
dialogText.en: Hmm. The Old Legend wasn't the only author. In fact, the first reservoir inspector assigned to this post wrote things as well...

dialogText.cn: 这太有意思了，不是枯燥的心得和教训，有许多我没见过，也想象不到的事情。
dialogText.en: This is really interesting. It's not filled with boring lessons or fowl soups for the soul. It's things that I never knew before, stuff that goes beyond my fantasies.

dialogText.cn: 甚至还有老前辈亲身经历过的武陵科考站历史……
dialogText.en: There are even records about the Wuling Science Station that the first inspector experienced...

dialogText.cn: 这位前辈喜欢铅笔手绘，老学长喜欢研究天文，这里也有他们工作之余对于生活的记录……
dialogText.en: The first inspector enjoyed making pencil sketches while our Old Legend loved astronomy. Look. They even scribbled things about life outside work...

dialogText.cn: 最重要的是，他们都给这个岗位的继任者留下了告诫——
dialogText.en: Most importantly, they left the same lesson to their next replacement—

dialogText.cn: “蓄水站的工作虽然枯燥，但却很重要，防川之险，人大于天”……
dialogText.en: "Work at the Reservoir Station might be boring, but it is very important. Effort decides the success of flood prevention"...

dialogText.cn: 虽然不是我想象中的百宝工具箱，但这本笔记对我也很有用！
dialogText.en: It might not be the Omni-Functionable Toolkit, but it's still really useful to me!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多谢你们了。接下来，我得好好研究一番《致后来人》……
dialogText.en: Thank you so much, Endmin. To Posterity. I'm going to take some time to study it thoroughly...

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，我会好好理解他们的心意，从里面多提炼些灵感素材……
dialogText.en: Heheh. Of course I will. Gotta milk these writings for more ideas and inspiration...

dialogText.cn: 欸，多颗恒星的恒星系统！这个点子就不错，假设有五个太阳……
dialogText.en: Wow. A multi-star system! That sounds great. If there were five suns...

dialogText.cn: 太好了，这就是我期待许久的<@qu.key>百宝工具箱</>吗？
dialogText.en: Awesome. Is this the <@qu.key>Omni-Functionable Tookit</> that I've been praying for?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我有新灵感了！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I got a brand new idea!

dialogText.cn: 这次不是“致文明”，也不是“致岁月”，我要写有五个太阳的恒星系统……
dialogText.en: I'm not going to write To Civilization or To the Years. I'm going to write about a star system with five suns...

dialogText.cn: 等着吧，我一定会写出一本传世巨作的！
dialogText.en: Just you wait. My work shall be lauded for generations to come!

dialogText.cn: “防川之险，人大于天”……这就是<@qu.key>通行指令</>吧？
dialogText.en: "Effort decides the success of flood prevention"... This is the <@qu.key>pass phrase</>, right?

dialogText.cn: 这位老学长看来是一位相当认真负责的职工。
dialogText.en: This Old Legend seems like a diligent and duty-bound laborer.

dialogText.cn: 他在工作记录里，总是把这一句话记在末尾。
dialogText.en: He concludes every work log with the same line.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这句话是对他很重要的提醒……
dialogText.en: Endmin, this line serves as an important personal reminder for him...

dialogText.cn: 咱们先试试吧，我觉得就是这一句！
dialogText.en: Let's give that a shot. Got a strong feeling that it's the line we need!

dialogText.cn: 祖泉保佑！得救了！
dialogText.en: Ancestral spring be praised! We're saved!

dialogText.cn: 没想到真的等来了救星……
dialogText.en: Phoo, someone really came here to save us...

dialogText.cn: 大恩大德，没齿难忘！
dialogText.en: We'll never forget your deeds for saving our lives!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？侵蚀消失了？这神通可太厉害了！
dialogText.en: Wow! The Blight is gone! What type of awesome Arts is this?

dialogText.cn: 谢谢恩人，我还有两个兄弟也被困住了！
dialogText.en: Thank you, dear hero. But two of my friends are trapped as well!

dialogText.cn: 他们也拜托您了！我相信您一定能带我们脱困！
dialogText.en: Please save them as well! I know you can definitely get us out of this mess!

dialogText.cn: 我还以为这次死定了呢！
dialogText.en: I thought I was a goner!

dialogText.cn: 我都闭上眼睛等着侵蚀把我带走了……
dialogText.en: I thought I'd be dead and Blighted for sure and accepted my fate...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？侵蚀消失了？这神通可太厉害了！
dialogText.en: Wow! The Blight is gone! What type of awesome Arts is this?

dialogText.cn: 谢谢恩人，我还有两个兄弟也被困住了！
dialogText.en: Thank you, dear hero. But two of my friends are trapped as well!

dialogText.cn: 他们也拜托您了！我相信您一定能带我们脱困！
dialogText.en: Please save them as well! I know you can definitely get us out of this mess!

dialogText.cn: 是您给了我第二条命，我会好好珍惜的。
dialogText.en: You gave me a second chance at life. I'll treasure it well.

dialogText.cn: 再见了……炭烤鳞丸……椒盐羽兽串……
dialogText.en: Good bye... roasted finballs ... and salt-pepper fowl-kebabs...

dialogText.cn: 是您……救了我？
dialogText.en: Did you just ... save me?

dialogText.cn: 嗯？侵蚀消失了？这神通可太厉害了！
dialogText.en: Wow! The Blight is gone! What type of awesome Arts is this?

dialogText.cn: 谢谢恩人，我还有两个兄弟也被困住了！
dialogText.en: Thank you, dear hero. But two of my friends are trapped as well!

dialogText.cn: 他们也拜托您了！我相信您一定能带我们脱困！
dialogText.en: Please save them as well! I know you can definitely get us out of this mess!

dialogText.cn: 感激不尽！
dialogText.en: I can't thank you enough!

dialogText.cn: 恩人，感谢您救了我们！
dialogText.en: Our savior! Thank you for saving us!

dialogText.cn: 我们一直躲着不敢出来，没想到反而被侵蚀包围了！
dialogText.en: We kept our heads low, but never realized that the Blight got us all surrounded!

dialogText.cn: 我们本想躲一躲寨子里的大乱，于是就跑到了这个僻静的地方……
dialogText.en: We came to this quiet place 'cos we wanted to avoid the war in the Stockade...

dialogText.cn: 兄弟们也没啥能报答您的，身上就这么多东西了，您可别嫌弃！
dialogText.en: We're not exactly rich folks. This is what we have. Please take them!

dialogText.cn: 唉，要是能帮上学姐的忙就好了……
dialogText.en: Oh dear. If only I could help out my senior...

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员？！你……你好，我叫安虞，是试验园区的天师学徒，目前在协助陆令香学姐修复园区里的设备……
dialogText.en: E-Endmin?! Hi ... yeah, I'm An Yu, Tianshi disciple of the Test Area. I'm currently helping my senior Lu Lingxiang fix the local facilities...

dialogText.cn: 这两天学姐一直在为排气管道的问题发愁。部分要维修的管道阀门附近还有侵蚀，可天师们的人手不太够……
dialogText.en: Lu is really frustrated about the gas pipes. We also have Blight near the valves that require fixing, but we don't have that many Tianshi to spare...

dialogText.cn: 说是过段时间才能派人来……可现在很多地方都因为管道故障无法进入，修复工作都被拖慢了……
dialogText.en: They said they'll send someone over after a while... But now, plenty of areas are inaccessible due to the broken pipes. Our repair work is getting delayed...

dialogText.cn: 要不是我不太擅长处理侵蚀，真想帮学姐解决这个难题，让她重新打起精神……她都唉声叹气好几天了……
dialogText.en: If I knew how to clean up the Blight, I could help Lu solve the issue and make her happy again... She's been sighing non-stop for days...

dialogText.cn: 欸？！真的吗？太谢谢你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Oh?! Really? Thank you so much, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 这里需要维修的阀门就在旁边储水池的底部，可现在池水全被污染了。
dialogText.en: The valve that needs repairs is located at the bottom of the reservoir next to us. Unfortunately, it is filled with contaminated sewage.

dialogText.cn: 必须处理掉这些污水，才能维修阀门，关闭故障的排气管道。
dialogText.en: We must get rid of the sewage to fix the valve and shut off the malfunctioning gas discharge pipe.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，如果你手上有能够抽水的设备，可以先试试看！
dialogText.en: Endmin, if you have any fluid pumps, we can try using those!

dialogText.cn: 这两个要维修的阀门都在旁边的储水池下面——
dialogText.en: The two valves that need fixing are at the bottom of the reservoir next to us —

dialogText.cn: 咦？怎么都已经关闭了……难道……
dialogText.en: Huh. All of them have been closed... What happened...?

dialogText.cn: 哇！不愧是管理员！那我们直接去下一个阀门那里吧！
dialogText.en: Wow! That's why you're the Endmin! Let's just head over to the next valve repair site!

dialogText.cn: ——安！小！虞！你该不会忘了之前答应过我什么了吧？
dialogText.en: AN! YU! I hope you didn't forget what you promised me.

dialogText.cn: 没、没有忘！“不会擅自行动”……对不起，学姐……
dialogText.en: No, of course not! Ah, "no scampering around without permission"... Sorry, Lu...

dialogText.cn: 唉，你看看你，不仅没做到，居然还拉上了管理员——
dialogText.en: Just look at you! Not only did you scamper around, you even dragged the Endmin along —

dialogText.cn: ……竟然是这样。小虞，错怪你了，该说对不起的是我才对。
dialogText.en: Is that so? Well, An, I guess I owe you an apology.

dialogText.cn: 没想到你是为了我才……不过，就算这样也下不为例哦！你都不知道那几个地方有多危险！
dialogText.en: I never thought you did all this for me... But don't make this excuse for next time! You should know how dangerous this area can be!

dialogText.cn: 刚刚我看到你坐标显示的那个位置，差点就吓晕了！幸亏有管理员在……
dialogText.en: When I saw your positioning coordinates just then, my heart almost gave out! Fortunately we have the Endmin with you...

dialogText.cn: 我、我知道了，绝对不会有第二次了！陆学姐，你要是不相信，可以让管理员做个见证！
dialogText.en: I-I know. There won't be a second time, Lu! If you don't believe me, I'll have the Endmin be my witness!

dialogText.cn: 好吧，现在这份解决园区重要难题的奖励就是你的了！拿好了哦。
dialogText.en: Fine. I think you deserve the reward for addressing the major problem of the Test Area! Take this.

dialogText.cn: 欸？给、给我的……奖励？
dialogText.en: Wha? Is-is this ... for me?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，管理员也有份——谢谢你！又帮试验园区搞定了这么大个麻烦！这下修复工作总算能顺利推进啦！
dialogText.en: Yeah. And our Endmin gets one too — Thank you! You just solved another serious issue of the Test Area! Repair work will progress a lot more smoothly now!

actorName.cn: 愁眉苦脸的天师学徒{林轲}

dialogText.cn: 怎么办……陆则他们也抽不开身，这样下去……
dialogText.en: What should we do... Lu Ze and the others are swamped too. At this rate...

actorName.cn: 愁眉苦脸的天师学徒{林轲}

dialogText.cn: 呃，你好，我叫林轲，是一名研究息壤设备的天师学徒，目前正在进行一次试验型天师桩的启动测试。
dialogText.en: Uh, hello. My name's Lin Ke. I'm a Tianshi disciple researching Xiranite devices. I'm running a startup test on an experimental Tianshi Pillar.

dialogText.cn: 原本我找了同组的一位同学帮忙，我来负责天师桩这边的数据监控，他则负责辅桩的启动。
dialogText.en: I originally asked a classmate from our group to help out. I was supposed to monitor the data from the Tianshi Pillar here, while he handled activating the auxiliary pillar.

dialogText.cn: 结果他却临时摔伤了胳膊，一时间我也找不到能替代他的人，可要是完成不了这次实验，我今年的课题就……
dialogText.en: But he picked the worst time to injure his arm... I can't find anyone to replace him on such short notice. If we can't complete this experiment, my research project this year will be...

dialogText.cn: 真、真的吗？步骤很简单的！一共六个辅桩，你只要按顺序开启就好了！
dialogText.en: Wait, really? It's really simple! You'll just need to activate the six auxiliary pillars in sequence!

dialogText.cn: 多谢！那我就在这里静候佳音了。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! I'll await your news here.

dialogText.cn: 哦，对了，去之前你记得先在<@qu.key>天师桩</>录入信息，我好给你开启动的权限。
dialogText.en: Oh right! Before you go, make sure to register your info at the <@qu.key>Tianshi Pillar</> so I can grant you access.

dialogText.cn: 这下总算能进入下一环了。我会再向所有辅桩发送一次指令，确定它们的当前状态。
dialogText.en: Finally we can move to the next phase! I'll send another command to all auxiliary pillars to confirm their current status.

dialogText.cn: 然后要麻烦你替我<@qu.key>启动天师桩</>，我想一次性完成对所有数据的回收。
dialogText.en: Endmin, please <@qu.key>activate the Tianshi Pillar</> so I can collect all the data.

dialogText.cn: 太感谢了！我这边也收到所有辅桩正常启动的讯号了……真的辛苦你了！
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! I'm getting signals that all auxiliary pillars are activated properly... You really saved my thesis!

dialogText.cn: 天师桩正式启动……最终数据已全部收集。
dialogText.en: The Tianshi Pillar is officially activated ... and the final data's in too.

dialogText.cn: 试验型天师桩第一次实地运行测试——确认成功！
dialogText.en: First real-world Tianshi Pillar test confirmed successful!

dialogText.cn: 是的，这下总算能继续推进课题了……
dialogText.en: Yep! Now we can finally make progress on this research project...

dialogText.cn: 总之多谢你了，真的帮了我一个大忙。
dialogText.en: Anyway, thanks a ton! You really saved my skin back there.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，承你吉言了。
dialogText.en: Haha, I'll take that blessing!

dialogText.cn: 对了，之前导师给过我一笔研究经费，这是其中的一部分。希望你能收下，就当是我的一点心意吧。
dialogText.en: By the way, our instructor recently granted us some research funding. Please accept this portion as a small token of our gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己……六个辅桩数据已全部收集。
dialogText.en: Data from all six auxiliary pillars received.

dialogText.cn: 虽然还需要对数据进行进一步的分析，但最困难的部分都已经被你解决了，剩下的就没那么费劲了。
dialogText.en: Though we still need to analyze the data further, you've already tackled the hardest part. The rest should be smooth sailing!

dialogText.cn: 怎么办……我一个人可搞不定检修计划啊……
dialogText.en: No way... I'll never get these stabilizers fixed alone.

dialogText.cn: 欸，你是……管理员？这回有救了！
dialogText.en: You're the Endministrator? Oh, perfect timing!

dialogText.cn: 我是参加实习的新任天师，方泽。一直听院里导师提起管理员，没想到会遇到真人！
dialogText.en: Fang Ze, trainee Tianshi, at your service! Wow, the legendary Endministrator? The masters weren't exaggerating!

dialogText.cn: 本来约了老师一起检修这边的地下<@qu.key>阵列稳定桩</>，但她临时变更了日程。
dialogText.en: My mentor was supposed to help with these <@qu.key>stabilizers</>, but she bailed on me last minute!

dialogText.cn: 可检修工作需要至少两人配合……
dialogText.en: And ... and these stabilizers need at least two operators for maintenance.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，地下阵列稳定桩可关系到武陵城周边天师桩阵列的状态。
dialogText.en: Thank you! The entire Tianshi Pillar Array around Wuling depends on these stabilizing rods!

dialogText.cn: 我会用天师的权限来弹出异常的阵列稳定桩，麻烦管理员帮忙处理。
dialogText.en: Okay, popping out the glitchy stabilizers with my Tianshi access. Endmin, you can handle the rest!

dialogText.cn: 要小心！异常桩会因能量失衡进入高温状态，得用射流无人机降温。
dialogText.en: Watch out though, the faulty stabilizers may overheat due to an energy imbalance. We'll need jet drones to cool them down.

dialogText.cn: 等一整组阵列稳定桩的能量都恢复平衡后，再由我来确认异常原因。
dialogText.en: First, let's stabilize a whole array, then I'll trace what caused the malfunction!

dialogText.cn: 幸亏有你在，我一个人肯定操作不过来……
dialogText.en: I'd be totally overwhelmed without you... Seriously, you saved this operation back there!

dialogText.cn: 等我检查一下异常原因……嗯……只是阵列稳定桩的程序运行错误？
dialogText.en: Let me analyze the anomaly... Hmm... Just a program error in the stabilizing rods?

dialogText.cn: 小心无大事！管理员，我先去检查下一处，异常的阵列稳定桩可不止这一处。
dialogText.en: Better safe than sorry! Endmin, I'm heading to the next array. This isn't an isolated case!

dialogText.cn: 这里的异常原因……嗯……也是程序运行错误？
dialogText.en: The anomaly here... Seriously?! Another program error?

dialogText.cn: 仅仅是程序不稳定导致的异常停机，阵列稳定桩本身倒还好……
dialogText.en: Well, at least the rods are fine. Just some buggy code throwing tantrums.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，实话说，现在我才松了一口气，我就住附近，脑子里总想着别出大事、别出大事……
dialogText.en: Endmin, not gonna lie ... I didn't realize how scared I was until it was over. I live nearby. All I could think was ... "Please don't let this go wrong."

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，新手上路，可能过分紧张了……
dialogText.en: Ehehe... Rookie jitters. Maybe I over prepared?

dialogText.cn: 我去中间的稳定状态指示柱再看看，第三组阵列稳定桩就拜托管理员了！
dialogText.en: I'll check the central status pillar. Endmin, the third stabilizer array is in your hands!

dialogText.cn: 还有一处异常，希望没啥问题吧……
dialogText.en: One more anomaly... Please let this be nothing serious...

dialogText.cn: 照阿姨看，能有啥问题，咱小方天师这么厉害！
dialogText.en: With our Tianshi Fang on duty? What's there to worry about?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……也没那么好啦……都放心吧，我立马就能完成检修，绝不扰民！
dialogText.en: Ehehe... You're too kind! And don't worry, I'll wrap this up clean and quiet!

dialogText.cn: 啊，管理员也在……咳咳，我已经检查过了，第三组也是程序运行错误导致的异常停机。
dialogText.en: Ah, Endmin! Ehem... Third array's down. Same glitch as before, just code issues.

dialogText.cn: 虽然还有一处异常的警报，但只要强制重启，应该就能解决所有异常。
dialogText.en: One anomaly remains, but a forced reboot should resolve all irregularities.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……前面三组都查过了，这次异常应该都是同一问题导致的，重启后肯定能一次性解决！
dialogText.en: Hmm... The first three arrays all had the same glitch, this one should be no different! A reboot will wipe it clean!

dialogText.cn: 大家先散开吧，由我来操作……搞定，开始地下阵列稳定桩重启！
dialogText.en: Stand back, everyone ... and — engage! Full array reboot commencing!

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事！这一片的地下阵列稳定桩都因能量失衡而过热了……
dialogText.en: What the?! The entire array's going critical! Thermal spikes everywhere!

dialogText.cn: 不行，不能这样下去！这情况老师有教过……
dialogText.en: O-okay, Fang Ze... It's okay, breathe... Ma'am covered this scenario...

dialogText.cn: 对了，紧急维护手册第二十九条……手动接入，调控平衡，稳定这一片的阵列稳定桩！
dialogText.en: Um, article 29... Article 29... Manual linkage! Rebalance core systems to stabilize the entire array!

dialogText.cn: 这里我先撑着！管理员，快！冷却第四组阵列稳定桩！
dialogText.en: I'll hold the line here! Endmin, now — cool down the fourth array!

dialogText.cn: 一定要快，我撑不了太久！
dialogText.en: Hurry! I can't hold this much longer!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多亏你在！我差点酿成大错……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I... I couldn't have fixed this alone. Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 不要急着悔过！我辈天师在此地的职责是发现问题、正视问题、分析问题、解决问题。
dialogText.en: The stabilizers care not for guilt. A Tianshi's duty is to detect, confront, analyze, and resolve.

dialogText.cn: 老师……
dialogText.en: Ma'am...

dialogText.cn: 过来，一起检查指示柱的信息……管理员，麻烦你稍等下。
dialogText.en: Come. We'll examine the indicator's data together. Endministrator, please stand by momentarily.

dialogText.cn: 问题出在第四组阵列稳定桩附近，程序正常……组件正常……
dialogText.en: The fault lies near the fourth array... Program checks out... Hardware nominal...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这份息壤已经过耗，余量不足以支持阵列稳定桩运行了。不可能啊，同期的其他息壤是正常的——
dialogText.en: Huh? This Xiranite unit is critically depleted. Reserves can't sustain the array. Impossible... The other peer units are testing normal...

dialogText.cn: 天师的工作没有侥幸和想当然，我来看看……
dialogText.en: Tianshi don't rely on luck or assumptions. Let me examine this properly...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这份息壤的状况……记录波段显示，其短时间内承担了超预期的负荷冲击，城外的情况不乐观啊。
dialogText.en: This Xiranite unit's logs show it endured unprecedented stress surges in a short time frame. The perimeter situation is ... concerning.

dialogText.cn: 方泽，你之前检修操作都很规范，第三次甚至已经快要接触到这份出问题的息壤了……
dialogText.en: Fang Ze ... your protocols were flawless. Your third inspection brought you this close to the compromised Xiranite...

dialogText.cn: 但侥幸心理令你对后续检修置之不理，直接选择了重启。若不是管理员在场，后果不堪设想……
dialogText.en: Overconfidence blinded you. You abandoned protocol for a quick fix. Without the Endministrator's assistance, this array would be scrap now.

dialogText.cn: 好在你还记得紧急处理手段，关键时刻守住天师的职责，没有导致最坏结果。
dialogText.en: Flawed execution ... but proper crisis response. You did prevent total collapse, and that counts.

dialogText.cn: 对不起！老师，是我错了，明明一直提醒自己检修无小事……
dialogText.en: I'm sorry, ma'am! I should have known better. "No margin for error" was drilled into us!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们已经定位了异常桩，之后会派人将其从这一片的阵列稳定桩中取出检修替换。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, we've pinpointed the anomalous stabilizers. A specialized team will extract, repair, and replace them within the stabilizer array.

dialogText.cn: 唉，一个异常桩倒还好。我更担心这不是个例，所有的阵列稳定桩都要排查一遍……
dialogText.en: A single faulty stabilizer is manageable... But I fear this isn't isolated. All stabilizer arrays may need inspection.

dialogText.cn: 欸，那不是要全城大检修了吗？
dialogText.en: You're saying ... a city-wide maintenance overhaul?!

dialogText.cn: 确实如此，武陵城的阵列稳定桩很久没进行过这种规模的检修了……
dialogText.en: Indeed. Wuling's stabilizer array hasn't undergone maintenance of this scale in decades...

dialogText.cn: 但检修无小事，一丝一毫的风险都会带来严重后果！
dialogText.en: But there is no margin for error. A single unchecked flaw could bring the entire city down!

dialogText.cn: 放心，方泽的成绩在这批实习的新任天师中，已经算不错了。
dialogText.en: Rest assured, Fang Ze is exceeding expectations among this year's trainee Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 虽然有些毛躁，但最后关头，她临危不乱稳定住了异常，算得上勇气可嘉。
dialogText.en: A bit reckless, perhaps. But when it mattered, she stabilized the anomaly. Commendable composure under pressure.

dialogText.cn: 我常教导年轻天师——在危难面前，坚守天师责任。但心里还是希望他们更加珍视自己的安全。
dialogText.en: I drill this into every young Tianshi: "Duty above all in crisis." Yet in my heart ... I beg them to value their own survival more.

dialogText.cn: 阵列稳定桩没了可以再造，但每个人的生命却只有一次。幸好，方泽这回没出事……
dialogText.en: Stabilizers can be mended. Bones cannot. This time ... we were lucky.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多亏有你在……我这学生差点就搞砸了。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness you were here, Endministrator... My student almost messed everything up big time.

dialogText.cn: 我再去准备点贡品，别再闹了，别再闹了……
dialogText.en: I'll get some more offerings. Please... Just make it stop...

dialogText.cn: 呜哇！！！无意冒犯，消灾免难，冤亲债主快走开！
dialogText.en: AAAHHH!!! No offense, no offense! By the old rites, begone, unseen ones!

dialogText.cn: 吓、吓我一跳！我以为那些家伙对贡品不满意，又在闹……
dialogText.en: Gah! You scared me! Thought those things were angry about the offerings again...

dialogText.cn: 不好意思啊……你、你们是要打听水渠里的“脏东西”？
dialogText.en: O-oh! You're ... asking about *the things* in the canals?

dialogText.cn: 最近有几处水渠，水面会无风起浪，深处还有怪异的响动……
dialogText.en: The water moves wrong. And the noises ... oh goodness the noises...

dialogText.cn: 还有啊，我亲眼所见，水下在冒鬼火！
dialogText.en: And — and the water glows green at night ... like drowned souls!

dialogText.cn: 是啊，大家很发愁，这几天都不敢用这里的水了……
dialogText.en: Right? Everyone's terrified. No one dares touch the water now!

dialogText.cn: 我二姨说，可能是有人掉进水渠，化成了……呃！
dialogText.en: They say a body fell in last month... Now it's not human anymore... *Shivers*

dialogText.cn: 不行，我腿肚子打颤……具体情况你们问那边的天师学徒吧，他叫<@qu.key>厉衡</>，好像很熟悉水渠……
dialogText.en: I've said too much! That Tianshi disciple over there, <@qu.key>Li Heng</> ... he knows the dark waters better...

dialogText.cn: 水渠里的<@qu.key>脏东西</>天天闹，咱们怎么用水啊……
dialogText.en: How do we use water with that <@qu.key>filth</> causing chaos every day?

dialogText.cn: 读数稳定，化学指标合格……嗯？管理员，你找我？
dialogText.en: Readings stable, chem-levels nominal... Hm? Endministrator, you need me?

dialogText.cn: 别听他们瞎说，哪儿有什么“脏东西”，都是迷信。
dialogText.en: Ignore that nonsense. "Filth"? Superstition is the real pollutant.

dialogText.cn: 我很熟悉这几个水渠，每周都要来两次，从来没见过什么异常。
dialogText.en: I walk these canals twice a week. Never once seen anything "abnormal".

dialogText.cn: 说不定是有人在里面偷偷养鳞兽，闹了些动静。一传十，十传百……
dialogText.en: My bet? Someone's illegally breeding fin, caused a ruckus, and sparked wild rumors.

dialogText.cn: 但……居民一直这么恐慌，连水都不敢用，也是个问题……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* But the panic's real. People refusing to use water is a public health risk...

dialogText.cn: 太好了，那就麻烦你们了！先检查下<@qu.key>方兴衢跟天师府学院附近的水渠</>吧。
dialogText.en: Perfect! You can start with the <@qu.key>canals under Fangxing Avenue and near the Tianshi Bureau Academy</>.

dialogText.cn: 完了完了，水渠里真的有“脏东西”！
dialogText.en: Oh goodness it's real! There really is "filth" in the waters!

dialogText.cn: 就在刚才……
dialogText.en: Just now...

dialogText.cn: 我放在水渠里测试的课程作业，信号断了！我去找……它们居然不翼而飞了！
dialogText.en: My prototypes deployed for testing... Their signals just vanished! I went to retrieve them and... Gone.

dialogText.cn: 只听说过农业方向的作业会被吃掉，怎么水渠系统方向的也会丢啊？
dialogText.en: Since when do canal sensors get "eaten"?! I signed up for tech, not predatory infrastructure!

dialogText.cn: 难道是因为我不信邪，水渠里的冤魂要报复我，让我挂科……
dialogText.en: Is this ... karma for mocking the water ghosts?! Are the drowned punishing my skepticism?!

dialogText.cn: 就是它！你是从哪儿……
dialogText.en: Yeah! Where did you...

dialogText.cn: 不可能吧，这是环境友好、无声的型号！
dialogText.en: No way! These are eco-friendly silent models!

dialogText.cn: 呃……主板进水了，所以电机跟指示灯出现了故障……那些光跟声音还真是它们造成的……
dialogText.en: Oh, uh... It's damaged by water, so the motors and LEDs are malfunctioning. Seems like those lights and the sounds ... were caused by them ... ha ... haha...

dialogText.cn: 万幸数据还在，换一块主板就好了。我拿去修修。
dialogText.en: Data's intact at least! Just needs a new motherboard. I'll patch it up.

dialogText.cn: 不对不对，还是有不对劲的地方。
dialogText.en: Wait, no. There *is* something wrong.

dialogText.cn: 刚才我听到居民说，<@qu.key>选剑局东边的水渠</>闹得最厉害，但是我没在那边放装置……
dialogText.en: Locals say the <@qu.key>canal east of HS.Swords</> is the worst, but I never deployed any there...

dialogText.cn: 那就拜托了！
dialogText.en: I owe you one!

dialogText.cn: 对了，这种装置有扫描功能，我这儿还有两个新的，麻烦把它们装在那个水渠里，我看看水下的情况。
dialogText.en: These spare scanners might identify the anomaly. Please install them in the troubled canal. I'll monitor remotely.

dialogText.cn: 那个水渠深处堆满了课程作业！
dialogText.en: You won't believe this... The canal's packed with prototypes!

dialogText.cn: 水相氧化装置、多介质过滤器……乱七八糟的，有几个故障了，在互相打架……
dialogText.en: It's like the worst group project... Everyone's broken oxidizers and filters fighting underwater!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，真的有“脏东西”，虽然只是同学们的血泪……
dialogText.en: Hah! The "filth" was real. Just half tears, half solder burns from my peers!

dialogText.cn: 主修水渠系统方向的太多了，最近又是考试季，实验室位置不够，大家都在用这些水渠做实验……
dialogText.en: Too many aquatic engineering majors, zero lab space. Of course they turned the canals into a backyard testing ground!

dialogText.cn: ……我还以为只有我能想到这么天才的主意呢！
dialogText.en: ...And here I thought I was the innovative one.

dialogText.cn: 说起来，水渠里还有好多落水的物品，正好让大家帮忙捞一下，办个失物招领好了……
dialogText.en: Well... Since we're here, might as well fish out all the drowned items and host a lost & found.

dialogText.cn: 我去跟居民们道歉，然后说明情况……
dialogText.en: I'm gonna apologize to the locals and explain the situation...

dialogText.cn: 对了，刚才我发现这儿的控制阀跟其他水渠的不太一样，可以让水位升、降到底，用它<@qu.key>把水位复原</>吧。
dialogText.en: By the way, I just noticed the control valve is different here. It lets you move the water level up or down. We can <@qu.key>reset the water level</> too.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了，我现在就进行扫描……
dialogText.en: Thanks for helping. I'll begin the scan now.

dialogText.cn: 没什么“脏东西”“怪动静”……唔，也许就像那个天师学徒说的一样，是流言？
dialogText.en: No sign of "filth" or "movement"... Hmm, maybe they're just rumors, like that Tianshi disciple said?

dialogText.cn: 那两个装置倒是让人有点在意……
dialogText.en: Though those devices are a bit concerning...

dialogText.cn: 嗯嗯，现在下判断也有点早。咱们走吧！
dialogText.en: Yeah, it's too early to tell. Let's head out!

dialogText.cn: 没什么“脏东西”“怪动静”……唔，也许就像那个天师学徒说的一样，是流言？
dialogText.en: No sign of "filth" or "movement"... Hmm, maybe they're just rumors, like that Tianshi disciple said?

dialogText.cn: 那两个装置倒是让人有点在意……
dialogText.en: Though those devices are a bit concerning...

dialogText.cn: 嗯嗯，现在下判断也有点早。咱们走吧！
dialogText.en: Yeah, it's too early to tell. Let's head out!

dialogText.cn: 完蛋了，这下该如何是好……
dialogText.en: I'm done for... What should I do...?

dialogText.cn: 嗯？看你这身穿着……想必是终末地工业的朋友。
dialogText.en: Wait... You must be our friends from Endfield Industries.

dialogText.cn: 看见我身后那座小剑桩了么？
dialogText.en: See that small sword pell behind me?

dialogText.cn: 那是“出师三剑”中的一个测试环节。它真的很折磨人！
dialogText.en: This is part of the "Three Swords of Mastery". It literally breaks people!

dialogText.cn: 我正想办法通过“出师三剑”呢……它是选剑局传承至今的学徒出师仪式。
dialogText.en: I'm trying to pass the "Three Swords of Mastery"... It's an ancient rite of passage of the Bureau of Swordmancers.

dialogText.cn: 启动小剑桩后，它周围的压力板会按顺序亮起。
dialogText.en: Once you activate the sword pell, its pressure plates light up in a set sequence.

dialogText.cn: 以足够的力道下砸，方能激活压力板。
dialogText.en: Only a firm, decisive strike will activate the pressure plate.

dialogText.cn: 这象征着铸剑需要的“劲”！
dialogText.en: That's "Jin". Not just strength, but the pulse that breathes life into steel.

dialogText.cn: 按照压力板亮起的顺序，正确激活全部压力板后，小剑桩才会升起。
dialogText.en: Only by activating all pressure plates in the exact sequence they lit up will the sword pell finally rise.

dialogText.cn: 这象征着铸剑需要的“势”！
dialogText.en: And this is "Shi". Not just force, but the flow that shapes steel like a river shapes stone.

dialogText.cn: 然而，我的“劲”远远不足以让单个压力板亮起……更别说连续地激活压力板让它们形成“势”了。
dialogText.en: Yet my Jin isn't even strong enough to light a single plate… Let alone chain them into Shi.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈！看你这身板不比我壮实多少，也不像练家子……
dialogText.en: Hah! You? Really? You look as flimsy as me, and even less trained.

dialogText.cn: 但还是欢迎尝试一下！大炎古训，能者皆可锻吾剑。
dialogText.en: But step forth! Yan's adage whispers: "Let worthy hands shape the steel's soul."

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？没关系，这本来也不是寻常人能……
dialogText.en: How did it go? No need to beat yourself up...

dialogText.cn: 哎哎哎哎？小剑桩升起来了？
dialogText.en: Waitwaitwait... You— The pell actually rose?!

dialogText.cn: 敢问阁下尊姓大名？
dialogText.en: May I ask for your esteemed name, honored one?

dialogText.cn: 原来你就是终末地的管理员！难怪如此轻松！我之前真是太失礼了！
dialogText.en: Endministrator?! So the stories are true… Guess making the impossible look easy is part of the job description. I can't believe I was so rude to you!

dialogText.cn: 实不相瞒，我成为选剑局门下学徒后，苦心钻研数载，书本知识皆熟记于心，理论成绩名列前茅……
dialogText.en: Truth be told, after joining HS.Swords as an apprentice, I spent years buried in research. Top of my class in theory, flawless manuscript recitation…

dialogText.cn: 但最后的出师仪式测的不是理论，而是体魄……
dialogText.en: Turns out being book-smart doesn't stop you from face-planting in actual trials. Who knew?

dialogText.cn: 唉，这都什么时代了，选剑局的天师早就可以使用自动车床完成大部分生产流程了！
dialogText.en: Ugh, get with the times! HS.Swords' Tianshi have been using automated forges for years. Who even hammers swords by hand anymore?!

dialogText.cn: 祖宗之法，不破不立！嘿嘿！而你，管理员，肯定就是锡某命中的贵人！
dialogText.en: Look, fate obviously sent you to fix my life. So! Wanna transcend tradition with me?

dialogText.cn: 接下来，还需要升起两座小剑桩，要像先前一样以对应顺序激活各处的压力板。这便象征着铸剑需要的“韧”。
dialogText.en: Two more pells to go. We need to activate their pressure plates in the correct sequence, just like before. This … is the trial of "Ren", the tenacity that tempers a true blade.

dialogText.cn: 升起全部小剑桩后，举一反三，便能升起选剑局中央的巨剑桩！出师仪式就算通过了！
dialogText.en: Raise all three pells in harmony, and bam! The central pell of the Bureau ascends! That's my graduation ticket.

dialogText.cn: 我的前途就靠你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Endmin, my future's in your hands now!

dialogText.cn: 巨剑桩升起来了！我不是在做梦吧！
dialogText.en: It's rising! I'm not hallucinating am I?

dialogText.cn: 太好了太好了，不愧是管理员！以后有用得上小弟的地方，我必涌泉相报！
dialogText.en: YES! Knew you could do it, Endmin! If you ever need backup or, uh, theoretical sword knowledge — just call! ... Please call.

dialogText.cn: 这下我就能出师了！接下来只要等着……
dialogText.en: Now I can finally graduate! And now, we wait...

dialogText.cn: 锡锭子，你真以为我没长眼吗？又整这些旁门左道！
dialogText.en: TIN! INGOT!!! HS.Swords' eyes see ALL! You better pray I'm feeling merciful.

dialogText.cn: 自从你上次想偷偷修改压力板数据来通过测试后，就已经被我重点关注了！
dialogText.en: Ever since you tried tampering with the pressure plate data last time, you've been on my special watchlist!

dialogText.cn: 升起中央的巨剑桩，乃是铸剑之“意”，意味着不断克服困难，锤炼自身的决心！
dialogText.en: Raising the central pell embodies the very "Yi", the resolve to forge ahead through adversity. Tempering not just steel, but oneself!

dialogText.cn: 事不过三，再有下次，你的理论成绩也一并作废！回去重新练！
dialogText.en: Three strikes and you're out! Next time, your theoretical scores get scrapped too! Back to the training yard. NOW!

dialogText.cn: 啊？不要啊……
dialogText.en: Wha-?! No, no, nooo...!

dialogText.cn: 我真、真是受不了，你、你这人*炎国粗口*怎么这样？
dialogText.en: I-I've had enough of your nonsense! H-how can you be such a *Yanese Expletive*?

dialogText.cn: 我哪样了？这本来就不是咱们该操心的事。
dialogText.en: Come again?! This was never our business to begin with.

dialogText.cn: 看你瞎嚷嚷，引起不必要的围观了吧。
dialogText.en: Oh great, your loud mouth just invited everyone to the circus.

dialogText.cn: 我、我们之间的事不用你——
dialogText.en: This is between me and him. P-please stay out of it.

dialogText.cn: 等、等等，这副黑色的面具……
dialogText.en: W-wait, wait a minute... That dark mask of yours...

dialogText.cn: 您……您是那个那个……管理员？
dialogText.en: Are... Are you the Endministrator?

dialogText.cn: 太——太好了！我听说，终末地的集成工业系统能生产息壤了！
dialogText.en: It's s-s-so great to see you! I-I heard the AIC Factory from Endfield can now p-produce Xiranite!

dialogText.cn: 能、能不能借、借我们点？
dialogText.en: C-could you ... lend us some?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还是我来解释下吧，尚进他一紧张就容易结巴。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, allow me to explain. Shang Jin tends to stutter when he's nervous.

dialogText.cn: 我叫莫余，我们是负责给这口“<@qu.key>三到钟</>”定时输送息壤的天师。
dialogText.en: I'm Mo Yu. We're the Tianshi responsible for transporting Xiranite to the <@qu.key>Bell of Three Presences</>.

dialogText.cn: 这口炎国古钟经过宏科院的改造后，其符文组件由息壤驱动，有预警侵蚀之用。
dialogText.en: After being modified by HAS, this ancient Yanese bell now runs on Xiranite, powering its runes to detect Blight and issue early warnings.

dialogText.cn: 武陵城其他地方也有类似这样被改造过的古钟，您或许有印象。
dialogText.en: You might've seen similar ones around Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 然而，最近的情况您也知道，息壤储备告急，再加上此钟位于武陵城内围……
dialogText.en: But ... as you know, our Xiranite reserves are nearly gone. And since this bell sits in the city's inner ring...

dialogText.cn: 相较于其他古钟，它的息壤配发优先级不高，所以我们迟迟等不到息壤的补给。
dialogText.en: Its Xiranite allocation priority is lower than the others. Supply skips us most of the time, and we've been waiting ages for nothing.

dialogText.cn: 那也不能干坐着不想办法，这、这是我们作为天师的责任。
dialogText.en: Still, w-we can't just sit here and t-twiddle our thumbs! As Tianshi, we're obligated t-to do something.

dialogText.cn: 你看，我都说你先别急，这不就等来了管理员嘛。
dialogText.en: Easy, Shang Jin. See, the Endministrator's here to lend a hand.

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员，请助我们一臂之力吧！
dialogText.en: R-right! Endministrator, p-please help us.

dialogText.cn: 钟体表面共有三个<@qu.key>符文组件</>，只需为它们注入足够的息壤即可。
dialogText.en: Simple. There are three <@qu.key>runes</> carved into this bell. We just have to feed each one enough Xiranite.

dialogText.cn: 总共需要<@qu.key>一千份息壤</>。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>A thousand</>.

dialogText.cn: 那就拜、拜托您了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Th-then we're counting on you, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我统计了一下，还需要九份息壤，才、才能完全激活三到钟！
dialogText.en: Endministrator, I-I just checked, we need nine pieces of Xiranite t-to fully activate the Bell of Three Presences!

dialogText.cn: 加油啊，管理员。
dialogText.en: You've got this, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我统计了一下，还需要六份息壤，才、才能完全激活三到钟！
dialogText.en: Endministrator, I-I just checked, we need six more pieces of Xiranite t-to fully activate the Bell of Three Presences!

dialogText.cn: 加油啊，管理员。
dialogText.en: You've got this, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我统计了一下，只需三份息壤，就、就能完全激活三到钟了！
dialogText.en: Endministrator, I-I just checked, we just need three more pieces of Xiranite t-to fully activate the Bell of Three Presences!

dialogText.cn: 加油啊，管理员。就快成功了！
dialogText.en: Just a little more elbow grease, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 太好了！三到钟终于又能响了，我的心也踏实了！
dialogText.en: Finally! The Bell of Three Presences is ringing again! My stress level just dropped to zero.

dialogText.cn: 我彻底放心了，太感谢您了！
dialogText.en: Phew, I can breathe freely now. Thank you, truly!

dialogText.cn: 这下尚进他晚上能睡个好觉了，谢谢您的付出，管理员。
dialogText.en: Shang Jin can finally sleep through the night. Thank you, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 至于向您借的息壤，等补给来了我们就去打申请还给您。
dialogText.en: As for the Xiranite we borrowed, we'll file the paperwork to repay you once supply comes in.

dialogText.cn: 啊！感、感感……
dialogText.en: Ah! Th-thank you...

dialogText.cn: 感激不尽，管理员。
dialogText.en: We really appreciate all you've done, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 哦？管理员，看来工业爆炸物的生产工作很顺利嘛。
dialogText.en: Oh? Endmin! I believe things are going smoothly for our Industrial Explosives production line.

dialogText.cn: 这可是出门在外必不可少的道具，炸开碎岩，甚至攻击敌人，都得靠它。
dialogText.en: Never leave home without a few trustworthy bombs in your backpack. They're essential for clearing out rubble, weak geological structures, and even some enemies.

dialogText.cn: 不过，用的时候可要注意安全。
dialogText.en: But try to be careful when using them.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请尽快清理这个能量淤积点。
dialogText.en: Endmin, please clean up this Energy Alluvium quickly.

dialogText.cn: 如果放任淤积现象继续下去，会产生不可控的后果。
dialogText.en: Well, if we leave this alluvium unchecked, the consequences may spiral out of control.

dialogText.cn: 将干员们在周围留下的作战设备利用起来吧。
dialogText.en: Try to use the combat facilities that our operators have placed.

dialogText.cn: 它们会协助你抵御敌人。如果你还是不放心，可以自己再搭建一些。
dialogText.en: They can help you fight off enemies but you can build more to ramp up our advantage.

dialogText.cn: 注意安全，管理员。
dialogText.en: Be careful, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 同时，在清理过程中，你需要坚守阵地，直到敌人被消灭干净。
dialogText.en: And while cleaning out the alluvium, you must stand your ground until every enemy is defeated.

dialogText.cn: 成功了！
dialogText.en: Success!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，如果以后遇到类似的能量淤积点，最好及时清理。
dialogText.en: If you run into another Energy Alluvium, try to clean it up as well, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你了，管理员。
dialogText.en: We're counting on you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，附近有一处能量淤积点。好在目前它还没失控。
dialogText.en: Careful, Endmin! There's an Energy Alluvium nearby. Luckily, it can still be contained.

dialogText.cn: 为了提前应对，干员们在这里放置了一些作战设备，在必要的时候你可以启动它们。
dialogText.en: Our operators have deployed several combat facilities here as part of their preventive measures. You can activate them when required.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，好久不见。你那边的情况怎么样？
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endmin. Is everything going well for you?

dialogText.cn: 确实有件事想拜托你……其实我正在研究应急药物的改良，目前需要一些药材样本作为实验素材……
dialogText.en: Actually, yes... I'm working on improving some emergency meds and need a few herbal samples for experiments.

dialogText.cn: 只是现在工人之家有很多事需要处理，我实在抽不开身。
dialogText.en: But things are hectic at the Worker Dorms, so I can't leave right now.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！那我这就把药材的位置发给你。种类比较多，可能需要花些时间搜寻……
dialogText.en: Perfect! I'll send you the herb locations. It might take you some time to gather them all.

dialogText.cn: 总之就辛苦你了，管理员……对了，这些药材大多生长在偏僻位置，采摘时千万注意安全。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much, Endmin! Oh, most grow in remote spots, so please be careful out there.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎使用综合型补给抽选机，本设备编号23，竭诚为您服务。
dialogText.en: Welcome to the Integrated Supply Vending Machine number 23. Pleased to be of service.

dialogText.cn: 设备调试中，暂时无法抽选。
dialogText.en: Machine under maintenance. Apologies, no draws can be made right now.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎使用综合型补给抽选机，本设备编号23，竭诚为您服务。
dialogText.en: Welcome to the Integrated Supply Vending Machine number 23. Pleased to be of service.

dialogText.cn: 恭喜您获得了基础物资补给。
dialogText.en: Congratulations! You have received a basic cache of supplies.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎使用综合型补给抽选机，本设备编号24，竭诚为您服务。
dialogText.en: Welcome to the Integrated Supply Vending Machine number 24. Pleased to be of service.

dialogText.cn: 设备调试中，暂时无法抽选。
dialogText.en: Machine under maintenance. Apologies, no draws can be made right now.

dialogText.cn: 纸张上写满了数字，能在角落处看到少许文字备忘。
dialogText.en: The paper is scrawled full of numbers. You see a few words written as a memo in the corner.

dialogText.cn: “协议源石点位优化验证”——纸张角落处写着这样的话。
dialogText.en: "V&V of Protorig point optimizations" — Words written on the corner of the memo.

dialogText.cn: 展示板上写着若干“管理员迎接仪式”的方案……能看出大家的热情。
dialogText.en: A number of plans for "The Endministrator's Welcoming Ceremony" have been pinned on this bulletin board... Everyone's enthusiasm is pretty evident.

dialogText.cn: 一张枢纽区救灾工作表，看上去刚刚贴好不久，不同部门的不同工作被按照紧急程度排列得非常清楚。
dialogText.en: A disaster relief job assignment table for the Hub has been posted here. It seems pretty new. Every job of every department has been clearly scheduled according to its relative urgency.

dialogText.cn: “因通行缆车维修，货运平台暂时关闭。如需开门，请联络安保人员。”
dialogText.en: "Logistics Platform is temporarily closed for cable car maintenance. Contact security if you need the gate opened."

dialogText.cn: 纸张上写着如此内容。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on this piece of paper.

dialogText.cn: 纸上画着战术布置图示，上面简单标示了在哪里设置防线，在哪里用运输车构建防御工事。
dialogText.en: A tactical plan drawn on a piece of paper. Locations of defense lines and convoy truck barricades have been marked out with simple lines.

dialogText.cn: “设施维修中，缆车（往供能高地方向）暂时停运。”
dialogText.en: "Facility under maintenance. Cable car trips (to the Power Plateau) temporarily unavailable."

dialogText.cn: 告示牌上写着如此内容。
dialogText.en: Words written on the sign.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎使用综合型补给抽选机，本设备编号24，竭诚为您服务。
dialogText.en: Welcome to the Integrated Supply Vending Machine number 24. Pleased to be of service.

dialogText.cn: 恭喜您获得了高威力爆炸物套组。
dialogText.en: Congratulations! You have received the Powerful Explosive Suite.

dialogText.cn: 一台抽奖机，看起来无需投币就可以玩。
dialogText.en: A slot machine. This unit does not require coins.

dialogText.cn: 很可惜，并没有中奖。
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, you did not win anything.

dialogText.cn: 与运气无关，这台机器一定是“故障”了。
dialogText.en: It might have nothing to do with luck. This vending machine is probably malfunctioning.

dialogText.cn: 不知何处传出了一点焦糊味道。
dialogText.en: You smell something burning.

dialogText.cn: 邦邦邦！头奖！
dialogText.en: DUN-DUN-DUUNNNNN! You won the grand prize!

dialogText.cn: 奇怪的焦糊味变重了。
dialogText.en: The strange burning smell got stronger.

dialogText.cn: 掉出了一张书写着奇怪内容的纸。
dialogText.en: A sheet of paper with weird stuff written all over it came out.

dialogText.cn: “恭喜您，请携带此故障报修单前往工程部门支付维修费用。”
dialogText.en: "Congratulations. Please take this repair order to the EF-ED and pay the repair fees upfront."

dialogText.cn: 抽奖机冒出了滚滚浓烟。
dialogText.en: Thick smoke emanates from the slot machine.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您需要更多武器吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, need more weapons?

dialogText.cn: 损毁了一些库存，不过暂时还足够保卫科使用。
dialogText.en: Part of the stockpile was ruined, but we still got enough iron for the Security Section.

dialogText.cn: 蚀刻弹药和其他耗材的情况也类似，还好秦主管平时就很看重补充物资，未雨绸缪。
dialogText.en: Could say the same for etched ammo and other ordnance. Lucky for us, Director Qin has a thing for keeping our stores filled in advance.

dialogText.cn: 只要撑过这段时间，恢复联盟工团和这里的货运联系，很快就不会有问题了。
dialogText.en: We just need to endure this and restore our UWST freight lines. That'll solve pretty much all of our problems.

dialogText.cn: 感谢您的帮助，管理员，这些药物帮大忙了。
dialogText.en: Thank you for your help, Endministrator. These medical supplies are a lifesaver.

dialogText.cn: 不过，恐怕有些伤员还没接受四号谷地突然变成了这样，我得再给他们做些心理辅导……
dialogText.en: However, I'm afraid some of the wounded are still struggling to accept that Valley IV has ended up like this. I'll need to provide them with further counseling...

dialogText.cn: 您好，管理员。我是小道奇，负责协调终末地战斗人员的训练计划。
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endmin. I'm Lil' Dodge, the one in charge of Endfield combatant training programs.

dialogText.cn: 您的复健训练好像只完成了第一阶段？虽然情有可原，但这样下去可不好。
dialogText.en: I think you only completed phase one of your rehab training. I know you're busy with stuff, but an incomplete training is a big no-no.

dialogText.cn: 如果现在您有空的话，不如我们继续推进一下战斗训练？
dialogText.en: So, if you have the time, I think we should continue with your next combat training sessions!

dialogText.cn: 好，不愧是您，那我们这就开始！
dialogText.en: Excellent! You're truly the best Endmin ever! Let's begin!

dialogText.cn: 明白，我就在这里，想练习随时可以找我。
dialogText.en: Okay, then. Talk to me when you need that training. I'll be right here.

dialogText.cn: 哦？管理员，有什么事吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin? You need anything?

dialogText.cn: 好啊！我这就给您准备场地。
dialogText.en: Great! I'll setup your training arena.

dialogText.cn: 明白，我就在这里，想练习随时可以找我。
dialogText.en: Okay, then. Talk to me when you need that training. I'll be right here.

dialogText.cn: 通讯故障期间发生了这么严重的袭击，谷地要塞的情况不容乐观。
dialogText.en: Such a severe attack during the comms blackout ... the situation at Valley Fort is grim.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请务必做好万全准备。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, we must ensure we are fully prepared.

dialogText.cn: 原型机的总体情况比想象中好一些，不过精密仪器怠慢不得，还得做些深入检测。
dialogText.en: The prototype's overall condition is better than expected, but we should be careful with precision instruments. Further testing is still required.

dialogText.cn: 如果您有需要帮助的地方，请随时联系我！
dialogText.en: Don't hesitate to contact me if you need any assistance!

dialogText.cn: 基地附近的几队工人好像大都平安无事，真是不幸中的万幸。
dialogText.en: It seems most of the work crews near the base made it through unharmed. A true stroke of luck amid this disaster.

dialogText.cn: 先前多谢您出手相救，我们会尽快把队伍再组织起来的。
dialogText.en: Thank you for your help back there. We'll get our teams reorganized as quickly as possible.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你开始使用工业爆炸物了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, have you started using industrial explosives?

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统也可以生产便携的爆炸物。只要准备一些随时带在身上，就不需要到处找桶现场制作爆炸物啦。
dialogText.en: The AIC can produce portable explosives too. Just keep some on you, and you won't need to scavenge for barrels to craft them on the spot.

dialogText.cn: 只花了这么短的时间就搭好线路，还是在这么麻烦的情况下一口气干完的……
dialogText.en: To set up the lines this fast, especially under such difficult circumstances...

dialogText.cn: 你们这套东西，将来一定能派上大用场！
dialogText.en: This system of yours is definitely going to be a game-changer in the future!

dialogText.cn: 某种异样存在突兀地凝滞在半空。
dialogText.en: A strange anomaly suspended in mid-air.

dialogText.cn: 现在还没有关注它的余裕。
dialogText.en: No time to investigate it now, though.

dialogText.cn: 现在我们三兄弟在一起，不会再让那些混账趁人之危抓住了。
dialogText.en: Now that the three of us are together, we won't let those bastards take advantage of us again.

dialogText.cn: 请放心吧，我们一定会把这里保护周全。
dialogText.en: Please rest assured, we will keep this place completely secure.

dialogText.cn: 我刚才还在附近看到几个裂地者，看他们那样子我就气得牙痒痒。
dialogText.en: I just spotted a few Landbreakers nearby. The sight of them makes my blood boil.

dialogText.cn: 现在保护大家要紧……哼，早晚要给这帮家伙一点颜色尝尝。
dialogText.en: Right now, protecting everyone is our priority ... But mark my words, we'll make those bastards pay sooner or later.

dialogText.cn: 有集成工业系统的帮助，相信我们很快就能完成道路清理工作。
dialogText.en: With the AIC's support, I'm confident we'll have the roads cleared in no time.

dialogText.cn: 很抱歉，在这期间还有一些事务需要您来处理。不过，相信它们也会让您的准备更加充足。
dialogText.en: My apologies, there are still some matters requiring your attention during this period. However, I'm sure they will further strengthen your preparations.

dialogText.cn: 我进行过不少阶段性测试，但是看到整套系统像这样流畅运转，还是有点感动……
dialogText.en: I've conducted plenty of phase tests, but seeing the entire system operate this smoothly ... it's genuinely moving.

dialogText.cn: 请放心准备后续的任务吧。遇到任何需要集成工业系统的地方，我和波可丝随时都能帮忙。
dialogText.en: Please focus on preparing for the upcoming tasks with peace of mind. Whenever you need the AIC, Pocus and I are ready to assist at any time.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们一定会按时完成全部任务！
dialogText.en: We'll be sure to complete our missions on time, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，如果放任超域爆发现象持续下去，整个四号谷地都会陷入危险。
dialogText.en: Endministrator, if we allow the Ætherside outburst to continue unchecked, the entire Valley IV will be at risk.

dialogText.cn: 我们会尽快安排队伍跟进，辛苦您先一步确保前往供能高地的路线了。
dialogText.en: We'll mobilize a team to follow up as soon as possible. In the meantime, we appreciate you securing the route to the Power Plateau ahead of us.

dialogText.cn: 还好原型机上有供能高地超域裂隙的样本数据，否则我们现在完全无计可施……
dialogText.en: Thankfully, the prototype had sample data on the Æther rift at the Power Plateau. Otherwise, we'd be completely out of options right now...

dialogText.cn: 请务必保护好它，管理员。TA-TA是我们扭转局势的关键。
dialogText.en: You must protect it at all costs, Endmin. TA-TA is our key to turning the tide.

dialogText.cn: 希望安德烈先生提供的超域能量探测装置能管用，这样我们就可以更早更深入地过去救人了。
dialogText.en: Let's hope Mr. Andre's Æther energy detection device works as intended. It could allow us to reach and rescue people earlier and more effectively.

dialogText.cn: 头疼的是那些裂地者……该死，他们难道连自己的命都不要了吗？
dialogText.en: Those Landbreakers are a real headache... Damn it, why are they so reckless with their own lives?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，如果遇到了够不着的侵蚀核心，也可以试试往它们上面丢爆炸物。
dialogText.en: Endmin, if you encounter an out-of-reach Blight Core, try throwing explosives at them.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生之前和我提过这个办法，虽然我们没有真的用原型机试验过啦……
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre mentioned this method to me before, though we never actually tested it with the prototype...

dialogText.cn: 连天都变色了，供能高地那边难道已经……
dialogText.en: The sky has changed color. Could it be that the Power Plateau has already...

dialogText.cn: 不行，冷静，冷静……有克劳他们在，一定会有办法的。
dialogText.en: No ... stay calm, stay focused. With Crowe and the others there, they'll find a way.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎光临我的小花园。
dialogText.en: Welcome to my little garden.

dialogText.cn: 我这里有些……纯天然保健品，来看看吗？
dialogText.en: I have some ... wholly natural health products. Interested?

dialogText.cn: 我的货都在这里了。
dialogText.en: Here they are.

dialogText.cn: 好吧，再见。
dialogText.en: Farewell, then.

dialogText.cn: 越是这个时候越不能慌张，先做好手头的事。
dialogText.en: The more critical the situation, the more we must keep our composure. Let's focus on the task at hand.

dialogText.cn: 不知道万尼科夫那边还需不需要人手……
dialogText.en: I wonder if Vannikov still needs extra hands over there...

dialogText.cn: 可恶，那群家伙想把我们赶尽杀绝吗？！
dialogText.en: Damn it, are those bastards trying to wipe us out completely?!

dialogText.cn: 我早晚得想办法过去教训他们一顿！
dialogText.en: I'll find a way to teach them a lesson sooner or later!

dialogText.cn: 联盟工团已经和我们建立了联系，暂时不用担心接下来的安全问题了。
dialogText.en: The UWST has established contact with us. At least we don't have to worry about immediate safety concerns for now.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地一定会恢复成原来的样子。这都要感谢您的努力，管理员。
dialogText.en: Valley IV will definitely be restored to what it once was. This is all thanks to your efforts, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统经受住了考验，原型机……唉，至少说明我们的理论方向是正确的。
dialogText.en: The AIC has proven itself. The prototype ... well, at least it confirms our theoretical approach was sound.

dialogText.cn: 这里的遭遇都会变成宝贵的经验。我们会好好吸收它们，改进自己，直到完成最后的目标。
dialogText.en: Every challenge will become a valuable lesson. We'll absorb them, improve ourselves, and keep pushing until we achieve our ultimate goal.

dialogText.cn: 因为供能高地上的那场大“爆炸”，重建工作估计还要进行很久。
dialogText.en: Rebuilding will likely take considerable time due to that massive "explosion" at the Power Plateau.

dialogText.cn: 不管要花多久，我们都会把它恢复成原状。四号谷地是我们的家，每一寸地方都是。
dialogText.en: No matter how long it takes, we will restore it to its original state. Valley IV is our home, every last inch of it.

dialogText.cn: 难得这样打上一场，总算让我把心里那股恶气好好出干净了。
dialogText.en: It's been a while since we had a real fight. I can finally blow off some steam.

dialogText.cn: 不说那些了。干活干活，要做的事还多着呢。
dialogText.en: Enough talk. Time to get back to work, there's still plenty to be done.

dialogText.cn: 总算熬过最困难的阶段了，也许我该去其他几个地方看看还有没有伤员。
dialogText.en: We've finally made it through the toughest part. Maybe I should check other areas for any remaining wounded.

dialogText.cn: 锚点袭击发生时，我预想过最坏的情况……感谢您没有让它变成现实。
dialogText.en: When the Ankhor attack happened, I braced for the worst ... Thank you for preventing that nightmare from becoming reality.

dialogText.cn: 嗨，要来兑换奖品吗？
dialogText.en: Hi! Interested in exchanging for some rewards?

dialogText.cn: 我们决定拿出游戏奖品库里的装备材料，提供给有需要的人。
dialogText.en: We decided to hand out gear assembly materials from the prize pool to people who need them more.

dialogText.cn: 希望能帮上你的忙。
dialogText.en: Hope this helps.

dialogText.cn: 嗯哼，慢走。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Have a nice day.

dialogText.cn: 疼……疼死了……该不会骨头都……
dialogText.en: It's hurting ... I think I got a fracture...

dialogText.cn: 一点不疼！完全没事！我绝对不会变成累赘的！
dialogText.en: What injury? I'm totally alright! I'm no deadweight, you know!

dialogText.cn: 明明马上就要执行计划了，基地突然变成这样，可千万别误了事啊……
dialogText.en: We're about to start our super project, but they turned our Base into this mess! I really hope the project won't get delayed...

dialogText.cn: 我没事，你快去帮秦主管的忙……
dialogText.en: I'm alright. Director Qin really needs your help...

dialogText.cn: 不行，我不能就这么放着你不管。
dialogText.en: No, I can't just leave you like this.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您来了！我没事，只是莎曼……
dialogText.en: Endministrator! You're here! I'm alright, but Salman...

dialogText.cn: 我也没事，呃，柯雷蒂安，向管理员，同步现状……
dialogText.en: I'm alright. Hngh. Chretien, give our Endmin the sitrep...

dialogText.cn: 锚点坠落的时候，我们所在的位置遭到了直接冲击。还好防卫科很快就有了反应……
dialogText.en: The Ankhorfall scored a direct hit on our position. Thank goodness our Security Division responded at once...

dialogText.cn: 工厂区不少地方都被破坏了。大家都在想办法找齐同伴，还得停止机器，阻绝次生灾害。
dialogText.en: Plenty of places in the factory area got wrecked. Everyone's looking for friends and colleagues. The crew is also trying to shut down the machines to avoid secondary disasters.

dialogText.cn: 是吗？太好了，我等莎曼再恢复一些就带她一起过去。
dialogText.en: Really? Great. Once Salman gets better, I'll take her along.

dialogText.cn: 秦主管那边好像暂时支撑住了，但天使实在是太多，又有这么多伤员，没法冒险会合。
dialogText.en: Director Qin managed to create a safety perimeter but there are just too many Aggeloi. We can't risk joining her with so many wounded people.

dialogText.cn: 要我说，不如继续固守这里，反正灰医生也在……
dialogText.en: I think we should stand our ground at this spot. At least we have a Dusthair surgeon with us...

dialogText.cn: 说起来，为什么要叫米格尔医生“灰医生”，他和“灰”也没关系啊。
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, why are we calling Miguel a Dusthair? His hair isn't really dusty.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的医生总是在第一线，天天和我们一起灰头土脸地忙活，这才有了这个尊称……
dialogText.en: Endfield surgeons often work at the frontlines with us. They often end up covered in dust and dirt like everyone. Dusthair became a respectable nickname for them...

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，一切还顺利吗？
dialogText.en: How is it? Is everything working out fine?

dialogText.cn: 协议共振塔启动之后，我们正在全力恢复枢纽区基地的基础功能运作。
dialogText.en: After the activation of the Protocol Resonance Tower, the entire Base is now fully committed to restoring the basic functions and operations of the Hub Base.

dialogText.cn: 伤员已经被妥善安置。还有许多受损区域暂时无法恢复，但眼下我们得集中资源应对要务。
dialogText.en: Our wounded are now getting proper treatment, but many damaged areas have yet to fully recover. We must concentrate our resources to meet our top priorities.

dialogText.cn: 工程团队正在修复通讯节点，进展不太顺利……我会密切关注这方面的进展。
dialogText.en: The engineering team is trying to repair the comms node but progress isn't looking too good... I'll be keeping a close eye on this.

dialogText.cn: 枢纽区基地是集成工业系统的重要研发基地。
dialogText.en: The Hub Base is an important R&D facility for the Automated Industry Complex.

dialogText.cn: 我们在这里推进了许多集成工业系统的落地项目，同类研究单位在塔卫二还有很多，但这里是其中的佼佼者。
dialogText.en: This is where we carried out multiple field tests for the AIC Factory. Though there are other sites on Talos-II carrying out the same project, the Hub has achieved quite a stellar performance.

dialogText.cn: 因此，总部才会计划将协议核心的部署测试放在这里。没想到会在最后的环节出现变故……
dialogText.en: This is why HQ planned to conduct the Protocol Automation-Core deployment test run at the Hub. Ugh... Nobody expected this major incursion at the last minute...

dialogText.cn: 我们会想办法解决基地里剩余的问题，援助工作就辛苦你们了，管理员！
dialogText.en: I'll try to settle the other problems at the Base. We're counting on you to carry out the SAR operations, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 协议核心运作正常，令人欣慰啊，管理员！
dialogText.en: The Automation-Core is working as intended! I can finally breathe easy, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统是您亲自整合的一套技术框架。真没想到有一天会是我来和您介绍它……
dialogText.en: But you're the one who integrated the technological framework of the Automated Industry Complex... Oh, I never expected to give you an introduction to the AIC...

dialogText.cn: 这套系统的首要目标，就是在各种复杂环境下，以最快速度建立完整的自动化生产线。
