dialogText.en: The primary goal of this system is to establish complete automated production lines at maximum speed, even in the most complex environments.

dialogText.cn: 不论是在沙漠、冻原，还是湿地，我们都能准备成套的电力系统、基础设施和工业设备，甚至还有农场……
dialogText.en: Whether it's desert, tundra, or wetlands, we can supply complete power systems, infrastructure, industrial equipment, and even farms...

dialogText.cn: 只要这套系统全部完成，塔卫二上就不再有所谓的“开拓区”了！每一片土地都将成为我们的家园！
dialogText.en: Once this system is fully operational, there will be no more "frontier" on Talos-II! Every inch of land will become our home!

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，当然这些还只是愿景……不过，这些愿景总有一天会变为现实的！
dialogText.en: Ahem. Of course, this is just a dream... But there will be a day when that dream becomes reality!

dialogText.cn: 真对不住，还得辛苦您亲自跑一趟……
dialogText.en: My apologies for making you come all this way...

dialogText.cn: 我会搞定这里的调试工作，原型机的零件和资料就拜托您了！
dialogText.en: I'll handle the debugging here. The prototype parts and data are in your hands!

dialogText.cn: 来吧，管理员，试试看！这些桶里的材料足够制作炸药了！
dialogText.en: Hey, Endmin! Try this out! We got enough stuff in the barrels to make explosives!

dialogText.cn: 粗糙的扩音装置，稍稍旋转开关就能听到极大的噪音。
dialogText.en: A crude loudspeaker. Slight nudges to the control knob are enough to get it blasting away.

dialogText.cn: “头领、赐福、力量”……这段话语在扩音器中咆哮，可见裂地者们的狂热。
dialogText.en: "BAWS! BLESSINGS! POWAAAHHH...!" The loud roaring is played on loop. Additional proof of the Landbreakers' zealotry.

dialogText.cn: 两个箱子间的草地上有踩踏的痕迹，像是有人在这里待了很久。
dialogText.en: You see footprints in the grass between the two crates. Someone was waiting here for a while.

dialogText.cn: 仔细看的话，能在草丛中看到被清理过的血迹，似乎曾有某位伤者躲藏于此。
dialogText.en: A closer inspection reveals bloodstains in the grass. Attempts were made to remove them. It seems an injured person was hiding here.

dialogText.cn: “货物目前的存放地在谷地中转站。”
dialogText.en: "Goods currently placed at the Valley Transfer."

dialogText.cn: “极北探索用物资需谨慎看守。即日起，在旧有两岗轮换执勤的基础上，额外增加一岗。”
dialogText.en: "Starting today, add one more shift to the two we have guarding the polar expedition supplies. They must be properly protected."

dialogText.cn: 带有“支援物资”印章的单据上写着如此内容。
dialogText.en: Scribbles on a bill furnished with a stamp that reads "Relief Supplies".

dialogText.cn: 碾骨氏族的涂鸦。这些裂地者似乎热衷于在所有袭击地点留下自己的符号。
dialogText.en: Graffiti of the Bonekrushers. These Landbreakers seem rather eager to leave their glyphs and marks all over the place.

dialogText.cn: 入侵者们在这里制作面具。独特的管子是他们与其他裂地者相区别的标志。
dialogText.en: The intruders made their iconic masks at this place. The pipes are a feature that distinguishes them from other LB clans.

dialogText.cn: 一个裂地者用来居住的集装箱，排气扇不停地把雾火吹进箱内。
dialogText.en: Container housing used by the Landbreakers. The ventilation fans constantly feed the interior with a steady stream of hazefyre.

dialogText.cn: 即便是“完整”的武器，落到裂地者手中也会被拆解、打乱、重新组装。
dialogText.en: "Intact" weapons would be forcibly taken apart and re-assembled by the Landbreakers to create other weapons.

dialogText.cn: 只要能开火就行——如果开不了火，那就用来当棍子。
dialogText.en: The LBs only need weapons that work. If their cobbled gun could not be fired, they would just swing it as a club.

dialogText.cn: 铁门上布满了深浅不一的凹痕，但“联盟工团制造”的铭文依旧熠熠生辉。
dialogText.en: The metal gate is covered with all sorts of dents and cuts, but it still sports a shiny label that reads: Made by the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 罗曼先生带来了最急需的物资，伤员们的情况都稳定下来了。
dialogText.en: Mr. Roman delivered some urgently needed supplies. Many of the injured are getting better.

dialogText.cn: 他还在帮忙安排后续的支援计划，等附近稍微再安全一些，就会想办法再来几趟。
dialogText.en: He's helping to arrange follow-up support plans. Once things get a little safer around here, he'll try to visit more often.

dialogText.cn: 加上各位提供的援助，我们一定能克服眼下的困难。
dialogText.en: With the help you've all given, we're sure we can pull through these hard times.

dialogText.cn: 斯托布到这里之后，带着阿杜把不少东西都翻新了一遍。
dialogText.en: Yeah. After Staub arrived, he and Dewey managed to fix quite a few things.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生带来的那些机器人也在帮忙调度物资，虽然这里到枢纽区基地有些距离，偶尔也会出些意外……
dialogText.en: The robots Mr. Andre brought are pitching in too, moving supplies here and there. But the Hub Base is pretty far and accidents do happen from time to time...

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么说，生活终于走上正轨了。
dialogText.en: In any case, life is finally back on track.

dialogText.cn: 联盟工团已经和我们沟通过了，等四号谷地的麻烦一结束，他们就会帮忙安顿所有人。
dialogText.en: The UWST talked to us. Once Valley IV gets back to peace, they'll help get everyone settled.

dialogText.cn: 有的人应该会被送回故乡去，但也有人想试试在这里安家，参与四号谷地的重建工作。
dialogText.en: Several would be going back to their hometowns, but some of us want to stay and help get Valley IV back on its feet.

dialogText.cn: 大家都跟卡贾约好了，只要打听到他们兄妹俩父母的消息，一定会马上发信给四号谷地，让阿吉知道。
dialogText.en: Everyone has promised Karja that the moment there's any news about his parents, word will immediately be sent to Valley IV so Ginny can be told.

dialogText.cn: 我们一定会尽力帮忙的。即使只有这一段时间，我们也算一家人啊。
dialogText.en: We'll do all we can to help. However brief this time may be, we are still a family.

dialogText.cn: 啊，管理员，欢迎回来。
dialogText.en: Welcome back, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我们正在一起建新家呢！那边帐子的篷布，还有窗户的棚板，都是我们找来的。
dialogText.en: We're putting up our new place together! We found the tent canvas over there and the pallet boards for that window.

dialogText.cn: 不过现在只能遮风挡雨，还不好意思招待你们，过两天记得再来坐坐！
dialogText.en: But it's just good enough to keep out the rain. I wish I could've built something nicer for guests, you know. Do come back in a couple of days!

dialogText.cn: 有你们给的药，阿吉的病情已经稳定下来了。
dialogText.en: Thanks to the medicine you brought, Ginny's doing better now.

dialogText.cn: 我每天都会在附近转转，按照罗曼先生教的知识找能用的东西。
dialogText.en: I go around the area every day, trying to find whatever I can with the know-how Mr. Roman showed me.

dialogText.cn: 伤员们需要许多药物和有营养的食物。附近还有不少裂地者，大家没法走得太远。
dialogText.en: The wounded still need medicine and food with some real nutrition. But since there are so many Landbreakers around, it's not safe to go too far.

dialogText.cn: 请放心，现在我们能应付得过来！
dialogText.en: Don't worry, we can manage for now!

dialogText.cn: 是啊，东西越来越齐全了。有几位伤员已经快痊愈了，现在也加入了我们的工作。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Place is feeling like a proper village already. A few of the injured are back on their feet and sharing the work.

dialogText.cn: 阿杜先生和斯托布先生每天都在修复大大小小的东西，大家给他俩安排了一间工作室。
dialogText.en: Mr. Dewey and Mr. Staub spend their days fixing up all sorts of stuff. We even set up a workshop just for them.

dialogText.cn: 没准等外面安全一些了，我们也能给工团帮上一点忙。
dialogText.en: Once things settle down outside, we can probably lend the UWST a hand too.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，爸爸妈妈不知道我和阿吉在四号谷地，我得多去几个地方，给他们留下消息。
dialogText.en: Yeah. My parents don't know Ginny and I are here. I need to stop by a few more places and leave messages for them.

dialogText.cn: 说实话，当初准备礼物那会儿，我其实心里很没底……
dialogText.en: Honestly, when I was putting that gift together, I wasn't feeling very sure of myself...

dialogText.cn: 不过，现在有大家帮忙，我已经有信心多了！
dialogText.en: But now that I have everyone's help, I'm feeling way more confident!

dialogText.cn: 他们人又多，又凶残，你们千万要小心。
dialogText.en: These monstrous scab eaters brought all their blighted cousins with 'em. Careful!

dialogText.cn: {F}大姐姐，你们又来看我了，好开心！{M}大哥哥，你们又来看我了，好开心！
dialogText.en: {F}You're here to see me again, Miss Endmin! I'm so happy!{M}You're here to see me again, Mister Endmin! I'm so happy!

dialogText.cn: 这段时间里，我一直很听话哦！
dialogText.en: I've been a good girl, you know!

dialogText.cn: 已经不疼了，就是没力气……想给哥哥和大家帮忙，但胳膊和腿好沉……
dialogText.en: The pain is gone, but I still feel kinda tired... I wanna help everyone, but my arms and legs feel so heavy...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我明白了。
dialogText.en: Okay. I'll keep that in mind.

dialogText.cn: 我又可以画画了！
dialogText.en: I can draw again, you know!

dialogText.cn: 这两天哥哥帮我采了一些花草和矿石，能用来做新颜料，又可以画五颜六色的风景了！
dialogText.en: Karja found all sorts of herbs and stones for making new paint. I can draw all sorts of colorful places again!

dialogText.cn: 是呀！受伤的哥哥姐姐们都好起来啦！
dialogText.en: Yeah! The injured grown-ups have gotten better already!

dialogText.cn: 我现在画得还不够好，等我画得再好一些，就给大家一人画一张！
dialogText.en: My drawings aren't very good right now. Once I get better at it, I'll make a drawing for everyone!

dialogText.cn: 索斯先生想让他们多休息，但他们还是想帮忙。他们都很喜欢来看我的画。
dialogText.en: Mister Soth wants them to rest more, but they still insist on helping. They love my drawings, you know!

dialogText.cn: 是啊，哥哥说我还太小，待在这里比较安全。
dialogText.en: Yeah... Karja said I'm too young to travel. It's safer for me to stay here.

dialogText.cn: 可是，我也很担心哥哥……
dialogText.en: But still ... I worry about him...

dialogText.cn: 索斯先生和丹尼尔叔叔都这么说了，还有好多好多人！
dialogText.en: Mister Soth and Uncle Daniel said the same thing. And so did a lot of other people!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，我最喜欢大家啦！
dialogText.en: Thank you, everyone! You are the best!

dialogText.cn: 我是工团应急指挥员玛丽娜·拉斯科娃，谢谢你们帮忙驱逐这里的裂地者。
dialogText.en: I'm UWST Emergency Commander Marinna Laskova. I'd like to extend my gratitude to you for helping drive out the local breaker scabs.

dialogText.cn: 首先需要修复被损坏的大门，检查建筑结构的完整性。
dialogText.en: First, we will repair the damaged gate and make sure the building is structurally sound.

dialogText.cn: 然后要处理裂地者留下的巢雕和其他痕迹，这些家伙到处随意改造，到处都是安全隐患。
dialogText.en: Then, we will clean out the denstacks and other LB trash. These guys mess with everything and leave hazardous stuff everywhere.

dialogText.cn: 乐观估计，在下一个生产计划开始之前，应该能恢复最低限度的运转。
dialogText.en: If things go well, we should be able to reach low intensity productivity before the next production plan begins.

dialogText.cn: 也祝你们接下来一切顺利。
dialogText.en: Hope the same for you too, Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，运输平台处于损坏状态，暂时不能使用。
dialogText.en: Sorry. The logistics platform is broken and can't be used right now.

dialogText.cn: 我们会尽全力抢修，尽快恢复这里的物流运输。
dialogText.en: We're working on emergency repairs to restore local logistics.

dialogText.cn: 是吗……唉，我会转告大家的。
dialogText.en: Is that so... *Sigh* I'll let the others know.

dialogText.cn: 这里所有人都欠他一条命。不，不只是他，还有和他一样帮过我们的工团朋友。
dialogText.en: Everyone here owes him their lives. Actually, it's not just him ... Every UWST crew mate who helped also deserves our gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 我会永远记住这些人。如果有机会为他们做些什么，请务必告诉我。
dialogText.en: I'll never forget them. If there's ever a way we could help, please tell me.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？你找到马克叔叔了吗？他怎么样啦？
dialogText.en: Hmm? Did you find Uncle Mark? How is he?

dialogText.cn: 嗯？我知道了，马克叔叔回去忙工作了！
dialogText.en: Hmm? Oh, I get it! Uncle Mark's busy with work!

dialogText.cn: {F}大姐姐，你能帮我再和马克叔叔说声谢谢吗？哥哥说过，有人帮忙一定要说谢谢。{M}大哥哥，你能帮我再和马克叔叔说声谢谢吗？哥哥说过，有人帮忙一定要说谢谢。
dialogText.en: {F}Miss Endmin, could you tell Uncle Mark I said thank you? Karja says I gotta say that to everyone who helped us. {M}Mister Endmin, could you tell Uncle Mark I said thank you? Karja says I gotta say that to everyone who helped us.

dialogText.cn: 阿吉……你一定要好起来啊。
dialogText.en: Be strong, Ginny... You'll definitely get better.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们救了阿吉，还帮忙赶跑了裂地者。
dialogText.en: Thank you for saving Ginny and thrashing the breaker scum.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，接下来我会安心待着，好好照顾阿吉的。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I'll behave. I'll stick around Ginny and take better care of her.

dialogText.cn: {F}大姐姐，我已经好多了！{M}大哥哥，我已经好多了！
dialogText.en: {F}I'm getting much better, Miss Endmin! {M}I'm getting much better, Mister Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 知道了。我要当好孩子，赶紧好起来……
dialogText.en: Okey dokey. I'll be good and get better soon...

dialogText.cn: 从洞里出来之后，有的人现在还很虚弱。
dialogText.en: They are out of the cave, but some haven't fully recovered their strength.

dialogText.cn: 我们尽量给他们分配了更好的位置，他们需要休养。
dialogText.en: We've tried to place them somewhere comfortable so they can rest and recover.

dialogText.cn: 阿吉现在经常和米娅一起玩，希望这样能让她早点忘记那些不好的经历……
dialogText.en: Ginny spends a lot of time with Mia these days. That'll hopefully help her recover from her trauma...

dialogText.cn: 现在我们有了基础的物资补给，已经比在洞里藏着好太多了。
dialogText.en: We now have basic supplies. I'd call that a huge improvement compared to the cave hideout.

dialogText.cn: 虽然条件还很不宽裕，但我们自己也会想办法解决一些问题。
dialogText.en: Conditions are not perfect, but we'll do our best and try to fix a few of our problems.

dialogText.cn: 希望工团那边也能尽早恢复啊……
dialogText.en: I hope things get better for the UWST as well...

dialogText.cn: 冷清的摊位前贴了一张像是告示的纸，上面写着：
dialogText.en: A notice is posted on this deserted stall. It reads:

dialogText.cn: 因设备故障，烤肉摊暂停营业。
dialogText.en: BBQ Stall is closed due to broken machinery.

dialogText.cn: 恢复时间待定。感谢各位工友一直以来的支持。
dialogText.en: Roasting will resume once we're ready. Thank you for your patronage, crew.

dialogText.cn: ——安娜
dialogText.en: — Anna

dialogText.cn: 你们……难道是安娜请过来的修理专家？
dialogText.en: Are you the repair experts that Anna hired?

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样。
dialogText.en: Really?

dialogText.cn: 唉，那边本来有家烤肉摊，味道特别好！
dialogText.en: That place used to be a BBQ stall. They make the best roasts ever!

dialogText.cn: 只可惜休息站的源石炉受灾害的影响突然陷入了故障，没法重新启动……这家依靠源石炉生火的烤肉摊也只好歇业了……
dialogText.en: But the disaster took out the Originium stove in the Staff Lounge. The thing just refuses to start again... And that means no more Origo-grilled kebabs and steaks...

dialogText.cn: 也不知道什么时候才能恢复营业。
dialogText.en: I don't know how long we have to wait for some decent roasts again.

dialogText.cn: 源石炉居然重启了？！是你们把它修好的吗？
dialogText.en: The Originium stove is working again?! Did you fix it?

dialogText.cn: 太好了！这下我的烤肉摊总算又能开业了……真不知道该怎么谢谢你们！
dialogText.en: You're a true lifesaver! I can start grilling and roasting for the crew again... I can't thank you enough!

actorName.cn: 惊喜的工团成员{惊喜的工团成员A}
actorName.en: Surprised UWST Crew Mate {Surprised UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 烤肉摊？开业？我没听错吧？安娜大姐！
dialogText.en: Grilling and roasting? Anna, are you starting the BBQ stall again?

actorName.cn: 惊喜的工团成员{惊喜的工团成员B}
actorName.en: Surprised UWST Crew Mate {Surprised UWST Crew Mate B}

dialogText.cn: 是真的对吧？安娜大姐！我可太想念你家的烤长耳兽了！！
dialogText.en: You are, right? We're dying to get more of your long-ear kebabs!

dialogText.cn: 别急！大家别急！是真的！我这就去做开业准备！争取让大家今晚就吃上！
dialogText.en: Yes, I am! But don't rush things! I gotta start marinating and making the skewers for the roast. Tell the crew they're in for a treat tonight!

actorName.cn: 惊喜的工团成员{惊喜的工团成员C}
actorName.en: Surprised UWST Crew Mate {Surprised UWST Crew Mate C}

dialogText.cn: 好耶！！
dialogText.en: ALRIGHTY!!

actorName.cn: 惊喜的工团成员{惊喜的工团成员A}
actorName.en: Surprised UWST Crew Mate {Surprised UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 别和我抢啊！我是第一个！后面来的都得排队！
dialogText.en: I got dibs on the first place in the queue! Everyone's gotta line up behind me!

dialogText.cn: 那边是我们的工人休息站，往常可热闹了，大家有空了都会去那儿转转，吃个烤肉烤饼什么的……
dialogText.en: That's our Staff Lounge over there. It used to be really crowded thanks to the kebab and bread stall...

dialogText.cn: 只是现在休息站那里的设备似乎出了故障，不知道什么时候才能恢复……唉……
dialogText.en: But the facilities at the Lounge are down. I don't know when they'll get to fixing it... Ugh...

dialogText.cn: 真好啊……安娜大姐的烤肉摊终于重新开张了！
dialogText.en: Anna's BBQ stall is back in business... This is the best news I had for a while!

dialogText.cn: 等我忙完手里的活就去！先来十串烤长耳兽再说！
dialogText.en: I'll head over once I finish my job! I'm gonna order at least ten long-ear kebabs!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，终末地的朋友！你们是来修理备用电梯的吧？它就在那边。
dialogText.en: Thank you, my Endfielder friends! Are you here to repair the backup elevator? It's over there.

dialogText.cn: 我还有一些研究资料需要带走，希望能在电梯修好前整理完……
dialogText.en: I have more research data to bring along. I hope I can get them packed and ready to go before the elevator is fixed...

dialogText.cn: 唉，大门的供电装置居然失灵了……
dialogText.en: Ugh. The device powering the gate is down...

dialogText.cn: 要是我们还有备用的电机就好了……通不了电，再怎么拉开关也没用啊……
dialogText.en: If only we had a backup generator... The switch is no use if we got no juice...

dialogText.cn: 大门的电量居然已经满了？！你、你们是怎么做到的？
dialogText.en: The gate is fully powered?! HOW?! How did you do it?

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样……太好了，这下大家总算能回休息站了！
dialogText.en: Really...? Well, this is terrific news! We can finally use our lounge again!

dialogText.cn: 我这就去开门，顺便把其他工友叫回来！
dialogText.en: I'll open the gate and holler the others.

dialogText.cn: 再次感谢你们的帮忙，终末地的朋友！
dialogText.en: Thank you again, my Endfielder friends!

dialogText.cn: 标识牌上的文字大多已经模糊不清。
dialogText.en: The words on this sign are barely legible.

dialogText.cn: “团结”“前进”“奠基”……勉强有这些字迹还能分辨。
dialogText.en: You can only make out these words: "UNITED" "FORWARD" and "SET THE PILES".

dialogText.cn: 未息屏的终端循环播放着一段视频：两鬓雪白的老人以此地为起点，徒手在岩壁上飞速攀爬……
dialogText.en: The terminal is still active and keeps playing a video on loop: A gray-haired old man rapidly scaling a cliff with bare hands from this very place...

dialogText.cn: “还是慢了呀……”以令人瞠目结舌的速度完成攀爬并返程的老人，在关闭录制功能前留下了这样的话。
dialogText.en: "I got slow..." The old man said after reaching the top and climbing back down with astonishing speed. He then switched off the camcorder.

dialogText.cn: 这本陈旧书籍的封皮上有一行亮眼的烫金字——“血与天赋——源石技艺锤锻肌肉大典”。
dialogText.en: An old book. The cover is furnished with a hot stamped title that reads: Blood and Talent - Ultimate Tome of Bodybuilding with Originium Arts.

dialogText.cn: 记录了阿伯莉采石场近五年石材质量检测的文件。
dialogText.en: A file that records Aburrey Quarry mineral sample quality over the last five years.

dialogText.cn: 从图形表格判断，整体呈逐年下降趋势。
dialogText.en: The graphs and tables show that overall quality has been dropping every year.

dialogText.cn: 你好，我叫伦纳德，在这里经营一个杂货店。
dialogText.en: Greetings. I'm Lonnard, a proprietor of a small grocery store at this place.

dialogText.cn: 虽说是小物件，但在对的人手上可能有大用哦！
dialogText.en: This may be small, but it can prove extremely useful in the right hands.

dialogText.cn: 怎么？要看看吗？
dialogText.en: Wanna take a look?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，有眼光！
dialogText.en: Heheh. I know you got an eye for quality!

dialogText.cn: 行吧。
dialogText.en: Sure.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还有什么想问的吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin! Got a question for me?

dialogText.cn: 事实上，这里其实是我们工团在四号谷地设立的第一座采石场。
dialogText.en: This is actually the very first quarry that the UWST built in Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 我记得在收尾的阶段，幸亏一个工友挺身而出，独自爬上山顶，引爆炸药将山体炸塌才阻挡住了那些天使……
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi attacked when this Quarry was near completion. A crew mate bravely ascended the peak of the hills and detonated powerful charges to trigger a landslide that finally stopped the Aggeloi...

dialogText.cn: 采石场建成后，大家为了纪念那位牺牲的工友，便用了她的名字来命名——称这里是“阿伯莉采石场”。
dialogText.en: When the Quarry was formally completed, everyone decided to name it after her to commemorate her bravery. That was how the Aburrey Quarry earned its name.

dialogText.cn: 那里过去是采石场最早的办公区域，后来因为扩建才改为了联络区，所以存放了很多过去的资料与文件。
dialogText.en: The place used to be the first office for directing mining activities at the Quarry. It was later expanded into a formal Listening Post and we stored plenty of files and documents over there.

dialogText.cn: 唉，已经连通的区域情况都还好，但还没连通的区域就……只希望工友们都平安无事吧……
dialogText.en: *Sigh*. Things are looking alright for the areas we can access. As for the others ... well, I just hope the stranded crew mates are still holding up...

dialogText.cn: 当时工团掌握的技术远远比不上现在……所以那时候参与建造的工友们都吃了不少苦头……
dialogText.en: Technology wasn't as advanced back then, and the crew mates who constructed this site went through some really rough days...

dialogText.cn: 要是没有她的牺牲，都不知道会有多少人受害……
dialogText.en: Many lives would be lost without her heroic sacrifice...

dialogText.cn: 起重机的修复工作总算能继续了……接下来就得麻烦你了，管理员。
dialogText.en: Repairs for the super crane can finally proceed. We're counting on you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这下起重机总算能正常运转了！管理员，这都多亏了你。
dialogText.en: The super crane is working! You're amazing, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 希望后续的救援工作也能这么顺利……
dialogText.en: I hope our SAR operations are just as successful...

dialogText.cn: 除了之前的联络区，目前去往入口、存料处、工人休息站和采石作业区的道路都已经连通了。
dialogText.en: We can now access the Entrance, Stockpile Area, Staff Lounge, and Quarry Site in addition to the Listening Post.

dialogText.cn: 尤其是刚刚连通的采石作业区——虽然救援队已经赶过去了，但可能还会有滞留的工友需要帮助……
dialogText.en: We just paved a way to reach the Quarry Site. Although an SAR crew has been deployed, there might be other stranded crew mates who need help...

dialogText.cn: 还是和之前想的一样，我们希望尽快连通各个区域，尤其是深层管理区。争取早点找到失联的工友们。
dialogText.en: Like before, we just need to reestablish comms with every area, especially the Deep Management Post. We gotta find our lost crew mates quickly.

dialogText.cn: 你们如果有需要，都可以去看看。
dialogText.en: You can head over to those areas if you're interested.

dialogText.cn: 那么，管理员，深层管理区的救援工作就交给你们了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I guess I'll need your help to support our SAR operations at the Deep Management Post.

dialogText.cn: 等等，我先把这个事和他们讲清楚……欸，原来是管理员啊，怎么了？
dialogText.en: Wait. I gotta clarify this entire thing with them... Oh, hi Endmin. How can I help you?

dialogText.cn: 你们要离开了吗？要是不急着走，可以在我们这儿多转转，毕竟大家都很想和你们说声谢谢呢！
dialogText.en: You're leaving already? Well, feel free to explore the Quarry if you're not in a hurry. Everyone really wants to thank you personally!

dialogText.cn: 要不是因为撤离的准备工作还有一大堆，我都想带着你们再在采石场逛一圈了。
dialogText.en: If only someone else could take care of the closure work... I really want to take your team on a tour of this Quarry.

dialogText.cn: 唉，不知道这里以后会变成什么样子……一想到这儿，总是有些不舍得。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*. I don't know what's going to happen to the Quarry... I think I'm gonna miss the place.

dialogText.cn: 一个落满灰尘的铁盒。
dialogText.en: A metal box covered with dust.

dialogText.cn: 似乎已经生锈，部分位置有明显的刮擦痕迹，打开后可以看到一堆写有佩妮名字的荣誉奖章。
dialogText.en: The box is rusted and has scratch marks at a few places. Opening it reveals a pile of commendation medals with Penny's name on them.

dialogText.cn: 一些屏幕上并没有画面，但能看到明显的抓痕……是那些天使造成的吗？
dialogText.en: Some of the monitors have gone dark and show deep gashes across the screens... Did the Aggeloi make those?

dialogText.cn: 大量被拆封的物资箱散落在此处，但只有最上层的东西被拿走了，取用者当时大概正处于极为慌忙的情境中。
dialogText.en: Many opened supply crates have been scattered about. Only a few things were taken from them. Those who opened these crates were probably in a great hurry.

dialogText.cn: 有些陈旧的开关装置。似乎设有特殊的验证机制，或许只能用工团特制的钥匙卡才能开启……
dialogText.en: A few old switches that might have a unique verification system. A special UWST key card might be needed to activate them...

dialogText.cn: 你好啊，又见面了！要看看我的货吗？
dialogText.en: Good to see you again! Interested in looking at my wares?

dialogText.cn: 来看看，都是实用的东西。
dialogText.en: Take a look. I got pretty useful things here.

dialogText.cn: 这种时候的生意可真的不好做。
dialogText.en: Business can get really tough in such trying times.

dialogText.cn: 我手上虽然不缺货，但很缺能来交易的客人……不再多看看吗？
dialogText.en: I'm very well stocked, just not very well patronized... Please, take your time and see what you need.

dialogText.cn: 小店什么都有，也什么都收。
dialogText.en: My store sells plenty of things, and I'm willing to buy things off your hands.

dialogText.cn: 你们就是终末地的朋友吧，我听头儿说了。唉，这时候有人来搭把手真可以说是雪中送炭了……
dialogText.en: Hey! You must be the Endfielders the boss told me about! Phew. Thank goodness you're helping us out in this blighted crisis...

dialogText.cn: 我们几个这段时间简直忙都忙不过来……要解决的问题实在太多了！
dialogText.en: There are just so many things to do ... and way too many problems to fix!

dialogText.cn: 我知道了，我等下就把你们那里的情况同步给负责人。
dialogText.en: Got it. I'll just report your sitch to the monitor.

dialogText.cn: 对，搜救任务继续……深层管理区那边还没消息吗？不，继续保持发讯状态，直到救援队伍到达。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Continue with the SAR operations... Are we getting anything from the Deep Management Post? No, keep hailing them until the SAR crew arrives.

dialogText.cn: 不知道深层管理区下面的情况怎么样……之前我们发出的搜救讯号和他们发出的求救讯号恐怕都被干扰了……
dialogText.en: I don't know what's going down there in the Deep Management Post... Our SAR broadcasts and their SOS signals are probably blocked by strong interference...

dialogText.cn: 但我相信，他们一定也和我们一样，都还没有放弃。
dialogText.en: But I know that the crew is just like us. None of them is giving up.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们回来了！现在救援工作差不多可以收尾了，我也总算能松口气了！
dialogText.en: You're back, Endmin! Our SAR operations are wrapping up. I can finally sit back and rest for a bit!

dialogText.cn: 可惜紧接着就是撤离工作，我们几个这下恐怕又得连轴转……
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, we still gotta pack our things and leave this place. My crew is gonna face some serious OTs again...

dialogText.cn: 不过经过这次的磨练，我感觉不管是头儿还是大家，做起事来都更像那么回事了，哈哈也算是一种收获了。
dialogText.en: But the ordeal taught everyone a lesson. It straightened the entire crew out. Even the boss himself. I guess we benefited from it in some way.

dialogText.cn: 你好啊，又见面了！要看看我的货吗？
dialogText.en: Good to see you again! Interested in looking at my wares?

dialogText.cn: 来看看，都是实用的东西。
dialogText.en: Take a look. I got pretty useful things here.

dialogText.cn: 大家回来得差不多了，我这儿的生意也越来越好了。
dialogText.en: More and more people are returning to their homes. Business is picking up again.

dialogText.cn: 能再次看到这么热闹的居住区……那位终末地的管理员真的功不可没……
dialogText.en: Boy am I glad to see a crowded village again... That Endministrator made this possible...

dialogText.cn: 呼，要先完成手上的工作……要先完成手上的工作……不能慌……不能慌……
dialogText.en: Phoo... I gotta finish ... finish my job... Don't panic ... no panicking, Mila...

dialogText.cn: 要是师傅和菲莉丝在这里，肯定会很镇定地做好一切的……她们能做到，米菈也肯定可以……肯定可以的……
dialogText.en: Madam Penny and Phyllis could probably handle all of this without breaking a sweat... If they could pull it off, you can too, Mila ... you definitely can...

dialogText.cn: 你好啊，又见面了！要看看我的货吗？
dialogText.en: Good to see you again! Interested in looking at my wares?

dialogText.cn: 来看看，都是实用的东西。
dialogText.en: Take a look. I got pretty useful things here.

dialogText.cn: 大家都在准备撤离了，我也该想办法把我的宝贝们收起来打个包……
dialogText.en: Everyone's leaving this place. I gotta pack my valuables and wares as well...

dialogText.cn: 希望能找到一辆装得下它们的大运载车。
dialogText.en: I hope I can get a truck large enough to store everything.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？你们怎么还在这里？不是要去深层管理区吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm? Why are you here? I thought you're going to the Deep Management Post.

dialogText.cn: 难道是忘了我说的地方在哪儿了？年纪轻轻的怎么记性还不如我这个老太太……那我再说一遍吧——
dialogText.en: Did you actually forget where it is? My, my. Senility is hitting the younger folks nowadays... Fine. This old lady will just tell it to you again —

dialogText.cn: 从那边的最高处跳到吊臂上方，之后再从那里的维修通道下去，把吊臂的角度调整下……
dialogText.en: Reach the highest point over there and jump onto the crane arm. Head down the maintenance shaft nearby and turn the arm to the proper angle...

dialogText.cn: 就可以搭出一条通往深层管理区的路了。
dialogText.en: And that will create a path to the Deep Management Post.

dialogText.cn: 找到了一些工作日志，或许是他们避难前留下的……
dialogText.en: I found some work logs. The crew left it behind during the evac...

dialogText.cn: 换算了一下时间，最新的一条大概在三天前……
dialogText.en: I looked at the timestamps. The last string of data was logged about three days ago...

dialogText.cn: 呼，虽然找到了那些工友的撤退路线，但还是不能确定下面的情况……
dialogText.en: Hmm. We found the evac route taken by our crew mates, but we aren't sure about the sitch down there...

dialogText.cn: 但愿他们都能撑住，胜利就在眼前了啊……
dialogText.en: I hope they're holding out. Victory is within our grasp...

dialogText.cn: 下面的情况就拜托你们确认了，终末地的朋友。
dialogText.en: Endfielders, we're really counting on you to check the sitch down there.

dialogText.cn: 我们会继续在这附近搜寻线索，有什么新消息会随时同步给你们的。
dialogText.en: We'll comb through the area for clues and update you whenever we find something new.

dialogText.cn: 洛昂老弟，你这腿上的伤才止住血……千万别急着起来啊。
dialogText.en: Dang it, Loang! We only managed to stop the bleeding on your leg. Sit your sorry arse down already!

dialogText.cn: 可一想到乔治他们到现在也没消息，我就……
dialogText.en: But I haven't heard anything from George. I can't just sit here...

dialogText.cn: 唉，没办法，通讯都还没恢复呢……现在我们也只能先顾好身边的工友了……
dialogText.en: Ugh. There's nothing we could do. Comms aren't even back online... The best option is to tend to the crew mates around us...

dialogText.cn: 好像来了个终末地的什么管理员帮忙，听说在帮拉蒙他们修起重机呢……
dialogText.en: Someone said that some Endfielders led by the Endmin are here, and they're helping Ramon fix the super crane...

dialogText.cn: 修起重机？你确定？之前有个路过的高级技术员还和我说，我们这个“老伙计”可不好修……
dialogText.en: Fix the super crane? You serious? Some senior technicians visited the Quarry a while back and they told us that this "old boy" isn't easy to fix...

dialogText.cn: 就算派他们一个小组过来，花上三五个月都不一定能搞定。
dialogText.en: Even if they sent a professional repair crew, it would take them an entire season or two to get the super crane working again.

dialogText.cn: 谁知道呢……指不定那位终末地的管理员就有这个本事呢。
dialogText.en: Maybe... But that Endfielder Endmin probably got some special skills.

dialogText.cn: 大新闻！“老伙计”被那位管理员修好了！
dialogText.en: Got some bonzer news for y'all! That Endmin actually fixed the "old boy"!

dialogText.cn: 我以前也听过些终末地的传闻，没想到居然真有他们说的那么厉害……
dialogText.en: I heard about this Endfield. I never knew they were actually as good as people claimed...

dialogText.cn: 是啊，帮了大忙了！这下负责救援的工友也能去支援其他区域了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. That Endmin gave us a ton of help! Our SAR crew mates can finally start supporting the other areas.

dialogText.cn: 救援小组和终末地的人好像都去深层管理区了……
dialogText.en: The SAR crew and the Endfielders went to the Deep Management Post...

dialogText.cn: 不知道会不会找到乔治他们……
dialogText.en: I hope they find George and other crew mates...

dialogText.cn: 但愿大家都能平安回来。
dialogText.en: I hope everyone comes back.

dialogText.cn: 你就是管理员吧？我们这段时间可听说了不少你的事！
dialogText.en: Are you the Endmin? We heard a lot of stories about you!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你为我们提供的帮助！等以后我们搬去新的采石场，也欢迎你来做客！
dialogText.en: Thank you for helping our crew! Pay us a visit when we move to the new Quarry!

dialogText.cn: 刚刚真是惊险！还好你们启动了吊舱，把那边的天使压扁了！不然我肯定会……
dialogText.en: That was so close! Thank goodness you activated the lifting cage and flattened that buggerloid! It would've...

dialogText.cn: 就是你修好的大门吗？谢了，这下大家总算能过去歇歇了……
dialogText.en: Did you fix the gate? Thanks a lot! We can finally take a proper break at a proper place...

dialogText.cn: 安娜大姐的烤肉摊重新开张了？难怪那边的人又多起来了，肯定都是去排队的。
dialogText.en: Is Anna firing up her BBQ stall again? Just look at that crowd. Everyone's probably getting some kebabs.

dialogText.cn: 你别说，我在四号谷地吃的烤长耳兽也有上百串了，但吃来吃去还要属她家烤得最香！
dialogText.en: I had hundreds of long-ear kebabs in Valley IV, but Anna roasts them just right!

dialogText.cn: 听说失联的工友都被你们找到了？真是万幸！
dialogText.en: I heard you found all our lost crew mates! Thank Talos you're here to help us!

dialogText.cn: 这边的善后工作也进入新阶段了——我们打算把附近用得上的设施里能修的都修了，方便后续进行一些必要的处理。
dialogText.en: The next phase of clean up can finally begin. We decided to fix every local facility just in case another extra job comes in.

dialogText.cn: 您好，欢迎选购！
dialogText.en: Greetings. Anything you need?

dialogText.cn: 它可能发生故障了，要不要试试其他商品？
dialogText.en: It might be broken. How about trying something else?

dialogText.cn: 没有出现任何货物……想想也是，毕竟没有付款嘛。
dialogText.en: No goods have appeared... This isn't surprising, since you didn't pay anything.

dialogText.cn: ……什么都没有发生。这台机器的作用似乎仅限于让人心怀期待。
dialogText.en: Nothing happened. The only function of this machine seems to be the dispensing of hopium.

dialogText.cn: 终端上反复提示着：已确认供能高地爆发大范围侵蚀，请撤离至最近的安全点。
dialogText.en: The terminal is repeatedly displaying this message: Large scale Blight rupture event detected at the Power Plateau. Evacuate immediately and seek the closest shelter.

dialogText.cn: 装满了珍贵特种钢材的密封箱，似乎是因为嫌弃沉重，裂地者并未将其搬走。
dialogText.en: A sealed crate filled with rare samples of specialized steel. The Landbreakers probably left it here because it is simply too heavy to loot.

dialogText.cn: 这些钢材是制造多种武器的重要材料，显然裂地者们并不识货，又或者说，他们有更重要的目标……
dialogText.en: These special steel samples are key for making weapons. The Landbreakers were either ignorant of this fact or they were carrying out a more important mission...

dialogText.cn: 一台厚重的工程装甲车，工程师巧妙地将炮管伪装成了吊臂。
dialogText.en: A heavily armored construction vehicle. The engineers cleverly disguised the cannon as a crane arm.

dialogText.cn: “模拟天灾测试个体——由罗德岛提供”
dialogText.en: "Simulated Catastrophe Test Entity — Provided by Rhodes Island"

dialogText.cn: 终端上反复提示着：已确认发电站方向爆发大范围侵蚀，请撤离至最近的安全点。
dialogText.en: The terminal shows repeats of the same line: Large scale Blight rupture event detected at the Power Plant. Evacuate immediately and seek the closest shelter.

dialogText.cn: “耐火特性测试组——由宏山科学院提供”
dialogText.en: "Flame Resistant Testing Group — Courtesy of Hongshan Academy of Sciences"

dialogText.cn: “填充用源石样本——采集自大树残块”
dialogText.en: "Originium sample from the filler material — Gathered from the remains of the Great Originium Oak"

dialogText.cn: “重力异常区源石样本——采集自地下暗河”
dialogText.en: "Originium Sample from the Anomalous Gravity Zone — Gathered from the Subterranean River"

dialogText.cn: “源石瞬时活性化模拟装置已启动。”
dialogText.en: "Originium flash-activation simulator activated."

dialogText.cn: “正在进行综合检测……”
dialogText.en: "Performing integrated inspections..."

dialogText.cn: “检测未通过……”
dialogText.en: "Inspection failed..."

dialogText.cn: “存在严重干扰，设备未处于正常运作状态。”
dialogText.en: "Severe interference detected. Simulator operations abnormal."

dialogText.cn: 高压塑形仓处于空置状态，请检查定时投放参数。
dialogText.en: High pressure moulding cabin is idling. Check parameters of material dispensing schedule.

dialogText.cn: 设备的角落处写着：伊冯专用物质反应仓，有侵蚀相关材料，未经允许禁止靠近。
dialogText.en: Writing on the side of this machine reads: Yvonne's special reaction chamber. Blight materials included. DO NOT APPROACH WITHOUT PERMISSION.

dialogText.cn: 桌子上随手扔着一张购物清单，清单上列有二十多个物品，从名字上看，有将近十五个是时尚杂志。
dialogText.en: A shopping list that someone left on the table without much of a thought. The list includes over 20 items, 15 of which seem like fashion magazines.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈对原型机的改装还不错，我很满意。
dialogText.en: I am satisfied with Andre's modifications on the prototype.

dialogText.cn: 塔塔……塔塔……还挺顺口的，我偶尔也这么叫它好了。
dialogText.en: TA-TA... TATA... Well, it's pretty easy to pick up. Maybe I'll call it Tata every now and then.

dialogText.cn: 只是觉得念着顺口，正式场合还是会用“原型机”来称呼它的。
dialogText.en: But when it comes to formal discussions, we should stick with the word "prototype".

dialogText.cn: 托您的福，现在源石研究园已经恢复正常运作了。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much, Endmin. The Originium Science Park is getting back to business.

dialogText.cn: 其实我最担心的是研究所里面，但没想到伊冯一个人就把所有裂地者挡住了。
dialogText.en: I was really worried about the Research Center. Boy was I wrong. Yvonne actually stood up against the LBs on her own.

dialogText.cn: 唉，事情总算是告一段落了。
dialogText.en: Well, this blasted invasion is finally over.

dialogText.cn: 我们更新了系统，那个已经没用了，给您留着做纪念吧。
dialogText.en: Nah. We just updated the system. That access card won't work anymore. Keep it as a souvenir.

dialogText.cn: 资料我全都收到了！
dialogText.en: I received all the files!

dialogText.cn: 不过似乎是我多虑了，裂地者根本就没冲着这边来。
dialogText.en: Maybe I was too paranoid. The LBs never bothered to attack this place.

dialogText.cn: 听说他被困在里面的时候又跑了两轮模拟……真是个工作狂。
dialogText.en: Well, he actually ran 2 more simulations while he was trapped inside... The dude has terminal-stage workaholism...

dialogText.cn: 啊！你吓了我一跳。
dialogText.en: BY TALOS! You scared the blight out of me!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我知道了……但我要找点东西。
dialogText.en: I know but I ... gotta find something.

dialogText.cn: 之前太感谢你了。
dialogText.en: Thanks for helping me out back then. Really.

dialogText.cn: 生态种植区你可以随意使用。
dialogText.en: The facilities and resources of the Eco-Farm are at your disposal.

dialogText.cn: 油盐酱醋都齐活儿了！干脆先做份红烧肉好了……
dialogText.en: Got the oil, salt, soy sauce, and vinegar! Hmm, let's make some roasted meat first...

dialogText.cn: 那可不！救援工作多辛苦啊，大家吃饱喝足了才好干活嘛！
dialogText.en: Of course! SAR work is tough. And a full belly keeps a tough crew going!

dialogText.cn: 大家都别急！一个个来。放心，人人都有份！
dialogText.en: No rush, people! One at a time! Don't worry! I made enough for everyone!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，昨天来了个小哥说想吃回锅肉，我就给他现炒了一盘试试咸淡……
dialogText.en: Hah! Some crew mate said he was craving for some twice-cooked meat. I wokked a plate to test their palate...

dialogText.cn: 没想到他吃完了，见人就夸我烧的味道好，这一传十，十传百的，弄得大家都想来尝尝咯。
dialogText.en: Turned out he finished the entire thing and went around telling everyone how good of a chef I am. Word got around and attracted quite a crowd.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，等下别急着走，我还给您留了一份呢！
dialogText.en: Don't just go running off, Endmin! I've left some for you!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，谢谢你和诺夫曼一起救出了我们……
dialogText.en: Endmin! Thank you for working with Noffman and saving all of us...

dialogText.cn: 我的伤已经好得差不多了，过两天就能去给大家帮忙了。
dialogText.en: My injuries have largely healed. I can start helping out the crew in two days.

dialogText.cn: 我也是！谢谢你们送来的药，真的太有效了。
dialogText.en: Me too! Thanks for the meds! They're really effective!

dialogText.cn: 唉，本来我也以为自己痊愈了，结果医生却说最好再休养几天……等完全好了，我再一口气把之前落下的工作补上！
dialogText.en: Ugh. I thought I was getting better but the surgeon told me to stay in bed for a few days... Welp, once I get better, I'll finish up all the work that I'm owing the crew!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，裂地者似乎开始撤退了。听说您跟他们大战了一场，真是痛快！
dialogText.en: Endmin! The LBs are scampering off with tails tucked between their legs! They told me you gave them a bloody good licking. Is that right?

dialogText.cn: 我和艾莱扎清理出一些安全区域，工友们也陆续开始返回了。
dialogText.en: Aleeza and I cleaned out a few safe zones. The UWST crew mates are slowly making their way back.

dialogText.cn: 法比安，别磨叽了。还有一些裂地者在到处乱跑，走，去教训一下他们。
dialogText.en: Cut the chit chat, Fabian. Spotted an LB mob nearby. Let's go show 'em what happens when you mess with the UW.

dialogText.cn: 对我们来说，工作才刚刚开始。
dialogText.en: Well, the work is just getting started.

dialogText.cn: 不过最艰难的那段时间已经过去了，听说基地的增援在路上了。
dialogText.en: But the most trying times are finally over. Help from the base is on its way.

dialogText.cn: 之后还需要给那些只做了紧急处理的伤员进行正式治疗。
dialogText.en: We still need to give the wounded proper treatment. They've only had emergency care so far.

dialogText.cn: 大家都出色地完成了自己的工作，我们也得跟上才行。
dialogText.en: Everyone's pulling their share of the weight. We must do the same as well.

dialogText.cn: 再坚持一下……
dialogText.en: Be strong...

dialogText.cn: 是你们啊。
dialogText.en: Ah, it's you.

dialogText.cn: 目前情况不容乐观，不过好在工人们都很配合。
dialogText.en: Things aren't optimistic right now, but the crew mates are doing their best to help.

dialogText.cn: 这种时候最怕恐慌蔓延，我们的辛苦都是其次的。
dialogText.en: Right now, our biggest fear is panic spreading. Our own hard work is secondary.

dialogText.cn: 人员和药品紧缺的问题还没能解决，我们得想办法渡过难关，撑到救援抵达。
dialogText.en: Personnel and medication shortages remain a problem. We must figure out a solution to tide us over till reinforcements arrive.

dialogText.cn: 你们来了，一切还顺利吗？
dialogText.en: You're here. Everything okay?

dialogText.cn: 现在人手严重不足，一些有药物知识或医疗经验的工人也在帮我们工作。
dialogText.en: We really need more people. Crew mates with medicinal knowledge and healthcare experience are helping us out.

dialogText.cn: 只是伤员越来越多，大家只能勉强维持着秩序。
dialogText.en: But the sick and injured keep coming in. We're barely keeping things together.

dialogText.cn: 一旦拖得太久，唉……
dialogText.en: If this continues, *sigh*...

dialogText.cn: 你们成功了？太好了。
dialogText.en: You did it? Wonderful.

dialogText.cn: 这下伤员们也能放下心来了，他们有信心，才更利于我们救治。
dialogText.en: One less thing for the sick and injured to worry about. Hope and good morale will make our treatment more effective.

dialogText.cn: 这都多亏了你们。
dialogText.en: You deserve our most sincere thanks.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，听说救援队要来了。
dialogText.en: I heard a SAR crew is on its way! Wonderful!

dialogText.cn: 这就像一剂强心剂，给予了我们信心。
dialogText.en: This great news is a powerful dose of confidence.

dialogText.cn: 我们会留下，也有小部分人会和伤员一起转移。
dialogText.en: Some of us will stay here. A few will be transferred to another site with the sick and injured.

dialogText.cn: 有什么需要的吗？
dialogText.en: Got anything you need?

dialogText.cn: 这里目前啥都缺，我能做的也就是把所有的货物都拿出来卖了。
dialogText.en: We're short on everything. The only thing I could do for the people is to offer all my remaining stock for sale.

dialogText.cn: 我在这里做生意好多年了，不可能趁机发灾难财的，现在都是按进货价卖给他们。
dialogText.en: I've been running my local business for years. Disaster profiteering is the last thing I'm gonna do. All my wares are being offered at purchase prices.

dialogText.cn: 有什么需要的可以来看看。
dialogText.en: Check them out and see if you need anything.

dialogText.cn: 还好这里有卖。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness we can still buy these.

dialogText.cn: 有些工具和食品只有这里有售，老板有时候也会带回来我们委托采购的商品。
dialogText.en: This is the only shop selling these tools and food items. The owner would also help us order special merchandise on various occasions.

dialogText.cn: 在现在这种紧急时刻，老板真是帮了大忙了。
dialogText.en: In desperate times like this, this shop owner really helped maintain our lifeline.

dialogText.cn: 离道路恢复可能还要一段时间。
dialogText.en: Getting the roads open again might take a while.

dialogText.cn: 很多商品需要补充了，我得找时间去外面联络一下平时合作的供应商。
dialogText.en: Gotta restock my shop. I have to head out there and get in touch with my usual supplies.

dialogText.cn: 希望这里能尽早恢复吧，这样我才好有生意做。
dialogText.en: I just hope we can get this place patched up. That'll get my business rolling again.

dialogText.cn: 你们要申请什么？我这边需要对每一批申请做记录。
dialogText.en: You need something? I'm busy right now registering and recording every incoming batch of supplies.

dialogText.cn: 这些物资基本上就是我们全部的资源了，如果它们消耗完了，情况就真的不妙了。
dialogText.en: What you're seeing here is basically everything we have. We'll be in deep blightery if this runs out.

dialogText.cn: 所以现在需要对资源严格分配，避免一些不必要的消耗。还请理解。
dialogText.en: That's why we gotta ration the stuff and avoid unnecessary waste. Please understand what we're doing here.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，剩下的物资足够坚持到救援队抵达。
dialogText.en: Great. The remaining supplies should last till the SAR crew arrives.

dialogText.cn: 这下不用那么紧张了。
dialogText.en: Life can be a lot less stressful now.

dialogText.cn: 在准备搜救工作的同时，尝试帮助一下其他区域的工友吧。
dialogText.en: While we prep for the SAR operation, let's try to help the workers in other sectors too.

dialogText.cn: 纸张上写着播放新蓝卡坞最新影片的计划。
dialogText.en: A piece of paper describing the plans for screening the latest New Wrankwood movies.

dialogText.cn: 当然，所谓的“最新”，应该也是上映有段时间的电影了。
dialogText.en: Of course, the "latest" movies also include those that have been in the theaters for quite a while.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，你们能去其他用餐点吃吗？
dialogText.en: Sorry. I probably don't have extra meals for you.

dialogText.cn: 我这里是受越医生之托，专门给伤员提供食物的。
dialogText.en: Medical Officer Yue asked me to prepare food for our sick and injured.

dialogText.cn: 所以仅供给伤员，谢谢配合。
dialogText.en: That means I only cook for the sick and wounded. Thank you for your understanding.

dialogText.cn: 吃饱了准备干活……
dialogText.en: Gotta finish the chow and start my shift...

dialogText.cn: 我们是轮流来吃饭的，维修工作不能落下。
dialogText.en: We take turns having our meal breaks. Can't afford delays for work in the repair area.

dialogText.cn: 用餐时间很紧张，我这就得回去了。
dialogText.en: I gotta finish eating and get back to work. Quickly.

dialogText.cn: 你们也是来吃饭的吗？
dialogText.en: Are you here for the chow?

dialogText.cn: 这个可好吃了，但是大家怎么都不来吃饭呢？
dialogText.en: This is the bestest chow ever but why isn't anyone eating?

dialogText.cn: 叔叔阿姨们看起来都好忙……
dialogText.en: The grown-ups look so busy...

dialogText.cn: 我正打算把这些食物送到各处。
dialogText.en: I gotta deliver these lunch tins to the work sites.

dialogText.cn: 很多人都忙得没时间过来吃饭，我们受了点伤没法干重活，就自发过来帮忙送饭了。
dialogText.en: People hardly have the time to eat at the canteen. Since we got a few scratches and can't do heavy lifting, we volunteered for food delivery instead.

dialogText.cn: 你们吃过了吗？没吃的话坐下来吃点？
dialogText.en: Had your meals yet? Sit down and have a bite.

dialogText.cn: 还好那些侵蚀被顺利解决了，不然我们不知道要被困在这里多久……
dialogText.en: Thank Talos someone took care of the Blight, otherwise we'd still be stuck at this place...

dialogText.cn: 这段时间大家还能保持良好的秩序，多亏了平日里的事故演习……
dialogText.en: All those disaster drills we had taught us a lot of useful things. They helped us keep everything under control...

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？这里的伙食还不错吧。
dialogText.en: How is it? We got the best chow in the region, right?

dialogText.cn: 现在是非常时刻，以前这里的饭菜种类特别多。
dialogText.en: These are trying times. Our usual menu has a lot more options than this.

dialogText.cn: 有时还会请来几位宏山的老师傅，那手艺，啧啧，又想尝尝了。
dialogText.en: We even hired master chefs from Hongshan at certain occasions. I bet they got some special Food Arts or something. Their cooking is the best.

dialogText.cn: 目前可能帮不上你们什么忙。
dialogText.en: I probably can't help you much right now.

dialogText.cn: 有太多需要修理的设备，还有载具……没有它们，我们的各项救援活动都难以展开。
dialogText.en: There are just so many machines and vehicles to fix... We gotta get them working again for the SAR operations.

dialogText.cn: 但目前工具紧缺，唉……
dialogText.en: But we're short on tools and parts...

dialogText.cn: 希望危机能早点解决……
dialogText.en: I hope this crisis ends soon...

dialogText.cn: 外面大部分侵蚀都被清理了，我们也能投放一些监测设备了。
dialogText.en: Most of the Blight outside this place have been cleansed. We can finally start deploying our surveillance equipment.

dialogText.cn: 要时刻监控这些侵蚀留下的痕迹，才能快速应对突发状况。
dialogText.en: Gotta keep monitoring the Blight residues to make rapid response possible.

dialogText.cn: 外面的情况好了很多，但依然充满危险。
dialogText.en: Things are settling down but it can still get pretty dangerous outside.

dialogText.cn: 我们正在组建搜救队伍，去寻找被困在外面的工友们。
dialogText.en: We're putting together an SAR crew to find and rescue crew mates who might be trapped out there.

dialogText.cn: 希望搜救任务能顺利。
dialogText.en: I wish the best for our SAR crew.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎光临芙蕾丝杂货铺。保证物美价廉，但是不退不换哦。
dialogText.en: Welcome to Fraissy's shop. I got very nice things at equally nice prices. No returns once sold, though.

dialogText.cn: 你需要的应有尽有。
dialogText.en: I have everything you need.

dialogText.cn: 好吧。
dialogText.en: Fine.

dialogText.cn: 《三十天学会如何战胜侵蚀》……
dialogText.en: Beating the Blight in 30 Days...

dialogText.cn: 不管内容如何，总之一定要有个夺人眼球的名字和封皮，这似乎是塔卫二大部分娱乐文学的通病。
dialogText.en: Regardless of content, most Talosian authors of entertainment literature have a habit of using controversial or eye-catching titles and cover pages.

dialogText.cn: 你们是要去供能高地吗？那可不容易，得穿过世代摇篮。
dialogText.en: Are you going to the Power Plateau? That won't be an easy trip. You gotta get through the Cradle of the Ages.

dialogText.cn: 不带足补给可是要出事的！来补充一些？
dialogText.en: Being under-supplied out there can be dangerous! Stock up with me!

dialogText.cn: 来，用补给把你的背包塞满吧。
dialogText.en: Come. Let's fill up your Backpack with yummy provisions.

dialogText.cn: 好吧。
dialogText.en: Fine.

dialogText.cn: 营地外有很多锚点，不带足补给可是要出事的！来补充一些？
dialogText.en: There are plenty of Ankhors outside the camp. Bad things might happen and having some supplies will get you covered.

dialogText.cn: 来，用补给把你的背包塞满吧。
dialogText.en: Come. Let's fill up your Backpack with yummy provisions.

dialogText.cn: 好吧。
dialogText.en: Fine.

dialogText.cn: 真厉害啊！你们竟然把锚点都摧毁了！
dialogText.en: You're amazing! You actually destroyed all the Ankhors!

dialogText.cn: 正所谓未雨绸缪，有备无患。在我这里把补给品买足吧！
dialogText.en: Plan and prep for the future. A full backpack is better than an empty one. Get yourself stocked at my little shop.

dialogText.cn: 你可算找对人了。
dialogText.en: You came to the right place.

dialogText.cn: 好吧。
dialogText.en: Fine.

dialogText.cn: 啊！欢迎光临！随便看看，买不买都行。
dialogText.en: Ah! Welcome! Look around. Don't worry. I won't get mad even if you buy nothing.

dialogText.cn: 你可算找对人了。
dialogText.en: You came to the right place.

dialogText.cn: 好吧。
dialogText.en: Fine.

dialogText.cn: 屏幕上显示着：因设备维修，高威力爆炸物套组兑换功能暂时关闭。
dialogText.en: The monitor displays: "Facility under maintenance. Powerful Explosive Suite exchange is currently unavailable."

dialogText.cn: 真是可惜。
dialogText.en: What a shame.

dialogText.cn: 门内传来了极轻的，不知什么东西抓挠铁门的声音。
dialogText.en: Sound of gentle scratching can be heard coming from the other side of the door.

dialogText.cn: 箱子的密封单上写着：五号谷地待建区建设用物资，严禁私自开启。
dialogText.en: The sealing document on the crate reads: Valley V construction zone supplies. DO NOT OPEN WITHOUT PERMISSION.

dialogText.cn: 警告！锚点密度异常，请尽快避难……
dialogText.en: Warning! Ankhor density anomaly detected. Evacuate immediately...

dialogText.cn: 正在将观测数据上传分析中心……
dialogText.en: Uploading observation data to the analytical center...

dialogText.cn: 正在同步防卫单元……
dialogText.en: Synchronizing with defense units...

dialogText.cn: 同步失效，请检查通信模块。
dialogText.en: Synchronization failed. Please check communications module.

dialogText.cn: 纸张上写着“天使”“人造”“特制”“控制材料”“特殊金属”“蓝铁”“奴役”“植入中枢”等看起来稍显危险的字样。
dialogText.en: Dangerous looking phrases and words written on paper: Aggelos | Artificial | Made to order | Control materials | Special metals | Ferrium | Enslave | Nexus implantation

dialogText.cn: 如你所见，我们在整理资源。
dialogText.en: Well, we're sorting out the supplies and resources.

dialogText.cn: 我们能做的也只有这些了，现在每个人都在做自己力所能及的事。
dialogText.en: That's all we can do right now. Everyone's doing their best to help.

dialogText.cn: 不这样的话，就撑不到救援抵达。
dialogText.en: If we don't work together, we'll never live till help arrives.

dialogText.cn: 不过别担心，我相信一切都会好起来的。
dialogText.en: Nobody's really worried, though. Things will definitely get better.

dialogText.cn: 危难关头，只能依靠自己。
dialogText.en: In times of crisis, you can only rely on yourself.

dialogText.cn: 还不错，不过工作可不能停下。
dialogText.en: Things are looking up but it's no excuse to slack.

dialogText.cn: 其实此前大家心里多少还是有些没底的，但我们相信彼此。
dialogText.en: Everything felt really uncertain back then. Nevertheless, everyone believes in each other.

dialogText.cn: 只有互相扶持，我们才能挺过来，等到转机。
dialogText.en: We'll only make it through and see a change for the better if we help each other.

dialogText.cn: 还得感谢解决了这场危机的人，没有他们，大家可能都还处在恐慌之中。
dialogText.en: We'd still be living in fear if not for the hero who came and solved this crisis.

dialogText.cn: 再坚持一下，还不能松懈。
dialogText.en: Hang in there a little longer. We can't let our guard down yet.

dialogText.cn: 能捡回一条命来已经是运气好了……唉。
dialogText.en: I'm glad to be alive ... *sigh*...

dialogText.cn: 事情发生得太突然，我们还在外面工作，突然天空就像被撕开了一条口子……
dialogText.en: It happened so quickly. I was working outside when this gashing wound suddenly appeared in the skies...

dialogText.cn: 我没有直接接触到那些侵蚀，勉强跑了回来。其他人就没有那么走运了，唉……
dialogText.en: I managed to get back here without touching the Blight. The others ... they ... they weren't so lucky. *Sigh*...

dialogText.cn: 太可怕了……
dialogText.en: It's terrible...

dialogText.cn: 还好，但离能下床走路还要一段时间。
dialogText.en: Yeah, but it'll take me a while to get off this bed.

dialogText.cn: 听说外面的危险已经解除了，我已经迫不及待想回到岗位上了。
dialogText.en: They told me the crisis has ended. I'm dying to get back to my post.

dialogText.cn: 这次灾难的影响很严重，还有很多人需要帮助。
dialogText.en: This disaster struck us hard. Plenty of people will be needing help.
*Sigh*...

dialogText.cn: 钢架扭曲着，能看出它曾被当作防御工事使用，且遭到了暴力的破坏。
dialogText.en: The steel structure has been twisted. It was obviously part of the defense works before it got hit by a violent force of destruction.

dialogText.cn: 门锁位置能看到被撬过的痕迹，但万幸的是，这扇门还没被撬开。
dialogText.en: There are signs that someone tried to break the lock. Fortunately, the gate has held.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者们应该还没来得及对供能高地的每一间屋子进行掠夺搜刮。
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers probably did not have the time to loot every house in the Power Plateau.

dialogText.cn: 废旧报纸上有铅笔涂画出的痕迹，勉强能看出是一张潦草的设计图。
dialogText.en: You can barely make out rough design sketches made with a pencil on the old newspaper.

dialogText.cn: 设计者似乎想要研发某种新型拍摄工具，也不知是为了拍摄什么。
dialogText.en: The designer seemed intent on designing a new type of camera, though you do not know what the designer was trying to photograph.

dialogText.cn: 设备标签磨损十分严重，但仍能辨认出一些内容。
dialogText.en: The label of this machinery has been worn. Parts of it remain slightly legible.

dialogText.cn: “大型……用……天使切割……台……”
dialogText.en: "Large ... PURPOSE: ... Aggelos saw ... platform ..."

dialogText.cn: 如此“古老”的设备，莫非它已经服役了一百多年？
dialogText.en: This facility looks "ancient". Perhaps it had worked for more than a century.

dialogText.cn: 草稿纸上有铅笔涂画出的痕迹，勉强能看出是在计算些什么的记录。
dialogText.en: Rough pencil sketches on a piece of draft paper. They seem like some kind of calculations.

dialogText.cn: 运算者似乎试图以数学方式来反向追溯锚点的根源。
dialogText.en: The author seemed to be making a mathematical attempt to trace the Ankhors' origins.

dialogText.cn: 树下有一枚弯曲的勋章，看起来像是工团内部颁发给研究人员的嘉奖品。
dialogText.en: A twisted medal found beneath a tree. It seems like an internal award given to a UWST scientist.

dialogText.cn: “走吧，走出漫漫冬夜”，勋章背面刻着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: Something has been engraved on the back of the medal: "Go and leave the wintry night behind."

dialogText.cn: 管理员！我们的任务就快完成了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Our mission is almost done!

dialogText.cn: 还是靠工人们集体的努力。邓恩……虽然他的奇思妙想添了不少麻烦，不过也确实提高了效率。
dialogText.en: The crew mates worked hard together to make it happen. As for Dean ... his ideas are a little weird, but they boosted our efficiency.

dialogText.cn: 等一切完成，我们会邀请管理员来一起见证的！
dialogText.en: Once it's done, we'll invite you to witness the grand activation, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我正想联络你们呢。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I was about to call you.

dialogText.cn: 克莱维尔那家伙还挺有办法，我们最后阶段的进展飞快。
dialogText.en: Clavell's trick worked. We're making amazing progress in the final phase.

dialogText.cn: 我俩都想邀请你们一起见证机器启动呢。
dialogText.en: We were about to invite you to witness the grand activation of the machinery.

dialogText.cn: 现在是最终冲刺，我先继续忙手上的工作了！
dialogText.en: This is our final sprint! I gotta really focus on my work now!

dialogText.cn: 前辈，您听见那些声音了吗？
dialogText.en: Professor, did you hear those sounds?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，小动物们窸窸窣窣的声音，植物的叶片相互摩擦的声音，还有那些机器转动的声音。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Sounds of the little creatures frolicking around, of blades of grass rubbing against each other, and of working machines as their parts move and turn.

dialogText.cn: 这都是这里重获生机的前奏。我喜欢这些声音……
dialogText.en: It's a symphonic prelude of a land being restored to life. I like it very much...

dialogText.cn: 我会努力融入它们，成为这些声音的一部分。
dialogText.en: I'll try to integrate them, and become part of these sounds.

dialogText.cn: 还有很多问题需要反思……
dialogText.en: There are many issues to reflect upon...

dialogText.cn: 我……这次负责建造工作，让我认清了自己很多不足的地方。
dialogText.en: I, uh... Leading the project made me realize that I ... have many personal issues to sort through.

dialogText.cn: 和邓恩的合作也是……总是发生分歧，影响进度。
dialogText.en: Working with Dean proved to be ... rather rough. It actually affected our progress.

dialogText.cn: 我很内疚，没能让克劳老师放心地把供能高地托付给我们。
dialogText.en: I feel really bad about it. We should have given Professor Crowe an ease of mind when he assigned us to the Power Plateau.

dialogText.cn: 但……我也找到了前进的方向！
dialogText.en: But ... it also pointed out a path of self-improvement for me!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，之前给你们添麻烦了。
dialogText.en: Sorry for causing all that trouble, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 我们……没能让克劳老师完全满意。
dialogText.en: We ... failed to deliver a satisfactory job for Professor Crowe.

dialogText.cn: 虽然很惭愧，但我其实还有点……庆幸。
dialogText.en: Although I'm rather ashamed, I also feel quite ... fortunate.

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师还会留在四号谷地，我还有很多机会向他学习。
dialogText.en: The fact that Professor Crowe is staying at Valley IV gives me a huge opportunity to learn from him.

dialogText.cn: 我一定会让他对我……对我们放心的！
dialogText.en: He'll definitely be impressed with my ... I mean, our performance!

dialogText.cn: 前辈，我打算在这里留一会儿。
dialogText.en: Professor, I'm planning to stay here for a while.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我想多帮他们做一些事。这里……和以往的调查工作不同。
dialogText.en: Hmm... I want to help them a little more. This is ... quite unlike the survey work I had in the past.

dialogText.cn: 我总是会经过各种地方，记录、监测那里的灾害……
dialogText.en: I often travel to various places to record and survey regional disasters...

dialogText.cn: 像这样留在某处一段时间，亲眼见证它一点点从灾害的伤痛中恢复元气……
dialogText.en: But having stayed here for quite a while and witnessing how it's slowly recovering from the painful disaster...

dialogText.cn: 我很享受这样的时光。
dialogText.en: These days have been really enjoyable for me.

dialogText.cn: 重建工作不能怠慢……
dialogText.en: Gotta treat this reconstruction work seriously...

dialogText.cn: 是终末地的各位！之前多亏你们了！我正在应克劳老师的要求清理这片区域，他说这对后续的重建工作很关键。
dialogText.en: Endfielders! Thanks a lot for your help! Professor Crowe asked me to clean up this place. Said it's super important for the reconstruction work.

dialogText.cn: 虽然供能高地受到了重创，但大家都有信心重建家园！
dialogText.en: Although the Power Plateau got really badly hit, everyone's confident about rebuilding our homes!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，是来查看重建指挥部的建设进度吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, here to check on the progress of the Reconstruction Headquarters?

dialogText.cn: 勉勉强强，正在缓慢推进。
dialogText.en: As you can see, we're trudging along. Slowly.

dialogText.cn: 我先去忙了，有什么事情尽管喊我。
dialogText.en: I gotta start doing my job. Call me if you need anything.

dialogText.cn: 得多思考怎么做……
dialogText.en: Gotta think over my approach carefully...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？不，没什么。我在算一组参数。
dialogText.en: Endmin? No, nothing's wrong. I'm trying to calculate a set of parameters.

dialogText.cn: 这组数据十分重要，可能会在启动大型地质探针的时候用到。
dialogText.en: These figures are really important. We might need them when activating the large geological probe.

dialogText.cn: 让邓恩一个人来做，我有点不放心。多个人留意一下，就多一道保险。
dialogText.en: I don't think it's safe to let Dean do the maths alone. Things will be safer if someone checks his work.

dialogText.cn: 等我忙完手上的工作再来招待你们，不好意思了。
dialogText.en: Sorry, but I gotta work on this. I'll talk to you once I'm done.

dialogText.cn: 不对，又搞错了……啊，管理员，是你们啊。
dialogText.en: Hmm. Another mistake... Ah, Endmin! It's you.

dialogText.cn: 一些样本，我打算在地质探针正式启动前先进行样本的制作。
dialogText.en: Just a few samples. I'm getting them prepared before formally activating the geological probe.

dialogText.cn: 打个提前量嘛，这样到时候就不用手忙脚乱了。当然了，前提是不出什么意外。
dialogText.en: Getting prepped in advance, see. It'll save us a ton of trouble once activation is underway. Assuming that everything goes smoothly.

dialogText.cn: 不过，就算出了什么事，也有管理员在这里，大家都很放心。
dialogText.en: But even if things were to go sideways, knowing that you're around is giving everyone a peace of mind, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这都多亏了你们！
dialogText.en: All thanks to you!

dialogText.cn: 想要抹去大地的伤痕……
dialogText.en: To mend the wounds of this land...

dialogText.cn: 前辈，您来啦。您看到了吗？那些藏起来的小生命。
dialogText.en: Oh, you're here, Professor. Did you see that? There are little creatures hiding in this place.

dialogText.cn: 它们刨开了被污染的土，躲开了枯萎的草……
dialogText.en: They're tunneling through the contaminated soil and avoiding the wilted grass...

dialogText.cn: 它们也在寻找这里仅剩的生机。
dialogText.en: They're also looking for what remains of life in this place.

dialogText.cn: 我们也必须更努力才行……
dialogText.en: We need to work harder...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，是来查看重建指挥部的建设进度吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, here to check on the progress of the Reconstruction Headquarters?

dialogText.cn: 勉勉强强，正在缓慢推进。
dialogText.en: As you can see, we're trudging along. Slowly.

dialogText.cn: 我先去忙了，有什么事情尽管喊我。
dialogText.en: I gotta start doing my job. Call me if you need anything.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们来啦！之前多谢你们了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're back! Thanks so much for your help back then.

dialogText.cn: 不瞒你们说，能源问题还没能完全解决。
dialogText.en: I'll be honest. We still got an energy issue.

dialogText.cn: 我和邓恩想借助终末地的一些力量……还不知道怎么开口……
dialogText.en: Dean and I wonder if we could ask Endfield for some juice... But we don't know if it's okay to ask...

dialogText.cn: 太好了！我们先确定一下方案！
dialogText.en: Really?! Alright! We'll come up with a plan!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们来得正好！
dialogText.en: Endmin, you came at just the right time!

dialogText.cn: 我刚才还在想，重建指挥部的建设有些停滞了。
dialogText.en: I was thinking about how progress for the Reconstruction HQ has stalled.

dialogText.cn: 能源和物资的调配都存在一些问题……我们人手不足，所以想请你们帮帮忙。
dialogText.en: We got problems with energy and supply redistribution... And our crew is too small. I wonder if we could, you know, ask you for help?

dialogText.cn: 太好了！还好有你们！
dialogText.en: Alright! I'm so glad we can count on you!

dialogText.cn: 前辈，最近还是那么忙吗？
dialogText.en: Professor, still busy as always?

dialogText.cn: 毕竟前辈肩负了所有人的希望。
dialogText.en: Well, you shoulders are carrying the weight of everyone's hope.

dialogText.cn: 不过与之相对的，这里的人们只要看到前辈，就会振作起来。
dialogText.en: But there's a bright side to this. The local crew feels very encouraged when they see you here.

dialogText.cn: 这都是多亏了前辈呢。
dialogText.en: All thanks to your hardwork, Professor!

dialogText.cn: “复归于此，前路自明。如遇危险请点亮引导灯，或联系武陵科学发展区紧急救助热线。”
dialogText.en: "Return here to illuminate the path. For emergencies, switch on the guiding lights or call the emergency hotline of the Wuling Scientific Developmental District"...

dialogText.cn: 雕像上刻着如此内容。
dialogText.en: These are the words carved onto the statue.

dialogText.cn: “请相信我们的小小导游。”
dialogText.en: "Please trust our little guide."

dialogText.cn: 雕像上刻着这样的话。
dialogText.en: These are the words carved onto the statue.

dialogText.cn: “严禁在公共交通站点钓鳞！！！”
dialogText.en: "Angling at public transport stations is strictly prohibited!"

dialogText.cn: 官方告示上写着这样的话。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the official notice.

dialogText.cn: “钓了又如何？”
dialogText.en: "So what if I do?"

dialogText.cn: 其下涂写着寨民留下的狂野宣言。
dialogText.en: Scrawled beneath it is a Stockader's bold declaration.

dialogText.cn: 一位抵挡过天使的英雄安静地破碎于此，或许不日就将被前来“捞宝”的寨民们拆解回收。
dialogText.en: A hero who once held off Aggeloi now lies shattered here in silence, likely to be scavenged and recycled by Stockaders coming to "salvage treasures" any day now.

dialogText.cn: “若发现特殊矿石，可联系武陵材料研究所进行回收。”
dialogText.en: "If you discover any special ores, please contact the Wuling Institute of Materials Science for recovery."

dialogText.cn: 雕像上刻有如此内容。
dialogText.en: These are the words carved onto the statue.

dialogText.cn: 这些碾骨氏族的破损武器为什么会出现在这里？
dialogText.en: Why are these damaged weapons from the Bonekrusher Clan showing up here?

dialogText.cn: 纸张上有一个被巨大红叉划掉的潦草头像，勉强能看出画的是一位萨卡兹女性巡卫。
dialogText.en: There's a hastily drawn portrait crudely crossed out with a large red X on the piece. You can just barely make out that it's supposed to be a Sarkaz lady of the watchguards.

dialogText.cn: 它原本似乎是用以提示封闭此处大门的告示……真是写意……
dialogText.en: Looks like it was originally posted as a warning to keep this gate sealed. So vague...

dialogText.cn: 啊……这群学生……
dialogText.en: Ah ... these students...

dialogText.cn: 记不清了。我猜您是要问那个经典问题——没错，每一届都很难带！
dialogText.en: Can't remember. I guess you're asking that classic question. And yes, every grade is a handful!

dialogText.cn: 当然，我也不会怪孩子们想法丰富。想法多是好事……
dialogText.en: Of course, I don't blame the kids for having so many ideas. Having a lot of thoughts is a good thing...

dialogText.cn: 我老了，忍一忍也就过了。
dialogText.en: I'm getting old. I can just grit my teeth and get through it.

dialogText.cn: 可不能小瞧了武陵人……
dialogText.en: We can't afford to underestimate the people of Wuling...

dialogText.cn: 说不定随便哪个路边扯闲篇的阿姨，都曾经获得过宏科院六项重大研究奖项的提名。
dialogText.en: You never know, maybe even some auntie chatting by the roadside was nominated for six major research awards at the HAS.

dialogText.cn: 说不定什么时候，就轮到语轩天师你来发明个新玩意儿，吓唬后来的人了。
dialogText.en: Who knows. Maybe one day it'll be your turn, Tianshi Yuxuan, to invent something new and spook the folks coming after us.

dialogText.cn: 好主意。我脑子里一下冒出了五六种想法！
dialogText.en: Good idea. Five or six ideas just popped into my head all at once!

dialogText.cn: 您往这儿安的那个“次级核心”挺新鲜，大伙儿还在适应。
dialogText.en: That Sub-PAC you set up here is quite something! Everyone's still trying to understand how it works.

dialogText.cn: 大当家放人进来这事儿，有些兄弟还是不太放心。但毕竟东西实打实送来了，这可没有假。
dialogText.en: Some of the guys are a bit uneasy about the Chief letting outsiders in, but since the goods were genuinely delivered, there's no denying that.

dialogText.cn: 慢慢来吧。有大当家作保，我觉着再过些日子，等那个“复合式农场”建好，再有疑心的人也该知道好赖了。
dialogText.en: Give them some time. With the Chief backing you, I'd say once that farm complex is finished, those who have doubts will come around.

dialogText.cn: 有我们盯着呢，没出别的乱子。而且别看浪头是那个样子，他说话可是算数的。
dialogText.en: We've been keeping watch, no incidents so far. And don't be fooled by Lang Tou's wild nature, he's a man of his word.

dialogText.cn: 连他都消停了，其他人也不好再说什么。更何况，最近这水花子的情况是不对，很多人其实心里有谱。
dialogText.en: With him staying in check, others aren't likely to cause trouble either. Besides, things have been off with the splatters recently, and most folks know what's actually going on.

dialogText.cn: 就是武陵城这搞法也太费料了……您看好吧，我们去出出主意，保准又快又省。
dialogText.en: I must say, Wuling City's approach is just burning through materials... How about we go offer solutions that are more efficient and cost-effective?

dialogText.cn: 托各位的福，好像运作得还不错。
dialogText.en: Well, looks like it's working out pretty well, all thanks to you guys.

dialogText.cn: 看到庄稼真能离地长，原本不看好的那些人现在也有了点兴致，经常来看热闹。
dialogText.en: Seeing the crops truly grow off the ground has won over even the skeptics. They now come often to see for themselves.

dialogText.cn: 洪波说，先前凑合装上的设备早晚要一点点换掉，不过浪头嫌浪费，死活没让。
dialogText.en: Hong Bo wanted to swap out the temporary devices installed earlier, but Lang Tou rejected the idea, calling it wasteful.

dialogText.cn: 这两个家伙……我看一时半会儿是消停不了啦。
dialogText.en: What a pair... I doubt they'll quit their bickering for a while.

dialogText.cn: 好着呢，就是每次见面都要嚷嚷，非得互相喊几声“三弟”才行。
dialogText.en: Those two are doing fine, though every time they meet, they insist on calling each other "Little Bro".

dialogText.cn: 前一阵子，洪波还从城里拿了些小玩意儿让浪头研究，说是修好就让他做几天二哥。
dialogText.en: A little while back, Hong Bo brought a gadget from the city for Lang Tou to tinker with, even promising to let him be "Younger Bro" if he managed to repair it.

dialogText.cn: 浪头那叫一个来劲，不吃不睡折腾了好久，结果还真弄出点名堂来。
dialogText.en: Lang Tou got completely fired up and, after days of working nonstop without eating or sleeping, actually managed to fix it.

dialogText.cn: 这两天洪波回寨子检查设备，都得躲着他走……我倒要看看这两个活宝能拉扯到什么时候去。
dialogText.en: Now, whenever Hong Bo comes back to check the devices, he has to steer clear of Lang Tou... I'm just waiting to see how long these two will keep up their little rivalry.

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你看到河佬了就和他说声，他那边要安排的东西我已经清点好了。
dialogText.en: Darkmask, if you see He Lao, let him know I've finished counting the items he needs.

dialogText.cn: 姑且在天师府里待过，你们的东西，我总比其他人熟一些嘛。
dialogText.en: Well, I spent some time at the Tianshi Bureau, so I'm just more familiar with your stuff than most.

dialogText.cn: 刚来那会儿河佬可照顾我了，现在也算还他个人情……不多说了，我接着点数去。
dialogText.en: He Lao took good care of me when I first got here, so this is just my way of repaying the favor... Anyway, I should get back to my inventory.

dialogText.cn: 浪头这家伙……
dialogText.en: Ugh, Lang Tou...

dialogText.cn: 啊，没什么。他好像又带小宝玩去了，给他派的活儿还没做完呢。
dialogText.en: Oh, it's nothing. He's gone off to play with Bobo again. He didn't even finish the tasks I assigned him.

dialogText.cn: 算了，估计再念叨也听不进去。等他们回来，我偷偷跟小宝告状……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* It's fine. Nagging won't work on him. I'll just have a little tattle to Bobo when they return...

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，又来检查咱们的农场啦？
dialogText.en: Hey, Darkmask. Here to check out our farm?

dialogText.cn: 没呢，大伙儿还要用地方，很快就收拾干净了，也不好为这事儿再专程忙活。
dialogText.en: Not yet. Everyone needed to use the space, so we cleaned up pretty quickly. Didn't seem worth making a big deal out of it.

dialogText.cn: 洪波还在念叨那些被弄坏的金贵设备，又不是他买的，也不知道他为什么这么心疼……
dialogText.en: Hong Bo is still grumbling about those broken devices. I don't get why he's so upset ... it's not like he bought them.

dialogText.cn: 总之，最近没有再发生类似的情况。要我说，说不定压根就没人动货物，它们自己——
dialogText.en: Anyway, no such incidents have occurred lately. Honestly, I'm starting to think nobody touched the goods, maybe they just...

dialogText.cn: 是吗？唉，真遗憾……
dialogText.en: Oh... Okay...

dialogText.cn: 你来啦，先坐坐歇会儿吗？
dialogText.en: You're here. Would you like to sit and rest for a while?

dialogText.cn: 上次闹完“黑风”，大家又把东西都收拾规整了一遍，该补上的地方也都补上了。
dialogText.en: After the last Blackwind incident, we tidied everything up and reinforced all the weak spots.

dialogText.cn: 现在，就算那群野兽再来闯十次，我们也不会怕啦。
dialogText.en: Now, even if those beasts charge in ten times over, we won't be afraid.

dialogText.cn: 不过，野生动物闹得这么凶，可不是什么常见的事。
dialogText.en: But for wildlife to act so fiercely is unusual.

dialogText.cn: 如果真有什么麻烦在附近，一定很棘手……千万小心啊，黑面煞。
dialogText.en: If danger truly lurks nearby, it won't be easy to deal with... Do be careful, Darkmask.

dialogText.cn: 那些花里胡哨的水花子，三天两头就往寨里窜，说不定就是那些武陵人放的！
dialogText.en: Those flashy splatters keep sneaking into the Stockade every other day. I bet those Wuling folks are behind it!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞，你咋帮外人说话？大当家可不乐意听这个！
dialogText.en: Darkmask, why are you taking an outsider's side? Chief won't like hearing that!

dialogText.cn: 唉，我这伤，又要有好几天弄不来鳞了……
dialogText.en: Ugh, with this injury, it'll be days before I can gather any more fin...

dialogText.cn: 害寨子的人喝不上鳞汤可难整了……
dialogText.en: It's a real problem if the folks in the Stockade can't have their fin soup...

dialogText.cn: 多么？寨里一向就这么点人，但有一个就要算一个呀……
dialogText.en: Is it a lot? The Stockade's always had just these few people, but every single one counts...

dialogText.cn: 而且，对付水花子还真得拾掇把武器来，赤手空拳碰上它们就是找死啊……
dialogText.en: Besides, you're gonna need a proper weapon to deal with splatters. Going barehanded against them is just asking for trouble...

dialogText.cn: 阮哥说得对，早该听他的……不过，你们那位耍双剑的姑娘，我倒是有兴趣跟她切磋切磋。
dialogText.en: Ruan was right. We should've listened to him sooner... Anyway, I must say I'd really like to spar with that girl with two swords.

dialogText.cn: 胡闹时讨的名号，不少年头了，现在作不得数。
dialogText.en: Just a silly title from my mischievous days. It's been years. Don't take it seriously now.

dialogText.cn: 要是在这儿遇到了什么麻烦，可以来找我。
dialogText.en: If you're in some kind of trouble ... you can always ask me for help.

dialogText.cn: 寨里人有的看着不太好相处，其实也是讲道理的，我能试试帮你们说开。
dialogText.en: Some folks here may come off as intense, but they're fair-minded at heart. Let me see if I can help you talk things through.

dialogText.cn: 说来话长……所以就不说了。也许哪天有兴致了，我们再来聊这个。
dialogText.en: That's a long story... Maybe we can talk about it another day when I'm in the mood.

dialogText.cn: 总之，别处有些伤心事。这里的人也不坏，何必自寻烦恼呢？
dialogText.en: Let's just say I've left some sorrow behind. The people here are kind, so there's no point in dwelling on the past.

dialogText.cn: 之前是青芜找你们来救我的？嘿嘿……真好……她心里有我呢。
dialogText.en: So it was Qingwu who asked you to come save me? Heh ... that's really ... she does care about me.

dialogText.cn: 我要带枝花儿回去找她。
dialogText.en: I'm gonna bring a flower for her.

dialogText.cn: 我也不知道啊。女孩子都会喜欢花的吧？
dialogText.en: I really don't know. Girls would like flowers, right?

dialogText.cn: 但以青芜的性格，喜欢长青苔的石头也不好说。
dialogText.en: But knowing Qingwu, she might just prefer a moss-covered rock.

dialogText.cn: 难搞咯……
dialogText.en: Tough decisions...

dialogText.cn: 你别说，跟你们见识了一圈以后，我对咱脚底下这块土地也有了点不一样的感觉。
dialogText.en: You know, after seeing all this with you folks, I'm starting to feel a bit different about the land right under our feet.

dialogText.cn: 就感觉水还是水吗，土还是土吗，我的手还是手吗……
dialogText.en: It's like, is water still just water? Is soil still just soil? Are my hands even my hands anymore...

dialogText.cn: 完了，搞得我也开始像李惴一样杞人忧天起来了！
dialogText.en: Great, now you've got me overthinking everything like Li Zhui too!

dialogText.cn: 我得回回神……
dialogText.en: I need to clear my head...

dialogText.cn: 在清波寨这地头办事，确实还得讲点手法，唉。
dialogText.en: Getting things done here in Qingbo Stockade really does take some finesse, huh.

dialogText.cn: 书读了那么多本，却还是被人家一句话噎回去……
dialogText.en: I've read so many books, yet I still get shut down by a single line...

dialogText.cn: 虽然您这话是安慰我……
dialogText.en: I know you're trying to make me feel better...

dialogText.cn: 不过好在和浪头的关系缓过来了，以后就好商量了！
dialogText.en: At least things have smoothed over with Lang Tou now. Should be easier to talk things out from here on!

dialogText.cn: ……好商量了吧？
dialogText.en: ...So we can talk this out, right?

dialogText.cn: 嘿，我也没想过有朝一日还能跟小天师拜上把子。
dialogText.en: Hey, never thought I'd live to see the day I'd become sworn brothers with the young Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 在清波寨这地头当然是我当哥啊！
dialogText.en: Of course I'm the big brother here in Qingbo Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 去他们武陵，听他的，自然就是他了。
dialogText.en: When we're in Wuling, he gets to be the big bro. Simple as that.

dialogText.cn: 咱们各论各的，正似那水无常形啊！
dialogText.en: We each do things our own way, just like water has no constant shape!

dialogText.cn: 你们来过这块吗？这里是农业天师专门研究庄稼的基地。历史很久了喔！
dialogText.en: Have you been here before? This is a base where Nongye Tianshi specialize in crop research. It's been around for ages!

dialogText.cn: 收成……不好说，看导师心情，看项目进度，还要看天。
dialogText.en: The harvest... hard to say. It depends on the master's mood, the project's progress, and the weather.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这么看基本没有什么事儿取决于个人意志。
dialogText.en: Yeah, looking at it that way, almost nothing really depends on personal will.

dialogText.cn: 怪不得阿土要换专业……
dialogText.en: No wonder Ah Tu is changing majors...

dialogText.cn: “活体天使水”“星辰”“岳研避瘴茶”“考运特饮”……
dialogText.en: "Living Aggeloi Extract", "Stardust", "Eureka Anti-smog Tincture", "Good Luck Exam Sip"...

dialogText.cn: 品类较为单调的自动贩售机。
dialogText.en: An auto-vendor that doesn't have much variety.

dialogText.cn: 代表着“考运特饮”的按钮已经被磨得凹了进去。
dialogText.en: The "Good Luck Exam Sip" button seems rubbed down from being pressed so much.

dialogText.cn: 某种意义上，这座息壤炉是武陵心脏之一。
dialogText.en: This Xiranite forge is more than a unit. It's one of Wuling's beating hearts.

dialogText.cn: 它产出的息壤如同血液，时刻在武陵血管中涌动。
dialogText.en: The Xiranite it produces flows through the city like lifeblood, sustaining us all.

dialogText.cn: “方兴街道办提醒您，侵蚀无小事，请尽快前往卫生服务站接受免费体检！”
dialogText.en: "A reminder from Fangxing Subdistrict Office. Blight is no laughing matter. Visit your closest healthcare stop for a free checkup!"

dialogText.cn: 告示牌上新贴了这样的文字。
dialogText.en: These words have been written on a sign.

dialogText.cn: “特调避瘴茶，每日8:00至14:00限时免费供应”。
dialogText.en: "Special Anti-smog Tincture. Served free every 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM."

dialogText.cn: 广告牌上写着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: These words have been written on an advertising board.

dialogText.cn: 这张桌子依旧一尘不染，不知是不是错觉，其附近龙泡泡的“浓度”似乎提高了。
dialogText.en: This table is spotlessly clean. The "concentration" of Chubby Lungs nearby has increased, though it may just be an illusion.

dialogText.cn: 或是有关斩断烦恼，或是有关雄心壮志……剑桩石雕上刻着各式各样的话语。
dialogText.en: The sword pell sculptures bear all sorts of inscriptions that cite aspirations to greatness or the cutting down of various frustrations.

dialogText.cn: 弃剑台是天师明誓之所，他们的誓言仍回荡于此，这些武器便是痕迹。
dialogText.en: Qijian Dais is where the Tianshi swore their allegiance. Those powerful oaths still echo in this place. The weapons are mere marks of their dedication.

dialogText.cn: “浊海未平，万难坐观——天师黎、天师风”。
dialogText.en: "We shall not rest till the Turbid Sea is quelled — Tianshi Li and Tianshi Feng."

dialogText.cn: 剑身上刻有如此小字。
dialogText.en: These are the tiny words inscribed upon the body of the blade.

dialogText.cn: 从屏幕上的内容看，这些设备似乎在进行有关息壤材料固化的数据运算。
dialogText.en: Contents of the screen suggest that these facilities are carrying out calculations for the fixation and shaping of Xiranite materials.

dialogText.cn: “关于高密度息壤材料在城防工事中的应用验证……”
dialogText.en: "Validation of urban defense applications of high density Xiranite-based materials..."

dialogText.cn: 屏幕上还有如此字样。
dialogText.en: The screen also displayed these words.

dialogText.cn: “有关调整源石浓度以提高息壤产量的可行性探讨”。
dialogText.en: A Feasibility Study on Adjusting Originium Concentration to Increase Xiranite Production

dialogText.cn: 白板上写着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the white board.

dialogText.cn: “源石活性增强技术研究——与四号谷地合作项目”。
dialogText.en: Originium Activity Enhancement Research: A Joint Project with Valley IV

dialogText.cn: 文件夹备注处写着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: The tab on the folder reads these lines.

dialogText.cn: “息壤在下一场可能的天使战争中的应用状况模拟”。
dialogText.en: "Simulation of Xiranite Applications in a Potential Future Aggeloi War".

dialogText.cn: 文件夹备注处写着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: The tab on the folder reads these lines.

dialogText.cn: “大型息壤飞行器设计思路汇总”。
dialogText.en: Design Overview: Large Xiranite Aircraft

dialogText.cn: 文件夹备注处写着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: The tab on the folder reads these lines.

dialogText.cn: 巨大的剑桩，它代表着铸剑之劲、铸剑之势、铸剑之意。
dialogText.en: The giant sword pell stands for the force, momentum, and purpose behind swordforge.

dialogText.cn: 包裹里有各式各样的杂物。
dialogText.en: The package is filled with a mix of random things.

dialogText.cn: 糖果、几张折金票、钢笔，以及《针对全部作战环境——标准/龙泡泡二形态变换式战车设计图》。
dialogText.en: Candy, a few T-Creds, a fountain pen, and the "All-Environment Combat — Standard/Chubby Lung Type II Transformable Armored Vehicle Design".

dialogText.cn: 这张图纸拥有一定可操作性。
dialogText.en: This design is actually somewhat workable.

dialogText.cn: “在寨子里是种地，在武陵城还是种地，我的人生大抵只能如此了。”
dialogText.en: "Whether in the stockade or here in Wuling City, all I do is farm. Perhaps this is all my life will ever be: nothing but tilling the soil until the end of my days."

dialogText.cn: 纸张上有如此灰心丧气的文字。
dialogText.en: Written on the paper were these gloomy words.

dialogText.cn: 虽然已经经过处置，但白霜的源石技艺所留下的破坏痕迹依旧十分明显。
dialogText.en: Even after the repairs, the traces of damage left by Bai Shuang's Originium Arts remain striking.

dialogText.cn: 仅仅是下意识就能用出这样的力量，她是不是选错志愿的专业了呢……
dialogText.en: To unleash such power without even realizing it ... maybe she chose the wrong major after all.

dialogText.cn: “招待小院（甲等）”。
dialogText.en: Cozy Courtyard (A+)

dialogText.cn: 门牌上写着这样的内容。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the gate.

dialogText.cn: 这种小院的住宿费用通常高得吓人，少有游商能够承担。
dialogText.en: The fees for this kind of courtyard are usually exorbitant — far beyond what most traveling merchants can afford.

dialogText.cn: “沧贼凶猛，行至景玉谷，请小心清波寨水匪。”
dialogText.en: Beware the Cangzei pirates. As you enter Jingyu Valley, watch out for the Qingbo river bandits.

dialogText.cn: 告示牌上写着这样的话。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the sign.

dialogText.cn: 展示着武陵城全貌的息壤沙盘，在必要时，可以通过它看到城中所有细节。
dialogText.en: A Xiranite sandbox displaying Wuling City in its entirety. It allows you to see every detail of the city when needed.

dialogText.cn: 椅子背上贴着龙泡泡贴纸，但不知为何看起来有些奇怪。
dialogText.en: There's a Chubby Lung sticker on the back of the chair, though for some reason it looks a bit off.

dialogText.cn: 奇怪的感觉主要来自于“厚度”，这张龙泡泡夏日限定款贴纸下一定有着厚厚的胶痕。
dialogText.en: The thickness is what makes it look odd. This Summer Limited Chubby Lung sticker has been piled on itself countless times.

dialogText.cn: 只有反复更新贴纸，日积月累，才会如此。张贴者……真是很喜欢龙泡泡。
dialogText.en: Whoever put this up is clearly a huge fan of Chubby Lung. They've layered it again and again...

dialogText.cn: 宽大的办公桌上堆放着各式物品。
dialogText.en: The wide desk is covered with all sorts of things.

dialogText.cn: 从文件，再到书籍和水杯，尤其是桌边的小爪杖……能看出使用者废寝忘食在此工作的痕迹。
dialogText.en: Files, books, a mug, and a little clawed staff by the edge. Every item hints at the owner's tireless, round-the-clock dedication.

dialogText.cn: 《天师府雷法总纲及实用化精简思路》……
dialogText.en: "Tianshi Bureau's Thunder Arts: Core Principles and Practical Applications"...

dialogText.cn: 《息壤生产方法二期迭代汇报》……
dialogText.en: "Xiranite Production Methods: Phase II Iteration Report"...

dialogText.cn: 《巡卫兵装升级方案》……
dialogText.en: "Watchguard Weapon Upgrade Plan"...

dialogText.cn: 桌上的文件五花八门。
dialogText.en: Various files sit on the desk.

dialogText.cn: 《龙泡泡设计草稿》……
dialogText.en: "Chubby Lung Design Draft"...

dialogText.cn: 此处有一道极细微，却极度深邃的剑痕。
dialogText.en: A fine, razor-thin sword mark cuts through the surface, deep beyond belief.

dialogText.cn: 痕迹尚温，似乎有人刚刚还在此演练剑法。
dialogText.en: It's still fresh ... someone must've been training here just moments ago.

dialogText.cn: 音箱里播放着极有节奏感的激昂音乐，只听数秒便会有被人揉捏心脏的新奇体验。
dialogText.en: From the speakers comes a pulse-pounding melody that grips your heart within seconds.

dialogText.cn: 虽然这曲子过于土气，但不知为何，多听片刻竟会让人恋恋不舍起来。
dialogText.en: It's a bit tacky, but somehow, the longer you listen, the harder it is to stop.

dialogText.cn: 此处张贴着一张绘画比赛活动的通知。
dialogText.en: A poster for a drawing contest is posted here.

dialogText.cn: “我们的宏山……”
dialogText.en: "Our Hongshan..."

dialogText.cn: 似乎是面对学龄前，尚未去过宏山本部的孩子们展开的活动。
dialogText.en: Looks like this contest is for preschoolers who haven't visited Hongshan Headquarters yet.

dialogText.cn: 菜单上能看到各式口味的能量棒。
dialogText.en: The menu lists energy bars in a variety of flavors.

dialogText.cn: “天使战争陈年军粮”口味、“叙拉古人的绝望”口味……
dialogText.en: A Taste of Rations from the Aggeloi War... Despair of Siracusans...

dialogText.cn: 是否过于新奇……
dialogText.en: These are rather peculiar...

dialogText.cn: “[龙泡泡·景玉谷冒险家]限定款挂饰，及[龙泡泡×选剑局]联名无人机外壳，即将开售，敬请期待。”
dialogText.en: Coming soon: the "Chubby Lung - Jingyu Valley Adventurer" Limited Keychain and the "Chubby Lung × Bureau of Swordmancers" Collab Drone Case. Don't miss it!

dialogText.cn: 这里是天桩的“家”，它们会在这里补充息壤。
dialogText.en: This area is home to the sky poles, where they replenish Xiranite.

dialogText.cn: 这些可爱的小东西在武陵城终日忙碌，是随叫随到的热心智能小助手。
dialogText.en: These diligent little units work tirelessly in Wuling, always ready to assist when called.

dialogText.cn: “方兴街道办提醒您，任何宣称能提前购买未发售龙泡泡的通信，都是诈骗，请勿相信。”
