dialogText.en: Reminder from Fangxing Subdistrict Office: any communication claiming you can get Chubby Lung before their official release is a scam. Don't fall for it.

dialogText.cn: 告示板上写着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the official notice.

dialogText.cn: 简单的水流景致，实际上是武陵技术最低调但也最豪放的展示。
dialogText.en: This simple waterscape stands as a subtle yet magnificent showcase of Wuling's technical prowess.

dialogText.cn: 在息壤装置的作用下，此处的循环水流永远处在可直饮状态。
dialogText.en: With the Xiranite facilities in place, the circulating water here is always safe for drinking.

dialogText.cn: 《息壤技术与武陵装置设计——杰出返校天师讲座》
dialogText.en: Xiranite Technology and Wuling Device Design — Lecture by a Distinguished Returning Tianshi

dialogText.cn: 看起来像是报名表的纸张上写着这样的标题。
dialogText.en: This title is written across what appears to be a sign up sheet.

dialogText.cn: 武陵的各种装置，大部分兼备实用性与美感，当真是大师级的设计水平。
dialogText.en: Nearly every device in Wuling marries utility with elegance, a testament to design at a masterful level.

dialogText.cn: “日新月异”。
dialogText.en: "Something new every day."

dialogText.cn: 这是武陵天师府学院的校训。
dialogText.en: This is the motto of the Tianshi Bureau Academy of Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 有了集成工业系统来帮我们量产息壤……息壤炉是不是就能空出来了？
dialogText.en: Now that the AIC Factory can mass-produce Xiranite, does that mean the Xiranite forge is free now...?

dialogText.cn: 你又想打什么主意？
dialogText.en: What are you scheming?

dialogText.cn: 继续研究枢壤仪啊！
dialogText.en: I just want to continue my research on the Xiranite Nexus!

dialogText.cn: 别忘了，我们真正的目标还是封闭甚大裂隙！
dialogText.en: Let's not forget our true goal is still to seal the Very Large Rift!

dialogText.cn: 怎么可能忘……我老师也牺牲在十年前那场事故里。
dialogText.en: How could I forget... My mentor also perished in that accident ten years ago.

dialogText.cn: 武陵新潮竹沥奶茶第二杯半价！一杯独饮开怀，两杯开启幸福。
dialogText.en: Try Wuling's trendy Bamboo Dew Milk Tea! Half off your second cup! One for solitary joy, two to unlock happiness!

dialogText.cn: 客人，我看你已经在周围转悠半天了。
dialogText.en: Hey, you've been around for a bit.

dialogText.cn: 要不带你朋友来买两杯，开启幸福哦！
dialogText.en: How about you and your friend treat yourselves to a couple of drinks? It'll kickstart some happiness!

dialogText.cn: 唉，这回天使闹得太凶了，都进到城里了。
dialogText.en: Ugh. The Aggeloi got really mean with this attack. They even made their way into the city.

dialogText.cn: 要不是庄天师和终末地出手，麻烦可就大喽……
dialogText.en: If not for Tianshi Zhuang and the Endfielders, we'd be in for some sticky trouble...

dialogText.cn: 我肯定没事，只可惜没能亲自上场打天使！
dialogText.en: I'm alright. Just a little sore that I didn't get to squish the jelly buggers myself!

dialogText.cn: 要是我年轻时候，不！只要早个十年……我铁定上去打天使了。
dialogText.en: If I were at my prime... NO! I just need to be ten years younger... I'll be squishing buggers left and right.

dialogText.cn: 到底还是老喽……幸好咱们年轻的天师、巡卫都不赖。
dialogText.en: But these old bones got cranky... Thankfully we got some reliable young Tianshi and Watchguards.

dialogText.cn: 唉，不服老不行啊……
dialogText.en: Ugh. Age can be very unforgiving...

dialogText.cn: 你说，咱们这回到底算停工还是放假啊？
dialogText.en: So, is this considered downtime or an actual holiday?

dialogText.cn: 这回大战，城里游客又变少了，我担心等咱们的机器修好，也拉不到活儿啊……
dialogText.en: The city is getting a lot less tourists after the battle. Even if the machines were repaired, I don't think we'd be getting business...

dialogText.cn: 我也这么觉得，那么大阵仗都熬过来了。还别说，咱这回也算是见义勇为了吧。
dialogText.en: I think so too. We turned that huge slugfest around. Hell, we even volunteered and fought the good fight.

dialogText.cn: 那一天，我可是瞅着终末地的英雄踏上我那台机器越过大火的！
dialogText.en: Know what happened that day? The heroes of Endfield rode through the fire on my machine!

dialogText.cn: 可惜我们的那几台机器，没能撑过大火啊……
dialogText.en: But our machines... they didn't survive the fire...

dialogText.cn: 算了，回头去方兴衢坐一坐，潘师傅应该会给我们打折吧。
dialogText.en: Whatever. Let's just look around Fangxing Avenue. Maybe Master Da Pan will give us a discount.

dialogText.cn: 肯定会的，等会儿一起去，趁着难得休息，好好撮上一顿！
dialogText.en: Of course he will. Just enjoy this break and then we'll head over. Gotta celebrate with a feast!

dialogText.cn: 武陵城这波侵蚀潮也太凶险了，关键时刻还好我足够清醒，在城外跟上了巡卫……
dialogText.en: The Wuling Blight Tide is way too dangerous. If I lost my cool or failed to follow the watchguards outside the city...

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二最伟大的植物学家差点就陨落了！
dialogText.en: ...the greatest botanist ever of Talos-II would be no more!

dialogText.cn: 保存有限之身，才是对无限的植物生态事业负责。
dialogText.en: Gotta keep myself secure. It's the only way to live up to the endless duties of my botanical enterprise.

dialogText.cn: 你说得对，收集种子刻不容缓，已经耽搁进度了，我得赶紧行动起来。
dialogText.en: You're right. Seed foraging must begin at once. My progress is already behind. I must start quickly.

dialogText.cn: 等我把武陵地区的植物收进种子库后，又要出发了。
dialogText.en: Once I gather the seeds of the Wuling flora, I'll be off again.

dialogText.cn: 听说武陵在北边有座关隘，环境险恶。
dialogText.en: They say there's a pass north of Wuling located in a dangerous environment.

dialogText.cn: 那里的特殊环境，代表着会有特殊的植物种类……
dialogText.en: Special biomes often give rise to special botanical species...

dialogText.cn: 幸好前线的大家都平安回来了……
dialogText.en: Thank goodness. Everyone who fought at the frontlines made it back...

dialogText.cn: 息壤堰遭受冲击，水质数据略有变化，但没有发生超标的情况。
dialogText.en: They managed to hit the Xiranite Dam. Water quality readings fluctuated a bit, but nothing went beyond the acceptable range.

dialogText.cn: 唉，老师之前告诉过我，日常工作疏忽不得，那时只当耳旁风……
dialogText.en: My mentor kept telling me how important the daily routines are. I hardly paid attention to those reminders...

dialogText.cn: 如今经历了一场大战，看到那天大家连口净水都顾不上喝……
dialogText.en: But having lived through the huge battle and seeing everyone in need of proper clean water...

dialogText.cn: 我才明白，就是这些日常工作维护着武陵城普通人的安宁。
dialogText.en: ...I finally learned that it was the daily routines that kept the peace of ordinary Wulingers.

dialogText.cn: 哪有什么凭空得来的岁月静好啊……
dialogText.en: Peace was never a thing that fell right into our laps...

dialogText.cn: 我想明白了，天师的日常工作就是为了保证人人安宁，饮水无忧！
dialogText.en: I figured it out. The routine work of the Tianshi is to keep everyone safe and make sure potable water is easily available!

dialogText.cn: 何来枯燥，以后我得加倍努力，绝不怠慢！
dialogText.en: It's not boring! I'm doubling my efforts to make sure everything's done right!

dialogText.cn: 这都几天了，不是说等没事就过来做检查吗？
dialogText.en: How many days has it been? I thought I told you to get a health check when you got time.

dialogText.cn: 你们整天上天入地的，身体健康疏忽不得……
dialogText.en: You people kept rushing all over the place. Health is something you can't afford to neglect...

dialogText.cn: 不光是身体健康，还有心理问题，这几天你有和方宜聊过吗？
dialogText.en: By health I mean physical as well as mental health. Did you talk to Zhuang Fangyi recently?

dialogText.cn: 我看她这些天总皱着眉，看上去心事重重……
dialogText.en: She has been frowning for several days. Something's on her mind...

dialogText.cn: 你可得重视起来，很多大病都是从心事积郁起来的。
dialogText.en: You should take a look. A buildup of stress eventually leads to a major illness.

dialogText.cn: 你得……不，你必须要好好开解方宜！
dialogText.en: You should... No. You must have a proper talk with her!

dialogText.cn: 那可要说到做到啊。
dialogText.en: I'm holding you to your words.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，小庄她是不是遇到事了？
dialogText.en: Endmin, is Zhuang doing okay?

dialogText.cn: 这几天看到她心事重重的样子。问了，又说自己没事。
dialogText.en: Something is weighing down heavily on her. I tried to ask but she told me she's fine.

dialogText.cn: 小庄对我总是报喜不报忧，这习惯一直没变过。
dialogText.en: Zhuang only shared the good news with me. It's a habit that never changed.

dialogText.cn: 唉，你这报喜不报忧的模样和小庄真像。
dialogText.en: And you're just the same. Only sharing the good news with me.

dialogText.cn: 我一直看着这界石坪，有没有事我还不知道吗？
dialogText.en: For years I've watched over the Marker Stone Flats. I can obviously tell if we have trouble.

dialogText.cn: 坪中央的那盏灯，大战之后一直没亮起来，肯定是遇到麻烦了。
dialogText.en: The lamp at the center of the flats stayed dark after the battle. There's definitely trouble somewhere.

dialogText.cn: 直到最近它才重新亮起，你们却都告诉我没问题……
dialogText.en: It only lit up again recently. Yet everyone tells me that things are fine...

dialogText.cn: 行吧，你和小庄都是心里有数的，我就不瞎操心了。
dialogText.en: Oh well. I suppose you and Zhuang know what's going on. This old lady will stop getting worked up.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，小庄她总藏着心事，你可要好好帮衬着她。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Zhuang has a habit of harboring secrets. Just try to help the poor girl.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还没好好感谢过你们。
dialogText.en: Endmin, never had the chance to properly thank you and your team.

dialogText.cn: 守卫阵列核心时，要不是你们及时出手，我们哥几个可就惨了，多谢各位啊！
dialogText.en: If it weren't for you during the defense of the Array Core, all of us would be in deep trouble. We owe you our lives.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，黎风是咱巡卫的好小伙，早就给安排上了。
dialogText.en: Heheh. Lifeng is a fellow watchguard. Got a celebration lined up for him.

dialogText.cn: 还别说，那小子上过阵之后，整个人都不一样了。
dialogText.en: FYI, that kid became totally different after facing an actual battle.

dialogText.cn: 战场果然是新兵成长最快的地方啊……
dialogText.en: The battlefield turns out to be the best place to forge raw recruits into proper soldiers...

dialogText.cn: 唉，对黎风而言，这究竟算好事还是坏事呢？
dialogText.en: Hmm. I wonder if this is a good or a bad thing for Lifeng.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多亏有你们在……这批试验田都保住了！
dialogText.en: Endmin, oh, so glad you were here... The test fields are safe!

dialogText.cn: 光说不行，白霜，把我们准备好的礼物拿出来。
dialogText.en: Our appreciation must go beyond words. Bai Shuang, bring out the gifts.

dialogText.cn: 金石稻，琼叶参。这批种子可都是优选的上上品。
dialogText.en: Amber Rice and Redjade Ginseng. These seeds are the best we've selected.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这些作物的品质和味道都不错，挑个喜欢的收下吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, these crops were chosen for quality and flavor. Choose and take what you like.

dialogText.cn: 不要客气，阿庄可专程叮嘱过我们，得让终末地满意而归。
dialogText.en: Don't be shy. Zhuang specifically told us to satisfy the Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，多亏你帮忙。枢壤仪这回能派上用场了……
dialogText.en: Thanks for helping, Endmin. The Xiranite Nexus can finally do its work...

dialogText.cn: 我们需要一手数据，后面还有得忙呢！
dialogText.en: We need some first-hand readings. Things will get way busier from here!

dialogText.cn: 可你也不能催着管理员和庄天师拿数据吧，人家两位……
dialogText.en: But you can't rush the Endmin or Tianshi Zhuang for data. They're...

dialogText.cn: 我可没催人家，我是在催你。
dialogText.en: I'm not rushing them. I'm rushing you.

dialogText.cn: 别松懈了，枢壤仪的研究还有很多前期工作要准备……
dialogText.en: You better not slack off. Preparing the Xiranite Nexus involves a ton of work...

dialogText.cn: 呦，管理员，今儿有空尝尝辣么大的红油锅不？
dialogText.en: Yo. Endmin. Interested in trying LA-ME-DA's red oil hotpot?

dialogText.cn: 嘿，我还以为啥事呢。早就打听到了……
dialogText.en: Hah. I thought you got actual news for me. That one's real old...

dialogText.cn: 照我说，息壤研究好不容易有了大突破，是时候开一门新课了。
dialogText.en: The way I see it, we made a major breakthrough in Xiranite sciences. About time we got a new course on that.

dialogText.cn: 总不至于往后的研究，还让庄管代她自个儿挑大梁，多些后来人才好。
dialogText.en: We can't force her to do all the heavy lifting in other future projects. Better get more graduates from this field quickly.

dialogText.cn: 她是该放松放松，趁闲暇时多回学院教一教新课程，收点新学生。
dialogText.en: She should take a break from governance. Give a few lectures for the new course and accept a few disciples when she can.

dialogText.cn: 您瞧着吧，这武陵城的未来早晚属于年轻人，庄管代她比我这前浪可清醒多了。
dialogText.en: Just look at it. The youths are the future of Wuling. The Viceroy should see it more clearly than an old geezer like me.

dialogText.cn: 行了，该吃吃，该喝喝，各忙各的去吧。
dialogText.en: Alright. Eat, drink, and do your stuff.

dialogText.cn: 辣么大的红油锅，我会一直给你们备着！
dialogText.en: I'll always set aside a LA-ME-DA red oil hotpot. Just for you!

dialogText.cn: 大战那天，我隔得远也看见诸位在前线的表现了。
dialogText.en: During that huge battle, I saw how you fought from my vantage point.

dialogText.cn: 太厉害了，不论是庄天师还是终末地的各位！
dialogText.en: Truly incredible! That goes for Tianshi Zhuang and Team Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 多亏你们拦住了聂菲斯的最后反扑……
dialogText.en: We were lucky you were there to stop Nefarith's last ditch madness...

dialogText.cn: 那一刻，我都以为观测站要被侵蚀潮淹没了！
dialogText.en: Back then, I thought the Blight Tide would flood the entire monitoring center!

dialogText.cn: 万幸，这次观测站终于挺过去了……可别有下回了！
dialogText.en: The monitoring center survived by the slimmest of margins... I hope we don't have to experience this again!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，还有千语姐！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Supervisor Perlica! And Operator Chen!

dialogText.cn: 这次同大家并肩作战，让我学到很多技巧。
dialogText.en: I learned a ton of techniques fighting along your side.

dialogText.cn: 就是……不知道以后还有机会吗？我还想同各位前辈学习。
dialogText.en: But I ... I wonder if I'd get another chance like this. I really want to keep learning from you.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，我会加油努力，继续期待那天的！
dialogText.en: That's great! I'm gonna double my efforts till that day arrives!

dialogText.cn: 呦，管理员，您来了。
dialogText.en: Hey, Endmin! You're here!

dialogText.cn: 今儿眼馋哪个口味，我亲自给您掌勺！
dialogText.en: Craving anything today? I'll cook it up for you myself!

dialogText.cn: 要是没想好也甭急，您找个空位儿先坐坐。
dialogText.en: No rush if you haven't decided yet. Just grab a seat and make yourself comfortable.

dialogText.cn: 说不定，闻着闻着味儿就有想法喽。
dialogText.en: Maybe the aroma will help you decide.

dialogText.cn: 感谢终末地的各位，观测站的设备恢复情况比我预期的还要好！
dialogText.en: Big thanks to you all, Endfielders! The monitoring center's facilities are back online and running smoother than I expected!

dialogText.cn: 接下来的工作，请交给我们吧。
dialogText.en: Please leave the upcoming work to us.

dialogText.cn: 天使和侵蚀造成的破坏，虽然清理起来还要费上一些工夫，但也并无大碍。
dialogText.en: It might take us some time to clean up the mess caused by the Aggeloi and the Blight, but things should be fine from here on.

dialogText.cn: 主要监测单元都已经恢复运转，监测数据也恢复同步更新了。
dialogText.en: The main monitoring units are fully functional, and the data streams have resumed syncing.

dialogText.cn: 按照庄天师的安排，我们会全力配合终末地搜索聂菲斯的踪迹！
dialogText.en: As per Tianshi Zhuang's instructions, we'll fully cooperate with Endfield in tracking down Nefarith!

dialogText.cn: 来点能量棒，遇到天使都不慌！
dialogText.en: Grab an energy bar, face Aggeloi without a scar!

dialogText.cn: 最近天使好像更活跃了……
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi seem more active lately.

dialogText.cn: 欸，你们看着不像本地人，也是刚从阵列外进来避难的？
dialogText.en: You don't look local. Also seeking shelter?

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么说，能安全进来就好。
dialogText.en: Anyway, I'm just glad you made it in safely.

dialogText.cn: 只是没想到，庄天师又亲自出手解决麻烦……
dialogText.en: Didn't expect Tianshi Zhuang to handle trouble again...

dialogText.cn: 当然不是！
dialogText.en: Of course not!

dialogText.cn: 外面的天师桩阵列你也看到了。平时有它们在，不光天使，就算是侵蚀潮淹过来，也别想进武陵城。
dialogText.en: You saw the Tianshi Pillar Array outside. With them standing guard, not even Aggeloi or a Blight Tide can breach Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 可最近城外的情况在恶化，巡卫都忙不过来，庄天师也不得不出手帮忙。
dialogText.en: But things outside are worsening. Watchguards are overwhelmed, so Tianshi Zhuang had to step in.

dialogText.cn: 唉，一直这么下去可不行，得早点查清楚原因……
dialogText.en: *Sigh*. This can't go on. We must find out why soon.

dialogText.cn: 如果城外情况一直没好转，以后游客会不会越来越少……
dialogText.en: If things outside don't improve, will tourists even keep coming?

dialogText.cn: 轮不到你瞎操心这些！
dialogText.en: None of your business worrying about that!

dialogText.cn: 走走走，你要心情不好，我陪你去抽限量版龙泡泡。
dialogText.en: Come on, if you're down, I'll take you to draw the limited Chubby Lung.

dialogText.cn: 紧张啥？武陵城要真有这么脆弱，方兴衢就不会建在这么靠近城外的地方了。
dialogText.en: Why stress? If Wuling were that fragile, Fangxing Avenue wouldn't be built so close to the outskirts.

dialogText.cn: 看你们的样子，也是刚来？方兴衢吃喝玩乐都有，来一趟不容易，可得好好逛逛！
dialogText.en: Looks like you just arrived? Fangxing Avenue has it all. Enjoy your visit!

dialogText.cn: 如果不嫌味大，那边的火锅店味道一绝！
dialogText.en: If you don't mind the smell, that hotpot place is amazing!

dialogText.cn: 对了，前面还有武陵特供的龙泡泡！只此一家，其他地方可找不到。
dialogText.en: By the way, there are Wuling-exclusive Chubby Lung ahead! Can't find them anywhere else.

dialogText.cn: 是啊。没想到建在裂隙上的城市会有这么繁荣的景象。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Never thought a city built on a rift could thrive like this.

dialogText.cn: 费这么大劲过来，这边的种子最好别让我失望。
dialogText.en: We came all this way. These seeds better not disappoint.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？是你？
dialogText.en: Hm? You?

dialogText.cn: 我才刚听说了你在四号谷地的事迹，怎么在这里见到你了！
dialogText.en: I just heard about your deeds in Valley IV. Can't believe you're here!

dialogText.cn: 旅游？我是来工作的！
dialogText.en: Vacay? I'm here for work!

dialogText.cn: 武陵地区的很多植物还没被我收进种子库呢！
dialogText.en: So many Wuling plants still missing from my seed bank!

dialogText.cn: 怎么？你觉得我和那些只会躲在实验室里的人一个样？
dialogText.en: What? You think I'm like those lab cowards hiding indoors?

dialogText.cn: 我还得给后人留下塔卫二最全的种子库呢！
dialogText.en: I still need to build Talos-II's most complete seed bank!

dialogText.cn: 那些巡卫，说什么外面危险，非要把我塞进城里。耽误我多少时间！
dialogText.en: Those watchguards said it's dangerous outside and forced me into the city. Wasted so much time!

dialogText.cn: 我还没来得及把那些会动的竹子放进我的种子库！
dialogText.en: I didn't even get to add those moving bamboos to my seed bank!

dialogText.cn: 对了，听说北边还有甚大裂隙爆发留下的废墟，里面会不会有还没被发现的植物……
dialogText.en: Heard there's ruins north from the Very Large Rift. Any undiscovered plants there?

dialogText.cn: 明明水质数据每天都一样，还要天天测……
dialogText.en: We test every day even though the readings never change...

dialogText.cn: 还能做什么，监测息流系统的水质呗。
dialogText.en: Just checking the Xiranflow's water quality.

dialogText.cn: 就你眼前这个息流总闸放出来的水。
dialogText.en: The water from this main Xiranflow sluice right here.

dialogText.cn: 水坝？你是说息流总闸？
dialogText.en: The dam? You mean the main Xiranflow sluice?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，好久没听到这么朴素的叫法了。
dialogText.en: Hah, haven't heard it called that in a long time.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我只是天天做同一件事，有点烦躁了。
dialogText.en: Sorry, I'm just a bit frustrated from doing the same thing every day.

dialogText.cn: 上面的息壤堰，它会源源不断把被净化的清水送出来，供应全城使用。
dialogText.en: The Xiranite Dam up there constantly releases purified water, supplying the entire city.

dialogText.cn: 水质的数据也会直接反映息壤堰的状况。
dialogText.en: The water quality data will directly reflect the condition of the Xiranite Dam.

dialogText.cn: 这些水的源头都是息壤堰。它会源源不断地把被净化的清水送出来，供应全城使用。
dialogText.en: All this water comes from the Xiranite Dam. It continuously sends out purified water to supply the entire city.

dialogText.cn: 水质的数据也会直接反映息壤堰的状况。
dialogText.en: The water quality data will directly reflect the condition of the Xiranite Dam.

dialogText.cn: 唉，所以就算我再不情愿，这件事也不敢怠慢。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*, so even if I really don't want to, I can't slack off on this.

dialogText.cn: 小庄她应该已经回来了吧？
dialogText.en: Zhuang should be back by now, right?

dialogText.cn: 对……欸，你们是终末地的人？
dialogText.en: Yeah ... wait, aren't you from Endfield?

dialogText.cn: 小庄，咳，庄天师提过你们要来，她应该已经在总桩办公室等你们了。
dialogText.en: Zhuang — ahem, Tianshi Zhuang mentioned you'd be coming. She's probably waiting in the Main Pillar Office already.

dialogText.cn: 就在那条界龙的后面。
dialogText.en: Right behind that Boundary Lung.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟息壤堰的下方就是裂隙多发区域，我们投入了大量的息壤来修建堰体，确保万无一失。
dialogText.en: After all, the area below the Xiranite Dam is prone to rifts. We invested massive amounts of Xiranite to build the dam, ensuring absolute security.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师办公室所在的总桩，更是稳定息壤堰，调控全城息壤能源的核心。
dialogText.en: The Main Pillar, where Tianshi Zhuang's office is located, serves as the core for stabilizing the Xiranite Dam and regulating the city's entire Xiranite energy supply.

dialogText.cn: 因为它是全城息壤能源的总控中心，庄天师也把自己的办公室安置在了总桩里。
dialogText.en: As the control center for the city's entire Xiranite energy grid, Tianshi Zhuang established her office within the Main Pillar itself.

dialogText.cn: 而且我们投入了大量的息壤来修建息壤堰，总桩作为核心节点，能够帮助稳定武陵地区的裂隙。
dialogText.en: Besides, we poured a huge amount of Xiranite into building the Xiranite Dam. The Main Pillar is the key node that helps keep the local rift stable.

dialogText.cn: 不如说，整个武陵城都在裂隙之上。
dialogText.en: Hmm, actually, you could say the whole Wuling City is sitting on top of the rift.

dialogText.cn: 各位，别耽搁了，她还在等你们呢。
dialogText.en: Alright everyone, no more stalling. She's still waiting for you.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你也对息壤堰感兴趣吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, interested to know more about the Xiranite Dam?

dialogText.cn: 为什么还要有更多需要承担风险的城市呢？
dialogText.en: Why do there need to be more cities that have to shoulder such risks?

dialogText.cn: 息壤堰可以继续延伸下去，但武陵城……一座足矣。
dialogText.en: Let the Xiranite Dam extend, but let there be only one Wuling City...

dialogText.cn: 首墩，息壤堰从那里开始延伸。
dialogText.en: The Xiranite Dam begins at the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 我们用了近十年的时间才把息壤堰建设到如此规模……
dialogText.en: It took us nearly ten years to build the Xiranite Dam to this state...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，无论武陵城如今的生活有多安逸，我们都不会忘记，遏制甚大裂隙才是这座城市的使命。
dialogText.en: Endmin, no matter how peaceful Wuling City may seem now, we never forget that containing the Very Large Rift is this city's mission.

dialogText.cn: 如果你有机会沿着息壤堰的方向一直走下去，你会在北部看到一片废墟。
dialogText.en: If you ever have the chance to follow the dam's path north, you will find the shattered remains of what came before.

dialogText.cn: 那里就是武陵科考站最初的选址，也是在十年前事故中被彻底抹去的地方——
dialogText.en: That was the original site of the Wuling Science Station — a place utterly erased during the accident a decade ago.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，总有一天，我们会重新回到那里。
dialogText.en: Endmin, one day, we will return there.

dialogText.cn: 因为那里是离威胁最近的地方……
dialogText.en: Because that is the place closest to the danger...

dialogText.cn: 不管是解释成总桩能调控全城的息壤能源也好，还是方便监控息壤堰的情况也罢。
dialogText.en: One might argue the Main Pillar regulates the city's Xiranite flow, or offers a strategic vantage over the Xiranite Dam.

dialogText.cn: 在我心里，小庄最初选定总桩的原因只是那里离威胁最近。
dialogText.en: But in my heart, I know Zhuang's primary reason for choosing that site was its proximity to the danger.

dialogText.cn: 十年前科考站遏制裂隙的尝试失败，成了她心里放不下的刺……
dialogText.en: She's never gotten over the Science Station's failure to contain the rift ten years ago...

dialogText.cn: 呦，管理员，终于有空来选剑局逛逛了？
dialogText.en: Hey there, Endmin! Finally found some time to visit HS.Swords?

dialogText.cn: 我最近半夜睡不着，闲来无事就弄了些逗趣的玩意儿，正等着找你试试！
dialogText.en: Been too restless to sleep these nights, so I made some fun stuff. You're just in time to be my test subject!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，别怕，伤不到你的。
dialogText.en: Don't sweat it, they're perfectly harmless!

dialogText.cn: 不过，话说回来，最近局里确实有一批好东西，记得看看。
dialogText.en: Anyway, word of advice: we've got some pretty sweet new stock in. You should definitely check it out.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，管理员，要走直接过去就行，我不会拦你的。
dialogText.en: Go on ahead, Endmin, no need to mind me! I won't stop you.

dialogText.cn: 不过，黎风那小子回来之后一直对终末地念念不忘。
dialogText.en: Ever since Lifeng returned from Endfield, it's been all he can think about.

dialogText.cn: 不会哪天突然就被你们终末地给拐跑了吧？
dialogText.en: You're not planning to steal him away one day, are you?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这边的试验田你随意参观。
dialogText.en: Endmin, feel free to look around the test fields here.

dialogText.cn: 阿庄特意叮嘱过我，如果终末地能帮忙推广武陵的“超高产精品栽培技术”——
dialogText.en: Zhuang made it clear: if Endfield helps spread Wuling's "high-quality, high-yield farming methods"...

dialogText.cn: 我们可以无条件分享技术和经验。
dialogText.en: ...we'll provide the know-how and experience, no strings attached.

dialogText.cn: 既然已经能让文明环带吃上饱饭，我们现在就得考虑怎么让大家吃上好饭了。
dialogText.en: Now that we can ensure the Civilization Band has enough to eat, our next task is to figure out how to make sure everyone eats well.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者风格的武器堆积于此，看起来，碾骨氏族为清波寨提供了部分武器。
dialogText.en: Landbreaker-style weapons are piled up here. Looks like the Bonekrushers supplied Qingbo Stockade with some arms.

dialogText.cn: 他们早有预谋。
dialogText.en: They planned this in advance.

dialogText.cn: 桶中装着清水，这里似乎是清波寨的一处取水地。
dialogText.en: The bucket is filled with clean water. The place seems to be a source of water for Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 毗邻甚大裂隙，但清波寨却极少缺乏净水，他们一定有特殊的手段。
dialogText.en: Despite being so close to the Very Large Rift, clean water shortages are rare at the Qingbo Stockade. They must have a special technique to create this supply.

dialogText.cn: 看来长久的囚禁并没有让这间牢房的上一任住客陷入虚弱，他——或她的源石技艺依旧足够撕开囹圄。
dialogText.en: A lengthy imprisonment failed to weaken the previous occupant. His (or her) Originium Arts were still capable of ripping apart the holding cell.

dialogText.cn: “也不知道裂地者从哪里搞到了这么多笼子，不如熔了当修缮寨子的材料。”
dialogText.en: "No idea where the LBs got all these cages. We can melt them down and use the metal for Stockade repairs."

dialogText.cn: 纸张上写着如此内容。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on this piece of paper.

dialogText.cn: 前方被落下的山石堵了个严严实实，看来短时间内无法清理干净。
dialogText.en: Up ahead's completely blocked by fallen rocks. Looks like it'll take a while to clear.

dialogText.cn: 祖泉周边的损坏尚未修复。
dialogText.en: The damage around the Ancestral Spring still hasn't been repaired.

dialogText.cn: 待修补的并非只有亭台，还有生活。
dialogText.en: What needs mending isn't just the pavilions, but life itself.

dialogText.cn: 祖泉周边的损坏尚未修复。
dialogText.en: The damage around the Ancestral Spring still hasn't been repaired.

dialogText.cn: 清波寨诸位先祖是否见证了那场悲剧？或许水竹铃的呜咽便是答案。
dialogText.en: Did the ancestors of Qingbo Stockade witness that tragedy? Perhaps the mournful chime of the bamboo water chimes holds the answer.

dialogText.cn: 这些武器仍堆放在这里。在它们被拿起来，挥向无辜者之前，一场阴谋之火已被熄灭。
dialogText.en: These weapons are still piled up here. Before they could be lifted and swung at the innocent, the flames of conspiracy have already been extinguished.

dialogText.cn: 似乎是因为寨内的冲突，这条道路被隔断了。
dialogText.en: This path is blocked, probably due to the fighting in the Stockade

dialogText.cn: 因为寨民的袭击，电梯暂时没法用了。
dialogText.en: The elevator's down. The Stockaders attacked it.

dialogText.cn: 你们想要上去，只能辛苦走旁边的楼梯。
dialogText.en: Take the stairs if you want up. It's the only way.

dialogText.cn: 你、你们怎么又找上门来了？弭、弭弗呢？
dialogText.en: Y-You again? How'd you find us? Wh ... where's Mi Fu?

dialogText.cn: 那你们来找我……？
dialogText.en: Why are you looking for me...?

dialogText.cn: 是、是二姑娘让你们来收拾我？
dialogText.en: D-Did Younger Dame send you to deal with me?

dialogText.cn: 我更怕你们！连阮哥都栽在你们手里……
dialogText.en: You scare me way more! Even Ruan couldn't take you down...

dialogText.cn: 是、是二姑娘让你们来收拾我？
dialogText.en: D-Did Younger Dame send you to deal with me?

dialogText.cn: 哼，她可舍不得收拾你们。
dialogText.en: Hah, as if she'd ever have the heart to touch you guys.

dialogText.cn: 不过，要是你还藏着裂地者的消息，可就另当别论了。
dialogText.en: But if you're still hiding intel about the Landbreakers ... that's a different story.

dialogText.cn: 我知道的，都告诉弭弗了！
dialogText.en: I already told Mi Fu everything I know!

dialogText.cn: 要是我真知道那些人在哪儿，我早就去找他们了，还留在这儿担惊受怕干嘛——
dialogText.en: If I really knew where they were, I'd have gone after them myself! Why would I stick around here living in fear—

dialogText.cn: 敢背叛汤汤，和裂地者勾结，这是你们自找的。
dialogText.en: How dare you betray Tangtang and collude with the LBs... You brought this on yourselves.

dialogText.cn: 可惜汤汤没开口，我们也不方便插手清波寨的事。
dialogText.en: What a shame... If Tangtang hadn't stayed silent, we would've dealt with Qingbo Stockade ourselves.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，而且那些裂地者还一直藏在某个地方，终归是个隐患。
dialogText.en: Yeah, and with those Landbreakers still hiding out somewhere ... it's a disaster waiting to happen.

dialogText.cn: 怎么到处都找不到那位大人物……
dialogText.en: How come we can't find that big shot anywhere...

dialogText.cn: 你也认识那位大人物？！
dialogText.en: You know him too?!

dialogText.cn: 还是说……你见到他了？
dialogText.en: Or have you ... met him already?

dialogText.cn: 什么意思……
dialogText.en: What's that supposed to mean...

dialogText.cn: 你见过他了？
dialogText.en: You've seen him?

dialogText.cn: 见过，但现在我们也在找他。
dialogText.en: Yes, but now we're looking for him too.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……眼下阮哥也走了，寨子里说不定会更乱。
dialogText.en: How did it come to this... Now that Ruan's gone too, the stockade will probably descend into chaos.

dialogText.cn: 你不相信汤汤能把寨子的问题解决？
dialogText.en: Don't you trust Tangtang to handle the stockade's problems?

dialogText.cn: 事情要是能这么简单，何至于闹到现在这个地步。
dialogText.en: If only things were that simple, we wouldn't be in this mess.

dialogText.cn: 你们快走吧，我们还有自己的事情要做。
dialogText.en: You'd better get going. We've got our own business to attend to.

dialogText.cn: 不管结果怎么样，都得先找到那位再说……
dialogText.en: Whatever happens, we need to find that person first...

dialogText.cn: 那位被你救出来后，号称要先干掉裂地者，再推翻阮一和汤汤，自己做大当家的狂人止步在了这里。
dialogText.en: That lunatic you rescued swore he'd take down the Landbreakers first, then overthrow Ruan Yi and Tangtang to become the chief himself ... but his grand plans ended right here.

dialogText.cn: 为了保护那些主动跟随他的寨民，他独自面对了裂地者的围攻……
dialogText.en: To protect the Stockaders who willingly followed him ... he faced the Landbreakers' ambush alone...

dialogText.cn: 他至死也未曾有过丝毫胆怯。
dialogText.en: He never showed a trace of fear until the very end.

dialogText.cn: 戴面具的，是你们？！
dialogText.en: Hey! Masked one ... it's you?!

dialogText.cn: 老子听有些吓破胆的人说，有个戴黑面具的人帮汤汤干掉了阮一那个软蛋！
dialogText.en: I heard from some scared blightless guys that someone in a dark mask helped Tangtang take out that coward Ruan Yi!

dialogText.cn: 老子服你！
dialogText.en: I yield to you!

dialogText.cn: 不过，能不能先放老子出来……
dialogText.en: But ... could you get me out of here first?

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，行，只要别忘了这儿还有个人就成！
dialogText.en: Ahem, fine! Just don't forget there's still someone stuck in here!

dialogText.cn: 爽快！
dialogText.en: Now we're talking!

dialogText.cn: 不愧是能干翻阮一的人！
dialogText.en: No wonder you took down Ruan Yi!

dialogText.cn: 老子欣赏你，这些都是老子珍藏的东西，都送你了。
dialogText.en: I like you! These are all my prized possessions, they're yours now.

dialogText.cn: 不过等着，老子会去再练练，之后一定来挑战你！
dialogText.en: But just you wait! I'm gonna train harder and come challenge you for sure!

dialogText.cn: 唉，如果我心再狠点，直接强行把他带回家，结果也许会不一样……
dialogText.en: Sigh ... if I'd been more ruthless and forced him to come home, maybe things would've turned out different...

dialogText.cn: 是你们啊……
dialogText.en: Oh, it's you...

dialogText.cn: 我找到我那个傻兄弟了……他当时趁乱逃跑之后，我没能拦住他。
dialogText.en: I found my foolish brother. When he took off during the chaos, I ... couldn't stop him.

dialogText.cn: 他最后还是加入了藏在周围的一帮裂地者。
dialogText.en: He ended up joining a group of Landbreakers hiding nearby after all.

dialogText.cn: 他一根筋想融入那帮疯子，怂恿他们替他去武陵城报仇，但……
dialogText.en: He was dead set on joining those maniacs, egging them on to get revenge for him in Wuling City, but...

dialogText.cn: 要是他也和你们一样了解那些裂地者就好了……
dialogText.en: If only he understood those Landbreakers as well as you do...

dialogText.cn: 那些疯子逼他挑战最强壮的人，赢了就听他的……结果，他被裂地者给、给活活打死了。
dialogText.en: Those maniacs forced him to challenge their strongest fighter, saying they'd follow him if he won ... but in the end, the Landbreakers beat him ... beat him to death.

dialogText.cn: 我、我甚至没能鼓起勇气去救他……
dialogText.en: I... I couldn't even muster the courage to save him...

dialogText.cn: 我那傻兄弟说得对，我就是个怂货……
dialogText.en: My foolish brother was right about me... I'm nothing but a coward...

dialogText.cn: 首墩建设者们集体记功于此。
dialogText.en: A group commemoration for those who built the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏寂静无声。它已负担了太多。
dialogText.en: The Feranmut Heart is silent. Its load is too heavy.

dialogText.cn: “随时警戒，定时分析，及时汇总……”
dialogText.en: "Always be alert. Analyze regularly. Compile on schedule..."

dialogText.cn: 告示栏上张贴着这样的标语。
dialogText.en: These slogans have been posted on the bulletin board.

dialogText.cn: “以息壤水雷防御水下的天使袭击的可行性探讨……”
dialogText.en: "An investigation on the feasibility of Xiranite mines to defend against attacks by aquatic Aggeloi..."

dialogText.cn: 白板上写着这样的文字。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the white board.

dialogText.cn: 各项数据在屏幕上流动，它们正实时记录着巨兽心脏的运行状况。
dialogText.en: Various numbers and readings keep appearing on screen. Operational data of the Feranmut Heart is being logged on a real-time basis.

dialogText.cn: 数据的高低变化极大，状况似乎不甚乐观。
dialogText.en: The data exhibits rather wild fluctuations. The situation does not look very good.

dialogText.cn: 小蟠兽的痕迹向内部延伸，此处似乎别有洞天？
dialogText.en: Trails of the little pantailbeast extend deep into the place. The cave might be larger than it seems.

dialogText.cn: 由息壤余料制成的纪念碑静静屹立着。
dialogText.en: A monument constructed using Xiranite debris. It stands in silence.

dialogText.cn: 由于阿达希尔的袭击，大部分区域暂时封锁。
dialogText.en: Most areas are temporarily under lockdown due to Ardashir's attack.

dialogText.cn: 科考站建设者们集体记功于此。
dialogText.en: A group commemoration for those who built the Science Station.

dialogText.cn: 姜义海亦刻名于此。立碑者在坚岩上刻下他的名字，以铭记他在建筑领域的卓越贡献。
dialogText.en: Witness the name of Jiang Yihai. The builder of the monument inscribed his name upon this stalwart stone for his outstanding contributions in the field of architecture.

dialogText.cn: 息壤研究者们集体记功于此。
dialogText.en: A group commemoration for the researchers of Xiranite Science.

dialogText.cn: 春荷亦刻名于此。壮志未酬，但她无惧生死，一切有关超高密度息壤研究的文献中都会有她的名字。
dialogText.en: Witness the name of Chun He. Though she did not live to see her project complete, she was a fearless soul. Every work on high-density Xiranite shall cite her name.

dialogText.cn: 武陵城建设者们集体记功于此。
dialogText.en: A group commemoration for those who built Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 需要金盏花吗？你看上去有很怀念的人。
dialogText.en: You look like you're missing someone very much. Need some marigolds?

dialogText.cn: 对呀，是你主动来找我的，不是吗？
dialogText.en: Yeah, but you started this convo, didn't you?

dialogText.cn: 如果你需要的话，这些金盏花我可以送给你。
dialogText.en: If you are really in need, you can have these marigolds for free.

dialogText.cn: 不论你心里想的是谁，把你的怀念和祝福留在安思园吧……
dialogText.en: No matter whom you miss, leave your longings and blessings at Serenity Garden...

dialogText.cn: 我不否认，毕竟要做卖花的生意。
dialogText.en: I won't deny that. I sell flowers for a living, after all.

dialogText.cn: 但有时是生意，有时是看缘分……
dialogText.en: Sometimes it's business, but sometimes, it's the hand of Fate...

dialogText.cn: 你心里好像藏着很多事，又单纯得像一页白纸，我对你很好奇。
dialogText.en: Your soul seems to hide many secrets, yet feels as clean as a blank slate. I'm extremely curious about you.

dialogText.cn: 花赠有缘人，我不吃亏的。
dialogText.en: A fated gift of flowers. No fear, I can still profit from this.

dialogText.cn: 唔，的确，回来的路上还遇到了不少天使……不过有惊无险。
dialogText.en: Mmhmm. That's true. I ran into quite a few Aggeloi on my way here... I'm a little shaken, but otherwise safe.

dialogText.cn: 至于我为什么非要在这儿，只是因为我答应过一个人。
dialogText.en: You might be curious why I'd come here. It's for a promise I've made.

dialogText.cn: 她喜欢花，所以我就带着花在这儿陪她。
dialogText.en: She liked flowers, so I brought them to keep her company.

dialogText.cn: 而且，总有人会需要花来纪念失去的人，那就总得有人来为他们准备好一些花。
dialogText.en: And people always need flowers to offer their beloved ones. Someone has to provide the blossoms.

dialogText.cn: 好吧，如果你有兴趣了，再来找我吧。
dialogText.en: Okay. Feel free to talk to me again if you're interested.

dialogText.cn: 需要金盏花吗？你看上去有很怀念的人。
dialogText.en: You look like you're missing someone very much. Need some marigolds?

dialogText.cn: 对呀，是你主动来找我的，不是吗？
dialogText.en: Yeah, but you started this convo, didn't you?

dialogText.cn: 如果你需要的话，这些金盏花我可以送给你。
dialogText.en: If you are really in need, you can have these marigolds for free.

dialogText.cn: 不论你心里想的是谁，把你的怀念和祝福留在安思园吧……
dialogText.en: No matter whom you miss, leave your longings and blessings at Serenity Garden...

dialogText.cn: 我不否认，毕竟要做卖花的生意。
dialogText.en: I won't deny that. I sell flowers for a living, after all.

dialogText.cn: 但有时是生意，有时是看缘分……
dialogText.en: Sometimes it's business, but sometimes, it's the hand of Fate...

dialogText.cn: 你心里好像藏着很多事，又单纯得像一页白纸，我对你很好奇。
dialogText.en: Your soul seems to hide many secrets, yet feels as clean as a blank slate. I'm extremely curious about you.

dialogText.cn: 花赠有缘人，我不吃亏的。
dialogText.en: A fated gift of flowers. No fear, I can still profit from this.

dialogText.cn: 唔，的确，回来的路上还遇到了不少天使……不过有惊无险。
dialogText.en: Mmhmm. That's true. I ran into quite a few Aggeloi on my way here... I'm a little shaken, but otherwise safe.

dialogText.cn: 至于我为什么非要在这儿，只是因为我答应过一个人。
dialogText.en: You might be curious why I'd come here. It's for a promise I've made.

dialogText.cn: 她喜欢花，所以我就带着花在这儿陪她。
dialogText.en: She liked flowers, so I brought them to keep her company.

dialogText.cn: 而且，总有人会需要花来纪念失去的人，那就总得有人来为他们准备好一些花。
dialogText.en: And people always need flowers to offer their beloved ones. Someone has to provide the blossoms.

dialogText.cn: 啊，我记得！
dialogText.en: Oh, of course I do!

dialogText.cn: 不久前，他还来找我买花纪念他的爷爷和兄弟。没想到，他现在都当上巡卫了。
dialogText.en: He visited recently and bought flowers for his grampa and brother. I was surprised he became a Watchguard.

dialogText.cn: 真是世事难料……
dialogText.en: The world works in mysterious ways...

dialogText.cn: 好吧，如果你有兴趣了，再来找我吧。
dialogText.en: Okay. Feel free to talk to me again if you're interested.

dialogText.cn: 感谢诸位，我是心脏修缮站的负责人韩方，这次的修缮工作正需要终末地的技术支持。
dialogText.en: Thank you all. I am Han Fang, the one in charge of the Cardiac Remediation Station. I'll need Endfield technical support for this repair work.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，欢迎到修缮站来。看到你在这儿，大伙都更有干劲了。
dialogText.en: Welcome to the Remediation Station, Endmin. Your mere presence just gave everyone a work boost.

dialogText.cn: 唉，巨兽心脏完成后，就没有出过错。前辈们是怎么做到的……
dialogText.en: Well, the Feranmut Heart hardly ran into problems ever since its completion. We have no idea how our predecessors did it...

dialogText.cn: 我和其他天师一起讨论过，心脏修缮有许多技术上的黑盒问题。
dialogText.en: I discussed this with the other Tianshi. Cardiac Remediation involves heavy use of black box tech.

dialogText.cn: 这次要同时开启几个新的研究课题，即便有终末地的技术支持，形势也不乐观。
dialogText.en: We have to start multiple research topics. Even with Endfield tech support, things don't look very good.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，成像仪运行得很完美，陈千语干员可是帮了大忙啊。
dialogText.en: It's working beautifully, Endmin. Operator Chen really helped a lot with the Imager.

dialogText.cn: 要不是她用自己拍的影像点醒我们，校验工作还得绕很多弯路。
dialogText.en: Her idea of taking selfies saved us a ton of trouble for the calibration work.

dialogText.cn: 成像仪运转良好，心音仪也输出了可用的声音频率，修缮站的大家都士气高昂。
dialogText.en: The Imager is working well. We also fed usable audio frequencies to the Cardiograph. Everyone at the Remediation Station is really pumped up.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，卜圆天师她一直想请你们喝茶，要答谢诸位的帮助。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Tianshi Bu Yuan wants to treat you to some tea for helping her out.

dialogText.cn: 别替她节约，修缮进展这么顺利，卜圆天师已经请过不少同事喝茶，就差你们了。
dialogText.en: Don't be too nice with her. We made tremendous Remediation Progress and Tianshi Bu Yuan has treated many to tea already. You're the only ones left.

dialogText.cn: 巨兽心脏已经正式启动了，我还记得终末地派遣人员刚到修缮站的情景。
dialogText.en: The Feranmut Heart has been officially activated. I still remember how things were like when the Endfielders first arrived at the Remediation Station.

dialogText.cn: 其实也没多久，不过咱们经历的波折不少，感觉像是过去很长时间。
dialogText.en: It wasn't that too long ago either, but it felt like a really long and exciting roller coaster ride.

dialogText.cn: 希望修缮后的巨兽心脏，能够长久庇护武陵城和这片土地上的人们。
dialogText.en: I hope the remediated Feranmut Heart will protect Wuling City and the people of this land for many years to come.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎各位，我是参与此次修缮工作的天师，卜圆。
dialogText.en: Greetings. I am Tianshi Bu Yuan who is part of the remediation team.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，等忙完这轮，我请你喝茶啊。
dialogText.en: Once this is over, I shall treat you to some tea, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 之前前辈们的经验都套用不上，这次麻烦了。
dialogText.en: None of the predecessors' experience worked. I suppose I'm indeed in trouble.

dialogText.cn: 很多设计要从头推导，都没时间去喝茶了……
dialogText.en: We have to redesign the entire thing from the drawing board. That means no time for tea...

dialogText.cn: 成像仪校验成功后，韩天师这几天工作变得干劲十足。
dialogText.en: The successful calibration of the Imager really gave Tianshi Han a huge boost in productivity.

dialogText.cn: 不喝茶了，我得加紧推进研究进度！
dialogText.en: Forget the tea! I must make some decent research progress!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，劳逸结合才能有灵感萌发，我请你们喝茶吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin, a work-life balance is essential for inspirations. Let me treat you to some tea!

dialogText.cn: 可不是偷懒，是为了答谢你们。
dialogText.en: Not slacking off. This is my way of thanking you all.

dialogText.cn: 你们带给整个修缮项目的变化，不亚于那场及时落下的雨啊。
dialogText.en: The changes you brought to the remediation project are just as significant as that timely rain.

dialogText.cn: 大功告成了，我要将这段时间错过的武陵城新口味茶饮尝个遍。
dialogText.en: Once this is over, I must try every flavor of Wuling tea that I missed during this time.

dialogText.cn: 比起岳研香茶铺的奶茶，宏味的新品咖啡也意外不错。
dialogText.en: In addition to milkteas from Eureka Teashop, Hongwei has some pretty good novel coffee blends.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我请你们喝吧。尝试新口味也算是拥抱变化嘛！
dialogText.en: Let me treat your team, Endmin. After all, trying new flavors is our way of embracing change!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这次巨兽心脏修缮，材料研究所也会一起参与。
dialogText.en: Endmin, the Institute of Materials Science is also taking part in the remediation of the Feranmut Heart.

dialogText.cn: 大家都盼着能和你合作，我好不容易才争取到这个机会。
dialogText.en: Everyone was hoping to work with you. It wasn't for me to get this opportunity.

dialogText.cn: 这次修缮，一定力争完美，不然常沄她会笑话我这个老师的。
dialogText.en: This remediation must be completed flawlessly. Otherwise Chang Yun would lose all respect in her Instructor.

dialogText.cn: 我听说那一张点醒韩天师的影像叫“苦恼的天师”？
dialogText.en: I heard that the photo that inspired Tianshi Han is titled "The Perplexed Tianshi"?

dialogText.cn: 这事整个研究所都知道了，连常沄都找我打听过。
dialogText.en: The entire Institute heard the story. Chang Yun even asked me about it.

dialogText.cn: 希望韩天师这回能理解大家的苦心，多注意注意自己。
dialogText.en: I hope Tianshi Han can understand why everyone's concerned and pay more attention to himself.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，卜圆天师请你喝过茶了吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin, Tianshi Bu Yuan treated you to tea, right?

dialogText.cn: 卜圆天师比我还有韩天师年轻，但科研能力却一点不差。
dialogText.en: Though Tianshi Bu Yuan's younger than me and Tianshi Han, she's just as good in science as the two of us.

dialogText.cn: 她和常沄一样，都是武陵城未来的中流砥柱。
dialogText.en: She and Chang Yun will become pillars supporting the future of Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 经过这次巨兽心脏修缮，我更加相信，武陵的未来会越来越好。
dialogText.en: This round of Feranmut Heart remediation convinced me that Wuling is in very safe hands.

dialogText.cn: 重新启动的巨兽心脏，和已经成长起来的年轻天师们，会比我们这代做得更好。
dialogText.en: The Feranmut Heart has been successfully restarted. The young Tianshi are also ready. Their achievements will outshine ours.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师的设想一定会在这代人手中实现的！
dialogText.en: This is the generation that will realize Tianshi Zhuang's vision!

dialogText.cn: 当初真不该答应你在武陵待满五年再离开……
dialogText.en: I wish I said no when you said I could leave after my five-tenure at Wuling was over...

dialogText.cn: 现在五年过去了，我反倒越来越喜欢这儿了……
dialogText.en: Five years passed, and I grew to love it here...

dialogText.cn: 如今真要走，反倒有些舍不得。
dialogText.en: And now I could hardly bring myself to leave.

dialogText.cn: 舍不得这座城市……
dialogText.en: I'll really miss this city...

dialogText.cn: 也舍不得你。
dialogText.en: ...and you as well.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有什么指示吗？
dialogText.en: Any instructions, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 开、开闸？
dialogText.en: Wha? Open the gates?

dialogText.cn: 现在的蓄水量应该还在正常范围内呀？难道是因为阿达希尔还动了其他手脚……
dialogText.en: But the reservoir capacity is still within nominal levels. Did Ardashir mess with other stuff...?

dialogText.cn: 不论如何，您下这样的指示，肯定有您的道理。
dialogText.en: Since you gave the order, you must have your reasons.

dialogText.cn: 稍等，我现在就确认蓄水站的各项指标，为开闸做准备。
dialogText.en: Hold on. I'll check the Reservoir Station readings and prepare the sluice gates for opening.

dialogText.cn: 开闸手续比较繁杂，辛苦耐心等等！
dialogText.en: Sluice gate opening is quite a hassle. Please be patient!

dialogText.cn: 啊？
dialogText.en: What?

dialogText.cn: 是庄天师有新的安排，但我没收到吗？
dialogText.en: Did Tianshi Zhuang give new orders? I certainly didn't receive any.

dialogText.cn: 反正没有接到新的通知之前，我还是认您来全权负责首墩事务。
dialogText.en: Unless new orders say otherwise, I still treat you as the sole commander of the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 我也很惊讶……
dialogText.en: I was surprised too...

dialogText.cn: 重新返回蓄水站后，我带人彻底检查了蓄水站的所有设施，暂时没有发现任何损坏。
dialogText.en: Since I'm back at the Reservoir Station, I got people to check every facility here. No damages have been found so far.

dialogText.cn: 呃，除了入口的道路被切断了。
dialogText.en: Oh, except for the path to the entrance. That's out.

dialogText.cn: 不过，保险起见，还是再组织一次全面检查吧。
dialogText.en: I say we should play it safe. Let's organize another full inspection.

dialogText.cn: 按照操作章程的描述，是为了“加强首墩区域水资源的节约集约利用，持续保障武陵人民生活安全”。
dialogText.en: Details on the operational procedures have one intent. "Enhance conservation and utilization of water resources in the Marker Stone area, and to ensure the safety and livelihood of the residents in Wuling."

dialogText.cn: 简单来说，是为了确保在特殊时期，蓄水站能为武陵城提供必要用水。
dialogText.en: Simply put, the Reservoir Station is to guarantee an essential supply of usable water during special circumstances.

dialogText.cn: 算是早年规划首墩区域时，天师们的未雨绸缪。
dialogText.en: When the Tianshi planned the Marker Stone area many years ago, the Reservoir was meant to be a safety net.

dialogText.cn: 您要是对这段历史感兴趣，不妨去城建馆看看。
dialogText.en: If you're interested in this history, the details are available in the Urban Development Hall.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，之前多谢你们来救了我们，还帮忙重启天师桩……
dialogText.en: Endmin, thank you so much for saving us. You even helped us restart the Tianshi Pillar...

dialogText.cn: 唔，明明作为应急维修小组负责人，我理应处理好这些问题……结果最后还是你们和诀少校出手解决。
dialogText.en: Well, I'm the lead of emergency repairs and should've taken care of the problem... But you and Major Arcane did the actual work.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我已经和奚墨老师沟通过了，准备重新回天师府学院进修裂隙灾害处理相关的课程。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I talked to Mr. Xi Mo about going back to the Academy and taking courses on Blight disaster handling.

dialogText.cn: 我不能指望每一次遇到这些问题，都靠别人来替我解决。
dialogText.en: I can't just keep running into problems and hope that someone can fix them for me.

dialogText.cn: 远远不够……管理员，这是我自己的决定，你不用劝我。
dialogText.en: I'm not good enough... It's okay, Endmin. I've made up my mind. It's decided.

dialogText.cn: 啊，是你们呀……
dialogText.en: Ah, it's you...

dialogText.cn: 之前在林地，多亏有你们帮忙，不然我们也拿裂隙一点办法都没有。
dialogText.en: Your team really helped us out back at the groves. That Rift was really beyond us.

dialogText.cn: ……只是，铃洛她一直放不下这件事。
dialogText.en: However, Ling Luo took that matter very personally.

dialogText.cn: 算是吧。
dialogText.en: I believe so.

dialogText.cn: 她一直很纠结，我们作为应急维修小组，没能及时解决天师桩的问题。
dialogText.en: She's still struggling with the fact that we, the emergency repair team, couldn't fix the Tianshi Pillar on time.

dialogText.cn: 她甚至和奚墨老师提，想回天师府学院继续深造，以免未来再遭遇那种境况……
dialogText.en: She even asked Mr. Xi Mo about going back to the Academy for further studies, just to make sure it doesn't happen again...

dialogText.cn: 可处理裂隙，本来就不是我们的责任……
dialogText.en: But handling the Rift wasn't part of our duty...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……她是我……唯一的朋友。
dialogText.en: Yeah... She's ... she's my only friend.

dialogText.cn: 而且，我清楚她在乎这件事的原因，根本就和能不能解决裂隙无关……
dialogText.en: And I actually know why she's so obsessed about this. It has nothing to do with fixing the Rift...

dialogText.cn: 她只是不满意自己没能在那位应龙特勤队员面前留下好印象罢了。
dialogText.en: She's only upset that she didn't get to impress that Yinglung Special Task Force member.

dialogText.cn: 我一定要去说服奚墨老师，让他出面把铃洛留下。
dialogText.en: I'm going to tell Mr. Xi Mo about this. Only he can persuade Ling Luo to stay.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你也是来确认诀的情况吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, here to check on Arcane?

dialogText.cn: 司岁台那边已经回消息了，支援正在赶过来。具体是谁，我没有权限得知。
dialogText.en: Sui Regulator got some news. Support is on the way, but I lack the authority level for more details.

dialogText.cn: 但你大可放心，他们一定有办法把诀从画卷里放出来。
dialogText.en: Rest assured. They will figure out how to get Arcane out of the scroll.

dialogText.cn: 我也希望他们动作再快点。
dialogText.en: I hope they could move quicker.

dialogText.cn: 再拖下去，我迟早被自己两个学生给烦死！
dialogText.en: Any more delays, and my two disciples will yap my ears off!

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯总算被解决了，谢谢你，管理员。
dialogText.en: Nefarith is no more. Thank you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 虽然她还在昏迷，但好歹生命无碍，你不必过多担心。
dialogText.en: She's still out, but her vitals look good. There's no need to worry.

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔留下的影响还没完全清除，要处理的事情都快堆成山了！
dialogText.en: We've yet to fully clean up Ardashir's mess. And there are just so much things to do!

dialogText.cn: 聂菲斯总算被解决了，谢谢你，管理员。
dialogText.en: Nefarith is no more. Thank you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 虽然她还在昏迷，但好歹生命无碍，你不必过多担心。
dialogText.en: She's still out, but her vitals look good. There's no need to worry.

dialogText.cn: 阿达希尔留下的影响还没完全清除，要处理的事情都快堆成山了！
dialogText.en: We've yet to fully clean up Ardashir's mess. And there are just so much things to do!

dialogText.cn: 咳，我们……都没空。
dialogText.en: Ahem. We're ... kinda occupied.

dialogText.cn: 忙着解决首墩的问题呢。
dialogText.en: The problems at the Marker Stone is taking up all my time.

dialogText.cn: 话说回来，让他搭把手清理首墩……好像也不算过分。
dialogText.en: Come to think of it, helping me clean up the Marker Stone ... sounds like an acceptable request.

dialogText.cn: 欸，你也是迷路的人吗？
dialogText.en: Hey, are you lost too?

dialogText.cn: 前面没有路啦，快回头吧！
dialogText.en: The road is already out. Turn around already!

dialogText.cn: 唔，我在自己家里很奇怪吗？
dialogText.en: Hey, I'm right at home. How is that strange?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，每个见到我家的人，都很喜欢这里的景色！
dialogText.en: Heheh. Everyone who sees my home literally loves the scenery!

dialogText.cn: 害怕？为什么要害怕？每个迷路来这儿的人，对我都很好呀！
dialogText.en: Afraid? Why should I be? Everyone who lost their way is nice to me!

dialogText.cn: 你也可以和他们一样，叫我念念！
dialogText.en: Everyone calls me Babbles. You can call me that too!

dialogText.cn: 对呀，不久之前就有一个白色头发的温柔小哥哥也在这儿迷路了呢。
dialogText.en: Yeah. There was a super nice guy with silver hair who couldn't find his way out.

dialogText.cn: 他还特意去给我带了热喷喷的米糕，动作超级快！就是城里最好吃的那家，你也可以去试试！
dialogText.en: He also brought me some warm rice cakes. Like, super fast! From the best store in the city! You should try them out too!

dialogText.cn: 不过他名字好像不怎么常见，叫……叫阿达……阿达希尔？
dialogText.en: But his name is very odd. He's called ... Arda ... Ardashir, I think?

dialogText.cn: 好怪的名字。
dialogText.en: What a weird name.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……陪我坐在门口的台阶上数花瓣？
dialogText.en: Hmm... He sat on the porch with me, and we counted some petals.

dialogText.cn: 对了，他还给我讲了好多好多他自己经历过的奇妙故事！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah, he also told me a ton of wonderful stories from his own experiences!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，是他和他的两位挚友一起冒险的故事哦！我最喜欢他们一起去了一个叫“星门”的地方，然后——
dialogText.en: Heheh. The stories are about himself and his two companions! My favorite's the one where they went to the "Cosmic Gate" and then —
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 差点忘了，我吃了他的米糕，所以答应要替他保密！
dialogText.en: I almost forgot. He gave me rice cakes to eat after I promised him to keep the stories secret!

dialogText.cn: 他走的时候，还想送我去其他地方逛逛呢，可我不想离开家……
dialogText.en: When he got up to leave, he wanted to take me around and explore the world. But I don't wanna leave my home...

dialogText.cn: 爸爸妈妈去世前，我们就一直住在这儿。
dialogText.en: Before Pa and Ma left, this place is where my family lived.

dialogText.cn: 他们修建首墩时牺牲了……
dialogText.en: Yeah. They passed away repairing the Marker Stone...

dialogText.cn: 不过已经是很久很久以前的事了，也一直有很多很多人会来帮我，所以不用担心我！
dialogText.en: But that was a long, long time ago. Plenty of people come around to help me out, so there's no need to worry!

dialogText.cn: 唔，我每次交到新朋友，就说个不停……
dialogText.en: Yeah, every time I meet a new friend, I just can't stop babbling on and on...

dialogText.cn: 总之，很高兴见到你！
dialogText.en: Anyways, I'm really glad to see you!

dialogText.cn: 欸，恩人，是你们呀！
dialogText.en: Oh. My heroes! You're here!

dialogText.cn: 嘿，弭弗队长比我想得还要好说话。
dialogText.en: Heh. Captain Mi Fu got really easy on me.

dialogText.cn: 我和她一提，事儿就成了！
dialogText.en: I just told her about my plans and she got everything done!

dialogText.cn: 而且最近这边人少，我执勤起来也不至于紧张，其他，呃……同僚也都很关照我。
dialogText.en: This place doesn't have a lot of people, so my guard duty isn't that hard. My other, er ... my fellow watchguards care for me too.

dialogText.cn: 我当初连做梦都不会想到，生活会变成这样。
dialogText.en: I never dreamed of this. Life really changed lot for me.

dialogText.cn: 恩人，您放心，我现在绝对不会让爷爷和钩子失望。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, heroes. I'll definitely make Grampa and Rusty Hook proud.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，勉勉强强。
dialogText.en: Heheh. It's going.

dialogText.cn: 换上这身制服，我都下意识要控制控制自己的脾气。
dialogText.en: Ever since I got this outfit, I have to constantly keep my temper in check.

dialogText.cn: 虽然现在还算不得什么优秀巡卫，但总有一天能让爷爷和钩子瞧见，我也是有出息的人了！
dialogText.en: I might not be the best Watchguard of the city, but Grampa and Rusty Hook would know that I made something out of life!

dialogText.cn: 呃，恩人就别拿我开涮了……
dialogText.en: Ugh. That's a dangerous joke, heroes...

dialogText.cn: 再怎么说，跑来武陵城当巡卫也不是件容易让寨子里弟兄姐妹们接受的事。
dialogText.en: Becoming a Wuling City Watchguard is something that the Stockade Fam can't really tolerate.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗队长还特别叮嘱过我，在大当家没把寨子里的情况完全稳定下来之前，我最好都别瞎跑。
dialogText.en: Captain Mi Fu specifically told me to stop romping around unless our Chief settles down the biz at the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 其实我懂，队长也是怕我给大当家添麻烦。
dialogText.en: I actually know what the Captain meant. I shouldn't go and stir up trouble for the Chief.

dialogText.cn: 等时机成熟了，我会回去看看的……得帮寨子做点什么。
dialogText.en: I'll check on the Fam once the time's right... I gotta help out the Stockade somehow.

dialogText.cn: 多谢恩人挂念，那我也继续执勤了。
dialogText.en: Thanks for thinking about me, heroes. I'll carry on with my duties.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，欢迎参观城建馆。
dialogText.en: Welcome to the Urban Development Hall, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 不过因为阿达希尔的袭击，目前城建馆的很多区域还在维护，暂时不能开放，实在抱歉。
dialogText.en: Apologies. Many areas of the Hall have been closed for maintenance due to Ardashir's attack.

dialogText.cn: 您还有更重要的事情要做呢，管理员。
dialogText.en: You seem to have more important tasks at hand, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 总不能所有事都让您亲力亲为，那样最后您会累垮的。
dialogText.en: We can't ask for your help in everything. The workload would be too much to bear.

dialogText.cn: 修缮城建馆的工作，我们会处理好的。
dialogText.en: Repair work for the Urban Development Hall can be handled on our own.

dialogText.cn: 对，是纪念城市，也是纪念那些为了武陵城而付出生命的英雄们。
dialogText.en: Yes. It is a memorial for the city as well as the heroes who sacrificed their lives for Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 十年前，前辈们为了建成首墩，所要面对的困难是难以想象的。
dialogText.en: When our predecessors built the Marker Stone ten years ago, they were plagued with unimaginable difficulties.

dialogText.cn: 不光要直面裂隙和天使的威胁，还必须顶着武陵科考站失败的压力继续使命……
dialogText.en: They had to face the Rift and Aggeloid threat. Furthermore, they must continue their work after the loss of the Wuling Science Station...

dialogText.cn: 就和最初的科考团一样，能支撑前辈们把这项事业坚持下来的，只有信念。
dialogText.en: Like the first scientific survey team, it was faith that kept them going and carry this grand project to its fruition.

dialogText.cn: 城市和人民，都值得纪念。
dialogText.en: Both the city and her people deserve to be commemorated.

dialogText.cn: 没错，它的主体材料就是当初完成首墩奠基的息壤余料。
dialogText.en: Correct. The primary material used in its construction is Xiranite, leftovers from laying down the Marker Stone foundations.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师把它设计成了您现在看到的样子，上面还刻印了每一位为这座城市作出过贡献的人的名字。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang designed its current iteration. The names of everyone who contributed to the construction of this city have been inscribed upon it.

dialogText.cn: 没有阿达希尔这档子事之前，来这边的游客不少。
dialogText.en: Plenty of tourists visited this place before that incident caused by Ardashir.

dialogText.cn: 天师府学院也会定期组织学生过来这边游学，还是挺热闹的……
dialogText.en: The Tianshi Bureau Academy often organizes field tours to the Hall for their disciples. The venue can be quite crowded at times...

dialogText.cn: 大伙儿也都希望尽快恢复运营……
dialogText.en: Everyone's actually hoping we'd be back in business sooner...

dialogText.cn: 但现在天使还在周边活跃，没彻底解决干净，我们也不敢冒险。
dialogText.en: But there are still clusters of Aggeloi active nearby. We shouldn't risk anything until the threat is completely removed.

dialogText.cn: 如果对城建馆有任何的兴趣，欢迎您随时来找我。
dialogText.en: Feel free to talk to me anytime if you're interested in the exhibits of the Urban Development Hall.

dialogText.cn: “实验生物已……请……”
dialogText.en: "The experimental organism has been ... please ..."

dialogText.cn: 纸张被什么撕去了大部分，仅剩几个手写字迹勉强可以辨认。
dialogText.en: Just a small part torn from a larger sheet of paper. Only a few handwritten words could be identified.

dialogText.cn: “水质模型相关数据提交中，请勿执行其他操作。”
dialogText.en: "Submitting water quality model data. Do not perform other actions."

dialogText.cn: 屏幕上显示着如此文字。
dialogText.en: These words are displayed on the monitor.

dialogText.cn: “长耳兽的环境适应性……”
dialogText.en: "Environmental adaptability of long-ears..."

dialogText.cn: 告示牌上有这样的字样。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the sign.

dialogText.cn: “矿石分布亦会对息壤散布产生影响……”
dialogText.en: "Mineral distribution also influences Xiranite dispersal..."

dialogText.cn: 告示牌上有这样的字样。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the sign.

dialogText.cn: “息壤亦能影响土壤改良及植物培育……”
dialogText.en: "Xiranite can also influence soil quality improvements and plant cultivation..."

dialogText.cn: 告示牌上有这样的字样。
dialogText.en: These are the words written on the sign.

dialogText.cn: “机芯模块非充能环境运行演算……”
dialogText.en: "Simulating Core Module operations in an uncharged environment..."

dialogText.cn: 屏幕上的数据旁有这样的备注。
dialogText.en: These comments are displayed next to the on-screen data.

dialogText.cn: 此处告示牌展示着园区内部构造，尤其重点标明了丙型天师桩的位置。
dialogText.en: This sign displays the internal structure of the park and highlights the locations of the Type-C Tianshi Pillars.

dialogText.cn: 你好，要参加环试验园区赛跑吗？可以来我这里报名。
dialogText.en: Greetings. Interested in taking part in our New Test Area Athletic Race? Sign up with me here.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，终于得救了！
dialogText.en: Thank goodness! Saved at last!

dialogText.cn: 最后一次看到她的时候，她向停车场那边去了。后来，我们就被天使堵在这里，不知道她现在的情况。
dialogText.en: When I last saw Cynthia, she was heading to the carpark. A bunch of Aggeloi then trapped us here, so I have no idea what happened to her afterwards.

dialogText.cn: 我们要赶快去停车场那边看看，附近太危险了。
dialogText.en: We must hurry to the carpark! That area is too dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 你找到希茜了吗？她往停车场那边去了，可能会有危险。
dialogText.en: Did you find Cynthia? She went to the carpark and might be in danger.

dialogText.cn: 附近有太多天使了……
dialogText.en: There are just too many Aggeloi nearby...

dialogText.cn: 哇！就是你把那些天使干掉了？还好有高人相助，不然我们都得交待在这里。
dialogText.en: Woah! You smashed those rock buggers! Thank goodness we got a master like you around! I thought we was all gonna die here!

dialogText.cn: 我们在这里帮工团干活，打打零工。结果，好家伙，来了这么多怪物！
dialogText.en: No. We're making a living doing odd jobs for them woosters. Things were fine but a ton of buggerloids suddenly showed up from nowhere!

dialogText.cn: 我们原本想躲到怪物走了再说，结果它们就停在这附近了，眼看着还越来越多……
dialogText.en: We thought we could just stay low and wait for the buggers to leave, but they stayed around. Hell, even more of the buggerloids started showing up...

dialogText.cn: 没错，天使都在往这里聚集。我听别人说，这里是那个“终末地”搞实验搞研究的地方……说不定，天使也是他们的研究引来的。
dialogText.en: That's right... Those buggerloids started gathering at this place. I heard some Endfield company was carrying out crazy tests here and... Well, those tests must have lured the buggerloids in.

dialogText.cn: 对对！我也听说过。太可怕了！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah! I heard about that one too! That's some wicked stuff!

dialogText.cn: 嗯……有时候也会有这样的谣传呢。管理员，你打算和他们解释吗？
dialogText.en: Well... Rumors like this happen every now and then. Endmin, should we try to clear things up?

dialogText.cn: 我也是这样想的！问题解决之后，话才更有说服力。
dialogText.en: I totally agree! We'll be more convincing once we take care of the problems.

dialogText.cn: 怎么这么多天使！你要说这个地方没啥别的问题……我是不信的。
dialogText.en: Where did all these buggerloids come from? Something's definitely wicked and evil in this place... Don't try to tell me otherwise.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，这些个实验不知道能搞出什么来。
dialogText.en: Yeah! Those crazy Endfield tests are messing up this place.

dialogText.cn: 呼……得救了。谢谢搭救，我是这里的分管负责人希茜。
dialogText.en: Hoo... Safe at last. Thank you for the rescue. I'm the deputy manager of these parts... Name's Cynthia.

dialogText.cn: 锚点落下后，我让其他人先撤离，自己折回去回收刚做好的材料样本。一来一回耽误了点时间，就被困在这里了……基地里的其他地方还好吧？
dialogText.en: Ugh. When the Ankhor fell, I evacuated the team and came back here on my own to recover the material samples we just made. Unfortunately, I was too slow and got myself trapped here... I hope the rest of the base is alright?

dialogText.cn: 附近已经清理完了，现在这里暂时安全了。
dialogText.en: We cleared out the nearby areas. This place should be safe for now.

dialogText.cn: 什么谣言？
dialogText.en: Rumors?

dialogText.cn: 这种说法没有依据，我从来没听说过天使会对我们的设备有什么反应……但附近的天使确实多得有点古怪。
dialogText.en: That is just a baseless accusation. I've never heard about the Aggeloi being attracted to our facilities... But the numbers of Aggeloi in the vicinity are strange indeed.

dialogText.cn: 要不，试试排除法？这里有什么东西是基地别的地方没有的吗？
dialogText.en: How about making a list? You know, things you can only find here, not anywhere else on the base? Then we can go through the list one by one.

dialogText.cn: 这里许多东西都是别处没有的。要是它们对天使有影响，早就应该发生过了。
dialogText.en: Well, we have plenty of things like that around here. But if they could attract the Aggeloi, it would have happened ages ago.

dialogText.cn: 对了，有台新到的脉冲发射器还开着，当时刚装完，没来得及管它。
dialogText.en: Oh. There's a new pulse generator that just arrived. It's probably still running. We just assembled the instrument but never had time to pay attention to it.

dialogText.cn: 我重新进行了扫描，天使的活动没有变化……好吧，也不是这个原因。
dialogText.en: I just performed a scan. Aggeloid activity did not change... Okay, I guess that wasn't the cause.

dialogText.cn: 是个好主意……嗯？你认识安德烈？我之前没在枢纽区基地见过你。
dialogText.en: Sounds like a great idea... Wait. You actually know Andre? I've never seen you in the Hub Base before.

dialogText.cn: 等等，难道说……管理员？！抱歉，光顾着想问题了，竟然没认出您来。
dialogText.en: Wait! Does that mean you're the ... Endministrator?! Oh by Talos! I should've recognized you! I was too preoccupied with our problems.

dialogText.cn: 秦主管！你怎么来了？
dialogText.en: Director Qin?! What brings you here?

dialogText.cn: 这么久没收到你的信息，我实在是放心不下。
dialogText.en: You didn't respond for a while. I was getting worried, so I thought I'd drop by to check.

dialogText.cn: 但是现在看来……有管理员在，问题肯定是已经解决了。
dialogText.en: But since our ... Endministrator is around, I believe the problem is now history.

dialogText.cn: 天使往往只会关注附近的生命活动，不过，这次锚点袭击的破坏效率也很异常，实在很难断定它没有特别之处。
dialogText.en: The Aggeloi tend to focus on the activity of nearby organisms. Nevertheless, this particular Ankhorfall happened to be unusually destructive. It would be a stretch to claim there's nothing special about it.

dialogText.cn: 不管是什么原因，现在有谣言，说天使是终末地的研究搞出来的。
dialogText.en: No matter what the cause is, we have a spreading rumor. It claims that Endfield testing has led to the Aggeloid problem.

dialogText.cn: 唉，遇上飞来横祸，难免会有人慌乱多疑。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*. We got hit by an unexpected disaster. People are bound to panic and get suspicious.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我本来安排了一些救灾物资要发放，有专员正在把东西往这边运。但解释工作还是需要有人去做，得有个他们愿意相信的人才行。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I have a team shipping a batch of disaster relief supplies to this place. But I need someone to do the explaining and stop the rumors. It must be someone that the locals are willing to trust.

dialogText.cn: 帮上大忙了，管理员！太感谢了，我们之后在基地里见吧。
dialogText.en: Thank you so much for helping, Endmin! So, I guess we'll meet you at the base.

dialogText.cn: 你也是来领物资的？
dialogText.en: You here for the supplies?

dialogText.cn: 是啊，我听说这里会发点吃的……但是，我有点担心，这附近会不会有怪物。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I heard they got some food and stuff... But I'm a little worried about monsters nearby.

dialogText.cn: 还真是，之前他们基地里那些天使可把我吓死了！喏，你看这个，不知道他们送的这些个电子小玩意儿危不危险……
dialogText.en: Me too. The rocky crawlers in the Endfield base gave me a heart attack! And now they are handing out this weird gadget. No idea what it does. Maybe it's dangerous...

dialogText.cn: 唉……管理员，得靠您了。类似的问题我反复解释过，但他们每次都能有点儿新说法。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Endmin, we really need your help. I've explained it to them like six times, but these people always find a way to cook up new rumors.

dialogText.cn: 是你！刚才救了我们的人！
dialogText.en: It's you! The hero who saved us!

dialogText.cn: {F}还不只是我们呢，听说很多工人都是她救下来的……{M}还不只是我们呢，听说很多工人都是他救下来的……
dialogText.en: {F}Not just us, bud. She saved a whole lot of woosters as well... {M}Not just us, bud. He saved a whole lot of woosters as well...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……连你都这么说的话……
dialogText.en: Hmm... Since you're the one who said it...

dialogText.cn: 工团和终末地的这些东西，咱们确实都搞不明白……还好，有你这样又懂技术又能打的人！我们信你。
dialogText.en: We could never figure out the wooster tech or the Endfield tech... But you know science and you can really fight! You definitely have our trust.

dialogText.cn: 果然实际行动才是最有说服力的。
dialogText.en: Action turns out to be the most convincing argument.

dialogText.cn: 你们回去之后，通知一下朋友和家人，告诉他们在这里还能领救灾物资。
dialogText.en: Good people, once you head home, tell your friends and family about this place. We'll be handing out disaster relief supplies here.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢！我们会把话传出去的。
dialogText.en: Thank you! We'll definitely spread the word.

dialogText.cn: 唉……是啊，还好管理员您帮了大忙。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Yeah. You did me a huge favor there, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 幸好没有造成更多意外。我还得回去叮嘱一下安德烈，要是他还有空摆弄那些“个人爱好”，不如来研究一下这些异常的天使……
dialogText.en: We're lucky nothing else happened. I need to talk to Andre once I head back. Instead of spending time on his "personal hobbies", he should be investigating these anomalous Aggeloi...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，辛苦您了。现在枢纽区基地有许多人都在谈论您四处帮忙的消息。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we really appreciate your work. Plenty of people in the Hub Base are talking about all the help you've provided.

dialogText.cn: 不论如何，我的工作压力确实小了很多……实在感谢。
dialogText.en: Regardless, my workload and stress dropped a lot... Thank you, and I mean it.

dialogText.cn: 也请您注意自己的身体，否则就本末倒置——
dialogText.en: Anyway, please take care of your health, Endmin. Your well-being matters—

actorName.cn: 终末地干员{sm1l1m7-终末地干员}

dialogText.cn: 秦主管，工团的代表到了，是据点规划的沟通会议。
dialogText.en: Director Qin, the UWST representative is here for the meeting about the outpost project.

dialogText.cn: 请至少收下这个，就当作是基地各位给您的谢礼吧。
dialogText.en: At least take this from us. A token of gratitude from everyone in this base.

dialogText.cn: 大家还惦记着那个迎接仪式呢，但只能等有空的时候再说了……我先失陪了。
dialogText.en: And just so you know, everyone's hoping to organize that welcoming ceremony. It may have to be delayed, but we'll do it when everyone has time... Now, if you'd excuse me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，秦工程师现在怎么样了？
dialogText.en: Endmin, how's Director Qin doing?

dialogText.cn: 哪怕只是一些你认为的小事，你也已经为她省下许多精力了。
dialogText.en: You might consider your help insignificant. But in fact, it took a lot of weight off her shoulders.

dialogText.cn: 几十年里，四号谷地已经挺过了一次又一次危机，这里的人一直都很坚强。
dialogText.en: For decades, Valley IV has weathered and survived one crisis after another. The people of the Valley have proven themselves to be incredibly resilient.

dialogText.cn: 大家需要的，只是跌倒之后，能有人伸手扶一把。
dialogText.en: What they need is simple: just a friendly and helpful hand after a fall.

dialogText.cn: 你已经做到最好了。相信大家吧，我们从来都是互相依靠才前行至今的。
dialogText.en: You've already done your best. Now all that's left is to trust everyone. We have always relied on each other, and that is exactly how we've made it to this day.

dialogText.cn: 欸？……当然，管理员，我一直都在。
dialogText.en: Oh...? Of course, Endmin. I'm always here.

dialogText.cn: 让我们继续行动吧，枢纽区基地一定会渡过难关的。
dialogText.en: Let's continue our work. The Hub Base will definitely endure these difficult times.

actorName.cn: 忙碌的工团成员{sm1l1m1-忙碌的工团成员}
actorName.en: Busy UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Busy UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 如果要我列举最想写进墓志铭的句子，“到点收工”肯定位列第一，紧随其后的则是“裂地者滚出我的生活！”。
dialogText.en: Lines I want on my headstone... "ZERO OT" is definitely the first line. "EAT MY SHORTS, LB SCUM!" will be right below.

dialogText.cn: 欢迎使用联盟工团出品的“埃科斯多功能播报器”，请根据您的需求进行操作——
dialogText.en: Welcome. You are now using an Echoes General-Purpose Broadcaster developed by the United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II. Enter your input to get started with —

dialogText.cn: 播放最新录音——
dialogText.en: Playing the latest recording—

dialogText.cn: *咕哝*我们的！都是我们的！！！
dialogText.en: *Mumbles* It's all ours! ALL THIS BELONGS TO US!

dialogText.cn: 都拿好了！*咕哝*只要吃的、能用的！别的全给我砸烂了！砸烂了！
dialogText.en: Grab the stuff! *Mumbles* Just the grub and tools! BREAK AND KRRRUUSH THE REST!! ALL OF 'EM!

dialogText.cn: 似乎是一群裂地者正在进行紧张刺激的抢劫活动……
dialogText.en: Sounds like a bunch of Landbreakers relishing in an exciting raid...

dialogText.cn: 为您播放适配广播——
dialogText.en: Playing a fitting public broadcast—

dialogText.cn: 库房注意标识，做好分门别类，物料轻拿轻放，严禁拖抛滚砸……
dialogText.en: Sort it, label it, love it. Handle all warehouse goods with tender care. No rolling, tossing, dropping, smashing, juggling...

dialogText.cn: 仿佛能一直循环下去的“严禁拖抛滚砸”在耳边回荡……
dialogText.en: The warehouse warning broadcast seemed to go on forever...

dialogText.cn: 电量已耗尽，自动进入休眠模式。
dialogText.en: Battery low. Switching to Sleep Mode.

dialogText.cn: 呼，总算关机了。
dialogText.en: Phew. It's finally turned off.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了，管理员，接下来先回源石副产物中心吧。
dialogText.en: Great job, Endmin. Now, let's head back to the Originium Byproduct Processing Center.

dialogText.cn: 这是……“工作提效智能终端”？！总算又能听到它亲切的播报声了！
dialogText.en: Isn't this our ... Smart Performance Booster?! Oh, we can finally listen to its all-too-familiar broadcasting once more!

dialogText.cn: 让我看看……那群混账裂地者没把它怎么样吧？
dialogText.en: Let me see... Those scabby breakers better not have done anything to it...

dialogText.cn: 啊，是我太激动了！忘了还有这茬了！我这就检查下——
dialogText.en: Ah! Yes! Sheesh, I guess I got too excited I forgot about it! I'll check them right now—

dialogText.cn: 没错，是我们的物资！不过怎么少了一部分……
dialogText.en: Yeah, this is it! Our supplies! But a portion seems to be missing...

dialogText.cn: 一些胶棉炸药。它们本来是用于制作工地的小型爆破装置的……虽然数量不多，但依然危险！
dialogText.en: Gel-cotton. We can use this material to make small demolition charges for construction sites... Our stash doesn't have a lot of them, but they're still pretty dangerous!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，管理员，是我之前疏忽了，以为那些裂地者不懂它们的用处……现在看来，很可能被裂地者藏起来了……
dialogText.en: Apologies, Endmin. This is an oversight on my part. I thought the Landbreakers knew nothing about gel-cotton, but it seems likely they have hidden it away...

dialogText.cn: 看来事情还没结束……我也把炸药丢失的事和警卫先生说一声吧。
dialogText.en: This probably isn't over... I'll also notify the security officer about the missing explosives.

dialogText.cn: 这么看来，或许这件事也和那个“印记”有关呢。
dialogText.en: Seems like this incident may have something to do with the "glyphs".

dialogText.cn: 你觉得呢，管理员？
dialogText.en: What do you think, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 这些裂地者难道是在……“膜拜”巢雕？简直像某种仪式。
dialogText.en: Are these LBs ... "worshiping" a denstack? It looks like some kind of a bizarre ritual.

dialogText.cn: 不过搭配工团这一本正经的安全喊话，反倒显得有点搞笑了……
dialogText.en: And they're doing this while the UWST safety reminders are playing... It's ... kinda funny...

dialogText.cn: 总之，还是先把这些裂地者解决掉再说吧。
dialogText.en: In any case, I'm afraid you might have to take down these breakers first.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这些应该就是裂地者抢走的物资了！把它们都带回去吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, these must be the supplies stolen by the Landbreakers! Let's take them back!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，能关掉那个多功能播报器吗？我听了半天，都有点头疼了……
dialogText.en: One more thing, Endmin. Can you switch off that general-purpose broadcaster? The endless noise is making my head hurt...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？噢，我没事！只是在研究这块石头……
dialogText.en: Endmin? Oh, I'm totally alright! Just checking out this rock...

dialogText.cn: 虽然研究了半天也没看出来个所以然……
dialogText.en: Haven't figured anything out yet, though...

dialogText.cn: 那可太不同了！前两天我亲眼看见，有几个裂地者鬼鬼祟祟地围到一起，在这石头上画了东西！
dialogText.en: Of course it's different! Just two days ago, I saw, with my very own eyes, a bunch of sneaky breakers gathered around the rock. They also drew stuff on it!

dialogText.cn: 这里离我们枢纽区基地这么近……他们肯定是想搞破坏！
dialogText.en: This rock is really close to our Hub Base... Those breakers must be planning another raid!

dialogText.cn: 唉！管理员，你怎么能被它的外表迷惑了呢！
dialogText.en: Come on, Endmin! Don't be deceived by its looks!

dialogText.cn: 它可不普通！上面可是被裂地者画了东西！前两天我亲眼见到的！他们肯定是在用这石头传递什么不可告人的讯息！
dialogText.en: This isn't your ordinary rock! The breakers drew stuff all over it! Saw it with my own eyes two days ago! They're definitely using the rock to spread their secret messages!

dialogText.cn: 呃……这不是……还没研究出来吗……
dialogText.en: Uhm... That's what I'm ... trying to find out...

dialogText.cn: 但我相信！凭借我乔斯特坚韧不拔的钻研精神——肯定能研究出来的！到时候自然就能看出画的什么了！
dialogText.en: But I, Jouster the Meticulous, believe that my persistence and investigative spirit — will figure it out! When that happens, I shall reveal what they drew on this rock!

dialogText.cn: 当然，这时候要是能有个博闻的学者指点我一下……就更好了……
dialogText.en: Yeah, if only some knowledgeable scholar would show up ... and give me some guidance...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你说的……难道是碾骨氏族的“<@qu.key>印记</>”？
dialogText.en: Endmin, from what you said ... can those drawings be Bonekrusher "<@qu.key>glyphs</>"?

dialogText.cn: 之前我们收到过相关的情报——说是他们涂的时候会使用某种特别的涂料，不用碾骨氏族特有的方法，一般很难看出来。
dialogText.en: We have received relevant intel — These glyphs are drawn using a special type of paint. You'll need a secret Bonekrusher way to see these glyphs.

dialogText.cn: 别着急，管理员，试试我们的扫描技术吧！
dialogText.en: Don't give up yet, Endmin! Try scanning it!

dialogText.cn: 它原本就是用来查看这类隐藏讯息的！
dialogText.en: Our scanners are designed to reveal secrets like this.

dialogText.cn: 听起来好像有戏？看来要想弄清楚这上面符号的意思……只能先扫描一下了！靠你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Sounds like a real solution! I guess all we need ... is a proper scan to reveal the secrets behind these dastardly glyphs! Do us the honors, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 啊！出现了！
dialogText.en: Ah! Look, they have been revealed!

dialogText.cn: 原来这就是“<@qu.key>碾骨印记</>”真正的样子……
dialogText.en: So this is what "<@qu.key>Bonekrusher glyphs</>" really look like...

dialogText.cn: 不过看起来怎么不太完整？就好像是缺了点什么……
dialogText.en: It seems rather incomplete. I think we're missing something...

dialogText.cn: 总觉得有什么蹊跷……
dialogText.en: Something doesn't look right...

dialogText.cn: 对了！我想起来了！那里可能会有线索！
dialogText.en: Ah! I just remembered something! We'll definitely find some clues at that place!

dialogText.cn: 就是那边的<@qu.key>源石副产物中心</>！
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>Originium Byproduct Processing Center</>! It's just over there!

dialogText.cn: 那里最近被裂地者袭击了！现场虽然一片狼藉，但或许能找到裂地者留下的痕迹……
dialogText.en: The breakers whacked the BPPC recently. The place is a total mess now, but the raiders probably left some graffiti behind...

dialogText.cn: 你肯定懂的吧，管理员！痕迹就是线索！我们说不定，可以通过这些印记的所在地推测出裂地者的动向！知道了他们的动向，要搞清楚这些图案的意思也是迟早的事！刑侦小说里不都是这么写的？
dialogText.en: Come on, Endmin, you know what I'm trying to say! The graffiti is the clue. We can use the glyphs' positions to predict the LB's plans, and with that, we'll figure out what their glyphs actually mean! That's what detective novels always say, right?!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，既然我们现在也没别的头绪，不如就先去源石副产物中心调查下吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, since we don't have any other leads, we might as well head to the Originium BPPC to investigate.

dialogText.cn: 靠你了，管理员！我就在这里等你的好消息了！有你帮忙，我们肯定能搞清楚那些裂地者的大阴谋！
dialogText.en: I'm counting on you, Endmin! I'll be waiting here for your good news! Your help will surely get us to the bottom of the Landbreakers' mega scheme!

actorName.cn: 愤怒的工团成员{sm1l1m1-愤怒的工团成员}
actorName.en: Furious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Furious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 四五天的活都白干了！该死的裂地者……
dialogText.en: Five days' worth of hard work! GONE! Damn those LB scum...

actorName.cn: 愤怒的工团成员{sm1l1m1-愤怒的工团成员}
actorName.en: Furious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Furious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 别问我，我现在可没这个闲工夫！
dialogText.en: Don't ask me. Got no time for this sort of nonsense!

actorName.cn: 愤怒的工团成员{sm1l1m1-愤怒的工团成员}
actorName.en: Furious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Furious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 想做采访？找那边管事的吧，他正气得有一肚子话想找人说呢。
dialogText.en: If you want an interview, go talk to the crew lead. He's got a ton of fury to share.

actorName.cn: 忙碌的工团成员{sm1l1m1-忙碌的工团成员}
actorName.en: Busy UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Busy UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 不能拖累其他生产线的工友……今天一定要干完这些活！
dialogText.en: Can't afford to slow down the crew of other production lines... I gotta finish the quota for today!

actorName.cn: 忙碌的工团成员{sm1l1m1-忙碌的工团成员}
actorName.en: Busy UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Busy UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我现在忙着干活，你还是换个人问吧。
dialogText.en: Sorry, but I'm really busy right now. It's best if you ask someone else.

actorName.cn: 忙碌的工团成员{sm1l1m1-忙碌的工团成员}
actorName.en: Busy UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Busy UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 比如那边的负责人？我看他再不找人说两句，估计快气上天了……
dialogText.en: You can try talking to our crew lead over there. He's like a volcano ready to blow. A good chat might help him vent off some steam...

actorName.cn: 气急败坏的工团成员{萨特}

dialogText.cn: 这些裂地者太过分了！要是被我逮住，我绝对饶不了他们！
dialogText.en: Now these LBs have done it! If I ever get my hands on them, there'll be no mercy!

actorName.cn: 气急败坏的工团成员{萨特}

dialogText.cn: 还不是那些裂地者……！抢了一大堆物资不说，连我们的“<@qu.key>工作提效智能终端</>”都被拿走了！本来大家这几天就够累了……现在整个工作规划都被他们打乱了！
dialogText.en: It's the Landbreakers... They stole loads of our stuff, even our <@qu.key>Smart Performance Booster</>! My entire crew is stretched thin, and without the booster ... our schedule is totally messed up!

actorName.cn: 气急败坏的工团成员{萨特}

dialogText.cn: 你是……终末地的人？嗐，还不是那群丧心病狂的裂地者！他们不仅把我们储备的物资全抢了，还顺走了我们的“工作提效智能终端”！！简直丧心病狂！
dialogText.en: You're ... Endfielders, right? Ugh. It's those Landbreaker lunatics again! They grabbed our stockpile and even stole our Smart Performance Booster!! I can't stand this anymore!

actorName.cn: 气急败坏的工团成员{萨特}

dialogText.cn: 你也知道了？对，那群该死的裂地者抢走了这边大半的储备物资，连我们的“工作提效智能终端”都被顺走了！这群裂地者真当我们工团的人这么好欺负吗！！
dialogText.en: You heard about it, eh? Yeah. Friggin' breakers nabbed more than half of our stockpile, including our Smart Performance Booster! Do these breakers treat the United Workers as a bunch of softies?!

actorName.cn: 气急败坏的工团成员{萨特}

dialogText.cn: 噢，那是台我们工团内部研发的多功能播报器，会根据天气、环境还有工作时间安排，播放专门录制的广播内容！大家一开始还不太适应，但听多了慢慢也习惯了它的“陪伴”……不少工友甚至觉得干活的时候都更有劲了……
dialogText.en: Yeah. It's a general-purpose broadcaster developed by the UWST. It automatically plays pre-recorded messages based on the weather, environment, and work schedule! Everyone found it annoying at first, but we got used to its "company"... In fact, it was boosting the work performance of many of our crew mates...

actorName.cn: 气急败坏的工团成员{萨特}

dialogText.cn: 所以我们干脆给它改了个名字，叫“工作提效智能终端”。那些裂地者……可别把它像其他机器那样拆了啊！否则我萨特·亚茨绝不会饶了他们的！
dialogText.en: So we decided to give it a new name — Smart Performance Booster. Those Landbreakers ... they better not take it apart like they do with the other machines — or I, Satyr Yatzi, will unleash hell on these scav rippers!

dialogText.cn: 我想想……那边的零件算吗？
dialogText.en: Let me think... Do those parts count?

dialogText.cn: 都是从裂地者砸烂后带走的机器上掉下来的！
dialogText.en: The breakers smashed our machines and looted the parts. They must have dropped them along the way.

dialogText.cn: 唔，这我也不太清楚。当时我刚午休结束，赶过来的时候他们早没影了……不过我敢肯定，他们一定是往那个方向走了！
dialogText.en: Hmm... I don't really know. I just came back from lunch break and the looters were already gone... But I'm sure they went that way!

dialogText.cn: 因为只有那里的地面上有很多零件——肯定是从他们砸烂后带走的机器上掉的！
dialogText.en: Look at the ground along that direction! Parts, nuts, and bolts — these must've been dropped from the machines looted by the breakers.

dialogText.cn: 等等……你是想去找那群裂地者？
dialogText.en: Wait... Don't tell me you're going to find those breaker scum?

dialogText.cn: 这样的话，能帮我们把“工作提效智能终端”带回来吗？
dialogText.en: Well, if that's the case, maybe you can help us retrieve our Smart Performance Booster?

dialogText.cn: 能带多少就带多少吧！至少能补充些我们缺的材料，多谢了！
dialogText.en: Just retrieve whatever you can find and bring along with you! At least it'd address our materials shortage. Really appreciate this!

dialogText.cn: “工作提效智能终端”啊……少了它，还真是不太习惯。
dialogText.en: Smart Performance Booster... Working without it feels really weird.

actorName.cn: 愤怒的工团成员{sm1l1m1-愤怒的工团成员}
actorName.en: Furious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l1m1-Furious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 活干不完了！终端在的时候好歹还能听它放点音乐呢……现在好了，连这点乐趣都没了！该死的裂地者！
dialogText.en: I CAN'T FINISH MY JOB! We would be getting some music if the booster was around... But now it's gone, we don't even have a decent BGM no more! Blight those breaker scum!

dialogText.cn: 乔斯特他怎么突然离线了？
dialogText.en: Why did Jouster suddenly go offline?

dialogText.cn: 感觉四号谷地的网络最近一直都不太稳定……等下再联系他好了。
dialogText.en: Network connection in Valley IV has been pretty unstable... Maybe I'll try calling him later.

dialogText.cn: 不过，想彻底搞清楚这些标记的意思，我们要不要再回到<@qu.key>裂地者的营地</>仔细调查下？说不定会有什么新发现呢？
dialogText.en: Since we're trying to figure out what the glyphs actually mean, maybe we should head back to the <@qu.key>LB camp</> and investigate, Endmin. Perhaps we'll find something new.

actorName.cn: 癫狂的裂地者焰术师{sm1l1m2-裂地者法师}

dialogText.cn: 烧！烧光这些虫子！这些垃圾！
