dialogText.en: BURN! Burn these buggerloids! To the flames with the trash!

actorName.cn: 癫狂的裂地者焰术师{sm1l1m2-裂地者法师}

dialogText.cn: 向他们复仇！全都烧干净！
dialogText.en: Rain vengeance upon them! BURN THEM ALL TO ASH!

actorName.cn: 癫狂的裂地者焰术师{sm1l1m2-裂地者法师}

dialogText.cn: 让雾气包围一切！雾中才能看见真实！
dialogText.en: Be immersed in the haze! Only in the haze will you see the truth!

actorName.cn: 癫狂的裂地者焰术师{sm1l1m2-裂地者法师}

dialogText.cn: 雾气能隐藏真实！没有人会看得见！没有人！
dialogText.en: The truth is hidden within the haze! No one will ever see it! NO ONE!

dialogText.cn: 虽然没怎么听懂……但话里有些字眼还挺让人在意的。
dialogText.en: I can't really understand him ... but some of his words could be worth our attention.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你怎么看？有什么和那个<@qu.key>印记</>有关的线索吗？
dialogText.en: What do you think, Endmin? Did you catch anything he said that might help us with the <@qu.key>glyphs</>?

dialogText.cn: 难道这些巢雕散发的雾气有什么我们不知道的作用？
dialogText.en: Perhaps the haze from these denstacks is causing effects we're not aware of?

dialogText.cn: 我想起来了，之前那次是不是也是这种情况？
dialogText.en: Oh, I remember. We did this before, right?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，不如你也像当时那样去调查一下吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's try what we did last time. We might find something.

dialogText.cn: 跳到巢雕上？管理员你也太大胆了！
dialogText.en: Jump onto the denstack? That's very audacious, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 不过也许可以试试看？我总觉得这些巢雕散发的雾气怪怪的……
dialogText.en: But we can try giving that a shot! Somehow, I feel the haze from these denstacks might be different...

dialogText.cn: 不过你这么一说我就想起来了，之前我们好像也遇到过类似的情况？这些巢雕散发的雾气确实很特别……
dialogText.en: Now that you mention it, we did this before, right? These denstacks are giving off a special kind of haze...

dialogText.cn: 但直接调查会不会不太安全？
dialogText.en: A direct investigation might be risky, though.

dialogText.cn: 好吧，那管理员你小心点，要是感觉有什么不对，就赶紧离开那里！
dialogText.en: Alright then, Endmin. Be careful. If anything doesn't smell right, make a run for it!

dialogText.cn: 唔，大门的周围有明显的进出痕迹，加上那三个长得一模一样的<@qu.key>装置</>……管理员，这里肯定有能开门的机关。
dialogText.en: I can see clear signs of passage around this gate. And those three identical <@qu.key>devices</>... Endmin, there're definitely mechanisms here to open the gate.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，看来得靠你去研究一下了……
dialogText.en: Endmin, we're counting on you to figure this out.

dialogText.cn: （封闭的大门，三个相同的机关……那边的巢雕会和它们有关吗？）
dialogText.en: (A sealed gate and three identical devices... That denstack may have something to do with them.)

dialogText.cn: 在地上找到了一张纸条，上面写着——“伟大的<@qu.key>头领</>将夺得的<@qu.key>宝藏</>赐予我们，我们将这些珍贵之物<@qu.key>埋藏</>在了此地。”
dialogText.en: There's a note on the ground. It reads: "Da greyt <@qu.key>BAWS</> gives us da <@qu.key>treyzsurr</> and we's <@qu.key>buryed</> da loot at dis place."

dialogText.cn: （总觉得最近在哪里看到过里面的某几个词……有空查一下档案库吧。）
dialogText.en: (These words seem familiar... Better check the Archive via Protosync.)

dialogText.cn: 哇，真的是工团的<@qu.key>物资</>！
dialogText.en: Woah! These are legit UWST <@qu.key>supplies</>!

dialogText.cn: 不过不是那些丢失的炸药，看起来更像是一些机器零件……应该是他们从其他地方抢来的？
dialogText.en: But these aren't explosives. They look more like machine parts... The breakers probably looted them from other places.

dialogText.cn: 总之等出去了就交还给工团的工友吧。
dialogText.en: Anyway, we should take these with us and return them to the UWST crew mates.

dialogText.cn: 唉！这次是我掉以轻心了……！身为警卫竟然沦落到要被人救的地步！太失职了！！
dialogText.en: Ugh! I've let my guard down...! I'm a security guard, but now I need people to come save me? This is so embarrassing!

dialogText.cn: 是我的错！都没发现自己被那些裂地者跟踪了！结果他们趁我专注找线索的时候偷袭了我！我刚打趴了一个，就被他们敲晕了……
dialogText.en: Well, I slipped up! I failed to notice the Landbreakers stalking me! They took me by surprise while I was focused on the clues! I got one down before the others knocked me out cold...

dialogText.cn: 等我清醒过来，人就已经被关在了这里……不过现在最重要的不是这些！管理员你看——
dialogText.en: Then I woke up in this crappy cell... But that's beside the point! Look, Endmin—

dialogText.cn: 通过已有的涂鸦，外加他们留下的一些记录，我推断出了一些涂鸦的含义！原来之前那块石头上画的是“集合点”！他们估计打算从那里进攻枢纽区基地！
dialogText.en: After analyzing the existing graffiti and the records they left behind, I cracked their code! That glyph we saw on the rock means "Rallying Point"! They're gearing up to attack the Hub Base from there!

dialogText.cn: 那我得赶快回去把那个石头处理掉！绝不能让那些裂地者得逞！
dialogText.en: Then I better hurry and get rid of that rock! We can't let the Landbreakers have their way!

dialogText.cn: 对了，我还记录了一些其他涂鸦的含义，就送给管理员你当纪念了！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah, I also made a few notes on the meanings of the other graffiti! Take this, Endmin. Treat it as a souvenir of our great teamwork!

dialogText.cn: （进入雾气后，似乎看到了一些<@qu.key>奇怪的涂鸦</>……）
dialogText.en: (Entering the haze seems to reveal <@qu.key>strange-looking graffiti</>...)

dialogText.cn: 什么？你说这些图案变得和你之前看到的不一样了？
dialogText.en: What? Are you saying that the glyphs are different from those you've seen before?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，保险起见，还是先按照它们的指引走吧？
dialogText.en: Maybe we should check what they're pointing at, Endmin. Just to be on the safe side.

dialogText.cn: 怎么办……忙死了……
dialogText.en: Need a solution... I'm busy enough as it is...

dialogText.cn: 管理员！啊，你来得正好！
dialogText.en: Endministrator! Thank goodness, you came at just the right time!

dialogText.cn: 唉，我手头正好有件特别棘手的事，都快两天没合眼了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I've got a very perplexing situation on my hands. It's kept me up for two nights.

dialogText.cn: 咱们终末地之前和一家公司刚谈好了一个代理权合作，就差跟人钱货两讫了。
dialogText.en: A while ago, Endfield entered into a vendor contract with another company. We just need to finalize the payment and delivery of the cargo.

dialogText.cn: 然后……四号谷地就出了状况，他们这会儿派人来接洽，我排不开人手了。
dialogText.en: But ... Valley IV endured quite a situation. The vendor sent one of their agents here to meet us, but I have no one to spare.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这次和我们合作的这家公司，叫作“<@qu.key>埃里克松商贸</>”，在环塔商会名录里登记过。
dialogText.en: Endmin, our partner in this undertaking is <@qu.key>Erikssohn Trading House</>. It's a company listed in the TGCC Corporate Registry.

dialogText.cn: 我检查过了，资质合法合规，但最近的交易记录少之又少。
dialogText.en: I've run the background checks. They seem like a legitimate operation but they hardly received any deals recently.

dialogText.cn: 而且，这里刚安定没多久，它就又来联络了……虽然是好事，但总觉得有点可疑。
dialogText.en: And Erikssohn gave us a call just as things started to settle down in the Valley... That's good news, but it smells a bit suspicious to me.

dialogText.cn: 最古怪的是，他们竞价时给我们开的报价，比市面上其他公司高出一大截！
dialogText.en: And I found something really funny: the bid they gave us during the bidding process is way, WAY higher than the market average!

dialogText.cn: 哦，对了，至于对合作方的考察，管理员，你可以凭借你的判断，把信息记录到这份档案里。要是有需要进一步核查的细节，相关部门的同事都会跟进的。
dialogText.en: And feel free to exercise your judgment when auditing our potential partner, Endmin. Record the data in this file. If there's something you wish verified, our people in the relevant divisions will handle it.

dialogText.cn: 那么这事就交给管理员你了！终于放下心了，我先去忙别的了！
dialogText.en: Really counting on you for this, Endmin! Now that's one thing off my checklist. Gotta go and handle another problem!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你总在外面跑，比我们坐办公室的见得多些，所以，能不能帮我们把把关，顺便安排个使用演示？
dialogText.en: Endmin, you've dealt with far more people than office clerks like us. So I wonder if I can ask you to audit them for us, and maybe arrange a product demo as well?

dialogText.cn: 这……毕竟眼见为实嘛！
dialogText.en: Well ... seeing is believing, right?

dialogText.cn: 你想，我们让人在滑索上划过裂谷，轻松便捷，潇洒自在……这才有说服力呀！
dialogText.en: Just picture this: our Endfielders zipping across the chasm — quick, easy, convenient, casual, and relaxed... Now that'll convince everyone to buy our product!

actorName.cn: 穿着考究的男人{哈特曼}

dialogText.cn: 您好，您就是终末地工业来对接的代表吧？
dialogText.en: Greetings. Are you the representative of Endfield Industries?

actorName.cn: 穿着考究的男人{哈特曼}

dialogText.cn: 对对对，哎呀，没想到贵司派来的人这么年轻。
dialogText.en: Ah, yes! That will be me. I didn't expect your company to send someone so young-looking.

actorName.cn: 穿着考究的男人{哈特曼}

dialogText.cn: 我叫<@qu.key>哈特曼</>，是埃里克松商贸的高级业务员，这是我的名片，请您先加个联系方式吧！
dialogText.en: My name is <@qu.key>Hartmann</>, senior marketing specialist of Erikssohn Trading House. This is my business card. Please add me to your list of contacts!

dialogText.cn: 唔，{player}？原、原来您就是那位管理员？！
dialogText.en: Huh?! {player}? You're actually the "Endministrator"?!

dialogText.cn: 当然，当然。没想到贵司会让您来见我，看来是真的很重视这次合作啊！
dialogText.en: Of course. I just didn't expect the Endministrator would personally come to meet me. This deal must be extremely important to your organization.

dialogText.cn: 那么，按照先前约定好的，我们开始产品演示的流程吧！
dialogText.en: So, as per our previous agreement, let's proceed with the product demo!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，产品演示要开始了吗？我已经给你们选好点了。对面那座山地势高、视野好，适合展示滑索的性能，就往那里去吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin, ready to give a product demo? I've marked the zipline deployment sites. That hill over there has the required elevation and a pretty decent view. It's perfect for showcasing the capabilities of our zipline. Let's go there!

dialogText.cn: 那么高那么远……我怎么有点发怵呢……
dialogText.en: This height ... and this distance... Honestly, I'm a little nervous.

dialogText.cn: 等着见识终末地的实力吧！管理员，可以开始铺设第一根滑索架了。
dialogText.en: Well, you'll be witnessing the true capabilities of Endfield soon enough! Endmin, let's lay down the first Zipline Pylon.

dialogText.cn: 这里风好大啊……峡谷这么深……滑索架这么高……
dialogText.en: The wind is so strong ... the gorge is so deep ... and the zipline pylon is so tall...

dialogText.cn: 等一下，你们就靠这玩意儿站人？这踏板，还没我女儿的玩具车大啊！
dialogText.en: Wait! You can't be serious! How am I supposed to step on this?! It's hardly bigger than my baby girl's toy car!

dialogText.cn: 要、要不先算了，我还是先去旁边做一下心理建设……
dialogText.en: How ... how about we skip the demo...? I really need to get myself mentally ready for this...
...WHOAAAAAARRAAAGGGGHHHH!

dialogText.cn: 啊啊啊啊啊啊……
dialogText.en: ...AAAAAARRRRRRRGGGGGHHHH...

dialogText.cn: 太……太快了！心脏还在怦怦跳！
dialogText.en: That was ... so, so fast! I gotta let my heart slow down a little!

dialogText.cn: 这个产品推广出去，销量绝对差不了！它能跨越恶劣地形的阻碍，大大提高通行能力。如果把价格打下来，那可都是滚滚而来的生产力啊！
dialogText.en: With a proper ad campaign, this zipline will definitely get stellar sales! It allows people to simply zip across bad terrain, significantly boosting transport efficiency. Once we bring the prices down, we'll be getting serious productivity boosts with your ziplines!

dialogText.cn: 那咱们就付定金签合同吧！我们出的价格，绝对配得上你们产品的质量，拿出去也是最有竞争力的那一档！
dialogText.en: I'm ready to finalize the deal with my signature! Our generous bid is surely worth the quality of your goods! It's one of the most competitive packages out there!

dialogText.cn: 我的合同准备好了，就在包里……咦？
dialogText.en: I've prepared the contract and it's in my briefcase... Hmm?

dialogText.cn: 我合同呢？我记得昨晚打好了，放到夹层里，还专门检查了一遍……噢，好像是……落在车里了……
dialogText.en: Where did it go? I thought I placed it in this compartment and checked it last evening... Oh. Dang it... I probably left it in the car...

dialogText.cn: 抱、抱歉，出了一点小问题！这个这个，有点丢人了，合同我刚好没带在身上，等我去车上取一下！我们待会儿直接在基地入口那儿见吧！
dialogText.en: Ah, apologies. Got a tiny problem! It's quite embarrassing to admit this, but I forgot to bring the contract along. Can you wait for me while I fetch it from my car? How about we meet a bit later at the base entrance?

dialogText.cn: ……疼……好疼啊……
dialogText.en: ...Urgh ... it really hurts...

dialogText.cn: 那是你要找的人吗？
dialogText.en: Looking for this guy?

dialogText.cn: 我的腿！我的腿被人打断了！
dialogText.en: My leg! They broke my leg!

dialogText.cn: 让我检查一下……是谁攻击了你？
dialogText.en: Let me take a look... Who attacked you?

dialogText.cn: 不知道……嘶……可能是裂地者吧……
dialogText.en: I don't know ... HSSSSS... Landbreakers, probably...

dialogText.cn: 没有伤到骨头，只是开了点皮肉——下手还是轻的。这附近应该有用来<@qu.key>止血的植物</>，去找找吧。
dialogText.en: Just a flesh wound, no broken bones — They weren't out to take his life. Herbs nearby should be able to <@qu.key>stop the bleeding</>. Let's look for some.

dialogText.cn: 这、这样吗？那就好……
dialogText.en: Really? Okay ... that's good to hear...

dialogText.cn: 妈呀……这破地方……
dialogText.en: This place is one ... blighted backwater...

dialogText.cn: 这辈子都不会再来了，给多少单子都不做！
dialogText.en: No way I'm coming back here! No matter how many orders they provide!

dialogText.cn: 呃……刚刚……刚刚……我本来好不容易取到了合同，然后就开着车往你们这儿过来了。结果谁知道才开了几步路，突然听到“砰”的一声，我这车的轮胎瞬间就爆了！
dialogText.en: Ugh... It all happened just now... I got back, found the contract, and started driving to your place. Everything was fine until "KABAM," the tires of my car blew out!

dialogText.cn: 我才刚停下车，想下去看看情况，就发现周围有群裂地者盯着我……
dialogText.en: So I stopped the car to take a look. Then I found myself surrounded by a Landbreaker mob...

dialogText.cn: 这群人二话没说，上来就把我丢下车，还把我车里的东西全给抢了……
dialogText.en: They attacked me, dragged me out of the car, threw me on the ground, and nabbed all my stuff...

dialogText.cn: 抢就抢了吧，还说什么“钱少了，不够交差”……也太看不起人了吧！
dialogText.en: Getting mugged happens all the time, but these breakers actually said, "Too little money. Leader won't be happy"... I mean, they took all my money — isn't that enough?

dialogText.cn: ……裂地者会说这样的话？
dialogText.en: ...Did the breakers say those words?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我有点怀疑。在事故现场调查一下吧。
dialogText.en: This looks suspicious to me, Endmin. Let's investigate the site of the attack.

dialogText.cn: 不太对劲……这群“裂地者”的做法未免有点太像样了。
dialogText.en: This doesn't look right... These "Landbreakers" conducted the attack too professionally.

dialogText.cn: 外行。裂地者不会用弩打破轮胎，况且，他们只会抢那些看起来就比较贵重的东西。文件、契约，对他们来说没有意义。
dialogText.en: Yes. An amateurish pretense of a Landbreaker attack. True breakers won't take out tires with crossbow bolts. They only grab things that look expensive. Files and contracts are worthless to them.

dialogText.cn: 这种事，像是环带的“文明人”做的。
dialogText.en: This feels like a setup done by "civilized people" from the Band.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样啊？找到是谁害了我吗？
dialogText.en: How goes your search? Found the Landbreakers who attacked me?

dialogText.cn: 唉……这……难办。算我认了吧！但是，这下搞得我们的交易要推迟了。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Whatever. I guess I'll have to live with this! Sorry, Endmin. We'll have to postpone the deal.

dialogText.cn: 虽然合同只要重拟一份，但没了那个关键的认证密钥，合同就不算数了。我必须回去找公司申请特批才行……
dialogText.en: We can always print another contract, but losing that verification key has voided the old contract. I must head back to my company and apply for a special permit...

dialogText.cn: 还是谢谢你们帮我包扎了，唉，还得头疼这车，真靠两条腿跑业务……不如让他们刚才杀了我！
dialogText.en: Anyways, thank you for dressing my wound. The car is another problem I have to fix. Being a sales agent without a vehicle is impossible — might as well kill me!

dialogText.cn: 我今天得先回去了，这班真是一天都没法上……等我后续联系你们吧。唉，真是晦气……
dialogText.en: I don't think I can get any work done in a state like this... I'll head back now and call you later. Ugh. Curse my luck...

actorName.cn: 穿着浮夸的男人{亚历山大}

dialogText.cn: 您好，您就是终末地的管理员阁下吧，幸会了。
dialogText.en: Greetings. You must be the Esteemed Endministrator of Endfield Industries. Pleased to meet you.

actorName.cn: 穿着浮夸的男人{亚历山大}

dialogText.cn: 换人？没有呀，管理员阁下，这项业务一直是我跟的呀。
dialogText.en: Someone else? No, Esteemed Endmin. I've been managing this contract since the very beginning.

actorName.cn: 穿着浮夸的男人{亚历山大}

dialogText.cn: 我是<@qu.key>埃里克松商贸</>的业务员亚历山大，这是我的名片。
dialogText.en: My name is Aleksandr and I work at the business and sales department of <@qu.key>Erikssohn Trading House</>. This is my business card.

dialogText.cn: 管理员阁下，我一看您这样貌，这气度，就知道这单铁定能成！
dialogText.en: Esteemed Endmin, seeing your regal bearing and aura of leadership, I'm sure our deal will be successfully concluded today!

actorName.cn: 穿着浮夸的男人{亚历山大}

dialogText.cn: 您看起来不太有兴致呀。这可是个大单子——是有什么疑虑吗？
dialogText.en: You don't look very enthusiastic. Please understand that this is a major contract — Is there anything you're concerned with?

dialogText.cn: 哈特曼？我……没听说过这号人呀。
dialogText.en: Hartmann? I ... don't think I've heard about him before.

dialogText.cn: 啊？还有这种事！
dialogText.en: Wha? That actually happened?!

dialogText.cn: 好在管理员阁下明察秋毫，没有让那诈骗犯捷足先登，不然这生意黄了，都没地方说理！
dialogText.en: My Esteemed Endmin, fortunately you have observant eyes. That man is a scammer. Signing his bogus contract would be a mistake that cannot be salvaged!

dialogText.cn: 唉，看来您最近事务冗杂，没时间读新闻。四号谷地最近流窜来了一个臭名昭著的诈骗犯，假扮公司员工，在到处招摇撞骗呢。
dialogText.en: You must have been too busy to keep yourself updated with the latest news. A notorious scammer recently made his way into Valley IV. He's now disguised as a corporate agent and has swindled plenty of honest businesses.

dialogText.cn: 管理员阁下，您想，终末地的滑索还没怎么在市场上露过面，只有深耕运输领域多年的业务员，才能嗅到这种消息，对吧？
dialogText.en: Think about it, Esteemed Endmin. The Endfield zipline suite has not been formally revealed to the market. Only agents most experienced in the transport business would sniff it out, right?

dialogText.cn: 我不是说您的东西不好……这个领域的先期投入很大，大家都在谨慎观望，初始报价一般不会太夸张的。
dialogText.en: I'm not painting your product in a bad light... But zipline systems are marked with high initial costs. Everyone is cautious. Initial bids would tend to be more conservative.

dialogText.cn: 除非……是商业间谍，早就探到了别家公司的报价，所以才给出了这么一个离谱的数额，想诱骗您赶紧签上那份假合同呢。
dialogText.en: Unless, of course, we're talking about ... a corporate spy who knows everyone else's bottom line. His bid would be too good to be true. His only aim is to get your signature on the bogus contract.

dialogText.cn: 什么认证密钥，自然也都是假的啦！到时候，再弄个皮套公司，把资金流转一下……这钱货两空，就不好了！好险好险。
dialogText.en: Anything like a verification key is a total fake. He might even create a shell company just to win your trust. And once you deliver the goods, he disappears with all your money and leaves you with nothing. You're lucky this hasn't happened to you.

dialogText.cn: 等等，你们不会也遇到诈骗犯了吧？
dialogText.en: Wait. Did you run into the scammer as well?

dialogText.cn: 哎！诈骗犯呀，我最近也听说了好几次！不是被骗了货就是被骗了单子……
dialogText.en: Ugh! I've heard plenty of stories about that scammer! People got scammed out of their goods and orders...

dialogText.cn: 真是世风日下！本来这年头的生意就不好做……现在好了，又多了个诈骗犯，大家钱袋子揣得紧紧的，以后想谈成交易怕是难上加难咯……
dialogText.en: What's happening to our world? Business is tough enough already ... and now a fraud has decided to join the show! People are gonna hold onto their money. It'd be damn near impossible to make a proper deal...

dialogText.cn: 看来，这位老先生也是来这里跑业务的？
dialogText.en: Well met, good sir. I take it that you're in business and sales as well?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，路过，路过而已……这不是听到你们在聊诈骗犯的事吗？忍不住多说了两句，当我没说哈……
dialogText.en: Heh. Just passing by, you know, just passing by... Heard you talking about the fraud so I had to give my two cents. Don't take my word for it, though.

dialogText.cn: 这位老板，还有这位……同僚，我叫汉斯，刚好也在附近跑销售呢。大家碰上了就是缘分，这是我的名片，您俩都收下吧！
dialogText.en: So, my friend and ... my fellow negotiator. I'm Hans, and I'm trying to get some deals going as well. Seems fate has brought us all together. Here's my card. And here's one for you, too.

dialogText.cn: 我也就做做小本生意，希望不要让我也碰上诈骗犯了！
dialogText.en: I represent a small business, and I really hope we don't have to deal with these scammers.

dialogText.cn: 管理员阁下，您看，不是我一个人这样说。
dialogText.en: You see, Esteemed Endmin. I'm not the only one worried about scammers.

dialogText.cn: 那么，合同拟好了，咱们去您的办公室签约吧？
dialogText.en: Now that we have a contract, I suppose we can have it formally signed at your office.

actorName.cn: 穿着浮夸的男人{亚历山大}

dialogText.cn: 我是埃里克松商贸的业务员亚历山大，这是我的名片。
dialogText.en: My name is Aleksandr and I work at the business and sales department of Erikssohn Trading House. This is my business card.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！！
dialogText.en: Endmin!!

dialogText.cn: 可算让我赶上了。管理员，千万别签字！
dialogText.en: I made it in time. DON'T SIGN THAT CONTRACT, ENDMIN!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，别信他！他压根就不是我们<@qu.key>埃里克松商贸</>的员工啊！
dialogText.en: Don't trust this guy, Endmin! He's no employee of <@qu.key>Erikssohn</>!

dialogText.cn: 亚历山大，我真没想到，你这个大公司的名嘴销售，居然也有玩冒名顶替的一天！下作啊！
dialogText.en: Well, well, Aleksandr. Top sales executive of a big company. Never expected you to steal my identity! How despicable!

dialogText.cn: 等等，什么？！……亚历山大这家伙还敢说我是诈骗犯？！
dialogText.en: Wait, what...?! He called me a scammer?!

dialogText.cn: 你这人，是在拿管理员阁下开玩笑吗？我可不认识你这半路杀出来的诈骗犯啊。
dialogText.en: Are you making fun of our Esteemed Endmin? I don't know you at all. You must be the scammer who crawled out from nowhere.

dialogText.cn: 什么？！你还敢说我是诈骗犯？！
dialogText.en: WHAT?! How dare you call me a scammer!

dialogText.cn: 真是……管理员你们看，我腿上还带着昨天的伤呢！我要真是骗子，怎么可能做到这地步？！
dialogText.en: I'll show you... Look, Endmin! My leg still carries the wound from yesterday! A criminal cheat wouldn't let his leg get cut up like this, right?

dialogText.cn: 谁知道你是不是在演苦肉计呢？
dialogText.en: Maybe you and your cronies did it for sympathy points.
Why you ... I ... I'm gonna...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我这里就有公司的终端，你来查查就知道了——我们埃里克松商贸的员工名册里，根本没有亚历山大这号人！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I have my company's handyterm right here. I'll show you our list of employees. Nobody in Erikssohn is called Aleksandr.

dialogText.cn: 说我冒充，你有什么证据吗？
dialogText.en: Do you have any proof that I'm an identity thief?

dialogText.cn: 咱们是讲道理的人，对不对？
dialogText.en: We are civilized people, after all.

dialogText.cn: 哎，好了好了。事到如今，再开玩笑也没什么意思。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Fine. If things have come to this, playing this game no longer serves any purpose.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，是这样的，为了和您谈上生意，我确实耍了一点小手段……
dialogText.en: I'll just be honest with you, Endministrator. I did use a few business tricks to secure a meeting with you...

dialogText.cn: 不过那都是正常范围内的操作，生意场上就是要残酷一些的。哈特曼，你也别太大惊小怪了。
dialogText.en: But this is part and parcel for anyone who wants to make the killer deal. Business can be cruel and merciless. Don't let this get to your head, Hartmann.

dialogText.cn: 我这是把管理员当作掏心掏肺的家里人了嘛！这时候还一口一个“阁下”，多生分呀！当然，如果您爱听，我就接着叫。
dialogText.en: I'm treating you like family now, Endmin! Calling you our Esteemed Endministrator creates distance between us! Of course, I will maintain formalities if that is your wish!

dialogText.cn: 其实我也没准备一直瞒着管理员阁下的呀。我是打算，咱们先到您的办公室里，坐下来再慢慢聊这事——没想到还是被哈特曼赶上了。
dialogText.en: I didn't plan to keep you in the dark, Esteemed Endmin. If things went my way, we would already be seated in your office going over the details of the deal — But Hartmann's sudden appearance interrupted my efforts.

dialogText.cn: 被我赶上？！怎么你还理直气壮起来了……
dialogText.en: My sudden appearance?! You're the criminal here, Aleksandr!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，也许这会儿您看我是坏人，可是这事儿实际上并没有这么单纯。埃里克松商贸的经营状况，您还没有了解过吧？
dialogText.en: I might look like the bad guy now, Endministrator, but this isn't as simple as it looks. Perhaps you haven't heard about the situation at Erikssohn Trading House?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我其实是<@qu.key>克莱韦思环塔贸易</>公司的员工。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'm actually an agent representing <@qu.key>Clavis TGCC Trading</>.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您真是敏锐！
dialogText.en: Very observant, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 那也不是你冒充我们公司的理由！管理员，这个亚历山大，可是环塔商会里人人闻风丧胆的“毒蛇”，克莱韦思也不是什么善茬。
dialogText.en: But that's no reason for you to dress up as an Erikssohn agent! Endmin, don't trust this Aleksandr! Tons of folk in the TGCC call him the Viper... And Clavis isn't as good as he describes.

dialogText.cn: 唉，也是我一时心急。我知道自家那个报价没法进最终轮，可我又不甘心放弃这个机会……这是我个人的行为，和公司没有任何关系，这点请您放心。
dialogText.en: Well, I must confess that I was desperate. I know the bid from Clavis won't get us into the final round, but I refuse to give up... Rest assured this is my personal doing and has nothing to do with my company.

dialogText.cn: 其实，这也是因为我没能给这单子争取到更多资源……但我一直很看好咱们产品的潜力！只不过，您知道，它还是超前了一些，市场还在观望嘛。
dialogText.en: Consider it my mistake for failing to secure more resources for this deal... But I see true potential in this product! That said, you should realize that it's quite revolutionary, and our market may not be ready to embrace it.

dialogText.cn: 我已经向公司打了保票，说咱们的产品一定能大卖特卖。可您知道，大公司的决策流程肯定要慢上一些，这就错过了咱们提交报价的窗口……
dialogText.en: I've assured my higher-ups that this product will sell. But you know how slowly large companies move — they took too long to decide and missed the window to offer a better bid...

dialogText.cn: 所以我才想到用这个身份接近您，先把坑位占住，我绝对不是什么诈骗犯啊。
dialogText.en: This is why I decided to approach you under a separate identity. The aim is to get me a chance to approach you about this new opportunity. I'm definitely not a scammer.

dialogText.cn: 这……管理员，不要被他放出的烟雾弹迷惑了！我们公司虽然小，但也会倾尽全力在下个季度把你们的产品当作主打，推广出去！我们是有足够的资金流保证这个目标预期的！
dialogText.en: Well... Endmin...! Don't let this man mislead you! Erikssohn is small, but your product will be the star of our next season's catalog! Our finances are healthy enough to achieve the expected sales!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？你们上周不是还退租了一批办公室吗？
dialogText.en: Really? I heard Erikssohn shut down several offices just last week.

dialogText.cn: 顺便一提，管理员，后来那些办公室是被我们承租了。
dialogText.en: And for your information, Endmin, Clavis has taken over the offices they closed.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，克莱韦思可是把竞品收购策略写在年会发言里的啊！说不定，他是为了搞乱你们的滑索销售计划，给他们的山寨产品铺路呢！
dialogText.en: Endmin, buying out the competition is Clavis's strategy! They even included it in their annual general meetings! I'm guessing Clavis is buying your zipline sales plan just to pave the way for their lousy counterfeit!

dialogText.cn: 而我们，才是真心诚意想要赌一把这个产品……这也是埃里克松商贸打开新市场的绝佳机会！
dialogText.en: My company is completely committed to your zipline suite... It is Erikssohn's golden opportunity to open up a new market!

dialogText.cn: 大公司都有大公司的毛病，弄出些花边新闻，影响股价，那都属于正常波动，请不要担心。
dialogText.en: Every large company does that. Media coverage is designed to generate sensation and influence stock prices. These are just standard fluctuations. It's nothing to worry about.

dialogText.cn: 正常波动？你们最近大搞裁员，这也算正常波动吗？
dialogText.en: Standard fluctuations? What about your recent massive layoffs? Are those standard too?

dialogText.cn: 这个……树挪死人挪活，不变通怎么活下去呢？这不是恰好证明我们有活力嘛！
dialogText.en: Well... Change brings about life. No one survives by sticking to the same old ways. This only proves that Clavis is a dynamic company!

dialogText.cn: 有公司的知名度背书，总比那种资金链断裂、全面收缩的小公司强呀！
dialogText.en: Clavis is a name you can trust. In any case, we're far better than some financially distressed small-timer trying to cut off loose ends everywhere!

dialogText.cn: 你……我们的资金链才没断！只是方向性调整，方向性调整！
dialogText.en: Why you... We're not financially distressed! We're just changing our corporate focus! A directional adjustment! That's all!

dialogText.cn: 好的好的，我这就以克莱韦思环塔贸易公司的名义，给您一份新合同。
dialogText.en: Well said. On behalf of Clavis TGCC Trading, I shall provide you with a new contract.

dialogText.cn: 我们公司不论规模、专业程度，还是市场的占有率，都要比埃里克松商贸这种付不起尾款的小公司强多啦，绝对值得您来签约！
dialogText.en: Clavis is far superior in terms of size, professionalism, and market share. We are way better than Erikssohn, a small-timer known for defaulting on their final payments. A contract with Clavis is definitely something you can trust!

dialogText.cn: 这……这都什么事啊……照理说，这也不是“毒蛇”亚历山大能看得上的大单子啊……
dialogText.en: Damn my luck... This isn't a major deal. Why is Aleksandr the Viper so interested in it...?

dialogText.cn: 昨天老婆就说了，出门得看看运势，我今天一看是“万事顺利”，还以为没啥问题呢……
dialogText.en: My wife just told me yesterday to read the horoscopes. The signs said today would be a day of "incredible success". I really thought everything would work out...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，唉，我们公司确实在经营状况上碰到了一些问题，所以，我们在寻找出路。
dialogText.en: It's true, Endministrator... We do have some ... operational issues. This is why we're looking for new opportunities.

dialogText.cn: 但我不是故意要隐瞒的！只是……我担心在主观上会影响你们的判断……
dialogText.en: I never intended to hide it from you, I swear! I just don't want anything to ... significantly affect your judgment...

dialogText.cn: 该说的话我都说了，您这么善于权衡利弊的人，想必对于做出一个利好我们双边的选择，已经心如明镜啦！
dialogText.en: I've said everything I needed to say. I'm sure someone of your legendary acumen has carefully weighed every choice, and identified the option that benefits both parties. I have faith in your decision!

dialogText.cn: 在如今的塔卫二，我们克莱韦思绝对是在交通运输和物流方面最有声望的几家大型公司之一，我们可是三十年诚信老品牌！
dialogText.en: Clavis is one of the most reputable leaders in the transport and logistics sector of Talos-II. We have proven ourselves with thirty years of success and integrity!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我这么看下来，是觉得埃里克松不靠谱，可那个克莱韦思也不是什么好东西！
dialogText.en: Got my own two cents, Endmin. Erikssohn is a rickety shack, but Clavis isn't any better!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？这里怎么轮得到你说话的？
dialogText.en: Wait. Why are you cutting in like that?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你想想，签了小公司，也就只能赌一把。但是签了大公司，那水也很深，万一只是用一点小甜头，骗你们进更大的坑呢？
dialogText.en: Think about it, Endministrator. A deal with a small company is like making a bet. But a deal with a giant is a swim in deep waters. Maybe Clavis is just baiting you into a bigger scheme.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，当然，这只是我的判断。不过，如果您考虑重新走竞价的流程，可以联系我！我是门德斯工业的业务员，我们也参与过竞价会的，记得吗？多个选择多条路，对不对？
dialogText.en: Ahem. That's just my personal take on this. But should you restart the bidding process, do give me a call! I represent Mendez Manufacturing. We also took part in the last bidding, remember? It's always better to have more options, right?

dialogText.cn: 这是……哦，谢谢，这是之前鄙人用来装合同的袋子，居然掉到这里了……
dialogText.en: What's this...? Oh. Thank you. This is the document holder for the contract. I didn't expect it to show up here...

dialogText.cn: 之前因为着急要与贵司签署合同，加上半路上……遇到了一点小纰漏，所以就把一些多余的东西处理了。
dialogText.en: I was rushing to sign a contract with your company and ran into a ... minor hiccup along the way. So, I dealt with the less essential items on my own.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你现在怎么想？
dialogText.en: What do you think, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我们今天先更新档案，明天再讨论一下吧。至于合作方那边，我会去通知他们明天再来。
dialogText.en: Alright... We'll update the files today and discuss this tomorrow. I'll tell the agents of our potential partners to come back then.

dialogText.cn: 一个<@qu.key>空酒瓶</>。瓶口处散发着浓烈的酸味，其质量暗示着它的购买者不会在意口味。
dialogText.en: An <@qu.key>empty bottle</>. The mouth is giving off a strong, sour smell. The quality of the contents suggests that its buyer did not care about taste.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，目前搜集到的证据就是这些。
dialogText.en: Endmin, these are the pieces of evidence we've gathered so far.

dialogText.cn: 哈特曼的<@qu.key>工牌</>……亚历山大的<@qu.key>文件袋</>……
dialogText.en: Hartmann's <@qu.key>employee ID</>... Aleksandr's <@qu.key>document holder</>...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你不认为，那个<@qu.key>文件袋</>有些太旧了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, don't you think this <@qu.key>document holder</> is a little too old?

dialogText.cn: 实际上，克莱韦思环塔贸易公司在今年初更新了他们的集团标识。但是那个<@qu.key>文件袋</>上印刷的，还是去年的版本。
dialogText.en: Clavis TGCC Trading actually updated their corporate logo early this year. But this particular <@qu.key>document holder</> is printed with the old logo from last year.

dialogText.cn: 如果这份合同如他所言，是近期从公司取来的，应该是一个更新的<@qu.key>文件袋</>才对。
dialogText.en: Aleksandr said he recently took this contract from his company. If that were true, the contract should be presented with the latest <@qu.key>document holder</>.

dialogText.cn: 我也有一个疑问。我发现，亚历山大的身上也有伤口。
dialogText.en: I also saw something suspicious. I noticed wounds on Aleksandr as well.

dialogText.cn: 难道，他也被裂地者袭击了？
dialogText.en: Was he also attacked by Landbreakers?

dialogText.cn: 更像是撕裂伤……不像是人为的。
dialogText.en: The wounds look more like lacerations... I don't think he was attacked by anyone.

dialogText.cn: 我在附近见过他几次。如果你们觉得不方便的话，我可以去追踪他。
dialogText.en: I saw him nearby a couple of times. If it's too much for you, I can go and shadow him.

dialogText.cn: 我也有一个疑问！
dialogText.en: I got a question too!

dialogText.cn: 你们谁见过亚历山大的<@qu.key>工牌</>吗？哈特曼有一个，亚历山大按理说也应该有一个吧？
dialogText.en: Did any of you see Aleksandr's <@qu.key>employment ID</>? Hartmann's got one from his company. I'd assume Aleksandr has one too.

dialogText.cn: 按照他的说法，也许他的计划是等到陈述事实的时候再出示这个。
dialogText.en: From what Aleksandr told us, he probably plans to show us his ID after he's ready to tell us the truth.

dialogText.cn: 哦……我还以为发现了什么呢……
dialogText.en: Oh... I just thought that I found something...

dialogText.cn: 陈说的也有道理。其实，我在那之后也问了亚历山大这个问题，他说他弄丢了，还在补办。
dialogText.en: Chen raised a pretty good point. I actually asked Aleksandr about his ID after our last meeting. He said he lost it and they're making a new one.

dialogText.cn: 问题就在这里——没有工牌或者身份信息，员工是没办法登入克莱韦思环塔贸易公司的内部系统的。
dialogText.en: That's where the problem lies — Employees need their employee pass or ID to log into the Clavis TGCC Trading Intranet.

dialogText.cn: 他不是假冒的埃里克松员工，而是假冒的克莱韦思员工！
dialogText.en: He's not pretending to be someone from Erikssohn! He's pretending to be someone from Clavis!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈，我好聪明！
dialogText.en: HAHAHAHAHA! I knew I was smart!

dialogText.cn: 所以，他以前确实是克莱韦思的员工……而且，这个汉斯也不是他当时所说的那样“单纯路过”……
dialogText.en: So ... he was a Clavis employee... And Hans wasn't just an ordinary passer-by...

dialogText.cn: 从刚才的<@qu.key>录音</>里听来，哈特曼被抢劫的事，亚历山大必然掺和了一手。
dialogText.en: And that <@qu.key>recording</> tells me that Aleksandr was part of the attack on Hartmann.

dialogText.cn: 可是，他也不是袭击的主谋……还有人在背后指示他呢。
dialogText.en: But he doesn't sound like the one who organized the attack... Someone else was giving him orders.

dialogText.cn: 事故现场的情报已经交给菲奥娜分析处理了，也许技术部门会有一些结论。
dialogText.en: I've submitted clues and intel collected from the site to Fiona. Our tech people will analyze them and share their findings with us.

dialogText.cn: 再去哈特曼当时被抢劫的地点看看吧。
dialogText.en: Let's head back to where Hartmann was attacked and see if we can find anything.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，结果已经出来啦！
dialogText.en: Endmin, we have results from the analysis!

dialogText.cn: 我把<@qu.key>弩箭碎片</>和坐标信息都发给了弹道学专家卡拉德先生。他已经计算出了弩箭射出的具体方向，也用三角定位找到了精确的位置！
dialogText.en: I sent the <@qu.key>data on the crossbow bolt</> and coordinates to our ballistics expert Mr. Krad. He calculated the bolt trajectory and triangulated the sniper's firing position!

dialogText.cn: 我这就把数据同步给你们！
dialogText.en: I'm syncing the data to you right now!

dialogText.cn: 看来答案已经浮出水面了。
dialogText.en: It seems the truth has finally been revealed.

dialogText.cn: 我看看噢……“<@qu.key>门德斯工业</>”？好熟悉……欸……是当时在场那个第三人？<@qu.key>汉斯</>？！
dialogText.en: Let me see... Hmm. <@qu.key>Mendez Manufacturing</>? Sounds really familiar to me... Hey, isn't that the third dude in the negotiations? <@qu.key>HANS</>?!

dialogText.cn: 果然啊，没有那么巧的事！塔卫二那么大，竟然能在那个犄角旮旯的地方，莫名其妙凑齐四个跟这个事情有关的人！
dialogText.en: I knew this was no mere coincidence! Talos-II is a big place, you know. Yet somehow all four parties involved with the deal showed up at that weird, isolated place.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……虽然我们现在也是四个人。但是，佩丽卡，你懂我意思吧！
dialogText.en: Yeah... We got a team of four people as well, but you know what I mean, Perlica!

dialogText.cn: 录音里，门德斯的人派来了<@qu.key>汉斯</>，而他显然不是正经的业务员。
dialogText.en: According to the recordings, someone from Mendez sent <@qu.key>Hans</>. And apparently he's not even a real sales agent.

dialogText.cn: 我们可以盯紧利益冲突。纠缠的利益线索可能很混乱，但绝对不会有巧合。
dialogText.en: We should study potential conflicts of interest. Chasing a messy trail of clues may be tiresome, but conflicts are never coincidental.

dialogText.cn: 现在可以确认的是，<@qu.key>汉斯</>背后的<@qu.key>门德斯工业</>是袭击哈特曼的幕后主导，目的是让亚历山大实行他的计划。
dialogText.en: We know for certain that <@qu.key>Hans</> is from <@qu.key>Mendez Manufacturing</> and they planned the attack on Hartmann. Their aim was to let Aleksandr carry out his plans.

dialogText.cn: 看来，这件事也该有个了结了。
dialogText.en: I believe the time has come to settle our accounts.

dialogText.cn: 各位，我们收集到了一些信息。
dialogText.en: Greetings, everyone. We've acquired some information.

dialogText.cn: 你、你们看了我的车？你们有搜查令吗？我要告你们——
dialogText.en: You ... you searched my car? Do you have a warrant?! I'll take you to court —

dialogText.cn: 啊？没想到大名鼎鼎的“毒蛇”也会被裁员？哈哈哈哈！我就说你怎么会看上我这种小单子，跑来搅这个浑水！
dialogText.en: Wow. Did the legendary Viper get the boot? Who would have thought? HAHAHA! And I was wondering why you're out here in the frontiers trying to steal my puny deal!

dialogText.cn: 真是恶有恶报啊！你们这些人在文明环带横行霸道，到处抢人生意，现在好了，你的报应来了，哈哈哈哈哈！
dialogText.en: Justice has been served! Cartel agents like you had your way in the Band! You bullied small-timers like us and nabbed our deals! The layoff is exactly what you deserve! HAHAHAHA!

dialogText.cn: 咦，怎么哭了？不会被我两句话就弄哭了吧？
dialogText.en: What?! Are you crying?! Come on, man. I only said a few harsh words!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我、我真的……很需要做成这笔单子。我……
dialogText.en: I'm sorry ... I ... I really need to get this deal... I...

dialogText.cn: 如果做成了，也许……
dialogText.en: If I pulled this off, I might...

dialogText.cn: 我已经走投无路了，管理员！要么，你们就在这里把我杀了吧，我真的没有办法向家里交代了——
dialogText.en: I'm out of options, Endministrator! You might as well kill me here! I can't even face my family anymore —

dialogText.cn: 我知道我一直以来做事的办法，得罪了很多人……也包括你，哈特曼。
dialogText.en: I know I've stepped on many toes with the way I do things... You were my victim as well, Hartmann.

dialogText.cn: 我已经得到惩罚了，我已经得到惩罚了！能不能……让我老爸醒来啊？就……让他撑过这一次，我什么都能替你们做！真的！
dialogText.en: I'm already being punished! I'm facing my retribution! I just ... want Papa to wake up again! Just ... help him live and I'll do anything for you! ANYTHING! I swear!

dialogText.cn: 我大概……已经跟不上时代了吧。早年在环塔商会，我们做事的那套方法……早就过时了。
dialogText.en: People like me ... we've probably been left in the dust by the changing times. The old practice we once used ... no longer works in the TGCC.

dialogText.cn: 公司要讲效率，讲表面上的礼数……可我其实，就是个街头收租的混混而已。
dialogText.en: Corporations are all about efficiency, civility, and etiquette nowadays... But I'm just ... a low-level thug who collects rents on the streets.

dialogText.cn: 但是，我真的不甘心……求求你们帮帮忙，帮我渡过这次难关吧……
dialogText.en: But I refuse to give up... Just help me out this time, please! Help me survive this...

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事？亚历山大，你不是说不会暴露我们的吗？
dialogText.en: By Talos, Aleksandr. You weren't supposed to expose us.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……如果这么说你能好受点，那我们就是自己查出来的。
dialogText.en: Well ... we actually found all this on our own. I hope that makes you feel better.
Tsk...

dialogText.cn: 不过，于我而言也没什么损失。我只是不想让埃里克松拿到这个单子，现在目的也达到了。
dialogText.en: Whatever, I haven't lost anything from this. My aim is to prevent Erikssohn from securing this deal. And it seems I've achieved my goal.

dialogText.cn: 本来，要是能在这个乱局里再占上一分利益，就是喜上加喜的事。
dialogText.en: Of course, it would be the icing on the cake if I were to get a cut myself.

dialogText.cn: 终末地，看在我们这么努力又这么有行动力的分上，不如，再考虑考虑我们？哈哈哈哈。
dialogText.en: Either way, we demonstrated both our commitment and initiative, Endfield. Perhaps you should consider signing a contract with Mendez. Hahahaha!

dialogText.cn: ……只有我觉得好笑吗？哈哈，好吧。嗯……那我先走了啊！
dialogText.en: ...Am I the only one laughing? Hurhur. Suit yourself... I'll be taking my leave!

dialogText.cn: 啊？！我们就让他那样跑了？这里最有问题的明明就是他吧！
dialogText.en: Wha?! Are we really letting him run away like that? He's like the worst guy in this entire deal.

dialogText.cn: 我们掌握了关键证据，如果向环塔商会提交此次事件相关的检举信，门德斯工业将失去他们的信任。
dialogText.en: We have crucial evidence. If we submit a report to the TGCC, Mendez Manufacturing will lose people's trust and become discredited.

dialogText.cn: 环塔商会的影响力覆盖整个文明环带，每个人都知道失信于它意味着什么。
dialogText.en: The influence of TGCC covers the entirety of the Civilization Band. Everyone knows what being discredited means.

dialogText.cn: 哼。他当然要跑。再晚点就跑不了了。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Of course he had to run. Dallied a bit longer, and he'd never get away.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……这个……确实是一时半会很难解决的问题。
dialogText.en: Uh... Yeah... Our company ... might need a while to straighten things out.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，管理员，我也是有点强人所难了。公司现在的困境，也不是能靠一个单子就能改变的……
dialogText.en: Sorry, Endmin. I wasn't being entirely truthful with you. Erikssohn has problems and a single contract won't turn things around for us...

dialogText.cn: 所以，我后来也想通了。如果你们放弃了这个单子……也行！没关系的！
dialogText.en: So, I've found peace with myself. If you decide to drop us ... I guess I wouldn't be too upset! And I won't blame you for anything!

dialogText.cn: 啊？可是你已经为它付出了这么多！
dialogText.en: Huh?! But you've put in so much effort into this deal!

dialogText.cn: 我刚才看到“毒蛇”那个惨状，就感觉……做人啊，也没必要把自己逼到那份上。
dialogText.en: I saw what happened to the Viper, and I felt that ... no one should be forced to go to such extremes.

dialogText.cn: 大不了就是一份工作嘛！失败了就失败了。我这些天跑东跑西，挨揍，丢密钥……倒霉事儿净让我占了，可是没缘分的东西，就算努力到这份上，也强求不来啊。
dialogText.en: This is just another job! And I stopped caring about winning. I spent days driving up and down the place and what did I get? I got mugged, knifed, and even lost my verification key... It was a never-ending string of bad luck. Now fate does not wish to close the deal. Nothing I do will change that.

dialogText.cn: 唔……他好像忽然想通了……
dialogText.en: Ooohhh... It seems he suddenly figured it all out...

dialogText.cn: 先这样吧！反正，我们的实际情况，各位都也知晓了，接下来就交给你们定夺了。
dialogText.en: I guess this is it! You already know what's really going on at Erikssohn. The choice is yours.

dialogText.cn: 唔，也不知道是因为今天我的运势写了“悲天悯人”，还是别的原因……管理员，我竟然觉得亚历山大那家伙现在有点可怜呢。
dialogText.en: Oh yeah, Endmin. I don't know why. Maybe my horoscope for today emphasized "mercy and forgiveness", or maybe it's something else ... but I suddenly feel a spike of sympathy for Aleksandr.

dialogText.cn: 希望我不会沦落成他那个样子吧。老老实实、本本分分地做点事就好，要是真过不下去了，就干脆搬来你们这里闯荡算了！
dialogText.en: I definitely don't want to end up like him. So I'll just focus on my share of work and keep myself safe. Should I fail to make ends meet... I guess I'll just move here and start over as your neighbor!

dialogText.cn: 嘿，什么叫“干脆”呀，四号谷地可不是谁的次选哦！
dialogText.en: Hey! Just move here and start over? Puh-lease, stop treating Valley IV as your backup plan!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，开个玩笑！看起来今天是给不出定论了，对吧？那我先回去了，要是你们有意愿了，随时联系我啊！
dialogText.en: Hahaha! I was just joking! So, I guess we won't be closing the deal today. I'll be heading back. Call me if you're still interested! I'm always available!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你回来了啊！怎么样，和埃里克松商贸的订单，你考虑好了吗？我听佩丽卡监督说，这次的情况还挺复杂的……
dialogText.en: Endmin?! You're back! Made up your mind about our deal with Erikssohn Trading House? Supervisor Perlica said it was a rather ... complicated affair...

dialogText.cn: 那么，你的判断是什么？
dialogText.en: So, who did you decide on?

dialogText.cn: 好的，我等你的消息。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'll wait for your decision.

dialogText.cn: 那么我就通知各个部门，开始走后续的合作流程了！这一次辛苦你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Alrighty! I'll tell the departments involved to start the partnership process! Thanks for doing this for us, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 啊？可是我们在第一轮就已经放弃了这家公司……他们的报价，我记得并没有胜过埃里克松商贸呢……是有别的考虑吗？
dialogText.en: Huh? But we dropped this company in round one... Their bid is less than that of Erikssohn... Do you have other concerns?

dialogText.cn: 不过，管理员你才是做决定的人，相信你的判断吧！那么，我就通知各个部门，走新的合作流程了！辛苦你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: But who am I to question your decision! I have faith in your judgment, Endmin. I'll tell the divisions involved to start the partnership process! Thanks a million!

dialogText.cn: 这……是因为接触下来感觉不太满意吗？
dialogText.en: Okay... Maybe you found something not to your liking during the negotiations.

dialogText.cn: 那我们就先终止目前的合作流程，看看市面上还有没有其他合作商吧。
dialogText.en: So, let's just terminate the current process first. Perhaps we'll find other partners to work with.

dialogText.cn: 不论怎样，这一趟都辛苦你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: In any case, I'm glad that you did this for us, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 一封克莱韦思环塔贸易公司内部的<@qu.key>裁员通知邮件</>。
dialogText.en: An internal letter of Clavis TGCC Trading titled <@qu.key>Notice of Corporate Restructuring</>.

dialogText.cn: 其内容大意为，由于销售部门的综合收益未达预期，因此即将对内进行优化裁撤。
dialogText.en: Summary of the contents: The business and sales department failed to achieve the expected figures, and shall undergo corporate streamlining and downsizing.

dialogText.cn: 一份写明了亚历山大被解雇的<@qu.key>通知书</>。
dialogText.en: A <@qu.key>letter</> notifying Aleksandr that his employment has been discontinued.

dialogText.cn: 我忙完手上的事情就过去，帮我把这个日程加在工作台上。
dialogText.en: I'll head over once I wrap things up here. Add this to my work schedule.

dialogText.cn: 这份伤员安置统计太旧了，给我一份更新过的表单。
dialogText.en: This injury accommodation report is out of date. I need the latest report.

dialogText.cn: 如您所见……只能说勉勉强强。
dialogText.en: As you can see ... we're hanging on. Barely.

dialogText.cn: 现在枢纽区基地的清理修复、人员安置、物资发放都要我确认，如果我这里有耽误，对后续其他环节都会有影响。
dialogText.en: I must verify the cleanup, staff housing, and supplies distribution at the Hub Base. Any delays on my part will affect everything else that follows.

dialogText.cn: 您要来帮忙吗？太谢谢了。现在工作流程很复杂，让我看看哪里可以——
dialogText.en: You're helping? Oh, thank you so much. Our work pipeline is very complicated right now. Let me see if there's a place ——

actorName.cn: 终末地干员{sm1l1m7-终末地员工}

dialogText.cn: 秦主管，会议要开始了，您现在……
dialogText.en: Director Qin, the meeting is about to begin. Are you...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，不好意思，我只能失陪了。您可以先自己逛逛，有什么疑问可以找菲奥娜……实在抱歉！
dialogText.en: Apologies, Endmin. I'm afraid I have to leave for now. Feel free to look around, and ask Fiona if you have any questions. Again, I'm really sorry!

dialogText.cn: 工作台上有她的日程表……内容可真是多。
dialogText.en: That's her schedule on the workstation... It looks incredibly packed.

dialogText.cn: 她的日程是公开的，所以你也可以自由查看。
dialogText.en: She also made her schedule public to all Base personnel. You can take a look at it as well.

dialogText.cn: 紧急情况是这样。有一些事项是根据求助信息自动生成的，特别容易堆积起来。
dialogText.en: For emergencies. Some of these task requests were auto-generated from incoming distress calls. These tasks can really build up.

dialogText.cn: 我标记了几个高优先级问题，都是需要到现场处理的。秦主管现在应该是顾不上它们了。
dialogText.en: I've marked several high-priority issues that must be handled on-site. Director Qin is probably too busy to take care of them right now.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，不好意思，最近事情实在是太多。
dialogText.en: I'm sorry, Endministrator. There are just too many things on our hands right now.

dialogText.cn: 本来我应该带您再了解一下这里，可是……
dialogText.en: I should be showing you around the place but...

dialogText.cn: 唉……没错，我又有一堆文件要处理。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... That's right. There's a pile of documents and files that I have to go through.

dialogText.cn: 这怎么好意思？汇报工作也在我的职责范围里，我不能失职啊。
dialogText.en: That wouldn't do. I am also in charge of drafting up work reports. I can't simply ignore my job.

dialogText.cn: 有我在呢，你就放心去忙吧。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, I got the Endmin covered. Go ahead and do your thing, Director.

dialogText.cn: 那……好吧。实在感谢大家能来帮忙。
dialogText.en: Okay ... great. I'm really glad you're taking the time to help us.

dialogText.cn: 你是谁？来这里做什么？
dialogText.en: Who are you? What's your business here?

dialogText.cn: 这里很危险，如果没有安全许可——
dialogText.en: This is a dangerous place. You need a security pass—

dialogText.cn: 让我看看申请的状态……秦主管这么快就安排好了？太感谢了！
dialogText.en: Let me check my application... Oh, Director Qin's got it approved already! Thank Talos for that!

dialogText.cn: 你好，我是莱科，负责清理工作。这位是我们的设备工程师莱雅。
dialogText.en: Greetings. I'm Lykor and I'm in charge of cleaning this place up. And this is Laeya, our facility engineer.

dialogText.cn: 锚点落下时，很多设备都被破坏了。那附近是受灾最严重的区域。
dialogText.en: The Ankhorfall damaged plenty of our facilities. The areas near the Ankhor got the worst of it.

dialogText.cn: 有台源石精炼炉还没来得及处理。今天那里传出了爆炸声，应该是源石反应不完全导致的。
dialogText.en: But we have yet to move an Originium refining unit in the place. People heard explosions from the area today. It was probably caused by an incomplete Originium reaction.

dialogText.cn: 不先把它搞定，实在不好展开清理作业。各位能帮个忙吗？
dialogText.en: If we can't take care of this facility, subsequent cleanup will be extremely difficult. Can we ask you for help?

dialogText.cn: 那就走吧！现在还来得及做关机处理，拖得更久的话，精炼炉可能会彻底熔毁，时间就是生命。
dialogText.en: Alright, then! Let's go! There's still time to shut the thing down. Any delay will only increase the risk of a refining unit meltdown. We gotta act quickly to save lives, people.

dialogText.cn: 莱科老师，我……
dialogText.en: Mr. Lykor, I...

dialogText.cn: 怎么了，莱雅？
dialogText.en: What is it, Laeya?

dialogText.cn: 没什么，我们走吧。
dialogText.en: Nothing. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 我们已经把能用的设备都迁走了。剩下都是受损的，有的已经彻底断电了，但……
dialogText.en: We've already moved the usable facilities elsewhere. Those left here are damaged. Some are no longer powered, but...

dialogText.cn: 他们还有呼吸，只是晕过去了，我先呼叫医疗小组过来。
dialogText.en: They're still breathing. They just passed out. I'm calling a medical team!

dialogText.cn: 这里还有操作手册，他们可能本来就在尝试关闭精炼炉，但过程中被爆炸的冲击波击晕了。
dialogText.en: The operation manual is here. They probably tried shutting down the Refining Unit, but it exploded and the shockwave knocked them out.

dialogText.cn: 这就是源石精炼炉。
dialogText.en: This is the Originium refining unit.

dialogText.cn: 莱雅是我们这里最好的设备工程师，你们一起过去吧，我留在这里——
dialogText.en: Laeya's our best facility engineer. You should head in together. I'll stay here—

dialogText.cn: 我……莱科老师，要不我来等医疗小组吧？
dialogText.en: Me...? Mr. Lykor, maybe I should stay and wait for the medical team.

dialogText.cn: 我……我不敢再往里面走了，我害怕。
dialogText.en: I ... I don't think I can go any further. I'm scared.

dialogText.cn: 锚点落下来的时候，这里很多人受了伤。我忍不住会想，要是有人死了，要是我……
dialogText.en: The Ankhorfall has injured so many people here. I can't help but think that if someone dies, if I...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我忽视了你的感受。
dialogText.en: Sorry. I should've been more aware of your feelings.

dialogText.cn: 基地刚受灾，我也能理解，你需要点时间来平复心情。
dialogText.en: The base has taken a serious hit. You need a breather and time to settle yourself.

dialogText.cn: 我带你进去吧。莱雅的听力很敏锐，可以听出许多故障，但这几天可能听到了一些……不好受的声音。
dialogText.en: I'll take you in. Laeya's got sharp ears. She can tell if something's broken by the sound it makes. But over the last couple of days, she might have heard some ... disturbing noises.

dialogText.cn: 我有探测装置和操作手册，也不至于出岔子。我们一起行动，这样效率更高。
dialogText.en: I have a detector and an operation manual, so we're still good. Let's do this as a team. It'll make the work quicker.

dialogText.cn: 这就是精炼炉了，按照操作手册来看，只要这样做……
dialogText.en: This is the refining unit. The manual tells me that I only need to do this...

dialogText.cn: 嗯？终端怎么失灵了，同步控制器没反应！
dialogText.en: Hmm. The terminal isn't working anymore. Synchronization controls aren't responding either!

dialogText.cn: 终端都失灵了，看操作手册也没用！咱们先退到安全距离，再呼叫别的设备工程师吧……
dialogText.en: The terminal is down and the manual failed us! We should get to a safe distance and request another facility engineer...

dialogText.cn: 你怎么进来了？
dialogText.en: Why are you here?

dialogText.cn: 我……我也是工程师，不能因为害怕就放着危险不管。医疗小组快要到了，这里有没有什么是我可以做的？
dialogText.en: I ... I'm an engineer. I can't ignore the dangers just because I'm scared. The medical team is almost here. Is there anything I can do?

dialogText.cn: 两个终端之间的同步器没有反应，这是你的专业领域！快来！
dialogText.en: The synchronizer between the two terminals isn't responding. That's your area of expertise! Get on with it! Quickly!

dialogText.cn: 我看一下！
dialogText.en: I'll take a look!

dialogText.cn: 定位到原因了！我来处理这个坏掉的终端，那位专家，请你去把另一个终端的电源关掉！
dialogText.en: I found the problem! I'll take care of this broken terminal. I'll also need your help, masked expert. Can you switch off the power of the other terminal?

dialogText.cn: 如果是这种程度的故障……还有办法。
dialogText.en: Such levels of damage ... I think I got a way.

dialogText.cn: 干得好！莱雅。也辛苦你了……这位专家，我还不知道怎么称呼你呢。
dialogText.en: Good job, Laeya! And thank you, my dear expert. But ... how should I address you?

dialogText.cn: 啊？！您就是……天哪，我一直都没反应过来！
dialogText.en: Wha?! You're the... By Talos, I never realized that!

dialogText.cn: 怪不得您处理得这么果断，果然有一手。
dialogText.en: No wonder! You handled the incident with such decisiveness! You're really amazing.

dialogText.cn: 原来管理员真的会到第一线啊……
dialogText.en: The Endministrator actually does visit the frontlines...

dialogText.cn: 我没事，我刚才只是有点害怕。因为我看到了那个……东西。
dialogText.en: I'm alright... I was just a little scared because ... because I saw ... that ... that thing.

dialogText.cn: 当时我们正在工作，警报响起的时候，广播让我们立刻撤离。但是没人走，大家都知道如果不关设备，会出更大的问题。就在那时候……锚点从天而降。
dialogText.en: Everyone was working, then the sirens started shrieking. The broadcast told us to evacuate, but nobody moved. We had to shut down the facilities, or things could get worse. And then ... the Ankhor fell from the skies.

dialogText.cn: 我只记得，地面就像一张纸一样翘起、翻转、破碎……我被卷到角落。等我醒来的时候，一切都变了。
dialogText.en: I remember seeing the ground rippling, buckling, and breaking apart like a piece of paper... The shockwave sent me flying and knocked me out. Everything had changed when I opened my eyes again.

dialogText.cn: 有人为保护我受了很重的伤。其实我刚才就一直在害怕，总感觉还有天使在眼前……
dialogText.en: Someone tried to protect me and got badly hurt. I was so afraid those Aggeloi might jump out at anytime.

dialogText.cn: 这不怪你，莱雅。第一次见到锚点的时候，我也被它的破坏力所震撼。
dialogText.en: It's not your fault, Laeya. When I saw the Ankhor for the first time, I was also pretty shaken up by the destruction it caused.

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二是一颗危险的星球，除了锚点和天使，我们还要面对侵蚀，面对更多没有了解的威胁。
dialogText.en: Talos-II is a dangerous planet. We have to face Ankhors, Aggeloi, the Blight, and all sorts of threats that we barely understand.

dialogText.cn: 只要互相支持，我们一定能渡过难关的。何况现在……我们还有管理员的帮助。
dialogText.en: By supporting each other, we shall prevail over the tribulations. And behold ... we now have the Endministrator's personal assistance.

dialogText.cn: 你已经做得很好了，莱雅。没有你，我们不可能这么顺利地关掉精炼炉。
dialogText.en: You did well, Laeya. We couldn't have successfully shut down the refining unit without you.

dialogText.cn: 也谢谢你，管理员。真人……和我想象的不太一样呢。
dialogText.en: Anyways, thank you, Endmin. The real you turns out to be really ... different from what I had in mind.

dialogText.cn: 和你共事很愉快！多亏有你帮忙，我现在有些勇气了。
dialogText.en: It was a pleasure working with you! Your assistance has granted me courage.

dialogText.cn: 但越是危险，我们就越是不能忘记自己肩负的职责。不管它有多小，我们都要完成它。
dialogText.en: But as dangers grow, it becomes even more important that we remember our duty. No matter how small a job may be, we must do everything we can to get it done.

dialogText.cn: 还没到能感慨的时候啊，很多地方在等着重建呢。
dialogText.en: This isn't the time to get emotional. There are still a lot of places that need to be rebuilt.

dialogText.cn: 那就走吧。看来，有些任务可以交给你了。
dialogText.en: Then let's keep going. I think I can start assigning jobs directly to you.

dialogText.cn: 嗯！
dialogText.en: Yeah!

dialogText.cn: ……这是我应该做的。
dialogText.en: ...Just doing my job.

dialogText.cn: 好厉害的修理技术……你是终末地的技术专家吗？
dialogText.en: Your repair technique is amazing... Are you a tech specialist from Endfield?

dialogText.cn: 欸，老员工？但是你看起来这么年轻……啊，先来挑一首曲子吧。
dialogText.en: Oh. A veteran? But you look so ... young. Anyway, let's pick a song to play.

dialogText.cn: 手上的工作都差不多了！谢谢你啊，没有你我还真不知道怎么办。
dialogText.en: Alright. That seems like the last thing on my list! Thanks a lot. I would be absolutely clueless if you weren't around.

dialogText.cn: 咱们现在再去看看工人们的情况吧？也许现在他们的心情能好些了。
dialogText.en: Let's check on the crew again. Perhaps they're feeling better now.

dialogText.cn: 物资已经分发下去了吧？
dialogText.en: Have we handed out the supplies?

dialogText.cn: 啊……是的，可把我忙坏了。不过，老埃斯顿交代的事情总算没搞砸。
dialogText.en: Ah, yes, that we did. Nearly broke these old bones of mine. Thank goodness I didn't mess up the work old Eston gave me.

dialogText.cn: 音乐怎么样？
dialogText.en: How's the music?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，嗯！有音乐就好多了！
dialogText.en: Oh. Yeah. Things feel better with the music on!

dialogText.cn: 你们怎么样了？药品用上了吗？
dialogText.en: How are you doing? Did the medicine come in handy?

dialogText.cn: 都分发了，也都用上了。有了这些，大家安心多了。
dialogText.en: We gave them out and used some as well. The crew feels much safer knowing that we have more meds.

dialogText.cn: 食物呢？现在够了吗？我是按照增加之后的人数来准备的。
dialogText.en: What about the food? Is everyone getting enough? I rationed them again because we took in more people.

dialogText.cn: 够的，够的……还有这么多水果，大家都很感谢埃里克你做的事情。
dialogText.en: It's more than enough... And we got plenty of fruits as well. Everyone is really thankful for what you're doing for us, Eric.

dialogText.cn: 但我看，很多人怎么还是无精打采的……？有什么需要帮助的，都可以告诉我，你放心，只要是我能做到的……
dialogText.en: But many people still look sad and tired... Go ahead and tell me if there's anything I can do. Don't you worry. I'll get it done if it's within my...

dialogText.cn: 埃里克……
dialogText.en: Eric...

dialogText.cn: 大家失去的不只是住处，还是一起经营了很久的生活环境。这里有过很多珍贵的回忆……现在，这些回忆都被打碎了。
dialogText.en: We lost more than a roof over our heads. We built a home and created many cherished memories together... But those memories have been shattered.

dialogText.cn: 许多创伤是没办法很快恢复的，需要自己慢慢消化。
dialogText.en: There is no recovery from many forms of pain and trauma. We need time to cope and learn how to live with these scars.

dialogText.cn: 我们也失去了一些人……对他们的回忆和纪念是在沉默中进行的，这都需要时间。
dialogText.en: Some of us lost friends and families as well... Give them time and let them grieve in silence, Eric.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我感觉已经尽了最大努力了……
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... I believe I've done everything I could...

dialogText.cn: 有人告诉我只靠热情不够……是我做错了什么吗？
dialogText.en: People told me that being passionate about my job isn't enough... Did I do something wrong?

dialogText.cn: 那为什么他们还是开心不起来？
dialogText.en: But why isn't everyone happy?

dialogText.cn: 好吧，我确实经常被人说少根筋……但我只是想让他们能开心一些啊。
dialogText.en: Okay. Plenty of people have called me a bit dense... But all I'm trying to do is to make them happier.

dialogText.cn: 埃里克，你和工人们的对话我也听到了。就像这位终末地专家说的，现在还没到那个时候。
dialogText.en: I heard you talking to the crew, Eric. This Endfield professional is right. This isn't the time to be happy yet.

dialogText.cn: 大家只是在学会适应……现在的生活。在这场灾害中，很多人失去了自己熟悉的生活，也有人失去了亲人。
dialogText.en: People gotta sort themselves out and get used to this ... new reality. The disaster destroyed the life we knew. Many of us also lost loving friends and family.

dialogText.cn: 只有时间能慢慢治愈这些伤口。在这个时候，有的人会选择微笑面对，有的人则需要悲伤一段时间，用一点泪水来洗刷这些记忆……我们要尊重他们的选择。
dialogText.en: Only time can heal the wounds. Some will be strong enough to smile and soldier on. Others will need a moment to wash away their painful memories with tears... We must respect their choices.

dialogText.cn: 卢……我明白了。
dialogText.en: I understand... Lou.

dialogText.cn: 那个唱片机确实是个好主意，我很喜欢。
dialogText.en: But fixing the phonograph is a great idea. I like it.

dialogText.cn: 我还有很多要学的，谢谢你，卢。也谢谢你的帮助，我还不知道你的名字呢。
dialogText.en: I guess I'm not that dense. Still, I have a lot to learn. Thank you, Lou. And yes, I need to thank you as well. But, I don't think I know your name.

dialogText.cn: 你就是那个……天哪！原来之前的传闻没错，你真的来了！卢，我得把这个好消息告诉大家！
dialogText.en: That's you...! BY TALOS! The rumors are true! You're really here! Lou, I gotta tell everyone about this great news!

dialogText.cn: {F}以前，有人和我说过，终末地的管理员，上天入地无所不能。只要她回来，就能解决一切问题……但我也听说，管理员只在最危险的时候才会出现。{M}以前，有人和我说过，终末地的管理员，上天入地无所不能。只要他回来，就能解决一切问题……但我也听说，管理员只在最危险的时候才会出现。
dialogText.en: {F}Someone once told me that the Endministrator of Endfield Industries is an omnipotent being. Her presence alone was enough to overcome all sorts of challenges... But I also heard that the Endmin would only show up when things are really bad. {M}Someone once told me that the Endministrator of Endfield Industries is an omnipotent being. His presence alone was enough to overcome all sorts of challenges... But I also heard that the Endmin would only show up when things are really bad.

dialogText.cn: 也就是说，如果我们能见到管理员，那我们就已经深陷危险当中了。
dialogText.en: Wait. If the Endmin walks amongst us, does that mean we're in super deep blight?

dialogText.cn: {F}我也是这么想的……还好，管理员其实很容易相处，她一定能带我们走出困境的。{M}我也是这么想的……还好，管理员其实很容易相处，他一定能带我们走出困境的。
dialogText.en: {F}I used to think that way... But the Endmin is really easy to get along with. She will lead us out of these trying times.{M}I used to think that way... But the Endmin is really easy to get along with. He will lead us out of these trying times.

dialogText.cn: 埃里克告诉我，你就是……管理员？十几年前，我正好被调去其他地方了，没能见到你。没想到我一把年纪了，还有机会经历有你的时代。
dialogText.en: Eric told me you're ... the Endministrator? It was more than a decade ago. I was assigned to another post and missed my chance to see you with my own eyes. And by some stroke of fate, I got to talk to you face to face at this ripe old age.

dialogText.cn: 等老埃斯顿的伤好了，我可要告诉他错过了什么！
dialogText.en: Once old Eston gets better, I'm gonna tell him what he missed!

dialogText.cn: 原来你就是管理员！听说你动动手就修好了唱片机……好厉害！
dialogText.en: You're the Endmin! I heard you fixed the phonograph by waving your hands around...! You're so cool!

dialogText.cn: 你好，我们给秦主管发送了求援信息，你是来帮忙的吗？
dialogText.en: Greetings. We sent Director Qin a request for help. Did she send you here?

dialogText.cn: 我叫埃里克，这位是卢。我们在组织附近的恢复工作。
dialogText.en: I'm Eric and this is Lou. We're organizing the rebuilding work.

dialogText.cn: 许多工人都被临时安置在这里。这里轻伤员居多，药品还有一些储备，暂时还应付得过来。
dialogText.en: Many crew mates are temporarily sheltered here. Most of the injured have minor wounds. We still have some meds to cover their treatment.

dialogText.cn: 但是，灾害发生之后……大家的情绪很压抑。我作为负责人，必须关注大家的心理健康……像过去菲雅在的时候那样。
dialogText.en: But since the disaster ... everyone's feeling a little down. As the one in charge, I must focus on the people's mental well-being ... just like Feya did when she was around.

dialogText.cn: 你说得没错，但实际入手的时候，还是要先从关心工人们的实际需求开始。先有物质，精神才好建设。
dialogText.en: You're right, but our actions should focus on the actual needs of the crew mates. We can start on mental well-being once those needs are met.

dialogText.cn: 好，我带你去了解下大家的需求吧。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'll show you around the place and ask everyone what they need.

dialogText.cn: 艾达，我来统计一下需求。现在物资很紧张，但我们会想办法尽快解决。
dialogText.en: Ada, let me consolidate the requirements. Supplies are low, but we're coming up with a solution.

dialogText.cn: 我们需要一些医疗物资。有人轻伤，其中一些人的伤口轻度感染了，大多都是不需要占用基地医疗资源的小问题。
dialogText.en: We need medical supplies. Some of us are injured, and a few are suffering from wound infections. Most are just minor issues that we can handle without using medical resources from the base.

dialogText.cn: 但随着更多的人在这里聚集，药品可能很快会不够。
dialogText.en: However, we got more people moving into the Dorms. We might not have enough meds to go around.

dialogText.cn: 好的，药品……我都记下了。
dialogText.en: Alright. Medication... I've made a note of it.

dialogText.cn: 我会抓紧把物资送来！大家要是有其他需求，也要记得第一时间提交给我们！
dialogText.en: I'll get the supplies brought in as quickly as I can! If there's anything you need, submit your requests to us ASAP!

dialogText.cn: 知道了，你们先看看其他地方的情况吧。
dialogText.en: Got it. Go ahead and check on the other places.

dialogText.cn: 你好，请问有什么能帮到你的吗？
dialogText.en: Good day, sir. Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 哦，你叫……埃里克？之前那个小姑娘呢？
dialogText.en: Oh, you're ... Eric? There was a girl back then. Where did she go?

dialogText.cn: 你是说菲雅？她受伤了，由我来暂时接替她。
dialogText.en: The girl? Feya, right? She's injured so I'm temporarily standing in for her.

dialogText.cn: 哦，受伤了……太多人受伤了。我的老伙计埃斯顿也受伤了，他是物流站的站长。他叮嘱我有一批物资近期会到，让我帮他盯着。但不知道为什么，一直没消息……
dialogText.en: Injured...? Too many crew mates are down with injuries. Even my buddy Eston. Old boy's in charge of this logistics station and told me to keep my eyes on a batch of incoming supplies. But I don't know why we're hearing nothing about it...?

dialogText.cn: 别担心，会好起来的，我就是来为大家提供帮助的！我先记下来……有一批物资延期交付了。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, things will get better. I'm here to help! I got this noted down ... delayed delivery of a batch of supplies.

dialogText.cn: 唉，行吧……小伙子，你挺有热情，但光是你自己有热情的话，是没法照顾好所有人的。
dialogText.en: Fine... Boy, you look like an energetic optimist, but being positive isn't going to make everyone feel better.

dialogText.cn: 希望老埃斯顿能早点好起来。
dialogText.en: I just hope old Eston can get better soon.

dialogText.cn: 如果是年轻那会儿，我一定要去运输线上亲自查一查。唉，岁月不饶人啊。
dialogText.en: If I were younger, I would've gone out there and checked the roads. But these cursed ol' blighty bones won't let me.

dialogText.cn: 小朋友，你怎么一个人坐在这里？
dialogText.en: Hey, kid. Why are you sitting here all by yourself?

dialogText.cn: 我有点害怕……大家现在怪怪的，都不怎么说话。
dialogText.en: I'm scared... Everyone's acting weird and nobody's talking to each other.

dialogText.cn: 不要怕，你已经安全了。你有什么需要的吗？我们可以帮你。
dialogText.en: Don't be scared, Stanley. You're safe. Is there anything you need? I can help.

dialogText.cn: 这里好安静，我害怕安静……要是能有点音乐就好了。
dialogText.en: It's so quiet here. I hate quiet places... If only we could have some music.

dialogText.cn: 啊……音乐？没想到还有这样的需求，我会记下来的。
dialogText.en: Oh ... music? I certainly didn't see that coming. I'll note it down.

dialogText.cn: 我记录了一下，大家的需求主要集中在药品和物资这两件事上。
dialogText.en: My notes tell me that everyone is primarily concerned about the meds and supplies.

dialogText.cn: 附近的仓库里应该还有一些存货，有你帮忙的话，这方面应该可以放心了。
dialogText.en: We should have a stockpile in a nearby depot. Your help will certainly get that issue off our minds.

dialogText.cn: 但那批延期的物资比较麻烦……感觉有点无从下手。
dialogText.en: But the delayed supplies might be a real hassle... I don't know how to deal with that.

dialogText.cn: 只能一步一步慢慢来了，先把能解决的药品问题解决掉吧。
dialogText.en: We'll take care of the problems one at a time. Let's solve the meds issue first.

dialogText.cn: 太好了。有了这些，一段时间内，大伙都不用发愁了。
dialogText.en: Wonderful! These will definitely tide us over for quite a while.

dialogText.cn: 你回来了？收集工作还顺利吗？
dialogText.en: You're back! How goes your search?

dialogText.cn: 物资啊……眼下只能指望威尔伯提到的运输线了。
dialogText.en: The supplies... The freight line mentioned by Wilbur might be our only hope.

dialogText.cn: 他的判断值得信任。我得赶紧把药品分发下去，运输线的位置已经标记给你了，辛苦你先去那里看看吧。
dialogText.en: His deductions should be reliable enough. I gotta distribute the meds. The location of the freight line has been marked on your map. It'd be great if you could head over and check things out.

dialogText.cn: 刚才物流机器人已经把物资送到了！是你找到的吗？
dialogText.en: The logistics robot just delivered the supplies! You're the one who found it, right?

dialogText.cn: 对了，我知道仓库里有一个旧唱片机。刚才的小朋友提醒了我，在大家都不太想讲话的时候，或许音乐能打破沉寂！
dialogText.en: By the way, I know there's an old phonograph in the warehouse. The little boy reminded me that music may help break the silence when no one is in the mood to talk!

dialogText.cn: 果然在这里！但是……好像坏掉了。
dialogText.en: It's here! Let me see ... I think it's broken.

dialogText.cn: 有很多人都从她那儿学到了生存技巧。
dialogText.en: She taught many about the techniques of survival.

dialogText.cn: 游人请求我们帮忙，那一定是碰到了什么棘手的问题。
dialogText.en: But now a Songseeker is asking us for help. That means she's probably facing some serious trouble.

dialogText.cn: 事不宜迟，我们还是赶紧找她问问情况吧。
dialogText.en: We better not delay, then. Let's hurry and ask her about the situation.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，情况菲奥娜都跟你说了吧？请求援助的人是<@qu.key>弧光</>干员。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I believe Fiona has filled you in on the situation? Operator <@qu.key>Arclight</> was the one who requested support.

dialogText.cn: 众生长地，终末地的合作组织。简单来说，众生长地里是一群乐于向他人传授生存智慧的流浪者，有许多人将他们的游牧聚落称为“荒野上的大学”。
dialogText.en: The Hannabit Circuit. They're a partner of Endfield Industries. Simply put, the Circuit is a group of wildland roamers who are happy to share the wisdom of survival. Many refer to their tribes as the "academy of the wilderness".

dialogText.cn: 弧光干员是其中的一位“游人”。游人四处游历，同时向需要帮助的人伸出援手。
dialogText.en: Operator Arclight happens to be their Songseeker. They travel around and lend their aid to those in need.

dialogText.cn: 都是游人在荒野中积累下来的生存经验，以歌谣的方式传授给所有需要的人，当然，也包括终末地的干员。
dialogText.en: Songseekers acquire plenty of experience as they travel and endure the wilderness. They would teach these lessons in the form of hanna songs to anyone who needs them. Naturally, this also includes Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 有人在门口等我们呢！咦？等等……佩丽卡，那好像不是弧光欸。
dialogText.en: Someone's waiting for us by the entrance! Hmm? Wait, Perlica... That doesn't look like Arclight.

dialogText.cn: 在这里！太好了，你们这么快就来了。
dialogText.en: Over here! Oh thank goodness, you've arrived so quickly.

dialogText.cn: 有一阵子没见了，卡贾。不过，怎么是你来接应？弧光呢？
dialogText.en: I haven't seen you for a while, Karja. Why are you the one meeting up with us? Where's Arclight?

dialogText.cn: 弧光给你们留下信息之后……就出去找孩子了。
dialogText.en: Arclight went out looking for the child ... right after she left you the message.

dialogText.cn: 太谢谢了！我知道，我一个人出去找的话也是添乱，其他人就是因为这个才不让我再出去……拜托各位了！
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! I know the others won't let me go 'cos they think I'll just end up causing more trouble... Please help us find Mia!

dialogText.cn: 这个时候，敢一个人在这种地方跑，弧光的身手应该不错吧！
dialogText.en: Hmm. Arclight ventured out into the wilderness on her own at a time like this. She must be really skilled!

dialogText.cn: 她让我留在这里，和你们说明情况。
dialogText.en: She asked me to stay here so I can tell you about the situation.

dialogText.cn: 有孩子失踪了？今天中午？那要赶紧找！有什么线索吗？
dialogText.en: A child went missing? At noon? We gotta start looking for her! Do you have any clues?

dialogText.cn: 失踪的孩子叫米娅……她是阿吉的朋友。她哥哥今天巡逻，把她托付给我。
dialogText.en: She's a friend of Ginny's, and her name's Mia. Her brother has patrol duty today, and asked me to look after her.

dialogText.cn: 米娅从小就好动，最喜欢在附近玩耍，我告诉过她附近不安全。
dialogText.en: Mia's an energetic girl. She really likes to run around the camp. I told her that this area isn't very safe.

dialogText.cn: 对了，这前面有一些画，是米娅在裂地者的涂鸦上面涂改的！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah, we got some drawings up ahead. Mia made them by painting over the Landbreaker graffiti.

dialogText.cn: 或许这些涂鸦都是有含义的？米娅可能是想通过画告诉我们什么！
dialogText.en: Perhaps the drawings have meaning! Maybe Mia is trying to tell us something with them!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们跟着这条线索追下去吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's follow this trail of clues.

dialogText.cn: 今天中午，暂居处里有一个孩子失踪了！
dialogText.en: A child went missing from our camp! She disappeared around noon today!

dialogText.cn: 但今天上午我被叫走帮忙，一时没看住……中午叫她吃饭的时候，我才发现米娅已经没了影。
dialogText.en: But I was tasked with something else this morning and took my eyes off her for just a brief moment... By the time I went to get her for lunch, she was already gone.

dialogText.cn: 弧光发现后，说这些可能是线索，就跟着米娅的涂鸦离开了。我现在听到“裂地者”三个字就害怕，我担心……
dialogText.en: Arclight found them and told me she could use them as clues. So she left to follow Mia's drawings. The mere mentioning of Landbreakers gives me the shakes... I'm worried that...

dialogText.cn: 看，她在这里丢下了笔，这可不是好兆头——地上还有打斗的痕迹！
dialogText.en: Looks like there was a fight here... Hey, that might be Mia's brush! Oh no, this doesn't look good...

dialogText.cn: 附近是之前我们清理过的碾骨氏族领地，要多留心。
dialogText.en: Be cautious. The surrounding areas used to be Bonekrusher territory that we cleared out before.

dialogText.cn: 明白。我们走吧！
dialogText.en: Roger. Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 这像是……管理员的面具？
dialogText.en: Wait. This looks like ... the Endmin's mask!

dialogText.cn: 米娅是阿吉的朋友，可能阿吉给她讲过管理员的事情。
dialogText.en: Mia is a friend of Ginny. Perhaps Ginny told her about the Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 最让我担心的是……这个标识代表“领地”。这意味着，碾骨氏族肯定有人回来了。
dialogText.en: But this glyph is a symbol of "territory" ... and that worries me. It means some of the Bonekrushers have returned.

dialogText.cn: 就连争夺领地的裂兽都不会这么残忍！为什么要这样做？
dialogText.en: Among manglerbeasts battling for ground, such cruelty is rare! Why have you wrought this?

dialogText.cn: 这声音……是弧光！我们得帮帮她！
dialogText.en: That voice...! It's Arclight! We must help her!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，具体情况卡贾和我们说了。这里发生了什么？
dialogText.en: Indeed. Karja told us about the situation. What happened here?

dialogText.cn: 还不清楚。我来到附近的时候，正碰到一些裂地者在往外跑，我打倒了其中几个，然后又碰到了刚刚这群家伙。
dialogText.en: I'm not sure. I came across a group of fleeing Landbreakers when I arrived at this place. I knocked down a few of them, and then ran into this mob right here.

dialogText.cn: 嚯，还真是！你对机关暗道很了解嘛，一眼就能看出来。
dialogText.en: Oh ho! You really know a lot about secret doors and mechanisms.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，在这里做一次扫描，看看有没有能打开暗门的机关。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's scan this place and look for mechanisms that might open the secret door.

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督，抱歉……没能按原定路线与你们会合。事态比我预想的更恶劣，他们就像风暴一样到处肆虐。
dialogText.en: Apologies, Supervisor Perlica... I failed to rendezvous with you at the appointed location. The situation is worse than I expected. Like a storm, they tear through this place.

dialogText.cn: 碾骨氏族已经把这里标记为领地，这些裂地者应该只是负责望风。我们得抓紧，或许还有更多的裂地者在路上。
dialogText.en: The Bonekrushers have marked this place as their territory. These Landbreakers are probably their sentries. We must hurry. More breakers are probably on the way.

dialogText.cn: 这山洞……声音回响不对。空间比预想中狭窄得多……看，果然有暗门。
dialogText.en: This cave... Its echoes do not sound right. The space is narrower than I expected... Yes, a secret door there.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我在一些遗迹里见过类似的设计。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I've seen similar designs in a number of ruins.

dialogText.cn: 我来操作。
dialogText.en: I'll activate it.

dialogText.cn: ……奇怪？这种门我开过不少，这个强度的电流应该是能奏效的。
dialogText.en: ...Strange. I've opened plenty of doors like this. A current of this intensity should have worked.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，管理员，这应当是你的专长。
dialogText.en: Could be. Endmin, this should be right up your alley.

dialogText.cn: 我也一直想见识一下你的源石技艺。
dialogText.en: I have always wanted to witness your Originium Arts.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，好。
dialogText.en: Hmm. Okay.

dialogText.cn: 这个机关在这种强度的电流下居然没有反应。管理员，接下来只能看你的了。
dialogText.en: This mechanism is not responding despite me coursing a high current through it. Necessary might be your Arts, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 风格？我倒想先听听你怎么看。
dialogText.en: How we commune with others? I'd like to hear what you think of it.

dialogText.cn: 也不尽然……众生长地的游人各有行事准则。你刚才说的，或许只是我作为一位游人的习惯。
dialogText.en: Not entirely... Every Songseeker of the Hannabit Circuit has their personal code. What you said might be my personal habits as a Songseeker.

dialogText.cn: 每位游人只属于他自己，每位游人都传唱不同的歌谣。这些“歌谣”或来自师者智慧的教导，或来自我们遍及这颗星球的足迹。
dialogText.en: Every Songseeker is their own master. Every Songseeker sings different hannas. These hannas might be based on an Aldertone's wisdom, or from lessons acquired as we leave our tracks across this planet.

dialogText.cn: 所有的这些“歌谣”最终都会汇成一首。因为所有的道路，起点都是一样的——尽力互助，在这颗星球上生存下去。
dialogText.en: Every hanna will flow into a single chorus, as every road begins with the same intent — we help each other so that we may survive upon this planet.

dialogText.cn: 这也是我来到终末地的原因。我想，这里也有一条值得走的路。而我……能从你身上学到很多。
dialogText.en: And that is why I came to Endfield. I believe it offers a path that I should travel upon. Also, there is much ... I can learn from you.

dialogText.cn: ……此情此景，搞得我鼻子酸酸的……
dialogText.en: ...This is making me snivel as well...

dialogText.cn: 或许这样的温情场面……就是终末地一直坚持战斗的意义。
dialogText.en: Perhaps such warmth ... is what keeps Endfield going.

dialogText.cn: 这里真的一个裂地者都没有……想到这里以后就是“家”了，就有一种莫名的心安。
dialogText.en: There really aren't any breakers around... Just the thought of this place being our home gives me peace of mind.

dialogText.cn: 好了！各位，新的家园需要我们的建设，也该到我们出一份力的时候了！
dialogText.en: Alright, people! We gotta make this home a beautiful place! Time to put in our fair share of work!

dialogText.cn: 好！
dialogText.en: Yeah!

dialogText.cn: 哥哥——
dialogText.en: Brother—

actorName.cn: 焦急的男子{sm1l2m2-焦急的男子}

dialogText.cn: 米娅！米娅！
dialogText.en: MIA! MIA!

actorName.cn: 焦急的男子{sm1l2m2-焦急的男子}

dialogText.cn: 米娅，你……你终于回来了，我……哥哥……是哥哥的错……
dialogText.en: Mia... You're finally back! It's my fault... I should have been a better brother...

dialogText.cn: 是米娅的错，呜呜！米娅再也不会乱跑了！
dialogText.en: No, it's my fault ... *hik, hik*... I'll never run off alone again, I promise!

dialogText.cn: 什么动静？！
dialogText.en: Who's there?!

dialogText.cn: 来了！准备战斗！
dialogText.en: They're coming. Prepare for battle!

dialogText.cn: 米娅！
dialogText.en: Mia!

dialogText.cn: 弧光姐姐……这里有好多坏人……
dialogText.en: Miss Arclight... There are so many bad people here...

dialogText.cn: 别怕，米娅，已经没事了……这里发生了什么？
dialogText.en: Don't be scared, Mia, it's alright... What happened here?

dialogText.cn: 这些哥哥姐姐是来帮忙的，这位是管理员……
dialogText.en: These friendly people are here to help. This is the Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 管理员！我认得你的面具！阿吉给我画过这个面具！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I remember your mask! Ginny showed me with her drawing!

dialogText.cn: 我……我追着墙上的画走，走着走着就迷路了。
dialogText.en: I ... I was just following the drawings on the wall. I kept going and ... lost my way home.

dialogText.cn: 然后就遇到了坏人……唔……山上突然开了一道门，有几个哥哥姐姐出来打跑了坏人。
dialogText.en: And then I ran into some baddies... And ... a door suddenly opened on the hilltop, and some nice people came out and beat the bad guys.

dialogText.cn: 然后发生什么了？你说的哥哥姐姐都去哪里了？
dialogText.en: What happened next? Where did the nice people go?

dialogText.cn: 一些坏人追着他们，进了那边的门，我不敢出声……然后过了一小会儿，你们就来了……
dialogText.en: The baddies chased them into that gate over there. I hid myself and tried to be really quiet... And then you arrived...

dialogText.cn: “哥哥姐姐”……不管他们是谁，目前处境都十分危险。我们得赶快去看看！
dialogText.en: In any case ... those who saved Mia might be in danger. We should look around quickly!

dialogText.cn: 哥哥姐姐们说外面很危险，就把我接了进来，但是里面也有很多坏人，然后，然后……
dialogText.en: Those nice guys said it was dangerous outside, so they took me here. But ... the bad guys were in here too! And then ... and then...

dialogText.cn: 快，快救我们出去！
dialogText.en: Quick! Please get us out of here!

dialogText.cn: 我们在想办法。扎克，你还记得我吧？说说这都是怎么回事。
dialogText.en: We're trying to open this, Zach. Remember me? Tell me what happened.

dialogText.cn: 你是……弧光？这事说来话长……
dialogText.en: You're ... Arclight? Well, you're in for a long story...

dialogText.cn: 之前……四号谷地就跟世界末日一样，到处都是裂地者，还有天使乱窜……连天空的颜色都变了，甚至还有锚点砸下来！
dialogText.en: So back then ... Valley IV turned into an apocalyptic blightshow. We got breakers and buggerloids stomping all over the place, the sky changing color, and even Ankhors falling out of the heavens!

dialogText.cn: 我们一群人走了好久，直到发现了这个……能住人，甚至还有补给的地方。
dialogText.en: This little group of ours walked for a really long time till we found this place... It's got a roof over our heads, and even some supplies.

dialogText.cn: 后来我们就一直藏在这里，一想到外面的裂地者我们也不敢主动出去。
dialogText.en: So we just started hiding at this place. None of us dared to venture out 'cos there were breakers outside.

dialogText.cn: 直到我们听到外面有孩子求救，我刚开了个门缝，就看见几个裂地者在靠近米娅！
dialogText.en: And we stayed till we heard some kid screaming for help. I opened the door a bit and saw a few breakers trying to get their hands on Mia!

dialogText.cn: 很快，就有裂地者从别的入口进来了。我们一路往山洞里面逃……
dialogText.en: Soon, another mob of breakers came rushing in from another entrance. We kept running deeper into the cave...

dialogText.cn: 这门还挺结实，看刚才裂地者的样子，连他们都砸不开。
dialogText.en: This gate looks pretty sturdy. Those breakers couldn't even put a serious dent in it.

dialogText.cn: 我们逃进来的时候，看到对面还有个小房间，里面可能有钥匙。拜托你们看一看！
dialogText.en: I saw a small room across the way when we escaped in here. See if you can find any keys there!

dialogText.cn: 你们去吧，我在这里守着，防止又有裂地者过来。
dialogText.en: Go ahead. I'll stand watch, just in case any more breakers try to get in.

dialogText.cn: 这里以前就是裂地者的基地。就在前不久，那些裂地者刚好被我们消灭了。
dialogText.en: This used to be the Landbreakers' base. We managed to take down their entire force not too long ago.

dialogText.cn: 还好你们打了这一架，至少拖到我们过来……
dialogText.en: Well, I'm glad you tried fighting them and survived till our arrival...

dialogText.cn: 我们是害怕自己暴露，但肯定不能放着孩子不管，就冲出去和他们打了起来。没想到，他们跑回去叫了更多人……
dialogText.en: We were scared of exposing our hiding place, but there's no way we'd let the breakers get the kid. That's why we charged out and whipped 'em hard. Sent 'em packing we did, but they ran off and called for help...

dialogText.cn: 走投无路时，我们只能钻进这个空牢房里，至少铁栅栏能挡住他们……还好在最要命的时候，你们出现了！
dialogText.en: We had nowhere else to go, so we fled into this empty cell. At least the metal bars kept the breakers at bay... And thank Talos you showed up before they broke through and killed us all!

dialogText.cn: 这把钥匙已经没用了。但我还有别的办法……我可以做一个“热指头”，应该能应付这个笼子。
dialogText.en: This key can't be used anymore. But I have another way ... I can make a "hot finger" to deal with this cage.

dialogText.cn: “热指头”？
dialogText.en: Hot finger?

dialogText.cn: 你们可能叫它“热能刀”？名字不重要，原理差不多。
dialogText.en: I think you call it a thermal lance. The name is not important. They work on the same principles.

dialogText.cn: 可我们现在手头什么材料都没有，你打算怎么做？
dialogText.en: But we don't have any materials right now. How are you going to do that?

dialogText.cn: 很简单，几块金属元件，加一个简易的源石回路就够了。在荒野上，我们常用废旧材料制造这种工具。用来焊接金属、切割晶体，方便又实用。
dialogText.en: Easy. A few metal components plus a simple Originium circuit should work. In the wilderness, we often use scrap and salvage to make all sorts of tools. These tools can help us weld metal or cut glass. They're quite practical and easy to use.

dialogText.cn: 好厉害……
dialogText.en: That's incredible...

dialogText.cn: 我身上带着一部分材料，可以马上动手。不过要启动它，还缺一些金属元件，得麻烦你们去找一下。
dialogText.en: I have some of these materials with me and can start immediately. But I do need a few metal components to activate the completed tool. Can you help find some?

dialogText.cn: 我们来时的路上有堆天使残骸，可以去那附近找找。或者这座矿洞的深处，应该也会有不少能用的东西。
dialogText.en: Look around the pile of Aggeloid remains we passed by on the way here. You might also find other useful things deep in this mine.

dialogText.cn: 找到金属元件了吗？去我们来时路上的那堆天使残骸附近找找，或者这座矿洞的深处，应该会有不少能用的东西。
dialogText.en: Found the metal components? Look around the pile of Aggeloi remains we passed by on the way here. You might find other useful things deeper in this old mine.

dialogText.cn: 这些就够了。稍微给我一些时间，我来搓一个“热指头”。
dialogText.en: This should be enough. Give me a moment to craft the "hot finger".

dialogText.cn: 所以说，这个明显比别人壮硕很多的裂地者，就是他们吸收侵蚀的结果吧？
dialogText.en: I gotta say something about this bigger LB. He bulked himself by absorbing the Blight, right?
