dialogText.cn: 米娅，躲在我们身后！弧光，你专心弄你的那个“热指头”，这些家伙交给我们。
dialogText.en: Mia, get behind us! Arclight, just focus on that hot finger thingy of yours. We'll handle these breakers!

dialogText.cn: 有人来了！注意警戒。
dialogText.en: Someone's coming! Stay alert.

dialogText.cn: 不确定。碾骨氏族一贯崇尚力量，只要能变强，他们什么都干得出来。
dialogText.en: Not sure. The Bonekrushers worship power. They'll do anything to get stronger.

dialogText.cn: 现在他们换了首领，行动风格也变得难以预测。我们不能掉以轻心。
dialogText.en: They now have a new leader. Their actions have also become unpredictable. Do not let your guard down.

dialogText.cn: 我总结一下，也就是说……你们觉得外边全完蛋了，逃命都不往外面跑，反而躲到这里面——整整三道门的后面？
dialogText.en: So, let me summarize what happened... You thought it was the end of the world, so instead of going outside, you decided to hide in here ... behind three locked gates?

dialogText.cn: 每一道门后面的空间都比之前更少，这最后一道门，甚至就是个笼子。
dialogText.en: The place behind each gate keeps getting smaller, and you ended up putting yourself in a metal cage.

dialogText.cn: 那你们运气不错嘛，先是在这么小的地方捡到裂地者剩下的补给，之后每次都能成功逃掉，还没有人缺胳膊少腿儿什么的。
dialogText.en: Hah! You're the luckiest people I've ever seen. You picked up some LB supplies at a tiny shed, escaped the breakers on every occasion, and survived this whole ordeal without anyone losing a limb.

dialogText.cn: 唉，确实是这样……运气好。
dialogText.en: Yeah... I guess you can say that... We got lucky.

dialogText.cn: 但没有你们来救命，我们都得交待在这里。
dialogText.en: But if you weren't here, all of us would probably end up dead.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……这地方你们继续待着也不是个事儿，指不定从哪儿又冒出来个裂地者。要不你们跟我们一起走吧，正好外面有一个难民暂居处。
dialogText.en: Hmm... You can't just stay here forever. The Landbreakers could show up at any time. Maybe you should follow us. There's a refugee camp outside, you know.

dialogText.cn: 难民暂居处？好啊！我们又有地方可以去了。
dialogText.en: A refugee camp?! Awesome! Alright, people! We're getting proper shelters again!

dialogText.cn: 今天实在是感谢各位，你们是我们的救命恩人！
dialogText.en: Thank you for what you've done today! You saved our lives!

dialogText.cn: 弧光，感谢你教给我们荒野上的生存技巧，我们才能在开始逃难时躲开裂地者，来到这里。
dialogText.en: And thank you, Arclight. You taught us how to survive in the wilderness — and it was those techniques that helped us avoid the Landbreakers in the first place.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，大雨冲刷荒野，虽然让土地变得泥泞，但雨后的泥土，能滋润万千草木。你们这次的遭遇，也并非坏事。
dialogText.en: Good. The rains of the wilderness may turn the land into mud, yet from the mud springs forth the grass and trees. A blessing in disguise, your hardships may be.

actorName.cn: 担忧的难民{sm1l2m2-担忧的难民}

dialogText.cn: ……所以，外面现在怎么样了？
dialogText.en: ...So, what's it like outside?

actorName.cn: 担忧的难民{sm1l2m2-担忧的难民}

dialogText.cn: 唉，啊……真的？那里是不是……没有裂地者？
dialogText.en: Ugh. Wait ... really? That place you said ... they got no breakers there, right?

dialogText.cn: 损失不小，这里的土地和人们都受了伤，但现在至少安定下来了。稍后我们就会带你们回难民暂居处。
dialogText.en: The losses were great. Both the land and its people suffered grievous wounds. However, peace has at least returned. I shall take you to the refugee camp shortly.

dialogText.cn: 当然。无论是什么样的风暴，只要互帮互助，我们都会渡过难关。荒野的教导，你们领悟得很好。
dialogText.en: Of course. No matter the storm you face, help each other and you'll endure. Learned well you have, the lessons of the wild.

dialogText.cn: 我理解你所担心的。后面我会继续教给你们更多的“歌谣”，记得来。
dialogText.en: I understand what your concerns are. I shall continue to teach you more hannas, songs that you will easily keep to heart.

actorName.cn: 温和的难民{sm1l2m2-温和的难民}

dialogText.cn: 弧光，你教给我的那些歌词……哦不，歌谣！我全都记得。
dialogText.en: Arclight, the songs you taught me ... I mean, the hannas! I remember them all!

actorName.cn: 温和的难民{sm1l2m2-温和的难民}

dialogText.cn: 多亏了那里面的求生技巧，我们才能熬过这段苦日子，活下来……真是太感谢了。
dialogText.en: The survival skills described by the hannas ... they're the reason we endured and survived these trying times! Thank you so much.

dialogText.cn: 不必客气，这就是“歌谣”的意义。之后我会再教给你们更多，到时候再来吧。
dialogText.en: You're welcome. That is the intent of the hannas. I shall teach you more afterwards. A visit will happen in the future.

dialogText.cn: 这位先生，你……还好吗？
dialogText.en: Hello, sir ... are you all right?

dialogText.cn: 我没事……
dialogText.en: Situation normal...

dialogText.cn: 你还能走吗？我们带你去基地找医生。放心，什么伤都能治。
dialogText.en: Can you still walk? We can take you to our base. Don't worry. Our surgeons can treat all sorts of injuries.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，叫我瓦茨就好。找医生的事，不急，我只是……还要恢复些体力。
dialogText.en: Ahem. Call me Waitz. There is no need to rush for a surgeon's presence. I only need ... some rest and recuperation.

dialogText.cn: 实在难以启齿……是我的行李被抢了。
dialogText.en: I am ... ashamed to speak of it ... but my luggage has fallen victim to brigandry.

dialogText.cn: 裂地者人数太多，我实在无力抵抗……那些行李非常重要，在夺回失物前，我还不能离开。
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers came at me with absolute numerical superiority. I could not stop them... But those pieces of luggage are important. I cannot leave until I recover my lost property.

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，小事一桩！我们帮你找回来就行！
dialogText.en: Aiyo. That sounds like an easy problem to fix! We'll just go and retrieve them for you!

dialogText.cn: 这可不像是没事的样子。别担心，我们马上把你弄出来。
dialogText.en: Your situation doesn't look normal to me. Don't worry, we'll get you out immediately.

dialogText.cn: 唔……谢、谢谢。
dialogText.en: Hngh... Many thanks...

dialogText.cn: 没错……嗯，还在的。万幸他们没来得及动什么东西。
dialogText.en: Indeed... Hmm. It's still here. It is by great fortune that the brigands did not move anything.

dialogText.cn: 可是……欸，他真的就这样走了啊！
dialogText.en: Hey, but... Okay, he really did just leave us like that!

dialogText.cn: 我有些在意他最后说的话。“剩下的货物”……瓦茨被抢走的东西好像不止这一件？
dialogText.en: I actually care more about what he said. "The rest of the cargo" ... I have a feeling Waitz lost more than just that one piece of luggage.

dialogText.cn: 那就麻烦了，他不会真去闯裂地者老巢了吧？
dialogText.en: That sounds like serious trouble. Maybe he went running off into the Landbreaker's turf.

dialogText.cn: 瓦茨，这就是你丢的东西吗？
dialogText.en: Waitz, is this the thing you lost?

dialogText.cn: 行李没事就好，只要它还在身边，我就一定能克服任何困难！
dialogText.en: The luggage is intact. So long as I have it with me, I shall conquer all manners of adversity!

dialogText.cn: 但你刚刚才被打倒欸……
dialogText.en: But you were defeated not too long ago...

dialogText.cn: 不论如何，感谢各位慷慨相助。我已经摸清裂地者的实力了，各位不必担心剩下的货物。
dialogText.en: Regardless, I am grateful for your generous assistance. I now have a better understanding of these Landbreakers and their strength. There is no need to worry about the rest of the cargo.

dialogText.cn: 那么，先行一步，有缘再会！
dialogText.en: Well then, this shall conclude our brief acquaintance. May we meet again!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？没想到又能遇见各位，我还以为你们已经先行离开了。
dialogText.en: Oh. I did not expect to meet you again. I thought you had already taken your leave.

dialogText.cn: 让我们也来帮忙吧，你刚刚还有气无力的，可别太勉强自己。
dialogText.en: Let us help you out. You were pretty weak back then. Please don't overwork yourself.

dialogText.cn: 这群强盗将货物抢走以后，似乎打算大肆瓜分一番。我用的锁一时半会儿砸不烂，可再晚点就不好说了。
dialogText.en: Those brigands have already seized the cargo. They would probably divide their ill-gotten gains. My locks are sturdy and might hold them off for a while, but they will not last forever.

dialogText.cn: 砸、砸不烂？算了，那些货物都长什么样？我们这就去找，顺带把这里的裂地者再收拾一遍！
dialogText.en: Sturdy? Whatever. Just tell us what the lost cargo looks like. We'll look for it, and probably clean out the local Landbreakers along the way!

dialogText.cn: 同样是些箱子，背起来会有点沉。也许还有人在看守，请务必当心。
dialogText.en: The cargo also has the form of standard crates, though with somewhat greater weight. Be vigilant. The brigands may have posted guards and sentries.

dialogText.cn: 好说好说！那些家伙得当心咱们几个才是！
dialogText.en: Well said! But those brigands don't know what's coming. They should be the ones watching out!

dialogText.cn: 二，四，六……嗯，少了两箱货。
dialogText.en: Two, four, six... Hmm. I'm still missing two crates.

dialogText.cn: 哇，瓦茨，你刚才生气的样子可真吓人。
dialogText.en: Wow, Waitz! You looked absolutely terrifying when you got angry!

dialogText.cn: “全部荣誉”……怎么越来越复杂了？
dialogText.en: Entirety of your honor... Now this is starting to sound incredibly complicated.

dialogText.cn: 诸位，东西应是被这群裂地者藏匿在了山洞里。我这就去取出来！
dialogText.en: Fellow heroes, I believe the Landbreaker miscreants have hidden the lost cargo in this very cave. I shall enter and retrieve them!

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，有些失态。我已经赌上了自己的全部荣誉，一定要将货物保护周全。如今承诺面临挑战，不免有些恼火。
dialogText.en: Apologies. I was not myself. I have pledged the entirety of my honor to keep the cargo safe. Wrath tends to burn more easily in moments of challenge and frustration.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，应该还有一箱……拜托各位，请帮忙在附近再找找。
dialogText.en: Hmm. There should be one more crate... Good people, might I beg for your assistance and look through the vicinity?

dialogText.cn: 一些对现在的四号谷地至关重要的物品。如果运用得当，它将拯救许多危难中的生命。
dialogText.en: Those crates held more than goods. They carry Valley IV's survival.

dialogText.cn: 因此，我必须完成这个使命。感谢各位理解。
dialogText.en: And hence, I must complete this mission. And I am grateful for your understanding.

dialogText.cn: 可你还是没说箱子里有什么啊……算了，放心吧，东西一定能找回来的。
dialogText.en: But you still haven't told us what's inside the crates... Oh well, whatever. Don't worry. We'll find your stuff.

actorName.cn: 昏迷的裂地者{sm1|2m3-昏迷的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 为什么……明明只是……
dialogText.en: Why...? They're just...

dialogText.cn: 已经找齐全部的物资箱了。那么请容我最后清点一番。
dialogText.en: All supply crates secured. Allow me to make a final inventory count.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，少了几个罐头……怎么回事？
dialogText.en: Hmm. A few tins have gone missing... How did this happen?

dialogText.cn: 也许已经让他们分了吧……等会儿，罐头？你箱子里装的是罐头？
dialogText.en: Perhaps the breakers divided the loot... Wait. Did you just say tins? Your crates are just filled with ... canned food?

dialogText.cn: 不只是罐头，还有饮用水、燃料、应急药品、基础施术单元，一应俱全。
dialogText.en: Not just tinned provisions. Drinking water, fuel, emergency medication, and basic Arts Unit. My cargo has everything required.

dialogText.cn: 这不就是标准的应急物资嘛！
dialogText.en: But that's just a typical set of emergency supplies!

dialogText.cn: 没错，如果运用得当，它确实将拯救许多危难中的生命。
dialogText.en: Indeed. If used properly, they will deliver many lives from the clutches of danger.

dialogText.cn: 这倒也没错啦……
dialogText.en: Well, you're not wrong...

dialogText.cn: 本人曾经立志成为一名铁誓军，但实在惭愧，最终还是没能通过考验。
dialogText.en: Joining the Order of Steel Oath was my dream. However, I didn't meet their requirements and failed to pass the trials.

dialogText.cn: 所以，我决定用力所能及的方式为他人提供帮助。一听说四号谷地遭了灾，我马上就背着物资来了这里。
dialogText.en: This is why I have decided to lend my assistance to others in ways I can. When I heard about the disaster in Valley IV, I immediately carried these supplies and made my way here.

dialogText.cn: 马上？！你不会一直都备着这些东西吧？
dialogText.en: Immediately?! You had all these supplies ready the whole time?

dialogText.cn: 那是自然。我的屋子里一直都装满了应急物资。只是路上车子抛锚，又遭了抢……现在只剩这些。
dialogText.en: Of course. My residence is filled with emergency supplies. Unfortunately, my vehicle suffered a malfunction and I was also ambushed... These crates are the only things left.

dialogText.cn: 这……该说你太有冲劲，还是运气太差呢……
dialogText.en: I don't know if I should call you selflessly dedicated, or seriously unlucky...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这里应该没有更多裂地者了。我们下一步的行动是？
dialogText.en: Endmin, there shouldn't be any Landbreakers nearby. What is our plan from here?

dialogText.cn: 罐头不会自己长腿跑，如果不是裂地者干的，应该是被什么动物盯上了。
dialogText.en: The tins won't go walk about on their own. If the Landbreakers didn't do it, then it's probably the local critters.

dialogText.cn: 那么，试试扫描功能吧。这山洞环境复杂，我们可以靠它寻找附近的生物活动痕迹，提升一点效率。
dialogText.en: This cave is quite complicated. Let's try the scanning feature. We can use it to find local wildlife activity. It'll make our search easier.

dialogText.cn: 咦？这里这里！找到了！
dialogText.en: Look! It's right here!

dialogText.cn: 看这罐头盖上的咬痕，还是新的……别拿这个来磨牙啊。
dialogText.en: There are bite marks on this can and they look fresh... Don't use this to grind your teeth, little one.

dialogText.cn: 唉，世道艰难，动物和人都不好过。罐头不能给它，我帮它再找些吃的吧。
dialogText.en: Sigh. Times are hard for humanity and beasts alike. Though the tins must be recovered, I shall assist in its search for food.

dialogText.cn: 瓦茨先生真好心啊。不过，东西总算都找回来了，接下来你要往哪儿去？
dialogText.en: You're such a kind soul, Mr. Waitz. Now that we've recovered everything, where are you headed next?

dialogText.cn: 唔，各位知道哪里能帮忙分发这些物资吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm. Do you know any organizations that can help distribute these supplies?

dialogText.cn: 如果四号谷地的管理机构还在运作，我们最好能和对方联系上。东西虽然不多，一定也能派上用场。
dialogText.en: If the administrative organization of Valley IV is still operational, we should attempt to get in touch with them. The supplies may be meager, but they will come in useful as well.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？各位这是怎么了？
dialogText.en: Hmm. I sense unease amongst my friends.

dialogText.cn: 要不……你直接把箱子给我们吧？
dialogText.en: Perhaps you can just ... give those crates to us.

dialogText.cn: 啊，你说的管理机构是……
dialogText.en: Administrative organization? Are you talking about...?

dialogText.cn: 除了联盟工团，我听说四号谷地的部分设施还有另一个组织在帮忙管理。能让工团配合工作，他们应该挺靠谱的。
dialogText.en: In addition to the UWST, I have heard about a separate organization. They are also managing several installations in Valley IV. Any organization that works with the UWST should be reliable enough.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你前面的这个门……我总觉得在哪里见过？
dialogText.en: Endmin, that gate in front of you... Have we seen it before?

dialogText.cn: 啊，想起来了，它和之前那个裂地者用来藏宝的山洞简直一模一样！
dialogText.en: Um... Oh, right! It looks just like that other cave where the LBs stash their loot!

dialogText.cn: 要不要进去看看？说不定也有什么宝藏呢。
dialogText.en: Maybe we should head in and take a look. We might strike gold.

dialogText.cn: 异常坚固的大门，不依靠特殊的办法恐怕无法打开……
dialogText.en: The gate is unnaturally solid. No ordinary force can get it to open...

dialogText.cn: 上面写着：“晴朗的<@qu.key>白昼</>为何会<@qu.key>下雨</>？我们的<@qu.key>同伴</>是否还在原地？——是否一切早已颠倒？”
dialogText.en: The note writes: "The sky is <@qu.key>sunny</> but yet it <@qu.key>rains</>. Can we still find our <@qu.key>friend</>? Or are things flipped over on its end?"

dialogText.cn: 好啦，门总算开了。
dialogText.en: Great! The gate is finally open!

dialogText.cn: 什么反应都没有……看来不是这个顺序……
dialogText.en: Nothing's happening... Maybe this isn't the right sequence...

dialogText.cn: 这个难道是……炸药？！
dialogText.en: Can these be the ... explosives?!

dialogText.cn: 啊，我想起来了！这是不是就是萨特提起过的胶棉炸药？居然被裂地者藏到了这里……
dialogText.en: Ah! I just remembered! These must be the gel-cotton explosives that Satyr mentioned! The Landbreakers actually hid them here...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们还是赶快联系萨特吧。让他赶快把这些炸药带回去，免得再出什么差错……
dialogText.en: Endmin, we should call Satyr right away. His crew should carry these explosives back to their sites. I really don't want anything bad to happen...

dialogText.cn: 2号大门已经检修完毕，各位可以正常出入。
dialogText.en: Gate 2 is fully repaired. You should be able to access the place now.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>阿伯莉采石场</>。我有个好哥们就在那里当技术员。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Aburrey Quarry</>. A good pal of mine works there as a technician.

dialogText.cn: 不过他最近好像闷闷不乐的，工友聚会都没来，也不知道是遇上什么事了……
dialogText.en: But he doesn't seem very happy recently. The dude stopped attending the UWST Crew Fest. I hope nothing bad happened to him...

dialogText.cn: 这是我们该做的。也谢谢你们帮我们解决了那么多问题，终末地的朋友。
dialogText.en: It's our job. And thanks for taking care of so many problems for us, my Endfielder friends.

dialogText.cn: 哇，管理员你来了！太好了，我正想着要不要先下去看看呢！
dialogText.en: Hoho, you've arrived, Endmin! Awesome. I was about to head in and look around the place on my own.

dialogText.cn: 有点不好说，我只看到一些人影在那边忙来忙去，但距离太远了，不确定具体是什么情况。
dialogText.en: I don't really know. I saw figures scurrying about but they're so far away. I'm not sure what they're up to.

dialogText.cn: 我倒是远远看到几个人影，大概是工团的？不过就看他们在那边来来回回，也不知道在干什么……
dialogText.en: Just those figures in the far distance. They kinda look like members of the Syndicates crew. Anyway, these guys are rushing back and forth and I have no idea what they're doing...

dialogText.cn: 我也这么觉得！好了，既然这样，那我们现在就先跳下去吧！
dialogText.en: I totally agree! Great. It's time to jump right in!

dialogText.cn: 对啊！很简单的！只要落地之前提前调整下姿势就能——
dialogText.en: Yeah! It's super easy! Just adjust your landing posture right before you hit the ground—

dialogText.cn: 不想走捷径吗？不愧是管理员！也对，这种时候还是该脚踏实地一点！
dialogText.en: You're not taking the shortcut? Hmm. Surefooted as always, Endmin! Perhaps a more cautious and grounded approach will work out better for us!

dialogText.cn: 当然，要是管理员你反悔了也没事！我背着你跳下去也是完全没问题的！
dialogText.en: And it's okay if you change your mind, Endmin. I can give you a piggyback ride and jump down. It's totally safe!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？是我的错觉吗？你的脸怎么变得这么白啊？
dialogText.en: Hmm. Endmin, I hope I'm not seeing things, but you turned really pale.

dialogText.cn: 没什么，我就是觉得……
dialogText.en: {F}Ah, I'm okay. Just feeling a little, you know...{M}It's nothing. I just felt a little...

dialogText.cn: 还是换个进去的方法比较好……
dialogText.en: {F}I'm wondering if there's another way in...{M}We should look for another way in...

dialogText.cn: 好吧，我明白了！那我们现在就开始找吧！
dialogText.en: Fine, I get it. Alright, then! Time to look for a detour!

dialogText.cn: 通道尽头的大门似乎<@qu.key>正在检修</>。
dialogText.en: The gate at the end of the corridor is <@qu.key>being repaired</>.

dialogText.cn: （看来这边暂时是过不去了……换条路吧。）
dialogText.en: (The way is blocked. I should look for another way.)

actorName.cn: 拘谨的采石场行政人员{拉蒙}

dialogText.cn: 唉……还是没找到合适的备用零件吗？
dialogText.en: I guess there are still no suitable backup parts.

actorName.cn: 沮丧的采石场工作人员

dialogText.cn: 是的……仓库那边也受了灾，很多备用物资都被掉下来的东西压坏了……
dialogText.en: No... Our depot was hit as well. Most of the backup parts have been destroyed...

actorName.cn: 拘谨的采石场行政人员{拉蒙}

dialogText.cn: 这下怎么办……<@qu.key>佩妮女士</>也不知道上哪儿去了……要是她在的话说不定还能有点办法……
dialogText.en: Okay... What should we do...? If only we knew where <@qu.key>Penny</> went... She'll definitely make something work...

actorName.cn: 拘谨的采石场行政人员{拉蒙}

dialogText.cn: 终末地？啊……我听说过你们，不过你们怎么会来我们这儿……？
dialogText.en: Endfielders? Ah... I ... heard about you, but why are you here...?

dialogText.cn: 因为收到了你们的求援讯号嘛，所以我们才大老远跑过来啦！
dialogText.en: 'Cos we received your distress call! We ran all the way from our Base to this place, you know!

dialogText.cn: 来来，有什么要帮忙的？直说就好！
dialogText.en: Anyways, I heard you got trouble. Spit it out and I'll get it settled!

actorName.cn: 拘谨的采石场行政人员{拉蒙}

dialogText.cn: 求援讯号？难道说……你们是其他基地派来支援我们的？太好了！总算等到你们了！！！
dialogText.en: Distress call? Someone at another base actually heard us and sent you here? Oh thank Talos for that! We really need all the help we can get!!

actorName.cn: 拘谨的采石场行政人员{拉蒙}

dialogText.cn: 不对不对……两位的打扮看起来也不像是工团的人啊……你们到底是……
dialogText.en: Wait a sec... But I don't really recognize your outfits... Are you really from the UWST?

dialogText.cn: 我们是终末地的啦！专门跑来帮你们的！
dialogText.en: We're Endfielders! We came all the way here to help you out!

actorName.cn: 拘谨的采石场行政人员{拉蒙}

dialogText.cn: 这……先谢谢你们了！我叫<@qu.key>拉蒙</>，是这座采石场的主要负责人。
dialogText.en: Oh ... okay. I mean, really nice to have you here! I'm <@qu.key>Ramon</> and I'm the person in charge of this Quarry.

dialogText.cn: 是这样的，你们既然收到了求援讯号，应该已经知道这边在受灾后道路阻断严重的事了吧？事实上我们面临的最大问题也源于此……
dialogText.en: So, since you have received our distress call, then you should know that the disaster blocked a lot of our roads... That also happens to be the major cause of our most pressing issue...

dialogText.cn: 没错。在那场灾害发生后，我们整个采石场都陷入了混乱，幸好之后的余震并不强，我们立刻执行了紧急预案……
dialogText.en: Indeed we do. The disaster made a mess of this Quarry. Fortunately the aftershocks weren't as strong so we initiated our contingency plans...

dialogText.cn: 只是，前往几个重要区域的道路都被阻断了。加上这边的通讯干扰现在特别严重，很多工友到现在都是失联状态。
dialogText.en: However, every road leading to other key zones is either blocked or has collapsed. Signal interference is also really bad here. We still couldn't contact many of our crew.

dialogText.cn: 所以我们才想尽快连通道路，找到工友们并确认他们的安全。
dialogText.en: This is why we must clear the roads, locate our crew, and get them to safety ASAP.

dialogText.cn: 是的，其实这个“关键”我们已经找到了，就是那个——
dialogText.en: Exactly! And we actually found a "bypass key" to handle our problem. It's this—

dialogText.cn: 这架大型起重机，过去承担了很多我们采石场的关键工作。虽然在我被调到这里前，它好像就因为长期高负荷运作而出现了一些故障，几乎没再正式启动过了……
dialogText.en: Our super crane! This juggernaut did a lot of heavy lifting in the Quarry. But our old boy seemed to have experienced a ... major mechanical hiccup because we overworked it for years. Happened before I got this assignment, too. We never really activated it since then...

dialogText.cn: 但这次多亏了它，我们才能借助上面的<@qu.key>吊舱</>前往部分道路阻断的地区。
dialogText.en: Lucky for us, the old boy's <@qu.key>lifting cage</> still works. It's how we could still reach the zones cut off by the road collapses.

dialogText.cn: 对，但大概是之前的故障影响，目前也就只有吊舱能进行一些简单的移动……
dialogText.en: Yeah. That old boy is pretty banged up from overwork... Its lifting cage is the only part that can still move...

dialogText.cn: 所以我们很需要了解它运行逻辑的技术人员来想办法修好它，这样就能连通更多区域了。
dialogText.en: This is also why we really need skilled machinists who know how this works! Fixing and activating the super crane will let us reach even more places in the Quarry!

dialogText.cn: 欸？难道你们自己人里就没有懂这个的吗？
dialogText.en: Wait. Are you saying that none of you know how this works?

dialogText.cn: 有是有，但她也在这次灾害后失联了……所以……
dialogText.en: We do... I mean ... we did. We just lost contact with her after the disaster... So...

dialogText.cn: 没问题！供电中枢就在那边，我这就带你们去。
dialogText.en: No problem! The power nexus is that way! Let me take you there!

dialogText.cn: 不错！你们比我预想的快不少！真是后生可畏啊！
dialogText.en: Not bad, children! You're faster than I thought! Very impressive!

dialogText.cn: 总之，按着这个路线来，你们就能到最高处了。
dialogText.en: So, just follow this route and you'll reach the highest point.

dialogText.cn: 从那里可以跳到吊臂上方，之后再从附近的维修通道下去，把吊臂的角度调整下，应该就能搭出一条通往深层管理区的路了。
dialogText.en: Once you're there, you can leap onto the crane arm and head down via the maintenance shaft. Turn the arm to the right angle and you'll have a path to the Deep Management Post.

dialogText.cn: 明白了，这次总能多谢您了吧，佩妮女士？
dialogText.en: Understood! I guess we really have to thank you this time, Penny!

dialogText.cn: 行吧，就当是我在帮拉蒙那小子还人情了。
dialogText.en: Fine. Just treat this as me thanking you for what you did for little Ramon.

dialogText.cn: 唉，这里啊，就是不让人省心的小年轻太多了，我才总是没法安心退休……
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... They crewed this place with young inexperienced children. They just won't let me retire in peace...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？！你、你们是怎么从上面下来的！难、难道说你们——
dialogText.en: Endmin?! HOW?! You came here from the top... Does that mean you—

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，那你肯定想不到——我们是从吊臂上下来的！
dialogText.en: Hahaha! You'll never guess! We actually came down from the crane arm itself!

dialogText.cn: 原来你们遇到了佩妮女士……果然是“转运”了……我终于能先松口气了……
dialogText.en: You met Penny...? Thank goodness... Looks like our luck has indeed turned around... Feels like having a weight off my shoulders...

dialogText.cn: 是的，因为对我乃至整个采石场的人来说，佩妮女士都是很重要的……她为这里做了很多事，我们一直都很敬仰她。
dialogText.en: Of course. Penny's really important not just to me, but to everyone in this Quarry... She did a lot of work here, and all of us have a ton of respect for her.

dialogText.cn: 所以我也相信她的判断，管理员，你就按照佩妮女士的说法操作吧！
dialogText.en: I have absolute faith in her judgment. I say we follow Penny's instructions and do things her way, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 呼，这下总算能过去了！管理员，真是多亏有你帮忙！
dialogText.en: Phew! We can finally get across! Really appreciate your help, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 救援小组注意！到达目标地点后务必先将抗干扰收讯器打开！别漏掉一点可能的求救信号！
dialogText.en: Attention! Rescue team! Once you reach your target nav point, deploy your counter-interference receiver at once! No one gets left behind on our watch!

actorName.cn: 工团救援人员{工团救援人员B}
actorName.en: UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST SAR Crew Mate B}

dialogText.cn: 明白！β小队已经在进行地毯式搜救了……
dialogText.en: Roger! β Team is commencing with a thorough sweep of this area...

dialogText.cn: 看来还算顺利，希望能尽快找到幸存的工友们……
dialogText.en: We're making good progress. Hopefully we'll find our missing crew ASAP...

dialogText.cn: 不错不错，这下我们的任务也算告一段落了吧？管理员，赶紧和菲奥娜说一声——
dialogText.en: Good job, people! I guess this concludes our mission in this area. Endmin, let's give Fiona a call—

actorName.cn: 工团救援人员{工团救援人员A}
actorName.en: UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST SAR Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 什、什么声音？！啊！小心！在我们背后——
dialogText.en: AHH! WATCH OUT! IT'S RIGHT BEHIND US—

dialogText.cn: ……α小队？β小队？所有人员收到请回话！收到请回话！
dialogText.en: ...α Team? β Team? Do you copy? Respond! This is Ramon. DO YOU COPY?

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你们来了！唉，负责救援的工友们恐怕遇到了什么意外……
dialogText.en: Endmin! You're back! Ugh. Our search and rescue crew mates probably ran into trouble...

dialogText.cn: 可我身为负责人，必须留守在这里确保指挥台的通讯，就拜托你们去现场确认实际的情况了！
dialogText.en: I'm the quarry monitor and I must stay at the command post to maintain radio communications. Can I ask you to check the sites for me, please?

dialogText.cn: 那我们就赶紧去看看吧，管理员！
dialogText.en: We must hurry over there, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样啊，管理员？能修不？
dialogText.en: How does it look, Endmin? Can you repair it?

dialogText.cn: 管理员？难道说，您就是终末地的……那个“管理员”？
dialogText.en: Endmin? Does that mean ... you're that ... Endministrator of Endfield Industries?

dialogText.cn: 太好了！这下起重机肯定有救了！咳，抱歉，我有点太激动了……对了，您刚刚说“不过”，“不过”什么？
dialogText.en: Wonderful! That means we can save the super crane...! Ah, apologies. I got too carried away... So you said you probably can, but you ended that line with a "but"...

dialogText.cn: 这……这您是怎么看出来的？
dialogText.en: Wha... Wow. How do you know?

dialogText.cn: 唉，实际上关于改造的事我也不是很清楚，那应该都是十几年前的事了……
dialogText.en: Yeah... I don't really know what happened when they modified this crane. It happened more than a decade ago...

dialogText.cn: 听说是为了让起重机更适应我们采石场的需求，所以当时负责的一位工程师特意对它进行了改造……
dialogText.en: I heard that they did it to make the crane more suitable for Quarry work. The engineer in charge slapped on some mods...

dialogText.cn: 图纸？我想想……设备科的菲莉丝可能知道……佩妮女士估计也……唉，关键时刻需要的工友居然都失联了……我这个负责人也太不走运了。
dialogText.en: Schematics? Let me think... Phyllis from the Hardware Division might know... Penny probably does too. But we've lost contact with these crew members... I must be the unluckiest manager ever.

dialogText.cn: 听着真是屋漏偏逢连夜雨……不过你看，你们这不也等到我们来了吗？保不准马上就要转运咯！
dialogText.en: Yeah, trouble usually comes in threes... But hey, look on the bright side. We're here, so your luck is probably gonna turn around!

dialogText.cn: 有了！我想起来了，那里肯定有！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah! I just remembered something! You'll definitely find the schematics there!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，但愿真是这样吧……
dialogText.en: Haha... I really hope so...

dialogText.cn: 总之，管理员，你要看改造时用的图纸，只要去一个地方就行了。
dialogText.en: Ahem. In any case, Endmin, if you're looking for the mod schematics, just visit this place...

dialogText.cn: 那就是我们设在联络区的<@qu.key>档案库</>。
dialogText.en: ...The <@qu.key>Archive</> located at the Listening Post.

dialogText.cn: 里面存放了采石场建立至今的所有资料。
dialogText.en: Every data file and document, created from the very founding of this Quarry, is kept at the Archive.

dialogText.cn: 采石场旧址！
dialogText.en: It's at the Old Quarry!

dialogText.cn: 不对，现在应该叫“联络区”了。
dialogText.en: But we now call it the Listening Post.

dialogText.cn: 我们在那里设有一个可以备份各种资料的<@qu.key>档案库</>。
dialogText.en: We built an <@qu.key>Archive</> at that place for storing all sorts of backup data and files.

dialogText.cn: 里面自然也存了改造这架起重机时用的图纸。
dialogText.en: Naturally, we should have a copy of the schematics used for modifying this crane.

dialogText.cn: 就在那边——
dialogText.en: It's over there—

dialogText.cn: 不过你们也看到了，那边的道路也因为灾害的影响被阻断了。
dialogText.en: Well, I guess you can also see that the road has been rendered impassable by the disaster as well.

dialogText.cn: 啊？那我们该怎么过去呢？
dialogText.en: O—kay... So how are we supposed to get across?

dialogText.cn: 这个距离……就算是我，估计也要费点劲才过得去呢……
dialogText.en: And it's kinda far... Even I would have trouble reaching that place...

dialogText.cn: 不用担心，前面我也提到过，是多亏了起重机上面的<@qu.key>吊舱</>，我们才能顺利连上一些地区。
dialogText.en: It's alright. Remember the <@qu.key>lifting cage</> of the crane I've mentioned? We can use it to reach certain zones.

dialogText.cn: 而联络区也是可以连通的区域之一。所以想过去的话，只需要再<@qu.key>操作</>一下就好。
dialogText.en: The Listening Post happens to be one of them. We'll just <@qu.key>use</> the crane and get you over there.

dialogText.cn: 明白了！管理员，轮到你出手啦！
dialogText.en: Got it! Endmin, I guess it's your turn to run the show!

dialogText.cn: 原来如此！所以你说的这个联络区在哪里？我们现在就去。
dialogText.en: Sounds really useful! So where's this Listening Post? We should set off at once.

dialogText.cn: 好了！已经安全啦！你可以出来了！
dialogText.en: Alright! Coast is clear! You can come out now!

dialogText.cn: 谢、谢谢你们……我、我还以为……死定了……
dialogText.en: Thank you... Thank you so much... I ... I really thought ... thought I was gonna die here...

dialogText.cn: 没事！举手之劳啦！对了，这边现在不安全，你还是快往回走吧！
dialogText.en: It's alright! Just doing my job, you know. Oh yeah, this place ain't safe. You should head back right now!

dialogText.cn: 不、不行！我、我的收尾工作……还没做完……不、不能回去！
dialogText.en: No ... NO! I ... I can't! I ... I haven't concluded the closing job... I ... I can't go ... go back...!

dialogText.cn: 收尾工作？那是什么？没听拉蒙提过啊……
dialogText.en: Closing job? Is it something important? Ramon never told us about this...

dialogText.cn: 就、就是很重要……很重要的工作，一定要完成……！
dialogText.en: It's ... it's a really ... really important jo ... job! I ... I must get it ... get it done...!

dialogText.cn: 以、以后……可能没机会了……
dialogText.en: I ... I ... might not get ... get another chance like this...

dialogText.cn: 这、这个……其、其实……我需要去……那边的<@qu.key>档案库</>。
dialogText.en: O ... okay... It's just ... just that I need ... I need to reach that ... that <@qu.key>Archive</> over there.

dialogText.cn: 必、必须把最后一批材料信息……上传上去。
dialogText.en: I ... I must ... must upload the last batch ... batch of data.

dialogText.cn: 档案库？巧了，我们刚好也要去那儿呢！要不我们一起？
dialogText.en: The Archive? Cool! We're heading that way too! Maybe you should join us!

dialogText.cn: 真、真的吗？那、那太好了！
dialogText.en: Really? That's ... that's wonderful!

dialogText.cn: 对、对了！忘、忘了自我介绍！我叫米菈，是一名……材料员！
dialogText.en: Oh ... ye ... yeah! I ... I forgot to introduce my ... myself! My name's Mila... I'm ... I'm a ... a material inspector!

dialogText.cn: 很高兴……很高兴认识你们！
dialogText.en: I'm really ... really happy to meet you!

dialogText.cn: 你、你们小心！这、这是对付入侵者的系统！
dialogText.en: You ... you must get to safety! This ... this system will attack intruders!

dialogText.cn: 我、我听过一次培训课……希、希望能帮上忙……
dialogText.en: I ... I took a training course... I hope ... I hope this works...!

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？看出眉目了吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: So, how does it look? See anything, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 太好了！那我们这就回去吧！
dialogText.en: Awesome! Let's head back right now!

dialogText.cn: 哦对，也和米菈说一声吧！看她要不要和我们一起！
dialogText.en: Oh, before I forget, we should tell Mila! She probably wants to come with us!

dialogText.cn: G-313花岗岩，硬度是……
dialogText.en: G-313. Granite. Hardness scale...

dialogText.cn: 米菈，我们这边结束了！你那边呢？要一起回去吗？
dialogText.en: Mila! We're done! How about you? Wanna head back with us?

dialogText.cn: 你们好快！我、我还有好多资料没录进去……还、还不能回去……
dialogText.en: You're so fast! But ... but I still have tons of data to upload... I ... I can't head back right now...

dialogText.cn: 好吧！这边有几道门，应该还挺安全的……那我们就先走了啊！
dialogText.en: Alright, then! The path through those gates should be safe... We'll see you around!

dialogText.cn: 嗯！可、可惜我和菲莉丝不一样，没和师傅学什么起重机的知识……不、不然也能回去帮帮你们……
dialogText.en: Okay! I should ... should have been more like Phyllis ... and learned something about heavy lifting cranes from the instructor... I would be ... be so much more useful that way...

dialogText.cn: 客气什么！你好好做完你的工作，然后安安全全地回去——就是对我们最好的“回报”啦！
dialogText.en: You're being too nice! Just focus on your job and get back safely—! That will put a smile on my face!

dialogText.cn: 我会的！谢谢你们啦！终末地的朋友！
dialogText.en: I will do that! Thank you, friends from Endfield!

dialogText.cn: 你们回来了？怎么样？有看到图纸吗？
dialogText.en: You're back! How was it? Did you find the schematics?

dialogText.cn: 那当然！我们怎么可能空着手回来嘛！
dialogText.en: Of course we did! We can't simply head out there and return empty-handed!

dialogText.cn: 太好了！看来我没记错！那……有修复的头绪了吗？
dialogText.en: Yessssss! I knew I was right! So ... do we have a solution for starting the super crane repairs?

dialogText.cn: 好好好！那就有劳你了，管理员！
dialogText.en: Great! Really appreciate this, Endmin!

actorName.cn: 系统提示音{sm1|3-系统提示音}

dialogText.cn: 373号大型起重机已启动，请各方注意。373号大型起重机已启动，请各方注意。
dialogText.en: Warning. To all nearby personnel. Super crane 373 has been activated. To all nearby personnel. Super crane 373 has been activated.

dialogText.cn: 这就是这架起重机完全启动后的状态吗！我还是第一次见到……果然比想象中更壮观！
dialogText.en: Whoa... This is my first time seeing the full activation of our super crane...! It's way more impressive than I ever imagined!

dialogText.cn: 难怪大家都舍不得……
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Perhaps it's the reason why the crew never wanted to leave...

dialogText.cn: 呃，没什么……总之多谢你了，管理员！这下我总算能安排救援小组的工友们继续去进行救助工作了……
dialogText.en: Err... Forget what I said, Endmin! And thanks a lot for everything you've done for us! Now I can use the crane to move the rescue teams and save more of our crew...

dialogText.cn: 不过有几个地方目前还去不了，不知道还能不能找到别的方法过去……唉，不行就只能等后续的支援了。
dialogText.en: But there are still a few zones we can't reach. I'm not sure if we'll find a way to get there... Ugh. I guess I just have to wait for backup to arrive.

dialogText.cn: 啊？什么问题？只要是我知道的我肯定……
dialogText.en: Ask me something? Sure, if it's something I know, I'll definitely give you the answer.

dialogText.cn: 您、您这又是怎么看出来的……
dialogText.en: Wha... How?! How did you know...?

dialogText.cn: 好吧，虽然我没想瞒着，但本来也不想多说这件伤心事……
dialogText.en: Fine. I'm not trying to hide things from you. It's just something really sad that nobody wants to talk about...

dialogText.cn: 你判断得没错，这座采石场确实快要关闭了。这几天原本是要开告别大会的……结果出了这种意外……
dialogText.en: And yes ... you're right. This Quarry is shutting down. We were putting together a closing ceremony and then ... the disaster happened...

dialogText.cn: 大部分应该是。当然，我是觉得大家除了收尾也是在告别……
dialogText.en: Yeah. We couldn't get in touch with most of them. I guess they were closing down the place ... and saying goodbye to it...

dialogText.cn: 虽然我来这里的时间不长，但能感觉到大家对于离开采石场这件事都各有各的想法……
dialogText.en: I haven't been here for long, but it's obvious that everyone has their own ideas about leaving the Quarry behind...

dialogText.cn: 所以才想要在最后的这点时间里，让更多人能好好告别，安全离开……我想，这就是我这个主要负责人该做的“收尾工作”了。
dialogText.en: These would be our last days at this place. I want to let our people say their farewells and leave safely... I believe this is the closing work I have to oversee as the last manager of the Quarry.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，接下来去哪里？
dialogText.en: So, where to next, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 好嘞！那就从那一块开始吧！走！
dialogText.en: Alright! We can definitely head over there. Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 管理员！从这里过去应该就能上去了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I think this is the spot! We can head up from here!

dialogText.cn: 年轻人，你们前面的路可不好走。
dialogText.en: Easy there, children. You're taking a dangerous path.

dialogText.cn: 还是别冲得这么快，多观察观察吧。
dialogText.en: Don't rush into things. Take the time to look around and be cautious.

dialogText.cn: 咦？声音好像是从那边传来的……
dialogText.en: Huh? The voice came from over there...

dialogText.cn: 别东张西望了，在这儿。
dialogText.en: Stop gawking around, girl. I'm over here.

actorName.cn: 漫不经心的工团老太太{佩妮}

dialogText.cn: 我就一路过的老太太，随口一劝罢了。
dialogText.en: I'm an old lady who happens to be passing by and giving a few random words of advice.

actorName.cn: 漫不经心的工团老太太{佩妮}

dialogText.cn: 你们想听就听，不想听就不听。
dialogText.en: Heed them or ignore them. Your choice. Matters not to me.

dialogText.cn: 老人家，刚刚多谢啦！
dialogText.en: Really appreciate that, ma'am!

actorName.cn: 漫不经心的工团老太太{佩妮}

dialogText.cn: 不用谢我，决定是你们自己做的，路也是你们自己走的，老太太也就废话了两句而已。
dialogText.en: No need to thank me. You made the call and took the path of your choosing. Pay no mind to what I've said.

actorName.cn: 漫不经心的工团老太太{佩妮}

dialogText.cn: 况且我也有点事想问问你们……两位终末地的朋友。
dialogText.en: This old lady got something to ask you ... friends from Endfield.

actorName.cn: 漫不经心的工团老太太{佩妮}

dialogText.cn: 只是认识你们衣服上的标志罢了……哦对，忘了自我介绍，我叫<@qu.key>佩妮</>，就一个快退休的老太太，偶尔喜欢管点闲事。
dialogText.en: Know the badges on your outfits, that's all... And by Talos, I'm getting senile. The name's <@qu.key>Penny</>. I'm just an old lady with one foot out of the retirement door ... and an occasional busybody.

dialogText.cn: 您就是佩妮女士？！拉蒙先生好像一直在找您……
dialogText.en: You're Penny?! Mr. Ramon has been looking around for you...

dialogText.cn: 哦？那你们就跟老太太说说吧，拉蒙这小子又遇到什么麻烦了？他啊，和我那两个徒弟不一样，每次想起找我，铁定是有了什么解决不了的难题……
dialogText.en: Oh? Did he? Do tell me about little Ramon and his silly problems. Unlike my other two apprentices, Ramon would only think about old Penny when there's a mess he can't clean...

dialogText.cn: 看来我喝完酒睡的这一觉是有点太长了。居然发生了这么多事！难怪把我那“老伙计”都折腾起来了……
dialogText.en: Oh dear, this old lady really got too hammered from all that porter. I missed the fun! You even got my old partner to work...!

dialogText.cn: “老伙计”？您说的是……那台起重机？
dialogText.en: Old partner? You're talking about that ... super lifting crane thing, right?

dialogText.cn: 是它，我在采石场干过不少活，但最久的还要属起重机驾驶……所以对它的感情是有点不一样。
dialogText.en: That's the one. I did my share of work at this Quarry and I probably spent half my life in the crane pilot's cabin... I got a special relationship with that old boy, you know.

dialogText.cn: 扯远了，说回正事。反正情况我都了解了，按照你们的说法，接下来应该去那边的<@qu.key>深层管理区</>。
dialogText.en: Alright, let's get back to business before I swerve into the far north with my nonsense. Now that I've learned about our current situation, I take it that you're heading to the <@qu.key>Deep Management Post</>, right?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们就想知道怎么才能上去！这边的路可真的是不太好走！
dialogText.en: Yeah. We really need to find a way to reach that place, but getting around this Quarry is such a nightmare!

dialogText.cn: 当然，只能说你们运气不错，算是问对人了！
dialogText.en: Of course I do. Count yourself lucky. You asked the right old lady!

dialogText.cn: 跟我来吧！
dialogText.en: Follow me!

dialogText.cn: 你们怎么还不撤退啊？这里还不算安全呢……
dialogText.en: You should call off this operation! This place isn't safe...!

actorName.cn: 认真的工团救援人员{工团救援人员A}
actorName.en: Serious UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST Rescue Crew A}

dialogText.cn: 我们是来救助失联工友的，当然得把能去的地方都去一趟。
dialogText.en: We came here to find and rescue our missing crew mates! The team is not going to leave any stone unturned!

actorName.cn: 认真的工团救援人员{工团救援人员A}
actorName.en: Serious UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST Rescue Crew A}

dialogText.cn: 就算之后真遇到了什么危险，那也是之后的事。
dialogText.en: Things might get hairy, but we'll handle them as they come.

actorName.cn: 认真的工团救援人员{工团救援人员A}
actorName.en: Serious UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST Rescue Crew A}

dialogText.cn: 现在我只在乎能不能找到一些新的线索与信号，让我们能带回更多失联的工友。
dialogText.en: My only concern is to find trails and pick up signals of our crew! We're leaving no one behind!

dialogText.cn: 我明白了……管理员，我们也跟上他们吧！
dialogText.en: I understand... Endmin! We should keep up with them!

dialogText.cn: 这边和那边都找过一遍了，应该没漏什么……
dialogText.en: We searched this place and ... that place... I don't think we missed anything...

dialogText.cn: 管理员！你那边怎么样？
dialogText.en: Endmin! Found anything?

dialogText.cn: 那就只能看救援小组有没有什么新消息了。
dialogText.en: I guess we'll have to wait and see if the rescue team found something.

actorName.cn: 细心的工团救援人员{工团救援人员B}
actorName.en: Meticulous UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST Rescue Crew B}

dialogText.cn: 我们找到新线索了——
dialogText.en: We made a discovery—!

actorName.cn: 细心的工团救援人员{工团救援人员B}
actorName.en: Meticulous UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST Rescue Crew B}

dialogText.cn: 熟悉这附近的同事和我们说，再往里走还有一条通道，是这里的同事平时前往工作区域的路。
dialogText.en: A fellow crew member familiar with these parts told us about another trail. The local teams would use it to commute.

actorName.cn: 细心的工团救援人员{工团救援人员B}
actorName.en: Meticulous UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST Rescue Crew B}

dialogText.cn: 或许那些失联工友就在下面，可惜我们现在人手严重不足……只能麻烦你们先帮忙去探查下了，两位终末地的朋友。
dialogText.en: Perhaps our lost crew mates are down there, but we have no one to spare... My Endfielder friends, I ... I'm wondering if you can help us investigate the place...

dialogText.cn: 没事！你不说，我们也是要去看看的！
dialogText.en: No problem! You don't have to ask. We're heading down there anyway!

actorName.cn: 细心的工团救援人员{工团救援人员B}
actorName.en: Meticulous UWST SAR Crew Mate {UWST Rescue Crew B}

dialogText.cn: 对了，这是备用的<@qu.key>电梯</>钥匙卡，用它应该就能启动这边的<@qu.key>电梯</>了。
dialogText.en: Here! Take this backup <@qu.key>elevator</> key! It should activate the <@qu.key>elevator</> here.

dialogText.cn: 你们是……深层管理区的人？呃，这是什么工团特有的欢迎仪式吗……
dialogText.en: Are you the ... Deep Management crew? And is this a special ... UWST welcoming ceremony...?

actorName.cn: 终于放松的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员A}
actorName.en: Relieved UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 是人……不是天使……太好了……
dialogText.en: It's not Aggeloi...! It's people! The people finally found us...! We're saved!

actorName.cn: 劫后余生的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员B}
actorName.en: Surviving UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew Mate B}

dialogText.cn: 吓死我了……还以为完蛋了……
dialogText.en: I was so scared... I thought the rock buggers would bury us all...

actorName.cn: 恍惚不已的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员C}
actorName.en: Confused UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew C}

dialogText.cn: 我们这是……死里逃生了吗……真的吗……
dialogText.en: Did we make it...? I'm not dreaming, right...?

actorName.cn: 理智的工团成员{菲莉丝}

dialogText.cn: 别介意，大家这几天都绷得太紧了。
dialogText.en: I hope you won't mind. The last few days have been incredibly stressful for the crew.

actorName.cn: 理智的工团成员{菲莉丝}

dialogText.cn: 所以一放松下来，就有点忘乎所以了……
dialogText.en: Your arrival literally lifted the lid off the pressure cooker... So our celebration ... got a little out of hand...

actorName.cn: 理智的工团成员{菲莉丝}

dialogText.cn: 给他们一点宣泄的空间吧……至于这里的具体情况，我们去那边细聊？
dialogText.en: Let's give the crew some space... And I say we head over there so we can discuss the situation.

actorName.cn: 理智的工团成员{菲莉丝}

dialogText.cn: 先自我介绍下，我叫菲莉丝……如果没看错的话，你们是终末地的人？
dialogText.en: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Phyllis... And if I'm not mistaken, you're from Endfield Industries.

dialogText.cn: 没错！我是陈千语，这是我们的管理员。
dialogText.en: That's right! I'm Chen and this is our Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 陈千语和……管理员？没想到会在这里见到教科书里的人物……两位好，非常感谢你们给予的帮助，能和我说说你们这一路是怎么过来的吗？
dialogText.en: Chen ... and the Endmin? I never expected to meet figures from the textbooks here... Well met and thank you for saving us. Can you tell me how you managed to reach this place?

dialogText.cn: 太不容易了……不过没想到你们竟然会遇到米菈和师傅……这个采石场果然太小了……
dialogText.en: That's really incredible... I didn't expect you to run into Mila and Penny... This Quarry is indeed smaller than it looks...

dialogText.cn: 欸？你们三个原来是认识的吗？
dialogText.en: Huh? So the three of you know each other?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，佩妮女士是我的师傅，米菈则算是我的师妹吧……不过我们俩和师傅学的东西完全不一样就是了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Penny is my mentor and Mila is like a fellow apprentice of sorts... But Penny taught us really different things.

dialogText.cn: 现在知道她们都平安无事，我总算能安心一点了。
dialogText.en: And I feel much better now knowing that both of them are alright.

dialogText.cn: 接下来最大的问题，就只剩该怎么带大家撤离了。
dialogText.en: So, the only thing left to do is to find a way to get everyone out of this place.

dialogText.cn: 事实上我们这儿有一部备用电梯，就在那边。它用的独立电机，专门就是来应对这种意外状况的。
dialogText.en: We actually have a backup elevator over there. It's meant for emergency scenarios like this, so it comes with its own motor.

dialogText.cn: 但灾害发生后，它似乎也受到了你们说的锚点的影响，发生了故障。我们尝试了不少办法，都没能修好它。
dialogText.en: But when the disaster struck, the Ankhor you mentioned probably broke the motor. We tried all sorts of ways to get it fixed but none of them worked.

dialogText.cn: 但管理员，听你们的描述，我在想，或许是它内部的装置出现了类似起重机的问题……
dialogText.en: However, I remembered something you said and I believe the problem lies in a fried internal component. The issue might be similar to that of the super crane...

dialogText.cn: 所以还是想麻烦您帮我们看看，它还能不能修好？要是这台电梯可以重新运作，我们就能直接回到地面了。
dialogText.en: So I wonder if you can help us by taking a look at it. We need to check if it can really be fixed. Once the elevator works again, we'll simply take it to reach the surface.

actorName.cn: 终于放松的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员A}
actorName.en: Relieved UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: ……我们能撑到现在，也是多亏了有菲莉丝在啊……我记得当时大家都挺慌的，就她特别冷静，一个人把其他人都召集了起来。
dialogText.en: We have Phyllis to thank for keeping us alive all this while... We were panicking and running around like headless fowls but Phyllis kept her cool and got everyone together.

actorName.cn: 终于放松的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员A}
actorName.en: Relieved UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 也是她带着我们逃到了这里，跟我们一起用各种杂物把入口封上，阻断了天使的搜寻……全程我就没见她慌乱过一秒，真不知道她是怎么做到的……
dialogText.en: She brought us to this place and together we built a barricade that successfully kept the Aggeloi out... Phyllis never panicked. Not even for a sec! I don't know how she got her nerves of steel...

actorName.cn: 劫后余生的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员B}
actorName.en: Surviving UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew Mate B}

dialogText.cn: 菲莉丝小姐真的太厉害了！唉，好羡慕设备科的人啊，能有这么靠谱的负责人……比我们一心只知道搞研究的负责人好多了……
dialogText.en: Phyllis is just incredible! I really envy the crew at the Hardware Division for having such a reliable manager... Our manager is just a nerdy egghead obsessed about research...

actorName.cn: 劫后余生的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员B}
actorName.en: Surviving UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew Mate B}

dialogText.cn: 不过菲莉丝小姐为什么会在这种时候来深层管理区呢……照理说，她不是应该在设备库那边做最后的收尾工作吗？
dialogText.en: I just wonder why Phyllis visited the Deep Management Post back then when she should be packing things up at the hardware storage.

actorName.cn: 恍惚不已的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员C}
actorName.en: Confused UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew C}

dialogText.cn: 嗯……灾害发生前，她好像和我们负责人谈了很久……我路过的时候听到了一点……她好像是为了某些没上传的研究资料来的……
dialogText.en: Hmm... I heard her talking to our manager before the disaster struck us... I think she came to the Deep for some research data that were not uploaded yet...

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？终末地的管理员，你有什么想问的吗？
dialogText.en: Endministrator, is there anything I can help with?

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？你是想问我一个不是深层管理区的人为什么会来这里吗？
dialogText.en: Interesting question. Perhaps you wish to know why I'm at this place when I should be somewhere else.

dialogText.cn: 对我的事很好奇吗？不过我倒是不介意把原因说出来。
dialogText.en: Are you that curious about me? I won't mind telling you the reason why I'm here.

dialogText.cn: 事实上，我只是想来找一些被侥幸保留下来的特别记录——有关这座采石场曾经的历史与……价值。
dialogText.en: I actually came here to look for special records — the history and ... true value of the Aburrey Quarry that survived the years.

dialogText.cn: 找到了，也没找到。
dialogText.en: Yes, and no.

dialogText.cn: 我确实找到了一段属于过去的“历史”，但里面并没有藏着我想要的“价值”……
dialogText.en: I found a piece of "history" that belongs to the past but it lacks the "value" I seek...

dialogText.cn: 真敏锐啊。
dialogText.en: You have keen senses.

dialogText.cn: 没错，我确实是希望通过这些资料来挖掘一点用得上的东西……毕竟“办法总比困难多”，我之前还想着说不准可以借此想出点厉害的方案，让采石场有新的出路。
dialogText.en: You're right, Endmin. I hoped my search could reveal something useful because ... there's always a solution to a problem. I might come up with a working alternative for the future of the Quarry.

dialogText.cn: 结果没想到我失败了，也没想到会发生这种意外……或许我是缺了点“逆天改命”的运气吧。
dialogText.en: But I failed. Nobody expected the disaster to hit us so badly... Perhaps I lacked the fortune and luck for changing fate itself.

dialogText.cn: 已经有人“转运”成功了。
dialogText.en: Luck is already turning around for some people here.

dialogText.cn: 你说不定就是下一个呢。
dialogText.en: You might be the next lucky soul.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你的“吉言”，我也希望如此。
dialogText.en: Thank you for your kind words. Let's hope that happens.

dialogText.cn: 因为我每次回看自己的人生都会觉得——我好像总是会在关键时刻，缺上那么一点的运气呢。
dialogText.en: When I look back at my life, I can't help but feel that fate always dealt me a poor hand whenever I needed her help.

dialogText.cn: 呼，总算出来了！在里面待久了，总觉得这外头的空气都是香的……
dialogText.en: Phew! Finally got ourselves out of the underground! All that tunnel crawling really makes you appreciate the fresh air out in the open...

dialogText.cn: 原来这地方离拉蒙那儿这么近？我们之前兜了好大一圈啊……
dialogText.en: Wow. That place is actually pretty close to Ramon. We really took the *long* way around...

actorName.cn: 被救的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员A}
actorName.en: Rescued UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew A}

dialogText.cn: 喂！喂！
dialogText.en: Hey! We're back!

actorName.cn: 被救的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员B}
actorName.en: Rescued UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew B}

dialogText.cn: 喂！喂！
dialogText.en: We're back! We're alive!

actorName.cn: 被救的工团成员{sm1|3-工团成员C}
actorName.en: Rescued UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew C}

dialogText.cn: 呜呜……
dialogText.en: *Hik, hik*

dialogText.cn: 真好啊！不枉我们费了这么老大的劲……
dialogText.en: I think this ended really well! A just reward for all the stuff we did...!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，听说你们已经把深层管理区的工友们解救上来了？太好了！我在这里等你们回来！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I heard that you've rescued the entire crew from the Deep Management Post! This is incredible news! I'll be waiting for you at my usual place!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们回来了！深层管理区的工友们能得救真是多亏了你们！
dialogText.en: Endmin! You're back! You really saved the lives of our crew in the Deep Management Post!

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，应该的！这种时候我们能帮上忙就好！你说对吧，管理员？
dialogText.en: Heheh! It's what we Endfielders do! I'm just glad we were able to help! Right, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 总之是你们的功劳，就别推辞了！大家都想好好谢谢你们呢！
dialogText.en: None of this would have happened without you! Please give us an opportunity to thank you properly!

actorName.cn: 热情的工团成员{获救的工团成员A}
actorName.en: Helpful UWST Crew Mate {Rescued UWST Crew Mate A}

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，终末地的朋友！
dialogText.en: Thank you, friends from Endfield!

actorName.cn: 欣慰的工团成员{获救的工团成员B}
actorName.en: Thankful UWST Crew Mate {Rescued UWST Crew Mate B}

dialogText.cn: 太感谢了……要不是你们把起重机修好了，我们都不知道得等到什么时候……
dialogText.en: Thank you so much... If you hadn't fixed the super crane, I don't know how long we'd have to wait...

actorName.cn: 激动的工团成员{获救的工团成员C}
actorName.en: Excited UWST Crew Mate {sm1|3-UWST Crew C}

dialogText.cn: 是啊！我本来连遗书都快写好了……没想到还能得救……简直像做梦一样……
dialogText.en: Yeah! I even wrote my will... Getting rescued and seeing the sun again almost felt like a dream...

dialogText.cn: 好了好了，心意到了就行了！你们也快回去收拾东西吧，搬迁的计划已经提上日程了。
dialogText.en: Alright, that ... that's enough thanking for now, crew! We still have to pack our belongings. Our redeployment plan is already back on schedule.

dialogText.cn: 我也得把剩余的工作安排下去，我们有空再聊。
dialogText.en: I guess I'll talk to you later. I need to assign a few jobs to the crew.

dialogText.cn: 那不是米菈她们吗？管理员，你要不要去看看？
dialogText.en: Isn't that Mila, Penny, and Phyllis? Endmin, maybe we should talk to them.

dialogText.cn: 师傅！菲莉丝！呜……你、你们没事真是太好了！！我、我好担心再也见不到你们了……
dialogText.en: Penny! Phyllis! Oh... I'm ... I'm so happy to see you in one piece!! I thought ... I thought I'd never see you again...

dialogText.cn: 我也很担心你和……佩妮女士，总之，没事就好。
dialogText.en: I was also really worried about you and ... Madam Penny... I'm just glad everyone's alright.

dialogText.cn: 哼……菲莉丝，我教过你吧？不要总勉强自己说一些言不由衷的话，一旦被听的人察觉了，那说的人就会成为一个笑话。
dialogText.en: Hmph... Phyllis, I thought I told you to talk straight. Dress your words poorly and the listener is bound to hear something, girl. Stop making an awkward clown of yourself.

dialogText.cn: 我当然记得，但我不觉得我的话里有什么言不由衷的地方，顶多是在对您的称呼上……稍微表达了一点我身为您弟子的不满罢了。
dialogText.en: I've kept your lessons to heart, Madam. If I've dressed up my words, know that it is solely a matter of honorifics and intended for respect... As well as a dash of displeasure for being your unfortunate apprentice.

dialogText.cn: 菲莉丝……师傅……别、别吵架啊……
dialogText.en: Kyaa... Phyllis... Penny... Please ... please stop fighting...

dialogText.cn: 吵架？我可不会和连情绪都藏不好的小鬼吵架。
dialogText.en: Fighting? Don't you worry, darling. I don't argue with little brats who can't keep their feelings in check.

dialogText.cn: 是吗？如果我有什么难以藏好的情绪，那也只是因为我不明白……有人明明只要再做点什么，就能解决问题。
dialogText.en: Oh, how true. Those unchecked feelings are grounded in confusion... Someone obviously could have done just a little more and solved this problem entirely.

dialogText.cn: 可她偏偏不去做，或者说不愿意去做。
dialogText.en: But no... She didn't do her part. Perhaps she chose not to.

dialogText.cn: 呵。
dialogText.en: Hmph.

dialogText.cn: 菲莉丝……你、你在说什么……我、我怎么听不懂……
dialogText.en: Phyllis... Are ... are you talking about someone I know...? I ... I don't understand...

dialogText.cn: 没什么，有的人听得懂就好。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Mila. That someone will figure it out.

dialogText.cn: 我、我也不知道……管理员，原、原来你也没懂啊……
dialogText.en: I ... I really don't know, Endmin... I guess ... I guess you find this all very confusing as well...

dialogText.cn: 咳、咳咳，管、管理员！你说，这、这次是不是多亏那架起重机？
dialogText.en: Ah ... ahem...! End ... Endmin! Luckily for us that ... that super crane still works, right?

dialogText.cn: 我听说……它、它老早前就在这里了！比、比我出生的时间还早呢！
dialogText.en: I heard that ... that it's been here for a while! It's ... it's even older than me!

dialogText.cn: 对吧！那、那些叔叔阿姨都说，当、当初要是没有它，不、不少工作都会被耽误的！它、它真的帮了采石场的大家好多好多忙，就、就像这次一样……
dialogText.en: That's right! The veteran crew always said how the super crane ... kept us all on schedule! It's ... it's the one that did all the heavy lifting... Just like this time...

dialogText.cn: 呜，我、我真的很舍不得它……
dialogText.en: Hngh... I ... I think I'll really miss it...

dialogText.cn: 所、所以想要好好地……和它告别。
dialogText.en: This is why we ... we really need to say goodbye to it ... properly...

dialogText.cn: 不、不可以哭，也不可以……吵架！你、你们说……对不对？
dialogText.en: And that means no ... no crying... And no fighting! Come on, people...! Just ... just get along!

dialogText.cn: 毕、毕竟……以后就……再也见不到它了吧……
dialogText.en: Because ... because we might ... we might never see it again...

dialogText.cn: 啊？什么再也见不到它了？佩妮女士没和你们说吗？这架起重机本来就是要跟着我们一起去K0327采石场的，现在它又被这位终末地的管理员修复了，那就更没道理留在这儿了……
dialogText.en: Huh?! Never see what again? Didn't Penny tell you? We're moving the super crane to Quarry K0327. The Endmin of Endfield Industries fixed it, so there's no way we're gonna leave it here...

dialogText.cn: 跟着我们一起？
dialogText.en: It's coming with us?

dialogText.cn: 去K0327采石场？
dialogText.en: We're going to Quarry K0327?

dialogText.cn: 也没人问我这个老太太啊？
dialogText.en: Well, these little girls never bothered asking this old lady.

dialogText.cn: 不是吧……那佩妮女士，你也没和她们说你帮大家争取更好的待遇外加申请将包括起重机在内的很多设备一起打包带走的事咯？
dialogText.en: Come on, Penny! You should have! Well, at least you told them about that fat raise you negotiated for the entire crew... Oh, we also get to keep our entire fleet of heavy machinery and take them with us... Erm, you did tell them, right?

dialogText.cn: ……没说。
dialogText.en: ...I didn't.

dialogText.cn: 怎、怎么了？这些又不是什么多重要的事，不说也没什么问题吧？
dialogText.en: Come on, darlings. No one's losing an arm or a leg if they didn't get informed about this. Things will be fine.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，而且问题很大。
dialogText.en: Indeed. None of this is fine.

dialogText.cn: 那你们想怎么样？我先说好，我可不会道什么歉的……本来就是你们俩自己想太多——
dialogText.en: Oh my heart. Fine, but you won't get an apology out of this old lady... You girls are always overthinking things and this is just another prime example of that nonsense—

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，师傅！
dialogText.en: Thank you, Penny!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，师傅！
dialogText.en: Thank you, Penny!

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员，你、你找我？
dialogText.en: End ... Endmin? You ... you looking for me?

dialogText.cn: 还、还是有种……做梦的感觉……
dialogText.en: Ye ... yeah. I ... uhm ... it felt ... felt like being in a dream...

dialogText.cn: 虽、虽然很高兴……但又有种……空、空落落的心情……
dialogText.en: I ... I'm really happy ... but I also feel ... feel kinda empty inside...

dialogText.cn: 不、不过不管怎样！我——米菈会努力的！
dialogText.en: I ... I don't care what happens but ... I ... I will put more effort into it!

dialogText.cn: 就算去了新的采石场！也要做一名称职的材料员！
dialogText.en: I'll ... I'll be a good ... good material inspector at the new ... new quarry!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？怎么了？还有事找我吗？
dialogText.en: What is it, Endmin? Need me for something?

dialogText.cn: 还好，也释怀了。
dialogText.en: I'm alright. Some things just had to be said.

dialogText.cn: 没办法，谁让我的师傅是个虽然特别别扭但也特别好的人呢。
dialogText.en: I guess it can't be helped. My mentor has a cranky temper but she's also really nice.

dialogText.cn: 就算去了新的采石场，这点也不会变。
dialogText.en: She's probably going to stay the same after we go to the new quarry.

dialogText.cn: 所以我也会继续努力的，继续努力习惯这一切，以及伸手握紧这点好不容易才抓到的……运气。
dialogText.en: I'll just work on myself and do my best to live with it. And yes, luck has indeed turned around for me ... so I'll try to make the best of things.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的管理员？怎么？想来找我这个老太太闲聊吗？
dialogText.en: Endministrator of Endfield Industries. What is it? You want a few words with a mean, old lady?

dialogText.cn: 这孩子曾经让我很担心。她的父母走得太早也太突然……才让她从小就落了说话不连贯的毛病。
dialogText.en: Poor little Mila lost her parents in accident when she was really young... That terrible thing gave her a bad stutter that she couldn't fix.

dialogText.cn: 好在她勤奋、认真，对石材的数据收集也充满热情，所以我把我过去积累的工作经验都教给了她，她也确实都把这些化作了自己成长的养分。
dialogText.en: Fortunately, Mila is hardworking, committed, and enjoys collecting data about rocks. This is why I taught her everything I know. The baby girl sucked all the lessons up like a sponge, she did.

dialogText.cn: 希望之后她也能一直保持这样纯粹的心态去投入属于她的事业。
dialogText.en: I hope she can maintain her professional dedication and take up a career that she loves.

dialogText.cn: 那样我之后……对她父母也能有一个交代。
dialogText.en: At least that way ... I can face her parents with a little peace of mind when I kick the bucket.

dialogText.cn: 她总是让我很头疼。如果说米菈是父母教给她的东西太少，那菲莉丝就是父母教给她的东西太多了……
dialogText.en: Phyllis? Hmph. Sweet little Mila was held back because her parents left too soon. But Phyllis ... she became what she is because she learned too much from hers.

dialogText.cn: 即使我想隐瞒，你也应该看得出来，她的出身……和工团的大多数人都很不一样，有些刻在骨子里的东西，不是她想抹去就能轻易抹去的。
dialogText.en: I wanted to keep it from you, but you probably already noticed. She wasn't raised by your typical family of frontiers crew... Certain things in the blood won't come off, even if you're wearing the UWST outfit.

dialogText.cn: 我一度以为，她会在成年之前就被不知道哪里冒出来的环带人接去某个远离开拓区的大城市。没想到她一直都那么坚持，坚持留在这儿，坚持丢掉那个姓氏，坚持做一个普普通通的采石场设备科负责人……
dialogText.en: I thought her rich Bander relative would eventually take her away and settle her in some fancy Bander penthouse away from the frontiers. But the girl refused and stayed. The fool of a brat even changed her fancy family name and insisted on working as the Quarry Hardware Division Manager...

dialogText.cn: 我既希望她能快速成长起来，好去面对一些不知何时会降临的暴风雨……又害怕她成长得太快，没法像同龄人一样感受一些人生中更该被记住的快乐与欢欣。
dialogText.en: Part of me wanted the little girl to be strong and ready to face blightshowers that may show up any minute... But that would deny her the happy childhood that everyone should have in their memories.

dialogText.cn: 万幸的是，她一直很有自己的想法与主见，知道自己在做什么，也知道自己该做什么……
dialogText.en: Fortunately, Phyllis grew up with a mind of her own. She knows what she wants and what she should be doing...

dialogText.cn: 某天，当我意外得知，原来她早就拒绝了某个包裹无数糖衣的危险邀请，才猛然发现——啊，原来这孩子确实已经不再需要我为她操心了……
dialogText.en: Then one day I accidentally saw that she had rejected plenty of sugar-coated invitations far more dangerous than a blighted cave of buggers. I realized that the girl has grown her wings and no longer needs my protection...

dialogText.cn: 是希望，是不会只局限在一座采石场的、属于工团未来的希望。
dialogText.en: They are beacons of hope. Hope that goes far beyond a simple quarry, one that is large enough for the future of the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 所以我其实并不想太多干涉她们的想法，不想她们被我的观念束缚住，更希望她们在不断地思考与取舍中，总结出她们自己的东西……
dialogText.en: I try not to interfere with the girls or give them too much of my old, cranky ideas. I want to see them trying out new things and coming up with brand new solutions of their own...

dialogText.cn: 我们那代人有我们需要解决的问题，自然就有一套我们为此想出来的办法。
dialogText.en: My generation faced challenges unique to our time. Naturally, we came up with our own way to work things out.

dialogText.cn: 而她们这代人有她们需要解决的问题，那么当然也需要她们为此去想出来一套只属于她们，也只有她们能用的办法。
dialogText.en: The new generation will be facing new problems. The girls must come up with their own strategies... Strategies that they themselves could use.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，反正“办法总比困难多”嘛！我相信她们能够做到，就像我一直相信我那个“老伙计”总有一天会睡醒。
dialogText.en: Hah. There's always a solution to every problem and I have faith in my girls, just as I always had faith that my old partner's never-ending hibernation would end.

dialogText.cn: 哦对，所以果然还是该向你补上一句感谢吧？
dialogText.en: Before I forget, I believe this old lady owes you a word of gratitude.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，终末地的管理员，你这次真的是帮了我们每个人一个大忙啊。
dialogText.en: Thank you for what you did for us, Endministrator of Endfield Industries. You did everyone here a big favor.

dialogText.cn: 而我……我们，都是不会忘记的。
dialogText.en: And I ... We will not forget

dialogText.cn: ——无论是今天，还是你。
dialogText.en: —We shall remember everything that happened today, and you as well.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我这边关于搬迁的安排也总算告一段落，接下来就是后续的工作交接了……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'm mostly done arranging our redeployment. My next job is to oversee the handover and transfer...

dialogText.cn: 虽然还是没法为你们开专门的庆祝会，但谢礼已经都准备好了！希望你们能收下——这是我们采石场所有人的一点心意。
dialogText.en: We really should have given you Endfielders a special party for helping us out, but I guess we have to settle for these tokens of our appreciation! Please accept these gifts, Endmin! They come from everyone of the Quarry crew.

dialogText.cn: 但愿未来我们还能在别处再会！终末地的朋友们！
dialogText.en: I really hope to see you again in the future, my friends from Endfield!

actorName.cn: 愤怒的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-愤怒的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 搞什么鬼啊？我要是能当记者，至于混得这么辛苦吗……我好不容易拍个展示照都要被删！气死我了！
dialogText.en: Are you serious!? If I were an actual journalist, would I be muckin' about for grub in these parts...? Oh ... my beautiful photos... Those stupid woosters murdered them!

dialogText.cn: 这么听着，似乎不是这位拍展示照的……男士？
dialogText.en: Hmm. I'm afraid our businessman taking display photos ... isn't the journalist we're looking for.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你确定要抓他吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, you sure you want to arrest him?

actorName.cn: 愤怒的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-愤怒的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 都说了我不是了！我既不是女人也不是什么记者！
dialogText.en: I thought I said I'm not the Bander sneak! I'm not a woman and I'm not a journalist!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，真的抓错人了啊……
dialogText.en: Ooopsie daisy. We got the wrong person...

actorName.cn: 好奇的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-好奇的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 我就是借文森特的眼镜玩了一下啊！又没干什么坏事……
dialogText.en: Hey! What did I do? I'm just playing around with Vincent's glasses...

dialogText.cn: 小姑娘，随便拿别人的东西玩闹，可不是什么值得鼓励的行为喔。
dialogText.en: Don't play with things that aren't yours, young lady. It's something I tend to frown upon.

actorName.cn: 好奇的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-好奇的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 我只是借来玩一下，又不是不还了……呜呜呜……
dialogText.en: But I was having fun with it ... and I was gonna give it back ... *hik, hik*...

dialogText.cn: 唔，看来是抓错人了呢……
dialogText.en: Oh dear. We got the wrong person...

actorName.cn: 不安的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-不安的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 你、你们是谁？凯文的朋友吗？是不是他让你们来接我的？
dialogText.en: Who are you? Friends of Kevin? Did he ask you to take me to our secret place?

dialogText.cn: 好吧，女士，先说明一下，我们并不认识什么凯文。
dialogText.en: Alright, lady. Just gonna lay it out for you. We don't know anyone named Kevin.

actorName.cn: 不安的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-不安的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 凯文你到底在哪里……我们不是说好了今天私奔的吗……
dialogText.en: Oh, where are you, Kevin...? You promised to take me with you today...

dialogText.cn: 我感觉，应该是抓错人了吧……
dialogText.en: I have a feeling we grabbed the wrong person...

actorName.cn: 自负的菲林女性{拉奎尔}

dialogText.cn: 你们是？我正在记这两天的账单……这些就是，你们要看看吗？
dialogText.en: Huh? Who are you? Look. I'm just noting down my receipts for the last couple of days... Wanna see?

dialogText.cn: 这位女士，你似乎对我们的到来早有准备？
dialogText.en: Well, well, well, lassie. You seem rather prepared for our arrival.

dialogText.cn: 还有就是……无意冒犯，但你确实是我见过的第一个拿终端而非纸笔记账的难民……
dialogText.en: Just one thing ... and I hope I'm not offending anyone. I've never seen a refugee taking notes with a handyterm instead of plain old pen and paper...
Darn it! You...!

dialogText.cn: 女士，这种时候你才想起来逃，多少有点太迟了吧？
dialogText.en: Well, too late to run now, lady.

dialogText.cn: 那个……我警告你们啊，我可是环塔商会《文明时报》的王牌记者，在业内很有名气的！要是我在这里出了什么事，我的保险公司不会放过你们的！
dialogText.en: I ... I'm warning you! I'm the ace correspondent of Civilization Times! I work for the TGCC! If anything were to happen to me, my insurance company would definitely make you pay!

dialogText.cn: 《文明时报》的王牌记者？
dialogText.en: The ace correspondent of Civilization Times?

dialogText.cn: 对、对啊！之前有篇报道，曝光了崔斯特公司私下不遵守商会经营管理条例的事——那就是我写的！
dialogText.en: Ye-YEAH! Remember the article that exposed Triste! They secretly violated the TGCC Practice of Business Management! I wrote that!

dialogText.cn: 是吗？我怎么记得那篇文章的撰稿人不叫“拉奎尔·琼斯”呢？
dialogText.en: Oh, you did? The correspondent for that exclusive wasn't Raquel Jones, I fear.
You!

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？难道琼斯女士想说……你不叫这个名字？
dialogText.en: Why so angry, Miss Jones? Or are you trying to say that ... you're someone else?

dialogText.cn: 你怎么会知道……
dialogText.en: How ... how did you know...?

dialogText.cn: 只是恰好从你的随身物品里看到了那支道格拉斯的定制钢笔，又恰好，知道他们的工匠总习惯在笔尖刻上定制人的姓名罢了。
dialogText.en: Well, I just saw that bespoke pen of yours. Douglas, right? Very choice. Meticulously crafted by master artisans. They typically engrave the tip with the name of their customer.

dialogText.cn: 当然啦，我也想过说不准这支笔不是你定制的，所以小小地诈了你一下。
dialogText.en: Of course, I wasn't sure if you could actually afford a bespoke Douglas. So, I decided to play a little trick instead.

dialogText.cn: 只是没想到琼斯女士这么轻易就坦白了呢。
dialogText.en: And you bit the bait like a hungry little fin, Miss Jones. It went easier than I expected.
...Hmph!

dialogText.cn: 走吧，琼斯女士，配合一点对你我都没坏处的。
dialogText.en: Alright, Raquel. Now, now, be a nice girl and behave. That will be best for both of us.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，联系一下柯林斯女士吧，就说“已控制住目标，稍后会合”。
dialogText.en: Endmin, be a darling and call Miss Collins for me. Tell her that we've "apprehended the VIP and will rendezvous with her".

dialogText.cn: 辛苦你们了，管理员。
dialogText.en: We really appreciate this, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 所以琼斯女士，你接受我们刚刚路上说的“即刻离开四号谷地”的方案吗？
dialogText.en: So, Miss Jones. We had a nice little convo along the way. Do we have a "yes" for you leaving Valley IV immediately?

dialogText.cn: 当然不接受！我的新报道还需要更多第一手资料！你们这些根本不懂纪实新闻价值的愚人！
dialogText.en: NO! NEVER! I need more first-hand information for my article! You guys don't know anything! You never appreciate the value of documentary journalism!

dialogText.cn: 嘁，你这几天干扰了那么多工友干活，我们还没找你算账呢！
dialogText.en: Tsk, cut the nonsense, blight-head. You've been a royal pain for our crew for days. We should have made you pay for that!

dialogText.cn: 那只是正常的采访流程！我有这个自由！
dialogText.en: I only followed the standard journalistic process! I have the right to request and conduct interviews with anyone!

dialogText.cn: 那按照商会的规矩，我们也有找你索赔的自由。
dialogText.en: Well, according to TGCC rules, we can also hold you liable for all those delays you caused.

dialogText.cn: 柯林斯女士，别着急嘛，让我们再和她沟通一下！
dialogText.en: Come now, Miss Collins. With your permission, we can try talking to her and see if we can work something out!

dialogText.cn: 好吧，那你们再和她说说？在你们决定怎么送走她之前，我们应该还能帮忙看顾她两天……但再久就不一定有那个人手了。
dialogText.en: Sure. Hope you can get through to her. Before you decide how to boot her out of our turf, we can put a roof over her head for a couple of days... But after that, I won't have anyone else to spare.

dialogText.cn: 我们现在时不时就会接到四号谷地其他区域的求助通信。刚刚没法和你们会合，也是因为临时去附近给工友帮了个忙……实在忙不过来了。
dialogText.en: We're receiving plenty of distress calls from other sites in Valley IV. I couldn't meet with you back then because I was getting a fellow crew mate out of a sticky sitch... We're really stretched thin.

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样……我明白了。那么琼斯女士，我们来多聊两句吧。
dialogText.en: Is that so...? I totally understand. Well then, Miss Jones, I hope you're up for a little chat.

dialogText.cn: 你、你可不要危言耸听……骗骗普通人就算了，我大学可是新闻学专业的！
dialogText.en: You ... you're just trying to scare me... Your tricks might work on common people, but I majored in journalism in college!

dialogText.cn: 况且，这里和工团其他的生产基地也没差多少吧？有什么危险的……
dialogText.en: And I don't see any difference between the Valley and other wooster factory sites. What's so dangerous about this place...?

dialogText.cn: 总而言之，在我拍到足够拿来写报道的素材前，我是不会离开这里的！
dialogText.en: In any case, I'll only leave here once I have enough material for my article!

dialogText.cn: 啧，你这记者还真是一点都不把自己的安全当回事……
dialogText.en: Tsk. You journalists really don't care about your own safety, do you...

dialogText.cn: 看来暂时是达成不了共识了呢，管理员。
dialogText.en: I'm afraid a healthy consensus is just out of reach, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 不过琼斯女士，我还在开拓区当信使的时候，一直觉得有句谚语很有道理呢——
dialogText.en: Miss Jones, may I share a piece of wisdom with you? It made a lot of sense when I was doing messenger work here in the frontier.

dialogText.cn: “多个朋友多条路。”
dialogText.en: "Make a friend and you pave a road."

dialogText.cn: 这是我的名片，如果你改变主意了，随时可以跟我联系的。
dialogText.en: Here's my card, darling. If you change your mind and decide to leave, give me a call. Any time.

dialogText.cn: 那我就先把她带回哨站了。回见，终末地的朋友。
dialogText.en: Well. I guess I'm taking this Bander princess back to the sentry post. Have a nice one, Endfielders.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，回见。
dialogText.en: Of course, Aleeza. Catchya later.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我打算问问在环塔商会认识的记者朋友，看看他们有什么办法说服这位琼斯女士。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let me ask my TGCC journalist friends. I'll see if they can convince Miss Jones to return to the Band.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，那就先这样吧。
dialogText.en: Alright, then. Let's wrap things up for now.

dialogText.cn: 等我这边有消息了，我再联系你哦，管理员。
dialogText.en: I'll give you a call once I've got news for you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……你是说有人看见她在附近？
dialogText.en: ...Oh, you mean someone saw her nearby?

dialogText.cn: 是的，毕竟一般人也不会拿着终端在那边拍来拍去……不过那个记者很狡猾，每次都被她跑掉了……
dialogText.en: Yeah. Nobody else would be running all over the place and taking photos with their handyterms... But that paparazza is a slippery one. She managed to get away every time...

dialogText.cn: 看来她果然是个麻烦人物……
dialogText.en: This one sounds like a royal pain in the butt...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您来了！其实我前面说的“意外状况”，指的是一位疑似来自环塔商会的记者女士……
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here! Yeah, we got a suspicious journalist, probably came from the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce. She's the "unexpected sitch" I mentioned...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您来得正好，我们刚好就在聊这个“意外状况”的源头——一位疑似来自环塔商会的记者。
dialogText.en: Endmin! You came at the right time! We were talking about the cause of our unexpected sitch — some journalist who probably came from the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce.

dialogText.cn: 这两天我们经常接到工友发来的消息，说有个自称是环塔商会记者的怪女人在附近出没。
dialogText.en: During the last couple of days, the crew have been telling us about a strange woman showing up nearby. She claims to be a TGCC journalist.

dialogText.cn: 她偷偷摸摸地拍了一大堆涉及保密内容的照片，还常问工友一些莫名其妙的问题……
dialogText.en: The Bander sneak took photos of confidential stuff. Then she kept pestering our crew with a lot of weird questions.

dialogText.cn: 有时候她还不听劝地跑到一些危险区域，让周围的工友不得不放下手上的工作，把她移送到安全的地方。
dialogText.en: She even ignored our warning signs and ran into hazardous areas. Our crew had to stop their work just to get her out.

dialogText.cn: 总之，是给大家添了一大堆麻烦。
dialogText.en: Let's just say she's a real nasty piece of work.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这场侵蚀灾害发生后，我们的人手就一直都不太够。
dialogText.en: Yeah, well, we've been stretched thin ever since that Blight disaster.

dialogText.cn: 现在大家只是想尽快完成重建工作，争取早日恢复往日的生活，根本没有精力去顾及这位记者女士。
dialogText.en: We're all busy trying to rebuild and get on with our lives. Nobody's got time for that Bander journalist.

dialogText.cn: 没错……您肯定也注意到了，我们最近的人手全都放在了灾后重建上，压根顾不上这位喜欢乱窜的记者女士。
dialogText.en: Yeah, you've probably noticed this too... Most of the crew are busy with post-disaster relief and rebuilding. No one has the time to keep an eye on a slippery journalist.

dialogText.cn: 但问题在于她是环塔商会的人……
dialogText.en: But she's from the TGCC. That makes things tricky...

dialogText.cn: 如果这名记者在我们这儿闹出了什么风波，回头恐怕会有更麻烦的问题。
dialogText.en: If anything happens to the journalist on UW turf, we'll be in for some major league Cartel-directed blightshow.

dialogText.cn: 所以我们考虑了半天，还是想委托终末地帮忙——你们过去也调解过不少类似的纠纷，更适合跟她交涉，之后再把人送离四号谷地就好。
dialogText.en: So, after *much* consideration, we'd like to ask for Endfield's assistance. You've handled disputes like this before, which makes you skilled mediators. Perhaps you could help us speak with her — and, if possible, send her away from Valley IV?

dialogText.cn: 那名记者藏身在<@qu.key>难民暂居处</>，艾莱扎已经过去查看情况了，我等下就把坐标发给您。
dialogText.en: That journalist is hiding in the <@qu.key>refugee camp</>. Aleeza went ahead to check the sitch. I'll send you the coordinates stat.

dialogText.cn: 哦对，差点忘了提醒您！听工友说，那个记者非常擅长伪装！
dialogText.en: Oh, before I forget! The crew also told me something really important. She's a master of disguise!

dialogText.cn: 所以，您最好多带点人过去，以防万一。
dialogText.en: I strongly recommend bringing a team of specialists with you, just in case.

dialogText.cn: 你好呀，管理员，总算等到你了。
dialogText.en: Greetings, Endministrator. You're finally here.

actorName.cn: 信使装扮的卡特斯女性{艾维文娜}

dialogText.cn: 嗯？很意外吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm. You look rather surprised.

actorName.cn: 信使装扮的卡特斯女性{艾维文娜}

dialogText.cn: 难道佩丽卡监督没有告诉你——来的人是我吗？
dialogText.en: Perhaps Supervisor Perlica neglected to mention that ... *I* was the one assigned to assist you?

dialogText.cn: 嗯哼，我上一个任务刚好是在谷地这边结束的，所以也收到了佩丽卡监督的干员召集消息。
dialogText.en: Mmhmm. I just completed my last assignment at the Valley. That's why I received the Supervisor's assembly call for the operators.

dialogText.cn: 本来她不打算把这个活派给我的，毕竟我的排班都已经快排到明年了。
dialogText.en: She was actually quite hesitant about giving the job to me, since my schedule for the entire year seems rather packed.

dialogText.cn: 只是我一听说能和管理员搭档……就主动申请了哦。
dialogText.en: Then I heard that you get to partner up with the Endmin for this mission ... so I volunteered and nabbed the post.

dialogText.cn: 别这么客气啦，不如先想想等任务结束了……再补偿我点什么？
dialogText.en: Oh, there's no need for such politeness. Just think about the ultimate success of this mission ... and what you should compensate me with.

dialogText.cn: 好啦，不逗你了，管理员。
dialogText.en: Okay then, I'll stop teasing you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 还是工作优先——所以那位柯林斯女士呢？不是约好了在这边会合吗？
dialogText.en: Let's focus on the task at hand — I wonder where Miss Collins went. I thought she agreed to meet us here.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，那就再等一会儿好了。
dialogText.en: Sure. I guess we'll wait.

dialogText.cn: 虽然根据我的经验，这种情况往往都是与“意外”相伴的呢……
dialogText.en: From my experience, an unexpected accident is usually the reason why people are running late...

dialogText.cn: 怎么了，管理员？有什么问题都可以问我哦。这种时候，就多依赖我一点吧！
dialogText.en: Got anything in mind, Endmin? Feel free to ask your trusty assistant. It's okay to count on me a little more, you know.

dialogText.cn: 我怎么看？这个嘛，里面有用的信息还是有一些的。
dialogText.en: What do I think? Well, some of the things in the reports might be helpful.

dialogText.cn: 首先可以确定的是，这是位女性，种族大概率就是菲林——这部分伪装起来可没那么容易哦。
dialogText.en: First, I'm pretty certain we're looking for a Feline lady. It's pretty hard to disguise yourself as that.

dialogText.cn: 其次呢，她很可能视力不佳，嗯，应该是戴了眼镜的——虽然环塔商会这几年流行过所谓的隐形眼镜，但根据证词，以她的度数恐怕是戴不了的。
dialogText.en: Second, our Feline lady may have poor eyesight and need some pretty thick glasses. Sure, contact lenses are getting more popular in the TGCC, but witness reports from the crew suggest otherwise. Her myopia is too severe for those.

dialogText.cn: 至于长发还是短发，这可不好说，也许她戴了假发？也许她把长发盘在帽子里了？
dialogText.en: The length of her hair is uncertain. She could disguise that with wigs or hide her long hair beneath a hat.

dialogText.cn: 而帽子、挎包这些装束上的东西，其实都不能确定，因为她随时可以换一身打扮。
dialogText.en: As for descriptions of her headwear, handbags, and other clothing articles, take them with a pinch of salt as they can be easily replaced.

dialogText.cn: 当然，她再怎么换装，看起来肯定都挺低调的。敢在这种受灾地带乱跑的人，心理素质肯定不差啦。
dialogText.en: Of course, our rogue journalist is probably using a disguise that lets her blend into the crowd. She made her way to a disaster site, so I guess she's mentally prepared for all sorts of things.

actorName.cn: 愤怒的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-愤怒的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 气死我了！工团那些家伙怎么回事……
dialogText.en: Blighted idiots! Friggin' U-double-U dimwits are acting all crazy...

actorName.cn: 愤怒的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-愤怒的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 这也要管，那也要管……居然还把我拍的照片全给删了！一张都没留！
dialogText.en: These woosters are poking their noses in everything... They even deleted all the photos I took! Every last one of 'em!

actorName.cn: 愤怒的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-愤怒的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 本来明天就能出摊了！现在又要重拍一次！
dialogText.en: I was about to get them printed for the shop! Now I'll have to take the photos again!

actorName.cn: 路过的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-路过的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 消消气，消消气，他们一向是这样嘛。洛伦特，你又不是第一天和他们打交道了。
dialogText.en: Take a deep breath, Laurent. This isn't your first day dealing with them woosters. You should've known better.

actorName.cn: 愤怒的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-愤怒的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 那也没必要这样吧？我就是给自己新做的裙子找个风景好点的地方拍些展示照片啊？有什么错！
dialogText.en: Is this really necessary, huh? They're just photos of scenery! I need scenic backdrops to help sell the new skirts I've made! Is that a crime?!

actorName.cn: 愤怒的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-愤怒的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 谁知道附近有他们不允许拍摄的实验室啊……再说了，我的照片里也没拍到什么啊！
dialogText.en: How am I supposed to know if the woosters got some secret lab hidden in the hills...? To the blight with them labs! My photos had none of those!

dialogText.cn: 因为拍照和工团的人起了矛盾……好像确实很可疑？
dialogText.en: This one got really upset with the UWST over some photographs... This does sound a little suspicious.

dialogText.cn: 但听这位女……啊不，先生的描述，似乎只是普通的小纠纷啊……
dialogText.en: According to the lady ... ahem... According to our man, the entire incident sounds like an ordinary dispute...

actorName.cn: 好奇的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-好奇的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 哇！居然变成这样了……
dialogText.en: Wow! Is this what the world looks like with these glasses on...?

actorName.cn: 好奇的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-好奇的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 太有意思了！
dialogText.en: It's so interesting!

actorName.cn: 怯弱的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-怯弱的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 薇薇安，该把眼镜还我了吧？
dialogText.en: Give me back my glasses, Vivian.

actorName.cn: 怯弱的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-怯弱的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 你又不近视，戴久了可没好处……
dialogText.en: Dere's nothing wrong with yer eyes. Wearing my glasses will hurt 'em...

actorName.cn: 好奇的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-好奇的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 再让我戴着玩一会儿嘛……就一会儿！
dialogText.en: Just let me wear them for a while longer, puh-lease?

actorName.cn: 怯弱的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-怯弱的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 好吧，那你再玩一会儿？我先去帮卡琳婶婶搬东西了。
dialogText.en: Fine. Have fun with 'em. I'm gonna help Aunt Carlyn move her stuff.

actorName.cn: 好奇的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-好奇的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 去吧去吧！对了！记得和妈妈说我在看书哦！
dialogText.en: Go and do your thing! Oh! Don't forget to tell mama that I'm reading!

actorName.cn: 怯弱的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-怯弱的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 知道了……
dialogText.en: Aye, aye ... whatever.

dialogText.cn: 这么东张西望还戴着眼镜……怎么看都很引人注目呢。
dialogText.en: That girl is attracting a great deal of attention ... gawking around with someone else's glasses.

dialogText.cn: 不过听她旁边那位小哥的说法，她的视力似乎是正常的？
dialogText.en: But according to that friend of hers, there's nothing wrong with her eyesight.

actorName.cn: 路过的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-路过的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 莉娜？
dialogText.en: Lina?

actorName.cn: 不安的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-不安的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 啊！什、什么事？！威尔叔叔……
dialogText.en: Wha? What is it, Uncle Wayle...?

actorName.cn: 路过的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-路过的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 你怎么一个人在这儿？迈克尔呢？
dialogText.en: Why are you here all by yourself? Where's your old man Michael?

actorName.cn: 不安的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-不安的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 呃……没、没什么……我就是在等个人……爸爸……爸爸在修那辆他新换的二手车呢……
dialogText.en: Erm... I'm ... I'm fine... I'm just ... just waiting for someone... And my papa's ... f-fixing that new second-hand car he got...

actorName.cn: 路过的菲林男性{sm1l5m1-路过的菲林男性}

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，等人等得这么紧张？好吧，替我向你爸爸问好。
dialogText.en: Hoho, getting all nervous waiting for someone? Well, say hi to your old man for me.

actorName.cn: 不安的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-不安的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 呼……吓死我了……还以为被爸爸发现了……
dialogText.en: Hoo... Almost had a heart attack... Thought papa was out here to get me...

actorName.cn: 不安的菲林女性{sm1l5m1-不安的菲林女性}

dialogText.cn: 凯文怎么还没来啊……不是说好在这边见的吗……
dialogText.en: Where's Kevin...? He promised to meet me here...

dialogText.cn: 她简直就像把“鬼祟可疑”四个字写在了脑门上呢……
dialogText.en: The girl has the word "sneak" written all over her face...

dialogText.cn: 当然，如果是那位来自环塔商会的记者女士，就算临时找了个人私奔……也不至于这么紧张吧？
dialogText.en: But a Bander journalist shouldn't look so panicked and scared ... even if she's eloping with someone she found off the streets.

actorName.cn: 自负的菲林女性{拉奎尔}

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这样就可以了……
dialogText.en: Hmm. That should be good enough...

actorName.cn: 自负的菲林女性{拉奎尔}

dialogText.cn: 不愧是我……
dialogText.en: Only I could have pulled this off...

actorName.cn: 自负的菲林女性{拉奎尔}

dialogText.cn: 再加一点点有趣的内容，配上这个主题……
dialogText.en: Now I'll just add some interesting anecdotes to support the general theme...

actorName.cn: 自负的菲林女性{拉奎尔}

dialogText.cn: 简直完美！
dialogText.en: Done! PERFECT!

actorName.cn: 自负的菲林女性{拉奎尔}

dialogText.cn: 拉奎尔啊拉奎尔，这个世界上怎么会有你这样的天才！
dialogText.en: O Raquel! You are a true genius! This world hardly deserves someone like you!

dialogText.cn: 好像没什么特别的。看她的动作，说不定只是在写日记，或者画画？
