dialogText.en: Looks like a passerby. She seems to be writing a diary entry, or is she drawing something?

dialogText.cn: 不过嘛，她的气质总让我觉得她和这里格格不入……
dialogText.en: But I sense something else. Her vibe feels really out of place compared to the locals...

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？管理员，现在所有的嫌疑人我们都观察过了……你有什么结论了吗？
dialogText.en: We've observed every suspect. What do you think, Endmin? Made up your mind yet?

dialogText.cn: 哦？那现在就去<@qu.key>指认</>吧！
dialogText.en: Oh? Alright then. Time to <@qu.key>nab the woosters' most wanted</>.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来得很及时呢。这里大部分该调查的地方，我都调查过了，情况已经比较明朗了……
dialogText.en: You arrived in good time, Endmin. I've looked around the suspect locations and have a good idea of what's going on...

dialogText.cn: 我猜，这位琼斯女士，应该是趁着看守人员换岗，从这里溜走了。
dialogText.en: I believe our Miss Jones escaped through here, while the guards were changing their shifts.

dialogText.cn: 你觉得呢，管理员？
dialogText.en: What do you think, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 所以，我们接下来要做的就是——
dialogText.en: So, for our next course of action...

dialogText.cn: 是啊，要是真让她跑远了，事情就有点麻烦了……
dialogText.en: Indeed. If she wanders off too far ... things might get complicated...

dialogText.cn: 不愧是管理员，这种时候也有心情开玩笑呢。
dialogText.en: Impressive, Endmin. You find things to joke about, even in moments like this.

dialogText.cn: 要是真能不管她，事情就好办多啦。
dialogText.en: Things would be so much easier if we could *afford* to ignore her.

dialogText.cn: 我现在只希望，她没扔掉我的名片……不然出事了，都没人能求救。
dialogText.en: I just hope she didn't throw away my business card... If she got into trouble, she wouldn't know who to call.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？是没见过的号码……
dialogText.en: Hmm? Incoming call from an *unknown* number...

dialogText.cn: 先接了再说。
dialogText.en: Let's see what the caller has to say.

dialogText.cn: 呼……暂时把人给稳住了呢。
dialogText.en: Hooo...! Managed to convince our little escape artist to stay put.

dialogText.cn: 没办法嘛，环塔商会一向是客户难缠钱难赚……我早就习惯了呢。
dialogText.en: Got used to it, I guess. The TGCC is full of stingy and nightmarish clients.

dialogText.cn: 不过，我可以保证一点哦——她绝对不是我见过的最麻烦的客户。
dialogText.en: But our dear little Miss Jones is definitely not the worst client I ever had. I can promise you that.

dialogText.cn: 没错，就是这里。那边的景色和照片上几乎一模一样……
dialogText.en: This is it. The place looks exactly like the photo Miss Jones sent us...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，先一起找找看吧。
dialogText.en: Let's look around, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 希望她只是累晕了……
dialogText.en: Hope the girl has just passed out from exhaustion...

dialogText.cn: 琼斯女士会把终端丢在这里只能说明一件事——
dialogText.en: There's only one reason why Miss Jones left her handyterm here...

dialogText.cn: 她不仅出事了，而且很有可能失去了意识。
dialogText.en: Bad people showed up and they probably knocked her unconscious.

dialogText.cn: 附近也没有新的血迹，只有一些怪异的脚印……
dialogText.en: There are strange footprints around the place, but no trace of blood...

dialogText.cn: 嗯哼，看来管理员你和我想的一样——
dialogText.en: Mmhmmm. Looks like we're on the same page, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 琼斯女士恐怕是被裂地者掳走了。
dialogText.en: Miss Jones got kidnapped by a band of Landbreakers.

dialogText.cn: 按照一般商业电影的套路，现在就该轮到我们两个“主角”来大展神威了吧？
dialogText.en: This is feeling like a frontier movie already. Time for the "two heroes" to give everyone a show.

dialogText.cn: 先想办法<@qu.key>追踪</>下这群裂地者的去向……但愿一切还来得及。
dialogText.en: We should <@qu.key>figure out</> where these Landbreakers went... And pray that we're fast enough.

dialogText.cn: 你、你们总算来了！我差点以为要死在这儿了……呜呜……
dialogText.en: You ... you finally made it! I thought I was gonna die here ... *hik, hik*...

dialogText.cn: 这些人居然也是裂地者……！太可怕了……跟我知道的那些裂地者完全不一样……根本不能沟通！
dialogText.en: I never knew those maniacs are Landbreakers...! They're so terrifying ... and nothing like the LBs I've met before... They couldn't be reasoned with!

dialogText.cn: 我之前还尝试逃过……结果还没跑多远就被他们抓回来了……
dialogText.en: I tried to escape ... but I barely got anywhere before they dragged me back here again...

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二这么大，容得下那些可以沟通的裂地者，自然也容得下这种沟通不了的裂地者。
dialogText.en: Talos-II is a big place. Since we have LBs who speak human, we'll also have LBs who refuse to speak human.

dialogText.cn: 不过，琼斯女士，这下你也算是收获了一点新素材？
dialogText.en: In any case, I believe this ordeal may have provided the new materials you need for your article, Miss Jones.

dialogText.cn: 新素材……
dialogText.en: New ... new material...?

dialogText.cn: 我是不是……有点说过头了？
dialogText.en: I hope I didn't ... go overboard with the things I said.

dialogText.cn: 那我还是表达一下歉意吧……
dialogText.en: Well then, allow me to express my sincere apologies...

dialogText.cn: 是吗？不过她毕竟被吓成那样了……我还是说两句安慰的话吧。
dialogText.en: Hard facts indeed. But our little journalist probably has a nasty case of PTSD... Maybe I should say something nice to make her feel better.

dialogText.cn: 想到了！就叫《四号谷地现状实录》！
dialogText.en: I got it! I'll call it the Valley IV Documented!

dialogText.cn: 就着重写这边的受灾情况好了……外加终末地的专业应对……嗯……再稍微提提这边复杂的地形，还有一群不讲道理的裂地者……
dialogText.en: I'll focus on the state of the disaster... and how Endfield professionals dealt with it... And embellish the story with descriptions of the complex local geography ... and the LBs who refuse to speak human...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢两位，不仅救了我，还给我提供了这么好的报道素材！
dialogText.en: Thank you both! You saved my life and even gave me interesting material for my article!

dialogText.cn: 之前……是我对四号谷地的危险性掉以轻心了……
dialogText.en: I ... I was a little oblivious to the dangers of Valley IV...

dialogText.cn: 给你们，和那几位工团的朋友都添了太多麻烦……真抱歉……
dialogText.en: I'm really sorry ... I must have given you and your UWST friends nothing but trouble...

dialogText.cn: 我们也只是做了该做的事，你能理解就好。
dialogText.en: We did what we had to, and I'm pleased to hear that we've arrived at an understanding.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，总之，我这就跟你们离开这里！
dialogText.en: We sure did! I'll be tagging along and heading back with you!

dialogText.cn: 这次我一定不乱跑了……
dialogText.en: And I promise I won't run off again...

dialogText.cn: 带你离开谷地的同事已经到了，琼斯女士，我们就送你到这里吧。
dialogText.en: Our colleagues have arrived to give you a ride out of the Valley, Miss Jones. This is where we go our separate ways.

dialogText.cn: 你的终端也已经修好了，虽然那些数据都损坏了——
dialogText.en: We fixed your handyterm as well. Unfortunately, we couldn't save all of the data.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢！真的不知道该怎么感谢你们了……
dialogText.en: Thank you so much! I don't really know how to repay your kindness...

dialogText.cn: 那不如之后多给我们终末地一点版面，怎么样？
dialogText.en: Hmm. How about a few good words and some positive publicity for Endfield?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈，这点不用你们说，我也会给的！
dialogText.en: Hahaha! That goes without saying! You don't even have to ask!

dialogText.cn: 毕竟……你们可是我这次报道的主角之一！肯定会给你们留很多篇幅的！
dialogText.en: And ... you'll be the heroes of my upcoming exclusive! I'll make sure you get pages worth of coverage!

dialogText.cn: 是吗？那我们可就提前期待了哦！
dialogText.en: Is that so? Well, we'll be looking forward to your story, Raquel.

dialogText.cn: 好了，任务圆满完成。管理员，这下我也能安心“退场”了。
dialogText.en: Okey doke. This job has ended pretty well. I guess it's safe enough for me to "exit the picture", Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 没办法，之前也和管理员你说过吧？我的排班表早就排满了，这次完全是靠佩丽卡监督帮忙才能破例的。
dialogText.en: Can't help it. I thought I told you before, Endmin. My schedule is packed. The Supervisor did some schedule-manipulation arts to help me bend the rules a little.

dialogText.cn: 所以我只能预支休假时间啦。
dialogText.en: And you should know that it came at the cost of my future leave.

dialogText.cn: 对我来说，能够和管理员你一起完成这次的任务，再多花一点假期额度也是值得的。
dialogText.en: But what can I say? I would gladly spend my leave to go on a mission with our very own Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 所以，下回要是还有这样的任务，可别忘了叫我来帮忙哦，管理员。
dialogText.en: So ... if we get another mission like this, don't forget to give me a call, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 现在还有没有可能再订一批药？量没那么大也可以，先给伤得最重的伤员用上……
dialogText.en: Is it possible to order another batch of medical supplies? A smaller order will work. The medicine will be given to those who are most injured...

dialogText.cn: 我还可以用一些其他手段来稳定住伤员的情况，会有些副作用，但这也比丢了命要强。
dialogText.en: I also have other means to stabilize the rest. There might be side effects ... but at least it will save their lives.

dialogText.cn: 药物交接给工团后，没多久就丢失了。知道这批货物的人不多，很可能是运输过程中出了意外。
dialogText.en: We lost the batch of medication shortly after we delivered it to the UWST. Not many people knew about this caravan, so I'm not ruling out the possibility of a shipment accident.

dialogText.cn: 有没有其他方法，先从别处调一批药物应急……
dialogText.en: Is there any other way? Can we move another batch of medication to deal with our current emergency...

dialogText.cn: 你们不用担心……莫莉姐姐有办法的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry ... Molly will figure it out.

dialogText.cn: 莉莉卡，你怎么跑出来了！你受伤了，要好好休息。
dialogText.en: Lilica? Why are you here? You're hurt. Go lay down and get some rest.

dialogText.cn: 莫莉姐姐跟我说，她会给我找到药的。让我不用担心！
dialogText.en: Molly told me she'll find the medicine! She said I don't have to be scared!

dialogText.cn: 小朋友，莫莉姐姐有跟你说她去哪里了吗？
dialogText.en: Hi, little girl. Did Molly tell you where she went?

dialogText.cn: 快，把她送到病床上……快！
dialogText.en: Quick! Help her onto the bed...!

dialogText.cn: 她需要急救，但是……
dialogText.en: She needs emergency treatment, but...

dialogText.cn: 我这里有应急用的便携药物。可以先用上！
dialogText.en: I have some emergency medication with me. We can use that first!

dialogText.cn: 管理员！
dialogText.en: ENDMIN!

dialogText.cn: 越医生，这是药。
dialogText.en: Here are the meds, Surgeon Yue.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢！
dialogText.en: Thank you!

dialogText.cn: 莫莉……莫莉姐姐……
dialogText.en: Molly... Molly...

dialogText.cn: 这个莫莉……好像是她很亲近的人。
dialogText.en: Molly... She sounds like someone very close to her...

dialogText.cn: 这里还有张证件。
dialogText.en: There's an ID here.

dialogText.cn: 情况怎么样？
dialogText.en: How is she doing?

dialogText.cn: 莉莉卡的情况稳定住了，但也只是暂时。
dialogText.en: The girl's condition has stabilized, but only temporarily.

dialogText.cn: 现在矿区营地里的伤员很多都需要这些药物。
dialogText.en: We really need the medical supplies to treat the sick and injured in the Mining Camp.

dialogText.cn: 如果没有药的话，那些伤情较重的病人……
dialogText.en: If we run out of medication, the critical patients will be...

dialogText.cn: 在现有的医疗资源下，我会尽全力抢救伤员。但没有药物……最多只能暂时稳定伤情。
dialogText.en: I'll do whatever I can to treat my patients with every medical resource we have right now. But if we run out of medicine ... the most we can do is to temporarily stabilize their condition.

dialogText.cn: 营地的伤员就先拜托你了。我们应该还有一点时间，管理员，你怎么看？
dialogText.en: The patients of the Mining Camp are in your hands. So, Endmin. I think we still have some time. What should be our next step?

dialogText.cn: 医护人员们需要花费更多精力去看护伤员，找回药物就全靠终末地的各位了！
dialogText.en: The medical personnel have their hands full looking after the patients. We're counting on you to help us recover the medication, my Endfielder friends!

dialogText.cn: 查到她的资料了。莫莉女士不仅年纪轻轻就做到了协调员，而且各项考核都是优。
dialogText.en: We received her profile data. Miss Molly qualified for the post of coordinator at a very young age. She also received stellar reviews in every aspect of her job.

dialogText.cn: 看这个工作笔记就知道，她很专业，也很细心。
dialogText.en: Look at the work notes she took. She's a professional, and a meticulous one at that.

dialogText.cn: 她似乎……还去过车队遇袭现场，调查药物的事情。
dialogText.en: And it seems she ... actually went to the site where the caravan was ambushed. She was trying to investigate the meds.

dialogText.cn: 管理员！我检测到了一个很强的求救信号……从制式上看，是来自工团的。
dialogText.en: Endmin! I picked up a strong distress call... The encryption pattern indicates it's from the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 地点是……西边！是气候监测站那边！
dialogText.en: And it's sent from somewhere ... west of your location! It came from the meteorological station!

dialogText.cn: 气候监测站？早就被废弃了啊……工团撤出来之后，那里被裂地者占领了。
dialogText.en: The meteorological station? But that site has been abandoned for ages... The Landbreakers occupied the place after the UWST withdrew.

dialogText.cn: 又是裂地者……
dialogText.en: The Landbreakers ... again...

dialogText.cn: 莉莉卡的情况总算是稳定下来了……
dialogText.en: Lilica's conditions have finally stabilized...

dialogText.cn: 气候监测站那边情况怎么样了？
dialogText.en: What's the situation at the meteorological station?

dialogText.cn: 好吧，你们要注意安全。
dialogText.en: Alright. Be safe out there.

actorName.cn: 冲动的工团成员{sm1l6m1-冲动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，差点儿就没命了……
dialogText.en: You saved our lives! Those scab eaters almost killed us...

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 莫莉……可以拜托你们救救莫莉吗？她主动替我们殿后，现在裂地者都追了上来，她一定是被抓住了！
dialogText.en: Can you please save Molly...? She volunteered to cover our retreat ... but if the breakers made it here, she's probably been captured by them!

dialogText.cn: 发生什么事了？
dialogText.en: Can you tell us what happened?

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 我们一开始打算潜入气候监测站找药，没想到那里的裂地者特别多，戒备严密！
dialogText.en: We planned to sneak into the meteorological station and look for the medication. None of us expected the place to be so heavily guarded! It's crawling with LBs!

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 我们进去后找了一会儿，都看到装药的箱子了，没想到还是惊动了裂地者……
dialogText.en: We got in and looked around. Even got confirmed visuals of our medical supply crates, but then we alerted the breakers...

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 好，我来带路！
dialogText.en: Great! I'll lead the way!

dialogText.cn: 你的伤……
dialogText.en: But your injuries...

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 我这点伤不算啥，我们抓紧时间。
dialogText.en: It's just a flesh wound... We gotta move fast!

actorName.cn: 冲动的工团成员{sm1l6m1-冲动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 莫莉……该死，早知道我们应该多叫点人来！差一点就成功了！
dialogText.en: Molly... Dammit. We should have brought a bigger crew! We almost had it!

dialogText.cn: 你们怎么知道药的下落的？
dialogText.en: How did you find out where the supplies went?

actorName.cn: 冲动的工团成员{sm1l6m1-冲动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 莫莉查到了那批药的线索，我们就跟她来了！
dialogText.en: Molly found clues about that medical shipment. We followed her here!

dialogText.cn: 听起来，听起来，你们很信任她？
dialogText.en: Sounds like you have faith in her.

actorName.cn: 冲动的工团成员{sm1l6m1-冲动的工团成员}
actorName.en: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 身为协调员，莫莉却总能亲赴生产第一线，我们都没少受到她的照顾，不信她我们信谁。
dialogText.en: Molly's our coordinator, but she's always there on the production floor with the crew. She showered us with plenty of care, so it's only natural we trust her.

actorName.cn: 焦急的工团成员{sm1l6m1-焦急的工团成员}
actorName.en: Desperate UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Desperate UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 我也要和你们一起去！
dialogText.en: Hey, let me tag along as well!

dialogText.cn: 你的伤势比较严重，还是回去吧。
dialogText.en: Your injuries look too severe. You should head back to the camp.

actorName.cn: 焦急的工团成员{sm1l6m1-焦急的工团成员}
actorName.en: Desperate UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Desperate UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 是我惊动了裂地者……才搞成这样。我对不起她。
dialogText.en: I was the one who startled the LBs and botched everything... I can never forgive myself if anything happens to her.

dialogText.cn: 你也不必太自责。
dialogText.en: It's not really your fault.

actorName.cn: 焦急的工团成员{sm1l6m1-焦急的工团成员}
actorName.en: Desperate UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Desperate UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 她让我走，我居然就走了。我是个懦夫！
dialogText.en: She told me to leave, and I did. I can't believe it... I'm such a blighted coward!

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 这里的裂地者，比预想中要多。我们来过之后……他们显然又加强了守卫……
dialogText.en: There are way more LBs here than we thought. They obviously strengthened their guards after we left...

dialogText.cn: 菲奥娜，还有其他信息吗？
dialogText.en: Fiona, do we have any more intel?

dialogText.cn: 这片区域的图纸上显示，有条废弃的下水管道可以潜入。这就发给你们。
dialogText.en: The plans of this area indicate an abandoned sewer tunnel. You can use that to sneak in. I'm sending you the data right now.

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了。
dialogText.en: Much appreciated.

dialogText.cn: 从图纸看来，这个下水管道确实很适合潜入。
dialogText.en: According to the plans, this sewer tunnel is indeed perfect for infiltration.

dialogText.cn: 它似乎已经废弃很久了，裂地者应该不会对这里过多关注。
dialogText.en: It should have been abandoned for a while. I don't think the Landbreakers would pay much attention to it.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你觉得呢？
dialogText.en: What do you think, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 你身上还有伤，早点回去吧。
dialogText.en: You're still wounded. Maybe you should head back and get some rest.

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 接下来就拜托你们了，一定要把莫莉带回来。
dialogText.en: Okay. We're counting on you for this. Please bring Molly back!

actorName.cn: 裂地者小头目{sm1l6m2-裂地者小头目}

dialogText.cn: 虫子里！你，有点胆量！
dialogText.en: Buggerloid crap! YOU! You got some serious guts!

actorName.cn: 裂地者小头目{sm1l6m2-裂地者小头目}

dialogText.cn: 来这儿！干什么？
dialogText.en: WHY! Tell me why you're here!

dialogText.cn: 我知道你们抢劫了车队。药……是不是在你们手上？
dialogText.en: I know you raided the caravan. The medicine... Do you have the medicine?

dialogText.cn: 别走，我还没说完。
dialogText.en: Stop! I'm not done asking.

actorName.cn: 裂地者小头目{sm1l6m2-裂地者小头目}

dialogText.cn: 抢药的！*咕哝*，虫子！
dialogText.en: You med-grubbing... *Mumble* ... BUGGERLOIDS!

actorName.cn: 裂地者小头目{sm1l6m2-裂地者小头目}

dialogText.cn: 你们！抢不走！
dialogText.en: YOU'LL NEVER TAKE 'EM FROM US!

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事……四周都是侵蚀。
dialogText.en: What happened...? The Blight is everywhere.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你没事吧！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 那边有道门，应该能从那里出去。
dialogText.en: There's a door over there. It should be the way out.

dialogText.cn: 但周围到处都是侵蚀，管理员，我们得想想办法。
dialogText.en: But the Blight is spreading everywhere, Endmin. We must think of something.

dialogText.cn: 你们也有同伴受伤，但无能为力的时候吧。
dialogText.en: I'm sure there were times your friends got hurt and you couldn't help.

dialogText.cn: 我的同伴们现在正等着这药救命——你们需要什么，可以提出来，我相信营地是愿意谈的。
dialogText.en: My friends are dying. The medication will save their lives — Just tell me what you need. I believe our camp is willing to negotiate.

dialogText.cn: 不放心的话，我也能留下当人质！只要你们肯把药……
dialogText.en: If you doubt us, I can stay here as a hostage! Just give the meds...

actorName.cn: 裂地者首领{sm1l6m2-裂地者首领}

dialogText.cn: 留下你？把药给那些人？
dialogText.en: Keep you hostage? Give the meds?

actorName.cn: 裂地者首领{sm1l6m2-裂地者首领}

dialogText.cn: 送上门的虫子，*咕哝*，谈……交易？
dialogText.en: Trespassing buggers who ... *mumble* want to parlay?

actorName.cn: 裂地者首领{sm1l6m2-裂地者首领}

dialogText.cn: 不！我们不交易！——我们只抢东西！
dialogText.en: We don't parlay! WE JUST —— TAKE!

actorName.cn: 裂地者首领{sm1l6m2-裂地者首领}

dialogText.cn: *咕哝*，你想要药，偏不给！
dialogText.en: *Mumble*. You want these meds? NEVER!

actorName.cn: 裂地者首领{sm1l6m2-裂地者首领}

dialogText.cn: 不要的东西，毁掉！也不跟虫子做交易！
dialogText.en: I'd rather trash them, smash them to bits ... than trade them with you buggers!

actorName.cn: 裂地者首领{sm1l6m2-裂地者首领}

dialogText.cn: 关进笼子里！药，本来是诱饵，*咕哝*。现在，你是诱饵！
dialogText.en: Put her in a cage! The meds were the lure. *Mumble*. Now, you are the lure!

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……药……都怪我。
dialogText.en: How...? Why...? The meds... This is all my fault.

dialogText.cn: 莫莉，你先冷静一下。我来查看药物的情况。
dialogText.en: Calm down, Molly. I'll check the medical supplies.

dialogText.cn: 内部是分装的，还可以回收总量的百分之四十左右。
dialogText.en: Most of the supplies are protected by secondary packaging. About forty percent are still usable.

dialogText.cn: 我已经通知加紧生产一批新药品。这些药，目前应该足够应急。
dialogText.en: I've already requested emergency production of one more batch. The ones here should be enough for now.

dialogText.cn: 莫莉，你还好吗？
dialogText.en: Molly, are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们……我没事，先把药送回去吧。
dialogText.en: Thank you... I'm alright. Just take these meds back to camp.

dialogText.cn: 你们终于回来了。目前轻伤病人已经稳定了，但重伤病人不是很乐观。莫莉发消息说你们找回了部分药品？
dialogText.en: You're finally back. Patients with minor injuries are getting better, but things still aren't looking too good for the severely injured. Molly messaged me that you recovered some of the meds.

dialogText.cn: 好的，谢谢了！事情我已经听说了。莫莉……我觉得她没做错，只是她要为自己的冒进行为负责。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin! I've heard about everything. As for Molly... She was not at fault, but she must bear the cost of her impulsiveness.

dialogText.cn: 她一回来就主动要求自己受处分。虽然这一次冒进确实带来了些不利影响，但考虑到她本意是好的，工团索性安排她重回基层，支援重建工作。
dialogText.en: When she came back, she immediately turned herself in and asked for penalization. Her impulsive actions may have set a bad example, but she did it with good intentions. The UWST demoted her to a fellow crew mate so she can continue to support the reconstruction.

dialogText.cn: 不过没关系，她的工友们一如既往地信任她。毕竟，她本没必要把事情一个人扛下来的。
dialogText.en: It's alright, actually. Most of the crew trust her. In truth, she didn't have to take the blame for the entire fiasco.

dialogText.cn: 莫莉……她还好吗？
dialogText.en: Molly... Is she doing okay?

dialogText.cn: 我已经联络了菲奥娜，新一批药物已经在路上了。
dialogText.en: I've already contacted Fiona. A new batch of medical supplies should be on its way.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！如果没有你们帮忙……我真不知道怎么办。
dialogText.en: Wonderful! If you weren't around to help ... I wouldn't know what to do.

dialogText.cn: 工团和终末地向来合作紧密。作为盟友，这是我们应尽的义务。
dialogText.en: The UWST has always been a close partner of Endfield. We have only fulfilled our duties as a proper ally.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我得回去照看伤员了。二位，再会。真的，多谢你们。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Now, if you'd excuse me, I need to go back to the patients. Once again, I must thank you both for your assistance. I'll see you around.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这次多亏你们了。只是莫莉，以她的能力……可惜了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we really owe you guys this time. It's such a shame what happened to Molly... She's so talented... *sigh*.

dialogText.cn: 应该就在仓库那边，去和她聊聊吧。
dialogText.en: She's at the depot. Maybe you should talk to her.

dialogText.cn: 我没想到会连累你们……
dialogText.en: I never wanted to get you in this mess...

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 是我们自愿去的。我们知道，你是在为大家冒险。
dialogText.en: We volunteered, Molly. Everyone knows you took the risk, blame, and fall for all of us.

dialogText.cn: 但结果就是不够好。
dialogText.en: But I could have done better.

actorName.cn: 担忧的工团成员{sm1l6m1-担忧的工团成员}
actorName.en: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 咱们工团本来就是一起选择，一起承担。
dialogText.en: We United Workers make our choices together, and bear the results as one.

dialogText.cn: 倒没什么特别的，毕竟我一直都在一线工作。在我们这里，头衔和职级并不重要。技术和经验，才是大家更看重的东西。
dialogText.en: Nothing special. I've always worked with the crew. Titles and ranks mean little to us. We place greater value on skill and experience.

dialogText.cn: 害这么多人受伤，降职的处罚已经算是很轻了。而且……这样也能让我好受一点。
dialogText.en: My poor judgment got many injured, so the demotion was more like a slap on the hand... It actually gave me some relief.

dialogText.cn: 大概是因为，当时的场景还历历在目。那些裂地者……还有他们的生存法则。
dialogText.en: Perhaps it's because ... I still remember vividly what I saw — those Landbreakers ... and their ways of life.

dialogText.cn: 我当时……把事情想简单了。
dialogText.en: I was ... too naive back then.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，管理员。无论如何……这次的教训，我记下了。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin. No matter what ... I believe I've learned my lesson.

dialogText.cn: 你就是把莫莉姐姐救回来的管理员吗？谢谢你！
dialogText.en: Are you the Endmin who saved Molly? Thank you!

dialogText.cn: 你看，已经完全好了！
dialogText.en: Look! I'm all better now!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我想问你一件事……莫莉姐姐只是想救大家，这不是在做好事吗？为什么要受处分？
dialogText.en: Endmin, I wanna ask something... Molly was trying to save everyone, right? She did the right thing, so why did they punish her?

dialogText.cn: 什么样的方法是对的呢？
dialogText.en: So what should be the right action?

dialogText.cn: 那大家不愿意做好事了怎么办？
dialogText.en: But what would happen if nobody wants to do the right thing?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，阿丽娅，你们那边情况怎么样？詹娜奶奶还好吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, Alia, how are you holding up? How's Granny Jenner?

dialogText.cn: 越医生，你知道哪里能找到布莱特乐队的<@qu.key>唱片</>吗？詹娜奶奶她好像很希望听到他们的歌……
dialogText.en: Surgeon Yue, do you know where to get a <@qu.key>vinyl</> by The Bretts? I think Granny Jenner really wants to listen to their songs...

dialogText.cn: 唱片？我想想，<@qu.key>老约翰</>他可能知道？他负责管理营地的旧仓库，说不定有保管过。现在他应该就在旧仓库附近，你们可以去问问他。
dialogText.en: Vinyl? Let me think. <@qu.key>Old John</> might know. He's in charge of the old depot of the camp. Maybe he managed the vinyls as well. Try asking him. You should be able to find him near the old depot.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，情况我都听越医生说了，真没想到詹娜居然会遇到这种事……
dialogText.en: Endmin, Surgeon Yue told me about everything. Can't believe Jenner is suffering from a condition like that...

dialogText.cn: 唉，不过布莱特乐队也是我们那代人的记忆了……以前广播站总放他们的歌……只是后来源石大树没了，大家也没心情再听了……
dialogText.en: Hooo. I gotta say, The Bretts is the collective memory of our generation... The radios couldn't stop playing their songs back then... But after the Great Oak was gone, nobody was in the mood to listen to their songs anymore...

dialogText.cn: 旧仓库清理杂物的时候确实发现了一些他们那时候发行的老唱片，应该就放在离这边不远的架子上，你们可以去找找看。
dialogText.en: While I was cleaning the shelves in the old depot, I found a couple of vinyls that came out when the band was still active. They're on the rack not too far from here. Help yourselves and look through them.

dialogText.cn: 这张是……莱帕乐队的唱片？我好像听过……对了，她们是我妈妈最喜欢的乐队……
dialogText.en: This one... It's a vinyl from Leippa Band. I think I heard their songs before... Oh yeah, my mom loves the Leippa...

dialogText.cn: 只是在大树被炸毁的那一年，她们也解散了……
dialogText.en: But the Leippas disbanded in the same year they detonated the Great Oak...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你看！看货架的标签，这里放的应该就是布莱特乐队的唱片……怎么会是空的……不会是被谁拿走了吧……
dialogText.en: Endmin, look! Check out the label on this shelf! We should be able to find some vinyls from The Bretts here... Wait. It's empty... Did someone take them away?

dialogText.cn: 你是说拿走唱片的人应该没走多远？
dialogText.en: Are you trying to say that the person who took the vinyls isn't too far away?

dialogText.cn: 那我们快追上去吧！
dialogText.en: We should chase them down!

actorName.cn: 凶狠的裂地者{sm1l6m3-凶狠的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 不是……食物……被骗了……被骗了！
dialogText.en: This ... is NOT FOOD!! We got cheated... CHEATED!!

actorName.cn: 气恼的裂地者{sm1l6m3-气恼的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 太吵了……太吵了……
dialogText.en: The noise... IT'S TOO LOUD...!!

dialogText.cn: 还好……唱片机和唱片都没事。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness... The player and the vinyls are alright.

dialogText.cn: 不过，没想到奶奶当年爱听的是这么轻快的音乐……
dialogText.en: I didn't expect young Granny to be a fan of such happy, bubbly music...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，总觉得当年的工团……和我想象的不太一样……
dialogText.en: Endmin, perhaps the UWST back then ... wasn't like what I imagined...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们拿到唱片了？
dialogText.en: Endmin! You found the vinyls?

actorName.cn: 年长的工团成员{sm1l6m3-年长的工团成员}
actorName.en: Old UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Old UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 是布莱特乐队的《午后》……当初就因为这首歌，我成了他们的粉丝……真快啊……转眼他们解散也快十年了吧……
dialogText.en: That's After Noon by The Bretts... It's the song that made me a fan of theirs... Time sure flies. Almost a decade has passed since they went their separate ways...

dialogText.cn: 没骗您，真的……我们……
dialogText.en: Nobody's lying to you. We're really ... trying...

dialogText.cn: 我不信！你们快放我过去！别耽误我今天的工作！
dialogText.en: I'M NOT CONVINCED! You let me through, right now! I will not have anyone delay my work for today!

dialogText.cn: 您不信我们，那管理员呢？管理员的话您总该信了吧？
dialogText.en: We might not be convincing enough, but what about the Endmin? You gotta take the Endmin's word for it, Jenner.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？管理员什么时候来了？你——
dialogText.en: Endmin? Why would the Endmin be here? You little —

dialogText.cn: 真的是管理员？我不会在做梦吧……
dialogText.en: The Endmin? You're really here! Am I dreaming...?

dialogText.cn: 所以……真的封路了？管理员，不会是大树那边出什么问题了吧？
dialogText.en: So ... we really have to block this road? Endmin, nothing's happened to the Great Oak, right?

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样……那今天我不能去看大树了？
dialogText.en: Oh, so that's why... So I guess I won't be seeing the Great Oak today?

dialogText.cn: 好吧，既然管理员都这么说了，那……我明天再去……
dialogText.en: Well, since the Endmin has put it that way, then ... I suppose I'll just go there tomorrow...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，明天……明天一定可以看到大树的，詹娜女士。
dialogText.en: Of course. Tomorrow... We'll definitely see the Great Oak tomorrow, Miss Jenner.

dialogText.cn: 到时候，我们陪你一起去。
dialogText.en: And every one of us will be joining you.

dialogText.cn: 希望詹娜奶奶平安无事……
dialogText.en: I hope Granny Jenner is alright...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! You're here!

dialogText.cn: 还没有……越医生说，很可能是她的矿石病导致的……
dialogText.en: Not yet... Surgeon Yue said this might be caused by her Oripathy...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，她的矿石病症状过去一直很轻微，通常来说，坚持用药就不太影响正常的生活……
dialogText.en: Yes. Jenner's Oripathy symptoms had been slight and minor. Her quality of life shouldn't be affected if she follows the medical regimen...

dialogText.cn: 这其中，可能也有她长期照料源石树苗的关系……总之，考虑到她的年纪，我会使用一些保守疗法，至少让她的病情不再恶化。
dialogText.en: One reason for this might be that she's been caring for the Originium sapling for quite a while... In any case, considering her age, I'll stick with more conservative treatment options. They will at least prevent her condition from getting worse.

dialogText.cn: 这个……其实我手上储备的药物已经不多了，现在急需一批新的<@qu.key>药材</>来给她配药。
dialogText.en: Well... My stockpile of medication is running low. I urgently need a new batch of <@qu.key>medical ingredients</> for her treatment.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你能按这份清单，帮我收集一些回来吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, can you use this list and gather some missing ingredients for me?

dialogText.cn: 只是随着年龄增长……她血液里的源石结晶还是表现出了不稳定性……
dialogText.en: But as time goes by ... the Originium crystals in her blood have begun to show signs of instability...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，药材都收集好了吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, have you gathered the medical ingredients?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这个量应该够了……多谢你，管理员，我这就去配药。
dialogText.en: Yes. This should be enough... Much appreciated, Endmin. I'll prepare her medicine right away.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？越医生？这下奶奶应该没事了吧……
dialogText.en: Is it working, Surgeon Yue? Will Granny be alright...?

dialogText.cn: 这要看她醒来后的状态。在那之前，我也不能给出具体的判断。
dialogText.en: We'll have to wait for her to come around first. I don't think I can give you a good diagnosis before that happens.

dialogText.cn: 奶奶！詹娜奶奶！你醒了吗？有没有哪里不舒服？
dialogText.en: Jenner! Granny Jenner! You're awake! Thank Talos ... are you feeling okay?

dialogText.cn: 这位工友……你是？我怎么会在这里……
dialogText.en: A fellow crew mate...? Who ... who are you? Why am I here...?

dialogText.cn: 奶奶？！你、你不认识我了吗？我是阿丽娅啊……
dialogText.en: Granny?! Don't ... don't you recognize me? I'm Alia...

dialogText.cn: 阿丽娅？抱歉，这个名字我没什么印象……我们认识吗？
dialogText.en: Alia? I'm sorry, but I'm afraid I don't really know you... Did we meet before?

dialogText.cn: 还有，虽然我对年龄不是很在意，但你看起来也就比我小个几岁……还没到要叫我“奶奶”的地步吧？
dialogText.en: One more thing. I'm not one who's easily offended when people talk about age, girl. But you seem just a few years younger than me... Calling me "granny" is stretching things a bit, wouldn't you say?

dialogText.cn: 老实说，我也是头一次遇到……
dialogText.en: Truth be told, it's my first time in a situation like this as well...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你什么时候来的？怎么都没人通知我一声。
dialogText.en: Endmin? When did you arrive? Why didn't anybody tell me about you being here?

dialogText.cn: 要是知道你会来……有关大树近况的报告文件，我肯定会提前准备好的……
dialogText.en: If I had known you were coming ... I would have prepared a report on the recent status of the Great Oak...

dialogText.cn: 唉，这下只能带你去现场看看了——看看你种下的大树，被我们照顾得多好！
dialogText.en: Oh well, I guess I'll have to take you to the Oak myself — We've got to show you all the tender loving care we gave to the tree you planted.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你这说的是什么话，参与了源石种植计划的人，哪个不认识你嘛！
dialogText.en: Are you trying to pull my leg, Endmin? Everyone who took part in the Originium Cultivation Project knows you!

dialogText.cn: 你种下大树的那天，我还代表其他人和你握过手呢！
dialogText.en: I even shook your hand on behalf of our entire crew, on the very day you planted the Great Oak.

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事……感觉头晕晕的……该不会是我昨天睡太晚了吧……
dialogText.en: Ugh, what's happening... I feel so woozy... Maybe it's because I stayed up too late last night.

dialogText.cn: 不行，管理员难得来一次……我一定得带你去看看大树才行……
dialogText.en: No matter. Your visit is always a rare occasion, Endmin... I've got to take you there and show you the Great Oak...

dialogText.cn: 好吧，既然管理员你都这么说了……那我就先睡一会儿……一小会儿……
dialogText.en: Fine. Since you put it that way, Endmin... I guess I'll rest my eyes for a bit... Just a little bit...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，就让她先休息吧……我们去外面聊。
dialogText.en: It's best to let her rest, Endmin... We should talk about this outside.

dialogText.cn: 这点我也无法确定。也许明天她就全都想起来了，也许……
dialogText.en: I am uncertain about that. Perhaps she will remember everything tomorrow, but there's also a chance that...

dialogText.cn: 等等——越医生，你的意思是，詹娜奶奶她不是单纯的失忆，而是……记忆退回到了二十多年前？！
dialogText.en: Wait, Surgeon Yue — are you saying that Granny Jenner isn't just suffering from simple memory loss, but that her memories have ... regressed to twenty years ago?!

dialogText.cn: 没错，根据她的反应……以及和管理员的对话，这恐怕是最有可能的情况了……
dialogText.en: That's correct. According to her reactions ... and her dialog with the Endmin, this diagnostic might be the most likely...

dialogText.cn: 不排除这个可能。
dialogText.en: That is a possibility we cannot rule out.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……
dialogText.en: How could this happen...?

dialogText.cn: 还有一点，根据我了解过的病例……以她目前的身体情况，接下来最好不要让她遭受太强烈的刺激或是冲击……
dialogText.en: One more thing. Based on similar cases I've read about ... and considering her current condition, we'd best avoid exposing her to overly strong or shocking stimuli...

dialogText.cn: 尤其是精神方面的，比如——
dialogText.en: Especially psychological stimuli, which include—

dialogText.cn: 詹娜奶奶一直都对大树很有感情，当年最先提出培育树苗的人里，就有她……
dialogText.en: Granny Jenner has always been emotionally attached to the Great Originium Oak. She was among the ones who proposed raising the sapling many years ago...

dialogText.cn: 是的，奶奶过去就很爱和我们讲关于那棵大树的事……说大树被炸毁，一直让她感到特别遗憾……
dialogText.en: Yeah. Granny always loved telling us stories about the Great Oak... She's been really affected and so sad about its destruction...

dialogText.cn: 所以这件事……最好不要被现在的她发现，否则后果不堪设想。
dialogText.en: Indeed. We would be wise to keep her from learning about this ... incident. Otherwise, the results might not be good.

dialogText.cn: 可大树早就不在了……我们总不能，给奶奶再变一棵出来吧？
dialogText.en: But the Great Oak's no longer around... We can't simply come up with a huge tree for Granny.

dialogText.cn: 也不用太悲观，我们可以想办法，将这件事掩盖过去。
dialogText.en: This is no cause for pessimism. Let's figure out ways to cover things up.

dialogText.cn: 通常罹患这类病症的患者，记忆都会出现一些缺损，认知上也存在一定障碍。他们在意的，一般只有自己特别在乎的事，与明显违背认知的事。
dialogText.en: Patients with such conditions often suffer patchy memories. They may experience certain cognitive issues as well, and tend to focus on matters that they really care about, or obviously conflict with their memories.

dialogText.cn: 只要我们能转移詹娜奶奶的注意力，减少她体会到的违和感，或许……会有转机。
dialogText.en: If we can divert Granny Jenner's attention, and alleviate the cognitive dissonance she experiences, we might be able to ... turn things around.

dialogText.cn: 明白了，这是要想办法骗过奶奶？让她觉得一切都和当年一样？
dialogText.en: Got it! That means we gotta give Granny a show, right? A show that makes her feel that everything is the same as before?

dialogText.cn: 事不宜迟，最好先想办法封锁前往世代摇篮的道路。哦，对了，还有一点——记忆回退的患者多数都会有一些突发的偏执行为。到时只能随机应变，尽量别刺激到她。
dialogText.en: Yes. Immediately. We should try to seal the roads to the Cradle of the Ages. And, one more thing — patients with memory age regression may experience sudden episodes of paranoia. We need to respond and improvise accordingly, and do our best to avoid triggering her.

dialogText.cn: 越医生，不好了！12号床的病人突然不见了……
dialogText.en: Surgeon Yue, something bad has happened! The patient in bed 12 has gone missing...

dialogText.cn: 12号床？那不是奶奶的床号吗！
dialogText.en: Bed 12? Isn't that Granny's bed?

dialogText.cn: 之后如果有什么新情况，我们再联系。
dialogText.en: We'll get in touch with you if anything new happens.

dialogText.cn: 其他事先放在一边吧……现在最重要的就是找到她。我和你们一起去——
dialogText.en: Set aside the prep work for now... The most important thing right now is to locate her quickly. I'll join you in the search —

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我明白了，管理员。我这就去找其他工友，让他们先想办法……把相连的路堵上。
dialogText.en: Okay... I understand, Endmin. I'll find a few crew mates to work something out ... and seal the connected roads.

dialogText.cn: ……怎么可能？我昨天还来吃过的……
dialogText.en: ...Impossible! I just had it yesterday...!

dialogText.cn: 可这道菜我从来没有做过……詹娜女士，你是不是记错了？
dialogText.en: But I've never made butter fowl before... Miss Jenner, maybe you've remembered it wrong.

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样！那管理员可不能错过我们这里的特色菜——黄油羽兽！我几乎每周都要点一次呢！
dialogText.en: Is that so? Well, you better not miss our local special — butter fowl! It's something I get almost every week!

dialogText.cn: 这么经典的菜，这个新来的厨师居然不会做……也太失职了。
dialogText.en: But our new chef here knows nothing about this signature food of ours... I call it a lapse of professionalism.

dialogText.cn: ……记错了？
dialogText.en: ...I remembered it wrong?

dialogText.cn: 对！他、他是新来的厨师！还不太熟悉我们的菜谱……
dialogText.en: Yeah! This chef ... erm ... he's new here! He's not really familiar with our menu...

dialogText.cn: 怪不得我看他有些陌生……
dialogText.en: That explains why I don't really know his face...

dialogText.cn: 咦？管理员，你什么时候来的？是来看大树情况的吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm? When did you arrive, Endmin? Are you here to check on the Great Oak?

dialogText.cn: 啊？哦……好的。
dialogText.en: Me? Oh ... okay.

dialogText.cn: 竟然发生了这种事……放心吧管理员，事关詹娜女士，我会努力配合你们的！
dialogText.en: That actually happened...? Don't worry, Endmin. If it's Miss Jenner, I'll do anything I can to help!

dialogText.cn: 罗南叔叔，你真的不会做黄油羽兽吗？感觉奶奶很想吃到这道菜……
dialogText.en: Uncle Ronan, you seriously don't know how to make butter fowl? It sounds like something that Granny Jenner really wants.

dialogText.cn: 唉，这道菜因为做起来太费劲，早就从我们菜单上删掉了……我小时候倒是吃过一次，但确实从没做过。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* Making butter fowl is too much hassle, so we removed it from the menu quite a while back... I tried it once when I was a boy, but I've never made it myself.

dialogText.cn: 不过，如果有菜谱，我或许能根据印象做出来……
dialogText.en: But if we could get a list of ingredients, it might help me make the dish from my memories...

dialogText.cn: 那……不如我们去问问奶奶？说不定她知道？
dialogText.en: So ... why don't we ask Granny Jenner? She might know something.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，现在我都有点好奇这道菜的味道了！居然能让奶奶吃那么多回……
dialogText.en: Huh? Granny Jenner had that every week? Oh, Endmin, now I'm curious about what butter fowl tastes like...

dialogText.cn: 待会儿要是罗南叔叔做出来了，我们也一起尝尝看吧。
dialogText.en: Once Uncle Ronan makes it, maybe we could try some too.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，怎么样？想好点什么了吗？
dialogText.en: How's it going, Endmin? Made up your mind about what to order?

dialogText.cn: 是吗？我也很喜欢这道菜，之前还专门研究过菜谱！等这次大树的养护工作结束，就回家做一次试试。
dialogText.en: Really? I like it too. I even took some time to read about it! Once we're done taking care of the Great Oak, I plan to make some myself.

dialogText.cn: 当然！整个流程我都记住了——先要准备材料，需要羽兽腿肉、番茄罐头、咖喱粉、黄油、重奶油……
dialogText.en: Of course! I memorized the entire recipe — You gotta get the ingredients first. Fowl drumsticks, canned tomatoes, curry powder, butter, thick cream...

dialogText.cn: 呼，和我们现在“焗羽兽”的做法很像，我应该可以试着做出来……
dialogText.en: Phew. Sounds about the same as roast fowl. I think I can make the dish based on what she said...

dialogText.cn: 太好了！
dialogText.en: Awesome!

dialogText.cn: 不过食材方面，可能还需要一些<@qu.key>番茄罐头</>，能麻烦你们找几罐回来吗？
dialogText.en: But we need some <@qu.key>canned tomatoes</> for the ingredients. Can you find a few cans for us?

dialogText.cn: 好，我来照看奶奶……管理员，就等你回来了！
dialogText.en: Right. I'll look after Granny, Endmin... We're counting on you!

dialogText.cn: （那边的箱子里似乎有番茄罐头。）
dialogText.en: (The crates over there might have canned tomatoes.)

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你怎么跑来这里了？不会也是来巡逻的吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin, why are you here? Are you doing patrol duty?

dialogText.cn: 记忆回退了二十多年……？天啊，简直比我昨天看的那本小说还离奇……
dialogText.en: What? Memory age regression of twenty years...? By Talos, this is even crazier than that novel I was just reading yesterday...

dialogText.cn: 但既然是詹娜奶奶的事，那我也必须尽一份力。当初刚来矿区营地的时候，她和我讲了很多关于世代摇篮的往事，我才明白了我们在这里坚守的意义……
dialogText.en: Well, if it's about Granny Jenner, I'll do anything I can to help. When I first arrived at the Mining Camp, she told me all sorts of things about the Cradle of the Ages. Her stories taught me why we still defend this place...

dialogText.cn: 每当遇到难题或是身陷困境时，一想到詹娜奶奶他们这些老工团成员在这里付出的努力与心血，就觉得我也不能轻易认输，咬着牙坚持了下来……
dialogText.en: Whenever I find myself in a fix or trouble, I think about the blood, sweat, and tears that Granny Jenner and the other veterans poured into this place... I remind myself not to give up ... and I grit my teeth and endure...

dialogText.cn: 这回也该轮到我来报答她了……管理员，让我和你一起吧。
dialogText.en: Now is the time for me to repay her kindness... Endmin, count me in as part of your plan.

actorName.cn: 认真的工团成员{sm1l6m3-认真的工团成员}
actorName.en: Serious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Serious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 不行，这样还是人手不够！得另外想办法……
dialogText.en: No. We'll need a bigger crew to make that happen! Gotta come up with another plan...

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工团成员{sm1l6m3-沉稳的工团成员}
actorName.en: Calm UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Calm UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 问题是，现在去哪里找……力气特别大又懂焊工的工友啊……
dialogText.en: Problem is, where can we find ... a crew mate with strong biceps and welding expertise?

actorName.cn: 认真的工团成员{sm1l6m3-认真的工团成员}
actorName.en: Serious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Serious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 唉，要是马特维在就好了。不过，今天应该轮到他去巡逻。以那家伙认真负责的个性，不到晚上肯定回不来的……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* If only we had Matvei here. But he's got patrol duty today, and from what I know about his diehard sense of duty, he probably won't be around till dinner time...

dialogText.cn: 哈克，路德，你们找我？
dialogText.en: Hack, Luther, you looking for me?

actorName.cn: 认真的工团成员{sm1l6m3-认真的工团成员}
actorName.en: Serious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Serious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 马特维，你居然提前回来了？！
dialogText.en: Matvei? Did you actually end your shift ahead of schedule?!

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工团成员{sm1l6m3-沉稳的工团成员}
actorName.en: Calm UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Calm UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 说不定，是我们的想法发生了什么共鸣效应，把他给影响到了。
dialogText.en: Hmm. Perhaps we found some form of telepathic resonance that brought him here to us.

dialogText.cn: 说什么呢！我是因为碰到了管理员……等等，你们在造的，难道就是那个用来阻路的工事？
dialogText.en: Stop making things up! I'm here because I met the Endmin... Wait. Are you building the barricade for blocking the road?

actorName.cn: 认真的工团成员{sm1l6m3-认真的工团成员}
actorName.en: Serious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Serious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 对，就是那个。你也知道詹娜奶奶的事了吧……唉，连我父亲那一辈，都被詹娜奶奶照顾过，更不用说我们这样的年轻一辈了……
dialogText.en: Exactly. You've heard about Granny Jenner, right? Granny looked after everyone — not just younger crew mates like us, but even my dad and his crew...

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工团成员{sm1l6m3-沉稳的工团成员}
actorName.en: Calm UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Calm UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 所以一听说是帮奶奶，好多工友就自发加入进来了。越医生说，他本来还想着就找几个工友帮忙的，结果现在几乎整个营地的人都来了。
dialogText.en: Tons of people volunteered when they heard that Granny Jenner needed help. Surgeon Yue said he was only expecting a few volunteers. But from what I'm seeing, nearly everyone in the camp is involved already.

actorName.cn: 认真的工团成员{sm1l6m3-认真的工团成员}
actorName.en: Serious UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Serious UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 嗯，她应该是……最早被派驻到四号谷地的工团人了……我爷爷常说，为了营地的建设还有源石种植计划，詹娜奶奶几乎奉献了自己的整个青春。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Granny's like ... one of the first UWST crew mates assigned to Valley IV... My gramps often talked about her — how she devoted almost her entire youth to building the Mining Camp ... and carrying out the Originium Cultivation Project.

actorName.cn: 沉稳的工团成员{sm1l6m3-沉稳的工团成员}
actorName.en: Calm UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m3-Calm UWST Crew Mate}

dialogText.cn: 可以说……现在还在这个营地生活的人，或多或少都从奶奶那里得到过帮助。现在她遇到了困难，我们也不可能袖手旁观的。
dialogText.en: You could even say that everyone who still lives in the camp ... has benefited from Granny's help in one way or another. Nobody's going to just stand around and do nothing if Granny's in trouble.

dialogText.cn: 我也一样……哎，好了，这些等工事搭完再说吧！先把你们遇到的麻烦说说？我看我能不能解决。
dialogText.en: Same here... Ah. We should focus on finishing the road works first! Tell me about your problem. I'll see if I can do something about it.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，本来想先去看一眼詹娜奶奶的，不过建这个工事明显更重要也更实际嘛……管理员，你快回她那里吧，免得又出现什么意外。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I wanted to see Granny Jenner first, but completing these road works seems more important and practical... Go on ahead and talk to Granny before anything else happens, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你回来了？有找到番茄罐头吗？
dialogText.en: You're back, Endmin! Found the canned tomatoes?

dialogText.cn: 这是……黄油羽兽？你之前不是说……你没做过吗？
dialogText.en: Isn't this ... butter fowl? And I thought you told me that ... you never made it before?

dialogText.cn: 好了，这下材料总算齐了，接下来就交给我吧。
dialogText.en: Great. We now have all the ingredients. Leave the rest to me.

dialogText.cn: 咳……这个……
dialogText.en: Ahem... Well...

dialogText.cn: 我就说嘛！怎么会有工团的厨师不会做黄油羽兽的……
dialogText.en: See? It's just what I said. Butter fowl is an essential menu item for every UWST chef...

dialogText.cn: 嗯……好像还行。
dialogText.en: Hmm... This is pretty decent.

dialogText.cn: 不过……总觉得缺了点什么……
dialogText.en: But ... I can't help but feel that something is missing...

dialogText.cn: 平时这个时候……广播站都会放布莱特乐队的歌……
dialogText.en: Well, this is usually the time ... when the station starts playing songs by The Bretts...

dialogText.cn: 今天怎么这么安静……真让人不习惯……
dialogText.en: But ... where's the music? Why is it so quiet?... I'm really not used to this...

dialogText.cn: 你说得对，管理员，肯定是这样……唉，希望他们能早点修好……
dialogText.en: That makes sense, Endmin. Bet that's exactly what happened... *Sigh* I truly wish someone gets it fixed quickly...

dialogText.cn: 最好赶在我带你去大树前……让管理员你也听听……
dialogText.en: And I hope you get to appreciate The Bretts ... before I take you to the Great Oak...

dialogText.cn: 明明之前都好好的……也没提大树的事……
dialogText.en: She was doing fine ... and she didn't say anything about the Great Oak...

dialogText.cn: 都怪我……以为奶奶她不会……昨天越医生还提醒我要多留心的……
dialogText.en: It's all my fault ... I thought Granny would be alright... Surgeon Yue even reminded me to pay close attention yesterday...

dialogText.cn: 啊，马特维他们搭的临时工事都撤掉了……奶奶不会是……已经发现……
dialogText.en: Wait, Matvei and his crew probably removed the temporary barricades... Granny... Oh no, she might have found out...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我先带你去奶奶最后去的地方，或许能发现什么蛛丝马迹……
dialogText.en: Okay. I'll take you where Granny last visited. Perhaps we'll be able to find some clues...

dialogText.cn: 这是……奶奶的工作手册？怎么会……我明明把它收在柜子最下层了……
dialogText.en: Is this ... Granny's work manual? How...? I thought I kept it on the lowest shelf of the cabinet...

dialogText.cn: 里面全是关于源石大树的记录……奶奶难道就是因为看到这些才……
dialogText.en: Oh dear, the manual has plenty of sections about the Great Originium Oak... Granny Jenner must have read them and...

dialogText.cn: 是奶奶的水壶……她果然来了这里……
dialogText.en: This is Granny's water canteen... She really came to this place...

dialogText.cn: 怎么办，管理员……奶奶肯定……
dialogText.en: What should we do, Endmin...? Granny must have...

dialogText.cn: 我知道……可是……奶奶还会去哪里呢……
dialogText.en: I know... But ... where could she go...?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，阿丽娅，你们回来了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Alia, you're back.

dialogText.cn: 詹娜……奶奶？
dialogText.en: Miss ... Jenner?

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？阿丽娅，这才过了多久，难道已经不认识奶奶了吗？
dialogText.en: What happened, Alia? It's only been a little while, and you don't recognize Granny Jenner anymore?

dialogText.cn: 不……不……我只是……
dialogText.en: No ... I mean... Yes, I ... I do, but...

dialogText.cn: 你这孩子，我就是……一觉醒来了，突然就想到处走走。不会是把你吓到了吧？
dialogText.en: Silly girl. I just ... woke up and suddenly felt like walking around. I hope I didn't scare you.

dialogText.cn: 没、没有，詹娜奶奶你回来了……回来了就好……
dialogText.en: No, of course not! Oh, Granny Jenner, I'm just so glad you're back... You're finally back with us...

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，管理员。我这个老家伙好像不小心给你们添了一些麻烦……实在不好意思……
dialogText.en: Apologies, Endmin. This old lady probably gave you more than a royal share of trouble... It's quite the embarrassment if you ask me...

dialogText.cn: 我知道你们不会介意，也知道有些事……任何人都没法幸免……
dialogText.en: Now I know you won't mind. You probably know there are certain things ... that eventually catch up with everyone...

dialogText.cn: 但我还是会希望，希望能在某个时刻到来前，多做些我能做的事，多交代一些必须完成的工作……哪怕总会留有遗憾，也好过什么都不去做。
dialogText.en: But I still have hope — hope that I'll do everything I can ... and entrust my ongoing duties to responsible hands before that eventuality befalls me... Now that may leave people sad and sorry, but it's at least better than doing nothing at all.

dialogText.cn: 阿丽娅，我那本工作手册……在你那里吧？
dialogText.en: Alia, I believe you have that ... work manual of mine.

dialogText.cn: 是、是的，詹娜奶奶，我——
dialogText.en: Ah, yes, Granny Jenner. I —

dialogText.cn: 收好它。
dialogText.en: Keep it safe.

dialogText.cn: 里面除了源石大树的生长记录，还记了我这些年培育树苗时，积累的经验和一些技巧。
dialogText.en: The manual has growth records of the Great Originium Oak, as well as lessons and techniques I jotted down after years of cultivating the sapling.

dialogText.cn: 往后……你会用上的。
dialogText.en: You'll ... find it useful.

dialogText.cn: 可是……我……
dialogText.en: But ... I...

dialogText.cn: 你一直是个细心又负责的孩子。把“它”交给你，我很放心。
dialogText.en: You pay great attention to details and you stick to your responsibilities. It'll set my mind at ease if I can entrust this to you, girl.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，其实上次见面的时候，我就想说了……谢谢你，愿意再回到四号谷地，回到这个……你亲手种下那棵大树的地方。
dialogText.en: Endmin... Thank you. I actually wanted to say this when we met last time. I was hoping that you would return to Valley IV again — to the very place ... where you planted the Great Oak with your own hands.

dialogText.cn: 尽管当年有太多的不得已……但没能保住源石大树，保住你给予我们的“家园”——这依然……是我与无数工友最痛心的事。
dialogText.en: Back then, the situation forced our hand... We did our best, but we couldn't keep the Great Originium Oak safe, nor protect the home you gave us — This incident ... remains the most painful event that countless crew mates and I have endured.

dialogText.cn: 一直以来，我之所以这样努力，培育这些小树苗，就是为了有一天……能重新看见当年的大树屹立在这片土地上……
dialogText.en: For years I've committed myself to tending these little saplings. My only wish ... is to see our Great Oak take root once more in the land and then reach up for the skies...

dialogText.cn: 让它重新成为我们的“摇篮”，我们的……“希望”。
dialogText.en: I hope the Great Oak will again become our "cradle", our ... "hope".

dialogText.cn: 而现在，我终于看到了一丝可能……
dialogText.en: And now, I've finally caught a glimpse of a possibility...

dialogText.cn: 所以，管理员，等到那一天真的到来了，你能不能……再来一趟四号谷地？看看这棵新生的大树，也看看这片土地……是不是……已经变成你曾经期望的样子了呢？
dialogText.en: So, if that day does come, can I ask you to ... visit Valley IV once again, Endmin? Could you please watch over the new Oak as well as these lands ... and see if they've grown and transformed into what you envisioned?

dialogText.cn: 詹娜奶奶她……走了……
dialogText.en: Granny Jenner... She's left us...

dialogText.cn: 就在今天早上。
dialogText.en: Happened this morning.

dialogText.cn: 我知道……我都知道……
dialogText.en: I knew... I knew it all along...

dialogText.cn: 奶奶她最后……是笑着的……
dialogText.en: Granny left ... with a smile on her face...

dialogText.cn: 我不会让她失望的……所以……就哭这么一会儿……一小会儿……
dialogText.en: I won't let her down... So I'll ... just sit in the sadness for a while... Just a little while...

dialogText.cn: 她说……她其实很高兴，这回能和管理员一起经历了那么多事……这曾经是她年轻时的梦想，没想到会以这样的形式实现……
dialogText.en: She said … she felt really happy about having gone through so much with the Endmin this time... She had dreamed of that when she was young, but never imagined it would happen in this way.

dialogText.cn: 她觉得那道黄油羽兽，比她当年吃到的还美味……布莱特乐队的那首《午后》……也依然是那么动听……
dialogText.en: She felt that the butter fowl was better than what she had in the past... And After Noon by The Bretts ... remained a beautiful song...

dialogText.cn: 最后她还说……希望我们不要为她的离去难过。因为，她已经把她最重要的梦想留在了这片土地上……也把承载梦想的源石树苗，托付给了我……
dialogText.en: Finally, she hoped that ... we would not feel sad about her departure, 'cos ... 'cos she left her most important dream upon these lands ... and entrusted the Originium sapling, the vessel of her dreams ... to me...

dialogText.cn: 奶奶……她……也谢谢营地的大家帮她好好回忆了那些美好的过往……
dialogText.en: Granny Jenner ... she ... she was also grateful to everyone in the camp for helping her remember the good old days...

dialogText.cn: ……多谢你们。我还在想，要是没人来，我该怎么脱身。
dialogText.en: ...Thank you, people. I probably wouldn't have been able to escape if you hadn't come to get me out of the mess.

dialogText.cn: 你是阿尔乔姆？
dialogText.en: Are you Artyom?

dialogText.cn: 是我。
dialogText.en: I am.

dialogText.cn: 我是终末地的监督佩丽卡，这位是——
dialogText.en: I'm Supervisor Perlica of Endfield Industries. And this is—

dialogText.cn: 我知道，是管理员吧。
dialogText.en: I know. The Endministrator, right?

dialogText.cn: 十年前——你上一次来四号谷地的时候，我已经在这里工作了……
dialogText.en: You last visited Valley IV ten years ago — I was already working here back then...

dialogText.cn: 现在不是叙旧的时候。这里就是你躲藏的地方？
dialogText.en: We don't have time for nostalgia. Is this where you've been hiding?

dialogText.cn: 躲藏？勉强算吧……我在人多的地方待不住，就找了个清净的角落。
dialogText.en: Hiding? I guess you can call it that... I don't really like crowded places, so I got myself a quiet spot.

dialogText.cn: 清净的角落？这里刚刚才冒出一群裂地者。
dialogText.en: A quiet spot? We literally just had a mob of Landbreakers here.

dialogText.cn: 他们……他们突然出现在这里，我也措手不及。
dialogText.en: They ... they just showed up, all of a sudden. Even took me by surprise.

dialogText.cn: 那么，阿尔乔姆先生——你的那辆卡车，为什么会在非工作时段出现在四号谷地边缘？监控拍得很清楚。
dialogText.en: Well then, Mr. Artyom — Why did that truck of yours appear along the fringes of Valley IV during non-working hours? We have the monitoring logs and the video is pretty clear.

dialogText.cn: 我不知道你在说什么。
dialogText.en: I don't know what you're talking about.

dialogText.cn: 不只有画面，还有路径。你绕过调度路线，直接去了裂地者出没的区域。
dialogText.en: We not only have the video, we even got your path mapped out. You strayed off the distribution route and headed straight into breaker turf.

dialogText.cn: 你们怀疑我跟裂地者勾结？
dialogText.en: Are you accusing me of working with the pipefaces?

dialogText.cn: 我承认，我违反了规章，但我没有背叛工团。那天夜里，我只是出去处理些……个人的事。
dialogText.en: I admit that I've violated a few of our SOPs, but I didn't betray the Syndicates. That night, I went out to handle a few ... personal affairs.

dialogText.cn: 现在这已经不是你的私事了。
dialogText.en: This is no longer a personal affair.

dialogText.cn: 安格鲁应该有很多问题要问你。
dialogText.en: I believe Angro will have more questions for you.

dialogText.cn: ……我明白了。
dialogText.en: ...I believe he does.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们回来了？太好了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're back! Wonderful.

dialogText.cn: 尤莉娅和格奥尔基已经被控制，目前都在接受调查。
dialogText.en: Both Yulia and Georgi have been detained. We're now questioning them.

dialogText.cn: 我早说过他们有问题！如果不是管理员，鬼知道他们还要干出多少事来！
dialogText.en: I already suspected them! Who knows what evil things they would've pulled off if the Endmin hadn't busted them!

dialogText.cn: 多亏了你们的帮助。现在我们可以确认，两人确实存在严重的违规行为。
dialogText.en: Your help is greatly appreciated. We are certain that these two are indeed guilty of major infractions.

dialogText.cn: 通信支持部门正在解密她用来发送加密通信的终端机。她用的不是通用协议，是她自己设计的，结构非常复杂。
dialogText.en: Communication Support is trying to crack the terminal she used to send her encrypted messages. She didn't use standard protocols. In fact, she designed the terminal herself and the encryption structure is incredibly complex.

dialogText.cn: 她确实聪明，动手能力强……但可惜把本事用错了地方。
dialogText.en: She's really smart. Handy with tools and tech as well... But she focused her skills on the wrong pursuit.

dialogText.cn: 别再“可惜”了！她删改了记录，还敢嘴硬。如果不弄清楚她做了什么，我们的损失只会更大！
dialogText.en: No more buts! She deleted the logs and tried to deny it. We gotta figure out what she actually did before our losses get any worse!

dialogText.cn: 我理解，但还得一步步来。只要我们能还原通信记录，就能厘清她到底在和谁接触。
dialogText.en: I understand, but we need to take things one step at a time. If we can restore the original comm records, we'll learn about the people she was talking with.

dialogText.cn: 已经锁定她的身份。表面上，她是个回收旧设备的流动商贩，没想到暗地里还干黑市勾当。
dialogText.en: We've managed to tag someone. She seems like a traveling merchant collecting old machinery. Never expected her to be dealing with underground markets.

dialogText.cn: 我们运气不错，格奥尔基愿意配合。我已经安排他假装继续交易，把她钓出来，只要她一露面，我们就能动手。
dialogText.en: We should count ourselves lucky. Georgi is willing to cooperate. I've made an arrangement with him. He'll have something on offer to lure her out, and then we'll pounce.

dialogText.cn: 我更关心的是她手上有没有关于格奥尔基是不是内鬼的证据。他到现在还是一副“只犯了小错”的委屈嘴脸，我不信。
dialogText.en: I'm actually more concerned about whether she has more evidence against Georgi. The man is still putting on an act of a minor miscreant. I refuse to buy his show.

dialogText.cn: 阿尔乔姆……他是四号谷地的老工人，我真不相信他会涉入这种事。
dialogText.en: Artyom... He's an old veteran of Valley IV. I don't think he's involved in this.

dialogText.cn: 你就是太心软，所以看谁都没有嫌疑。他可是半夜开车出去了！
dialogText.en: You're too soft. That's why you can't get any suspects. He's the one who drove a truck out there in the dead of night!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，而且我们还在他的藏身处撞见了裂地者。
dialogText.en: Yeah. We even ran into Landbreakers near his hideout.

dialogText.cn: 我明白，所以我已经提高了他的嫌疑等级。
dialogText.en: I understand. That's why I'm pegging him as a serious suspect.

dialogText.cn: 但是他现在什么都不愿意说，你打算怎么办？
dialogText.en: But right now, that Artyom still refuses to tell us anything. What are you planning to do?

dialogText.cn: 再给我点时间，我亲自审问他。
dialogText.en: Give me some time. I'm going to interrogate him myself.

dialogText.cn: 目前为止，我们掌握了三条明确的方向。只要下一步行动顺利，我们就能接近真相。
dialogText.en: We now have three clear approaches to the problem. If our next step is successful, we'll be one step closer to the truth.

dialogText.cn: 不能只是“接近”，我们要一个结果。为了牺牲的兄弟姐妹，不能有任何妥协。
dialogText.en: We can't just be closer to the truth. We need actual results. No compromises. Our fellow crew mates who lost their lives in this incident deserve this much.

dialogText.cn: 嗯！我们一定会帮你们揪出内鬼！
dialogText.en: Yeah! And we'll definitely help nab the traitor!

dialogText.cn: 你们已经帮了很大忙了。接下来的行动，我们会继续推进。有新进展，我第一时间通知你们。
dialogText.en: You've already given us a ton of help. We'll move things forward from this point. I'll notify you once we make any progress.

dialogText.cn: 大家听我说——克劳老师委托终末地来进行这次调查，就是为了能够还原真相。
dialogText.en: Listen, everyone — Professor Crowe asked Endfield to support this investigation to help us reveal the truth.

dialogText.cn: 在管理员的帮助下，我们确实控制了三名嫌疑人，也掌握了部分证据。但现阶段，还不能草率定罪。联盟工团的制度从不是儿戏。
dialogText.en: We managed to detain three suspects with the Endmin's help. We have secured some evidence, but not enough to condemn anyone yet. We have to follow UWST procedures carefully.

dialogText.cn: 他们——联系外人、倒卖物资，他们已经背叛了联盟工团！
dialogText.en: Those people — they got involved with outsiders and sold off our supplies to fill their purses! They've betrayed the United Workers!

dialogText.cn: 我明白！我们都希望从严惩罚叛徒。可如果草率定罪，也无法告慰逝去的工友！
dialogText.en: I understand! We all want the traitors to be severely punished! But cursory trials and vigilantism are not justice! Our departed crew mates will not find rest in that!

dialogText.cn: 收起那些大道理吧，我的队员们还没安息呢！
dialogText.en: Keep your philosophies to yourself! None of my people departed in peace!

dialogText.cn: 袭击那天，他们没有一个人想着逃走！你还记得马克吗？
dialogText.en: When they attacked us, not a single member of my team abandoned their post! Remember Mark?

dialogText.cn: 他三个月前才刚订婚……他未婚妻现在还在特里格拉夫，天天在等消息……可我却——
dialogText.en: He just got engaged three months ago... His fiancée is still waiting at Triglava, hoping for news about him... But I just couldn't —

dialogText.cn: 尤里、伊万、安娜……我带过的每一个人，我必须给他们一个交代！
dialogText.en: Yuri, Ivan, Anna ... everyone I ever led — I must secure justice for their souls!

dialogText.cn: 对！不能放过叛徒！
dialogText.en: That's right! Death to the traitors!

dialogText.cn: 就是你们……
dialogText.en: You're the ones...

dialogText.cn: 肖娜，冷静些！
dialogText.en: Shawna! Calm down!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I...

dialogText.cn: 我必须替他们报仇！我发过誓的！
dialogText.en: I must avenge them! I took an oath!

dialogText.cn: ……你相信我？可我已经不知道能相信谁了……
dialogText.en: ...You believe in me? But I don't know who to believe in anymore...

dialogText.cn: ……如果是你说的，我信。
dialogText.en: ...If that's what you say, I trust you.

dialogText.cn: 真相与复仇……我想要的，只有这些。
dialogText.en: The truth and vengeance... Those are the only things I want.

dialogText.cn: 进度怎么样？
dialogText.en: Made any progress?

actorName.cn: 烦躁的工人{sm1l7m1-烦躁的工人}

dialogText.cn: 她用了硬件加密，连电路都改了。
dialogText.en: This is hardware-based encryption. She even changed the circuitry to achieve this.

actorName.cn: 烦躁的工人{sm1l7m1-烦躁的工人}

dialogText.cn: 我已经接入源石研究园主机，尝试暴力破解……但没有同型号设备，我们根本不知道她使用的这台终端机怎么响应信号。
dialogText.en: I've connected this to the Originium Science Park server and attempted brute force decryption... But we don't have a device of the same model or make ... so we don't know how this terminal of hers responded to the signal.

dialogText.cn: ……今天之内能有结果吗？
dialogText.en: ...Will we have anything by the end of the day?

dialogText.cn: 硬件加密……你们有没有保留旧型号的加密设备？哪怕是报废件？
dialogText.en: Hardware encryption... Do you have any older encryption device? Even broken ones might work.

dialogText.cn: 你是说——模拟它？
dialogText.en: Are you saying we could — emulate Yulia's device?

dialogText.cn: 我明白了！管理员利用源石技艺，模拟出同型号终端机！
dialogText.en: I got it! The Endmin's Originium Arts could emulate a terminal of the same model!

dialogText.cn: 就像之前修复损坏的电路那样。只要管理员能重建终端机的运行模式——我们就能跳过硬件加密，用源石技艺逼它“开口”。
dialogText.en: It's just like how we repaired the broken circuitry. Once the Endmin recreates the operational process of the terminal, we can bypass the hardware encryption and use Originium Arts to force it to "talk".

dialogText.cn: 这确实可行！
dialogText.en: This will definitely work!

actorName.cn: 烦躁的工人{sm1l7m1-烦躁的工人}

dialogText.cn: 需要用来模拟的旧型号加密设备交给我，剩下的就看你们了。
dialogText.en: Alright. I'll find the old model encryption device. The rest is in your hands.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，通信内容已经还原。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we've restored the call contents.

dialogText.cn: 我们已经看过了，她联络的对象不是碾骨氏族。
dialogText.en: We've read through them. The people she was talking to don't look like Bonekrushers.

dialogText.cn: 这是件好事，但就算没有泄露任何情报，尤莉娅的行为也是严重的违规行为。
dialogText.en: That's great. However, even though she didn't leak any intel, her actions are still considered a major infraction.

dialogText.cn: 你打算怎么处置她？
dialogText.en: How will you deal with her?

dialogText.cn: 我会将她移交安全局……接下来，她大概都得待在监狱里，配合安全局把通信另一头的人揪出来。
dialogText.en: I'm going to transfer her to the Security Bureau... She probably has to spend some time behind bars and work with SEC-B to reveal the identity of her callers.

dialogText.cn: 不是尤莉娅……那另外两个嫌疑人呢？有新线索吗？
dialogText.en: So it isn't Yulia... What about the other two suspects? Anything new about them?

dialogText.cn: 我设法联络上了那个中间人。她没察觉到我们的行动，还以为只是格奥尔基想继续交易。
dialogText.en: I found a way to reach the go-between. She seems oblivious to our investigation, and believes that she's still dealing with Georgi.

dialogText.cn: 格奥尔基已经约她在源石发电站西侧见面，如果能当场控制住她，就有机会得到真相。
dialogText.en: Georgi's already arranged a meeting on the west side of the Originium Power Plant. If we can nab her there, we might have a chance to get the truth.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，有你们在，我就放心了。
dialogText.en: Great. Having you around is giving me peace of mind.

dialogText.cn: 这次行动，我们必须成功。她……是证明格奥尔基是否是内鬼的关键线索。
dialogText.en: Failure is not an option for this operation. This go-between ... is key to proving if Georgi is the traitor.

dialogText.cn: 从通信内容看，交易和最近的四号谷地袭击事件无关，对方要的是二十年前的记录。而且尤莉娅回绝了他们。
dialogText.en: These call contents seem unrelated to the recent Incursion of Valley IV. The caller asked for records from twenty years ago, and Yulia turned them down.

dialogText.cn: 他们是谁啊？要源石大树爆炸时的通信记录干什么？
dialogText.en: Who are these people? Why do they want call records from when the Great Originium Oak blew up?

dialogText.cn: 那场爆炸轰动整个文明环带。据我所知，那次爆炸的未公开资料里，涉及了工团的机密设施分布与军事部署。
dialogText.en: That explosion shook the entire Civilization Band. From what I know, classified data from that event includes the locations of secret facilities and military deployment of the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 这么说……尤莉娅的叛徒嫌疑洗清了？
dialogText.en: Does that mean we ... proved that Yulia is not the traitor?

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: ……格奥尔基，你说过干完那一单就收手。
dialogText.en: ……Georgi, I thought you washed your hands of this after that last deal.

dialogText.cn: 我、我只是最近手头有点紧……
dialogText.en: I ... I'm a little short again...

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 你撒谎的时候，声音总会发颤——这次也不例外。
dialogText.en: Your voice quakes when you lie — This is no exception.

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 你不是一个人来的，对吧？
dialogText.en: I have a feeling you brought company, hmm?

dialogText.cn: 什么？我不是……
dialogText.en: Wha?! No, I didn't...

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 出来吧，潜地虬兽！
dialogText.en: Come out now, my tunneling nidwyrm!

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 天哪，连潜地虬兽都不是你们的对手……
dialogText.en: By Talos, even my tunneling nidwyrm is no match for you...!

dialogText.cn: 格奥尔基的货，之前都是卖给你吗？
dialogText.en: Are you the only buyer of Georgi's supplies?

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 账单你们不是拿走了吗？我的收货记录都在上面……
dialogText.en: I thought you seized the manifest. It's got everything about my incoming shipments...

dialogText.cn: 我没时间跟你废话。告诉我你知道的，不然我的铳就不客气了。
dialogText.en: I don't have time nor patience for a nice convo, woman. Tell me what you know or this piece of iron won't go easy on you.

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 等等——冷静点！你们想知道谁在跟裂地者来往，对吧？
dialogText.en: Hold on — Calm down! You wanna know who the Landbreakers' liaison is, right?

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 你们的运输队里有个叫阿尔乔姆的，他的亲兄弟几年前投靠了碾骨氏族。
dialogText.en: It's Artyom! Someone in your trucking crew! His brother joined the Bonekrushers several years ago.

dialogText.cn: 什么？！
dialogText.en: WHAT?!

dialogText.cn: 肖娜，冷静！
dialogText.en: Calm down, Shawna!

dialogText.cn: 我们需要证据。
dialogText.en: We need better evidence.

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 哼，阿尔乔姆和他弟弟碰头的照片，就在这里。
dialogText.en: Hur. I got a picture of Artyom meeting his brother here.

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 阿尔乔姆是四号谷地资格最老的运输司机，车队的活地图。
dialogText.en: Artyom is the most senior trucker in Valley IV. He's literally the walking map of your trucking crew.

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 为了和他做生意，我查了很长时间，最后拍到了他和裂地者的谈话。
dialogText.en: I had to do plenty of homework to get in touch with him for my business. I finally snapped a photo of him talking with the LBs.

actorName.cn: 警惕的女性{sm1l7m1-警惕的女性}

dialogText.cn: 有个裂地者管他叫哥哥……不用怀疑照片的真实性，我本打算拿这张照片“敦促”他合作，假的可不管用。
dialogText.en: One of those pipefaces called him brother... Now there's no need to doubt the authenticity of this photo. I was planning to use it to "coerce" him into backing my business. A fake photo would never work.

dialogText.cn: ……够了。我这就去找他算账！
dialogText.en: ...Enough! I'm going to settle my scores with him.

dialogText.cn: 至于你……你捡了一条命，你的命运将由安全局决定。
dialogText.en: As for you... Count yourself lucky I decided to let you live. SEC-B will determine your fate.

dialogText.cn: 肖娜？你——
dialogText.en: Shawna? What are you —

dialogText.cn: 闭嘴。你自己看，这照片上是不是你兄弟？你又跟他说了什么？
dialogText.en: Shut yer trap! Take a good look at this! Is that your brother? What did you tell him?

dialogText.cn: ……你在说什么？
dialogText.en: ...What are you talking about?

dialogText.cn: 没想到，你的亲弟弟居然是个裂地者！
dialogText.en: Talking about the unexpected, fool! Your own brother turns out to be a breaker!

dialogText.cn: 我们有人证和物证，别装傻了。
dialogText.en: So quit playing dumb! We already have the testimonies and hard evidence.

dialogText.cn: ……没错，弗洛里安是我弟弟。我们失散多年，我从没想过，最后会以这种方式见到他……
dialogText.en: ...You're right. I have a younger brother. Florian. He disappeared for several years, but I didn't expect to meet him again under such circumstances...

dialogText.cn: 我承认，我私下见过他。他变了——嗜血、偏激，嘴里只剩那个什么“头领”。
dialogText.en: I'll also admit that I met him in private. He's changed — into a bloodthirsty extremist who can't stop rambling about that boss of his.

dialogText.cn: 所以你承认了。你见过他，你和他接触过……是你出卖了情报。
dialogText.en: So you admit that you met and talked to him... You're the one who betrayed our intel to them.

dialogText.cn: 不！我没有泄密！
dialogText.en: No! I didn't leak anything!

dialogText.cn: 够了！我已经看够了……
dialogText.en: ENOUGH! I've tolerated you for too long...

dialogText.cn: 你是最后的嫌疑人。如果不是你，还有谁能出卖工团的情报！
dialogText.en: You're the only suspect. No one else could've sold UWST intel to the enemy!

dialogText.cn: 快！拦住她！
dialogText.en: SOMEONE! STOP HER!

dialogText.cn: 等等。
dialogText.en: Hold it.

dialogText.cn: ……动手吧。
dialogText.en: ...Do it.

dialogText.cn: 弗洛里安的尸体……就在那个中转站下面，就是你们找到我的地方。
dialogText.en: Florian... He's buried under the transfer station. The place where you found me.

dialogText.cn: 他已经死了？！
dialogText.en: He's already dead?!

dialogText.cn: 最后一次见面的时候，只有我们两个人。弗洛里安要敲碎我的膝盖，把我交给“头领”。他告诉我，他的同伴质疑他对氏族的忠诚，怀疑他要跟着我逃回工团。
dialogText.en: There were only the two of us when we last met. Florian wanted to smash my knees and hand me over to his boss. He said his breaker friends were suspicious of his loyalty to the clan — they thought he wanted out and planned to return to the UWST with me.

dialogText.cn: 所以他……必须向“头领”证明自己。
dialogText.en: So he ... had to prove himself to the boss.

dialogText.cn: 我们狠狠打了一架……我记得我夺过了他的刀。
dialogText.en: We had a hell of a fight... I remember seizing that blade of his.

dialogText.cn: 我……我只是想让他回来……
dialogText.en: I ... I just wanted Florian to be back with the crew...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，安全局的人到了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, the Security Bureau agents are here.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们已经做得够多了。
dialogText.en: You've done more than was expected of you, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 我会向安全局提交所有的线索和调查记录，他们会接管调查，直到找到真相。
dialogText.en: I'll submit every piece of evidence and investigation records to the Security Bureau. They will take over this case and find out what really happened.

dialogText.cn: 四号谷地已经失去了太多，不能再让“信任”也一起被摧毁。
dialogText.en: Valley IV has already lost too much. We cannot afford to let "trust" become another casualty.

dialogText.cn: 这段时间……谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: After all this time ... I'm just thankful that you're here with us.

dialogText.cn: 我劝他离开裂地者，我甚至说我可以……帮他回到工团，但他根本不听。
dialogText.en: I tried to persuade him to leave the Landbreakers. I even said I could help him ... return to the Syndicates, but he refused to listen.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你来了。
dialogText.en: You're here, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: ……还是被你看出来了。
dialogText.en: ...You saw through me again.

dialogText.cn: 这不是你的错……真相，从来都不肯轻易现身。
dialogText.en: It isn't your fault... The truth never reveals itself that easily.

dialogText.cn: 我今天请管理员来，其实没别的事……就是想亲口说一声谢谢。
dialogText.en: I asked to meet you here for a simple reason... I just wanted to say thank you in person.

dialogText.cn: 如果不是你的冷静和信任，我可能已经犯下无法挽回的错误。
dialogText.en: You kept your cool and trusted in me. Without you, I might have made a terrible mistake from which there would've been no turning back.

dialogText.cn: 可我还记得。谷地通道那一次，你在危急时刻出现。那时候我以为，没人会记得我们这些人。
dialogText.en: But I still remember that time at the Valley Pass. You showed up in the nick of time. I thought my crew mates and I had already been left behind.

dialogText.cn: 只是马克他们……就没那么幸运了。
dialogText.en: But Mark and the others ... they weren't so lucky.

dialogText.cn: 有时候我一闭眼，就能看见他们的脸。他们一点儿都没变，还是像往常一样笑着喊我“队长”。明明他们就在眼前，但只要我一抬手，想拉住他们……
dialogText.en: Sometimes, when I shut my eyes, I see their faces. It feels as though nothing has changed. They are so close, calling me their captain, but when I try to reach out to them...

dialogText.cn: 其实，还有一件事。我要离开这里了。
dialogText.en: And there's one more thing. I'm leaving the Valley.

dialogText.cn: 安全局最近在招人，我已经递了申请。
dialogText.en: The Security Bureau is hiring. I've submitted my application.

dialogText.cn: 不管要花多少年，我都要找到那个叛徒。不为别的，只为了我那些……再也回不来的工友。
dialogText.en: I don't care how many years it takes. I'll find that traitor. I'm doing this for one reason only ... for my crew who will never be coming back.

dialogText.cn: 如果有那一天，我会第一时间告诉你。
dialogText.en: When that day comes, you'll be the first to know.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，保重。
dialogText.en: Farewell, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 安格鲁跟我说了，是尤莉娅的事，对吧？
dialogText.en: Angro told me. It's about Yulia, right?

dialogText.cn: 我真心希望这是一场误会。我们是同一批进工团的，干了快十年了。
dialogText.en: I hope this is just a misunderstanding. We joined UWST in the same crew. The two of us have worked together for almost a decade.

dialogText.cn: 快十年？那她应该是技术骨干了吧！
dialogText.en: Almost a decade? That means she's one of your technical leads, right?

dialogText.cn: 尤莉娅技术过硬，这点没得说。但她……太孤僻了。在工团，我们的多数工作都需要集体协作。
dialogText.en: It goes without saying that Yulia is a skilled technician. But she ... she's too much of a loner. Most work in the UWST requires us to function as a proper crew.

dialogText.cn: 通信支持部门也给过她机会，可她一个人把事情搞砸了，还咬定是有人故意整她。
dialogText.en: The Communication Support Department gave Yulia a chance, but she tried to solo the job and screwed up. She took it very badly and even claimed that someone was out to get her.

dialogText.cn: 我不是为她辩护。只是……她一直觉得自己被其他工人排挤在外。
dialogText.en: I'm not trying to defend Yulia, but ... she's convinced that the rest of the crew is ostracizing her.

dialogText.cn: 我听她吐过不少苦水，有时候喝了点酒，她就会说很多……但要说通敌，我还是很难相信。
dialogText.en: I heard her complain a lot. Sometimes, when she got a little too tipsy, she'd start blabbering nonsense... She even said something about working for the enemy. Even then, I found that hard to believe.

dialogText.cn: 不过，你们放心，我会把知道的一切告诉你们，不会有任何隐瞒。
dialogText.en: But you don't have to worry about anything from me. I'll be completely open. I'll tell you everything I know.

dialogText.cn: 尤莉娅最近有什么可疑的动向？
dialogText.en: Has Yulia been acting strange lately?

dialogText.cn: 工作时间规律，通信内容也干干净净。可就在袭击发生前几天，她访问了四号谷地的长程通信记录库。
dialogText.en: Her shift hours look normal. Call contents look clean. But she accessed the Valley IV long-range radio logs just a few days before the attack.

dialogText.cn: 我查了一下，记录库里少了一段时间的通信记录……她删掉了什么，我查不到。
dialogText.en: I reviewed the logs and found that all comm records within a certain time frame are missing... She deleted something, and I lost my trail.

dialogText.cn: 自己手动删通信记录？这也太可疑了。
dialogText.en: Comm records? Did she delete them manually? That's really sus.

dialogText.cn: 是啊……可惜她清理得很干净，我完全没法还原数据。
dialogText.en: Yeah... And it was a really clean removal. I can't even restore the data.

dialogText.cn: 你留着长程通信记录库的终端机吗？管理员说不定能还原数据。
dialogText.en: Do you still have the terminal carrying the long-range radio logs? The Endmin can probably restore the data.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！终端机就在我这里，跟我来！
dialogText.en: Great! I do have that terminal. Follow me!

dialogText.cn: 安格鲁，发生什么事了？
dialogText.en: What happened, Angro?

dialogText.cn: 终末地的各位？太好了，这么快就来帮忙，辛苦你们了。
dialogText.en: My Endfielder friends! Wonderful, you've arrived quickly enough to help us out! Thank you.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，总算把你们等来了。这位好好先生离了你们就不会做事了，只会念叨什么“流程”“证据”。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I'm glad help has arrived. Mister Goody Two-Shoes can't do anything without his Endfielder friends. All he cares about is procedure or evidence.

dialogText.cn: 内部调查不是儿戏……克劳老师让我们联系终末地，就是为了让调查更加严谨。你是知道的！
dialogText.en: An internal audit is not to be trifled with... Professor Crowe was the one who asked us to contact Endfield for a better and more thorough investigation. You know why they have to be here!

dialogText.cn: 稍等一下，你们是在为什么事情争执？
dialogText.en: Hold on. What are your exact disagreements?

dialogText.cn: 就是眼下要做的事。虽然官方说法是调查近期的失职行为，但越来越多的工人已经猜到我们真正想查什么了。
dialogText.en: How to carry out the task at hand. Officially, they called it an investigation into recent instances of professional negligence. But more and more of the crew mates have guessed what we're really after.

dialogText.cn: 当然会猜到了。碾骨氏族能进犯供能高地，总不会是因为运气好吧？肯定是这边有人接应。
dialogText.en: Of course they know what's going on. I don't think anyone believes the Bonekrushers got lucky when they invaded the Power Plateau. They definitely had inside help.

dialogText.cn: 直觉上这么想无可厚非，可我得看证据，不然这次调查根本无法收场。
dialogText.en: It's natural to arrive at such conclusions. But I need to see some proper evidence to conclude this investigation.

dialogText.cn: 调查……得了吧，你是在等罪犯主动招供吗？
dialogText.en: Investigation...? Forget it. The way you're handling it, you're practically waiting for the criminals to step forward and own up.

dialogText.cn: 原来是在抓内鬼啊。所以，你们已经有目标了？
dialogText.en: Oh! So you're trying to dig around for traitors? Do you already have someone in mind?

dialogText.cn: 我做了一些初期工作，已经锁定了两个嫌疑人。
dialogText.en: I did my homework and I've got my eyes set on two suspects.

dialogText.cn: 那你为什么迟迟不行动？他们现在还在四号谷地里乱逛！
dialogText.en: So why aren't you doing anything? These criminals are still running free in Valley IV!

dialogText.cn: 克劳老师反复叮嘱，要慎重行事。而且他特别交代，必须要做到能服众才行。
dialogText.en: Professor Crowe has told us, repeatedly, to step lightly and act with caution. He also reminded us that the operation must be seen as fair and credible by the entire crew.

dialogText.cn: 所以……各位，这场调查需要你们的协助。
dialogText.en: This is why ... we'll need your help in this investigation.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们该怎么做？
dialogText.en: What should we do, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 太好了，我这就把<@qu.key>档案</>同步到你们的终端。
dialogText.en: Awesome. I'll sync your terminals with the <@qu.key>files</>.

dialogText.cn: 我们得快一些了，不能让叛徒总是抢先我们一步。
dialogText.en: We must act quickly. We can't let the traitors stay one step ahead of us.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的各位，四号谷地的安危托付给你们了，我先说一句谢谢。
dialogText.en: Alright, my Endfielder friends, the safety of Valley IV rests upon your shoulders. You have my sincere thanks in advance.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，拜托了！
dialogText.en: I'm counting on you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，我们需要更多线索和证据。
dialogText.en: No matter what, we need more evidence and clues.

dialogText.cn: 尤莉娅是四号谷地的长程通信技术员。她在供能高地干了好些年，负责多处通信设备的运行维护，熟得不能再熟了。
dialogText.en: Yulia's the long-range comms technician of Valley IV. She has worked at Power Plateau for quite a few years and is in charge of operating and maintaining all comms equipment at multiple sites. She's one of our most experienced crew mates for this job.

dialogText.cn: 若是她真有别的打算，要泄露情报，干扰通信……都不难。
dialogText.en: If she had plans to leak intel or disrupt our comms channel ... she could pull them off really easily.

dialogText.cn: 她现在还在破碎边界的通信设备那儿正常工作，我没惊动她。她的上司季米特里是我的人，你可以找他了解一下情况。
dialogText.en: She's still on her job as usual, taking care of the comms facilities at the Shattered Fringe. I haven't alerted her. Her superior, Dmitry, is my man. Talk to him for details about the sitch.

dialogText.cn: 格奥尔基，源石发电站的物资调度员，几个月前才调来四号谷地。他负责的是发电站的物资调配，表面上是个新手，但岗位敏感。
dialogText.en: Georgi's in charge of stock redistribution at the Originium Power Plant. He got assigned to Valley IV just several months ago. The man takes care of supplies allocation at the plant. Looks like a greenhorn, but his post is a rather sensitive one.

dialogText.cn: 他知道大部分储藏点的分布情况，不过权限有限，接触不到保密等级更高的储藏点。
dialogText.en: He knows where most of the stashes are, but since his authority level is limited, he wouldn't know the locations of higher level storage facilities.

dialogText.cn: 目前，他在协助重建指挥部协调物资。我们的人已经盯紧了他，这回他没机会再动手脚。
dialogText.en: Right now he's coordinating supplies allocation at the Reconstruction Headquarters. My people got their eyes on him. I don't think he has any chance to mess around anymore.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！有任何需要随时联系我。
dialogText.en: Great! Call me if there's anything you need.

dialogText.cn: 像是四号谷地的各个通信设备的节点位置、权限分级、系统开关，她都了如指掌。
dialogText.en: She's super familiar with every comms node in Valley IV, and that includes their locations, authority levels, and system switches.

dialogText.cn: 我查看了调配清单和出库清单，他负责的储藏点里有一部分物资不翼而飞了。从数量上看，不像是正常损耗。
dialogText.en: I've checked the tables for goods allocation and outgoing supplies. I found some missing supplies from the stashes he's in charge of. The quantities do not look like standard losses to me.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，好久不见。
dialogText.en: It's been a while, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 再次感谢你在谷地要塞救了我一命。
dialogText.en: I gotta thank you again for saving my life back at the Valley Fort.

dialogText.cn: 但……当务之急，是把工团里的内鬼揪出来。
dialogText.en: But ... we desperately need to identify and arrest the traitors in the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 一想到叛徒还隐藏在我们中间，我就觉得不寒而栗……害死了这么多工友，还能跟没事人一样。
