dialogText.en: The thought of the traitors still walking amongst us gives me the shivers... Their betrayal killed so many fellow crew mates. I wonder how they sleep at night.

dialogText.cn: 尤莉娅和格奥尔基的嫌疑都很大！依我看，现在应该马上把他们控制起来！
dialogText.en: Yulia and Georgi are the prime suspects! If I had my way, I would have them arrested at once!

dialogText.cn: 安格鲁是个好人，但他太优柔寡断了。现在是特别时期，我们承担不起更多损失了。
dialogText.en: Angro is a nice guy, but he's also indecisive. These are tough times, and we can't afford to suffer any more losses.

dialogText.cn: 我们对外宣称是在调查袭击发生期间一般意义上的失职行为。
dialogText.en: We publicly described the audit as a formal investigation — specifically for acts of standard professional negligence that occurred during the attack.

dialogText.cn: 但说实话，特殊时期，这类行为在不造成严重后果的情况下，也不需要调查到人尽皆知的地步。
dialogText.en: But truth be told, even in a time like this, such negligence shouldn't warrant an investigation with this much publicity — especially if it didn't result in any major problems.

dialogText.cn: 工人们很容易看出端倪。更糟糕的是……已经有人开始互相猜忌了。
dialogText.en: The crew mates know how to read the signs. The worse thing is ... people are starting to get suspicious of each other.

dialogText.cn: 所以我们才要抓紧行动，耽搁不得！
dialogText.en: That's why we can't afford to delay! We must move quickly!

dialogText.cn: 调查内鬼这件事如果处理不好，对工团而言不亚于再遭受一次“袭击”。
dialogText.en: If we fail to properly handle this investigation of traitors, the results could be just as devastating as another attack on the UWST.

dialogText.cn: 拜托了，管理员！
dialogText.en: We're all counting on you, Endministrator!

dialogText.cn: 通信必须尽快恢复，干扰源排查列为一级优先！所有数据直接走加急流程送重建指挥部！
dialogText.en: We must restore the comms channels. Primary priority is identifying sources of interference! All data must be sent directly to the Reconstruction HQ using the emergency procedure!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？还有……几位都来啦。好吧，换个地方说。
dialogText.en: Endmin? And ... your team is here. Okay. Let's talk somewhere else.

dialogText.cn: 别碍事，没见我正在忙吗？
dialogText.en: Stop getting in my way. Can't you see I'm busy?

dialogText.cn: 你是尤莉娅吗？
dialogText.en: Are you Yulia?

dialogText.cn: 是我，怎么了？有事快说，耽误了我的工作进度，上面又要怪罪我！
dialogText.en: Yeah. So what? If you got something to say, spit it out. The boss is going to blame me if my work gets delayed.

dialogText.cn: 没什么……你忙吧。
dialogText.en: Just carry on... We're alright.

dialogText.cn: 到头来还不是得我顶上？
dialogText.en: I always end up having to clean up someone's mess.

dialogText.cn: 恢复了！正在重建缓存文件……通信记录找到了。
dialogText.en: It's been restored! Reconstructing cache documents and files... There! That's the comm records.

dialogText.cn: 这些记录……数量太密集了，连续几天，每晚都有发送行为。
dialogText.en: These logs... The data volume is way too high. Something is sent every evening over the course of several days.

dialogText.cn: 通信地址……不在四号谷地，是外部节点，走的是特殊的自适应跳频技术。这种规避手段……
dialogText.en: Call destinations are ... not in Valley IV. They're nodes outside the region. Data packs were sent with a special auto-adaptive frequency jumping technology. Such detection avoidance measures...

dialogText.cn: 能调取通信内容吗？
dialogText.en: Can we access the call contents?

dialogText.cn: 不行，全是加密流。结构复杂，不是通用协议。这种方法……她不是第一次用了。
dialogText.en: No. They've been encrypted. Data structure is complex and not included in any standard protocol. This wasn't ... the first time she used it.

dialogText.cn: 这么看……她的嫌疑很大！
dialogText.en: That means ... she's super sus!

dialogText.cn: 但我们还不能下结论。
dialogText.en: We can't jump to conclusions yet.

dialogText.cn: 问题是……她可能已经察觉到终端机被动过。接下来很难再拿到新证据了。
dialogText.en: The problem is ... Yulia likely knows that someone's been looking at this terminal. We probably won't get any new evidence out of it.

dialogText.cn: 她去其他地方支援了，不过这会儿应该回来了，我带你们去找她！
dialogText.en: Yulia's gone to support another site, but she should be back by now. I'll take you to her!

dialogText.cn: 季米特里！你跑哪儿去了？爆破组的人刚刚找你找疯了！
dialogText.en: Dmitry! Where did you go? The demolition crew is running all over the place looking for you.

dialogText.cn: 现在这种节骨眼，你也敢擅离职守？你这负责人怎么当的？
dialogText.en: How could you leave your post at a moment like this? I don't understand why they made you the one in charge.

dialogText.cn: 这位是终末地的管理员，这位是佩丽卡监督，还有陈千语干员……他们找你，有些事要问。
dialogText.en: This one here is the Endministrator of Endfield Industries. This is Supervisor Perlica, and that one is Operator Chen... They got a few questions for you.

dialogText.cn: 找我？我不过是个普通技术员，能犯什么事？
dialogText.en: For me? I'm just an ordinary technician. What could I do?

dialogText.cn: 还是说——你又出事了，想拉我垫背？这一套我见得太多了，季米特里。
dialogText.en: Did you — mess things up again? Are you forcing me to take the blame? I've seen this way too often, Dmitry.

dialogText.cn: 别这么说。配合调查对你有好处，也是对工团负责。
dialogText.en: Stop putting it like that. Cooperate with the investigation. It'll help you ... and the UWST as well.

dialogText.cn: 调查我？我在这破地方干了八年，每天风吹雨淋，连信号断点都是我一个人顶过来——现在出事了，先把我推出去？这就是“规矩”？
dialogText.en: Investigation? Me? I've slogged in this backwater for eight friggin' years through storm and rain. I even soloed that signal outage and fixed it — But now, when the blight hits the fan, you decide to blame me for everything? I guess pinning everything on Yulia is our latest rule.

dialogText.cn: 那你解释一下——袭击前，你和四号谷地外某个未备案节点反复联系，还是全程加密。你怎么说？
dialogText.en: Then you better explain this — Right before the attack, you made multiple calls to an unregistered comms node outside Valley IV. Your calls are also fully encrypted. What do you have to say about this?

dialogText.cn: 那是我的私人通信！你们凭什么翻我的记录？安全局授权了？
dialogText.en: That's my private call! How dare you flip through my records? Did the Security Bureau authorize this search?

dialogText.cn: 你真觉得我会背叛？你忘了当年你连终端机系统都不会操作，是谁帮你的？现在转头咬我？
dialogText.en: You really think I'd betray the UW? Forget things much? You didn't even know how to use the terminal OS back then. Guess who taught you that? And now you're biting the hands that helped you?

dialogText.cn: 我不想吵。我只说一句：如果你清白，那就解开加密。
dialogText.en: I'm not here to argue. I'll keep it simple: Undo the encryptions and prove your innocence.

dialogText.cn: 我拒绝！
dialogText.en: I refuse!

dialogText.cn: 你说什么？
dialogText.en: What did you just say?

dialogText.cn: 我，尤莉娅，塔卫二全联盟工团驻四号谷地通信技术员。我在四号谷地服务了八年六个月，出事我也没逃。你们现在没证据，就想让我自证清白？
dialogText.en: I'm Yulia, a comms technician stationed in Valley IV facility of the United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II. I served in the Valley for eight years and six months, and I didn't even run for it when the crisis hit us. And now you want me to prove my innocence without bringing any hard evidence to the table?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，抱歉……我搞砸了。
dialogText.en: Apologies, Endmin... I've messed everything up.

dialogText.cn: 至少我们有通信日志，足够安格鲁分析一阵了。
dialogText.en: At least we acquired the comms log. Angro will have plenty of materials to analyze for a while.

dialogText.cn: 我会帮忙解密这些通信内容，只是……可能需要些时间。
dialogText.en: I'll help decrypt the call contents, but ... this might take some time.

dialogText.cn: 尤莉娅，在结果出来前……你被停职了。这不是针对你，而是为了四号谷地的安全。
dialogText.en: Yulia, your duties have been suspended as we wait for the results... This isn't just about you. We're doing this for the safety of Valley IV.

dialogText.cn: 呵，说得真好听。可惜我早就明白了，在这地方，没人会替我说话。
dialogText.en: Hah. That's a nice way to put it. Unfortunately, I'm very much aware that nobody in this blighted place would defend me.

dialogText.cn: 唉……管理员，佩丽卡监督，你们先去忙。我会把她带去见安格鲁。
dialogText.en: Ugh... Endmin, Supervisor Perlica, just carry on with your tasks. I have to bring her to Angro.

dialogText.cn: 明白！
dialogText.en: Roger that!

dialogText.cn: 这批货不多，我一个人就能盯——重建指挥部那边也还忙不过来……
dialogText.en: This batch isn't really big. I can keep my eyes on it alone — The Reconstruction HQ is way too busy anyways...

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{sm1l7m1-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 克劳先生说了，每一批物资的交接必须经过两个部门的核对，记录要完整，流程不许省。
dialogText.en: Mr. Crowe said delivery and receiving must be verified and validated by two departments. All records must be properly taken. And no skipping of the procedure.

dialogText.cn: 可这样效率会很低……三级储藏点以前都——
dialogText.en: But this will slow things down... When I handled the level three stashes, we —

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{sm1l7m1-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 执行就是了，交接单一式三份，马上填。
dialogText.en: Get on with it. Complete the supplies delivery and receiving form. And remember, the form is a triplicate.

dialogText.cn: 谁是负责记账的格奥尔基？
dialogText.en: Who's Georgi, the one in charge of logging the records?

dialogText.cn: 是、是我……请问有什么问题？
dialogText.en: That would be me... Do we have a problem here?

dialogText.cn: 我是终末地的监督佩丽卡，这位是管理员，还有陈千语干员。
dialogText.en: We are. I'm Perlica, Supervisor of Endfield Industries. This is the Endministrator and Operator Chen.

dialogText.cn: 我们来找你，是因为联盟工团委托我们调查四号谷地袭击事件中，工团内部的失职行为。
dialogText.en: We're here because the UWST commissioned us to investigate internal acts of professional negligence during the Valley IV Incursion.

dialogText.cn: 你管理的储藏点在裂地者袭击四号谷地期间，频繁出现账目异常、物资失踪的情况。说吧，什么原因？
dialogText.en: When the Landbreakers attacked Valley IV, frequent counts of abnormal records and missing supplies were found in the stashes you managed. Care to explain why?

dialogText.cn: 这、这……我不知道，可能是系统出错了。
dialogText.en: Wha... I ... uh ... I don't know. Maybe something was wrong with the system.

dialogText.cn: 就算是系统出错导致了账目异常，那失踪的物资你怎么解释？这个和系统没关系吧。
dialogText.en: System error might help explain the accounting issues, but what about the missing supplies? I don't think that was caused by system errors.

dialogText.cn: 那……也许我调错了仓！供能高地储藏点太多，流程太复杂，可能是我记混了！
dialogText.en: Well ... maybe I allocated stuff to the wrong stash! There are just too many stash locations in the Power Plateau. The procedure is also a mess. Maybe I remembered and punched the numbers wrong!

dialogText.cn: 好、好……跟我来。
dialogText.en: Oh, okay... Follow me.

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{sm1l7m1-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 格奥尔基，你鬼鬼祟祟地是要干什么？
dialogText.en: Georgi, why are you sneaking around? What are you doing?

dialogText.cn: 您、您还在呀？我还以为检查已经结束了……
dialogText.en: Wha ... you're still here?! I thought the investigation had ended already...

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，我这储藏点，看起来还算整洁吧？
dialogText.en: What do you think? This stash looks pretty tidy, right?

dialogText.cn: 什、什么？管理员……这种话可不能随便说。
dialogText.en: Wow, what?! Oh come on, Endmin... You can't be serious.

dialogText.cn: 我们找到了你这里异常流失的货物，你有什么想解释的吗？
dialogText.en: We've found evidence of supplies going missing from this stash. Wanna try explaining that?

dialogText.cn: 你、你说的是……你们真的看到……
dialogText.en: Are ... are you trying to say that ... that you actually saw...

dialogText.cn: 我们还有监控作证。
dialogText.en: We have acquired the monitoring logs for evidence.

dialogText.cn: 晚上？晚上……哦对，晚上送货去矿脉源区的车有时候会晚到。现在又有宵禁，要是车到的时候我不在，货就运不了。
dialogText.en: Night? Oh ... yeah. Night-time deliveries to Origin Lodespring have made the trucks arrive late. And we got this curfew now. If I'm not around when the truck arrives, we can't deliver the goods.

dialogText.cn: 你加班送的货，最后出现在裂地者手里。怎么解释？
dialogText.en: So, how do you explain that the night-time batch of supplies ... ended up with the Landbreakers?

dialogText.cn: 裂、裂地者？不、不可能……
dialogText.en: Land ... landbreakers?! That's ... that's impossible...!

dialogText.cn: 我不知道……我真的不知道……我确实有……我确实缺钱……
dialogText.en: I don't know ... I don't know anything, I swear... I ... I admit that I'm a little short on money...

dialogText.cn: ……是她找上我的。她说绝对不会被发现……
dialogText.en: ...She found me first. She said the operation would be completely waterproof...

dialogText.cn: 是谁？裂地者吗？
dialogText.en: Who is she? A Landbreaker?

dialogText.cn: 不，不是……她说自己是“做小生意的中间人”，如果想要赚点外快，就找她。
dialogText.en: No, she's not... She calls herself a go-between with a small business. Anyone looking for some quick bucks on the side would talk to her.

dialogText.cn: 我只是把快要过期的罐头交给她，我真不知道她会把东西给裂地者……
dialogText.en: I just gave her canned provisions that were about to expire... I never knew she would give them to the LBs...

dialogText.cn: 还有一个问题。阿尔乔姆——你接触过他吗？
dialogText.en: One more question. Artyom — have you talked to him before?

dialogText.cn: 他是运输队的老前辈，资历比我深。我知道他，但是——
dialogText.en: Artyom? He's an old veteran of the trucking crew. He's got way more years than me. I know him, but —

dialogText.cn: 你运的这批货，他有没有插手？
dialogText.en: Was he involved in this delivery of yours?

dialogText.cn: 我不清楚……真的不清楚。我从头到尾只联系过那个中间人！别的我什么都不知道！
dialogText.en: I don't know ... I really don't know! The only one I talked to was that go-between! I'm in the dark about anything else!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请你相信我。我不是叛徒。我只是……犯了错……
dialogText.en: Endmin, you gotta believe me! I'm not a traitor ... I just ... made a mistake...
I —

dialogText.cn: 都这个点了，我……刚准备下班……
dialogText.en: Oh, it's getting pretty late. I, uh ... just got off my shift...

actorName.cn: 严肃的工人{sm1l7m1-严肃的工人}

dialogText.cn: 调查完成之前，哪儿都不许去。
dialogText.en: No one's going anywhere until the investigation is over.

dialogText.cn: 我总不能把货堆在这儿不管，只要是车晚到的时候，就得留下来加班处理。
dialogText.en: I can't just let the supplies sit around this place. If the trucks arrive late, I gotta work overtime and get the cargo out.

dialogText.cn: 打扰一下，这里是不是有位叫阿尔乔姆的运输员？
dialogText.en: Excuse me. Is there a trucker named Artyom here?

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督？各位怎么来了……
dialogText.en: Supervisor Perlica? And you brought your team...

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 我是运输队的队长，阿尔乔姆平常跟我们一组。你们找他做什么？
dialogText.en: I'm the leader of this trucking crew. Artyom is usually assigned to our team. Why are you looking for him?

actorName.cn: 散漫的工人{sm1l7m1-散漫的工人}

dialogText.cn: 你们要找他？不容易。最近他干完活就消失，一天到晚不跟人打交道。
dialogText.en: Won't be easy looking for Artyom. Recently, he's just been disappearing right after his shift and avoiding people for the rest of the day.

dialogText.cn: 但他的卡车昨晚驶出了停车场，还是在宵禁时段哦。
dialogText.en: But his truck drove out of the parking lot last night. During the curfew, actually.

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 怎么可能？运输任务都安排在白天，晚上我会把车辆的权限关闭——
dialogText.en: Impossible. All delivery jobs are scheduled during the day. I would even switch off vehicle access for the night—

actorName.cn: 散漫的工人{sm1l7m1-散漫的工人}

dialogText.cn: 锁车流程还是阿尔乔姆教你的，对吧？锁车权限，他也有。他可是这里资历最老的工人，你忘了？
dialogText.en: Artyom was the one who taught you how to lock down the vehicles, right? I bet he's got the same authorization. Don't forget. He's the oldest guy in the crew.

actorName.cn: 散漫的工人{sm1l7m1-散漫的工人}

dialogText.cn: 你们在调查什么？他不会……和那件事有关吧？
dialogText.en: What are you after, really? Is he ... involved in that thing?

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 问那么多干嘛！车蜡到了，去把人叫上来搬货！
dialogText.en: You got too many questions, boy! The vehicle wax has arrived. Holler at the crew and get the stuff moving!

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这事可能真不简单。我得立刻联系安格鲁。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this might be more complicated than we thought. I have to inform Angro at once.

dialogText.cn: 安格鲁？他也通知了你有关调查的事？
dialogText.en: Angro? Did he tell you about the investigation?

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 是的，前段时间通知说要查失职行为的时候，他让我留点心。
dialogText.en: Yes. Back when we got notified about the investigation on professional negligence, he asked me to keep an eye out for things.

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 阿尔乔姆是这里的老前辈，我真不相信……
dialogText.en: Artyom is a very respected veteran of the crew. I can hardly believe this...

dialogText.cn: 你就从没注意过他的异常？
dialogText.en: Didn't you notice anything unusual about him?

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 我们运输队平时吃住都在一起，感情很好。但最近……阿尔乔姆确实有点躲着人。
dialogText.en: My trucking crew eat and live together. We're like family, you see. But recently ... Artyom has been avoiding the rest of us.

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 唉……在发电站西南方，有个<@qu.key>废弃的中转站</>，他时不时就会一个人去那里散心。你们可以去那里找找线索。
dialogText.en: There's an <@qu.key>abandoned transfer station</> southwest of the Power Plant. Artyom occasionally goes there to blow off some steam. Maybe you can check out that place.

actorName.cn: 热心的工人{sm1l7m1-热心的工人}

dialogText.cn: 明白，我会取消今天的任务，留人在这边。找到他之前，我们都不会离开。
dialogText.en: Understood. I'll cancel the jobs for today and get the crew glued to this post. Nobody's leaving till Artyom is found.

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 终末地的人……？难道这次的大规模故障真的是被你们解决了……
dialogText.en: Endfielders...? Were you really the ones who fixed this large-scale malfunction...?

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 那你们……还真是厉害……
dialogText.en: You... You're really good...

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 和我这种庸人不一样……我这辈子估计都搞不懂那些什么技术源码吧……
dialogText.en: You're so different from mediocre people like me... I'll probably never figure out those technical source codes...

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 什么？梦？
dialogText.en: What? A dream?

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 机器人……也会做梦吗？呵，我都不会做梦了，机器人却还会吗……真是讽刺……
dialogText.en: Do robots ... dream as well? Heheh. I don't even dream anymore. And yet the robots do... How ironic...

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 算了，今天干脆早点回去睡一觉吧……说不定能梦见什么呢……
dialogText.en: That's that. I might as well sleep early tonight... Maybe I'll dream of something...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 你们……是不是你们？！把这一切都毁了……都毁了……
dialogText.en: You...! WAS IT YOU?! You ruined everything... EVERYTHING...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 这下我的研究怎么办……还有我梦中的技术革新……
dialogText.en: My project is finished... And so is the technological revolution I've dreamed about...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 怎么可能……这简直……
dialogText.en: How could that be possible...? That's just...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 等等……等等等等！梦？难道说……那个自发行为实际上是……
dialogText.en: Hold on... WAIT! A dream, you said? Does that mean ... those autonomous actions are actually...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 我懂了！我懂了！是我一直搞错了！记录仪……不……笔……得马上记下来……都记下来……
dialogText.en: OH! I GOT IT! I had read it all wrong! I gotta get a datalogger ... No... A pen! I gotta jot this down right now ... gotta jot everything down...

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 管理员、佩丽卡监督，你们来得正好，我才把这次事件的相关报告整理完……
dialogText.en: Endmin and Supervisor Perlica, you came at the right time. I just finished drafting a report about this incident...

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了。我们想了解一些更具体的情况，比如：你们提到的那些故障机器人，现在都在哪里？
dialogText.en: Much appreciated. We would like to learn more about the details. For example, where are all the broken robots you just mentioned?

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 噢，它们目前全躲在附近的一处废弃平台上，离这里不远。
dialogText.en: Oh, they're all hiding at an abandoned platform not too far from here.

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 我们最开始还派了技术员过去检修，结果刚修好没多久，它们就又开始报错了……简直没完没了。
dialogText.en: At first, we dispatched a technician to perform check-ups and repairs. But these robots started reporting errors soon after... And this just kept going on and on forever.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，情况似乎比想象中复杂……去现场看看吧。
dialogText.en: Hmm. The situation sounds a little more complicated than I thought... Time for a field investigation.

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 对了，这是我们用来监测机器人状态的设备，管理员，佩丽卡监督，你们把它带上吧。
dialogText.en: Oh, I just remembered. This is a device we use to monitor the robots' condition. I think you should carry it with you, Endmin and Supervisor Perlica.

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 上面配置了最新的定位系统，说不准能帮上你们。
dialogText.en: And the device is also furnished with our latest geo-positioning system. I hope it can help you out.

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 给我站住！想跑……也等我把维修记录登记好了再跑！
dialogText.en: STOP! If you're gonna run ... at least let me confirm and register your repair log!

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: ……终末地的人？来这里干什么？
dialogText.en: ...Endfielders? Why are you here?

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 等等，难道你们就是头儿之前在通信里说的……打算来解决这次大规模故障的“专家”？
dialogText.en: Wait. Are you the ones my boss mentioned in that message earlier...? We were told we've got some pros to handle this epic-scale breakdown.

dialogText.cn: 是的，我们就是为此而来的。
dialogText.en: Yes. We are here to handle that issue.

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 哦，那你们自己过去吧……反正那些坏了的玩意儿都在那边。
dialogText.en: Okay. You can just head over that way... All the broken bots are there anyhow.

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 有什么要我关心的？我就是个不得不修这些铁块，再反复看它们继续故障的倒霉蛋……
dialogText.en: Why should I care? I'm the unlucky wooster forced to repair these metal boxes ... and see them break down again...

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 就算你们真的解决了故障又怎样……我不过就是换个地方继续修罢了，顶多修的东西新鲜点。
dialogText.en: So even if you actually solve this malfunction ... they'll only assign me to repair stuff at another place. Maybe I'll get to fix something different, but that's about it.

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 对了，之前来支援的几个高级技术专家，也想解决这茬麻烦，结果一个都没成功。
dialogText.en: By the way, we've previously hired quite a few high-level tech experts to handle this problem. None of them have succeeded.

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 你们看……不管修好多少次，只需要这么点时间，它们就又回到了之前的状态，不会有任何变化……
dialogText.en: Look ... no matter how many times you fix them, it only takes a few minutes before they revert and malfunction again. Nothing ever changes...

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 就像……我的工作一样。
dialogText.en: It's just like ... my entire job.

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 毫无意义的修理，毫无意义的工作，毫无意义的人生……但那又怎么样呢？
dialogText.en: The repair job is meaningless ... the career is meaningless ... and my life is meaningless... So what?

actorName.cn: 工团技术员{sm1l7m2-工团技术员}

dialogText.cn: 学会告诉自己“就这样吧”，才是最正确的。
dialogText.en: Just gotta convince yourself to let things be. That's the only way to go about it.

dialogText.cn: 这个数量……难怪工团的物流会受到影响。
dialogText.en: Just look at all these robots... No wonder the UWST is facing significant logistics issues.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，需要尽快找到故障的根源才行。或许可以从这些机器人身上残留的数据入手？
dialogText.en: Indeed. We must quickly identify the source of these errors and malfunctions. Perhaps we can start by going through the local data fragments on the robots.

dialogText.cn: 那么管理员，等下就由你来提取数据，我则负责分析数据……
dialogText.en: Alright, Endmin, you'll extract the data and I'll analyze it...

dialogText.cn: 我相信，即使这些机器人真的“一成不变”，我们也可以从中找到些许“改变”的可能。
dialogText.en: Even though these robots may seem "completely unchanged", we might be able to locate possibilities of "change" within them.

dialogText.cn: 要是我像莱昂叔叔那样，会给小朋友治病就好了……
dialogText.en: If only I were as good as Uncle Leon and knew how to cure little children...

dialogText.cn: 说不定就能帮到你了……
dialogText.en: Maybe I'll be able to help you out...

dialogText.cn: 不、不是的……我只是想帮帮小灰……
dialogText.en: No. Not really ... I just wanna help Gray-Gray...

dialogText.cn: 它好像很不舒服……一直红红的，没什么精神……大家都让我别管它……说它已经坏掉了……
dialogText.en: Gray-Gray doesn't look too good... It's showing red text and looks really sad... Everyone told me to ignore it... They said it's broken...

dialogText.cn: 可是……它帮我把娃娃送回来了……妈妈留给我的娃娃……所以，我也想帮帮它……
dialogText.en: But ... Gray-Gray found my little doll... The one that mama gave me... So I'm going to do what I can to help Gray-Gray...

dialogText.cn: 别担心，我们也是来帮它的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. We're also here to help it.

dialogText.cn: {F}真的吗？！那、那就拜托你了！戴面具的大姐姐！{M}真的吗？！那、那就拜托你了！戴面具的大哥哥！
dialogText.en: {F}REALLY?! Th-then I'm counting on you, Lady Mask! {M}REALLY?! Th-then I'm counting on you, Mister Mask!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们！谢谢你们帮了小灰！
dialogText.en: Thank you so much for helping Gray-Gray!

dialogText.cn: {F}偷偷告诉你噢，大姐姐。其实……我觉得小灰就没有坏，它之前会那样，只是……只是没找到自己想做的事！{M}偷偷告诉你噢，大哥哥。其实……我觉得小灰就没有坏，它之前会那样，只是……只是没找到自己想做的事！
dialogText.en: {F}I've got a secret for you, Lady Mask. I ... actually don't think Gray-Gray's broken. It was acting up because ... it couldn't find things that it likes to do! {M}I've got a secret for you, Mister Mask. I ... actually don't think Gray-Gray's broken. It was acting up because ... it couldn't find things that it likes to do!

dialogText.cn: 现在它肯定找到了！正在……正在，唔，像丽露老师说的——“实现自己的梦想”！
dialogText.en: But Gray-Gray has found it now! And it's ... it's, uhm... "fulfilling its dreams", just like what Miss Liru said.

dialogText.cn: 我会给它加油的！
dialogText.en: I'll be rooting for it!

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……难道是我研究的方向不对……
dialogText.en: Why did this happen...? Did I take the wrong approach...?

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 那当然！我已经把它们的所有行为变化都记录下来了！一条都没漏！
dialogText.en: Of course! I've logged all behavioral changes of these robots! Every single action!

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 只要回去搭好模型，很快就能再次进行深入分析了……我的方向肯定没错……
dialogText.en: Once I head back and create the model, we'll be able to conduct deep analysis... My approach is 100% foolproof...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 你们就等着看我在《环塔科学周刊》上发表的新论文吧！
dialogText.en: Just you wait! My new paper will soon be published on the TGCC Science Weekly!

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: ……你们是谁？这里正在进行重要的人工智能研究，搞不好就是一次技术革新！外行人就不要来凑热闹了。
dialogText.en: ...Who are you? We're running an extremely important AI project at this site! This might be the beginning of a technological revolution! Untrained personnel should keep themselves out.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，还是去看看其他机器人的情况吧。
dialogText.en: No. But let's check on the other robots.

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 已经确定是自发行为……接下来，就差最关键的运行情况验证了……哼，等到验证完成，就是跨时代的巨大发现！到时候，商会的那些老学究都得高看我们工团一眼！
dialogText.en: I've verified these actions to be autonomous in nature... Now for the most crucial step of operational verification... Hurhur. Once I get this verified, I'll have the greatest discovery of this era! In my hands! The old eggheads at TGCC will have no choice but to bow to us! The UWST!

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 唔？怎么没反应？难道是我的思路不对？没道理啊……
dialogText.en: Huh? No reaction. Maybe I adopted the wrong approach. This makes no sense at all...

dialogText.cn: 型号和反馈信号跟之前我们查看过的机器人都很相似……
dialogText.en: The model and feedback signals seem rather similar to the robots we recently checked...

dialogText.cn: 我们接到了工团的委托，来处理这里机器人大范围故障的情况。
dialogText.en: We've received a UWST commission. Our job is to handle the large-scale robot malfunctions in this area.

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 原来是约翰他们找来的外援……哎，我都说了别放人进来，他们怎么……算了，你们要查就查吧……
dialogText.en: I guess John et al. got the outsiders involved... And I specifically told them not to. How could they... Ugh. Forget. If you wanna take a look, go ahead...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 那边几个随你们挑，别碰我手边这台就行！
dialogText.en: Feel free to take a look at those units over there. Just don't touch this one next to me!

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 还是不行……问题到底出在哪里呢……不会是模块损坏了吧？
dialogText.en: It's still not working... Where is the problem...? Did it burn through the module?

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 啊？那些还不够你们调查的吗？
dialogText.en: What?! I thought those units over there would keep you busy for a while.

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 都说了，就这个机器人不能给你们！它是我好不容易找到的特殊个体！和那些普通的运输机器人不一样！万一被你们碰坏了……
dialogText.en: I've told you already you can't touch this particular unit! It's a special entity that took me a long time to identify! This isn't your ordinary logistics robot! If you break it...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 好吧……小心点啊！手脚千万放轻点！要是出了差错，你们可得负责……
dialogText.en: Fine... But be careful! Also, be gentle! If anything goes wrong, I'll hold you responsible...

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 竟、竟然真的启动了？你们怎么做到的？
dialogText.en: You ... you actually rebooted the robot?! How?

actorName.cn: 工团技术专家{sm1l7m2-工团技术专家}

dialogText.cn: 这、这是怎么回事？难道是新的自发行为？不行！我得记录下来，马上记录下来！
dialogText.en: What ... what's happening? Is this a new autonomous action? No! I must record this! Immediately!

dialogText.cn: 不排除这个可能……或许，这张图片也是指令的一部分。
dialogText.en: That is a possibility we should not rule out... Perhaps the projected image is part of the command.

dialogText.cn: 而根据前面获得的数据，接收到这条指令的机器人会重置优先级，并无视之后的所有命令……
dialogText.en: According to the data we previously acquired, any robots receiving this specific command will reset the priorities of their executables. They would then ignore all other commands received afterwards...

dialogText.cn: 是的。但指令给出的坐标与它指定的目的地却似乎存在矛盾……
dialogText.en: Yes. But the coordinates given by the command seem to conflict with the designated destination...

dialogText.cn: 所以机器人们即使到达了指定坐标，也无法抵达目的地，最终引发了连续报错……
dialogText.en: So, even when the robots reach the coordinates marked by the command, they would not be able to reach the said destination. This resulted in a string of constant malfunctions...

dialogText.cn: 没错，必须弄清楚那条指令的真正含义……不然我们就无法探明机器人故障的原因……
dialogText.en: That's right. The actual meaning of the command must be acquired... Otherwise, we won't be able to identify the actual cause of the robots' malfunctions...

dialogText.cn: 我们之前尝试过，并不能在短时间内搜索到对应的发信频段……
dialogText.en: We tried it before. Its duration is too short for us to identify the frequency range of signal emission...

dialogText.cn: 可惜它的存储与执行模块都受损了……几乎没什么能用于分析的数据……
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, its storage and execution modules are damaged... There is hardly any data we can analyze...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这确实不像是它本地存储的数据内容……但我不认为这是纯粹的自发行为。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this action does not seem to be based on data from its local storage... However, I do not believe the action is entirely autonomous in nature.

dialogText.cn: 你给它装了……定位和图像输出的功能模块？
dialogText.en: Did you just furnish it with ... functional modules for positioning and image output?

dialogText.cn: 原来如此。让接收到信号的机器人来定位，再由它告诉我们结果……这确实是个好办法。
dialogText.en: This might just work. Let the robot receiving the signals conduct positioning and feed us the resulting coordinates... A very effective solution.

dialogText.cn: 似乎是……一张地图。
dialogText.en: This looks like ... a map.

dialogText.cn: 地图上标记的位置……应该就是发信者的所在地了。
dialogText.en: The marked location on the map... It should be where the sender is.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，去这里看看吧。
dialogText.en: Let's go there and take a look, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 那是……
dialogText.en: What is this...?

dialogText.cn: 等等，难道我们找的发信者……
dialogText.en: Wait, does this mean the sender we're looking for...

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事……解析之后，它的数据几乎只剩下了乱码……
dialogText.en: What happened...? After decrypting the data, all that's left is a bunch of garbled code...

dialogText.cn: 就好像被重新编写了一遍……
dialogText.en: It's like everything has been rewritten...
{F}(A sea of flowers...?){M}(A sea of flowers...?)

dialogText.cn: 它已经彻底停止运作了……要将它带走吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: It has completely shut down... Should we bring it with us, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: （总觉得，在哪里见到过……）
dialogText.en: {F}(It feels familiar. Where have I seen this...?){M}(It feels familiar. Where have I seen this...?)

dialogText.cn: （就是……这里吗？）
dialogText.en: {F}(Is this ... the place?){M}(Is this ... the place?)

dialogText.cn: ……管理员？管理员？！
dialogText.en: ...Endmin? ENDMIN?!

dialogText.cn: 管理员？你怎么了？哪里不舒服吗？
dialogText.en: What happened to you, Endmin? Are you feeling any pain?

actorName.cn: 来源不明的机械音{sm1l7m2-物流机器人}

dialogText.cn: 遭受……破坏……即将……停止……
dialogText.en: ...Suffered ... damage ... is ... shutting...

actorName.cn: 来源不明的机械音{sm1l7m2-物流机器人}

dialogText.cn: 好……温暖……看见了……花……好多花……
dialogText.en: Temperature ... is warm... Visuals of ... flowers ... many flowers...

actorName.cn: 来源不明的机械音{sm1l7m2-物流机器人}

dialogText.en: Come — here — please.

actorName.cn: 来源不明的机械音{sm1l7m2-物流机器人}

dialogText.en: Come — here — please.

actorName.cn: 来源不明的机械音{sm1l7m2-物流机器人}

dialogText.cn: 这里是……终点……到这里来……真好……真美……
dialogText.en: This is ... the very end... Come here, please... It's comfortable ... and beautiful...

dialogText.cn: 转码成功了！记录的内容是……
dialogText.en: Decryption success! The recorded data is...

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 管理员！佩丽卡监督！真是幸亏有你们帮忙！我们的运输机器人已经全都恢复正常了！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Supervisor Perlica! Thank you so much for helping! All of our logistics robots are working properly again!

dialogText.cn: ……那就好，也辛苦你们了。
dialogText.en: ...That's good to hear. You did well.

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 这……不就是二十多年前的那片花田吗？当时就种在这里……
dialogText.en: Wait... Isn't this the sea of flowers from over twenty years ago? It was planted right here...

dialogText.cn: 二十多年前？
dialogText.en: Over twenty years ago?

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 是啊，当初……我们把从塞梦珂带来的花种种在了这里，作为工团人扎根在这片土地上的见证……后来便形成了一片花田。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Back then ... we planted a small bed of flowers we brought from Simonch. It witnessed how the United Workers raised our facilities at this very site... Eventually it became a sea of flowers.

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 可惜几年前为了完成扩张，最后还是将这里的花田移栽到了别处，修了这个仓库……
dialogText.en: But then we had to expand our site several years ago. In the end, the sea of flowers was moved somewhere else ... just so we could make room for this depot...

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 这些运输机器人在当时也只是刚投产不久，它们的制造站就建在对面。
dialogText.en: It was also the time when we started manufacturing these logistics robots. The production line was right opposite this place.

actorName.cn: 工团物流负责人{sm1l7m2-工团物流负责人}

dialogText.cn: 型号更老一点的，还是在这附近完成的第一次启动……哎，说不定，它们醒来见到的第一处风景，就是那片花田呢……
dialogText.en: In fact, the oldest models were first activated near here... Huh. The first scene they saw after activation was probably that very same sea of flowers...

dialogText.cn: 对它们而言，那一定是一场好梦。
dialogText.en: It must have been a beautiful dream for them.

dialogText.cn: 无论如何，“故障”已经解决。管理员，我们的工作也告一段落了。
dialogText.en: Regardless, the issue of "malfunctioning" robots has been resolved. This should conclude the commission, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 哇！是你们呀！
dialogText.en: Ah! It's you!

dialogText.cn: 对了对了！差点忘了告诉你们！虽然不知道是什么原因，但小灰和小灰的朋友们都变得更有精神啦！
dialogText.en: Oh! Before I forget, I must tell you something! I don't know why, but Gray-Gray and its friends are now lively again!

dialogText.cn: 原来是这样！啊……真是好美丽的梦啊……要是我做了这样的梦……肯定也会想找到这个地方，去看看这片花田的！
dialogText.en: A dream?! Oh... It must have been a beautiful dream... If I had a dream like that ... I'd totally go look for the place, and see the sea of flowers!

dialogText.cn: {F}戴面具的大姐姐，你说以后小灰它们还会做新的梦吗？新的梦里又会有什么景色呢？我好想看一看呢……{M}戴面具的大哥哥，你说以后小灰它们还会做新的梦吗？新的梦里又会有什么景色呢？我好想看一看呢……
dialogText.en: {F}Lady Mask, will Gray-Gray and its friends get a new dream? What will they see in it this time? I really want to see it too... {M}Mister Mask, will Gray-Gray and its friends get a new dream? What will they see in it this time? I really want to see it too...

dialogText.cn: 哇！
dialogText.en: WHOA!

dialogText.cn: 我……有些丢人……唉……你们知道南边那片吃人的林子吗？
dialogText.en: I, uh... It's kinda embarrassing... Oh well... Heard about that man-eating grove to the south?

dialogText.cn: 吃人的林子？
dialogText.en: Man-eating grove?

dialogText.cn: 就是那片会动的竹林。新上任的巡林员前几日失踪了，派去找他的天师也没再回来……
dialogText.en: Yeah. That grove with the moving bamboo. The new forest ranger assigned to that place disappeared a few days ago. The Tianshi dispatched to find the forest ranger went missing too...

dialogText.cn: 对，竹林虫我们打过交道，放心跟着我们就是了。难不成还能比天使可怕？
dialogText.en: Yep. We've dealt with grovenymphs before. Just stick with us. I don't think they're any worse than Aggeloi.

dialogText.cn: 感谢！太感谢了！
dialogText.en: Oh! Thank you so much! You are the best!

dialogText.cn: 需要帮忙吗？
dialogText.en: Need a hand?

dialogText.cn: 还好，还好是人！……万幸还是你们几位！
dialogText.en: Thank Talos it's people...! And boy am I glad to see you!

dialogText.cn: 他们大概都被竹林虫吃了吧！如今我也难逃——
dialogText.en: The grovenymphs probably devoured them! And now they're gonna eat me too!

dialogText.cn: 还有这事儿？竹林虫还吃人？
dialogText.en: What?! REALLY? Grovenymphs actually eat people?

dialogText.cn: 吃人的！我知道你们不信那种故事，但我一直深信不疑。不然，那些失踪的人都到哪儿去了？！
dialogText.en: THEY DO! I know you find it hard to believe, but I am absolutely certain. It's the only explanation for why people go missing!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我想……唉，算了，不好这样。巡卫的职责就是……硬着头皮上吧，逃不了……
dialogText.en: Endmin, I'm thinking if... Ugghhhh... Never mind. Shouldn't say it. A watchguard must uphold his duties... Ah, to hell with all this. I can't run away now...

dialogText.cn: 时间到了，我得去当班了。人固有一死，心一横眼一闭……
dialogText.en: My shift is around the corner. And so is death, probably. Everyone dies. I shall strengthen my resolve and face mine with dignity...

dialogText.cn: 不如……我们陪你去吧！
dialogText.en: Maybe ... we can ... you know, tag along?

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？！
dialogText.en: REALLY?!

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？！
dialogText.en: REALLY?!

dialogText.cn: 再见了，各位。
dialogText.en: Farewell, my good people.

dialogText.cn: 阿青，别担心，我们只是来打听消息的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Qing. We're only here to ask a few questions.

dialogText.cn: 筏子坏了，我正在帮度渡修，不然他去不了<@qu.key>迷踪林</>了。
dialogText.en: The raft is down. I'm helping Dudu with the repairs. He can't reach the <@qu.key>Stragglers Grove</> on a broken raft, you know.

dialogText.cn: 咦，怎么都要上那儿去？
dialogText.en: What? He's going to the grove as well? Why?

dialogText.cn: 洪泥说去那边挖虫笋，两天了也没回来。不知道是不是出了什么岔子……
dialogText.en: Two days ago, Hong Ni told me he was headed there to dig for nymphsprouts. But Hong hasn't returned. I don't know if he's in trouble...

dialogText.cn: 寨民应该很熟悉迷踪林才对……
dialogText.en: But I thought the people of the Stockade would know the grove really well...

dialogText.cn: 熟悉归熟悉，可是我们又不傻。加上阮哥千叮咛万嘱咐过，<@qu.key>迷踪林</>太危险，没人爱上那儿去……
dialogText.en: We know it well enough to avoid doing stupid stuff. Big Bro kept warning us about the dangers of <@qu.key>Stragglers Grove</>. No one likes to go there...

dialogText.cn: 我们来搭把手，修快点儿，好进林子。
dialogText.en: We should help. Let's fix this up quickly to get to the grove.

dialogText.cn: 武陵的巡卫大人，来我们这儿有何贵干？
dialogText.en: So, Lord Watchguard from Great Wuling. What brings you here to our humble little hamlet?

dialogText.cn: 欸，他也是跟你们一起的？
dialogText.en: Oh. So the badge is with you?

dialogText.cn: 对，我、我不挑事，你们别紧张。
dialogText.en: Y-yeah, I... I'm not here to start trouble, no need to be nervous.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，阿青，你在这儿忙什么？
dialogText.en: Heheh. Anyways, Qing, you seem to be busy with something.

dialogText.cn: 又有人失踪了？！你们看，我说得没错吧！
dialogText.en: Another one?! See! I told you I was right!

dialogText.cn: 这人咋咋呼呼的，在说什么呀？
dialogText.en: Why is this badge so loud? What's he even on about?

dialogText.cn: 只有洪泥这死心眼。他一走，这竹筏就坏了，唉……希望不是不吉利的预兆……
dialogText.en: Well, no one except for Hong Ni the stubborn fool. And the raft broke right after he went. Ugh... I hope this isn't a bad omen...

dialogText.cn: 啊，谢谢你们。材料就在那边，辛苦了。
dialogText.en: I'll really appreciate that. The materials are over there. Thanks for helping out.

dialogText.cn: 青芜让你们来的？材料带来了吗？
dialogText.en: Did Qingwu ask you to come here? Did you bring the materials?

dialogText.cn: 要现在就出发吗？
dialogText.en: So, shall we set off?

dialogText.cn: ……我看看，没错，数量正好！
dialogText.en: Let me see... Yeah. Exactly what I need!

dialogText.cn: 李惴，你嘴唇都吓白了……
dialogText.en: Li Zhui, you look super pale...

dialogText.cn: 没事没事，我准备好了，不能怂！
dialogText.en: No, I'm fine. Ready as I can ever be! No backing out now!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢……太感谢了。
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you... Saved my life, you really did.

dialogText.cn: 多亏了你们……我先前在这里找路，结果没想到踩空了。这里平时几乎没人过来，补给包也快用完了，我还以为这回真完蛋了！
dialogText.en: Thank Talos you're here... I was trying to get back to the trail when I stepped into a pit. Hardly anyone comes to this place and I was running out of supplies. Almost thought this was the end of me!

dialogText.cn: 你、你不就是巡林队的晏林嘛！我还以为你被竹林虫吃掉了……
dialogText.en: Aren't you Yan Lin the forest ranger?! I thought the grovenymphs ate you...

dialogText.cn: 吃掉？啥？李惴，你又在胡说啥呢？
dialogText.en: Ate me? Really? You spouting nonsense again, Li?

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈！那种故事只有小孩子才会相信呢。
dialogText.en: Man, don't tell me you actually believe in those stories. They're meant to scare kids! HAHAHAHA!

dialogText.cn: ……哈、哈哈！就是嘛……差点儿唬到我了……
dialogText.en: Heheh... Yeah, right...! Almost got me there for a second...!

dialogText.cn: 不过最近这些虫子是有些不正常。以前它们的移动都有规律可循，如今杂乱无章的！要我说，都是沧贼搞的鬼！
dialogText.en: Still ... these grovenymphs have been acting weird lately. Their movements used to be predictable, but now? Total chaos! I smell a conspiracy. By the river pirates!

dialogText.cn: 沧……寨民？他、他们应该不会……
dialogText.en: River pirates...? You mean the people living in the Stockade. But they wouldn't...

dialogText.cn: 要不是他们，这好好的竹林虫，怎么会突然狂躁起来？
dialogText.en: Yeah. It must be the bloody pirates. They're why these bamboo buggers got all bothered and angry!

dialogText.cn: 其实，清波寨那边也有寨民失踪……他们总不会害自己人吧？
dialogText.en: But someone from the Stockade went missing as well... Why would they make life that difficult for themselves?

dialogText.cn: 呃……欸，你们看那边的东西。
dialogText.en: Uh... Hey. What's that over there?

dialogText.cn: 那是……老型号的核心，一般里面配有三个<@qu.key>需水方块</>。现在都在储备站地下堆着，已经没人用了。
dialogText.en: That ... looks like an old core. They're usually furnished with 3 <@qu.key>hydrocubes</>. We got plenty of these underground at the Field Logistics Depot. No one uses them any more.

dialogText.cn: 上轮巡查它还好好的……怎么突然坏了？
dialogText.en: Well, the core was running properly when I last made my rounds... How did it get busted like this?

dialogText.cn: 何况你也说了，这是老型号，本来就容易出故障。唉，它一坏，竹林就起动静。
dialogText.en: Besides, you said it yourself. An old core. That means they're prone to breakdown. I guess that must have triggered the entire grove.

dialogText.cn: 是……是……竹林虫显灵了吧……
dialogText.en: Th-this... this has to be the grovenymphs' doing...!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，你别吓唬自己！大概就是哪个沧贼手欠。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Stop scaring yourself! I know what this looks like. Sabotage. By the blighted river pirates!

dialogText.cn: 唔，不知道这样虫子会不会安分些。
dialogText.en: Hmm. I wonder if this would get the bamboo bugs to simmer down.

dialogText.cn: 所以，这竹林虫动起来到底有什么规律，是什么原理啊？
dialogText.en: So, you mentioned something about grovenymphs and their predictable movements. How does that work?

dialogText.cn: 我、我听说……竹林虫饿了，就会找活物吃掉……
dialogText.en: I ... I heard about grovenymphs moving like a swarm when they need to feed... And they prefer living prey...

dialogText.cn: 都说了那是故事嘛，依我看，是水土的问题！武陵水多，渗入土壤，又有侵蚀潮，这些虫子就被水带着动来动去……
dialogText.en: Come on, we told you those were just stories! Honestly, it's gotta be the water. Wuling's got too many rivers, the soil's soaked. Plus the Blight Tide on top of that, you get bugs that ride the flow...

dialogText.cn: 这是生态吗？和土、竹子有关，这是“土木”吧？
dialogText.en: Ecological? I say it's based on the earth and bamboo. It's geo-planto-logical, okay.

dialogText.cn: 算啦算啦，反正我也不懂，基础课程我早就忘光了！
dialogText.en: Ah, whatever. It's not like I get it anyway. Flunked my basic science courses ages ago!

dialogText.cn: 这东西，看上去是这样的，那就权当是这样得了！总比小孩子听的故事要真嘛。
dialogText.en: Look, if it seems like that's how it works, then let's just go with it! At least it makes more sense than those kids' scary stories!

dialogText.cn: 唔，不管这事里到底有什么学问，我们还是先找人吧。
dialogText.en: Uhm. Okay. Why don't we set aside the hard sciences for now and ... look for the missing people?

dialogText.cn: 那跟我来！虽然那些沧贼把这里搅和得乱了套，但我这巡林员，怎么也比你们熟悉地形。
dialogText.en: Then follow me! Those river pirates really made a mess of this place, but I'm a forest ranger. And that means I know this place way better than any of you!

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>这个总控台上有三个灯</>……一明两暗，是因为我们刚才修好了一个核心？
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>There are three lights on the control panel</>... And only one of them is on. Is it because we repaired one of the cores?

dialogText.cn: 没错，这些都是核心对应的指示灯。
dialogText.en: That's right. These are activity indicator lights for the three cores.

dialogText.cn: 说、说不定是死人留的……
dialogText.en: Oh man, what if ... they were left by victims?!

dialogText.cn: 你别成天自己吓自己啦！
dialogText.en: Can you please stop scaring yourself!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们赶紧扫描一下脚印，说不定他们人就在附近。
dialogText.en: Endmin, let's scan the footprints. Maybe they're nearby.

dialogText.cn: 那没亮的灯……
dialogText.en: So those that aren't on...

dialogText.cn: 说明还有两台没好。
dialogText.en: Means that we need to activate two more.

dialogText.cn: 哈……好在有这张纸片儿。不知道是哪个好心人留下的。
dialogText.en: Okay... Well, thank goodness we found these instructions. Wonder who's kind enough to do that.

dialogText.cn: 对呀，也许就是我们要找的洪泥或者失踪的天师呢。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Maybe Hong Ni did this. It could also be the missing Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 啥，你们要去迷踪林？去不成喽，竹筏坏了！
dialogText.en: Heading to the Stragglers Grove? Good luck with that. The raft is busted!

dialogText.cn: 听我一句劝，你们也别去，那竹林最近不安生。连洪泥都丢那儿了，别添乱了。
dialogText.en: Take my advice, don't even go. That grove ain't right lately. Even Hong Ni got lost in there. Don't push your luck.

dialogText.cn: 不管啥事儿，要去迷踪林就得靠这艘<@qu.key>竹筏</>了。
dialogText.en: Regardless, you'll need this <@qu.key>raft</> to reach the Stragglers Grove.

dialogText.cn: 沧贼！好哇，武陵禁止你们在这林子里打秋风，你们就存心来捣乱是吧……我才不信你们这些邪门鬼道的家伙是来挖虫笋的！
dialogText.en: Damn pirates! Wuling banned you leeches from waylaying travelers here, so now you're just here to cause trouble?! As if I'd buy your "oh we're just digging sprouts" crap!

dialogText.cn: 什么……你不要栽赃陷害！我洪泥说什么做什么，从来不骗人！
dialogText.en: Wha— How dare you frame me like this?! Hong Ni never lies! What I say is what I do, straight as a bamboo pole!

dialogText.cn: 先、先别急，万一有什么误会呢？
dialogText.en: Let's not jump to accusations. Maybe there's a misunderstanding.

dialogText.cn: 我也正在纳闷怎么出不去呢！
dialogText.en: Oh, yeah! I've been trying to figure out how to leave this place!

dialogText.cn: 唉，以前阮哥就教我，咱们清波好汉来这林子里面办事得守规矩，得敬着这竹林……竹林也敬着我们，一直好好的。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Big Bro taught me that all good fellows of the Stockade must respect the grove... And the grove will respect us in return. That's how we got along.

dialogText.cn: 可这回，我就出来挖个虫笋，居然遇到了一条从来没见过的路！真出怪事了！
dialogText.en: But for this nymphsprout dig, I found myself stumbling into a path I've never seen before! This ain't natural at all!

dialogText.cn: 水池边的那个东西，不是你们弄坏的？
dialogText.en: Did you break the thing next to the pool?

dialogText.cn: 欸！那是武陵的物什吧？阮哥怎么没和我说过这个？
dialogText.en: Oh? This looks like some Wuling contraption. Big Bro never told me about this.

dialogText.cn: 这好端端的竹林，都被搞乱了！
dialogText.en: And why is this machine even here? It's messing up with this piece of beautiful nature!

dialogText.cn: 照你的意思，这竹林虫乱动都赖武陵的天师？
dialogText.en: I guess you're blaming the Wuling Tianshi for the misbehaving grovenymphs?

dialogText.cn: 哼，我看是你们心在乱动！
dialogText.en: Hurr. Accusations? You look pretty guilty. Bet you're hiding something!

dialogText.cn: 还是快把那武陵的冒犯东西关了吧！你们不打扰这片土地，竹林就正常了！
dialogText.en: I say we switch that Wuling gizmo off! Right now! The grove will return to normal once you Wulingers quit trying to change this turf!

dialogText.cn: 你们武陵那帮天师坏得很！肯定想搞什么大动作，要把手伸到这边来！
dialogText.en: The dastardly Tianshi of Wuling are plotting some major schemes again! Oooh. They're trying to get their dirty hands on our turf!

dialogText.cn: 你怎么开始帮他们说话了？
dialogText.en: Hey, since when did you start siding with pirates?

dialogText.cn: 你这沧贼，胡说什么呢……
dialogText.en: Come on, pirate, stop making up random accusations...

dialogText.cn: 呼、呼……总算解决了！多亏你们及时赶到……
dialogText.en: *Hoo* ... *haa*... It's finally over! Thank Talos you got here on time...

dialogText.cn: 西壹号核心也修好了，失踪人员还差一个没找到。
dialogText.en: Core W1 is up and running. And we just need to look for the last missing person.

dialogText.cn: 天师？我先前看到个人影往南山去了，不过怎么叫都没反应，我还以为见着鬼了呢！
dialogText.en: Tianshi? I saw a figure headed to South Hill. Hollered as loud as I could but it just ignored me. Maybe it's a ghost!

dialogText.cn: 南山……那得找个竹筏过去。
dialogText.en: South Hill... We need a raft to get there.

dialogText.cn: 你们是……？
dialogText.en: Who are you...?

dialogText.cn: 语轩天师！原来你在这里！
dialogText.en: Tianshi Yuxuan! Turns out you're here!

dialogText.cn: 咦，你们很熟吗？
dialogText.en: Oh. You know each other?

dialogText.cn: 嗯！之前我很怕龙泡泡，语轩天师帮我讲解了一下那个东西，从此我就安心了……
dialogText.en: Yeah! I used to be terrified of Chubby Lungs. Fortunately, Tianshi Yuxuan explained to me what they really are. Now I'm totally at peace...

dialogText.cn: ……你连龙泡泡都害怕啊？
dialogText.en: ...Chubby Lungs? Seriously?

dialogText.cn: 总之，语轩天师，能找到你真是太好了！这竹林虫究竟是怎么了？为什么突然如此躁动？
dialogText.en: Er, okay. Anyway, I'm so glad we found you at last, Tianshi Yuxuan! Can you tell us what's happening to these grovenymphs? What's making them so aggravated and upset?

dialogText.cn: 照我看，只是因为那个<@qu.key>定波器</>坏了而已。
dialogText.en: From what I see, I'm fairly certain the issue stems from a broken <@qu.key>fixed wave emitter</>.

dialogText.cn: 定波器……？
dialogText.en: Fixed wave emitter...?

dialogText.cn: 是的。武陵早在二十年前安扎科考站的时候，就开始研究竹林的运动了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. When Wuling started building the Science Station twenty years ago, they started observing and recording grove activities.

dialogText.cn: 生物研究组做了很多数据、实验分析。甚至有猜想，认为是塔罗斯的重力活动间接影响了这片竹林的生态。
dialogText.en: The bio research team acquired plenty of data and test results. Some even hypothesized that grove ecology is indirectly influenced by the gravitational activities of Talos.

dialogText.cn: 当时他们联合了其他科研组，最终找到了几组特殊波频，能够显著影响竹林虫的行为。其中一种似乎可以安抚竹林虫，让它们不至于常常受惊。
dialogText.en: The team then started working with other research groups. Eventually, they identified several frequency bands that exert significant changes to grovenymph activities. One of the bands actually pacified the bugs and made them less jumpy.

dialogText.cn: 后来，天师们根据在定波器上取得的成果，安装了能够精确引导竹林虫行为的“引导灯”——你们来时已经用过很多次了吧？
dialogText.en: The Tianshi used the results from the fixed wave emitter project and developed guiding lights. These newer devices could direct grovenymph activities with pinpoint accuracy — You probably used them a few times before coming here, right?

dialogText.cn: 唉，听到有人失踪，我就想到可能是这个东西坏了。
dialogText.en: Oh well... When I heard that people went missing, a malfunctioning emitter was the first thing that came to mind.

dialogText.cn: 其实，只要把三台核心修理好，等总控台恢复了正常显示，再去小岛上重启定波器——
dialogText.en: All you need to do is fix the three cores, make sure the control panel is working properly, then reset the fixed wave emitter at the islet —

dialogText.cn: 不行，定波器虽然有些年头了，但还有自己的作用。假如侵蚀潮淹没这里，我们还可以通过定波器“刺激”竹林虫，赶它们去避难。
dialogText.en: That won't work. The fixed wave emitter might be old, but it still serves a function. If the Blight Tide floods this place, we can use the emitter to "excite" the grovenymphs and direct them to safety.

dialogText.cn: 原、原来是这样啊……
dialogText.en: Huh... that's it?

dialogText.cn: 怎么了吗？阿惴？
dialogText.en: Li, are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 没……没什么！我们这就把这些需水方块归位……
dialogText.en: Ye-yeah, I'm ... I'm alright! So we'll get those hydrocubes back to their places...

dialogText.cn: 经过验证，特殊波频和他们研发的定波器确实有效。不过那也是十几年前的事了，这些装置比这城还老呢。
dialogText.en: They verified their hypothesis via field testing. The special frequency band and the fixed wave emitter they developed really worked. But these tests took place more than a decade ago. The contraptions are even older than the city itself.

dialogText.cn: 吃人？你们在说什么？竹林虫没有食人的习性，不都辟过谣了嘛。要多听科普啊！
dialogText.en: Eat people? What nonsense are you spouting? Grovenymphs don't have carnivorous habits. That rumor was debunked ages ago! Maybe listen to some actual science for once!

dialogText.cn: 生态规律？这倒是有点儿接近。
dialogText.en: Ecological patterns? That sounds pretty close to what's actually happening.

dialogText.cn: 武陵……嗯，可能寨民们对武陵还是有些误解。这块地方，武陵只是按需解决问题，不会干涉寨民的合法处置的。
dialogText.en: Oh well... Stockade residents tend to have their misunderstandings about Wuling. When it comes to problems in the grove, we focus on legal measures that won't interfere with the locals' livelihood.

dialogText.cn: 听起来是有点儿麻烦，但它们环环相扣，是一个完整的系统。只有全部重启一遍，才能让竹林恢复正常。
dialogText.en: Yeeeaah, I know it sounds really complicated, but every step is necessary. We're talking about an entire system. The whole setup must be restarted to restore normalcy to the grove.

dialogText.cn: 咦，既然是出故障的旧设备，为什么不直接拆掉呢？
dialogText.en: Wait. If the thing is really old and broken, why don't you just dismantle it?

dialogText.cn: 之后我会向庄管代提交申请，保证定波器得到维护。
dialogText.en: I'll also be submitting an application to Viceroy Zhuang after this. I must make sure that the emitter is properly maintained.

dialogText.cn: 前人的成果也好，竹林虫这个物种也罢，他们的研究价值可大着呢。
dialogText.en: The research is old and grovenymphs are simple bugs. But they will offer plenty of scientific value.

dialogText.cn: 真妙，真妙！
dialogText.en: A true work of art and wonder!

dialogText.cn: 语轩天师，在夸什么？
dialogText.en: Ooh. You seem pretty impressed, Tianshi!

dialogText.cn: 这造物，复古又精美，还给人一种……很温柔的感觉。
dialogText.en: Looking upon the craft, an artifice of traditional and intricate aesthetics. It feels ... so warm and gentle.

dialogText.cn: 感觉……竹林安静了一些。
dialogText.en: The grove ... is gaining its peace.

dialogText.cn: 嗯？有变化吗……
dialogText.en: Hmm? Not really sensing anything, but sure...

dialogText.cn: 哪里传来的歌声……？
dialogText.en: Is someone humming a song...?

dialogText.cn: 哎，你们刚才有没有听到什么奇怪的动静？像是路通了的声音……
dialogText.en: Erm, did you hear something strange? Sounds like a path has just been opened...

dialogText.cn: 快快快，我们过去找找。
dialogText.en: Really?! We gotta look for it! Go, go, go!

dialogText.cn: 哈，灯全都亮了！
dialogText.en: Hahaha! All the lights are on!

dialogText.cn: 莫非……是世外高人？
dialogText.en: Are you a ... secret hermit master?

dialogText.cn: 老人家，可以让一下吗？我们要修设备，您到旁边去歇会儿吧。
dialogText.en: My dear lady, can you kindly let us through? There's a broken machine that needs to be repaired. How about we set you up nearby?

dialogText.cn: 这人怎么不回话呢！你们武陵的人，比我们还没规矩！
dialogText.en: Friggin' hell. Is she playing deaf? You Wulingers have less manners than we do!

dialogText.cn: 这位……是……欸，我总觉得……有说不上来的熟悉感……
dialogText.en: Can this be...? Hmm ... she looks quite familiar...

dialogText.cn: 我问你——你，俱与他们不同。既在众人之中，又在众人之外。
dialogText.en: You —! Yes, I'm talking to you. You stand apart. An entity who walks with them all, yet held aloof from the crowd.

dialogText.cn: 你见到树——树是树吗？
dialogText.en: You see a tree — Is the tree truly a tree?

dialogText.cn: 哼。
dialogText.en: Hmph.
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈……
dialogText.en: HAHAHAHA...

dialogText.cn: 这是……我们可以修了的意思？
dialogText.en: So, I guess ... we can go ahead and fix the machine?

dialogText.cn: 真是个奇怪的老太太啊……
dialogText.en: What a strange old lady...

dialogText.cn: 你们见过了竹林，穿过了竹林。
dialogText.en: Eyed the grove, you did. Through the grove, you walked.

dialogText.cn: 对……我们就是这么过来的。
dialogText.en: Yeah... I guess that's how we got here.

dialogText.cn: 竹动，为何而动？
dialogText.en: So, why then, does the bamboo sway?
Well, it...

dialogText.cn: 一群被故障设备波频影响的虫子罢了。
dialogText.en: Turns out the bugs were just affected by a malfunctioning machine.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈……
dialogText.en: Hahahaha...

dialogText.cn: 欸？您这是什么意思？
dialogText.en: Hey, what are you trying to do, dear lady?

dialogText.cn: 为何……行走在塔卫二？
dialogText.en: Why ... treadeth thou ... on Talos-II?

dialogText.cn: 这还能因为啥？因为咱们生在这里，长在这里！
dialogText.en: Ha! Why else? Because we were born here, raised here. This dirt's in our bones!

dialogText.cn: 不，不对！我从小就学过，泰拉才是我们的家……和这些竹林虫不一样，我们是塔卫二的外来者……
dialogText.en: W-wait! No, that's wrong! Since I was a child, I've been taught that Terra is our home! We're not like these grovenymphs... We're outsiders here... Talos-II was never ours to begin with...

dialogText.cn: 见竹是竹，见人是人，见虫是虫，如此而已。
dialogText.en: Bamboo stays bamboo, man stays man, the worm just worms. All is as it began.

dialogText.cn: 泰拉人，曾做过同样的波频影响实验，来研究驮兽的行为。
dialogText.en: Terrans! Once they performed the exact same trials of wave frequencies! 'Twas burdenbeast behavior they seek to elucidate.

dialogText.cn: 驮兽与竹林虫，物种迥异，受波频影响时的行为模式却出奇一致。
dialogText.en: Burdenbeasts and grovenymphs are vastly different species. However! They responded remarkably similar when influenced by waves of certain frequencies.

dialogText.cn: 唔，我现在想起来了。那个奇怪的人……好像是研究塔卫二生物学的一位老天师。
dialogText.en: Hmm. I suddenly remembered who that weird old lady is... I think she's some super old Tianshi who's also really into the sciences of Talosian biology.

dialogText.cn: 十多年前……“蟠兽”的物种名就是她取的，定波器背后的项目也是由她带头的。
dialogText.en: It was over a decade ago... The old lady's the one who named the cute little pantailbeasts. She was also the primary investigator of the fixed wave emitter project.

dialogText.cn: 她都隐退好多年了，没想到还能见到。
dialogText.en: Then she retired and became a hermit. I can't believe we actually ran into her.

dialogText.cn: 啊，《四时竹林虫考略》的作者也是她……这么说，她对着个“结果已知”的项目又研究了这么多年……？
dialogText.en: Wow. She's also the one who wrote A Study of Grovenymphs in Different Seasons... That means she actually spent years working on a project ... that she practically knew everything about...!

dialogText.cn: 不愧是上一辈的老科研人……这牛角尖也算钻到底了。
dialogText.en: I guess that's a true scientist from the last generation... They would do anything to prove an esoteric point.

dialogText.cn: 我不懂这些！总之，以后挖虫笋不会出问题了对吧！
dialogText.en: I don't know nothing about that scientific mumbo-jumbo you just said! I just wanna know if I can dig my nymphsprouts safely, aight?!

dialogText.cn: 这就是对我们最好的消息！
dialogText.en: That's the only good news we need!

dialogText.cn: 他好像回去了，嘴上念叨着要转行，要研究自己从哪儿来，到哪儿去。
dialogText.en: Seems he went back. Mumbling something about 'changing careers' and 'studying his origins'... You know, the usual post-grove existential crisis.

dialogText.cn: 啊？也是……他那么胆小，巡卫这个活儿对他来说，压力太大了吧。
dialogText.en: Eh? Well... when you think about it, he definitely was way too jumpy for this job.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐又少了个得力助手啊！
dialogText.en: That means, Captain Mi Fu is gonna miss one reliable assistant!

dialogText.cn: 总之……大家都顺利回来了，竹林好像也恢复了平静……
dialogText.en: Anyhoo... We've all made it safe and sound. Seems like peace has once again returned to the grove...

dialogText.cn: 小小长耳兽，香喷喷，外焦里嫩……
dialogText.en: Little furry long-ear, roasted over a slow fire, crispy skin and tender...

dialogText.cn: 耶？你们怎么还在这儿闲逛，咱都要饿扁了！
dialogText.en: Oh? Why are you still loitering here? The Fam is famished.

dialogText.cn: 你们见到小吴了吗？就是一只长耳兽……我刚刚好不容易才把它关进笼子里面，怎么又跑掉了……
dialogText.en: Have you seen Woolsey? She's a long-ear... Took me ages to get her inside a cage. Ugh. How did she escape again...?

dialogText.cn: ……原来是你的长耳兽吗？！
dialogText.en: Wha...? That long-ear is yours?!

dialogText.cn: 对、对呀，我叫阿土，是武陵的天师学徒……那是我今年的毕业研究成果！要是没了，我就要延毕第四年了！
dialogText.en: Y-yeah! I'm Ah Tu, a Tianshi disciple of Wuling... Woolsey is my graduation research project! If she goes missing, I'll have to put off my graduation — for the fourth year!

dialogText.cn: 对呀，这里的生态环境受人为影响少，我认为，是最适合小吴生长的试验场！今年，一定能成！
dialogText.en: Of course I am. With its natural setting and barely any human interference, I figured it'd be the ideal spot to raise Woolsey. My project is definitely going to work this year!

dialogText.cn: 你们怎么看起来这么紧张，难道……是寨民干的？！
dialogText.en: Why do you look so nervous...? Oh by Talos ... did the Stockade dwellers steal my Woolsey?!

dialogText.cn: 没什么！我们……我们看到它往那个方向跑了，这就去帮你把它抓回来！
dialogText.en: No! We ... uh ... we saw her running that way! Let's chase her down for you!

dialogText.cn: 你、你们对它做了什么？！
dialogText.en: What? What did you do to my Woolsey?!

dialogText.cn: 没什么！我们……我们看到它往那个方向跑了，这就去帮你把它抓回来！
dialogText.en: No! We ... uh ... we saw her running that way! Let's chase her down for you!

dialogText.cn: 这下有点尴尬了，嘿嘿……
dialogText.en: Awk-ward, heheh...

dialogText.cn: 哎，等等，这是个武陵的丫头！稀奇！
dialogText.en: Oh. Hold up. A Wuling girl? Here? Now that's interesting.

dialogText.cn: 怎么，应有尽有的武陵，连只长耳兽都要跟我们争啊？
dialogText.en: I thought Wuling has everything, but someone's here demanding a share of this fine long-ear we caught.

dialogText.cn: 啥时候起畜生也有主人啦？这天地，这江河，难道都有主人？
dialogText.en: What? Does the wildlife belong to people now? Since when did anyone "own" the earth, the skies, or the rivers?

dialogText.cn: 小吴不一样！你们在狡辩……
dialogText.en: Woolsey is different! You just want her for yourself...

dialogText.cn: 大桨，这人好像是那个终末地的老大啊。
dialogText.en: Da Jiang, this one right here looks like the Endfield chief.

dialogText.cn: 哎？还真是，帮过咱的那几个人——大当家钦定的！这武陵丫头是跟你们一起的？
dialogText.en: Oh! You're right! The heroes who had our backs — and were approved by the Supreme Chief herself! So, is this Wuling girl part of your crew?

dialogText.cn: 没错，阿土是我们罩着的人。
dialogText.en: Uh-huh. Ah Tu is under our protection.

dialogText.cn: 是自己人，那就好说话了！
dialogText.en: Great. Talking's easier when it's fam to fam.

dialogText.cn: 多少钱？我出！
dialogText.en: So, how much are you asking for her? I'll pay.

dialogText.cn: 钱？哈哈哈，咱要那劳什子做啥？现在弟兄们就想吃口午饭，不过被你们搅和了……
dialogText.en: Money? Nah. We don't need stupid pieces of paper. Lunch! That's what the Fam wants right now. But you came without invitation and got in the way...

dialogText.cn: 嗨嗨，小东西，这下拿我没法子了吧？叫你踹老子！
dialogText.en: Hurhurhur, furball. Tried kicking me back then. Guess you can't do anything behind the cage, eh?

dialogText.cn: 小吴！！你这个人，把小吴还给我！
dialogText.en: Woolsey!! Hey you, gimme back my Woolsey!

dialogText.cn: 可这小畜生，也是咱凭本事抓的。要不，你们去找个吃食，咱就把它还给你们。
dialogText.en: We caught this furball with our own hands. Tell you what — bring us something else to chew on, and we'll trade.

dialogText.cn: 武陵丫头，你养的这玩意儿真是长耳兽？这力气你能降住？
dialogText.en: City gal, that really a long-ear? Helluva kick. How do you keep her under control?

dialogText.cn: 哇，看不出来阿土你连打架都会！
dialogText.en: Wow! I didn't know you could fight, Ah Tu!

dialogText.cn: 会一点。虽然，第三轮考核那天早上睡过头了。
dialogText.en: Just a bit. Unfortunately, I overslept and missed the third round of trials.

dialogText.cn: 找了那么久！还以为你们跑了呢！
dialogText.en: Took you quite a while! Thought you ran away.

dialogText.cn: 我以前申请过巡卫实习的，别小瞧我！
dialogText.en: I once applied to a watchguard internship. Don't underestimate me!

dialogText.cn: 喏，吃的。现在，把小吴还给我吧。
dialogText.en: Here. Things you can eat. Give my Woolsey back to me.

dialogText.cn: 武陵丫头，这是能吃的东西？你少敷衍咱！
dialogText.en: Gal, you call this edible? Do you think we are fools?

dialogText.cn: 咋不能吃？煮一下就能吃，你们自己看。
dialogText.en: Of course they're edible. You just need to cook them. I'll show you.

dialogText.cn: 还真是！阿土，你对做菜都这么有研究，怎么不当个厨子呀？
dialogText.en: Wow! You're pretty good at cooking, Ah Tu. Ever thought about being a chef?

dialogText.cn: 我想过改行当厨子，研究过一阵子——把所有样本都采集回去，试了一遍。
dialogText.en: I thought about a culinary career and looked into it for a bit — even collected all sorts of ingredients and tried them out.

dialogText.cn: ……但这世上做厨子的人太多了，我出不了头。出不了头的事，我就不做了。
dialogText.en: ...But there are just too many chefs around. I'll end up being really mid, and that's something I want to avoid.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈！武陵丫头，别的不说，哄人笑这点，你算出头了！
dialogText.en: Hahaha! City gal, say what you want, but you're actually pretty good at being funny!

dialogText.cn: 那我们也讲义气，把小吴还你。
dialogText.en: Guess we'll honor our promise, and give your Woolsey back to you.

dialogText.cn: 啊！小吴！不能再聊了，小吴要跑远了！
dialogText.en: Ah! Woolsey! Gotta cut the chit-chat or she'll be too far away.

dialogText.cn: 这下可好，还不知道老师要怎么骂我……
dialogText.en: I'm totally finished. My instructor is gonna get really mad at this...

dialogText.cn: 永宁学长，你也要挨骂啦？
dialogText.en: Yongning? Are you in trouble too?

dialogText.cn: 阿土？你怎么跑到这边来了。你不是早就转项目了吗，两个月前？
dialogText.en: Ah Tu? Why are you here? I thought you switched majors — and your project too. Wasn't that like two months ago?

dialogText.cn: 唉，先不说那些了，刚我去吃饭，一看监控一只长耳兽跑进试验区里去了！
dialogText.en: Let's talk about something urgent right now. I was eating lunch. Then, on the camera feeds, I saw a long-ear running into the testing area.

dialogText.cn: 小吴！各位抱歉，我要去找小吴了！
dialogText.en: Woolsey! Oh, I'm so sorry, people. I gotta look for my Woolsey!

dialogText.cn: 小吴……是谁？是阿土给长耳兽起的名字么？
dialogText.en: Woolsey...? Did Ah Tu name her long-ear?

dialogText.cn: 是啊。你是阿土的同学？
dialogText.en: She did. Are you Ah Tu's classmate?

dialogText.cn: 你是说“转学威龙”阿土？那她的“同学”可以说是遍布整个武陵城了！
dialogText.en: Ah Tu the Major Changer? Hah. She's got classmates all over Wuling City.

dialogText.cn: 虽然在武陵上学不花学费，但像阿土这样把每个专业都学一遍的，庄管代还要倒给她贴点！
dialogText.en: Studying at Wuling is tuition-free, but no one does it like Ah Tu. She's literally dabbled in every major. I think even Viceroy Zhuang's wallet is feeling the pain from that nonsense.

dialogText.cn: 不然怎么会延毕这么久？她总是做着做着就说做不下去了，出不了头，没希望了，换一个吧。就这样拖到现在了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Whenever she starts a new major, hopelessness will soon catch up and she'll switch to another. And that's why she's never graduating.

dialogText.cn: 我和阿土挺处得来的，她人很好，有点理想主义，而且很聪明！
dialogText.en: I actually get along with Ah Tu. She's pretty nice. Quite an idealist, and super smart too!

dialogText.cn: 说实话，这谁能做到啊？也算是种天才了吧？
dialogText.en: I don't think anyone else could do it. If you ask me, she's a genius. Of sorts.

dialogText.cn: 对哦，我也发现了，阿土跟我们待了那么一小会儿，就向我们展示了至少三种专业技能！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah! We hardly spent any time with Ah Tu, but that girl managed to show us three different professional skill sets.

dialogText.cn: 但她好像不知道自己有这么聪明呢，左一下右一下，净在捣鼓，全都没结果，挺可惜。
dialogText.en: Well, I don't think she realizes just how smart she is. She dabbles in this, and then that, but never manages to get anything done. What a shame.

dialogText.cn: 看来我们一定得把小吴找回来，好让阿土今年顺利毕业。
dialogText.en: We better find Woolsey to make sure that Ah Tu graduates this year.

dialogText.cn: 这小东西下脚没轻没重的，嘴上也不闲着，谁知道要搞砸多少东西！
dialogText.en: That critter's stomping all over the place! And she won't stop munching! She's ruining everything!

dialogText.cn: 我跟你说，别看她老说自己做不好这个做不好那个，但她换了那么多专业，门门都能拿及格以上！
dialogText.en: Gotta tell you something. Ah Tu keeps saying that she's not good at anything. But her GPA? It's way above passing for every major she's taken.

dialogText.cn: 这孩子……
dialogText.en: And there she goes again...

dialogText.cn: 唉，我没想着要训她啊。但她碰到问题，总是自己憋着，憋到做不下去了，就来找我说，要换方向……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* I'm not here to tell her off. But every time she runs into a problem, she just bottles it all up until it's too late to fix. And that's when she comes to me, asking to change her major...

dialogText.cn: 我知道她妈妈是著名学者，对她从小就要求严格，这个压力肯定是有的。所以，她凡事都想做到出类拔萃才行。
dialogText.en: Her mother is a respected scientist and a very demanding parent. I imagine her childhood was stressful. Maybe that's why she's always trying to be the best in her pursuits.

dialogText.cn: 我这边也不容易。武陵从来不是卡着孩子们毕业的地方，庄管代反而还鼓励大家，多尝试新的方向，各才有各用。
dialogText.en: She's not making things easy for me. We want our students to graduate. Viceroy Zhuang's been encouraging everyone to try out different majors — it helps build a more diverse talent pool.

dialogText.cn: 我想呀——是她自己不想。这份进度报告也是。上回面批的时候完成度已经够高了，今天突然又换了个新方向……
dialogText.en: I want to — but she refused. I'm starting to see the signs again with her progress report. The project was pretty much complete during presentation. But just today, she told me she wanted to switch to something else...

dialogText.cn: 欸？我听阿土说话，感觉她还挺着急的呢！
dialogText.en: Huh? We talked to Ah Tu, but she sounded pretty desperate about her project.

dialogText.cn: 唔，我也搞不懂这孩子。不过与其让她出去撞得一头包，还不如留在我这儿继续探索一些方向，我能给她兜底。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* I don't really know what that girl wants. Instead of blindly running all over the place, I'd rather her stay under my tutelage and find her way around. At least I can help her draw the bottom line.

dialogText.cn: 孩子们现在也不容易。
dialogText.en: Young people nowadays have it difficult as well.

dialogText.cn: 但是做不到，就要放弃，也不是个事。你们说，对不对？
dialogText.en: But every time she realizes she can't be the best, she quits. That's just ridiculous, don't you agree?

dialogText.cn: 阿土的毕业证卡着，连我也得年年都要被“关怀”一轮。
dialogText.en: And every time Ah Tu delays her graduation, I get another "special visit" from the Viceroy. This has gone on for years.

dialogText.cn: 这还不止一次啦。你们说，这阿土是不是故意这么做的？
dialogText.en: This isn't Ah Tu's first time doing something like this. Do you think she's doing this on purpose?

dialogText.cn: 这只不是小吴啦。我……我肚子饿了，走回来的时候，桨叔叔说刚才没吃饱，我又给他们做了顿饭。
dialogText.en: This one isn't Woolsey. I ... I was starving. While I was heading back, Uncle Jiang told me he's hungry for more, so I came here and cooked extra.

dialogText.cn: 吓死我了——那你还要继续找小吴吗？
dialogText.en: You almost gave me a heart attack. Well, are you gonna keep looking for Woolsey?

dialogText.cn: 我……我又有点……
dialogText.en: I ... I got a little...

dialogText.cn: 别放弃啊，阿土！这回是真的临门一脚啦！
dialogText.en: Don't give up, Ah Tu! You're just one step away from graduation!

dialogText.cn: 我总觉得，小吴不是最好的长耳兽。
dialogText.en: I just don't think Woolsey is the best long-ear specimen.

dialogText.cn: 阿土，这不对哦。如果事事都以“最好”为准，哪能做到头呢？我们都要给自己长大的空间呀。
dialogText.en: Now that's not right, Ah Tu. You won't get anything done if you only want the "best". Gotta give yourself room for growth, you know.

dialogText.cn: 长大的空间……你好会说话，听得我又想去学文学了。
dialogText.en: Room for growth... Wow. That's really a nice way to put it. You got me interested in a literature major.

dialogText.cn: 等等，你别急……欸，我会说话吗？嘿嘿，管理员，阿土夸我会说话呢！要不下次报告我来做？
dialogText.en: Wait! Hold on... Did you just compliment me for talking nice? Heheh. Endmin, hear that? Ah Tu called me a smooth talker! I can totally present the next report for you!

dialogText.cn: 我只是有点急。可我……也搞不清楚自己在急什么。我嘴笨，说不明白，你能懂吗？
dialogText.en: Feeling a little desperate right now... not even sure why I'm worried. Words aren't really my strong suit, so maybe I didn't come across clearly. Hope you understand.

dialogText.cn: 好像盛夏的阴天，空气湿度百分之九十五，云像脏抹布在脸上胡乱抹，皮肤都被水汽刺得发痒发痛，我知道这感觉！
dialogText.en: Like a cloudy day in high summer. Humidity is ninety-five percent. The clouds are like a piece of rag rubbed all over my face, making my skin itch with the heavy wetness of it all. Of course I understand how that feels!

dialogText.cn: 我有种感觉，今天找到小吴以后，你就会有答案啦！
dialogText.en: Once we find Woolsey today, I have a feeling that you'll find your answers!

dialogText.cn: 算了算了，先说正事……阿土，你可要想明白啦。
dialogText.en: Alright, let's focus on Ah Tu's issue right now... Tu, you sure you got it figured out?

dialogText.cn: 快看那儿……难道是小吴和蟠兽交上朋友了？！
dialogText.en: Look there... Did Woolsey become friends with the pantails?

dialogText.cn: 我说呢，小吴怎么到处乱窜，原来是为了找到自己的归宿。
dialogText.en: I guess that explains why Woolsey kept running around. She was looking for her true home.

dialogText.cn: 看得我也有点想家了，这次回武陵，一下勾起了许多……
dialogText.en: Looking at this got me thinking about home. Our Wuling trip is bringing back memories...

dialogText.cn: ……欸？小吴又……跑了？怎么……蟠兽朋友也不是它想要的吗？
dialogText.en: Hey...?! Woolsey ... ran off again. Hmm... Wasn't making friends with pantailbeasts what she was after?

dialogText.cn: 我知道了！我知道小吴要什么了！
dialogText.en: Ah! I got it! I know what Woolsey wants!

dialogText.cn: 小吴，只是喜欢跑步而已！
dialogText.en: Woolsey just wants to run!

dialogText.cn: 阿土，你不抓小吴了吗？
dialogText.en: Ah Tu, aren't you chasing after Woolsey?

dialogText.cn: 我要去找老师——
dialogText.en: I'm going to talk to my instructor.

dialogText.cn: 我想把这个……给你们。
dialogText.en: I want to ... offer you this gift.

dialogText.cn: 我刚在收拾书包，准备把这张照片带着的。突然又觉得，留着也没用了，现在就给你们吧。
dialogText.en: I was packing my bag when I saw this photo. Wanted to take it along, but I realized ... it's kinda useless to me. Here. Please take it.

dialogText.cn: 是小吴和蟠兽的照片啊！阿土，没想到你拍照技术也不错呢。
dialogText.en: Hey! It's a photo of Woolsey and the pantails! Oh, it's so pretty! You're an amazing photographer, Ah Tu!

dialogText.cn: 虽然很舍不得，但是，往前跑的人，最不需要回头了。
dialogText.en: I ... I want to, but people who want to keep moving forward should never look back.

dialogText.cn: 对了，感谢你们陪我跑了一天。
dialogText.en: One more thing. Thank you for sticking with me all day and running around like this.

dialogText.cn: 那就好。看来，我们都喜欢跑步！那就再见了，我要去准备下一个项目了。
dialogText.en: Awesome. I guess we all like running! So, this is it! I'm heading to my next project.

dialogText.cn: 接下来，我要申请到塔卫二最荒无人烟的地方去，找出一种最神奇的矿石！
dialogText.en: Next, I'm applying to *the* most desolate and uninhabited realms of Talos-II. There, I shall find the most wondrous mineral of them all!

dialogText.cn: ……没想到意外的乌龙，竟然让阿土的人生发生了新的转折……
dialogText.en: Seems like our unexpected mistake became a life-changing event for Ah Tu...

dialogText.cn: 乌龙？什么乌龙？
dialogText.en: Mistake? What mistake?

dialogText.cn: 啊，没有没有！
dialogText.en: Ah! Nothing! I didn't say anything!

dialogText.cn: 那我走啦！各位，未来有缘再见！
dialogText.en: Okay then! I'm off, people! I hope to see you again!

dialogText.cn: 阿土，你啊……唉，你这孩子！
dialogText.en: Ah Tu, you... Girl, please!

dialogText.cn: 老师，我已经决定了。这是小吴教给我的一课！
dialogText.en: I've already made up my mind, Mr. Lu. Woolsey taught me that!

dialogText.cn: 我决定——再换一个方向。
dialogText.en: I've decided ... to change my major.

dialogText.cn: 我要去研究矿物！
dialogText.en: I'm going to get started on mineralogy!

dialogText.cn: 又、又换？！
dialogText.en: WHA?! AGAIN?!

dialogText.cn: 阿土，你上周的进度报告已经满足毕业的基本要求啦，要不听老师的劝，这次就好好先把学位证给拿了……
dialogText.en: Ah Tu, your progress report last week has already met our basic graduation requirements. Just listen to me for once and get your diploma...

dialogText.cn: 可是，老师，我很厉害，不是吗？我门门都能毕业！
dialogText.en: But I'm good, right? I can graduate from every major, Mr. Lu.

dialogText.cn: 原来我只是想要——一直奔跑。我只是喜欢跑步！
dialogText.en: Turns out that I just wanna ... keep running. And it's only because I LOVE running!

dialogText.cn: 这个世界需要你和我妈妈那样为了跑向终点而跑的人，也会需要像我这样，一直在跑道上跑个不停的长耳兽啊。
dialogText.en: The world needs people like you and Mom, those who run to reach the finishing line. But it also needs people like me, long-ears who would never stop running.

dialogText.cn: 你这孩子，这都是什么歪理……
dialogText.en: That doesn't make any sense to me, girl...

dialogText.cn: 你要是兴趣广博，想要做博物学者，大可以继续待在武陵，我们找个新路子，一定会成功的。不好吗？
dialogText.en: If you wish to become a polymath and pursue other fields of studies, you can stay at Wuling. We'll find a new direction and figure something out. What do you say?

dialogText.cn: 这我可以证明！阿土真的很厉害，连她的师兄都这么说！
dialogText.en: I can totally back her up! Ah Tu is just awesome! Even her senior said so!

dialogText.cn: 老师，我本来一直以为自己是因为做不到最好，才一直定不下心来，但小吴……我像小吴一样……
dialogText.en: Mr. Lu, I used to think that I couldn't focus on a single major because I wasn't good enough. But Woolsey... I guess I'm more like Woolsey...

dialogText.cn: 幸好……在这里的驮兽群没有受伤。
dialogText.en: We got really lucky... None of the burdenbeasts were hurt.
Uh...

dialogText.cn: 哞？
dialogText.en: Moo?
Moo...?
MOOOO —

dialogText.cn: 大侄子，这不合适！我都这把年纪了！
dialogText.en: This isn't appropriate, young bro! I'm too old for this!

dialogText.cn: 哞哞哞！
dialogText.en: MOO! MOOOO!

dialogText.cn: 哞！
dialogText.en: MOO!

dialogText.cn: 大侄子，你别再过来了！听我说一句，强扭的瓜它不甜啊！
dialogText.en: Not a step closer, kiddo! Listen to this old pooper. You can't force love!

dialogText.cn: 啊，你们还在旁边傻看什么！还不赶紧帮我把它赶走！
dialogText.en: Hey! YOU TWO! Stop gawking and shoo this pesky little calf away!

dialogText.cn: 哎哟，那家伙可算走了，我一过来它就死缠着我不放……哼，你们想笑就笑，一直憋着怕你们憋出毛病来。
dialogText.en: Ugh. That young blood finally agreed to give up. It was on me the instant I arrived... Hmph. Go ahead and laugh your butts off. It's unhealthy to pent it up inside.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈，想不到你这家伙竟然被追求了。
dialogText.en: Hah. Never knew someone like you could get a mate.

dialogText.cn: 怎么就不能？我年轻的时候就很受欢迎，追在我屁股后面的能从城东排到城西！要不是被耕田耽搁了，我肯定……肯定……
dialogText.en: Whatchu mean by that? I was the hottest thing around back then. Got a massive queue of bulls and heifers stretching across the city just to get a piece of me! If not for the farm, I would have... I would...

dialogText.cn: ……你放心。之后，你又找到另外一片土地，在那里继续耕种。
dialogText.en: ...Stop worrying already. You'll find new farms, till new fields, and see new crops grow.

dialogText.cn: 那片地现在……？
dialogText.en: So ... what happened to that farm...?

dialogText.cn: 知道它好就够了，我怕到时候真的去了……这把老骨头，反而是给大家添麻烦……
dialogText.en: I just wanna know if it's doing alright. Imagine if I actually got there... I'll just end up making trouble for everyone...

dialogText.cn: 不会的，你去了，大家会很高兴的……管理员，你可以帮我最后一个忙吗？
dialogText.en: No. Everyone will be super happy if you show up... I really need one more favor, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 和我一起，带它再去那片田看看吧。
dialogText.en: Help me take this old boy to his farm.

dialogText.cn: 肯定不像现在这样，孤零零一头驮兽趴在兽栏里，只有我这个小屁孩陪着。
dialogText.en: You would not end up all alone in a cozy pen, with a snotty brat as your only friend.

dialogText.cn: 谈恋爱有什么意思？还不如跟你这个小屁孩在田间地头散步，玫瑰花哪有稻花好看？
dialogText.en: Romance is overrated anyway. Rather spend time on the farm with my two-legged rascal. Roses? Fffft. Golden heads of grain. That's what I wanna see.

dialogText.cn: 哼，嘴上这么说，还不是一声招呼都不打就跑到这里来……
dialogText.en: Yeah, yeah, whatever. We got no idea why someone went running to burdenbeast matchmaking central without warning...

dialogText.cn: 你知道我刚才找不到你，心里有多着急吗？
dialogText.en: Do you know how worried I was when you suddenly disappeared again?

dialogText.cn: 那是因为……我当时在广场上，突然回忆起来一些曾经的事，因为害怕自己很快又忘记，只能赶紧过来了。
dialogText.en: That's because ... I suddenly remembered something back at the plaza. I gotta get over to this place before my memories fail again.

dialogText.cn: 只有一些模糊的画面，田地被侵蚀吞没，而我在一旁……什么都做不了。
dialogText.en: Nothing but a blur... I think I saw the Blight washing over my farm... I was right next to it... Couldn't do anything...

dialogText.cn: 里面的作物就快丰收了。
dialogText.en: Getting ready for the harvest, that's what.

dialogText.cn: 那就好，那就好……咱们回去吧。
dialogText.en: Good... Very good... We should head back now.

dialogText.cn: 不是的，大家都惦念着你呢。
dialogText.en: That's not true. Everyone misses you.

dialogText.cn: 唉，可惜我再也不能为大家做些什么了。
dialogText.en: Hrrrrgh. I'm useless and grouchy. Can't do nothing for the people no more.

dialogText.cn: 小武，你不想让我来，是不是因为……那片田地其实早就不在了？
dialogText.en: Little Wu, you didn't agree to let me come here ... because you knew... The farm's ... already gone, right?

dialogText.cn: 那怎么了？驮兽粪便可是上好的肥料。
dialogText.en: Goes without asking. Burdo-muck. Best fertilizer ever.

dialogText.cn: 让我趴着吧，趴一会儿就好。
dialogText.en: Just let me lie for a while. I'll get better soon.

dialogText.cn: ……对不起。
dialogText.en: I'm sorry...

dialogText.cn: 傻孩子说傻话，你有什么对不起我的啊？
dialogText.en: Stupid brat getting emo again. What's there to apologize for?

dialogText.cn: 我不该不顾你的想法，让你一直待在兽栏里……
dialogText.en: I kept ignoring you and kept you in the pen...

dialogText.cn: 欸，打住打住，我可听不得这个，还不如咱俩斗嘴来得舒服。
dialogText.en: Ugh. Sod off. Got no ears for sniveling nonsense. We should try to piss each other off again. That's what I like.

dialogText.cn: 那你这样想，田地虽小，却有无限的生机，能结出无数的种子；而种子会被带到更遥远的地方，生根发芽。
dialogText.en: Boy, think of it this way. This tiny farm is a fount of life. Plenty of seeds will grow out of it. And people will plant those seeds in places further away.

dialogText.cn: 孩子……田地有人照料，作物自会生长，可以后我不在了，谁驮着你往前走呢？
dialogText.en: Boy... Someone's tending to the farm and the crops. But what about you? Who's gonna carry you around when I shuffle off this mortal pen?

dialogText.cn: 我……没关系，我长高了，不用骑着你也能走得远……很远很远。
dialogText.en: I ... I'll be okay... I'm tall and strong now. I can reach faraway places without riding... Like, really faraway places.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，那就好，那就好。
dialogText.en: Okay. That's good to hear. Very good.

dialogText.cn: 以后记得不要挑食，按时吃饭，多多锻炼身体，这样才能长得高。
dialogText.en: Don't be picky with food. Have your meals on time. And work out, dammit. That's the secret to being big and tall.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……爽！
dialogText.en: Mmmhmm... Sweet, sweet release!

dialogText.cn: 好！长快些，长高些，长多些……这就对了！
dialogText.en: Suck it all up, my tender little plants! Grow faster, taller, and fruitier... That's right!

dialogText.cn: 呼……哎哟，这下是真的走不动了。
dialogText.en: Hooo... Oh my goodness. All this bowel action is really exhausting.

dialogText.cn: 你把一生的时光都倾注进了这片小小的田里。到了该休息的年纪还整天劳神惦记着。明明……
dialogText.en: You gave your life to this little farm. And you're still caring about it after retirement. I just...

dialogText.cn: 我觉得……有些不值。你已经做了很多，早就不必被束缚在这片田里了……
dialogText.en: I just ... it's really not worth your while. You've done more than enough. It's time to move on...

dialogText.cn: 田地之外的风光，这些种子早就代我看过了。
dialogText.en: Those tiny seeds have explored the world outside the farm already. They did it for me.

dialogText.cn: 而且，最后看到这片田，知道上面的作物正在结穗，按理说，我是不该有遗憾的。
dialogText.en: And when I saw this farm, the crops, and their beautiful ears, I should have no regrets.

dialogText.cn: 你还有什么遗憾吗？
dialogText.en: Is there something you still want to do?

dialogText.cn: 那我就放心了。
dialogText.en: Another burden off this beast.
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 好孩子……对了……
dialogText.en: Good boy... Oh, by the way...

dialogText.cn: 你说。
dialogText.en: Yes?

dialogText.cn: 你以后做鲜榨果汁不要往里面放生姜了……太难喝了。
dialogText.en: Stop adding ginger to the fresh fruit juice... It's disgusting.

dialogText.cn: 保重……
