dialogText.en: Take good care of yourself...

dialogText.cn: 没错，它的耕田就在这边。
dialogText.en: Absolutely! This is the old boy's farm.

dialogText.cn: 啊，是了，就是这里……我都想起来了。
dialogText.en: Ah, yeeees, this is it... AHHHH... I remember everything.

dialogText.cn: 喂，你来到这里第一件事居然是做这个吗？
dialogText.en: CAN'T BELIEVE THIS! First thing you do at the place you missed the most ... is to poop on it?

dialogText.cn: 您怎么睡在草地上？小心着凉！
dialogText.en: Why are you sleeping on the lawn? You'll catch a cold!

dialogText.cn: 学院？您睡糊涂了，这里是工农生产单位啊！
dialogText.en: Academy? I guess you're still blurry from your nap. This is the industrial and agricultural production unit.

dialogText.cn: 您刚刚做梦了吧？这里的驮兽有专人照看，不可能乱跑的。
dialogText.en: You probably dreamed it all up. We got a pro taking care of the burdenbeasts and keeping them safe here.

dialogText.cn: 说不定您梦里的老驮兽，是在现实里见过的。您可以和我讲讲，我认识这里所有驮兽，肯定帮您找出来。
dialogText.en: That Old Burdenbeast in your dream... You probably saw him in real life. Describe him to me. I know all the burdenbeasts here. Maybe I'll find him for you.

dialogText.cn: 这太笼统了，该怎么找呢……
dialogText.en: That's a little too vague for me. I can't start my search with that...
So...

dialogText.cn: 交流会提前结束了，小霜和彦宁姐已经先一步离开。
dialogText.en: The Farmers' Meet actually ended early. Shuang and Yan Ning have already left.

dialogText.cn: 学院的一位<@qu.key>老天师</>突然离世，小霜和彦宁姐去送他最后一程了。
dialogText.en: An <@qu.key>old Tianshi</> of the Academy suddenly passed away. Shuang and Yan Ning went to pay their last respects.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，醒醒！醒醒！
dialogText.en: Endmin! Wake up! Come on!

dialogText.cn: 听说……他弥留之际还一直念叨着自己那片试验田。
dialogText.en: They say ... the old man was still very much attached to his experimental farm.

dialogText.cn: 好家伙，这孩子还真是受驮兽的欢迎，不像我，天天被它们追着顶屁股。
dialogText.en: Amazing. The burdenbeasts really like this kid. If it were me, they would be chasing my butt out of the pens.

dialogText.cn: 也、也不是，只是黎风他比较受动物喜欢。
dialogText.en: T-that's not true. Lifeng is just a bit more popular with the animals.

dialogText.cn: 一个一个来，零食管够，你们今天可要好好听话，有位很重要的客人来看你们。
dialogText.en: One at a time. There are enough snacks for everyone. Now listen up, we got a visiting VIP today to take a good look at you.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 不、不好意思，我没注意到您来了。我这就为您介绍此次参加交流会的驮兽。
dialogText.en: My... My apologies, I must've missed your arrival. Allow me to introduce all the burdenbeasts taking part in the Farmers' Meet.

dialogText.cn: 呃……您还是尽量都见见，才能投出公平公正的一票嘛。
dialogText.en: Well... I think it's better if you take a look at everyone. We gotta make the voting fair, right?

dialogText.cn: 我有自信，您最后肯定会选她。
dialogText.en: But I'm pretty confident you'll be voting for her.

dialogText.cn: 真是上尊老，下爱幼，逮到中间使劲揍。
dialogText.en: The elderly get respect. The youths get tender loving care. And those in between get the brutality of life.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这位是我们工农生产单位的王牌饲养员欧阳先生。
dialogText.en: Endmin, this is Mr. Ouyang. Ace rancher of our industrial and agricultural production unit.
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 您好，这是我饲养的驮兽小多。
dialogText.en: Greetings. Meet Lil' Tote. Raised him myself.

dialogText.cn: 可以向管理员介绍一下您的特色饲养方法吗？
dialogText.en: So, can you introduce your unique livestock raising approach?

dialogText.cn: 我饲养驮兽的秘诀在于“飞翔”。动物受困于地面太久，太不自由，难免会有抑郁的情绪。
dialogText.en: "Flying" is my secret of burdenbeast raising. These creatures don't feel free when they're always stuck on the ground. Gets them depressed, you see.

dialogText.cn: 肉眼可见，它比其他驮兽都要开心。
dialogText.en: Take a look. He's obviously much happier than the other burdenbeasts.

dialogText.cn: 于是我在驮兽饲养栏中安装了磁悬浮装置，每天让它“飞”一会儿。
dialogText.en: So, I installed magnetic levitators on my burdenbeast pens, and give Lil' Tote a bit of "air" time every day.

dialogText.cn: 这一位是职农安女士，她饲养驮兽也很有一手。旁边是她的驮兽淼淼。
dialogText.en: This one here is Miss An. She's also really good at raising burdenbeasts. Next to her is Miaomiao.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，很高兴认识你。
dialogText.en: Pleased to meet you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 它刚一出生，我就用它的生辰八字卜了一卦，算出它命中缺水，所以起名“淼淼”。
dialogText.en: When Miaomiao came into this world, I acquired the Eight Characters of Birth. The readings showed that she lacked water in her life, so I gave her a name with six water characters.

dialogText.cn: 稍等，你先报一下你的八字，我帮你俩合一下命盘。
dialogText.en: Hold on. I'll need your Eight Characters of Birth as well. Gotta make sure that the two of you match.

dialogText.cn: 在饲养驮兽方面，我讲究科学与玄学并重。
dialogText.en: When it comes to raising burdenbeasts, I focus on both the scientific approach as well as the metaphysics.

dialogText.cn: 除了搭配各种营养饲料，提供舒适的环境外，我还会格外重视驮兽的运势。
dialogText.en: In addition to wholesome feed mixes and comfortable pens, I also pay great attention to their horoscopes.

dialogText.cn: 而它的兽栏，我也用代表水的蓝色彻底粉刷过了。
dialogText.en: I also painted over her entire pen with an aquatic blue.

dialogText.cn: 这儿还有一头呢，管理员。
dialogText.en: There's one more right here, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 这头就是莎莎……
dialogText.en: Er, this one is Shasha, actually...

dialogText.cn: 喂，你就是管理员吗？！
dialogText.en: Hey you! You the one called the Endmin?!

dialogText.cn: 小朋友，这位是贵客，不可以这么没有礼貌！
dialogText.en: Alright, little one. You gotta be more polite than that. This one here is our VIP.

dialogText.cn: 对、对不起……我因为有事，一时着急。
dialogText.en: Sorry... I really am... But something really bad happened and I'm super desperate.

dialogText.cn: 我叫<@qu.key>小武</>，是负责这里的牧童，打扫兽栏的时候，发现少了一头驮兽。
dialogText.en: I'm <@qu.key>Wu</>, the herdsboy in charge around here. I was cleaning the pens, then I noticed one of the burdenbeasts went missing.

dialogText.cn: 它年纪很大了，又生着病……我到处找都没找到……
dialogText.en: He's really old ... and sick... I couldn't find him anywhere...

dialogText.cn: 他们都说你很厉害，你能帮帮我吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: Everyone says you're the best, Endmin! HELP ME! PUH-LEASE!

dialogText.cn: 那交流会的事……
dialogText.en: Then what about the Farmers' Meet...

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿……毕竟我不是职农，做不到那么专业地——
dialogText.en: Heheh... I'm not a Farmer by trade, so I'm not that professional...

dialogText.cn: 确实，还是寻找驮兽比较紧急。
dialogText.en: Makes sense. We should find the missing burdenbeast quickly.

dialogText.cn: 就在对面的<@qu.key>农田</>附近。但那边房屋很多的，谁知道跑到哪里去了……
dialogText.en: Somewhere near the <@qu.key>farms</> over there. But it's got many farmhouses ... who knows where he ran off to.

dialogText.cn: 喂！你这家伙撅起屁股干什么？这里可不是你上厕所的地方！
dialogText.en: Hey! STOP! Stop raising your butt! You can't poop at this place!

dialogText.cn: 怪不得我哪儿都找不到，原来你跑到这儿来了。快和我回去！
dialogText.en: So this is where you went! That's why I couldn't find you anywhere! TIME! TO! HEAD! BACK!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀呀……天地广阔，任我遨游，我想去哪里去哪里，休想让我回去。
dialogText.en: Take a break, kiddo... The world is my pasture. I go anywhere I want. No little kid is gonna order me around.

dialogText.cn: 这批番茄的株高数据你测完了吗？第三组好像长得比前两组慢。
dialogText.en: Checked the heights of the tomato plants? Group three seems shorter than the rest.

dialogText.cn: 可能是基质含水量的问题？我昨天发现灌溉系统阀门有点漏水。
dialogText.en: Substrate water content might be a little low. I found a small leak in the irrigation valves yesterday.

dialogText.cn: 你在这里哞哞叫什么？再不情愿你也得和我走！
dialogText.en: Ugh. Stop mooing nonsense! You're coming with me, whether you like it or not!

dialogText.cn: 我不走！
dialogText.en: MOOVE ME?! NEVER!

dialogText.cn: 快点走！
dialogText.en: JUST! GET! MOOOVING!

dialogText.cn: 呼……呼……气死我了……你爱上哪儿去上哪儿去，我、我再也不管你这倔脾气了！
dialogText.en: *Hoo*... *ffff*... I'm super pissed... FINE! Do whatever you like! I ... I'm not putting up with this nonsense anymore!

dialogText.cn: 你挡着我干什么，也想把我赶回兽栏吗？
dialogText.en: You. Why are you in my way? Are you also trying to get me penned?

dialogText.cn: 没礼貌的小家伙，我在和你说话呢！
dialogText.en: Scabrous runt. I'm talking to you!

dialogText.cn: 回去？你别劝我了。
dialogText.en: Back to my pen? Try and make me.

dialogText.cn: 我这次出来可不是乱跑，是要去年轻时耕作的田野里看看呢。
dialogText.en: And I wasn't just missing. I was searching for the farm where I once toiled, back when I was young and strong.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳，总之呢，只要我在那片田里，我就开心；可要让我离开田野，趴在小小的兽栏里，我就不开心。
dialogText.en: Ahem. In any case, I feel happy when I'm at that special farm of mine. And I get grouchy when some little kid tries to keep me in a tiny pen.

dialogText.cn: 唉，我现在老眼昏花，脑袋也糊涂了，哪里还记得那片田的位置……
dialogText.en: Ugh. My eyes can't see that well no more, and my mind is getting slow. I don't think I know where the farm is...

dialogText.cn: 你想让我回兽栏，可以，但你得帮我找到那片田。只要让我再看一眼，我就老老实实回到兽栏歇着。
dialogText.en: Want me back in the pen? Sure. But you better find that farm for me. All I need is a good look at it and I'll agree to head back.

dialogText.cn: 我还能骗你们这些孩子不成？武陵城的<@qu.key>农田</>就在附近，你带我一起去看看？
dialogText.en: Do I look like someone who lies to young people? The Wuling <@qu.key>farms</> are just nearby. Take me there.

dialogText.cn: 当年我埋首田间地头，每年最高兴的时候，就是看见青苗破土而出。哎，不对……应该是作物丰收的时候。
dialogText.en: Back then, I felt happiest when I pulled the plows. No. It's when the sprouts emerged... Not quite. I felt happiest during the bountiful harvest.

dialogText.cn: 不是……是吗？感觉有点熟悉，又有点陌生……好像来过……等等，我来过吗？
dialogText.en: Is it...? Hmm. Feels familiar ... and foreign... Maybe I was here... Wait. Was I?

dialogText.cn: 事到如今只有一个办法可以验证了。
dialogText.en: There is only one way to find out.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……不太对……再去下一块田看看吧。
dialogText.en: No... Not quite feeling it... We should check the next farm.
MOOOO —

dialogText.cn: 哎哟……哎哟……累死了，走不动了，让我歇会儿先。
dialogText.en: Hngh... My damn legs... Hrruugggh... I'm out of breath. Gotta take a breather.

dialogText.cn: 真的不行，我的腿脚已经不听使唤了，嗓子也干得冒烟了，给我、给我喝口水。
dialogText.en: I can't move no more. My knees are creaking and my throat is parched. Just ... go and find me some water.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……让我想想，都不要，我要喝<@qu.key>息流总闸</>那边刚刚净化过的水。
dialogText.en: Hmm... Let me think. Not going along with your choice. Purified water from the main <@qu.key>Xiranflow sluice</>. That's the only thing I drink.

dialogText.cn: 哼哼，你要是不答应，我就在你鞋子上拉屎。
dialogText.en: Hrrrmmmph. If you refuse, I'll poop all over your shoes.

dialogText.cn: 咦……对面那不是……
dialogText.en: {F}Wait... Isn't that...?{M}Wait... Isn't that...?

dialogText.cn: 接到水了，带回去给老驮兽……嗯？
dialogText.en: {F}Got enough water. Time to bring it back to that old burdenbeast... Oh?{M}Got enough water. Time to bring it back to that old burdenbeast... Oh?

dialogText.cn: 老了，唉……以前武陵城每个街道我都能记得清。
dialogText.en: I'm getting old. Hrrnnngh... There was a time when I remembered every map in the city.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，武陵城也变了，当年哪有什么息流……只有铺天盖地袭来的侵蚀潮。我的老伙计们啊，好多都折在里面了……
dialogText.en: Yeah. The city's changed. Nobody knew what Xiranflow was... And there was nothing but Blight Tides that swept everything aside. Killed plenty of fellow beasts. Good beasts, all of them...

dialogText.cn: 当然了。天师们到不了的地方，驮兽能到；天师们做不了的事，驮兽能做。
dialogText.en: Of course. We burdenbeasts could reach places and carry loads that the Tianshi couldn't even dream of.

dialogText.cn: 哼哼……我休息好了，咱们走吧。
dialogText.en: Harrumph... I am now fully rested. Let us be off.

dialogText.cn: 你们不许走！
dialogText.en: NOT ONE MORE STEP!

dialogText.cn: 你是不是……？
dialogText.en: Were you...?

dialogText.cn: 我没有！胡说什么！谁跟着你们了？谁担心你了？
dialogText.en: I WAS NOT! What are you talking about? I hate following you! And I'm NOT worried at all!

dialogText.cn: 我还什么都没说呢……你这孩子，不打自招。
dialogText.en: I don't think I said anything, kiddo... Stop giving everything away.

dialogText.cn: 你不要再给我添麻烦，赶快和我回去！
dialogText.en: Stop making things hard for me! Head back! NOW!

dialogText.cn: 添麻烦？你说我给你添麻烦？！
dialogText.en: Make things hard for you? Did I ever make things hard for anyone?!

dialogText.cn: 我今天还有好多事情呢，要不是你到处乱跑，我这会儿肯定都做完了！
dialogText.en: I couldn't even finish my work today! And it's all your fault! You ran off, and I had to chase you down!

dialogText.cn: 好，好，我这辈子还是第一次被人当作麻烦！
dialogText.en: Oh, hoho. First time in my life! Some snotty brat thinks I'm making life difficult for them!

dialogText.cn: 我不是那个意思……
dialogText.en: No! That's not what I meant...

dialogText.cn: 我还有力气，我还能走动！不用麻烦你们，那片田我自己去找！你们都别跟着我！
dialogText.en: I still got life in my legs, so I won't be troubling you anymore. I can look for that farm on my own, thank you very much! And quit tailing me!

dialogText.cn: 起开，别挡在我面前，碍眼！
dialogText.en: And you're a real eyesore. Out of my way!

dialogText.cn: 对啊，我为什么在这里……有人送我来的？风筝捎我过来的？我光记得自己渴得受不了……
dialogText.en: That's a very good question. Why am I even here... Someone probably led me here. Or was it a kite? I think I was super thirsty...

dialogText.cn: 唉，我这个记性，刚刚发生的事情，下一秒就忘了。
dialogText.en: *Sigh* My memories are failing. I can't even remember what happened a second ago.

dialogText.cn: 我从来没见过它那么生气……我只是想让它回去好好歇着。
dialogText.en: He's never been this upset... I just want him to head back and rest in the pen.

dialogText.cn: 要是它以后再也不理我了，我、我又不能不理它……怎么办，管理员？
dialogText.en: What if he refuses to be my friend anymore? I ... I can't just leave him wandering around like this... What should I do, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 我们要进去找吗？
dialogText.en: Should we head in and look for him?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我闻到了……跟我来。
dialogText.en: Ugh... I smell it too... Follow me.

dialogText.cn: 哦，难怪……这家伙留了好大一坨！
dialogText.en: Oh, dude... That old boy left a big pile for us!

dialogText.cn: 真是的，原来它在学院门口徘徊，只是为了找个地方方便一下。
dialogText.en: Ugh. That's why he did all that loitering around the Academy entrance! He was looking for a place to dump his cake.

dialogText.cn: 哎，左边扭扭，伸展腰肢，右边扭扭，肩膀打开……一二三四，再来一次。
dialogText.en: Oh ho. Left, baby, left! Feel the shaka-laka. Move those hips. Right, baby, right! Work those shoulders... Ah one, two, three, four! One more round, people.

dialogText.cn: 哼，我还以为你发完那么大的脾气，会躲到哪个角落气得哞哞叫呢，没想到居然在广场上轻松地跳舞。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Here you are. I thought you'd be off fuming in some secret place. Never expected you to be dancing around in the plaza.

dialogText.cn: 胡说，我跟你一个孩子能生多久的气。
dialogText.en: Fuming? Ridiculous. I don't fume at kiddos. Not for too long, anyway.

dialogText.cn: 我给你带了果汁。
dialogText.en: Hmph. I brought some fruit punch. For someone.

dialogText.cn: 鲜榨果汁？哎，好不容易出来一趟，就不能喝竹立劲汽水吗？
dialogText.en: Fresh fruit punch? Ugh. This is my outdoor getaway. Can't an old boy get something proper? Like BAM-BOOM Fizz soda?

dialogText.cn: 不行，你当自己还年轻吗？每天敢拿功能饮料当水喝。
dialogText.en: No. You're too old to chug functional energy drinks all day!

dialogText.cn: 当年任务重啊……喝功能饮料才能打起精神呀。
dialogText.en: We got metric tons of work back then... Needed all the functional energy drink we could to get things rolling.

dialogText.cn: 明明是你自己只顾耕田不顾身体，我和你说过好几遍！你哪一次听了的！
dialogText.en: That's because you refused to rest and kept working the farm. I tried to get you to stop, but you NEVER listen!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，别翻旧账了，我之后不也吸取教训，开始好好锻炼身体了吗？就说这舞，我当年从田地回来，肯定要扭上一段的。
dialogText.en: Enough with the blame game. I learned my lesson and did my workouts properly. Remember this jig? Used to do a routine every time I got back from the farm.

dialogText.cn: 我记得，你当年有“武陵舞王”的称号，倾倒全城的公母驮兽。
dialogText.en: Of course I remember. They called you the Dancing Beast of Wuling. Every burdenbeast was trying to copy your move.

dialogText.cn: 这些往事就不用再提啦，我只能说，是金子在哪里都会发光。怎么样，我这舞姿和当年比起来如何啊？
dialogText.en: Let's not dwell on my legendary past. All I wanna say is true heroes would shine anywhere. What do you say? Think I still got my moves?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……还是很潇洒的。
dialogText.en: Yeeahhh... Smooth as ever, heartbreaker.

dialogText.cn: 唉……那就好，那就好。
dialogText.en: Hoooo... That's good to hear... I guess.

dialogText.cn: 哎，你有相机吗？能不能给我在这里拍一张照片，以后也不知道还有没有机会再来这里跳舞了。
dialogText.en: Oh, I see you have a camera. Wonder if you can take a photo of me right here. I don't know if I'd ever get another chance to dance again.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，可以站远一些，把我也一起拍进去吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, can you take a few steps back? Get me in the picture as well.

dialogText.cn: 再远一些吧，把广场上跳舞的人群都拍进去！
dialogText.en: I say you should back up all the way! Take a photo of the entire crowd in the plaza!

dialogText.cn: 让我看看！
dialogText.en: SHOW ME!

dialogText.cn: 这个方向……难不成它往<@qu.key>城郊</>去了？奇怪，它的田也不在那个位置啊？
dialogText.en: From what I'm seeing ... he's headed for the <@qu.key>city outskirts</>. Why? That's not where his farm is.

dialogText.cn: 你这是让我看什么？
dialogText.en: Are you trying to show me something?

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事，那家伙呢……怎么又不见了……？
dialogText.en: What?! Where did that old boy go...? Did he just run off again...?

dialogText.cn: 它到底去哪里了？怎么一个脚印也没有留下啊……
dialogText.en: Ugghh... Where did he go? He didn't even leave footprints this time...

dialogText.cn: 那里以前是科考站的试验田，十年前那次事故后就彻底荒废了，驮兽们经常会去那里吃草。
dialogText.en: Experimental farms of the Science Station. Everything was abandoned after the accident ten years ago. Burdenbeasts usually go there to graze.

dialogText.cn: 或许它就是饿了……不论如何，我们得赶紧去看看，听说最近那里总有<@qu.key>水灯虫</>出没。
dialogText.en: Maybe he got hungry... Ugh. We've gotta head over there right now — people saw <@qu.key>waterlamps</> lurking around.

dialogText.cn: 拍好啦？我瞧瞧。嗯，完美地捕捉了小壳兽的姿态！
dialogText.en: Got it? Lemme see. Hmm. A perfect capture of the mini shellbeasts!

dialogText.cn: 我很喜欢小壳兽！小时候养过一只，非常亲人！
dialogText.en: I love mini shellbeasts! I raised one myself. They like being close to people!

dialogText.cn: 好喽，这张照片也拍好了，劳烦各位去下一个打卡点吧。
dialogText.en: Alright. This photo is done. Well, people, gotta need help at the next check-in location.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，没想到在这儿见面了，你们是来进行什么研究的吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, I didn't expect to meet you here. Is the team visiting this place for some research?

dialogText.cn: 研究？不不不，我们是来……做任务的。
dialogText.en: Research? No, of course not. We're here ... on a mission.

dialogText.cn: 不会是阿仔的任务吧？哈哈，我也帮他跑了不少腿。
dialogText.en: Mission? Did Ah Zai give it to you? Hah. I ran plenty of errands for him as well.

dialogText.cn: 算是同学。阿仔他老早就退学做生意……不是，创业去了。
dialogText.en: We're kinda like classmates, but he quit school to learn a trade... I mean, to start a business.

dialogText.cn: 阿仔的性格，确实更适合去经营生意。老师说，按着他在椅子上学习，就像要了他的命一样。
dialogText.en: And Ah Zai seems like someone cut out for running a biz. Our instructor ran out of tricks to get him to read to study.

dialogText.cn: 能够一直坚持自己选择的道路，我很佩服他呢！
dialogText.en: And he really stuck to his choice and plans. I really admire the guy!

dialogText.cn: 对了，既然碰上了，让我们一起合个影吧！
dialogText.en: Oh yeah, since everyone's here, why don't we take a group photo?

dialogText.cn: 主料准备好啦？还有辅料呢，别忘了。
dialogText.en: Got the main ingredients? Don't forget the condiments.

dialogText.cn: 没有甜的、辣的、香的，味道就出不来呀！
dialogText.en: You need the sweetness, the heat, and the herbal aroma!

dialogText.cn: 三到钟这个机位，我已经帮他拍了六七遍了……
dialogText.en: For the Bell of Three Presences, I've taken six or seven photos of this place already...

dialogText.cn: 看起来，阿仔对这次活动很上心啊。
dialogText.en: I got a feeling that Ah Zai is taking this event really seriously.

dialogText.cn: 忙活了那么久，总算能休息啦！走，一块儿上方兴衢吃一顿！
dialogText.en: We've been busy long enough. 'Tis time for a break! Let's go and feast along Fangxing Avenue!

dialogText.cn: 对！学生们的伙食费不多，方兴衢的馆子又便宜好吃，所以考完试，他们都愿意来这边庆祝！
dialogText.en: Yeah! Students aren't exactly rich, but Fangxing Avenue offers great food on the cheap! Once exams are over, everyone celebrates here!

dialogText.cn: 我们这次，也算是过了一关。这顿饭包我身上，算管理员请客，嘿嘿。
dialogText.en: And we did survive a major challenge. This one's on me. Actually, I say our Endmin's got the tab. Heheh.

dialogText.cn: 我有印象，这里吃饭的学生似乎挺多。
dialogText.en: I think I remember the place. Plenty of students have their meals at the avenue.

dialogText.cn: 这就忘啦？主料是——长耳兽肉五百克，凉葛五十克切细丝！
dialogText.en: Did you forget already? The main ingredients are half a key of long-ear meat and fifty grams of liangge turnip cut in strips!

dialogText.cn: 辅料是——糖汁十克，辣缕子末二十克，切段的壤香芹三十克。
dialogText.en: The condiments are ten grams of syrup, twenty grams of chopped hot fennel, and thirty grams of cut earthy parsley.

dialogText.cn: 没关系，做多了就熟练了！
dialogText.en: It's okay. You'll get better with practice.

dialogText.cn: 阿仔给的坐标就是这里。
dialogText.en: This is the location of Ah Zai's coordinates.

dialogText.cn: 神神秘秘的……但是，这个机位拍龙泡泡确实不错！他挺有品味的嘛。
dialogText.en: Why is he being so mysterious...? This place is great for photographing Chubby Lungs! He does have taste!

dialogText.cn: 这大音响……一看就是阿仔放的吧。
dialogText.en: Look at this huge speaker... Ah Zai must have placed it here.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，刚好你们来了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, what a coincidence.

dialogText.cn: 让他们给你解释吧。
dialogText.en: I'll let them do the explaining.

dialogText.cn: 唉……算是啦，昨天我看到公告板上张贴了新通知，说有一家商户退租了。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... I guess so. I saw a new post on the bulletin. A business is ending their lease.

dialogText.cn: 我从去年就开始准备商业方案了哦，机会只留给有准备的我！
dialogText.en: I've been perfecting my business plan since last year. Fortune smiles on me 'cos I'm prepared!

dialogText.cn: 都停一停，有话好好说……
dialogText.en: Let's all take a step back and talk nicely, okay...?

dialogText.cn: 弭队，管理员，问题就在于咱们这商业街招标，一贯是公平竞争。
dialogText.en: Captain Mi and Endmin, the Avenue business bidding process might be the problem. It calls for fair competition.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们怎么看？
dialogText.en: What's your take, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 这我没意见。比赛，考核，我们武陵人最爱的两招，公平！就定在<@qu.key>后天</>吧！
dialogText.en: Sure thing! We Wulingers have a thing for competitions! Fair and simple! Let's start <@qu.key>in two days</>.

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨，你俩的理由，都是很充分的，可是情况你们也知道，<@qu.key>空铺子</>现在只有一处，总归是要得出个结论来的……
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian, both of you have valid reasons, but you know there's only one <@qu.key>stall left</>. We have to reach an agreement...

dialogText.cn: 我知道，小刘啊，阿姨从来没想过为难你们，不管是我，还是阿仔，都会全力配合你们的安排。
dialogText.en: I know, Liu. I never wanted to make things difficult. Ah Zai and I will do our best and go with the watchguards' arrangements.

dialogText.cn: 等等，你自己服从安排，怎么又带上我啦？刘叔叔，我和她不一样，我不只带着方案，我还带着决心！
dialogText.en: Hold up. Count me out if you're going with the arrangements! I'm different, Uncle Liu. I got a plan *plus* the determination to see it through!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这事有点麻烦了。
dialogText.en: Hmph. Got some trouble on our hands.

dialogText.cn: 终末地不好介入这种复杂的……
dialogText.en: Endfield can't really handle complicated things like this...

dialogText.cn: 请你们吃饭。
dialogText.en: Dinner's on me.

dialogText.cn: 哦？那我有点子啦！管理员，靠过来点儿，我们商量商量……
dialogText.en: ...Oh! I might have an idea! Endmin, come here! Let's talk about this...

dialogText.cn: 办个比赛，嗯……倒是个主意。
dialogText.en: Start a competition? Hmm... Sounds like a plan.

dialogText.cn: 看在弭弗姐的面子上，有啥需要帮忙的，你们尽管张口！
dialogText.en: And to help Mi Fu out, feel free to ask if you need anything from us!

dialogText.cn: 好心肠的孩子们，阿姨这里没什么事，你们先去帮阿仔吧！
dialogText.en: You darlings are too kind, but I'm fine for now. Why don't you help Ah Zai first?

dialogText.cn: 这位阿姨和这位年轻人，是在争取同一家店铺的经营权吗？
dialogText.en: Are the lady and the young man arguing about who gets to use the stall?

dialogText.cn: 今天一大早，阿姨就过来了，想看看有没有机会接手这个铺面，结果撞上……
dialogText.en: I came here really early in the morning. Just wanna see if I could get lucky with the stall, but I ran into...

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨，阿仔，你们觉得呢？不如你俩各自去支个摊子，谁的人气高，就选谁。
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian and Ah Zai, you going along? Maybe you could set up your stalls first. May the most popular one win.

dialogText.cn: 这个铺面，我非租下来不可！
dialogText.en: This stall is mine to rent, and that's final!

dialogText.cn: 现在他俩的资质都齐全，方案也完整，又都是……唉，不好办啊！
dialogText.en: Both are qualified and their business plans are sound, but they're... Ugh. This is a real dilemma!

dialogText.cn: 阿姨也没意见，我有信心赢！
dialogText.en: Count this lady in. There's no way I'll lose!

dialogText.cn: 哦，是你们啊！是来支持我的吗？
dialogText.en: Oh, it's you! Here to back me up?

dialogText.cn: 我啊，准备办一个活动，刚好缺几个人手帮我<@qu.key>拍几张照</>，测试一下流程。
dialogText.en: I'm ... planning something special. Kinda need someone to <@qu.key>take a few photos</> and check the process.

dialogText.cn: 不过，测试流程听起来挺有意思的。这活我们接了！
dialogText.en: Hmm. Checking out the process sounds interesting. Your job is as good as done!

dialogText.cn: 开了个好头啊！来，我把几个坐标同步给你们，帮我去拍下对应的照片带回来就行！
dialogText.en: Sounds like a great start! I'm syncing you with the coordinates. Just help photograph the listed things for me!

dialogText.cn: 阿仔，你开始准备比赛了吗？
dialogText.en: Ah Zai, you ready for the competition?

dialogText.cn: 你准备开照相馆？
dialogText.en: Are you opening a photography studio?

dialogText.cn: 谁说是照相馆了！我要卖的是——保密，不然就没意思了。
dialogText.en: It's not gonna be a studio! I'm gonna sell — Ahem. It's a secret for now. I don't want to spoil the surprise.

dialogText.cn: 哦？这么快就拍好了？拍得怎么样，给我看看！
dialogText.en: Oh? Done already? Awesome. Show me the photos!

dialogText.cn: 唔，构图还不错，光影差了点味道，要是能等到一缕阳光恰好洒在那座天师桩顶上，就算过关了。
dialogText.en: Hmm. Composition is decent, but lighting's a bit off. I was hoping for a sprinkle of sunlight on the Tianshi Pillar. That'd be perfect.

dialogText.cn: 那没必要，后面还有流程呢。来，这个给你们。
dialogText.en: That's alright. There are other steps in the process. Here, take this.

dialogText.cn: 原来还送小礼物呀！对了，阿仔，刚才我们听到了你预先录制的音频？
dialogText.en: There's a giveaway too? Oh, Ah Zai, we also heard your pre-recordings back then.

dialogText.cn: 你们听到啦，那说明我放在打卡点的感应装置终于起效了，我确实是个天才。
dialogText.en: You heard it? That means my check-in location sensors are working. I am a genius.

dialogText.cn: 那些导览词，也是你自己写的吗？
dialogText.en: Did you write those tourist-guiding lines as well?

dialogText.cn: 当然咯，自古成就伟业之人都是面面俱到……又孑然一身的！
dialogText.en: Of course I did. People who achieve great things are meticulous... And they work alone as well!

dialogText.cn: 我准备的活动方案，是这样的——在打卡点拍照的客人，都能听到一段我精心准备的武陵风貌简述。
dialogText.en: I'll summarize my event plan for you — Patrons taking photos at the check-in locations will hear my well-prepared intro of Wuling's beautiful sights.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，到时候告诉你们。接下来，请你们去下一个打卡点吧！
dialogText.en: Heheh. I'll tell you when the time's right. So, interested in hitting the next check-in location?

dialogText.cn: 带着照片回到我这里，就能换一张连连乐兑奖券！
dialogText.en: If they bring the photos to my place, they'll get a Connect-and-Win voucher!

dialogText.cn: 我数数……嗯，一张不差。你们还碰上黎风了！……来，这是其余的兑奖券。
dialogText.en: Lemme count the photos... Hmm. We're all set. Wow. You ran into Lifeng...?! Alright, here are the rest of the vouchers!

dialogText.cn: 阿仔，你这个活动办得挺用心的啊。
dialogText.en: Ah Zai, this event of yours seems really well-planned.

dialogText.cn: 我太感动了——这对我来说是一个无比巨大的鼓励！我从小就被人评价，眼高手低，满脑子都是歪主意……
dialogText.en: Sorry, I got too carried away — They're the most motivating words I've heard! Everyone criticized me as a kid. They kept saying I aim too high and how my head is full of weird ideas...

dialogText.cn: 不怕你们笑，其实这些招数都是我从环塔商会那里学来的。
dialogText.en: Oh, I hope that doesn't feel like too much. I actually learned these tricks from the TGCC.

dialogText.cn: 可是，你的想法也不算是歪主意，我觉得还挺有创意的。
dialogText.en: But your ideas aren't weird. I think they're really innovative, you know.

dialogText.cn: 没错！创意，这就是我要说的——我眼中的武陵城，就应该是一座有创意的城市！
dialogText.en: That's right! Innovation! That's what I was gonna say — My vision is to make Wuling a city of innovations!

dialogText.cn: 她才不是那种整天闷头考学做实验，让人听得哈欠连天的地方。她一天一个模样，她最应该拥抱的是新意——
dialogText.en: She shouldn't simply focus on science and experiments and super boring lessons. The city deserves something new every day. She's gotta embrace innovation —

dialogText.cn: 她也不会沉湎于过去。没人能限制武陵城的未来！
dialogText.en: And Wuling shouldn't keep herself mired in the past. No one should shackle her future!

dialogText.cn: 感谢你们帮我忙啦。
dialogText.en: And thank you all for helping me out.

dialogText.cn: 别急，奖品还没准备齐全，比赛时你们再来吧！
dialogText.en: But sit tight. 'Cuz not all the prizes are ready yet. Swing by when the competition starts!

dialogText.cn: ……真、真的吗？真的很用心吗？！
dialogText.en: ...Re-really?! You think it's well-planned?!

dialogText.cn: 哼，他们不会击倒我的——我走的是艺术的道路，我，是商业艺术家！
dialogText.en: Hmph, but they won't take me down — Art is the career I chose! I ... am a business artist!

dialogText.cn: 他们那边办事可比我们这里时髦多了，你得包装自己，才能把东西推销出去。
dialogText.en: The TGCC's got all sorts of super-rad tricks! You need a really flashy package if you want your things to sell!

dialogText.cn: 放在哪儿了呢……我这记性，真是越老越不中用了……
dialogText.en: Where did I put it...? Ugh, my memories are getting worse with every year...

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨，您在找什么？
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian, what are you looking for?

dialogText.cn: 啊，是你们几个热心的孩子。阿姨正准备做烂肉面呢，结果放在这儿的一罐笋死活找不到了。
dialogText.en: Oh, the helpful young people are here. I'm trying to make some braised meat noodles, but I can't find my jar of bamboo sprouts.

dialogText.cn: 瞧，阿姨这熬高汤的大锅都准备好了。
dialogText.en: Look. I even prepared a huge pot for making the stock.

dialogText.cn: 光是开锅的工序就这么复杂啊……
dialogText.en: Getting the pot ready sounds like a ton of work already...

dialogText.cn: 这么多年都是这样做下来的，没觉得复杂。拿手的事，做得当然是越细越好呀。
dialogText.en: I've followed the steps all my life. Never felt complicated to me. If it's something you're good at, you'll get into the little, gritty details.

dialogText.cn: 是<@qu.key>竹林虫笋</>，一般长在<@qu.key>迷踪林</>那边。我每周都去挖一罐带回来，大概是这两天搬东西的时候落在哪儿了。
dialogText.en: They're <@qu.key>grove nymphsprouts</> that grow at the <@qu.key>Stragglers Grove</>. I would get a jar every week. And then I lost it while moving stuff around during the last few days.

dialogText.cn: 我们这就去给您挖！
dialogText.en: We'll dig some fresh ones for you!

dialogText.cn: 昨天专门拿去淬剑荡的山泉水里泡过的，回来还用粗盐擦了三遍，亮不亮？……结果找不到笋了，开不成伙！
dialogText.en: I soaked it in the mountain spring of Sword Quenching Marsh and rubbed it down with coarse salt. Look at it shine...! But my sprouts went missing, and now I can't even start cooking!

dialogText.cn: 你们挖的竹林虫笋可鲜了！真好，你们真是好孩子。
dialogText.en: These grove nymphsprouts are super fresh! I can't thank you enough, kind children.

dialogText.cn: 别的阿姨都收拾好了。凉葛洗干净了，壤香芹过了油，辣缕子也切了末……不差什么了，开工！
dialogText.en: I got the rest prepped. Washed the liangge turnip, soaked the earthy parsley in oil, and chopped the hot fennel... Everything's set. Time to cook!

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨，您以前是不是在居民区前头那块儿出摊的？开着一辆动力五轮车，上面支着一个小顶棚？
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian, did you run a stall back at the Residential Area? A five-wheel power-cart with a little canopy on top?

dialogText.cn: 是呀，好孩子，你是武陵人？
dialogText.en: Of course, darling. Are you from Wuling?

dialogText.cn: 我以前在武陵的时候，吃过您的面！在帝江号上还和人说起过呢！
dialogText.en: I had your noodles back when I was in Wuling! I even talked about them with my friends aboard Dijiang!

dialogText.cn: 那可有缘啦。不如，今天阿姨也教你们一手，回头也能自己做着吃。
dialogText.en: Seems we're tied together by fate. I can reveal a few of my secrets so you can make your own.

dialogText.cn: 这烂肉面说来简单，但要做好……还得下点功夫。
dialogText.en: Braised meat noodles may look simple, but perfection ... requires true commitment.

dialogText.cn: 先把材料备好，需要剁成臊子的长耳兽肉，还有凉葛、竹林虫笋、糖块、壤香芹和辣缕子。
dialogText.en: Our first step is prepping the materials. We need minced long-ear fillets, plus liangge turnips, grove nymphsprouts, rock sugar, earthy parsley, and hot fennel.

dialogText.cn: 另外，阿姨这面里有三个学问。第一，就是虫笋炖的高汤，要鲜！
dialogText.en: And there are three house secrets from Aunt Tian. First, use fresh stock for the nymphsprouts!

dialogText.cn: 第二，就是烂肉面的肉得烂。肉要文火慢炖，早了就生硬，晚了就全化了。
dialogText.en: Second, cook that meat over a small fire till it's just right. Too fast and it would be too tough. Too long and it would melt into the stock.

dialogText.cn: 第三个学问就在这现擀的面条里了。孩子们，面是有自己的想法的，你们得自己摸索。
dialogText.en: The third secret lies in the dough. It's living and breathing, children. You need to find it out yourselves.

dialogText.cn: 摸索？有什么诀窍吗？
dialogText.en: Find it out ourselves? Is there any trick to this?

dialogText.cn: 阿姨的诀窍就是，带着一份给人做饭的心。只要把这份心揉进去了，东西就好吃了。
dialogText.en: My trick is having the heart to feed someone. Once you get these feels, your meals will end up delicious.

dialogText.cn: 来，给你们示范一下！帮阿姨把材料拿过来。我说要多少，你们就拿多少，别多拿了啊！
dialogText.en: Come, I'll show you what it means! Help me bring the ingredients here. And just what I need, please! Don't bring too much!

dialogText.cn: 做好啦。孩子们来，趁热来尝一口。
dialogText.en: It's done, my darlings. Have it while it's hot.

dialogText.cn: 好吃——太幸福了，香香软软的，甜滋滋的，一口就回到从前的日子了！
dialogText.en: It's so good — Oh I feel so happy right now! It's so soft and sweet and nostalgic!

dialogText.cn: 唉，阿姨说到以前的事，总是止不住话。老了，老了。现在日子是好了，好得都不敢想。
dialogText.en: Oh dear, I just rambled on and on about the past, didn't I? Age is catching up, but days got a lot better. It felt too good to be true.

dialogText.cn: 好孩子，你们去忙别的事吧，阿姨今天收工了。
dialogText.en: Alright, darlings. Go ahead and do your thing. This old lady is ending the daily shift.

dialogText.cn: 好吃就好！现在日子好了，都用上好肉啦。
dialogText.en: And I'm happy you like it! Days got better, and so did the fillet.

dialogText.cn: 咦？那以前做烂肉面，用的是什么肉啊？
dialogText.en: Huh? So what meat did you use to make braised meat noodles in the past?

dialogText.cn: 以前那用的都是草菇，糊弄着填饱肚子的。
dialogText.en: Back then it was just straw mushrooms and a mix of other stuff to make it filling.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，说来话长了。
dialogText.en: Indeed. It's a long story.

dialogText.cn: 阿姨本来也没想着把面的生意做得这么大。第一碗面，是做给孩子吃的。
dialogText.en: I never thought about building a big noodle business. The first bowl I made was for a child.

dialogText.cn: 孩子吃了，带着他的朋友们来家里吃；小朋友们吃了，又带着家里的大人来吃。
dialogText.en: The child then brought friends over to try the noodles, and the other kids brought their parents over for more.

dialogText.cn: 那段时间，大家应该都过得很艰苦。
dialogText.en: Back in those days, I believe everyone had it hard.

dialogText.cn: 当年建城时，阿姨在这里当建筑工。
dialogText.en: When they were building this city, I worked in the construction crew.

dialogText.cn: 那时候啊，一个月才送一次物资，连“烂肉”都难吃上一口！
dialogText.en: We only received supplies once per month. Hardly any of us got the "braised meat".

dialogText.cn: 周围见不着人影不说，就连羽兽飞到这里，都得摇着头飞回去。
dialogText.en: This place was literally uninhabited. The fowlbeasts that arrived probably went home because there was nothing around.

dialogText.cn: 孩子生病，吃起来嘴里苦，阿姨为了哄他，拿最后的粮食熬了麦芽糖，和凉葛一起放进面里。
dialogText.en: The child got sick and everything tasted bitter. So I made some maltose with the remaining grains and added them to the dough with liangge turnip.

dialogText.cn: 大人们一吃，直掉眼泪！说这口味道，让人回到宏山，眼瞧见夏夜里，家门口外面矮墙上爬着的凉葛藤了。
dialogText.en: The adults couldn't stop crying as they ate! The flavors reminded them of Hongshan and the liangge turnip vines of summer sprawling along the fence.

dialogText.cn: 你们需要什么呢？
dialogText.en: What would you like?

dialogText.cn: 让故人久久安思吧……
dialogText.en: May they rest in peace...

dialogText.cn: 长眠之人会收到你们的心意的。
dialogText.en: The departed will appreciate this.

dialogText.cn: 有位老人总喜欢买这种花。
dialogText.en: There's an old man who likes this flower.

dialogText.cn: 你们……有什么事？
dialogText.en: Welcome, visitors... What is the purpose of this visit?

dialogText.cn: 我姓尹，是莫天师的学生。我老师他……
dialogText.en: Oh, hi. My name's Yin Dong. I'm a student of Tianshi Mo. My mentor has...

dialogText.cn: 莫天师……我听过他。他又收学生了？唉，想必你也受了不少苦。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Mo... I know him. Has he accepted another student? Oh poor thing, I hope you haven't suffered much.

dialogText.cn: 啊？我……老师他待我很好，哪来受苦一说？
dialogText.en: Wha? My ... uh, Mr. Mo treats me really well. No one's suffering.

dialogText.cn: 这些……也是我的老师告诉我的，他是莫天师旧识。听说，这位莫天师性情……难以捉摸，很少收学生。
dialogText.en: Well... My own mentor told me about Old Mo. They go back a long way. Old Mo has an ... interesting temperament. He rarely accepts disciples.

dialogText.cn: 最早跟着他的几个学生总是叫苦连天，待不了多久就离他而去了。
dialogText.en: And when he did, those poor souls just wouldn't stop complaining. All of them left after a while.

dialogText.cn: 自他最中意的学生病逝后，他就再也没收过学生。
dialogText.en: When his favorite disciple passed away, he simply stopped accepting any more.

dialogText.cn: 不过也好，他的理论过于剑走偏锋，谁跟了他都不容易。
dialogText.en: That was for the best. His theories are fringe and extreme. It's not easy for anyone involved.

dialogText.cn: 对了，我听说他去医疗点了，现在怎么样？
dialogText.en: Oh, I also heard Old Mo had been admitted to the Medical Clinic. How is he doing?

dialogText.cn: 老师他……我这次来，就是来打听老师下落的。大潮来袭时，老师突然就失踪了。
dialogText.en: He's... Well, I came here to see where he went. Tianshi Mo went missing when the Blight Tide hit us.

dialogText.cn: 什么？大潮……难道他又……这……
dialogText.en: What? The Blight Tide... Did he ... do it again...?

dialogText.cn: 他还是忘不了那些荒唐想法啊……抱歉，所里这两天没有看到他。
dialogText.en: He just couldn't let go of his preposterous ideas... Sorry, but I'm afraid we haven't seen him.

dialogText.cn: 你似乎知道些关于莫天师的事，能详细点告诉我们吗？
dialogText.en: You seem to know Tianshi Mo very well. Can you share a few more details with us?

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡监督、管理员？原来你们也是为此事而来。
dialogText.en: Endministrator and Supervisor Perlica? You're actually here for Old Mo as well.

dialogText.cn: 关于莫天师……我也不知道该怎么说。我资历尚浅，认识他时，他已经打算离开研究所了。
dialogText.en: I don't really know what to say about him. I just started my career when I met him, and he was already planning his resignation.

dialogText.cn: 他为什么要走？
dialogText.en: Why did he want to leave?

dialogText.cn: 大潮，据说都是因为侵蚀大潮。自十年前，他就忘不了那“潮水”。
dialogText.en: It was the Blight Tide. Everyone says so. It's been the only thing on his mind in these last ten years.

dialogText.cn: 十年前的灾难中，他失去了一只眼睛的视力，自那之后，他便发誓要退去这些侵蚀潮……
dialogText.en: He lost vision in one of his eyes during that disaster ten years ago. Since then, he swore to completely neutralize the Blight Tide...

dialogText.cn: 原来老师的残疾是这样造成的……
dialogText.en: So that's what happened to his eye...

dialogText.cn: 城里有很多像他一样的人，他们被灾难夺走了亲人，烙印下伤痕。
dialogText.en: He's like many in the city. They lost loved ones or family, and it burned a mark on them.

dialogText.cn: 看着那些因灾难愈发严重的侵蚀潮，眼里都是仇恨……
dialogText.en: He looked upon the ever-growing Blight Tide with nothing but hate...

dialogText.cn: 莫天师时不时还会到侵蚀潮前叫骂，一骂就是一整天。
dialogText.en: Old Mo occasionally went to the tidal shores just to curse the Tide. And his curses could last an entire day.

dialogText.cn: 研究所经常会批评他对待研究的态度，可他不以为意。
dialogText.en: The Institute often criticized his attitude towards his research, but Old Mo never cared.

dialogText.cn: 他的研究到底是……
dialogText.en: What is his research...?

dialogText.cn: 他的研究方向源于息壤研究的分支，但他坚持选择了其中最为危险的打潮鞭。
dialogText.en: It's a project based on a branch of Xiranite science. He chose the most dangerous project of all — the Tide Flayer.

dialogText.cn: 他认为那鞭子能够以点破面，再大的“浪潮”，只要直击核心，就能轻易击溃。
dialogText.en: He believed the flaying whip could expand fracture points into fault planes. A direct strike at the core would bring the whole thing down.

dialogText.cn: 理论上确实可能实现，但……
dialogText.en: It's theoretically feasible, but...

dialogText.cn: 但风险实在太大了，使用打潮鞭几乎要让自己完全暴露在侵蚀面前。
dialogText.en: But it's too risky. A user of the Tide Flayer would be completely exposed to the Blight itself.

dialogText.cn: 对核心的判断哪怕只是一点偏差，都可能让人送命……
dialogText.en: The slightest miscalculations of core locations would have potentially lethal consequences...

dialogText.cn: 难怪会遭到研究所的反对。
dialogText.en: No wonder the Institute went against it.

dialogText.cn: 老师他平时都是一个温和的人，居然……
dialogText.en: But Mr. Mo is usually a really kind man, this is...

dialogText.cn: 他离开研究所后，我就没怎么见过他了，希望他这一次平安无事。
dialogText.en: I hardly ever saw him after he left the Institute. I hope he's doing alright.

dialogText.cn: 感谢你告诉我们这些，我们再在研究所的其他地方找找，看会不会有什么遗漏的线索。
dialogText.en: Thank you for sharing the information with us. We'll keep searching the Institute to see if there're any clues we've missed.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀潮，侵蚀潮……老师竟是如此痛恨侵蚀潮……
dialogText.en: Blight Tide, Blight Tide... Mr. Mo really hates this thing...

dialogText.cn: 这些记录……看起来这就是莫天师曾经主导的研究了，“危险系数过高”……所以研究所才会建议停止项目。
dialogText.en: Look at these files... They look like Tianshi Mo's project. "Hazard factors are too high"... I guess this is why the Institute decided to shelve it.

dialogText.cn: 看来刚才那位天师说得没错。
dialogText.en: That Tianshi told us the truth.

dialogText.cn: 老师的研究居然如此危险……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo's project ... it turned out to be dangerous...

dialogText.cn: 这里还写着老师旧居的位置……我认识老师不久，他就住进医疗点了，这里……老师他从未提起过。
dialogText.en: This looks like Mr. Mo's old address... He got admitted to the Medical Clinic not long after I met him... Mr. Mo never mentioned it to me.

dialogText.cn: 没有半途而废的道理，我们走一趟吧。
dialogText.en: I'm not leaving any leads unchecked. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 老师会不会回家去了呢……
dialogText.en: Maybe Mr. Mo went home...

dialogText.cn: 这封信是……
dialogText.en: There's a letter...

dialogText.cn: 上面的日期是几天前的，你的老师果然回过这里。
dialogText.en: The date written on it is several days ago. Your mentor did indeed come back here.

dialogText.cn: “所托之事，安思园再议”……老师和其他人约了明天在安思园见面……
dialogText.en: "We shall meet at Serenity Garden and discuss the promise at length"... Mr. Mo is going to meet someone at the Garden tomorrow...

dialogText.cn: 这封信没有署名欸，但看语气，是你老师的熟人。
dialogText.en: The letter is anonymous. But the tone tells me it's from someone close to Tianshi Mo.

dialogText.cn: 终于有些收获了，我们再看看其他地方吧。
dialogText.en: We finally got a strong lead! Let's look around some more.

dialogText.cn: 医生，你好。我们在找一位姓莫的老天师，你知道他吗？
dialogText.en: Hello, physician. I'm looking for Tianshi, one named Mo. Is he on record?

dialogText.cn: 莫天师……你们说的是老莫吧？我何止是知道……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Mo...? You're talking about Old Mo. We probably know him too well...

dialogText.cn: 这半年来，我可被他折腾得够呛。
dialogText.en: He's been a constant headache for six months.

dialogText.cn: 他刚住进这个医疗点时，精神还算正常……只需要调理长期被实验所影响的身体。
dialogText.en: Old Mo was still quite normal when we first admitted him... It was just a case of rehab to undo the effects of his tests and experiments.

dialogText.cn: 可随着时间一长，我就发现他的举止越来越怪。
dialogText.en: But as time went by, Old Mo's behaviors became increasingly erratic.

dialogText.cn: 房间里的陈设总是被他搞坏……你问他怎么回事，他又会摆出一脸呆呆傻傻的样子。
dialogText.en: He kept breaking ward furnishings and equipment... We tried asking him why, but he always played stupid.

dialogText.cn: 损坏……是用东西抽打导致的吗？
dialogText.en: Breaking... Did he hit or whip them with something?

dialogText.cn: 也不全是，他还因此受过两次伤，把我吓坏了。
dialogText.en: Not entirely. He got injured twice due to his tantrums. The incidents scared me.

dialogText.cn: 相对正常的时候，他就总是神神叨叨地念着一些让人听不懂的话……
dialogText.en: And when he's relatively stable, he would start mumbling things that nobody understands...

dialogText.cn: 什么施力点，什么道法因果……经常前言不搭后语。
dialogText.en: Things like "force point" and "karmic cycle"... None of it made any sense.

dialogText.cn: 有时他还会在半夜跳起来，像是发现了什么不得了的东西一样在走廊里大敲警铃，引起了不少不必要的麻烦。
dialogText.en: Sometimes he'd wake up at midnight and start setting off alarms as though he sensed something. Like I said, a real source of trouble.

dialogText.cn: 他……那位莫天师一直是这个样子吗？
dialogText.en: Has the old dude... I mean, has Tianshi Mo always acted like this?

dialogText.cn: 唉，他正常的时候人还算不错，只是随着时间推移，他言行古怪的时候就越来越多。
dialogText.en: Well, he was nice before he got sick. But his behaviors only grew stranger with time.

dialogText.cn: 你们此行是……他又惹出什么麻烦了吗？我先替他赔个不是。
dialogText.en: Since you're here ... I'm assuming he caused trouble again. We really apologize for that.

dialogText.cn: 不……他没有造成什么麻烦。只是……老先生现在行踪不明，他的学生担心他的安危。
dialogText.en: No... He didn't cause any. But the old Tianshi went ... missing. His disciple is worried about his safety.

dialogText.cn: 行踪不明……你们试过去技术生产办那边的试验田找他吗？
dialogText.en: Missing...? Did you try looking for him at the Tech Production Office test fields?

dialogText.cn: 试验田？
dialogText.en: Test fields?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我也不知道他去那里想做什么，但他以前也偷偷溜出去过。那儿的夏毅天师向我们抱怨过好几次。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I don't know why he kept sneaking off to the farm. Tianshi Xia Yi has made quite a few complaints about this.

dialogText.cn: 唉，现如今处处都绷紧了神经，希望老莫他没出什么大碍。
dialogText.en: Hoo. Everyone's pretty stressed and anxious. I just hope Old Mo is alright.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你，我们会去看看的。
dialogText.en: Thank you. That's where we'll look.

dialogText.cn: 结果还是没能找到老师的下落……
dialogText.en: After all this, we still couldn't find where Mr. Mo went...

dialogText.cn: 我不会放弃的，只要还有一点希望。
dialogText.en: I won't give up, not when there's a glimmer of hope.

dialogText.cn: 你们和老师素不相识，但……依然为他做了这么多，我说不出有多感激你们。
dialogText.en: You didn't know him, but ... you still did so much for him. I can't even begin to tell you how grateful I feel.

dialogText.cn: 不必客气，莫天师一定吉人自有天相。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. Mr. Mo is definitely the lucky type.

dialogText.cn: 我再去研究研究老师留下的那些线索，一定还能找到什么蛛丝马迹的。
dialogText.en: I'll study the files and clues left by Mr. Mo closely. There's definitely something hidden inside.

dialogText.cn: 有什么进展随时告诉我们，我们也会多留意的。
dialogText.en: Keep us updated on your progress. We'll also pay extra attention on our end.

dialogText.cn: 明天我们再来这里，等等看那位与你老师有约的人吧。
dialogText.en: We shall return here tomorrow, and wait for the person your mentor promised to meet.

dialogText.cn: 这是……老师最喜欢的花，你们怎么知道的？
dialogText.en: This ... this is Mr. Mo's favorite flower. How did you know?

dialogText.cn: 老师……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo...

dialogText.cn: 坏了，坏了，这里也找不到，他老人家究竟到哪里去了！
dialogText.en: Oh dear, I'm so screwed... I can't find the old dude here either! Where did he go?

dialogText.cn: 老师啊，老师，你可让学生好找啊。
dialogText.en: Oh, Mr. Mo ... I need to find you fast.

dialogText.cn: 这位小兄弟怎么满脸愁容，发生了什么？
dialogText.en: Hello there, young man. You look troubled. What happened?

dialogText.cn: 啊？你们是？
dialogText.en: Oh? Who are you?

dialogText.cn: 你们定是庄天师的客人吧！我都听说了，守住武陵城，全靠各位的努力。
dialogText.en: You must be the guests of Tianshi Zhuang! I heard all about you! The defenders of Wuling City!

dialogText.cn: 这是全城人齐心协力换来的。你一个人在这儿发愁，是出什么事了吗？
dialogText.en: Everyone in the city fought hard to protect their homes. What's going on?

dialogText.cn: 这……这从哪儿说起好啊。各位，我想请你们，帮我找回我的老师。
dialogText.en: Er... where should I start? Well, I really need your help to find my mentor.

dialogText.cn: 你的老师？你们是……
dialogText.en: Your mentor? You're...

dialogText.cn: 我叫尹冬，去年来武陵求学。我的老师莫天师曾在天师府学院授课，最近半年……都在医疗点里。
dialogText.en: My name's Yin Dong and I started my studies at Wuling last year. My mentor, Tianshi Mo, is a lecturer at the Tianshi Bureau Academy. But he's been ... institutionalized for six months now.

dialogText.cn: 在大潮袭来后，我本想带着老师去避难，他老人家腿脚不方便需要人照料，可谁知……
dialogText.en: When the Blight Tide came, I went looking for him to get him to shelter. He's got bad legs, you see. But...

dialogText.cn: 医疗点的崔大夫说他又跑丢了！我寻遍了城里都没找到他的人。
dialogText.en: Physician Cui of the Medical Clinic told me he had run off! I searched the entire city! Nothing!

dialogText.cn: 崔大夫还以为，他老人家又在胡闹……以前他也经常乱跑，但最多一两天就会回去。
dialogText.en: Physician Cui thinks that the ... old dolt is just throwing a tantrum. He did plenty of that, but always returned after a couple of days.

dialogText.cn: 可这次，这次不太一样。有人说他是冲着侵蚀潮去的！
dialogText.en: But ... it's really different this time. People told me he charged straight for the Blight Tide!

dialogText.cn: 他疯了吗？那可是侵蚀潮！
dialogText.en: Is he crazy?! We're talking about a Blight Tide!

dialogText.cn: 老师他平时就有些……特立独行，人们都说，医疗点是看在他几十年的贡献上，才对他再三宽容……
dialogText.en: Well, Mr. Mo has always been ... rather interesting. People told me that the Medical Clinic was being extra forgiving because he worked really hard for decades...

dialogText.cn: 但他是我的恩师！他不嫌我笨拙，为我传道解惑……而且，这次事关侵蚀潮，我担心老师他……
dialogText.en: But I don't care what they say about Mr. Mo! I'm clumsy too but he took the time and taught me how things work... I'm just worried he really went off into the Blight Tide...

dialogText.cn: 你先冷静一下，你之前有找到什么线索吗？
dialogText.en: Take a deep breath, young man. Have you found any other clues?

dialogText.cn: 我先前……
dialogText.en: Back then, I was...

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀潮袭来的样子……我们也看到了。那种情况下出城，恐怕凶多吉少……
dialogText.en: Remember the Blight Tide...? We all saw it. Heading outside the city feels like a death wish...

dialogText.cn: 但，宏山讲究师恩如山，看到他这副样子，我有点于心不忍。
dialogText.en: But respecting one's mentor is a really big thing in Hongshan. I don't know ... the lad looks really desperate.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？那太好了！
dialogText.en: Really? That's awesome!

dialogText.cn: 所以，最后的目击者是看到他往城外待修缮区的方向去了吗？城外可能还有危险，交给我们吧。
dialogText.en: So the last witness saw him running off to the Maintenance Zone outside the city? The area may be dangerous. We'll handle it.

dialogText.cn: 这位小兄弟，你在城里继续打听打听消息，我们去城外帮你找找线索。
dialogText.en: Alright, young man. Stay in the city and keep searching. We'll look outside the city for you.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？那……太感激三位了！
dialogText.en: You're really helping? I don't know how to thank you all!

dialogText.cn: 但……侵蚀潮凶险无比，天使又那么多，如果……
dialogText.en: But ... Blight Tides and Aggeloi are really dangerous. If...

dialogText.cn: 我不强求什么，只是，我是老师如今唯一的学生，我得给他，给自己一个交代。
dialogText.en: I'm not asking much. But I'm his only disciple. It's the very least I could do for him ... and myself.

dialogText.cn: 我们会竭尽所能的。
dialogText.en: And we will do everything we can.

dialogText.cn: 你们回来了！怎么样？有找到我的老师吗？
dialogText.en: You're back! What did you find? Anything about Mr. Mo?

dialogText.cn: 我们跟着线索和脚印找到了待修缮区附近，很遗憾……
dialogText.en: The clues and footprints led us near the Maintenance Zone. Unfortunately...

dialogText.cn: 脚印最终走向了侵蚀潮中，已经没有办法继续搜索了。
dialogText.en: ...the footprints disappeared into the Blight Tide. And that's where our leads ended.

dialogText.cn: 什么……老师他，老师他真的……
dialogText.en: What...? Did Mr. Mo ... did he really...?

dialogText.cn: 沿途还有一些像是挥鞭留下的痕迹，但……再无其他信息了。
dialogText.en: We also found traces that look like lashes from a whip. But there's ... nothing else.

dialogText.cn: 那是老师的<@qu.key>打潮鞭</>留下的……他总是拿着他的打潮鞭，念叨着“退潮、退潮”的。
dialogText.en: They were made by Mr. Mo's <@qu.key>Tide Flayer</>... He always walked around with that while mumbling: "Back, filthy tide! Back!"

dialogText.cn: 你先别着急，还没有证据证明莫天师遇险了。
dialogText.en: Don't give up yet. There's no proof that Tianshi Mo didn't make it.

dialogText.cn: 我、我知道了……无论如何，还是感谢你们帮了我这么大一个忙，你们既是武陵城的恩人，也是我的大恩人。
dialogText.en: I understand... But I gotta thank you all for helping me out. You've been true heroes to Wuling ... and to me.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉……只是结果……
dialogText.en: I'm sorry... But the results...

dialogText.cn: 唉，大潮消退，有些人、事、物却也已经随潮水而去，不知道还回不回得来……
dialogText.en: Ugh. The Blight Tide has receded, but it washed away plenty of people and things... I don't know if they would ever return...

dialogText.cn: 还不能放弃希望，他之前提到过自己的老师常住在城里的医疗点？
dialogText.en: We shouldn't give up. He told us that his mentor was getting treated at the City Medical Clinic.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，过去看看能不能找到什么线索吧。
dialogText.en: Yeah. We should head over and ask around.

dialogText.cn: 无论结果如何，我都不能就此放弃……三位恩人，多谢你们的帮助，我再去找找其他线索。
dialogText.en: I'm not giving up just yet... Really appreciate your help, but I have to start looking for other leads.

dialogText.cn: 你们是谁？这里正忙着呢，没时间招待你们。
dialogText.en: Who might you be? People are really busy and I can't spare anyone to give you a tour.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀大潮刚刚退去，抢救下来的田地就这么些，还被那怪老头捣乱……
dialogText.en: The Blight Tide just receded and we could only save a few fields. Also some old troublemaker is giving us grief...

dialogText.cn: 怪老头？难道是莫天师？
dialogText.en: Old troublemaker? Could that be Tianshi Mo?

dialogText.cn: 你认识他？那倒好了，你们看看，这附近变成了什么样子？
dialogText.en: You know him? Great. Take a look at this mess we have on our hands.

dialogText.cn: 这些侵蚀……
dialogText.en: The Blight...

dialogText.cn: 原本大潮刚过，我们还在想办法处理这些残留的侵蚀，谁知道他突然冒了出来。
dialogText.en: The Blight Tide was just receding. We were trying to get rid of the residual masses when the old geezer showed up.

dialogText.cn: 他举着根鞭子在侵蚀上这抽一下，那打一下，把情况弄得更糟了！
dialogText.en: Then he started lashing out at the Blight with some kind of whip. And he made it worse!

dialogText.cn: 嘴里还念叨着什么“破点——断面”的，在我看来完全是捣乱！
dialogText.en: He was also spouting nonsense like "fracture point" and "fault plane". That old clot is nothing but trouble!

dialogText.cn: 他这是……
dialogText.en: Is he...?

dialogText.cn: 我不管他是怎么想的，但结果就是这里变得更糟了！
dialogText.en: I don't care what he was trying. He made things worse. Period.

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀到处都是，农田都被破坏了。我们准备的补救措施根本推进不下去，只能指望靠这些试验田想想办法。
dialogText.en: The Blight messed up the farms. We can't even deploy the rescue measures we prepared. These test fields are the only solution we have.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……
dialogText.en: How did things end up like this...

dialogText.cn: 现在正是缺储备粮的时候，我们来帮你把这些侵蚀处理掉。
dialogText.en: Food reserves are low. Let's help you with the de-blighting operations.

dialogText.cn: 这位小哥能否也帮我们个忙，找找那位老人？他现在行踪不明，他的学生担心得很。
dialogText.en: But I wonder if you could help us find that old troublemaker as well. He's gone missing and his disciple is kinda worried.

dialogText.cn: 眼下保住这些田地才是最重要的，如果你们真有办法，我当然心存感激。
dialogText.en: Protecting these fields is our top priority. I'll be super grateful if you could fix them.

dialogText.cn: 这样吧，我带人在四周多找找，这些侵蚀就拜托你们了。
dialogText.en: Got a plan. I can get people to look around. But we're really counting on you to clear the Blight.

dialogText.cn: 交给我们吧！
dialogText.en: Leave it to us!

dialogText.cn: 这些侵蚀的核心……似乎有些不太一样。
dialogText.en: These Blight Cores ... kinda look different.

dialogText.cn: 在我们动手之前，它们就有过被攻击的痕迹，看上去就像……鞭痕？
dialogText.en: Someone attacked them before we arrived here. These look like ... lash marks.

dialogText.cn: ……难道说？
dialogText.en: ...Does that mean?

dialogText.cn: 你们真的做到了？太好了！这下大家都能放下心来了。
dialogText.en: You did it?! Wonderful! Now everyone can have a peace of mind.

dialogText.cn: 这里的侵蚀都被人从外部破坏过……虽然看上去影响扩大了，实际上危害性有所降低。
dialogText.en: Someone attacked the Blight masses here... They might look bigger, but they're also less hazardous.

dialogText.cn: 真的吗？你的意思是……
dialogText.en: Really? Are you saying that...?

dialogText.cn: 但……这个人的技术并不完善，没办法准确地破坏核心，从结果而言，他确实把局面搞得更乱了。
dialogText.en: Well ... his technique wasn't perfect and he couldn't strike the core itself. It would seem that he made things worse, but he was only trying to help.

dialogText.cn: 原来他不是有意来捣乱的……我为刚才的出言不逊道歉。
dialogText.en: So he wasn't here to cause trouble... I should apologize for my outburst earlier.

dialogText.cn: 多亏有你们保住了试验田。不过……很遗憾，我们的人没能找到那位老人。
dialogText.en: And thank you for saving the test fields. But ... we couldn't locate the old man. Sorry.

dialogText.cn: 他留下的痕迹和天使的路径重合在了一起……
dialogText.en: The lash marks he left overlap with the Aggeloid trail...

dialogText.cn: 那些痕迹延伸到了很远的地方，我想他当时应该还没卷入麻烦。
dialogText.en: The lash marks go a long way into the distance. I don't think he's in trouble yet.

dialogText.cn: 天使？那他岂不是很危险？
dialogText.en: Aggeloi? That means he's in danger.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，职责所在，我们需要为大家的口粮负责，只能帮你们这么多了。
dialogText.en: Sorry, I want to do more but I gotta do my job. We need to grow enough food for everyone.

dialogText.cn: 没事的，剩下的事交给我们自己处理就好。
dialogText.en: It's alright. We can handle the rest from here.

dialogText.cn: 怎么办？我们先把得到的信息告诉尹冬？
dialogText.en: What now? Should we inform Yin Dong about our findings?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我们可以交流一下彼此已知的信息。
dialogText.en: Yes, and we should also use the opportunity to keep everyone updated.

dialogText.cn: 居然一下子就修好了！
dialogText.en: I can't believe you fixed it so quickly!

dialogText.cn: 我看看……这里是过去实验项目的记录，还有一些日记片段。
dialogText.en: Let me see... Records from past projects and segments from a few diary entries.

dialogText.cn: 上面记录了研究侵蚀的项目档案……有些数据需要破译和解读。
dialogText.en: Records of Blight research files... Some data needs decryption and deciphering.

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？你发现了什么吗？
dialogText.en: What is it? Did you find something?

dialogText.cn: 而日记部分……
dialogText.en: The diary entries...

dialogText.cn: 原来老师是因此才放弃了一直坚持的研究……
dialogText.en: The reason why Mr. Mo gave up the project he was obsessed with...

dialogText.cn: 这是老师的日记，最后一篇的时间是两年前……恩人们也看看吧。
dialogText.en: This is Mr. Mo's diary. The last entry was written two years ago... You should take a look as well.

dialogText.cn: 这里有老师所有的实验记录……是老师全部的心血。
dialogText.en: These are all the test logs made by Mr. Mo ... everything he worked on.

dialogText.cn: 老师他……为了打潮鞭几乎付出了所有，却又为什么把这一切破坏？
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo ... he gave up almost everything for the Tide Flayer. Why did he destroy it all?

dialogText.cn: 身体的残缺、众人的质疑都没有把他击垮，但……研究定格在了两年前……
dialogText.en: Nothing stopped him. Not even his disability nor his doubtful peers... But the research progress halted two years ago...

dialogText.cn: 看样子，莫天师在那次失败之后选择了放弃。
dialogText.en: From the looks of it, Tianshi Mo decided to give up after the failure.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……随后老师便申请了调岗，又去医疗点休养了……
dialogText.en: Yeah... Mr. Mo then applied for a transfer ... and got himself admitted to the Medical Clinic...

dialogText.cn: 老师平时最常说的就是“放下”……我这才知道，他指的是什么。
dialogText.en: He kept talking about "letting go"... I finally realized what he was talking about.

dialogText.cn: 三位恩人，我有个想去的地方。老师他……很可能前往了那里。
dialogText.en: My dear heroes, there's a place I want to go. Mr. Mo ... might be there.

dialogText.cn: 是的，是安思园……
dialogText.en: Yes. Serenity Garden...

dialogText.cn: 你们来了，就是这里……
dialogText.en: You're here. This is the place...

dialogText.cn: 这里是……
dialogText.en: This is...

dialogText.cn: 这个功绩石上，刻着老师一个学生的名字……春荷师姐……她曾经是最认同老师的人。
dialogText.en: This merit stone bears Chun He's name ... She was my senior ... and she was ... Mr. Mo's strongest supporter.

dialogText.cn: 哪怕其他师兄师姐都走了，她依然跟着老师奔波在侵蚀潮的最前线……但，先天的疾病让她英年早逝……
dialogText.en: Other senior disciples left but Chun He stayed with Mr. Mo, fighting the Blight Tide at every shore... But she had a birth defect and died young...

dialogText.cn: 老师带我来过这里。每一次来……他都会摆一朵荷花，怪自己没有好好看着身边人……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo brought me here. And every time he did ... he always brought a lotus flower and blamed himself for not protecting those around him...

dialogText.cn: 老师只说过这么多，或许老师选择放下，也跟这些有关吧。
dialogText.en: That's all Mr. Mo told me. Perhaps he chose to let go because of this.

dialogText.cn: 放下……也是一件难事。
dialogText.en: Letting go ... is a very difficult thing to do.

dialogText.cn: 师姐她，真的希望老师放下吗……
dialogText.en: But would Chun He really want Mr. Mo to let this go...?

dialogText.cn: 这些是……
dialogText.en: What are these...?

dialogText.cn: 看来师兄师姐们也来过……
dialogText.en: I guess my fellow seniors came here as well...

dialogText.cn: 那边有一位卖花少女，你们先去吧，我还想和师姐说说话……我们查到的那些，我也希望师姐知道。
dialogText.en: There's a florist over there. I... wanna talk to Chun He alone for a while... I want her to know what we found.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师……为什么您会来这里？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang...? What brings you here?

dialogText.cn: 你是莫天师的学生吗？我听他提起过你，怎么是你来赴约？莫天师呢？
dialogText.en: Are you a disciple of Tianshi Mo? He told me about you, but I didn't expect to meet you in this meeting. Where is your mentor?

dialogText.cn: 老师他……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo ... he's...

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，潘叔，你们怎么来了？难道说……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang and Uncle Pan?! If you're here, that means...

dialogText.cn: 莫天师早先说有事希望与我商议，至于他……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Mo told me earlier about a matter he wishes to discuss. As for him...

dialogText.cn: 上次瞧见这小兄弟在茶馆里哭，我一听和老莫有关，就有点担心。这不晨练那时见他匆忙出了城，想跟上来瞅瞅。
dialogText.en: I saw the young man getting all emotional in a teahouse, and got worried when I heard Old Mo's involved. I was doing my morning exercise when the young man rushed out, so I decided to see what's going on.

dialogText.cn: 原来庄天师就是与老师相约之人。老师他……依然不知去向。
dialogText.en: So Mr. Mo made an appointment with you, Tianshi Zhuang, but ... I don't know where he went.

dialogText.cn: 莫天师……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Mo...

dialogText.cn: 莫非……
dialogText.en: Perhaps he...

dialogText.cn: 庄天师，难道您知道我老师的行踪？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang, I don't suppose you know where he went?

dialogText.cn: 我只是有些担忧。你知道他约我来，是打算和我商议什么事吗？
dialogText.en: I'm just a little worried. Do you know the purpose and topics we're supposed to discuss?

dialogText.cn: 他希望，我能帮你找一位新的老师。
dialogText.en: He wanted me to ... find you a new mentor.
WHAT?!

dialogText.cn: 从那时起，我就隐隐觉得有些不安。
dialogText.en: Since then, I can't help but feel a little worried.

dialogText.cn: 哎，自你就任管代以来，他一直和你关系不好。
dialogText.en: Ever since you became the Viceroy, Old Mo turned quite grouchy as well.

dialogText.cn: 材料研究所对息壤的研究方向和他的理论渐行渐远。他会来求你，我听着也有点吃惊。
dialogText.en: Xiranite research at the Institute of Materials Science got further away from his theories. I'm surprised he actually asked you to help the young man.

dialogText.cn: 老师他究竟是什么意思……
dialogText.en: What is Mr. Mo trying to do...?

dialogText.cn: 他希望我给你找一个靠谱的老师。说自己平时最愧对的，一个是你的师姐，另一个就是你。
dialogText.en: He wants me to transfer you to a dependable mentor. Tianshi Mo can't stop saying how he has failed you and your senior.

dialogText.cn: 对你的师姐，是因为……她壮志未酬；对你，则是因为没能授业解惑。
dialogText.en: Your senior is ... was just short of achieving her dreams. As for you, he confided that he failed his duties of mentorship.

dialogText.cn: 我看他的信，字里行间，满满都是一个“悔”字。
dialogText.en: I read his letter. Every line is filled with regret.

dialogText.cn: 或许，他也认为，为了研究，为了他眼里的复仇，自己失去了太多吧。
dialogText.en: Perhaps he realized that ... he had lost way too much for the sake of research and his revenge.

dialogText.cn: 哼，你一点也不了解老莫。
dialogText.en: Hmph. That's because you know nothing about Old Mo.

dialogText.cn: 他悔的，从不是做过什么，他悔的，是自己放下了什么。
dialogText.en: Old Mo grieves not because he didn't do it. He grieves because he let things go.

dialogText.cn: 如果没能放下，他为何愿意住进医疗点？
dialogText.en: If he didn't want to let go, why get himself checked in to the Medical Clinic?

dialogText.cn: 如果放下了，他又为何不辞而别？
dialogText.en: If he gave up already, why did he leave without a word?

dialogText.cn: 老师他……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo ... he's...

dialogText.cn: 他曾故意赶我走，想让我去换个老师，但……
dialogText.en: He tried to kick me out of his lab so I can find a new mentor, but...

dialogText.cn: 每当老师到师姐的墓前，他都会像变了一个人一样。
dialogText.en: ...whenever Mr. Mo visits Chun He's stone, he would turn into someone else.

dialogText.cn: 他平时总念叨着“放下了，放下了”，在师姐墓前却从来不说。
dialogText.en: "Let it go. Just let it go." He never stopped saying that, but he didn't tell any of that to Chun He.

dialogText.cn: 我时不时还能在他那双眼睛里，看到一股燃起的熊熊烈火……
dialogText.en: There were times when I saw the spark of flaming passion in his gaze...

dialogText.cn: 失去的越多，就越难放下啊。
dialogText.en: The more you lose ... the less likely you are to give up.

dialogText.cn: 依我看，他就从未放下过一刻。
dialogText.en: From what I see, Old Mo never gave up. Not one moment.

dialogText.cn: 大潮……对了，侵蚀潮边你们找过吗？
dialogText.en: The Tide... Hold on. Have you checked the Blight Tide itself?

dialogText.cn: 恩人们出去寻找过……但……
dialogText.en: These heroes searched the place ... but...

dialogText.cn: 那片带走他的亲人，损毁他的身体，腐蚀他的精神的大潮。
dialogText.en: The Tide that took his loved ones, left a mark on his body, and ate at his soul.

dialogText.cn: 我们来了，让你久等了。
dialogText.en: We're here. Sorry to keep you waiting.

dialogText.cn: 是恩人们啊！我还以为是老师的友人……我从早上就在这里等了，还没有人来过……
dialogText.en: My heroes! I thought you'd be friends of Mr. Mo... I've been waiting since morning, but no one else came...

dialogText.cn: 我们走吧，去看看那片潮。
dialogText.en: We should go and see that Blight Tide.

dialogText.cn: 观测站有个地方，在那里，能够看到侵蚀潮的全貌……
dialogText.en: There's a place at the monitoring center where one can see the entirety of the Blight Tide...

dialogText.cn: 这片侵蚀潮好像不太对劲。
dialogText.en: This Blight Tide doesn't look right.

dialogText.cn: 这样的扩散面……和试验田那里的侵蚀很像。
dialogText.en: The spread and distribution... It actually resembles the Blight in the test fields.

dialogText.cn: 老师，难道真是老师……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo... Maybe Mr. Mo...

dialogText.cn: 别着急，我们去更近些的地方看看。
dialogText.en: No rush. Let's find a place where we can get closer.
MISTER MO —!! MISTER MO —!!

dialogText.cn: 老师……您……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo... Are you...

dialogText.cn: 老师……老师……
dialogText.en: No... Mister ... Mo...

dialogText.cn: 说什么放下放下的，不就是因为放不下嘛……
dialogText.en: "Let it go. Just let it go." Well... Old Mo never let go...

dialogText.cn: 侵蚀……真的被劈开了？
dialogText.en: The Tide... It's been split apart.

dialogText.cn: 这些侵蚀处在一种异常的不稳定态，息壤通过打潮鞭影响了侵蚀核心……
dialogText.en: This Blight is held in a strangely unstable state. The Tide Flayer delivered the Xiranite and affected the Blight Core...

dialogText.cn: 他真的成功了……
dialogText.en: He really did it...

dialogText.cn: 老师，老师您看看啊，您的研究成功了啊！
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo! Please just open your eyes again! Look! Your project succeeded!

dialogText.cn: 千古多少事，听潮，饮酒，又付一念间……
dialogText.en: So many legends pass us by, while we drink and listen to the lapping of tides...

dialogText.cn: 放不下的，也总会放下。
dialogText.en: Every obsession ... will find its release.

dialogText.cn: 敬你一杯，老莫。
dialogText.en: I raise this cup in your name, Old Mo.

dialogText.cn: 老师……
dialogText.en: Mr. Mo...

dialogText.cn: 或许，那就是他将你托付给庄天师的原因吧？
dialogText.en: Perhaps it's why he entrusted you to Tianshi Zhuang.

dialogText.cn: 你才是他唯一放不下的。安排好一切后，他才能和侵蚀潮做个“了结”。
dialogText.en: The old man really cared about you. He made the arrangements before he "settled" his business with the Blight Tide.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，我只是……
dialogText.en: I know, but I'm just...

dialogText.cn: 三位恩人，我只是老师教了不到一年的学生，他却对我视为己出，教我做人，为我解惑。
dialogText.en: My heroes, I only studied under Mr. Mo for less than a year but he treated me like his own kid. He taught me real values and lifted my ignorance.

dialogText.cn: 无论其他人怎么看待老师，在我眼里，他就是我最重要的恩师。
dialogText.en: I don't care what others say about him. He's the most important guide in my life.

dialogText.cn: 看到那“潮水”，看到他的身姿……我更加坚信了这一点。
dialogText.en: Witnessing the "Tide" and his final pose ... only proved me right.

dialogText.cn: 庄天师联系了天师府学院，莫天师……之后的事他们会接手的。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang contacted the Tianshi Bureau Academy. Tianshi Mo ... will be well taken care of.

dialogText.cn: 至于莫天师的托付……她联系了几位德高望重的天师，他们都有兴趣收你做学生。你……
dialogText.en: As for his final wishes... She contacted several respectful Tianshi interested in mentoring you. You can...

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们的好意，但……我是老师唯一的学生，我想要，继续他的研究。
dialogText.en: Thank you, but ... I'm his only disciple. I intend to continue his project.

dialogText.cn: 眼前种种，就是他为我上的最好的一课。虽然他没有教授过打潮鞭的知识，但作为学生，我不想放弃这一项研究。
dialogText.en: The recent events were his best lesson for me. He taught me nothing about Tide Flayers, but I do not intend to give up the project.

dialogText.cn: 和庄天师猜的一样……她为你申请了一个实验室。这些成果，研究所也一定会重视。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Zhuang expected this outcome... She will make arrangements and get you a lab. The project will also be getting attention from the Institute.

dialogText.cn: 再次谢过几位恩人，我不会忘记你们的恩情的。
dialogText.en: I really appreciate everything you've done, my heroes. I will not forget it.

dialogText.cn: 老师的天师仪里，有不少实验报告我还没有参透。我想……
dialogText.en: I still need to read through the papers on Mr. Mo's Tianshi apparatus. I kinda need...

dialogText.cn: 快回去吧，我们也很期待你最后的成果。
dialogText.en: It's okay, just head back already. We're looking forward to the results too!

dialogText.cn: 你们说，他的老师究竟是抱着怎样的情感，劈开那侵蚀大潮的呢？
dialogText.en: Say, I wonder what was going through Tianshi Mo's mind when he finally split that big Blight Tide in half?

dialogText.cn: 确实，总说人生无悔，可人生又怎能无悔。
dialogText.en: Yeah. "Don't leave any regrets in life." But everyone's bound to have at least a few.

dialogText.cn: 恨意绵绵，至死不休……可能直到这一刻，才能真的放下吧。
dialogText.en: I guess seething hatred only ends with death... One can only let go at the very final moments.

dialogText.cn: 直到大潮劈开的那一刻，他也才知道自己想要的是什么吧。
dialogText.en: Perhaps Tianshi Mo only realized what he wanted when he split the Tide apart.

dialogText.cn: 那一刻，将永远刻在那道鞭痕上。
dialogText.en: And that moment will be forever etched upon the Flayer's lash.

dialogText.cn: 莫天师还是去直面了自己的夙愿……
dialogText.en: In the end, Tianshi Mo decided to resolve his final wish...

dialogText.cn: 你们是田阿姨昨天最后见到的人，我只是正常取个证。
dialogText.en: Just gathering evidence, people. You're the last ones Aunt Tian saw yesterday.

dialogText.cn: {F}这几个好孩子都热心得很，阿姨是亲眼看着她们离开的，别为难她们！{M}这几个好孩子都热心得很，阿姨是亲眼看着他们离开的，别为难他们！
dialogText.en: {F}Don't make things difficult for these darlings, Captain! I saw them leave myself!{M}Don't make things difficult for these darlings, Captain! I saw them leave myself!

dialogText.cn: 我知道。门锁没有破坏的痕迹，窗子也关得好好的，要么是熟人，要么就是技术高超。
dialogText.en: I know. Door locks aren't damaged. Windows are shut. It's either someone you know, or a truly skilled professional.

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨，能和我们说说具体情况吗？
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian, can you tell us exactly what happened?

dialogText.cn: 阿姨一回来，就发现屋里被翻得乱七八糟的，可想不起来丢了什么……
dialogText.en: I came back and my house turned into a blighted mess. I can't even remember what I've lost...

dialogText.cn: 咦？这里多了一罐东西？好像昨天来没看到过呢？
dialogText.en: Hey, there's a jar of something. I don't remember seeing it yesterday.

dialogText.cn: 噢！瞧我这记性，这是<@qu.key>草菇</>，昨天收拾屋子时拿回来的，随手放下就忘了收了。
dialogText.en: Oh! My memories are really failing me. It's <@qu.key>straw mushrooms</>. Found it during housecleaning, but forgot about it and left it here.

dialogText.cn: 不加的不加的，这草菇是以前没肉吃的时候才往里加的，现在咱们早就用上正经的肉啦！
dialogText.en: No, not anymore. We used straw mushrooms when there was no meat, but meat's aplenty nowadays!

dialogText.cn: 最近孩子们又开始往烂肉面里加这些东西，这不是硬找苦吃嘛……
dialogText.en: What baffles me is that young people nowadays are adding the mushrooms to the noodles again. I just don't know why...

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨是要把它加进烂肉面配方吗？
dialogText.en: Are you gonna add it to your braised meat noodles recipe, Aunt Tian?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有什么发现吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, found anything yet?

dialogText.cn: 这连连乐……好眼熟啊。
dialogText.en: This Connect-and-Win ... looks pretty familiar.

dialogText.cn: 等一下，这不是阿仔之前给我们看过的那款吗！
dialogText.en: Wait! Isn't this the same Connect-and-Win that Ah Zai showed us before?

dialogText.cn: 总不会是……他看上去像是那种人吗……
dialogText.en: Don't tell me that... No. Does he look like that sort of person...?

dialogText.cn: 陈，先别想太多，还是先去和弭弗说明情况吧。
dialogText.en: Try not to overthink it, Chen. We should just tell Mi Fu what we found.

dialogText.cn: 好好好，先别让田阿姨知道……
dialogText.en: Yeah, let's do that. Better not let Aunt Tian know...

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，我们找到了些线索，调查闯入者的事不如交给我们吧？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu, we found some clues. Maybe we can help investigate the break-in for you?

dialogText.cn: 我猜猜，线索指向了你们认识的人？
dialogText.en: Let me guess. The clues point to someone you know.

dialogText.cn: 是阿仔吧。
dialogText.en: It's Ah Zai, right?

dialogText.cn: 当了这么多年巡卫，直觉也是能培养出来的。
dialogText.en: Spending years in the watchguards will sharpen one's intuition.

dialogText.cn: 我们会把真相查个水落石出的！
dialogText.en: We'll definitely get to the bottom of this!

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨这边交给我，阿仔那边就交给你们了。
dialogText.en: I'll take care of Aunt Tian. You can go ahead and take care of Ah Zai.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，这个地方比我想得还危险！差点为了草菇把命丢了！
dialogText.en: Thank you all! Oh, this place is more dangerous than I thought! Imagine getting killed over some straw mushrooms!

dialogText.cn: 看来你真的是来采草菇的，而不是要逃跑。
dialogText.en: I'm just glad you're really here for the mushrooms instead of running away.

dialogText.cn: 我为什么要逃？草菇到处都卖光了，只能来这边采。
dialogText.en: Running away? No! Straw mushrooms are sold out everywhere. We can only forage for them.

dialogText.cn: 真是，都说了我虽然屋子乱，但心里都有数，非要把我的东西都按她的意思整理一遍……
dialogText.en: Sheesh. I wouldn't have had to come out here in the first place if she hadn't touched my stuff... I know my place is a dump but I know where everything is..

dialogText.cn: 什么？
dialogText.en: Wha?

dialogText.cn: 我没说你们，说别人呢。
dialogText.en: Oh, I'm talking about someone else, not you of course.

dialogText.cn: 东西是寻常，可它赋予的故事不一样。
dialogText.en: It's just a shroom, but it's got a really interesting story.

dialogText.cn: 没有它，我的艺术就会丢掉最有灵魂的部分，就好像最快的驮兽没能配上最好的鞍！
dialogText.en: This, my friends, is the very soul of my art! Without it, my plan would be a racing burdenbeast without a saddle!

dialogText.cn: 阿仔，先打住，我们有些严肃的问题希望你如实回答。
dialogText.en: Hey, Ah Zai, before we get into that, we got some serious questions to ask. Kinda need you to be honest with us.

dialogText.cn: 啊？
dialogText.en: Huh?

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨家发现了被人闯入的痕迹，这是我们在现场找到的线索。
dialogText.en: Someone broke into Aunt Tian's house. Here are the clues we found at the scene.

dialogText.cn: 这个线索似乎没什么直接关联……
dialogText.en: This evidence seems pretty unrelated to me...

dialogText.cn: 等等，这草菇是我丢的那罐啊！怎么会在她那里？我根本没带过去啊！
dialogText.en: Wait! This is the jar of shrooms I lost! How did it end up at her place? I never brought it there!

dialogText.cn: 你等等，怎么是你丢的？什么又叫你“没带过去”……
dialogText.en: Hold up! You lost this jar? What do you mean you "never brought it there"...?

dialogText.cn: 明明是她把我的草菇拿走了，你们怎么先来对我兴师问罪！
dialogText.en: What are you trying to suggest? She took my jar of shrooms!

dialogText.cn: 是啊！她肯定是不想我把草菇放到烂肉面里……她总是以为只有她的配方才能受欢迎……
dialogText.en: Yeah! She hates it when I add shrooms into the braised meat noodles... Can't stop going on about how her recipe is the popular choice...

dialogText.cn: 这是在田阿姨的厨房里拍的照片，里面是一罐草菇。
dialogText.en: A photo of Aunt Tian's kitchen. There's a jar of straw mushrooms in it.

dialogText.cn: 这是你的东西吧？
dialogText.en: This has to be yours, right?

dialogText.cn: 欸，我就说，原来是丢在那里了……
dialogText.en: Ugh. No wonder I couldn't find this thing anywhere...

dialogText.cn: 什么？你真的闯入田阿姨家了？
dialogText.en: What? Did you really break into Aunt Tian's place?

dialogText.cn: 什么叫闯入啊？把我说得跟贼一样！
dialogText.en: Break into her place? Hey, I'm not a thief, okay.

dialogText.cn: 你们俩是亲戚啊？！田阿姨是你姨妈？！
dialogText.en: What?! The two of you are relatives?! Aunt Tian is literally *your aunt*?!

dialogText.cn: 唔……唉，是呀，我……我爸妈去世以后，就是姨妈把我养大的。
dialogText.en: Uh... Yeah... My Dad and Mom passed away, so it was my aunt who raised me.

dialogText.cn: 但我已经长大了，我要自立门户，和姨妈她……哼，很多话越来越说不来了。
dialogText.en: But I'm a grown-up now. Gotta start my own biz and go my own way... Hrrrngh. Let's just say my aunt and I don't really agree on everything.

dialogText.cn: 她老人家什么都不懂，只是一味地阻止我！
dialogText.en: She's got tons of outdated ideas and kept trying to get in my way!

dialogText.cn: 呃，你们既然是一家人，为什么要鬼鬼祟祟，像做贼一样啊？！
dialogText.en: Well, if you're family, why do you have to sneak around and act all sus?

dialogText.cn: 还能因为什么，因为我不想撞见她啊！
dialogText.en: Isn't it obvious?! I don't wanna run into my aunt again!

dialogText.cn: 我明明已经长大了，可以安排好自己的生活了，但她就是不相信！
dialogText.en: I'm a grown-up and I'm doing very well on my own. But someone refuses to believe in that!

dialogText.cn: 这笔账越来越糊涂了，我们还是回去再找田阿姨确认一遍吧。
dialogText.en: This affair's getting more and more complicated. We should head back and double check with Aunt Tian.

dialogText.cn: 在杂物间里发现的连连乐，和阿仔准备的连连乐是一个款式。
dialogText.en: A Connect-and-Win voucher found in the storage room. It is the same as those prepared by Ah Zai.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，别纠结啦，有啥想问的就先问吧！
dialogText.en: Come on, Endmin. Go ahead and ask if you got a question!

dialogText.cn: 这个日记本……你们是在跟我开玩笑吗？
dialogText.en: A diary...? Is this some kind of a joke?

dialogText.cn: 小孩子一派胡言，写着玩的，真丢人……
dialogText.en: I don't read childish scribbles. Just a bunch of stupid nonsense. Ugh...

dialogText.cn: ……换一个试试？
dialogText.en: ...Maybe we should try the next.

dialogText.cn: ……换一个试试？
dialogText.en: ...Maybe we should try the next.

dialogText.cn: 好在说开了，不然我差点要被你们扔进大牢！
dialogText.en: Yeah... And I'm glad we got all that cleared up before you threw me into prison!

dialogText.cn: 你是说，其实是田阿姨偷了你的东西？
dialogText.en: Wait. Are you saying that Aunt Tian took your stuff?

dialogText.cn: 有些话翻来覆去地说，说得我脑子疼​！
dialogText.en: Sometimes her nagging is like a broken record! I can't take it anymore!

dialogText.cn: 说我只会出歪主意，说我就会往烂肉面里加些没用的东西，说我屋子乱不会照顾自己……
dialogText.en: "Get those strange ideas out of your head!" "NO! Stop adding weird stuff to the noodles" "What a mess! You can't take care of yourself...!"

dialogText.cn: 去年她还非要我留在这里继承烂肉面生意，不同意我跟商会的人走，去当天灾骑手……
dialogText.en: Just last year she wanted me to take over the noodle biz. But it's 'cos she doesn't want me to join the TGCC as a Catastrophe Rider...

dialogText.cn: 天灾骑手是什么……
dialogText.en: What is a Catastrophe Rider...?

dialogText.cn: 亏我这么相信你！
dialogText.en: And I trusted you so much!

dialogText.cn: 我回姨妈家找证件而已……我的环带居民证还放在她那里，要拿回来，才能办临时营业执照。
dialogText.en: I went back to my aunt's place for my stuff... My Band Residence ID was at her place, and I need it to get a temporary business license.

dialogText.cn: 自从上次和她吵完架，我就搬出去住了。
dialogText.en: We got into a big argument and I moved out after that.

dialogText.cn: 好了，我要回去忙了，还有什么问题，你们找我姨妈问去吧。
dialogText.en: Alright. Gotta get back to work. Just go ask my aunt if you have any more problems.

dialogText.cn: 她家里进人了？！怎么回事？
dialogText.en: Someone broke into her place?! HOW?! WHAT HAPPENED?!

dialogText.cn: 阿姨，你们俩早点说开，我们也好办事。
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian, things would have been easier for us if either of you told us about it.

dialogText.cn: 唉，弭长官，给你们添麻烦了……
dialogText.en: I'm sorry, Captain Mi, for causing you so much trouble.

dialogText.cn: 阿仔这孩子，想法多，脾气随他妈，打定了主意，十头驮兽都拉不回来。我又忙，关心他的时间少了。
dialogText.en: Ah Zai got all sorts of ideas and inherited his mother's temper. Once he made up his mind, not even ten burdenbeasts can rein him in. I hardly have time to take proper care of him.

dialogText.cn: 我想着，要是能申请到铺面，就不用每天开车出摊这么麻烦了，或许还能让阿仔回来帮忙……
dialogText.en: I was hoping to get that available stall so I don't have to work from my noodle cart again. The kid might even decide to come back and help at a proper shop...

dialogText.cn: 弭长官，这回又让你们看笑话了，明天我多做几串糖油粑粑给你们送去。
dialogText.en: Really sorry about making a scene, Captain Mi. I'll make some extra sweet rice cakes for the watchguards tomorrow.

dialogText.cn: 不用。
dialogText.en: It's alright.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，田阿姨，你们还在呢。
dialogText.en: Mi Fu and Aunt Tian! You're still here.

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事？
dialogText.en: What happened?

dialogText.cn: 阿仔说，田阿姨拿他东西了。
dialogText.en: Ah Zai said that Aunt Tian took his stuff.

dialogText.cn: 阿姨，你自己解释吧。
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian, I better leave this to you.

dialogText.cn: 好孩子们，让你们费心了……
dialogText.en: Oh darlings, you really went out of your way...

dialogText.cn: 我一门心思想让阿仔继承我的生意，让他以后过得轻松点……
dialogText.en: I really want Ah Zai to inherit my business so he'll have an easier time in life...

dialogText.cn: 越说他还越生气，我也来气，去他屋子送饭的时候，顺手就给他收拾了。
dialogText.en: I tried talking sense but he raised his voice and riled me up. So after delivering some food to his place, I just decided to clean up his mistakes.

dialogText.cn: 阿姨也不是要为难他，就是当长辈的，孩子头撞南墙的时候，总想着要拉他们一把。
dialogText.en: I'm not making things hard for him. As elders, we must rein in the young ones before they smash themselves into a wall.

dialogText.cn: 但是，阿仔说这草菇，是他办活动的重要道具。
dialogText.en: But Ah Zai told us he needs these straw mushrooms for an important event.

dialogText.cn: 啊？……唉，这阿姨确实是不知道，我就是担心阿仔还小，想一出是一出，怕他吃亏……
dialogText.en: Oh...? Well, maybe I didn't know about that. But Ah Zai is a kid with all sorts of crazy ideas. I don't want him to feel defeated...

dialogText.cn: 你们说的也有道理……毕竟他也长大了……
dialogText.en: You're right... Ah Zai's all grown up now...

dialogText.cn: 结果他非要往面里加什么草菇，不加肉……这不是砸了自己家的招牌嘛？
dialogText.en: But he kept adding straw mushrooms to the noodles instead of proper meat... He's ruining the brand name!

dialogText.cn: 那就用比赛的结果说话吧，让阿姨看看那孩子究竟是怎么想的。
dialogText.en: We should let the competition decide, then. I should see, with my own eyes, what that kid is up to.

dialogText.cn: 这是什么？童话书吗？
dialogText.en: What's this? A fairy tale book?

dialogText.cn: 哎，小孩子的玩意儿，前两天收拾东西翻出来的，没放回去。
dialogText.en: Oh, just something from a kid. Found it two days ago while going through stuff, but left it outside.

dialogText.cn: 还挺有意思的呢……
dialogText.en: Well, the story's really interesting...

dialogText.cn: 阿仔，刚才尝了你的草菇面，这草菇呀，得先焯个水，直接放汤里，汤就涩了……
dialogText.en: Ah Zai, I tried your straw mushroom noodles. You gotta parboil them first. Cook them raw and your soup will be bitter...

dialogText.cn: 我盘下了新店面，正需要人手呢，你要实在想卖草菇面，咱们就把你这道菜加到菜单上……
dialogText.en: The new store really needs all the help it can get. We can add a straw mushroom noodles to the menu if you want...

dialogText.cn: 不听不听！姨妈，我今天是输了比赛，但我可没准备回去继承烂肉面生意！
dialogText.en: Ugh, whatever! I may have lost the competition, Aunt, but I'm not gonna inherit the noodles stall!

dialogText.cn: 你这孩子……
dialogText.en: Okay, here you go again...

dialogText.cn: 没事，我放弃了。尊老爱幼，就让给她了！我还年轻，有的是机会。
dialogText.en: It's alright. I concede. Gotta take care of the elderly, you know! I'm young. I still have my chances.

dialogText.cn: 我还有事情要忙——我还要准备我的下一个商业方案。
dialogText.en: I gotta work on something — Time to prep my next business plan.

dialogText.cn: 没错！我已经想好了，先保密，不能让这么多人听了去……
dialogText.en: That's right! I got it all figured out...! But it's a secret and not for everyone's ears...

dialogText.cn: 哦，对了，姨妈，你可别掉以轻心啊，这武陵城，可是时时刻刻在变的。
dialogText.en: By the way, Aunt, don't lower your guard. Wuling City is constantly changing.

dialogText.cn: 今天不变，明天也会变，你做好准备，我可是——时刻准备回来挑战的！
dialogText.en: Maybe it won't change today, but who knows about tomorrow? Be prepared — I'm getting ready for round two!

dialogText.cn: 大家都到齐了？我们的比赛马上要开始了！我来倒数啊，三，二，一——
dialogText.en: Everyone's here? The competition is about to start! Time for the countdown. Three, two, one —

dialogText.cn: 我来瞧瞧。这是“田阿姨烂肉面”！你的老手艺啊，田阿姨！你没出摊这几天，我看弭队都要馋疯了。
dialogText.en: Let me take a look-see. Aunt Tian's Braised Meat Noodles! Aunt Tian, you've been absent from the market for a few days and Captain Mi really misses your noodles!

dialogText.cn: 欸？阿仔，你这个……是什么玩意儿？我有点没看懂。你要卖啥啊？
