dialogText.en: Wait. Ah Zai, what ... is this exactly? I don't really know what you're trying to sell.

dialogText.cn: 我这个，是“武陵生活方式总店”！我卖的是武陵的特产，是武陵人的日常生活，是武陵寻常景色背后的故事！
dialogText.en: This is my "Wuling Lifestyle Station"! I'm selling the special produce of Wuling, the daily lives of Wulingers, and the stories behind our daily routines!

dialogText.cn: 各位，请听我说！
dialogText.en: Everyone, listen to me!

dialogText.cn: 首先，你们需要完成一个全城收集活动。
dialogText.en: Your first task is a city-wide scavenger hunt.

dialogText.cn: 头奖是——全年霸王餐资格！
dialogText.en: The grand prize shall be — Eat-for-free at my place, effective for one full year!

dialogText.cn: 哇！我要报名！等等，霸王餐，吃什么的？
dialogText.en: OH! Sign me up already! And what's on the eat-for-free menu?

dialogText.cn: 吃的就是这个二等奖——阿仔特制“武陵记忆”烂肉面一碗。
dialogText.en: The second prize — A bowl of Ah Zai's "Wuling Memory" Special Braised Meat Noodles.

dialogText.cn: 阿仔，你卖的也是烂肉面么？
dialogText.en: Ah Zai, are you selling braised meat noodles as well?

dialogText.cn: 不不不，不一样啊。我这个烂肉面，是抽奖才能抽到的奖品！是非卖品哦！
dialogText.en: No, it's different. My special braised meat noodles are prizes awarded only to the winners! They're not for sale!

dialogText.cn: 我的面，不放肉，放的是草菇。
dialogText.en: My special noodles got no meat. It has straw mushrooms instead.

dialogText.cn: 不放肉的叫什么烂肉面！你这孩子真是——
dialogText.en: No meat?! How could you call it braised meat noodles, my boy? Oh, my heart —

dialogText.cn: 姨妈，你还记不记得我小时候养的那只“坨坨”？
dialogText.en: Aunt, remember Pebbles? The one I raised when I was a boy?

dialogText.cn: 嗯？
dialogText.en: Oh?

dialogText.cn: 无所谓，你不记得就算了。
dialogText.en: Whatever. You probably forgot.

dialogText.cn: 此情此景，令我心中百感交集，老刘有些心里话想对各位市民朋友们说说……
dialogText.en: This very moment has sparked a flood of emotions. As your fellow watchguard, I've got a word to share with my friends and neighbors...

dialogText.cn: 别写打油诗，老刘，别让我把嘴给你塞上——
dialogText.en: Enough with your silly old floods, Liu. Don't make me gag you —

dialogText.cn: ……算了，管理员，老刘开始了就停不下来，你们先在附近逛逛吧。
dialogText.en: ...Sheesh. Endmin, there's no stopping Liu once he gets started. Just look around the place at your leisure.

dialogText.cn: 带着三张拍好的“今日武陵”照片，就能找我换一张阿仔连连乐兑奖券！
dialogText.en: Get three "Today at Wuling" photos and exchange them for a special Ah Zai Connect-and-Win voucher!

dialogText.cn: 好饿啊，什么时候轮到我……
dialogText.en: I'm so hungry. Will I ever get my bowl...?

dialogText.cn: 咳，你们没听到。
dialogText.en: Ahem. You didn't hear anything.

dialogText.cn: 我们这趟运气还行，碰上“武陵必吃”了！
dialogText.en: We got lucky! There's an ongoing "Wuling Gastronomic" event!

dialogText.cn: 耶尔什吃不到这种味道的食物！
dialogText.en: You'll never get this taste in Kjersch!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你们也来啦！哈哈，我特地来支持一下阿仔的事业。
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here too! Haha. I'm here to support my friend Ah Zai's biz.

dialogText.cn: 希望他能创业成功！
dialogText.en: I hope his business succeeds!

dialogText.cn: 好热闹呀！田阿姨那里排了好多人，我们去看看！
dialogText.en: It's so crowded! Look at all those people at Aunt Tian's place! Let's check it out!

dialogText.cn: 孩子们，阿姨这儿都忙不过来了，来帮阿姨打个下手！
dialogText.en: Oh, my sweet darlings! I can barely meet the demand! I wonder if you can help me serve the crowd!

dialogText.cn: 噢，对啦，这一碗是给阿仔的，里面放的是草菇。
dialogText.en: And before I forget, this one's for Ah Zai. It's got straw mushrooms.

dialogText.cn: 咦？
dialogText.en: Huh?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，阿姨突然想明白了一些事儿，孩子嘛，有自己的想法，就随他去吧。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I figured out a few things on my own. The lad prefers things his own way. I'll let him have it.

dialogText.cn: 好，这一碗<@qu.key>“特制烂肉面”</>，我们去送给阿仔吧。
dialogText.en: Great. We'll take this <@qu.key>"special braised meat noodles"</> to Ah Zai.

dialogText.cn: 各位，你们拍到的这些小壳兽，寿命很长，性情很温顺，还很有智慧！
dialogText.en: Good people, the mini shellbeasts you photographed are known for their long lifespans, gentle nature, and wisdom!

dialogText.cn: 我很久以前养过一只哦，它叫坨坨，碰到想不明白的问题，我都会去问它……
dialogText.en: I used to have one called Pebbles. I always asked Pebbles whenever there was something I didn't understand...

dialogText.cn: 我小时候的武陵，物资可没有现在那么丰富，全靠每个月从宏山运过来的补给撑着。那时候是攻坚期，可辛苦了。
dialogText.en: Life wasn't easy at Wuling when I was a kid. We relied on monthly supplies from Hongshan. Things were really rough.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，但我发誓不会让坨坨挨饿，有我一口吃的，就少不了它一口。
dialogText.en: Yeah. But I swore I'd keep Pebbles happy and fed. If I had something to eat, Pebbles got a share too.

dialogText.cn: 唉，我本以为这幸福能持续下去，直到有一次涨潮，下了大雨……地标都失效了，里外通信也断掉了。
dialogText.en: Well, I thought happiness could last. But then the tide rose, and it really poured... We lost the geo-beacons and communication with the outside.

dialogText.cn: 那个周期的物资迟迟没有送到，我们的存粮又快吃光了……
dialogText.en: The monthly supplies got delayed too. We were literally running on our last reserves...

dialogText.cn: 然后呢，阿仔哥哥？
dialogText.en: What happened next, Ah Zai?

dialogText.cn: 然后……我也生病了，病得很重。姨妈翻箱倒柜找出了最后一点面粉，要做一碗面给我吃。
dialogText.en: Then ... I got sick. It was really bad. My aunt scraped together the last flour we had and made a bowl of noodles for me.

dialogText.cn: 我们那时候已经一个月没有吃到肉了。
dialogText.en: We hadn't had meat for a month already.

dialogText.cn: 我记得，姨妈说，周三是最后的期限，如果还没有等到物资……就只能……把坨坨……
dialogText.en: My Aunt told me Wednesday was the final day. If the supplies failed to arrive ... we'd have to ... take Pebbles...

dialogText.cn: 啊？！要把它吃掉吗？
dialogText.en: WHAT?! Did she force you to eat Pebbles?!

dialogText.cn: 那时我也觉得很残酷，我躺在床上，抱着坨坨一直哭，不让她把坨坨带走！
dialogText.en: I thought it was cruel too. I was in bed and held Pebbles really close so my Aunt wouldn't take him away!

dialogText.cn: 我醒来以后，闻到了一股香味……坨坨不见了，姨妈端着一碗面，叫醒了我。
dialogText.en: But later I smelled something delicious... Pebbles was gone, but my Aunt woke me with a bowl of noodles.

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨说，特地给你做的。
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian made it especially for you.

dialogText.cn: 放那边吧，我忙着……算了，你还是拿过来吧，我就吃一口，我……
dialogText.en: Just put it there. I'm busy... Well, maybe just a little bite. I...

dialogText.cn: ……阿仔？怎么不说话啦？
dialogText.en: Ah Zai...? You alright? Why so quiet?

dialogText.cn: 一下子就吃完了……汤都喝干净了……
dialogText.en: He literally emptied the entire thing ... plus the soup...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，阿仔好像在哭啊，鼻涕眼泪都掉碗里了！阿仔，你没事吧？
dialogText.en: Psst. Endmin, I think he's crying. Literally dripping like a faucet! Ahem. Ah Zai, are you okay?

dialogText.cn: 呜呜，就是这个味道！这个味道……就是那个时候，那碗面……
dialogText.en: Hngh. This is how it tasted! It's the exact same thing... That bowl of special noodles back then...

dialogText.cn: 阿仔哥哥，别哭啦！难道……坨坨……坨坨被吃掉了吗？
dialogText.en: Please don't cry, Ah Zai! What happened to .... to Pebbles? Did it end up in the soup?

dialogText.cn: 没有！没有啊……坨坨后来是老死的。它当时爬进了屋子，仰头看着我呢。
dialogText.en: No! Of course not! Pebbles lived to a wise old age. He'd just gone for a walk but he came back later.

dialogText.cn: 倒是姨妈她身上全湿了，还受了伤。是她顶着雨出门去，找到了这种草菇，放进了那碗面里。
dialogText.en: But my aunt ... she went out in the pouring rain and foraged shrooms — just to put them in my noodles. It's the same shrooms in these noodles.

dialogText.cn: 我吃完面，突然听到了窗外的喇叭声……雨停了，物资车也到了。
dialogText.en: And as I finished them, I heard the convoy honking their horns... The rain stopped and the supplies finally arrived.

dialogText.cn: 哇，小壳兽真可爱！
dialogText.en: Wow! These mini shellbeasts are so cute!

dialogText.cn: 我也好想养一只！
dialogText.en: I want one too!

dialogText.cn: 唔……我知道，饿肚子的感觉可难受了……
dialogText.en: Ugh... I know. Being hungry feels terrible...

dialogText.cn: 阿仔哥哥好爱坨坨呀，坨坨真幸福……
dialogText.en: You really loved your Pebbles, Ah Zai. It must've been really happy...

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……
dialogText.en: Oh no. Why...?

dialogText.cn: 好残酷啊，我不敢听了……
dialogText.en: Uuuhhh! I don't want to hear this...

dialogText.cn: 后来，我就睡着了，也可能是昏过去了……
dialogText.en: And then I fell asleep. Maybe it was the fever...

dialogText.cn: 这比赛搞得我都两天没吃上面了！走吧，管理员，请你吃武陵最好吃的烂肉面。
dialogText.en: I had zero noodles for two days because of this competition! Come, Endmin. The best braised meat noodles of Wuling are on me.

dialogText.cn: 田阿姨，再加两碗面，我和弭队长的！
dialogText.en: {F}Aunt Tian, give us two more. For the Captain and me!{M}Aunt Tian, give us two more. For the Captain and me!

dialogText.cn: 好嘞！
dialogText.en: Alright!

dialogText.cn: 才两碗？……你不吃么？
dialogText.en: Just two...? Aren't you having anything?

dialogText.cn: ……田阿姨，三碗面！
dialogText.en: {F}...Aunt Tian, make that three!{M}...Aunt Tian, make that three!

dialogText.cn: 好，准备掐表——三，二，一，比赛结束！
dialogText.en: Okay. Final countdown — Three, two, one! And it's over!

dialogText.cn: ……噢，已经统计出来了。下面，我来公布两个摊点的人流数据——
dialogText.en: ...Oh. We got the figures. Time for me to reveal the number of patrons for the two stalls —

dialogText.cn: “田阿姨烂肉面”，在比赛时间里共计接待120人次！
dialogText.en: Aunt Tian's Braised Meat Noodles served 120 patrons during the competition!

dialogText.cn: “武陵生活方式总店”，在比赛时间里共计接待35人次！阿仔啊，好像有一大部分人还在拍照过程中没回来啊……
dialogText.en: Wuling Lifestyle Station served 35 patrons during the competition! Ah Zai, has everyone come back! Are they still taking their photos...?

dialogText.cn: 所以按先前公布的比赛规则，店铺承租权由田阿姨赢得！恭喜恭喜！
dialogText.en: According to the competition rules, Aunt Tian wins the leasing rights for the stall! Congratulations!

dialogText.cn: 感谢大家的支持！阿姨心里也高兴得很，哎呀，这回好了，有地方可以遮风挡雨，每天都可以给大家做面条了！
dialogText.en: Thank you, everyone! I'm so happy about this. Ohoho. With a roof over my head, I can finally make noodles every day for everyone!

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……是打卡点的讲解太吸引人了么……
dialogText.en: Uh oh, what happened...? Are my location intros keeping people there...?

dialogText.cn: 多谢几位……我叫<@qu.key>杜鸣</>，打清波寨来……被关在这儿是……
dialogText.en: Thank you... I'm <@qu.key>Du Ming</>, born and raised in the Stockade... I suppose you want to know why I was locked up here.

dialogText.cn: 唉，前几天我和寨子里的阮大哥大吵了一架，结果就被他关在了这里，说是让我冷静下……
dialogText.en: *Sighs* A few days ago, I was still in the Stockade. I had an altercation with Brother Ruan, and he locked me up here to "simmer down"...

dialogText.cn: 要我说，他才该冷静一下……
dialogText.en: But if you ask me, he's the one who needs to "simmer down"...

dialogText.cn: 这个阮一……等回了寨子，看我不好好训他一顿！
dialogText.en: Once I get back to the Stockade ... I'm gonna teach that stubborn Forte a real lesson!

dialogText.cn: 你这话是什么意思？什么叫“不在了”？阮一他……
dialogText.en: What do you mean by that? No longer around? What happened to Ruan Yi...?

dialogText.cn: 这丰蹄……怎么这么死心眼！
dialogText.en: Damn that Forte... I knew his stubbornness would be the death of him!

dialogText.cn: 寨子里的其他人呢？大当家……还好吗？
dialogText.en: What about the Stockade fam? How's the Chief...? Is she alright?

dialogText.cn: 大部分寨民还留在寨子里，但也有一部分人……加入了裂地者。至于汤汤……
dialogText.en: Most people stayed in the Stockade, but a few of them ... joined the Landbreakers. As for Tangtang...

dialogText.cn: 对，她可忙了！天天为寨子里的事跑前跑后的。
dialogText.en: Yeah. She's super busy! Always rushing about and taking care of business for the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 唉，苦了她了……小小年纪就担了那么多事……
dialogText.en: Poor little girl... Can't believe she has to shoulder so much when she's still so young...

dialogText.cn: 也别说这些了！我们先送你回去！
dialogText.en: Enough talking! Let's get you back home!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们，但我还不能回寨子……我想去一趟祖泉……
dialogText.en: Thank you, but I can't return to the Stockade right now... I need to pay a visit to the Ancestral Spring...

dialogText.cn: 没错，各位恐怕不知，当年要不是有祖泉庇护，先祖也没法在这儿建成清波寨。
dialogText.en: That's right. You probably haven't heard about this story. The founding of Qingbo Stockade would be impossible without the protection offered by the Spring.

dialogText.cn: 但你一个人……未免太危险了。
dialogText.en: But doing it alone ... might be too dangerous.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，那些裂地者可不好打发！
dialogText.en: Yeah. Those Landbreakers are not a joke!

dialogText.cn: 好吧……我刚刚就想问了，你们这个什么终末地工业，不是专门造东西的吗？怎么身手都那么好？
dialogText.en: Okay... I have a question I need to get off my chest. You're working for Endfield Industries, right? I thought you were a manufacturing company. How did you get so good at fighting?

dialogText.cn: 可听你们的描述，那帮叫“裂地者”的家伙，还在祖泉附近游荡，我担心他们会对祖泉做什么……
dialogText.en: But from what you said, the brigands calling themselves Landbreakers are still loitering around the Ancestral Spring. I'm worried they might do something to it...

dialogText.cn: 身为寨里的“守泉人”，我本来就该看顾祖泉……不亲自去看一眼，实在安心不了。
dialogText.en: As guardian of the Spring, it's my duty to watch over it. I must see for myself that the Spring is all right.

dialogText.cn: 跟他说了多少遍……别总想着和武陵来硬的……他是半点没听进去啊……
dialogText.en: I told him so many times... Never go head-to-head against Wuling... But I guess he never listened...

dialogText.cn: 这么多年了，祖泉早就成了我们的一份寄托。大家都相信，只要祖泉还在，清波寨就在……
dialogText.en: Through all these years, the Ancestral Spring has already become our spiritual refuge. Everyone believes that the well-being of the spring is tied to that of the Qingbo Stockade...

dialogText.cn: 现在到处不太平，造东西的也得会两手嘛！
dialogText.en: Well, this isn't exactly a peaceful world. A manufacturer's gotta learn some self-defense, you know!

dialogText.cn: 说得也是……那就麻烦各位了。
dialogText.en: That's true... Well, I shall entrust my life to your dependable hands.

dialogText.cn: 是当时阮一留下的……
dialogText.en: They appeared after Ruan Yi left...

dialogText.cn: 祖泉……我们的祖泉……怎么成了这样……
dialogText.en: The Ancestral Spring ... our fount of protection... How did it end up like this...?

dialogText.cn: 祖泉外围都是这副惨状……泉源该不会也……
dialogText.en: They've already ruined the places around the Ancestral Spring... Don't tell me that the source of the spring itself...

dialogText.cn: 各位……能帮我找壶酒来吗？我想在这里……祭拜一下，好告慰先人。
dialogText.en: My good people ... help bring me a flask of fine brew. I intend to make an offering ... and appease our ancestors.

dialogText.cn: 可这地方全是山石草木，我们去哪儿找酒呢？
dialogText.en: Fine brew? Dude, this place has nothing but grass, rocks, trees, and bamboo.

dialogText.cn: 附近有祭台……说不定有寨里的大伙留下的酒水。
dialogText.en: There should be another altar nearby... You might find some brew or kohlic beverages left there by the Stockade family.

dialogText.cn: 我想再做点准备。等你们回来，应该就完事了。
dialogText.en: I intend to prepare for the rites. It should be done when you return.

dialogText.cn: 这、这冒出来的是什么……发生什么了？！
dialogText.en: What is this ... this abominable growth? What happened here?!

dialogText.cn: 先人们见了，怕不是要痛骂我们这些后辈无能，竟然连祖泉都护不住！唉……
dialogText.en: If our ancestors learn of this, they would curse our ineptitude. How low the young generation had fallen! We couldn't even keep the Spring safe! Ugh...

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣！酒我们带回来了！……欸？人呢？不会是等急了，去找我们了吧？
dialogText.en: Du Ming! We're back with some kohlic drinks...! Wait. Where did he go? Did he run out of patience and go around looking for us?

dialogText.cn: 恐怕不是。
dialogText.en: Probably not.

dialogText.cn: 如果他是往外走的，一定会被我们发现……
dialogText.en: We would have run into him if he had left this area...

dialogText.cn: 或许他是去了附近的山林洞穴……调查下周围吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Maybe he went to a nearby cave or grove... Let's investigate the surroundings, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会？这么个大活人总不可能凭空消失吧？
dialogText.en: That's impossible! He can't simply disappear into thin air!

dialogText.cn: 你们说，会不会有什么机关？我来试试！
dialogText.en: Hey, maybe there's some hidden mechanism. Let me look around!

dialogText.cn: 听声响也不像是空心的啊……奇怪了……
dialogText.en: Hmm. This is so weird... The wall sounds really solid and has nothing behind it...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，不过这一路上，我们既没看到裂地者，也没发现有打斗的痕迹。
dialogText.en: He is missing, but there weren't any Landbreakers or signs of fighting along the way.

dialogText.cn: 有道理！她那里人够多，找个杜鸣绰绰有余！
dialogText.en: That sounds like the smartest thing to do! Tangtang's got a huge fam behind her! They'll find Du Ming in no time!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，先去清波寨吧。
dialogText.en: Agreed. Let's head to Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 如果杜鸣没有被裂地者抓走，那么……
dialogText.en: If the Landbreakers didn't get Du Ming, then...

dialogText.cn: 前面就是尽头，应该没有更多线索了。
dialogText.en: This is where the trail ends. No more clues around here.

dialogText.cn: 但我们对这附近并不熟悉，搜救会有不少困难……
dialogText.en: Unfortunately, we're unfamiliar with this area. Searching for him will be quite a challenge...

dialogText.cn: ……死透了，但身上还是暖的，估计没断气多久。
dialogText.en: Okay, he's really dead, but the body is still warm... Guess he died very recently.

dialogText.cn: 很有可能……看现场的痕迹，这名裂地者明显死于偷袭。
dialogText.en: It's a possibility... The scene tells me that this Landbreaker fell into an ambush.

dialogText.cn: 下手真狠，小看他了。可他先是躲着我们，又干掉了裂地者，图什么呢？
dialogText.en: And the attack was pretty vicious. Really underestimated the dude. So he tried to avoid us, and then killed a Landbreaker. What is he planning?

dialogText.cn: 这洞附近有股难闻的味道……不会是裂地者用炸药炸开的吧？那祖泉……
dialogText.en: The cave really smells... Did the Landbreakers blast it open with their explosives? Does that mean the Ancestral Spring...

dialogText.cn: 恐怕他就是在做准备时看到了这个裂地者，然后一路跟了过来……
dialogText.en: He was probably preparing for the rites when he saw the Landbreaker, and secretly followed the raider all the way here...

dialogText.cn: 结果看这地方居然被炸了个大洞……一气之下砸死了这个裂地者？之后呢？他去哪儿了？
dialogText.en: Then he saw the huge cave that the Landbreakers blasted with explosives ... got super pissed and smashed the Landbreaker, right? Okay. So what happened next? Where did he go?

dialogText.cn: 如果一个人回到家门口，发现大门被人炸开了，第一反应会是什么？
dialogText.en: Chen, if you returned home and saw the gates of your house blasted wide open, what would you do?

dialogText.cn: 马上进去，看丢没丢东西啊——我懂了！杜鸣是跳进洞里，找那个什么泉源了！
dialogText.en: What?! I'll charge right in and see if they stole — Ah! I got it! Du Ming jumped into the cave to find the source of the spring, right?

dialogText.cn: 赶紧下去看看吧！万一他出了什么事，可就糟了……
dialogText.en: Oh dear. We should get down there right now! It'd be bad if anything happens to him...

dialogText.cn: 是啊，之前青芜说过，有些寨民可在乎祖泉了，把祖泉的安危看得比自己的命都重！
dialogText.en: Yeah. Qingwu mentioned that before. Stockade residents are more than willing to defend the Spring with their lives!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，河佬也提起过，祖泉是清波寨的根，寨民们依泉而生，一些人甚至视祖泉为信仰……想必杜鸣就是如此。
dialogText.en: Yeah. He Lao also referred to the Ancestral Spring as the roots of Qingbo Stockade. The residents depend on the spring for livelihood. They even treated it as a symbol of faith... Perhaps Du Ming feels the same as well.

actorName.cn: 浮躁的寨民{sm2l3m2-浮躁的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？阮一都没了！现在谁安心得下来？！我不想着另谋出路，难道还要像你一样，去祖泉求先人保佑吗？
dialogText.en: Come on! Nobody's getting any peace knowing that Ruan Yi's deader than a nail! And you're asking me to pray to a spring for ancestral protection? Sheesh. Do that yourself. I gotta find a new job.

actorName.cn: 急切的寨民{sm2l3m2-急切的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 那你也不该说那种话！什么叫“寨子里再这么死气沉沉，迟早祖泉也得出事”？还嫌大家不够心烦吗？！
dialogText.en: And you've been talking nonsense all this time. "Ahhh! The Stockade's finished!" "Ahhh! Something bad will happen to the spring!" Don't you see the fam is feeling bad enough already?

actorName.cn: 浮躁的寨民{sm2l3m2-浮躁的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 我那是——
dialogText.en: I was just —

dialogText.cn: 给我住手！想打架？不先问问我这个大当家？
dialogText.en: Hold it right there, boys! Did you ask the Supreme Chief for permission to scrap?

actorName.cn: 浮躁的寨民{sm2l3m2-浮躁的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 大当家……我们……
dialogText.en: Supreme Chief ... we're ... uh ... we...

actorName.cn: 急切的寨民{sm2l3m2-急切的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 大当家！是他先——
dialogText.en: Supreme Chief! He started it!

dialogText.cn: 都给我冷静点儿！
dialogText.en: Zip your blight traps already! Shoo! Away with you!

dialogText.cn: 唉，让你们看笑话了。自打我哥出了事，寨子里一直乱糟糟的……你们呢？来找我的？
dialogText.en: Urgh. These two are making a joke of the Stockade. The entire place is a mess ever since what happened to Big Bro... So, what brings you here? Lookin' for me?

dialogText.cn: 你说对了，就是来找你帮忙的，去救个叫杜鸣的寨民！
dialogText.en: That's right, Chief! There's a Stockade resident named Du Ming who needs help!

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣哥？！你们遇到他了？在哪儿？之前他跟我哥大吵了一架，人就不见了……
dialogText.en: Brother Du?! You actually found him? Where is he? He had a really bad fight with Big Bro and disappeared right afterwards...

dialogText.cn: 总说我哥死脑筋，他自己不也是！搞不懂他们……不说这些了！我这就去叫帮手——
dialogText.en: Du Ming keeps calling Big Bro a hard-headed fool, but I don't think he's any different! I can't figure them out... Alright, enough talk! I'll get the Fam together.

actorName.cn: 张皇的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 大当家、大当家！出大事了！
dialogText.en: Supreme Chief! We got a sitch! A major sitch!

dialogText.cn: 怎么了？大呼小叫的……
dialogText.en: Get your act together! Tell me about this sitch!

actorName.cn: 张皇的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 是祖泉！祖泉显灵了！
dialogText.en: The spring! Our Ancestral Spring has performed a miracle!

actorName.cn: 张皇的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 听山头放哨的伙计说，他们在裂地者聚集的地方看到杜鸣了！
dialogText.en: Our Fam patrolling the hilltops saw Du Ming at the breaker lair!

actorName.cn: 张皇的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 他、他好像是得了祖泉护佑，一个人徒手降服了好几只彪兽！
dialogText.en: Brother Du... He's earned some protective powers from the Ancestral Spring! Knocked several rakerbeasts with his bare hands, he really did!

actorName.cn: 张皇的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 连裂地者都被他吓跑了不少！就是他样子有点不太对劲……整个人神神叨叨的……
dialogText.en: The fight was epic and sent the shitless breakers packing! It's just that Brother Du ... kinda looks a little weird and all...

dialogText.cn: 还愣着干什么！赶紧把杜鸣哥救回来！
dialogText.en: What are you still standing here for?! Get Brother Du back home already!

dialogText.cn: 你刚刚说的“裂地者聚集的地方”……具体在哪里？
dialogText.en: So that "breaker lair" you've just mentioned... Where is it?

actorName.cn: 张皇的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 这个……就在祖泉那一带，离寨子不远。
dialogText.en: It's uhm ... close to the Ancestral Spring, and not too far from the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 祖泉？或许他之前真的去了更深处……先去把人找回来吧。
dialogText.en: Ancestral spring? Maybe Du Ming did venture further into the place... We should help the residents find him.

dialogText.cn: 我也一起去！
dialogText.en: I'm going too!

dialogText.cn: 汤汤，你就先留下召集人手！出了岔子也好接应！
dialogText.en: Maybe you should stay behind and gather your Fam, Tangtang! If anything happens, we can count on you for backup!

dialogText.cn: ……有道理！等我攒够了人，就去找你们！
dialogText.en: Oh... Yeah, makes total sense! I'll go looking for you once I get our Fam together!

actorName.cn: 惊慌的裂地者{sm2l3m2-惊慌的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 呼……呼……够远了，*咕哝*他追不上的！
dialogText.en: *Khooo* ... *wheeze*... Me thinks we're far enough. *Mumble* Far enough from that blasted freak!

actorName.cn: 愤恨的裂地者{sm2l3m2-愤恨的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 那疯子……*咕哝*彪兽都弄不死！
dialogText.en: He's blight-crazy, man... *Mumble* Even the rakers can't kill 'im!

dialogText.cn: 想逃？给我站住！
dialogText.en: Trying to escape? Not on my watch!

actorName.cn: 愤恨的裂地者{sm2l3m2-愤恨的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 你们？疯子？一伙的？
dialogText.en: WHA? You on the same side as that blight-crazy dude?

actorName.cn: 惊慌的裂地者{sm2l3m2-惊慌的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 疯、疯子的同伙？
dialogText.en: Y-You're also them blight-crazy people?!

dialogText.cn: 等等，你们口中的“疯子”在什么地方？
dialogText.en: Hold on. Where are the "blight-crazy" people you mentioned?

actorName.cn: 愤恨的裂地者{sm2l3m2-愤恨的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 这条路后面！*咕哝*自己找吧！
dialogText.en: Just go down this road! *Mumble* Have fun looking for him yourself!

actorName.cn: 惊慌的裂地者{sm2l3m2-惊慌的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 走了！别把疯子招来了！
dialogText.en: I'm out of here! And don't lead that blight-crazy dude to us!

dialogText.cn: 喂！你们——
dialogText.en: HEY! YOU —

dialogText.cn: 别管他们了，去那边看看吧。
dialogText.en: Leave them. We should look around the place they mentioned.

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！百只彪兽又何妨！我“泉中客”杜鸣已获祖泉垂青！
dialogText.en: HAHAHAHAHAHA! A hundred rakerbeasts are no match for me! I'm Du Ming, Patron of the Spring! And my ancestors watch over me!

actorName.cn: 惧怕的裂地者{sm2l3m2-惧怕的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 疯子！根本就是个疯子！
dialogText.en: Man! The blight ate his brains! He's crazy!

actorName.cn: 胆怯的裂地者{sm2l3m2-胆怯的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 他、他到底在说什么？*咕哝*怪吓人的……
dialogText.en: Can someone understand his gibberish? *Mumble* This guy ain't normal no more...

dialogText.cn: 泉源深幽，不皇出矣！玄离于器，曷其没矣！
dialogText.en: The fount runs deep! The fearless may seek! Darkness it skims! When does it cease?

dialogText.cn: 先人从没抛弃清波寨！什么水花子！什么裂地者！等我杜鸣宰了这几头彪兽，就亲手把你们这些宵小一扫而空！
dialogText.en: Our ancestors never abandoned the Stockade! To hell with the Splatterlings and breaker scum! Once I'm done tearing these rakers apart, I'll start with you!

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！再来！再来！祖泉庇护在我身，林莽野兽根本不是我的对手！
dialogText.en: HAHAHAHAHA! Keep fighting! I'm blessed by the spring! These foul beasts are no match for me!

actorName.cn: 惧怕的裂地者{sm2l3m2-惧怕的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 疯、疯子又来了……
dialogText.en: The blight-crazy nut-job is attacking again...

actorName.cn: 胆怯的裂地者{sm2l3m2-胆怯的裂地者}

dialogText.cn: 跑！跑快点！*咕哝*别被疯子逮到！
dialogText.en: Run! Run for your lives! *Mumble* Don't let the maniac catch you!

dialogText.cn: 你们……哈哈哈哈！看到了吗！！祖泉派人来助我了！
dialogText.en: It's you... HAHAHAHA! Did you see this?! The spring even blessed me with reinforcements!

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣！没事吧？之前你跑去哪儿了？我们找了你老半天！
dialogText.en: Du Ming! Are you alright? Where did you run off to? We spent ages trying to find you!

dialogText.cn: 黑面煞！怎么样？裂地者都被我们打跑啦！
dialogText.en: Darkmask! How goes your search? We sent the breakers fleeing for their sorry hides!

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣哥？！你没事吧？！
dialogText.en: Brother Du?! Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 我……我本泉中客，今日方得真！方得真啊！哈哈哈哈哈！
dialogText.en: I, uh... Patron of the Spring was I, now the very truth is mine! THE VERY TRUTH! HAHAHAHAHA!

dialogText.cn: 喂！别跑啊！杜鸣哥！杜鸣哥！
dialogText.en: Hey! Why are you running?! Brother Du! DU MING!

dialogText.cn: 那里地势复杂，贸然行动很危险。
dialogText.en: That place is quite treacherous. It might be dangerous if you just blunder into it.

dialogText.cn: 可是……我……
dialogText.en: But ... I...

dialogText.cn: 我知道了……那你们别忘了，横竖得告诉他：我这个大当家，还有清波寨的大伙儿，都在念着他呢！
dialogText.en: Alright then... But when you see him, lay this fact straight to him: The Supreme Chief and the entire Stockade Fam want him back!

dialogText.cn: 我……对不住，那会儿我本来在做祭泉的准备，突然看到了个裂地者，鬼鬼祟祟的，就跟了上去……
dialogText.en: I ... apologies. I was preparing the ritual offerings when I suddenly noticed a Landbreaker sneaking around. So, I decided to follow him...

dialogText.cn: 那家伙为了找什么宝藏，已经在那儿炸了一个洞，居然还想炸第二个！我当时气急了，就把他……
dialogText.en: That raider already blasted a hole for some nonexistent treasure. And I saw him trying to blast another! I got furious, so I...

dialogText.cn: 后来，我担心泉源出事，就从洞口跳了下去。然后……
dialogText.en: I was worried that something bad had happened to the source of the spring, so I leaped into the cave and...

dialogText.cn: 然后，你没有遇到裂地者，更没有被谁抓住，而是去了祖泉的泉源，对吧？
dialogText.en: You didn't run into any Landbreakers or get yourself captured. Instead, you went straight to the source of the Ancestral Spring. Correct me if I'm wrong.

dialogText.cn: 不错，只是……我没想到……
dialogText.en: You're right. But ... I never thought that...

dialogText.cn: 他怎么往那个洞穴跑了？上回他不就是从那里……
dialogText.en: Why is he running towards that cave again? Didn't he —

dialogText.cn: 上回？洞穴？杜鸣哥真去了泉源？不行……我得找他问清楚！
dialogText.en: That cave? Again? Did Brother Du visit the source of the spring? No... I gotta get a proper answer from him!

dialogText.cn: 对啊汤汤，不是还有人被裂地者伤了，你一个人过去了，放心得下？
dialogText.en: Yeah, Chief. And those LBs injured some of your people. You'd agree that it's unsafe to leave them out here.

actorName.cn: 负伤的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 大当家，都是小伤……嘶！
dialogText.en: Supreme Chief, I'm totally fine! It's just a lil' — SSSSSS!

dialogText.cn: 还好来的是各位！大当家……没跟下来吧？！
dialogText.en: Ah, thank goodness it's you! Chief Tangtang stayed up there, right?

dialogText.cn: 那就好……那就好……
dialogText.en: That's good... That's very good...

dialogText.cn: ……之前多谢了，要是没你们在，我指不定会死在那几只彪兽手上……
dialogText.en: First, I must say I'm extremely grateful for your timely intervention back then. Those rakerbeasts would have torn me to pieces...

dialogText.cn: 你引我们过来，还不愿牵连汤汤，究竟为了什么？
dialogText.en: You led us to this place but don't want Tangtang to be involved. Is there a reason for this?

dialogText.cn: 不错……你们要是想知道原因，就跟我来吧。
dialogText.en: You're right... Follow me if you wish to learn of the truth behind all this.

dialogText.cn: 不就是一面墙吗？我早敲过了，实心的啊！
dialogText.en: Isn't this the same wall? I've checked it already. Pure, solid rock.

dialogText.cn: 真、真进去了？我没眼花吧……是宏科院的技术？
dialogText.en: What?! Did he just disappear into solid rock? I'm not seeing things, right...? Is this HAS tech?

dialogText.cn: 很精妙的机关，里面恐怕另有构造……管理员，陈，我们也试试吧。
dialogText.en: A very clever trick. The inner workings are probably on the other side... Endmin, Chen, we should all give this a try.

dialogText.cn: 这大家伙是什么？祖泉底下怎么会有一座……人造装置？
dialogText.en: What is the big thingy right underneath the Ancestral Spring? Is that a ... machine? How?

dialogText.cn: 这座装置……看起来已经运行了超过一个世纪。
dialogText.en: It appears that this machine ... has kept running for well over a century.

dialogText.cn: 我明白了，所谓的“玄离于器”，意思是——靠水利装置将侵蚀与泉水分流，才能使祖泉免受侵蚀的影响。
dialogText.en: I figured it out. "Darkness it skims" refers to the irrigation machine. It separates the Blight from the clean water, and that's why the Ancestral Spring is Blight-free.

dialogText.cn: 但它运行了太长时间，长期无人维护。即使没遭到外部破坏，装置本身……也已经快无法运行下去了。
dialogText.en: It kept running without maintenance for far too long. Though the chassis is undamaged, the machine itself is ... almost at the verge of malfunctioning.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，虽然这装置与如今的息壤装置截然不同……但我基本可以确定，它是炎国天师留下的。
dialogText.en: Yes. Although this machine is wholly different from the modern Xiranite facilities ... I am quite certain this is the work of the Yanese Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 这就是……你想让我们看的“真相”？
dialogText.en: Is this ... the "truth" you wanted to show us?

dialogText.cn: 你这是做什么？！
dialogText.en: What are you doing!?

dialogText.cn: 那时，我误打误撞闯进这里，得知了……祖泉泉源的“真面目”。
dialogText.en: When I stumbled into this place by accident back then, I didn't expect ... to confront the "true form" of the Ancestral Spring.

dialogText.cn: 没想到……我们家守了这么多年的祖泉，源头竟是这副模样！
dialogText.en: I wasn't prepared for it... My family has guarded the spring for so many generations, but it turned out to be something else!

dialogText.cn: 我不清楚先人是否留下过关于真相的笔记，或是维护这装置的方法……
dialogText.en: I don't know if my ancestors left writings about the truth ... or even the means of repairing this machine...

dialogText.cn: 只知道清波寨中，现在就剩那些语焉不详，让人以为祖泉确有神能的传说故事……
dialogText.en: I grew up in Qingbo Stockade and all I got are ambiguous stories and legends ... those that make people believe in the miraculous powers of the Ancestral Spring...

dialogText.cn: 您……高看了。我到现在都接受不了……
dialogText.en: No... You flatter me. I still can't bring myself to accept this...

dialogText.cn: 但是当我回到地上，在路口远远看到清波寨的寨旗……内心只剩下一个念头——
dialogText.en: When I returned to the surface and saw the banner of Qingbo Stockade from afar ... the only thing on my mind was —

dialogText.cn: 哪怕那些传说全是假的，我也想为寨子里的大伙把心中的“祖泉”守住……
dialogText.en: Even if the legends were false, I must protect the Fam's faith in the Ancestral Spring...

dialogText.cn: 所以你才在那些裂地者面前装疯？
dialogText.en: That's why you pretended to be mad in front of the Landbreakers!

dialogText.cn: 不错。我……没有阮一那样的身手，也没法像大当家那样把大伙聚在一处……
dialogText.en: Yeah. I ... I'm not a great fighter like Ruan Yi, and I couldn't unite the Fam like our Supreme Chief...

dialogText.cn: 能想到的法子，也就是像话本故事讲的那样“装疯唬人”了……
dialogText.en: The only tactic I knew ... is to feign madness and possession like the folk tales...

dialogText.cn: 但即便你赶走了裂地者，祖泉的现状依然是一个隐患，被分入储污池的侵蚀迟早会因为容器满溢而影响到清波寨。
dialogText.en: Though the Landbreakers are gone, the Ancestral Spring is in pretty bad shape. The Blight containment tank will eventually overflow and affect the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 我大概猜到了。所以……才生了带你们来这儿的念头。
dialogText.en: I guessed that too. That's why I ... came up with an idea of guiding you down to this place.

dialogText.cn: 我想请各位帮我关停这装置，将它封存。
dialogText.en: I hope you can help me shut down this machine and seal it away.

dialogText.cn: 但装置一旦停转，不再被分流的侵蚀也……
dialogText.en: But if the machine stops working, it would no longer filter out the Blight and...

dialogText.cn: 会慢慢影响到祖泉吧……
dialogText.en: And the Ancestral Spring will eventually be affected...

dialogText.cn: 就让我杜鸣……来当毁去祖泉的第二号罪人吧！
dialogText.en: Let me, Du Ming ... perform the transgression and destroy the Ancestral Spring!

dialogText.cn: ……管理员，你认为呢？
dialogText.en: ...What do you think, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 多谢各位。之前我试了很多次，一次都没能关掉这装置。也许是有什么特殊的关窍……
dialogText.en: Thank you, everyone. I've already made a few attempts but none of them worked. There's probably a special mechanism involved...

dialogText.cn: 辛苦了，管理员。这处装置终于能“功成身退”了……
dialogText.en: Excellent work, Endmin. This machine is finally getting its well-deserved retirement...

dialogText.cn: 这样……我对先人们也算是有了个交代。
dialogText.en: Now ... I can finally face my ancestors with peace of mind.

dialogText.cn: 我……想再借用一回祖泉的传说……
dialogText.en: I ... I probably need to allude to the legend of the Ancestral Spring one more time...

dialogText.cn: 希望各位，再帮我最后一个忙。
dialogText.en: I hope you will aid me once more.

dialogText.cn: 可不这么做，这里积攒那么多年的侵蚀随时都可能往上涌！我必须得为清波寨的大伙保住一线生机！
dialogText.en: But it must be done, or all that built up Blight will overflow and surge to the surface! I have to protect the livelihood of everyone in Qingbo Stockade!

dialogText.cn: 那我就守在这里，把大伙儿照顾好……
dialogText.en: I'll guard this place and protect the Fam...

dialogText.cn: “守泉人”你问的是……杜鸣哥他们家的那名头？
dialogText.en: Spring guardians...? You're asking about ... the profession of Brother Du and his family, right?

dialogText.cn: 太细的我也不知道，只知道是他祖上传下来的。
dialogText.en: I don't really know the details. I just know his family has been doing this for ages.

dialogText.cn: 有这名头的，一辈子得守着祖泉，还要记那一大堆的故事……小时候我从他那儿听过好多呢。
dialogText.en: Every spring guardian gotta watch over the Ancestral Spring their whole life. They gotta memorize all sorts of stories too... He actually told me plenty of them when I was a little girl.

dialogText.cn: 祖泉……我们清波寨信它也敬它，我打小也爱往这儿跑，看泉水这么流过去，心里也变清爽了。
dialogText.en: Hmm... People in Qingbo Stockade sometimes pray to the Ancestral Spring. Everyone kinda respects it. I love exploring this place as well. Seeing the pretty spring waters flowing down the stream always made me feel better.

dialogText.cn: 它能护着我们也好，护不了也罢，总归是我们自个儿的祖泉嘛。
dialogText.en: I don't really care if the Ancestral Spring could or could not protect us. It's our spring, and that's all that matters.

dialogText.cn: 你们回来了！刚才地动了半天，我还怕是你们出了什么事……
dialogText.en: You're back! The ground was heaving and churning for a bit. I thought something bad happened to you...

dialogText.cn: 对了！你们找到杜鸣哥了？——杜鸣哥？！
dialogText.en: Oh! Did you find Du Ming? Wait. BROTHER DU?! Is that you?

dialogText.cn: 那仙人……可有救赎祖泉之法？杜鸣恳请仙人赐教……
dialogText.en: O, divine one... Is there a way to save the Ancestral Spring? Your servant humbly asks you to point the way...

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣哥，你和谁说话呢？我在这儿啊！
dialogText.en: Brother Du, I'm right here! Who the hell are you talking to?

dialogText.cn: 是了！是了！杜鸣愿为仙人凭依——
dialogText.en: That's it! O, thank you, divine one! I shall gladly serve as your vessel —

dialogText.cn: 汝即清波寨后人之首？
dialogText.en: Who art thou? A chief ruling o'er the scions of Qingbo?

dialogText.cn: 啊……我？
dialogText.en: Ah...? You're talking to me?

dialogText.cn: 我乃驻守祖泉泉源之灵，尔等虽屡次对祖泉不敬，却也是应了个中因缘……
dialogText.en: I am the spirit of the fount from whom the ancient spring floweth. Ye mortals have trespassed upon the sanctity of the spring, but such was already ordained by fate...

dialogText.cn: 须知心中无泉泉自去，心中有泉泉长存……若求生路，必先自寻……
dialogText.en: Behold! Those who care little for the spring shall lose it, but everlasting it shall be to those who carry faith... Survival is achieved by those who seek...

actorName.cn: 迷茫的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 这……这是祖泉里边的仙人附在杜鸣哥身上了？话说得神神叨叨的……啥意思啊……
dialogText.en: Erm... Did some spirit of the source take over Brother Du's body? He's talking weird and stuff... I can barely understand all those hard words he's using...

actorName.cn: 恍然大悟的寨民{sm2l3m2-急切的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 我懂了！是不是说……让我们自己多想些法子，别只想着靠祖泉了？
dialogText.en: I got it! I think he's telling us to ... uhm ... stop using the Ancestral Spring all the time. And maybe we ... should come up with our own ways?

dialogText.cn: 我管你是哪路神仙！快把杜鸣哥还回来！
dialogText.en: I don't care if you're a spirit or ghost or talking cloud! GET OUT OF BROTHER DU! NOW!!!

dialogText.cn: 也别说这种难懂的话了——祖泉当然重要，但我也不想大家……只靠祖泉才活得下去。
dialogText.en: And STOP talking in mumbo-jumbo! I know the spring is super important... And I never wanted the Fam to be helpless without the spring...

dialogText.cn: 我想……不，我会靠自己，给寨子的兄弟姐妹们找条新出路的！说到做到！
dialogText.en: I think... NO! I'm gonna figure it out! ON MY OWN! I'll find a way for the Stockade Fam! I swear on it!

actorName.cn: 迷茫的寨民{sm2l3m2-张皇的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 大，大当家……
dialogText.en: Chief, you're...

actorName.cn: 恍然大悟的寨民{sm2l3m2-急切的寨民}

dialogText.cn: 说得好！咱们清波寨一条心，肯定能跟着大当家闯出条新路来！
dialogText.en: Hear, hear! Every Stockader is right behind you, Chief! We'll carve open a new way!

dialogText.cn: 孺子可教，孺子可教！此人心愿即了，已随我去也！去也！
dialogText.en: Good. I see hope in thee! As for my vessel, he hath fulfilled his wish and shall now take my stead! Fare thee well!

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣哥！
dialogText.en: BROTHER DU!

dialogText.cn: 我本泉中客，今日方得真……
dialogText.en: Patron of the Spring was I, now the very truth is mine...

dialogText.cn: 今日……方得真……
dialogText.en: Today is when ... truth sings...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: Thank you, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣，怎么不走了？汤汤他们就在前面了——
dialogText.en: Du Ming, why don't you keep going? Tangtang and the Stockade residents are up ahead.

dialogText.cn: 几位，你们先过去吧。我……还想再准备下……
dialogText.en: You can go ahead first. I, uh... I need a moment to ready myself...

dialogText.cn: 杜鸣哥以后都会这样……没法恢复了吗？
dialogText.en: Is Brother Du gonna be like this forever...? There must be a cure, right?

dialogText.cn: 道理我明白……但心里总是酸酸的……有些闷……
dialogText.en: I know what he's trying to say... But it's really making me sad... There's something I wanna get off my chest...

dialogText.cn: 可作为大当家，不可能丢下他不管的！寨子里的大家也是！
dialogText.en: But I'm the Supreme Chief, and nobody gets left behind on my watch! The same goes for anyone in the Stockade Fam!

dialogText.cn: 不管多久，我们都会等他回来。
dialogText.en: We'll wait for his return! No matter how long it takes!

dialogText.cn: 你好，遇到麻烦了吗？
dialogText.en: Greetings. Are you in trouble?

dialogText.cn: 呃……你们是谁？
dialogText.en: Uh... Who are you people?

dialogText.cn: 我们来自终末地，我是佩丽卡，这位是……
dialogText.en: We're Endfielders. I'm Perlica and this...

dialogText.cn: 终末地？哦，我知道你们！
dialogText.en: Endfield? Oh! I actually know your company!

dialogText.cn: 二位好，我叫皮奥特，来自商……呃不对，是一名天师。
dialogText.en: Well met. I'm Piot and I'm from the T... Uh, I mean, I'm a Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 天师？
dialogText.en: Tianshi?

dialogText.cn: 啊对对对……你觉得我不像本地人是吧？
dialogText.en: Y-yeah! Of course...! And I don't look like a local to you, right?

dialogText.cn: 我……我是从菈……南方的城市来的，是来游学的。
dialogText.en: I, uh, I'm from La Fan... Far south. Yes, yes! A city really down south. I'm here as an exchange student.

dialogText.cn: 咳……不重要，你们，能不能帮我个忙！
dialogText.en: Ahem... Where I'm from isn't important. I actually need your help!

dialogText.cn: 请你们帮忙找到玛蒂娜！
dialogText.en: Please help me find Martina!

dialogText.cn: 玛蒂娜？
dialogText.en: Martina?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，是我的老板……呃不对，是我的同伴。她被本地的强盗抓走了。
dialogText.en: Yeah. She's my bo... Erm, ahh! My bosom companion! Yes! Some local bandits kidnapped her!

dialogText.cn: “强盗”……你是说清波寨寨民吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm... Are you referring to the residents of Qingbo Stockade?

dialogText.cn: 对对对，玛蒂娜被关进了他们的城寨。
dialogText.en: Yes! Yes! YES! They took Martina and brought her to their wooden castle!

dialogText.cn: 我完全不会打架，只能在这里干着急。
dialogText.en: I'm completely useless in fighting. The only thing I could do is to stand here and hope help shows up.

dialogText.cn: 如果玛蒂娜有什么闪失，我就完蛋了，你们能帮帮我吗？
dialogText.en: I'll be finished if anything happens to Martina! Can you please help me?

dialogText.cn: 没错没错。
dialogText.en: Yes! That's right!

dialogText.cn: 唔……她有什么特征吗？
dialogText.en: So ... do you have any details about her appearance?

dialogText.cn: 哦，穿着和我类似的天师服，然后，背着一个很大的背包。
dialogText.en: Oh! She's wearing a Tianshi outfit like me! And she's carrying this HUUUGE backpack.

dialogText.cn: 有这么大，你们看见了不会认错的。
dialogText.en: It's *THIS* big. You definitely won't miss it.

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，管理员？我认为值得调查一下。
dialogText.en: What do you think, Endmin? This might be something we can look into.

dialogText.cn: 皮奥特天师，你还记得玛蒂娜天师被关的大致方位吗？
dialogText.en: Tianshi Piot, do you know where Tianshi Martina is being held?

dialogText.cn: 记得记得，我这就给二位标记一下。
dialogText.en: Of course I do! I'll mark out her location for you.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，你就待在这里，不要离开。
dialogText.en: Alright. Try to stay put and don't go anywhere.

dialogText.cn: 拜托了，一定要把她平安带回来！
dialogText.en: Please! Bring her back safely!

dialogText.cn: 是玛蒂娜天师吗？
dialogText.en: Are you Tianshi Martina?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我是玛蒂娜……
dialogText.en: Si, I'm Martina...

dialogText.cn: 欸？你们是谁？要干什么？
dialogText.en: Wait. Who are you? What are you trying to do?

dialogText.cn: 我们来自终末地，你的同伴皮奥特委托我们救你出去。
dialogText.en: We're from Endfield. Your companion, Piot, asked us to save you.

dialogText.cn: 终末地？我听过你们的事！不过，皮奥特是怎么能找上你们的……
dialogText.en: Endfield? Yeah, I heard about you! But how did Piot manage to acquire your services...?

dialogText.cn: 好吧……对了，皮奥特呢？他跑哪里去了？还好吗？
dialogText.en: Fine... Okay. What about Piot? Where did he go? Is he doing okay?

dialogText.cn: 他没事，待在很安全的地方。就是有些焦虑……他好像很担心你的安危。
dialogText.en: Piot's at a very safe place right now. He's doing fine, just a little bit nervous... That young man's very concerned about your safety.

dialogText.cn: 呼，那就好。他啊，总爱瞎操心……不过我还不能回去，这场冒险才刚开始呢！
dialogText.en: Phew. Good to know. Piot's always the paranoid sort... But I don't intend to go back right now. My adventure has just begun!

dialogText.cn: 你要在这里……冒险？
dialogText.en: An adventure? Here?

dialogText.cn: 啊……没错，其实我是民俗学专业的天师，正在为我的学术报告取材，方向是清波寨的传统文化现象。
dialogText.en: Ah... That's right. I'm actually a Tianshi focusing on folk traditions and I intend to gather materials for my academic project. My focus is traditional and cultural phenomena observed for the Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 啊，我在凭记忆还原寨民们使用的暗语，这是一种独特的交流方式，很有趣的！
dialogText.en: Ah! I'm trying to memorize and recreate the secret messages used by the Stockaders. Their unique way of communication is really interesting!

dialogText.cn: 他们会将面具挂在各种地方形成暗语，不同样式、颜色、排列，构成不同的语义。
dialogText.en: They compose secret messages by hanging various kinds of masks. Messages are determined by the type, color, and sequence of the masks.

dialogText.cn: 先前我本来已经拍了一些暗语的照片，就等解开了。
dialogText.en: I actually took a few photos of the secret mask messages. It's a puzzle waiting to be solved.

dialogText.cn: 结果我被寨民追的时候，不小心弄丢了相机……那些照片全没了！太可惜了！
dialogText.en: However, I got chased by the Stockaders and accidentally lost my camera... All those photos! Lost! Ay! What a shame!

dialogText.cn: 话说回来，你也戴着面具呢。要是相机还在，我肯定要给你拍两张的！
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, I also noticed the mask on your face. If I had my camera, I would have taken a few shots of you already.

dialogText.cn: 为了开这道锁，我把包里的东西试了个遍。你们竟然这么轻松就打开了，有两把刷子嘛！
dialogText.en: I tried everything in my backpack, but this lock refused to open! But you opened it just like that! Incredible!

dialogText.cn: 这只是一种源石技艺，也可以用来处理类似的问题。
dialogText.en: It's just a form of Originium Arts. It can also be used to handle other mechanical problems.

dialogText.cn: 哦？这么说，你很擅长开锁咯？我懂了……你是<@qu.key>怪盗假面</>！
dialogText.en: Oh? That means you're a professional locksmith? I see... You must be the <@qu.key>Masked Rogue</>!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，她似乎误会了什么……
dialogText.en: It's just a misunderstanding, Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 久违了，自由的空气！
dialogText.en: Oh, sweet fresh air! I'm free at last!

dialogText.cn: 我现在突然有了个想法，怪盗假面和……
dialogText.en: I just got an idea, Masked Rogue and, uhm...

dialogText.cn: 我叫佩丽卡……什么想法？
dialogText.en: I'm Perlica... Please tell me about this idea of yours.

dialogText.cn: 咳！那么——怪盗假面和佩丽卡，我想邀请你们一起完成这次的冒险！
dialogText.en: Ahem! Well then, Masked Rogue and Perlica, I'm formally inviting you to my adventure!

dialogText.cn: 玛蒂娜天师，我们会协助你完成你的课题取材。希望你也尽量配合，避免不必要的冲突……
dialogText.en: Tianshi Martina, we shall assist you in the gathering of research materials. We also hope you can follow our lead to avoid unnecessary confrontations...

dialogText.cn: 好，没问题！哼哼，有你和怪盗假面在，这下我的课题肯定能顺利完成！
dialogText.en: Si! No problema! Hmhmph. Having you and the Masked Rogue around will guarantee the completion of my research topic!

dialogText.cn: 老实说，我不太擅长应付这里的人……你们能深入这里，应该不光是会开锁？
dialogText.en: Truth be told, I'm not very good at dealing with the locals... The fact that you made it here tells me you know more than breaking locks.

dialogText.cn: 老实说，清波寨的文化很独特，寨民们还会使用暗语来和彼此沟通。
dialogText.en: Truth be told, Qingbo Stockade has a unique culture. The Stockaders actually use secret messages to communicate with each other.

dialogText.cn: 所以完成课题的关键，是找到尽可能多的暗语，再结合暗语去考察。
dialogText.en: The key to completing my project is to identify as many secret messages as I can, then use them to support subsequent investigations.

dialogText.cn: 我就是靠风吹动面具时发出的声音找到暗语的。
dialogText.en: When the wind blows across the masks, they make sounds that lead me to the secret messages.

dialogText.cn: 确实是悦耳与独特的声音。
dialogText.en: The sounds they make are rather unique and pleasing.

dialogText.cn: 这些面具虽然是单独悬挂的，可是会有那么一个角度……
dialogText.en: These masks are hung separately, but they've been placed at a certain angle...

dialogText.cn: 从那个角度看过去，面具就会组成一个可被解读的整体！
dialogText.en: If you look at them from a particular angle, they would form a decipherable message!

dialogText.cn: 只不过……我有点……
dialogText.en: But I'm ... a little...

dialogText.cn: 玛蒂娜，你怎么了？
dialogText.en: Martina? Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: 不行不行，我太久没吃东西了，睁开眼就是星星在下坠。
dialogText.en: Ah... I've not eaten anything for a while. I think I'm seeing shooting stars right now.

dialogText.cn: 休息一下吧，背包里有食物吗？
dialogText.en: We should stop and rest. Do you have any food in your backpack?

dialogText.cn: 吃的都在皮奥特那里，我只带了装备器材，应该听他劝，多少带点干粮。
dialogText.en: Piot carried all the food, and I only had the equipment and instruments. I should've listened to him and brought some rations along.

dialogText.cn: 真的？真是可靠啊，怪盗假面。
dialogText.en: Really? You would?! That's so kind of you, Masked Rogue.

dialogText.cn: 你只要找好地点与视角，再按下快门，咔嚓一下，搞定。
dialogText.en: Just find the proper spot, aim at the right angle, and press the button! CLICK! Job done!

dialogText.cn: 我们就在这里等你的战果。
dialogText.en: We shall wait here for your good news.

dialogText.cn: 加油，管理员。
dialogText.en: Let's do it, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 唔……看来我之前果然记错了，这里是这样排列的……
dialogText.en: Hmm... Turns out I remembered it wrong. This is the proper sequence...

dialogText.cn: 我想想，爱河……离人……不对。
dialogText.en: Lemme think. River of love... Separation... This doesn't sound right.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>爱人……河边……离开……</>
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Lover ... riverbank ... leaving...</>

dialogText.cn: 嗯，没错，就是这样！
dialogText.en: Okay. This must be it!

dialogText.cn: 这些暗语是如何解读的？
dialogText.en: How do you decipher these secret messages?

dialogText.cn: 唔，说起来有点复杂，涉及到泰拉的语言学与符号学、塔卫二的民俗学，以及其他大量相关资料的比对。
dialogText.en: Hmm, this is a little hard to explain. It's a comparative study of Terran linguistics and semiotics, Talosian folk traditions, and tons of other relevant data.

dialogText.cn: 总之，出发前我就做好了解读的准备，花了好几天时间呢。
dialogText.en: To keep it short, I prepped the deciphering work before I started this journey. It actually took me quite a few days.

dialogText.cn: 留下暗语的人告诉我们，他的爱人辛夷已经从河边离开。
dialogText.en: The one who left the secret message is telling us that his lover, Xin Yi, had left the riverbank.

dialogText.cn: 暗语本身，似乎也有额外的含义……
dialogText.en: The secret message seems to have other meanings...

dialogText.cn: 目前有用的信息就是<@qu.key>“河边”</>，先去附近的河边看看吧。
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>"Riverbank"</> is the most useful data we have right now. Time to look around the nearby river.

dialogText.cn: 稍等，最近的河边已经标记在地图上了。
dialogText.en: Okay. The closest riverbank has been marked on the map.

dialogText.cn: 好嘞，出发吧。
dialogText.en: Great. Let's go.

dialogText.cn: 玛蒂娜，你不饿了吗？
dialogText.en: Martina, aren't you hungry?

dialogText.cn: 探险就是最好的食粮！
dialogText.en: Exploration is the best food I'd ever need!

dialogText.cn: 应该就是这里了……
dialogText.en: This should be the place...

dialogText.cn: 咦？这难道就是<@qu.key>“水竹铃”</>吗？
dialogText.en: Hmm? Are these the <@qu.key>"bamboo water chimes"</>?

dialogText.cn: 等等，这只水竹铃上面，写着“辛夷”。
dialogText.en: Hold on. The name "Xin Yi" is written on these bamboo water chimes.

dialogText.cn: “辛夷”……不就是暗语里提到的，那位恋人的名字吗？
dialogText.en: "Xin Yi"... Isn't that the name of the lover mentioned in the secret message?

dialogText.cn: “离开”……我明白了。
dialogText.en: "Left"... I got it.

dialogText.cn: 你们知道，清波寨寨民用水竹铃缅怀逝者的传统吗？
dialogText.en: Traditionally, Qingbo Stockaders use bamboo water chimes to commemorate the deceased.

dialogText.cn: 按照学界的说法，这个传统似乎呼应了过去炎国哲学家提出的“生如远舟”的哲思，但……
dialogText.en: An academic explanation of this tradition is that it relates to the concept of "life as a voyaging boat". It was first proposed by a Yanese philosopher, but...

dialogText.cn: 我总觉得有些悲伤，那些对逝者的哀思，都只能寄托在这铃声中随水而去……
dialogText.en: I can't help but feel sad about this. The chimes by the flowing river... They're the only vessels for expressing one's grief...

dialogText.cn: 但事实上，除了缅怀逝者，清波寨的寨民也会向水竹铃许下心愿，相信能借此得到逝者们的回应与祝福。
dialogText.en: Actually, the bamboo water chimes are used for more than just memorializing the departed. Residents of Qingbo Stockade also make wishes with them and believe the deceased could answer and bless their hopes.

dialogText.cn: 原来水竹铃还有这样的意义……结合那条暗语，那位寨民或许不仅是在缅怀爱人，也是在告诉爱人“我不曾忘记你”吧。
dialogText.en: I see... When taken together with the secret message we saw, that Stockader wasn't just grieving his loved one. He was also telling her that she would not be forgotten.

dialogText.cn: 对了，帮我给水竹铃<@qu.key>拍张照</>吧，我想记录下来。
dialogText.en: Alright. Can you help <@qu.key>take a photo</> and record these bamboo water chimes for me?

dialogText.cn: 也算是给这次旅行留的一份特别纪念……
dialogText.en: It would serve as a very special memento of this journey...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，是的，之前我们在清波寨的其他地方也见过。
dialogText.en: Yes, they are. We saw these at other locations around Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 不错不错，照片我收下啦。
dialogText.en: Not bad at all. Thanks for the photo.

dialogText.cn: 还剩两处暗语，怎么样，一起吗？
dialogText.en: We have two more secret messages to decipher. Interested in tagging along?

dialogText.cn: 你们俩，都是很棒的探险家。和你们一起探险很开心！
dialogText.en: You're both excellent explorers. This journey of discovery is really fun with you around!

dialogText.cn: 能更多地了解这里的习俗，对我们也是很有裨益的。
dialogText.en: Learning more about the local traditions has been very beneficial for us as well.

dialogText.cn: 太好了，跟我来，出发出发！
dialogText.en: Excellent! Follow me, then! Time to move!

dialogText.cn: 我看看……这次的暗语是……
dialogText.en: Let me see... This secret message means...

dialogText.cn: 寨子……高处……睡觉……
dialogText.en: Stockade... High place... Sleeping...

dialogText.cn: 怎么样，解读出来了吗？
dialogText.en: How's the deciphering going?

dialogText.cn: 留下暗语的寨民说，他在清波寨的高处睡觉。
dialogText.en: The Stockader left this message: I'm sleeping at a high place within the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 难道是指……在水车上？
dialogText.en: Maybe he's sleeping on ... a waterwheel.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>“高处”</>是指那里的话……确实蛮高的。
dialogText.en: That ... is actually pretty high for a <@qu.key>"high place"</>...

dialogText.cn: 我们先到水车附近调查一下吧。
dialogText.en: Let's get closer to the waterwheel and continue our investigations there.

dialogText.cn: 好，我突然又不饿了，咱们走！
dialogText.en: Agreed! And I'm suddenly not hungry anymore! Let's go!

dialogText.cn: 你好……
dialogText.en: Hola...
Hngh... Huh...? WHA?!

dialogText.cn: 小心！我们没有恶意，是看到你的暗语才来到这里的。
dialogText.en: Careful, there! Phoo. We mean you no harm. In fact, we came here because we saw your secret message.

dialogText.cn: 暗语说，你在水车的高处睡觉。
dialogText.en: Your message says you're sleeping up high on the waterwheel.

dialogText.cn: 没……没错，你们是谁？
dialogText.en: That's ... that's right. Who are you?

dialogText.cn: 我们是……探险家！对，来这里探险。
dialogText.en: We're ... explorers! That's right! We're here to explore the area.

dialogText.cn: 俺叫长杆头，真亏你们能找到这里啊，怎么看懂暗语的？
dialogText.en: Name's Punty Pole. Can't believe you made your way up here. How did you learn about our secret code?

dialogText.cn: 总之，做了些功课。
dialogText.en: Well, I did my homework.

dialogText.cn: 你为什么要待在这么高的地方？
dialogText.en: Sir, why are you staying at a place so high up?

dialogText.cn: 俺的工作是放哨，你明白吗，就是通常意义上的放哨。
dialogText.en: They placed me on sentry duty. And this isn't a secret message. It's plain old simple sentry duty.

dialogText.cn: 最早，是在寨子周围巡视，一天得走个一百里地，累得够呛。
dialogText.en: Initially, I had to patrol the areas around the Stockade. That's like fifty klicks worth of walking. The job is exhausting.

dialogText.cn: 之后俺便寻思，有句俗话怎么说的来着，“站得高看得远”——
dialogText.en: Then I started thinking about the Wise Sage Says. And one of those sayings went like: "The higher you stand, the further you see".

dialogText.cn: 于是，俺便不断选择更高的地方，这样就不用每日奔波。
dialogText.en: Then I kept looking for higher places so I wouldn't have to do all that walking every day.

dialogText.cn: 等回过神，就已经在这水车上了。
dialogText.en: When I got back to my senses, I somehow ended up on this waterwheel.

dialogText.cn: 那你为什么要在这里睡觉？
dialogText.en: Okay. So why would you sleep here as well?

dialogText.cn: 还不是因为无聊，这一天天的，只管放哨，可是为什么要放哨？
dialogText.en: Because I got bored doing sentry duty and trying to look for trouble. Seriously, why are we even doing this?

dialogText.cn: 俺去问了大当家，她好像也说不清，让俺只管放哨，别琢磨有的没的。
dialogText.en: I asked the Supreme Chief, and she couldn't give me a good answer. In fact, she told me to focus on my duties and stop thinking about random stuff.

dialogText.cn: 无聊就会犯困，犯困就会睡，睡着了，俺就开始做梦。
dialogText.en: And sure enough, I got bored really fast. And when I get bored, I'd fall asleep and start dreaming.

dialogText.cn: 你猜怎么着？俺在梦里找到了<@qu.key>放哨的意义</>！
dialogText.en: Guess what happened? I discovered the <@qu.key>meaning of sentry duty</> in my dreams!

dialogText.cn: 什么意义？
dialogText.en: Mind sharing it with us?

dialogText.cn: 俺还没完全理解，俺寻思一定是这里离天更近的原因，这是老天爷的意思！
dialogText.en: I haven't figured it out completely, but this place is closer to the skies. Maybe the Heavens sent me that message!

dialogText.cn: 他没事吧？
dialogText.en: Is he alright?

dialogText.cn: 也许，长杆头先生真的领悟到了什么。
dialogText.en: I think he is. Mr. Punty Pole may have realized something.

dialogText.cn: 你现在怎么不继续睡觉了？
dialogText.en: Why don't you keep sleeping, then?

dialogText.cn: 呃，这个嘛……就得你们帮俺个忙了……
dialogText.en: Well, erm... I probably need someone to help with that... Will you?

dialogText.cn: 俺之前本想再找个更高点的地方睡觉的，结果一不小心摔了下来……
dialogText.en: I was trying to look for an even higher place to sleep but ... I fell off by accident...

dialogText.cn: 什么……那你没受伤吗？要不要紧？
dialogText.en: Ay, yai, yai... Are you alright? Did you get hurt?

dialogText.cn: 没事，俺皮实得很，以前摔过好多回了，不打紧！
dialogText.en: I'm alright! Fell off a couple of times already, but I got a solid hide that makes me tough to kill.

dialogText.cn: 只是这一摔，把俺的入梦工具不知道摔哪儿去了，弄得俺都睡不了觉了……
dialogText.en: That last fall, though, made me lose my dream kit. Now I couldn't even sleep no more...

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>“入梦工具”</>是什么？
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>"Dream kit"</>? What is that?

dialogText.cn: 俺的眼罩！
dialogText.en: My eye mask!

dialogText.cn: 不知道咋回事，如果不戴着眼罩，俺就没法睡着，更别提做梦了。
dialogText.en: I don't know why, but I must wear my eye mask to sleep. And if I can't sleep, I definitely can't dream.

dialogText.cn: 能不能帮俺把眼罩找回来，这很重要！
dialogText.en: Please! Help me find my eye mask! It's really important!

dialogText.cn: 他看上去，确实很久没睡过觉了。
dialogText.en: Yeah, he looks like he hasn't slept for a while.

dialogText.cn: 感激不尽，俺就在这儿等你们。
dialogText.en: I'm mighty grateful! I'll wait for you here!

dialogText.cn: 这么快？太好了太好了，俺可以接着做梦了。
dialogText.en: Back so soon! This is great! I can start dreaming again.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢几位探险家！
dialogText.en: You have my thanks, explorers!

dialogText.cn: 欸？已经睡着了？这么快！
dialogText.en: Hey, is he already asleep? That was quick.

dialogText.cn: 我还想问问床是怎么回事呢！
dialogText.en: I was about to ask about the bed.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你觉得长杆头是怎么把竹床带上来的？
dialogText.en: Endmin, any idea how Punty Pole brought his bamboo bed up to this place?

dialogText.cn: 有几分道理。
dialogText.en: That makes a lot of sense.

dialogText.cn: 好，圆满完成，我们给长杆头拍个照吧！对了，把风景也一起拍下来！
dialogText.en: Okay! Job done! Hey, let's take a photo of Punty Pole! And make sure you get the scenery as well!

dialogText.cn: 构图、光影、立意都无可挑剔，完美到可以直接拿来展出了！
dialogText.en: The composition, light and shadow, and staging are just incredible. It's so flawless I can showcase it without any post-processing!

dialogText.cn: 展出？
dialogText.en: Showcase?

dialogText.cn: 没事，哈哈。咱们去看最后一处暗语吧。
dialogText.en: Ah, just a ... figure of speech! Haha. Let's check the last secret message.

dialogText.cn: 没事，我的精神“吃”得饱饱的！走吧。
dialogText.en: I'm alright. My mind and spirit have been well-fed! Come on!

dialogText.cn: 这次的有点难认，稍等。
dialogText.en: Hold on. This one's a little hard to decipher.

dialogText.cn: 唔……源石……山洞……练习？
dialogText.en: Hmm... Originium... Cave... Training?

dialogText.cn: 听起来……似乎是说练习源石技艺的事？
dialogText.en: Sounds like ... someone's doing Arts training.

dialogText.cn: 这条暗语很混乱，我没法完全理解。
dialogText.en: This secret message is a real mess. I can't decipher it at all.

dialogText.cn: 大致的意思是……
dialogText.en: I think the general meaning is...

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>源石技艺很痛，很好玩。</>
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>Originium Arts are painful but fun.</>

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我感觉很不妙，留下暗语的人也许正处于危险之中。
dialogText.en: I'm a little worried, Endmin. The one who left this secret message might be in danger.

dialogText.cn: 根据暗语，他应该身处一个存在大量源石的山洞里。
dialogText.en: According to this message, he should be in a cave filled with plenty of Originium.

dialogText.cn: 只是我在此前的探索中，并没有发现这样的地方。
dialogText.en: But I didn't find any Originium caves during my previous explorations.

dialogText.cn: 管理员……
dialogText.en: Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 感应到了吗？……明白，我帮你标记下。
dialogText.en: Can you sense it...? Okay then, I'll mark it out for you.

dialogText.cn: 怪盗假面！你还有多少本事是我不知道的！
dialogText.en: ¡Que increíble, Masked Rogue! Just how many skills do you have?

dialogText.cn: 不过眼下的事情要紧，既然知道目的地了，我们走吧。
dialogText.en: Maybe I'll save the compliments for later. Now that we have a location, we should go there at once.

dialogText.cn: 根据现场遗留的线索，留下第三段暗语的人恐怕已经……
dialogText.en: From the clues we found at the scene, I'm afraid the one who left the third secret message has...

dialogText.cn: 这名寨民过度使用了源石技艺，最终因<@qu.key>矿石病</>而亡。
dialogText.en: ...This Stockade resident overused the Arts and succumbed to <@qu.key>Oripathy</>.

dialogText.cn: 如同其他死于矿石病的人……只留下了一些随身物品。
dialogText.en: And like other victims of Oripathy ... all that's left of him are just a few personal belongings.

dialogText.cn: 矿石病，在我们这代人心里，已经不是不治之症了……我们也就都慢慢遗忘了它的可怕。
dialogText.en: Oripathy is just a chronic condition these days... Most of us have forgotten how terrible it was in the past.

dialogText.cn: 患者如果没有足够的抑制药物，还是会走向悲惨的结局。
dialogText.en: A terrible fate still awaits any patient who couldn't access enough suppressants.

dialogText.cn: 矿石病本身，并没有任何变化。
dialogText.en: Nothing has changed about Oripathy.

dialogText.cn: 我知道，寨民们没有处理复杂病症的医疗条件，他在写下那些话时，一定是已经预感到了自己的结局吧……
dialogText.en: I know the Stockaders lack medical resources to handle complex diseases like this. He probably knew his fate when he wrote the secret message...

dialogText.cn: 如果他能及时去武陵城就医……以那里的医疗水平，应该也不至于……
dialogText.en: If only he could've gotten himself to Wuling City on time... The medical services there would have...

dialogText.cn: 从遗言的内容来看，他过度磨练的源石技艺，指向的正是武陵城。
dialogText.en: From what he wrote in his will, he actually trained his Arts to attack Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 唉，虽然作为外来人无法评判什么……但我确实很难理解他们这样为了仇恨轻视自身的做法……
dialogText.en: *Sigh* I'm just an outsider so I can't really comment... But I don't understand why anyone would harm themselves over a feud...

dialogText.cn: 身份、阵营就那么重要吗？明明这个世界，还有那么多美好的地方。
dialogText.en: Why obsess about factions when this world offers so much beauty to focus on?

dialogText.cn: 我们在这颗星球上，创造了那么多存在的痕迹……
dialogText.en: We've created so many traces of our existence upon this planet...

dialogText.cn: 玛蒂娜……
dialogText.en: Martina...

dialogText.cn: ……我其实，并不是什么天师。
dialogText.en: I'm actually not a Tianshi...

dialogText.cn: 欸？那你们还帮我到现在。
dialogText.en: What? You knew? Why did you keep helping me then?

dialogText.cn: 正如你所说，身份本身并没有那么重要。但我也有必要确认一下，你们假扮成天师的缘由。
dialogText.en: It's like what you said. Factions aren't that important. But I do need to know why you disguised yourself as a Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 倒没有什么特别的理由啦，只是我们作为<@qu.key>客座学者</>，得到了这身天师服。
dialogText.en: There are no special reasons, really. They give Tianshi outfits to <@qu.key>visiting scholars</> like us.

dialogText.cn: 穿上它，就感觉自己更好地融入了这里，这也是为了深度体验武陵文化嘛。
dialogText.en: Wearing it made me feel like I was part of the local community. It also gives an immersive experience of Wuling culture.

dialogText.cn: 不过，也因此被某些寨民敌视，算是“沉浸式体验”了。
dialogText.en: But I also got plenty of hate from the Stockaders. I guess that's part of the "immersion".

dialogText.cn: 不冒昧，重新自我介绍一下——我叫玛蒂娜，是一名游历四方的<@qu.key>博物学者</>。皮奥特是我的助理。
dialogText.en: Oh, no you're not. I shall introduce myself again. I am Martina, a traveling <@qu.key>naturalist</>. Piot is my assistant.

dialogText.cn: 我在<@qu.key>菈梵朵玛</>经营了一座博物馆，将四处探险收购的人文物品收藏、展览。
dialogText.en: I run a museum at <@qu.key>La Fantoma</>, where I showcase cultural artifacts gathered during my explorations.

dialogText.cn: 当然，也会定期举办摄影展，毕竟不是所有美好都可以私藏，留影是个好方式。
dialogText.en: Of course, I also host regular photo exhibitions. After all, not every beautiful thing can be procured. A photograph is a great alternative.

dialogText.cn: 我的本意，也只是想让更多人意识到塔卫二的美好。
dialogText.en: My intent is to help more people realize and appreciate the beauty of Talos-II.

dialogText.cn: 这确实是个值得去践行的想法，玛蒂娜学者。
dialogText.en: That is indeed a very worthwhile pursuit, Miss Martina.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，谢谢夸奖！对了，能帮我为这些<@qu.key>源石晶簇</>也拍张照吗？
dialogText.en: Heheh. Thanks! Oh, can you actually help me take a photo of these <@qu.key>Originium clusters</> as well?

dialogText.cn: 不过这张照片我不打算公开。我想将这里的情况反映给武陵城，请他们来处理这位寨民遗留在世上最后的痕迹……
dialogText.en: I don't intend to show this photo to the public, though. I just want to tell Wuling City of the situation here, and ask them to send people to help settle the final proof of this Stockader's existence...

dialogText.cn: 啊？不是吧？难道当时我拿错了？怪不得……怪不得当时那个天师大哥的表情那么怪……
dialogText.en: What? Really? Did I take the wrong outfit? No wonder that Tianshi boy was giving me weird looks...

dialogText.cn: 撇开制服的事不提……我冒昧询问一下，你们的真实身份是？
dialogText.en: We can discuss the uniform later... I hope I'm not being too intrusive, but what exactly is your profession?

dialogText.cn: 这些是，寨民的面具。
dialogText.en: This is a Stockader's mask.

dialogText.cn: 不对，这是……暗语。
dialogText.en: No. This is a ... secret message too.

dialogText.cn: 暗语说了什么？
dialogText.en: What does the message say?

dialogText.cn: 愿水流寄托我所有的祈愿……我的孩子……原谅我已无法陪伴在你身边……
dialogText.en: May the water carry my wishes... My child... Forgive me for leaving your side...

dialogText.cn: 也许，是一名无奈的母亲，在告别自己的孩子。
dialogText.en: Perhaps the mother was left with no choice but to say goodbye.

dialogText.cn: 她一定有什么苦衷，才不得不在这样的地方，生养自己的孩子……
dialogText.en: She must have had her reasons for raising a child under such harsh conditions...

dialogText.cn: ……最终又选择了<@qu.key>放手</>。
dialogText.en: ...In the end, she had no choice but to <@qu.key>give up</>.

dialogText.cn: 这清波寨里，也有这样令人痛心的事啊。
dialogText.en: I didn't expect such a sad story in Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 作为炎国后人，在这无神的土地，将无限的虔诚寄于山水……傍山而生，随水而去。
dialogText.en: And thus the children of Yan grew up in this world without deities, and devoted their boundless faith to the mountains and rivers... By the mountains they live, and upon the waters they depart.

dialogText.cn: 而他们经历的种种悲喜，也被他们留在了这山水间。
dialogText.en: The same mountains and rivers thus became a vessel of their sorrows and joys.

dialogText.cn: 说起来，不知道暗语中提及的那个孩子现在怎么样了……
dialogText.en: Speaking of which, what happened to the child mentioned in the secret message...

dialogText.cn: 顺流水而下，也许最终的归宿还是清波寨。
dialogText.en: If we follow the flow of this river, the child probably ended up at Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 你们在说什么？神神秘秘的。
dialogText.en: What are you talking about? Something mysterious?

dialogText.cn: 不管了，来一起<@qu.key>合个影</>，就当是纪念吧！
dialogText.en: Well, not my business anyway. Say, why don't we <@qu.key>take a group photo</> as a memento?

dialogText.cn: 是啊……自从我开始冒险，已经走过了很多地方。
dialogText.en: You're right... I've traveled to many places after starting my adventures.

dialogText.cn: 过去我总觉得，必须把遇上的有趣事物都带回家收藏，才能证明我去过那儿。
dialogText.en: In the past, I only felt compelled to add the interesting artifacts to my collection back home as proof of my visits.

dialogText.cn: 但现在我却在想，或许冒险时的广阔天地，已经替我记下了<@qu.key>“来过”</>的意义……
dialogText.en: Now, I'm beginning to think that the open lands and skies themselves have marked the meaning of my <@qu.key>"passage"</> through them...

dialogText.cn: 对寨民们了解越深，越不忍心下狠手了。
dialogText.en: Now that I've learned so much about the Stockaders, I couldn't bring myself to hurt them!

dialogText.cn: 老板，也没见你动手呀！
dialogText.en: Boss! Have you learned more about them, or are you just avoiding the fight?

dialogText.cn: 饿得没力气了，快，拿点吃的给我。
dialogText.en: I'm so starved I couldn't move a muscle. Quick. Throw me some food.

dialogText.cn: 皮奥特天师……不，皮奥特先生，我们叮嘱过你不要离开。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Piot... I mean, Mr. Piot... We did tell you to stay at your place.

dialogText.cn: 就乎，你住署无护羽住力的，准末想的？
dialogText.en: Yeah. *NOM* you could hardly *NOM* anything. What were you *NOM*king.

dialogText.cn: 抱歉，我看你们去了那么久还没回来，就有点着急。
dialogText.en: Sorry, sorry! I got a little worried since you were gone for such a long time.

dialogText.cn: ……我们后来去把暗语全解密了，真是一趟印象深刻的冒险！
dialogText.en: ...We then cracked all the secret messages! It was a true adventure worth remembering!

dialogText.cn: 什么？你一个人去了？
dialogText.en: What? You went alone?

dialogText.cn: 还有佩丽卡和怪盗假面啊。
dialogText.en: Not alone. I had Perlica and Masked Rogue in the team.

dialogText.cn: 对了，我跟你说，这怪盗假面太厉害了。
dialogText.en: Before I forget, this Masked Rogue is simply astounding.

dialogText.cn: 你回去，得多学点本事。
dialogText.en: You better pick up some real skills once we get back, Piot.

dialogText.cn: 我已经按照你的要求，精通了摄影、测绘、自然导航……
dialogText.en: But I've already done what you said and mastered photography, topography, natural navigation...

dialogText.cn: 停停停，我知道了。
dialogText.en: Okay, okay. I know what you can do.

dialogText.cn: 不管怎么说，冒险到这里就真的结束了呢，时间过得真快。
dialogText.en: Well, time really flies. I suppose this is where we conclude our local adventure.

dialogText.cn: 我们也很享受这次冒险，看到了不一样的清波寨。
dialogText.en: It has been a most enjoyable trip so far. We saw another side of Qingbo Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 我们回去会办一次关于清波寨文化的展览，你们有空的话一定要来！
dialogText.en: Once we head back, we'll start organizing a Qingbo Stockade cultural exhibition. Please visit if you can!

dialogText.cn: 给我个联络方式，我回去把博物馆的地址和门票发给你们。
dialogText.en: I wonder if there's a way to send you the museum address and tickets.

dialogText.cn: 好的，老板。我已经联络了长途客运站，我们马上就能踏上回菈梵朵玛的旅途了。
dialogText.en: Okay, boss. I've contacted the coach station. We'll soon be on the way back to La Fantoma.

dialogText.cn: 真好！我可太想念热水澡了。
dialogText.en: Wonderful! I really miss a hot water bath.

dialogText.cn: 对了老板，那个……我们<@qu.key>假扮天师</>的事情……
dialogText.en: Sure, boss. There's also this matter of us ... <@qu.key>disguised as Tianshi</>...

dialogText.cn: 玛蒂娜学者都告诉我们了。
dialogText.en: Yes. Miss Martina told us about that already.

dialogText.cn: 对……对不起，我们不是有意要骗你们的。
dialogText.en: I'm so sorry... We didn't mean to lie to you.

dialogText.cn: 怪盗假面，都这种时候了，就别再提那些个旧事了嘛。
dialogText.en: Masked Rogue, this isn't the best time to talk about embarrassing moments.

dialogText.cn: 放轻松皮奥特，大家一起冒险过，就已经是朋友啦。
dialogText.en: And relax, Piot. We're fellow explorers. That makes us friends.

dialogText.cn: 我们得走了，佩丽卡，怪盗假面，再次谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: I guess that's our cue. Thank you again, Perlica and Masked Rogue.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们！
dialogText.en: Thank you very much!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，玛蒂娜，皮奥特，再见。
dialogText.en: You're welcome, Miss Martina and Mr. Piot. Farewell.

dialogText.cn: 老板，你先吃完再说吧……
dialogText.en: Finish your meal, boss. We can talk later...

dialogText.cn: 似乎是几件破烂的衣服，上面的破洞明显是被什么从内向外刺穿的……
dialogText.en: A few tattered pieces of clothing. The rips and holes seem to have been made from the inside...

dialogText.cn: 施术者一定经历了非常残酷的战斗……
dialogText.en: The caster must have fought a terrible battle...

dialogText.cn: 这个施术者，会是贾班吗……
dialogText.en: Can this caster be Jia Ban...?

dialogText.cn: 这是……钩子的……
dialogText.en: This ... this is Rusty's...

dialogText.cn: 就在你们战斗的时候，我看到某个很眼熟的东西，就过去捡了起来。
dialogText.en: When you were fighting, I saw something familiar and went ahead to pick it up.

dialogText.cn: 这只能证明他来过这里。
dialogText.en: This only proved that he was here.

dialogText.cn: 铁锚子，有线索了就是好事，你哥说不定已经出城了。
dialogText.en: Boatswain, finding a clue is a good thing. Your brother probably already left the city.

dialogText.cn: 把弭弗姐的问题解决完，我们专心帮你找哥哥。
dialogText.en: Once we take care of Mi Fu's issue, we'll focus on finding him.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们！
dialogText.en: Thank you!

dialogText.cn: 我这边有结果了，确认第二具遗体就是<@qu.key>甄行远</>的……你们呢？
dialogText.en: I made some progress. We verified the second body as <@qu.key>Zhen Xingyuan</>... What about you?

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，我们这里发现了源石活性化痕迹……是施术单元失控导致的。
dialogText.en: Mi Fu, we found traces of Originium activation... An Arts Unit ran out of control.

dialogText.cn: 现场有施术单元的残骸，只是我们无法确定是不是<@qu.key>贾班</>留下的。
dialogText.en: We found what is left of the Arts Unit, but we're unsure if it belonged to <@qu.key>Jia Ban</>.

dialogText.cn: 我在附近，就来。
dialogText.en: I'm actually nearby. Heading over right now.

dialogText.cn: 这是……施术单元？
dialogText.en: Is this ... the Arts Unit?

dialogText.cn: 你们说，这是不是……钩子……钩子是不是……
dialogText.en: What do you say? Does this mean that ... Rusty... Is... Is Rusty...?

dialogText.cn: 没错，这确实是贾班的施术单元。
dialogText.en: Yes, this is indeed Jia Ban's Arts Unit.

dialogText.cn: 等等，这人谁啊？
dialogText.en: Wait. Who is this?

dialogText.cn: 哦对对对，我都忘了。这是铁锚子，弭弗姐你应该也见过，在清波寨。
dialogText.en: Oh, I almost forgot. This is Iron Boatswain. You two probably met before. At the Stockade.

dialogText.cn: 那对兄弟。你们另一个呢？
dialogText.en: The Stockader brothers. Where's the other one?

dialogText.cn: 我、我们俩走丢了，我正在找他。
dialogText.en: I, uh, we got separated. I'm trying to find him.

dialogText.cn: 他这样子，在武陵太不方便了，又到处是危险，我们就……
dialogText.en: He probably won't get far in Wuling, and since the place is dangerous, we ... sort of...

dialogText.cn: 嗯。现在城里对立的情绪很重，你们看好他吧。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Stockaders aren't popular in the city right now. Keep your eyes on this one.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你……
dialogText.en: Thanks...

dialogText.cn: 你确定？……他怎么样？有没有生命危险？……啧，怎么找到的？
dialogText.en: Hmm. You sure...? How is he? Any critical conditions...? Hmm... How did you find him?

dialogText.cn: 好，把目击者的信息给我，我现在就去……等一下，他穿巡卫服了没？
dialogText.en: Okay. Give me the witness's info. I'm heading over right now... Hold on. Is he wearing his watchguard uniform?

dialogText.cn: 行，我知道了，就这样。
dialogText.en: Okay. Got it. I'll be there.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>贾班</>，人找到了。
dialogText.en: We found <@qu.key>Jia Ban</>.

dialogText.cn: 他还活着？！
dialogText.en: He's still alive?!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，他在安思园附近，虽然昏迷不醒，但没有生命危险。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Somewhere near Serenity Garden. Unconscious, but not in critical condition.

dialogText.cn: 太好了！
dialogText.en: That's wonderful!
So...

dialogText.cn: 我知道。我特地问了，贾班被发现时，只穿着贴身的衬衣。
dialogText.en: I got the same question, so I asked. Jia Ban was only wearing his undergarments when they found him.

dialogText.cn: 啊？那我们检查的遗体，身上穿着的巡卫服是贾班的吗……
dialogText.en: Wha?! But the body we were investigating ... wasn't he wearing Jia Ban's watchguard uniform...?

dialogText.cn: 我现在就去安思园找目击者，问问情况。眼下她是唯一的线索了。
dialogText.en: I'm going to Serenity Garden and have a talk with the witness. She's our only lead.

dialogText.cn: 安思园……爷爷的功绩石就在那里……
dialogText.en: Serenity Garden... Gramp's merit stone is there too...

dialogText.cn: 唉……总之，这事就算完了吧，谢谢你们了。
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... I guess this is over. Thank you for your assistance.

dialogText.cn: 还有……城里巡卫的衣服……别告诉我你又逞英雄了，钩子。
dialogText.en: And ... that city watchguard's outfit... Rusty, don't tell me you were trying to be a tough guy again.

dialogText.cn: 唉，果然是这里……这儿的地下，其实是一处“医护舱”。
dialogText.en: Ugh, I guessed right... There's a "medical cabin" right underneath.

dialogText.cn: 医护舱？城区医疗点不是在……
dialogText.en: Medical cabin? But isn't the City Medical Clinic at...

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡，医护舱是委婉的说法……这里是……临时安放逝者的地方。
dialogText.en: Perlica, "medical cabin" is just a nice way to put it... It's actually ... a place for the deceased to rest a while.

dialogText.cn: 追悼会？
dialogText.en: Memorial service?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我听说，三天后，大家会在永垂壁下开一场追悼会，将牺牲者们的名字刻在壁面上，以作纪念。
dialogText.en: Yeah. I heard that a memorial service will be held at the Eternal Wall in three days. The names of those who bravely died will be engraved upon it for remembrance.

dialogText.cn: 我们之后应该也会正式收到邀请。
dialogText.en: We'll probably receive an official invite soon.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐向来把队内的巡卫当作亲人……巡卫这次的伤亡不少……她心里一定不好受吧……
dialogText.en: Mi Fu always treats her watchguards like family ... and many of them fell in battle... She's definitely feeling terrible right now...

dialogText.cn: 对了……你们听说追悼会的事了吗？
dialogText.en: So ... did you hear about the memorial service?
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 这次拜托你们了……
dialogText.en: I'm counting on you...

dialogText.cn: 我就不过去了。
dialogText.en: Gotta skip this for now.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐……
dialogText.en: Mi Fu...

dialogText.cn: 你们来了。
dialogText.en: You're here.

dialogText.cn: 你还好吗？
dialogText.en: Are you alright?

dialogText.cn: ……数完人头了。七个兄弟。七个……我希望，他们的牺牲能被人记住。
dialogText.en: ...I've made a headcount. Seven good men... Seven... I hope people will remember their sacrifices.

dialogText.cn: 他们会被视为英雄，武陵不会忘记他们。
dialogText.en: They shall be lauded as heroes. Wuling will not forget them.

dialogText.cn: 问题是……
dialogText.en: There's a problem...

dialogText.cn: 一共有七名巡卫在战后失踪，也确实找到了七具穿着巡卫服的遗体。
dialogText.en: Seven watchguards went missing during the battle, and we found seven bodies wearing our uniform.

dialogText.cn: 其中有四名逝者确认了身份，家属来道过别了。
dialogText.en: Four of the deceased have been identified. Their families bade them farewell.

dialogText.cn: 还有三名逝者无法分辨身份。
dialogText.en: But there are three deceased that we cannot identify.

dialogText.cn: 欸，怎么回事？
dialogText.en: Huh? What happened?

dialogText.cn: 他们……他们的遗体，被侵蚀毁坏了。
dialogText.en: Their bodies... They have been ruined by the Blight.

dialogText.cn: 安葬前，一旦去侵蚀处理完成，就彻底无法分辨逝者的身份了。
dialogText.en: Once we cleanse the bodies of Blight for burial, they will be completely unidentifiable.

dialogText.cn: 长时间保存受侵蚀影响的遗体很不妥当……这我也明白。
dialogText.en: Storing Blight-affected remains is not very appropriate ... I know that too.

dialogText.cn: 头儿为我争取了十二个小时，我还有一些时间。
dialogText.en: The boss got me a twelve-hour window. I still have some time.

dialogText.cn: 终末地，你们是应对侵蚀问题的专家，能拜托你们帮忙确定三位巡卫的身份吗？
dialogText.en: Endfielders, you're experts in handling Blight issues. Can I ask you to identify these three watchguards?

dialogText.cn: 这是我唯一能替他们做的事情了。
dialogText.en: This is the very least I can do for them.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，你放心，就交给我们吧！
dialogText.en: Don't worry, Mi Fu. We'll take care of this!

dialogText.cn: 好。我……我就不过去了。
dialogText.en: Thank you. I ... I need to be somewhere else.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我们的扫描技术能穿透侵蚀物质。
dialogText.en: Hmm... Our scanning tech can penetrate Blighted materials.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，有什么发现吗？
dialogText.en: Endmin, found anything yet?

dialogText.cn: 怎么样？
dialogText.en: How are we doing?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我比对了你传来的扫描数据，这个物质是息壤没错。
dialogText.en: Endmin, I used your scanning data and ran a comparative check. You're right, it's Xiranite.

dialogText.cn: 下肢存在息壤材料制成的人工构造，是息壤骨骼。
dialogText.en: There are artificial Xiranite parts in the lower limbs. It's Xiranite bone.

dialogText.cn: 唔，这是很重要的信息。
dialogText.en: Hmm. That's a really important discovery.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 遗体已经……彻底侵蚀物质化了吗？
dialogText.en: Is the body ... completely Blightified?

dialogText.cn: 出结果了，我看看。
dialogText.en: The results are out. Let me see.

dialogText.cn: 这个我能看明白，是源石！
dialogText.en: I know this one. It's Originium!

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐一向很关心大家的健康状况，她应该能识别出这个信息。
dialogText.en: Mi Fu keeps really close tabs on everyone's health. This will help her identify the brave soul.

dialogText.cn: 腿部的息壤骨骼……老李……
dialogText.en: A leg with Xiranite bone... It's Old Li...

dialogText.cn: 老李？是那个会弹腿的老李？
dialogText.en: Old Li? The one who couldn't keep his legs still?

dialogText.cn: 没办法，为了保住他的命，只能放弃这条腿……
dialogText.en: He had no choice. To stay alive, he had to give it up...

dialogText.cn: 他岁数也不小了，按他的情况，完全可以提前退休。
dialogText.en: He wasn't young anymore. Old Li could have retired early.

dialogText.cn: 可这家伙倔得很，非说什么站完最后一班岗，连头儿去劝都没用。
dialogText.en: But the stubborn old fool refused to leave his post. Even the boss couldn't talk him out of it.

dialogText.cn: 不仅如此，他还说动头儿，批准他安了息壤假肢，这老家伙……
dialogText.en: Not only that. The silly old dolt even convinced the boss to give him a Xiranite leg...

dialogText.cn: 老李一定是舍不得大伙，想在武陵多待几年。
dialogText.en: Old Li probably didn't want to leave the crew. He wanted to stay in Wuling for a bit longer.

dialogText.cn: 嗯。老李这边有眉目了，还有其他线索吗？
dialogText.en: Indeed. Now we have Old Li, what about the other two?

dialogText.cn: 彻底的侵蚀物质化……
dialogText.en: Completely Blightified...

dialogText.cn: 明白了，我会优先对他进行去侵蚀处理，他的身份只能通过排除法来确认了。
dialogText.en: Understood. I'll prioritize his Blight cleanse. The process of elimination is our only option to confirm his identity.

dialogText.cn: 先让他安息吧。
dialogText.en: Let him rest for now.

dialogText.cn: 你说这具遗体，生前是矿石病患者？
dialogText.en: You mentioned this one was Oripathy-positive?

dialogText.cn: 不可能。武陵每一位巡卫今年的体检报告我都看过，没有人感染矿石病。
dialogText.en: Impossible. I read through all of the watchguards' health examination reports. None of us have Oripathy.

dialogText.cn: 管理员对于源石物质的判断是不会出错的，会不会是近期感染的？
dialogText.en: It's unlikely for our Endmin to make mistakes about Originium matter. Perhaps the infection was recent.

dialogText.cn: 不排除这个可能。但我觉得，哪里不对。
dialogText.en: That is a possibility. But something doesn't feel right about this.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，案子办多了，碰到有些事在心里过不去，就得查查。
dialogText.en: Yeah. Got through plenty of cases. Things warrant a closer look whenever I get these feelings.

dialogText.cn: 还有其他线索吗？
dialogText.en: Have you found other leads?

dialogText.cn: 老李确认了，尚未确认身份的还有<@qu.key>贾班</>和<@qu.key>甄行远</>，他俩都不是矿石病患者。
dialogText.en: We found Old Li. Now we gotta verify <@qu.key>Jia Ban</> and <@qu.key>Zhen Xingyuan</>. Both are Oripathy-negatives.

dialogText.cn: 那具矿石病患者的遗体，如果不是巡卫的话……啧。
dialogText.en: If that poor Oripathy-positive is not a watchguard... Hur...

dialogText.cn: 我想优先排除这条可能。
dialogText.en: I want to focus on this variable first.

dialogText.cn: 可是，如果不是巡卫，又能是谁呢？
dialogText.en: Not a watchguard? But who else could he be?

dialogText.cn: 现在，还有少量武陵群众处在失踪状态，也许是巡卫把制服穿到了平民身上。
dialogText.en: As of now, some Wulingers are still missing. Perhaps he was one of those civilians, and a watchguard gave him their uniform.

dialogText.cn: 毕竟巡卫服的防护性要比一般的衣服好上很多。
dialogText.en: After all, watchguard outfits offer better protection than ordinary clothing.

dialogText.cn: 这份造影图很清楚……
dialogText.en: This image is very obvious...

dialogText.cn: 对了，武陵的矿石病患者并不多。去医疗点比对一下病例，应该很快就能查清楚。
dialogText.en: There aren't that many cases of Oripathy in Wuling. A simple check at the Medical Clinic should clear things up.

dialogText.cn: 能麻烦你们吗？
dialogText.en: Can you help me with that?

dialogText.cn: 我去联系老李的亲属。
dialogText.en: I need to talk to Old Li's family.

dialogText.cn: 好，医疗点那边就交给我们吧。
dialogText.en: Of course. We'll visit the Medical Clinic.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，调查结果如何？
dialogText.en: Endmin, how goes the investigation?

dialogText.cn: 他是个好人……汛期出外勤的时候，他为了救人，右腿沾染了侵蚀。
dialogText.en: And a good man... He saved someone during a Blight Tide and ended up Blighting his right leg.

dialogText.cn: 是你的直觉吗？
dialogText.en: You sense that something's off?

dialogText.cn: 你们好，我是这个科室的护士。有什么能帮忙的吗？
dialogText.en: Hi there. I'm the nurse for this department. Anything I can help you with?

dialogText.cn: 我们是终末地的，来帮弭弗姐……弭弗队长查件事。
dialogText.en: We're Endfielders helping out Mi ... I mean, Captain Mi. We need to check something.

dialogText.cn: 我想起来了！我在报道中见过，你们是拯救了武陵的英雄！
dialogText.en: Oh! I read about you in the news! You're the heroes who saved Wuling!

dialogText.cn: 英雄吗……也许只是足够幸运地活了下来。
