dialogText.en: Heroes...? Maybe we're just lucky and survived.

dialogText.cn: 唉，我们这一屋子的病患伤员，不都是么。
dialogText.en: Yeah, but I could say the same for all the injured people in this ward.

dialogText.cn: 我们想确认这名矿石病患者的身份。
dialogText.en: {F}Can you verify the identity of this Oripathy-positive?{M}Can you verify the identity of this Oripathy-positive?

dialogText.cn: 这是……如此清楚的造影图，比我们医疗点的还要……
dialogText.en: It's ... look at the resolution of this image. It's even better than what we...

dialogText.cn: 行，这事交给我吧，稍等片刻。
dialogText.en: Sure. Just wait for a bit while I search for it.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我们比对了所有矿石病患者的档案，并没有与之符合的患者。
dialogText.en: Endmin, we compared this with every Oripathy-positive we have on file. No one fits this image.

dialogText.cn: 可能性不大……我甚至将数据库扩大到了整个宏科院，还是没有查到。
dialogText.en: That's not possible... I even searched the HAS database. Sorry, we found no hits.

dialogText.cn: 所有宏山人从出生开始都会登记医疗档案吧？
dialogText.en: Everyone in Hongshan has a healthcare registration file since birth, right?

dialogText.cn: 没错，只要是登记在案的宏山人，每年都会根据体检结果更新档案。
dialogText.en: That's right. And all registered individuals get a file update based on their annual health examination reports.

dialogText.cn: 看来是另一种可能，他的矿石病是近期感染上的。
dialogText.en: The alternative seems likely. He might have been recently infected.

dialogText.cn: 是弭弗找你们来的吧？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu sent you here, didn't she?

dialogText.cn: 帮我带个话，让她别像个铁人一样顶着，忙完记得来我这儿做个检查。
dialogText.en: Please relay a message for me. She must take a break and rest, and get her health examination at the clinic.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐！
dialogText.en: Mi Fu!

dialogText.cn: 老李那边我去过了。你们有新消息吗？
dialogText.en: I visited Old Li. Found anything new for the investigation?

dialogText.cn: 啧，难道也不是武陵人，而是……不对，不太对。
dialogText.en: Tsk. Perhaps he's not a Wulinger but... Wait. This isn't right.

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐，你自言自语啥呢？
dialogText.en: Mi Fu, what are you mumbling about?

dialogText.cn: 没事，看来得去调查另一个可能性了。
dialogText.en: Nothing. We need to look into the other possibility.

dialogText.cn: 我对手底下的人知根知底，谁要是感染矿石病，这事儿不可能没动静。
dialogText.en: I know all of my watchguards. I would know if anyone catches Oripathy.

dialogText.cn: 所以，可能就是在最后一次行动中感染上的。
dialogText.en: This means that he might be infected during the last operation.

dialogText.cn: 那我们应该去他俩最后的执勤点，看看能不能发现什么。
dialogText.en: Where was their final shift? We should go there and see if we can find anything.

dialogText.cn: 分头行动吧。我去<@qu.key>甄行远</>的执勤点，那里比较偏僻，你们不好找。
dialogText.en: We should divide our forces. I'll search <@qu.key>Zhen Xingyuan</>'s post. It's remote and hard to find.

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>贾班</>的执勤点就在巡卫地图上，你们会看吗？
dialogText.en: The watchguard map should have <@qu.key>Jia Ban</>'s post. Do you know how to read it?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我和陈带着管理员过去。
dialogText.en: We do. Chen and I will head over there with our Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 好，有什么结果再联系。
dialogText.en: Good. Contact me if you make any progress.

dialogText.cn: 等等，弭弗姐，崔大夫让我……
dialogText.en: Wait. Mi Fu, Physician Cui asked me to...

dialogText.cn: 她又要我去她那儿体检？不去，少来。人不检就没事儿。
dialogText.en: She wants me to get a checkup? No. Never. No checkups, no problems found.

dialogText.cn: 就是这里了，管理员。
dialogText.en: This is it, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 不过，你有没有发现……
dialogText.en: But hey, did you happen to notice...

dialogText.cn: 别、别动手！我只是跟你们正好同路而已！
dialogText.en: NO! STOP! I'm just going the same way, that's all!

dialogText.cn: 铁锚子……是你？你们不是应该已经离开武陵了吗？
dialogText.en: Iron Boatswain...? Why are you here? I thought you left Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 唉……别提了……我找不着钩子了。
dialogText.en: Ugh ... don't mention it... I can't find my bro Rusty.

dialogText.cn: 上回和你们分开之后，我俩本来确实是要离开武陵。
dialogText.en: After we got away from you, Rusty and I planned to leave Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 可是，我们撞上了水花子，还是那种块头很大的类型。
dialogText.en: But we ran into a bunch of splatters. Extra-extra-large ones too, mind you.

dialogText.cn: 钩子为了保护我，自己一个人引开了它们。
dialogText.en: Rusty tried to protect me and distracted them on his own.

dialogText.cn: 然后呢？
dialogText.en: What happened next?

dialogText.cn: 他临走前扔下一句话，让我去桃花坞找他。
dialogText.en: I dunno. He told me to look for him at Peach Blossom Wharf before he ran off.

dialogText.cn: 总之，我在桃花坞等了很久，可他一直没出现。我哥……他……唉，我心里急死了。
dialogText.en: Anyways, I waited for ages but Rusty never showed up. What happened to my bro...? Ugh. I'm super worried right now.

dialogText.cn: 我只知道，他是朝着城门的方向离开的。结果一路找了过来，什么也没找到。
dialogText.en: I knew he scampered off towards the city. I made my way here but found nothing.

dialogText.cn: 欸……可、可以吗？
dialogText.en: Oh... Wha? Really? I can?

dialogText.cn: 武陵城遭遇了这样的事，你作为清波寨寨民在这附近行动肯定不方便。
dialogText.en: Wuling just went through a lot. A Stockader wouldn't have an easy time near the city.

dialogText.cn: 更何况，现在还有很多残留的侵蚀和天使，你一个人实在是太危险了。
dialogText.en: And there's tons of residual Blight and Aggeloi around. It's safer in a group, right?

dialogText.cn: 可是，你们不也有要调查的事情吗？会不会耽误你们……
dialogText.en: But I thought you got some important investigations going on. Would I get in your ways...?

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们！我又欠了你们一个大人情——我会让钩子加倍报答你们的。
dialogText.en: Oh, thank you very much! I owe you bigshots a big time. AGAIN! I'll tell Rusty to pay you back double.

dialogText.cn: 你对你哥还真是不客气啊。
dialogText.en: You're really nice to your bro, you know that?

dialogText.cn: 他就爱逞英雄……上次，你们也瞧见了。
dialogText.en: Well, he likes being a hero... You saw that before, right?

dialogText.cn: 有人鬼鬼祟祟地跟了我们一路！
dialogText.en: ...some dirty sneak following us in secret!

dialogText.cn: 哦，是个代号啦，只有我跟钩子知道。
dialogText.en: Oh, it's a codename that only the two of us know.

dialogText.cn: 对了……你们来这儿，是查什么？
dialogText.en: Oh yeah... What exactly are you investigating around here?

dialogText.cn: 唉，我们当时遇到的就是这种东西。
dialogText.en: Ugh. We ran into these same things as well.

dialogText.cn: 这种天使很危险啊，锈钩子真有能耐……
dialogText.en: These Aggeloi are dangerous. Rusty Hook has some serious skills...

dialogText.cn: 能耐？他那是找死！
dialogText.en: Serious skills? The dude has a death wish!

dialogText.cn: 他就爱逞强，总是吹嘘着自己在外面的各种冒险，干掉的水花子都连成线了。
dialogText.en: He's always acting like a boss, bragging about his crazy adventures and the gazillion Splatters he squished.

dialogText.cn: 可每次让他带上我，就总说我是拖油瓶，没法兼顾到我。
dialogText.en: Whenever I was around, he kept yapping about me being a useless dead weight slowing him down.

dialogText.cn: 只会自己硬撑……这回出事了吧！
dialogText.en: He's always trying to be tough ... but things got too rough this time!

dialogText.cn: 别急，我们会帮助你的。
dialogText.en: Don't worry. We'll help you.

dialogText.cn: 对，没事儿，他肯定好端端地在桃花坞等着你呢！
dialogText.en: Things will be alright. He's probably waiting for you at the Peach Blossom Wharf!

dialogText.cn: 啊……弭队长？你们是来问当时的情况？
dialogText.en: Ah... Captain Mi? Are you here to talk about the situation?

dialogText.cn: 我叫菱月，平时都会在这里卖花。当时，我远远看见一个人影，有些踉跄。
dialogText.en: I'm Ling Yue and I usually sell flowers here. I saw someone stumbling into the garden.

dialogText.cn: 战事刚刚平息，我不确定他的身份，就躲了起来。
dialogText.en: It was shortly after the battle. I hid because I didn't know who the man was.

dialogText.cn: 等他走近，我看他伤得很重，似乎在这里寻找什么，就过去问他……
dialogText.en: He got closer and I saw he was really hurt. He seemed to be looking for something, so I asked...

dialogText.cn: 等等，他当时穿着什么衣服？
dialogText.en: Wait. What was this man wearing?

dialogText.cn: 就一件很普通的衬衣，上面有很多污痕。
dialogText.en: Just his undergarments. And they were really dirty.

dialogText.cn: 我想想……他似乎抱着什么东西，像是衣服之类的。
dialogText.en: Let me think... He was holding something, like a bundle of clothes.

dialogText.cn: 衣服？什么样的？
dialogText.en: Clothes? What kind?

dialogText.cn: 不知道，他抱得很紧，看不出来。我问他是不是在找东西……
dialogText.en: I don't know. I couldn't see clearly because he was holding it real right. I asked if he was looking for something...

dialogText.cn: 他很虚弱，问我姜天师的功绩石在哪里。
dialogText.en: He was very weak, but he asked me where Tianshi Jiang's merit stone is.

dialogText.cn: 姜天师！
dialogText.en: Tianshi Jiang!

dialogText.cn: 我只是在这里卖花，并不知道姜天师的功绩石在哪儿……
dialogText.en: But I only sell flowers here. I didn't know where they placed Tianshi Jiang's merit stone...

dialogText.cn: 他很着急，迟疑了会儿，便进入安思园了。
dialogText.en: He hesitated a bit, but he also looked really worried and went right into Serenity Garden.

dialogText.cn: 过了没多久，他踉踉跄跄地回来了，怀里抱着的东西也不见了。
dialogText.en: And then he stumbled out shortly afterwards. The bundle in his arms was gone as well.

dialogText.cn: 我正想过去扶住他，他就栽倒在地。
dialogText.en: I was thinking about helping him when he suddenly fell to the ground.

dialogText.cn: 我吓坏了，就联系了巡卫，他们让我在原地等待。
dialogText.en: It scared me, so I called the watchguards and they told me to wait here.

dialogText.cn: 好，前因后果我明白了。去休息吧，谢谢你的合作。
dialogText.en: Good. I think I know what happened. Rest easy now. Thank you for your cooperation.

dialogText.cn: 等我们找到他怀里抱着的那个东西，也许就能破案了。
dialogText.en: We should find the bundle he was carrying. That should crack our case.

dialogText.cn: 跟、跟我来吧。
dialogText.en: Uh, just... follow me.

dialogText.cn: 姜天师，是我爷爷啊……
dialogText.en: Yeah, Tianshi Jiang! He's my grampa...

dialogText.cn: 贾班认识你爷爷吗？
dialogText.en: Does Jia Ban know your grampa?

dialogText.cn: 我不清楚……他为什么要去我爷爷的功绩石？
dialogText.en: I don't know... Why is he looking for my grampa's merit stone?

dialogText.cn: 你爷爷的功绩石在哪里？
dialogText.en: Where is your grampa's merit stone?

dialogText.cn: 爷爷……就在这里了。
dialogText.en: Here's Grampa... This is where he rests.

dialogText.cn: 这里……只有花。
dialogText.en: There's only ... flowers at this place.

dialogText.cn: 啧……不应该啊。
dialogText.en: Tsk... Something's not right.

dialogText.cn: 是吗？扫描瞧瞧是什么东西……
dialogText.en: Really? Maybe we should give it a scan...

dialogText.cn: 不……不可能……不可能啊！我们说好在桃花坞见面的……
dialogText.en: No... This can't be... IMPOSSIBLE! We promised to meet up at Peach Blossom Wharf...

dialogText.cn: 爷爷，是我们兄弟俩不孝！
dialogText.en: Grampa, we're really the worst kids ever!

dialogText.cn: 先让他冷静一会儿吧。
dialogText.en: We should give him a moment.

dialogText.cn: 我们书书读不进，字字写不好，一气之下落了草，肯定把您的心都伤透了。
dialogText.en: We failed at school and everything. We then ran off and became bandits. We're the worst letdowns ever.

dialogText.cn: 在寨里那几年，我最怕听见人说，姜老爷子是被自己的孙儿气死的……
dialogText.en: Back at the Stockade, I was afraid to hear people talk about Old Jiang and his super disappointing grandkids...

dialogText.cn: 越怕越不敢回，越不敢回越怕，一直不敢来见您。
dialogText.en: We were afraid to see you. We were terrified. We couldn't even bring ourselves back here.

dialogText.cn: 爷爷，阿构他一直跟我说，他心里还是想当天师的。
dialogText.en: Grampa, Ah Gou told me that he still wants to be a Tianshi.

dialogText.cn: 我不敢说我也想！我怕说了……对不起您，也对不起这么多年我们……蹉跎的时间……
dialogText.en: I want to say it too! But ... I've been such a disappointment to you ... to ourselves ... to all these years we've wasted...

dialogText.cn: 所以我们想着，干脆就和这些清波债统统了断，逃到新天地，重新开始……
dialogText.en: That's why we decided to quit the Stockade. Run off to a new place and start over...

dialogText.cn: 我们马上就要重新开始了呀，爷爷。爷爷，您能不能……
dialogText.en: We were really trying to start over, Grampa! Just ... I beg you...

dialogText.cn: ……保佑阿构他好好地回来？
dialogText.en: ...protect Ah Gou and help him return safely?

dialogText.cn: 这是……钩子的……
dialogText.en: This ... this is Rusty's...

dialogText.cn: 铁锚子……你别心急……只是一件衣服而已！
dialogText.en: Calm down, Boatswain... It's alright... It's just some clothing!

dialogText.cn: 你们调查的那具遗体，左胸有源石结晶……对吧？
dialogText.en: The body you're investigating... It's got an Originium Crystal on the left chest... right?

dialogText.cn: 和他的情况一模一样。
dialogText.en: That's what he had.

dialogText.cn: 山洞里的眼罩也是他的……
dialogText.en: The eye patch in the cave is also his...

dialogText.cn: 好歹，在头儿争取的时间内解决了。谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: We got it settled within the time given by the boss. Couldn't have done it without you.

dialogText.cn: 节哀弭弗姐，终于能安心送他们走了。
dialogText.en: My condolences, Mi Fu. We can finally send them on their way.

dialogText.cn: ……为什么他们要互相换衣服？
dialogText.en: ...But why did they change their clothes?

dialogText.cn: 你在想什么？
dialogText.en: What are you thinking about?

dialogText.cn: 源石装置……对哦，可后来挖出来的是一件衣服？
dialogText.en: Originium device... Yeah, but we dug out some clothing instead.

dialogText.cn: 是我……什么？
dialogText.en: It's me... Say what?

dialogText.cn: 好，我马上到。
dialogText.en: Sure. Heading right over.

dialogText.cn: 怎么了弭弗姐？
dialogText.en: What is it, Mi Fu?

dialogText.cn: 贾班醒了，我现在去医疗点。一起来？
dialogText.en: Jia Ban is awake. I'm heading to the Medical Clinic. You coming?

dialogText.cn: 我想不通。
dialogText.en: I can't figure it out.

dialogText.cn: 我们还漏了什么细节……？
dialogText.en: Did we actually miss something...?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡，你们先去，我去看看铁锚子怎么样了。
dialogText.en: Go ahead, Endmin and Perlica. I'm staying behind to check how Boatswain is doing.

dialogText.cn: 我看到他身后有一群天使在追，没多想就出手了。可是天使数量太多，我一下就陷入了苦战。
dialogText.en: I saw a pack of Aggeloi chasing him and did not hesitate. But there were too many of them and things got a little hot.

dialogText.cn: 那个兄弟，我不知道他的名字……
dialogText.en: I didn't even know the name of the poor guy...

dialogText.cn: 我记得的最后一件事，就是他在解我的衣服。
dialogText.en: The last thing I remember was him taking off my outfit.

dialogText.cn: 他叫姜正构。
dialogText.en: He is Jiang Zhenggou.

dialogText.cn: 我救下他之后，才发现他是个寨民。好寨民，坏寨民，那时候根本分不清！
dialogText.en: I only realized later that I saved a Stockader. Sometimes it's hard to tell the bandits apart from the good ones.

dialogText.cn: 但不管怎么样，他当时已经到了安全的地方。我以为他要走，结果……他回来帮我了。
dialogText.en: Regardless, the guy managed to reach a safe place. I thought he'd run for it, but ... he came back to help me.

dialogText.cn: 我身上的血，都不知道是从哪个窟窿流的。他也没好到哪儿去。
dialogText.en: I was bleeding all over the place, couldn't even tell where my wound was. He wasn't doing any better.

dialogText.cn: 我倒在地上，他一直摇我，让我别睡，说是叛逃的寨民要来了。
dialogText.en: I collapsed to the ground and he kept shaking me to keep me awake. Told me that the Stockade turncoats were coming.

dialogText.cn: 叛逃的寨民……
dialogText.en: Stockade turncoats...

dialogText.cn: 他为什么要……算了，我知道了。
dialogText.en: Why did he...? It's okay. I figured it out.

dialogText.cn: 那群叛逃的寨民见到武陵的人就要下死手。你捡回了条命。
dialogText.en: The Stockade turncoats were killing every Wulinger they see. The guy saved you.

dialogText.cn: 是他救了我。
dialogText.en: He saved me.

dialogText.cn: 也许是我昏倒后的幻觉，他临走前把我的巡卫服穿在了身上，还笑了。
dialogText.en: Perhaps I was seeing things before I passed out. He wore my watchguard uniform and smiled before he left.

dialogText.cn: “安思园，姜天师，功绩石”，他一直在我耳边喊这几个词……
dialogText.en: "Serenity Garden, Tianshi Jiang, merit stone"... He kept shouting these words over and over in my ears...

dialogText.cn: 噢，原来你醒来的时候，嘴里说的是这几个字。我听了半天没听明白……
dialogText.en: Oh. That's why you were mumbling these words when you were out. I was so confused...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，“安思园，姜天师，功绩石”，这几个词在我脑海里一直重复。
dialogText.en: Yeah. "Serenity Garden, Tianshi Jiang, merit stone"... These words kept appearing in my mind.

dialogText.cn: 我醒来以后还在山洞里，他已经不见了。城里的仗，似乎也打完了。
dialogText.en: I was still in the cave when I woke up, but the guy was already gone. The battle in the city seemed to be over.

dialogText.cn: 在安思园，我找到了刻有“姜”字的功绩石，把他的衣服留在了那里。
dialogText.en: And in the Garden I found the merit stone with Jiang's name inscribed upon it, and left his clothes there.

dialogText.cn: 我用尽了全身的力气，然后……醒来就在医疗点里了。
dialogText.en: It took the last bits of my strength. When I opened my eyes again ... I was in the Medical Clinic.

dialogText.cn: 姜正构……他还活着吗？
dialogText.en: So this Jiang Zhenggou ... is he still alive?

dialogText.cn: 啊。
各位的问题，得到解答了吗？探视时间要结束了，伤员还需要休息。
dialogText.en: I hope you have your answers. Visiting hours are almost over. Please let the patient rest.

dialogText.cn: 你养伤吧。我们先出去了。
dialogText.en: Look after yourself. We're leaving for now.

dialogText.cn: 我的脑袋昏昏沉沉的，跟着脑海里的几个词就往安思园去了。
dialogText.en: I felt incredibly dizzy. I used the words to guide me and made my way to Serenity Garden.

dialogText.cn: 我们仔细搜了一遍锈钩子的衣服，找到了这个。
dialogText.en: We carefully searched Rusty Hook's clothing and found this.

dialogText.cn: 我们扫描到的源石痕迹，应该就是这个了……铁锚子，你介意吗？
dialogText.en: It probably gave off the traces of Originium in our scans... Would you mind, Boatswain?

dialogText.cn: 你们放吧……我可以再听一遍。
dialogText.en: Just play it ... I won't mind listening again.

dialogText.cn: 阿茂，我相信你没在桃花坞找到我的话，一定会找到爷爷这儿。
dialogText.en: Ah Mao, I know you'd go and find Grampa if I didn't show up at Peach Blossom Wharf.

dialogText.cn: 老杀手临终前给徒弟录的录音带。
dialogText.en: The Old Slayer also gave his disciple an audio tape.

dialogText.cn: 嗨，锚儿哥，当你听到这段录音，我已经不在人世了。
dialogText.en: Hah, Boatswain my man. By the time you hear this, I'll no longer be around.

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿，像不像？
dialogText.en: Heh. That's great acting, right?

dialogText.cn: 我接下来说的话，你听好。
dialogText.en: Listen well to the words I'm about to say.

dialogText.cn: 我呢，要踏上自己的旅途了。
dialogText.en: I ... am about to start my own journey.

dialogText.cn: 先跟你道个歉，我跟你说的外面的世界，都是骗你的。
dialogText.en: Gotta apologize to you. I told you nothing but lies about the world outside.

dialogText.cn: 那是爷爷的冒险，我只是个添油加醋的转述者。
dialogText.en: Those were Grampa's adventures. I just spiced things up and told them again.

dialogText.cn: 而现在，我想自己去闯一闯，这样以后才能带上你这个拖油瓶。
dialogText.en: Now I gotta get myself a decent head start. And then I'll come over and pick you up, dead weight.

dialogText.cn: 不过，桃花坞、雨花田，这些都是真的。
dialogText.en: But the Peach Blossom Wharf and Yuhua Field are real.

dialogText.cn: 想我了，就去这些地方看看吧。
dialogText.en: If you ever miss me, just visit these places.

dialogText.cn: 要是不想我，就等着吃我的弹脑壳吧。
dialogText.en: If you don't miss me, I'll give you a flick on the head.

dialogText.cn: 不啰嗦了，回见……
dialogText.en: 'Nuff said. See you around...

dialogText.cn: 混蛋，混蛋，混蛋！到最后都在骗我……
dialogText.en: Blasted blighted bastard! That old dolt kept lying till the very end...

dialogText.cn: 他以为穿着巡卫的衣服，拿着巡卫的武器，就算是巡卫了？！
dialogText.en: He thought he could be a watchguard by wearing their outfit and swinging their slapstick!

dialogText.cn: 他以为他是什么大侠，是什么大英雄吗？！
dialogText.en: Who does he think he is? A master warrior? Some kind of a hero?!

dialogText.cn: 英雄才不是这个样子的！！
dialogText.en: Heroes... Heroes don't end up like this!!

dialogText.cn: 呼。
dialogText.en: Phoo.

dialogText.cn: 弭队……至少……我们还原了真相。
dialogText.en: Captain Mi ... we found the truth ... at least.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，可我……
dialogText.en: Yes, but I...

dialogText.cn: 真相确实被还原了，但却是我不想面对的那种。
dialogText.en: We have the truth, but it's not one I am ready to accept.

dialogText.cn: 不知道我们能为铁锚子做点什么……他现在，太伤心了。
dialogText.en: I wonder what we can do for Boatswain... He's totally devastated right now.

dialogText.cn: 做点什么……能做什么呢？永垂壁下的追悼会，明天就要开了。
dialogText.en: Do what...? What can we really do? The Eternal Wall memorial service starts tomorrow.

dialogText.cn: 永垂壁……嗯，我知道了。
dialogText.en: The Eternal Wall... Hmm. I know.

dialogText.cn: 还记得我们翻墙到那个老天师院子里，隔着窗看的电影吗？
dialogText.en: Remember when we sneaked into that Old Tianshi's courtyard? We watched a movie through the window.

dialogText.cn: 各位恩人，你们来啦！我想把阿构的名字，也刻在这上面。
dialogText.en: You've arrived, everyone! I'm thinking about carving Ah Gou's name on this.

dialogText.cn: 这个石壁，似乎需要动用特殊的工具，才能在上面留下痕迹。铁锚子，我们可以代你向弭队申请正式的——
dialogText.en: A special tool may be needed to engrave a name on the stone face. Boatswain, we can submit an official application to Captain Mi on your —

dialogText.cn: 不不，那可别！
dialogText.en: No! No way! Please don't!

dialogText.cn: 他们武陵……我们……我们现在是寨民，没法相提并论的。唉，这件事，真的很复杂。
dialogText.en: They're Wulingers ... and we're ... we're Stockaders. We're different. This whole thing is just a mess.

dialogText.cn: ……嗯，我能理解。
dialogText.en: ...Yes. I understand.

dialogText.cn: 我其实还指望你们，能用什么终末地的神通帮帮我呢……
dialogText.en: I actually wonder if you can, uh, use those fancy Endfield tech and help me out...

dialogText.cn: 铁锚子，你哥哥本名是不是叫——
dialogText.en: Boatswain, your brother's actual name —

dialogText.cn: 叫正构，姜正构，我们是正字辈的。恩人，您找到刻字的办法了？
dialogText.en: Zhenggou. Jiang Zhenggou. Zheng is our generation name. So you found a way to engrave his name?

dialogText.cn: 咦？这儿，不是已经刻了你哥哥的名字了吗？
dialogText.en: Oh? Look here, your brother's name is already on the wall.

dialogText.cn: 这……啊？！我看看。没错，这是他的名字！是重名吗？
dialogText.en: Wha...? Really?! Lemme see. By Talos, that is his name! Is there another Wulinger with the same name?

dialogText.cn: 不对啊，后面还专门刻上了“锈钩子”……
dialogText.en: Now that's weird. Because "Rusty Hook" is engraved right after it...

dialogText.cn: ……这是谁刻上去的？什么时候的事？！
dialogText.en: ...Who did this?! When did it happen?!

dialogText.cn: 看痕迹还很新。管理员，你有什么想法吗？
dialogText.en: It looks newly inscribed. Endmin, any ideas?

dialogText.cn: 原来是她啊……
dialogText.en: Oh, it must be her...

dialogText.cn: 弭弗姐真的很讲义气呢。待会儿仪式上见到她，你可以好好谢谢她了。
dialogText.en: Mi Fu is truly a righteous soul. You gotta thank her properly if you see her during the service.

dialogText.cn: 你们是说，是巡卫的那个头头把我哥的名字刻上去的？
dialogText.en: Are you saying that madam captain of the watchguards carved my brother's name on this wall?

dialogText.cn: 那、那他也能……被大伙纪念了吗？
dialogText.en: Does that mean ... people are gonna remember him too?

dialogText.cn: 对，他和武陵的英雄们刻在了一起，他将会被更多的人铭记。
dialogText.en: Yes. He has been inscribed with the heroes of Wuling. He shall be remembered by many.

dialogText.cn: 哥，这下，你真的是英雄啦……
dialogText.en: Rusty, you made it. You're a true hero now...

dialogText.cn: 我听说，所有牺牲者的名字都会被刻到永垂壁上……
dialogText.en: People said that everyone who fell for the city will get their names carved on Eternal Wall...

dialogText.cn: 这里埋葬的，都是过去为了武陵献出生命的人。
dialogText.en: Every soul who rests here gave their life for Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 他们躺在这里，就说明，他们心里有比命更重要的东西——
dialogText.en: The fact that they rest here proves there is something they held dearer than their own lives —

dialogText.cn: 义气，职责，道德。死亡并没有打败他们。
dialogText.en: Honor, duty, and virtue. Death has not defeated them.

dialogText.cn: 他们都是胜利者。
dialogText.en: In fact, they have emerged triumphant.

dialogText.cn: 向这群胜利者，致以哀悼。
dialogText.en: Let us pay our respects to the deserving victors.

dialogText.cn: 陈大侠……你太为难我了……
dialogText.en: Master Chen ... you're pushing me too hard...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你怎么来啦！铁锚子马上就要成为见习巡卫了，我帮他拉体能呢！
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here?! Boatswain is gonna be a trainee watchguard. I'm giving him stamina training!

dialogText.cn: 陈大侠要我跟着她在馆内折返跑，跑到有人出现为止……
dialogText.en: Master Chen wants me to keep running laps until someone shows up...

dialogText.cn: 我……从来没有这么期待见到人！
dialogText.en: And ... thank Talos you finally showed up!

dialogText.cn: 这才哪儿到哪儿？巡卫的常规训练，比这可难多了。你在我手里都过不了关，弭弗姐那儿更是——
dialogText.en: This isn't over, dude! Standard watchguard PT is gonna be tougher. If you think my training is hard, Capitan Mi's gonna —

dialogText.cn: 哦哦，对呀，我来的路上就瞧见了。
dialogText.en: Oh, right. I saw it along the way.

dialogText.cn: 原来是队长又麻烦您来修桩子了。瞧瞧咱们，人还是这群人，事却完全不一样了。
dialogText.en: So the Captain needs you for pillar-fixing again? Welp, we got the same crew but things are different now.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，还有陈大侠！你们完事儿啦？
dialogText.en: Endmin! And Master Chen! You're done already?

dialogText.cn: 我、我想告诉你们一个好消息。我下周当上见习巡卫以后，准备申请来这片地方执勤！
dialogText.en: I, uh, I got some great news! Once I become a trainee watchguard next week, I'm gonna apply to this post and perform my duties here!

dialogText.cn: 可不是嘛，首墩这片地方很不稳定，经常出状况呢，队长老不情愿让我来这里……
dialogText.en: Exactly. The Marker Stone has always been unstable and troublesome. The Captain really didn't want me on this post...

dialogText.cn: 但我想陪陪爷爷，也陪陪阿构，让他们常常看着我。
dialogText.en: But I wanna keep Grampa and Ah Gou company, and give them a chance to watch over me.

dialogText.cn: 咱们其实还有明天！
dialogText.en: There's always tomorrow to look forward to!

dialogText.cn: 铁锚子，你看起来已经走出来了。
dialogText.en: You really got your stuff sorted out, Boatswain.

dialogText.cn: 家里出了两个大英雄，我也不能输这口气呀！
dialogText.en: I got two heroes in the family. Can't let myself be a disappointment, right?

dialogText.cn: 对了，我当上巡卫这事儿，也多亏了你们的帮助。
dialogText.en: Before I forget, I only became a watchguard thanks to your help.

dialogText.cn: 以后有问题，你们尽管找我，虽然我是个见习的，但我能做的事也不少！
dialogText.en: Come talk to me if you need anything. I may be a trainee, but I'm a very capable trainee!

dialogText.cn: 好说！我已经看到了，明亮又美好的生活，就在我们眼前了！
dialogText.en: Great! I can already see a bright and beautiful life right before our eyes!

dialogText.cn: 咦，你们还没出发吗？
dialogText.en: Hey. Done chatting? Get running. Chop, chop!

dialogText.cn: （怎么还有这些幻影？）
dialogText.en: {F}(Why are the phantoms still here?){M}(Why are the phantoms still here?)

dialogText.cn: 嗯……巨兽心脏应该暂时稳定了，但为什么还有数据异常？
dialogText.en: Hmm... The Feranmut Hearts are temporarily stabilized, but why am I still getting anomalous data?

dialogText.cn: 怪了……
dialogText.en: This is odd...

dialogText.cn: 小心背后！
dialogText.en: Watch your back!

dialogText.cn: 快躲开！
dialogText.en: Get down!

dialogText.cn: 吵死了……丁零当啷的干什么呢？不是说我观测数据期间不要来打扰的吗？
dialogText.en: Enough...! Cease that useless banging! I've already given instructions not to be disturbed during data analysis!

dialogText.cn: 我在巡逻途中看到奚天师被幻影围困，出手唐突，打扰了。
dialogText.en: Apologies, sir. I saw phantoms all around you during my patrols and intervened.

dialogText.cn: 幻影……行吧，多谢了。
dialogText.en: Phantoms... Alright then. You have my thanks.

dialogText.cn: 既然来了，过来帮我把设备扛到研究所去。
dialogText.en: Since you're here, carry these instruments to the Institute.

dialogText.cn: 您没有调遣应龙队员的权力。
dialogText.en: Sir, you don't have the authority to order a member of Yinglung.

dialogText.cn: 我是没有，但司岁台不是发了文件，写明部署在武陵的应龙队员应当全力配合修复工作？
dialogText.en: I don't, but the Sui Regulator has issued clear written orders. All Yinglung members in Wuling are to provide full support towards the repair work.

dialogText.cn: 怎么，说话不算话？
dialogText.en: So, are you saying those orders are false?

dialogText.cn: 好……您说了算，奚天师。
dialogText.en: Alright... You got me there, sir.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你也来了？
dialogText.en: Endmin, you're here too?

dialogText.cn: 行，知道你是来帮忙的了。
dialogText.en: Sure. Good to know that you're here to help.

dialogText.cn: 研究所里有些和巨兽相关的文件和数据报告，劳烦你和他一起去拿回来。
dialogText.en: There are some files and data on Feranmuts in the Institute. It'd be nice if you can go with Mr. Yinglung trooper and get me those.

dialogText.cn: 拿到后尽快回来，今天要做的多着呢。
dialogText.en: And get back quickly once you have the files. Plenty of work today.

dialogText.cn: 首墩内修复工作为重，虽然奚天师为人……特立独行，相处不易。
dialogText.en: Repairing the Marker Stone is important. Tianshi Xi Mo is ... an interesting character. Getting along won't be easy.

dialogText.cn: 但有命令在，我也只能受他差遣，跑这一趟了。
dialogText.en: But orders are orders. I have no choice but to be his errand boy.

dialogText.cn: 至少，能与您共事，我很荣幸。
dialogText.en: I do have to say, I am very honored to work with you.

dialogText.cn: （咦？奚墨天师之前……是这样子的吗？）
dialogText.en: {F}(Hmm? Tianshi Xi Mo... Was he ... like this before?){M}(Hmm? Tianshi Xi Mo... Was he ... like this before?)

dialogText.cn: 距我上次过来……也有两三年了，武陵城又变了许多。
dialogText.en: About two or three years have passed since my ... last visit. Wuling City has changed quite a bit.

dialogText.cn: 应龙队员责任重大，非必要不得离岗，但每年还是有两次轮休。
dialogText.en: Personnel of the Yinglung Special Task Force have important duties and cannot leave our posts easily. But we do get two rounds of R&R every year.

dialogText.cn: 我只是因为个人原因没有休假。
dialogText.en: I did not apply for leave due to personal reasons.

dialogText.cn: 十年前，我答应过一位朋友，一定会倾尽所能稳定北部禁区的裂隙，让科考站的事故不再重演。
dialogText.en: Ten years ago, I promised a friend to do my best and stabilize the rift in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone. The tragedy of the Science Station would not be repeated.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，惨剧发生后，应龙第一时间派队伍驰援科考站，我就在其中。
dialogText.en: Yes. When the disaster happened, Yinglung immediately dispatched teams to the Science Station. I was amongst them.

dialogText.cn: 只可惜，当年我只是个新人，许多事……有心无力。
dialogText.en: But I was just a raw recruit. Many things were ... beyond my capabilities.

dialogText.cn: 相似的话，那位朋友也和我说过。
dialogText.en: My friend also told me the same thing.

dialogText.cn: 那时面对惨状，他反倒先安慰我不必伤心，说若是十年后再来看，有天师们在，武陵一定会重生，甚至更加辉煌。
dialogText.en: Though facing calamity, he said there was no need to be sad. If I could just come back in ten years. As long as the Tianshi stand in Wuling, the city shall rise again with greater splendor.

dialogText.cn: 如今看来，他说的都实现了，很好。
dialogText.en: And it seems he was right. The city is well.

dialogText.cn: 我的朋友在一次侵蚀潮余波中……去世了。
dialogText.en: The subsequent floods of the Blight Tide ... got him.

dialogText.cn: 没事，管理员，都已经过去了。
dialogText.en: It's alright, Endmin. What happened, already happened.

actorName.cn: 热情的分析员{sm2l4m5-热情的分析员}

dialogText.cn: 管理员，奚天师要的数据报告都在实验桌上。
dialogText.en: Endmin, Tianshi Xi Mo's data reports are on the lab bench.

actorName.cn: 热情的分析员{sm2l4m5-热情的分析员}

dialogText.cn: 他也真是的……让您做这跑腿的活。
dialogText.en: I just can't believe that grouch ... made you do chores like this.

actorName.cn: 热情的分析员{sm2l4m5-热情的分析员}

dialogText.cn: 奚天师他平时忙于工作，在人际交往方面比较……笨拙，您和他共事，是辛苦了。
dialogText.en: Tianshi Xi Mo is really obsessed with work. But he can be quite ... blunt when dealing with others. I'm really sorry that you have to work with him.

actorName.cn: 热情的分析员{sm2l4m5-热情的分析员}

dialogText.cn: 好，您要是有空，也欢迎在研究所多转转。
dialogText.en: Good to hear. Feel free to tour the Institute if you have the time.

actorName.cn: 痛苦的研究员{sm2l4m5-痛苦的研究员}

dialogText.cn: 完了……这不对啊……奚天师回来肯定又要训我……
dialogText.en: Oh dear... It's all wrong... Tianshi Xi Mo is gonna make me cry again...

actorName.cn: 痛苦的研究员{sm2l4m5-痛苦的研究员}

dialogText.cn: 都测试了好几遍了，这版修复方案还达不到预期效果，谁能救救我……啊……
dialogText.en: I tested it over and over again... But the corrective approach isn't giving me the numbers I need... Someone save me... Aaahhh...

actorName.cn: 痛苦的研究员{sm2l4m5-痛苦的研究员}

dialogText.cn: 我真是……真是……唉，当初我怎么就一意孤行，投在奚天师门下了。
dialogText.en: How... How could I...? Why didn't I listen to my friends? Why did I choose him as my mentor?

actorName.cn: 痛苦的研究员{sm2l4m5-痛苦的研究员}

dialogText.cn: 算了，巨兽相关的研究，除了他也没人更适合。
dialogText.en: This is fate... He's the best scientist in Feranmut sciences.

actorName.cn: 自信的技术员{sm2l4m5-自信的技术员}

dialogText.cn: 这结果太完美了，奚天师肯定满意！嘿嘿……不枉我熬了整整一周的时间。
dialogText.en: Beautiful. Data's just beautiful! Tianshi Xi Mo will be pleased! Heheh. Last week's grind is finally starting to pay off.

actorName.cn: 自信的技术员{sm2l4m5-自信的技术员}

dialogText.cn: 如果能拿到他的推荐信就更好了，有他为我背书，去本部深造岂不是轻而易举？
dialogText.en: If only I could get a letter of recommendation. His endorsement will easily get me an actual fellowship at HQ.

dialogText.cn: 这位奚天师确实有过人之处，明知道当他学生会受折磨，却还是有很多人拜在他门下。
dialogText.en: This Tianshi Xi Mo is quite a personality. He's known for his unforgiving style of mentoring, yet many chose to become his disciple.

dialogText.cn: 想想……如果他还活着，也该有很多学生。
dialogText.en: If he were ... alive, he would have plenty of disciples.

dialogText.cn: 我们相处时间不多，但……他性情温和，我能确保，他绝不会像这位奚天师一样苛责学生。
dialogText.en: I didn't know him for long, but he was ... warm and mild-tempered. I can assure you, he wouldn't be a strict mentor like Tianshi Xi Mo.

dialogText.cn: 我也很想和您讲讲他的事，但他走得太早。照片、物件……什么都没留下。
dialogText.en: I wish I could tell you more about him, but he left early. There were no photos or personal belongings ... nothing...

dialogText.cn: 除了那个约定。
dialogText.en: Except that promise.

dialogText.cn: 怎么这么慢？
dialogText.en: Took your sweet time, didn't you?

dialogText.cn: 虽然壤心玉归位，被损坏的巨兽心脏的状态暂时稳定，但仍需要时常检查。
dialogText.en: Hmph. The Xirancore Jade is back in place and the compromised Feranmut Hearts are stable for now. Routine checks are still required.

dialogText.cn: 这一颗的检查工作就交给你了。
dialogText.en: This heart is yours. Keep your eyes on it.

dialogText.cn: 管理员小心。
dialogText.en: Careful, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 奇怪，这通道的能量波动还是不在正常范围。
dialogText.en: Strange. The energy fluctuations around this passage are not within nominal range.

dialogText.cn: 不行……靠近后能量的波动更大了。
dialogText.en: No... Approaching it only increases the fluctuation amplitude.

dialogText.cn: 近期，巨兽心脏能量爆发的频率是有所增高，但……这一次读数简直高得惊人。
dialogText.en: We did have a recent increase in the Feranmut Heart's energy burst frequency. However ... this reading is through the roof.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我是否需要召集应龙队员前来支援？
dialogText.en: Endmin, should I call the Yinglung task force for support?

dialogText.cn: 读数达到峰值，我们必须通知首墩内的所有人员，尽快进入警备状态。
dialogText.en: If we hit peak readings, we must inform all Marker Stone personnel and enact emergency readiness measures.

dialogText.cn: 啊……墨魉？
dialogText.en: Oh... Ink Spirit?

dialogText.cn: 如果这是巨兽代理人的意思，我们不妨大胆跟过去看看。
dialogText.en: If that's the will of the Feranmut Proxy, I say we head straight in, and take a look around.

dialogText.cn: 好一个大胆设想。
dialogText.en: That's a very bold proposal.

dialogText.cn: 那奚天师有何高见？
dialogText.en: Perhaps Tianshi Xi Mo has a better alternative?

dialogText.cn: 当然是小心翼翼地跟过去看看。
dialogText.en: Of course. I say we follow it cautiously, and stay alert.

dialogText.cn: 咦，那个应龙队的没过来？！
dialogText.en: Hmm. Did that Yinglung trooper fail to keep up...?

dialogText.cn: 算了，管他来没来，巨兽代理人既然引我们到这儿，肯定是有我们要做的事情。
dialogText.en: Let's forget about him. The Feranmut Proxy led us here. There's probably something that we must do.

dialogText.cn: 首墩里哪儿来的动物？谁带宠物进来了！
dialogText.en: Beasts? At the Marker Stone? Who brought their pet here?

dialogText.cn: 嚯，机要重地，我看是谁胆子那么大，让我抓到，非得好好修理一顿不可。
dialogText.en: This is a strategic asset! If I catch the one treating this place as a pet zoo, there'll be hell to pay.

dialogText.cn: 咳咳……呃，我觉得还是先过去看看情况再说……咳咳。
dialogText.en: Ahem... Yes, well, I believe we should clarify the situation... Mmhmm.

dialogText.cn: 先是“蝴蝶”，后是“蟠兽”……是想在这里重新打造一个生态圈吗？
dialogText.en: First a butterfly, then a pantail... Is it trying to create a duplicate ecology here?

dialogText.cn: 我就说，明明巨兽心脏暂时稳定了，首墩内的数据为什么还是不正常……
dialogText.en: I now know why the Marker Stone data are still all over the place, even with temporary stabilization of the Feranmut Hearts...

dialogText.cn: 我们得把逸散的巨兽心脏能量——这只“蟠兽”，送回画卷。
dialogText.en: We must contain this spill of Feranmut Heart energy - and send this "pantail" back to the scroll.

dialogText.cn: 如果不能及时制止能量从画卷中流失，修复工作就很难进行。
dialogText.en: Energy leak from the scroll must be contained quickly, or our repair work will never be done.

dialogText.cn: 过来……到我这边来……
dialogText.en: Alright, little guy... Come over here...

dialogText.cn: 为什么没反应？
dialogText.en: Why isn't it reacting?
Hmm...

dialogText.cn: 它以为自己在柱子上假装雕像，就不会被发现？
dialogText.en: Pretending to be a pillar-top statue? I can still see it.

dialogText.cn: 那个阿达希尔在首墩内四处乱窜，肉眼可见的破坏至少好找——
dialogText.en: That Ardashir has been rampaging unchecked in this Marker Stone. Acts of physical vandalism are easy to find —

dialogText.cn: 可那些藏在暗处的呢，只能扛着仪器一处处排查了。
dialogText.en: But what about damages hidden away from sight? A special crew with detectors must go through each area.

dialogText.cn: 我在首墩好几年的心血……他一来折腾，进度退回几年前。呸，晦气。
dialogText.en: I've spent years on the Marker Stone... That fool and his shenanigans set me back for years. Curses.

dialogText.cn: 什么？到底是谁可怜？！
dialogText.en: What?! Are you comparing me to them?

dialogText.cn: 本来我事就多，那些从北部禁区传来的数据，得二十四小时眼都不眨地盯着。
dialogText.en: I took on a fair share myself. I have to spend twenty-four hours, non-stop, studying data from the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.

dialogText.cn: 还要抽空看一堆漏洞百出的论文和报告。
dialogText.en: And I gotta find time to get through a pile of error-ridden papers and reports.

dialogText.cn: 答应了别人，没办法。
dialogText.en: I got no other option. I made a promise.

dialogText.cn: 说到就要做到，再累再痛苦，也不能失信。
dialogText.en: We live by our words. If we have to suffer to keep a promise, so be it.

dialogText.cn: 再说，难道痛苦就一定和厌恶划等号？
dialogText.en: Also, I may be suffering, but that doesn't mean I hate my job.
"Also"?

dialogText.cn: 算了，懒得问了……
dialogText.en: Whatever. You don't have to tell me...

dialogText.cn: 既然还有墨魉出现，说明逸散的能量不止一处，咱们今天有得跑了。
dialogText.en: Since Ink Spirits are still around, there'll be several energy spills to cover. This job won't be easy.

dialogText.cn: 十年前，我也参与了救援行动，并且结识了一位候补的应龙队员。
dialogText.en: Ten years ago, I was also part of the search-and-rescue operations and met an Yinglung reservist.

dialogText.cn: 相似的是，那位队员也死在了后续的余波灾害中。
dialogText.en: That poor soul ran out of luck and didn't survive the secondary disasters.

dialogText.cn: 我答应那人，许多年后一定会让武陵重新焕发生命，如今看来，也算说到做到，没有辜负当年的情谊。
dialogText.en: I promised them I'd rebuild the city into a place teeming with life. I tried to keep my word and brought that vision to life.

dialogText.cn: 都是巧合罢了。我认识的应龙队员……是个姑娘。
dialogText.en: Just a coincidence. The Yinglung reservist I knew ... was a young woman.

dialogText.cn: 唉……可惜，她要是活着，如今也该升为正式队员，有自己的代号了。
dialogText.en: Ugh... If she were around, she would have become a full-fledged trooper and earned her codename.

dialogText.cn: 我还记得，她是个很喜欢小动物的人。那场灾害里，很多动物也遭了殃，她还为它们立了碑。
dialogText.en: She really liked cute little critters. So many died in that disaster. She made a little headstone for them.

dialogText.cn: 没必要，都是过去的事了。
dialogText.en: Don't be. It's all behind us.

dialogText.cn: 该去追下一处逸散的能量了。
dialogText.en: Time to find the last energy spill.

dialogText.cn: 可算是给抓住送回去了。
dialogText.en: Finally! Caught them all and sent them back.

dialogText.cn: 不过……你刚刚说“也”是指？
dialogText.en: Endmin ... you said "also made a promise"...

dialogText.cn: 约定？故人？
dialogText.en: A promise? Made to someone?

dialogText.cn: 想不到那家伙的经历竟然和我这么像。
dialogText.en: Can't believe he went through the same thing.

dialogText.cn: 明明只是逸散出的巨兽心脏能量……却还是和真的一样。
dialogText.en: It's just spilled Feranmut Heart energy ... yet it's so life-like.

dialogText.cn: 都凑过来，是想和我玩吗？
dialogText.en: Alright, little buddies. Come closer. Wanna play?

dialogText.cn: 我和管理员一路上都想尽办法把它们送回画卷。你倒好，待在这里玩得不亦乐乎！
dialogText.en: The Endmin and I have been running around to send them back to the scroll. Yet here you are cuddling these critters!

dialogText.cn: 见谅……我一进通道，就被送到了这里。
dialogText.en: Apologies... I ended up right here after going through the portal.

dialogText.cn: 上不来下不去，还没带通信器，正好它们就在旁边……
dialogText.en: I can't get up or down. I forgot my handyterm. Then these little buddies showed up...

dialogText.cn: 哼，赶紧送它们回去吧！
dialogText.en: Hmph. Just send them back where they belong! Stat!

dialogText.cn: 墨魉没再出现了，看来逸散出的能量已经尽数回到画卷了。
dialogText.en: No more Ink Spirits. I guess all the energy leaks are back in the scroll.

dialogText.cn: 怎么你听起来还有点不开心？
dialogText.en: You don't sound very happy about this.

dialogText.cn: 我只是喜欢小动物，有些舍不得。
dialogText.en: I really like my little friends. I think I might miss them.

dialogText.cn: 啧，小动物……？
dialogText.en: Huh. Little friends...?

dialogText.cn: 能量已经全部回收，还需要再检查，看看有没有暗处的损坏。
dialogText.en: All entities are back in place. I need another check for hidden damages.

dialogText.cn: 等修复结束，就不用满首墩追着这些能量跑了。
dialogText.en: Once it's fixed, there'll be no more chasing of runaway energy blobs around the Marker Stone.

dialogText.cn: 这次，咳咳……多谢你们了。
dialogText.en: In any case, ahem... Really appreciate your help.

dialogText.cn: 我说，谢谢你们！
dialogText.en: I said, "I really appreciate your help!"

dialogText.cn: 等这轮忙完，请你们吃顿好的。
dialogText.en: Once this is all over, I'm treating you all to a feast.

dialogText.cn: 不用了，本职工作而已。
dialogText.en: Don't sweat it. Mr. Yinglung Trooper is just doing his job.

dialogText.cn: 哎……我这不是顺便还想请你帮个忙？
dialogText.en: Come on... I actually need your help with something else.

dialogText.cn: 奚天师直说就是。
dialogText.en: Of course, Tianshi Xi Mo. This trooper is in your service.

dialogText.cn: 我想问问，你认不认识一个叫沈娇娥的女孩，应该和你一起参与过十年前的救援行动……
dialogText.en: I want to know if you knew Shen Jiao'e, a girl who took part in a SAR operation ten years ago...

dialogText.cn: 认识……只不过不是女孩。
dialogText.en: I know... but I'm afraid that person wasn't a girl.

dialogText.cn: 什么？！
dialogText.en: WHAT?!

dialogText.cn: 我本名……就是沈骄峨，骄是骄阳的骄，峨是巍峨的峨。
dialogText.en: Shen Jiao'e ... is my actual name. "Proud Summit". That's what the words mean.

dialogText.cn: 呃……可我记得那人比我矮半头，还很瘦弱。
dialogText.en: But... She was weak, frail ... ever shorter than me.

dialogText.cn: 十年里长开了。反倒是你，模样和性情大变也就算了，甚至……连名字也变了。
dialogText.en: Maybe someone used ten years to bulk. But you ... changed a lot, too. Temper got worse ... and what's up with the new name?

dialogText.cn: 那人防护服的名牌上明明不是……
dialogText.en: The name on the PPE suit ID tag was...

dialogText.cn: 当时资源紧张，我穿的是阵亡的前辈留下来的防护服。
dialogText.en: We were low on supplies, so I was wearing a suit from a fallen superior.

dialogText.cn: 可我记得，那人不叫奚墨。
dialogText.en: The one I remember wasn't called Xi Mo.

dialogText.cn: 你怎么知道？
dialogText.en: How do you know?

dialogText.cn: 他防护服的名牌上写了。
dialogText.en: The ID tag on his PPE suit said so.

dialogText.cn: 因为……我当时穿的是阵亡的前辈留下来的防护服。
dialogText.en: Well ... I was wearing a suit from a fallen superior.

dialogText.cn: 唉……世事难料。
dialogText.en: ...Fate works in unpredictable ways.

dialogText.cn: 怎么会这样……造化弄人……
dialogText.en: Unpredictable indeed ... this feels quite unexpected.

dialogText.cn: 高兴是高兴，只是更唏嘘。
dialogText.en: I am happy, but I am sentimental as well.

dialogText.cn: 阴差阳错，十年就这么过去了，要不是今天，恐怕一辈子都解不开这误会。
dialogText.en: Got the Yin and Yang mixed up for ten years. I would have probably carried this mistake to my grave if not for this.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，一想到我在驻扎地，奚天师在武陵城……
dialogText.en: Yeah. For all this time, Tianshi Xi Mo stayed at Wuling while I was just up north...

dialogText.cn: 竟然都没能遇到彼此，十年啊……唉！
dialogText.en: Yet we never ran into each other for ten whole years... Hah!

dialogText.cn: ……也好也好，还能把酒言欢。
dialogText.en: ...I guess so. That's something we can drink to.

dialogText.cn: 只能说，每天熬夜加班……害人不浅……
dialogText.en: I guess ... over-working is a bad habit...

dialogText.cn: 双方按理说，该有很多次工作往来的机会。
dialogText.en: We probably worked together at the same place a few times.

dialogText.cn: 我有些担心，奚墨天师他……没让你生气吧？
dialogText.en: I came because I was concerned. I hope Tianshi Xi Mo didn't do anything upsetting.

dialogText.cn: 也是，看你出来的时候笑得满面春风，我想……总不会是你们打了一架。
dialogText.en: Hmm. I saw you smiling rather positively when you came out. So I guess, at the very least, you didn't get into a fight.

dialogText.cn: 发生了什么，你这么开心？
dialogText.en: What exactly happened in there? Why are you so happy?

dialogText.cn: 你和奚墨天师，都是我信任的人。
dialogText.en: I have complete faith in you and Tianshi Xi Mo.

dialogText.cn: 说吧，你今天遇上什么好玩的事情了？
dialogText.en: Now, just let me in on the interesting details.

dialogText.cn: 故人重逢？确实是件好事。
dialogText.en: Old friends meeting again? That is a good thing.
{F}Phoo...{M}Phoo...

dialogText.cn: 刚才不是还很开心吗？为什么又叹气？
dialogText.en: I thought you were happy about it. Why are you sighing?

dialogText.cn: 我只是在想，或许某个地方，也有被我遗忘的老朋友等着我。
dialogText.en: {F}I was just wondering if there are any forgotten old friends out there waiting for me.{M}I was just wondering if there are any forgotten old friends out there waiting for me.

dialogText.cn: 等我……与他们重逢。
dialogText.en: {F}They might be hoping ... to see me again.{M}They might be hoping ... to see me again.

dialogText.cn: 当然，因为这条路上，你从来都不是孤单一人。
dialogText.en: Of course. You are never alone in this journey of yours.

dialogText.cn: 这样是不是全都搞定了？
dialogText.en: That should do it, right?

dialogText.cn: ——情况不太对劲。
dialogText.en: Something's wrong.

dialogText.cn: 嗯！我会努力不拖你们后腿的！
dialogText.en: Got it! I'll do my best not to slow you down!

dialogText.cn: 走吧，我带你们过去！
dialogText.en: Let's go! I'll lead the way!

dialogText.cn: 嗯，马上就要到一个小时的时限了。
dialogText.en: Yes, and we're almost at the one-hour time limit.

dialogText.cn: 那得赶紧出去，免得被巡卫——
dialogText.en: Then we'd better get out fast, before the watchguard —

dialogText.cn: 等等！你们快看——
dialogText.en: Wait! Everyone, look —

dialogText.cn: 哇……好美！
dialogText.en: Whoa ... it's beautiful!

dialogText.cn: 像是醒过来了一样。
dialogText.en: It's like they've all woken up.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……这块地方，叫“经纬田”，可以模拟水生植物的培育环境。
dialogText.en: Mmm... This area is called the "Meridian Grids." It simulates cultivation environments for aquatic plants.

dialogText.cn: 我刚开始做研究的时候，就是在这里完成的第一次实验。
dialogText.en: When I first started my research, this is where I completed my initial experiments.

dialogText.cn: 啊？可是它的操作台在测试区，现在还不能确定那边的情况。
dialogText.en: But ... its control panel is in the testing zone. We have no idea what the situation is over there.

dialogText.cn: 别担心，这可是管理员！没问题的！
dialogText.en: Don't worry! It's the Endmin we're talking about! It'll be fine!

dialogText.cn: 不……机芯模块又和丙型天师桩有这么多关联，作为机芯模块的研究者……
dialogText.en: No... The core modules are so deeply linked to the Type-C Tianshi Pillars. As their primary researcher...

dialogText.cn: 你可以留在外面等我们。
dialogText.en: You can wait for us outside if you'd prefer.

dialogText.cn: 不过我当时只用到了一块田地，所以也只见到了经纬田很小的一部分。
dialogText.en: But I was only using one plot back then. So, I only ever saw a tiny corner of it.

dialogText.cn: 没想到经纬田全部启动后竟然会这么壮观……
dialogText.en: I never imagined the Meridian Grids would look this magnificent when fully activated...

dialogText.cn: 我、我无论如何都不能置身事外。
dialogText.en: I... I can't just stand by and do nothing.

dialogText.cn: 完了，不会是丙型天师桩出问题了吧？！
dialogText.en: Oh no ... you don't think the main Type-C Tianshi Pillars are malfunctioning, do you?!

dialogText.cn: 我从没见到过这样的异常状况……
dialogText.en: I've never seen anything like this before...

dialogText.cn: 它叫“胆小鬼”？……竟然真的在哆嗦！
dialogText.en: It's called "Scaredy-pants"? ...It's actually trembling!

dialogText.cn: 大家轻点，它很容易被吓到。
dialogText.en: Take it easy, everyone. It startles really easily.

dialogText.cn: 这片地面上的轨道……似乎已经完全损坏了。
dialogText.en: The tracks in this area ... seem to be completely destroyed.

dialogText.cn: 别跑！是我呀！
dialogText.en: Hey! It's me! Don't run!

dialogText.cn: 得追上它，它这么乱跑，可能会把自己撞出问题……
dialogText.en: We have to catch it! If it keeps panicking like this, it might damage itself...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，这片区域的轨道刚好在翻修……
dialogText.en: Yeah ... they were scheduled for renovation...

dialogText.cn: 弭弗队长特意把我调来，就是想避免普通民众进到这园区里。小陆，你就听叔叔一句劝，快回去吧……
dialogText.en: Captain Mi Fu put me here specifically to keep folks out of this area. Kid, just listen to your old man and turn back, alright...

dialogText.cn: 可……可我不是无关人士啊！我在这里都做了好几年研究了！
dialogText.en: B-But... I'm not just some outsider! I've been doing research here for years!

dialogText.cn: 那也不行。里面的侵蚀不是你应付得了的……等天师们都清理干净了，你再回去做研究也不迟嘛。
dialogText.en: Still not happening. The Blight inside isn't something you can handle... Once the Tianshi have cleared it out, then you can go back to your research.

dialogText.cn: 可等到那时候，它们说不定就……！
dialogText.en: But by then, they might already be...!

dialogText.cn: 小陆，你就别为难我了，现在情况特殊，要是你进去出了什么事，我真的不好交代啊……
dialogText.en: Lu, don't make this hard for me. The situation's too risky right now. If something happens to you in there, I really won't be able to explain it...

dialogText.cn: 管理员？您怎么来了……？
dialogText.en: Endministrator? What brings you here...?

dialogText.cn: 小陆，你一个天师学徒，还是老老实实待在这儿，让天师啊，管理员啊这些专业人士来处理吧。
dialogText.en: Lu, you're still a Tianshi disciple. Stay put right here and let the Tianshi and the Endministrator handle this.

dialogText.cn: 我能应付的！里面的路我很熟悉，知道怎么避开侵蚀……
dialogText.en: I can handle it! I know the paths inside well, I know how to avoid the Blight...

dialogText.cn: 叔叔，就让我进去吧，我保证不会出事的！
dialogText.en: Please just let me in. I promise! Nothing will go wrong!

dialogText.cn: 这……这可怎么办……<@qu.key>“愣头青”</>它们……
dialogText.en: What ... what am I supposed to do... <@qu.key>"Blockhead"</> and the others...

dialogText.cn: 难道您也知道试验园区被侵蚀潮影响的事了？唉，我刚说什么来着，这里的情况真的很严重……
dialogText.en: Did you hear about the Blight Tide affecting the Test Area too? Like I was just saying, the situation here is really bad...

dialogText.cn: 这位同学，你为什么要进去呀？
dialogText.en: Hey there, why do you wanna go in so bad?

dialogText.cn: 我、我有要紧事……它们有麻烦，我能感受到它们很害怕，它们在等我！
dialogText.en: I-I need to take care of something... They're in trouble. I can feel how scared they are, they're waiting for me!

dialogText.cn: 等等，刚刚巡卫大叔是不是叫你……管理员？！难道你就是书上的那位……太好了！这下有救了！
dialogText.en: Wait, did uncle just call you... the Endministrator?! You're the one from the books... That's amazing! Now I have hope!

dialogText.cn: 它们是我很重要的伙伴，现在都在园区里被困住了……我进去就是为了救它们！
dialogText.en: They're my buddies! Right now they're stuck in there... I've got to get them out!

dialogText.cn: 要是我不能及时赶过去，它们就真回不了家了……
dialogText.en: If I don't get there in time, they'll never make it home...

dialogText.cn: 我叫陆令香，是试验园区的天师学徒。
dialogText.en: I'm Lu Lingxiang, a Tianshi disciple in the Test Area.

dialogText.cn: 拜托你们帮帮我，能让我进去就好！
dialogText.en: Please help me out! Just let me in!

dialogText.cn: 唉，好吧……看在管理员的分上，我就当一回睁眼瞎吧。
dialogText.en: Alright, fine... For the Endmin's sake, I'll turn a blind eye just this once.

dialogText.cn: 叔叔，你答应啦？
dialogText.en: Really? You mean it?

dialogText.cn: 本来你一个人我肯定是不放心的，但现在有终末地的管理员在，也不是不能通融一次。
dialogText.en: Honestly, letting you go in alone was a hard no. But with the Endministrator on the case... I guess I can make an exception this time.

dialogText.cn: 那……给你们一个小时怎么样？再久我也拖不了了。
dialogText.en: Alright ... how about one hour? Any longer and I can't cover for you.

dialogText.cn: 一个小时？不能再多——
dialogText.en: Only one? Can't we please just—

dialogText.cn: 小陆，你再讨价还价，可就一个小时都没有咯？
dialogText.en: Lu, if you keep haggling, you won't even get the hour.

dialogText.cn: 好、好吧！一个小时就一个小时！
dialogText.en: Okay, okay! One hour it is!

dialogText.cn: 对了，还是得提醒几位，这园区里的侵蚀可不一般，你们进去前最好做足准备。
dialogText.en: Just a heads-up. The Blight in this area is no joke. You'd better make sure you're fully prepped before going in.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？小陆？你们该不会是……
dialogText.en: Endmin? Lu? Don't tell me that you're still...

dialogText.cn: 机芯模块会定期从丙型辅桩脱出，在园区内巡逻一段时间后返回。
dialogText.en: The core modules detach from the pillars on a regular schedule. They then patrol the area for a while before returning.

dialogText.cn: 所以，你想进入园区，就是为了找回那些机芯模块？
dialogText.en: So, you wanted to return ... to retrieve those core modules?

dialogText.cn: 没错。我一直在做和它们相关的研究，它们就像我的好伙伴一样，帮了我好多忙……
dialogText.en: That's right. I've been doing research alongside them the whole time. They're ... they're like my partners. They've helped me so much...

dialogText.cn: 这里的天师桩和园区外的很不一样，是不同型号吗？看起来更像是某种树木根植于此……
dialogText.en: These Tianshi Pillars are very different from the ones outside. Are they a different model? They look more like ... trees that have taken root here.

dialogText.cn: 这是丙型辅桩，用来辅助丙型天师桩的运行。“外面见到”的天师桩和辅桩，是根据它们研究出的新型号。
dialogText.en: These are Type-C Auxiliary Pillars. They support the main Type-C Tianshi Pillars. The models you saw "outside" are newer versions developed based on this research.

dialogText.cn: 幸好，充能轨道还没坏……机芯模块通常都是沿着这些轨道巡逻的。
dialogText.en: Great, the charging tracks are still intact... The core modules usually patrol along these tracks.

dialogText.cn: 以往这样的侵蚀屏障也拦不住它们。我们在实验时让它们学习过很多技能，<@qu.key>消除侵蚀屏障</>就是其中之一。
dialogText.en: Normally, a Blight barrier like this wouldn't stop them. We trained them to learn all sorts of protocols during testing, and <@qu.key>eliminating these barriers</> was one of them.

dialogText.cn: 但现在的深度读数已经远远超过了平时的实验环境，老实说，我很担心它们现在的状况……
dialogText.en: But the current depth readings are way beyond anything in the normal test parameters. Honestly... I'm really worried about their conditions...

dialogText.cn: 不过，与那些辅桩不同，丙型辅桩需要搭配机芯模块工作。
dialogText.en: But unlike other auxiliary pillars, these Type-C models require a core module to function.

dialogText.cn: 巡逻期间，它们会监测深度读数，如果遇到了实验环境下的侵蚀，也会主动进行消除。
dialogText.en: They monitor depth readings during their patrols. If they encounter Blight present in a testing environment, they'll initiate elimination protocols on their own.

dialogText.cn: 哇，居然能做这么多事，这些机芯模块真能干！
dialogText.en: Wow, they can do all that? These core modules are really something!

dialogText.cn: 对，可我之前却收到了它们发来的深度异常警报，定位器上也显示它们一直停在丙型辅桩之外的区域……
dialogText.en: Right. But then I started getting abnormal depth alerts from them. Their locators also show they've been stuck in an area away from the Type-C Auxiliary Pillars...

dialogText.cn: 它们很可能是遇到了什么处理不了的侵蚀，或是别的麻烦……
dialogText.en: They must have run into Blight they couldn't handle ... or some other kind of trouble.

dialogText.cn: 怪不得你之前那么着急，还是快点把那些机芯模块找回来吧！
dialogText.en: No wonder you were in such a hurry. Let's go find those core modules now!

dialogText.cn: “愣头青”，总算找到你啦！
dialogText.en: "Blockhead"! There you are, finally!

dialogText.cn: 真棒，看来内部结构没出问题！它已经重回轨道了，待会儿就能顺利回到丙型辅桩啦。
dialogText.en: Good job! Its internal systems are still functional! It's back on the tracks now. It should make it back to the Type-C Auxiliary Pillar without any trouble.

dialogText.cn: 你的操作很熟练……应该维护过这些机芯模块很多次？
dialogText.en: You handled that very deftly... It looks like you must have performed maintenance on these core modules many times before?

dialogText.cn: 嗯，和它们相处久了，自然而然就做了些维护的工作……
dialogText.en: Yeah, after working with them for so long, you just sort of ... pick it up along the way.

dialogText.cn: 这机芯模块长得还挺可爱的嘛！刚刚我就有点好奇，这名字是……
dialogText.en: Aw, it's pretty cute! But I was wondering earlier ... who gave it that name?

dialogText.cn: 嘿嘿！是我给它起的！很好记，对吧？
dialogText.en: Heh! That was me! Rolls off the tongue, doesn't it?

dialogText.cn: “愣头青”，你还记得怎么工作吧？
dialogText.en: Alright, "Blockhead," you remember how to do your job, right?

dialogText.cn: 管理员？
dialogText.en: Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 怎么了，有哪里不对吗？
dialogText.en: What is it? Does something seem off?

dialogText.cn: 这些丙型辅桩与机芯模块被造出来的时候，管理员还在沉睡……照道理，不会见过它们的运行方式……
dialogText.en: These Type-C Auxiliary Pillars and their core modules were created before the Endmin awakened... In theory, you shouldn't have seen their operation before...

dialogText.cn: 好厉害，我试过绕开权限，但丙型辅桩每次都会拒绝。
dialogText.en: That's incredible! I tried bypassing the permissions before, but the pillars always rejected my access.

dialogText.cn: 咦？路打开了！是园区的设备恢复运行了吗？
dialogText.en: Hey, the path is open! Did the systems just come back online?

dialogText.cn: 或许管理员和这些丙型辅桩与机芯模块，确实有些不一样的关系……
dialogText.en: Perhaps ... the Endmin really does have a unique connection to these Type-C Auxiliary Pillars and core modules...

dialogText.cn: 等一下，机芯模块……
dialogText.en: Wait a second, the core module...

dialogText.cn: “愣头青”，你到家啦！
dialogText.en: "Blockhead," you made it home!

dialogText.cn: 你用源石技艺改写了丙型辅桩的整套系统？！你能做到这一步？！
dialogText.en: You ... you used Originium Arts to rewrite the entire Type-C Auxiliary Pillar system?! You can actually do that?!

dialogText.cn: 等等，为什么丙型辅桩会把机芯模块的核心吐出来给你……是因为系统被改写了吗？
dialogText.en: But wait... Why did the pillar just eject the core module's kernel to you? Is it because you rewrote the system?

dialogText.cn: 那、那么，到了下一个丙型辅桩时，能不能麻烦你们再试一试——
dialogText.en: So, um, when we get to the next pillar ... do you think you could try it again—

dialogText.cn: 看看是巧合，还是……
dialogText.en: To see if it was just a coincidence, or...

dialogText.cn: 到家啦，快回去吧。
dialogText.en: Home sweet home. Go on.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，要不要再试一次？看看会不会想起什么？
dialogText.en: Wanna give it another try, Endmin? See if it jogs your memory any further?

dialogText.cn: 身体不好？
dialogText.en: Not very healthy?

dialogText.cn: 对，因为它耗能总是特别快，我用了很多办法都没能帮它改善这个问题。
dialogText.en: Yeah. It burns through energy way too fast. I've tried everything but nothing's helped improve its efficiency.

dialogText.cn: 是啊，它总是能量很低，有气无力的，难以适应寻常的应用环境。
dialogText.en: Uh-huh. It's always running on empty, sluggish. It just can't cope with normal operating conditions.

dialogText.cn: 也不知道它怎么样了……
dialogText.en: I just hope it's holding up okay...

dialogText.cn: 没想到“胆小鬼”的核心也被丙型辅桩交给了你，看来它们真的跟你存在某种关系……会是什么呢？
dialogText.en: I can't believe "Scaredy-pants" handed its kernel to you too. It really seems like there's some kind of connection with you... But what could it be?

dialogText.cn: 这园区里还有其他机芯模块吗？
dialogText.en: Are there any other core modules left around here?

dialogText.cn: 还有一个。不过，那个机芯模块……身体有点不好。
dialogText.en: Just one more. But ... that core module ... is not very healthy.

dialogText.cn: 这个机芯模块肯定过得很辛苦……
dialogText.en: It must have had a really tough time...

dialogText.cn: 所以，我给它起了个名字，叫“病秧子”。
dialogText.en: So, I gave it a name. I call it "Sniffles".

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>“病秧子”</>在这里！果然能量不足了……
dialogText.en: <@qu.key>"Sniffles"</> is here! Just as I thought, its energy is critically low...

dialogText.cn: 别怕别怕，我们来帮你了。
dialogText.en: Hey, hey, it's alright. We're here to help you.

dialogText.cn: 充能轨道结构还算完整，只要让充能板的运行系统被激活，“病秧子”就能自己回去了。
dialogText.en: The charging tracks are mostly intact. If we can just activate the energy panel system, "Sniffles" should be able to make its way back on its own.

dialogText.cn: 嘘，好像是只咆兽。
dialogText.en: Shh. Sounds like a howlerbeast.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，毕竟我们平常面对的敌人，大多都比它更可怕。
dialogText.en: Well, the adversaries we usually face tend to be far more formidable.

dialogText.cn: 哇！它不会听见了吧？！动静这么大？
dialogText.en: Whoa! Did it hear us?! What's with all the racket?!

dialogText.cn: 我、我在生物图鉴上见过它，名字我记得是……“天鼓”，一种很凶恶的动物。
dialogText.en: I-I've seen it in the bestiary. I think its name is ... "Skydrummer". It's a really vicious creature.

dialogText.cn: 天鼓？哈哈，看着确实气鼓鼓的！
dialogText.en: "Skydrummer"? Hah, it does look pretty puffed up!

dialogText.cn: 你们都不害怕吗？它看起来可一点都不好惹……
dialogText.en: Aren't any of you scared? It looks seriously dangerous...

dialogText.cn: <@qu.key>丙型天师桩</>是一个很大的装置。地面上的只是它的一部分，<@qu.key>操作台</>在下面的测试区——
dialogText.en: The <@qu.key>Type-C Tianshi Pillar</> is a massive installation. The part you see above ground is only a section of it. The main control panel is in the testing zone below—

dialogText.cn: 不好，我们得赶紧了。
dialogText.en: That doesn't sound good. We need to hurry.

dialogText.cn: 往好处想，离出问题的地方也不远了！
dialogText.en: Look on the bright side, we must be getting close to the source of the trouble!

dialogText.cn: ……你好乐观啊！
dialogText.en: ...You're really optimistic!

dialogText.cn: 我吗？嘿嘿……往这儿走能行吗？
dialogText.en: Me? Heh... Wait, you sure about this way?

dialogText.cn: 看起来是唯一的路了。
dialogText.en: Seems like the only way forward.

dialogText.cn: 好了好了！它暂时不会来妨碍我们了。
dialogText.en: There, all done! It won't be bothering us for a while.

dialogText.cn: 你们三个……是想要到这里来吗？
dialogText.en: Um, you three ... were you trying to get here?

dialogText.cn: 很亲切？可那时管理员不是还在睡觉吗？
dialogText.en: Familiar? But you were still sleeping when these were made, weren't you?

dialogText.cn: 如果没有你的坚持，这一切都不会发生吧？
dialogText.en: If you hadn't insisted on coming back, none of this would have happened, would it?

dialogText.cn: 或许……制造丙型天师桩的人，有看过管理员当初留下的研究笔记。
dialogText.en: Perhaps ... the person who created them had access to the research notes the Endmin left behind.

dialogText.cn: 可以了？什么可以了？
dialogText.en: What should do the trick?

dialogText.cn: 欸？怎么做到的？！
dialogText.en: Wha?! How did you do that?!

dialogText.cn: 太好了，我今天真的非常非常开心！开心得……能一口气做十场实验！
dialogText.en: This is amazing! I'm so, so happy today! So happy I could... I could run ten experiments back-to-back!

dialogText.cn: 日丽风和，春回大地……确实是非常美丽的景色。
dialogText.en: A gentle sun, and a fair wind as spring returns to the land. It truly is a beautiful sight.

dialogText.cn: 怎么回事？等等我！
dialogText.en: What's going on? Wait!

dialogText.cn: 多亏了……我？
dialogText.en: Thanks to ... me?

dialogText.cn: 啊？你的意思是……管理员会觉得似曾相识，是因为这是他们照着管理员的想法做出来的？
dialogText.en: Huh? So you're saying ... the reason it feels familiar is because they built it based on the Endmin's own ideas?

dialogText.cn: 不能说是“照着”，更像是参考了管理员的思路，将其应用在了他们的设计之中。
dialogText.en: "Based on" isn't quite accurate. It's more that they referenced the Endmin's foundational concepts and applied them within their own designs.

dialogText.cn: 从结果上而言，确实是这样。正因为你执着于返回园区解救机芯模块，才有了管理员完善丙型天师桩构造的契机。
dialogText.en: Yes, thanks to you. It's down to your determination to rescue the core modules, that the Endmin could perfect the pillar's design.

dialogText.cn: 哇！小陆！你快看！
dialogText.en: Whoa! Lu! Look over there!

dialogText.cn: 那当初造它的天师们，干嘛要把它们拆出来啊？
dialogText.en: Then why did the Tianshi who built it go through the trouble of taking them out in the first place?

dialogText.cn: 唔，这么一说，我倒是听前辈们提过——
dialogText.en: Hmm, now that you mention it ... I think I remember my seniors saying something about that —

dialogText.cn: 当年，丙型天师桩是仿造首墩设计的，本来应该是独立设备，没打算制作辅助装置……
dialogText.en: Back then, the Type-C Tianshi Pillar was designed based on the Marker Stone. It was originally meant to be a standalone unit, with no auxiliary devices planned...

dialogText.cn: 也许……天师们就是为了解决这个问题，才选择了拆离三个核心的方案——
dialogText.en: Perhaps ... the Tianshi chose to extract the three kernels precisely to resolve that instability...

dialogText.cn: 将它们改装成机芯模块，并增设丙型辅桩，协同工作。
dialogText.en: Then modified them into core modules and added the Type-C Auxiliary Pillars to create a cooperative system.

dialogText.cn: 所以，管理员等于是实现了当年前辈们没能实现的最佳方案？完善了丙型天师桩的构造？这、这真是太厉害了……
dialogText.en: So, the Endmin ... actually realized the optimal solution our seniors couldn't achieve? Perfected the Type-C Tianshi Pillar's structure? That's ... that's incredible...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我有个好消息要告诉你们！
dialogText.en: Endmin! I have some great news!

dialogText.cn: 现在我已经正式成为这个净水节点的项目负责人啦！以后会继续做污水处理装置的研究！
dialogText.en: I've officially been appointed the project lead for the Purification Node! I'm going to keep researching water treatment systems from now on!

dialogText.cn: 最近我还发现了这个——
dialogText.en: And I recently discovered this —

dialogText.cn: 欸？这个是？
dialogText.en: Huh? What's this?

dialogText.cn: 对，他们在论文里提过一套可行性很强的污水处理提效方案！虽然已经有点过时了……但确实启发了我！
dialogText.en: Yes! They mentioned a highly feasible efficiency enhancement plan for water treatment in their thesis! It's a bit outdated now ... but it's really inspiring!

dialogText.cn: 按照这个方案改良的装置，不仅能处理污水，还能从中提取一些有价值的材料哦！
dialogText.en: A device modified according to this plan wouldn't just process polluted water, it could even extract some valuable materials from it!

dialogText.cn: 不过整体还处在摸索阶段……估计要再调整两次，改良工作才能全部完成。
dialogText.en: The whole thing is still in its experimental phase, though... I'll probably need a couple more rounds of adjustments before the modifications are fully complete.

dialogText.cn: 我已经在装置上做了一些新尝试。管理员，欢迎你来试一试！
dialogText.en: I've already implemented some new modifications to the device. Endmin, you're welcome to come and test it out anytime!

dialogText.cn: 终于找到你们了！
dialogText.en: There you are! Finally!

dialogText.cn: 我在外面听到动静，赶紧进来看看情况。
dialogText.en: I heard the commotion from outside and rushed in to check on you. What happened?

dialogText.cn: 太好了！这里没有被侵蚀潮破坏。
dialogText.en: Thank goodness! The Blight Tide didn't wreck this place.

dialogText.cn: 哎，想当年也有几个像你这样的天师学徒，在这儿搞什么污水处理装置的研究……可惜后来好像遇到了什么大难题。
dialogText.en: Ah, takes me back. We used to have a few Tianshi disciples like you, tinkering with some water treatment system research right here... Shame they seemed to run into some major roadblock later on.

dialogText.cn: 什么？污水处理装置？你说的……莫非是当年前辈们研究的“净水节点”？
dialogText.en: What? Water treatment system? You mean ... could you be talking about the "Purification Node" my seniors were researching back then?

dialogText.cn: 这我就不清楚了。与其听我说，不如自己看看嘛！
dialogText.en: Beats me. But rather than listening to me, why not go see for yourself?

dialogText.cn: 呼，还好园区里的材料够齐全，真的让我做出来了！管理员你看——
dialogText.en: Whew... Good thing the materials here were so well-stocked. I actually made it! Look, Endmin—

dialogText.cn: 他们最终也没能解决，只能选择放弃……那之后，这地方也就没什么人来了。
dialogText.en: They never managed to solve it in the end. Had to give up... This place just fell quiet ever since.

dialogText.cn: 真的是他们……太遗憾了……就差一点点……
dialogText.en: It really was them... What a shame... They were so close...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我想试试！翻看这些资料时，我有了一些思路，说不定能实现前辈们的愿望，让他们的心血不至于白费！
dialogText.en: Endmin, I want to try! While I was looking through these records, I got some ideas. I might be able to fulfill my seniors' wish! We can't let their hard work go to waste!

dialogText.cn: 这就是前辈们当初想要造出来的净水节点！
dialogText.en: This is it! The Purification Node my seniors wanted to create!

dialogText.cn: 那个什么污水处理装置……真被你造出来了？
dialogText.en: So that water treatment system ... you really built it?

dialogText.cn: 嗯！搞定了！净水节点确实在正常运作了。
dialogText.en: Yep! All done! The Purification Node is up and running.

dialogText.cn: 我立即写一份报告提交给庄天师，告诉她丙型天师桩恢复运作了，污水处理区也能发挥它真正的作用了。
dialogText.en: I'll write up a report for Tianshi Zhuang immediately. I'll tell her the Type-C Tianshi Pillar is operational again, and that the water treatment sector can finally serve its true purpose.

dialogText.cn: 这遍地的桃花，今天真是个好日子啊。我们完成了一项很了不起的大工程呢。
dialogText.en: Peach blossoms everywhere... Today really is a wonderful day. We accomplished something truly remarkable.

dialogText.cn: 欸？我给它起名？
dialogText.en: Huh? Me?!

dialogText.cn: 对，你来起！管理员都这么说了！
dialogText.en: That's right, you name it! If the Endmin says so!

dialogText.cn: 既然你选择将它继承下去……那么，我想不会有比你更合适的命名人选了。
dialogText.en: Since you've chosen to carry this legacy forward... I can think of no one more fitting to give it its name.

dialogText.cn: 那、那管理员，你有什么建议吗？我其实不太擅长起名……
dialogText.en: Then, um, Endmin ... do you have any suggestions? I'm not really good at naming things...

dialogText.cn: 哈哈哈哈，机芯模块们一定很喜欢这个名字。
dialogText.en: Pfft — Hah! The core modules would definitely love a name like that.

dialogText.cn: 如果不是前辈们留下了那么多珍贵的研究资料，也不会有现在的成果……确实是一种“传承”呢。
dialogText.en: If my seniors hadn't left behind all that precious research, none of this would exist now... It really is a "Legacy's Flow".

dialogText.cn: 这个名字真好听，还特别贴合这里的景色……我喜欢这个！就叫它吧！
dialogText.en: That name is so beautiful, and it fits the scenery here perfectly... I love it! Let's go with that one!

dialogText.cn: 我会一直记住这个名字……然后，把当年的故事告诉每个来到这里的人。
dialogText.en: I'll always remember this name ... and I'll make sure to tell the story behind it to everyone who comes here.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢你们。
dialogText.en: Thank you. Every one of you.

dialogText.cn: 等到所有的设备都维修完毕，试验园区应该就能重新启用啦！
dialogText.en: Once all the devices are repaired, the Test Area should be ready for full operation again!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，猜猜看我给你准备了什么惊喜？是我专门为你挑选的哦！猜错了也没关系的，试一下嘛。
dialogText.en: Surprise, Endmin! I picked something super special, just for you. C'mon, guess what it is!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？你要去忙了吗？注意安全哦。
dialogText.en: Oh? Going back to work? Be safe, okay?

dialogText.cn: 这是给我的吗？谢谢！我会把它摆在房间里最显眼的位置！
dialogText.en: Is this for me? Oh, thank you so much! It's getting the most conspicuous spot in my cabin!

dialogText.cn: 嗯？你要去忙了吗？注意安全哦。
dialogText.en: Oh? Going back to work? Be safe, okay?

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 在社会交往中，人们选择通过赠予对方物件来传达心意和感受。所以我准备了一份礼物，想送给您。
dialogText.en: Conventions of socialization dictate that people exchange gifts to convey their feelings. I have prepared this particular gift for you, recipient.

dialogText.cn: 好吧，下次再跟您交流冷笑话心得，管理员。
dialogText.en: Very good. We will have another exchange on the art of dispensing good satire, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢，我明白送礼这一行为的意义，我会珍惜。
dialogText.en: I am grateful. I understand what it means to offer a gift, and I shall treasure this offering.

dialogText.cn: 好吧，下次再跟您交流冷笑话心得，管理员。
dialogText.en: Very good. We will have another exchange on the art of dispensing good satire, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 他因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: He is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 可以借用您一点时间吗？这是我外出勘测时收集的一些纪念品，众生长地的羽饰、宏山的小玉器、铁誓军的纪念章……都是送给您的，希望您能喜欢。
dialogText.en: A moment of your time, Endmin? I gathered some souvenirs during prospecting. Decorative feathers from the Hannabit Circuit, jade trinkets from Hongshan, and medals from the Order of Steel Oath... They're all for you. Hope you like them.

dialogText.cn: 前辈慢走，多利先生也跟您说再见呢。
dialogText.en: See you around, Professor. Mr. Dolly wants to say goodbye as well.

dialogText.cn: 送我的礼物吗？让我拆开看看里面有什么。真是的……前辈怎么比我还着急呀。
dialogText.en: A gift? For me? Aww, thank you! Let's see what's inside... *Giggle* Professor, you're looking even more anxious than me.

dialogText.cn: 前辈慢走，多利先生也跟您说再见呢。
dialogText.en: See you around, Professor. Mr. Dolly wants to say goodbye as well.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我从冰原带回来了一点小东西，请收下吧。
dialogText.en: Endmin, take this. It's a tiny something I brought from the snowfields.

dialogText.cn: 没问题的，管理员，之后再聊吧。
dialogText.en: No problem, Endmin. We'll talk later.

dialogText.cn: 这是给我的吗？谢谢，有种很温暖的感觉……我会好好珍藏的！
dialogText.en: Is this for me? Oh, thank you! It's got such a warm feel... I'll definitely treasure it!

dialogText.cn: 没问题的，管理员，之后再聊吧。
dialogText.en: No problem, Endmin. We'll talk later.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 这可是我专门从下面给你带回来的哦，找得很辛苦！看到它，有没有再想起点儿什么？
dialogText.en: I went through quite a bit to bring this back for you. Does it spark any memories?

dialogText.cn: 不想再和我聊点什么了吗，那再见喽？
dialogText.en: Not hanging around for a chat? Well, I'll see you around.

dialogText.cn: 我这么漂亮的女孩子，当然收到过很多礼物啦！但你这一份，和别的那些完全不一样哦。
dialogText.en: A pretty girl like me has definitely gotten a lot of gifts, but this one from you is ... special.

dialogText.cn: 不想再和我聊点什么了吗，那再见喽？
dialogText.en: Not hanging around for a chat? Well, I'll see you around.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，请收下这个。
dialogText.en: Please accept this, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 好的，下次见，管理员。
dialogText.en: Acknowledged. Till we meet again, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢，我将把它视作一种肯定。
dialogText.en: My thanks. I will treat this as a token of your approval.

dialogText.cn: 好的，下次见，管理员。
dialogText.en: Acknowledged. Till we meet again, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 再送你个小东西。放心，这次的不吓人。
dialogText.en: Here, a little gadget for you. Relax, nothing will pop out of it.

dialogText.cn: 这就要去忙了？真辛苦呀，大英雄。
dialogText.en: Rushing off to work already? It's tough being a hero, I guess.

dialogText.cn: 以前，我有位“同事”收了一件礼物，然后就被抓去顶罪了——你拼命摇头做什么？
dialogText.en: Hmm, a "colleague" of mine once accepted a gift and ended up taking the fall... Why are you shaking your head so hard?

dialogText.cn: 这就要去忙了？真辛苦呀，大英雄。
dialogText.en: Rushing off to work already? It's tough being a hero, I guess.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 我们常说“礼轻情意重”。倘若真的心怀情意，又会觉得送什么礼都嫌轻，但愿你能喜欢！
dialogText.en: "A gift is but a gentle token of heartfelt sincerity." That's how the saying goes. But if someone's truly sincere, no gift will be fitting enough. Well, I just hope you'll like this one, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 欸？这就不聊啦？
dialogText.en: Huh? I was hoping we could chat some more.

dialogText.cn: 给我的？！哇……我现在就拆开看看！
dialogText.en: For ... me?! WOW ... I'm totally gonna open it right now!

dialogText.cn: 欸？这就不聊啦？
dialogText.en: Huh? I was hoping we could chat some more.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 总算逮着您了，管理员！专门弄来的特产，接好咯！
dialogText.en: Found you, Endmin! Here! Something special straight from Hongshan!

dialogText.cn: 成，您先忙着，咱回头见。
dialogText.en: Sure. Go do your thing. Hope to hear from you again.

dialogText.cn: 承蒙关照！
dialogText.en: I am deeply honored!

dialogText.cn: 成，您先忙着，咱回头见。
dialogText.en: Sure. Go do your thing. Hope to hear from you again.

dialogText.cn: 他因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: He is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 顺手给你买了份礼物，拿着。商店买两件打五折，是不是很划算？
dialogText.en: Here, Boss. Got something nice for you. The shop got this fifty percent discount if you buy another. A great steal, right?

dialogText.cn: 再见。下回提前打个招呼，我给你钓条鲜鳞。
dialogText.en: See ya. Call me ahead of time and I'll get a fresh fin for you.

dialogText.cn: 给我的？除了催债信和仇家恐吓信，居然有人送我正常的礼物。
dialogText.en: For me? Holy... I usually get love letters from butt-hurt punks asking me to pay up or guys who want to kill me. Never expected to get a real gift.

dialogText.cn: 再见。下回提前打个招呼，我给你钓条鲜鳞。
dialogText.en: See ya. Call me ahead of time and I'll get a fresh fin for you.

dialogText.cn: 他因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: He is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 我给你带了点东西，荒野的馈赠，希望你会喜欢。
dialogText.en: I brought you something. A gift of the wilds. I hope you like it.

dialogText.cn: 我明白了，再见。
dialogText.en: Understood. Farewell.

dialogText.cn: 礼物？荒野上的赠礼意义非凡……我会认真对待的。
dialogText.en: For me? Gifts are important in the wildlands... I shall treasure this one.

dialogText.cn: 我明白了，再见。
dialogText.en: Understood. Farewell.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这次外勤任务，我带回来了一些小纪念品，请收下！
dialogText.en: Ah, Endmin! I got you a little something from the field mission. Hope you like it!

dialogText.cn: 好，等您下次有空时，再指导一下我吧。
dialogText.en: Great. And I'm always up for another lesson if you're free.

dialogText.cn: 哇，管理员的礼物！我猜一猜，这是奖励吗？还是……
dialogText.en: Wow, a gift for me?! Is it a reward for something I did, or...?

dialogText.cn: 好，等您下次有空时，再指导一下我吧。
dialogText.en: Great. And I'm always up for another lesson if you're free.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 给你的，作为你一直记住我的回报。嗯？不会忘记在意的人本身就是回报？嘁……
dialogText.en: Here. It's yours. Thanks for keeping me on your mind. Huh? Being able to remember someone you care about is gift enough...? Pfft...

dialogText.cn: 那就先这样吧。
dialogText.en: That's it for now.

dialogText.cn: 哦？我不是很喜欢接受礼物，因为最后总是会忘记。不过既然是你的……那就另当别论。
dialogText.en: Hmm, I don't really like receiving presents, because I always end up forgetting about them. But this one's from you ... so it will be an exception.

dialogText.cn: 那就先这样吧。
dialogText.en: That's it for now.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管、管理员！小小礼物不成敬意，请请请请笑纳！对不起，我、我不知道怎么说比较好……
dialogText.en: Endmin, please accept this humble token of my eternal and everlasting g-gratitude! I ... I'm so sorry... I don't know what to say...

dialogText.cn: 好的，下、下次我们再聊？
dialogText.en: Alright. I, uh, maybe we'll talk again next time.

dialogText.cn: 送我的？管理员？没骗人？！这……居然——我、我腿有点软……
dialogText.en: This is ... for me...? A-are you really sure, Endmin? Oh gosh... I ... I think I'm ... I think I'm gonna pass out...

dialogText.cn: 好的，下、下次我们再聊？
dialogText.en: Alright. I, uh, maybe we'll talk again next time.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，上次打游戏输给你的时候说好给你送的小礼物，嘿嘿，你快拿着！
dialogText.en: Endmin, remember I promised you a gift when I lost that game to you? Well, here it is!

dialogText.cn: 好的好的，之后再见吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Alright, then. Really hope to see you again, Endmin. Have a nice one.

dialogText.cn: 这是大家都有的奖励？……专门给我的吗？！谢谢您啊，管理员！
dialogText.en: Is everyone getting this?... No? It's just for me? Thank you so much, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 好的好的，之后再见吧，管理员。
dialogText.en: Alright, then. Really hope to see you again, Endmin. Have a nice one.

dialogText.cn: 他因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: He is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，一点微不足道的慰问品……希望你能收下。
dialogText.en: It's just some minor gifts, Endmin... But I hope you can accept them.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，管理员，下回再聊。
dialogText.en: Alright, Endmin. Talk to you next time.

dialogText.cn: 是送给我的？谢谢，我会把它放在保险箱里妥善保管的。
dialogText.en: For me? Thank you so much, Endmin. It shall be secured in a proper safe.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，管理员，下回再聊。
dialogText.en: Alright, Endmin. Talk to you next time.

dialogText.cn: 他因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: He is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我为你申请了一些补给，应该能帮上你的忙。你有时候太过努力了，但其实，依赖一下我和终末地也没什么不好。
dialogText.en: I've requested for a set of supplies on your behalf, Endmin. I hope it can help. There are times when you overwork yourself. But do remember: it is alright to count on me and Endfield Industries.

dialogText.cn: 可以随时再来找我，管理员。
dialogText.en: You are welcome to talk to me anytime, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 非常感谢，管理员，我一定会珍惜的。
dialogText.en: I really appreciate this, Endmin. I shall treasure it well.

dialogText.cn: 可以随时再来找我，管理员。
dialogText.en: You are welcome to talk to me anytime, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 这是我在北方意外得到的……也许对你有用，管理员。
dialogText.en: I stumbled upon this in the north... It might prove useful to you, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 无妨，管理员，剩下的事往后再聊吧。
dialogText.en: Of course, Endministrator. We'll leave the rest for another day.

dialogText.cn: 感谢你的馈赠，管理员。这对我来说亦是一种嘉奖……请收下这个吧，就当是我的回礼。
dialogText.en: Thank you for your gift, Endministrator. I take it as a commendation as well... And please accept this as my token of gratitude.

dialogText.cn: （收到了一颗水果糖，很甜。）
dialogText.en: (Just received a fruit-flavored candy. It is very sweet.)

dialogText.cn: 无妨，管理员，剩下的事往后再聊吧。
dialogText.en: Of course, Endministrator. We'll leave the rest for another day.

dialogText.cn: 他因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: He is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，占用一下您的进程。我……我想感谢您带给我的增益。您……完全没有注意到吗？呼，那太好了……
dialogText.en: Endministrator, may I interrupt your processing for a moment? I ... I would like to offer a token of appreciation for all the boosts you have brought me. Oh ... you have noticed nothing at all? Phew, I'm so relieved...

dialogText.cn: 愿您在之后的旅途中收获启迪。
dialogText.en: May you acquire enlightenment in your travels.

dialogText.cn: 这是一个指示符！噢，抱歉，我有些失态了……真知感谢您的付出。
dialogText.en: This is an indicator! Oh, please forgive my lapse in decorum... Veritas acknowledges your efforts.

dialogText.cn: 愿您在之后的旅途中收获启迪。
dialogText.en: May you acquire enlightenment in your travels.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 别问哪儿来的，收着，我的规矩就是论功行赏，你……你干得不错！
dialogText.en: Don't ask where it's from, just take it. My rule is to reward good work, and you ...  you're pretty good!

dialogText.cn: 走吧走吧，但你下回出门，得把我带上！
dialogText.en: Just go already. And bring me along on your next trip!

dialogText.cn: 哎呀，这怎么好意思……还有吗？再来点儿？
dialogText.en: Aw, you shouldn't have... Got anymore? How about another one?

dialogText.cn: 走吧走吧，但你下回出门，得把我带上！
dialogText.en: Just go already. And bring me along on your next trip!

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你愿意收下这个吗？放心……不是什么奇怪的东西。
dialogText.en: Endmin, will you accept this? Have no fear... There's nothing odd about this thing.

dialogText.cn: 下次也欢迎工作时间找我聊天……嗯。
dialogText.en: And feel free to talk to me during office hours... that'd be nice.

dialogText.cn: 送给我的……？嗯……很感谢……很少有小队以外的人送给我礼物。
dialogText.en: It's for ... me? Well... Thank you... I usually do not receive gifts from people who are not in my team.

dialogText.cn: 下次也欢迎工作时间找我聊天……嗯。
dialogText.en: And feel free to talk to me during office hours... that'd be nice.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 有空吗？上次任务我发现了一些有趣的东西……特意带给管理员的。
dialogText.en: Got a moment, Endmin? I found something interesting on my last mission ... and I brought it for you.

dialogText.cn: ……嗯，先聊到这里。
dialogText.en: Okay... this is it for now.

dialogText.cn: 给我的？谢谢，我会物尽其用的。
dialogText.en: For me? Grazie. I'll put it to good use.

dialogText.cn: ……嗯，先聊到这里。
dialogText.en: Okay... this is it for now.

dialogText.cn: 他因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: He is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这是我得到的战利品！全都送给您！别担心，我还会弄到更多的！
dialogText.en: Endmin, these are the spoils I've collected! They're all for you! Don't worry, I'll get even more!

dialogText.cn: 我还想多和管理员聊一会儿的，管理员不要忘了哦！
dialogText.en: I still want to talk to you some more, Endmin! Don't forget about me!

dialogText.cn: 这是……给我的？我真的可以收下吗？谢谢您，我会好好领会管理员的用意的！
dialogText.en: This is ... for me? Can I really have it? Thank you! I'll make sure to understand the meaning behind your gift!

dialogText.cn: 我还想多和管理员聊一会儿的，管理员不要忘了哦！
dialogText.en: I still want to talk to you some more, Endmin! Don't forget about me!

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 给你准备了点小东西，记得回去后再打开。嘿嘿，我咨询过“专业人士”的意见，你肯定会喜欢！
dialogText.en: Got a little something for you. Open it when you're back at your place. Heh. You're definitely going to like it, 'cos I asked plenty of "professionals" to make sure of that!

dialogText.cn: 拜拜，下次再来找我玩哦！
dialogText.en: Call me again next time! Buh-byez!

dialogText.cn: 谢谢啦！放心，你送的东西，就算是有点丑我也会当宝贝收着！
dialogText.en: Aww, thanks! Don't worry, even if it's a teensy bit weird, I'll still treasure it forever ... because it's from you!

dialogText.cn: 拜拜，下次再来找我玩哦！
