dialogText.en: Call me again next time! Buh-byez!

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 我从宏山述职回来，给你带了些礼物，不是很贵重，但……都是精心挑选过的，希望你能喜欢。
dialogText.en: I've just returned from a work trip to Hongshan and brought you a few gifts. They are modest, but I picked each one with care... I hope you like them.

dialogText.cn: 没关系，等你回来，我们再聊。
dialogText.en: It's alright. We can continue this conversation once you return.

dialogText.cn: 论礼数，我该好好收藏才是，可要是算上私心，不如就放在手边，放在眼前。
dialogText.en: By etiquette, I should put it in proper storage, but personally, I'd rather keep it within reach, where I can see it at all times.

dialogText.cn: 没关系，等你回来，我们再聊。
dialogText.en: It's alright. We can continue this conversation once you return.

dialogText.cn: 她因你收下礼物而开心。
dialogText.en: She is delighted that you accepted the gift.

dialogText.cn: 那就先停下来一会儿！
dialogText.en: Sure! Time for a break, then.

dialogText.cn: 结合能量损耗的情况，休整确实是必要的。
dialogText.en: Given the depletion of energy reserves, resting has become a necessity.

dialogText.cn: 其实不怎么累……但前辈都这么说了，那就休息下吧。
dialogText.en: I'm not that tired... But I guess I'll take a break since you asked me to, Professor.

dialogText.cn: 太好啦，谢谢管理员。
dialogText.en: That'd be awesome! Thank you, Endmin!

dialogText.cn: 终于可以睡个懒觉了吗？
dialogText.en: Nice. An official permit for a beauty sleep.

dialogText.cn: 虽然尚未感到疲惫，但我遵从管理员你的判断。
dialogText.en: Fatigue has yet to touch me, but I shall comply with your judgment, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 哦？你也挺懂我的想法嘛。
dialogText.en: Oh. I guess you know me pretty well.

dialogText.cn: 好啊，那我就歇一会儿吧！
dialogText.en: Alrighty! Time to stretch my legs!

dialogText.cn: 好嘞！听您的吩咐。
dialogText.en: Alright! I hear you loud and clear.

dialogText.cn: 刚有点倦意就放假，今天真是幸运日啊。
dialogText.en: I was feeling a little tired when this recess call arrived. This is my lucky day.

dialogText.cn: 抓紧时间睡一会儿。
dialogText.en: Good. Time for some much needed shuteye.

dialogText.cn: 谢谢管理员，我会劳逸结合的。
dialogText.en: Thanks, Endmin. I'll look out for work-life balance.

dialogText.cn: 行吧。我需要找一个足够安静的地方。
dialogText.en: Okay. Now I need to find a place that's quiet enough.

dialogText.cn: 咦？！这不会算我偷懒……吧？
dialogText.en: Wha?! This doesn't count as slacking off ... right?

dialogText.cn: 啊？这就要休息了？
dialogText.en: Ah? Rest? Really? Now?

dialogText.cn: 我还不……好吧，是该调整下状态了。
dialogText.en: I'm not... Fine. I need to get adjusted a little.

dialogText.cn: 已经到这个时间了吗？那就稍微休息一下……
dialogText.en: Is it that time already? Fine. I'll rest for a while...

dialogText.cn: 到休整时间了？多谢提醒。
dialogText.en: Break time already? Appreciate the reminder.

dialogText.cn: 好的，我将进入低功耗状态。
dialogText.en: Command accepted. I shall enter low-power hibernation promptly.

dialogText.cn: 可算能歇歇了，要累死你大当家了……
dialogText.en: Phew. Finally, a break. Your Supreme Chief is totally exhausted...

dialogText.cn: 呵啊——等这一刻好久了。
dialogText.en: Hur... Been waiting for this for a while.

dialogText.cn: 稍作休息下？我知道了。
dialogText.en: A short break? Got it.

dialogText.cn: 我还可以继续的！不过，既然是管理员的要求……
dialogText.en: I can keep going! But if this is your request, Endmin...

dialogText.cn: 嗯——确实该歇会儿了。
dialogText.en: Yeeaaah — I guess it's really time for a break.

dialogText.cn: 劳逸结合，确实也该停停了。
dialogText.en: Indeed. Resting will be good for work-life balance.

dialogText.cn: 我好喜欢收集五颜六色、不同香味的唇彩，这样说出来的话语，是不是也会变得五彩斑斓呢？
dialogText.en: I just love collecting lipsticks of all sorts of colors and flavors. I can't help but wonder if they add sparkling hues and tints to our words?

dialogText.cn: 塔罗斯赋予了塔卫二天空绚丽的颜色，看着那些不期而遇的光华一闪而过……管理员，你不觉得这是一件很浪漫的事情吗？
dialogText.en: Talos adds a brilliant spectrum of colors to the sky of Talos-II. Those unexpected spectacles with flashes of radiance... Aren't they simply romantic, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，看我带回来了什么？好多好看的小彩灯！还有巫术时刻的特制小香薰。我们可以一起布置一下管理员的房间，等到晚上，周围就会变得像夜空一样璀璨！一起去试试吧！
dialogText.en: Look at what I brought, Endmin! Mini-lamps with all sorts of colors PLUS a little incense burner from Witching Hour. I'm thinking if we could ... use them to decorate your cabin together, Endmin? Once the lights are off, your place will be as brilliant as the starry night! Come on, what do you say?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我在想，为什么小说里的角色总是会把心事藏起来？发不出的邀请、送不出的信、说不出的话语……明明那么简单，却迟迟不敢传达……我就可以轻松地邀请管理员出门，送出好玩的礼物……究竟是哪里不一样呢……
dialogText.en: Hmm... Characters in novels keep hiding their feelings. Why? There were so many invitations they failed to deliver, so many letters they failed to send, and so many things they failed to say... It's so obviously simple but they just couldn't find the courage to convey their feelings... Now I could easily invite you to an adventure or give you fun prezzies... I wonder where the difference is?

dialogText.cn: 秋栗小姐送给了我一枚很特别的护身符，说是只要一直带在身边，总有一天愿望就会实现。我的愿望嘛……我希望每一个交给我信件的人，都能实现自己所写下的愿望！嘿嘿，这样是不是有一点贪心了？
dialogText.en: Miss Akekuri gave me this special talisman. She told me that my wishes will eventually come true if I carry it around with me. Now, I wish that ... everyone who hires me for a letter delivery will have their wishes fulfilled! Heheh! I hope this wish doesn't sound too greedy!

dialogText.cn: 我总是会梦见曾经见到过的景色，在那些梦幻而又模糊的影子背后，总是有着一个人的身影，静静地站在远处，像是在等一个人，或是在等一封信。最近，我觉得那个身影似乎变得越来越清晰，像是身边某个熟悉的人……
dialogText.en: I always dream about the places I've seen. And amidst my blurry dreamscapes, there's always a figure standing in silence, as though waiting for a person ... or a letter. Recently, I've been getting a clearer view of that figure — and it's someone whom I'm ... pretty familiar with.

dialogText.cn: 我能检查一下您的武器吗，管理员？嗯，除了零件有些许磨损，别的没有太大问题，只需替换一个新的精密源石元件就行。没什么麻烦的，在Z7小队，我一直都这么做。
dialogText.en: May I inspect your weaponry, Endmin? Hmm. The only issue I see is the wearing down of certain components. Replacing a single precision Originium component will fix it. This repair job won't be much trouble. I offer this service for every individual in Team Z7.

dialogText.cn: 我在观察帝江号，它无疑是工程设计的巅峰，每一部分都极有学习和研究价值，中枢控制系统、协议网络节点与生命维持系统等等，我甚至已经构思好了下篇论文的选题。
dialogText.en: My studies of Dijiang reveal that she is a pinnacle of engineering. Central Control, the Protorig Network Node, Life Support systems, and various parts of the vessel offer ample opportunities of learning. It has granted me the structure for my next thesis.

dialogText.cn: 我根据萤石的经历想到一个冷笑话：收到敌人的威胁信息该怎么办？答案是退订。您笑了，证明它有效果，那为什么其他人没有这样的反馈？
dialogText.en: I have a joke based on Fluorite's personal experiences. How should one respond to a threatening message from an antagonist? Answer: Unsubscribe. You laugh. This joke is proven humorous. But why didn't the others laugh as you did?

dialogText.cn: 情绪持续低迷的话，可以跟我一起去室外享受自然日光浴，阳光会刺激大脑释放血清素，能有效驱散一定的负面情绪。以前，学院附近有一个喷泉公园，安静、日光充足，只要感到疲惫我就会去那儿休息。
dialogText.en: If your emotions are cold, join me in the outdoors. Solar radiation induces cerebral serotonin secretion that alleviates negative emotions. There was a fountain park near my Academy, one that offered serenity and plenty of solar exposure. When I studied in the Academy, the park was my resting grounds in moments of exhaustion.

dialogText.cn: 我昨天收到了奶奶的回信，她对我信中频繁提到的一个人很感兴趣，也就是您。她有句话让我代为传达：“您也看到了，这孩子有些较真，但本质不坏，还麻烦您多多担待，有机会真想找您喝杯茶，再聊聊他小时候的事。”
dialogText.en: My grandmother's reply arrived yesterday. She seems rather interested in a particular individual that I repeatedly mentioned in my letters to her. I shall relay her message to the said individual, which happens to be you, Endmin: "You should know by now that a certain young Savra may be quite stubborn, albeit in a good-natured way. Please bear with him. I hope to share some tea with you and tell you more about how I raised that little scaley kid."

dialogText.cn: 很多人会站在帝江号上眺望塔卫二，我也尝试过这么做，但发现除了提供给我不同的观察角度，似乎没能像他们一样去怀念家乡，也许是因为奶奶的关系吧。她总是告诉我：“不必沉浸于过去，你该去追寻更广阔的未来。”
dialogText.en: Many people gaze upon Talos-II from the decks of Dijiang. I did the same and though it offered a novel perspective, I did not share the nostalgia they felt. Perhaps my grandmother is to blame. She taught me: "Do not obsess about the past. Seek and broaden your future."

dialogText.cn: 维护中的帝江号到处都有警示牌……前辈可要小心些。我在思考时也经常不看路，总是会不小心摔倒。
dialogText.en: Be careful when walking around Dijiang, Professor... There are all sorts of warning signs aboard the ship and ... and I keep tripping over them. I just couldn't notice them when I'm thinking about things.

dialogText.cn: 从帝江号上能看到很多我曾勘查过的地方，荒野、草原、北地……都变得很小很小，那些我曾走过的漫长的路，现在一眼就能望到尽头……而且站在这么高的地方，感觉稍微有点刺激。
dialogText.en: I can see plenty of sites that I personally prospected from aboard Dijiang... The wildlands, the prairies, and the north seem so small from this place. The view from orbit easily covers all those lengthy field trips I took... Gotta say, it's kinda exciting being up here — tee-hee!

dialogText.cn: 我明天要举办一场读书会，前辈有空参加吗？该分享些什么？只要是自己喜欢的书都行！说起来，卡拉德先生曾经给我带过一本关于塔卫二火山的摄影杂志。感兴趣的话，我可以带给您看！
dialogText.en: Professor, interested in the reading group I'm organizing tomorrow? What are we sharing? Oh, it can be anything you like reading! Speaking of which, Mr. Krad once brought a photo magazine about the volcanoes of Talos-II. I'll bring it to the reading group if you're interested!

dialogText.cn: 工作这么久，前辈饿不饿？这是秋栗小姐送我的东国特产甜点，您尝尝看。不用分给我，我……我刚才已经吃过啦。可是包装没拆？因、因为秋栗小姐又多给了我一份！
dialogText.en: You must be hungry after all that work, Professor! Try these. They're Higashinese snacks that Miss Akekuri gave me. Uh, I don't need any, actually, because ... I-I had some already. Why is this unopened? Ah, umm... Miss Akekuri gave me a-another box!

dialogText.cn: 您有注意到吗，前辈？队伍里，您总是走得最快的那个，好像前方总有什么危险等着我们，您已准备好挺身迎击，有时我需要小跑才能跟上您……放轻松，我们会照顾好自己。
dialogText.en: Haven't you noticed, Professor? You're always out in the front, like you're trying to shield us from whatever danger's ahead. Sometimes, I even had to jog a little just to keep up with you. Maybe ... you don't have to go so fast. We're right here with you — and we want to help too.

dialogText.cn: 每次回到帝江号都感觉很放松，除了和同事们交流外出时的见闻，我还会去看培养舱里的植物，不忙的时候我也会帮忙照顾它们。这算是我小小的爱好吧，看着植株一点点长大，感觉很欣慰呢。
dialogText.en: Every trip back to Dijiang is so relaxing. When I'm not sharing stories of my trip with my colleagues, I'll visit the Growth Chambers and see how the little plants are doing. I'll even give them some tender loving care if I have time to spare. It's a little hobby of mine. It feels so fulfilling seeing them grow.

dialogText.cn: 每次来帝江号都能学到很多新东西：没见过的技术设备，特别的作战思路，大胆的监测方案……真的是数都数不过来！嗯，终末地果然好厉害！
dialogText.en: I learn tons of new stuff every time I step aboard Dijiang: There's tech and machinery that I've never seen before, special combat theories, bold monitoring plans... Oh, I can barely keep pace with everything! Endfield is just awesome! And I mean it!

dialogText.cn: 什么？帝江号食堂的点心是不限量供应的吗？！啊，抱歉，我只是稍微有些吃惊……没、没打算一口气全吃完的！真的！
dialogText.en: What? The Dijiang canteen has an all-you-can-eat snackbar?! Ah, apologies. I was just a little surprised... No, of course not! I'm not going to eat everything! Honest!

dialogText.cn: 管理员你来得正好！我刚好收到了之前采购的食材，要不要来试试我亲手做的奶酪火锅呀？……唔，口味应该算比较特别的吧？好多吃了的同事都说是种“终生难忘的味道”……
dialogText.en: Endmin! You came at just the right time! My package just arrived and I wonder if you're interested in trying out my special cheese fondue? The flavor...? I think it's quite ... special? Plenty of my colleagues told me it's an "unforgettable experience of a lifetime"...

dialogText.cn: 嘿咻！伸展四肢，活动关节。这套热身运动不仅有助于预防拉伤，在极地环境下也能降低失温风险哦，管理员，来一起试试吧？没关系，我当过培训课的助教，会帮你调整姿势的！——你看，很简单吧？
dialogText.en: Hnnnggghh! Stretching will help limber up the joints. This routine can help prevent muscle tears and keep hypothermia at bay in polar environments. Wanna give it a go? Don't worry. I've been an assistant coach in the training sessions, so I can definitely get your posture right! — See? Easy, right?

dialogText.cn: 每次遇到小道奇教官，我就会想起我们的队长。他也是个佩洛，虽然平时很好说话，但到了救援行动的时候，他总是要求最严格的那个，连热水钻头的直径都会反复确认……“救援无小事”的道理就是他教给我的。
dialogText.en: Lil' Dodge reminds me of our captain every time I see him. My captain's also a Perro. He's a really nice guy — but once an SAR mission begins, he turns into super bossy-boots. He even makes us do multiple caliber checks on the hot water drill bit... "Every tiny detail matters in SAR!" That's what I've learned from him.

dialogText.cn: 塔卫二云层上的光真的很漂亮，很像我印象里的“极光”……如同梦中的景色。我常在北方雪峰的最高处望见它们，虽然知道那是危险的超域能量，却总觉得像遇到了一个老朋友，在遥远的地方注视着我，守护着我……
dialogText.en: The light reflecting off the clouds of Talos-II can be so beautiful. It reminds me of the aurora I know ... and the visions of my dreams. I often see them when I'm atop the highest peaks of the northern snowy mountains. I know the light is a form of dangerous Æther energy, but seeing it felt like meeting an old friend... One who watches me ... and protects me from afar...

dialogText.cn: 管理员，又见面了，你还像五分钟前那么可爱呢。
dialogText.en: Hey, Endmin, good to see ya again. And yep, you're still rocking that charm — just like five minutes ago, huh?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，这艘帝江号是你的心血？真厉害，光是在天上漂一会儿，就走完了我几年的路途！
dialogText.en: I must say, you've really poured your heart into crafting Dijiang. It's incredible — just floating up here for a bit, and it's already covered the distance that took me years to travel.

dialogText.cn: 你脸上沾着的是什么？不对，在右边……哈哈，逗你的。不常见到你这么迷茫的样子呢！
dialogText.en: What's that on your face? Uh-uh, other side... Haha, just messing with you. It's rare to see you all flustered like this!

dialogText.cn: 站在舰桥上才感受到，塔卫二是一颗大圆球。这样的话，不论往哪里走，都会重逢呢。
dialogText.en: Y'know, Talos-II really looks like one giant sphere from up here on the Bridge. Guess that means no matter where we travel, we'll always circle back to each other.

dialogText.cn: 我马上又要到地面上去旅行啦，要给你带点儿什么回来？快想想，我走得很急哦！
dialogText.en: I'm off on another adventure! Need somethin'? Spit it out quick, or you'll have to wait till next time!

dialogText.cn: 昨晚的恐怖电影没有吓着你吧？……看来还是没有找到一部能挑战到我们胆量的片子！唔，那么，下次再叫上你。
dialogText.en: Still standing after last night's horror flick? Tsk, guess I'll have to up the stakes next time. Don't worry, I'll drag you into the next one too!

dialogText.cn: 帝江号的各项功能都很完备，但终究不是战舰……没有常时备战的流程，多少让我有些不习惯。
dialogText.en: Dijiang is a vessel furnished with various amenities, but she's not built for war. Her absence of constant operational readiness is something I'm still adjusting to.

dialogText.cn: 铁誓军的日常训练？唔……当时我能独自处理一个“欧墨萨隆”集群，所以长官直接让新兵们组队挑战我。
dialogText.en: Training at the Order? Hmm... Back then, I could take on an entire Homoiossaron cluster alone, so my commander would send full squads of new recruits to fight me.

dialogText.cn: 那片极光下方，就是铁誓军的防线。战事发生时，天使常常遮天蔽日，我们的航天母舰和护航机群也——等等，这个山脉的走向……抱歉，我……我好像认错位置了。
dialogText.en: Beneath the aurora lie the defense lines of the Oathkeepers. When battle erupted, the skies would be blanketed with swarms of hovering Aggeloi. Of course, our battlecarriers and escort aircraft would also — wait, why is the mountain range running this way... Sorry, I might have ... misidentified the location.

dialogText.cn: 我所在的陷阵旗队经常从高空跳进战区，为此还会进行针对性训练。不过到了这个高度，连距离的概念都变模糊了。
dialogText.en: High-altitude drops into warzones are standard for my unit. Yet, up here, the very idea of altitude starts to fade.

dialogText.cn: 这里的干员们是很好的切磋对象，各位不仅重视战场协作，在策略制定上也很有创新意识，让我获益良多。铁誓军不会停止自我改进，我不能掉队。
dialogText.en: The operators here make excellent sparring partners. They value battlefield coordination and show great creativity in developing strategies. I've learned a lot from them. As an Oathkeeper, I must keep pace and never stop improving myself.

dialogText.cn: 情报办公室向我开放了一些终末地的行动记录。就算不在正面战场，同样有这么多人为理念奉献了生命……或许他们不曾有过怨言，但我还是忍不住会想，该怎么做才能让这样的“英雄”更少一些？
dialogText.en: The Intel Office granted me access to some mission logs. So many gave their lives for what they believed in, even without ever setting foot on the battlefield. Maybe they had no regrets, but I find myself pondering: what can we do to prevent such sacrifices from happening so often?

dialogText.cn: 嗯……真难得，不像是找我出任务呢。
dialogText.en: Well ... this is new. No tasks for me today?

dialogText.cn: 秋栗她笑着进训练室了？还拿着剑？好，那我再躲一会儿……
dialogText.en: Did Akekuri just stroll into the training room, grinning ... with a sword? Guess I'll stay out of her sight for a bit longer...

dialogText.cn: 第一次摸到铳的时候，我连怎么打开它的弹巢都不知道，但对面已经冲上来好几人了……和开拓区比起来，这里的训练很温柔呢。
dialogText.en: The first time I picked up a gun, I didn't even know how to open the chamber. With a bunch of guys charging at me, it wasn't like I had a choice... Honestly, this training's a breeze compared to the chaos back in the frontier.

dialogText.cn: 我们小队这几位要不是刚好凑在一起，能惹的麻烦大概要多好几倍。放心，我当然会帮你看着他们啦。
dialogText.en: If it wasn't for pure luck that we ended up in the same team, we'd be doubling the trouble. But don't worry, I'll keep them in check.

dialogText.cn: 小时候，我们几个小鬼会在驮兽车上晒着太阳睡一整天，这样肚子才不容易饿……我没在抱怨员工福利，只是飞得这么高，不多晒晒太阳就可惜了。
dialogText.en: When we were kids, we'd sleep all day on the burdenbeasts, sunbathing so we wouldn't feel hungry... Not that I'm complaining about the perks; I just think it'd be a shame not to soak up a little sunshine at this altitude.

dialogText.cn: 你和佩丽卡监督一样，让人讨厌不起来呢。开拓区的“大人物”们只会揪着排场和面子不放，可就算没有那些东西，大家也愿意跟着真正的领袖，对吧？
dialogText.en: You're like Supervisor Perlica — can't really hate you. The big shots out in the frontier love clinging to their status and pride, but honestly, people will follow a real leader, with or without all that.

dialogText.cn: ……哇！差点没看到你，管理员！嘿嘿，刚才我在琢磨新想到的剑招，没看路。
dialogText.en: Woah! I almost didn't see you, Endmin! Heheh, yeah. I was trying to perfect a new move and didn't see where I was going.

dialogText.cn: 离开宏山的时候可没想到自己会天天待在这——么高的地方。这样一看，塔卫二也很渺小呢。不知道我和我的剑，最终能抵达哪里……塔罗斯有可能吗，管理员？
dialogText.en: I never expected to be somewhere *THIS* high in orbit after leaving Hongshan. Talos-II actually looks pretty small from where we're standing. I wonder where me and my blade could reach... Talos, maybe? Watchu think, Endmin?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，之前借给你的武侠传记你有看吗？小说？不不不，那可不是小说，都是真实发生在大炎过去的故事哦！“以指为剑”很难想象？的确呢……不过“拳定春秋”更离谱吧？
dialogText.en: Endmin! Did you read that martial arts legend I lent you? No, no, no, it's not a novel. It's based on things that really happened at Yan! What? You can't picture someone whose "fingers can cut like blades"? Oh... You make a good point... But the "fists that settled the tides of Spring and Autumn" are even worse, right?

dialogText.cn: 我？哎哟——在放松肌肉呢。来到终末地之后，光是每天出任务，体能训练量就能达标了！要不……我也帮你松松？我可是知道几个穴位哦！来嘛来嘛，把外套脱了，别客气！
dialogText.en: What am I doing? OW! Ugh. I'm trying to loosen my muscles. Being an Endfielder and running all these missions took me way beyond my daily PT quota... Hey, interested in loosening up a bit? I actually know a few meridians! Come on! Off with that jacket! And you're welcome!

dialogText.cn: 我正要去武库取剑，一起吗？说起来，我本来想在剑柄上刻字来着，只是一直没想好刻“当破即破”还是“当断即断”……管理员，你帮我出出主意呗！
dialogText.en: Join me on a trip to the Arsenal! I got a sword to claim. What should I engrave on the hilt? "Cleave now as cleft" or "Once known be deft"? Endmin, puh-lease help me decide!

dialogText.cn: 最近经常感觉到有一些瓶颈呢。和技术无关，总觉得是心情方面的问题。传说有一些神兵利器就是会根据主人心境的变化而变化的……可我这只是普通的剑啊！管理员，帮帮忙嘛。
dialogText.en: I recently ran into a bottleneck. Ugh. It's got nothing to do with technique and I think something's bugging me from the inside. The legends say that the finest weapons will adapt to their wielders' mind... But ... but this is just an ordinary piece of steel! Endmin! Puh-lease help me out with this!

dialogText.cn: 您可看着又瘦了。这节骨眼儿上您更该对自己多上上心，要不给您开点小灶？
dialogText.en: You lost weight again. Please, take better care of your health. Want me to cook something?

dialogText.cn: 嗬，帝江号之前的伙食总是不得劲儿。您先甭反驳我，今天我掌勺，弄了点新鲜的，您先尝尝！
dialogText.en: Hrrmph. The Dijiang cafeteria wasn't hitting the right place. Don't disagree yet. Try this. I cooked it myself!

dialogText.cn: 听说您刚批评了那些对我说话刺了点的晚辈？其实不碍事，天师也好，厨子也罢，我听着都开心。帝江号上也难得有愿意找我聊天的同事了。
dialogText.en: Heard you talked to the youths who disagreed with me. It's alright. I don't care if they're Tianshi or chefs. Not everyone aboard Dijiang has the time to share a few words with an old panda.

dialogText.cn: 我在帝江号上看到不少宏山科学院的技术，院里轨道技术专家们的心血都真切摆在我眼前——您保管想象不出那个场面，几位老师为了一个小自检模块该搁哪儿都能吵个天昏地暗。
dialogText.en: I see plenty of Academy tech aboard Dijiang. Actual pieces of hard work carried out by the HAS orbital tech experts — You definitely can't picture this bunch of loud, angry codgers! They'll start wars about where to place a tiny diagnostic module!

dialogText.cn: 不是驳您面子，终末地的宿舍不够大呀！早上我伸个懒腰，胳膊和膝盖就都磕青了。您给想想法子！
dialogText.en: Endfield dorm rooms aren't big enough! No disrespect, but I just did a morning stretch and ended up bruising my elbows and knees. PLEASE! Do something!

dialogText.cn: 您要见到安德烈，就替我招呼一句——我还等着听他的新思路呢！他怎么还躲着我啊？
dialogText.en: If you see Andre, tell the Big Owl that — he owes an Old Panda his latest ideas! AND tell him to stop hiding from me!

dialogText.cn: 接下来应该没什么事了吧。待会儿有个钓鳞节目重播，我赶着去看。
dialogText.en: Nothing's left on the schedule? Great. Time to catch that angling show rerun.

dialogText.cn: 那片被冰雪覆盖的区域就是北地吧？不是来终末地的话，我可能永远见不到这种风景。虽然刚来帝江号那会儿，往舷窗外看有点心慌，但适应之后，这种在空中看塔卫二的感觉还挺奇妙的嘛！
dialogText.en: That place. Yeah. That one all covered in snow. It's the north, right? I would not be seeing this if I never joined Endfield. When I first got on Dijiang, the view from the Bridge was almost too much to take in. Now that I'm used to it, looking down at Talos-II from up here feels pretty magical.

dialogText.cn: 我的作战实力？只是拿剑胡乱挥砍的水平，野路子罢了。如果你曾经砍过三米长的牙兽、会动的藤蔓、钢铁构成的天使和欠钱不还的“好兄弟”，你也可以掌握这样的“剑法”。
dialogText.en: My combat skills? I just swing the sword around and hope it hurts something real bad, boss. But you can also learn my special skill after fighting giant Tuskbeasts, man-eating vines, full metal Aggeloi, and dudes who owe you serious money.

dialogText.cn: 人啊，到了这个年纪就会对很多东西失去兴趣，钓鳞算是我唯一可以逃避现实的方式了。我还年轻？你说什么呢，我可比你……呃。管理员，你到底算多大？
dialogText.en: You see, folks my age get bored of a lot of things. Angling's the only escape I've got left from all this grim reality. Wha? I'm still young? Cut the buggerloid crap, I'm way older... Wait, Endmin. How old are you again?

dialogText.cn: 我在看一本书，讲的都是些小人物的故事。其实我不太关注里面那些生存的意义啊，人性的挣扎啊这些东西。我只是觉得写这本书的人，似乎真的经历过类似的事。怎么突然这副表情？我只是钦佩他而已，真的真的！
dialogText.en: I've been flipping through this book about common folks. Y'know, stuff like survival and humanity's struggle doesn't usually interest me... But I feel the author is like ... like someone who actually lived the life. Ai, what's wrong? Why so serious all of a sudden? Relax, Boss. I'm just saying I admire the author, that's all.

dialogText.cn: 我唯一的优点，大概就是生命力比较顽强吧，受多重的伤也不会倒下，因为心里有很多重要的人——过去的朋友、房东老头......现在还有你们。无论如何，我都要爬起来继续战斗的。
dialogText.en: Being hard to kill is probably my only advantage. I got hit real bad a couple of times, but there were too many people I might miss — like my buddies, the old landlord ... and you guys as well. The thought alone always makes me crawl back up for round two.

dialogText.cn: 修摩托车就像给瘤兽看病一样，都需要仔细倾听，然后给出回应。
dialogText.en: Repairing an iron steed is like treating a cystybeast. One must listen closely before administering the treatment.

dialogText.cn: 这里的星空，与荒野不同……但同样让人想一直看下去。
dialogText.en: The stars here are different from what we see from the wildlands... But both vantages are equally enthralling.

dialogText.cn: 我在看那些云团，边缘很锋利，是暴风雨的预兆。近期如果要去那一带，请务必小心。
dialogText.en: I am studying those clouds. Their sharp edges herald a storm. Be wary if your next mission takes you down there.

dialogText.cn: 你的头发很漂亮，像被晨雾打湿的兽皮。没见过？总之……很好看。
dialogText.en: Your hair is lovely, like beast hide wet with the dew of dawn. You've never seen it? Well, it's just beautiful.

dialogText.cn: 你见过草原上的迁徙吗？篷车驱赶着兽群，缓缓追逐着雨和云。那就是我想守护的东西。
dialogText.en: Ever seen the Prairie Migrations? An army of beasts and wagons chasing the rain and clouds. Such are the things I wish to protect.

dialogText.cn: 你常常对着这颗星球出神，我想，我能理解。即使距离再远，我们的心也总会留在最牵挂的地方。
dialogText.en: You often lose yourself gazing upon this world. I think I know how you feel. Our hearts always yearn for places we care for, no matter how far away they may be.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您好呀！我是秋栗，隶属于重建不久的Z7行动组……没关系，虽然现在我们的工作并不起眼，但很快就会让您记住的。
dialogText.en: Nice to meet you, Endministrator. I'm Akekuri from Operation Team Z7. Oh, it's okay! We may be newly reformed and flying under the radar for now, but I promise — we're going to make our mark.

dialogText.cn: 他们都说管理员是从终末地建立至今，一直以来的领导者……没想到竟然这么有亲和力。我懂我懂，这也是体现领导力的一环。
dialogText.en: Knowing you've been guiding Endfield since day one, I thought you'd be a lot stricter. But you're more easygoing than I expected — heehee, I guess that's part of what makes a true leader!

dialogText.cn: 比起新都筑的“高端场合”，还是帝江号的大厅更适合我。在这里，每个人显得那么轻松，而且做的事情远比那些“商业精英”们有意义。
dialogText.en: I must say, I'd much rather be here in Dijiang than at those so-called "fancy events" run by the business elites in Neo Tsukushi. People here are way more relaxed and actually making a real impact.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，您尝过“生八桥”吗？那是一种东国风格的甜点，有红豆、抹茶，还有烤栗子味的。想试试的话，下次可以列席Z7行动组的行动部署会哦。
dialogText.en: Have you ever had nama yatsuhashi? It's a traditional Higashi sweet with red beans, matcha, and roasted chestnut flavor. If you're up for it, come along to the next Z7 team meeting.

dialogText.cn: 来，管理员，这里有热红茶，坐下来，听我们讲讲这次任务的见闻吧。
dialogText.en: Hey, Endmin. Wanna sit down for a cup of hot tea? We've got cool stories from the mission to share!

dialogText.cn: 我喜欢在帝江号的舰桥眺望塔卫二，这里能看到我长大的地方、家人最后踏足的地方，还有被管理员改变过的地方——别惊讶，星球地理学和近代史我都拿了A+。
dialogText.en: I love looking up at Talos-II from the Bridge. It's got all my memories — where I grew up, where my family last was, and the places you've changed. Hey, what's with the surprise face? I totally got A+ in planetary geology and modern history!

dialogText.cn: 为什么在这里无所事事？出发，去舰桥，把你过去的足迹和未来的目的地都指给我看。
dialogText.en: Why are you idling here? C'mon, let's go to the Bridge. Then you can tell me all about the places you went in the past, and the destinations you have in store for the future.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……我为食堂有无限量供应的冰淇淋，向后勤部门表达崇高的敬意。要帮你拿一份吗？
dialogText.en: Mmmm... I hereby offer my utmost appreciation to the Logistics Division for the all-you-can-eat ice cream bar. Need me to grab a few scoops for you?

dialogText.cn: 待会儿有任务要去处理，一起？不，不用协议传送，我更喜欢用降落舱，带着火焰和呼啸直接砸到他们头上。
dialogText.en: I got a mission. Wanna come with? No, no need for tele-protocol. I prefer the drop pod. I'm going in a deafening howl of fire, right on top of their heads.

dialogText.cn: 感觉有点冷？是我要求把温控度数调低的，谁让这艘船连露天吹风的地方都没有。要是受不了的话，就站得离我近点儿。
dialogText.en: Cold? I told them to lower the thermostat, because some dummy built this ship and forgot to leave a spot for fresh air. If you can't take the cold, stand a little closer.

dialogText.cn: 空闲的时候，我能边吃冰淇淋边盯着外面看一整天。脑海里有成百上千段记忆，却没有哪一段是从这个角度看着大地与星空的。
dialogText.en: When I have nothing to do, I would just eat ice cream and enjoy the view outside. I can do that all day. My mind is filled with countless fragments of shattered memories. Yet none of them gave me a look of the world or starry nights from this angle.

dialogText.cn: 还被困在回忆里？哼，想不起来就别想了。记住接下来发生的事情。
dialogText.en: Still trapped in your memories? Hmph. If they're gone, they're gone. Just remember what happens from here on.

dialogText.cn: 自信大方……自信大方……嘿！管理员！……今、今天的餐后甜点很棒呢！
dialogText.en: I can do this. It's just one line. Yes, be confident! Hey, Endmin...!!! D-d-de-de-dessert's ... g-g-grrr-great today, right?

dialogText.cn: 好多人啊，要是他们搭话……果、果然还是储物箱比较适合我吧？
dialogText.en: Oh no ... it's so crowded... W-what if someone comes up to me? I should just go curl up in a crate...

dialogText.cn: 您、您知道哪里可以申请报损吗？我又把训练室砸坏了……
dialogText.en: W-wo-would you happen to know where we can report damages? I ... uh ... smashed the training cabin ... again...

dialogText.cn: 呜……能扶我一下吗，我想去拿点压缩饼干……没事，我就是……有点……肚子饿……
dialogText.en: Hngh... C-could I lean on you for a sec...? I just need to grab some hardtack... I-I'm okay... Just a little ... hungry...

dialogText.cn: 随身听、万用工具箱、简易施术单元……啊，这是购物清单啦。有些东西在我老家挺难买的，后勤办事处有几位前辈肯帮我顺路捎一些，他们人实在太好了！
dialogText.en: Personal stereo, omni-toolkit, basic Arts Unit... Ah, it's just a shopping list. These things are really hard to get in my hometown. Thankfully, a few colleagues at the Logistics Office offered to pick them up along the way. They're so nice to me!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我能在帝江号上发小广告吗？塞什卡给我塞了好多推广任务，再不完成的话，又要被抓去特训了……
dialogText.en: Endmin ... can I ... post some flyers in Dijiang? Seš'qa gave me a load of promotional work. If I don't meet my KPI, they'll drag me back for special training...

dialogText.cn: 咳……这种时候应该怎么说话呢……管理员，终末地正式干员黎风向您问好。
dialogText.en: Uh ... what should I say in a moment like this... Lifeng, official operator of Endfield Industries. It's an honor to meet you.

dialogText.cn: 啊，你刚才就瞧见我了？……我没有在这里等任务啊，没有，嘿嘿……
dialogText.en: Oh, you saw me just now and wonder why I'm still here? Uh ... I'm totally not waiting for a mission. Hehe, not at all!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你还认识别的阿纳萨吗？我们这一支好久以前就生活在城市里了，但我听说还有一些族人留在荒野里……下次你见到和我不一样的阿纳萨，叫我去看看！
dialogText.en: Endmin, do you know any other Anasa? My branch of the family has lived in the city for ages, but I've heard that other branches still live in the wilds. If you happen to come across them, please let me know so I can pay them a visit!

dialogText.cn: 其实我……会晕车，连武陵那种动力五轮车我都吃不消。但是在帝江号上站着，还真没感觉到自己在动呢。
dialogText.en: Actually ... I get carsick pretty easily. Even riding a five-wheeler at Wuling would make me queasy. But for some reason, I don't feel any motion at all on Dijiang.

dialogText.cn: 用帝江号上的望远镜真的能看到息壤堰啊！就是很小，好像两根手指头就能夹起来……没想到那么大的东西，换个角度看就变得这么渺小。唔，我得去琢磨琢磨。
dialogText.en: I can actually see the Xiranite Dam through Dijiang's telescope! It looks so tiny from here, like I could pinch it between two fingers... Amazing how a change in perspective makes something huge seem small. Mmm, I need to ponder on this.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，培养舱里的植物，一直都是有人专门照顾的吧？……有意思，它们竟然能在离地面这么远的地方生长。不过，我也没想到我会在这儿就是了。
dialogText.en: Endmin, there's someone looking after the plants in the growth chambers, right? Ooh... It's amazing to think they can thrive here, a place so far above the ground. But hey, I didn't think I'd be here either.

dialogText.cn: 管理员？有事找我？嗯，我今天不算忙，就是半小时后需要连上五堂剑术训练课……剩下的时间都挺空的。
dialogText.en: You're looking for me, Endmin? Well, I got thirty minutes before five back-to-back sessions of swordfighting... And I'll be free for the rest of the time.

dialogText.cn: 根据大家的建议，最近我又改良了一版野炊浓汤……管理员，有空你可以来尝尝。
dialogText.en: I have recently reviewed everyone's suggestions and improved my wildlands stew recipe... Feel free to give it a taste if you're curious, Endmin.

dialogText.cn: 每次回到帝江号，我都觉得有种莫名的安心感……安塔尔坚称这和宿舍床铺的舒适程度脱不开关系，当然，这点我不打算反驳。
dialogText.en: Whenever I return to Dijiang, I always get this sense of comfort and relaxation that I could hardly describe... Antal insists that it was the coziness of the dorm mattresses... Of course, I don't intend to disagree with him.

dialogText.cn: 在任务中，我会无条件信任Z7的每个队友。但要我相信他们会听队长的话回来乖乖休息？那还是算了。估计不是在图书室废寝忘食，就是在娱乐室捉弄新人……必须要我亲自“送”他们回宿舍才行。
dialogText.en: I have complete faith in my teammates during missions. Yet, I have zero faith that they will heed the Captain's orders and get proper R&R afterwards. One would stay up all night at the library, and another would be pulling pranks on raw recruits at the game room... Such nonsense can only end when I personally "escort" them back to their cabins.

dialogText.cn: 前两天我回了趟老家，虽然家里人依然不太能接受我现在的工作，但我还是跟他们讲了不少在Z7的经历。他们没多说什么，只是临走前多给我塞了好几袋特产，大概是够Z7全员吃半年的量……管理员，回头我也分你半袋吧。
dialogText.en: I paid my family a visit two days ago. They don't really like my career choice but I told them what Team Z7 was really like. They didn't say much to that, except giving me a few rucksacks of local specialties. Z7 would need six months to go through all that... Endmin, I think you should get half a sack as well.

dialogText.cn: 每天都很充实，每天都感觉自己被很多人需要着……这些应该是来到终末地后我最大的感受。即使时不时会累到睡不着，我也不认为是什么坏事，因为对我而言，这也算一种“认可”。
dialogText.en: Life is very fulfilling. I actually feel useful and everyone actually appreciates it... That's what being an Endfielder means to me. There are occasions where I get too exhausted to sleep, but I take that in stride. It only means that I've earned someone's approval.

dialogText.cn: 自从管理员醒来以后，帝江号每天都在变得更有活力……我很期待未来的日子，管理员。
dialogText.en: Since your awakening, Dijiang is becoming a livelier place with every passing day... And this makes me hopeful for the future, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你的气色好多了。如果还有什么需要，可以随时找我。
dialogText.en: You're looking much better, Endmin. Feel free to talk to me if there's anything you need.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，你的需求是最优先的。我可以把其他事情先放下……或是交给菲奥娜去办。
dialogText.en: Your needs are our top priority, Endmin. To see them met, I'll gladly set aside other tasks ... or ask Fiona to handle them.

dialogText.cn: 中央环厅总是这么繁忙，这意味着一种责任。百余年来，一代又一代的终末地干员都在为复兴文明环带而努力。也许有一天，帝江号会落回到地上，在我们亲手建设的乐土中小憩片刻吧。
dialogText.en: The Central Ring is always this busy. It is a symbol of our obligations to this world. For more than a century, generations of Endfielders have devoted themselves to reviving the Civilization Band. Perhaps a day will come when Dijiang can finally land, and take a well-deserved rest within the haven we've built.

dialogText.cn: 有很多干员并不会停留在帝江号，特别是精英干员们。比起逗留在天空之上的安全地带，危机四伏的文明环带更需要他们。没关系，你们迟早会见面的。到时候，我会好好向管理员介绍大家。
dialogText.en: Many operators wouldn't spend too much time aboard Dijiang, especially our elites. They are sorely needed by the Civilization Band where danger lurks, and not by this orbital refuge. No matter, you will meet them soon. I shall make the proper introductions when the time comes.

dialogText.cn: 曾经我们在帝江号上这样交谈的时候，我还是个只有现在一半高的孩子。如今物换星移，我长大了，帝江号也有许多变化，管理员你却……依旧如初。
dialogText.en: When I last had a conversation like this, I was a girl barely half my current height. Times have changed. Dijiang received plenty of modifications and I grew up... But you, Endministrator... You remain the same as before.

dialogText.cn: 帝江号比我以为的更加巨大，但我熟悉它的各个部分却只花了极短的时间。这大概要归功于建造者赋予它的，那近乎精巧的合理构造。这是一个远大理想的起点，我很期待，管理员。
dialogText.en: Dijiang is much larger than I expected, but I hardly spent any time familiarizing myself with its entire layout. That's thanks to the ingenious and impeccable designs by its creator. It's a great starting point for a great dream, Endmin, and I'm eager to see how that dream unfolds.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统确实远超我的想象。借由协议核心，泰拉文明的军工机器将拥有一颗无可匹敌的钢铁心脏，能够不断向这颗星球所有危险的角落输送血液。管理员，你们将会拯救无数人的性命，我可以向你保证。
dialogText.en: The Automated Industry Complex is far beyond what I imagined. With the Protocol Automation-Core, the suite of Terran military-industrial machines will finally have a potent heart, one that sustains stable deliveries of essential resources to every imperiled corner of the planet. Endmin, your work will save countless lives. On that I give you my sincere promise.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的武库工程师着实令人钦佩，竟然能在这样有限的时间内，完成所有人员的武器维护工作……这样的效率即使是在北方前线也称得上是数一数二。不过，他们的负责人为何如此年幼？
dialogText.en: The Arsenal Engineers of Endfield are truly impressive. They managed to complete weapon maintenance for every personnel despite the tight schedules... Such efficiency is rare, even on the Northern Front. Though I must admit, I didn't expect someone that young to be in charge of your Arsenal.

dialogText.cn: 我看过小道奇教官为你们拟定的训练方案，十分务实也足够循序渐进。我并没有改动的打算，只是会根据经验额外追加一两场小小试炼……但想必是难不倒你的，管理员。
dialogText.en: I've reviewed Instructor Lil' Dodge's training program for you. The content is practical and the difficulty curve is well-balanced. I don't intend to make any changes to it, though I added one or two extra minor trials based on my experience... But I trust that won't be a problem for you, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 在你醒来前，我已许久未直接参与过终末地的行动。对我而言，罗德岛、终末地、铁誓军，并无不同。我只是想保护那些值得保护的东西，而这一次，我可以义无反顾。
dialogText.en: Before you were awakened, I hadn't taken part directly in Endfield operations for years. To me, whether I serve at Rhodes Island, Endfield, or the Order of Steel Oath makes no difference. I only want to protect what I believe is worth protecting. And this time, I shall advance, and never retreat.

dialogText.cn: 眺望塔卫二总是能给我莫大的鼓舞，足以覆盖整颗卫星的异类被战士们以血肉之躯拦截在北方极光下的方寸之地中。这是铁誓军最伟大的军事成就之一，也是我们值得被委以文明延续之重任的铁证。
dialogText.en: Every time I look out over Talos-II, I feel a surge of inspiration. Massive swarms of abominations, capable of engulfing the entire planet, are forced into cauldrons in the auroral north. Mere soldiers of flesh and blood were the brick and mortar that held the enemy in check. This is one of the Oathkeeper's greatest military feats, an undeniable proof that we are worthy ... of the immense responsibility of preserving civilization.

dialogText.cn: 确定数据，运行语法，生成结果……管理员，您好。
dialogText.en: Validating data, analyzing syntax, generating results... Greetings, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 我收到来自您的信号了，管理员。我正在释读它的含义，请稍等。
dialogText.en: I have received your signal, Endministrator. I am in the process of interpreting its meaning. Please wait...

dialogText.cn: 啊……相比起人，我更愿意同机器相处……人的律动千变万化，机器的呼吸始终依照逻辑。
dialogText.en: Ah ... I find myself preferring the presence of machines over the company of humans. While human pulses are erratic and immeasurable, machines breathe in a consistent and logical pattern.

dialogText.cn: 我的终端在过去的十毫秒内接收到超过五十个报错，但是别担心，我已经将与您的交流列为最高优先级。嗯？我对……帝江号整体运行状况的评价吗？……虽然千疮百孔，但仍然在努力挣扎，仿佛……在替什么而受难。
dialogText.en: My terminal registered more than fifty errors within the past ten milliseconds. But set your mind at ease, for I have set our communication as top priority. Hmm? My evaluations for Dijiang's overall performance...? I would say, despite a myriad of issues, the vessel has continued to endure her tribulations with grace, as though she is ... suffering for someone else.

dialogText.cn: 如律法应允，如我等所行：乐园终将重回大地。凡筑路的，将在困苦的荒野中通达至福。因无尽的真知藏在谜团里面，叫迷途的，不再作客旅，乃是与圣徒同路，在基业中永生。
dialogText.en: As the Law permits, so we act: Paradise shall be restored unto this world. Whosoever paveth the path, shall cross the forlorn wildlands and attain bliss. For Veritas layeth hidden in enigmas, that the lost may no longer wander, but walk with the Noble Ones, sharing in an eternal purpose.

dialogText.cn: 其他干员眼中所见的您，是昔日的领袖，如今的善人，一株生长在未来的源石树苗。而我在源石网络中所见的，却与他们相悖……我只能，不住地为您祈祷……愿我们的能指与所指终能联结。管理员，愿您受庇佑。
dialogText.en: In the eyes of my fellow operators, you are a leader from the past, a noble being in the present, and an Originium sapling maturing toward the future. Yet within the depths of the Protorig Network, I beheld a different you... All I can do is pray — that our signifier and the signified may one day become one. May you walk in blessing, Endministrator.

dialogText.cn: 你的手下都挺厉害，但真切磋起来，我也没输过谁！呃，嗯，唯一有点儿没辙的就是……就是那些穿白大褂的医疗干员！他们说要给我治那什么矿石病，非拿针扎我屁股——呀啊啊过来了！黑面煞，让我躲一躲！
dialogText.en: Your crew's pretty tough, but I've never lost a real spar! Uh ... well ... the only ones I can't handle are ... those white-coated medics! They keep saying they'll treat my Oripathy and try to jab my butt with needles — Aah! They're coming! Darkmask, let me hide!

dialogText.cn: 你这帝江号上的能人太多了，要是能把其中几个收为己用……嘿嘿，黑面煞，我也不贪心，就把白面书生跟小青龙派给我！不行？那给我那个爱说话的，有三个脑袋的铁面公！别胡说，它才不怕我呢，我俩关系可好了！
dialogText.en: You've got too many talented folks on this Dijiang, if I could just have a few for myself... Heh, Darkmask, I'm not greedy, just give me Pale Scribe and Green Scales! No? How about that three-headed, super talkative Old Iron-Face! Come on, he's not scared of me. We're best friends!

dialogText.cn: 我觉得心烦时，去水边喊几声，浑身就舒坦了。像你这种每天都忙得要命，心里装着好多事儿的人，也该找个地方喊两声——那边的平台怎么样？或者那个大窗户？嘁，能有什么问题，一直憋着才是问题呢！
dialogText.en: Whenever I'm stressed, I just go yell by the water a few times, and it always makes me feel loads better. Someone as busy as you, with so much on their mind, should find a spot to shout too. How about that platform over there? Or that big window? Pfft, what do you mean this could cause problems? Holding it all in is the real problem!

dialogText.cn: 从帝江号的窗户能看到好多星星，跟我在祖泉边睡觉时，水里映着的那些星星一模一样。飞船也是船，银河也是河……这么一想，帝江号跟清波寨也没什么不同嘛，都是好地方！
dialogText.en: You can see so many stars from Dijiang's windows. Kinda reminds me of the old days, when I'd lie by the ancestral spring, watching the stars reflected in the water. A spaceship's also a ship, the galaxy's also a river... When you think about it, Dijiang and Qingbo Stockade aren't so different after all. Both are good places!

dialogText.cn: 这张赔偿单……可不是我的错！都怪那绿毛小巡卫，还我钱包也不直说，追了我一路，我还以为他要逮我。躲避的时候，咳咳，撞坏了几个箱子……我没心虚啊！嗐，这不是以前在武陵，躲巡卫躲习惯了。
dialogText.en: This damage bill ... wasn't my fault! Blame that green-haired patrol rookie — he could've just returned my wallet. Instead he chased me halfway across the base! I thought he was trying to arrest me! While dodging him, well ... I might've bumped into a few crates. Not like I'm guilty or anything! Just old habits from dodging watchguards back in Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，管理员，管理员——哼哼，我跟小青龙打赌，我要是能坚持叫你一天管理员，她就给我买一大堆好吃的！这次我赢定了，等着看她破财吧，黑面煞！哎？我没叫，你听错了，刚才不算！
dialogText.en: Endmin Endmin Endmin — Hmph! I bet Green Scales that if I could call you Endmin for a whole day, she'd buy me a ton of snacks! I'm so winning this time! Just wait until she coughs up the cash, Darkm — Ack! I didn't say it! You misheard! That one doesn't count!

dialogText.cn: 自从我告诉安塔尔我不喜欢他的那些数字游戏后……他就再也不向我推荐了。嗯……其他人也应该这么做的。
dialogText.en: After I told Antal that I didn't like his math games, he stopped sharing them with me. Hmm... Actually, people should follow my example.

dialogText.cn: 武库的工程师总是向我抱怨我的枪破损率太高……那也没办法……我能挥舞起这么重的家伙已经是不小的奇迹了。
dialogText.en: The Arsenal engineers keep grumbling about how fast I break my lances... Honestly, the fact that I can swing these excessively heavy weapons is already a miracle.

dialogText.cn: 安德烈先生……他的脑袋能做到一百八十度旋转吗？嗯……下次我会去问问他的。
dialogText.en: Mr. Andre...? Can he turn his head 180 degrees? Hmm... I should ask him about this next time.

dialogText.cn: 秋栗很喜欢长耳兽，所以我专门收集了许多长耳兽的料理食谱送给她……不知为何在那之后她整整一个星期没和我说话……真奇怪……
dialogText.en: Akekuri loves long-ears so I compiled plenty of long-ear recipes and gave them to her... Then she stopped talking to me for an entire week... That was so weird...

dialogText.cn: 我已经习惯孤军深入的战术行动了……虽然很麻烦，但总得有人去做这些事。毕竟……我比其他人更耐得住寂寞。
dialogText.en: I'm used to carrying out solo infiltration operations... It's a hassle but someone has to do it. Especially because ... I'm a better loner than the rest of the team.

dialogText.cn: 噪音和金属乐更能让我变得平静……停住那些声音很容易，但我喜欢嘈杂声中的些许迷失感，会有些……忘我？
dialogText.en: Loud metal music calms me down... Stopping such noises may be easy, but I enjoy the sense of aimlessness amidst the cacophony. It helps me ... forget who I am.

dialogText.cn: 和其他干员合作并不算简单。狼群的手段很难让普通人立刻接受，更别提我本就习惯独来独往。但如果是管理员您的要求……我会尝试做出一些改变。
dialogText.en: It's not easy working with the other operators. The Way of the Pack and my solitary nature aren't for everyone. But if you want me in line ... I'll adapt and make it work.

dialogText.cn: 相比帝江号，我还是更习惯在开拓区待着。这里太安逸了，容易让人丧失该有的警惕。但洛茜很喜欢这里，能够满足她的好奇心。
dialogText.en: I'm more at home in the frontier than aboard Dijiang. A comfortable place like this makes you soft. But Rossi loves this place. The ship satisfies her curiosity.

dialogText.cn: 老实说，我并没有研究裂地者其他氏族的兴趣。只是在荒地行走的日子久了，自然会牢记那些能够保命的常识。对于狼群而言，求生意志就是最好的老师，也是唯一的信仰。
dialogText.en: I'll be blunt with you. I was never interested in studying the other Landbreaker clans. I just spent enough time in the wildlands ... and survival skills simply became part of me. In the Pack, we believe the best teacher is our survival instinct. It is our *only* belief.

dialogText.cn: 终末地的干员来自塔卫二各个地方，其中有一些熟面孔……或者说，一些危险人物。我对你们的选择保持信任，但如有必要，各位应该相信我的直觉。
dialogText.en: Endfield operators come from all corners of Talos-II, and I see quite a few familiar faces... Or should I say ... familiar threats. I still have faith in your judgment, but when the situation calls for it, I hope you can have faith in my instincts.

dialogText.cn: 我在检查铳械，这是我的习惯。拿着弹尽的铳械，和赤裸裸地被丢在荒野中心没有区别。你手无寸铁，沦为猎物，一切技能和技巧都不再作数。那种感觉令人窒息……我在很小的时候体会过，所以，我会杜绝再次感受的可能。
dialogText.en: Gun checks are my ritual. In the wild, if your fangs fail, you're meat. Same goes for a dead weapon — all your skills, all your training, useless. No power, no defense — just slow death. I went through it as a young pup. That lesson stuck. I won't be prey again.

dialogText.cn: 我确实已经有一段时间没回到过氏族的据点，更有很长一段时间没有带领过氏族的行动。我更擅长为他们开辟一片新的猎场，而不是成为每一次狩猎的头狼。
dialogText.en: It's been a long while since I last visited my clan, or led them on a hunt. I'm better at finding new hunting grounds than leading raids as the Alpharion.

dialogText.cn: 终末地是怎么管理这么多干员的？什么……系统……什么……中控来着？搞不懂……不过很值得学习。
dialogText.en: How does Endfield manage so many operators? Something about ... systems? And some kind of ... central control? I can't figure it out ... but it's definitely worth learning.

dialogText.cn: 氏族的老狼让我多来帝江号上看看，他们说在这里能学习到作为领导者的知识和经验，尤其是在管理员身边。可是能抓到管理员的机会太少了！
dialogText.en: The elder wolves from the clan told me to visit Dijiang more often. They said I could learn about leadership here, especially by your side. But getting a chance to catch you is just so hard!

dialogText.cn: 帝江号上的哥哥姐姐们总把我当小孩子看待！可我已经是狼群的精锐了，下次要和他们说清楚才行，不能再这样了！！不过他们给的小点心都很好吃……
dialogText.en: The big brothers and sisters on Dijiang always treat me like a kid! But I'm already an elite of the Pack. Next time I'll make it clear to them, this has to stop! ...Though the snacks they give me are really good ...

dialogText.cn: 氏族事务优先！不过，如果终末地有什么突发情况，我肯定会第一时间赶到的。只是不知道管理员需不需要我的帮助……管理员那么优秀，哪怕没有我也能轻松解决危机的吧，但我还是想帮到管理员……怎么办呢……
dialogText.en: Clan affairs come first! But if anything urgent happens to Endfield, I'll definitely rush over right away. It's just ... I'm not sure if you really need my help... You're so capable, you could probably handle crises easily, even without me. But I still want to be helpful... What should I do...

dialogText.cn: 我听说在帝江号上能找到卡特洛，可他在这儿怎么也是神出鬼没？嗯……该说是本性难移吗？再找不到他，罗赞爷爷可就要生气了！我可不想见到他发火的样子……管理员，您知道在哪里能找到卡特洛吗？
dialogText.en: I heard Catello could be found on Dijiang, but why's he so elusive here too? Hmm ... guess old habits die hard? If I can't find him soon, Nonno Rozzan's gonna be furious. I really don't wanna see him angry... Endmin, do you know where I might find Catello?

dialogText.cn: 帝江号上为什么也查询不到管理员的相关记录呢？我好不容易才学会使用这个什么情报档案库……查到的净是些没用的信息，或者就是说我权限不够……呜……管理员，您有时间亲自跟我说说您的那些英勇事迹吗？
dialogText.en: Why can't I find any records about you on Dijiang, either? I finally learned how to use this so-called Intel Archive, but all I get are useless results or "No Authority" messages... Ugh... Endmin, do you have time to tell me about your heroic deeds yourself?

dialogText.cn: 啊啊……无论看几次都觉得，集成工业系统实——在是太完美了！在协议核心的指挥下，生产不再只是冰冷的重复，而像……一套生命系统！可以循环和呼吸！真是天才设计！管理员，能让我玩一下吗？
dialogText.en: *Sigh*... Every time I study the Automated Industry Complex, I can't help but feel that it's — pure perfection! PAC-directed production is no longer a cold, repetitive chore ... but a living, breathing system of intertwining process loops! Absolutely ingenious! Endmin, I've gotta try this. C'mon, pleaaase?

dialogText.cn: 管理员，虽然我很喜欢你的造型，但总穿这一身，我都要看腻了！有没有想过换一身更亮眼的衣服？我带你去买！保证搭配得更有型！
dialogText.en: I'll be honest with you, Endmin. I like your style, but don't you think it's time for a wardrobe refresh? Come on, let's get you something flashier and brighter! Your fashion upgrade will be the vogue. Gua-ran-teed!

dialogText.cn: 佩丽卡不让我带小暴鸰上舰，说太危险。但我又离不开它们，只能妥协喽，上舰前我把爆破模块都拆掉啦！
dialogText.en: Perlica won't let me bring my Tweety-Bombs along because she said they're safety hazards. But I just can't live without them! *Sigh*. In the end, I compromised and dismantled the demolition modules before boarding this ship.

dialogText.cn: 我打算过阵子去菈梵朵玛度个假，久违的沙滩和海风……管理员，要不要一起？还可以顺便去考察一下那里的海岸工程，听说采用了新研发的防侵蚀涂层。
dialogText.en: I'm planning a La Fantoma getaway. Kinda missed the beaches and ocean breeze... Wanna come with, Endmin? We can also check out their latest coastal engineering. I heard it's got a new layer of Blight-resistant coating they just recently developed.

dialogText.cn: 管理员，我还没有跟你合过影呢！一起来张自拍吧？我会把它放在“伊冯的年度时刻”集锦里。不要质疑我的拍照技术！如果拍得不好看……那就怪帝江号的灯光咯！
dialogText.en: I guess we haven't been in the same picture together, Endmin? How about a selfie? I'm going to add it to Yvonne's Annual Moments collection. And if it doesn't turn out cute, I'm blaming Dijiang's terrible lighting, not my skills!

dialogText.cn: 管理员，咱们喜欢的音乐还挺像的嘛！下次新唱片到了，可以来我的实验室，我们一起听。好音乐就是要和懂的人一起分享！
dialogText.en: It appears we have similar tastes in music, Endmin! That means you can swing by my lab and enjoy my latest vinyl once it arrives. After all, good music gets even better with good company!

dialogText.cn: 我确实是第一次来帝江号，不过……我的全息投影肯定来这里开过会。
dialogText.en: It's my first time on Dijiang, but ... my holographic projection has been here for meetings before.

dialogText.cn: 嗯……你说要的巨型龙泡泡雕像，我细细想了想，也不是送不上来。但摆在哪里，就该你好好想想了。
dialogText.en: I've given some thought to that giant Chubby Lung statue you asked for... Delivery is possible, but ... you might want to think carefully about where to place it.

dialogText.cn: 与终末地的……说顺嘴了，不好意思。与武陵的合作项目已经出结果了，实验报告已经上传，你这几天要是有时间，记得看一眼。
dialogText.en: Our cooperation plan with Endfield ... pardon me, with Wuling has concluded, and the experiment report has been uploaded. If you have time over the next few days, please be sure to take a look.

dialogText.cn: 我这次来帝江号不是为正事……因为武陵的梨树结果了，想顺路给大家送些来。
dialogText.en: I didn't come to Dijiang for work this time... The pear trees in Wuling have fruited, so I thought I'd bring some to share with everyone.

dialogText.cn: 小时候在宏山，最喜欢跟着老师去天文台，她数着天空中的星星，说其中一颗是帝江号，我看着，觉得可真是个遥远的地方。现在帝江号就在眼前，遥远的，反而是那段回忆了。
dialogText.en: When I was a child, I loved accompanying my master to the observatory. She would count the stars and point out one as Dijiang. I would watch it, thinking how far away it must be. Now, with Dijiang right before me, it is the memories that feel distant.

dialogText.cn: 都说是读书万卷，行路万里。我读过的书有很多，但去的地方确实不多，宏山、武陵，还有帝江号，算下来，也就三个。确实，我是很容易就留在一个地方，十年、二十年……说不好，一辈子也不是没可能。
dialogText.en: They say one should read widely and travel far. I've read a great deal, yet I've not visited many places. Hongshan, Wuling, and Dijiang make just three. This is hardly surprising, for I have a habit of lingering in one place for many years — ten, twenty ... or perhaps even a lifetime.

dialogText.cn: 马上就到！
dialogText.en: I'll be right there!

dialogText.cn: 状态已完全恢复，这就投入新一轮工作。
dialogText.en: Physiological indices have been fully restored. Initiating new work shift.

dialogText.cn: 把这件事情托付给我吗？谢谢前辈。
dialogText.en: You're giving this job to me? Thank you, Professor.

dialogText.cn: 好！从哪里开始做起呢？
dialogText.en: Great! Now, where should we start?

dialogText.cn: 拿出专业的精神来！
dialogText.en: Time for some professionalism!

dialogText.cn: 明白，我会继续执行任务。
dialogText.en: Understood. The mission shall continue.

dialogText.cn: 好好好，我这就去。
dialogText.en: Okay, fine. I'll be right there.

dialogText.cn: 有什么要我做的吗？直说就好啦！
dialogText.en: Got a job for me? Just spell it out!

dialogText.cn: 让我伸个懒腰，马上来。
dialogText.en: Be right there! Gotta stretch my back a bit!

dialogText.cn: 这就去，证明我除了钓鳞还能干点别的。
dialogText.en: I'll be off. Gotta prove to you that I'm good at other things besides angling.

dialogText.cn: 叫我？来了。
dialogText.en: You need me? I'm coming.

dialogText.cn: 收到啦！请期待我的表现！
dialogText.en: Roger that! I won't disappoint!

dialogText.cn: 只要是不让我无聊的事情就行。
dialogText.en: Just make sure it isn't some boring errand.

dialogText.cn: 明白，我……我能顺路去一趟食堂吗？
dialogText.en: Okay. Can I also ... head to the canteen for a bit as well?

dialogText.cn: 有活儿干了！
dialogText.en: Time to get back to work!

dialogText.cn: 好的，立刻前往目标地点。
dialogText.en: Roger. Heading to target location.

dialogText.cn: 嗯，我已经休息够了，继续工作吧。
dialogText.en: And I'm fully rested. Let the work continue.

dialogText.cn: 了解了，这类工作我并不陌生。
dialogText.en: Understood. I am no stranger to such assignments.

dialogText.cn: 好的，我将全速运转。
dialogText.en: Acknowledged. My performance shall be set to full clockspeed.

dialogText.cn: 又有活儿干啦？好吧，让你看看我的厉害！
dialogText.en: More work? Great. Gotta show you what I'm capable of!

dialogText.cn: 啊？不是才刚开始休息吗……
dialogText.en: Huh? I thought break time just got started...

dialogText.cn: 嗯，该干活了。
dialogText.en: Okay. Let's settle the business.

dialogText.cn: 我肯定不会让管理员失望的，请您好好期待我的表现！
dialogText.en: I won't let you down, Endmin. My results will surely astound you!

dialogText.cn: 刚好，我已经准备开工了。
dialogText.en: And I was just about to get started. Let's do it.

dialogText.cn: 我现在精神正好，很适合处理工作。
dialogText.en: I feel refreshed and ready to take on these tasks.

dialogText.cn: 培养舱尚未解锁，需要提升<@qu.key>总控中枢</>等级到<@qu.key>2级</>。
dialogText.en: Growth Chamber is still locked. Reach <@qu.key>Control Nexus</> Level <@qu.key>2</> first.

dialogText.cn: 制造舱II尚未解锁，需要提升<@qu.key>总控中枢</>等级到<@qu.key>3级</>。
dialogText.en: Manufacturing Cabin II is still locked. Reach <@qu.key>Control Nexus</> Level <@qu.key>3</> first.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>反应池</>在扩增<@gd.key>更多缓存区</>后可同时进行多个配方的生产。
dialogText.en: Expand the <@gd.key>cache</> of the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> to produce multiple formulas simultaneously.

dialogText.cn: 请帮助集成工业系统补齐生产线，使用一个反应池同时生产<@gd.key>锦草溶液</>和<@gd.key>芽针溶液</>。
dialogText.en: Complete the AIC Factory production line. Use 1 Reactor Crucible to produce <@gd.key>Jincao Solution</> and <@gd.key>Yazhen Solution</> simultaneously.

dialogText.cn: 集成核心区域外围增设了一批<@gd.key>作战设备</>。
dialogText.en: A batch of <@gd.key>combat facilities</> has been deployed along the perimeters of the Core AIC Area.

dialogText.cn: 这批作战设备尚未通电，需要使用<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>进行充能后，才可正常运行。
dialogText.en: These combat facilities are unpowered and must be charged with <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</> to work properly.

dialogText.cn: 请搭建低容谷地电池生产线，并为所有作战设备进行<@gd.key>充能</>。
dialogText.en: Set up an LC Valley Battery production line to <@gd.key>charge</> the combat facilities.

dialogText.cn: 随着蓝铁矿的开采和应用，集成工业系统可以实现<@gd.key>中容谷地电池</>的生产了。
dialogText.en: Ferrium Ore mining and processing will let your AIC Factory produce <@gd.key>SC Valley Batteries</>.

dialogText.cn: 请灵活使用已放置设备，搭建<@gd.key>中容谷地电池</>生产线。
dialogText.en: Use the existing facilities to set up an <@gd.key>SC Valley Battery</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 原料不够时，还可以使用长距滑索架前往野外自行采集。
dialogText.en: If you're low on raw materials, you can use Zipline Towers to gather them from the wilderness.

dialogText.cn: 有些设备年久失修，需要使用特定材料进行修复。
dialogText.en: Some old facilities have not been repaired for years. Use special materials to repair them.

dialogText.cn: 矿物区附近的山体出现了坍塌，有工人受困。
dialogText.en: There has been a landslide near the mining area. Several workers are trapped.

dialogText.cn: 这些阻塞道路的落石可通过<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>进行破坏。
dialogText.en: Use <@gd.key>Industrial Explosives</> to blast apart the rubble blocking the road.

dialogText.cn: 请先<@gd.key>采集酮化灌木</>，并使用集成工业系统<@gd.key>制造工业爆炸物</>，再返回矿物区进行救援。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Gather some Aketine</> first, use the plant at the AIC Factory to <@gd.key>produce Industrial Explosives</>, then return to the mining area to rescue the trapped workers.

dialogText.cn: 落石已被清理，受困人员已获救。
dialogText.en: Rubble cleared. The workers have been rescued.

dialogText.cn: 落石已被清理，受困动物已获救。
dialogText.en: Rubble cleared. The trapped animals have been rescued.

dialogText.cn: 矿物区突然出现大面积断电，需要进行紧急抢修。
dialogText.en: The mining area is experiencing power outage. Emergency repairs are required.

dialogText.cn: 已定位到故障原因——<@gd.key>中继器损坏</>。修复此设备即可恢复供电。
dialogText.en: We found the cause of the power outage—<@gd.key>the Relay Tower is down</>. Repair this facility to restore power.

dialogText.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>精炼炉</>和<@gd.key>粉碎机</>这两种设备，生产所需材料，并修复中继器。
dialogText.en: Use the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> to produce the materials needed to repair the Relay Tower.

dialogText.cn: 中继器修复完成，本次模拟目标已达成。
dialogText.en: Relay Tower repaired. Simulation goal completed.

dialogText.cn: 矿物区供电已恢复，所有设备运转正常。
dialogText.en: The mining area now has power. All facilities are working properly.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统需要对一批原料进行加工，请在现有布局上进行物流连线，连通各设备。
dialogText.en: The AIC must process some raw materials. Set up a logistics line connecting the existing facilities.

dialogText.cn: 原料已分别放入两个<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>中。请使用<@gd.key>传送带</>，将协议储存箱中的原料分别输送至精炼炉和粉碎机中进行加工。
dialogText.en: The raw materials are placed in 2 <@gd.key>Protocol Stashes</>. Use <@gd.key>transport belts</> to move raw materials from the 2 stashes to the Refining Unit and Shredding Unit for processing.

dialogText.cn: 再将精炼炉和粉碎机的产物通过传送带输送回仓库中进行储存。
dialogText.en: Then use transport belts to move Refining Unit and Shredding Unit products to the Depot for storage.

dialogText.cn: 这里是旧集成核心区域的遗址，重建工作十分复杂。
dialogText.en: This is the site of the old Core AIC Area. Rebuilding this will be quite a challenge.

dialogText.cn: 区域内只剩下了一些无法移动、只能生产指定配方的设备。
dialogText.en: The area only has a number of facilities with fixed locations and production formulas.

dialogText.cn: 请使用传送带完善物流连线，重建一条能够循环生产<@gd.key>砂叶</>的生产线。
dialogText.en: Use transport belts to complete the logistics and restore the self-sufficient <@gd.key>Sandleaf</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 砂叶生产线已搭建完成。接下来，还需生产<@gd.key>高容谷地电池</>。
dialogText.en: Sandleaf production line completed. You now need to produce <@gd.key>HC Valley Batteries</>.

dialogText.cn: 生产<@gd.key>高容谷地电池</>的各个设备已放置在此，请使用传送带搭建生产线。
dialogText.en: All the facilities for producing <@gd.key>HC Valley Batteries</> are here. Use the transport belt to set up a working production line.

dialogText.cn: 灵活放置额外的设备，将残缺的生产线补齐，还可达成附加奖励目标。
dialogText.en: Place additional facilities at strategic locations to complete the production line and complete bonus goal for more rewards.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统现已引入<@gd.key>仓库存取线</>，以支持更为高效灵活的物流运输。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory can now use the <@gd.key>Depot Bus</> to expand your logistics options.

dialogText.cn: 仓库存取线是一种特殊的设备，在解锁后会出现在集成核心区域内。在仓库存取线上放置<@gd.key>取货口</>与<@gd.key>存货口</>，能使物流传输更加灵活。
dialogText.en: The Depot Bus is a special facility. Once unlocked, it will appear in the Core AIC Area. Place <@gd.key>unloaders</> and <@gd.key>loaders</> along the Depot Bus for an incredibly flexible way to move products in and out of the AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 请参考荞花粉末生产线，使用仓库取货口与仓库存货口，搭建<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>生产线。
dialogText.en: Reference the Buckflower Powder production line, then use Depot Unloaders and Depot Loaders to set up an <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottle</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 此处遭到了破坏，集成工业系统受损严重。
dialogText.en: Something bad happened here. The AIC Factory has suffered serious damage.

dialogText.cn: 目前还有一些无法移动、只能生产指定配方的设备。
dialogText.en: We only have several facilities with fixed locations and production formulas.

dialogText.cn: 请判断各个设备的用途，使用仓库存取线与传送带重新搭建<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>生产线。
dialogText.en: Determine what the facilities are used for, then use the Depot Bus and transport belts to restore the <@gd.key>LC Valley Battery</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 低容谷地电池生产线已恢复运转。想要达成附加奖励目标，请前往此区域继续。
dialogText.en: The LC Valley Battery production line is working again. You can continue your work at this area to complete bonus goal for rewards.

dialogText.cn: 生产<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>的各个设备已放置在此。
dialogText.en: This place has various facilities for producing <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</>.

dialogText.cn: 请利用现有的设备资源，灵活使用<@gd.key>仓库存取线与传送带</>，搭建能够稳定产出荞愈胶囊的生产线。
dialogText.en: Reference the existing resources and facilities, then use the <@gd.key>Depot Bus and transport belts</> to set up a stable Buck Capsule [C] production line.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>长距滑索架</>出现故障，需要尽快修复。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Zipline Tower</> has been damaged and must be repaired quickly.

dialogText.cn: 修复此长距滑索架需要使用<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>。这种材料可通过<@gd.key>配件机</>进行制造。
dialogText.en: You need <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> to repair the Zipline Tower. The parts can be produced using the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</>.

dialogText.cn: 请先使用<@gd.key>精炼炉</>和<@gd.key>配件机</>将紫晶矿加工成紫晶零件。
dialogText.en: Use the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</> to process Amethyst Ore into Amethyst Parts.

dialogText.cn: 然后再使用紫晶零件<@gd.key>修复长距滑索架</>。
dialogText.en: Then use the Amethyst Parts to <@gd.key>repair the Zipline Tower</>.

dialogText.cn: 长距滑索架修复完成，本次模拟目标已达成。
dialogText.en: Zipline Tower repaired. Simulation goal completed.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>物品准入口</>可以设定传送带上允许通过的物品种类及其最大数量。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Item Control Ports</> can be set to allow the passage of a selected item and control the quantity that is allowed to pass through.

dialogText.cn: 若有非设定物品进入物品准入口，则传送带会被<@gd.key>堵住</>。
dialogText.en: If a non-selected item tries to enter the Item Control Port, it will be <@gd.key>blocked</>.

dialogText.cn: 请管理员调整<@gd.key>物品准入口</>的物品种类，使源矿顺利通过并输送至精炼炉中。
dialogText.en: Change the item type at the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</> so that Originium Ore is successfully transported to the Refining Unit.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统引入了<@gd.key>物流桥</>来实现更为灵活的物流运输。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory can now use the <@gd.key>Belt Bridge</> to expand your logistics options.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>物流桥</>可使两条传送带相交传输而互不影响。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Belt Bridge</> allows a transport belt to cross over another without interfering the product flows of both.

dialogText.cn: 请参考已搭建的生产线，使用<@gd.key>物流桥</>，将源矿从协议核心取货口输送至粉碎机。
dialogText.en: There is an existing production line. Use the <@gd.key>Belt Bridge</> to move Originium Ore from the PAC output port to the Shredding Unit.

dialogText.cn: 为了在输入口有限的情况下简化物流运输，集成工业系统引入了<@gd.key>汇流器</>。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Converger</> has been introduced to the AIC Factory to simplify logistics and provide a solution for the limited input ports we have.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>汇流器</>能够将最多三条传送带合并入一条传送带。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Converger</> can merge product flows from 3 belts into a single belt.

dialogText.cn: 请使用汇流器，将灌装机生产的荞愈胶囊与封装机生产的柑实罐头一同运输至仓库存货口。
dialogText.en: Use the Converger to move Buck Capsule [C] produced by the Filling Unit and Canned Citrome [C] produced by the Packaging Unit to the Depot Loader.

dialogText.cn: 武陵地区的集成工业系统增设了新的工业设备<@gd.key>拆解机</>，该设备可以将灌有液体的瓶子重新拆分为空瓶子与液体。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Separating Unit</> is a new facility added to the Wuling AIC Factory. It can separate fluid-filled bottles to yield empty bottles and the fluid.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统需要生产一批芽针针剂，但仓库中只存有瓶装的芽针溶液和已灌有锦草软饮的蓝铁瓶。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory must produce a batch of Yazhen Syringe [C], but the warehouse only has bottled Yazhen Solution and Ferrium Bottles filled with Jincao Drink.

dialogText.cn: 请完善生产线，使用<@gd.key>拆解机</>拆分出生产芽针针剂的所需材料，并生产<@gd.key>芽针针剂</>。
dialogText.en: Complete the production line by using the <@gd.key>Separating Unit</> to get the required materials for producing <@gd.key>Yazhen Syringe [C]</>.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统需要搭建药品和食品的自动化生产线。
dialogText.en: You must set up auto-production lines for food and medication in the AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 此处已经放置了搭建<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>生产线所需的设备，请使用<@gd.key>传送带</>进行物流连线使其可以正常运转。
dialogText.en: This place already has facilities for a <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</> production line. Use <@gd.key>transport belts</> to provide logistics needed to make the production line run properly.

dialogText.cn: 然后，再参考荞愈胶囊生产线，利用<@gd.key>灌装机</>建立一条<@gd.key>柑实罐头</>生产线。
dialogText.en: Then reference the Buck Capsule [C] production line and use the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> to set up a <@gd.key>Canned Citrome [C]</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统中已有一条完整的<@gd.key>柑实罐头</>生产线。
dialogText.en: This AIC Factory has a complete <@gd.key>Canned Citrome [C]</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 随着<@gd.key>蓝铁矿</>的开采和应用，集成工业系统需要在此基础上进行<@gd.key>优质柑实罐头</>的生产。
dialogText.en: Since we can now mine and process <@gd.key>Ferrium Ore</>, let the AIC Factory use the new material to produce the better quality <@gd.key>Canned Citrome [B]</>.

dialogText.cn: 请灵活利用已放置的设备，搭建<@gd.key>优质柑实罐头</>的自动化生产线。
dialogText.en: Use the existing facilities to set up an automatic <@gd.key>Canned Citrome [B]</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 原料不够时，还可以使用长距滑索架前往野外自行采集。
dialogText.en: If you're low on raw materials, you can use Zipline Towers to gather them from the wilderness.

dialogText.cn: 野外矿物资源丰富，使用合适的电驱矿机进行开采可为自动化生产提供极大帮助。
dialogText.en: There are plenty of mineral resources in the wilderness. Mine them with the Electric Mining Rig to support auto-production lines in your AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 经过<@gd.key>研磨机</>加工之后的粉末，可以用来制作更高级的<@gd.key>钢质瓶</>。
dialogText.en: Powders processed by the <@gd.key>Grinding Unit</> can be used to produce higher quality <@gd.key>Steel Bottles</>.

dialogText.cn: 这些钢质瓶可以在<@gd.key>灌装机</>中灌装品质更高的药剂。
dialogText.en: Steel Bottles can be used at the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> to produce better quality medicine.

dialogText.cn: 请灵活使用已放置的设备，搭建<@gd.key>精选荞愈胶囊</>的自动化生产线。
dialogText.en: Use the existing facilities to set up an automatic <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [A]</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 请先前往<@gd.key>灌装机</>处，查看精选荞愈胶囊的配方。
dialogText.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> to check the Buck Capsule [A] production formula.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>液体模式</>是武陵地区特有的工业技术，在设备上启用<@gd.key>液体模式</>后，可以将液体原料与其他材料一起输入到设备中进行生产。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Fluid Mode</> is a unique AIC technology exclusive to the Wuling region. When a facility is switched to <@gd.key>Fluid Mode</>, it can make products using fluids and other material inputs.

dialogText.cn: 场地中已经预设了所需的设备，请完成生产线的搭建，使用<@gd.key>反应池和灌装机</>生产<@gd.key>锦草软饮</>。
dialogText.en: This site has all the facilities needed for your goal. Complete the <@gd.key>Jincao Drink</> production line by using the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible and Filling Unit</>.

dialogText.cn: 粉碎机的生产出现了中断，请使用<@gd.key>传送带</>重新进行物流连接，恢复产线的运转。
dialogText.en: Work at the Shredding Unit has been interrupted. Use <@gd.key>transport belts</> to create logistics connections and get the production line working again.

dialogText.cn: 在区域1中，源石粉末生产线可正常运转。
dialogText.en: The Originium Powder production line is working properly in Area 1.

dialogText.cn: 请参考该生产线，使用传送带搭建<@gd.key>荞花粉末</>生产线，将产物运输至指定储存箱。
dialogText.en: Reference this production line and use transport belts to set up a <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</> production line and move the products to the specified Protocol Stash.

dialogText.cn: 此协议储存箱已通电，其内部存储的物品会通过<@gd.key>无线传输</>直接运往仓库。
dialogText.en: This Protocol Stash is connected to the power grid. The Stash can directly send its contents to the Depot via <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</>.

dialogText.cn: 荞花粉末生产线搭建目标已达成。接下来请前往区域2搭建<@gd.key>晶体外壳粉末</>生产线。
dialogText.en: Buckflower Powder production line completed. You can now head to Area 2 to set up the <@gd.key>Origocrust Powder</> production line.

dialogText.cn: 生产原料<@gd.key>源矿</>已存入此协议储存箱中。
dialogText.en: Production raw materials, <@gd.key>Originium Ore</>, are stored in this Protocol Stash.

dialogText.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>供电桩</>为精炼炉、粉碎机和指定协议储存箱供电。
dialogText.en: Use <@gd.key>Electric Pylons</> to supply power to the Refining Unit, Shredding Unit, and the specified Protocol Stash.

dialogText.cn: 请合理规划线路，搭建<@gd.key>晶体外壳粉末</>生产线，并将产物运输到目标储存箱中。
dialogText.en: Plan and deploy the logistics route to set up the <@gd.key>Origocrust Powder</> production line while moving the products to the target Protocol Stash.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统需要建立自动化的<@gd.key>荞花粉末</>生产线。
dialogText.en: You must set up an automatic <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</> production line in the AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 现有一条晶体外壳生产线可供参考，请使用<@gd.key>传送带</>完善物流连线，先将原料运输至粉碎机中进行加工。
dialogText.en: Reference the Origocrust production line. Use <@gd.key>transport belts</> to move raw materials to the Shredding Unit for processing.

dialogText.cn: 再将加工的产物运输回仓库，以实现荞花粉末的自动生产和储存。
dialogText.en: Move the products to the Depot to create an automatic Buckflower Powder production and storage line.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>精炼炉</>在液体模式下可以将赤铜矿加工为<@gd.key>赤铜块</>。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> can use Fluid Mode to process Cuprium Ore into <@gd.key>Cuprium</>.

dialogText.cn: 但同时也需要额外使用<@gd.key>清水</>作为原料。
dialogText.en: However, you must also use <@gd.key>Clean Water</> as a raw material.

dialogText.cn: 接下来就请使用<@gd.key>管道</>将清水输送到<@gd.key>精炼炉</>中吧。
dialogText.en: Next, please use <@gd.key>pipes</> to move Clean Water to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

dialogText.cn: 制造<@gd.key>更好的装备</>需要赫铜块，因此我们需要生产一些<@gd.key>赫铜溶液</>来制造赫铜块。
dialogText.en: Hetonite is required to assemble <@gd.key>better gear</>. We need to produce <@gd.key>Hetonite Solution</> before we can make Hetonite.

dialogText.cn: 场地中已经预先放置了一条赤铜溶液的生产线。
dialogText.en: A Cuprium Solution production line has been placed in this site.

dialogText.cn: 请完善生产线，使用<@gd.key>提纯机</>将<@gd.key>赤铜溶液</>加工为<@gd.key>赫铜溶液</>。
dialogText.en: Complete the production line with a <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> to purify <@gd.key>Cuprium Solution</> into <@gd.key>Hetonite Solution</>.

dialogText.cn: 矿物区引进了一批<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>，准备对<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>进行开采。
dialogText.en: New <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</> have been delivered to the mining area to mine <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</>.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>电驱矿机</>通电后，可自动开采矿物并将其通过无线传输运往仓库。请在电驱矿机附近放置供电桩，并从中继器运输电力至供电桩以为其供电。
dialogText.en: When powered, the <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> can start mining and deliver minerals to the Depot via belt-free transfer. Place the Electric Pylon near the Electric Mining Rig, then connect the Electric Pylon to the Relay Tower to power the mining area.

dialogText.cn: 将矿物区中原有的<@gd.key>便携源石矿机</>也更换为电驱矿机，还可以实现源矿的自动开采和运输。
dialogText.en: Replace all existing <@gd.key>Portable Originium Rigs</> with Electric Mining Rigs to achieve automatic mining and transfer of Originium Ore.

dialogText.cn: 矿物区发现了一种新型矿物——<@gd.key>蓝铁矿</>。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Ferrium Ore</> is a new mineral found in the mining areas.

dialogText.cn: 由于原有的电驱矿机无法对蓝铁矿进行开采，矿物区决定引入一种新设备。
dialogText.en: Since existing Electric Mining Rigs cannot mine Ferrium formations, the mining area has introduced a new facility.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>二型电驱矿机</>，现已实装。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig Mk II</> can now be deployed.

dialogText.cn: 与便携源石矿机、电驱矿机相比，二型电驱矿机在二者基础之上，增加了支持针对<@gd.key>蓝铁矿</>的开采技术。
dialogText.en: When compared to Portable Originium Rig and Electric Mining Rigs, the Electric Mining Rig Mk II is capable of mining <@gd.key>Ferrium Ore</>.

dialogText.cn: 请合理分配各种矿机，保证每种矿机都可以正常运作。
dialogText.en: Deploy the right mining rigs to make sure that all rigs are working properly.

dialogText.cn: 我们在武陵地区发现了一种新的矿物资源——
dialogText.en: We found a new type of mineral in Wuling.

dialogText.cn: 赤铜矿
dialogText.en: Cuprium Ore

dialogText.cn: 赤铜矿需要使用一种新型的矿机才能进行开采。
dialogText.en: Cuprium Ore must be mined with a new type of mining rig.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统现已引入<@gd.key>水驱矿机</>。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory now has the <@gd.key>Hydro Mining Rig</>.

dialogText.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>水驱矿机</>来开采这批<@gd.key>赤铜矿</>吧。
dialogText.en: Use the <@gd.key>Hydro Mining Rig</> to mine the <@gd.key>Cuprium Ore</> in this area.

dialogText.cn: 武陵地区的集成工业系统中增设了<@gd.key>反应池</>来进行液体的混合生产。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Reactor Crucibles</> have been added to Wuling AIC Factory to mix and produce various fluids.

dialogText.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>管道和水泵</>将清水引入到反应池中与锦草粉末进行混合。
dialogText.en: Use <@gd.key>pipes and Fluid Pumps</> to bring Clean Water to the Reactor Crucible and mix it with Jincao Powder.

dialogText.cn: 再使用管道将产出的<@gd.key>锦草溶液</>输送到<@gd.key>储液罐</>中进行存储。
dialogText.en: Use pipes to move the <@gd.key>Jincao Solution</> from the Reactor Crucible to the <@gd.key>Fluid Tank</> for storage.

dialogText.cn: 清水池里堆积了一些<@gd.key>小型垃圾</>，需要手动进行清理。
dialogText.en: There are <@gd.key>bits of trash</> at the bottom of the clean water pool. We must clean them out.

dialogText.cn: 但目前水池的<@gd.key>水位太深</>，无法直接进入。
dialogText.en: But the pool is now <@gd.key>too deep</> for the cleanup work.

dialogText.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>水泵</>和<@gd.key>给水器</>进行<@gd.key>液体的转移</>，将水抽走并排放到另一个水池中。
dialogText.en: Use a <@gd.key>Fluid Pump</> and <@gd.key>Fluid Supply Unit</> to pump out the fluid from the clean water pool and <@gd.key>move</> it to another pool.

dialogText.cn: 这边的水池里也有不少杂物，我们需要手动清理掉这些<@gd.key>矿物垃圾</>。
dialogText.en: There is plenty of <@gd.key>mining slag</> in this pool as well. We must remove them manually.

dialogText.cn: 漂浮的荷叶可以帮助我们在水面上行走，请利用这一点来清理杂物吧。
dialogText.en: The floating lotus leaves let us walk on the water. Use this to help us remove the waste.

dialogText.cn: 和花花草草在一起的时间总是过得很快，我再处理一会儿就来！
dialogText.en: Time passes by quickly when you spend time with plants. I'll be there once I'm done!

dialogText.cn: 我就说肚子怎么饿了，果然是到饭点了啊！那我先去吃饭喽！
dialogText.en: That explains why I'm so hungry. It's chow time! I can't wait to bite into something!

dialogText.cn: 大潘对你的找人效率表示高度认可。
dialogText.en: Da Pan approves of your efficiency in finding people.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>管道汇流器</>可以将多条管道中的液体汇聚到一条管道中。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Pipe Converger</> can merge fluid flows from several pipes into a single pipe.

dialogText.cn: 但需要注意，只有<@gd.key>同类液体</>才可以使用<@gd.key>管道汇流器</>进行汇聚。
dialogText.en: Remember, you can only merge <@gd.key>fluids of the same type</> with the <@gd.key>Pipe Converger</>.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>荞花</>库存不足，无法完成下一批荞愈胶囊的生产，需要对现有产线进行改进。
dialogText.en: This area is running out of <@gd.key>Buckflower</> for making the next batch of Buck Capsule [C]. You must improve upon the existing production line.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统现引进了两种新的设备——<@gd.key>采种机和种植机</>。
dialogText.en: The AIC has introduced 2 new facilities: <@gd.key>(1) Seed-Picking Unit</> and <@gd.key>(2) Planting Unit</>.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>采种机</>可以从植物中提取种子，<@gd.key>种植机</>可以培育种子并使其快速生长。将两者配合使用就可实现植物的循环生产了。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Seed-Picking Unit</> can extract seeds from plants while the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> can quickly grow the seeds into mature plants. Use these two facilities to create a self-contained plant production loop.

dialogText.cn: 请使用这两种设备改进原有生产线，完成<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>的生产。
dialogText.en: Use the 2 facilities to improve upon the existing production line to produce <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</>.

dialogText.cn: 武陵地区的<@gd.key>种植机</>新增了液体模式，可通过管道输入<@gd.key>清水</>来种植当地植物。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Planting Units</> in Wuling can be switched to Fluid Mode (FM) and grow local plants with <@gd.key>Clean Water</>.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统已经预设了生产<@gd.key>锦草软饮</>所需的设备，请使用<@gd.key>管道</>完善液体物流连线，将<@gd.key>种植机</>接入到整条生产线中。
dialogText.en: This AIC has all the facilities needed to make <@gd.key>Jincao Drink</>. Provide fluid logistics with <@gd.key>pipes</> and connect the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> into the production line.

dialogText.cn: 注意本次模拟中只有<@gd.key>一台水泵</>，请使用<@gd.key>管道分流器</>进行物流搭建，使水泵可同时为多个设备供水。
dialogText.en: There is only <@gd.key>1 Fluid Pump</> in this simulation. Use the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> to supply fluids for multiple facilities from a single Fluid Pump.

dialogText.cn: 扩建了低容谷地电池的自动化生产线后，当前<@gd.key>设备总耗电功率</>已超过了<@gd.key>电网的发电功率</>。
dialogText.en: Facilities of the expanded automatic LC Valley Battery production line is <@gd.key>consuming more power</> than the <@gd.key>power grid output</>.

dialogText.cn: 在<@gd.key>存储电能</>耗尽后，设备将因电力不足而停止工作。
dialogText.en: Once the <@gd.key>reserves run out</>, the facilities will shut down due to insufficient power.

dialogText.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>热能池</>提升发电功率，使低容谷地电池自动化生产线恢复运转。
dialogText.en: Use <@gd.key>Thermal Banks</> to raise power output and make the automatic LC Valley Battery production line work again.

dialogText.cn: 发电功率已满足需求，低容谷地电池自动化生产线已恢复运转。
dialogText.en: Your power output is now high enough. The automatic LC Valley Battery production line is working again.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统中已搭建了一条荞花粉末生产线。
dialogText.en: A Buckflower Powder production line has been deployed in the AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 请先使用<@gd.key>精炼炉</>和<@gd.key>塑形机</>将紫晶矿加工成紫晶质瓶。
dialogText.en: Use the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> to process Amethyst Ore into Amethyst Bottles.

dialogText.cn: 再通过<@gd.key>简易制作</>，将荞花粉末装入紫晶质瓶，制作所需的<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>。
dialogText.en: Use <@gd.key>Crafting</> to fill Amethyst Bottles with Buckflower Powder and produce <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</>.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统需要建立<@gd.key>优质锦草软饮</>的生产线。
dialogText.en: You must set up a <@gd.key>Jincao Tea</> production line in the AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 但一些设备尚未设定为<@gd.key>液体模式</>，请手动开启液体模式并完成生产线的搭建。
dialogText.en: Some facilities have not been switched to <@gd.key>Fluid Mode</>. Switch these facilities manually to set up the complete production line.

dialogText.cn: 随着生产线数量的增加，协议核心上的取货口可能会出现不足的情况。
dialogText.en: You'll eventually run out of PAC output ports to use as you add more production lines to your AIC Factory.

dialogText.cn: 为解决这一问题，集成工业系统现已引入<@gd.key>分流器</>，可将单一传送带分流出最多三条传送带。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Splitters</> are designed to solve this AIC Factory issue. This logistics unit can split product flow from 1 transport belt into 3 belts.

dialogText.cn: 使用分流器后，单个取货口就可以同时输送原料到多个设备中了。
dialogText.en: Using the Splitter lets you supply multiple facilities with raw materials from a single output port.

dialogText.cn: 请参考荞花粉末生产线，使用<@gd.key>分流器</>，将紫晶纤维从协议核心取货口输出后再分别运送至粉碎机、配件机和塑形机。
dialogText.en: Reference the Buckflower Powder production line, then use the <@gd.key>Splitter</> to supply the (1) Shredding Unit, (2) Fitting Unit, and (3) Moulding Unit with Amethyst Fibers from a single PAC output port.

dialogText.cn: 本次模拟的主要目标已达成，请前往协议核心另一侧继续。
dialogText.en: You completed the main goal of this simulation. Go to the other side of the PAC to work on the bonus goal.

dialogText.cn: 在设备生产效率低于传送带运输效率时，使用<@gd.key>分流器</>同时为多个设备进行供货，可进一步提升生产线的整体效率。
dialogText.en: When facility production rate is lower than the input material transport rate of the belt, you can use <@gd.key>Splitters</> to supply multiple facilities with a single belt to improve overall production efficiency.

dialogText.cn: 请利用分流器同时为所有<@gd.key>热能池</>输送原料，完成附加奖励目标。
dialogText.en: Use Splitters to supply raw materials to all <@gd.key>Thermal Banks</>. Complete this to earn bonus goal rewards.

dialogText.cn: 琼叶参田块需要进行<@gd.key>多次浇水</>才能完成生长。
dialogText.en: Redjade Ginseng plots must be <@gd.key>watered</> multiple times to grow the plant to maturity.

dialogText.cn: 为了节省人力，集成工业系统引入了可以自动浇水的设备——<@gd.key>洒水机</>。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory thus released a new facility—The <@gd.key>Sprinkler</>. This can be used to automate the watering of farmable plots.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>洒水机</>可以对其前方的多个田块进行自动浇灌。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Sprinklers</> can automatically water and irrigate multiple farm plots in front of it.

dialogText.cn: 请利用管道和洒水机来提供种植效率吧。
dialogText.en: Use the Sprinkler and pipes to make your farming more efficient.

dialogText.cn: 矿物区新开采了一批源矿并将其存放在了<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>中，现在需要将这批源矿送往仓库以供应生产。
dialogText.en: The mining area has excavated a new batch of Originium Ore and stored it in the <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</>. We must move the Ore to the Depot to supply our production lines.

dialogText.cn: 协议储存箱在通电后可进行<@gd.key>无线传输</>，将其内部存储的物品直接远程运往仓库。
dialogText.en: Connect the Protocol Stash to the power grid to activate its <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> function that moves Stash contents directly to the Depot.

dialogText.cn: 请先放置<@gd.key>供电桩</>，确保所有<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>均已通电。再使用<@gd.key>无线传输</>功能，将所有源矿输送至仓库。
dialogText.en: Your first step is to deploy <@gd.key>Electric Pylons</> to supply power to all <@gd.key>Protocol Stashes</>. Once connected to the power grid, the Stashes can use their <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> function and move their Originium Ore to the Depot.

dialogText.cn: 请注意，在集成核心区域之外，供电桩不会自动供电，需要从<@gd.key>中继器</>运输电力至供电桩。
dialogText.en: Remember, Electric Pylons outside the AIC Area are not powered and will not supply power on their own. You must connect them to a <@gd.key>Relay Tower</> first to add them to the power grid.

dialogText.cn: 源矿已全部传输至仓库，本次模拟目标已达成。
dialogText.en: You have moved all Originium Ore to the warehouse. Simulation goal completed.

dialogText.cn: 集成工业系统需要引入新设备来生产更多种类的材料。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory needs new facilities to produce new products and materials.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>研磨机</>，现已实装。
dialogText.en: The <@gd.key>Grinding Unit</> is now available.

dialogText.cn: 研磨机可以将<@gd.key>砂叶粉末</>与多种粉末合成为高密度材料。
dialogText.en: Grinding Units can use <@gd.key>Sandleaf Powder</> to process various powders into denser materials.

dialogText.cn: 经过<@gd.key>精炼炉</>加工后，高密度材料在<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中能够被加工为更高级的装备原件。
dialogText.en: These dense materials can be first processed at the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and then at the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> to produce high quality components.

dialogText.cn: 请参考密制晶体生产线，搭建<@gd.key>高晶纤维</>生产线，并接入装备原件机以生产<@gd.key>高晶装备原件</>。
dialogText.en: Refer to the Packed Origocrust production line to set up a <@gd.key>Cryston Fiber</> production line, then connect it to a Gearing Unit to produce <@gd.key>Cryston Components</>.

dialogText.cn: 为了给装备生产储备原料，集成工业系统引进了<@gd.key>装备原件机</>。
dialogText.en: The AIC Factory has introduced the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> to make gear assembly materials.

dialogText.cn: 请使用传送带完善物流运输，搭建<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>生产线。
dialogText.en: Use transport belts to complete the production line and set up an <@gd.key>Amethyst Component</> production line.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>天有洪炉</>是武陵地区独有的工业设备。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Forges of the Sky</> are facilities exclusive to the Wuling region.

dialogText.cn: 也是唯一能生产<@gd.key>息壤</>的工业设备。
dialogText.en: It is the only AIC Factory facility capable of producing <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.

dialogText.cn: 请修复已停滞的<@gd.key>息壤</>产线。
dialogText.en: Please repair the stalled <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>重息壤</>可以进行<@gd.key>装备生产</>与<@gd.key>据点提交</>，因此我们需要进行<@gd.key>重息壤</>的生产。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</> can be used for <@gd.key>gear assembly</> or <@gd.key>outpost trading</>. This is why we need to produce <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

dialogText.cn: <@gd.key>息壤</>与<@gd.key>清水</>反应后，可以生产获得<@gd.key>液化息壤</>。
dialogText.en: <@gd.key>Xiranite</> can react with <@gd.key>Clean Water</> to produce <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</>.

dialogText.cn: 在反应池输入<@gd.key>液化息壤</>和污水后，可以生产获得<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>与惰性壤晶废液。
dialogText.en: Input <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> and Sewage into a Reactor Crucible to produce <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> and Inert Xircon Effluent.

dialogText.cn: 最后在天有洪炉处输入<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>与<@gd.key>息壤</>，就可以生产出<@gd.key>重息壤</>。
dialogText.en: Finally, input <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> and <@gd.key>Xiranite</> into a Forge of the Sky to produce <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.
